recipes.name: Shrimp Pasta Salad
recipes.description: Chilled pasta tossed with sautéed shrimp, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and a lemon-Dijon dressing — a classic American lunch that's great the next day too.
steps: Cook pasta per package; drain, rinse cold.
Cook shrimp in 1 tbsp olive oil with garlic, salt — 2 min per side. Cool.
Dice tomatoes and cucumber. Chop parsley.
Dressing: remaining olive oil + lemon + Dijon + garlic + salt.
Toss pasta with shrimp, tomatoes, cucumber, spinach, parsley, dressing. Serve chilled.
cheapTips: Pasta is the cheapest base at ~$0.38 per serving
This salad keeps 3 days refrigerated — make a large batch for the week

substitutions.swap: Canned tuna or flaked salmon for a pantry version
Chickpea pasta for extra protein

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Salmon Grain Bowl
recipes.description: Simple baked salmon with a lemon-herb crust over quinoa and roasted vegetables — a clean, bright bowl that never gets old.
steps: Mix lemon juice, Dijon, garlic, olive oil, parsley. Spread over salmon fillets.
Roast salmon and broccoli/pepper at 400°F, 12–14 min.
Cook quinoa.
Stir spinach into warm quinoa.
Bowl: quinoa-spinach, baked salmon, roasted veg.
cheapTips: Baking salmon in the same oven as the vegetables saves time and energy
One lemon provides all the brightness this bowl needs for $0.70

substitutions.swap: Cod, tilapia, or any white fish
Asparagus or green beans

recipes.name: Spicy Tuna Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Sriracha-spiked canned tuna over rice with avocado, cucumber, and sesame — a pantry poke bowl that's ready in 5 minutes and hits every craving.
steps: Cook or microwave rice. Drain tuna.
Mix tuna with sriracha, mayo, soy sauce, sesame oil — taste and adjust heat.
Dice avocado, slice cucumber.
Bowl: rice, spicy tuna, avocado, cucumber, scallions, sesame seeds.
cheapTips: This is a 5-minute pantry meal that costs under $3 per serving
Spicy mayo is just mayonnaise + sriracha — no specialty ingredients needed

substitutions.swap: Greek yogurt for a lighter sauce
Cauliflower rice for a low-carb version

recipes.name: Shrimp Quinoa Power Bowl
recipes.description: Garlic-butter shrimp over protein-rich quinoa with roasted broccoli and a lemon-herb dressing — a clean bowl that tastes like it took an hour but doesn't.
steps: Cook quinoa (15 min). Roast broccoli at 425°F with 1 tsp olive oil, salt, 15 min.
Melt butter in a pan; add garlic and shrimp. Cook 2 min per side. Squeeze lemon over.
Stir spinach into warm quinoa.
Bowl: quinoa-spinach, roasted broccoli, garlic-butter shrimp, parsley.
cheapTips: Broccoli is one of the most nutrient-dense and affordable vegetables
Quinoa's protein combines with shrimp for an impressive amino acid profile

substitutions.swap: Olive oil for a dairy-free version
Asparagus or green beans

recipes.name: Salmon, Kale, and Lentil Bowl
recipes.description: Omega-3 rich salmon over iron-rich lentils and massaged kale with a lemon-Dijon dressing — a nutritionally complete bowl that checks every macro box.
steps: Simmer lentils with garlic, onion, cumin, and salt, 20–22 min until tender.
Massage kale with a drizzle of olive oil and pinch of salt for 2 min.
Pan-sear salmon in remaining olive oil, 4 min skin-down, flip 2–3 min.
Make lemon-Dijon dressing.
Bowl: lentils, massaged kale, flaked salmon, tomato. Drizzle dressing.
cheapTips: Lentils + salmon gives complete protein for under $5 per serving
Massaging kale breaks down the tough fibers — it becomes almost as tender as spinach

substitutions.swap: Canned lentils for a faster version
Canned salmon to cut cost significantly

recipes.name: Miso Glazed Salmon and Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Classic Japanese-inspired miso-glazed salmon over white rice with pickled cucumber and sesame spinach — a simple, beautiful bowl with deep savory flavor.
steps: Marinate salmon in soy sauce, mirin, honey, ginger for 10 min. Broil or bake at 400°F, 12–14 min.
Cook rice. Quick-pickle cucumber: slice thin, toss with vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Wilt spinach in sesame oil.
Bowl: rice, sesame spinach, miso salmon, pickled cucumber, scallions, sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Quick-pickled cucumber takes 5 min and adds a restaurant-quality brightness
The miso glaze is soy sauce + mirin + honey — all pantry staples

substitutions.swap: Rice vinegar + 1 tsp sugar
Tofu marinated in the same glaze for a vegan version

recipes.name: Chicken and Egg Power Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Sliced grilled chicken and two jammy eggs over brown rice with wilted spinach and a soy-sesame drizzle — the simplest, most reliable high-protein bowl in the book.
steps: Cook brown rice. Season chicken with garlic, salt, olive oil; cook 5–6 min per side. Slice.
Soft-boil eggs 7 min (or fry them if you prefer). Wilt spinach in the pan with garlic.
Drizzle: whisk soy sauce + sesame oil.
Bowl: rice, spinach, chicken, halved eggs, scallions, sesame seeds. Drizzle sauce.
cheapTips: Chicken + eggs is the most economical high-protein combo available
Brown rice in bulk costs ~$0.27 per cup

substitutions.swap: White rice cooks in half the time
Tofu for a vegan version

recipes.name: Ground Turkey Quinoa Power Bowl
recipes.description: Herbed ground turkey over quinoa with roasted bell pepper and a tangy tomato sauce — a filling, protein-rich bowl that works for lunch or dinner.
steps: Cook quinoa. Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil, 5 min.
Add garlic, Italian seasoning, ground turkey; cook 8 min until browned.
Stir in tomato sauce; simmer 5 min. Fold in spinach.
Bowl: quinoa, turkey-tomato mixture.
cheapTips: Ground turkey + tomato sauce gives you Italian-American flavor for under $3
Quinoa cooked in this tomato sauce makes incredible leftovers

substitutions.swap: Ground beef or lentils for a vegan version
Crushed tomatoes or marinara

recipes.name: Tuna and Lentil Power Bowl
recipes.description: Canned tuna over spiced lentils with roasted tomato and a lemon-parsley dressing — one of the cheapest high-protein bowls possible at under $2 per serving.
steps: Simmer lentils in 2.5 cups water with garlic, cumin, salt, 22 min.
Dice tomatoes. Drain tuna. Chop parsley.
Stir spinach into warm lentils. Season with lemon.
Bowl: lentils-spinach, drained tuna, tomato, drizzle of olive oil, parsley.
cheapTips: Lentils + canned tuna is arguably the best protein-per-dollar combination in the grocery store
A cup of dried lentils costs ~$0.85 and serves 2 people generously

substitutions.swap: Sardines or canned salmon
Canned chickpeas for a faster version

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese and Veggie Power Bowl
recipes.description: Creamy cottage cheese over quinoa with roasted vegetables and a herb vinaigrette — a surprisingly hearty, high-protein bowl that works warm or cold.
steps: Roast bell pepper and broccoli with olive oil, Italian seasoning, garlic at 425°F, 22 min.
Cook quinoa. Wilt spinach.
Bowl: quinoa-spinach base, warm roasted veg, a generous scoop of cold cottage cheese.
Drizzle with lemon juice, salt. The contrast of warm veg and cold cheese is the point.
cheapTips: Cottage cheese is one of the cheapest high-protein dairy products at ~$0.28 per gram of protein
The hot-cold contrast makes this feel more elegant than the ingredients suggest

substitutions.swap: Greek yogurt for a thinner, tangier protein topping
Brown rice

recipes.name: Double Protein Grain Bowl
recipes.description: Grilled chicken AND a full can of chickpeas over quinoa — this bowl was designed from the ground up to hit 50 g protein while keeping it clean and filling.
steps: Toss chickpeas with 1 tbsp olive oil, cumin, garlic, salt. Roast at 425°F, 20 min.
Cook quinoa. Cook chicken with remaining olive oil, 5–6 min per side. Slice.
Make simple lemon dressing.
Bowl: quinoa, spinach, chicken, crispy chickpeas, tomato, cucumber. Lemon drizzle.
cheapTips: Chicken + chickpeas together cost ~$2.50 per serving and provide 50 g protein
Crispy roasted chickpeas add texture that rice or plain legumes can't match

substitutions.swap: White beans for a creamier legume
Canned chicken for a no-cook shortcut

recipes.name: Chicken and Black Bean Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Smoky cumin-rubbed chicken over rice and black beans with corn, avocado, and a zesty lime crema — a burrito bowl that's faster to make at home.
steps: Season chicken with cumin, chili powder, garlic, salt. Cook in olive oil, 5–6 min per side. Slice.
Microwave corn 3 min. Warm black beans.
Make lime crema: Greek yogurt + lime juice + pinch of salt.
Bowl: rice, black beans, corn, chicken, diced avocado, lime crema, cilantro.
cheapTips: Black beans and rice together form a nutritionally complete cheap base
Making your own lime crema saves $3 vs buying chipotle crema

substitutions.swap: Sour cream for the traditional crema
Guacamole or extra salsa

recipes.name: Shrimp and Edamame Grain Bowl
recipes.description: Garlic shrimp and warm edamame over brown rice with a soy-lime dressing and sesame — a clean, protein-forward bowl that takes 20 minutes.
steps: Cook brown rice. Microwave edamame. Wilt spinach.
Sauté shrimp with garlic, ginger, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 2 min per side.
Make dressing: remaining soy sauce + lime juice + sesame oil.
Bowl: rice, spinach, edamame, shrimp, scallions, sesame seeds. Drizzle dressing.
cheapTips: Shrimp + edamame is one of the best protein pairings for cost and variety
Brown rice keeps you full much longer than white rice — worth the extra 15 min cook

substitutions.swap: Salmon cubes or canned tuna
White beans for pantry convenience

recipes.name: Salmon and White Bean Bowl
recipes.description: Pan-seared salmon and creamy white beans over spinach and brown rice with a Dijon-lemon dressing — Mediterranean simplicity at its best.
steps: Cook rice. Season salmon with salt and garlic. Sear in olive oil, 4 min per side.
Warm white beans with garlic, lemon, parsley in the same pan.
Wilt spinach. Make lemon-Dijon dressing.
Bowl: rice, spinach, white beans, flaked salmon, dressing.
cheapTips: White beans + salmon is an Italian classic — the bean creaminess acts like a sauce
Use canned salmon to cut costs in half while keeping all the omega-3s

substitutions.swap: Canned salmon or canned tuna
Cannellini beans or chickpeas

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Tender soy-ginger beef and crispy broccoli over rice — the Chinese-American classic made faster, healthier, and cheaper at home.
steps: Cook rice. Heat vegetable oil over high heat; stir-fry broccoli florets 4–5 min until charred at edges.
Add ground beef, garlic, ginger; break up and cook 6 min.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, honey into a sauce; pour over beef. Cook 2 min.
Bowl: rice, beef and broccoli, scallions, sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Ground beef makes a great weeknight beef and broccoli — much cheaper than sliced steak
The sauce is soy + sesame oil + honey — already in your pantry

substitutions.swap: Ground turkey or sliced chicken breast
Bok choy, green beans, or snap peas

recipes.name: Turkey-Stuffed Pepper Bowl
recipes.description: All the flavors of a stuffed pepper deconstructed into a bowl — Italian-seasoned ground turkey, rice, and tender bell pepper in a bright tomato sauce.
steps: Cook rice. Sauté onion and diced bell pepper in olive oil, 5 min.
Add garlic, Italian seasoning, paprika, turkey; cook 8 min until browned.
Stir in tomato sauce; simmer 5 min. Season.
Bowl: rice, turkey-pepper mixture, fresh parsley.
cheapTips: This is the stuffed pepper dinner with none of the stuffing work — all the flavor in half the time
Ground turkey costs the same as beef but has much less fat

substitutions.swap: Ground beef for traditional stuffed pepper flavor
Quinoa for extra protein

recipes.name: Chicken and Cherry Tomato Pasta
recipes.description: Sautéed chicken breast with burst tomatoes, garlic, and basil tossed through pasta — a 20-minute Italian-American dinner that tastes like it took all evening.
steps: Cook pasta per package; reserve ¼ cup pasta water.
Slice chicken into strips; season with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper. Cook in olive oil, 5–6 min.
Add garlic; cook 1 min. Add diced tomatoes; cook 5 min until burst and saucy.
Toss pasta with chicken-tomato sauce and a splash of pasta water if too thick.
Finish with fresh basil and Parmesan.
cheapTips: Pasta water is the secret sauce — the starch makes the dish saucy without added fat
Parmesan by the block costs half as much as pre-shredded

substitutions.swap: Ground turkey or shrimp

recipes.name: Ground Turkey Bolognese Pasta
recipes.description: Rich, slow-simmered turkey bolognese in 25 minutes — deeply savory from garlic, tomato paste, and Italian herbs, tossed with your choice of pasta.
steps: Finely dice onion and carrot. Sauté in olive oil over medium heat, 8 min.
Add garlic and turkey; cook 8 min until browned.
Stir in tomato paste; cook 2 min. Add crushed tomatoes and Italian seasoning; simmer 15 min.
Cook pasta. Toss with bolognese. Finish with Parmesan.
cheapTips: Carrot and onion add natural sweetness that mimics slow-cooked bolognese — a classic Italian hack
A can of crushed tomatoes + tomato paste makes a restaurant-quality sauce for $2.10

Marinara sauce for a faster shortcut

recipes.name: Shrimp Lemon Garlic Pasta
recipes.description: Plump shrimp in a bright lemon-garlic butter sauce tossed through pasta — an elegant dinner that takes 15 minutes and costs under $4 per serving.

Add lemon juice, parsley, spinach; toss until spinach wilts.
Toss pasta with shrimp and splash of pasta water. Finish with Parmesan.
cheapTips: Lemon + garlic + butter is the simplest great pasta sauce — no jarred product needed
Frozen shrimp is indistinguishable from fresh in this sauce

substitutions.swap: Extra olive oil for dairy-free
Nutritional yeast for vegan finish

recipes.name: Tuna Arrabbiata Pasta
recipes.description: Spicy tomato arrabbiata sauce with canned tuna — a fiery pantry pasta that's on the table in 15 minutes and delivers 38 g protein.

Add chili-garlic sauce and crushed tomatoes; simmer 8 min until slightly thickened.
Stir in drained tuna; cook 2 min.
Toss pasta with sauce. Top with parsley and Parmesan.

Canned tuna in spicy tomato sauce is a classic Neapolitan pasta

substitutions.swap: Red pepper flakes + extra garlic
Canned salmon or sardines

recipes.name: Chicken Pesto Pasta

Toss hot pasta with pesto, chicken, tomatoes, and a splash of pasta water.

recipes.name: Vegetable Marinara Pasta

Cook bacon until crispy; cook garlic in the drippings 30 sec.
Beat eggs + Parmesan + lots of black pepper into a smooth sauce.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Chicken Soup

recipes.name: Ground Turkey and Vegetable Minestrone

recipes.name: Potato and Caramelized Onion Soup

recipes.name: Chickpea and Tomato Stew

recipes.name: Beef and Vegetable Stew

recipes.name: Mushroom and Lentil Soup

recipes.name: Spiced Chickpea and Sweet Potato Soup

recipes.name: Kung Pao-Style Chicken

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Tofu Stir-Fry

recipes.name: Ground Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Ground beef and crispy broccoli in a classic oyster-soy-ginger sauce over rice — a Chinese-American weeknight dinner that's better than delivery.
steps: Cook rice. Stir-fry broccoli in vegetable oil over high heat, 4–5 min.
Add ground beef; break up and cook 6 min.
Add garlic, ginger; cook 1 min. Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil; stir-fry 2 min.
Serve over rice with scallions and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Oyster sauce costs ~$0.13/tbsp and is the backbone of Chinese-American stir-fries
Ground beef + broccoli beats sliced steak for budget and speed

substitutions.swap: Hoisin sauce or 2 tbsp soy + 1 tsp honey
Ground turkey for a leaner stir-fry

recipes.name: Japanese Curry Chicken Bowl
recipes.description: Mild, slightly sweet Japanese-style curry with chicken, potato, and carrot over rice — the most comforting bowl in the collection, and one of the simplest.
steps: Sauté onion in oil, 5 min. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder; cook 2 min.
Add chicken thighs (bone-in or boneless), diced potato, carrot, soy sauce, honey, and bouillon + 3 cups water.
Simmer 20–25 min until chicken is cooked and potatoes are tender.
Remove chicken; slice or shred. Return to pot.
Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Chicken thighs give richer curry flavor than breast meat and cost 20% less
Curry powder is the entire spice blend in one jar — perfect for weeknights

substitutions.swap: Chicken breast, tofu, or chickpeas
Sweet potato for extra sweetness

recipes.name: Dan Dan Noodle Bowl
recipes.description: Ground pork-style turkey noodles in a nutty, spicy sesame-chili sauce — a Sichuan street food classic simplified for the home kitchen.
steps: Cook soba noodles per package; drain.
Brown ground turkey in a dry pan, breaking up, 8 min.
Make dan dan sauce: peanut butter + soy sauce + sesame oil + chili-garlic + garlic + ginger + 4 tbsp hot water.
Blanch spinach in noodle water.
Bowl: noodles, spinach, meat sauce. Drizzle dan dan sauce. Scallions and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Peanut butter sauce costs pennies and is the entire flavor base
Soba noodles cost $4–5 for a bag that serves 4+ people

substitutions.swap: Ground pork (traditional) or tofu for vegan
Rice noodles or spaghetti

recipes.name: Chicken Yakisoba
recipes.description: Japanese stir-fried noodles with chicken, cabbage-style spinach, and a sweet soy sauce — a festival food classic that's weeknight-simple at home.
steps: Cook and drain soba noodles. Slice chicken into strips.
Stir-fry chicken in vegetable oil over high heat, 5 min.
Add onion, bell pepper, garlic; cook 3 min. Add spinach; cook 1 min.
Mix yakisoba sauce: soy sauce + mirin + Worcestershire + sesame oil.
Add noodles and sauce; stir-fry 2 min until glossy. Top with scallions.
cheapTips: Soba noodles are the authentic choice — their earthy flavor works beautifully in yakisoba
Worcestershire + soy is the classic shortcut for homemade yakisoba sauce

substitutions.swap: Rice noodles for gluten-free
Extra soy sauce with a splash of vinegar

recipes.name: Sesame Beef and Broccoli Bowl
recipes.description: Tender sliced beef (using ground beef) and crispy broccoli in a rich sesame-soy sauce — a restaurant-quality bowl at home in 20 minutes.
steps: Cook rice. Stir-fry broccoli in vegetable oil over high heat, 4–5 min until edges char.
Add ground beef; cook 6 min. Add garlic, ginger.
Mix sauce: soy + sesame oil + honey. Pour over; cook 2 min.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds and scallions.
cheapTips: A sesame-soy-honey sauce is the perfect no-fuss weeknight sauce — pantry staples, restaurant result
Charring broccoli in a very hot pan gives the wok-breath effect at home

substitutions.swap: Sliced steak or ground turkey
Bok choy, snap peas, or green beans

recipes.name: Miso-Style Ramen Bowl
recipes.description: A rich, umami-forward ramen broth made from soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and sesame — with ramen noodles, soft-boiled egg, spinach, and scallions.
steps: Make broth: simmer 4 cups water with bouillon, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, 8 min.
Soft-boil eggs 7 min; cool in ice water; halve.
Cook ramen noodles in broth for 3 min. Add spinach; cook 1 min.
Ladle into bowls. Add eggs, drizzle sesame oil and sriracha, top with scallions and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Ramen packs cost $0.55 each — discard the flavor packet and make your own broth
Soft-boiled eggs transform ramen from a snack into a real protein-rich meal

substitutions.swap: Soba noodles for a more complex flavor
Tofu for a vegan ramen

recipes.name: Oyakodon Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl
recipes.description: The beloved Japanese parent-and-child rice bowl — tender simmered chicken and silky eggs in a sweet soy-dashi broth over rice. Comfort food at its purest.
steps: Cook rice. Slice chicken thighs into pieces. Thinly slice onion.
Simmer soy sauce, mirin, honey, bouillon, and 1 cup water in a wide pan.
Add chicken and onion; simmer 8 min until chicken is cooked.
Beat eggs lightly. Pour over chicken; cover and cook 60–90 sec until eggs are just barely set (custardy).
Slide over rice bowls. Top with scallions and a drop of sesame oil.
cheapTips: Oyakodon is one of Japan's great cheap comfort foods — two servings for under $4
Chicken thighs stay tender in the braise while breast can dry out

substitutions.swap: 1 tbsp sugar + 1 tbsp water
Chicken breast (cook 2 min less to prevent drying)

recipes.name: Chinese Braised Tofu Bowl
recipes.description: Tofu simmered in a savory soy-ginger-garlic braising sauce with mushrooms and spinach — a plant-based Chinese dish that's deeply satisfying.
steps: Cook rice. Slice mushrooms. Cube tofu (no pressing required for braising).
Heat oil; brown tofu 3 min per side. Remove.
Sauté mushrooms 5 min. Add garlic, ginger; cook 1 min.
Add soy sauces, sesame oil, and ½ cup water; bring to a simmer.
Return tofu; braise 5 min until sauce reduces. Add spinach.
Serve over rice with scallions and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Dark soy sauce adds mahogany color for $0.17/tbsp — your tofu will look gorgeous
Braised tofu absorbs sauce into its interior — much more flavorful than stir-fried

substitutions.swap: Extra regular soy sauce — color will be lighter
Eggplant for an equally absorptive braising vegetable

recipes.name: Lightened Chicken Korma
recipes.description: Aromatic chicken in a mild, creamy yogurt-almond sauce with warming spices — all the comfort of korma without the heavy cream.
steps: Blend almonds with ½ cup water into a thin almond milk sauce.
Sauté onion in ghee until golden, 8 min. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, cumin, cinnamon; cook 2 min.
Add chicken pieces; sear 5 min. Pour in almond sauce and ½ cup water.
Simmer 15 min until chicken is cooked. Off heat, stir in Greek yogurt.
Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Greek yogurt + almond milk is a convincing cream substitute for a fraction of the fat
Ghee is concentrated butter — a little goes a long way for authentic flavor

substitutions.swap: Butter or coconut oil
Cashews (traditional) or omit for nut-free

recipes.name: Keema Matar — Ground Beef with Peas
recipes.description: Fragrant ground beef with frozen peas in a spiced tomato gravy — one of India's most popular everyday dishes, ready in 20 minutes and served over rice.
steps: Cook rice. Sauté onion in oil, 6 min until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, cumin, paprika; cook 2 min.
Add ground beef; cook 8 min until browned. Add diced tomatoes; cook 5 min.
Stir in frozen veg (peas); cook 3 min.
Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Keema matar is one of the most budget-friendly Indian dishes — ground beef + pantry spices + frozen peas
The spices here cost under $0.20 per batch but transform everything

substitutions.swap: Ground turkey or ground lamb (more traditional)
Canned peas or fresh peas

recipes.name: Tofu Tikka Bowl
recipes.description: Tofu marinated in tikka spices and baked until charred at the edges — a vegan Indian bowl that channels the smoky depth of the tandoor.
steps: Cut tofu into cubes. Marinate in 1 tbsp olive oil, paprika, curry powder, cumin, garlic, ginger, lemon, 10 min.
Bake marinated tofu at 425°F, 20 min until edges are charred.
Make tikka sauce: sauté onion 6 min; add garlic, ginger, spices; cook 2 min; add tomato sauce.
Stir baked tofu into sauce; simmer 5 min. Add spinach.
Serve over rice with cilantro.
cheapTips: Tofu takes marinade beautifully — marinate for even 10 minutes for a dramatic flavor boost
Paprika + curry powder creates a convincing tikka color and flavor without special ingredients

substitutions.swap: Cottage cheese cubes for a paneer-like experience
Crushed tomatoes or 3 diced fresh tomatoes

recipes.name: Lightened Dal Makhani
recipes.description: Creamy black bean and lentil dal in a tomato-butter-spice sauce — the restaurant classic made lighter with Greek yogurt instead of cream, and faster with canned beans.
steps: Cook lentils 20 min. Sauté onion in butter, 8 min until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, curry powder, paprika; cook 2 min.
Add black beans, cooked lentils, and tomato sauce; simmer 10 min.
Off heat, stir in Greek yogurt for creaminess. Season with salt.
Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Black beans + lentils together replicate the traditional black lentil dal for a fraction of the cost
Greek yogurt creates the same creamy finish as heavy cream at much lower fat

substitutions.swap: Coconut milk for dairy-free version
Kidney beans for a slightly different dal

recipes.name: Quick Chicken Biryani Bowl
recipes.description: Saffron-inspired golden rice with spiced chicken, caramelized onions, and fresh herbs — all the biryani drama in 35 minutes on the stovetop.
steps: Caramelize onions in oil, 15 min until dark golden. Remove half; set aside for topping.
Add garlic, ginger, and all spices to remaining onion; cook 2 min.
Add chicken pieces; cook 8 min. Add rice and 3 cups water. Season.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and cook 15 min.
Rest 5 min. Fluff rice. Top with reserved caramelized onions, mint, and cilantro.
cheapTips: Caramelized onions are the most important part of biryani — don't rush them
Rice cooked directly in the spiced chicken broth absorbs all the flavor

substitutions.swap: Chicken breast (add less water as it cooks faster)
1 tsp dried mint added with the spices

recipes.name: Aloo Palak — Potato and Spinach Curry
recipes.description: Tender potato cubes and wilted spinach in a ginger-garlic-spice gravy — a North Indian home-cooking staple that's deeply satisfying and vegan.
steps: Cube potatoes; boil or microwave until just tender, 8–10 min. Drain.
Sauté onion in oil, 6 min. Add garlic, ginger, cumin, curry powder, paprika; cook 2 min.
Add diced tomatoes; cook 5 min. Add potatoes and ½ cup water.
Fold in spinach; cook until wilted. Season with salt.
Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Potatoes + spinach are two of the cheapest vegetables — this dish costs under $1.50 per serving
Aloo palak is traditionally eaten with roti but works great over rice for budget cooking

substitutions.swap: Sweet potato for a sweeter, more nutritious version
Kale (add 5 min earlier)

recipes.name: Goan-Style Fish Curry Bowl
recipes.description: Tender fish fillets in a fragrant coconut-tomato curry sauce — a simplified Goan classic that captures the warmth of coastal Indian cooking.
steps: Cook rice. Sauté onion in oil, 5 min. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, paprika; cook 2 min.
Add diced tomatoes; cook 4 min. Pour in coconut milk; simmer 5 min.
Lay salmon fillets in sauce; cover and cook 8 min until flaky.
Stir in spinach. Season with salt. Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Canned salmon works perfectly here — flake it in at the sauce stage
Coconut milk adds richness without dairy for ~$2.20 a can

substitutions.swap: Canned salmon, tilapia, or any firm white fish
Canned tomatoes for a tomato-based curry

recipes.name: Chole — Chickpea Curry Bowl
recipes.description: Hearty Punjabi-style chickpea curry in a tomato-onion-spice gravy — one of India's most beloved vegan dishes, and one of the most filling.
steps: Sauté onion in oil until dark golden, 10 min — this makes the gravy rich and sweet.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, curry powder, paprika, cinnamon; cook 2 min.
Add crushed tomatoes; cook 5 min. Add chickpeas and ½ cup water.
Simmer 10 min until thick. Squeeze lemon; top with cilantro.
Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Chole from two cans of chickpeas costs ~$2.20 for protein — the most affordable Indian curry
Darkening the onion deeply (10 min) is the entire secret to restaurant-quality chole

substitutions.swap: 3 fresh tomatoes diced and cooked down
Pita bread or naan (store-bought) for a more traditional pairing

recipes.name: Rajasthani Spiced Lentil Bowl
recipes.description: Smoky, deeply spiced yellow lentil dal with a tempering of cumin and garlic — a bowl of pure comfort from the royal kitchens of Rajasthan.
steps: Cook lentils in 3 cups water with turmeric/curry powder until very soft, 20–22 min.
Heat ghee in a small pan; add cumin seeds and garlic; sizzle 30 sec. Add onion; cook 6 min.
Add tomatoes and ginger; cook 5 min. Stir this tempering into cooked lentils.
Add paprika and spinach. Simmer 3 min. Season with salt and lemon.
Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Lentils are the cheapest high-protein food available — a full pot for 3 people costs under $1 in lentils
The tadka (tempering) is what elevates simple lentils to restaurant quality — always bloom spices in fat

substitutions.swap: Butter or coconut oil for a similar effect
Split peas (longer cook time) or canned lentils (5 min shortcut)

recipes.name: South Indian Coconut Vegetable Curry
recipes.description: Tender vegetables in a fragrant coconut milk curry with mustard seeds and curry leaves (or cumin) — a Kerala-inspired dish that's vegan and deeply nourishing.
steps: Cube sweet potato; microwave or boil 8 min until just tender.
Sauté onion in oil, 5 min. Add garlic, ginger, cumin, curry powder; cook 2 min.
Add coconut milk, sweet potato, and chickpeas; simmer 10 min.
Stir in spinach. Season with salt and lemon.
Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Sweet potato + chickpeas + coconut milk costs under $5 for 3 servings
South Indian coconut curries have the most complex flavor from the simplest pantry ingredients

substitutions.swap: Butternut squash or potato
Greek yogurt for a dairy-based version (add off heat)

recipes.name: Chicken Enchilada Bowl
recipes.description: All the flavors of chicken enchiladas deconstructed into a bowl — seasoned chicken, rice, black beans, cheese, and a smoky tomato-chili sauce in 25 minutes.
steps: Season chicken with chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic, salt. Cook in olive oil, 5–6 min per side. Slice.
Warm black beans in the pan. Add tomato sauce and stir — this is the enchilada sauce.
Cook rice.
Bowl: rice, enchilada-sauce black beans, sliced chicken, shredded cheese, cilantro, lime squeeze.
cheapTips: This is enchiladas without the tortillas — costs 30% less and takes half the time
Tomato sauce + chili powder = quick enchilada sauce for under $1

substitutions.swap: Feta or skip for dairy-free
Refried beans for a creamier sauce

recipes.name: Shrimp Taco Bowl
recipes.description: Chili-lime shrimp over rice with black beans, corn, avocado, and a cilantro-lime crema — a fresh Mexican bowl that's ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Cook rice. Toss shrimp with chili powder, garlic, lime zest, olive oil. Cook in hot pan 2 min per side.
Microwave corn 3 min. Warm black beans.
Make crema: Greek yogurt + lime + cilantro + salt.
Bowl: rice, beans, corn, shrimp, diced avocado, crema, cilantro.
cheapTips: Frozen shrimp + canned black beans = affordable taco bowl under $4 per serving

substitutions.swap: Ground turkey or chicken breast for cheaper protein
Guacamole from a tube for convenience

recipes.name: Ground Turkey Taco Bowl
recipes.description: Smoky taco-spiced ground turkey over rice and beans with all the fixings — faster than Chipotle and half the price.
steps: Cook rice. Brown turkey with chili powder, cumin, garlic in olive oil, 8 min.
Warm beans and corn. Dice tomato.
Bowl: rice, turkey, beans, corn, tomato, lime, cilantro.
cheapTips: Ground turkey taco bowl costs under $3 per serving — the best budget Chipotle substitute
Taco seasoning from individual spices costs a fraction of the packet

substitutions.swap: Ground beef for richer flavor
Salsa for extra flavor without cooking

recipes.name: Chicken Fajita Skillet
recipes.description: Sizzling chicken breast and bell peppers in a smoky fajita seasoning over rice — the Tex-Mex classic in bowl form, no tortillas required.
steps: Slice chicken into strips. Season with cumin, chili, paprika, garlic, salt.
Cook chicken in olive oil over high heat, 5–6 min. Remove.
Cook sliced peppers and onion in same pan, 5 min until caramelized.
Return chicken; toss together. Squeeze lime.
Serve over rice with cilantro.
cheapTips: Bell peppers and onion caramelize best in a very hot pan without stirring too often
Fajita seasoning is just pantry spices you already have

substitutions.swap: Chicken thighs for juicier fajita strips
Poblano peppers for mild heat

recipes.name: Mexican Ground Beef Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Cumin-chili spiced ground beef over tomato rice with black beans and all the toppings — a weeknight Tex-Mex staple in 20 minutes.
steps: Cook rice with tomato sauce and water instead of plain water — gives it color and flavor.
Brown beef with onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin, 8 min.
Warm black beans.
Bowl: tomato rice, spiced beef, black beans, lime, cilantro.
cheapTips: Cooking rice in diluted tomato sauce is a Mexican technique that adds flavor for free
Ground beef + canned beans covers protein for under $3

substitutions.swap: Ground turkey for leaner version
Salsa for a different tomato flavor

recipes.name: Taco Soup
recipes.description: All the flavors of a taco in a spiced broth — ground turkey, beans, corn, and tomatoes with taco seasoning. Hearty, fast, and endlessly customizable.
steps: Brown turkey with onion and garlic in olive oil, 8 min.
Add crushed tomatoes, black beans, corn, bouillon + 3 cups water, chili powder, cumin.
Simmer 12 min. Squeeze lime; top with cilantro.
cheapTips: Taco soup is one of the most budget-friendly high-protein soups — under $1.50 per bowl
A big batch freezes perfectly for up to 3 months

substitutions.swap: Ground beef or canned chicken for a no-cook shortcut
Kidney beans or pinto beans

recipes.name: Peruvian-Style Quinoa Chicken Bowl
recipes.description: Cumin-herb marinated chicken over quinoa with aji-inspired green sauce, avocado, and tomato — a South American bowl with excellent macros.
steps: Marinate chicken in cumin, paprika, garlic, olive oil, lime, 10 min. Cook 5–6 min per side.
Cook quinoa. Make aji-style green sauce: blend cilantro + garlic + lime + sriracha + 1 tbsp olive oil + salt.
Bowl: quinoa, spinach, sliced chicken, avocado, tomato. Drizzle green sauce.
cheapTips: The green sauce is just blended cilantro and lime — free flavor from the bunch you bought
Quinoa + chicken together hit 50 g protein from just two ingredients

substitutions.swap: Jalapeño or no heat for a milder sauce
Cucumber for crunch without fat

recipes.name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Soup
recipes.description: Smoky, warming black bean and sweet potato soup with cumin and lime — a vegan Mexican-inspired bowl that's thick, filling, and under $2 per serving.
steps: Sauté onion in oil 5 min. Add garlic, cumin, chili powder; cook 1 min.
Add diced sweet potato, black beans, bouillon + 4 cups water.
Simmer 18 min until sweet potato is tender. Partially blend for creamy-chunky texture.
Squeeze lime. Top with cilantro.
cheapTips: Two cans of black beans + two sweet potatoes cost ~$3.60 total for 3 generous servings
Partially blending makes this feel rich and creamy without any dairy

substitutions.swap: Butternut squash or regular potato
Vegetable bouillon for fully vegan

recipes.name: Venezuelan-Style Chicken Asado Bowl
recipes.description: Oven-roasted chicken with garlic, onion, cumin, and sour orange served over white rice with black beans — a simplified asado criollo.
steps: Blend onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, lime juice, orange juice, and oil into a marinade. Coat chicken thighs.
Roast at 425°F, 22–25 min until caramelized and cooked through.
Cook rice. Warm black beans.
Bowl: rice, black beans, sliced chicken, cilantro.
cheapTips: Orange juice marinade is free if you squeeze an orange — it tenderizes the meat beautifully
Chicken thighs roasted at high heat get caramelized edges that taste like they came from a wood-fired grill

substitutions.swap: A splash of apple juice + extra lime
Chicken breast (reduce roasting time by 5 min)

recipes.name: Colombian-Style Red Beans and Chicken
recipes.description: Hearty kidney beans simmered with chicken, cumin, and tomato in a Colombian bandeja paya-inspired bowl — a complete meal for under $3.
steps: Cook rice. Sauté onion in oil 5 min. Add garlic, cumin, diced tomato; cook 5 min.
Add chicken pieces, kidney beans, and bouillon + 2 cups water.
Simmer 15 min until chicken is cooked. Shred or slice chicken.
Top with cilantro.
cheapTips: Two cans of kidney beans + chicken for 3 people costs under $4
Colombia's national dish uses whatever beans and protein are affordable — this is authentically budget-friendly

substitutions.swap: Black beans or pinto beans
Ground turkey browned first

recipes.name: Korean Spicy Chicken Stew
recipes.description: Tender chicken thighs braised in a gochujang-soy sauce with potatoes and carrots — a one-pot Korean comfort dish ready in 35 minutes.
steps: Cut chicken into pieces. Sauté garlic and ginger 1 min.
Add gochujang, soy sauce, ½ cup water. Add chicken, potatoes, carrots. Bring to boil.
Simmer covered 25 min until chicken is tender and potatoes are cooked through.
Finish with sesame oil and green onion. Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Chicken thighs are 40% cheaper than breasts and stay juicy in stews
Gochujang keeps 6 months — the flavor base for many Korean dishes

substitutions.swap: Chicken breast or tofu
Chili garlic sauce + 1 tsp miso

recipes.name: Korean Beef Bulgogi
recipes.description: Thinly sliced beef marinated in soy, pear, and sesame — caramelized in 10 minutes and served over rice with kimchi.
steps: Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, brown sugar into marinade.
Cook ground beef in marinade on high heat until caramelized — about 8 min.
Wilt spinach in the pan. Serve over rice with sesame seeds and green onion.
cheapTips: Ground beef bulgogi cooks faster and costs 60% less than sliced sirloin
The marinade doubles as a sauce — don't waste any

substitutions.swap: Ground turkey or chopped mushrooms
Bean sprouts or cabbage

recipes.name: Korean Spicy Pork Bowl
recipes.description: Pork shoulder marinated in gochujang, garlic, and sesame — stir-fried until caramelized and served with rice and pickled cucumber.
steps: Slice pork thin. Marinate in gochujang, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, sesame oil — 5 min.
Stir-fry pork on high heat 10–12 min until caramelized.
Quick-pickle cucumber: toss with rice vinegar and pinch of salt, 5 min.
Serve pork over rice with pickled cucumber and green onion.
cheapTips: Pork shoulder is one of the cheapest meats — under $3/lb
The quick pickle takes 5 min and adds a bright contrast to the spicy pork

substitutions.swap: Chicken thighs or tofu
Sambal oelek + 1 tsp miso

recipes.name: Korean Silken Tofu Stew
recipes.description: Soft silken tofu simmered in a spicy anchovy-gochugaru broth with mushrooms and egg — a warming 20-minute Korean staple.
steps: Sauté garlic in sesame oil 1 min. Add gochugaru — toast 30 sec.
Add broth, soy sauce, and mushrooms. Boil 5 min.
Gently slide in tofu in large spoonfuls. Simmer 5 min — don't stir.
Crack an egg directly into the stew. Cover 1 min. Garnish with green onion. Serve with rice.
cheapTips: Silken tofu is one of the cheapest protein sources — $1.50 for 450 g
The raw egg poaches in the stew — no need for a separate pot

substitutions.swap: Button mushrooms or enoki
½ tsp chili flakes + ½ tsp paprika

recipes.name: Korean Chicken Bibimbap
recipes.description: The classic Korean rice bowl — seasoned ground chicken, five sautéed vegetables, a runny egg, and gochujang sauce, all mixed together at the table.
steps: Cook each vegetable separately in sesame oil with a pinch of soy sauce — 2 min each.
Cook seasoned ground chicken until browned.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Bowl: rice base, arrange chicken and each veg in sections, top with egg. Add gochujang, mix before eating.
cheapTips: Bibimbap is the best fridge-cleanout meal — use any veggies you have
Ground chicken is 30% cheaper than thighs for the same protein

substitutions.swap: Canned tuna or ground beef
Button mushrooms

recipes.name: Gochujang Glazed Salmon
recipes.description: Salmon fillets coated in a gochujang-honey glaze, broiled until caramelized, served with steamed rice and bok choy.
steps: Mix gochujang, honey, soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil into glaze.
Coat salmon. Broil on parchment-lined sheet 12–14 min.
Steam bok choy: boil 3 min, drain, toss with sesame oil.
Serve salmon over rice with bok choy. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.
cheapTips: Salmon on sale freezes perfectly — buy in bulk when under $8/lb
Gochujang glaze works on any firm fish, shrimp, or chicken thighs

substitutions.swap: Tilapia, cod, or chicken breast
Spinach or broccoli

recipes.name: Korean Doenjang Soup with Tofu
recipes.description: A soothing Korean fermented soybean paste soup with tofu, zucchini, and mushrooms — made in 15 minutes and rich in umami.
steps: Heat broth. Dissolve doenjang paste into broth — start with 2 tbsp, taste and adjust.
Add cubed tofu, sliced zucchini, mushrooms, and garlic. Simmer 8 min.
Top with green onion. Serve with rice.
cheapTips: Doenjang is very cheap per serving — a tub lasts months and adds depth to any broth
Never boil vigorously after adding doenjang — gentle simmer preserves the probiotics

substitutions.swap: Miso paste (same fermented flavor)
Any mushrooms or skip

recipes.name: Korean Glass Noodle Stir-Fry (Japchae-Style)
recipes.description: Chewy sweet potato glass noodles stir-fried with beef, spinach, mushrooms, and carrots in a light soy-sesame sauce.
steps: Soak glass noodles in warm water 15 min. Drain, cut in half.
Cook beef. Add garlic, mushrooms, carrot — stir-fry 3 min.
Add noodles, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar. Toss and stir-fry 3 min.
Add spinach, toss until wilted. Finish with sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Glass noodles are gluten-free and very cheap — a bag makes 4 servings for $2
Japchae is a Korean celebration dish that's actually easy to make for weeknights

substitutions.swap: Ground turkey, tofu, or shrimp
Rice noodles or zucchini noodles

recipes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
recipes.description: Leftover rice stir-fried with kimchi, pork belly (or bacon), and gochujang — topped with a crispy fried egg. Under 20 minutes.
steps: Cook bacon bits in the pan. Remove, leave fat.
Add kimchi, stir-fry 3 min. Add rice, soy sauce, gochujang — stir-fry on high 4 min.
Add bacon back. Finish with sesame oil.
Fry eggs in the same pan. Place on top of rice. Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Kimchi fried rice is the original use-what-you-have meal
Leftover cold rice fries better than freshly cooked

substitutions.swap: Spam (traditional), turkey, or skip for vegetarian
Sauerkraut with extra gochugaru

recipes.name: Korean Galbi-Style Beef Bowl
recipes.description: Ground beef marinated galbi-style in soy, sesame, pear juice, and garlic — a budget version of the iconic Korean short rib flavor served over steamed rice.
steps: Mix soy, sesame oil, garlic, brown sugar, apple juice, ginger into marinade.
Add ground beef to pan with marinade. Cook on medium-high, breaking up, 8 min until caramelized.
Add carrot, stir-fry 2 more min.
Serve over rice. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.
cheapTips: Apple juice mimics the pear juice in traditional galbi at a fraction of the cost
Ground beef gives you the galbi flavor for $4 instead of $20+ for actual short ribs

substitutions.swap: Ground pork or turkey
1 tbsp brown sugar + 1 tbsp rice vinegar

recipes.name: Vietnamese Lemongrass Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken thighs marinated in lemongrass, fish sauce, garlic, and turmeric — pan-seared until golden and served with jasmine rice and pickled daikon.
steps: Pound lemongrass to bruise. Mix with fish sauce, garlic, turmeric, sugar into marinade.
Marinate chicken 5+ min. Pan-sear 6 min per side until golden and cooked through.
Quick-pickle carrot: toss with rice vinegar and pinch of salt, 5 min.
Serve chicken over rice with pickled carrot and cilantro.
cheapTips: Lemongrass stalks are cheap and freeze well — buy a bunch and freeze the rest
Fish sauce is the backbone of Vietnamese cooking — one bottle lasts months

substitutions.swap: 1 tsp lemon zest + 1 tsp lemon juice per stalk
Soy sauce (not identical but works)

recipes.name: Vietnamese Caramelized Shrimp (Tôm Kho)
recipes.description: Shrimp simmered in a sticky caramel-fish sauce glaze with chilies and garlic — a 15-minute Vietnamese comfort dish served over steamed rice.
steps: Caramelize sugar in pan 2 min until amber. Add garlic and chili, stir 30 sec.
Add shrimp, fish sauce, 2 tbsp water. Toss to coat.
Simmer 5–6 min until shrimp are cooked and sauce is sticky.
Garnish with green onion and black pepper. Serve over rice.
cheapTips: Frozen shrimp thaws in 10 min — perfect for weeknight dinners
This dish uses a minimal pantry but tastes like a Vietnamese restaurant

substitutions.swap: Pork belly cubes (traditional) or tofu
Soy sauce + few drops of Worcestershire

recipes.name: Vietnamese Chicken Congee
recipes.description: Silky rice porridge simmered with chicken, ginger, and fish sauce — garnished with crispy shallots and fresh herbs. Healing, cheap, and ready in 30 minutes.
steps: Simmer rice in broth with whole chicken breast, ginger, and garlic — 25 min.
Remove chicken, shred. Return to pot. Season with fish sauce and white pepper.
Serve topped with green onion, cilantro, and a drizzle of sesame oil.
cheapTips: Congee stretches one chicken breast into two filling servings
The long simmer concentrates flavor — no need for expensive stock

substitutions.swap: Soy sauce
Bone-in chicken for more flavor

recipes.name: Filipino Chicken Adobo
recipes.description: The quintessential Filipino dish — chicken braised in soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, and bay leaves until deeply savory and tender. Meal-preps beautifully.
steps: Combine soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, sugar, and pepper in pot.
Add chicken. Bring to boil, then simmer covered 25 min.
Uncover, raise heat, reduce sauce until glossy — about 10 min. Turn chicken to coat.
Serve over rice with pan sauce. Garnish with green onion.
cheapTips: Chicken adobo actually tastes better the next day — make extra
The 4-ingredient sauce is the most budget-friendly way to make deeply flavored chicken

substitutions.swap: Apple cider vinegar or rice vinegar
Pork shoulder or tofu

recipes.name: Filipino Garlic Fried Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Cold leftover rice fried in abundant garlic until crispy, topped with tocino-style chicken (sweet soy marinade), a fried egg, and pickled vegetables.
steps: Tocino chicken: mix soy sauce and sugar, marinate diced chicken 5 min. Cook until caramelized.
Fry garlic in oil 2 min until golden. Add rice, stir-fry on high 5 min until crispy.
Quick-pickle carrot with rice vinegar.
Plate: garlic rice, tocino chicken, fried egg, pickled carrot.
cheapTips: Sinangag is the Filipino answer to leftover rice — it's better cold rice
Tocino can be made with any meat — pork, chicken, even spam

substitutions.swap: Ground pork or Spam (traditional)
Cucumber or mango pickles

recipes.name: Filipino Sinigang
recipes.description: A sour tamarind broth with pork, eggplant, okra, and leafy greens — the defining Filipino soup, ready in 35 minutes.
steps: Simmer pork with onion and tomato in broth 20 min.
Dissolve tamarind paste in the broth. Add eggplant, cook 8 min.
Add spinach, cook 2 min. Season with fish sauce.
Serve with rice.
cheapTips: Tamarind paste is cheap, shelf-stable, and gives sinigang its unique sour complexity
Sinigang works with shrimp, fish, or chicken — use whatever protein is cheapest

substitutions.swap: 2 tbsp lime juice + 1 tsp tomato paste
Shrimp, salmon, or chicken

recipes.name: Filipino Arroz Caldo
recipes.description: Ginger-scented chicken rice porridge topped with crispy garlic, green onion, and a fried egg — the Filipino version of congee for sick days or cold mornings.
steps: Sauté garlic and ginger 2 min. Add chicken, fish sauce — cook 5 min.
Add rice and broth (3:1 ratio). Simmer 25 min, stirring occasionally.
Shred chicken. Fry remaining garlic until golden and crispy.
Top bowls with crispy garlic, fried egg, green onion, and lime.
cheapTips: Arroz caldo stretches two thighs into 2 generous bowls with broth and rice
The crispy garlic on top is what makes it special — don't skip it

substitutions.swap: Chicken breast or any leftover cooked chicken
Soy sauce

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapao)
recipes.description: Ground chicken stir-fried with Thai holy basil, oyster sauce, and chilies — one of Thailand's most popular street foods, ready in 12 minutes.
steps: Stir-fry garlic and chilies in oil 1 min on high heat.
Add ground chicken, break up, cook 5 min until no pink remains.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce. Toss 2 min.
Off heat, stir in basil leaves until just wilted.
Fry eggs sunny-side up. Serve chicken over rice with fried egg on top.
cheapTips: Ground chicken is the cheapest protein that works in this dish
Regular Italian basil is a fine substitute for Thai basil in a pinch

substitutions.swap: Regular basil + a few mint leaves
Ground pork (traditional) or ground turkey

recipes.name: Thai Peanut Chicken Satay Bowl
recipes.description: Skewered chicken thighs marinated in coconut milk and turmeric, grilled or pan-seared, served over rice with a homemade peanut dipping sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken in coconut milk, turmeric, cumin — 5 min.
Pan-sear or grill 6 min per side until charred.
Peanut sauce: mix peanut butter, soy sauce, lime, honey, garlic, 2 tbsp water.
Serve chicken over rice with cucumber slices and peanut sauce.
cheapTips: Peanut butter sauce takes 2 min to make and is far better than jarred satay sauce
Canned coconut milk marinade is the secret to juicy chicken

substitutions.swap: Beef strips, shrimp, or tofu
Almond butter or tahini

recipes.name: Filipino Chicken Tinola
recipes.description: A clear ginger-garlic broth with chicken, chayote, and moringa leaves — a nourishing Filipino soup that tastes complex despite its simplicity.
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and ginger 3 min until fragrant.
Add chicken, fish sauce, and broth. Boil then simmer 20 min.
Add chayote, cook 8 min. Add spinach, cook 2 min. Season with pepper.
Serve with rice.
cheapTips: Chayote squash is very cheap in Asian or Latin grocery stores — much cheaper than zucchini
Tinola proves that the simplest broths can be the most satisfying

substitutions.swap: Zucchini, green papaya, or choko
Malunggay/moringa leaves (traditional) or bok choy

recipes.name: French Niçoise-Style Tuna Bowl
recipes.description: Canned tuna, hard-boiled eggs, green beans, potatoes, and olives in a Dijon vinaigrette — a proper Niçoise without the faff, ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Boil potatoes and green beans together 10–12 min. Drain and cool.
Hard-boil eggs 9 min. Cool and halve.
Dressing: whisk Dijon, red wine vinegar, olive oil, garlic, salt.
Toss potatoes and green beans in dressing. Arrange with tuna, eggs, olives, and capers.
cheapTips: Canned tuna in water is one of the cheapest protein sources — $1–1.50 per can
Niçoise is designed for pantry staples — everything lasts weeks

substitutions.swap: Canned salmon or sardines
Chopped pickles or skip

recipes.name: Italian Panzanella with Tuna
recipes.description: Stale bread chunks soaked in tomato juices and olive oil with canned tuna, cucumber, red onion, and basil — Tuscany's most satisfying summer salad.
steps: Tear bread into chunks. Toss with olive oil and let sit 5 min.
Cut tomatoes over the bread — let the juices soak in.
Add cucumber, red onion, tuna, capers, and basil.
Dressing: olive oil, vinegar, crushed garlic, salt. Toss and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Panzanella was invented specifically to use stale bread — the older the bread, the better it soaks
Canned tuna makes this a protein salad instead of a side dish

substitutions.swap: Hard-boiled eggs or sardines
Pickled jalapeños or skip

recipes.name: Spanish Potato Omelette (Tortilla Española)
recipes.description: Thick egg and potato omelette cooked in olive oil — the definitive Spanish tapa, served at room temperature with green salad.
steps: Slice potatoes and onion thin. Cook in olive oil on medium 15 min until soft but not browned. Drain.
Beat eggs with salt. Mix in potato and onion.
Pour into oiled 8-inch pan. Cook on medium 5 min until set on bottom.
Flip using a plate. Return to pan. Cook 2 min. Serve with salad.
cheapTips: A tortilla uses 5 eggs and 2 potatoes to feed 2 — one of the cheapest satisfying lunches possible
Tortilla improves if made ahead and served at room temperature

substitutions.swap: Sweet potato or zucchini
Shallot or skip

recipes.name: German Lentil and Sausage Salad
recipes.description: Warm green lentils tossed with turkey sausage, pickles, red onion, and a tangy mustard-vinegar dressing — a German Linsen salad for lunch.
steps: Cook lentils in broth 20–22 min until tender. Drain.
Slice and pan-fry turkey sausage 4 min. Slice pickles and red onion.
Dressing: whisk mustard, vinegar, olive oil, salt.
Toss warm lentils with sausage, pickles, onion, and dressing. Top with parsley.
cheapTips: Green lentils are one of the cheapest high-protein ingredients — $1.50/lb
This German classic proves that simple pantry ingredients make the best food

substitutions.swap: Kielbasa, chicken sausage, or canned tuna
Capers or cornichons

recipes.name: British Chicken and Leek Soup
recipes.description: A classic British soup of shredded chicken, sliced leeks, and creamy potato in a light chicken broth — simple, filling, and ready in 30 minutes.
steps: Slice leeks and carrot. Sauté in pot with garlic and thyme 3 min.
Add broth, diced potato, and whole chicken breast. Simmer 20 min.
Remove chicken, shred, return. Stir in cream. Season with salt.
Serve topped with parsley.
cheapTips: Leeks are cheap in autumn/winter and give a sweet onion flavor
A splash of cream is all it takes to transform a simple broth into a creamy soup

substitutions.swap: Greek yogurt or evaporated milk
Onion and extra garlic

recipes.name: Italian Farro and Roasted Vegetable Bowl
recipes.description: Nutty farro grain tossed with roasted zucchini, cherry tomatoes, and white beans in a lemon-basil dressing — an Italian grain bowl that's protein-packed and filling.
steps: Cook farro in broth 25–30 min. Drain.
Roast zucchini and tomatoes at 425°F with olive oil and garlic — 20 min.
Toss warm farro with roasted veg, white beans, lemon zest and juice, and basil.
cheapTips: Farro is more filling than rice per serving and keeps well for meal prep
White beans and farro together create a complete protein without any meat

substitutions.swap: Barley, spelt, or quinoa
Chickpeas or lentils

recipes.name: French Green Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A French country lentil soup with Puy lentils, smoked ham, carrots, and herbes de Provence — humble ingredients, extraordinary depth of flavor.
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, and garlic 5 min. Add lentils, broth, ham, thyme, and bay leaf.
Simmer 30 min until lentils are tender.
Remove bay leaf. Stir in vinegar and mustard — this is the French finishing touch.
cheapTips: Lentil soup is the most economical high-protein meal you can make — $3 for 2 generous servings
The mustard-vinegar finish transforms the flavor completely — don't skip it

substitutions.swap: Smoked turkey or skip for vegan
Brown or black lentils

recipes.name: Scandinavian Open-Face Salmon Sandwich
recipes.description: Rye bread topped with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers, red onion, and dill — a Nordic smørrebrød that looks impressive but takes 5 minutes.
steps: Spread cream cheese on rye bread.
Layer smoked salmon, sliced cucumber, red onion, capers, and dill.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.
cheapTips: Smoked salmon goes on sale regularly — buy it then and store in the fridge
This is a genuine 5-minute meal that feels like a restaurant lunch

substitutions.swap: Any dark bread or whole-grain crispbread
Greek yogurt mixed with lemon

recipes.name: Greek Spanakopita-Style Omelette
recipes.description: All the flavors of spanakopita in a 10-minute omelette — spinach, feta, dill, and scallions folded into eggs with a crispy edge.
steps: Wilt spinach in olive oil with garlic 2 min. Season.
Beat eggs with dill, green onion, and pepper. Pour over spinach.
Cook on medium-low until mostly set — 4 min. Crumble feta on half.
Fold omelette and slide onto plate. Eat with pita or on its own.
cheapTips: Spinach and feta is one of the most satisfying vegetarian protein combinations
A bag of frozen spinach costs $2 and works perfectly here — just thaw and squeeze dry

substitutions.swap: Goat cheese or ricotta
Dried dill (use half the amount)

recipes.name: Belgian Endive Salad with Ham and Walnut
recipes.description: Bitter chicory endive with diced ham, walnuts, gruyère, and a warm Dijon-cream dressing — a classic Belgian bistro salad.
steps: Slice endive into thin strips or separate into leaves.
Warm cream with mustard, vinegar, and garlic in small pan — do not boil.
Toss endive with ham, walnuts, and gruyère. Drizzle warm dressing.
Garnish with parsley.
cheapTips: Endive keeps a week in the fridge — buy ahead
Belgian bistro salads are simple by design — the quality of ingredients matters more than technique

substitutions.swap: Radicchio or any bitter green
Swiss or aged cheddar

recipes.name: Lebanese Chicken Shawarma Bowl
recipes.description: Chicken thighs marinated in shawarma spices — cumin, turmeric, allspice, and cinnamon — roasted and served over rice with garlic sauce, tomato, and pickled turnip.
steps: Mix cumin, turmeric, allspice, cinnamon, 3 garlic cloves, olive oil, lemon into marinade.
Coat chicken. Roast at 425°F 22–25 min until charred at edges.
Garlic sauce: mix yogurt, 1 crushed garlic, lemon, salt.
Serve chicken over rice with diced tomato, parsley, and garlic sauce.
cheapTips: The spice blend makes the dish — and you probably have all these spices already
Chicken thighs are far more forgiving in the oven than breasts

substitutions.swap: Mixed spice or extra cinnamon
Hummus for a dairy-free sauce

recipes.name: Persian Herb Frittata (Kuku Sabzi)
recipes.description: A fragrant Persian egg cake packed with dill, parsley, cilantro, fenugreek, and walnuts — crispy outside, soft inside, served with yogurt and flatbread.
steps: Finely chop all herbs and green onion. Mix into beaten eggs with walnuts and salt.
Heat olive oil in oven-safe skillet. Pour in egg mixture.
Cook on medium 5 min until bottom is set. Transfer to 350°F oven 12–15 min.
Serve with Greek yogurt and scattered barberries (or pomegranate seeds).
cheapTips: The cheapest Persian recipe — herbs, eggs, and nuts. Feeds 2 for under $4
This is the traditional Nowruz (Persian New Year) dish — made for celebration but easy enough for Tuesday

substitutions.swap: Pomegranate seeds or dried cranberries
Skip or add a pinch of curry powder

recipes.name: Turkish Menemen
recipes.description: Scrambled eggs cooked directly in a spiced tomato-pepper sauce — Turkey's beloved breakfast-for-dinner that's ready in 15 minutes.
steps: Sauté onion and peppers in olive oil 5 min until soft.
Add tomatoes and spices. Cook 4 min until sauce thickens.
Beat eggs and pour in. Stir gently — the goal is soft, creamy curds.
Remove from heat when eggs are still slightly underdone. Top with parsley. Serve with bread.
cheapTips: Menemen is one of the most satisfying dishes in the world using only $2 of ingredients
The trick is removing from heat before the eggs fully set — they continue cooking in the pan

substitutions.swap: Pinch of chili flakes
Pita or skip for low-carb

recipes.name: Israeli Sabich Bowl
recipes.description: Fried eggplant, hard-boiled eggs, hummus, and Israeli salad over rice — the iconic Israeli street food deconstructed into a macro-friendly bowl.
steps: Slice eggplant, salt, and fry in olive oil 4 min per side until golden.
Hard-boil eggs.
Israeli salad: dice tomato and cucumber, toss with lemon, parsley, salt.
Bowl: rice, hummus, fried eggplant, halved eggs, Israeli salad. Drizzle with amba or hot sauce.
cheapTips: Hummus and eggs are two of the most protein-dense cheap foods
Amba (mango pickle sauce) is available at Middle Eastern stores and worth finding

substitutions.swap: Mango chutney or hot sauce
Baba ganoush for a smokier version

recipes.name: Moroccan Harira Soup
recipes.description: Morocco's national soup — lentils, chickpeas, tomatoes, lamb or chicken, and warm spices like cinnamon, ginger, and turmeric. Thick, warming, and deeply satisfying.
steps: Sauté beef with onion, garlic, and spices 5 min.
Add tomatoes, lentils, chickpeas, celery, and broth. Simmer 35 min.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley. Adjust seasoning.
cheapTips: Harira uses lentils + chickpeas for plant protein to supplement the meat — very economical
Ground beef adds big flavor with just a small amount

substitutions.swap: Ground lamb (traditional) or skip for vegetarian
Brown lentils (longer cooking)

recipes.name: Egyptian Koshari
recipes.description: Egypt's national street food — layers of rice, lentils, and pasta topped with crispy onions and a spiced tomato sauce. Completely vegan and deeply satisfying.
steps: Cook rice and lentils together. Cook pasta separately.
Caramelize onions in olive oil 20 min until dark golden — these are the topping.
Tomato sauce: simmer tomato sauce with garlic, cumin, coriander, vinegar 5 min.
Layer rice-lentils, then pasta, then chickpeas. Top with tomato sauce and crispy onions.
cheapTips: Koshari is Egypt's ultimate budget dish — it feeds a whole family for very little
The crispy onions are what makes koshari special — don't rush the caramelization

substitutions.swap: Any small pasta shape
Black-eyed peas

recipes.name: Syrian Freekeh with Chicken
recipes.description: Smoky green wheat (freekeh) cooked with chicken in a warm spiced broth and topped with toasted almonds and caramelized onions — a Syrian feast grain.
steps: Brown chicken thighs 4 min per side, remove. Caramelize onion in same pan 10 min.
Add garlic, allspice, cinnamon, cumin — toast 1 min. Add freekeh and broth.
Nestle chicken back in. Cover and simmer 25 min.
Toast almonds in dry pan. Serve freekeh and chicken topped with almonds and parsley.
cheapTips: Freekeh has a nutty, smoky flavor unlike any other grain — worth finding at a Middle Eastern grocery
The caramelized onion is what gives this dish its sweetness — take time with it

substitutions.swap: Bulgur wheat or quinoa (shorter cooking time)
Pine nuts or walnuts

recipes.name: Levantine Chicken with Rice and Yogurt
recipes.description: Tender spiced chicken over buttery basmati rice, drenched in a garlicky yogurt sauce and finished with toasted almonds and parsley — a simplified mansaf.
steps: Season chicken with allspice, cinnamon, cumin. Brown 5 min, then simmer in broth 20 min.
Cook rice in the chicken broth.
Warm yogurt sauce: mix yogurt, 2 garlic cloves, lemon, salt — heat gently (don't boil).
Serve chicken over rice, ladle yogurt sauce over, top with almonds and parsley.
cheapTips: Yogurt sauce is the secret of Levantine cooking — it costs almost nothing and transforms the dish
This is the easy weeknight version of a Middle Eastern feast dish

substitutions.swap: Labneh or sour cream
Pine nuts or walnuts

recipes.name: Gulf Spiced Chicken Rice (Machboos)
recipes.description: Fragrant Gulf-style rice cooked in spiced chicken broth with tomatoes, dried limes, and saffron — a dish from the Arabian Gulf that rivals biryani.
steps: Brown chicken, set aside. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger with spices 5 min.
Add tomatoes and broth. Simmer 20 min. Return chicken — cook 15 more min.
Remove chicken. Add washed rice to the spiced broth. Cover and cook 18 min on low.
Rest 5 min. Serve rice topped with chicken and cilantro.
cheapTips: Machboos is a one-pot meal — fewer dishes, more flavor absorption
The dried lime (loomi) is optional but gives it an authentic Gulf citrus depth

substitutions.swap: Whole chicken pieces
Extra cumin

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs with Roasted Vegetables
recipes.description: Bone-in chicken thighs roasted alongside broccoli, bell peppers, and red onion — everything cooks on one pan at 425°F for a complete, hands-off dinner.
steps: Toss vegetables with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and garlic. Spread on sheet pan.
Season chicken with remaining olive oil, paprika, cumin, salt. Place on same pan.
Roast at 425°F 28–30 min until chicken is golden and vegetables are tender.
Finish with lemon squeeze.
cheapTips: Sheet-pan meals require almost no cleanup — just one pan to wash
Bone-in thighs at $1.50/lb are the most forgiving roast chicken — hard to overcook

substitutions.swap: Cauliflower, green beans, or asparagus
Lemon pepper seasoning

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Salmon with Asparagus
recipes.description: Salmon fillets and asparagus roasted together on one pan with garlic, lemon, and herbs — a healthy, elegant dinner in 20 minutes.
steps: Toss asparagus with 1 tbsp olive oil, garlic, salt. Spread on sheet pan.
Brush salmon with Dijon mustard mixed with remaining olive oil. Place on pan.
Roast at 425°F 12–14 min until salmon flakes easily.
Finish with lemon and dill.
cheapTips: Asparagus is the fastest-cooking vegetable — it roasts in the same time as salmon
Buy salmon when on sale and freeze portions individually

substitutions.swap: Green beans, broccolini, or snap peas
Fresh parsley or tarragon

recipes.name: Baked Turkey Meatballs with Marinara
recipes.description: Lean ground turkey meatballs baked in the oven and simmered in marinara sauce — served over spaghetti squash or pasta. High protein, lower fat than beef meatballs.
steps: Mix ground turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, garlic, parsley, fennel, salt. Form 12 meatballs.
Bake at 400°F 18–20 min until browned.
Simmer in marinara sauce 5 min. Cook pasta.
Serve meatballs and sauce over pasta.
cheapTips: Turkey meatballs freeze perfectly — make a double batch for later
Store-bought marinara is fine here — use the good stuff you'd put on pizza

substitutions.swap: Ground chicken or lean ground beef
Spaghetti squash for low-carb

recipes.name: Oven-Baked BBQ Chicken Thighs
recipes.description: Chicken thighs slathered in a homemade smoky-sweet BBQ glaze and oven-roasted until sticky and caramelized — easier than grilling and just as good.
steps: BBQ sauce: mix ketchup, brown sugar, ACV, Worcestershire, garlic powder, smoked paprika, onion powder.
Coat chicken thighs. Bake at 400°F 25 min. Brush with extra sauce. Bake 10 more min.
Serve with corn and coleslaw.
cheapTips: Homemade BBQ sauce costs $0.50 vs $4 for a bottle and tastes better
Chicken thighs stay juicy in the oven even when coated in sugary sauce — don't worry

substitutions.swap: Tomato paste + extra brown sugar + ACV
Any crunchy salad

recipes.name: Oven-Roasted Chicken and Sweet Potato
recipes.description: Bone-in chicken thighs roasted with sweet potato, red onion, and rosemary until golden — a complete meal on one pan with zero effort.
steps: Cube sweet potato and onion. Toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt.
Season chicken with remaining olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast everything at 425°F 30–35 min until chicken is golden.
Drizzle balsamic over sweet potatoes before serving.
cheapTips: Sweet potato and chicken thighs are two of the cheapest filling foods — this meal costs $4
Balsamic at the end transforms this into a restaurant-quality dish instantly

substitutions.swap: Thyme, sage, or Italian seasoning
Butternut squash or regular potato

recipes.name: Baked Lemon Herb Chicken Breast
recipes.description: Juicy, tender chicken breasts baked in a lemon-garlic-herb marinade — the go-to high-protein meal for meal prep. 35 g protein per breast.
steps: Whisk lemon zest, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, herbs, salt, pepper.
Coat chicken. Marinate 5 min (or overnight).
Bake at 400°F 22–25 min until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 min before slicing. Serve with green beans.
cheapTips: Baked chicken breasts meal-prep beautifully — cook 4 at once for the whole week
Pound breasts to even thickness before baking for consistent cooking

substitutions.swap: Rosemary or Italian seasoning
Any steamed vegetable

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Shrimp Fajitas
recipes.description: Seasoned shrimp and fajita vegetables roasted on one pan at high heat until slightly charred — ready in 20 minutes and piled into warm tortillas.
steps: Toss shrimp and vegetables with olive oil and spices.
Spread on sheet pan. Roast at 425°F 10–12 min (shrimp turns pink and curls).
Warm tortillas in the oven last 2 min.
Fill tortillas with shrimp and vegetables. Top with lime and cilantro.
cheapTips: Frozen shrimp thaws in 5 min in cold water — always cheaper than fresh
Fajita vegetables can be any color bell pepper — buy what's on sale

substitutions.swap: Chicken breast strips or steak
Lettuce wraps or rice bowls

recipes.name: Oven-Baked Herb-Crusted Cod
recipes.description: Cod fillets topped with a parmesan-herb breadcrumb crust and baked until golden — the easiest way to make fish feel special, ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Mix breadcrumbs, parmesan, garlic, parsley, olive oil.
Brush cod with Dijon. Press breadcrumb mixture onto top.
Bake at 400°F 12–14 min until crust is golden.
Serve with roasted asparagus.
cheapTips: Frozen cod is under $5/lb and one of the best value seafoods
The breadcrumb crust keeps the fish moist and gives it texture — it's the secret to restaurant-quality baked fish

substitutions.swap: Tilapia, haddock, or any white fish
Extra breadcrumbs with herbs

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Italian Sausage and Peppers
recipes.description: Turkey Italian sausage links roasted with bell peppers, onion, and zucchini — a classic Italian-American dinner that cooks entirely in the oven.
steps: Slice peppers, onion, and zucchini. Toss with olive oil, garlic, Italian seasoning.
Add whole sausage links on top.
Roast at 400°F 25–30 min, turning halfway.
Serve with warm marinara and crusty bread.
cheapTips: Turkey sausage is leaner and cheaper than Italian pork sausage — works just as well
This literally could not be simpler: chop, toss, roast

substitutions.swap: Chicken or pork sausage
Polenta or rice

recipes.name: Oven-Baked Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.description: Bell peppers stuffed with a savory mix of ground turkey, rice, marinara, and cheese — baked until the peppers are tender and the filling is bubbling.
steps: Cook rice. Brown turkey with onion and garlic. Mix with rice, marinara, and seasoning.
Halve peppers, remove seeds. Fill with turkey mixture. Top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F 30–35 min until peppers are tender.
cheapTips: Bell peppers on sale? Stuff them immediately and freeze unbaked
This is one of those meals that looks impressive but is just glorified meat and rice

substitutions.swap: Ground beef or ground chicken
Any melting cheese

recipes.name: Lightened High-Protein Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Creamy mac and cheese made with cottage cheese sauce, reduced-fat cheddar, and whole-grain pasta — 28 g protein at 420 calories.
steps: Cook pasta. Blend cottage cheese, milk, garlic powder, Dijon, salt until smooth.
Drain pasta. Return to pot on low heat. Pour in cottage cheese sauce.
Add cheddar, stir until melted. Season with pepper and paprika.
cheapTips: Cottage cheese sauce replaces a butter-flour roux — saves 150 kcal and adds 14 g protein
Blending cottage cheese makes it completely smooth — no one will know

substitutions.swap: Greek yogurt (even creamier)
Chickpea pasta for more protein

recipes.name: Lean Turkey Chili
recipes.description: Ground turkey with kidney beans, black beans, tomatoes, and chili spices — a satisfying low-fat chili that's even better the next day.
steps: Brown turkey with onion and garlic 5 min.
Add spices, toast 1 min. Add beans, tomatoes, and sauce.
Simmer 25 min, stirring occasionally. Season to taste.
cheapTips: Canned beans are one of the cheapest proteins — two cans add 30 g protein for $2
Chili improves dramatically after 24 hours — make extra

substitutions.swap: Ground beef or lentils for vegan
Pinto or cannellini beans

recipes.name: Chicken Pot Pie Bowl
recipes.description: All the creamy vegetable-chicken filling of a pot pie, served over mashed cauliflower instead of under pastry — comfort food without the crust calories.
steps: Steam cauliflower, mash with salt and a splash of milk.
Sauté onion, carrot, celery 5 min. Add diced chicken, cook 5 min.
Add broth, peas, thyme. Simmer 10 min. Stir in yogurt for creaminess.
Serve filling over cauliflower mash.
cheapTips: All the comfort of pot pie for $4 and in 35 min — no pastry needed
Frozen peas are the easiest vegetable — straight from freezer into the filling

substitutions.swap: Real mashed potato for a more traditional feel
Heavy cream (more calories but creamier)

recipes.name: Lightened Turkey Sloppy Joe
recipes.description: Ground turkey in a tangy-sweet tomato sauce piled on whole-wheat buns — all the fun of the classic with half the fat.
steps: Brown turkey with onion, pepper, and garlic 5 min.
Add tomato sauce, ketchup, Worcestershire, brown sugar, vinegar. Simmer 15 min.
Pile on buns.
cheapTips: Ground turkey sloppy joe uses $3 of ingredients to feed 2 — one of the best value dinners
The sauce takes 5 min to make and is far better than canned

recipes.name: Lightened Shepherd's Pie
