Cook the pasta following pack instructions, then drain, reserving a cup of the pasta water, and add the pasta to the ragu. Stir to coat all the pasta in the sauce and cook for 1 min more, adding a splash of cooking liquid if it looks dry. Serve with grated Parmesan, if you like.

recipes.name: Venezuelan Arepas
recipes.description: Venezuela side — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 410° F.
Pour the water into a large bowl. Make sure it is room temperature.
Add the salt. Blend well with a mixer, fork or spatula to make sure it dissolves well.
While you continue to beat the mixture, slowly add the corn meal—a little bit at a time.
Once all the flour is added, keep mixing until the corn meal, water and salt are thoroughly blended and dissolved.

Set aside the masa in its bowl. Let it rest for 5 minutes so that the flour is thoroughly hydrated. This type of corn flour does not have any gluten, so it doesn’t need to be kneaded. The masa should be smooth, firm yet malleable.
While waiting for the 5 minutes’ rest, heat your budare (or comal, griddle, cast-iron pan or non-stick pan) over medium heat. Coat with a little bit of the oil.
Fill a small bowl with water to wet your hands to make the arepas.
Take about 2 Tbsp of the masa in your damp hands. The masa should fit easily in your palm so that it is easy to shape into a small ball.

Cross your hands, so that one is on top of the other, with the masa ball between them. Rotate your right hand in a circle, so that you are at the same time both pressing the masa into a flat disc and keeping its round shape.
arepa making

The last step in shaping your arepa is to quickly pass and lightly press the masa disc from one hand to the other until it is about ¾ of an inch thick and 4 inches wide. Smooth the edges with your fingertips (quickly dip them into the water bowl first) so that they stay as round as possible and without cracks.
arepa making
Place your arepas in batches on the preheated surface of your budare griddle or nonstick pan. Let each side turn golden, about 4 to 5 minutes per side. Check them often so that they don’t burn.

recipes.name: Venezuelan Coconut Chicken
recipes.description: Venezuela chicken — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut the chicken up into bite size pieces. Peel and cut the onions, mince the garlic.
Assemble the rest of the ingredients and you are ready to start cooking.
Make the Dish
Heat up a fry pan over medium heat. Add the oil and when hot, sauté the onion until translucent. Remove from pan and transfer to a blender or food processor.
Add tomatoes, garlic, turmeric, cumin, sugar, ginger paste, coconut milk, water and blend smooth.
In the same pan you cooked the onion, add the chicken and brown all sides. This should take about 3 minutes.
Add the blender ingredients and bay leaves to the pan, bring to a simmer and cook until the chicken is white inside and the liquid is creamy. (15 to 20 minutes)
Remove the bay leaves and serve with white rice.

recipes.name: Venezuelan Sancocho
recipes.description: Venezuela beef — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add hind shank, 1 halved small onion, halved bell pepper, 4 whole garlic cloves, the dark green leaves of the leek, and stock to a large stockpot. Cook for 45-60 minutes until the meat is fork-tender. NOTE: the meat can take a bit longer to be fork-tender; that is okay, just add more cooking time if necessary.
When the meat is tender, remove the big pieces of vegetables and bones. Discard.

Add diced onion, 2 minced garlic, mini sweet peppers, sliced leeks (light green part), scallions, yucca, and corn; Mix and simmer covered over medium heat for 5- 8 minutes, until the yucca is starting to soften. NOTE: the yuca can take a bit longer to start softening; that is okay, just add more cooking time if necessary.

Add yautia, white yam, and butternut squash. Mix to combine. Simmer covered over medium heat for 5 – 6 minutes, until all the root vegetables are tender. NOTE: Do not cook too much, or they will fall apart.
Taste and add salt to your taste, if necessary. Add cilantro and the remaining 2 minced garlic cloves. Mix and let simmer for 2 more minutes.
Serve hot in large soup bowls, dividing the meat and vegetables evenly. Add a squish of lime juice and/or hot sauce, if desired. Serve along with arepas and or casabe (cassava bread).

recipes.name: Venezuelan Shredded Beef
recipes.description: Venezuela beef — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season beef with salt, pepper and minced garlic
Chop 1 onion in 4 big wedges
Place in the beef pressure cooker with the 4 wedges of onion and the stock
Pressure cook for 20 minutes
Release the pressure and open the lid
Remove the beef and SAVE 2 cups of stock in another container
With 2 forks, shred the beef. Beef should be tender enough to so easily. If not, cook for another 10 minutes
Press the saute button of the Instant pot. Add the olive oil
When the machine beeps, add the sliced onion, pepper and tomatoes. Cook until tender
Add the shredded beef back in the pot and mix
Pour in 1 1/2 cups of the saved stock, the Worcestershire sauce, tomato paste, ketchup and cumin. Mix
If sauce seems to dry, add a tad more of stock
Season with salt and pepper
Serve!

recipes.name: Venezuelan turnovers
recipes.description: Venezuela side — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season meat with Adobo. In skillet, heat oil on medium high. Cook meat until pink is gone. Stir in onion, pepper, garlic, alcaparras, tomato sauce and Sazón. Cook, stirring often until most of the liquid has evaporated (about 20 minutes). Cool.

Prepared dough should be moist and should hold together, but it should not stick to your fingers. Start with about ½ cup of dough and roll into a ball between palms of your hands. Working on a sheet of non-stick parchment paper, form the ball into a 5-inch circle about ⅛ inch thick. Place a generous tbsp. of filling on one half of circle and using parchment paper close dough over to form a semi-circle. To seal and trim edges of the empanada, press lip of inverted bowl over semi-circle shaped patty. Repeat for all the Empanadas.

In large skillet on medium high, heat ½ inch of oil until hot but not smoking. Cook empanadas in batches, turning once or twice until lightly browned. Drain on paper towel. Do not over crowd skillet or let oil get too hot.

recipes.name: Vietnamese caramel trout
recipes.description: Vietnamese seafood — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Put the sugar in a large shallow pan, along with a small splash of water. Heat gently, swirling the pan, until the sugar has dissolved. Increase the heat and bubble the syrup until it turns a dark amber colour. Add the fish sauce, most of the chilli and ginger, then splash in 1 tbsp water to dilute. Boil again until syrupy, then add the fish fillets, skin-side down, and the bok choi, cut-side down.

Cover the pan with a lid and simmer for 4-5 mins until the fish is cooked and the bok choi has wilted. Turn off the heat, squeeze over the lemon and scatter with the remaining chilli, ginger and the coriander sprigs. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Vietnamese chicken salad
recipes.description: Vietnamese chicken — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: To make the dressing, whisk all the ingredients together in a large serving bowl. Cook the noodles following pack instructions, then drain and add to the bowl with the dressing.

Peel the carrot into long strips using a vegetable peeler. Do the same for the cucumber, until you reach the seeds (discard them). Add the carrot and cucumber to the noodle mixture along with the shredded chicken, radishes, red onion and mint. Toss well to coat in the dressing, scatter over the peanuts and serve.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Grilled Pork (bun-thit-nuong)
recipes.description: Vietnamese pork — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the uncooked pork thinly, about ⅛". It helps to slightly freeze it (optional).
Mince garlic and shallots. Mix in a bowl with sugar, fish sauce, thick soy sauce, pepper, and oil until sugar dissolves.
Marinate the meat for 1 hour, or overnight for better results.
Bake the pork at 375F for 10-15 minutes or until about 80% cooked. Finish cooking by broiling in the oven until a nice golden brown color develops, flipping the pieces midway.
Assemble your bowl with veggies, noodles, and garnish. Many like to mix the whole bowl up and pour the fish sauce on top, but I like to make individual bites and sauce it slowly.

recipes.name: Vietnamese lamb shanks with sweet potatoes
recipes.description: Vietnamese lamb — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a heavy-bottomed casserole, season the shanks, then brown them 2 at a time on all sides, adding the remaining oil for the second batch. Remove the lamb and add the onions. Fry them quite briskly, about 30 secs, add the ginger, garlic and chopped chilli, then turn the heat down and cook for 1 min. Add 1 tbsp sugar, stir, then add the star anise, lemongrass, stock, purée and seasoning. Bring to the boil.

Cover and cook in the oven for 1½ hrs, then add the sweet potatoes and cook for 1 hr more. The lamb should be completely tender and almost falling off the bones. Stir in the fish sauce, lime juice and 1 tsp sugar to just lift the flavour, then scatter with the mint, basil and the sliced chilli to serve.

recipes.name: Vietnamese pork salad
recipes.description: Vietnamese pork — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: The day before: make the dressing. Put the sugar and lime juice in a pan with 1 tbsp water and bring to the boil to dissolve the sugar. Add the chilli and coriander and stir well, then pulse in a blender until smooth. Tip into a bowl, then stir in the sesame oil, fish sauce, soy sauce and sesame seeds to make a dressing. Cover and chill until needed.

Two hours before serving: heat a griddle pan. Preheat the oven to 200C/gas 6/fan 180C. Brush the pork with oil and griddle on all sides for a few minutes until seared. Transfer to a baking tray and put in the oven for about 10-12 minutes until cooked through. Cool, thinly slice against the grain of the meat. Tip into a bowl and pour over half the dressing.
To serve: toss the remaining salad ingredients in a bowl with the remaining dressing. Pile on to a platter, top with the pork slices and spoon over any juices.

recipes.name: Vietnamese prawn spiralized rolls
recipes.description: Vietnamese seafood — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix all the ingredients for the dipping sauce along with 50ml water in a bowl and set aside to allow the sugar to dissolve and flavour to infuse.

To assemble the rolls, fill a wide bowl with warm water and grab a clean damp tea towel to work on. Dip a rice paper wrapper into the water for a few seconds until it softens then carefully place onto the tea towel.
Put a few mint and coriander leaves in the centre of the wrapper then top with two prawns and a small handful of the spiralized veg, which may need to be cut up if the spirals are too long.

Fold the sides of the wrapper into the centre, over the filling, then fold in the edges, so that the filling is completely encased, then tightly roll. Repeat until all of the wrappers and filling have been used. To serve, slice on a diagonal and eat with the dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Vietnamese veg parcels
recipes.description: Vietnamese vegetarian — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak the rice fl our pancakes according to pack instructions or in boiling water for 30 secs. Remove and cool on kitchen paper. Soak the rice noodles according to pack instructions, then drain and cut them into 2cm strips.

Lay a rice pancake on a board and arrange some rice noodles, chicken, vegetables and herb leaves about a third of the way up, leaving a 1cm edge at the side. Fold the sides over the vegetables and then roll up lengthways to make a cigar. Store in the fridge, covered with moist kitchen paper for up to 1 day.

Mix together the ingredients for the dipping sauce and put into a bowl. To serve, arrange the rolls on a plate along with the leaves and herbs. To eat, wrap each roll in a piece of lettuce with a herb sprig and dunk into the sauce.

recipes.name: Vietnamese-style caramel pork
recipes.description: Vietnamese pork — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a wok over a high heat and stir-fry the pork in batches until browned all over. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.

Turn the heat right down and add the remaining oil, then stir in the shallots, ginger and chilli. Cook over a low heat for a couple of mins until just starting to soften. Add the sugar, fish sauce and 200ml water to the pan and stir everything together. Bring to the boil, stirring, so that the sugar dissolves, then return the pork to the pan. Bubble vigorously for 8-10 mins until the sauce thickens to coat the meat and become glossy. Taste and stir in a little more fish sauce, if needed, along with the chilli sauce. Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve with steamed rice and pak choi.

recipes.name: Vietnamese-style veggie hotpot
recipes.description: Vietnamese vegetarian — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps:
step 1
Heat the oil in a medium-size, lidded saucepan.
Add the ginger and garlic, then stir-fry for about 5 mins.
Add the squash, soy sauce, sugar and stock.
Cover, then simmer for 10 mins.
Remove the lid, add the green beans, then cook for 3 mins more until the squash and beans are tender.
Stir the spring onions through at the last minute, then sprinkle with coriander and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Walnut Roll Gužvara
recipes.description: Croatian dessert — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix all the ingredients for the dough together and knead well. Cover the dough and put to rise until doubled in size which should take about 2 hours. Knock back the dough and knead lightly.

Divide the dough into two equal pieces; roll each piece into an oblong about 12 inches by 8 inches. Mix the filling ingredients together and divide between the dough, spreading over each piece. Roll up the oblongs as tightly as possible to give two 12 inch sausages. Place these side by side, touching each other, on a greased baking sheet. Cover and leave to rise for about 40 minutes. Heat oven to 200ºC (425ºF). Bake for 30-35 minutes until well risen and golden brown. Bread should sound hollow when the base is tapped.
Remove from oven and brush the hot bread top with milk. Sift with a generous covering of icing sugar.

recipes.name: Walnut, date & honey cake
recipes.description: Turkish dessert — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat the oven to 160C/Gas 3/fan oven 140C. Line the base and long sides of a 900g/2lb loaf tin with greaseproof paper, buttering the tin and paper.

Tip the flour, cinnamon, butter, sugar, 2 tablespoons of the honey and the eggs into a large mixing bowl. Mash the bananas and chop the dates (kitchen scissors are easiest for this) and add to the bowl. Beat the mixture for 2-3 minutes, using a wooden spoon or hand-held mixer, until well blended.
Spoon into the prepared tin and level the top. Scatter the walnut pieces over. Bake for 1 hour, then lightly press the top – it will feel firm if cooked. If not, bake for a further 10 minutes.
Cool for 15 minutes, then lift out of the tin using the paper. When cold, drizzle the remaining honey over. Cut into thick slices.

recipes.name: Warm roast asparagus salad
recipes.description: Australian pork — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C/Gas 6/fan 180C. Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus and discard. Arrange the asparagus in a single layer in a baking tray with sides. Cut the tomatoes in half widthways, nestle them in with the asparagus, season with sea salt and pepper and drizzle with olive oil. Roll each bacon rasher into a tight roll (if large, first cut in half crosswise), and arrange in the tray. Drizzle the bacon rolls with the honey and bake for 20 minutes until the tomatoes are soft and the bacon is crisp.

In the meantime, boil the potatoes until tender. Whisk the vinegar, olive oil, mustard, some sea salt and pepper in a large bowl until blended. Toss the rocket or spinach leaves in half of the dressing, and arrange on a large serving platter.
Drain the potatoes and cut in half. Gently toss them in the rest of the dressing, and arrange on the platter with the asparagus. Tuck in the tomatoes and bacon.

recipes.name: White chocolate creme brulee
recipes.description: France dessert — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat the cream, chocolate and vanilla pod in a pan until the chocolate has melted. Take off the heat and allow to infuse for 10 mins, scraping the pod seeds into the cream. If using the vanilla extract, add straight away. Heat oven to 160C/fan 140C/gas 3.

Beat yolks and sugar until pale. stir in the chocolate cream. Strain into a jug and pour into ramekins. Place in a deep roasting tray and pour boiling water halfway up the sides. Bake for 15-20 mins until just set with a wobbly centre. Chill in the fridge for at least 4 hrs.
To serve, sprinkle some sugar on top of the brûlées and caramelise with a blowtorch or briefly under a hot grill. Leave caramel to harden, then serve.

recipes.name: Wontons
recipes.description: Chinese pork — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine pork, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and vegetables in a bowl.
Separate wonton skins.
Place a heaping teaspoon of filling in the center of the wonton.
Brush water on 2 borders of the skin, covering 1/4 inch from the edge.
Fold skin over to form a triangle, sealing edges.
Pinch the two long outside points together.
Heat oil to 450 degrees and fry 4 to 5 at a time until golden.
Drain and serve with sauce.

recipes.name: Yaki Udon
recipes.description: Japanese vegetarian — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil some water in a large saucepan. Add 250ml cold water and the udon noodles. (As they are so thick, adding cold water helps them to cook a little bit slower so the middle cooks through). If using frozen or fresh noodles, cook for 2 mins or until al dente; dried will take longer, about 5-6 mins. Drain and leave in the colander.

Heat 1 tbsp of the oil, add the onion and cabbage and sauté for 5 mins until softened. Add the mushrooms and some spring onions, and sauté for 1 more min. Pour in the remaining sesame oil and the noodles. If using cold noodles, let them heat through before adding the ingredients for the sauce – otherwise tip in straight away and keep stir-frying until sticky and piping hot. Sprinkle with the remaining spring onions.

recipes.name: Yemeni Lahsa (Elite Shakshuka)
recipes.description: Saudi Arabian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: First, On medium heat, heat the olive oil and add the diced onion until it wethers. Next, add the tomatoes and cook for another 4-5 min. Lastly, add the all spice, salt, and cracked pepper.
Add the eggs and mix throughly for 2 minutes and cover to cook 5-6 minutes until top is solidified. Lastly, spread the liquid cheese and have it covered for a minute.
I served mine Mediterranean style with hash-browns, Egyptian fava beans, Turkish salami and olives, cheese wedges, and greek feta.

recipes.name: Yorkshire Puddings
recipes.description: British miscellaneous — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oven to 230C/fan 210C/gas 8.
Drizzle a little sunflower oil evenly into two 4-hole Yorkshire pudding tins or two 12-hole non-stick muffin tins and place in the oven to heat through.
To make the batter, tip 140g plain flour into a bowl and beat in 4 eggs until smooth.
Gradually add 200ml milk and carry on beating until the mix is completely lump-free. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour the batter into a jug, then remove the hot tins from the oven. Carefully and evenly pour the batter into the holes.
Place the tins back in the oven and leave undisturbed for 20-25 mins until the puddings have puffed up and browned.
Serve immediately. You can now cool them and freeze for up to 1 month.

recipes.name: Zapiekanki
recipes.description: Polish pork — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Bake the baguettes on a baking tray for 8-10 mins, then leave to cool.

Heat 2 tsp of the butter and 1 tsp of the oil in a pan over a low heat and cook the chopped onion for 5 mins until soft. Stir in the mushrooms, turn the heat to medium and cook for 5-10 mins more until the veg is soft and the mushroom liquid has evaporated. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1-2 mins until soft. Season, then stir in the mayonnaise and remove from the heat.

Halve the baguettes lengthways, then return to the baking tray, cut-side up and spread over the mushroom mixture, then sprinkle over the cheddar, ham, kabanos and mozzarella. Bake for 8-10 mins, or until the cheese has melted and turned golden.

Meanwhile, heat the remaining butter and oil in a pan over a medium heat and fry the sliced onions for 5 mins until golden and soft. Remove from the heat and set aside. Once the pizzas are cooked, top with the caramelised onions, dill pickles (if using), the chives and a zig-zag drizzle of ketchup.

recipes.name: Zeeuwse bolussen
recipes.description: dessert — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place the dried yeast, milk and sugar in the bowl of your food processor. Mix and let stand for a few minutes until it begins to foam.
Then add the flour, egg, butter, salt, 1 tsp of cinnamon and cardamom and process until smooth.
Form the dough into a ball, cover the bowl and let it rise for 1 hour or until it has doubled in size.
Mix the caster sugar with 1 tablespoon of cinnamon, pour over the dough and roll it in.
Form 10 equal balls (about 75 grams each) and let them “sweat” for a while. The sugar will dissolve a little. When you roll them again later, the rest of the dough will absorb the sugar better.
Then roll the ball into a strand about 35-40 centimeters long while rolling through the powdered sugar.
Fold the strand around one end and tuck the other end under the bolus. Push something between the roll to secure the end.
Place on a baking sheet lined with a baking sheet, cover with plastic wrap and let them rise for ½-1 hour.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 250 degrees Celsius/480 Fahrenheit top and bottom heat
Bake the Zeeland Boluses for about 8 minutes until done. Be careful – if you bake them too long, they will get dry and you will want something sticky 😉 .
Let them cool out of the oven for 1 minute, then turn them over and let them cool further (on a wire rack if necessary). Enjoy!

recipes.name: Zemiakové Placky
recipes.description: Slovakia side — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: 1. Prepare the Potatoes
Start by peeling and finely grating the potatoes. To ensure extra crispiness, use a clean kitchen towel to squeeze out as much moisture as possible.
2. Mix the Ingredients
In a large mixing bowl, combine the grated potatoes, chopped onion, minced garlic, eggs, flour, marjoram, salt, and black pepper. Stir well until the mixture forms a thick, consistent batter.
3. Heat the Oil
In a large frying pan, heat a generous amount of oil over medium heat. The oil should be hot but not smoking.
4. Fry the Pancakes
Spoon portions of the batter into the pan, flattening each into a thin pancake. Fry until golden brown and crispy on one side, then flip and cook the other side until equally golden and crispy.
5. Drain & Serve
Transfer the cooked pancakes onto a plate lined with paper towels to remove excess oil. Serve immediately while hot, with sour cream, garlic dip, or as a side dish.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
While pasta cooks, fry pancetta in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, grated Pecorino Romano, and black pepper until combined.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain spaghetti.
Remove skillet from heat and add hot drained pasta to pancetta, tossing to coat.
Pour egg mixture over pasta while tossing constantly, adding pasta water a little at a time until creamy sauce forms.
Serve immediately with extra Pecorino Romano and black pepper.
cheapTips: Use bacon instead of pancetta to save 30%
Buy Pecorino Romano in blocks and grate yourself

recipes.name: Lasagna Bolognese
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot, sauté minced onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking it apart, until browned, about 8 minutes, then stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Prepare béchamel sauce by melting butter in a saucepan, whisking in flour for 1 minute, then slowly adding milk while whisking constantly until thickened, about 8 minutes.
Boil lasagna noodles according to package directions, drain and lay flat on parchment.
Spread a thin layer of béchamel on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish, then layer noodles, meat sauce, béchamel, and Parmesan, repeating until dish is full.
Top with final layer of béchamel and Parmesan.
Bake covered at 375°F for 25 minutes, then uncovered for 15 minutes until golden and bubbling.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions
Make béchamel from scratch rather than using jarred sauce

recipes.name: Risotto alla Milanese
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat chicken broth in a separate pot and keep at a simmer throughout cooking.
Steep saffron threads in 2 tablespoons warm broth for 5 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a large, shallow pan, sauté minced onion until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add Arborio rice and toast for 1-2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed, about 2 minutes.
Add hot broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly and waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding the next, for about 18-20 minutes total.
When rice is creamy and al dente, stir in saffron broth, butter, and Parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip saffron or use a tiny pinch to reduce cost significantly
Use vegetable broth instead of chicken broth

recipes.name: Osso Buco
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat veal shanks dry and season with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat olive oil in a large heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown veal shanks on all sides, about 4 minutes per side; set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion, carrot, and celery until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then deglaze with white wine, scraping up browned bits.
Return veal to pot, add beef broth, bay leaf, and thyme, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in a 325°F oven for 2-2.5 hours until meat is very tender and falling from the bone.
Remove veal and strain braising liquid, pressing vegetables through a sieve to thicken sauce.
Return veal to pot with strained sauce and simmer gently for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Substitute beef shanks or lamb shanks for a similar result at lower cost
Buy shanks from a butcher counter where they're often cheaper than packaged

recipes.name: Pasta alla Amatriciana
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and add pasta, cooking until al dente.
While pasta cooks, fry diced guanciale in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced onion to guanciale and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and red pepper flakes, then simmer for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain pasta.
Add drained pasta to sauce and toss well, adding pasta water as needed to reach desired consistency.
Serve topped with Pecorino Romano cheese and additional red pepper flakes if desired.
cheapTips: Use bacon instead of guanciale to cut cost in half
Buy canned tomatoes in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Pappardelle al Cinghiale
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large heavy pot, sauté minced onion, carrot, and celery until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add ground boar and cook, breaking it apart, until deeply browned, about 10-12 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then deglaze with red wine, scraping up browned bits.
Add crushed tomatoes, beef broth, and bay leaf, then bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 1.5-2 hours, stirring occasionally, until sauce is rich and thick.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook pappardelle until al dente.
Drain pasta and toss with wild boar ragù sauce.
Serve topped with grated Parmesan cheese.
cheapTips: Use ground pork instead of wild boar for 40% savings
Buy ground meat on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Ravioli di Ricotta e Spinaci
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pasta dough by mounding flour on a clean surface, creating a well in the center, cracking eggs into well, and mixing together with a fork, then kneading until smooth, about 10 minutes.
Wrap dough in plastic and rest for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Meanwhile, prepare filling by mixing chopped spinach, ricotta, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Divide dough into 4 pieces and run each through a pasta machine, thinning until you can see light through it.
Place small spoonfuls of filling on one sheet of pasta, spacing 2 inches apart, then fold another pasta sheet over and press around filling to seal.
Cut into ravioli squares with a pasta wheel or knife, then place on a parchment-lined tray.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and drop ravioli in carefully, cooking until they float and float for 2 more minutes.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a skillet with sage leaves, then gently toss drained ravioli with sage butter and top with Parmesan.
cheapTips: Use frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry, to save on prep time
Buy ricotta at warehouse clubs in bulk

recipes.name: Tagliatelle al Ragù
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot, sauté minced onion, carrot, and celery until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add ground beef and pork, cooking and breaking apart until deeply browned, about 10-12 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then deglaze with white wine, scraping up browned bits.
Add crushed tomatoes and bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thick and rich.
Stir in milk and simmer for another 5 minutes to mellow the sauce.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook tagliatelle until al dente.
Drain pasta and toss with ragù sauce, then serve topped with Parmesan cheese.
cheapTips: Use all ground beef instead of the pork blend for consistency
Buy ground meat when on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Pasta all'Arrabbiata
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and add pasta, cooking until al dente.
While pasta cooks, gently heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat and add sliced garlic and red pepper flakes.
Cook garlic and pepper flakes for 2-3 minutes until fragrant, being careful not to burn garlic.
Pour crushed tomatoes into the skillet and simmer for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain pasta.
Toss drained pasta into the sauce, adding pasta water as needed to reach desired consistency.
Serve immediately garnished with fresh parsley and additional red pepper flakes.
cheapTips: Buy canned tomatoes on sale and stock up
Use regular olive oil instead of extra virgin to save money

recipes.name: Spaghetti alle Vongole
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse clams thoroughly under cold running water, discarding any that are open and don't close when tapped.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and add pasta, cooking until al dente.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat and add minced garlic and red pepper flakes.
Cook garlic for about 1-2 minutes until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
Increase heat to medium-high, add clams and white wine, and cover with a lid.
Cook for 8-10 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally, until clams have opened, discarding any that remain closed.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain pasta.
Add drained pasta to the clam sauce, tossing well and adding pasta water to create a light sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy clams at the seafood counter rather than pre-packaged
Use canned clams in a pinch for a budget option

recipes.name: Risotto ai Funghi Porcini
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried porcini in 1 cup hot water for 15 minutes, then strain, reserving liquid.
Heat broth in a pot and keep at a simmer throughout cooking.
Dice onion and mince garlic, then sauté in olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a wide pan over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes until translucent at edges.
Pour in wine and stir until absorbed, then add soaked porcini mushrooms.
Add broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting for each addition to absorb before adding the next (about 18-20 minutes total).
Sauté fresh mushrooms separately in a pan with salt and pepper, then add to risotto in final 3 minutes of cooking.
When rice is creamy and tender, stir in remaining butter and Parmesan, then season to taste and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy dried porcini in bulk bins instead of pre-packaged for savings
Use regular button mushrooms only and skip fresh additions to reduce cost

recipes.name: Polenta Concia
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring milk and broth to a simmer in a heavy pot over medium heat.
Slowly pour polenta into the liquid while whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat to low and stir frequently with a wooden spoon for 15-20 minutes until very thick and creamy.
Stir in butter, Fontina, and Parmesan cheese until fully melted and combined.
Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg to taste.
Pour into a buttered serving dish or individual bowls and serve hot, optionally drizzling with more melted butter and cheese.
cheapTips: Use standard cheddar instead of Fontina to cut cheese costs in half
Buy polenta in bulk sections of grocery stores

recipes.name: Saltimbocca alla Romana
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place veal between plastic wrap and pound to quarter-inch thickness with a meat mallet.
Place one sage leaf and one prosciutto slice on each veal piece, then secure with a toothpick.
Dredge each saltimbocca in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook saltimbocca 2-3 minutes per side until lightly browned, working in batches if necessary.
Pour wine into pan and simmer for 3-4 minutes, allowing sauce to reduce slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve immediately with pan sauce drizzled over top.
cheapTips: Substitute chicken breast scaloppine for veal to save $2-3 per serving
Buy prosciutto at deli counter instead of pre-packaged

recipes.name: Piccata al Limone
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breasts to quarter-inch thickness between plastic wrap.
Season flour with salt and pepper, then dredge chicken pieces evenly.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until foaming.
Cook chicken 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, then remove to a plate.
Add minced garlic to same pan and cook 30 seconds, then pour in lemon juice and broth.
Add capers and return chicken to pan, simmering for 2 minutes to combine flavors.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve garnished with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Skip capers or use only 2 tablespoons to reduce cost
Buy chicken on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Ossobuco in Umido
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and season veal shanks with salt and pepper.
Dredge shanks in flour, shaking off excess, then brown in olive oil over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes per side.
Remove shanks and add diced onion, carrots, and celery to same pot, sautéing for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then pour in wine and broth.
Return shanks to pot and add bay leaf and thyme, bringing to a simmer.
Cover pot and transfer to oven, braising for 2-2.5 hours until meat is very tender.
Remove shanks to serving plates, strain braising liquid through a fine sieve, and skim fat from surface.
Pour sauce over shanks and serve with risotto or polenta.
cheapTips: Ask butcher for cheaper veal shank cuts or substitute beef shanks
Make double batch and freeze half for another meal

recipes.name: Risotto al Nero di Seppia
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean squid by removing ink sacs carefully and reserving them, then cut body and tentacles into small pieces.
Heat broth in a pot and keep at a simmer throughout cooking.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic in olive oil over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add squid pieces and cook for 5 minutes, then add rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes.
Pour in wine and stir until absorbed, then dissolve squid ink in 2 tablespoons warm water and add to rice.
Add broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently for 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy and tender.
Stir in butter and Parmesan cheese, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately garnished with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy frozen squid which is cheaper and easier than fresh
Purchase squid ink packets online in bulk for multiple batches

recipes.name: Penne all'Amatriciana
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook penne according to package directions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, dice guanciale and cook in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy and rendered, about 8 minutes.
Remove guanciale and set aside, leaving about 1 tablespoon of fat in pan.
Dice onion and sauté in remaining fat for 3-4 minutes until softened, then add red pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Return guanciale to sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Drain pasta and add to sauce, tossing well to combine.
Serve immediately topped with grated Pecorino Romano cheese.
cheapTips: Substitute pancetta for guanciale to save $1-2 per serving
Buy whole peeled tomatoes and crush by hand instead of canned crushed

recipes.name: Bistecca alla Fiorentina
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove steak from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking and pat completely dry with paper towels.
Season both sides generously with sea salt and black pepper just before cooking.
Heat a cast iron skillet or grill to very high heat until smoking.
Place steak on hot surface and cook without moving for 5-6 minutes for medium-rare, then flip and cook another 4-5 minutes.
In the final minute, add olive oil, rosemary, thyme, and smashed garlic to the pan.
Baste steak with the herb-infused oil by tilting pan.
Transfer steak to a cutting board and rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with fresh lemon wedges and sprinkle with fleur de sel if desired.
cheapTips: Buy NY strip or ribeye steaks instead of T-bone to save $1-2 per pound
Look for sales on premium cuts and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Pasta Boscaiola
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook pasta according to package directions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, finely chop mushrooms and sauté in olive oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until moisture evaporates.
Add ground pork to mushroom pan, breaking it up as it cooks for 4-5 minutes until browned.
Stir in diced onion and minced garlic, cooking for 3 minutes.
Pour in white wine and simmer for 2 minutes to reduce, then add crushed tomatoes.
Simmer sauce for 8 minutes, then stir in cream and cook for 2 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then drain pasta and add to sauce.
Toss well to combine, then serve topped with Parmesan cheese and fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Use only common button mushrooms instead of mixed varieties
Substitute milk with cream for a less rich but cheaper version

recipes.name: Gnocchi di Ricotta
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using spinach, cook it in a skillet until wilted, squeeze out excess moisture, and finely chop.
Combine ricotta, flour, egg, 0.5 cup Parmesan, spinach, nutmeg, salt, and pepper in a bowl, mixing gently until dough comes together.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Form ricotta mixture into small balls about 1.5 inches in diameter and gently place in boiling water.
Cook until gnocchi float to surface and continue cooking for 2-3 minutes after floating.
While gnocchi cook, melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and add sage and minced garlic.
Cook sage and garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Remove gnocchi with a slotted spoon and add to sage butter, tossing gently to coat, then serve with remaining Parmesan cheese.
cheapTips: Make ricotta from scratch using milk and lemon juice to cut cheese cost in half
Skip sage and garlic butter; toss with simple tomato sauce instead

recipes.name: Risotto alla Pescatora
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a separate pot and keep it warm on low heat throughout cooking.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large pan over medium heat, then sauté diced onion and garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add rice and stir constantly for 1 minute until lightly toasted.
Pour in white wine and stir until fully absorbed.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until each addition is absorbed before adding the next, about 18 minutes total.
In the last 5 minutes, push rice to the sides and add shrimp and clams to the center of the pan, cooking until shrimp are pink and clams open.
Remove from heat and stir in remaining butter and Parmesan cheese until creamy.
Taste and season with salt and pepper, then garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and clams instead of fresh for significant savings
Use inexpensive white wine or substitute with chicken broth

recipes.name: Linguine ai Frutti di Mare
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook linguine until al dente, then drain and reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and sauté garlic and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes and white wine, bringing to a simmer and cooking for 5 minutes.
Add shrimp to the sauce and cook for 2 minutes, then add clams and mussels, stirring occasionally.
Cover and cook for 6-8 minutes until clams and mussels open, discarding any that remain closed.
Add cooked linguine to the pan with seafood and sauce, tossing gently and adding pasta water as needed to reach desired consistency.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish generously with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen seafood mix instead of individual items
Use canned clams and mussels to reduce cost and prep time

recipes.name: Penne all'Vodka
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook penne until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large pan over medium heat, then sauté garlic and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Carefully pour in vodka and let it simmer for 2 minutes to burn off the alcohol.
Reduce heat to low and stir in heavy cream until fully combined.
Add cooked penne to the sauce and toss gently to coat, heating for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese until melted.
Taste and season with salt and pepper, then garnish with fresh basil and serve.
cheapTips: Use half-and-half instead of heavy cream to save money
Buy the cheapest vodka available since quality doesn't matter when cooking

recipes.name: Orecchiette con Cime di Rapa
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and add broccoli rabe, cooking for 3 minutes until just tender, then remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same pot, cook orecchiette pasta according to package directions until al dente, then drain and reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté minced garlic and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add cooked broccoli rabe and chicken broth to the pan, stirring and heating for 2 minutes.
Add cooked pasta to the pan and toss everything together, adding pasta water as needed to create a light sauce.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese and lemon juice.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and black pepper.
Serve immediately with extra Parmesan cheese on the side.
cheapTips: Buy broccoli rabe when it's in season or look for sales at ethnic markets
Regular broccoli can substitute if broccoli rabe is unavailable

recipes.name: Cannelloni Ricotta e Spinaci
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and spread 0.5 cup marinara sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Mix ricotta cheese, spinach, egg, 0.5 cup Parmesan, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg in a bowl until well combined.
Fill each cannelloni tube with the ricotta mixture using a piping bag or small spoon, placing them seam-side down in the prepared baking dish.
Pour remaining marinara sauce over the cannelloni, covering them completely.
Mix remaining Parmesan cheese with mozzarella and sprinkle evenly over the top.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes, then remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Allow to cool for 5 minutes before serving to prevent filling from running out.
cheapTips: Make your own marinara sauce from canned tomatoes and save significantly
Buy store-brand ricotta and cheese to reduce ingredient costs

recipes.name: Risotto al Barolo
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a separate pot and keep it warm on low heat throughout cooking.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large pan over medium heat, then sauté diced onion and garlic until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add rice and stir constantly for 1 minute until the grains become translucent at the edges.
Pour in Barolo wine and stir frequently until almost completely absorbed, about 3 minutes.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until each addition is mostly absorbed before adding the next, approximately 18-20 minutes total.
Taste a grain of rice—it should be creamy but with a slight firmness in the center when done.
Remove from heat and stir vigorously while adding remaining butter and Parmesan cheese until the risotto becomes creamy and glossy.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute a less expensive red wine if Barolo is unavailable
Buy Arborio rice in bulk from Asian markets for better pricing

recipes.name: Enchiladas Verdes
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat and briefly warm each tortilla to make it pliable, about 10 seconds per side.
Mix salsa verde with crema and chicken broth in a bowl, then pour 1 cup of this mixture into the bottom of the prepared baking dish.
In a separate bowl, combine shredded chicken with 1 cup cheese, minced garlic, half of the cilantro, and salt and pepper to taste.
Dip each warm tortilla in the remaining salsa mixture and place on a plate, then fill with 2-3 tablespoons of the chicken mixture, sprinkle with onion slices, and roll tightly.
Place each rolled enchilada seam-side down in the baking dish over the salsa layer.
Pour any remaining salsa mixture over the enchiladas and sprinkle the remaining cheese evenly on top.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes, then remove foil and bake an additional 10 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with remaining cilantro and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the grocery store to save time and money
Buy store-brand salsa verde instead of name brands

recipes.name: Chiles en Nogada
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place poblano peppers directly over a gas flame or under a broiler until skin is charred all over, then place in a plastic bag for 5 minutes to steam.
Peel away the charred skin from each pepper under cool running water, then carefully make a slit and remove seeds while keeping pepper intact.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté diced onion and garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add ground beef to the pan and cook until browned, breaking it apart with a spoon, then drain excess fat and add diced apple, raisins, and chopped prunes, cooking for 3 minutes.
Stir in chopped pecans and almonds, season with salt and pepper, then remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Carefully fill each roasted poblano with the beef mixture, about 3-4 tablespoons per pepper.
Make the walnut sauce by blending crushed walnuts with Mexican crema, garlic, salt, and a splash of water until smooth and pourable.
Place filled poblanos on a serving platter and pour walnut sauce generously over each pepper.
Garnish with crumbled queso fresco, pomegranate seeds, and fresh cilantro, then serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Substitute sunflower seeds or peanuts for pecans to reduce cost
Use regular pomegranate juice on top if fresh pomegranate is expensive

recipes.name: Mole Poblano
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chicken breasts in a pot with 4 cups broth, quartered onion, and 2 garlic cloves; bring to simmer and cook 25 minutes until cooked through, then shred the chicken and reserve 3 cups broth.
Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles and toast in a dry skillet for 30 seconds until fragrant, then remove and soak in hot water for 15 minutes.
Drain soaked chiles and blend with reserved chicken broth, 3 garlic cloves, cinnamon stick, cloves, cocoa powder, peanut butter, raisins, and ground almonds until completely smooth.
Heat vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat and carefully strain the chile mixture through a fine sieve into the hot oil, stirring constantly for 5 minutes.
Add shredded chicken to the mole sauce and simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, adding more broth if sauce becomes too thick.
Taste and adjust seasonings with salt and pepper.
Transfer mole to a serving dish and garnish with toasted sesame seeds before serving over rice.
cheapTips: Look for dried chile deals at Mexican grocery stores or online
This recipe makes enough to freeze portions for future meals

recipes.name: Tamales
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried corn husks in hot water for 30 minutes to soften, then drain and pat dry.

Beat butter or lard in a large bowl with an electric mixer for 5 minutes until light and fluffy, then gradually add masa harina mixed with baking powder and salt, alternating with chicken broth until dough is light and spreadable.
Test dough by dropping a small piece in cold water—if it floats, it's ready; if not, beat longer.
Lay a softened corn husk flat, spread 2 tablespoons of masa dough in the center, then top with 1 tablespoon shredded chicken, 1 tablespoon salsa, a few jalapeño slices, and a small piece of cheese.
Fold the sides of the corn husk over the filling, then fold up the bottom, leaving the top open (this is the traditional shape).
Stand tamales upright in a steamer pot with water below a steamer rack, packing them snugly together with open ends up.
Cover the tamales with extra corn husks and a damp cloth, then cover the pot and steam over boiling water for 45 minutes.
Remove from heat and let sit covered for 5 minutes before carefully removing tamales from steamer.
Serve hot with additional salsa on the side.
cheapTips: Buy masa harina in bulk at Mexican markets instead of grocery stores
Make a large batch and freeze uncooked tamales for quick future meals

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized cubes.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken until golden and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Pour sauce over cooked chicken and simmer for 3-4 minutes until sauce thickens.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.
Serve over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken on sale and freeze it in portions
Use honey or brown sugar as mirin substitute

recipes.name: Teppanyaki
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet or griddle over high heat and add 1 tablespoon vegetable oil.
Cook beef until browned, then set aside on a plate.
Add remaining oil and butter, then cook onions and zucchini until softened.
Return beef to the pan with mushrooms and garlic.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil together and pour over ingredients.
Toss everything together and cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Serve immediately with steamed rice or noodles.
cheapTips: Use round steak instead of sirloin for savings
Buy vegetables on sale and prep ahead

recipes.name: Miso Soup
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat dashi stock in a pot over medium heat until steaming but not boiling.
Add wakame seaweed and simmer for 2 minutes.
Place miso paste in a small bowl and dissolve it with some warm dashi.
Pour dissolved miso back into the pot and stir well.
Add tofu cubes and simmer for 2 more minutes.
Pour into bowls and garnish with green onion and nori strips.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Make dashi from kombu and bonito flakes instead of buying instant
Buy miso in bulk and store in the freezer

recipes.name: Tamagoyaki
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Beat eggs in a bowl with soy sauce, mirin, dashi, and sugar until well combined.
Strain the mixture through a fine sieve.
Heat oil in a rectangular tamagoyaki pan or small skillet over medium heat.
Pour a thin layer of egg mixture into the pan.
When edges are set but center is still wet, roll the omelet toward you using chopsticks or a spatula.
Push the roll to the far end and add more egg mixture, rolling again.
Repeat rolling 3-4 times until all mixture is used, then cut into pieces and serve.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk at warehouse stores
Use regular sugar instead of special sweeteners

recipes.name: Edamame
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a pot.
Add frozen edamame and return to a boil.
Cook for 5-6 minutes until beans are tender.
Drain well in a colander.
Toss with sesame seeds and garlic powder while still warm.
Transfer to a serving bowl and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy large frozen bags instead of small packages
Skip garnishes or use basic salt only for cheapest option

recipes.name: Takoyaki
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, eggs, and dashi stock to create a smooth batter.
Heat takoyaki pan over medium-high heat and coat each mold with oil.
Pour batter into molds, filling about halfway.
Place a piece of octopus, green onion, and pickled ginger in each mold.
Top with more batter to fill each mold completely.
Using takoyaki picks or skewers, rotate each ball constantly to achieve round shape, about 8-10 minutes.
When golden brown, remove and place in a serving dish.
Drizzle with takoyaki sauce and sprinkle bonito flakes on top to serve.
cheapTips: Use frozen octopus instead of fresh
Buy takoyaki pan and supplies once for repeated use

recipes.name: Yakisoba
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook soba noodles according to package directions, then drain and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat.
Cook chicken until no longer pink, about 4-5 minutes.
Add cabbage and carrots, stir-frying for 3-4 minutes until slightly softened.
Add cooked noodles and garlic to the pan.
Pour soy sauce and mirin over everything and toss well for 2 minutes.
Transfer to serving plates, garnish with green onion and bonito flakes, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use ramen noodles if soba is unavailable
Buy shredded cabbage pre-packaged to save time

recipes.name: Tonkotsu Ramen
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch pork bones and chicken in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain and rinse thoroughly.
Place cleaned bones and chicken in a large pot with 3 quarts of fresh water and kombu.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2-3 hours, skimming impurities.
Remove bones and chicken, add pork belly and simmer for 30 more minutes.
Strain broth and season with soy sauce and mirin.
Boil eggs for 6-7 minutes, then peel and halve.
Cook ramen noodles according to package directions and drain.
Divide noodles into bowls, pour hot broth over, top with pork belly, egg halves, nori, and green onion.
cheapTips: Use instant ramen noodles instead of fresh
Simmer broth in slow cooker overnight to reduce active cooking time

recipes.name: Karaage
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Marinate chicken pieces in this mixture for at least 30 minutes.
Mix flour and cornstarch together in another bowl.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep pot or fryer.
Pat chicken dry and coat completely in flour mixture.
Fry chicken in batches for 5-6 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze in portions
Reuse cooking oil by straining through cheesecloth

recipes.name: Nikujaga
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown ground beef, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks.
Add onions and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots, stirring to combine.
Pour in dashi stock, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Add green peas in the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Serve hot as a rice bowl topping or as a standalone dish.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk and divide into portions
Use frozen peas instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Chirashi
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook sushi rice according to package directions.
Mix rice vinegar, sugar, and salt together, then fold into the warm cooked rice until combined.
Beat eggs and cook in a pan over medium heat, stirring gently to create thin scrambled strands, then set aside.
Cut cucumber into thin sticks, slice carrot into thin matchsticks, and cut crab stick into bite-sized pieces.
Divide seasoned rice between two bowls and arrange cooked egg, cucumber, carrot, and crab in rows on top.
Cut nori sheets into thin strips and sprinkle over the bowl.
Drizzle soy sauce over the entire bowl and garnish with sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Use imitation crab instead of real crab to reduce cost
Buy sushi rice in bulk as a staple

recipes.name: Green Curry
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons of coconut milk in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add curry paste and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add remaining coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and add to the curry, cooking for 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
Add diced eggplant or zucchini and cook for 5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Season with fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice.
Stir in fresh basil just before serving.
Serve over cooked jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy curry paste in Asian markets for better prices
Use affordable vegetables like zucchini or bell peppers

recipes.name: Tom Yum Goong
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Bruise lemongrass stalks and add to broth along with galangal and lime leaves.
Simmer for 5 minutes to infuse flavors.
Add shrimp and cook for 3-4 minutes until pink.
Add sliced mushrooms and halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Add sliced Thai chilies for heat if desired.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp to save money
Buy dried lemongrass and lime leaves in bulk

recipes.name: Pad Krapow Moo
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook jasmine rice and set aside.
Mince garlic and chilies together.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add minced garlic and chilies, stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add ground pork and break it apart while cooking for 5-7 minutes until fully cooked.
Add soy sauce, fish sauce, and brown sugar, stirring to combine.
Tear basil leaves by hand and add to the pork, tossing quickly for 30 seconds.
Serve over rice with a fried egg on top if desired.
cheapTips: Use regular basil from the produce section if holy basil is unavailable
Buy ground pork on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Larb
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast rice in a dry pan over medium heat for 3-4 minutes until golden, then grind into powder using a mortar or spice grinder.
Mince garlic and cook in a large pan over medium-high heat until fragrant.
Add ground meat and cook until fully cooked and browned, breaking apart as it cooks.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Stir in lime juice, fish sauce, and dried chilies.
Add rice powder and mix well to combine.
Chop mint, cilantro, and green onions, and stir into the meat mixture.
Serve on lettuce leaves as wraps with diced red onion on the side.
cheapTips: Use chicken instead of pork for lower cost
Buy herbs from an Asian market for better prices

recipes.name: Massaman Curry
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons of coconut milk in a large pot over medium heat.
Add curry paste and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Cut beef into chunks and add to the curry, stirring to coat.
Add remaining coconut milk and broth, bringing to a simmer.
Cut potatoes into chunks and onion into wedges, then add to the pot.
Simmer for 25-30 minutes until meat is tender and potatoes are cooked.
Stir in peanut butter, fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice.
Simmer for another 5 minutes and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze it
Use natural peanut butter from bulk bins

recipes.name: Panang Curry
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 3 tablespoons of coconut milk in a large pan over medium heat.
Add curry paste and fry for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in remaining coconut milk and stir to combine.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and add to the curry.
Simmer for 12-15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Cut bell pepper into strips and add along with drained bamboo shoots.
Cook for another 5 minutes until pepper is tender-crisp.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar.
Garnish with crushed peanuts and basil before serving.
cheapTips: Buy canned bamboo shoots instead of fresh
Use frozen bell peppers to reduce cost

recipes.name: Pad Phed
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Mince garlic and add to hot oil, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add curry paste and fry for 1 minute.
Cut chicken into thin strips and add to the pan, cooking for 5 minutes until mostly cooked.
Cut onion into wedges and long beans into 2-inch pieces, then add to the pan.
Stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp and chicken is cooked through.
Season with fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice.
Serve over jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Use frozen long beans to save money
Buy chicken breast on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Som Tam
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound garlic and chilies in a mortar with a pestle until bruised.
Add green beans and tomatoes, lightly bruising to release juices.
Add shredded green papaya and toss gently to combine.
Pour lime juice and fish sauce over the salad.
Add brown sugar and mix everything together gently.
Transfer to a serving plate and top with crushed peanuts.
Add dried shrimp if desired and toss before serving.
cheapTips: Buy green papaya at Asian markets for better prices
Omit dried shrimp to reduce cost

recipes.name: Satay
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Cut chicken breast into strips about 1/2 inch thick and 4 inches long.
Thread chicken strips onto skewers.
Brush skewers with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill or broil skewers for 6-8 minutes, turning halfway, until cooked through.
For peanut sauce, blend peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, lime juice, minced garlic, brown sugar, and cayenne pepper until smooth.
Heat sauce gently in a small saucepan but do not boil.
Serve skewers hot with warm peanut sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale and marinate ahead
Use natural peanut butter from bulk bins

recipes.name: Elote
recipes.description: Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook corn for 8-10 minutes until tender.
Remove corn and let cool slightly, then pat dry with paper towels.
Mix mayonnaise, chili powder, and minced cilantro in a small bowl.
Brush the mayo mixture generously over each ear of corn.
Roll coated corn in crumbled cotija cheese until fully coated.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over each ear and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular feta cheese if cotija is unavailable
Buy corn when in season for best prices

recipes.name: Birria
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles and toast in a dry skillet for 1 minute.
Soak toasted chiles in hot water for 10 minutes until soft.
Blend soaked chiles with garlic, onion, cumin, oregano, cinnamon, and vinegar until smooth.
Strain chile mixture through a fine sieve into a pot and add beef broth.
Cut beef into large chunks, add to broth, bring to boil then simmer covered for 2.5 hours until meat shreds easily.
Shred beef with two forks and return to pot, simmer 15 more minutes.
Warm tortillas and dip in hot broth, then fill with shredded beef and diced onion.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze until needed
Make large batch and freeze portions for later

recipes.name: Mofles
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and anise seeds in a large bowl.
Whisk together egg, milk, melted butter, and vanilla in a separate bowl.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until smooth batter forms.
Preheat mofle iron or waffle maker and brush with butter.
Pour batter into hot iron and cook until golden brown, about 4-5 minutes.
Transfer cooked mofles to a plate and drizzle generously with honey or warm piloncillo syrup.
cheapTips: Use regular sugar if piloncillo unavailable
Make batter night before and refrigerate

recipes.name: Peking Duck
recipes.description: Beijing dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat duck dry and prick skin all over with fork without piercing meat, then hang in cool place for 1 hour.
Mix honey, soy sauce, vinegar, five-spice, garlic, and ginger in a bowl and brush over duck skin.
Place duck breast-side up on roasting rack over water in a 450°F oven.
Roast for 25 minutes, then reduce heat to 350°F and continue roasting 1 hour until skin is crispy and meat cooked through.
Let duck rest 10 minutes, then slice skin and meat thinly with a sharp knife.
Warm pancakes according to package directions.
Serve duck slices with pancakes, green onion, cucumber, and hoisin sauce for wrapping.
cheapTips: Buy duck from Asian markets for better prices
Save bones for making rich stock

recipes.name: Chow Mein
recipes.description: Cantonese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Stir-fry pork until cooked through, about 5 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry garlic, ginger, and vegetables for 3-4 minutes.
Return pork to wok with cooked noodles and add soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil.
Toss everything together over high heat for 2 minutes until heated through.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use leftover cooked meat or vegetables
Buy noodles in bulk at Asian markets

recipes.name: Fried Rice
recipes.description: Cantonese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Beat eggs in a bowl with a fork.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Scramble eggs until cooked, then push to the side and remove from wok.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry garlic for 30 seconds.
Add rice and break up clumps, stir-frying for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in peas, carrots, soy sauce, white pepper, and cooked eggs.
Toss everything for 2 minutes, finish with sesame oil and green onions.
cheapTips: Use leftover rice from previous meals
Buy frozen vegetables instead of fresh

recipes.name: Dim Sum
recipes.description: Cantonese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork, shrimp, bamboo shoots, garlic, green onion, soy sauce, sesame oil, and cornstarch in a bowl.
Place 1 teaspoon filling in center of each wonton wrapper.
Wet wrapper edges with water, fold into triangle, then bring two corners together and pinch to seal.
Bring a large pot of water to boil and gently drop wontons in batches of 6-8.
Once wontons float, cook for 2 more minutes and transfer to serving bowl with broth.
Alternatively, steam wontons in a bamboo steamer for 6-8 minutes for a lighter version.
Serve hot with chili oil and soy sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy wonton wrappers frozen in bulk at Asian markets
Make filling ahead and freeze wontons for later

recipes.name: Hot Pot
recipes.description: Sichuan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring beef broth to a boil in a hot pot or large shallow skillet at the table.
Add dried chilis, Sichuan peppercorns, ginger slices, and garlic, then reduce to medium heat.
Arrange all raw ingredients on a platter around the pot.
Each diner picks ingredients and dips them in the hot broth until cooked, 30 seconds to 2 minutes.
Mix soy sauce and sesame oil in individual bowls for dipping sauce.
Continue cooking and eating until all ingredients are consumed.
The remaining broth can be enjoyed as soup at the end.
cheapTips: Use vegetable broth instead of beef to reduce cost
Buy pre-sliced mushrooms and vegetables from salad bar

recipes.name: Mongolian Beef
recipes.description: Northern Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss beef slices with cornstarch until coated.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until very hot.
Cook beef in batches 2-3 minutes until browned, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry ginger and garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return beef to wok and add soy sauce, brown sugar, and red pepper flakes.
Toss everything together for 2 minutes until beef is coated and sauce thickens.
Finish with green onions and sesame seeds, then serve over rice.
cheapTips: Use less expensive beef like round steak if flank is too pricey
Make double batch and freeze extra

recipes.name: Orange Chicken
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss chicken pieces with 1 tablespoon cornstarch and salt to coat.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken in batches until golden and cooked through, about 4-5 minutes per batch, then remove.
In same pan add remaining oil, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes, stirring for 30 seconds.
Whisk together orange juice, orange zest, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and remaining cornstarch.
Pour sauce into pan and bring to a simmer, stirring constantly until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Return chicken to pan, toss to coat with sauce, and cook 1 minute more.
Garnish with green onions and serve over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use bottled orange juice concentrate in place of fresh
Substitute chicken thighs which are cheaper and stay juicy

recipes.name: Soba
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil and cook soba noodles according to package directions until tender.
Drain noodles and rinse with cold water until cooled completely.
In a saucepan, combine dashi stock, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar, then bring to a simmer for 2 minutes.
Divide noodles between two bowls and pour the warm dipping sauce into separate small bowls.
Top noodles with sliced green onions and nori strips.
Stir wasabi into the dipping sauce and serve alongside the noodles for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy soba noodles in bulk from Asian markets for significant savings
Make your own dashi with kombu and bonito flakes instead of premade stock

recipes.name: Donburi
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and cut onion into thin wedges.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add sliced chicken, cooking until nearly done.
Add onion slices to the pan with the chicken.
Pour dashi stock, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar into the pan and simmer for 5 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Beat eggs in a bowl and slowly pour into the pan while stirring to create egg ribbons.
Divide rice between two bowls and top with the chicken and egg mixture.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for more flavor at lower cost
Buy day-old rice for best results and lower cost

recipes.name: Gyudon
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onion into thin half-moons.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add sliced onion to the beef and cook for 2 minutes until softened.
Pour in dashi stock, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Divide rice between two bowls and top with the beef and onion mixture.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use regular onions instead of sweet onions to save money

recipes.name: Katsudon
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat pork cutlets dry and pound with a meat mallet until thin and even thickness.
Set up three shallow bowls: one with flour, one with beaten egg, one with panko breadcrumbs.
Coat each cutlet with flour, then dip in egg, then press into panko breadcrumbs until fully coated.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and fry cutlets for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown, then drain on paper towels and slice into strips.
Slice onion and simmer in a sauce made from dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar for 3 minutes.
Divide rice between two bowls and arrange pork cutlet slices on top.
Pour the onion sauce over the cutlets and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder and slice into cutlets yourself for cheaper option
Reuse cooking oil by straining through cheesecloth

recipes.name: Oyakodon
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice chicken into bite-sized pieces and cut onion into thin wedges.
In a pan, combine dashi stock, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar, then bring to a simmer.
Add chicken and onion slices to the simmering broth and cook for 5 minutes until chicken is nearly cooked through.
In a bowl, beat 3 eggs and slowly pour into the pan while stirring gently to create ribbons, leaving some egg partially cooked.
Beat the remaining egg and pour over the top without stirring so it stays in a layer.
Remove from heat when eggs are just set but still slightly runny, after about 1-2 minutes.
Divide rice between two bowls and carefully slide the chicken and egg mixture on top.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk during sales and store in refrigerator
Use inexpensive chicken breast from budget grocery stores

recipes.name: Okonomiyaki
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, and water until smooth batter forms.
Fold shredded cabbage into the batter until evenly coated.
Heat oil in a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Pour half the batter onto the skillet and shape into a thick pancake about 8 inches across.
Arrange 2 slices of pork belly on top of the batter.
Cook for 5-6 minutes until the bottom is golden, then carefully flip and cook another 4-5 minutes.
Transfer to a plate and drizzle with okonomiyaki sauce and mayonnaise in a crosshatch pattern.
Sprinkle bonito flakes and aonori powder on top and serve hot.
Repeat with remaining batter and pork belly for second okonomiyaki.
cheapTips: Make your own okonomiyaki sauce by mixing ketchup, Worcestershire, and soy sauce
Skip the pork and make vegetarian version with mushrooms and cheese

recipes.name: Yakitori
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken thighs into 1.5-inch cubes and chicken liver into chunks.
Cut green onions into 1.5-inch pieces.
In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, mirin, sugar, sake, minced garlic, and ginger, then simmer for 3 minutes to make yakitori glaze.
