Thread chicken pieces and green onions alternately onto wooden skewers that have been soaked in water.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat and cook skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush skewers generously with yakitori glaze during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Arrange on a plate and drizzle any remaining glaze over the skewers before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale in bulk and freeze for later
Omit chicken liver if unavailable and use all thighs instead

recipes.name: Sukiyaki
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice carrot into thin matchsticks and onion into thick wedges, then chop napa cabbage and slice green onions.
Cut tofu into 1-inch cubes and slice mushrooms in half.
In a bowl, combine soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and dashi stock for the sukiyaki broth.
Heat a large shallow pan or sukiyaki pot over medium-high heat and quickly sear beef slices until lightly cooked, then remove to a plate.
Arrange prepared vegetables and tofu in sections around the pan.
Pour the sukiyaki broth over all ingredients and simmer for 8-10 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Return beef slices to the pan and simmer 2 more minutes.
Beat eggs into small bowls and serve as a dipping sauce for each piece of meat and vegetables.
cheapTips: Ask the butcher to slice beef thin or partially freeze first and use a sharp knife
Buy pre-cut vegetables from grocery store salad section to save prep time

recipes.name: Shabu-shabu
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice carrot into thin matchsticks, chop napa cabbage into bite-sized pieces, and slice green onions diagonally.
Cut tofu into 1-inch cubes and slice mushrooms in half.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot and add kombu seaweed to infuse flavor.
Arrange beef slices, vegetables, and tofu on a platter around the simmering pot at the table.
Each diner picks ingredients and dips them into the hot broth for a few seconds until cooked.
Mix ponzu sauce with sesame seeds to create dipping sauce for cooked pieces.
Continue cooking and eating until all ingredients are consumed.
At the end, pour remaining broth into bowls and enjoy as soup.
cheapTips: Skip kombu and use vegetable broth to reduce cost and prep time
Buy cheaper cuts of beef and partially freeze them before slicing thin

recipes.name: Unagi
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat eel fillets completely dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook eel skin-side down for 2-3 minutes until crispy, then flip and cook flesh side 1 minute until just cooked through.
In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, mirin, sugar, sake, water, minced ginger, and minced garlic.
Simmer the sauce for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened, then taste and adjust sweetness with more sugar if needed.
Brush the cooked eel generously with the glaze on both sides.
Return glazed eel to the skillet skin-side up and cook 1 more minute to set the glaze.
Divide rice between two bowls and carefully place glazed eel on top.
Drizzle remaining glaze over the eel and garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.
cheapTips: Buy frozen eel fillets which are significantly cheaper than fresh
Make glaze in large batches and freeze in ice cube trays

recipes.name: Chow Fun
recipes.description: Cantonese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat and add 2 tbsp oil.
Stir-fry the shrimp or chicken until cooked through, about 4 minutes, then remove to a plate.
Add remaining oil and garlic to the wok, stirring until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the rice noodles and break them apart gently while stirring for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, mixing well to coat the noodles.
Return the cooked protein to the wok and add bean sprouts and green onions, tossing everything together for 1 minute.
Drizzle with sesame oil and toss once more before serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk and thaw as needed to save money.
Use chicken thighs instead of shrimp for a cheaper protein option.

recipes.name: Wonton Noodles
recipes.description: Cantonese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork with half the green onions, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Place 1 tsp filling in the center of each wonton wrapper and fold into a triangle, then bring corners together.
Bring a pot of water to boil and cook wontons until they float plus 2 more minutes, then set aside.
In another pot, bring broth to a simmer with ginger, garlic, and remaining soy sauce.
Cook noodles separately according to package directions and drain well.
Add bok choy to the broth and simmer for 2 minutes.
Divide noodles into bowls, add wontons and greens, then pour hot broth over top and garnish with remaining green onions.
cheapTips: Make extra wontons and freeze them for quick meals later.
Use store-bought broth instead of making your own to save time.

recipes.name: Ants Climbing a Tree
recipes.description: Sichuan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak cellophane noodles in hot water for 8 minutes until softened, then drain well.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat.
Add ground pork and break it apart as it cooks, about 4-5 minutes until no pink remains.
Stir in garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chili paste, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, and water, stirring to combine.
Add the softened noodles to the pan and toss everything together for 2-3 minutes until heated through and well coated.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions.
Chili paste lasts a long time, so one jar covers many meals.

recipes.name: Mapo Eggplant
recipes.description: Sichuan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplant into 2-inch chunks and heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat.
Fry eggplant in batches until golden and tender, about 8 minutes total, then set aside.
Add remaining oil and cook ground pork over high heat, breaking it apart until browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in bean paste, garlic, and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return eggplant to the wok and add soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and water.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly.
Garnish with Sichuan peppercorns and green onions, then serve with rice.
cheapTips: Buy eggplant when in season for better prices.
One jar of bean paste makes multiple recipes, so cost per use is low.

recipes.name: Soy Sauce Chicken
recipes.description: Cantonese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil and blanch the chicken for 3 minutes, then drain and rinse under cool water.
In the same pot, combine soy sauce, water, sugar, ginger, garlic, green onions, star anise, and cinnamon.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then add the blanched chicken and reduce heat to medium-low.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes, turning the chicken halfway through to ensure even coloring.
Remove the chicken and let it cool slightly, then drizzle with sesame oil.
Slice or cut the chicken into pieces and serve with the soy sauce broth spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens when on sale and freeze until ready to use.
Reuse the braising liquid for soups or to cook rice for extra flavor.

recipes.name: Tonkatsu
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound pork chops with a meat mallet until about 0.5 inches thick, then season both sides with salt and pepper.
Set up three shallow dishes with flour in one, beaten eggs in another, and panko in the third.
Coat each pork chop in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, and finally coat thoroughly with panko, pressing gently.
Heat oil in a deep skillet or wok to 350°F and carefully place breaded pork chops in the oil.
Fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through, then drain on paper towels.
Slice the tonkatsu into strips and serve over shredded cabbage, drizzled with tonkatsu sauce and garnished with green onions and a lemon wedge.
cheapTips: Make your own tonkatsu sauce with ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, and soy sauce.
Buy pork chops on sale and freeze until ready to cook.

recipes.name: Tempura
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Add ice water to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined; the batter should be lumpy and cold.
Heat oil in a deep skillet or wok to 350°F.
Pat shrimp or fish dry and vegetables dry, then dip each piece into the batter.
Fry battered items in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until light golden, then drain on paper towels.
Serve immediately with tempura dipping sauce on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Use a mix of cheaper vegetables like zucchini and regular potatoes instead of all premium ingredients.
Buy shrimp frozen in bulk for better pricing.

recipes.name: Sashimi
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat the sushi-grade fish completely dry with paper towels.
Using a sharp knife and light pressure, slice the fish against the grain into 0.25-inch thick pieces.
Arrange fish slices on a plate in slightly overlapping pattern over a bed of daikon slices.
Serve alongside small bowls of soy sauce and wasabi with pickled ginger on the side.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over the fish and add a squeeze of lemon juice just before eating.
cheapTips: Buy sashimi-grade fish from warehouse clubs like Costco for better prices.
Make this when fish is on sale, as quality matters more than quantity here.

recipes.name: Ramen
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a small pot of water to boil and carefully lower in eggs, simmer for 6-7 minutes for soft-boiled, then ice bath and peel.
In a large pot, bring broth to a simmer and add garlic, ginger, soy sauce, mirin, and sake, cooking for 5 minutes.
Cook ramen noodles in a separate pot according to package directions, then drain and divide into serving bowls.
Pour hot broth into bowls over the noodles.
Top each bowl with a halved soft-boiled egg, green onions, bean sprouts, and nori strips.
Serve immediately while broth is hot.
cheapTips: Use store-bought broth instead of homemade to save significant time.
Buy ramen noodle packs in bulk; they're inexpensive and store well.

recipes.name: Udon
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a pot of water to boil and cook udon noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
In another pot, bring dashi broth to a simmer over medium heat.
Add soy sauce, mirin, and sugar to the broth, stirring until combined.
Add ginger slices and simmer for 2 minutes.
Divide cooked noodles into serving bowls and pour hot broth over them.
Top with green onions, kamaboko slices, nori, and tempura if using, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip the kamaboko and tempura for a cheaper version, or add them when on sale.
Use regular chicken broth instead of dashi to reduce costs.

recipes.name: Tacos al Pastor
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from guajillo and ancho chiles, then toast them in a dry skillet for 1 minute.
Boil the toasted chiles in 1 cup water for 5 minutes until softened, then blend with garlic, vinegar, cumin, and oregano into a smooth marinade.
Cut pork shoulder into 1/4-inch thick slices and coat completely with the chile marinade, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook marinated pork in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Chop fresh pineapple into small chunks and warm in the same skillet with the pork for the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side until pliable.
Assemble tacos by filling each tortilla with pork-pineapple mixture, diced onion, and fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for later use
Substitute dried chiles with bottled chile powder if unavailable

recipes.name: Pescado a la Veracruzana
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion and garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add sliced jalapeño, cumin, and bay leaf, then cook for 1 minute more.
Pour in canned tomatoes with juice and bring to a simmer, then add olives and capers and stir well.
Arrange fish fillets in the sauce and reduce heat to medium-low, then cover and simmer for 10-12 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the fish and taste sauce for seasoning, adjusting salt as needed.
Serve the fish topped with the warm tomato-olive sauce and pan juices.
cheapTips: Use frozen fish fillets which are often cheaper than fresh
Buy large cans of olives and capers to divide cost

recipes.name: Mofongo
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel plantains by slicing off ends and cutting along the skin, then cut into 1-inch thick rounds.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry plantain pieces for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and tender.
Remove plantains with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels, reserving the oil.
In a mortar and pestle, mash garlic with salt into a paste, then add the fried plantains and mash until chunky but combined.
Heat the reserved garlic oil in a small pan and pour over the mofongo mixture while folding gently.
Warm chicken broth separately and serve the mofongo mound in a bowl with warm broth on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy plantains in bulk when on sale and freeze extras
Use homemade or store-brand broth instead of fresh

recipes.name: Ropa Vieja
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sear the beef flank steak on both sides for 3 minutes per side until browned.
Remove beef and set aside, then sauté minced garlic and diced onion in the same pot for 2 minutes until softened.
Add cumin, oregano, and bay leaves, then cook for 1 minute to bloom the spices.
Pour in beef broth and tomato sauce, stirring well, then return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours until beef is very tender and shreds easily with a fork.
Remove beef from the pot and shred into thin strips using two forks, discarding any fat.
Slice bell peppers into thin strips and add to the pot with the shredded beef, then simmer for 10 more minutes until peppers are tender-crisp.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the dish and taste for salt and pepper, adjusting as needed before serving.
cheapTips: Buy flank steak on sale and freeze for later cooking
Use generic canned tomato sauce instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Arroz con Pollo
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and season chicken thighs with salt and pepper, then sear skin-side down for 5 minutes until golden.
Flip chicken and cook for another 3 minutes, then remove and set aside on a plate.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion and bell pepper for 3 minutes until softened, then add minced garlic and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add rice to the pot and stir constantly for 2 minutes to coat with oil, then pour in chicken broth and tomato sauce.
Stir in saffron threads and return the chicken thighs to the pot skin-side up, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Stir in frozen peas, cover again, and let sit for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork and serving.
cheapTips: Skip saffron and use a pinch of turmeric for similar color at lower cost
Buy chicken thighs in bulk and freeze for meal prep

recipes.name: Chuletas de Puerco
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine lime juice, orange juice, minced garlic, cumin, and oregano in a bowl to make the marinade.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and season on both sides with salt and pepper.
Place pork chops in a shallow dish and pour marinade over them, turning to coat evenly, then let sit for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Remove pork chops from marinade and place in the hot skillet, reserving the marinade, then cook for 5-6 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Pour reserved marinade into the skillet around the pork chops and let simmer for 2 minutes to reduce slightly and coat the meat.
Transfer pork chops to a serving plate and spoon any pan sauce over them before serving.
cheapTips: Buy pork chops when on sale and freeze in individual portions
Substitute bottled lime and orange juice to save prep time

recipes.name: Tostadas
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry each corn tortilla for 30 seconds per side until crispy and golden, then drain on paper towels.
In the same skillet (without adding oil), brown ground beef over medium heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, for about 5 minutes until no pink remains.
Add taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water to the cooked beef, stir well, and simmer for 2 minutes until thickened.
Warm refried beans in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Spread a thin layer of warm refried beans on each crispy tortilla, then top with seasoned ground beef.
Layer lettuce, diced tomato, and shredded cheese on each tostada.
Serve with sour cream and salsa on the side, letting each person add toppings to taste.
cheapTips: Make tostadas ahead by frying and storing tortillas in an airtight container
Use store-brand ground beef and canned beans to reduce costs

recipes.name: Flautas
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix shredded chicken with refried beans, diced onion, 1/2 cup cheese, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Warm flour tortillas in a dry skillet for 20 seconds per side to make them pliable and easier to roll.
Place about 3 tablespoons of filling in the center of each tortilla and roll tightly, tucking in the sides, then place seam-side down on a plate.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 350°F (a piece of tortilla should sizzle immediately when dropped in).
Carefully place flautas seam-side down in the hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes until golden brown, then turn and fry the other side for another 2 minutes until crispy.
Remove flautas with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels, then sprinkle with remaining cheese while still hot.
Serve flautas topped with sour cream and salsa on the side.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the grocery store to save prep time
Buy cheese in bulk and shred it at home instead of pre-shredded

recipes.name: Sopes
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix masa harina, warm water, and salt together in a bowl until a soft dough forms, then let rest for 5 minutes.
Divide dough into 8 equal portions and form into balls, then flatten each into a 3-inch disk about 1/4-inch thick on plastic wrap.

Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and carefully slide each masa disk into the hot oil, cooking for 1-2 minutes until lightly golden, then flip and cook the other side for 1 minute.
Remove sopes and immediately pinch up the edges to form a slight wall around the perimeter while still warm and pliable.
Spread a spoonful of warm refried beans on top of each sope, then layer with shredded chicken.
Top each sope with shredded lettuce, crumbled queso fresco, and a dollop of sour cream, then drizzle with salsa.
cheapTips: Buy masa harina in bulk for significant savings on repeated recipes
Use rotisserie chicken to save time and reduce overall prep

recipes.name: Chacales
recipes.description: Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Stack flour tortillas and cut into 6 wedges (like pizza slices) to create 36 pieces total.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 350°F (a small piece of tortilla should sizzle immediately when dropped in).
Carefully place tortilla pieces in the hot oil in small batches, about 10-12 pieces at a time, and fry for 1-2 minutes until light golden and crispy, stirring gently.
Remove chacales with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
While still warm, toss the fried tortilla pieces with a mixture of powdered sugar and ground cinnamon in a shallow bowl.
Transfer to a serving plate and enjoy warm as a sweet snack.
cheapTips: Use store-brand flour tortillas for the lowest cost
Make a large batch and store in an airtight container for up to 3 days

recipes.name: Pozole Rojo
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil pork shoulder with half the onion and salt in 8 cups water for 1.5 hours until very tender.
Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles, soak in hot water for 15 minutes until softened.
Blend soaked chiles with garlic, cumin, and 1 cup of their soaking liquid until smooth.
Strain chile mixture through a fine sieve into the pork broth.
Add drained hominy and simmer for 20 minutes to meld flavors.
Shred pork with two forks and return to pot.
Season with salt and lime juice, serve in bowls with diced onion and lime wedges.
Garnish with shredded cabbage, radishes, and tostadas if desired.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze; use canned hominy instead of dried.
Make dried chile paste in bulk and freeze for future pozole batches.

recipes.name: Cochinita Pibil
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix achiote paste with orange juice, lime juice, garlic, cumin, cloves, and salt to form a paste.
Rub paste all over pork shoulder, cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Preheat oven to 325°F and line a baking dish with banana leaves.
Place marinated pork in center, fold banana leaves over it, and cover tightly with foil.
Bake for 4.5 to 5 hours until pork shreds easily with a fork.
Remove from oven, let cool slightly, and shred pork into bite-sized pieces.
Strain cooking liquid and drizzle over shredded pork.
Serve on warm tortillas with diced red onion and cilantro.
cheapTips: Achiote paste is pricey; buy from Latin markets for better prices.
Make double batch and freeze portions for future quick meals.

recipes.name: Carne Asada
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine lime juice, orange juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, olive oil, and sliced jalapeños in a blender and puree.
Place skirt steak in a zip-top bag and pour marinade over it, seal and refrigerate for 4-8 hours.
Remove steak from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking and preheat grill to high heat.
Grill steak 5-7 minutes per side for medium-rare, basting occasionally with leftover marinade.
Rest meat for 10 minutes, then slice against the grain into quarter-inch strips.
Warm tortillas on the grill briefly, then fill with carne asada.
Serve with diced onion, cilantro, lime wedges, and salsa.
cheapTips: Buy skirt steak when on sale and freeze; flank steak is a cheaper substitute.
Make citrus marinade with juice from grocery store clearance citrus.

recipes.name: Barbacoa
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from chipotle and ancho chiles, soak in hot water for 15 minutes.
Toast cumin seeds in a dry skillet for 1 minute until fragrant, then grind coarsely.
Blend soaked chiles with garlic, cumin, vinegar, and 1 cup broth until smooth.
Sear beef chuck roast on all sides in a Dutch oven over high heat until browned.
Pour chile mixture and remaining broth over roast, add bay leaves, cover and transfer to 325°F oven.
Braise for 5-6 hours until meat pulls apart very easily with a fork.
Remove meat and shred finely, strain braising liquid and drizzle over meat.
Serve in warm tortillas with diced onion, cilantro, and lime.
cheapTips: Chuck roast goes on sale frequently; buy and freeze for this dish.
Use homemade or store-bought beef broth; bouillon cubes work too.

recipes.name: Chile Colorado
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into 1.5-inch cubes and brown in a large pot over medium-high heat until golden on all sides.
Remove stems and seeds from guajillo and ancho chiles, toast in a dry pan for 1 minute, then soak in hot water for 15 minutes.
Blend soaked chiles with garlic, cumin, oregano, and 1.5 cups soaking liquid until completely smooth.
Strain chile sauce through a fine sieve into the pot with beef.
Add beef broth and diced onion, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 1.5 hours until beef is very tender.
Season with salt to taste and adjust consistency with more broth if needed.
Serve in bowls with warm tortillas and diced raw onion and cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy dried chiles in bulk at Latin markets for significant savings.
Use beef chuck roast on sale; it gets more tender the longer it braises.

recipes.name: Chilaquiles
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté diced onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add salsa roja to the skillet and simmer for 3 minutes, then stir in chicken broth.
Add tortilla chips and shredded chicken, toss gently for 2-3 minutes until chips are slightly softened but still have texture.
Drizzle sour cream over the top and sprinkle with shredded cheese, toss gently to combine.
Make 4 small wells in the chilaquiles mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Cover skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes until eggs reach desired doneness.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately with extra sour cream and salsa on the side.
cheapTips: Use store-brand salsa and rotisserie chicken for quick budget-friendly prep.
Stale tortilla chips work perfectly and are sometimes cheaper.

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for 1 minute per side, then place on plates.
Heat olive oil in the same skillet and sauté minced garlic and onion for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add salsa roja to the skillet and simmer for 3 minutes, then add warm pinto beans and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour bean and salsa mixture over tortillas on the plates and keep warm.
In the same skillet, crack eggs one at a time and fry sunny-side up or to preferred doneness.
Place two fried eggs on top of each tortilla and bean mixture.
Sprinkle with shredded cheese and fresh cilantro, season with salt and pepper, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use canned beans instead of dried; cheaper and faster.
Store-brand salsa and cheese work perfectly fine.

recipes.name: Tinga de Pollo
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil chicken breasts in broth with half the onion and salt for 15 minutes until cooked through, then shred and reserve broth.
Remove stems and seeds from chipotle chiles, soak in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with garlic and 0.5 cup soaking liquid.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add chipotle puree and cumin to the skillet, cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in shredded chicken, canned tomatoes with their juices, and 0.5 cup reserved broth.
Simmer for 15 minutes until sauce thickens and flavors meld.
Warm tortillas and serve tinga on them with diced onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze; use canned tomatoes to save time.
Chipotle chiles in adobo sauce can substitute for dried chiles.

recipes.name: Chiles Poblanos Rellenos de Queso
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Char poblano peppers directly over a gas flame or under the oven broiler until blackened all over, about 8 minutes.
Place charred peppers in a plastic bag for 5 minutes to steam, then peel off the blackened skin carefully.
Make a slit in one side of each pepper and carefully remove seeds without tearing the pepper.
Stuff each pepper with a slice of oaxaca cheese, then fold the opening closed.
Whisk egg whites until stiff peaks form, then gently fold in yolks to make a light meringue.
Coat stuffed peppers in flour, dip into egg meringue, and fry in hot oil until golden on both sides, about 4 minutes total.
Simmer tomatoes with sautéed onion and garlic for 10 minutes to make sauce, then season with salt.
Pour warm sauce onto plates and top with fried poblano and serve with cilantro and extra sauce.
cheapTips: Use fresh mozzarella instead of oaxaca cheese for significant savings.
Make tomato sauce ahead of time to reduce last-minute cooking stress.

recipes.name: Quesadillas
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 0.5 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook diced onion and pepper for 3 minutes until softened.
Add shredded cooked chicken or ground beef and sliced jalapeños to the skillet, cook for 2 minutes until heated through.
Lay a tortilla flat on a work surface and spread half with cheese, then add a spoonful of meat mixture and fold in half.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling to make 4 quesadillas.
Wipe out skillet and add remaining butter over medium-high heat.
Cook quesadillas one or two at a time for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese is melted.
Serve quesadillas warm with sour cream, salsa, and fresh cilantro on the side.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cheese and store-bought rotisserie chicken or ground beef.
Add leftover cooked vegetables to stretch filling and reduce cost.

recipes.name: Chungking Chicken
recipes.description: Sichuan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized cubes and toss with 1 tablespoon cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat and stir-fry chicken until golden, about 5-7 minutes; remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil, then fry dried chilies, garlic, ginger, and Sichuan peppercorns for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Mix soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, and water in a bowl.
Return chicken to wok and pour sauce over it, tossing constantly for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens and coats chicken.
Drizzle with sesame oil and toss once more before serving.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken and cut yourself instead of pre-cut breasts
Dried chilies can be sourced from bulk bins at Asian markets for cheaper prices

recipes.name: Lanzhou Beef Noodles
recipes.description: Gansu lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch beef in boiling water for 2 minutes, drain, and rinse under cold water.
Heat oil in a large pot and toast star anise, cinnamon, dried chilies, and bay leaf for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add blanched beef, ginger, and garlic, stirring for 2 minutes.
Pour in 6 cups water and 3 tablespoons soy sauce; bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 60 minutes until beef is tender.
Cook wheat noodles in salted boiling water according to package directions; drain well.
Divide noodles into bowls, ladle hot beef broth and meat over noodles, and top with scallions and cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck from bulk meat sales sections—often cheaper per pound
Make extra broth to freeze for future use

recipes.name: Mapo Doufu with Minced Pork
recipes.description: Sichuan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut firm tofu into 3/4-inch cubes and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat; brown ground pork, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 3-4 minutes; drain excess fat if needed.
Add garlic, ginger, and chili paste to pork and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in water and soy sauce, then carefully add tofu cubes and bring to a simmer.
Mix cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water, then stir into sauce to thicken, about 2 minutes.
Season with ground Sichuan peppercorns, top with scallions, and serve immediately over rice.
cheapTips: Buy tofu from bulk sections or Asian markets where it's cheaper
Doubanjiang is inexpensive and lasts months in the fridge

recipes.name: Beijing Roast Duck
recipes.description: Beijing dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove giblets from duck cavity and pat duck dry inside and out with paper towels.
Bring 4 cups water to boil with ginger, star anise, and cinnamon; simmer 10 minutes, then cool slightly.
Blanch duck in boiling water for 3 minutes, remove, and hang to dry for at least 30 minutes.
Mix honey, soy sauce, and rice vinegar; brush generously all over duck skin.
Roast duck breast-side up in a 375°F oven for 1.5 to 2 hours until skin is deep mahogany and meat is cooked through.
Rest duck 10 minutes, then carve skin and meat into thin slices.
Warm crepes and serve with sliced duck, hoisin sauce, scallion strips, and cucumber slices for wrapping.
cheapTips: Shop at Asian markets for better duck pricing than mainstream grocers
Save duck fat and bones for making stock

recipes.name: Lion's Head Meatballs
recipes.description: Jiangsu dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork, napa cabbage, scallions, ginger, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, sesame oil, egg, and 2 tablespoons cornstarch in a bowl until combined.
Shape mixture into 6-8 large meatballs.
Heat oil in a braising pot or deep skillet and brown meatballs on all sides, about 5-6 minutes total; remove and set aside.
Pour chicken broth and remaining soy sauce into pot, add meatballs back, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise for 20 minutes until meatballs are cooked through and cabbage is tender.
Mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water; stir into broth to thicken slightly, then add sugar and serve.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork from bulk sections instead of pre-packaged
Napa cabbage is inexpensive year-round

recipes.name: Beggar's Chicken
recipes.description: Zhejiang dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried lotus leaves in warm water for 10 minutes until softened.
Brown ground pork in a skillet, add mushrooms, ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil; cook 3 minutes and cool slightly.
Pat chicken dry and stuff cavity with cooked pork mixture; rub outside with salt and soy sauce.
Wrap chicken tightly in softened lotus leaves, then wrap entire bundle in parchment paper or foil.
Bake wrapped chicken in 375°F oven for 75-90 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Carefully unwrap (steam will escape) and present chicken in torn lotus leaf pieces; serve with pan drippings as sauce.
cheapTips: Lotus leaves are inexpensive online and can be bought in bulk
Use a whole chicken instead of parts to reduce cost per serving

recipes.name: Chicken with Cashews
recipes.description: Cantonese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized cubes and toss with 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and stir-fry chicken until golden and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes; remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil, then cook garlic and ginger for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Combine soy sauce, oyster sauce, water, sugar, and remaining cornstarch in a small bowl.
Return chicken to wok, add sauce and cashews, and toss constantly for 2 minutes until sauce thickens and coats everything.
Top with chopped scallions and serve immediately over rice.
cheapTips: Buy cashews in bulk from warehouse stores for lower per-ounce cost
Use chicken thighs instead of breast to save money and add more flavor

recipes.name: Black Pepper Beef
recipes.description: Cantonese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice beef thinly against the grain and toss with 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and stir-fry beef in batches until browned, about 2-3 minutes per batch; remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and cook onion until soft, about 3 minutes; add garlic and black pepper and cook 30 seconds.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, remaining cornstarch, and water in a bowl.
Return beef to wok, pour sauce over it, and toss constantly for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens and beef is coated.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve hot over rice.
cheapTips: Buy flank steak on sale and slice yourself instead of pre-sliced beef
Use freshly ground black pepper for better flavor than pre-ground

recipes.name: Twice-Cooked Pork
recipes.description: Sichuan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 4 cups water to boil with ginger slices; add pork belly and simmer for 30 minutes until cooked through and tender.
Remove pork from water, cool slightly, then slice into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and briefly sear pork slices until lightly browned, about 1 minute per side; remove and set aside.
In same wok, add chili paste, garlic, and bell pepper; stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return pork to wok with soy sauce, sugar, and 2 tablespoons cooking liquid from broth; toss constantly for 2-3 minutes.
Drizzle with sesame oil, top with scallions, and serve immediately over rice.
cheapTips: Pork belly is inexpensive compared to other cuts
Make extra broth to freeze for future use

recipes.name: Fish-Fragrant Eggplant
recipes.description: Sichuan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 3 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and fry eggplant batons in batches until soft and golden, about 4-5 minutes per batch; set aside on paper towels.
Add remaining oil to wok and stir-fry garlic, ginger, and dried chilies for 1 minute until fragrant.
Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, water, and cornstarch in a bowl.
Return eggplant to wok and pour sauce over it, tossing gently for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens and coats eggplant.
Drizzle with sesame oil, top with scallions, and serve immediately over rice.
cheapTips: Eggplant is inexpensive in summer months when in peak season
Buy dried chilies in bulk from Asian markets

recipes.name: Pad Gratiem Prik
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces and pat dry.
Mince garlic cloves and slice chilies into thin rings, removing seeds if less heat is desired.
Heat oil in a wok or large pan over high heat until shimmering.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and stir-fry for 5-6 minutes until cooked through.
Add fish sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and sliced chilies, then toss for 1 minute.
Stir in lime juice and remove from heat.
Serve over jasmine rice and garnish with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy whole garlic heads rather than pre-minced garlic to save 60%.
Use chicken breast instead of thighs to reduce cost by $1 per serving.

recipes.name: Gaeng Kiaw Wan
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add curry paste and fry for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in coconut milk slowly while stirring to combine with the paste.
Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes and add to the pot, simmering for 8 minutes.
Cube eggplant and slice bell pepper, then add both to the pot.
Stir in fish sauce, palm sugar, and chicken broth, and simmer for 10 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Add basil leaves and stir gently just before serving.
Serve hot with jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Make curry paste from scratch using dried chilies, garlic, and shallots to save $2.
Substitute Thai eggplant with regular eggplant at half the cost.

recipes.name: Pad Prik King
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and cut pork into thin strips.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and add minced garlic for 20 seconds.
Add pork strips and stir-fry for 4 minutes until mostly cooked.
Add red curry paste and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in coconut milk and add cut long beans.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar, then simmer for 8 minutes.
Tear kaffir lime leaves and stir into the curry, cooking for 1 more minute.
Serve over jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork from a butcher counter and ask for shoulder trim scraps—often 30% cheaper.
Substitute kaffir lime leaves with regular lime zest for negligible difference.

recipes.name: Boat Noodles
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork and chicken into thin bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a pot over medium heat and fry minced garlic and whole dried chilies for 2 minutes.
Add pork and chicken pieces and cook for 5 minutes until browned.
Pour in pork broth and bring to a boil.
Season with fish sauce and dark soy sauce, then reduce heat and simmer for 8 minutes.
Cook rice noodles separately according to package directions and drain.
Place cooked noodles in bowls and pour hot broth with meat over top.
Garnish with cilantro, a squeeze of lime, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use chicken broth instead of pork broth to save $1.50 per serving.
Buy pre-made broth and skip making it from scratch.

recipes.name: Pad Lad Na
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice noodles according to package directions, drain, and divide between two bowls.
Cut chicken breast into thin slices and mince garlic.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry chicken for 5 minutes, then set aside.
Add remaining oil to the wok and cook garlic for 30 seconds.
Add broccoli and stir-fry for 3 minutes until slightly tender.
Return chicken to the wok and pour in chicken broth and soy sauce.
Mix cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir into the sauce until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Pour the thickened gravy over noodles, drizzle with sesame oil, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy pre-cut broccoli frozen rather than fresh to save 40%.
Use chicken thighs instead of breast—they're cheaper and stay moister.

recipes.name: Isaan Sausage
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak hog casings in warm water for 30 minutes to soften.
Mince garlic and dried chilies finely.
In a large bowl, combine ground pork, fish sauce, minced garlic, chilies, white pepper, cooked sticky rice, and salt.
Mix thoroughly with hands until the mixture becomes sticky and holds together.
Stuff mixture into prepared casings using a sausage stuffer or piping bag, leaving 0.5 inch at ends.
Tie off casings with butcher's string to create 3-inch links.
Refrigerate for 24 hours to allow flavors to develop.
Grill over charcoal or pan-fry in oil for 8-10 minutes, turning frequently, until cooked through.
Serve with sticky rice, raw vegetables, and spicy dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy hog casings from a butcher counter—often free or very cheap.
Source ground pork from Asian markets for 30% less cost.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: North Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into 1.5-inch cubes and marinate in yogurt, 0.5 tbsp garam masala, half the garlic paste, salt, and red chili powder for 30 minutes.
Dice onion and heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat.
Cook chicken cubes in batches until browned and cooked through, about 6 minutes total, then set aside.
In the same skillet, heat remaining oil and add diced onion, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add remaining garlic paste and ginger paste, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato sauce and remaining garam masala, simmering for 8 minutes.
Return chicken to the skillet and stir in heavy cream, simmering for 5 more minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with basmati rice or naan bread.
cheapTips: Use Greek yogurt from the dollar store instead of premium brands.
Buy garlic and ginger paste in bulk Asian markets for 60% less.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
recipes.description: North Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cube chicken thighs and marinate in yogurt, 1 tsp chili powder, minced garlic, 0.5 tbsp ginger, and salt for 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat and cook marinated chicken until browned, about 6 minutes, then remove.
Dice onion and cook in the same skillet with remaining butter and garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add remaining ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in garam masala and remaining chili powder, cooking for 30 seconds.
Add tomato puree and simmer for 8 minutes, breaking down any chunks.
Return chicken to the skillet and stir in heavy cream, simmering for 8 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasonings, then serve with basmati rice or naan bread.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs from bulk sections at Costco or ethnic markets—40% cheaper.
Make tomato puree from tomato paste and water to save $1 per can.

recipes.name: Biryani
recipes.description: Hyderabadi lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak basmati rice in water for 30 minutes.
Cut chicken into 2-inch pieces and marinate in yogurt, 2 tbsp minced garlic, 0.5 tbsp ginger, and 0.5 tsp salt for 30 minutes.
Slice onions very thin and fry in 3 tbsp ghee until deep golden brown, set aside half for topping.
Heat remaining 3 tbsp ghee and cook chicken with remaining onions until 75% cooked, about 8 minutes.
Boil salted water in a large pot with bay leaves, cinnamon, and cardamom.
Add soaked and drained rice to boiling water and cook until 70% done, about 8 minutes.
Layer half-cooked rice over chicken, then add reserved fried onions, garam masala, cilantro, and mint.
Cover the pot with foil and a tight-fitting lid, then cook on low heat for 30 minutes until rice is fully tender.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then gently fork through biryani to mix and serve.
cheapTips: Buy bulk basmati rice from Indian markets for 50% of supermarket price.
Use vegetable oil instead of ghee to save $2 per serving.

recipes.name: Rogan Josh
recipes.description: Kashmiri dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut lamb into 1.5-inch cubes.
Dice onions and mince garlic.
Heat oil in a large pot over high heat and cook lamb in batches until browned on all sides, about 8 minutes total, then set aside.
In the same pot, cook diced onions until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in garam masala, cumin, coriander, and chili powder, cooking for 30 seconds.
Add tomato puree and yogurt, stirring well to combine.
Return lamb to the pot with salt and bring to a simmer, then cover and cook on low heat for 25 minutes until lamb is tender.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with basmati rice or naan bread.
cheapTips: Buy lamb from ethnic butchers—often 30% cheaper than supermarkets.
Substitute goat meat for lamb to save 40% while maintaining authentic flavor.

recipes.name: Spring Rolls
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice paper wrappers in warm water for 30 seconds until pliable.
Lay a wrapper on a damp cloth and arrange lettuce, noodles, shrimp, herbs, and cucumber in a line on the lower half.
Fold the wrapper sides inward and roll tightly away from you.
Mix peanut butter, fish sauce, lime juice, and 2 tablespoons water to make dipping sauce.
Serve spring rolls with peanut dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Use canned shrimp or substitute with tofu to reduce cost
Buy rice paper in bulk at Asian markets for significant savings

recipes.name: Pad Krapow Gai
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until very hot.
Add minced garlic and Thai chilies, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add minced chicken and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until fully cooked.
Pour in fish sauce and soy sauce, stirring to combine.
Add fresh basil and lime juice, tossing for 1 minute until basil wilts slightly.
Serve immediately over jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Substitute fresh basil with cilantro if basil is expensive
Buy chicken when on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Khao Pad
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over medium-high heat and scramble eggs until cooked, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add chilled rice and break up clumps with the spatula, cooking for 3-4 minutes.
Stir in frozen vegetables, fish sauce, and soy sauce, mixing well.
Return eggs to the wok and add green onions, tossing for 1 minute.
Serve with lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Make extra rice the day before to use for fried rice
Buy frozen mixed vegetables instead of fresh to reduce cost

recipes.name: Red Curry
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat and stir in red curry paste for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and stir until curry paste is fully incorporated.
Add chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Add cubed chicken and cook for 8-10 minutes until mostly cooked through.
Stir in bell peppers and eggplant, simmering for 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice.
Add basil leaves and stir gently for 1 minute.
Serve over jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy red curry paste at Asian markets in bulk for cheaper prices
Use chicken thighs instead of breast for more flavor at similar cost

recipes.name: Pad Gaprao Moo
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat until smoking.
Add minced garlic and Thai chilies, stirring for 30 seconds.
Add ground pork and stir-fry for 5-6 minutes, breaking it into small pieces.
Stir in fish sauce and soy sauce, mixing thoroughly.
Remove from heat and add fresh basil, tossing gently for 30 seconds.
Serve over jasmine rice topped with a fried egg.
cheapTips: Use ground chicken instead of pork for a leaner and cheaper option
Buy basil in bulk and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Gaeng Phed
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat coconut milk in a large pot over medium heat.
Stir in red curry paste and let cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add chicken broth and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add chicken thighs and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add long beans, eggplant, and whole Thai chilies, simmering for 8-10 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Tear kaffir lime leaves and add to the pot along with fish sauce and palm sugar.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, simmering for 2 more minutes.
Serve hot over jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Substitute kaffir lime leaves with lime zest if unavailable
Use chicken breasts instead of thighs to reduce fat and cost slightly

recipes.name: Khao Soi
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook egg noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a pot and fry sliced shallots until golden and crispy, remove and set aside.
In the same pot, stir curry paste over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and broth, stirring well.
Add cubed chicken and simmer for 10-12 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in fish sauce and lime juice.
Divide cooked noodles between bowls and pour curry broth and chicken over top.
Garnish with fried shallots and fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Use regular pasta instead of egg noodles for savings
Skip frying shallots and toast them in a dry pan to reduce oil use

recipes.name: Pad Makua Yao
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat until very hot.
Add minced garlic and Thai chilies, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add ground meat and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until cooked through.
Add eggplant pieces and stir-fry for 6-8 minutes until softened.
Pour in fish sauce, soy sauce, and oyster sauce, stirring well.
Add fresh basil and toss for 1 minute.
Serve over jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy eggplant when in season for better prices
Substitute with zucchini or other vegetables if eggplant is expensive

recipes.name: Sour Sausage
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork with minced garlic, rice bran, fish sauce, salt, sugar, and ginger in a bowl.
Form mixture into small sausage patties about 2 inches long and 1 inch thick.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 4-5 minutes per side until browned.
Cool slightly and serve warm or at room temperature with sticky rice.
Serve with lime wedges for squeezing over the sausages.
cheapTips: Use regular rice flour instead of rice bran for easier sourcing
Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Thai Fish Cakes
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground fish, red curry paste, fish sauce, and egg in a bowl.
Fold in breadcrumbs, chopped beans, and lime leaves until mixture holds together.
Form into patties approximately 2 inches wide and 1/2 inch thick.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry fish cakes for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve warm with sweet chili sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish and thaw before use for better pricing
Use regular curry paste if lime leaves are unavailable

recipes.name: Goan Fish Curry
recipes.description: Goan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast coriander and cumin seeds in a dry pan for 1 minute, then grind with dried chilies, garlic, and ginger into a paste.
Heat oil in a large pan and sauté diced onions until golden brown.
Add the spice paste and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes until soft.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add fish fillets and cook for 8-10 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Season with salt and lime juice.
Simmer for another 2 minutes and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy frozen white fish fillets to save 40%
Use regular milk mixed with coconut oil if canned coconut milk is expensive

recipes.name: Dhokla
recipes.description: Gujarati breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix chickpea flour, yogurt, ginger, green chili, turmeric, and salt in a bowl.
Add water gradually to form a smooth batter of medium consistency.
Add baking soda and stir gently until bubbles form.
Grease a square baking pan and pour the batter into it.
Steam in a covered pan with 1 inch of boiling water for 15-18 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes, then cut into square pieces.
Heat oil in a small pan and add mustard seeds until they pop.
Add curry leaves and pour this tempering over the dhokla pieces.
cheapTips: Buy chickpea flour in bulk from Indian stores
Use any oil you have for tempering

recipes.name: Fafda Jalebi
recipes.description: Gujarati breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix chickpea flour, rice flour, turmeric, and salt with water to make a thick batter.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and transfer batter to a squeeze bottle.
Squeeze long strands directly into hot oil in circular coils, working quickly.
Fry until golden (about 2 minutes), remove with a slotted spoon, and drain on paper towels.
For jalebi, make a batter with all-purpose flour and water, add coloring, and squeeze into hot oil in spiral shapes.
Fry jalebi until light golden, then immediately dip into hot sugar syrup (made by boiling sugar, water, and lemon juice).
Remove and place on a wire rack to set.
Serve fafda and jalebi together while still warm.
cheapTips: Make your own sugar syrup instead of buying pre-made
Use a plastic squeeze bottle with a cut tip instead of expensive frying tools

recipes.name: Pani Puri
recipes.description: North Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, semolina, and salt, then add water to make a stiff dough and knead for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into small balls and roll each into a thin puri shape.
Heat oil to 350°F and deep fry each puri until light and crispy, about 1-2 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
For filling, mash boiled potatoes and mix with boiled chickpeas and diced onion.
For pani, blend mint leaves, tamarind paste, cumin, chaat masala, and water; strain through a fine sieve.
To serve, make a small hole in each puri, fill with potato-chickpea mixture, dip in pani, and eat immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen puri from Indian stores to skip frying
Make tamarind paste from whole tamarinds if buying paste is expensive

recipes.name: Chaat
recipes.description: North Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes until tender, peel, and cut into cubes.
Drain and rinse canned chickpeas, then mix with diced potatoes.
Add diced onion, tomato, and cilantro to the potato-chickpea mixture.
In a small bowl, whisk together tamarind paste, water, and salt to make tamarind water.
Pour tamarind water over the potato mixture and toss gently.
Drizzle yogurt over the top.
Sprinkle with chaat masala and cumin powder.
Toss lightly and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use canned chickpeas instead of dried to save cooking time
Make tamarind paste from concentrate if available

recipes.name: Vada Pav
recipes.description: Marathi snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil and mash potatoes with split peas, turmeric, green chili, ginger, garlic powder, and salt.
Shape the mixture into balls about 1.5 inches in diameter.
Mix besan flour with water, turmeric, and salt to make a smooth, thick batter.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan.
Dip each potato ball into the batter until fully coated, then carefully place in hot oil.
Fry until golden brown on all sides, about 4-5 minutes per vada.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Slice pav bread and optionally pan-fry with a little butter, then sandwich a hot vada inside and serve.
cheapTips: Buy potato and pea flour in bulk from Indian stores
Use store-bought pav bread to save time and money

recipes.name: Misal Pav
recipes.description: Marathi lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil and sauté diced onions and ginger-garlic paste until fragrant.
Add diced potato and tomato, cooking until soft, about 8 minutes.
Add sprouted moong beans, chili powder, turmeric, and salt.
Pour water and bring to a boil, then simmer for 15-20 minutes until beans are soft and curry thickens.
Mash some beans lightly for a chunky consistency.
Toast pav bread lightly or pan-fry with a little butter.
Serve misal curry in bowls topped with chopped cilantro and onion.
Dip the warm pav bread into the misal and eat together.
cheapTips: Sprout your own moong beans at home to save money
Buy bread from discount stores or make at home

recipes.name: Kofta Curry
recipes.description: Mughlai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice half the onion and mix with ground beef, ginger-garlic paste, green chili, cilantro, breadcrumbs, egg, and salt.
Shape the mixture into 12-16 oval balls and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan and fry the remaining sliced onions until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tomato puree and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in yogurt and simmer for 3 minutes.
Gently add the koftas to the gravy, being careful not to break them.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until cooked through, then stir in cream and garam masala.
Simmer for another 2 minutes and serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions
Use milk mixed with cornstarch instead of heavy cream to save money

recipes.name: Korma
recipes.description: Mughlai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak almonds in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend into a smooth paste.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and marinate in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and salt for at least 20 minutes.
Heat oil and add cumin seeds, let them crackle.
Slice onions thinly and cook in the oil until golden brown, then set aside half for garnish.
Add the marinated chicken to the pan and cook for 8-10 minutes until lightly browned.
Pour in coconut milk and add the almond paste, stirring well to combine.
Add garam masala and turmeric, then simmer for 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Top with reserved fried onions and cilantro, then serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breast for richer flavor at lower cost
Use peanut butter instead of almond paste

recipes.name: Malai Kofta
recipes.description: North Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Grate paneer and mash boiled potato together with salt and mix well.
Coarsely chop cashew nuts and mix with peas and cream into the paneer-potato mixture.
Shape into 12 balls, roll in breadcrumbs if available, and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Heat oil and gently fry koftas until light golden, then set aside.
In the same oil, sauté sliced onions until golden brown and set aside half for garnish.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook until fragrant, then add chopped tomatoes.
Cook tomatoes until soft, then blend the mixture into a smooth paste and return to the pan.
Add garam masala and cream, simmer for 5 minutes, gently add koftas, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Garnish with fried onions and cilantro before serving with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Make paneer at home from milk to save 50%
Use crushed nuts instead of whole cashews

recipes.name: Pho Bo
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Char the onion and ginger directly over a flame for 3 minutes until blackened.
Blanch beef bones and brisket in boiling water for 2 minutes, then rinse under cold water.
In a large pot, add 12 cups fresh water, cleaned bones, charred onion, ginger, star anise, and cinnamon stick.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 90 minutes until broth is aromatic and flavorful.
Remove brisket when tender, slice into thin pieces, and set aside.
Strain broth through a fine mesh, add fish sauce, and return to pot.
Cook pho noodles separately according to package directions, then divide into bowls.
Pour hot broth over noodles, top with sliced brisket, bean sprouts, basil, and serve with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy beef bones from the butcher counter—often cheaper than packaged.
Use dried spices and buy in bulk sections rather than pre-packaged.

recipes.name: Pho Ga
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Char the onion and ginger over a flame for 3 minutes until blackened.
Blanch chicken in boiling water for 2 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.
In a large pot, combine 10 cups water, cleaned chicken, charred onion, ginger, star anise, and cinnamon stick.
Bring to boil, skim foam, then simmer for 60 minutes until chicken is very tender.
Remove chicken, shred the meat into bite-sized pieces, and discard bones.
Strain broth, add fish sauce, and return to pot with shredded chicken.
Cook pho noodles according to package directions and divide into bowls.
Pour hot broth with chicken over noodles, top with bean sprouts and fresh herbs, serve with lime.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens on sale and portion yourself—chicken thighs are cheaper than breasts.
Make broth in bulk and freeze in portions for quick future meals.

recipes.name: Bun Cha
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork with minced garlic, 2 tbsp fish sauce, and 1 tbsp brown sugar in a bowl.
Form mixture into small balls about 1 inch diameter.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook meatballs until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes total.
For the dipping sauce: combine 1.5 cups water, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, lime juice, and minced garlic.
Cook vermicelli noodles according to package directions, then drain and cool.
Arrange lettuce, cucumber, fresh herbs, and cooled noodles in bowls.
Top with warm meatballs and pour dipping sauce over the bowl.
Garnish with crushed peanuts and serve with extra lime and herbs on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions.
Make extra dipping sauce to store refrigerated for 3-4 days.

recipes.name: Banh Mi Thit Nuong
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine fish sauce, minced garlic, and brown sugar, then marinate thin pork slices for at least 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, julienne carrot and cucumber, combine with vinegar and a pinch of sugar, and let sit to pickle.
Heat a skillet over high heat and cook marinated pork in batches until caramelized and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Slice baguettes lengthwise and spread mayo on both sides.
Layer pickled vegetables, cooked pork, fresh cilantro, and jalapeño slices into each baguette.
Serve immediately while pork is still warm.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when on sale and slice yourself with a sharp knife.
Use regular white bread as a budget baguette substitute.

recipes.name: Banh Mi Pate
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Julienne carrot and cucumber, mix with vinegar and pinch of sugar, and set aside to pickle.
Slice baguettes lengthwise and toast lightly if desired.
Spread butter and mayo on both sides of the baguette.
Spread pâté generously on one side of each baguette.
Layer pickled vegetables, fresh cilantro, and jalapeño slices on top of the pâté.
Wrap in paper and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned pâté—it's affordable and shelf-stable for quick breakfasts.
Prepare pickled vegetables the night before.

recipes.name: Com Tam
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook broken rice with 3 cups water in a pot using the absorption method (boil, cover, simmer 15 minutes).
Marinate pork chops in 2 tbsp fish sauce, half the garlic, and 1 tbsp brown sugar for 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a skillet and cook pork chops until caramelized and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes per side, then set aside.
In the same skillet, fry remaining garlic and cook eggs sunny-side up, then set aside.
Slice tomato and cucumber into rounds.
Fluff cooked rice and portion into bowls.
Top each bowl with one pork chop, one fried egg, sliced tomato and cucumber, and sliced scallions.
Serve with a small bowl of dipping sauce made from remaining fish sauce and brown sugar dissolved in warm water.
cheapTips: Buy broken rice in bulk from Asian markets—it's much cheaper than whole grain rice.
Use budget pork chops from the sale section.

recipes.name: Hu Tieu
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch pork bones in boiling water for 2 minutes, then rinse and clean thoroughly.
Bring 8 cups fresh water to boil with cleaned bones and minced garlic, then simmer for 50 minutes.
Brown ground or diced pork belly in a separate skillet until cooked through, about 5 minutes, then set aside.
Add shrimp to the broth and cook until pink, about 3-4 minutes, then remove and chop.
Strain broth, return to pot, add cooked pork and shrimp, season with fish sauce and black pepper.
Cook tapioca noodles according to package directions and divide into bowls.
Pour hot broth and meat mixture over noodles.
Top with bean sprouts, sliced scallions, and cilantro, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy shrimp frozen in bulk and thaw as needed.
Use pork bones and budget cuts for inexpensive, flavorful broth.

recipes.name: Cao Lau
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Marinate thin pork slices in fish sauce, minced garlic, and brown sugar for at least 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a skillet over high heat and cook marinated pork until caramelized, about 4-5 minutes per batch.
Bring 4 cups water to simmer in a pot and cook noodles until tender, about 4-5 minutes for fresh noodles.
Drain noodles and toss with a small amount of oil to prevent sticking.
Arrange lettuce and fresh herbs on serving plates.
Top with warm noodles and caramelized pork.
Sprinkle with crushed peanuts and toasted sesame seeds.
Serve with lime and extra fish sauce dipping sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Substitute fresh ramen or egg noodles if cao lau noodles are unavailable.
Toast peanuts at home from bulk raw peanuts for significant savings.

recipes.name: Mi Quang
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cube pork shoulder and marinate with turmeric, garlic, and fish sauce for 15 minutes.
Bring 5 cups water to boil and cook marinated pork until tender, about 20 minutes.
Add shrimp to the broth and cook until pink, about 3-4 minutes.
Cook mi quang noodles separately according to package directions until soft and curly.
Arrange lettuce and fresh herbs on serving plates.
Top with cooked noodles, pork, shrimp, and broth.
Garnish with crushed peanuts and serve with sesame crackers on the side.
Serve with lime wedges and extra fish sauce for seasoning to taste.
cheapTips: Use budget cuts of pork like shoulder instead of premium cuts.
Buy frozen shrimp in bulk for consistent low pricing.

recipes.name: Banh Xeo
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour, turmeric, salt, coconut milk, and water in a bowl to form a thin batter and let rest 15 minutes.
Cut pork belly into thin strips or use shrimp, season with fish sauce, and set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Pour one portion of batter (about 1/2 cup) into the hot skillet and tilt to spread thin, creating a large round crepe.
When the bottom starts to crisp and turn golden, add one portion of pork, bean sprouts, and sliced onion to half of the crepe.
Fold the crepe in half and continue cooking until edges are crispy and golden, about 2 minutes more.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter and fillings.
Serve hot with lettuce leaves, fresh herbs, and dipping sauce made from fish sauce, sugar, lime, and garlic.
cheapTips: Use pork belly instead of shrimp—it's usually cheaper and more flavorful.
Buy rice flour in bulk from Asian markets for significant savings.

recipes.name: Vindaloo
recipes.description: Goan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried red chilies in warm water for 10 minutes, then blend with garlic, ginger, and vinegar into a smooth paste.
Heat coconut oil in a heavy pot and temper cumin seeds until fragrant.
Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the chili paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add cubed pork and cook for 5 minutes, stirring to coat with the spice mixture.
Add potatoes, salt, and water, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 25-30 minutes until pork is tender and potatoes are cooked.
Taste and adjust salt and spice level as needed before serving with rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for later use
Use dried chilies instead of fresh for better value

recipes.name: Samosa
recipes.description: North Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and 2 tablespoons oil with water until a stiff dough forms, then let rest 20 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a pan and add cumin seeds, then add onion and cook 1 minute.
Add boiled potatoes, peas, green chili, and garam masala, cooking until well mixed, then cool.
Divide dough into 12 balls and roll each into a thin circle, then cut in half.
Take one half, wet the straight edge, and form a cone by bringing the two corners together.
Fill each cone with 1 tablespoon of potato filling and seal the open end by pressing the edges.
Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan and fry samosas in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with tamarind and mint chutney.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze uncooked samosas for quick frying later
Use frozen peas instead of fresh to reduce cost

recipes.name: Dosa
recipes.description: South Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice, urad dal, and fenugreek seeds separately in water for at least 4 hours.
Drain and grind rice with a small amount of water to a smooth paste, then transfer to a bowl.
Grind urad dal with fenugreek and minimal water until fluffy and light, taking 10-15 minutes.
Combine rice and dal pastes with salt and let ferment at room temperature for 8-12 hours until batter rises slightly.
Heat a cast iron griddle or non-stick pan over medium-high heat and lightly oil it.
Pour 0.25 cup batter onto the griddle, quickly spread thin with the back of a spoon to form a large crepe.
Add sautéed onions, green chili, and curry leaves on top, drizzle with oil around the edges, and cook until golden and crispy, about 2 minutes per side.
Fold or roll the dosa and serve hot with sambar and coconut chutney.
cheapTips: Buy rice and urad dal in bulk from Indian grocery stores
Fermentation is free—use pantry time to develop flavor naturally

recipes.name: Idli
recipes.description: South Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice, urad dal, and fenugreek seeds in water separately for 4-6 hours.
Grind rice with minimal water to a smooth but thick paste, then transfer to a bowl.
Grind urad dal with fenugreek and a small amount of water until completely smooth and fluffy, about 10-15 minutes.
Mix rice and dal pastes with salt and let ferment at room temperature for 8-12 hours until batter doubles in volume.
Preheat a steamer pot with water and lightly oil idli molds or cups.
Pour fermented batter carefully into oiled molds, filling about three-quarters full.
Place molds in the steaming vessel and steam for 5-7 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Cool for 1 minute and gently tap out idlis onto a plate, then serve warm with sambar and chutney.
cheapTips: Buy rice and dal in bulk at Indian markets for 40% savings
Reuse fermentation time by making sambar the same day

recipes.name: Uttapam
recipes.description: South Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice and urad dal in water for 4 hours, then grind separately to smooth pastes.
Mix rice and dal pastes with salt and water, then ferment at room temperature for 8-12 hours.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and lightly oil it.
Pour 0.5 cup fermented batter onto the skillet and gently spread into a thick pancake shape, about 0.5 inch thick.
Top the batter with diced onions, tomatoes, green chili, cilantro, and curry leaves while still wet.
Drizzle oil around the edges and cook for 3-4 minutes until the bottom is golden, then flip carefully.
Cook the other side for 2 minutes until light brown and crispy.
Transfer to a plate and serve hot with sambar and coconut chutney.
cheapTips: Use leftover dosa batter for uttapam to save time and ingredients
Buy diced frozen tomatoes in bulk to reduce prep time

recipes.name: Chole Bhature
recipes.description: Punjabi lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and yogurt with enough water to form a soft dough, then let rest for 30 minutes covered.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a pot and add cumin seeds, then add diced onions and cook until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes, cooking for 3 minutes until tomatoes soften.
Add drained chickpeas, turmeric, garam masala, and salt, then simmer with 0.5 cup water for 10 minutes until flavors blend.
Heat 0.5 cup oil in a deep pan to 350°F for frying the bhature.
Divide dough into 8 portions and roll each into a thin circle about 6 inches in diameter.
Carefully slide one bhature into hot oil and it will puff up within 30 seconds; flip and fry the other side until golden, about 1 minute total.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with the spiced chickpea curry (chole) and pickled onions.
cheapTips: Use canned chickpeas instead of dried to save overnight soaking time
Make extra bhature dough and freeze for quick weeknight meals

recipes.name: Rajma Chawal
recipes.description: North Indian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rajma beans in water overnight, then drain and boil in fresh water for 45 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, wash rice thoroughly and cook in 4 cups boiling water with salt until fluffy, about 18 minutes.
Heat oil in a large pot and add cumin seeds, allowing them to crackle for 10 seconds.
Add diced onions and cook until softened, about 4 minutes, then add ginger-garlic paste and fry for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until they break down.
Add the cooked rajma beans, turmeric, garam masala, and chili powder, stirring well to combine.
Simmer the rajma curry for 10 minutes to allow flavors to marry, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust salt and spices, then serve the rajma over steamed rice with sliced onions and lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy dried rajma in bulk from Indian markets—much cheaper than canned
Soak beans overnight to reduce cooking time and fuel costs

recipes.name: Dal Makhani
recipes.description: Punjabi dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak urad dal for 2 hours, then cook in 3 cups water until completely soft and broken down, about 45 minutes.
Mash the cooked dal with a spoon until smooth and creamy.
Heat butter in a heavy-bottomed pot and add cumin seeds, allowing them to crackle.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes, then add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree and garam masala, cooking for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the mashed dal and kidney beans to the pot, stirring well to combine.
Simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in heavy cream and salt, cooking for another 5 minutes until creamy and smooth.
Taste and adjust spices, then serve hot with naan bread or rice and a dollop of cream on top.
cheapTips: Use Greek yogurt mixed with milk instead of heavy cream to cut cost by 40%
Buy urad dal in bulk and freeze cooked portions for quick weeknight meals

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
recipes.description: North Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch spinach in boiling salted water for 2 minutes, then drain and blend into a smooth puree with 0.25 cup water.
Heat butter in a large pan and add cumin seeds, allowing them to crackle for 10 seconds.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 4 minutes, then add ginger-garlic paste and fry for 1 minute.
Add diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes until softened.
Pour in the spinach puree and 0.75 cup water, bringing to a simmer and cooking for 5 minutes.
Add garam masala and salt, stirring well.
Gently add cubed paneer and cream or yogurt, stirring carefully to avoid breaking the paneer pieces.
Simmer for 5 minutes without boiling to keep the paneer tender, then taste and adjust seasoning before serving with naan or rice.
cheapTips: Make paneer at home from whole milk for 50% savings—curdle with lemon juice
Buy frozen spinach in bulk during off-season and store for year-round use

recipes.name: Shahi Tukda
recipes.description: Mughlai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
