steps: Make sugar syrup by combining sugar and 0.5 cup water in a pot, bringing to a boil and simmering for 5 minutes, then add crushed cardamom and cool completely.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and cut bread into 2-inch squares.
Fry bread squares in hot oil until deep golden and crispy, about 1-2 minutes per side, then drain on paper towels.
Combine condensed milk, heavy cream, and 0.5 cup milk in a bowl and soak saffron strands in 1 tablespoon of this mixture for 5 minutes.
Add the saffron milk to the cream mixture and stir in grated khoya until well combined.
Dip each fried bread piece into the cooled sugar syrup for 2 seconds, then immediately place on a serving dish.
Pour the creamy malai (condensed milk and cream mixture) over the bread pieces.
Garnish generously with sliced pistachios and almonds, then chill for 15 minutes before serving cold.
cheapTips: Skip saffron and use a pinch of cardamom powder mixed with a drop of food coloring
Use evaporated milk diluted with water instead of condensed milk to save 30%

recipes.name: Galbijjim
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch beef short ribs in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse thoroughly.
Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, minced garlic, ginger, and grated pear in a bowl.
Place blanched ribs in a pot and pour the marinade mixture over them.
Add 2 cups of water or beef broth and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 60-70 minutes until ribs are tender.
Stir occasionally and add more broth if needed to keep ribs partially submerged.
Once ribs are fork-tender, increase heat to reduce sauce until slightly thickened.
Transfer to serving dish, garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
Season with black pepper and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy beef short ribs on sale and freeze until needed
Use regular pear or apple instead of Asian pear if unavailable

recipes.name: Doenjang Jjigae
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 4 cups of water or broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add diced onion and garlic, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Dissolve doenjang paste in a small bowl with 1/4 cup of the hot broth, then add back to pot.
Add diced zucchini and cubed tofu, simmering for 10 minutes.
If using clams or shrimp, add them now and cook until done (3-5 minutes).
Stir in red chili flakes and adjust seasoning with additional doenjang if needed.
Turn off heat and drizzle sesame oil over the stew.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Doenjang keeps for months in the fridge once opened
Omit seafood to reduce cost significantly

recipes.name: Gyeran Mari
recipes.description: Korean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk together with milk, salt, and black pepper.
Stir in finely chopped green onion and diced carrot.
Heat oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Pour egg mixture into skillet and let set for 30 seconds without stirring.
Using chopsticks or a spatula, gently push cooked edges toward center and tilt pan to spread uncooked egg.
Once eggs are mostly set but still slightly wet on top, use a spatula to roll the egg omelet toward one side.
Slide onto a cutting board and slice into 1-inch thick rounds.
Serve immediately with ketchup on the side if desired.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk at warehouse stores
Use ham or spam if available for extra flavor at minimal cost

recipes.name: Tteokguk
recipes.description: Korean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 4 cups of beef broth or water to a boil in a pot.
Add minced garlic and sliced rice cakes, stirring gently to prevent sticking.
Simmer for 5-7 minutes until rice cakes are soft and slightly translucent.
Add soy sauce and optional cooked beef or ham, stirring well.
In a small bowl, beat eggs lightly with a fork.
Slowly pour beaten eggs into the simmering broth while stirring gently to create thin egg ribbons.
Add sliced green onion and sesame oil, cooking for 1 minute more.
Season with salt and pepper, transfer to bowls, and garnish with sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy frozen rice cakes in bulk from Asian markets
Omit meat and use vegetable broth for a vegetarian version

recipes.name: Nakji Bokkeum
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil and blanch octopus pieces for 20-25 minutes until tender, then drain well.
Mix gochujang, sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, and minced garlic in a small bowl to create sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add sliced onion and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Add blanched octopus and the gochujang sauce mixture, tossing well to coat.
Add 1/4 cup water and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes, allowing sauce to thicken and coat the octopus.
Add chopped green onion and black pepper, tossing for 1 minute more.
Transfer to serving plate and garnish generously with sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy frozen octopus which is cheaper and pre-cleaned
Skip fresh octopus from fishmonger to reduce cost

recipes.name: Kimchi Bokkeumbap
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add chopped kimchi and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes to release flavors.
Add cooled rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add soy sauce and kimchi juice, mixing well to distribute color and flavor evenly.
Push rice to sides of skillet and add remaining oil in center.
Crack eggs into center and let cook for 1 minute, then scramble and mix with rice.
Add optional diced ham and sesame oil, tossing everything together.
Top with chopped green onion and sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Use day-old rice which is drier and fries better than fresh
Make your own kimchi to save money over time

recipes.name: Buchimgae
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice zucchini and onion thinly and place in a colander, sprinkling with salt to draw out moisture for 5 minutes.
Squeeze sliced vegetables gently to remove excess liquid.
Whisk eggs, flour, water, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl until smooth batter forms.
Add squeezed vegetables and chopped green onion to batter, mixing well.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil, flattening gently with spatula to form thin pancakes.
Fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame seeds in a small bowl for dipping sauce.
Serve hot pancakes with dipping sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Use seasonal zucchini when prices are lowest
Buy flour in bulk for significant savings

recipes.name: Bossam
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place pork belly in a large pot and cover with 6 cups of cold water.
Bring to boil, then drain and rinse pork under cold water, cleaning away scum.
Return cleaned pork to pot with fresh water, onion, garlic, ginger slice, soy sauce, rice wine, and salt.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 60-90 minutes until pork is very tender.
Pierce with a knife—it should go through easily when fully cooked.
Remove pork from broth and let cool slightly, then slice into thin strips.
Arrange butter lettuce or cabbage leaves on a serving platter.
Place sliced pork and fresh garlic slices on top of leaves.
Serve with ssamjang sauce for wrapping pork in lettuce leaves and eating fresh.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly on sale and freeze for later use
Reuse cooking broth as a base for soups or stews

recipes.name: Yeonpo Tang
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 5 cups of anchovy broth and kelp to boil, then remove kelp after 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add fish fillet whole or in large chunks to the broth.
Simmer gently for 8-10 minutes until fish is cooked through but not falling apart.
Mix doenjang paste with 1/4 cup of hot broth in a small bowl, then add to pot.
Add sliced zucchini and simmer for 3 minutes until tender.
Add soy sauce and red chili flakes, adjusting seasoning with salt and pepper.
Stir in chopped green onion and sesame oil just before serving.
Serve hot in bowls with steamed rice on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish fillets which are cheaper than fresh
Make your own anchovy broth from dried anchovies

recipes.name: Gyeran Jjim
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and beat well until completely combined.
Add water or broth, soy sauce, sesame oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper to eggs, whisking until smooth.
Strain mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a heatproof bowl to remove bubbles and ensure silky texture.
Fill a pot with 2 inches of water and bring to boil, then reduce to gentle simmer.
Place the egg-filled bowl in the pot (water bath style) or steam in a steamer basket covered with foil.
Steam for 12-15 minutes until the custard is set but still slightly jiggly in the center.
Remove from heat and let rest for 1 minute.
Top with chopped green onion and sesame seeds, then drizzle with a touch more sesame oil.
Serve immediately with rice and side dishes.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk at warehouse stores for best price
Use water instead of broth to reduce cost further

recipes.name: Japchae
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil the sweet potato noodles according to package directions until tender, drain, and set aside.
Slice the beef thinly against the grain and marinate with 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, minced garlic, and sugar for 10 minutes.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and stir-fry the marinated beef until cooked, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, stir-fry the sliced mushrooms and carrots until softened, about 5 minutes, then add blanched spinach and toss.
Return the beef to the skillet with the cooked noodles, remaining soy sauce, remaining sesame oil, and mix everything together for 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste and transfer to a serving platter.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy mushrooms and spinach on sale or use frozen spinach to reduce cost
Substitute with ground beef instead of sirloin to save 30-40%

recipes.name: Ddukbokki
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak the rice cakes in warm water for 5-10 minutes until slightly softened, then drain.
Mix gochujang, gochugaru, sugar, minced garlic, and fish sauce with water to create the sauce.
Heat vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and pour in the sauce mixture.
Add the softened rice cakes to the boiling sauce and stir frequently for 8-10 minutes until the cakes are cooked and the sauce thickens.
Add chopped green onions and stir to combine.
Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with sesame seeds.
Serve hot and warn guests the sauce is very hot.
cheapTips: Buy rice cakes in bulk at Asian markets for 50% less than regular supermarkets
Make your own sauce with basic pantry items instead of buying pre-made versions

recipes.name: Galbijim
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch the beef short ribs in boiling water for 5 minutes to remove impurities, drain and rinse thoroughly.
In a large pot, combine the ribs with water, soy sauce, minced garlic, ginger, and half the sugar.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 40 minutes until the meat is tender.
Cut carrots and potatoes into uniform chunks and add to the pot with remaining sugar and sesame oil.
Continue simmering for 20 more minutes until vegetables are fully cooked and tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and adjust soy sauce if needed.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve hot in individual bowls with both meat and vegetable broth.
cheapTips: Buy short ribs when on sale or from Asian markets for better prices
Use chicken thighs instead of beef to reduce cost by 40%

recipes.name: Dakgangjeong
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized chunks and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix cornstarch and flour together in a bowl and coat the chicken pieces evenly.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan or wok to 350°F and deep-fry the coated chicken in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 8-10 minutes total, then drain on paper towels.
In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, sugar, water, minced garlic, minced ginger, and rice vinegar, and simmer for 2 minutes.
Return the fried chicken to a large pan and pour the sauce over it, tossing gently to coat evenly.
Cook over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until the sauce caramelizes and coats the chicken.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately while still warm and crispy.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for cheaper, juicier results
Save leftover oil for future frying to reduce waste and cost

recipes.name: Kimbap
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions and transfer to a large bowl while still warm.
Mix rice with sesame oil, rice vinegar, sugar, and salt until well combined and let cool slightly.
Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, squeeze dry, and season with a little sesame oil and salt.
Cut carrots and cucumber into thin matchstick pieces, and cook crab or tuna gently in a pan with a touch of sesame oil.
Make thin egg omelets by beating eggs and cooking them in a pan, then slice into thin strips.
Place a nori sheet shiny side down on a bamboo mat and spread a thin layer of seasoned rice evenly across it.
Arrange a small line of each filling ingredient horizontally across the center of the rice: spinach, carrots, cucumber, egg, and crab.
Roll tightly using the bamboo mat, seal the edge with a bit of water, and slice into 6-8 pieces with a sharp wet knife.
Arrange on a platter, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve at room temperature with soy sauce.
cheapTips: Buy nori in bulk from Asian markets and store in an airtight container
Use imitation crab instead of real crab to save money while maintaining flavor

recipes.name: Ganjang Gejang
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Humanely chill the crabs in the freezer for 15 minutes to make them dormant, then quickly separate the legs and body into pieces.
In a large glass container or bowl, combine soy sauce, water, sugar, minced garlic, sliced ginger, chopped green onions, sliced red chili peppers, and rice vinegar.
Arrange the crab pieces in the marinade, making sure they are submerged, and cover the container.
Refrigerate for at least 24 hours but preferably 2-3 days, stirring gently once per day to ensure even marination.
The crab meat will gradually cook in the soy sauce and develop a rich umami flavor.
Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container and consume within 7-10 days.
To serve, arrange crab pieces on a plate and garnish with sesame seeds and fresh green onion slices.
Serve chilled with the remaining marinade as a dipping sauce with warm rice.
cheapTips: Buy crabs when in season or on sale at Asian seafood markets
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for up to 2 months

recipes.name: Naengmyeon
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil the buckwheat noodles according to package directions until tender, drain, and rinse thoroughly with cold water until chilled.
In a saucepan, heat beef broth and combine with gochugaru, sugar, rice vinegar, minced garlic, and sesame oil to make the cold broth sauce.
Chill the broth sauce in the refrigerator for at least 15 minutes.
Thinly slice the raw beef sirloin and cut cucumber into thin matchstick pieces.
Divide the cold noodles between two bowls and top with sliced beef, cucumber, and halved hard-boiled eggs.
Pour the chilled broth sauce over the noodles until nearly full.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve immediately with small side dishes like kimchi.
Mix everything together before eating and add more vinegar or chili sauce to taste.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pre-cooked beef slices instead of raw sirloin to save time and money
Make broth from scratch using beef bouillon cubes for 50% savings

recipes.name: Ojingeochae
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the squid by removing the innards and skin under running water, then cut the body into rings about 0.5 inches wide.
Bring a pot of water to boil and blanch the squid rings and tentacles for 1-2 minutes until they turn opaque, then drain immediately.
In a large bowl, whisk together gochugaru, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, sugar, and minced garlic.
Add the cooked squid to the dressing and toss well to coat evenly.
Let the squid marinate for 5-10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Add chopped green onions and toss gently.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with sesame seeds, salt, and pepper.
Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled as a side dish or appetizer.
cheapTips: Buy frozen squid instead of fresh for 40% less cost with same quality results
Make in bulk and store in the refrigerator for up to 5 days

recipes.name: Spicy Dak Bokkeum Tang
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken thighs into large chunks and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat sesame oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the chicken chunks until golden brown on all sides, about 8 minutes, then set aside.
In the same pot, mix gochugaru, gochujang, minced garlic, soy sauce, and sugar together.
Return the chicken to the pot and stir to coat evenly with the spicy mixture.
Add water and diced potatoes, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are tender.
Stir occasionally and add more water if the sauce reduces too much.
Season with additional salt and sugar to balance the heat if needed.
Remove from heat, add chopped green onions, and transfer to a serving bowl.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs in bulk when on sale and freeze for later use
Skip the sesame seeds garnish to save 20-30 cents per serving

recipes.name: Sundubu Jjigae
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat sesame oil in a heavy earthenware pot or regular pot over medium-high heat and add minced garlic.
Add ground beef to the pot and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in gochugaru, soy sauce, and sliced mushrooms and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the broth and bring to a boil, then gently add the soft tofu in large spoonfuls without breaking it apart.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
Create three small indentations in the tofu and crack one egg into each, then cover and simmer for 3-4 minutes until eggs are cooked.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and add chopped green onions.
Serve immediately in the hot pot with steamed rice on the side.
Note: This is best served and eaten in individual bowls directly from the heating pot.
cheapTips: Buy soft tofu in bulk from Asian markets at half the price of supermarkets
Use ground chicken or pork instead of beef to save 30% on cost

recipes.name: Hyderabadi Haleem
recipes.description: Hyderabadi lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wheat grains and lentils in water for 30 minutes, then drain.
Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot and add cumin seeds and cinnamon stick until fragrant.
Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown, then add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies.
Add meat pieces and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in yogurt and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add soaked wheat and lentils, followed by water and salt.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 1.5 hours, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Mash the mixture with a spoon until it reaches a thick, porridge-like consistency.
Simmer for another 15 minutes until fully blended, then adjust seasoning and serve hot with fried onions on top.
cheapTips: Buy lentils and wheat in bulk from Indian grocery stores
Use beef instead of lamb to reduce cost significantly

recipes.name: Appam
recipes.description: Kerala breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice in water for 4 hours, then grind to a smooth batter with shredded coconut.
Mix yeast with sugar and 1/4 cup warm water, let it sit for 10 minutes until foamy.
Add yeast mixture to the rice batter and stir well, then cover and let ferment for 8 hours or overnight.
Stir fermented batter to release gas, then add salt and mix.
Heat appam pan or nonstick skillet over medium heat and lightly oil each mold.
Pour batter into molds and cook until the edges are golden and crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Flip carefully and cook the other side until light golden brown.
Remove and serve warm with vegetable stew or chicken curry.
cheapTips: Make large batches and freeze unbaked appams
Buy rice and coconut from Asian markets in bulk

recipes.name: Bibimbap
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook each vegetable (spinach, carrots, zucchini, mushrooms, bean sprouts) separately in boiling salted water for 2-3 minutes until tender-crisp, then drain and season with sesame oil, soy sauce, and garlic.
Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, then season with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a skillet and fry eggs sunny-side up.
Mix gochujang with 1 tbsp sesame oil and 1 tbsp soy sauce to make a sauce.
Divide cooked rice between two bowls and arrange cooked vegetables and beef on top in sections.
Place a fried egg in the center of each bowl and drizzle with gochujang sauce.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over the top and serve, mixing everything together before eating.
cheapTips: Skip expensive mushrooms and use only carrots, zucchini, and spinach
Buy gochujang from Asian markets instead of specialty stores

recipes.name: Bulgogi
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, minced garlic, ginger, pear, and rice vinegar in a bowl to make the marinade.
Add black pepper and stir until sugar dissolves completely.
Place beef slices in a large zip-lock bag or shallow bowl and pour marinade over them.
Massage the marinade into the beef, cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat until very hot.
Remove beef from marinade, shaking off excess, and cook in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until caramelized.
Transfer cooked beef to a plate and add onion slices to the pan, cooking for 2 minutes until softened.
Return beef to the pan, toss with onions, and serve immediately with rice and lettuce wraps.
cheapTips: Use flank steak instead of sirloin for savings
Skip the pear and use apple juice as a substitute

recipes.name: Kimchi Jjigae
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat sesame oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown pork cubes for 5 minutes.
Add chopped onion and garlic, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in chopped kimchi and gochugaru, cooking for 3 minutes to release flavors.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add tofu cubes and cook for 10 minutes until tofu absorbs flavors.
Season with soy sauce and sugar, adjusting to taste.
Simmer for another 5 minutes, then top with chopped green onions and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Use store-bought kimchi from Asian markets instead of making from scratch
Substitute tofu with canned spam if preferred

recipes.name: Tteokbokki
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak frozen rice cakes in warm water for 5 minutes if using frozen, then drain.
Mix gochujang, gochugaru, sugar, garlic, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a bowl to create the sauce.
Bring vegetable broth to a boil in a shallow pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sauce mixture to the boiling broth and stir well until combined.
Add rice cakes and fish cake (if using) to the sauce and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
The rice cakes should become chewy and the sauce should thicken slightly.
Top with chopped green onions and sesame seeds, then serve hot in bowls with the sauce.
cheapTips: Buy frozen rice cakes in bulk from Asian markets
Skip fish cake to save money and keep it vegetarian

recipes.name: Jajangmyeon
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil and cook wheat noodles according to package directions, then drain and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a separate pot and brown ground meat over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the meat, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add diced potato and stir, then add black bean paste and mix thoroughly to coat the meat and vegetables.
Pour in water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 8 minutes until potato is tender.
Mix cornstarch with 2 tbsp water to make a slurry, then stir into the sauce to thicken it.
Add soy sauce and sugar, adjusting seasoning to taste.
Divide noodles between two bowls and top with the black bean sauce, then garnish with cucumber slices and serve.
cheapTips: Buy black bean paste in bulk from Korean markets
Use ground beef instead of pork to save money

recipes.name: Samgyetang
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse the whole chicken inside and out, then blanch briefly in boiling water and drain.
Stuff the chicken cavity with glutinous rice, 2-3 jujubes, 1 piece of ginseng, and garlic cloves.
Place stuffed chicken in a large pot and cover with chicken broth, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes, skimming foam from the surface as it accumulates.
Add ginger slices, remaining jujubes, and ginkgo nuts, then simmer for another 15 minutes.
Season with salt and sesame oil to taste.
Carefully transfer chicken to a serving bowl with broth and garnish with chopped green onions, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Use dried jujubes and ginseng from Asian markets instead of specialty stores
Omit expensive ginkgo nuts and use more ginseng instead

recipes.name: Galbitang
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch beef short ribs in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water to remove impurities.
In a large pot, bring 8 cups fresh water to boil and add cleaned ribs, quartered onion, garlic cloves, and ginger slices.
Simmer for 45 minutes until meat is tender, skimming foam from surface regularly.
Strain broth and return it to the pot, then add cubed daikon radish and cook for 15 minutes.
Soak sweet potato noodles in warm water for 10 minutes until softened, then drain.
Add softened noodles to the broth and cook for 5 minutes, then add cooked beef ribs back to the pot.
Season with soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt, then add sesame leaves and simmer for 2 minutes.
Top with chopped green onions and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Ask your butcher for beef rib tips instead of premium short ribs
Omit sesame leaves and use spinach as a substitute

recipes.name: Budae Jjigae
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat sesame oil in a large stew pot over medium heat and brown spam slices on both sides until edges are crispy.
Remove spam and add beef hot dogs, cooking for 2 minutes until slightly browned, then push everything to the sides.
Mix gochujang, gochugaru, garlic, and sugar in the center of the pot, stirring to combine.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a simmer, then add kimchi and stir well.
Return spam and hot dogs to the pot, then add baked beans and tofu cubes.
Break instant ramen noodles and add to the pot (discard seasoning packet or save for another use), cooking for 3-4 minutes until noodles soften.
Season with soy sauce and adjust flavor to taste.
Top with chopped green onions and serve hot directly from the pot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy spam and hot dogs on sale and freeze for later use
Use leftover kimchi from previous dishes to save money

recipes.name: Ga Nuong
recipes.description: Vietnamese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and finely chop lemongrass, then combine with fish sauce, honey, soy sauce, lime juice, and black pepper in a bowl.
Cut chicken thighs into 2-inch pieces and coat thoroughly with the marinade, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add marinated chicken in a single layer.
Cook for 6-7 minutes per side until caramelized and cooked through, turning occasionally to brown all sides.
Transfer to a serving plate and drizzle with any remaining sauce from the pan.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts—they're cheaper and more flavorful
Use bottled minced garlic to save prep time

recipes.name: Bo Nuong La Lot
recipes.description: Vietnamese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and shallot, then mix with ground beef, fish sauce, lime juice, and sesame seeds.
Blanch grape leaves in boiling water for 2 minutes to soften, then lay flat on a work surface.
Place 1 tablespoon of beef mixture in the center of each leaf and fold sides in, then roll tightly into a cylinder.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and place wrapped rolls seam-side down.
Cook for 4-5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through, working in batches if needed.
cheapTips: Use frozen grape leaves from an international market instead of fresh betel leaves
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Banh Chung
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak sticky rice and mung beans separately in cold water for 2 hours, then drain thoroughly.
Cut pork belly into 4 equal chunks and season with 0.5 tsp salt.
Cook mung beans in 2 cups water for 30 minutes until tender, then drain and season with salt.
Toast sticky rice in a dry pan for 3 minutes, then cook in 3 cups water for 15 minutes until nearly done.
Blanch banana leaves in boiling water for 1 minute to soften, then lay one leaf flat.
Layer rice, mung beans, pork, mung beans, and rice in the center of the leaf, then fold sides in and tie securely with twine.
Place wrapped packets in a pot, cover with water, and boil for 3 hours, checking water level occasionally.
cheapTips: Buy sticky rice and mung beans in bulk from an Asian market
Use banana leaves from the frozen section instead of fresh pandan leaves

recipes.name: Cua Rang Me
recipes.description: Vietnamese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Kill crabs humanely, remove the top shell, clean out innards, and cut each crab into quarters.
Mince garlic and chili, then mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, sugar, and water together in a bowl.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and stir-fry garlic and chili for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add crab pieces and stir-fry for 3 minutes until they begin to brown.
Pour in tamarind sauce and reduce heat to medium, then cover and cook for 8-10 minutes until crabs are cooked through and sauce is glossy.
cheapTips: Buy frozen crab instead of live crab to save money
Make tamarind paste from concentrate rather than buying pre-made paste

recipes.name: Tom Rang Muoi
recipes.description: Vietnamese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat shrimp dry and leave shells intact, then toss with salt and sugar in a bowl.
Slice garlic and break dried chilies in half, removing seeds if you prefer less heat.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and add garlic and dried chilies, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp in a single layer and cook without stirring for 3 minutes until they begin to brown on one side.
Toss and continue cooking for 2-3 minutes more until shells turn completely orange and shrimp are cooked through.
Squeeze lime juice over the top and sprinkle with black pepper just before serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp when on sale and stock your freezer
Skip the lime juice or use bottled to reduce prep costs

recipes.name: Bun Bo Hue
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch beef and pork in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain, and rinse under cold water.
Smash lemongrass stalks and mince garlic, then combine with 1 tbsp shrimp paste.
Bring beef broth to a boil in a large pot and add blanched meat, lemongrass, and garlic-shrimp paste mixture.
Simmer for 60 minutes until meat is tender, then strain broth and season with fish sauce.
Shred cooked meat and divide between serving bowls, then pour hot broth over the top.
Cook rice vermicelli according to package directions, drain, and place in bowls.
Serve with lime wedges and fresh herbs on the side for guests to add to taste.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck instead of shank to reduce cost
Use store-made broth instead of making from scratch

recipes.name: Bun Rieu
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crush crab shells and simmer in chicken broth for 20 minutes to extract flavor, then strain through cheesecloth.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds, then add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in strained crab broth and bring to a boil, then add shrimp and simmer for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Season soup with fish sauce and lime juice, then remove from heat.
Cook rice vermicelli according to package directions, drain, and divide among serving bowls.
Ladle hot soup over noodles and serve with fresh herbs and lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Use frozen crab instead of fresh to lower cost significantly
Buy pre-made chicken broth rather than making your own

recipes.name: Banh Hoai
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour, tapioca flour, salt, and water in a bowl until smooth, then let rest for 10 minutes.
Dice pork belly and shrimp into small pieces, then season with fish sauce.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a small skillet over medium heat and sauté pork until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes until beginning to turn pink, then add chopped scallions and remove from heat.
Heat remaining 2 tbsp oil in a flat skillet over medium-high heat, then pour 0.25 cup batter into the center.
Immediately scatter 2 tbsp of pork-shrimp filling over the batter, then cook for 3-4 minutes until the bottom is golden and crispy.
Slide onto a plate and serve while warm with fish sauce dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy shrimp on sale and freeze until ready to use
Use cheaper pork shoulder instead of pork belly if budget is tight

recipes.name: Cassoulet
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried beans overnight in cold water, then drain and rinse.
Cut pork shoulder into 2-inch chunks and brown in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, then remove and set aside.
Brown sausage links in the same pot for 5 minutes, then remove and slice into thick rounds.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic in the remaining fat for 3 minutes until soft.
Return pork to the pot, add beans, chicken broth, tomato paste, and bay leaves, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook in a 325°F oven for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Nestle duck confit thighs and sausage slices into the cassoulet, top with bread crumbs mixed with melted fat, then bake uncovered for 30 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Skip duck confit and use regular roasted duck or additional sausage instead
Buy dried beans in bulk from a discount grocer

recipes.name: Bouillabaisse
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced fennel, onion, and minced garlic for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add saffron and fish stock and bring to a simmer.
Simmer for 15 minutes to allow flavors to develop, then add fish fillets and mussels to the pot.
Cook for 5 minutes, then add shrimp and simmer for 3 more minutes until all seafood is cooked through and mussels have opened.
Discard any unopened mussels, then season the broth with salt and pepper to taste.
Toast bread slices until golden, then ladle soup into serving bowls and serve with toasted bread on the side.
cheapTips: Use store-bought fish stock instead of making your own
Buy frozen mussels and shrimp to reduce cost and prep time

recipes.name: Goi Cuon
recipes.description: Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dip each rice paper wrapper in warm water for 5 seconds until pliable and lay on a damp towel.
Slice cucumber into thin matchsticks and arrange lettuce, noodles, cucumber, mint, and cilantro on each wrapper.
Place 2-3 shrimp on top of the filling and fold in the sides, then roll tightly like a burrito.
Mix fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, water, and minced garlic in a bowl to make dipping sauce.
Serve rolls immediately with the sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk when on sale and thaw before using
Use dried rice vermicelli which is very inexpensive

recipes.name: Cha Gio
recipes.description: Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook ground pork in a skillet over medium heat until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, then mix in crab meat, cooked noodles, shredded carrot, mushrooms, fish sauce, and black pepper.
Dip rice paper wrappers in warm water for 3 seconds and lay on a damp surface.
Place 2 tablespoons of filling on the lower third of each wrapper, fold in the sides, and roll tightly.
Heat oil to 350°F in a heavy pot and fry rolls in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with sweet and sour sauce or fish sauce dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions
Substitute canned crab meat which is cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Tom Yum
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add smashed lemongrass, galangal slices, and whole chilies.
Simmer for 5 minutes to infuse flavors, then add minced garlic and mushrooms.
Add shrimp and simmer for 3-4 minutes until shrimp turns pink and is cooked through.
Stir in fish sauce and lime juice, then add cherry tomatoes and heat through for 1 minute.
Remove from heat, discard lemongrass and galangal pieces, garnish with cilantro, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp which is cheaper than fresh
Skip galangal if unavailable and use extra ginger instead

recipes.name: Canh Chua Ca
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring vegetable broth to a boil and add minced garlic and sliced onion, cooking for 3 minutes.
Stir in tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar, then add pineapple chunks and tomatoes.
Gently place fish fillets into the broth and simmer for 5 minutes until fish is nearly cooked.
Add okra slices and chopped chilies, then simmer for 3-4 minutes more until okra is tender and fish is fully cooked.
Taste and adjust seasoning with fish sauce or tamarind, then garnish with cilantro and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use affordable white fish like tilapia or catfish
Buy canned pineapple which is cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Mam Tom
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound garlic and Thai chilies together in a mortar and pestle until a rough paste forms.
Add shrimp paste to the garlic-chili mixture and pound until combined.
Stir in fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, and water to create a dipping paste.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat and add cubed eggplant.
Stir-fry eggplant for 8-10 minutes until golden and tender, stirring occasionally.
Serve the roasted eggplant hot with the shrimp paste dip on the side.
cheapTips: Shrimp paste is inexpensive and lasts a long time
Eggplant is one of the cheapest vegetables year-round

recipes.name: Banh Khot
recipes.description: Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together rice flour, cornstarch, salt, coconut milk, and water until smooth batter forms with no lumps.
Heat a banh khot pan or small muffin tin pan with oil over medium-high heat for 2 minutes.
Pour about 2 tablespoons of batter into each cup and bake until edges are golden, about 1 minute.
Place one shrimp and a pinch of mung beans into each cup, then top with more batter.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes until the bottoms are crispy and golden brown.
Use a thin spatula to pry each cake out and transfer to a serving plate, garnish with scallions.
cheapTips: Use coconut milk from a can which is cheaper than fresh
Make bean sprouts at home from dried mung beans

recipes.name: Banh Bot Loc
recipes.description: Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix tapioca starch, wheat starch, and salt in a bowl, then slowly add boiling water while stirring until a rough dough forms.
Knead the dough with oiled hands for 2 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Fry diced pork belly in a skillet until crispy, about 4 minutes, then set aside.
Take a piece of dough, flatten it into a thin disc, place 1 shrimp and a pinch of pork in the center, then fold into a half-moon shape.
Place each banh bot loc on a banana leaf square and steam in a bamboo steamer for 5 minutes until dough becomes translucent.
Mix fish sauce with lime juice for dipping and serve hot with dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy tapioca starch in bulk from Asian grocery stores
Use parchment paper instead of banana leaf if unavailable

recipes.name: Nem Cua Be
recipes.description: Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix crab meat, chopped shrimp, cooked rice noodles, minced garlic, fish sauce, sugar, and black pepper in a bowl.
Beat egg in a small bowl and add to the filling mixture, stirring until well combined.
Place 2 tablespoons of filling on the lower third of each spring roll wrapper.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly into a cylinder, sealing the edge with a damp finger.
Heat oil to 350°F in a heavy pot and fry rolls in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with dipping sauce made from fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, water, and minced garlic.
cheapTips: Use canned crab meat which is much cheaper than fresh
Buy shrimp frozen in bulk and thaw as needed

recipes.name: Thit Nuong Xa
recipes.description: Vietnamese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Combine minced lemongrass, garlic, shallots, fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, oil, and black pepper in a bowl.
Add sliced pork to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it marinate for 15 minutes.
Thread marinated pork slices onto skewers, folding and layering the meat.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat and grill skewers for 3-4 minutes per side until meat is charred at the edges and cooked through.
Serve hot with rice, fresh vegetables, and additional dipping sauce made from the reserved marinade mixed with water.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder which is the cheapest cut of pork
Use store-brand fish sauce to save money

recipes.name: Canh Chua Tom
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot and add minced garlic and sliced onion.
Stir in tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar, simmering for 3 minutes to blend flavors.
Add pineapple chunks and chopped tomatoes, then bring back to a boil.
Add shrimp and okra slices, simmering for 4-5 minutes until shrimp turns pink and okra is tender.
Stir in chopped Thai chilies and taste for seasoning, adjusting fish sauce or tamarind as desired.
Ladle into bowls, garnish with fresh cilantro, and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp which is cheaper than fresh and works just as well
Use canned pineapple in juice to save money

recipes.name: Tiropita
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix feta, ricotta, eggs, dill, salt, and pepper in a bowl until well combined.
Brush a 9x13 baking dish with melted butter.
Layer 4 sheets of phyllo dough in the dish, brushing each sheet with butter.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the phyllo.
Layer remaining phyllo sheets on top, brushing each with butter.
Cut the tiropita into squares or triangles with a sharp knife.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough on sale and freeze it
Use store-brand feta to reduce costs

recipes.name: Kolokithokeftedes
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Grate zucchini and squeeze out excess moisture using a clean towel.
Mix zucchini with feta, flour, eggs, mint, salt, and pepper until combined.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Drop spoonfuls of mixture into hot oil and flatten slightly with the back of the spoon.
Fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with Greek yogurt.
cheapTips: Use regular yogurt instead of Greek yogurt to save money
Make a larger batch and freeze for later

recipes.name: Yemista Domates
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cut off the tops of tomatoes and scoop out the insides, reserving the juice.
Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté onion and garlic until softened.
Add rice to the pan and stir for 2 minutes, then add tomato juice, water, parsley, dill, salt, and pepper.
Simmer the rice mixture for 10 minutes until partially cooked.
Fill each tomato with the rice mixture, place in a baking dish, and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until tomatoes are tender and rice is cooked through.
cheapTips: Use generic long-grain rice instead of specialty varieties
Buy tomatoes in season for better prices

recipes.name: Souvlaki Psariko
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Cut fish into 1.5-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Pour the marinade over fish and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Thread fish cubes onto skewers, alternating sides.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and oil the grates.
Grill souvlaki for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through and lightly charred.
Serve with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy fish on sale and freeze until ready to use
Use frozen fish if fresh is too expensive

recipes.name: Paidakia
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Rub the marinade generously on both sides of each lamb chop.
Let chops marinate for at least 10 minutes at room temperature.
Heat a grill or grill pan to high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Grill chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare doneness.
Let rest for 2 minutes before serving with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy lamb chops when on sale and freeze
Check ethnic markets for better lamb prices

recipes.name: Koulouri
recipes.description: Greek breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine warm water, yeast, and sugar in a bowl and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt in a large bowl, then add yeast mixture and olive oil.
Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a long rope about 12 inches.
Shape each rope into a ring by wrapping around your hand and pinching the ends together.
Beat egg and brush over each koulouri, then dip in sesame seeds.
Place on a baking sheet, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes.
Bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze extras
Buy flour in bulk to reduce per-serving costs

recipes.name: Paella Valenciana
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat chicken broth with saffron threads and keep warm.
Heat olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken cubes until browned, about 5 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in the same pan for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes to coat with oil.
Pour in the warm saffron broth and bring to a simmer without stirring.
Add green beans and return chicken to the pan, then simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Omit saffron and use turmeric for a similar color at a fraction of the cost
Use boneless chicken thighs instead of breast for better flavor and lower cost

recipes.name: Paella de Marisco
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat fish broth with saffron threads and keep warm.
Heat olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Sauté onion and garlic for 3 minutes until softened.
Add rice and paprika, then stir for 2 minutes to coat.
Pour in the warm saffron broth and bring to a simmer.
Cook without stirring for 15 minutes.
Nestle shrimp, mussels, and clams into the rice, then cover and simmer for 10 minutes until seafood is cooked.
Remove from heat and garnish with parsley and salt to taste.
cheapTips: Buy frozen seafood instead of fresh for significant savings
Use a mix of frozen and fresh seafood to balance cost and quality

recipes.name: Gazpacho
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roughly chop tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, and tear bread into pieces.
Place vegetables, bread, garlic, salt, and pepper in a blender or food processor.
Add olive oil and red wine vinegar.
Blend until smooth, then add ice water and blend briefly to combine.
Strain through a fine sieve if you prefer a smoother soup.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or serve immediately with ice.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and vinegar as needed.
cheapTips: Make with canned tomatoes when fresh are out of season
Use day-old bread from a bakery discount bin

recipes.name: Salmorejo
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roughly chop tomatoes and tear bread into small pieces.
Place tomatoes, bread, garlic, salt, and pepper in a blender or food processor.
Blend until completely smooth, then add olive oil slowly while blending to emulsify.
Add red wine vinegar and blend to combine.
Divide into serving bowls and chill until ready to serve.
Top each bowl with crispy serrano ham pieces and chopped hard-boiled egg.
cheapTips: Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh to save money and reduce prep time
Skip the serrano ham or use regular ham as a cheaper alternative

recipes.name: Croque Monsieur
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a small saucepan over medium heat, whisk in flour to make a roux, and cook for 1 minute.
Add milk slowly while whisking constantly until the sauce thickens, then season with salt and pepper.
Spread dijon mustard on two bread slices and arrange ham and grated gruyere on top of each.
Top each sandwich with another bread slice and spread the béchamel sauce on the outside of both sandwiches.
Heat remaining butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook each sandwich for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese melts.
cheapTips: Use Swiss cheese instead of gruyere for savings.
Buy deli ham on sale and freeze for later use.

recipes.name: Sole Meunière
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat sole fillets dry with paper towels and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Beat the egg in a shallow bowl, then dip each fillet into egg and dredge lightly in flour, shaking off excess.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until foaming.
Cook fillets for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and flaky, then transfer to a serving plate.
Add remaining 2 tablespoons butter to the pan, let it brown for 1-2 minutes, then pour over the fish with fresh lemon juice and chopped parsley.
cheapTips: Substitute flounder or tilapia for sole to reduce cost.
Use frozen fillets which are often cheaper than fresh.

recipes.name: Coq à la Crème
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper, then brown them in butter in a large Dutch oven for 4-5 minutes per side and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté pearl onions and sliced mushrooms for 5 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables, stir for 1 minute, then deglaze with white wine, scraping up browned bits.
Return chicken to the pot with broth and thyme, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove from heat, stir in cream, and season to taste before serving over rice or egg noodles.
cheapTips: Use bone-in chicken legs instead of thighs for better value.
Make your own stock from chicken bones to save money.

recipes.name: Steak Frites
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch fries, soak in cold water for 15 minutes, then pat dry thoroughly.
Heat oil to 325°F in a large pot and fry potatoes in batches for 5-7 minutes until softened but not colored, then drain on paper towels.
Season steaks generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat until smoking, sear steaks for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, then rest for 5 minutes with butter, garlic, and rosemary.
Increase oil temperature to 375°F and fry potatoes again for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy, then season with salt and serve alongside steak with lemon.
cheapTips: Buy sirloin steak instead of ribeye for significant savings.
Use canola oil instead of premium oils for frying.

recipes.name: Nicoise Salad
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes until tender (about 12 minutes), then cool and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Arrange romaine lettuce on a platter and arrange tuna, eggs, tomatoes, olives, anchovies, and potatoes on top.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Drizzle dressing over salad just before serving.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand canned tuna instead of premium brands.
Use frozen hard-boiled eggs for convenience and lower cost.

recipes.name: Escargots de Bourgogne
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and rinse canned escargot under cool water, then drain well.
Mince garlic, parsley, and shallots together finely and mix with softened butter, wine, salt, and pepper.
Fill each shell halfway with garlic-parsley butter, place an escargot inside, then top with remaining butter.
Arrange filled shells in a baking dish with the opening facing up.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until butter is bubbly and hot, then serve immediately in the shells.
cheapTips: Buy canned escargot on sale and freeze for later.
Make extra garlic butter in batches to use throughout the month.

recipes.name: Blanquette de Veau
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut veal into 2-inch pieces, blanch in boiling salted water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat, add veal, pearl onions, and carrots, cooking without browning for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over meat, stir for 1 minute, then add broth and bay leaf, bring to a simmer, and cook covered for 35-40 minutes.
Add mushrooms and simmer for 5 more minutes until all ingredients are tender.
Whisk egg yolks with cream in a bowl, slowly add a ladleful of hot broth while whisking, then pour mixture into pot while stirring constantly off heat, season to taste, and serve.
cheapTips: Substitute pork or chicken for veal to reduce cost significantly.
Buy mushrooms when on sale and freeze for later use.

recipes.name: Pot-au-Feu
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place beef and marrow bones in a large pot with cold water to cover by 2 inches, bring to a boil, then skim foam for 5 minutes.
Add halved onion, carrots, celery, leeks, bay leaf, and thyme, reduce heat, and simmer gently for 60 minutes until beef is tender.
Remove vegetables and beef to a plate, then strain broth back into the pot.
Add peeled potatoes and return broth to a simmer for 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Return beef and other vegetables to the pot to warm through, season with salt and pepper, and serve in bowls with broth.
cheapTips: Use beef shank or brisket instead of chuck for better price.
Buy frozen vegetables to reduce prep time and cost.

recipes.name: Choucroute Garnie
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse sauerkraut under cold water and squeeze out excess moisture.
Layer half the sauerkraut in a large heavy pot, then arrange bratwurst, pork belly, ham hock, sliced onion, and caraway seeds on top.
Cover with remaining sauerkraut, add wine, broth, and bay leaf, then cover and simmer for 40-45 minutes.
Add peeled potatoes cut into chunks and continue cooking for 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Serve everything together in a large bowl with cooking liquid spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand sauerkraut instead of premium brands.
Use chicken instead of pork for a leaner, cheaper option.

recipes.name: Moules Marinières
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Scrub mussels under cold running water, remove any beards, and discard any that don't close when tapped.
Mince shallots and garlic finely.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat, add shallots and garlic, and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in white wine, add bay leaf, then bring to a boil and add mussels in one batch.

Cover and cook for 5-7 minutes, shaking the pot halfway through, until all shells open; discard any that remain closed, stir in fresh parsley, and season to taste before serving in bowls with the cooking liquid.
cheapTips: Buy mussels at farmers markets often cheaper than supermarkets.
Use dry white cooking wine which is usually lower cost than premium wine.

recipes.name: Pastitsada
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs on all sides for 8 minutes.
Remove chicken and sauté diced onions and minced garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then deglaze with red wine and scrape up browned bits.
Return chicken to pot and add broth, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, and peppercorns.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 60-75 minutes until chicken is very tender.
Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
Plate pasta and top with chicken and sauce, discarding bay leaves and cinnamon stick.
Serve hot with fresh parsley if available.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breast—they're cheaper and more flavorful
Use store-brand pasta and tomato paste to cut costs

recipes.name: Kleftiko
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and line a large sheet of parchment paper on a baking sheet.
Make slits in the lamb and insert whole garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs throughout the meat.
Rub lamb with olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper on all sides.
Place lamb in center of parchment, surround with sliced tomatoes and onion, and top with crumbled feta.
Fold parchment paper tightly around the lamb to create a sealed packet.
Bake for 2.5-3 hours until lamb is fork-tender.
Carefully open the packet away from your face to release steam.
Transfer lamb and vegetables to a serving platter and pour pan juices over top.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shoulder on sale and freeze until needed
Skip fresh rosemary and use dried for 1 teaspoon

recipes.name: Gemista
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and lightly oil a baking dish.
Halve tomatoes and peppers, then place cut-side-up in the baking dish.
Dice onion and garlic, then distribute over the vegetable halves along with uncooked rice.
Drizzle olive oil over everything and sprinkle with oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour vegetable broth carefully around the vegetables.
Cover with foil and bake for 50-60 minutes until rice is tender and vegetables are soft.
Remove foil and bake an additional 10 minutes to lightly brown tops.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy tomatoes and peppers when on sale and freeze for later
Use white or brown rice—cheapest option at bulk stores

recipes.name: Fasolada
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse dried beans and place in a pot with 6 cups of water, then bring to boil and remove any foam.
Drain beans and return to pot with fresh vegetable broth.
Dice onion, garlic, carrot, and celery, then add to pot with bay leaf and bring to simmer.
Simmer for 45 minutes until beans are nearly tender.
In a bowl, whisk together tomato paste with olive oil and 1/4 cup hot broth.
Stir tomato paste mixture into the soup along with salt and pepper.
Continue simmering for 15 more minutes until beans are completely soft and creamy.
Stir in vinegar and adjust seasoning, then serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy dried beans in bulk—significantly cheaper than canned
Use homemade vegetable broth or water with bouillon cubes

recipes.name: Horta
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into large chunks and boil in salted water for 15 minutes until just tender.
Meanwhile, trim and rinse the greens, discarding thick stems.
Add greens to the pot with potatoes and simmer for 3-5 minutes until wilted.
Drain everything in a colander, pressing gently to remove excess water.
Transfer to a serving plate and drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use whatever greens are cheapest—spinach, kale, or collard greens all work
Buy potatoes by the bag for the best price

recipes.name: Salade Horiatiki
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop tomatoes into large chunks and place in a large bowl.
Chop cucumber, red onion, and bell pepper into chunks and add to bowl.
Top with kalamata olives and cube the feta cheese over the vegetables.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, and oregano.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy feta in bulk or from the deli counter for better prices
Use pitted olives to save prep time

recipes.name: Stifado
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into 2-inch cubes and heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown beef in batches for 8 minutes per batch, then set aside.
Peel pearl onions and garlic cloves, then sauté in the pot for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then deglaze with red wine.
Return beef to pot and add broth, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, cloves, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low heat for 1.5-2 hours until beef is tender.
Remove and discard bay leaves and cinnamon stick.
Serve hot, dividing beef and onions equally among bowls with sauce poured over.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck when on sale and freeze for later use
Frozen pearl onions are cheaper than fresh and already peeled

recipes.name: Pastitsada Corfou
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into large pieces and heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown chicken on all sides for 10 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onions and minced garlic until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then deglaze with red wine.
Return chicken to pot with broth, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, peppercorns, and salt.
Simmer covered for 60-75 minutes until chicken is very tender.
Cook pasta separately in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
Divide pasta among bowls and top with chicken and sauce, sprinkled with grated cheese.
cheapTips: Use chicken drumsticks and thighs instead of whole chicken
Buy grated Parmesan instead of whole block to save time and money

recipes.name: Htipiti
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crumble feta cheese into a food processor and add Greek yogurt.
Add lemon juice, olive oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Pulse until smooth and creamy, scraping down sides as needed.
Transfer to a serving bowl and smooth the top with the back of a spoon.
Drizzle with additional olive oil and sprinkle red pepper flakes on top.
Serve with pita chips or crackers.
cheapTips: Use store-brand feta and Greek yogurt
Make your own pita chips from pita bread instead of buying

recipes.name: Melitzanosalata
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and prick eggplants all over with a fork.
Roast eggplants directly on oven rack for 25-30 minutes until completely soft and collapsing.
Cool until barely warm, then scoop flesh into a colander and let drain for 5 minutes.
Transfer eggplant to a bowl and mash with a fork until slightly chunky.
Mince garlic and finely dice red onion, then fold into eggplant.
Stir in lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Fold in chopped fresh parsley and adjust seasoning if needed.
Transfer to a serving dish and serve at room temperature with pita bread or crackers.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants when in season for best prices
Use dried parsley if fresh is unavailable or expensive

recipes.name: Blanquette à l'Ancienne
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut veal into 1.5-inch cubes and blanch in boiling salted water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse.
In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat and add flour to create a roux, stirring constantly for 2 minutes.
Gradually add chicken broth to the roux, whisking until smooth, then add blanched meat, bay leaf, and simmer for 40 minutes.
Add pearl onions, carrots, and mushrooms, and simmer for 20 more minutes until vegetables are tender.
In a bowl, whisk egg yolk with milk and lemon juice to create the liaison.
Slowly temper the egg mixture by adding hot broth while whisking, then stir into the pot off heat.
Season with salt and white pepper, ensuring the sauce is creamy and smooth.
Serve hot in shallow bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use chicken instead of veal for significant savings.
Buy frozen pearl onions and mushrooms to reduce prep time and cost.

recipes.name: Pastitsio
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and cook penne according to package directions, then drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet and sauté diced onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart, about 8 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cinnamon, cooking for 2 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
In a saucepan, melt 4 tablespoons butter and whisk in flour to create a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Gradually add milk while whisking until the béchamel is smooth and thick, about 5 minutes.
Toss cooked pasta with half the béchamel and half the Parmesan, then layer in a greased 9x13 baking dish.
Spread meat sauce over pasta, then top with remaining béchamel and Parmesan.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden brown on top.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use.
Make the béchamel ahead of time to reduce active cooking time.

recipes.name: Souvlaki
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork or chicken into 1-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper, then pour over meat.
Marinate for at least 15 minutes at room temperature, or up to 4 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread meat onto metal skewers, alternating with onion and tomato pieces.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to high heat and cook skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until meat is cooked through.
Warm pita bread on the grill for 30 seconds per side.
Serve skewers with pita, fresh tomato and onion slices, and tzatziki sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale and freeze; it marinates beautifully.
Use wooden skewers soaked in water instead of metal to save money.

recipes.name: Gyro
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pulse minced onion and garlic in a food processor until finely chopped.
In a bowl, combine ground meat, onion-garlic mixture, bread crumbs, oregano, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Form mixture into a loaf shape and place on a sheet pan lined with foil.
Drizzle with olive oil and bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes until cooked through.
Slice the cooked gyro meat into thin strips.
Warm pita bread in the oven for 2 minutes or on a skillet.
Fill each pita with gyro meat, tomato slices, onion, and a generous dollop of tzatziki sauce.
cheapTips: Use all ground beef instead of beef and lamb blend to save money.
Make tzatziki at home with yogurt, cucumber, and garlic instead of buying pre-made.

recipes.name: Spanakopita
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thaw and squeeze dry the frozen spinach thoroughly to remove excess moisture.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in olive oil over medium heat until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add spinach and cook for 2 minutes, then remove from heat and let cool.
In a bowl, mix cooked spinach, crumbled feta, egg, dill, salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Preheat oven to 375°F and brush a 9x9 baking dish with olive oil.
Layer 4 sheets of phyllo dough in the dish, brushing each sheet with olive oil.
Spread spinach-feta filling evenly over phyllo, then layer remaining 4 phyllo sheets on top, brushing each with olive oil.
Score the top into 4 squares and bake for 30 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough on sale and freeze for future use.
Use block feta and crumble it yourself instead of pre-crumbled.

recipes.name: Saganaki
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cheese into 1/2-inch thick slices and pat dry with paper towels.
In one shallow dish, place flour mixed with salt and pepper; in another, beat the egg.
Coat each cheese slice in flour, then dip in egg, then dip in flour again.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry coated cheese slices for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer to a plate and squeeze fresh lemon juice over warm cheese immediately.
cheapTips: Use feta cheese instead of halloumi for lower cost.
Make in bulk and reheat briefly in the oven instead of frying again.

recipes.name: Dolmades
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse grape leaves under cold water and pat dry, then set aside.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in a skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add ground meat and cook until browned, breaking apart, about 5 minutes.
Stir in uncooked rice, mint, dill, salt, and pepper, and remove from heat.
Place a grape leaf shiny-side down, spoon 1 tablespoon filling near the stem, fold sides in, then roll tightly.
Arrange rolled dolmades seam-side down in a pot, packing them snugly.
Pour beef broth and lemon juice over dolmades, then place a plate on top to keep them in place.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 35-40 minutes until rice is tender.
Serve warm or at room temperature with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze uncooked dolmades for later.
Use ground beef instead of lamb to reduce cost significantly.

recipes.name: Tzatziki
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Grate cucumber and squeeze out excess moisture using a fine-mesh strainer or clean cloth.
Mince garlic finely or press through a garlic press.
In a bowl, combine Greek yogurt, grated cucumber, minced garlic, lemon juice, and dill.
Stir well and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Drizzle with olive oil and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Serve with warm pita, vegetables, or alongside grilled meats.
cheapTips: Buy Greek yogurt in large containers instead of single servings.
Make a big batch to use throughout the week with different meals.

recipes.name: Loukoumades
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
In a large bowl, combine flour and salt, then make a well in the center.
Pour yeast mixture into the well and mix until a thick, sticky batter forms.
Cover with a damp cloth and let rise for 30 minutes until slightly puffy.
Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F, using a thermometer to monitor temperature.
Using two wet spoons, drop golf-ball sized portions of batter into hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 1-2 minutes per side.
Drain fried loukoumades on paper towels.
In a small saucepan, warm honey with cinnamon, then drizzle over warm loukoumades and sprinkle with chopped nuts.
cheapTips: Buy honey in bulk containers to save on this high-use ingredient.
Use regular peanuts instead of walnuts or pistachios for significant savings.

recipes.name: Keftedes
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pulse onion and garlic in a food processor until finely minced.
In a bowl, combine ground meat, bread crumbs, onion-garlic mixture, egg, mint, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Form mixture into 12-16 meatballs, about 1.5 inches in diameter.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Working in batches, brown meatballs on all sides for about 8-10 minutes total, turning occasionally.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over cooked meatballs.
Serve warm with tzatziki sauce, lemon wedges, and fresh pita bread.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of lamb for more budget-friendly meatballs.
Make extra and freeze raw meatballs for quick weeknight meals.

recipes.name: Couscous Royal
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken and lamb into 1.5-inch chunks and brown them in a large pot over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, then set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion and carrots for 3 minutes until softened.
Add turmeric, return meat to pot, and pour in broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, then add chickpeas and sliced zucchini.
Add sausages and simmer for 10 more minutes until vegetables are tender.
Place couscous in a bowl and pour 3 cups hot broth over it, cover with foil for 5 minutes until fluffy.
Fluff couscous with a fork and stir in butter, then mound on serving plates.
Ladle meat and vegetables over couscous and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy sausage on sale and freeze; substitute ground lamb for stew meat
Use dried chickpeas soaked overnight instead of canned to save 40%

recipes.name: Chicken Normande
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper, then brown skin-side down in butter over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, flip and brown 4 minutes more, then remove.
In the same pot, sauté sliced mushrooms and pearl onions for 4 minutes until golden.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir for 1 minute to coat.
Pour cider and broth into pot, scraping up browned bits, then return chicken and add thyme sprigs.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Peel, core, and slice apples into wedges, then add to pot with cream and simmer 5 minutes.
Remove thyme sprigs and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve chicken with sauce and vegetables over rice or potatoes.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze in bulk
Use regular onions halved instead of pearl onions

recipes.name: Calf's Liver à la Lyonnaise
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice liver into quarter-inch pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
Slice onions thinly and cook in 3 tablespoons butter over medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring often, until golden and caramelized, then set aside.
Dredge liver pieces in flour and shake off excess.
Heat oil and 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook liver 2 minutes per side until browned but still slightly pink inside, then transfer to plates.
Pour vinegar and broth into the same skillet, scraping up browned bits, and simmer 2 minutes.
Stir caramelized onions back into sauce and heat through.
Spoon onions and sauce over liver and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Serve immediately with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy liver at specialty butchers or ethnic markets where it's cheaper
Make onions ahead and reheat to save time

recipes.name: Fish Amandine
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat fish fillets dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Toast almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant, then set aside.
Mix flour with salt and pepper on a plate, then lightly dredge each fillet.
Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook fish 3 minutes per side until opaque and flakes easily, then transfer to plates.
In the same skillet, melt remaining 3 tablespoons butter and add toasted almonds, then cook 1 minute.
Pour milk into the almond mixture and stir for 30 seconds to create a light sauce.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over fish and spoon almond sauce on top.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with roasted vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy whole almonds and slice them yourself to save money
Use cod or tilapia instead of premium white fish

recipes.name: Crêpes Suzette
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, salt, and 1 tablespoon sugar in a bowl.
