Beat eggs with milk and vanilla, then pour into flour mixture while whisking until smooth, then stir in 1 tablespoon melted butter and let rest 15 minutes.
Heat an 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and lightly butter it.
Pour 0.25 cup batter into skillet and immediately tilt to spread evenly, cook 1 minute until light golden, flip and cook 30 seconds, then transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
Zest both oranges and squeeze juice into a small saucepan.
Add 4 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons sugar to the saucepan with orange juice and heat over medium, stirring until sugar dissolves and sauce thickens slightly, about 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and carefully stir in Grand Marnier.
Fold each crêpe into quarters, arrange on serving plates, pour warm sauce over top, and sprinkle with orange zest.
cheapTips: Skip Grand Marnier and use orange extract instead
Make crêpes ahead and freeze, then reheat and sauce before serving

recipes.name: Omelette Française
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk vigorously with a fork for 30 seconds until frothy, season with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in an 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until foaming.
Pour eggs into the skillet and let sit undisturbed for 5 seconds until edges begin to set.
Using a spatula, gently push cooked edges toward the center while tilting the pan so uncooked egg flows to the edges, repeat 2-3 times over 10-15 seconds.
When the center is still slightly wet but edges are set, fold the omelette in half.
Slide onto a serving plate, garnish with fresh chives, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk from warehouse stores
Skip fresh chives and use dried or omit entirely

recipes.name: Confit de Canard
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix salt, crushed garlic, thyme, bay leaves, pepper, and rosemary in a bowl to create a curing mixture.
Rub the curing mixture all over duck legs and place in a glass dish, cover and refrigerate for 24 hours.
Preheat oven to 250°F and rinse the curing salt off the duck legs under cold water, then pat dry.
Heat duck fat in a large pot until warm, then gently place duck legs into the fat and add fresh thyme and bay leaf.
Cover the pot and place in oven for 10-12 hours until duck is very tender and meat easily pulls from the bone.
Remove duck from fat and let cool, then shred meat from bones into a serving dish.
Strain the cooking fat through cheesecloth and pour a thin layer over the shredded duck to preserve it.
Serve warm, reheated gently in a 300°F oven for 20 minutes, with crusty bread and pickled vegetables.
cheapTips: Save rendered duck fat from roasting whole ducks and freeze it
Buy duck legs on sale and cure/cook in batches

recipes.name: Tarte Flambée
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 475°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Roll pizza dough or pastry into a thin rectangle about 12 by 8 inches and place on baking sheet.
Chop bacon into small pieces, cook in a skillet until crispy, then set aside on paper towels.
Thinly slice onion and cook in the bacon fat over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft and light golden.
Mix sour cream with salt, pepper, and nutmeg in a small bowl.
Spread sour cream mixture evenly over the dough, leaving a small border.
Scatter bacon pieces and cooked onion over the sour cream, then top with shredded gruyere cheese.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly and lightly charred, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pizza dough from the bakery section to save time
Substitute cheddar for gruyere to save 30-40%

recipes.name: Pâté de Foie Gras
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim connective tissue and veins from chicken livers and soak in cold water for 1 hour, then pat dry.
Mince shallots and cook gently in 2 tablespoons butter over medium-low heat for 3 minutes until soft.
Add livers to the pan with thyme and bay leaf, cook 4-5 minutes until just cooked through but still slightly pink inside.
Remove thyme and bay leaf, then transfer liver mixture to a food processor.
Add remaining butter cut into cubes and cognac to the processor and blend until completely smooth.
Season with salt and pepper, then pass the mixture through a fine sieve for ultra-smooth texture.
Pour into a terrine or crock and smooth the top, then cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours.
Serve chilled with crusty toast points and cornichon pickles on the side.
cheapTips: Use regular chicken liver instead of expensive foie gras
Buy liver on sale and make multiple batches to freeze

recipes.name: Salade Lyonnaise
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a small pot of water to a simmer and carefully lower eggs into water, cook for 4-5 minutes until soft-boiled, then remove and set aside.
Chop bacon into lardons and cook in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, then transfer to a paper towel.
Mince shallot finely and whisk together with vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
While whisking, slowly drizzle in olive oil until emulsified into a vinaigrette.
Tear frisée lettuce into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
Toss warm vinaigrette over lettuce along with crispy bacon, mixing gently.
Divide salad between two plates and gently crack a soft-boiled egg on top of each portion.
Serve immediately while egg yolk is still warm and runny.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk and use the cheapest bacon available
Substitute endive or radicchio for frisée

recipes.name: Cocido Madrileño
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak chickpeas in water for 8 hours or overnight, then drain.
In a large pot, bring water to boil and add beef, chicken, and bay leaves.
Simmer for 45 minutes, then add chorizo, soaked chickpeas, and quartered onion.
Continue simmering for 30 minutes, then add carrots and potatoes cut into chunks.
After 20 minutes, add chopped cabbage and salt to taste.
Simmer until all vegetables are tender, about 15-20 minutes.
Serve the broth first as soup, then the meat and vegetables on separate plates.
cheapTips: Buy chickpeas dried instead of canned to save 60%
Use chicken thighs instead of breast for better flavor at lower cost

recipes.name: Rabo de Toro
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the oxtail pieces on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Remove oxtail and sauté chopped onion, carrots, celery, and garlic until softened.
Add tomatoes and red wine, scraping browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return oxtail to pot, add beef broth and bay leaves, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 2.5 hours until oxtail is very tender.
Remove oxtail pieces and shred the meat from the bones.
Return shredded meat to the pot and simmer 10 more minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
cheapTips: Oxtail is inexpensive compared to other beef cuts
Use store-brand canned tomatoes and broth to reduce costs

recipes.name: Caldo Gallego
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a large pot, bring water to boil and add ham hock, halved onion, and 2 garlic cloves.
Simmer for 40 minutes until ham hock is tender, then remove and shred meat from bone.
Add diced potatoes and canned beans (drained) to the broth and simmer for 15 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté chopped garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add chopped collard greens and sauté for 3 minutes, then transfer to the pot.
Add smoked paprika and shredded ham back to the pot.
Simmer for 15 more minutes until all vegetables are tender, season with salt and pepper.
cheapTips: Buy ham hock instead of ham steaks—much cheaper per pound
Use frozen collard greens to save money and time

recipes.name: Fabada Asturiana
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak fava beans in water overnight, then drain and rinse well.
In a large pot, add beans, ham hock, halved onion, and 4 quarts of water with bay leaves.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1.5 hours, skimming foam as needed.
Add chorizo and morcilla (sliced) or pancetta to the pot and simmer for 30 more minutes.
In a small pan, sauté minced garlic in oil and add saffron dissolved in warm water.
Stir the garlic-saffron mixture into the bean pot.
Simmer for 15 more minutes until beans are very tender and creamy, then season with salt and pepper.
cheapTips: Buy dried beans in bulk to reduce cost by 40%
Substitute pancetta for expensive morcilla if unavailable

recipes.name: Pulpo a la Gallega
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a large pot of water, add octopus, halved onion, 2 bay leaves, and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 40-45 minutes until octopus is tender, then drain and cool slightly.
Cut octopus tentacles into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a serving platter.
Boil potatoes whole in salted water until tender, about 20 minutes, then slice into thin rounds.
Arrange potato slices over the octopus pieces.
In a small pan, heat olive oil with minced garlic for 30 seconds, then remove from heat.
Drizzle garlic oil over octopus and potatoes, sprinkle with paprika, sea salt, and black pepper, then serve.
cheapTips: Frozen octopus is 30-40% cheaper than fresh and works just as well
Buy paprika in bulk at ethnic markets for significant savings

recipes.name: Bacalao a la Vizcaína
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod in cold water for 24 hours, changing water 3-4 times, then drain and flake.
Roast dried peppers over an open flame for 20 seconds per side, then soak in warm water for 15 minutes.
Blend soaked peppers with 0.5 cup soaking water until smooth.
Heat olive oil and sauté sliced onions and minced garlic until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add blended pepper sauce, canned tomatoes, and flaked cod to the pot with water and bay leaf.
Simmer for 20 minutes until cod is heated through and sauce thickens.
Add olives, season with salt and pepper, and simmer 5 more minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy salt cod in bulk from Spanish markets instead of specialty stores
Use jarred roasted peppers instead of dried to save 30 minutes prep time

recipes.name: Merluza a la Romana
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat fish fillets dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Set up three shallow bowls: one with flour, one with beaten eggs, and one with breadcrumbs.
Dredge each fillet in flour, then dip in egg, then coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a large skillet to 350°F (about 3 minutes on medium-high heat).
Carefully place breaded fillets in hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer cooked fish to paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and sprinkle with minced parsley.
cheapTips: Make breadcrumbs from stale bread in a food processor instead of buying packaged
Cod is cheaper than hake and works equally well

recipes.name: Espinacas con Garbanzos
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet and sauté diced onion and minced garlic for 3 minutes.
Add cumin and paprika, stirring constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add drained and rinsed chickpeas and vegetable broth, then simmer for 3 minutes.
Add fresh spinach in batches, stirring as each batch wilts, about 5 minutes total.
Once all spinach is wilted, simmer for 2 more minutes to blend flavors.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy frozen spinach for 60% savings and equal nutritional value
Use dried cumin and paprika bought in bulk

recipes.name: Croquetas de Jamón
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan and whisk in flour to create a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Gradually add milk while whisking constantly to prevent lumps, then simmer for 5 minutes until thick.
Chop ham finely and stir into the sauce with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Spread mixture on a baking sheet and refrigerate for 30 minutes until firm.
Form chilled mixture into 12-16 oval shapes about 2 inches long.
Set up three bowls: one with beaten eggs and two with breadcrumbs; coat croquetas in egg then breadcrumbs.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry croquetas for 2-3 minutes until golden brown, then drain on paper towels.
cheapTips: Use deli ham trim or sale ham instead of expensive jamón serrano
Freeze uncooked croquetas to fry later and save time

recipes.name: Camarones en Salsa
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet and sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced onion and bell pepper, cooking for 3 minutes until softened.
Pour in white wine and canned tomatoes, bringing to a simmer.
Add shrimp to the sauce and cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes to taste.
Continue simmering until shrimp are pink and cooked through, about 3 more minutes.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot over rice or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp instead of fresh—same quality at 40% less cost
Use canned diced tomatoes in bulk or store-brand to save money

recipes.name: Raciones de Queso Manchego
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut the Manchego cheese into ½-inch thick wedges or cubes.
Arrange cheese pieces on a serving plate.
Cut quince paste into thin slices or small squares.
Drizzle olive oil lightly over the cheese and season with salt and pepper.
Serve cheese and quince paste together, alternating on the plate.
cheapTips: Buy quince paste in bulk from Hispanic markets
Purchase larger cheese wheels and cut yourself

recipes.name: Jamón Ibérico
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the bread and lightly toast it until golden.
Cut the garlic clove in half and rub it gently across each warm toast slice.
Slice the tomato in half and rub the cut side onto the toasted bread, letting the juice soak in.
Drizzle olive oil over each toast and sprinkle with salt.
Arrange thin slices of Jamón Ibérico on top of each toast and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy jamón from Hispanic markets instead of specialty stores
Use regular Spanish ham (jamón serrano) as a cheaper alternative

recipes.name: Pimentón de la Vera
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Season pork with salt and pepper, then brown all sides until golden (8-10 minutes).
Remove pork and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened (5 minutes).
Sprinkle smoked paprika over the onions and stir constantly for 1 minute to bloom the spice.
Add tomatoes, red wine, and chicken broth; return pork to the pot.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes until pork is tender, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with crusty bread or over rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder in bulk and freeze portions
Use tomato sauce instead of canned diced tomatoes

recipes.name: Churros con Chocolate
recipes.description: Spanish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat water and butter in a saucepan until boiling, then stir in flour and salt to form a thick dough.
Let dough cool for 5 minutes, then transfer to a churrera (piping bag with large star tip).
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or Dutch oven.
Pipe 6-inch strips of dough directly into hot oil using scissors to cut; fry 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain churros on paper towels and roll immediately in cinnamon-sugar mixture.
For chocolate sauce, heat milk in a saucepan over medium heat and whisk in cocoa powder and sugar until smooth.
Serve warm churros with hot chocolate for dipping.
cheapTips: Make chocolate sauce from cocoa powder instead of buying prepared chocolate
Use a pastry bag with a large tip instead of a churrera

recipes.name: Callos a la Madrileña
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean tripe thoroughly under running water and cut into 1-inch pieces.
Boil tripe in salted water for 1.5 hours until tender; drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until golden (5 minutes).
Add paprika and stir for 1 minute, then add diced chorizo and pancetta; cook 5 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes and beef broth; add cooked tripe and bring to a simmer.
Cut morcilla into rounds and add to the pot; simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in shallow bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy tripe from butcher counters at ethnic markets
Substitute ham or bacon for jamón

recipes.name: Rabo de Toro Cordobés
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season oxtail pieces with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown oxtail on all sides (8-10 minutes).
Remove oxtail and sauté chopped onions, carrots, and celery until softened (7 minutes).
Return oxtail to pot and add tomatoes, red wine, broth, bay leaf, and thyme.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and cover; simmer for 1.5 hours until meat is very tender.
Remove bay leaf and thyme sprigs.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve in deep bowls with vegetables and broth, accompanied by crusty bread.
cheapTips: Oxtail is often discounted at meat counters
Make in a slow cooker to save energy costs

recipes.name: Espetos
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the fish by removing guts and rinsing under cold water; pat dry.
Thread fish lengthwise onto wooden skewers (soak skewers 30 minutes first).
Mix coarse salt with paprika and coat fish generously on both sides.
Heat a grill or cast iron skillet to high heat and lightly oil the surface.
Grill or pan-fry fish 4-5 minutes per side until the skin is crispy and flesh is opaque.
Mince garlic finely and mix with olive oil.
Place cooked fish on a serving plate, drizzle with garlic oil, squeeze fresh lemon, and garnish with parsley.
cheapTips: Buy whole fresh sardines from fish markets
Substitute frozen sardines if fresh are unavailable

recipes.name: Gazpachuelo
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube potatoes; chop onion finely.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion and minced garlic until softened (5 minutes).
Add potatoes and broth; bring to a boil and simmer for 12 minutes until potatoes are nearly tender.
Add fish fillets and simmer for 5 minutes, then add shrimp and simmer 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
Whisk mayonnaise in a separate bowl with a splash of hot broth to temper it.
Slowly whisk the mayonnaise mixture into the pot off the heat to create a creamy soup.
Season with salt and white pepper.
Serve hot in bowls garnished with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp and fish to reduce cost
Make your own broth from fish scraps

recipes.name: Marmitako
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes and dice onion, red pepper, and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion, garlic, and bell pepper until softened (7 minutes).
Stir in paprika, then add potatoes and broth; bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are just beginning to soften.
Cut tuna into chunks and add to the pot along with tomatoes.
Simmer for 10 minutes until tuna is cooked through and potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in bowls garnished with fresh parsley and crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use canned bonito in oil instead of fresh fish
Buy potatoes in bulk from warehouse stores

recipes.name: Chanfaina
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean organ meats thoroughly under running water and remove any membranes; cut into 1-inch pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown lamb shoulder pieces on all sides (8 minutes); remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic until golden (5 minutes).
Stir in paprika and cook 1 minute to bloom the spice.
Add organ meats and brown for 5-7 minutes.
Return lamb shoulder to pot and pour in red wine and beef broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1 hour until all meats are tender.
Stir in vinegar, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot with crusty bread or potatoes.
cheapTips: Buy organ meats from halal or ethnic butchers at lower prices
Use chicken livers as a substitute for lamb liver

recipes.name: Lamb Chops
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pat lamb chops dry and coat both sides with the marinade.
Let chops sit for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill to high heat until very hot.
Sear chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or longer for well-done.
Remove from heat and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve with lemon wedges and fresh herbs.
cheapTips: Buy lamb chops on sale and freeze for later use
Skip expensive fresh rosemary and use dried oregano instead

recipes.name: Grilled Fish
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean and gut fish thoroughly; pat dry with paper towels.
Score the fish skin in two places on each side to prevent curling.
Stuff cavity with lemon slices and garlic slices.
Brush fish inside and out with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat and oil grates well.
Grill fish for 6-8 minutes per side until flesh flakes easily with a fork.
Transfer to serving plate and drizzle with remaining olive oil and fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish instead of fillets to save 30-40%
Use regular lemon instead of buying pre-sliced

recipes.name: Halibut Grilled
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, pepper, and thyme in a bowl.
Pat halibut fillets dry and place on a cutting board.
Brush both sides generously with the olive oil mixture.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Grill halibut for 4-5 minutes per side until it flakes easily with a fork.
Transfer to plates and drizzle with any remaining marinade from the bowl.
cheapTips: Buy halibut when on sale and freeze in portions
Skip fancy marinades and use basic pantry staples

recipes.name: Imam Baildi
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplants in half lengthwise; scoop out centers leaving ½-inch shell and reserve insides chopped.
Heat ¼ cup olive oil in a pan and fry eggplant shells briefly on both sides until light brown; place skin-side down in baking dish.
In same pan, sauté onions and garlic in remaining oil until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped eggplant centers, tomato paste, and tomatoes; cook for 10 minutes until softened.
Stir in parsley, pine nuts, and currants; season with salt and pepper.
Spoon filling into eggplant shells and drizzle any remaining oil on top.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until eggplants are tender.
Serve warm or at room temperature with bread.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants when in season for 50% savings
Use raisins instead of currants to cut costs

recipes.name: Menemen
recipes.description: Turkish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and sauté for 2 minutes until translucent.
Add bell peppers and garlic; cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Add diced tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes until they begin to break down.
Crack eggs directly into the skillet, stirring gently to create a scrambled texture.
Cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until eggs are just set.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve immediately with bread.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk for best per-unit pricing
Use whatever vegetables you have on hand

recipes.name: Sucuk and Eggs
recipes.description: Turkish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice sucuk sausage into ¼-inch rounds.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry sucuk slices for 2-3 minutes per side until browned and oil is released.
Push sucuk to the sides of the pan and crack eggs into the center.
Cook eggs for 3-4 minutes, stirring gently, until whites are set but yolks are still slightly runny.
Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer to plates and garnish with fresh parsley; serve with warm bread.
cheapTips: Buy sucuk from ethnic markets for 20% less than supermarkets
Skip expensive specialty bread and use regular pita

recipes.name: Pastrami Sandwich
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm pita bread in a dry skillet for 30 seconds on each side until pliable.
Spread mayonnaise on the inside of each pita pocket.
Layer pastrami, tomatoes, onion, and cucumbers inside each pocket.
Top with crumbled feta cheese and fresh parsley.
Serve immediately while pita is still warm.
cheapTips: Buy pastrami on sale and freeze to use later
Use store-brand pita instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Turkish Pizza
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground lamb in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add minced onion and garlic to the lamb; cook for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste, lemon juice, salt, and pepper; cook for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and fold in fresh parsley and pine nuts.
Preheat oven to 425°F and place naan on a baking sheet.
Divide lamb mixture evenly between the two naan pieces.
Drizzle with olive oil and bake for 8-10 minutes until edges are crispy and topping is heated through.
Slice and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of lamb to save 40%
Buy naan from the bakery section rather than pre-packaged

recipes.name: Tagine
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Season chicken with salt and pepper; brown on all sides for 5 minutes total, then remove and set aside.
In same pot, sauté onions until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return chicken to pot and add broth, apricots, olives, and cinnamon.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 35-40 minutes until chicken is very tender.
Serve over couscous or with bread to soak up the sauce.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for more flavor and better price
Buy dried apricots in bulk bins instead of packaged

recipes.name: Couscous
recipes.description: Moroccan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté onion and garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add diced carrots and zucchini; cook for 5 minutes until starting to soften.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in couscous, raisins, cinnamon, salt, and pepper.
Remove from heat, cover tightly with a lid, and let stand for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy couscous in bulk bins for 50% savings versus boxes
Use frozen vegetables when fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Musakhan
recipes.description: Lebanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown chicken, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the same pan and sauté sliced onions until golden and soft, about 15 minutes.
Return chicken to the pan, add sumac and chicken broth, and simmer for 15 minutes until chicken cooks through.
Toast pine nuts in a dry skillet until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Warm pita bread and place on serving plates.
Top pita with chicken and onion mixture, then sprinkle with toasted pine nuts and extra sumac.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts—cheaper and more flavorful
Skip pine nuts or use walnuts as a budget substitute

recipes.name: Fatteh
recipes.description: Lebanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pita bread into small pieces and toast in a 375°F oven for 8 minutes until crispy.
In a bowl, whisk together yogurt, minced garlic, and salt until smooth.
Drain and rinse canned chickpeas, then warm them gently in a skillet with 1 tablespoon olive oil.
In another bowl, mix tahini with lemon juice and a little water to create a drizzle consistency.
Layer toasted pita on a plate, top with yogurt sauce, then spoon warm chickpeas over top.
Drizzle tahini sauce over everything and finish with olive oil, pomegranate molasses, and sumac.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand yogurt and canned chickpeas to save money
Pomegranate molasses can be replaced with lemon juice mixed with a pinch of sugar

recipes.name: Mujadara
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse lentils under cold water and drain.
Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and add sliced onions, cooking until golden, about 10 minutes.
Remove half the caramelized onions and set aside for topping.
Add lentils, rice, cumin, salt, and pepper to the pot with remaining onions.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until lentils and rice are tender.
Stir occasionally and add more water if needed to prevent sticking.
Transfer to a serving dish and top with reserved crispy onions and a drizzle of olive oil.
cheapTips: Buy lentils and rice in bulk to cut costs significantly
Use water instead of broth if needed

recipes.name: Sambousek
recipes.description: Lebanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet with diced onion, then stir in pine nuts, allspice, salt, and pepper, and cool completely.
Cut filo dough sheets into 3-inch strips and cover unused sheets with a damp towel to prevent drying.
Place 1 tablespoon filling at the corner of each strip and fold into a triangle by folding the corner over and continuing to fold along the length.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Fry sambousek triangles in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve warm with yogurt or tahini sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Use ground lamb or chicken instead of beef to save money
Make double and freeze unbaked for quick future meals

recipes.name: Labneh
recipes.description: Lebanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Line a fine-mesh strainer with cheesecloth or paper towels.
Pour yogurt into the lined strainer and tie the corners of the cloth together.
Hang the bundle over a bowl in the refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight until all whey drains out and labneh becomes thick like cream cheese.
Transfer labneh to a serving bowl and season with salt.
Make a shallow well in the center and drizzle with olive oil, then sprinkle za'atar on top.
Serve with halved cherry tomatoes, cucumber slices, and pita bread for scooping.
cheapTips: Buy large containers of plain yogurt on sale and make labneh in bulk
Use regular paper towels instead of cheesecloth to save money

recipes.name: Halloumi Cheese
recipes.description: Middle Eastern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve lipase powder in cool non-chlorinated water 30 minutes before making cheese.
Heat milk to 90°F and add vinegar, then add dissolved lipase and stir for 5 minutes.
Add diluted rennet (mixed with 0.25 cup cool water) and stir for 3 minutes, then let sit 30 minutes until curds form.
Cut curds into pea-sized pieces and stir gently for 15 minutes while slowly heating to 104°F.
Drain curds through cheesecloth and press until firm, then cut into cubes.
Heat drained whey to 190°F and add curds back in, stirring gently for 5 minutes until curds become elastic.
Remove curds with a slotted spoon, press flat, cool, cut into slices, and pan-fry until golden.
cheapTips: Use store-bought halloumi instead—authentic cheese making requires specialized equipment
Buy halloumi on sale at Middle Eastern or Greek markets where it's cheaper

recipes.name: Koobideh
recipes.description: Middle Eastern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pulse minced onion, parsley, and mint in a food processor until finely chopped.
Mix ground lamb, herb mixture, egg, salt, pepper, and sumac in a bowl until combined.
Divide mixture into 8 equal portions and mold each firmly onto a flat metal skewer.
Brush koobideh with oil on all sides.
Grill over charcoal or on a grill pan over medium-high heat for 12-15 minutes, turning frequently until cooked through with charred edges.
Let rest for 2 minutes, then slide off skewers onto a cutting board.
Serve on warm pita bread with sliced onions, tomatoes, and yogurt sauce.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of lamb for a budget-friendly version
Make without skewers by forming into patties and pan-frying

recipes.name: Chicken Kebab
recipes.description: Lebanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper to make marinade.
Cut chicken into 1.5-inch cubes and toss with marinade, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Cut onion and bell peppers into 1.5-inch chunks.
Thread marinated chicken, onions, and peppers alternately onto skewers.
Grill over medium-high heat for 12-15 minutes, turning every 3 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are charred.
Let rest for 3 minutes after removing from heat.
Serve with tahini sauce, hummus, and pita bread.
cheapTips: Buy chicken on sale and freeze in marinade for up to 2 weeks
Use wooden skewers soaked in water instead of metal ones

recipes.name: Lamb Kabsa
recipes.description: Middle Eastern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown lamb cubes in batches, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion in the same pot until soft, then stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Return lamb to pot, add cardamom, bay leaf, salt, and pepper, and pour in broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 40 minutes until lamb is tender.
Toast almonds in a dry skillet until fragrant and set aside.
In a separate pot, cook rice according to package directions using the lamb cooking liquid instead of water.
Transfer rice to a serving platter, top with lamb and sauce, and garnish with toasted almonds.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of lamb to reduce cost by half
Skip almonds or use peanuts as a cheaper topping

recipes.name: Muhammara
recipes.description: Lebanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain roasted red peppers and pat dry with paper towels.
Toast walnuts in a dry skillet for 3 minutes until fragrant, then let cool slightly.
Combine roasted peppers, walnuts, breadcrumbs, minced garlic, and cumin in a food processor.
Pulse until coarsely chopped, then add pomegranate molasses and olive oil.
Pulse again until desired consistency is reached—it should be textured but hold together.
Season with salt to taste and adjust pomegranate molasses if needed.
Transfer to a serving bowl, drizzle with extra olive oil, and serve with warm pita bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy roasted peppers on sale or roast fresh peppers yourself to save money
Use panko or homemade breadcrumbs instead of store-bought

recipes.name: Kibbeh
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bulgur wheat in warm water for 15 minutes, then drain and squeeze dry.
Mix half the ground lamb with soaked bulgur, half the onion, half the mint, salt, and allspice to form the outer shell mixture.
In a separate bowl, combine remaining lamb, onion, mint, parsley, and pine nuts for the filling.
Wet your hands and form a small ball of shell mixture, press your thumb in the center to create a cavity, fill with meat mixture, and seal into an oval shape.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan to 350°F and fry kibbeh in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with tahini sauce and lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of lamb to reduce cost by 30%
Make filling ahead and refrigerate to save time

recipes.name: Baba Ganoush
recipes.description: Lebanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and poke eggplants several times with a fork.
Place eggplants directly on oven rack and roast for 30-35 minutes until skin blackens and flesh is very soft.
Cool eggplants for 5 minutes, then scoop soft flesh into a colander and let drain for 5 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Transfer eggplant to a food processor with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and salt, and blend until smooth and creamy.
Transfer to a serving bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with paprika and parsley.
Serve at room temperature with pita bread and fresh vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants on sale and freeze roasted flesh for later use
Make large batches and refrigerate for up to 5 days

recipes.name: Tabbouleh
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour boiling water over bulgur wheat until just covered and let sit for 20 minutes until tender and water is absorbed.
Fluff bulgur with a fork and transfer to a large bowl.
Add chopped parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber, and red onion to the bulgur.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss well to combine all ingredients.
Let sit for 10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld, then taste and adjust seasoning.
cheapTips: Buy fresh herbs at farmers markets or ethnic grocery stores for better prices
Use frozen parsley if fresh is unavailable

recipes.name: Fattoush
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and cut pita bread into 1-inch pieces.
Toss pita pieces with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread on a baking sheet and toast for 8-10 minutes until golden and crispy.
Chop lettuce, tomato, cucumber, bell pepper, and radish and combine in a large salad bowl.
Whisk together lemon juice, remaining olive oil, minced garlic, sumac, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour dressing over salad and toss well to coat all vegetables.
Top with warm crispy pita chips just before serving and toss again gently.
cheapTips: Make pita chips earlier in the day and store in an airtight container
Buy vegetables in season for lowest prices

recipes.name: Mansaf
recipes.description: Middle Eastern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat ghee in a large pot and brown lamb cubes on all sides in batches, then set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onions until soft, add garlic and allspice, and cook for 1 minute.
Return lamb to pot, add chicken broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes until lamb is tender.
Whisk yogurt with cornstarch in a bowl to create a smooth paste, then slowly add 1 cup of hot broth from the pot while whisking continuously.
Slowly pour yogurt mixture back into the pot while stirring constantly, then simmer gently for 10 minutes without boiling until sauce thickens.
Toast pine nuts in a dry pan until fragrant, then set aside.
Place pita bread on a platter, spoon lamb and yogurt sauce over top, and garnish with toasted pine nuts and fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Use lamb leg instead of shoulder and cut cooking time by 15 minutes
Buy pine nuts at ethnic markets for 40% less than regular supermarkets

recipes.name: Kafta
recipes.description: Lebanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground beef, minced onion, parsley, mint, pine nuts, allspice, cayenne, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl and mix until just combined.
Divide mixture into 8 equal portions and form each into a long oblong patty about 4 inches long.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Grill kafta for 4-5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through, being careful not to flip too often.
Warm pita bread on the grill for 30 seconds per side.
Serve kafta in warm pita bread with tahini sauce, tomato, cucumber, and onion pickles.
cheapTips: Form kafta ahead of time and refrigerate for up to 24 hours before cooking
Use ground lamb for authentic flavor at similar cost

recipes.name: Grilled Hammour
recipes.description: Middle Eastern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, coriander, parsley, salt, pepper, cumin, and paprika in a bowl to create marinade.
Place fish fillets on a plate, coat both sides with marinade, and let sit for 15 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Place fish fillets skin-side down on grill and cook for 4-5 minutes without moving, until skin is golden and crispy.
Carefully flip fillets and cook for another 3-4 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve immediately with grilled lemon wedges, rice, and a fresh salad.
cheapTips: Substitute with local whitefish like sea bass or halibut for same preparation and lower cost
Buy frozen hammour fillets and thaw in refrigerator for 30% cost savings

recipes.name: Majadra
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse lentils under cold water and sort through them to remove any debris.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large pot and sauté 2 sliced onions over medium heat until golden and crispy, about 15 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, add remaining olive oil and sauté remaining onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add lentils, bulgur, vegetable broth, cumin, salt, and pepper to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes until lentils are tender and liquid is absorbed.
Top with crispy fried onions and fresh parsley, then drizzle with additional olive oil and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy lentils and bulgur in bulk at Middle Eastern markets for 50% savings
Make large batches and freeze portions for easy weeknight meals

recipes.name: Dolma
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using fresh grape leaves, blanch them in boiling water for 2 minutes then drain; if using jarred, rinse and drain well.
Combine ground beef, cooked rice, minced onion, mint, parsley, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Place a grape leaf shiny-side down on a flat surface and place 1 tbsp of filling near the base of the leaf.
Fold the bottom of the leaf over filling, fold in the sides, then roll tightly toward the top of the leaf to form a cylinder.
Line the bottom of a pot with extra grape leaves, then arrange rolled dolmas seam-side down in layers.
Pour tomato sauce, lemon juice, and 1 cup water over the dolmas, drizzle with olive oil, place a plate on top to keep them compressed.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 40 minutes until flavors meld and liquid reduces slightly.
Serve warm or at room temperature with yogurt on the side.
cheapTips: Buy jarred grape leaves instead of fresh to save time and cost
Use ground lamb or chicken as budget-friendly alternatives to beef

recipes.name: Zaalouk
recipes.description: Middle Eastern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplants into 1/2-inch cubes, then place in a colander, sprinkle with salt, and let drain for 10 minutes to remove bitter liquid.
Pat eggplant cubes dry with paper towels.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and sauté eggplant for 8-10 minutes until softened and lightly browned.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes, cumin, and paprika to the pan and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes break down and form a sauce.
Stir in fresh coriander and parsley, then taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Cook for another 2 minutes, then transfer to a serving bowl and let cool slightly.
Serve warm or at room temperature with pita bread and olives.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants when on sale and freeze the cooked zaalouk for up to 3 months
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh when out of season to reduce cost

recipes.name: Amlou
recipes.description: Moroccan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pulse roasted almonds in a food processor until finely ground.
Add peanut butter and blend until smooth and creamy.
Drizzle in argan oil while blending until well combined.
Add honey and salt, then pulse to incorporate thoroughly.
Transfer to a serving bowl and serve with warm flatbread or bread.
cheapTips: Use regular peanut butter instead of argan oil to save 40%.
Buy almonds in bulk from discount grocers.

recipes.name: Bessara
recipes.description: Moroccan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse dried split peas and place in a pot with 4 cups water.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until peas are very soft.
Mince garlic and add to peas with cumin and paprika.
Simmer for 3 more minutes, then blend until smooth using an immersion blender.
Drizzle olive oil on top, sprinkle with salt, pepper, and parsley, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy dried peas in bulk sections—much cheaper than canned.
Skip parsley garnish if budget is tight.

recipes.name: M'hanncha
recipes.description: Moroccan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix almond flour, 2 tablespoons honey, cinnamon, and orange zest in a bowl.
Melt butter and brush one phyllo sheet; layer 2 more sheets with butter between each.
Spread one-third of almond mixture along the edge, then roll tightly like a log.
Coil the log into a spiral and place on a baking sheet; repeat with remaining phyllo and filling.
Brush entire pastry with beaten egg and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes until golden.
Drizzle warm pastry with remaining honey and dust with powdered sugar before serving.
cheapTips: Use ground hazelnuts or walnuts instead of almond flour.
Buy phyllo dough on sale and freeze for later use.

recipes.name: Mechoui
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and mix with cumin, paprika, salt, pepper, olive oil, and lemon juice to form a paste.
Score the lamb skin in a crosshatch pattern and rub the spice paste all over the meat.
Place lamb on a roasting rack skin-side up and roast at 325°F for 3 hours, basting every 45 minutes.
Increase heat to 450°F in the final 15 minutes to crisp the skin until golden brown.
Rest the lamb for 10 minutes, then carve and serve with warm flatbread and lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Use lamb leg or neck instead of shoulder to save 30%.
Buy on sale and freeze up to 3 months ahead.

recipes.name: Bastilla aux Fruits de Mer
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onion and mince garlic and ginger, then sauté in 2 tablespoons butter until soft.
Cut shrimp, fish, and scallops into bite-sized pieces and add to pan; cook 5 minutes until opaque.
Stir in chopped cilantro and let cool slightly, then stir in 2 beaten eggs.
Layer 5 phyllo sheets brushed with melted butter, then spread seafood mixture down the center.
Fold phyllo over filling and roll into a tight package, brush with remaining butter and beaten egg.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes until golden, then dust with cinnamon mixed with powdered sugar.
cheapTips: Use frozen mixed seafood instead of fresh individual items.
Skip the egg filling and just layer seafood with sauce.

recipes.name: Tfaya
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut onions into thick slices and mince garlic with ginger.
Heat olive oil in a large tagine or pot and brown chicken thighs on all sides, then remove.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook 5 minutes, then add turmeric and cinnamon.
Return chicken to pot, add apricots, raisins, and chicken broth, then cover and simmer 45 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, and simmer 10 more minutes until chicken is tender and juices run clear.
cheapTips: Use chicken breasts instead of thighs to reduce cost by 25%.
Buy dried fruit on sale and store in airtight containers.

recipes.name: Chermoula Grilled Fish
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and finely chop cilantro and parsley.
Blend herbs, garlic, lemon juice, paprika, cumin, olive oil, salt, and pepper into a smooth paste.
Coat both sides of fish fillets with half the chermoula and let marinate 10 minutes.
Grill fish over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and flaky.
Serve hot with remaining fresh chermoula drizzled on top.
cheapTips: Use tilapia or frozen cod instead of premium white fish.
Make chermoula paste in bulk and freeze in ice cube trays.

recipes.name: Tajine Kefta
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely mince onion, cilantro, and parsley.
Mix ground beef with minced herbs, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Form mixture into 12 meatballs and brown in olive oil in a tagine or deep skillet.
Add tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes, gently shaking the pan to coat meatballs.
Create 4 wells in the sauce and crack one egg into each; cover and cook 8-10 minutes until eggs are set.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze ahead.
Use canned tomato sauce instead of fresh for consistent pricing.

recipes.name: Tajine aux Pruneaux
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a tagine and brown lamb pieces in batches, then set aside.
Add diced onions, minced garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until fragrant.
Stir in cinnamon and cumin, then add lamb back to the pot with beef broth.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes, then add prunes and honey.
Continue simmering for 15 more minutes until lamb is very tender and prunes are plump.
cheapTips: Use lamb shoulder or neck cuts instead of premium stew meat.
Substitute beef chuck for lamb to cut costs by 40%.

recipes.name: Choumicha
recipes.description: Moroccan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onion and mince garlic and ginger.
Heat olive oil and sauté onion, garlic, and ginger for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add paprika and cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a simmer, then add drained chickpeas.
Simmer for 10 minutes, season with salt and pepper, then serve hot topped with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas in bulk to save 20%.
Use vegetable broth instead of beef broth for vegetarian option.

recipes.name: Taouk
recipes.description: Lebanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into 1.5-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Mix yogurt, lemon juice, minced garlic, paprika, cumin, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a separate bowl.
Pour marinade over chicken, stir well, cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread marinated chicken onto metal skewers, leaving small gaps between pieces.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and cook skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes until cooked through.
Warm pita bread on the grill for 30 seconds per side.
Serve chicken in pita with diced tomato and cucumber, drizzled with extra yogurt sauce.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Make yogurt sauce ahead and use for multiple servings

recipes.name: Maqluba
recipes.description: Lebanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplant and potatoes into 0.5-inch thick slices and fry in olive oil until golden, then set aside.
Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and allspice, then brown in the same pan for 5 minutes per side.
Slice onion and fry until golden, then remove and set aside.
Toast pine nuts in a dry pan until fragrant, about 2 minutes, and set aside.
Rinse rice and add to the pan, stirring for 2 minutes to coat with oil.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Layer fried eggplant and potatoes on top of rice, then place chicken pieces on top.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Let sit 5 minutes, then invert onto a large platter so rice forms the bottom layer with vegetables and chicken on top.
cheapTips: Substitute pine nuts with crushed peanuts to save money
Use chicken drumsticks instead of thighs for budget savings

recipes.name: Fattet Hummus
recipes.description: Lebanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pita bread into triangles and toast in a 375°F oven for 8-10 minutes until crispy.
Drain and rinse chickpeas, reserving 0.5 cup of liquid.
Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and reserved chickpea liquid until smooth.
Spread hummus on the bottom of a serving dish and make a shallow well in the center.
Top hummus with yogurt in the center well, then drizzle with olive oil.
Toast pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden, then sprinkle over yogurt.
Sprinkle paprika on top and surround with toasted pita chips, serving immediately.
cheapTips: Use sunflower seeds instead of pine nuts for significant savings
Make hummus in bulk and store for multiple breakfasts

recipes.name: Kibbeh Nayye
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bulgur wheat in warm water for 10 minutes until softened, then drain well.
Finely mince onion, mint, and parsley together on a cutting board.
Combine ground lamb, soaked bulgur, minced herbs and onion, lemon juice, 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt, pepper, and allspice in a bowl.
Mix gently with your hands until all ingredients are evenly distributed.
Shape mixture into small oval patties about 2 inches long and 1 inch thick.
Arrange lettuce leaves on a serving plate and place kibbeh on top.
Drizzle remaining olive oil and extra lemon juice over the kibbeh before serving.
cheapTips: Substitute ground lamb with ground beef for lower cost
Buy fresh herbs at farmers markets or Middle Eastern stores for better prices

recipes.name: Upside Down Rice
recipes.description: Middle Eastern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cauliflower into small florets and dice onions into small pieces.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large pan and sauté diced onions until golden, then add ground beef and cook until browned.
Add cauliflower florets to the meat mixture and season with salt, pepper, and allspice.
In a separate pot, heat remaining oil and toast pine nuts until golden, then set aside.
Add rice to the pan with meat and vegetables, stirring for 2 minutes to coat with oil.
Pour beef broth over rice and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 25 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Invert the rice onto a large platter so the cauliflower and meat layer forms the top, then sprinkle toasted pine nuts on top.
cheapTips: Use sunflower seeds or peanuts instead of pine nuts
Buy cauliflower when on sale and use frozen if fresh is expensive

recipes.name: Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely mince onion and parsley, then combine with ground beef, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Shape mixture into long cylindrical patties around wooden skewers or into flat oblong patties.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and cook kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning every 2 minutes until cooked through.
Warm pita bread on the grill for 30 seconds per side.
Slice tomato and cucumber into thin pieces.
Place warm kebab in pita bread and top with tomato slices, cucumber, and drizzle of tahini sauce.
cheapTips: Make tahini sauce by mixing tahini with lemon juice and water instead of buying pre-made
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Doner Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pulse together ground beef, ground lamb, minced onion, garlic, paprika, cumin, pepper, and salt in a food processor until mixture becomes sticky.
Knead mixture by hand for 2 minutes to develop binding, then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F and pack meat mixture tightly onto a vertical rotisserie stick or into a loaf pan lined with foil.
Roast in oven for 45-50 minutes, turning the stick or pan every 10 minutes until outside is browned and cooked through.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then slice thinly with a sharp knife.
Warm pita bread in a dry skillet for 20 seconds per side.
Dice tomato and white onion finely.
Place diced tomato and onion on pita, top with doner meat slices, and drizzle generously with tahini sauce.
cheapTips: Use all ground beef instead of lamb to reduce cost
Buy meat in bulk and process multiple doners at once for freezing

recipes.name: Shish Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef sirloin into 1.5-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper to make a marinade.
Pour marinade over beef, stir well, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Cut bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes into 1.5-inch pieces.
Thread marinated beef and vegetables alternately onto metal skewers, starting and ending with vegetables.
Heat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and cook skewers for 12-15 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes until beef is cooked to desired doneness.
Remove from heat and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck instead of sirloin and marinate longer for tenderness
Buy vegetables in season for best prices

recipes.name: Urfa Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely mince onion and garlic, then combine with ground beef, ground lamb, red pepper flakes, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Mix gently until well combined, then shape into flat oval patties about 0.5 inch thick.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat and cook patties for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.
While cooking kebabs, grill halved tomatoes cut-side down for 2-3 minutes until charred.
Warm pita bread on the grill for 30 seconds per side.
Place grilled tomato and kebab patty in pita bread and serve with extra paprika and pepper flakes on the side.
cheapTips: Use all ground beef and skip the lamb to save money
Buy red pepper flakes in bulk at international markets for better prices

recipes.name: Iskender Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely mince onion and combine with ground beef, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Shape mixture into thin rectangular patties about 0.25 inch thick.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
In a small pot, warm tomato sauce with minced garlic over low heat for 5 minutes.
Cut pita bread into pieces and arrange on serving plates.
Top pita pieces with cooked meat patty pieces, then spoon warm tomato sauce over the meat.
Mix yogurt with a pinch of salt and spread generously over the tomato sauce.
Melt butter in a small pan and pour over the top, then serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Use store-brand yogurt and tomato sauce to reduce costs
Make the meat mixture in bulk and freeze portions

recipes.name: Sos Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown the ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Add diced onions and minced garlic, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in paprika and cumin, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tomato sauce and beef broth, then simmer for 15 minutes until sauce thickens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm pita bread and fill with the meat mixture, folding into wraps.
Serve immediately with the sauce drizzled on top.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions
Make double batch and freeze extra meat sauce

recipes.name: Beyti Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook ground beef with diced onions and bell peppers in a skillet over medium heat until browned, about 8 minutes.
Season the meat mixture with salt, pepper, and chopped parsley.
Lay crepes flat and divide the meat mixture among them, rolling tightly into cylinders.
Arrange rolled crepes seam-side down in a buttered baking dish.
Mix yogurt with minced garlic and spread over the crepes.
Heat tomato sauce in a pan and drizzle over the yogurt layer.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes until heated through.
Serve hot with additional yogurt sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Use store-bought thin wraps instead of making crepes from scratch
Buy plain yogurt in bulk and divide portions

recipes.name: Kofte
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely chop onion and parsley.
Combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, onion, parsley, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Mix gently with your hands until just combined.
Shape mixture into 12-16 oblong meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook kofte in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Transfer to a plate and serve hot with lemon wedges.
Serve with flatbread or over rice.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk and freeze in portions
Use panko breadcrumbs which are less expensive per ounce

recipes.name: Meatball
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, finely diced onion, mint, allspice, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Mix gently and form into 16-20 small meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Brown meatballs on all sides, about 8 minutes, working in batches if needed.
Add tomato sauce and chicken broth to the pan.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 15 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve with rice, bread, or pasta.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze extras for quick weeknight dinners
Use dried mint instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Lahmacun
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet and cook finely diced onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, cumin, paprika, salt, pepper, and chopped parsley.
Simmer the meat mixture for 5 minutes until flavors combine.
Preheat oven to 425°F and place naan on baking sheets.
Spread meat mixture evenly on each piece of naan.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until bread is crispy and edges are golden.
Serve hot, optionally with lemon juice and fresh herbs.
cheapTips: Buy naan bread on sale and freeze until needed
Make the meat topping in advance and reheat when ready to serve

recipes.name: Pide
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and sugar in a bowl; let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour and salt, then add yeast mixture and olive oil; knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Place dough in oiled bowl, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, brown ground beef with diced onion in a skillet, then add diced tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Divide dough into 4 portions and shape each into an oval boat on parchment paper.
Fill each boat with meat mixture and crumbled feta cheese, leaving edges uncovered.
Brush edges with beaten egg and bake at 425°F for 15-18 minutes until golden.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy feta cheese from the bulk section instead of pre-crumbled
Use store-bought pizza dough to skip the rising time

recipes.name: Borek
recipes.description: Turkish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using fresh spinach, chop and cook in a skillet until wilted, then squeeze dry; if frozen, thaw and squeeze dry.
Crumble feta cheese and combine with spinach, egg, diced onion, black pepper, dill, and salt.
Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Lay one phyllo sheet on work surface and brush lightly with melted butter.
Place 2-3 tablespoons of filling on one end, then fold the phyllo into a triangle over the filling repeatedly until the sheet is folded completely.
Place triangle seam-side down on baking sheet and brush top with butter.
Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets and filling.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough when on sale and store in freezer
Use spinach when it's on sale or from frozen section

recipes.name: Manti
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, egg, water, and 1/4 tsp salt to form dough; knead 5 minutes, cover, and rest 20 minutes.
Combine ground beef with finely diced onion and cinnamon.
Roll dough thin and cut into 2-inch squares.
Place 1 teaspoon filling in center of each square, fold to triangle, then bring corners together.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook manti in batches until they float, then 2 minutes more.
Mix yogurt with minced garlic and 1/4 tsp salt.
Drain manti and place in serving bowl, top with yogurt sauce.
Heat 2 tbsp butter with dried mint and drizzle over top, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make dough and filling a day ahead to reduce cooking time
Freeze shaped manti to cook later in batches

recipes.name: Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté diced onions and carrots until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste, cumin, and paprika, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add lentils and vegetable broth, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 25-30 minutes until lentils are very soft.
Blend soup using an immersion blender until smooth, or leave chunky if preferred.
Stir in lemon juice and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy lentils in bulk and store in airtight containers
Make a large batch and freeze in portions for later

recipes.name: Chicken Shish
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into 1.5-inch cubes and cut bell peppers and onions into similar-sized chunks.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Toss chicken and vegetables with marinade, cover, and refrigerate for 15-20 minutes.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread chicken and vegetables alternately on skewers.
Grill skewers for 12-15 minutes, turning every 3 minutes, until chicken is cooked through.
Let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve with rice, salad, and pita bread.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast when on sale and freeze until ready to use
Use whatever bell peppers are cheapest at the market

recipes.name: Pastilla
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into chunks and cook with diced onions, garlic, cinnamon, ginger, and saffron in olive oil over medium heat for 25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken from pan, shred it finely, and return to pan to reduce liquid until nearly dry, about 10 minutes.
In a separate pan, scramble eggs and fold gently into the chicken mixture, then cool completely.
Toast sliced almonds in a dry skillet for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Lay one phyllo sheet on a work surface and brush generously with melted butter.
Place a thin layer of chicken mixture and some almonds on one quarter of the phyllo sheet, fold into a triangle, and brush with butter.
Repeat with remaining phyllo and filling to make 4 pastillas.
Bake at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until phyllo is golden brown and crispy.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy almonds from bulk section rather than pre-packaged
Use store-brand phyllo dough instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Harira
recipes.description: Moroccan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the meat on all sides for 5 minutes.
Add diced onions, garlic, ginger, and turmeric, cooking for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, then add diced tomatoes, lentils, and diced celery.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes until lentils are nearly tender.
Add canned chickpeas and cook for an additional 15 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Stir in fresh cilantro just before serving.
Serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy lentils and chickpeas in bulk bins for significant savings
Use canned tomatoes year-round instead of fresh for better price consistency

recipes.name: Tanjia
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into large chunks and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a heavy pot or tagine over medium-high heat and brown beef pieces on all sides for 8 minutes total.
Add minced garlic, ginger, paprika, and cumin, stirring constantly for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add beef broth, sliced onion, and lemon juice, bringing to a simmer.
Cover partially and cook over low heat for 1.5 hours until beef is very tender.
Add pitted green olives in the last 15 minutes of cooking.
Taste and adjust seasonings; the sauce should be rich and concentrated.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with crusty bread or over couscous.
cheapTips: Use regular lemon juice instead of preserved lemons to save money
Buy olives from bulk bins or discount stores for better pricing

recipes.name: Rfissa
recipes.description: Moroccan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown chicken thighs for 4 minutes per side, then set aside.
In the same pot, cook diced onion and garlic with fenugreek seeds, ginger, and saffron for 2 minutes.
Return chicken to pot, add chicken broth and lentils, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 35-40 minutes until lentils are tender and chicken is cooked through.
Tear flatbread pieces into bite-sized chunks.
Remove chicken from pot and shred or cut into pieces, returning it to the broth.
Layer flatbread pieces in serving bowls and ladle the hot chicken and lentil broth over top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately while bread is still warm.
cheapTips: Make your own flatbread or use store-bought tortillas as an affordable substitute
Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Kefta Mkaouira
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground meat with minced onion, garlic, cilantro, parsley, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Form meat mixture into 12-16 oval patties about 3 inches long.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown kefta patties for 2 minutes per side, then set aside.
In the same skillet, cook remaining minced onion for 2 minutes, then add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes with juice and stir well, bringing to a simmer.
Return kefta patties to the skillet and simmer for 15 minutes.
Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them, then cover and cook for 5-7 minutes until eggs are set to your preference.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with bread or over rice.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze in portions for weeknight dinners
Use dried herbs instead of fresh when budget is tight

recipes.name: Shebakia
recipes.description: Moroccan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and orange zest in a bowl.
Cut softened butter into flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs, then add egg yolk and mix until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth, then wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll dough thin between parchment paper and cut into diamond or flower shapes.
Toast sesame seeds in a dry skillet for 2 minutes and set aside.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and fry dough pieces 1-2 minutes per side until golden, then drain on paper towels.
Warm honey with cinnamon in a saucepan over low heat.
Dip fried pastries into warm honey and sprinkle generously with toasted sesame seeds.
Arrange on a platter and serve at room temperature or warm.
cheapTips: Buy sesame seeds in bulk from international markets for better pricing
Make a double batch and freeze unbaked pastries for future frying

recipes.name: Briouats
recipes.description: Moroccan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground almonds with powdered sugar, cinnamon, salt, and egg white in a bowl.
Lay one phyllo sheet on a work surface and brush lightly with melted butter.
Place 2 tablespoons of almond filling in a horizontal line about 1 inch from the bottom.
Fold bottom edge over filling, then fold in sides and roll tightly into a cylinder.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry briouats in batches for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain fried briouats on paper towels.
Warm honey in a small saucepan and briefly dip each warm briouat into it or drizzle with honey.
Dust with additional cinnamon and powdered sugar if desired.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy ground almonds from bulk bins instead of pre-packaged
Use store-brand phyllo to reduce overall cost

recipes.name: Khliaa
recipes.description: Moroccan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Shred or finely chop khliaa or beef jerky into small pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté minced onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add shredded khliaa and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add diced tomato and cumin, cooking for 2 more minutes.
Break eggs directly into the skillet and scramble gently, cooking until eggs are set, about 3-4 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Garnish with fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately with warm bread.
cheapTips: Substitute beef jerky or dried beef from the grocery store if khliaa is unavailable
Buy eggs on sale and store in the refrigerator for multiple breakfast meals

recipes.name: Seffa
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 3 tablespoons butter in a large pot and brown chicken pieces for 5 minutes on each side.
Add diced onions, garlic, cinnamon stick, ginger, and turmeric, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a simmer, then cook covered for 30 minutes until chicken is tender.
Toast almonds in a dry skillet for 3 minutes and set aside.
Prepare couscous according to package directions using 2 cups broth from the chicken pot, then fluff with a fork.
Fold remaining butter, raisins, and toasted almonds into the couscous gently.
Taste the chicken broth and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Mound couscous mixture on a serving platter, arrange chicken pieces on top, and ladle broth around the couscous.
Serve hot, garnishing with additional almonds if desired.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze for future use
Use bulk almonds and raisins instead of pre-packaged for significant savings

recipes.name: Msemen
recipes.description: Moroccan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a large bowl, then add warm water and knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover dough and let rest for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Divide dough into 6 equal balls and let rest another 10 minutes.
On an oiled surface, stretch one dough ball very thin until it's nearly transparent, then brush generously with melted butter.
Fold the dough in thirds lengthwise, then fold in thirds again widthwise to create a square package.
Heat a nonstick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat with a thin layer of oil or butter.
Place folded dough square on hot skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Serve immediately, drizzled with honey and optionally sprinkled with cinnamon.
Repeat with remaining dough balls.
cheapTips: Msemen can be made ahead and reheated in a skillet for busy mornings
Use regular honey from budget grocery stores instead of premium varieties

recipes.name: Matouche
recipes.description: North African lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and 2 tablespoons olive oil with water to form a soft dough and let rest 20 minutes.
Brown ground beef with diced onions and garlic, then stir in harissa and cinnamon.
Divide dough into 6 balls and roll each very thin on oiled surface.
Layer alternating sheets of dough with meat mixture and fold into triangles, brushing with olive oil between layers.
Heat 1/4 cup olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry triangles until golden brown on each side, about 3 minutes per side.
Make a well in the center of each triangle and crack an egg into it.
Cover and cook until egg white is set, about 2 minutes.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Make harissa at home with dried chilies and spices

recipes.name: Brick à l'Oeuf
recipes.description: North African snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely chop the onion and parsley and mix with salt, pepper, and harissa.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a small pan over medium heat and sauté onion mixture for 2 minutes.
Place one brick sheet on a work surface and spoon onion mixture onto one quarter of the sheet.
Crack an egg onto the mixture, then fold the brick sheet into a triangle, tucking in the sides.
Heat remaining olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the brick triangle for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy on each side.
cheapTips: Use phyllo sheets instead of brick pastry as a budget substitute
Buy eggs in bulk for better pricing

recipes.name: Makroudh
recipes.description: North African snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix semolina, flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
Rub melted butter into the dry mixture until it resembles breadcrumbs.
Add 2-3 tablespoons water and mix until dough is moist but not sticky.
Finely chop dates and form into small balls about 1 inch in diameter.
Take a spoonful of dough, flatten it, place a date ball in center, and seal dough around it.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan and fry makroudh for 2-3 minutes until golden brown.
Mix honey and water in a bowl.
Immediately dip warm makroudh into honey mixture to coat thoroughly.
cheapTips: Buy dates in bulk from Middle Eastern markets
Reuse frying oil for multiple batches

recipes.name: Doro Wot
recipes.description: Ethiopian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onions finely and cook in butter over medium heat until caramelized, about 15 minutes.
