cheapTips: Buy saltfish from Caribbean markets, which are much cheaper than grocery stores
Reuse frying oil multiple times by straining through cheesecloth

recipes.name: Fried Bammy
recipes.description: Jamaican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel the cassava root and grate it finely using a box grater or food processor.
Squeeze out excess moisture from the grated cassava using cheesecloth or a clean kitchen towel.
Mix the squeezed cassava with salt and minced garlic to form a dough.
Form the dough into flat, round patties about 0.5 inches thick.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan.
Fry the bammy patties until golden and crispy on both sides, about 3-4 minutes total.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with hot sauce or dipping sauce of choice.
cheapTips: Buy cassava root from Latin or Caribbean markets where it's significantly cheaper
Make large batches and freeze uncooked patties to fry later

recipes.name: Bami and Cheese
recipes.description: Jamaican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add finely diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 2 minutes.
Gradually add cassava flour while stirring constantly to form a dough.
Continue stirring and add water a little at a time until the mixture becomes a thick, workable paste.
Stir in the shredded cheese until fully combined and the mixture is golden.
Form into patties by dropping spoonfuls onto a plate or pressing flat in the pan.
Fry or toast the patties until the edges are crispy, or serve warm directly from the pan.
cheapTips: Buy cassava flour in bulk from Caribbean or Latin markets
Use block cheddar and shred it yourself instead of pre-shredded cheese

recipes.name: Fish Tea
recipes.description: Jamaican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean and scale the fish, then cut into chunks, keeping the head for additional flavor.
Peel and cut yam into small chunks.
Heat oil in a large pot and add chopped onion and minced garlic, cooking until softened.
Add fish chunks, yam, thyme, and whole scotch bonnet pepper to the pot.
Pour in water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Remove the scotch bonnet pepper and serve the broth hot with the fish and yam.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish at fishmongers instead of fillets for better prices
Purchase yam at Caribbean markets where it's fresher and cheaper

recipes.name: Chicken Soup
recipes.description: Jamaican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown the chicken pieces on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion, minced garlic, diced carrots, and diced celery until softened.
Return the chicken to the pot and pour in water.
Add thyme and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with the chicken pieces and vegetables in the broth.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts, which are cheaper and more flavorful in soup
Buy vegetables in season at farmers markets for better prices

recipes.name: Conch Salad
recipes.description: Caribbean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thaw the conch meat and boil in salted water for 20 minutes until tender, then drain and chop into bite-sized pieces.
Place the chopped conch in a bowl and immediately cover with lime juice to begin the curing process.
Dice the bell peppers, tomatoes, and red onion into small pieces.
Finely mince the garlic and cilantro.
Combine the conch with all vegetables, garlic, cilantro, and olive oil in a large bowl.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow flavors to meld before serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen conch in bulk from Caribbean specialty stores
Use bottled lime juice if fresh limes are expensive

recipes.name: Roti with Curry Chicken
recipes.description: Jamaican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then knead in water and 1 tablespoon butter to form a smooth dough; let rest 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare curry: heat oil in a pan and brown cubed chicken, then remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant, then add curry powder and cook 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes, diced potato, chicken, and coconut milk; simmer 20 minutes until cooked.
Divide dough into 3 balls and roll each into a thin circle on a floured surface.
Cook each roti on a hot skillet or griddle for 1-2 minutes per side until slightly blistered, brushing with butter.
Serve hot roti alongside or wrapped around the curry chicken.
cheapTips: Make roti dough in larger batches and freeze for quick meals later
Buy chicken in bulk and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Ackee Scramble
recipes.description: Jamaican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain the canned ackee carefully and set aside, keeping it as intact as possible.
Beat the eggs in a bowl with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion, bell pepper, and tomato, sautéing for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Pour the beaten eggs into the skillet and scramble gently for 2 minutes.
Carefully fold the ackee into the eggs without breaking it up, stirring gently for 1-2 minutes until just heated through.
Serve immediately while hot on toast or with boiled ground provisions like yam or green banana.
cheapTips: Buy canned ackee online or at Caribbean markets in bulk for better pricing
Prep vegetables the night before to speed up morning cooking

recipes.name: Tapa
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice beef thinly against the grain into 1/8-inch pieces.
Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, black pepper, and salt in a bowl.
Marinate beef in the mixture for at least 6 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry marinated beef slices in batches until edges are caramelized and meat is cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck instead of sirloin to save 30-40%
Make large batches and freeze portions for up to 2 months

recipes.name: Tocino
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine brown sugar, soy sauce, pineapple juice, garlic, and salt in a large bowl.
Add sliced pork and mix thoroughly to coat evenly.
Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Fry pork slices with the marinade until caramelized and cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Serve warm with steamed rice and fried eggs for breakfast.
cheapTips: Use pork shoulder or pork belly scraps instead of premium cuts
Make double batches and refrigerate for 3-4 days or freeze for 1 month

recipes.name: Longanisa
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork with brown sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Let the mixture marinate for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Soak pork casings in warm water for 15 minutes until pliable.
Use a sausage stuffer or funnel to carefully fill casings with the pork mixture, tying off at 3-4 inch intervals.
Hang casings in the refrigerator overnight to develop flavor and allow to dry slightly.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and fry longanisa until cooked through and browned, about 8-10 minutes.
Serve with steamed rice and garlic fried rice or with vinegar for dipping.
cheapTips: Skip casings and form into patties to save time and money
Buy pork at Asian markets for better pricing on specialty cuts

recipes.name: Afritada
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork cubes on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in the same pot until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Return pork to pot and add tomato sauce, soy sauce, and water.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 30 minutes until pork is tender.
Add potatoes and carrots, and simmer for another 15-20 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Add bell peppers and cook uncovered for 5 more minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then serve over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use pork shoulder or butt cuts which are cheaper than loin
Buy vegetables in season or frozen to reduce costs

recipes.name: Bicol Express
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the pork slices in batches.
Remove pork and sauté garlic and onion in the same skillet until softened, about 3 minutes.
Return pork to skillet and stir in shrimp paste until well combined.
Pour in coconut milk and water, stirring well, then bring to a simmer.
Add sliced chili peppers and simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes until pork is very tender and sauce reduces slightly.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy coconut milk in bulk at Asian markets for 20-30% savings
Adjust chili pepper count based on preference to reduce waste

recipes.name: Lapu-Lapu
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean and scale the whole fish, then pat dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a large skillet or fish steamer over medium heat.
Sauté garlic and ginger until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.
Add onion slices and cook for 2 more minutes.
Place the whole fish over the aromatics and arrange tomato slices on top.
Mix soy sauce, vinegar, and water in a bowl, then pour over the fish.
Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes until fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish rather than fillets to save 20-30%
Check fish markets for daily specials on fresh catches

recipes.name: Halang-Halang
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef cubes on all sides.
Add garlic and onion, sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Pour in water and soy sauce, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes until beef is tender.
Add bitter melon slices and tomato quarters, then simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy bitter melon at Asian markets where it's cheaper than mainstream grocers
Use beef chuck for budget-friendly protein

recipes.name: Bulalo
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch the beef knuckle and marrow bones in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain and rinse thoroughly.
In a large pot, bring 8 cups of fresh water to a boil with the cleaned bones, onion, and garlic.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes to create a flavorful broth.
Add potatoes and corn, then simmer for another 25-30 minutes until potatoes are nearly tender.
Add cabbage wedges and simmer uncovered for 8-10 minutes until vegetables are fully cooked.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy bones and shanks from the butcher counter at significant discounts
Make large batches and freeze the broth for future soups

recipes.name: Nilaga
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place pork chunks in a large pot with water and bring to a boil.
Boil for 5 minutes to release scum, then drain and rinse the pork thoroughly.
Return pork to the pot with 8 cups of fresh water, onion, and garlic.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes until pork is tender.
Add potatoes and carrots, then simmer covered for 20 minutes until vegetables soften.
Add cabbage wedges and simmer uncovered for another 8-10 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Season generously with salt and black pepper, then serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder with bone at butcher counters for best pricing
Use seasonal vegetables to reduce costs year-round

recipes.name: Pampano sa Banana Leaves
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch banana leaves in boiling water for 1-2 minutes to soften, then pat dry.
Heat oil in a small pan and sauté garlic, ginger, and onion for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in coconut milk and sliced chili peppers, then simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place one fish fillet on each banana leaf, then top with the coconut-chili mixture.
Fold banana leaves over the fish to form secure packets, then place seam-side down on a baking sheet.
Bake in a preheated 375°F oven for 15-18 minutes until fish is cooked through and flakes easily.
cheapTips: Buy fresh pompano when on sale and freeze for later use
Use frozen banana leaves from Asian markets instead of fresh

recipes.name: Jamaican Hot Pot
recipes.description: Jamaican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef chunks on all sides, about 8 minutes total, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onions and minced garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Return beef to the pot, add beef broth, thyme, and whole scotch bonnet pepper, then bring to a boil and reduce heat to simmer for 45 minutes covered.
Cut potatoes, carrots, and yam into 2-inch chunks, peel and cut green bananas into 1-inch rounds.
Add all vegetables to the pot and simmer for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Remove scotch bonnet pepper, season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot in bowls with broth.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for later use
Substitute yam with sweet potato if unavailable or cheaper

recipes.name: Adobo
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and brown chicken pieces on both sides, about 8 minutes total.
Add minced garlic and sliced onion to the pan and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Pour in soy sauce, vinegar, water, bay leaves, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove cover and simmer for 5 more minutes to reduce sauce slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning with soy sauce or vinegar as needed, then serve over white rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor and lower cost
Make extra and freeze for quick reheating later

recipes.name: Sinigang
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil, add pork chunks, and boil for 10 minutes, then drain and rinse pork under cold water.
In the same pot, add 8 cups of fresh water, return pork, and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Slice onion, mince garlic, and slice ginger, then add to the pot and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Stir in tamarind paste, then add radish, taro root, and green beans, and simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and fish sauce to taste.
Serve hot in bowls with broth and rice on the side.
cheapTips: Use tamarind powder instead of paste for longer shelf life and lower cost
Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Lechon
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and pat pork dry inside and out with paper towels.
Stuff cavity with garlic cloves, onion chunks, thyme, and bay leaves, then secure opening with toothpicks or skewers.
Rub entire exterior with salt, black pepper, and vegetable oil, massaging into skin thoroughly.
Place pork on a roasting pan, add 2 cups water to the pan, and roast uncovered for 3 to 3.5 hours, basting with pan juices every 30 minutes.
Increase oven temperature to 425°F for the last 20 minutes to crisp the skin until golden brown.
Meat thermometer should read 160°F in the thickest part of thigh; if not, continue cooking and check every 10 minutes.
Let rest for 15 minutes before carving, then serve with liver sauce and rice.
cheapTips: Order suckling pig from Asian markets in advance for better pricing
Use pork belly as an affordable whole-roast alternative with similar results

recipes.name: Lumpia Shanghai
recipes.description: Filipino snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook ground pork, breaking it apart, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add shredded cabbage and carrots, cooking for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in soy sauce and remove from heat, then let filling cool for 5 minutes.
Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl to make a paste for sealing.
Lay a lumpia wrapper on a clean surface, place 2 tablespoons filling in the center, fold in sides, roll tightly, and seal end with cornstarch paste.
Heat 3 cups oil in a deep pan to 350°F, then fry lumpia rolls in batches for 2 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with sweet and sour sauce or vinegar for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy lumpia wrappers from Asian markets in bulk and freeze extra for later
Use ground chicken instead of pork to reduce costs

recipes.name: Pancit Canton
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook egg noodles according to package directions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat, add sliced pork or chicken, and cook until done, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and sliced onion to the pan and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in carrots and cabbage, cooking for 3 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Add cooked noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and water, then toss everything together for 3 minutes until well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy egg noodles in bulk from Asian markets for significant savings
Use leftover cooked chicken or pork to reduce cooking time and cost

recipes.name: Tinola
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté sliced ginger and minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sliced onion and cook for 1 minute, then add chicken pieces and lightly brown for 5 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 20 minutes until chicken is nearly cooked.
Peel and cut chayote squash into chunks, add to the pot, and simmer for 10 minutes until tender.
Add spinach or pechay and cook for 2 more minutes until wilted.
Season with fish sauce, salt, and pepper to taste, then serve hot with white rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor and lower cost
Substitute chayote with zucchini or cabbage if unavailable

recipes.name: Kare-Kare
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef or pork cubes on all sides, about 8 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté minced garlic and sliced onion until softened, about 2 minutes.
Return meat to the pot, add beef broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes until meat is tender.
In a small bowl, mix peanut butter with 1 cup of hot broth from the pot until smooth, then stir into the pot.
Add annatto powder and stir well, then add string beans and eggplant chunks, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add bok choy and simmer for 3 more minutes until wilted, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve over white rice with shrimp paste (bagoong) on the side if desired.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck roast instead of pre-cut cubes and cube it yourself to save money
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for quick meals later

recipes.name: Sisig
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil pork head or shoulder in salted water for 30 minutes until tender, then let cool and chop finely into small pieces.
In a separate pot, boil chicken liver for 5 minutes, drain, and chop finely.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté minced garlic and diced onion until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add chopped pork and liver to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in lime juice, soy sauce, vinegar, and minced red chili peppers, then cook for 2 more minutes.
Push mixture to the sides of the skillet, crack egg into the center, scramble it slightly, then mix with the pork mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot on a sizzling plate with rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork head from Filipino butchers for much lower cost than standard cuts
Use chicken thighs as an affordable substitute if pork head unavailable

recipes.name: Caldereta
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef pieces on all sides, about 10 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté minced garlic and diced onion until softened, about 2 minutes.
Return beef to the pot, add beef broth and tomato sauce, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Cut potatoes and carrots into chunks, add to the pot, and simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are nearly tender.
Add diced red bell pepper and peas, then simmer for 5 more minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Stir in grated cheddar cheese until melted, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over white rice or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck roast on sale and cut into cubes yourself instead of pre-cut stew meat
Use frozen peas and carrots to reduce prep time and often lower cost

recipes.name: Escabeche
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat fish dry and season with salt and pepper, then lightly coat in flour.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and fry fish until golden on both sides, about 4-5 minutes per side, then set aside.
In the same pan, sauté minced garlic and sliced onions until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add bell pepper strips and pineapple chunks, stirring for 2 minutes.
Mix in vinegar, brown sugar, and soy sauce, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Return fish to the pan and gently coat with the sauce.
Simmer uncovered for 8-10 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Transfer to a serving dish and let cool slightly before serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen tilapia instead of fresh fish to save 30-40%
Buy canned pineapple instead of fresh for consistent pricing year-round

recipes.name: Relleno
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Have your fishmonger remove the backbone from fish while keeping skin intact, or carefully butterfly the fish yourself.
Brown ground pork with minced garlic and diced onion in a pan, then mix in raisins, olives, and salt and pepper; let cool.
Stuff the cooled pork mixture inside the fish cavity evenly.
Beat egg in a shallow dish and coat the stuffed fish lightly with flour, then dip in beaten egg, and coat again with flour.
Heat oil in a large pan and carefully fry the fish until golden brown on both sides, about 5-7 minutes per side, then remove.
In the same oil, make a simple roux by adding flour and stirring; cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato sauce and water, stirring until smooth, then return fish to pan.
Simmer covered for 15-20 minutes until fish is tender and sauce thickens.
Transfer to a platter and pour sauce over the fish before serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen whole fish if fresh is unavailable and thaw completely before cooking
Skip the olives and use extra raisins to reduce costs

recipes.name: Empanada
recipes.description: Filipino snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then cut in cold butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add beaten egg and water gradually until dough forms; knead gently until smooth, wrap, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Cook diced potato in boiling salted water for 5-7 minutes until just tender; drain.
Brown ground beef with minced garlic and onion until cooked through, about 8 minutes, then mix in potato and raisins.
Roll out dough thinly between plastic sheets and cut into 3-inch circles.
Place 1 tbsp of filling on each circle, fold into half-moon shape, and seal edges with a fork.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry empanadas until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes total.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with vinegar or sweet chili sauce.
cheapTips: Make filling a day ahead to reduce active cooking time
Use ground pork instead of beef to save 20%

recipes.name: Bibingka
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease an 8x12 inch baking pan with butter.
Whisk together rice flour, brown sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat eggs and mix with coconut milk.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top.
Sprinkle grated coconut and shredded cheese evenly over batter.
Dot with small pieces of butter across the surface.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean and top is golden brown.
cheapTips: Make your own grated coconut from frozen coconut to save 40%
Use powdered milk mixed with water instead of coconut milk if unavailable

recipes.name: Puto
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, beat eggs and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.
Add melted butter and vanilla to egg mixture and mix well.
Alternately add flour mixture and milk to wet ingredients, stirring until combined.
Fill puto molds or muffin tins halfway with batter.
Steam in a steamer or pot with water for 12-15 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for 2 minutes in molds, then turn out onto a wire rack.
Serve warm with cheese or puto sauce if desired.
cheapTips: Buy flour in bulk to reduce per-unit cost
Skip cheese topping and serve with brown sugar or syrup instead

recipes.name: Turon
recipes.description: Filipino snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel plantains and slice lengthwise into thin strips about 1/4 inch thick.
Lay out a spring roll wrapper in a diamond shape on a flat surface.
Place one plantain slice in the center, then add a piece of jackfruit on top.
Sprinkle about 1/2 tsp brown sugar over the filling.
Fold the wrapper into a spring roll by folding bottom corner up, then sides, then roll tightly to the top corner.
Seal the edge with a dab of water on your finger.
Heat oil to 350°F and carefully fry turon until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels; serve warm.
cheapTips: Use regular bananas instead of plantains for lower cost
Make filling ahead and assemble just before frying to speed up process

recipes.name: Taho
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook sago according to package directions until translucent, then drain and set aside.
In a saucepan, combine brown sugar and water, bringing to a boil over medium heat.
Stir in sago and simmer for 2 minutes, then remove from heat and cool.
Add vanilla and salt to the syrup once cooled.
Gently scoop silken tofu into serving bowls without breaking up too much.
Pour the warm or cool syrup with sago over the tofu.
Serve immediately at room temperature or chilled.
cheapTips: Buy tofu from Asian markets instead of regular supermarkets
Make large batches of syrup and store in fridge for several days

recipes.name: Goto
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil tripe in water with salt for 15 minutes to clean; drain and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté minced garlic and ginger for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced onion and cook until soft, about 3 minutes.
Pour in broth and bring to a boil, then add cleaned tripe pieces.
Reduce heat and simmer tripe for 30-40 minutes until very tender.
Rinse rice and add to the pot, stirring occasionally.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until rice is very soft and mixture is porridge-like.
Stir in soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in bowls topped with sliced green onion.
cheapTips: Buy tripe from Asian or Hispanic markets where it's significantly cheaper
Use instant broth or bouillon instead of fresh broth to save money

recipes.name: Dinuguan
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into cubes and boil in water for 10 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté minced garlic and diced onion until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add parboiled pork shoulder and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in water and vinegar, then add bay leaf and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until pork is nearly tender.
Cut pork liver into chunks and add to the pot, simmering for 5 minutes.
Gradually add pork blood while stirring constantly to avoid lumps; season with soy sauce.
Add whole red chilies and simmer for 10-15 minutes until blood is cooked and mixture thickens.
Adjust seasoning and serve hot with white rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork offal from Asian butchers where it costs 40-50% less than regular markets
Use vinegar-based marinade for regular pork if blood is unavailable

recipes.name: Nasi Goreng
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large pan over high heat and scramble eggs, breaking into small pieces; remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry minced garlic and sliced chili for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp or chicken and cook until done, about 3-4 minutes.
Add diced onion and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry constantly for 3-4 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce and mix thoroughly until rice is evenly coated.
Add cooked eggs back to the pan along with sliced green onion.
Toss everything together for 1 minute and finish with a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve immediately on plates, optionally topped with fried shallots and a fried egg.
cheapTips: Use leftover cooked rice from the fridge or freezer
Substitute with vegetarian version using extra vegetables and tofu

recipes.name: Rendang Daging
recipes.description: Indonesian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend onions, garlic, ginger, chilies, lemongrass, and galangal into a paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté the spice paste for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.
Add beef cubes and brown them on all sides for 5 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk, turmeric, and salt, then stir well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 60-70 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Continue cooking until the sauce reduces to a thick, rich coating and beef is tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt as needed before serving.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze; use galangal powder if fresh is unavailable
Make large batch and freeze portions for later meals

recipes.name: Soto Ayam
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to boil with turmeric, minced garlic, ginger, onion, and lemongrass.
Add chicken breast and simmer for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken, shred it, and set aside; strain broth.
Return broth to pot and bring back to simmer; season with salt.
Cook rice noodles separately according to package directions; drain and divide into bowls.
Place shredded chicken and half a boiled egg in each bowl over noodles.
Pour hot broth over each serving and top with fried shallots and fresh lime juice.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for lower cost
Omit fried shallots or make at home by frying thinly sliced shallots

recipes.name: Gado-Gado
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes and green beans separately until tender; drain and set aside.
Cut tofu into cubes, then fry in oil until golden on all sides; drain on paper towels.
Blanch chopped cabbage in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain well.
Blend peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, garlic, chili, and 3 tablespoons water into smooth sauce.
Arrange cabbage, carrots, potatoes, green beans, tofu, and eggs on a serving platter.
Pour peanut sauce over vegetables or serve on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables in season or frozen for lower prices
Use store-brand peanut butter to reduce cost

recipes.name: Satay Ayam
recipes.description: Indonesian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend peanut butter, coconut milk, garlic, onion, soy sauce, lime juice, sugar, and chili into smooth sauce; set aside.
Thread chicken strips onto soaked bamboo skewers.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook skewers 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Warm peanut sauce in a small pot over low heat for 2-3 minutes.
Serve cooked satay skewers with peanut sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy chicken when on sale and freeze until needed
Make sauce in larger batches for multiple meals

recipes.name: Lumpia
recipes.description: Indonesian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a skillet and cook ground pork until browned; drain excess fat.
Add garlic and onion to pork and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in cabbage, carrots, soy sauce, salt, and pepper; cook for 3-4 minutes until vegetables soften slightly.
Remove from heat and let filling cool for 5 minutes.
Place 2 tablespoons filling on lower third of each lumpia wrapper, fold sides in, and roll tightly.
Heat 3 cups oil in a deep pot to 350°F and fry lumpia in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with sweet chili sauce.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions
Reuse cooking oil by straining through cheesecloth

recipes.name: Perkedel
recipes.description: Indonesian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes until tender; drain, peel, and mash while warm.
Mince onion and garlic finely, then mix into mashed potatoes.
Add egg, flour, salt, and pepper to potato mixture and stir until combined.
Let mixture cool slightly, then shape into 12-15 oval patties.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and fry perkedel in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk when on sale
Strain and reuse frying oil multiple times

recipes.name: Bakso
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground beef, tapioca starch, egg, onion, and garlic in a bowl; mix until just combined.
Bring beef broth to boil in a large pot with salt and soy sauce.
Shape beef mixture into 20-24 small balls using a spoon or ice cream scoop.
Carefully drop meatballs into boiling broth and simmer for 8-10 minutes until they float and are cooked through.
Cook rice noodles separately according to package directions; drain and divide into bowls.
Add bok choy to broth and cook for 2-3 minutes until tender.
Ladle meatballs, vegetables, and broth over noodles in each bowl.
cheapTips: Use 80/20 ground beef instead of leaner cuts
Substitute bok choy with regular cabbage if unavailable

recipes.name: Tahu Goreng
recipes.description: Indonesian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Cut tofu into ½-inch thick rectangular pieces.
Whisk together flour, corn starch, water, salt, and pepper to create a batter.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Dip tofu pieces in batter, coating both sides, then carefully place in hot oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with chili sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy tofu in bulk and freeze in portions
Make homemade chili sauce instead of buying bottled

recipes.name: Martabak
recipes.description: Indonesian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, water, egg, and salt into a smooth dough; let rest 15 minutes.
Brown ground beef with onion and garlic in a skillet; add soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Divide dough into 6 equal balls and flatten each into a thin square.
Spread 2 tablespoons filling on half of each dough square.
Fold dough in half to enclose filling and seal edges by pressing firmly.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook martabak 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with sweet chili sauce or condensed milk.
cheapTips: Make filling with leftover cooked meat
Prepare and freeze uncooked martabak for later use

recipes.name: Pempek
recipes.description: Indonesian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine tapioca starch, fish paste, egg, water, salt, and garlic in a bowl until smooth and sticky.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Using a spoon, carefully drop elongated portions of batter into hot oil.
Fry pempek for 3-4 minutes until they float and become golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Make sauce by blending soy sauce, chilies, and lime juice with 2 tablespoons water.
Serve pempek warm with spicy soy sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy fish paste from Asian markets in bulk for better pricing
Reuse frying oil by straining and storing in a sealed container

recipes.name: Perut Ikan
recipes.description: Indonesian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean fish belly thoroughly under running water and cut into 2-inch pieces.
Blend onions, garlic, ginger, and red chilies into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the paste for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add turmeric powder and stir for 30 seconds.
Add fish pieces and stir gently to coat with spice paste for 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk, add salt, and bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered for 15-20 minutes until fish is tender and sauce thickens slightly.
Finish with lime juice and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy fish belly scraps from your fishmonger for half the price of fillets
Use regular onions instead of shallots for significant savings

recipes.name: Soto Banjar
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil chicken in 6 cups broth with turmeric for 20 minutes until cooked through, then shred.
Blend garlic, shallots, ginger, and galangal into a paste.
Heat oil and fry the paste for 2 minutes until aromatic.
Add fried paste to the broth and stir well.
Cut potatoes into cubes and add to broth, simmer for 12 minutes.
Return shredded chicken to broth and season with salt.
Add bruised lemongrass stalks and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve in bowls with halved hard boiled eggs and rice crackers on the side.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for better flavor and lower cost
Omit hard boiled eggs and add more potatoes to stretch the meal

recipes.name: Nasi Kuning Kuah
recipes.description: Malaysian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend onion, garlic, and ginger into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add turmeric powder and stir for 30 seconds.
Rinse rice and add to the pot, stir constantly for 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk, chicken broth, water, and salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover with a lid.
Cook for 18-20 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot with curried vegetables or sambal.
cheapTips: Buy turmeric in bulk from Asian grocery stores
Use light coconut milk or a coconut cream and water mix to save money

recipes.name: Ayam Goreng
recipes.description: Indonesian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend garlic, shallots, ginger, and galangal into a smooth paste.
Mix turmeric, salt, and paste together in a bowl.
Rub spice mixture all over chicken pieces and let marinate for 20 minutes.
Add water to the marinated chicken and simmer in a covered pot for 15 minutes until half-cooked.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and carefully fry marinated chicken pieces in batches for 8-10 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and finish with a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve hot with sambal matah and steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken and cut it yourself instead of pre-cut pieces
Use chicken thighs which are cheaper and more flavorful than breasts

recipes.name: Sauerbraten
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine vinegar, broth, sliced onions, garlic, bay leaves, juniper berries, and peppercorns in a large bowl.
Place beef in the marinade, cover, and refrigerate for at least 24 hours or up to 3 days.
Remove beef from marinade, pat dry, and season with salt.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven and brown the beef on all sides for 8-10 minutes total.
Strain the marinade, reserving liquid and discarding solids.
Pour marinade liquid over beef and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in a 325°F oven for 2.5 hours until very tender.
Remove beef and crumble gingersnap cookies into the braising liquid, simmer 5 minutes to thicken, then slice beef and serve with sauce.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck which becomes very tender when braised instead of expensive cuts
Make your own beef broth from bones if possible

recipes.name: Wiener Schnitzel
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place veal cutlets between plastic wrap and pound to 0.25 inch thickness using a mallet.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and bread crumbs mixed with salt and pepper.
Dredge each cutlet in flour, shake off excess, then dip in egg, then coat thoroughly in bread crumbs.
Heat oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until very hot.
Carefully place breaded cutlets in the pan and fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and potato salad or sauerkraut.
cheapTips: Substitute pork or chicken cutlets for veal to save 30-40% on cost
Use store-brand panko bread crumbs instead of Japanese panko

recipes.name: Spätzle
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, eggs, milk, salt, pepper, and nutmeg until a sticky batter forms.
Bring salted water to a rolling boil in a large pot.
Press batter through a colander or spätzle maker directly into boiling water in small batches.
Cook for 2-3 minutes after the spätzle float to the surface, then remove with a slotted spoon.
Transfer cooked spätzle to a buttered baking dish.
Slice onion thinly and cook in 3 tablespoons butter until golden brown and crispy.
Toss spätzle with remaining butter and top with caramelized onions.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot as a side dish.
cheapTips: Skip the caramelized onions and serve with just butter and cheese to save money
Make a large batch and freeze extras for quick meals later

recipes.name: Bratwurst
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onion thinly and heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Cook onion for 5 minutes until softened, then push to the side of the pan.
Place bratwurst links in the pan and brown for 2 minutes per side.
Pour beer and beef broth into the pan around the sausages.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes until sausages are cooked through.
Remove sausages and let the liquid reduce for 2 minutes.
Return sausages to pan, stir in mustard, salt, and pepper.
Serve hot in buns with caramelized onions and additional mustard on the side.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand bratwurst instead of specialty brands
Skip the beer and use additional broth to save cost

recipes.name: Currywurst
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fry sausages in oil in a skillet over medium-high heat for 8-10 minutes until golden, turning occasionally.
While sausages cook, mix ketchup, curry powder, paprika, onion powder, Worcestershire sauce, and water in a small bowl.
Remove sausages and slice into 0.5 inch thick pieces.
Reduce heat to medium and pour curry sauce into the same pan.
Return sliced sausages to the pan and coat well with sauce, simmer for 2 minutes.
Prepare fries according to package directions.
Arrange fries on a plate and top with curry sausage and extra sauce.
Serve immediately with additional curry sauce on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Make your own curry sauce base and freeze in ice cube trays
Use frozen fries instead of fresh to save time and money

recipes.name: Knockwurst
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and brown knockwurst on all sides for 6-8 minutes total.
Remove knockwurst and set aside on a plate.
In the same skillet, combine sauerkraut, caraway seeds, beer, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Return knockwurst to the pan and nestle into the sauerkraut mixture.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes for flavors to meld.
Toast buns in a dry skillet or toaster oven for 1-2 minutes.
Place one knockwurst in each bun and top generously with the sauerkraut mixture.
Serve hot with extra mustard and pickles on the side.
cheapTips: Buy canned or jarred sauerkraut instead of fresh to save cost
Use store-brand knockwurst instead of premium butcher sausages

recipes.name: Hasenpfeffer
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat rabbit dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the rabbit pieces on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Dust with flour and stir to coat, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in red wine and beef broth, add tomato paste, juniper berries, and bay leaves, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven at 325°F for 60 minutes.
Add pearl onions and mushrooms, then return to oven uncovered for 30 minutes until meat is tender.
Remove bay leaves and adjust seasoning before serving over egg noodles or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Substitute rabbit with chicken thighs for significant savings
Use frozen pearl onions to reduce prep time and cost

recipes.name: Fleischpflanzerl
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice the onion and cook in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat until softened, about 3 minutes.
Combine bread crumbs and milk in a bowl and let sit 2 minutes.
Mix ground beef, pork, cooked onion, soaked bread crumbs, egg, parsley, salt, and pepper in a large bowl until just combined.
Form into 8 patties about 0.75 inches thick.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook patties 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve immediately with mustard and crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze for later use
Use panko or homemade bread crumbs instead of store-bought

recipes.name: Königsberger Klopse
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bread crumbs in milk for 2 minutes, then combine with ground beef, minced anchovies, 1 egg, minced onion, salt, and pepper.
Form into 12-16 meatballs about 1.5 inches diameter.
Bring beef broth to a boil in a large pot and gently add meatballs.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.
Make a roux by melting butter and whisking in flour, cooking 1 minute.
Slowly whisk 1 cup hot broth into the roux to create a smooth sauce, then stir into the pot.
Stir in capers and simmer 5 minutes to thicken, adjusting seasoning as needed.
Serve over egg noodles or boiled potatoes with the sauce spooned over top.
cheapTips: Omit anchovies if budget is tight; use Worcestershire sauce instead for umami
Use store-brand ground beef and capers to save costs

recipes.name: Frikadellen
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice onion and mix with ground pork, beef, bread crumbs, egg, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper until just combined.
Form into 12 oval patties about 2 inches long and 0.5 inches thick.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry patties 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve warm with mustard, pickles, and fresh bread.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze uncooked patties on a baking sheet
Use equal parts pork and beef for better flavor and texture at lower cost

recipes.name: Sauerkraut und Kartoffelpuffer
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and grate potatoes and onion, then squeeze out excess moisture with a clean kitchen towel.
Toss grated mixture with eggs, flour, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Heat 0.25 cup oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Working in batches, drop spoonfuls of potato mixture and flatten into 3-inch patties, frying 3-4 minutes per side until crispy and golden.
Drain patties on paper towels and add more oil as needed between batches.
In a separate pot, warm sauerkraut over medium heat with caraway seeds for 10 minutes.
Serve potato puffers topped with warm sauerkraut and a dollop of sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk when on sale and store in cool dark place
Use store-brand sauerkraut from the barrel section, not jarred

recipes.name: Kartoffelsalat
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil waxy potatoes in salted water until just tender, about 15-18 minutes.
While potatoes cook, fry bacon until crispy, then crumble and set aside.
Drain potatoes and slice into 0.25-inch rounds while still warm.
Whisk together warm beef broth, vinegar, mustard, and oil.
Toss warm potatoes with dressing and minced red onion.
Let salad rest for 10 minutes to absorb flavors.
Fold in crumbled bacon and fresh dill, then adjust seasoning.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.
cheapTips: Use regular potatoes if waxy varieties are unavailable
Make a day ahead and store in refrigerator for better flavor development

recipes.name: Pretzel
recipes.description: German breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm milk to 110°F, then combine with yeast, sugar, and let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt together, then combine with yeast mixture and melted butter, kneading 8 minutes until smooth dough forms.
Let dough rise in a greased bowl for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Divide dough into 8 pieces, roll each into a 20-inch rope, then twist into pretzel shape.
Bring 2 quarts water to a boil with baking soda, then briefly dip each pretzel for 30 seconds.
Place pretzels on parchment-lined baking sheet, brush with beaten egg yolk, and sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake at 425°F for 15-18 minutes until deep golden brown.
Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Bake a large batch and freeze extras for quick breakfast throughout the week
Use active dry yeast instead of instant for marginal cost savings

recipes.name: Brezel
recipes.description: German breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm milk to 110°F, combine with yeast and sugar, let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt, add yeast mixture and melted butter, knead 7 minutes until smooth.
Allow dough to rise in greased bowl for 45 minutes until nearly doubled.
Divide into 6 pieces, roll each into 18-inch ropes, and form into pretzel twists.
Bring water to boil with baking soda and quickly dip each pretzel for 20 seconds.
Place on greased baking sheet, brush with beaten egg, and sprinkle with pretzel salt.
Bake at 425°F for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
Cool on wire rack for 5 minutes before serving warm.
cheapTips: Make dough the night before and refrigerate for easier handling and better flavor
Buy yeast in bulk from warehouse stores for significant savings

recipes.name: Sauerkraut
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onion and cook in melted butter over medium heat until softened, about 5 minutes.
Rinse sauerkraut briefly under cold water and squeeze out excess moisture.
Add sauerkraut to onions along with caraway seeds, bay leaves, and juniper berries.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally.
Peel, core, and grate apple, then stir into sauerkraut.
Simmer uncovered for 30-35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld.
Remove bay leaves and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve warm as a side dish with sausages, pork, or other main courses.
cheapTips: Buy sauerkraut from the barrel at delis instead of jarred versions
Omit apple if budget is tight; the sauerkraut is delicious without it

recipes.name: Laugenbrezel mit Leberwurst
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm milk to 110°F, combine with yeast and sugar, let sit 5 minutes.
Mix flour and salt, add yeast mixture and melted butter, knead 7 minutes until smooth.
Let dough rise 45 minutes until nearly doubled.
Divide into 4 pieces and roll each into an 18-inch rope, forming pretzel shapes.
Bring water to boil with baking soda and dip each pretzel for 20-30 seconds.
Place on baking sheet, brush with water, and sprinkle with pretzel salt.
Bake at 425°F for 12-14 minutes until golden brown.
Split warm brezels and fill with leberwurst and a thin spread of mustard.
Serve immediately while still warm.
cheapTips: Make brezels ahead and reheat before serving to save time
Use liverwurst or braunschweiger as cheaper alternatives to imported leberwurst

recipes.name: Leberwurst
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chill all equipment, casings, and meat in freezer for 30 minutes.
Cut pork liver, shoulder, and back fat into 1-inch cubes and keep cold on ice.
Grind liver, pork shoulder, and fat together through a fine die, keeping mixture very cold throughout.
Mix ground meat with minced onion, garlic, salt, pepper, and marjoram until just combined.
Stuff mixture into prepared hog casings and tie into 6-inch links.
Simmer sausages in water at 160-170°F for 25-30 minutes until internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Cool sausages in ice bath for 15 minutes, then refrigerate.
Slice and serve cold or lightly pan-fried with mustard and bread.
cheapTips: Buy pork parts at Asian or Eastern European markets for better pricing on offal
Make casings yourself from pork intestines if available; otherwise reuse commercial casings

recipes.name: Blutwurst
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Keep pork blood at room temperature and strain through fine sieve to remove clots.
Dice onions and cook slowly in a pan with a bit of lard until soft, then cool completely.
Grind pork shoulder and back fat together, then mix with cooked onions, barley, and spices.
Gently fold blood into meat mixture in batches until fully incorporated; do not overmix.
Stuff mixture into prepared hog casings using a sausage stuffer, tying into 6-inch links.
Simmer sausages in water at 160-165°F for 20-25 minutes until they float.
Remove with slotted spoon and cool on a rack for 10 minutes.
Serve warm with mustard, bread, and sauerkraut, or slice and pan-fry until edges crisp.
cheapTips: Source pork blood from a butcher or specialty meat supplier; often very inexpensive
Use pearl barley instead of groats if groats are unavailable

recipes.name: Bauernwurst
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Keep all ingredients and equipment cold by chilling for 30 minutes in freezer.
Finely dice onion and garlic, then mince cold pork back fat.
Mix ground pork with diced fat, onion, garlic, salt, pepper, marjoram, and caraway seeds.
Add ice water slowly while mixing with your hands until mixture is light and fluffy.
Stuff into prepared hog casings using a sausage stuffer and tie into 5-inch links.
Simmer sausages in water at 160°F for 20 minutes until internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Transfer to ice bath to cool for 10 minutes, then refrigerate.
Grill, pan-fry, or boil sausages when ready to serve with sauerkraut or potato salad.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze; ask butcher to grind pork shoulder yourself
Make casings by hand from pork intestines or skip casings for patties

recipes.name: Schweinshaxe
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and pat pork shank dry with paper towels.
Rub shank generously with salt, pepper, and crushed garlic.
Heat olive oil in large roasting pan on stovetop and brown shank on all sides until golden, about 10 minutes total.
Add roughly chopped onions, carrots, and celery to pan and roast in oven at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Pour beef broth over shank, add bay leaves, cover with foil, and reduce heat to 325°F.
Braise for 2-2.5 hours until meat is fork-tender and pulls easily from bone.
Transfer shank to cutting board; strain pan juices and skim fat to make gravy if desired.
Serve shank whole or carved with gravy, mustard, and boiled potatoes or sauerkraut.
cheapTips: Buy pork shanks from a butcher or ethnic market; often cheaper than retail cuts
Skip roasting vegetables in pan; roast them separately to save on oil

recipes.name: Rouladen
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Have butcher pound beef slices thin, or place between plastic wrap and pound with mallet until thin.
Lay out beef slice and spread lightly with mustard, then add 1 bacon strip, thin onion slice, and pickle spear to center.
Roll tightly from one end and secure with kitchen twine or toothpicks; repeat with remaining beef.
Heat olive oil in large skillet and brown rouladen on all sides until golden, about 8 minutes total.
Add remaining sliced onions around rouladen and cook until onions soften, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over rouladen and stir to coat, then add beef broth.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 40-45 minutes until beef is tender, turning rouladen halfway through.
Remove twine or toothpicks and serve rouladen with sauce and boiled potatoes or egg noodles.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck roast and ask butcher to slice thin; cheaper than pre-sliced beef
Skip bacon and use only mustard and pickles for a vegetarian filling

recipes.name: Schnitzel Holstein
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place pork chops between plastic wrap and pound to 0.25-inch thickness using mallet.
Set up three bowls: flour mixed with salt and pepper, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs.
Coat each pork chop in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, then coat thoroughly in breadcrumbs.
Heat oil to 350°F in large skillet and fry breaded pork chops 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Transfer to paper towel-lined plate and keep warm.
In same skillet, melt butter and warm anchovy fillets for 1 minute.
Fry eggs in remaining oil until whites are set but yolk is runny, about 3-4 minutes.
Top each pork schnitzel with one anchovy fillet and one fried egg, then serve immediately with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Use chicken cutlets instead of pork; similar price or cheaper
Skip anchovies if unavailable or disliked; use capers or fried onions instead

recipes.name: Zwiebelrostbraten
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onions into thin rings, keeping rings intact.
Heat 3 tablespoons butter in large skillet over medium-high heat and cook onions until softened, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer onions to a bowl and season with salt, pepper, and sugar; set aside.
Add olive oil and remaining butter to same skillet over high heat.
Season beef steaks with salt and pepper, then sear in hot skillet 4-5 minutes per side for medium doneness.
Transfer steaks to serving plates and keep warm.
Add beef broth and crumbled bouillon cube to skillet, scraping up browned bits and simmering for 2 minutes.
Top each steak with caramelized onions and pour pan sauce over top; serve immediately with potatoes.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck roast sliced thick instead of expensive steaks
Cook onions in advance; reheat gently before serving to save time

recipes.name: Eintopf
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches, about 8 minutes total; season with salt and pepper.
Add chopped onions to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour beef broth into pot, add bay leaves, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes until beef begins to soften.
Add diced potatoes and carrots to pot and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in chopped cabbage and simmer for 10-15 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt and pepper as needed.
Serve hot in bowls with fresh bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Use 2 lbs of vegetables and skip meat for a vegetarian version at half the cost
Buy carrots and potatoes at discount grocery stores for significant savings

recipes.name: Gulasch
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in large heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches without crowding, about 12 minutes total; season with salt and pepper and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add diced onions to pot, cooking until caramelized, about 12 minutes.
Add crushed garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in paprika powder and tomato paste, cooking for 2 minutes while stirring constantly.
Return beef to pot and add beef broth and caraway seeds, then bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours until beef is very tender, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust seasonings with additional salt, pepper, or paprika as desired.
Serve hot with egg noodles, spaetzle, or crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck roast and trim excess fat yourself; cheaper than pre-cut stew meat
Make a vegetarian version using mushrooms and beans instead of beef

recipes.name: Kasseler Rippchen
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Heat olive oil in large ovenproof pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and quickly brown pork on both sides, about 4 minutes total.
Remove pork and set aside, then add chopped onions, carrots, and celery to pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Return pork to pot, add broth, bay leaves, and black pepper.
Cover and transfer to oven, braising for 1-1.5 hours until pork is tender and cooked through.
Remove pork from braising liquid and keep warm on serving plate.
Strain braising liquid, pressing vegetables to extract liquid; discard solids.
Stir mustard into braising liquid and serve as gravy alongside pork with sauerkraut and boiled potatoes.
cheapTips: Buy smoked pork chops instead of ribs; usually cheaper per pound at most grocery stores
Skip braising vegetables and use store-bought sauerkraut to save prep time and cost

recipes.name: Leberkäse
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bread crumbs in milk for 5 minutes until softened.
Sauté diced onion in butter over medium heat for 3 minutes until softened.
Mix ground pork, ground beef, soaked bread crumbs, cooked onion, egg, salt, pepper, marjoram, and mustard powder in a large bowl until just combined.
Transfer mixture to a greased loaf pan and smooth the top.
Bake at 350°F for 50-60 minutes until internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a cutting board.
Slice and serve warm with mustard and fresh bread.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork and beef on sale and freeze until needed
Make your own bread crumbs from stale bread

recipes.name: Maultaschen
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pasta dough with 2.5 cups flour, 2 eggs, and 0.5 cup water; knead for 10 minutes until smooth, then rest for 30 minutes.
Sauté diced onion in butter for 3 minutes, add spinach and cook until wilted, then cool completely.
Mix ground pork, cooked spinach mixture, bread crumbs, 1 egg, salt, pepper, and nutmeg in a bowl.
Roll dough very thin between two sheets of parchment paper until about 1/16-inch thick.
Cut dough into 3-inch squares and place 1 tbsp filling on each square.
Fold corners to center and press edges to seal, creating a small package.
Boil in salted water for 4-5 minutes until they float, then simmer 1 more minute.
Pan-fry cooked maultaschen in butter until golden, or serve in warm broth.
cheapTips: Use frozen spinach to save money and prep time
Make dough and filling ahead, assemble when ready to cook

recipes.name: Bigos
recipes.description: Polish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown ground beef, breaking it up as it cooks for 5 minutes.
Add diced onion and garlic, sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add sauerkraut, fresh cabbage, beef broth, caraway seeds, and bay leaf.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and cook covered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with crusty bread or over rice.
cheapTips: Sauerkraut is inexpensive and keeps well in the fridge
This stew tastes better the next day; make ahead and reheat

recipes.name: Pierogi
recipes.description: Polish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make dough with flour, egg, 0.5 cup sour cream, water, and 0.5 tsp salt; knead until smooth and rest for 30 minutes.
Boil and mash potatoes with cheddar cheese, 1 tbsp butter, remaining salt, and black pepper.
Roll dough very thin and cut 3-inch circles using a glass or cookie cutter.
Place 1 tbsp potato filling on each circle, fold in half, and press edges firmly to seal.
Boil pierogi in salted water for 3-4 minutes after they float to the surface, then remove with a slotted spoon.
Sauté diced onion in remaining 2 tbsp butter until golden and crispy.
Toss cooked pierogi with caramelized onion and serve with additional sour cream on the side.
cheapTips: Potatoes and onions are budget-friendly staples for filling
Make a large batch and freeze uncooked pierogi for quick meals

recipes.name: Żurek
recipes.description: Polish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rye flour with 0.5 cup water and let sit at room temperature for 2-3 days to ferment, or use store-bought żurek starter.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and carrot for 3 minutes.
Add beef broth, potatoes, kielbasa, bay leaf, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil then simmer for 20 minutes.
Strain fermented rye mixture through cheesecloth to get the liquid.
Pour rye liquid into the soup and simmer for 10 more minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in sour cream until smooth.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy kielbasa on sale and freeze for future soups
Use potatoes and carrots as your vegetable base to keep costs low

recipes.name: Barszcz
recipes.description: Polish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine grated beets, water, beef broth, onion, garlic, and bay leaf in a large pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Strain soup through a fine mesh strainer, pressing gently on solids.
Return liquid to pot and stir in red wine vinegar and sugar.
Simmer for 5 more minutes and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream on top and crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Beets are inexpensive, especially in fall and winter
Make a large batch and freeze in portions for quick meals

recipes.name: Kielbasa
recipes.description: Polish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chill ground pork and diced fat in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Mix cold pork, fat, salt, pepper, garlic, paprika, marjoram, and water until well combined.
Stuff mixture into prepared sausage casings using a sausage stuffer, working carefully to avoid air pockets.
Tie casings at 4-inch intervals with kitchen twine.
Place sausages in a pot of simmering water (not boiling) for 25-30 minutes until internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Remove sausages and cool slightly, then refrigerate until ready to serve.
Pan-fry sausages in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until golden, or grill until charred.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder and fat when on sale and freeze
Skip casings and make patties instead for easier preparation

recipes.name: Kotlety Mielone
recipes.description: Polish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork, ground beef, bread crumbs, egg, minced onion, salt, and pepper in a bowl until just combined.
Shape mixture into 8 oval patties about 0.75-inch thick.
Place flour in a shallow dish and lightly dredge each patty on both sides.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Cook patties for 4-5 minutes per side until browned and internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Transfer to a plate and serve hot with potatoes and pickled vegetables.
cheapTips: Use a mix of ground pork and beef to stretch the meat budget
Make patties ahead and refrigerate for quick weeknight cooking

recipes.name: Flaki
recipes.description: Polish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 2 lbs, cleaned and cut into strips

steps: Bring tripe and 6 cups beef broth to a boil in a large pot, then reduce heat and simmer for 2.5 hours until very tender.
Drain tripe and set aside, reserving 4 cups cooking liquid.
Heat oil in the same pot and sauté diced onion, carrot, and celery for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, paprika, and marjoram, cooking for 1 minute.
Return cooked tripe to pot along with reserved cooking liquid, bay leaves, salt, and pepper.
Simmer for 30 more minutes to blend flavors.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve hot in bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Tripe is very inexpensive at butcher counters and ethnic markets
Make large batches and freeze for easy reheating

recipes.name: Czarnina
recipes.description: Polish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown duck pieces on all sides for 8 minutes, working in batches.
Remove duck and set aside, then sauté onion and carrot in the same pot for 5 minutes.
Return duck to pot, add beef broth, bay leaves, and black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 1 hour until duck is tender.
Add prunes and simmer for 15 more minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together duck blood and red wine vinegar.
Slowly stir blood mixture into the hot soup while stirring constantly; do not boil after adding blood.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot with red cabbage and potatoes.
cheapTips: Buy whole duck when on sale and freeze until ready to cook
Omit duck blood and use chicken blood, or substitute with tomato paste for depth of flavor

recipes.name: Golabki
recipes.description: Polish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and carefully remove 8-10 cabbage leaves, boiling until pliable (about 5 minutes), then set aside on paper towels.
Heat butter in a skillet and sauté diced onion and garlic until fragrant, then add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Mix the cooked beef with cooked rice, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Place 2-3 tablespoons of beef mixture on each cabbage leaf, fold in the sides, and roll tightly.
Pour 1 cup of tomato sauce into the bottom of a baking dish and arrange rolled cabbage seam-side down.
Mix remaining 1 cup tomato sauce with beef broth and pour over the rolls.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes until heated through and sauce is bubbling.
Serve hot with sour cream on the side if desired.
cheapTips: Buy cabbage when on sale and freeze it to soften leaves easily
Use ground beef on sale or the cheapest available cut

recipes.name: Placki Ziemniaczane
recipes.description: Polish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and coarsely grate potatoes and onion into a bowl, then squeeze out excess moisture using a clean kitchen towel.
Mix grated potato mixture with egg, flour, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Drop heaping tablespoons of potato mixture into oil and flatten with the back of a spatula to 1/4-inch thickness.
Fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer cooked pancakes to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve warm with sour cream as a topping or dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk when cheapest
Store-brand sour cream is nearly identical to name brands

recipes.name: Paczki
recipes.description: Polish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine warm milk, yeast, and 1 tablespoon sugar in a small bowl and let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour, remaining sugar, and salt in a large bowl, then create a well in the center.
Pour yeast mixture, egg yolks, and melted butter into the well and stir until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled.
Divide dough into 12 pieces, roll each into a ball, and place on parchment-lined baking sheets.
Cover and let rise 30 minutes until puffy.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot, then carefully fry doughnuts 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to paper towels to drain, then use a piping bag to inject 1 tablespoon jam into the center of each warm paczki.
Dust generously with powdered sugar while still warm.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze extras for later
Use store-brand jam to save money

recipes.name: Sernik
recipes.description: Polish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press firmly into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan.
Bake crust at 325°F for 5 minutes, then remove and let cool slightly.
Beat softened cream cheese with sugar until smooth and creamy, scraping bowl frequently.
Add sour cream and vanilla extract to cream cheese mixture and beat until combined.
Add eggs one at a time, beating on low speed after each addition until just incorporated.
Gently fold in flour with a spatula.
Pour filling onto prepared crust and smooth the top.
Bake at 325°F for 55-60 minutes until the center is set but slightly jiggles when gently shaken.
Turn off oven, crack door open, and let cheesecake cool in the oven for 1 hour to prevent cracking.
cheapTips: Buy cream cheese on sale and freeze until needed
Make your own graham cracker crust from crushed crackers

recipes.name: Oscypek
recipes.description: Polish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk slowly to 86°F, stirring frequently, then add diluted rennet and stir for 1 minute.
Let milk sit undisturbed for 30 minutes until a firm curd forms.
Cut curds into 1/4-inch pieces using a long knife, making horizontal and vertical cuts, then let rest 5 minutes.
Slowly heat curds to 105°F over 30 minutes while stirring gently and constantly.
Drain whey through cheesecloth, pressing curds gently, then transfer curds to a colander lined with cheesecloth.
Fold cheesecloth around curds and hang to drain for 1 hour.
Mix drained curds with salt and caraway seeds, then knead gently to develop elasticity.
Form into a ball or loaf shape, wrap in cheesecloth, and hang to dry for 2-3 days in a cool place.
Unwrap and store in a cool location, turning daily for even drying.
cheapTips: Buy milk in bulk when on sale for the lowest cost
Use standard liquid rennet available online cheaply

recipes.name: Bigos ze Smalcem
recipes.description: Polish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat lard in a large pot over medium-high heat and sauté diced onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add ground pork to the pot and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sauerkraut, sliced kielbasa, diced tomatoes with juice, beef broth, bay leaves, and caraway seeds.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Cook for 45-60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld and mixture thickens.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper as needed.
Serve hot in bowls, optionally topped with sour cream and fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy sauerkraut in bulk from a deli section if available
Use bacon fat instead of lard to save money

recipes.name: Rosół
recipes.description: Polish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chicken pieces in a large pot and cover with 8 cups cold water.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Skim off any foam or impurities that rise to the surface.
Add halved onion, carrots, parsnips, celery, parsley root, and bay leaves.
Simmer uncovered for 1-1.5 hours until chicken is very tender and broth is flavorful.
Remove chicken from pot and let cool, then remove meat from bones and shred into bite-sized pieces.
Strain broth through a fine-mesh strainer into a clean pot, discarding vegetables.
Return chicken meat to broth, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy chicken legs and thighs in bulk when on sale
Freeze leftover broth in ice cube trays for later use

recipes.name: Varenyky
recipes.description: Ukrainian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then create a well and add egg and warm water.
Stir until a shaggy dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rest for 20 minutes.
Boil diced potatoes until tender, then mash with cheese and salt to taste.
Roll out dough on a floured surface to 1/8-inch thickness and cut into 3-inch circles using a cup or cookie cutter.
Place 1 tablespoon filling in the center of each circle, fold in half, and press edges to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook varenyky in batches until they float, then cook 2 more minutes.
In a separate skillet, sauté diced onion in butter until golden, then toss with drained varenyky.
Serve warm with sour cream on the side.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze uncooked varenyky on a tray before storing
Use store-brand cheese to reduce cost

recipes.name: Holubtsi
recipes.description: Ukrainian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and carefully submerge cabbage head for 10 minutes until leaves soften.
Remove cabbage and peel off leaves gently, setting aside the largest 10-12 leaves.
Heat butter in a skillet and sauté diced onion until soft, then add ground beef and cook until browned.
Mix cooked beef with cooked rice and season generously with salt and pepper.
