Place 2-3 tablespoons of filling on each cabbage leaf, roll tightly, tucking in the sides as you go.
Combine diced tomatoes, tomato paste, and beef broth in a bowl.
Pour half the tomato mixture into a baking dish, arrange rolls seam-side down in a single layer, and top with remaining sauce.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 45-50 minutes until rolls are heated through.
Serve hot with crusty bread and optionally drizzle with sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk when on sale
Use canned tomatoes from your pantry staples

recipes.name: Chicken Kyiv
recipes.description: Ukrainian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix softened butter with minced parsley, dill, garlic, salt, and pepper, then refrigerate while preparing chicken.
Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound to 1/4-inch thickness using a meat mallet.
Divide herb butter into 3 portions and place one in the center of each flattened chicken breast.
Roll each chicken breast tightly around the butter, tucking in the sides, and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs.
Coat each chicken roll in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing gently so coating adheres.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and carefully place breaded rolls in the hot oil.
Fry for 5-7 minutes per side until golden brown on all sides.
Transfer to paper towels to drain and serve immediately while the butter center is still warm.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts in bulk when on sale and freeze individually
Use panko breadcrumbs for a crispier coating at a similar price

recipes.name: French Toast
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla extract in a shallow bowl.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place coated slices on the hot skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to a plate and dust with powdered sugar.
Serve hot with maple syrup drizzled on top.
cheapTips: Use day-old bread from the bakery discount bin
Make your own cinnamon-sugar topping instead of buying fancy syrups

recipes.name: Cheeseburger
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Divide ground beef into two patties and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side.
Place a cheese slice on each patty during the last minute of cooking, covering the skillet to melt.
Toast the hamburger buns lightly in the skillet if desired.
Spread mayo and ketchup on the bottom buns and top with lettuce, tomato, and onion.
Place cheeseburger patties on top and close with the top bun.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Skip expensive cheese brands and use store-brand cheddar

recipes.name: Hamburger
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Shape ground beef into two patties and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Toast the hamburger buns lightly in the skillet.
Spread ketchup and mustard on the bottom buns.
Layer lettuce, tomato slices, and onion on the spread.
Top with cooked patty and close with the top bun.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on manager's special for discounts
Use generic store-brand condiments instead of name brands

recipes.name: Hot Dog
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat water in a pot to boiling and add frankfurters, or heat them in a skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Warm the hot dog buns by toasting them lightly in a separate skillet or oven.
Place cooked hot dog in each bun.
Drizzle with mustard and ketchup.
Top with diced onion and relish.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy hot dogs and buns in bulk during sales
Use basic yellow mustard and ketchup for lowest cost

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Butter one side of each bread slice generously.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Place one bread slice butter-side down in the skillet.
Layer two cheese slices on top and cover with second bread slice butter-side up.
Cook for 3-4 minutes until golden brown, then flip carefully.
Cook the other side for 2-3 minutes until the cheese is melted and bread is golden.
Remove from heat and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use store-brand sliced cheese instead of deli counter cheese
Buy bread on discount from the bakery section

recipes.name: BLT Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8 minutes, then drain on paper towels.
Toast bread slices until light golden.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each toast slice.
Layer lettuce, tomato slices, and bacon on two of the toasted slices.
Season with salt and pepper.
Top with remaining toast slices and cut diagonally.
cheapTips: Buy bacon ends and pieces instead of premium slices for lower cost
Use store-brand mayonnaise

recipes.name: Reuben Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm the corned beef gently in a skillet over low heat, about 3 minutes.
Spread thousand island dressing on one side of each bread slice.
Layer corned beef, sauerkraut, and two cheese slices on two of the bread slices.
Top with remaining bread slices, dressing side down.
Butter the outside of each sandwich.
Cook in a skillet over medium heat for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese is melted.
cheapTips: Buy corned beef on sale and freeze for future use
Use canned sauerkraut which is cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Meatloaf
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, milk, onion, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Shape mixture into a loaf and place in a baking dish.
Mix ketchup and brown sugar together and spread over the top.
Bake for 45-50 minutes until internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk when on sale and freeze portions
Make your own breadcrumbs from stale bread

recipes.name: Pot Roast
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sear the beef roast on all sides until browned, about 10 minutes total.
Remove beef and set aside, then add onion and garlic, cooking for 2 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Return beef to pot and add broth, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 2 hours.
Add carrots and potatoes, cover, and continue simmering for 45 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Serve hot in bowls with broth.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck roast on sale and freeze, as it's the most economical cut for this dish
Use store-brand beef broth to reduce costs

recipes.name: Beef Stew
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Coat beef cubes with flour and brown them in the pot in batches, about 5 minutes per batch, then set aside.
Add onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Return beef to pot with bay leaf, salt, pepper, and broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 90 minutes.
Add potatoes and continue simmering for 30-40 minutes until beef is tender and potatoes are cooked.
Remove bay leaf and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze in smaller portions
Use frozen vegetables to save money and prep time

recipes.name: Fried Catfish
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat catfish fillets dry with paper towels and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Mix cornmeal, flour, salt, black pepper, and cayenne in a shallow bowl.
Whisk eggs and buttermilk together in another shallow bowl.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or Dutch oven.
Dip each fillet in buttermilk mixture, then coat thoroughly in cornmeal mixture.
Carefully place coated fillets in hot oil and fry 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer fillets to a paper towel-lined plate to drain and cool slightly before serving.
cheapTips: Buy catfish fillets on sale and freeze them for later use.
Use basic vegetable oil instead of specialty oils for frying.

recipes.name: Blackened Fish
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, thyme, oregano, black pepper, and salt in a small bowl.
Pat fish fillets dry and coat both sides generously with the spice mixture.
Heat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat until very hot, about 2 minutes.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the surface.
Place fish fillets in the hot skillet and cook 3-4 minutes without moving them.
Flip fillets carefully and cook the other side 2-3 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Transfer to serving plates and serve immediately with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Make your own spice blend instead of buying pre-mixed blackening seasoning.
Use tilapia or cod as affordable white fish options.

recipes.name: Dirty Rice
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown ground beef until cooked through, breaking it into small pieces.
Add diced chicken liver to the skillet and cook until no longer pink, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in diced onion, celery, bell pepper, and minced garlic and cook until vegetables soften, about 5 minutes.
Add rice to the skillet and stir constantly for 2 minutes to lightly toast the grains.
Pour in chicken broth, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover with a lid, and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff rice with a fork and taste to adjust seasonings before serving.
cheapTips: Omit the chicken liver and use all ground beef to reduce cost and complexity.
Buy rice in bulk for better per-serving pricing.

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Steak
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder in a shallow dish.
Whisk eggs and buttermilk together in another shallow dish.
Pound cube steaks with a meat mallet to tenderize them further if desired.
Dip each steak in buttermilk mixture, then dredge thoroughly in flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Place floured steaks in the hot skillet and fry 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer steaks to a paper towel-lined plate and serve hot, optionally with country gravy.
cheapTips: Buy cube steak in bulk when on sale and freeze for future meals.
Make a simple pan gravy with flour and beef broth instead of buying pre-made sauce.

recipes.name: Fried Green Tomatoes
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice green tomatoes into 0.5-inch thick rounds and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix cornmeal, flour, salt, and black pepper in a shallow dish.
Whisk eggs and buttermilk together in another shallow dish.
Heat oil to 350°F in a large skillet or Dutch oven.
Dip each tomato slice in buttermilk mixture, then coat both sides with cornmeal mixture.
Carefully place coated slices in hot oil and fry 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer fried tomato slices to a paper towel-lined plate to drain before serving.
cheapTips: Pick green tomatoes from your own garden or farmers market in late summer.
Use a shallow oil pan instead of a deep fryer to use less oil.

recipes.name: Black Eyed Peas
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crispy, then remove and crumble, reserving 1 tbsp drippings.
Dice onion and mince garlic, then sauté in bacon drippings for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.
Drain and rinse canned black eyed peas and add to the pot.
Pour in chicken broth and add salt, black pepper, red pepper flakes, and bay leaf.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in crumbled bacon and taste to adjust seasonings.
Simmer 5 more minutes and remove bay leaf before serving.
cheapTips: Use canned peas instead of dried to save time and avoid soaking.
Skip the bacon or use just 2 slices for a lower-fat version.

recipes.name: Okra and Tomatoes
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, then remove and crumble, reserving drippings.
Chop okra into 0.5-inch pieces and dice onion, then sauté in bacon drippings for 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in canned tomatoes with juices and add salt, black pepper, and sugar.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 15 minutes until okra is tender.
Stir in crumbled bacon and taste to adjust seasonings.
Serve warm as a side dish or over rice.
cheapTips: Buy okra fresh in season for better prices, or use frozen okra year-round.
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh for consistent pricing and availability.

recipes.name: Cornmeal Catfish
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornmeal, salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder in a shallow bowl.
Beat eggs in another shallow bowl.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or Dutch oven.
Pat catfish fillets dry and dip each in beaten egg.
Coat both sides thoroughly with cornmeal mixture and let rest 2 minutes.
Carefully place coated fillets in hot oil and fry 4-5 minutes per side until crispy and golden brown.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain and serve hot.
cheapTips: Purchase catfish from a local fishmonger for better prices than supermarkets.
Reuse frying oil by straining and storing in the refrigerator for multiple uses.

recipes.name: Shrimp Creole
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onion, celery, and bell pepper into small pieces and mince garlic.
Heat a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced vegetables for 5 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in canned tomatoes with juices and chicken broth.
Add salt, cayenne pepper, and thyme, then bring to a simmer.
Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes to develop flavors.
Add shrimp and cook 4-5 minutes until pink and cooked through, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust seasonings before serving over rice.
cheapTips: Buy shrimp on sale and freeze for later use, or use frozen shrimp.
Make a double batch and freeze extra portions for quick weeknight meals.

recipes.name: Low Country Boil
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil in a large stockpot and add salt, old bay seasoning, smashed garlic cloves, and lemon juice.
Add halved potatoes and boil for 10 minutes until just tender.
Cut sausage into 1-inch thick coins and add to the pot, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add corn cobs and bring back to a boil, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook 3-4 minutes until pink and fully cooked, stirring gently.
Drain all contents into a large colander, reserving liquid for dipping sauce.
Transfer shrimp, sausage, corn, and potatoes to a large platter and drizzle with melted butter before serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp instead of fresh to save 20-30% on cost.
Buy sausage in bulk when on sale and freeze for future boils.

recipes.name: Smothered Pork Chops
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and pepper in a shallow dish and dredge each pork chop thoroughly.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the pork chops on both sides for 3-4 minutes per side, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté the sliced onions and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and thyme, scraping up browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Return the pork chops to the skillet, cover, and reduce heat to medium-low.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until pork is cooked through and gravy thickens.
cheapTips: Buy bone-in pork chops on sale and freeze for later use
Use onions from your pantry instead of expensive pre-sliced varieties

recipes.name: Fried Okra
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash okra and pat completely dry, then trim stems and cut into 1/2-inch pieces.
Mix cornmeal, flour, salt, cayenne pepper, and black pepper in a bowl.
Toss okra pieces in the cornmeal mixture until fully coated.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or Dutch oven.
Fry okra in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy, stirring occasionally.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy okra when in season at farmers markets for better prices
Reuse frying oil multiple times by straining it through cheesecloth

recipes.name: Crawfish Cakes
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix crawfish meat, mayonnaise, egg, green onions, bell pepper, mustard, Worcestershire, and Old Bay in a bowl.
Stir in 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs and fold gently to combine without breaking up the crawfish.
Form the mixture into 8 patties and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Spread remaining 1/4 cup panko on a plate and coat both sides of each cake.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and fry cakes for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and serve warm with remoulade or lemon.
cheapTips: Buy frozen crawfish tail meat in bulk when on sale for significant savings
Make cakes ahead and freeze for quick pan-frying later

recipes.name: Hoppin' John
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crispy, then remove and chop into pieces.
In the same pot, sauté onion, celery, and garlic in bacon fat until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add black-eyed peas and chicken broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in cooked rice and collard greens and simmer for 8-10 minutes until greens are tender.
Add cooked bacon pieces, hot sauce, salt, and pepper to taste and stir well.
Simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use canned black-eyed peas instead of dried to save time and reduce energy costs
Buy collard greens at discount ethnic markets for better pricing

recipes.name: Shrimp Étouffée
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat and whisk in flour to create a roux, stirring constantly for 3-4 minutes until light brown.
Add onion, celery, and bell pepper and sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth and tomato paste, whisking to combine, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add shrimp and Cajun seasoning and cook for 5-7 minutes until shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasonings, then serve over cooked rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp on sale and thaw overnight in the refrigerator for better prices
Make a big batch of rice to stretch the recipe further

recipes.name: Fried Chicken Livers
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse chicken livers and soak in buttermilk for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Mix flour, cornmeal, salt, pepper, and paprika in a shallow dish.
Remove livers from buttermilk and dredge thoroughly in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or Dutch oven.
Fry livers in batches for 3-4 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels, then serve hot with hot sauce or gravy.
cheapTips: Chicken livers are often one of the cheapest proteins available at the butcher counter
Buy in bulk and freeze in portions for future use

recipes.name: Eggs Benedict
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make hollandaise sauce by whisking egg yolks and lemon juice over simmering water in a double boiler until pale.
Slowly whisk in melted butter until sauce is thick and creamy, then season with salt and cayenne and keep warm.
Warm Canadian bacon slices in a skillet over medium heat for 1 minute per side.
Toast English muffins until golden and place two halves on each plate.
Top each muffin half with a slice of Canadian bacon.
Poach eggs in simmering water with a splash of vinegar for 3-4 minutes until whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Carefully place one poached egg on top of each Canadian bacon slice and pour warm hollandaise sauce generously over each egg.
cheapTips: Skip Canadian bacon and use regular bacon or ham for significant savings
Buy eggs in bulk when on sale and store safely

recipes.name: Pancakes with Maple Syrup
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Combine milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla in another bowl.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined (batter should be slightly lumpy).
Heat a griddle or nonstick skillet over medium heat and lightly butter the surface.
Pour 1/4 cup batter onto the griddle for each pancake and cook until bubbles form on the surface and edges look set.
Flip pancakes and cook the other side until golden brown, about 1-2 minutes.
Transfer to plates and serve immediately with warm maple syrup.
cheapTips: Use store-brand maple-flavored syrup instead of pure maple for significant savings
Buy bulk dry ingredients like flour and baking powder to reduce per-serving costs

recipes.name: Hash Browns
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and shred them using a box grater, then squeeze out excess moisture using a clean kitchen towel.
Finely dice the onion and mix with the shredded potatoes.
Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder and mix thoroughly.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Spread the potato mixture evenly in the skillet and press down gently with a spatula.
Cook undisturbed for 5-7 minutes until the bottom is golden and crispy.
Break into chunks, stir gently, and cook for another 3-5 minutes until all potatoes are tender and golden, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk bags for the lowest per-pound price
Use vegetables past their prime appearance but still safe to eat from the discount bin

recipes.name: Bacon and Eggs
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Lay bacon slices flat in a large skillet and cook over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, turning occasionally, until crispy.
Transfer cooked bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
Pour off most of the bacon grease, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the skillet.
Add butter to the skillet and crack eggs directly into it, leaving space between each egg.
Cook eggs over medium heat for 3-4 minutes for sunny-side up, or longer if you prefer firmer yolks.
Season eggs with salt and pepper and serve hot alongside the bacon.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale and store in the refrigerator for 3+ weeks
Buy bacon in bulk packages instead of pre-sliced for better value

recipes.name: Pork Chops
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and season both sides generously with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Place pork chops in the hot skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown; transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium and add butter and sliced onions to the same skillet, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Pour apple juice or broth into the skillet, scraping up browned bits from the bottom.
Return pork chops to the skillet and simmer gently for 5-8 minutes until cooked through and internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Transfer pork chops to a serving platter and spoon pan sauce and onions over the top.
cheapTips: Buy pork chops on sale and freeze them; bone-in chops are cheaper than boneless.
Skip the apple juice and use water or chicken broth instead.

recipes.name: Mashed Potatoes and Gravy
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes, cut into 2-inch chunks, and place in a large pot of cold salted water.
Bring to a boil and cook for 12-15 minutes until potatoes are very tender and a fork easily pierces them.
Drain potatoes thoroughly and return them to the pot.
Add 3 tablespoons butter and milk, then mash until smooth or to your desired consistency; season with salt and pepper.
For gravy, melt remaining 1 tablespoon butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to form a paste.
Gradually whisk in broth, stirring until the mixture thickens and reaches a boil, about 5 minutes.
Season gravy with salt, pepper, and onion powder; simmer for 2 more minutes.
Transfer mashed potatoes to a serving bowl and pour gravy over the top or serve on the side.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk bags when on sale.
Make gravy from pan drippings if available instead of using broth.

recipes.name: Chicken Salad Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine shredded chicken, mayonnaise, celery, red onion, relish, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Stir well until fully combined and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Toast bread slices lightly if desired.
Lay lettuce leaves on two slices of bread.
Divide chicken salad evenly between the two bread slices, spreading it generously.
Top each with the remaining bread slice and cut diagonally in half.
Serve immediately or wrap in plastic for a later meal.
cheapTips: Use leftover home-cooked chicken instead of rotisserie.
Buy store-brand mayo and relish to save significantly.

recipes.name: Turkey Club Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast bread slices lightly until golden.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each of three bread slices.
Layer turkey, bacon, and lettuce on the first slice.
Top with the second bread slice, then layer more turkey, bacon, and tomato slices on top.
Cap with the third bread slice.
Secure sandwich with four toothpicks inserted diagonally through the sandwich.
Cut into four triangles and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale and freeze in portions.
Use store-brand deli turkey when on sale.

recipes.name: Apple Pie
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then cut in cold butter with a fork or pastry cutter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add ice water a tablespoon at a time, mixing gently until dough just comes together; divide in half, wrap in plastic, and chill for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Toss sliced apples with brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, and cornstarch in a bowl.
Roll out one dough portion and place in a 9-inch pie dish; add apple mixture.
Roll out second dough portion and place over apples, trimming and crimping edges to seal.
Brush top with beaten egg and cut three small vents for steam.
Bake for 50-60 minutes until crust is golden brown and filling bubbles at the edges.
Cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before slicing.
cheapTips: Buy apples in bulk during fall season and store in the refrigerator.
Make the crust with shortening instead of butter for slightly lower cost.

recipes.name: Milkshake
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add vanilla ice cream, milk, and chocolate syrup to a blender.
Blend on high speed until smooth and creamy, about 1-2 minutes.
Pour into two tall glasses.
Top with whipped cream if desired and serve immediately with a straw.
cheapTips: Make your own whipped cream with heavy cream and sugar.
Use store-brand ice cream and chocolate syrup.

recipes.name: Cheesecake
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and wrap the outside of a 9-inch springform pan with foil.
Mix graham cracker crumbs and melted butter, press firmly into the bottom of the pan.
Bake crust for 8 minutes until lightly golden; remove and cool slightly.
Beat softened cream cheese and sugar together until smooth, scraping bowl frequently.
Add eggs one at a time, beating on low speed after each addition.
Stir in vanilla extract and sour cream until just combined.
Pour filling over crust and place the springform pan in a larger roasting pan.
Pour hot water into the roasting pan until it reaches halfway up the sides of the springform (water bath).
Bake for 55-65 minutes until the edges are set but the center jiggles slightly when gently shaken.
Turn off oven and let cheesecake sit in the oven for 1 hour with the door cracked slightly.
Remove from oven and cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Buy cream cheese when on sale and freeze it; thaw overnight before use.
Make your own graham cracker crust base instead of buying pre-made.

recipes.name: Cherry Pie
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add ice water gradually until dough just comes together; divide in half, wrap, and chill for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Combine cherries, sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, and almond extract in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat for 3-4 minutes, stirring gently, until mixture thickens slightly; cool for 5 minutes.
Roll out one dough portion and place in a 9-inch pie dish; add cherry filling.
Roll out second dough portion and place over cherries, crimping edges to seal.
Brush top with beaten egg, cut three vents, and bake for 50-60 minutes until crust is golden.
Cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before slicing.
cheapTips: Use frozen or canned cherries year-round for significant savings.
Make pie crust with shortening instead of butter.

recipes.name: Brownies
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x9 inch baking pan.
Melt butter and mix with cocoa powder and sugar in a bowl.
Beat in eggs and vanilla extract until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Fold dry ingredients into wet ingredients until just combined; do not overmix.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the pan for 15 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely before cutting into 12 squares.
cheapTips: Buy cocoa powder in bulk at warehouse stores.
Store-brand cocoa works just as well as name brands.

recipes.name: Chile Con Carne
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5-7 minutes; drain excess fat.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the pot, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in chili powder and cumin, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes, kidney beans, and beef broth to the pot.
Bring to a simmer and reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld and sauce thickens slightly.
Season with salt, pepper, and hot sauce to taste.
Serve hot in bowls, optionally topped with shredded cheese, sour cream, or diced onion.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions.
Use store-brand canned beans and tomatoes instead of name brands.

recipes.name: Beef Fajitas
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice beef sirloin against the grain into ¼-inch strips and place in a bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, lime juice, minced garlic, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Pour marinade over beef and let sit for 10 minutes while preparing vegetables.
Slice bell peppers and onions into thin strips.
Heat a large skillet or cast iron over high heat and sear beef in batches for 2-3 minutes per side, then transfer to a plate.
In the same skillet, sauté peppers and onions until slightly charred and tender, about 5-6 minutes, then return beef to skillet.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or over an open flame for 20 seconds per side.
Serve beef and vegetable mixture on warm tortillas with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy beef on sale and freeze; use cheaper cuts like flank or skirt steak
Buy peppers and onions in season or use frozen bell pepper strips

recipes.name: Chile Relleno
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast poblano peppers over an open flame or under a broiler until blackened all over, about 5-7 minutes.
Place roasted peppers in a plastic bag for 5 minutes to steam, then peel off the charred skin carefully.
Make a slit down the side of each pepper and remove seeds and stem gently.
Stuff each pepper with 2 oz of cheese, then heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Beat eggs with salt and pepper, then dredge each stuffed pepper lightly in flour and dip into beaten egg.
Fry peppers in hot oil until golden on all sides, about 3-4 minutes total, and drain on paper towels.
Simmer tomato sauce with minced garlic, onion, cumin, salt, and pepper for 10 minutes.
Pour warm tomato sauce onto a serving plate and top with fried chiles rellenos.
cheapTips: Use canned tomato sauce instead of making from scratch
Substitute poblanos with bell peppers if poblanos are unavailable

recipes.name: Crispy Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown ground beef, breaking it apart with a spoon, about 5-7 minutes.
Drain excess fat from the beef and stir in taco seasoning mix with ½ cup water.
Simmer seasoned beef for 5 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Warm taco shells according to package directions, about 3-4 minutes.
Dice tomatoes and chop lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
Fill each taco shell with beef and top with cheese, lettuce, and tomatoes.
Serve tacos with sour cream and salsa on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and use store-brand taco seasoning
Use less cheese or buy block cheese and shred it yourself to save money

recipes.name: Chiles Rellenos de Queso
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast poblano peppers over an open flame until completely blackened on all sides.
Steam roasted peppers in a covered bowl for 5 minutes, then carefully peel away the charred skin.
Make a vertical slit and gently remove the seeds and stem without tearing the pepper.
Stuff each pepper with 2 oz of cheese and set aside.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and beat eggs until frothy.
Lightly dust peppers with flour, dip into beaten egg, and fry until golden brown on both sides.
Strain the egg coating oil into a saucepan, sauté minced garlic and onion, then add chicken broth and salt.
Pour broth sauce onto serving plates and arrange fried peppers on top.
cheapTips: Make your own broth from vegetable scraps or use boxed vegetable broth
Substitute mozzarella for oaxaca cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Chicken Flautas
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix shredded chicken with half the cheese, minced garlic, minced onion, salt, pepper, and cilantro in a bowl.
Warm tortillas in a skillet to make them pliable, about 20 seconds per side.
Spoon about ¼ cup chicken filling down the center of each tortilla and roll tightly, tucking in the sides.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or pot.
Fry flautas seam-side down for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy, turning once.
Drain fried flautas on paper towels.
Mix sour cream with salsa verde to create a crema sauce.
Serve flautas on a plate, drizzle with crema sauce, and top with remaining cheese.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken or leftover cooked chicken to save time and money
Buy flour tortillas in bulk and freeze any extras

recipes.name: Beef Chimichanga
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat with diced onion and minced garlic for 8-10 minutes.
Drain excess fat and stir in cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper; cook for 2 more minutes.
Remove from heat and mix in 1 cup shredded cheese.
Warm tortillas to make them pliable, then place about ⅓ cup beef mixture in the center of each tortilla.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla and roll tightly to enclose the filling completely.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet and fry each chimichanga until golden brown on all sides, about 4-5 minutes total.
Drain on paper towels and place on serving plates.
Top with salsa roja, sour cream, and remaining cheese, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand salsa and cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadilla
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice bell pepper and onion.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté peppers and onions for 3 minutes until softened.
Add shredded chicken to the skillet and warm through for 1 minute, then remove from heat.
Place one tortilla in a clean skillet over medium heat and top half with cheese, chicken mixture, more cheese, then fold the tortilla in half.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy, then flip carefully and cook the other side for 2 minutes until cheese is melted.
Transfer to a cutting board and cut into triangles.
Repeat with the second tortilla and remaining filling.
Serve with salsa and sour cream for dipping.
cheapTips: Use leftover rotisserie chicken to save money and time
Buy flour tortillas and cheese on sale and store in the freezer

recipes.name: Carne Guisada
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into 1-inch cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef on all sides in batches, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Remove beef and set aside, then sauté diced onion and minced garlic in the same pot for 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add beef broth and return beef to the pot.
Add cumin, bring to a simmer, and cook partially covered for 30 minutes until beef is tender.
Peel and cube potato, then add to the pot along with diced jalapeño.
Simmer for another 15-20 minutes until potatoes are fork-tender and the stew has thickened.
Taste and adjust seasonings with salt and pepper, then serve hot with flour tortillas or rice.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale when available; it's affordable and perfect for stewing
Skip fresh jalapeños and use canned if on a tight budget

recipes.name: Breakfast Tacos with Chorizo
recipes.description: Tex-Mex breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove chorizo from casing and crumble into a large skillet over medium heat, cooking for 5-6 minutes until browned.
Remove chorizo and set aside, leaving about 1 tbsp of fat in the skillet.
Beat eggs with salt and pepper in a bowl.
Pour beaten eggs into the skillet and stir constantly for 3-4 minutes until scrambled but still moist.
Stir in cooked chorizo, diced jalapeño, and diced onion.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 20 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with the chorizo-egg mixture and top with shredded cheese and cilantro.
Serve immediately with salsa on the side.
cheapTips: Buy bulk chorizo and portion it into freezer bags for future use
Use store-brand salsa instead of premium versions

recipes.name: Chili Cheese Fries
recipes.description: Tex-Mex snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake frozen french fries according to package directions, about 20-25 minutes, until golden and crispy.
While fries bake, brown ground beef in a skillet with minced onion and garlic over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes.
Drain excess fat and stir in chili powder, cumin, tomato sauce, and beef broth.
Simmer chili for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Transfer cooked fries to a serving dish and top with hot chili.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the chili while hot.
Top with sliced jalapeños and a dollop of sour cream, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fries in bulk and ground beef on sale
Use store-brand canned tomato sauce instead of fresh

recipes.name: Pelmeni
recipes.description: Russian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, egg, and water until a stiff dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
Let dough rest covered for 30 minutes at room temperature.
While dough rests, finely dice onion and mix with ground beef, ground pork, salt, and pepper.
Roll dough thin on a floured surface and cut into 2-inch squares using a knife.
Place 1 teaspoon filling in center of each square, fold into triangle, then bring corners together to seal.
Bring chicken broth to boil in a large pot and carefully drop in pelmeni.
Simmer for 8-10 minutes until pelmeni float and cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve hot in bowls with broth, sour cream, and black pepper on the side.
cheapTips: Use a 50/50 beef and pork blend instead of all beef to save money
Make pelmeni in batches and freeze on a tray before boiling for future quick meals

recipes.name: Stroganoff
recipes.description: Russian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook egg noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Cut beef into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over high heat and sear beef strips for 3-4 minutes until browned, then remove.
In same skillet, add remaining butter and sauté diced onion and sliced mushrooms for 5 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables, stir for 1 minute, then add beef broth and bring to simmer.
Return beef to skillet and reduce heat to low, cooking for 10 minutes.
Stir in sour cream until combined, cooking 2 more minutes without boiling.
Serve stroganoff over noodles, garnished with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Substitute beef chuck roast for sirloin and cook 5 minutes longer for budget savings
Use canned mushrooms instead of fresh to reduce cost by 50%

recipes.name: Goulash
recipes.description: Hungarian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into 1-inch cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches for 4-5 minutes, set aside.
Add diced onions and garlic to pot, cooking for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in paprika and tomato paste, cooking for 1 minute.
Return beef to pot and add beef broth, bringing to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 40 minutes until beef is tender.
Add diced potatoes and carrots, cooking covered for 20 more minutes until vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper before serving.
cheapTips: Use beef stew meat from the sale section instead of chuck roast
Add extra potatoes and carrots to stretch meat further and reduce cost per serving

recipes.name: Paprikash
recipes.description: Hungarian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown chicken for 4 minutes per side, then remove.
Add diced onions and minced garlic to skillet, cooking for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in paprika and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sliced red bell pepper and chicken broth, returning chicken to skillet.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove from heat and stir in sour cream gently without boiling.
Serve paprikash over cooked egg noodles with fresh parsley if desired.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale or from budget-friendly stores like Aldi
Substitute plain yogurt for half the sour cream to reduce cost and calories

recipes.name: Tripe Soup
recipes.description: Hungarian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thoroughly clean and blanch tripe in boiling water for 5 minutes, then rinse and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Heat beef broth in a large pot and add tripe with bay leaves, simmering for 90 minutes until very tender.
In a separate skillet, sauté diced onions, carrots, celery, and garlic until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add sautéed vegetables to the pot with tripe and broth.
Stir in paprika and diced potatoes, simmering for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer for 5 more minutes, ensuring all flavors are well combined.
Serve hot in bowls with crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Tripe is extremely affordable at ethnic butcher shops compared to standard supermarkets
Make a double batch and freeze portions for quick reheating later

recipes.name: Schnitzel
recipes.description: Czech dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place pork cutlets between plastic wrap and pound with a meat mallet until 0.25 inch thick.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs mixed with salt and pepper.
Coat each cutlet in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, and coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry schnitzel for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and fresh parsley garnish.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder chops and pound them instead of pre-cut cutlets for 40% savings
Use regular breadcrumbs instead of panko to reduce cost

recipes.name: Svickova
recipes.description: Czech dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season beef roast with salt and pepper on all sides.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown roast for 4 minutes per side.
Remove roast and sauté diced onions, carrots, parsnips, and celery for 5 minutes until softened.
Return roast to pot and add beef broth and tomato paste.
Cover and simmer for 60 minutes until beef is tender, turning halfway through.
Remove roast and let rest for 5 minutes, then slice into 0.5-inch thick pieces.
Strain sauce through a sieve, pressing vegetables to extract liquid, then return to pot.
Cook egg noodles according to package directions and serve with sliced roast, vegetables, and sour cream sauce.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck roast instead of sirloin and increase cooking time by 30 minutes
Skip the parsnips and use extra carrots if parsnips are unavailable or expensive

recipes.name: Knedliki
recipes.description: Czech dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast bread cubes in a skillet with butter until golden, about 5 minutes, then set aside.
Whisk eggs with milk, salt, pepper, and nutmeg in a bowl.
Gradually fold flour into egg mixture until a soft dough forms, then fold in toasted bread cubes.
Let dough rest for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil.
Using wet hands, form dough into oval dumplings about 3 inches long.
Carefully drop dumplings into boiling water and simmer for 10-12 minutes until they float and cook for 2 more minutes.
Remove with a slotted spoon and serve warm as a side dish with goulash or stroganoff.
cheapTips: Make dumplings ahead and freeze on a tray before boiling for convenient side dishes
Use day-old bread or bread heels instead of fresh for bread cubes

recipes.name: Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak chicken pieces in buttermilk for at least 30 minutes at room temperature.
Mix flour, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, salt, and black pepper in a shallow bowl.
Heat oil in a deep skillet or Dutch oven to 350°F (use a thermometer).
Remove chicken from buttermilk and dredge thoroughly in seasoned flour mixture.
Carefully place chicken pieces in hot oil, skin side down, and fry for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
Flip chicken and fry for 8-10 minutes more until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with biscuits, collard greens, or coleslaw.
cheapTips: Buy bone-in chicken quarters instead of mixed pieces for better value
Reuse cooking oil by straining it through cheesecloth after cooling

recipes.name: Shrimp and Grits
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet until crispy, remove and chop, leaving 2 tablespoons bacon fat in skillet.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a saucepan and slowly whisk in cornmeal, stirring constantly for 15 minutes until thick.
Stir 2 tablespoons butter and cheddar cheese into grits, season with salt and pepper.
In the skillet with bacon fat, sauté diced onion and minced garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Remove from heat and stir in remaining 2 tablespoons butter, lemon juice, hot sauce, and chopped bacon.
Season shrimp mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Divide creamy grits among bowls and top with shrimp mixture and sauce.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp instead of fresh to save 30-40% on cost
Make grits from scratch with inexpensive cornmeal instead of instant packets

recipes.name: Gumbo
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and whisk in flour continuously for 8-10 minutes until the roux is dark brown, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add diced onion, celery, and bell pepper to the roux and cook for 5 minutes until vegetables soften.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth slowly while stirring to avoid lumps, then add bay leaves and Cajun seasoning.
Add sliced sausage and chicken pieces, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Add okra and simmer for an additional 10-15 minutes until okra is tender.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed, then serve over rice in bowls.
cheapTips: Use chicken drumsticks instead of thighs to reduce cost.
Buy frozen okra which is cheaper than fresh and works just as well.

recipes.name: Jambalaya
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the cubed chicken on all sides, about 5 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, brown the sausage slices for 3 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Add diced onion, bell pepper, and celery to the skillet and sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, then add rice and stir to coat with oil, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and add canned tomatoes with juice, Cajun seasoning, and hot sauce, stirring well.
Return the chicken and sausage to the skillet and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy sausage on sale and freeze for later use.
Use store-brand Cajun seasoning which is significantly cheaper.

recipes.name: Red Beans and Rice
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse dried red beans and soak in water for at least 4 hours or overnight, then drain.
Heat oil in a large pot and brown the sliced sausage for 3 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion, celery, and bell pepper for 5 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, then return sausage to pot.
Add drained beans, chicken broth, bay leaves, and Cajun seasoning, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 60-75 minutes until beans are very tender, stirring occasionally and adding water if needed.
While beans cook, prepare rice according to package directions.
Serve beans over cooked rice in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy dried beans in bulk which is much cheaper than canned.
Make a large batch and freeze portions for quick meals later.

recipes.name: Crawfish Boil
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a large pot with 6 gallons of water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.
Add salt and crawfish boil seasoning to the boiling water and stir well.
Add quartered onion, halved garlic bulbs, and halved lemons to the water and let boil for 5 minutes.
Add baby potatoes and sausage chunks, and boil for 10 minutes until potatoes are nearly tender.
Add corn pieces and boil for 5 minutes.
Carefully add live crawfish in batches and return to a boil, cooking for 5-7 minutes until crawfish turn bright red.
Turn off heat and let crawfish soak in the seasoned water for 5-10 minutes to absorb flavor.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer crawfish and vegetables to a large table or colander to drain and cool slightly before serving.
cheapTips: Buy crawfish during peak season (spring/early summer) when prices are lowest.
Check local seafood markets for better prices than chain grocery stores.

recipes.name: Biscuits and Gravy
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix 2 cups flour, baking powder, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a large bowl.
Cut in cold butter cubes with a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in buttermilk until just combined into a shaggy dough, being careful not to overmix.
Turn dough onto a floured surface and gently pat to 1-inch thickness, then cut into 8 biscuits using a biscuit cutter or glass and place on baking sheet.
Bake biscuits for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
While biscuits bake, brown the ground sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks, then drain excess fat.
Sprinkle 3 tablespoons flour over sausage and stir for 1 minute, then slowly add milk while stirring, and simmer for 5 minutes until gravy thickens, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
Split warm biscuits and serve with sausage gravy spooned on top.
cheapTips: Use store-brand buttermilk or substitute regular milk with 1 tablespoon vinegar.
Buy bulk sausage from the meat counter which is cheaper than packaged.

recipes.name: Catfish Po'Boy
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornmeal, flour, salt, and pepper in a shallow dish.
Pat catfish fillets dry with paper towels and dip each in beaten egg, then dredge thoroughly in cornmeal mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or Dutch oven.
Carefully place breaded catfish fillets in hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and fish flakes easily.
Remove catfish with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Slice po'boy rolls in half lengthwise and spread mayonnaise on both sides.
Layer lettuce, tomato slices, and fried catfish on each roll, then top with pickle slices.
Mix hot sauce with any remaining mayonnaise and drizzle over the sandwiches before serving.
cheapTips: Buy whole catfish and ask the fishmonger to fillet them, which is cheaper.
Use regular sub rolls instead of authentic po'boy rolls to save money.

recipes.name: Chicken and Dumplings
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion, celery, and carrot for 5 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute to eliminate raw flour taste.
Pour in chicken broth slowly while stirring to avoid lumps, then add thyme, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken pieces and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium and simmer for 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
While chicken simmers, prepare dumplings by mixing biscuit mix with milk until just combined into a thick dough.
Increase heat to a gentle boil and carefully drop spoonfuls of dumpling dough into the simmering broth, making 12-16 dumplings.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes until dumplings are cooked through and no longer doughy in the center.
Taste and adjust seasonings, then serve in bowls with broth and dumplings.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs or drumsticks instead of breast for better flavor at lower cost.
Make your own biscuit dumplings from scratch with flour and buttermilk to save money.

recipes.name: Collard Greens
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook chopped bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crispy, about 5 minutes, then remove and set aside, leaving drippings in the pot.
Add diced onion to the bacon drippings and sauté for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chopped collard greens in batches, stirring down as they wilt, until all greens are in the pot.
Pour in chicken broth and add apple cider vinegar, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes, stirring well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 40-45 minutes until greens are very tender and flavored throughout.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed, then stir in crispy bacon before serving.
cheapTips: Buy collard greens in season (fall/winter) when they're cheapest and most tender.
Use bacon ends and pieces which are much cheaper than regular bacon slices.

recipes.name: Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook elbow macaroni according to package directions until al dente, then drain and set aside.
In the same pot, melt 3 tablespoons butter over medium heat and whisk in flour, cooking for 1-2 minutes while stirring constantly.
Slowly add milk while whisking constantly to avoid lumps, then continue cooking and stirring until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in shredded cheddar and gruyere cheese until completely melted and smooth, then season with salt, pepper, and cayenne.
Return cooked pasta to the pot and stir until all noodles are coated with cheese sauce.
Transfer to a baking dish and set aside, or serve immediately for a creamy version.
For a baked version, preheat oven to 350°F and mix panko breadcrumbs with 2 tablespoons melted butter.
Sprinkle buttered breadcrumb mixture over mac and cheese and bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown on top.
cheapTips: Use all cheddar cheese instead of a blend to reduce cost significantly.
Skip the breadcrumb topping and serve creamy style to save time and money.

recipes.name: Cornbread
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and place a 9-inch cast iron skillet in the oven to heat for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk together beaten egg, milk, and vegetable oil.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Remove hot skillet from oven and add melted butter, swirling to coat the pan.
Quickly pour batter into buttered skillet and return to oven immediately.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and top is golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes in the skillet, then turn out onto a wire rack or serve directly from the skillet.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from warehouse stores for significant savings.
Skip the sugar entirely or reduce to 2 tablespoons for authentic Southern cornbread.

recipes.name: Gudeg
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse the canned jackfruit, cutting large pieces into smaller chunks.
Blend shallots, garlic, galangal, and red chilies with 1/4 cup water until smooth paste forms.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the paste for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, jackfruit, brown sugar, salt, and chicken pieces to the pot.
Simmer uncovered for 60-75 minutes until the chicken is tender and sauce thickens.
Stir occasionally and adjust seasoning with salt to taste before serving.
cheapTips: Buy canned jackfruit at Asian markets instead of specialty stores
Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor and lower cost

recipes.name: Nasi Kuning
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince shallots, garlic, and ginger finely and set aside.
Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté the minced aromatics for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add turmeric powder and stir constantly for 30 seconds.
Pour in rice and stir to coat with the oil and spices for 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk, water, lemongrass, and salt to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes until rice is cooked.
cheapTips: Buy turmeric in bulk at Asian grocery stores
Use regular long-grain white rice instead of jasmine for savings

recipes.name: Laksa
recipes.description: Malaysian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch rice noodles in boiling water for 3-4 minutes, drain and set aside.
Cut tofu into cubes and crush lemongrass with the side of a knife.
In a large pot, whisk together red curry paste, coconut milk, and broth until smooth.
Add crushed lemongrass, minced shallots, and garlic to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Add shrimp and tofu cubes and cook for 5-7 minutes until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice, adjusting to taste.
Divide cooked noodles into bowls and ladle hot laksa broth over them.
Garnish with sliced green onions and additional cilantro if desired.
cheapTips: Buy red curry paste at Asian markets in larger containers
Substitute shrimp with canned fish or extra tofu to reduce cost

recipes.name: Roti Canai
recipes.description: Malaysian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, condensed milk, and 2 tablespoons oil with warm water to form a soft dough.
Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth, then rest for 30 minutes covered.
Divide dough into 3 equal portions and roll each into a ball.
On an oiled surface, stretch one ball very thin until nearly transparent, working from center outward.
Fold the stretched dough into a square, then roll into a tight spiral.
Heat remaining oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry each spiral for 1-2 minutes per side until golden and crispy, pressing gently with a spatula.
Remove to paper towels and serve warm with curry sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Make large batches and freeze uncooked spirals for quick breakfasts
Use vegetable oil throughout instead of mixing with butter

recipes.name: Rendang Ayam
recipes.description: Malaysian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend red chilies, shallots, garlic, ginger, and galangal with 1/4 cup water until smooth paste forms.
Heat oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven and fry the paste for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and stir-fry for 5 minutes until partially cooked.
Pour in coconut milk, add crushed lemongrass, salt, and brown sugar.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 50-60 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Continue cooking until sauce reduces and coats the chicken pieces in a rich, dark brown coating.
Remove lemongrass stalk and adjust seasoning before serving with rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs in bulk and freeze for better unit pricing
Use a slow cooker on low for 4 hours instead of stovetop

recipes.name: Char Kway Teow
recipes.description: Malaysian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice Chinese sausage thinly and dice it into small pieces.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat and cook sausage until edges curl, then set aside.
Add 1 tablespoon oil and cook shrimp for 2-3 minutes until pink, then set aside.
Beat eggs with a fork and push them to the side of the wok while cooking in remaining oil.
Push all ingredients to the side and add rice noodles with remaining 2 tablespoons oil, breaking them apart as they heat.
Add minced garlic and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Pour soy sauce and dark soy sauce over noodles and toss constantly for 2-3 minutes.
Return shrimp and sausage to wok, add bean sprouts and chives, tossing for another minute.
Season with white pepper and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk rather than fresh for 30% savings
Use lap cheong sausage from the freezer section at Asian markets

recipes.name: Mee Goreng
recipes.description: Malaysian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil egg noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Blend red chilies with garlic and 2 tablespoons water until smooth.
Dice onion, julienne carrot, and shred cabbage into small pieces.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat and fry chili-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Push to the side and beat eggs into the wok, scrambling until partially cooked.
Add onion, carrot, and cabbage, stirring for 2-3 minutes until vegetables soften.
Add cooked noodles, soy sauce, and chili sauce, tossing everything together for 2 minutes.
Finish with lime juice and sliced green onions, tossing gently before serving.
cheapTips: Buy fresh red chilies in bulk and freeze for year-round use
Substitute any available fresh vegetables to reduce cost

recipes.name: Oxtail Soup
recipes.description: Malaysian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch oxtail pieces in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water.
Bring 10 cups fresh water to a boil in a large pot and add cleaned oxtail pieces.
Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes, skimming off foam and impurities that rise to the surface.
Cut carrots, potatoes, and onion into chunks; smash garlic and ginger.
Add vegetables, garlic, ginger, star anise, and cinnamon to the broth.
Simmer for 60-75 minutes more until oxtail is very tender and meat pulls easily from bones.
Remove cinnamon stick and star anise, then season with soy sauce, salt, and pepper.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with sliced green onions.
cheapTips: Buy oxtail from Asian or Latin markets for 40% less than mainstream supermarkets
Use a pressure cooker to reduce cooking time from 2 hours to 45 minutes

recipes.name: Teh Tarik with Roti
recipes.description: Malaysian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and 2 tablespoons oil with warm water to form soft dough, knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Rest dough for 20 minutes covered with a damp cloth.
Divide dough into 2 portions, stretch each very thin on an oiled surface, fold into rectangles.
Heat remaining oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry each roti 1-2 minutes per side until golden.
Brew strong black tea using 2 tea bags in 2 cups hot water for 4-5 minutes.
Strain tea and add condensed milk, evaporated milk, and sugar to a pot.
Heat the tea mixture gently but do not boil.
Pour hot tea rapidly between two metal cups 5-6 times to create foam and cool slightly.
Serve teh tarik immediately alongside warm roti with butter for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy loose black tea or bulk tea bags instead of premium brands
Make roti dough in large batches and freeze uncooked for future use

recipes.name: Chicken Rendang
recipes.description: Indonesian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend red chilies, shallots, garlic, galangal, and ginger with 1/3 cup water until very smooth paste forms.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the paste over medium heat for 4-5 minutes until fragrant and oil separates.
Add chicken pieces and stir constantly for 5-7 minutes until coated and partially cooked.
Pour coconut milk into the pot slowly while stirring to avoid lumping.
Crush lemongrass and add along with salt and brown sugar.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 60-70 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Continue cooking until sauce thickens significantly and oil floats on top, chicken is very tender.
Remove from heat, discard lemongrass, and adjust seasoning before serving with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze half in portions for quick future meals
Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze until rendang is planned

recipes.name: Puffy Tacos
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl, then gradually add warm water until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough for 2 minutes, then let rest covered for 15 minutes.
Divide dough into 9 balls and roll each flat into a thin 4-inch circle.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet and fry each dough circle until it puffs up and turns golden, about 1 minute per side.
Drain puffy shells on paper towels and carefully cut an opening along one side.
Brown ground beef in a skillet and stir in taco seasoning with 0.25 cup water, simmer 5 minutes.
Fill each puffy shell with seasoned beef, cheese, lettuce, and tomatoes.
Serve immediately while shells are still warm and crispy.
cheapTips: Use store-brand ground beef and seasonings
Buy cheese in blocks and shred yourself instead of pre-shredded

recipes.name: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil chicken breasts in salted water for 15 minutes until cooked through, then shred into bite-sized pieces.
Preheat oven to 350°F and lightly butter a 9x13 baking dish.
Mix sour cream, cream of chicken soup, diced green chiles, minced garlic, and chopped onion in a bowl.
Stir shredded chicken into the sour cream mixture and add 0.5 cup chicken broth.
Warm tortillas in microwave for 30 seconds to make them pliable, then fill each with chicken mixture and roll tightly.
Place rolled enchiladas seam-side down in the prepared baking dish.
Pour any remaining sauce over the enchiladas and top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Bake uncovered for 30 minutes until sauce is bubbly and cheese is melted and lightly golden.
cheapTips: Buy rotisserie chicken instead of cooking your own to save time
Use store-brand sour cream and soup

recipes.name: Beef Taco Salad
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 8 minutes.
Add taco seasoning and 0.25 cup water to the beef, simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
Tear romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces and divide among serving bowls.
Top lettuce with warm seasoned beef, cherry tomatoes, cheddar cheese, and black olives.
Crush tortilla chips and sprinkle over the top of each salad.
Drizzle with a mixture of sour cream and salsa, then squeeze fresh lime juice over each salad.
Toss gently before eating to combine flavors.
cheapTips: Buy pre-shredded cheese to save prep time
Use generic salsa and store-brand chips

recipes.name: Chile Cheese Burrito
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat refried beans in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally for 5 minutes.
Sauté diced onion in oil until softened, about 3 minutes, then stir into warm beans.
Warm tortillas in a skillet for 30 seconds on each side to make them pliable.
Lay tortilla flat and spread warm bean mixture in the center, leaving borders.
Top beans with cooked rice, green chiles, and cheddar cheese.
Roll tortilla tightly, tucking in sides as you roll to form a burrito.
Place burritos seam-side down in a baking dish and pour enchilada sauce over them.
Top with additional cheese and bake at 350°F for 15 minutes until cheese is melted.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans and pre-cooked rice to save time
Use store-brand enchilada sauce

recipes.name: Charro Beans
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crispy, about 8 minutes, then remove and chop.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic in the bacon drippings for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add drained pinto beans, chicken broth, diced jalapeños, and diced tomatoes to the pot.
Stir in cumin and return chopped bacon to the pot.
Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot as a side dish.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans on sale and stock up
Use bacon ends and pieces which are cheaper than whole slices

recipes.name: Cheese Enchiladas with Red Sauce
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onion and mince garlic, then sauté in oil in a saucepan for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in chili powder and cumin, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, and chicken broth to the pan, simmer for 15 minutes.
Season red sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Preheat oven to 350°F and lightly oil a 9x13 baking dish.
Dip each tortilla into warm red sauce to coat, then fill with cheddar cheese and roll tightly.
Arrange rolled enchiladas seam-side down in the baking dish and pour remaining sauce over top.
Sprinkle extra cheese on top and bake uncovered for 25 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.
cheapTips: Buy canned tomatoes in bulk on sale
Make sauce without oil by using the pan drippings

recipes.name: Fajita Platter
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice flank steak thinly against the grain and place in a bowl with lime juice, minced garlic, cumin, and chili powder for 15 minutes.
Slice bell peppers and onion into 0.5-inch strips.
Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat until shimmering.
Cook marinated steak in batches for 3-4 minutes until browned, then remove and set aside.
Add peppers and onions to the same skillet and cook for 5-6 minutes, stirring frequently, until slightly charred.
Return steak to the skillet and toss with vegetables, season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm tortillas in a skillet for 30 seconds on each side.
Transfer fajita mixture to a platter and serve with warm tortillas on the side for assembly.
cheapTips: Buy flank steak on sale and freeze for later use
Use whatever bell peppers are on sale

recipes.name: Queso Fundido
recipes.description: Tex-Mex snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove casing from chorizo and crumble into a small skillet, cooking over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add diced onion and bell pepper to the chorizo and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Transfer chorizo mixture to a small baking dish or skillet suitable for serving.
Top chorizo mixture with Oaxaca cheese, cheddar cheese, and diced jalapeños.
Bake at 375°F for 8-10 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and sprinkle fresh cilantro over the top.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips for dipping.
cheapTips: Use shredded mozzarella if Oaxaca cheese is unavailable
Buy chorizo on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Barbacoa Tacos
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles and toast them in a dry skillet for 1 minute until fragrant.
Soak toasted chiles in 1 cup hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with garlic, vinegar, cumin, and oregano until smooth.
Rub beef chuck roast with salt and pepper, then sear in a large pot over high heat for 3 minutes per side until browned.
Strain chile mixture and pour over the beef, add beef broth, quartered onion, and additional garlic.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 2.5 hours until beef is very tender and shreds easily.
Remove beef from liquid and shred with two forks, then return to the pot and simmer 15 more minutes.
Warm corn tortillas in a skillet for 30 seconds on each side.
Fill warm tortillas with shredded barbacoa and serve with onion and cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck when on sale and freeze until ready to use
Use a slow cooker to cook overnight instead of stovetop

recipes.name: Nachos Supreme
recipes.description: Tex-Mex snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart, about 8 minutes.
Stir taco seasoning and 2 tablespoons water into the beef, simmer for 3 minutes.
Spread tortilla chips on a large oven-safe platter or baking sheet.
Top chips with seasoned ground beef, jalapeños, and cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 8-10 minutes until cheese is completely melted.
Remove from oven and drizzle with sour cream and salsa in zigzag patterns.
Top with diced tomatoes, black olives, and green onions, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned jalapeños instead of fresh to save money
Use store-brand chips and toppings

recipes.name: Jollof Rice
recipes.description: Nigerian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend tomatoes, red peppers, onion, garlic, and Scotch bonnet pepper until smooth.
Heat oil in a large pot and add tomato paste, cooking for 2 minutes until darkened.
Pour the blended mixture into the pot and cook for 10 minutes until thickened.
Add broth, salt, and black pepper, then bring to a boil.
Rinse rice and add to the pot, stir well, and bring back to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and cook for 25 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy tomatoes in bulk cans
Use regular onions instead of shallots

recipes.name: Fufu
recipes.description: West African dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cut plantains and cassava into chunks, removing fibrous centers from cassava.
Boil water with salt in a large pot and add plantain and cassava pieces.
Cook for 20-25 minutes until very soft and easily pierced with a fork.
Drain well, reserving 1 cup of cooking water.
Mash with a wooden pestle or potato masher until very smooth and sticky, adding reserved water gradually as needed.
Add butter and continue mashing until fufu reaches a thick, dough-like consistency.
Serve warm with soup or sauce.
cheapTips: Buy plantains in season at African markets
Cassava is cheaper than plantains; use mostly cassava if budget is tight

recipes.name: Egusi Soup
recipes.description: Nigerian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend egusi seeds with 1 cup water until you get a paste-like consistency.
Heat oil in a large pot and brown ground meat with diced onion for 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add canned tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
