Pour in broth, crushed garlic, and Scotch bonnet pepper, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and add the egusi paste slowly while stirring to prevent lumps.
Simmer for 15 minutes, then add spinach and cook for 5 more minutes.
Season with salt and red pepper flakes, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Use vegetable broth instead of meat broth
Buy egusi seeds at African markets in bulk

recipes.name: Pepper Soup
recipes.description: Nigerian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and brown meat with diced onion for 5 minutes.
Add minced ginger and garlic, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add whole Scotch bonnet peppers, black peppercorns, thyme, and salt.
Continue simmering for 15 more minutes until meat is very tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, keeping the soup spicy.
Serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for cheaper protein
Buy peppers at farmer's markets

recipes.name: Suya
recipes.description: Nigerian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix peanut butter, paprika, garlic powder, ginger powder, cayenne, salt, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Thread beef slices onto wooden skewers (soaked 30 minutes) or place on a grill rack.
Brush meat on all sides with the peanut spice mixture.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Cook meat skewers in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through and charred.
Transfer to a plate and sprinkle extra spice mixture on top while hot.
Serve with sliced onion on the side.
cheapTips: Buy meat on sale and freeze
Make your own spice blend instead of buying pre-mixed

recipes.name: Pounded Yam
recipes.description: Nigerian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel yams by cutting off thick skin with a knife and removing the fibrous layer underneath.
Cut peeled yam into uniform chunks approximately 2 inches in size.
Boil water with salt in a large pot and add yam chunks.
Cook for 15-20 minutes until yams are completely soft and easily pierced with a fork.
Drain thoroughly, reserving 1 cup of cooking water.
Mash with a wooden pestle or strong spoon, adding reserved water gradually to achieve a smooth, fluffy consistency.
Add butter and continue mashing until well combined and light, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy yams in bulk from African or international markets
Use oil instead of butter to save money

recipes.name: Okra Soup
recipes.description: West African dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown ground meat with diced onion for 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and canned tomatoes, cooking for 5 minutes until flavors combine.
Pour in broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add okra, cut into 0.5-inch pieces, stirring well to prevent excessive sliminess.
Simmer for 15 minutes until okra is tender but not mushy.
Season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes to taste.
Serve hot, preferably with fufu or rice.
cheapTips: Frozen okra is cheaper than fresh and just as good
Buy ground meat on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Moi Moi
recipes.description: Nigerian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend cooked black-eyed peas with onion, red pepper, Scotch bonnet, garlic, and fish until smooth.
Pour mixture into a bowl and fold in eggs and baking powder until well combined.
Add salt and 2 tablespoons oil, mixing until the batter is smooth and pourable.
Grease small bowls or ramekins with remaining oil and pour batter 3/4 full.
Place bowls in a larger pot with hot water (water bath), cover, and steam for 25-30 minutes until set.
Insert a toothpick into the center to check doneness; it should come out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes, then run a knife around edges and turn out onto a plate.
cheapTips: Use canned beans instead of fresh-cooked beans
Buy sardines on sale and stock up

recipes.name: Akara
recipes.description: Nigerian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried black-eyed peas in hot water for 5 minutes, then rub with hands to remove skins.
Drain and blend peas with onion, Scotch bonnet, garlic, salt, and a little water until fluffy and frothy.
Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350°F.
Using a spoon, carefully drop balls of batter into the hot oil, frying 4-5 at a time.
Fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy all over.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot, ideally with pepper sauce or tomato sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy dried black-eyed peas in bulk
Reuse frying oil multiple times

recipes.name: Chin Chin
recipes.description: Nigerian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, then beat in eggs and vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, and nutmeg.
Fold dry ingredients into the butter mixture until a stiff dough forms.
Roll dough between two sheets of parchment paper to 0.25-inch thickness.
Cut into small rectangular or square pieces using a knife or pastry cutter.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet, then fry chin-chin pieces in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and cool completely before storing in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Buy butter on sale and freeze
Make large batches and store for a week

recipes.name: Enchilada Suiza
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil chicken breasts in salted water for 15 minutes until cooked through, then shred the meat.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic in olive oil until soft, about 3 minutes.
Mix shredded chicken, sautéed onion, garlic, sour cream, half the cheese, and diced jalapeños in a bowl.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet to make them pliable.
Dip each tortilla in salsa verde, fill with chicken mixture, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a greased baking dish.
Pour remaining salsa verde mixed with chicken broth over the enchiladas.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and bake at 350°F for 25 minutes until bubbly.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with additional sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken and butcher it yourself instead of boneless breasts.
Use store-brand salsa verde to cut costs in half.

recipes.name: Chorizo Breakfast Burrito
recipes.description: Tex-Mex breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook diced potatoes until golden, about 8 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Brown chorizo in the same skillet, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes, then drain excess fat.
Add diced onion and jalapeño to the skillet and sauté for 2 minutes until soft.
Scramble eggs in a bowl, then pour into the skillet with chorizo and vegetables, stirring until cooked through.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Assemble each burrito by placing filling in the center of a tortilla, adding cheese, folding in the sides, and rolling tightly.
Serve with salsa and additional cheese on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chorizo on sale and freeze for later use.
Use regular potatoes instead of hash browns.

recipes.name: Chili Relleno Casserole
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and butter a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Drain canned poblanos well and layer half of them in the bottom of the baking dish.
Sprinkle half the cheese over the poblanos.
Layer remaining poblanos and top with remaining cheese.
Whisk together eggs, milk, flour, and salt until smooth, then pour over the peppers and cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes until the egg mixture is set.
Meanwhile, warm enchilada sauce in a saucepan with sautéed onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Pour sauce over the casserole in the last 5 minutes of baking and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use canned poblanos instead of fresh, which are often expensive.
Substitute Monterey Jack for Oaxaca to save 20%.

recipes.name: Blackened Catfish
recipes.description: Cajun dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix paprika, cayenne, thyme, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt in a shallow bowl.
Pat catfish fillets dry and coat both sides generously with the spice mixture.
Heat butter in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until very hot and just smoking.
Place blackened catfish in the hot skillet and cook for 3 minutes without moving.
Flip fillets carefully and cook the other side for 2-3 minutes until the spices form a dark crust.
Transfer fish to a serving plate and serve immediately with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy catfish on sale and freeze for later.
Make your own spice blend instead of buying pre-made Cajun seasoning.

recipes.name: Muffuletta
recipes.description: Creole lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the muffuletta loaf in half horizontally.
Spread half of the Italian olive salad on the bottom half of the bread.
Layer mortadella, mozzarella, salami, capicola, roasted red peppers, and provolone on the bottom half.
Spread remaining olive salad on the top half of the bread.
Close the sandwich and let it sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Cut into 4 equal wedges using a sharp knife and serve.
cheapTips: Buy deli meats on sale and stock your freezer.
Make your own olive salad by mixing canned olives, capers, and olive oil.

recipes.name: Po' Boy Sandwich
recipes.description: Creole lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat shrimp dry and set aside.
Mix flour, cornmeal, cayenne, paprika, salt, and black pepper in a shallow bowl.
Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F.
Coat shrimp in the flour mixture and carefully place in hot oil in batches.
Fry shrimp for 2-3 minutes until golden, then transfer to paper towels to drain.
Slice French bread lengthwise and spread mayonnaise on both halves.
Layer lettuce and tomato on the bottom half, then top with fried shrimp.
Close the sandwich and cut in half to serve.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp at a fraction of fresh shrimp cost.
Skip the deep fryer and shallow-fry in a skillet with less oil.

recipes.name: Beignets
recipes.description: Creole breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Combine vanilla extract and milk in a separate bowl.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until a soft dough forms.
Heat oil to 375°F in a deep pot or Dutch oven.
Drop heaping teaspoons of dough into hot oil, frying 3-4 beignets at a time for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer fried beignets to paper towels to drain.
Dust warm beignets generously with powdered sugar and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Reuse frying oil by straining and storing it for later use.
Buy powdered sugar in bulk bins to save money.

recipes.name: Crawfish Pie
recipes.description: Cajun dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Melt butter in a pot and whisk in flour to make a roux, stirring constantly for 3 minutes until light brown.
Add diced onion, celery, bell pepper, and garlic to the roux, cooking for 5 minutes until vegetables soften.
Pour in chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well to remove lumps.
Add crawfish tails, Cajun seasoning, and thyme, simmering for 10 minutes.
Place one pie crust in a 9-inch pie dish and fill with crawfish mixture.
Top with second pie crust, seal edges, and brush with beaten egg yolk.
Bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes until crust is golden brown and filling bubbles at the edges.
cheapTips: Substitute frozen crawfish when fresh is unavailable and expensive.
Use frozen pie crusts to save significant time and cost.

recipes.name: Blackened Chicken
recipes.description: Cajun dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breasts to 0.75 inch thickness using a meat mallet.
Combine paprika, cayenne, oregano, basil, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt in a bowl.
Coat both sides of chicken breasts thoroughly with the spice mixture.
Heat butter in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until just smoking.
Place chicken in the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes without moving until a dark crust forms.
Flip chicken and cook the other side for 3-4 minutes until cooked through and blackened.
Transfer to a plate and serve immediately with rice or vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and pound and freeze them flat for convenience.
Make a large batch of the spice mix and store in an airtight container.

recipes.name: Seafood Gumbo
recipes.description: Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown sliced sausage in a large pot, then remove and set aside.
Melt butter in the pot and whisk in flour to make a dark roux, stirring constantly for 8-10 minutes until chocolate brown.
Add diced onion, celery, bell pepper, and garlic, cooking for 5 minutes until softened.
Pour in chicken broth slowly while stirring to avoid lumps.
Add sausage, Cajun seasoning, bay leaves, and thyme, simmering for 30 minutes.
Add okra and simmer for 10 minutes until tender.
Stir in shrimp and crabmeat, cooking for 5 minutes until shrimp turns pink.
Remove from heat and stir in file powder.
Serve over rice in deep bowls.
cheapTips: Use frozen okra and shrimp instead of fresh to cut costs significantly.
Buy a whole chicken, butcher it yourself, and use the meat and broth in the gumbo.

recipes.name: Boudin
recipes.description: Cajun lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil the pork liver in chicken broth for 15 minutes until cooked through, then chop finely.
Sauté the diced onion, celery, bell pepper, and garlic in a large pot over medium heat for 5 minutes until softened.
Add ground pork to the pot and cook for 8 minutes, breaking it apart as it browns.
Stir in the chopped liver, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly, then stuff the mixture into pork casings using a sausage stuffer.
Grill the boudin over medium-high heat for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally until browned and heated through.
Serve hot with crackers or on a bun.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder and grind it yourself instead of pre-ground pork.
Use natural casings from a butcher counter instead of synthetic ones.

recipes.name: Crawfish Pasta
recipes.description: Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the diced onion and garlic for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the crawfish tail meat and cook for 2 minutes, stirring gently to warm through.
Pour in the heavy cream and chicken broth, then stir in the cayenne pepper and season with salt and black pepper.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss gently to coat with the sauce.
Remove from heat and stir in most of the green onions and parmesan cheese, reserving some for garnish.
Serve hot, topped with remaining green onions and parmesan cheese.
cheapTips: Use frozen crawfish tails instead of fresh for significant savings.
Substitute heavy cream with half-and-half or milk mixed with a bit of cornstarch.

recipes.name: Alligator Gumbo
recipes.description: Cajun dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the alligator meat in batches, then set aside.
In the same pot, whisk together the remaining oil and flour to make a roux, stirring constantly for 15-20 minutes until it reaches a deep chocolate brown color.
Add the diced onion, celery, bell pepper, and garlic to the roux and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour in the chicken broth slowly while stirring to combine, then add the browned alligator meat back to the pot.
Add bay leaves and cayenne pepper, then bring to a boil and reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the alligator is very tender.
Add the sliced okra and simmer for an additional 10 minutes until the okra is tender.
Remove from heat and stir in the filé powder, then serve over rice.
cheapTips: Substitute alligator with chicken or andouille sausage if alligator is unavailable.
Make your own stock from chicken bones instead of buying broth.

recipes.name: Blackened Salmon
recipes.description: Cajun dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix together paprika, cayenne pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, dried thyme, black pepper, and salt in a small bowl.
Pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels and coat both sides generously with the spice mixture.
Heat butter in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until it just begins to smoke.
Carefully place the salmon fillets in the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on the first side without moving them.
Flip the fillets and cook for another 3-4 minutes on the second side until the skin is charred and the flesh is opaque.
Transfer the salmon to a serving plate and serve immediately with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy salmon fillets on sale and freeze them for later use.
Use olive oil instead of butter to reduce cost and create the same blackening effect.

recipes.name: Crayfish Bisque
recipes.description: Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Shell the crayfish, reserving the tails and shells separately.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large pot over medium heat and cook the crayfish shells for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the diced onion, celery, and garlic, then sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then pour in the chicken broth and add the bay leaf.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes to infuse the broth with crayfish flavor.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve, discarding the shells and vegetables.
In the same pot, melt the remaining 3 tbsp butter and whisk in the flour to make a roux, cooking for 2 minutes.
Slowly add the strained broth while whisking to avoid lumps, then add the crayfish tails, heavy cream, and cayenne pepper.
Simmer for 10 minutes until the tails are heated through and the bisque thickens, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Use frozen crayfish tails with shells to make stock, then buy cheaper frozen tail meat separately.
Substitute heavy cream with evaporated milk for a similar richness at lower cost.

recipes.name: Pain Perdu
recipes.description: Creole breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together eggs, milk, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and nutmeg in a shallow bowl.
Heat 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, coating both sides thoroughly but not soaking too long.
Place the coated bread slices in the hot skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on the first side until golden brown.
Flip the bread and cook for another 2-3 minutes on the second side until golden.
Transfer the cooked pain perdu to a serving plate and repeat with remaining butter and bread slices.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve hot with warm maple syrup.
cheapTips: Use day-old French bread from a bakery discount section.
Make your own powdered sugar by blending granulated sugar with cornstarch.

recipes.name: Oysters Rockefeller
recipes.description: Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F and spread rock salt on a baking sheet to create a bed for the oysters.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the spinach, parsley, green onions, and garlic for 3 minutes until wilted.
Remove from heat and stir in the breadcrumbs and parmesan cheese, then let cool slightly.
Arrange the oyster shells on the rock salt bed, then top each oyster with about 1 tbsp of the spinach mixture.
Dot each oyster with a small amount of remaining butter.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until the topping is golden brown and the oysters are heated through.
Serve hot directly on the rock salt with lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy oysters from a fish counter and ask them to shuck them on the half shell.
Use frozen spinach instead of fresh to save money and reduce prep time.

recipes.name: Crawfish Étouffée
recipes.description: Cajun dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 4 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the diced onion, celery, and bell pepper for 5 minutes until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant, then stir in the tomato sauce and cayenne pepper.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer, then cook uncovered for 15 minutes to reduce slightly.
Add the crawfish tail meat and remaining 2 tbsp butter, stirring gently to combine.
Simmer for 5 minutes until the crawfish is heated through and the flavors are blended.
Stir in most of the green onions and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over cooked rice, garnished with remaining green onions.
cheapTips: Use frozen crawfish tails instead of fresh for significant savings.
Cook rice in bulk and freeze in portions for quick weeknight dinners.

recipes.name: Blackened Redfish
recipes.description: Cajun dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix together paprika, cayenne pepper, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, dried oregano, and salt in a small bowl.
Pat the redfish fillets dry with paper towels and coat both sides generously with the spice mixture.
Heat butter in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until it just begins to smoke.
Place the redfish fillets in the skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes on the first side without moving them.
Flip the fillets and cook for another 3-4 minutes on the second side until the skin is charred and the flesh flakes easily.
Transfer the redfish to a serving plate and serve immediately with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Substitute redfish with any firm white fish like cod or tilapia for savings.
Make your own spice blend instead of buying pre-made Cajun seasoning.

recipes.name: Okra Gumbo
recipes.description: Cajun dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat and whisk in the flour, stirring constantly for 20-25 minutes until the roux reaches a deep chocolate brown color.
Add the diced onion, celery, bell pepper, and garlic to the roux and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour in the chicken broth slowly while stirring to prevent lumps from forming.
Add the bay leaves and cayenne pepper, then bring to a boil and reduce heat to low.
Brown the andouille sausage slices in a separate skillet, then add to the gumbo.
Simmer the gumbo for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the sliced okra and simmer for another 15-20 minutes until the okra is tender and the gumbo has thickened.
Remove the bay leaves and serve the gumbo over cooked rice.
cheapTips: Use frozen okra instead of fresh to save money and skip prep time.
Make your own chicken stock from bones for a fraction of the cost of broth.

recipes.name: Scotch Pie
recipes.description: Scottish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pastry by cutting cold butter into flour and salt until breadcrumb texture, then add water gradually until dough forms; chill 30 minutes.
Brown ground lamb with diced onion in a skillet, season with salt and pepper, then add beef broth and simmer 10 minutes.
Divide dough in half and roll out on floured surface to fit a 4-inch pie tin and its lid.
Fill pastry-lined tin with lamb mixture, top with pastry lid, seal edges with a fork, brush with beaten egg, and cut small steam vents.
Bake at 400°F for 35-40 minutes until golden brown.
Cool 5 minutes before removing from tin and serving warm.
cheapTips: Buy ground lamb when on sale and freeze; use ground beef as cheaper substitute
Make multiple pies at once to maximize oven use

recipes.name: Haggis, Neeps and Tatties
recipes.description: Scottish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil cubed rutabaga in salted water for 15 minutes until fork-tender.
In separate pot, boil cubed potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Drain rutabaga and potatoes separately, then mash each with 1.5 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp milk.
Season rutabaga mash with salt, pepper, and nutmeg; season potato mash with salt and pepper.
Heat haggis according to package directions (usually 15 minutes in boiling water or 8 minutes in microwave).
Arrange mashed rutabaga and potatoes on plates with haggis in the center and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Canned haggis is significantly cheaper than fresh and readily available at most grocery stores
Buy potatoes and rutabaga in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Welsh Rarebit
recipes.description: Welsh lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat, then whisk in flour to create a roux and cook 1 minute.
Slowly add beer while whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Add shredded cheddar cheese, Worcestershire sauce, mustard powder, salt, and pepper; stir until cheese melts completely.
Toast bread slices until golden brown on both sides.
Place tomato slice on each toast piece and top generously with cheese sauce.
Broil for 2-3 minutes until sauce is bubbly and lightly browned on top, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand sharp cheddar instead of premium brands
Substitute beer with water or milk if budget is tight, though flavor will differ

recipes.name: Colcannon
recipes.description: Irish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil quartered potatoes in salted water for 15-18 minutes until very tender.
In a separate pot, cook shredded cabbage in 2 tbsp butter over medium heat until softened, about 8 minutes.
Drain potatoes thoroughly and mash with remaining 2 tbsp butter and milk until smooth.
Fold cooked cabbage and chopped scallions into mashed potatoes.
Season generously with salt and black pepper.
Serve hot, optionally making a well in the center and adding a pat of butter for richness.
cheapTips: Potatoes and cabbage are year-round budget vegetables
Make large batches and reheat; leftovers keep 3-4 days refrigerated

recipes.name: Boxty
recipes.description: Irish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Grate raw potatoes and squeeze excess moisture out using a clean kitchen towel or cheesecloth.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk together beaten eggs and milk, then add grated potatoes.
Fold wet ingredients into flour mixture until just combined; batter will be thick.
Heat butter on a griddle or large skillet over medium-high heat until foaming.
Drop 3-inch diameter portions of batter onto griddle and flatten slightly with spatula; cook 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Serve hot with butter, jam, or sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk; grate and freeze extras for quick future batches
Use basic flour and baking powder; premium brands unnecessary

recipes.name: Soda Bread
recipes.description: Irish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and lightly flour a baking sheet.
Mix flour, baking soda, salt, and caraway seeds (if using) in a large bowl.
Add buttermilk and fold gently with a spatula until shaggy dough forms; fold in raisins if desired.
Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a round loaf, and place on prepared baking sheet.
Cut a deep X into the top of the loaf with a sharp knife.
Bake 35-40 minutes until golden brown and hollow-sounding when tapped on bottom.
Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing.
cheapTips: Buttermilk can substitute with milk plus 1 tbsp vinegar; let sit 5 minutes
Skip caraway seeds and raisins to reduce cost further

recipes.name: Mushy Peas
recipes.description: British lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add finely diced onion and cook 3-4 minutes until softened, stirring occasionally.
Add frozen peas and vegetable broth, bring to simmer.
Cook 8-10 minutes until peas are very tender and broth is mostly absorbed.
Mash peas with a potato masher until mostly smooth but retaining some texture.
Stir in mint, salt, and black pepper, then adjust seasonings to taste.
Serve warm as a side dish or part of a traditional British meal.
cheapTips: Frozen peas are cheaper than fresh and store indefinitely
Buy store-brand frozen peas; quality is identical to premium brands

recipes.name: Pie and Mash
recipes.description: British lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pastry by cutting cold butter into flour and salt until breadcrumb texture, add water gradually, form dough, and chill 30 minutes.
Brown ground beef and diced onion in skillet, drain fat, add beef broth, simmer 15 minutes, season with salt and pepper, and cool.
Boil potatoes in salted water 15-18 minutes until tender, then mash with 2 tbsp butter and milk.
Roll out pastry, line a 9-inch pie dish, fill with beef mixture, top with pastry, seal edges, and cut steam vents.
Bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes until crust is golden brown.
Cool 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve pie alongside creamy mashed potatoes.
cheapTips: Use 80/20 ground beef; fattier meat has more flavor and is cheaper
Make double batch of pastry and freeze for future use

recipes.name: Steak and Kidney Pudding
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make suet pastry by mixing flour and salt, grating in cold suet, adding water gradually until dough forms; chill 20 minutes.
Dust beef stew meat and diced kidney with flour seasoned with salt and pepper.
Roll out two-thirds of pastry and line a buttered pudding basin, leaving overhang.
Fill basin with beef, kidney, onion, and thyme, then pour in beef broth until nearly full.
Roll out remaining pastry for lid, place over filling, seal edges firmly by pressing pastry together.
Cover pudding with buttered parchment and foil, tie securely with string.
Place pudding basin in pot of simmering water (water level reaches halfway up basin sides) and steam 2.5-3 hours, adding water as needed.
Carefully remove pudding from steamer, let rest 5 minutes, then invert onto plate to unmold.
Serve hot with the rich gravy from inside.
cheapTips: Buy beef kidney at ethnic or specialty butchers for lower cost than chain stores
Use rendered pork fat (lard) instead of suet for lower cost

recipes.name: Laverbread
recipes.description: Welsh breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon slices in a large skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, then remove and drain on paper towels.
Pour off most bacon fat, leaving about 2 tbsp in the skillet.
Mix canned laverbread with oatmeal, salt, pepper, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Form laverbread mixture into 8 patties and place in the skillet with bacon fat.
Cook patties over medium heat 3-4 minutes per side until lightly crispy on edges.
Serve hot laverbread cakes alongside crispy bacon for a traditional Welsh breakfast.
cheapTips: Canned laverbread is surprisingly affordable at specialty or online retailers
Buy bacon on sale and freeze for breakfast cooking

recipes.name: Plantain Chips
recipes.description: West African snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel plantains by cutting off ends and slicing skin lengthwise, then remove flesh.
Slice plantains into thin rounds about ¼ inch thick using a knife or mandoline.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Fry plantain slices in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Season immediately with salt and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy plantains when on sale and store in pantry for weeks
Reuse frying oil several times if strained properly

recipes.name: Jollof Paella
recipes.description: Ghanaian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large paella pan or deep skillet over medium heat.
Dice onion, bell peppers, and garlic, then sauté for 3 minutes until softened.
Add minced scotch bonnet pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in rice and toast for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, and broth, stirring well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes without stirring.
Remove from heat, let rest 5 minutes covered, then fluff with a fork.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh for lower cost year-round
Buy rice in bulk bins for significant savings

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Soup
recipes.description: Sierra Leonean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube sweet potatoes and carrots into 1-inch pieces.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic for 3 minutes.
Add sweet potatoes and carrots, cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in broth and canned tomatoes with juice, bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables soften.
In a bowl, whisk peanut butter with 1 cup of warm broth until smooth, then stir into pot.
Add spinach and simmer for 5 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt and red pepper flakes and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use store-brand peanut butter to reduce cost
Buy seasonal carrots and sweet potatoes at farmer's markets

recipes.name: Banku
recipes.description: Ghanaian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil in a large pot with salt.
In a bowl, mix cornmeal with cassava flour and ½ cup cold water to form a smooth paste without lumps.
Slowly pour the cornmeal mixture into boiling water while stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat to medium-low and stir continuously for 15-20 minutes as mixture thickens.
Add butter and milk, stirring well until smooth and creamy.
Continue cooking for 3 more minutes until banku reaches a smooth, dough-like consistency.
Divide into 3 portions, shape into mounds, and serve hot with grilled fish or soup.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal and cassava flour in bulk from international markets
Use evaporated milk instead of whole milk if budget is tight

recipes.name: Waakye
recipes.description: Ghanaian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse dried black-eyed peas and soak in water for 30 minutes, then drain.
Rinse brown rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion, garlic, and ginger for 2 minutes.
Add drained peas and rice, stir for 1 minute.
Pour in 6 cups water and add bay leaves.
Bring to boil, then reduce to low heat, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes.
Check that water is absorbed and both rice and peas are tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot, optionally with fried plantains or tomato sauce.
cheapTips: Buy black-eyed peas dried in bulk for 50% savings vs canned
Brown rice costs less than white rice in most stores

recipes.name: Groundnut Soup
recipes.description: West African dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown meat on all sides over medium-high heat, then set aside.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic in the same pot for 2 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in broth and return meat to pot, bring to boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes.
Grind or blend roasted peanuts into a coarse paste, then stir into soup.
Add diced carrots and potatoes, simmer for 15 more minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and cayenne pepper and serve over rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for cheaper protein
Buy bulk peanuts and roast yourself instead of pre-roasted

recipes.name: Macaroni Pie
recipes.description: Ghanaian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Cook macaroni according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté minced onion for 2 minutes.
Whisk in flour to form a paste and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually pour in milk while whisking to create a smooth sauce, cook for 5 minutes until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in shredded cheese, salt, pepper, and nutmeg until smooth.
Pour cheese sauce over cooked macaroni and toss well, then transfer to baking dish.
Mix breadcrumbs with beaten egg and sprinkle over top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbling, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cheddar and macaroni to cut costs significantly
Buy cheese in block form and shred yourself instead of pre-shredded

recipes.name: Kontomire Stew
recipes.description: Ghanaian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown meat pieces on all sides over medium-high heat, set aside.
Sauté diced onion, garlic, and ginger in the same pot for 3 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Return meat to pot and add canned tomatoes with juice, bring to boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until meat is tender.
Wash and roughly chop kontomire leaves, discarding tough stems.
Stir in coconut milk and chopped greens, simmer uncovered for 10 more minutes.
Season with salt and red pepper flakes and serve with rice or fufu.
cheapTips: Substitute collard greens or spinach if kontomire is unavailable
Buy meat on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Cassava Leaves
recipes.description: West African dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thoroughly wash cassava leaves and remove from stems, discarding tough parts.
Finely mince or pound the cassava leaves until very fine (traditionally done in mortar).
Heat oil in a large pot and brown ground meat over medium-high heat, breaking into small pieces.
Add diced onion, garlic, and ginger, sauté for 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add water and bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in minced cassava leaves and coconut milk, cover and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and cayenne pepper and serve with rice, plantains, or cassava root.
cheapTips: If cassava leaves unavailable, substitute spinach or collard greens
Buy ground meat in bulk and divide into portions to freeze

recipes.name: Beans and Plantain
recipes.description: Nigerian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel plantains by cutting ends and slicing skin lengthwise, then cut flesh into 2-inch chunks.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic for 2 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in canned tomatoes with juice and water, bring to boil.
Add drained canned beans and plantain chunks.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until plantains are tender.
Season with salt and red pepper flakes.
Serve hot, either as is or over rice.
cheapTips: Use canned beans instead of dried to save time and cost
Buy plantains when ripe and discounted at the end of day

recipes.name: Seafood Jambalaya
recipes.description: Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the sliced sausage for 3 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Add onion, bell pepper, and celery to the pot and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic and cajun seasoning, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes to lightly toast it.
Pour in chicken broth and crushed tomatoes, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20 minutes, then stir in the sausage, shrimp, and crab meat.
Cover and cook for another 5 minutes until shrimp is pink and rice is tender.
Remove from heat, let stand 5 minutes covered, then fluff and serve.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp and crab meat to save 20-30%
Substitute half the seafood with diced chicken if budget is tight

recipes.name: Andouille Sausage Po' Boy
recipes.description: Cajun lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice the andouille sausages lengthwise and place cut-side down in the skillet, cooking for 4 minutes per side until browned.
Toast the po' boy rolls lightly in the skillet for 1 minute per side.
Spread mayonnaise on the inside of each roll.
Layer lettuce, tomato, and onion on the bottom half of each roll.
Place the cooked sausage halves on top of the vegetables.
Add pickles and a drizzle of hot sauce.
Close the sandwich and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy sausage at warehouse clubs for bulk savings
Use regular sandwich rolls if po' boy rolls unavailable

recipes.name: Fish and Chips
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a deep fryer or large pot to 350°F and fry potato wedges for 8-10 minutes until golden, drain on paper towels.
Increase oil temperature to 375°F.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Whisk together beer and egg, then combine with dry ingredients until a thick batter forms.
Pat fish fillets dry with paper towels.
Dip each fillet into the batter, coating completely, and carefully place into hot oil.
Fry for 6-8 minutes until golden brown and fish flakes easily with a fork.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels, then season lightly with salt and serve with fries, lemon wedges, and malt vinegar.
cheapTips: Use frozen cod fillets to reduce cost by 30%
Reuse frying oil multiple times by straining and storing properly

recipes.name: Bangers and Mash
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until fork-tender, then drain and mash with 2 tablespoons butter and warm milk until creamy.
While potatoes cook, heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown sausages on all sides for 10 minutes, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add remaining butter and cook sliced onions over medium heat for 8 minutes until caramelized.
Stir tomato paste into onions and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth to the skillet, scraping up any browned bits.
Return sausages to the skillet and simmer for 5 minutes.
Divide mashed potatoes among plates and top with 2 sausages each.
Spoon onion gravy over the sausages and potatoes and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy sausages on sale and freeze for later
Use chicken broth instead of beef to save 15%

recipes.name: Cornish Pasty
recipes.description: British lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs.
Add ice water a tablespoon at a time, stirring until dough just comes together, then form into a disk and refrigerate 30 minutes.
Combine diced beef, potato, rutabaga, onion, pepper, and salt in a bowl.
Divide dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a 7-inch circle on floured parchment.
Place a quarter of the filling on one half of each dough circle, leaving a 1-inch border.
Fold dough over to create a half-moon, press edges, crimp with a fork, and brush with beaten egg.
Place pasties on a baking sheet and bake at 400°F for 35-40 minutes until golden brown.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze up to 3 months ahead
Use store-bought puff pastry to cut prep time in half

recipes.name: Cottage Pie
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, drain and mash with butter and milk.
Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks for 5 minutes, then drain excess fat.
Add onion, carrot, and celery to the beef and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic and tomato paste, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add beef broth and simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in frozen peas and season with salt and pepper.
Transfer beef mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and spread evenly.
Spread mashed potatoes over the beef layer, creating a rough top with a fork.
Bake at 375°F for 15-20 minutes until the top is lightly golden, then rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use 80/20 ground beef instead of leaner cuts to save 20%
Buy frozen peas in bulk for consistent pricing

recipes.name: Steak and Ale Pie
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss beef cubes with flour, salt, and pepper, then brown in batches in hot oil in a large pot over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per batch, set aside.
Add onion and carrot to the pot and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then deglaze with ale, scraping up browned bits.
Return beef to the pot, add broth, potatoes, and thyme, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes until beef is tender.
Transfer filling to a 9-inch pie dish and let cool for 10 minutes.
Cover with puff pastry sheet, seal edges by pressing with a fork, brush with beaten egg, and cut a small slit in the center.
Bake at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until pastry is golden brown, then rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Substitute beer with extra beef broth and 1 tablespoon soy sauce to save $2
Use frozen puff pastry which is cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Cullen Skink
recipes.description: Scottish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place haddock fillets in a skillet with milk, bay leaf, and thyme, bring to a simmer, and poach for 6 minutes until fish flakes easily.
Remove fish from milk, discard skin and bones, flake the meat, and reserve the poaching milk.
In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat and cook diced onion for 4 minutes until softened.
Add potatoes and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour the reserved poaching milk into the pot with potatoes and onion.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are very tender.
Stir in flaked haddock and heavy cream, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 2 minutes.
Serve hot in bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy smoked haddock frozen to save 25-30%
Substitute half the milk with vegetable broth to reduce dairy cost

recipes.name: Bubble and Squeak
recipes.description: British lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook diced onion for 2 minutes until softened.
Add shredded cabbage and cook for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender and begins to brown.
In a bowl, combine mashed potatoes with the cooked cabbage mixture, season with salt and pepper, and stir until well combined.
Heat oil and remaining butter in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Form potato-cabbage mixture into 4 patties and place in the hot skillet.
Fry for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels and serve hot with fried or poached eggs and beans.
cheapTips: Use leftover mashed potatoes and cabbage to minimize waste
Skip the eggs to reduce cost by 50 cents per serving

recipes.name: Coronation Chicken
recipes.description: British lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, yogurt, curry powder, mango chutney, and lime juice, stirring until smooth.
Fold in shredded chicken, chopped apricots, and almonds until evenly coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Divide lettuce leaves among serving plates as a base.
Spoon coronation chicken mixture onto the lettuce.
Garnish with additional almonds and serve with lemon wedges and crusty bread or on a bed of rice.
cheapTips: Buy rotisserie chicken on sale or discount near closing time
Omit almonds and use crushed peanuts to save 40%

recipes.name: Miyan Taushe
recipes.description: Nigerian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the ground meat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add diced onion, garlic, and ginger to the meat and sauté for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes to deepen the flavor.
Add the cubed pumpkin and pour in water or beef stock.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until pumpkin is very tender.
Crumble in Maggi cubes and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot as a stew with rice, cassava, or fufu.
cheapTips: Buy pumpkin in season or use canned pumpkin puree to reduce cost
Use ground beef from budget cuts like chuck instead of premium grades

recipes.name: Gari and Soup
recipes.description: West African dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 6 cups of water to a boil in a large pot and add salt.
Slowly sprinkle gari into boiling water while stirring constantly to prevent lumps from forming.
Reduce heat to low and stir frequently for 20-25 minutes until the mixture is smooth and thick.
In another pot, heat butter and brown the ground beef with onions and garlic.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add diced carrots and crumbled Maggi cubes.
Pour in 2 cups of water and simmer for 15 minutes until carrots soften.
Stir in spinach and cook for 3-5 minutes until wilted.
Serve the gari mound on a plate with soup spooned over and around it.
cheapTips: Buy gari in bulk from African markets for significant savings
Use frozen spinach instead of fresh to reduce cost and prevent waste

recipes.name: Garri
recipes.description: Nigerian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a pot with salt.
Slowly pour gari into the boiling water while stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Add butter and sugar to the mixture and stir well.
Continue stirring over medium heat for 8-10 minutes until the mixture thickens and becomes smooth.
Sprinkle nutmeg or cinnamon on top for flavor.
Pour into a bowl or cup and serve warm, either as a thick porridge or drinkable consistency depending on preference.
cheapTips: Gari is one of the cheapest African staples available
Use palm oil instead of butter for an even lower cost and more authentic taste

recipes.name: Boiled Corn and Beans
recipes.description: West African snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse the dried black-eyed peas thoroughly under cold water and pick through for any debris.
Add peas to a large pot with 8 cups of water, quartered onion, garlic, and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 45-50 minutes until peas are tender.
Add corn kernels and salt to the pot.
Continue simmering for 10-15 minutes until corn is cooked through.
Drain off excess water if desired and serve warm or at room temperature as a snack.
cheapTips: Buy dried beans in bulk from stores with good African or Latin sections
Use frozen corn which is often cheaper than fresh and lasts longer

recipes.name: Red Red
recipes.description: Ghanaian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried beans for 4 hours or overnight, then drain and rinse thoroughly.
Heat palm oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onions, garlic, and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add beans and pour in 6 cups of water, bring to a boil then reduce heat to simmer.
Add whole scotch bonnet pepper and Maggi cubes, simmering for 45-50 minutes until beans are very soft.
Gently crack eggs one by one into the simmering sauce, poaching them until whites are set.
Season with salt and pepper, remove whole pepper if desired, and serve with bread, fried plantains, or cassava.
cheapTips: Buy beans in bulk from bulk bins or African markets
Palm oil is cheaper in West African markets than mainstream grocery stores

recipes.name: Fufu and Abenkwan
recipes.description: Ghanaian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil cubed plantains and cassava in salted water for 20-25 minutes until very soft.
In a mortar and pestle or food processor, pound or blend the boiled plantains and cassava into a smooth fufu, moistening with small amounts of water as needed.
Brown ground beef in oil with onions and garlic, breaking meat apart as it cooks.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then pour in 5 cups water and add bay leaves.
Stir in peanut butter until dissolved, then add coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Season the soup with salt and pepper, simmering for 15-20 minutes.
Form fufu into balls or mounds and serve in bowls topped with the hot peanut and meat soup.
cheapTips: Make fufu with just plantains if cassava is unavailable
Buy bulk peanut butter from discount grocers to reduce soup cost

recipes.name: Kelewele
recipes.description: Ghanaian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 4 green, peeled and cut into thick diago

steps: Combine minced ginger, garlic, scotch bonnet pepper, onion, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl to create the spice mixture.
Coat each plantain slice thoroughly with the spice mixture, pressing gently so it adheres.
Heat oil in a deep pan or pot to 350°F, or until a small piece of plantain sizzles immediately when dropped in.
Carefully place spiced plantain slices into hot oil in small batches, being careful not to crowd the pan.
Fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot as a snack or appetizer, optionally with lime wedges or hot pepper sauce.
cheapTips: Buy plantains when they are on sale and freeze for later use
Reuse cooking oil after straining to reduce cost per batch

recipes.name: Tahdig
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak saffron threads in 0.25 cup hot water for 10 minutes to bloom and release color.
Rinse basmati rice thoroughly under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring 4 cups water to a boil and add salt and rinsed rice, boiling for 8-10 minutes until rice is partially cooked.
Drain rice thoroughly in a colander.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a non-stick pot and layer potato slices on the bottom.
Mix yogurt with 0.5 cup of the partially cooked rice and spread over potatoes.
Layer remaining rice on top in a pyramid shape, then sprinkle saffron water over the rice.
Dot with remaining 2 tablespoons butter, cover pot with foil then place lid on top, and cook on medium heat for 20 minutes until a golden crust forms on the bottom.
Serve with crispy tahdig rice crust on top and bottom of the mound.
cheapTips: Use regular long-grain white rice if basmati is too expensive
Omit saffron or use turmeric for color if saffron is unavailable

recipes.name: Chelo Kebab Koobideh
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground meat with minced onion, parsley, mint, garlic, salt, and pepper in a bowl and mix thoroughly.
Divide mixture into 8 equal portions and mold each around a metal skewer, forming long cylindrical kebabs.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and brush grates with oil.
Grill kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning frequently to ensure even cooking and browning on all sides.
Grill tomato halves alongside kebabs until softened, about 8-10 minutes.
Prepare chelo (Persian rice) by cooking basmati rice and fluffing with melted butter and saffron.
Arrange rice on a platter, place hot kebabs on top, and serve with grilled tomato and onion slices.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat in bulk when on sale and freeze individual portions
Skip fresh herbs and use dried parsley and mint if budget is tight

recipes.name: Chelo Kebab Shami
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground beef, lamb, mashed chickpeas, 2 minced onions, parsley, cilantro, salt, pepper, turmeric, and egg in a large bowl.
Mix thoroughly until the mixture holds together and is evenly combined.
Divide into 8 equal portions and mold each into a flat oval patty about 0.5 inch thick.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and pan-fry patties for 4-5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
In the last minute of cooking, add remaining minced raw onion to the pan for freshness.
Serve kebab shami patties over fluffy Persian rice with grilled tomato and lemon wedges.
Optionally wrap in lavash bread with onion and herbs for a handheld meal.
cheapTips: Use canned chickpeas instead of dried to save time and money
Mix beef and lamb at a 3:1 ratio to reduce lamb cost while maintaining flavor

recipes.name: BBQ Ribs
recipes.description: Pacific Islander dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs and pat them dry with paper towels.
Mix brown sugar, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl, then rub all over the ribs.
Place ribs on a baking sheet lined with foil and bake at 250°F for 2 hours covered with foil.
Combine ketchup, vinegar, and soy sauce in a small saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes.
Brush the BBQ sauce over the ribs and bake uncovered for 30 more minutes at 350°F.
Let the ribs rest for 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy ribs on sale and freeze; spare ribs are cheaper than baby back ribs
Make your own BBQ sauce instead of buying bottled

recipes.name: Coconut Crab
recipes.description: Pacific Islander dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat coconut oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Add crab meat, fish sauce, and diced chili pepper, stirring gently to combine.
Simmer the mixture for 20 minutes, allowing flavors to meld without boiling.
Squeeze fresh lime juice into the pot and taste for seasoning.
Simmer for an additional 10 minutes and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Use frozen crab meat instead of fresh to save money
Buy canned coconut milk in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Ulu Soup
recipes.description: Pacific Islander lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube the breadfruit or plantain into 1-inch pieces.
Heat a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil, then add the breadfruit cubes.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until breadfruit is tender.
Stir in coconut milk, salt, and pepper, and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Look for breadfruit at ethnic markets for better prices than specialty stores
Use vegetable broth instead of chicken broth for a vegetarian version

recipes.name: Garlic Shrimp Plate
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add shrimp, salt, and red pepper flakes, cooking for 2 minutes per side until they begin to turn pink.
Pour in white wine and squeeze lemon juice into the pan, scraping up any browned bits.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until shrimp are fully cooked and opaque.
Stir in fresh chopped parsley and serve immediately over cooked rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk and thaw before cooking to save 20-30%
Skip the wine and use additional lemon juice for a budget version

recipes.name: Mahimahi with Lemon Butter
recipes.description: Hawaiian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place mahimahi fillets on the baking sheet and brush with olive oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a small saucepan with minced garlic over low heat for 2 minutes.
Squeeze lemon juice into the butter and stir in fresh dill.
Drizzle the lemon butter sauce over each fillet and bake for 12-15 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Squeeze additional fresh lemon juice over the fish before serving.
cheapTips: Buy mahimahi when on sale and freeze for later use
Substitute with cod or tilapia for a cheaper fish option

recipes.name: Opakapaka Snapper
recipes.description: Hawaiian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix soy sauce, minced ginger, minced garlic, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Arrange snapper fillets on the baking sheet and season with salt.
Brush half the sauce over the fillets and top with sliced green onions.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Drizzle remaining sauce over the fish and serve with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Red snapper works as a good substitute and is often cheaper
Buy whole fish and have the market fillet it for a discount

recipes.name: Kalua Pork and Cabbage
recipes.description: Hawaiian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Score the fat cap of the pork shoulder in a crosshatch pattern.
Mix salt, liquid smoke, pepper, and minced garlic into a paste and rub all over the pork.
Place pork in a large roasting pan or Dutch oven and add chicken broth to the bottom.
Cover tightly with foil and roast at 325°F for 3-4 hours until meat shreds easily with a fork.
Chop the cabbage and add it to the pan with the shredded pork during the last 30 minutes of cooking.
Stir everything together and serve hot with the cooking liquid.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until ready to cook
Liquid smoke is optional; omit if unavailable and adjust salt slightly

recipes.name: Chicken Long Rice
recipes.description: Hawaiian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Soak rice noodles in warm water for 15 minutes until softened, then drain.
Heat a large pot over medium-high heat and add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute.
Add chicken pieces and cook until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and soy sauce, bringing to a boil, then add the softened noodles.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes until noodles are tender and chicken is cooked through.
Top with sliced green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Rice noodles are budget-friendly; check Asian markets for bulk pricing

recipes.name: Açai Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove açai packets from freezer and let sit for 2 minutes to slightly soften.
Blend açai with honey and coconut milk until smooth and thick, about 1-2 minutes.
Divide the açai mixture between two bowls.
Slice banana and arrange over the top along with fresh berries.
Sprinkle granola, shredded coconut, and sliced almonds over the top.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy frozen açai packets at Costco or ethnic markets for better pricing
Use frozen berries instead of fresh to save money year-round

recipes.name: Croissants
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour, sugar, and salt in a large bowl and make a well in the center.
Warm milk slightly and mix with yeast until foamy, then pour into the flour well and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead dough for 8 minutes until smooth, then cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll dough into a 12x8 inch rectangle and distribute cold butter pats over two-thirds of the dough.
Fold the dough in thirds (like a letter) and rotate 90 degrees, then roll and fold three more times over 2 hours with 30-minute chilling between each fold.
After final fold, cover and refrigerate overnight or up to 24 hours.
Roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness, cut into triangles, roll up tightly, and place on baking sheets.
Let proof for 2 hours until puffy, brush with beaten egg yolk, then bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze shaped croissants before baking for later use
Use margarine instead of butter to reduce cost, though butter makes superior croissants

recipes.name: Chelo Kebab Soltani
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground beef with minced onion, egg, salt, and pepper; let rest 30 minutes.
Divide meat mixture into four portions and mold onto flat metal skewers, pressing firmly.
Heat grill or skillet to medium-high and cook kebabs 12-15 minutes, turning every 3 minutes until cooked through.
Boil rice in salted water for 12 minutes, drain, and layer in a pot with melted butter.
Steep saffron in hot water and pour over rice, cover, and steam on low heat for 20 minutes.
Create a golden rice crust by increasing heat to medium for 5 minutes until bottom is crispy.
Serve kebabs over rice with grilled tomato slices on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk and freeze portions
Skip expensive saffron by using turmeric for color

recipes.name: Fesenjan
recipes.description: Persian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown chicken thighs on both sides, 8 minutes total; remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onions and garlic in the same pot until soft and golden, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add ground walnuts, pomegranate molasses, chicken broth, salt, and pepper; stir well.
Return chicken to the pot, cover, and simmer on low heat for 40 minutes until chicken is tender.
Adjust seasoning and simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes to reduce sauce slightly.
Serve over steamed rice with pomegranate seeds if available.
cheapTips: Make your own walnut paste by blending walnuts if store-bought is expensive
Substitute pomegranate molasses with lemon juice mixed with a touch of sugar

recipes.name: Ghormeh Sabzi
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown beef pieces in olive oil over medium-high heat, about 8 minutes; remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion in the same pot until softened, about 4 minutes.
Return beef to pot and add beef broth, salt, and pepper; bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes until beef is nearly tender.
Add fresh parsley, cilantro, dried limes (punctured with a knife), and kidney beans.
Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until herbs are wilted and flavors meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning; remove dried limes before serving over rice.
cheapTips: Buy fresh herbs in bulk and freeze portions in ice cube trays
Use canned beans instead of dried to save cooking time

recipes.name: Tahdig Tahdig
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice in salted water for 30 minutes; drain well.
Boil 4 cups salted water in a large pot and add rice; cook uncovered for 8 minutes until partially tender.
Drain rice in a colander and reserve 1 cup of the cooking water.
Mix saffron threads with hot water and let steep for 5 minutes.
Whisk together yogurt and egg yolk until smooth.
Brush 2 tbsp butter on the bottom and sides of the pot; arrange thin potato slices as a base.
Layer half the rice over potatoes, sprinkle with saffron water, add remaining rice, pour yogurt mixture over top, and dot with 2 tbsp butter.
Cover pot with foil and lid, reduce heat to low, and steam for 25 minutes until bottom forms a golden crust.
Run a knife around edges and invert onto a serving plate to reveal the golden tahdig crust.
cheapTips: Skip saffron and use turmeric for less cost
Use regular white rice instead of basmati to save money

recipes.name: Zereshk Polo ba Morgh
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper; set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp butter in a large pot and cook sliced onions until golden brown, about 7 minutes.
Push onions aside, add chicken, and brown on both sides for 5 minutes total.
Add 2 cups water, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Boil 5 cups salted water and cook rice for 10 minutes until partially tender; drain well.
Steep saffron in hot water for 5 minutes, then mix with 0.5 cup drained rice.
Layer remaining rice with barberries and saffron rice in the pot with remaining butter.
Cover tightly and steam on low heat for 25 minutes until a crust forms on bottom.
Toast almonds in a dry skillet for 2 minutes and garnish over rice and chicken.
cheapTips: Substitute barberries with dried cranberries
Buy barberries online in bulk for better pricing than specialty stores

recipes.name: Tahchin
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook diced chicken in 1 tbsp butter over medium heat until no longer pink, about 10 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Boil rice in salted water for 12 minutes until partially cooked; drain well.
Steep saffron in hot water and let sit for 5 minutes until colored.
Whisk together yogurt, eggs, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Mix cooked chicken, most of the cooked rice, saffron water, and barberries together.
Brush a round baking dish or oven-safe pot with 1 tbsp butter; press a thin layer of plain rice on the bottom and sides.
Pour chicken-rice mixture into the center and fold remaining plain rice over top.
Dot with 1 tbsp butter, cover with foil, and bake at 350°F for 35 minutes until set.
Let cool 5 minutes, run a knife around edges, and invert onto a serving plate.
cheapTips: Make with leftover chicken to save cost
Substitute barberries with raisins or dried cranberries

recipes.name: Khorovatz Mahi
recipes.description: Persian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat fish fillets dry and season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Thread fish fillets and tomato slices onto metal skewers, alternating with onion rings.
Whisk together olive oil, fresh lemon juice, minced garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Brush skewers generously with the lemon-herb mixture.
Heat grill or grill pan to medium-high and cook skewers 4-5 minutes per side until fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Serve immediately with grilled lemon wedges and extra fresh parsley on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen white fish fillets and thaw before cooking for significant savings
Use lime juice instead of lemon if cheaper at your store

recipes.name: Ash Reshteh
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse dried split peas and add to a large pot with 6 cups vegetable broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until peas are partially soft.
Heat olive oil in a separate skillet and sauté diced onion until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add sautéed onion to the pot along with kidney beans, parsley, dill, and spinach.
Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until peas and vegetables are tender and soup thickens.
Season with salt and pepper, and simmer 5 more minutes to meld flavors.
Serve in bowls as a thick soup, optionally drizzled with a touch of olive oil and garnished with fresh herbs.
cheapTips: Buy dried peas in bulk from ethnic markets for best pricing
Substitute fresh herbs with dried if more budget-friendly

recipes.name: Ash Adas
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse red lentils under cold water until water runs clear.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until soft and golden, about 5 minutes.
Add turmeric and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add rinsed lentils and 6 cups vegetable broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover partially, and simmer for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils break down into a thick soup.
Add salt, black pepper, and lime juice (or dried lime punctured with a knife).
Simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes to meld flavors.
Taste and adjust seasonings; remove dried lime if used, and serve garnished with fresh mint and a drizzle of olive oil.
cheapTips: Red lentils are inexpensive staples; buy in bulk
Skip lime juice and use a pinch of salt instead for lowest cost

recipes.name: Dizi
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place lamb meat in a large pot with 5 cups water and bring to a boil; skim foam and reduce heat.
Add chopped onion, potatoes, tomato paste, and turmeric; stir well.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 60 minutes until meat is very tender.
Add drained chickpeas and kidney beans, salt, and black pepper.
Continue simmering covered for 25 more minutes until beans are heated through and flavors blend.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve in deep bowls as a thick stew, traditionally mashed at the table with bread.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck instead of lamb for cheaper substitution
Buy canned beans to avoid long soaking and cooking times

recipes.name: Baghali Polo
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse basmati rice under cold water until water runs clear, then soak for 20 minutes.
Bring 4 cups of salted water to a boil in a large pot and add the drained rice.
Cook rice for 8-10 minutes until partially cooked, then drain well.
In a separate pot, melt butter over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of the cooked rice.
Layer remaining rice with dill and lima beans, then top with remaining butter.
Cover pot with foil and a lid, then cook on medium heat for 20 minutes until rice is fully cooked and a golden crust forms on the bottom.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then serve with tahdig (crispy rice) from the bottom of the pot.
cheapTips: Buy rice in bulk at ethnic markets for significant savings
Use frozen lima beans instead of fresh to reduce cost

recipes.name: Tahdig Saffron
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Steep saffron threads in hot water for 15 minutes until deeply colored.
Rinse rice thoroughly and soak for 20 minutes, then drain completely.
Bring 4 cups of salted water to boil and add rice, cooking for 8 minutes until partially cooked.
Drain rice and mix half of it with yogurt and 2 tablespoons butter in a small bowl.
Layer yogurt-rice mixture with plain rice in a pot lined with butter, then pour saffron water over top.
Dot with remaining butter, cover with foil and lid, and cook on medium heat for 25 minutes.
Serve with the golden-crispy tahdig layer from the bottom of the pot.
cheapTips: Use a smaller amount of saffron or substitute with turmeric for savings
Buy saffron from bulk sections at Middle Eastern markets

recipes.name: Khoresht-e Albaloo
recipes.description: Persian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the meat in batches until golden.
Add diced onions and cook for 5 minutes until softened and translucent.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then deglaze with broth.
Add sour cherries, salt, pepper, and cinnamon, then bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 40-45 minutes until meat is very tender.
Taste and adjust seasonings, adding more salt or cinnamon as needed.
Serve over steamed basmati rice.
cheapTips: Buy dried sour cherries in bulk or use dried cranberries as a substitute
Use chuck steak instead of lamb for lower cost

recipes.name: Tahdig ba Morgh
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak saffron in hot water for 10 minutes and rinse rice thoroughly, soaking for 20 minutes.
Season chicken pieces with salt and pepper, then brown in a pot with 2 tablespoons butter for 8 minutes per side.
Remove chicken and sauté sliced onion in the same pot until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Boil salted water and add drained rice, cooking for 8 minutes until partially tender.
Drain rice and layer it with chicken pieces in the pot, pour saffron water over top, dot with remaining butter, and cover tightly.
Cook on medium heat for 25 minutes until rice is fully cooked and a golden crust forms.
Let rest 5 minutes, then serve with crispy tahdig from the pot bottom.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze in portions
Use turmeric instead of expensive saffron for color

recipes.name: Shami Kabab
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mash cooked chickpeas in a bowl until chunky, then combine with ground meat, onion, and garlic.
Mix in chopped parsley, egg, salt, and pepper until just combined.
Form mixture into 8 oval patties, about 3 inches long and 1.5 inches thick.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry kababs for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and serve warm with rice and yogurt.
cheapTips: Use ground chicken instead of beef or lamb for lower cost
Buy canned chickpeas in bulk for significant savings

recipes.name: Kalua Pork
recipes.description: Hawaiian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat pork shoulder dry and rub generously with salt and black pepper on all sides.
Place pork in a slow cooker with water and cover.
Cook on low heat for 8 hours or high heat for 4-5 hours until meat shreds easily with a fork.
Remove pork from slow cooker and let cool slightly, then shred using two forks.
Skim excess fat from cooking liquid and mix a portion back into shredded meat for moisture.
Serve warm on plates or in rolls with pickled onions and cabbage slaw.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when on sale and freeze for later use
Cook large batches and freeze portions for easy weeknight meals

recipes.name: Laulau
recipes.description: Hawaiian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean taro leaves thoroughly under running water and remove stems, then chop coarsely.
Divide taro leaves into portions and layer on individual pieces of ti leaf or parchment paper.
Layer pork cubes, butternut squash cubes, and salt pork on the taro leaves.
Season with salt and pepper, then wrap tightly in the taro leaf package and secure with twine if needed.
Place packages seam-side down in a pot with water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 90 minutes until pork and squash are tender.
Carefully unwrap packages and serve hot with the cooking liquid spooned over top.
cheapTips: Substitute spinach or collard greens for taro leaves if unavailable
Buy pork butt on sale and prepare multiple batches for freezing

recipes.name: Loco Moco
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown ground beef with onion, breaking up meat as it cooks for 8 minutes.
Season beef with salt and pepper, then remove from skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, whisk together beef broth and cornstarch until smooth, then pour into pan.
Bring gravy to a simmer and cook for 3 minutes until thickened, then return beef to pan and keep warm.
Cook two eggs sunny-side up or over-easy in remaining butter in another skillet.
Divide cooked rice between two plates and top each with a beef patty formed from the mixture.
Top each patty with a fried egg and pour generous gravy over the entire plate.
cheapTips: Use 70/30 ground beef instead of leaner cuts for lower cost
Make rice in batches and refrigerate for quick meal prep

recipes.name: Saimin
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add minced ginger, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Season broth with soy sauce and salt to taste.
In a separate pot of salted boiling water, cook saimin noodles according to package directions, then drain well.
While noodles cook, boil eggs for 6 minutes until soft-boiled, then peel and halve.
Poach chicken cubes directly in the broth for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Divide cooked noodles among four bowls and ladle hot broth with chicken into each bowl.
