Top each bowl with fish cake slices, boiled egg halves, and chopped green onions, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use instant ramen as a budget-friendly substitute for saimin
Make homemade broth using chicken bones for significant savings

recipes.name: Plate Lunch
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, minced garlic, and ginger, then let sit for 10 minutes.
Bake chicken at 425°F for 25-30 minutes until skin is crispy and meat reaches 165°F internally.
While chicken cooks, prepare macaroni salad by mixing cooked pasta with mayonnaise until creamy.
Warm rice in a microwave or on stovetop, then divide rice between two plates along one edge.
Arrange cooked chicken thighs on each plate next to the rice.
Spoon macaroni salad onto each plate as the third portion.
Drizzle chicken lightly with soy sauce and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze in portions for weeks of easy meals
Make macaroni salad in bulk and store in the refrigerator for multiple servings

recipes.name: Tahdig ba Khoresht-e Khalaal
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion until golden, then add beef and brown on all sides.
Stir in tomato paste and turmeric, cook for 2 minutes, then add water, salt, and pepper.
Pierce dried limes with a knife and add to the pot, then simmer covered for 45 minutes until beef is tender.
Cook rice in salted boiling water for 10 minutes until partially cooked, then drain.
In a separate pot, heat butter and layer half the rice on the bottom, then add beef stew with limes, and top with remaining rice.
Cover tightly, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for 15 minutes until a golden crust forms on the bottom.
Fluff rice gently with a fork and serve, scooping the crispy tahdig onto each plate.
cheapTips: Buy dried limes in bulk at Middle Eastern markets for 50% less
Use beef chuck on sale instead of premium cuts

recipes.name: Kashk-e Bademjan
recipes.description: Persian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplants into thick rounds, salt generously, and let sit for 15 minutes to remove moisture.
Heat oil in a large skillet and fry eggplant rounds until golden brown on both sides, about 8 minutes total.
Remove eggplant and set aside, then sauté sliced onions in remaining oil until deeply caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, then return eggplant to the pan and stir gently to combine.
Arrange eggplant mixture on a serving plate, drizzle generously with kashk, and sprinkle dried mint over top.
Drizzle pomegranate molasses in a decorative pattern and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Greek yogurt mixed with a pinch of salt can substitute for kashk
Buy eggplant in summer when prices drop

recipes.name: Mirza Ghasemi
recipes.description: Persian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Char eggplants directly over a gas flame or under a broiler, turning occasionally for 15 minutes until skin is blackened and flesh is soft.
Let eggplants cool slightly, peel off blackened skin under cool running water, and chop flesh into small pieces.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté chopped garlic for 30 seconds, then add diced tomatoes and turmeric and cook for 5 minutes.
Add chopped eggplant to the pan, stir well, and cook for 3 minutes until flavors combine.
Make two wells in the mixture and crack an egg into each, then cover and cook for 4 minutes until eggs are set.
Season with salt and pepper, transfer to a plate, and serve with warm bread for scooping.
cheapTips: Use canned tomatoes if fresh are expensive
Buy eggplant from discount grocers or farmers markets

recipes.name: Khoresht-e Gheimeh
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown cubed beef on all sides, about 8 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion in the same pot until golden, stir in tomato paste and turmeric, and cook for 2 minutes.
Return beef to the pot, add water, salt, pepper, and pierced dried limes, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes until beef is nearly tender.
Drain and rinse canned kidney beans, add to the pot, and simmer uncovered for 10 more minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve over steamed basmati rice.
cheapTips: Buy canned kidney beans in bulk for discounts
Use less expensive beef chuck instead of prime cuts

recipes.name: Khoresht-e Fesenjan
recipes.description: Persian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown chicken thighs on both sides for 8 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onions in the same pot until golden, add turmeric, and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in ground walnuts and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant, then add pomegranate molasses and chicken broth.
Return chicken to the pot, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 50 minutes until chicken is very tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and additional pomegranate molasses if needed.
Serve over steamed rice and garnish with pomegranate seeds and extra walnuts.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts—they're cheaper and more flavorful
Make your own pomegranate molasses from concentrate

recipes.name: Kaleh Pacheh
recipes.description: Persian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak chickpeas and beans overnight in separate bowls of water.
Clean lamb head and legs thoroughly, blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse well.
In a large pot, bring 3 quarts of fresh water to a boil and add lamb head, legs, halved onion, turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Simmer covered for 2 hours, then drain soaked chickpeas and beans and add to the pot.
Continue simmering for another hour until meat falls from bones and legumes are very tender.
Remove meat from bones, shred finely, and return to the broth along with the cooked legumes.
Simmer for 15 more minutes to combine flavors, adjust seasoning, and serve hot in bowls with warm bread.
cheapTips: Buy lamb head and legs at ethnic butchers for 60% less than mainstream stores
Soak beans the night before to save cooking time and gas

recipes.name: Tahdig ba Ghourmeh Sabzi
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pot and brown beef chunks on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion until golden, add dried herbs and cook for 1 minute, then return beef to pot.
Add 3 cups water, salt, and pepper, then cover and simmer for 45 minutes until beef is tender.
Drain and rinse kidney beans, stir into the stew, and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook rice in salted boiling water for 10 minutes until partially cooked, then drain.
Heat butter and remaining oil in a large pot, layer rice, then stew, then top with remaining rice.
Cover tightly, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for 15 minutes until crispy tahdig forms on bottom.
cheapTips: Buy dried herbs from bulk sections instead of bottled for 70% savings
Frozen chopped herbs can replace dried if you have a freezer

recipes.name: Kabab Koobideh
recipes.description: Persian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely mince onion, garlic, and parsley, then combine with ground beef, egg, salt, pepper, and turmeric in a bowl.
Mix gently until just combined, then divide into 8 equal portions and mold each onto a metal skewer, pressing firmly.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook kababs for 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
Toast flatbread in the same skillet or over a flame for 30 seconds per side until warm and slightly charred.
Slide each kabab off the skewer onto a piece of flatbread and wrap tightly.
Serve immediately with sliced tomatoes, onions, and herbs on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk and freeze portions for later use
Use 80/20 ground beef instead of leaner cuts to save money

recipes.name: Kabab Lula
recipes.description: Persian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince onion and fresh herbs very finely, then combine with ground beef and lamb in a large bowl.
Add egg, breadcrumbs, salt, pepper, and turmeric, and mix gently until ingredients are just combined.
Divide mixture into 8 portions and mold each into an oval patty, slightly wider than a skewer.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook kababs for 10 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Toast flatbread in the skillet or over a flame for 30 seconds per side.
Place each kabab on flatbread, wrap tightly, and serve with sliced tomatoes, onions, and pickled vegetables.
cheapTips: Mix beef with ground lamb instead of using all lamb to reduce cost
Buy ground meat on sale and freeze immediately for future use

recipes.name: Lubia Polo
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pot and sauté diced onions until golden, then add ground beef and brown, breaking it into small pieces.
Stir in tomato paste and turmeric, cook for 2 minutes, then drain and rinse canned kidney beans and add to the pot.
Add salt and pepper to taste, then remove the meat and bean mixture and set aside.
In the same pot, heat remaining oil and butter, add rice and stir for 2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Pour in water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes until rice is partially cooked.
Gently fold the meat and bean mixture into the rice, cover again, and cook for 10 more minutes until rice is tender and fluffy.
Fluff gently with a fork and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use canned beans instead of dried to save time and cost

recipes.name: Spam Musubi
recipes.description: Hawaiian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice Spam into eight quarter-inch thick slices and pan-fry each slice until edges are crispy, about 2 minutes per side.
Combine soy sauce, mirin, and sugar in a small bowl, then brush the glaze onto both sides of each cooked Spam slice.
Wrap each nori sheet around a musubi mold or small plastic container, shiny side facing out.
Press half a cup of sushi rice firmly into the mold, then place a glazed Spam slice on top.
Press another half cup of rice on top of the Spam and push out using the mold.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over the top and wrap the nori around the sides if needed.
Slice each musubi in half with a sharp wet knife and serve immediately or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy Spam on sale and freeze for later use
Use regular short-grain white rice if sushi rice is expensive

recipes.name: Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, minced ginger, and minced garlic in a bowl.
Cut sushi-grade ahi tuna into half-inch cubes and toss gently with the marinade.
Let the tuna marinate for 10-15 minutes while preparing other ingredients.
Divide cooked sushi rice between two bowls.
Arrange marinated tuna on top of the rice, then add cucumber slices, avocado slices, and seaweed salad around the bowl.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and green onions over the top.
Serve immediately with extra marinade drizzled over if desired.
cheapTips: Check for sushi-grade tuna sales at Asian markets
Substitute with salmon if tuna is unavailable or too expensive

recipes.name: Ahi Tuna Poke
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, minced ginger, minced garlic, and red pepper flakes in a large bowl.
Add cubed ahi tuna and toss gently to coat evenly with the marinade.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or up to 4 hours for stronger flavor.
Remove from refrigerator and stir gently to redistribute marinade.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions just before serving.
Serve cold as an appetizer or over rice as a light meal.
cheapTips: Buy whole ahi tuna steaks and cube yourself to save money
Make ahead and refrigerate up to 2 days before serving

recipes.name: Kulolo
recipes.description: Hawaiian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and grate the taro root into a large bowl.
Mix grated taro with coconut milk, brown sugar, and salt until well combined.
Divide the mixture evenly among eight pieces of ti leaves or foil squares.
Wrap each portion tightly into a square package.
Place wrapped portions in a steamer pot with water, seam-side up.
Steam for 30-40 minutes until the taro mixture is firm and cooked through.
Remove from steamer and let cool for 5 minutes before unwrapping.
Serve warm or at room temperature as a traditional Hawaiian treat.
cheapTips: Buy taro root at Asian markets where it's fresher and cheaper
Use canned coconut milk which is more affordable than fresh

recipes.name: Haupia
recipes.description: Hawaiian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour coconut milk into a saucepan and heat over medium heat until steaming, do not boil.
In a small bowl, whisk cornstarch, sugar, salt, and water until smooth.
Slowly add the cornstarch mixture to the hot coconut milk while stirring constantly.
Continue stirring frequently for 8-10 minutes until the mixture thickens and becomes opaque.
Pour the hot mixture into an 8x8 inch baking dish and spread evenly.
Let cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours until firm.
Cut into nine squares and serve chilled or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand coconut milk to reduce costs
Make in bulk and freeze extra portions for up to one month

recipes.name: Chicken Adobo
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken pieces on all sides, about 5-7 minutes total.
Add minced garlic and sliced onion, stirring until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Pour in vinegar and soy sauce, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add bay leaves, black pepper, and water, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes until chicken is tender.
Remove lid and simmer for 5 more minutes to slightly reduce the sauce.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt, then serve hot over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor and lower cost
Buy garlic in bulk and mince at home instead of using pre-minced

recipes.name: Pancit
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook egg noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat and stir-fry minced garlic until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add chicken slices and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until cooked through, then add shrimp and cook for 2 more minutes.
Add carrots and cabbage, stir-frying for 3-4 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Add cooked noodles to the pan and toss to combine, breaking up any clumps.
Pour in soy sauce and chicken broth, tossing everything together for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Top with green onions and serve hot with lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Skip shrimp and use only chicken to reduce cost significantly
Buy pre-shredded cabbage to save prep time

recipes.name: Kinilaw
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fresh white fish into small cubes and place in a bowl.
Pour vinegar or lemon juice over the fish and toss gently to coat evenly.
Let the fish sit for 10 minutes so the acid begins to cure the fish.
Add minced ginger, minced garlic, diced red onion, and sliced green chili peppers to the fish.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir gently to combine all ingredients.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately over rice or with crackers as a refreshing appetizer.
cheapTips: Buy whole white fish and fillet at home to save 20-30%
Use fresh lime juice instead of expensive coconut vinegar

recipes.name: Bisque
recipes.description: Chamorro lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion, celery, and garlic for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes to deepen the flavor.
Add chicken broth and bay leaf, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat and add crab meat, simmering for 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream, cayenne pepper, and salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer for another 10 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally.
Remove bay leaf and serve hot in bowls, optionally garnished with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Use frozen crab meat which is much cheaper than fresh
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for later meals

recipes.name: Red Rice and Beans
recipes.description: Chamorro dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add uncooked rice and stir frequently for 2-3 minutes to lightly toast the grains.
Pour in tomato sauce, broth, salt, pepper, and bay leaf, stirring well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover tightly.
Simmer for 15 minutes, then gently stir in drained kidney beans.
Cover again and continue simmering for 5-10 more minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork before serving.
cheapTips: Buy rice in bulk at warehouse stores for significant savings
Use canned beans to save time and reduce preparation complexity

recipes.name: Congee
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse the rice under cold water until water runs clear, then drain well.
Bring chicken broth and water to a boil in a large pot.
Add rinsed rice and sliced ginger to the boiling liquid.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down into a creamy porridge.
Stir in soy sauce, sesame oil, and white pepper.
Taste and adjust salt as needed.
Ladle into bowls and top with chopped green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Use homemade broth or water with bouillon cubes to save money
Buy rice in bulk from Asian markets for significant savings

recipes.name: Bagels and Lox
recipes.description: Jewish American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Split bagels in half and toast them until golden and crispy.
Spread 2 tablespoons of cream cheese on each bagel half.
Layer 1 ounce of smoked salmon on top of each bagel half.
Arrange sliced red onion and capers over the salmon.
Sprinkle with fresh dill and season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy bagels from the day-old bakery section to save 30-50%
Use lox trimmings (cheaper than sliced) when available

recipes.name: Crêpes
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Make a well in the center and crack eggs into it, then slowly whisk in the milk while mixing to avoid lumps.
Stir in melted butter and vanilla extract until the batter is smooth.
Let the batter rest for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Heat a non-stick 8-inch skillet or crêpe pan over medium-high heat and lightly butter it.
Pour about 1/4 cup batter into the center and tilt the pan immediately in a circular motion to spread it thin and evenly.
Cook for about 1-2 minutes until the bottom is light golden, then flip and cook the other side for another 30 seconds.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
cheapTips: Make crêpes ahead and freeze them between parchment paper for quick breakfasts
Serve with fresh fruit or jam instead of expensive fillings

recipes.name: Smørrebrød
recipes.description: Danish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Lightly toast the rye bread slices until they are firm but not too crispy.
Spread a thin layer of butter on each slice, followed by a layer of cream cheese.
Layer smoked salmon on two slices and arrange thin cucumber and red onion slices over it.
Slice the hard-boiled eggs and layer them on the remaining two slices.
Sprinkle fresh dill over all the smørrebrød and season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve immediately while bread is still slightly warm.
cheapTips: Buy rye bread at discount stores or bakery day-old sections
Use eggs from bulk purchases to keep costs low

recipes.name: Khachapuri
recipes.description: Georgian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water with yeast and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour and salt in a bowl, then add yeast mixture and knead until a soft dough forms, about 8 minutes.
Let dough rise in an oiled bowl covered with a damp cloth for 20 minutes.
Divide dough into 3 equal pieces and roll each into a thin oval about 1/4 inch thick.
Mix mozzarella and feta cheese together in a bowl.
Place cheese mixture on one half of each dough oval, then fold the other half over and seal edges by pressing with a fork.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and fry each khachapuri for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Make a small indent in the center of each khachapuri, crack an egg into it, and cook covered for 2-3 minutes until the egg sets slightly.
cheapTips: Make cheese blend with equal parts mozzarella and cheddar to reduce cost
Prepare dough the night before and refrigerate to save time

recipes.name: Chikhalwali
recipes.description: Georgian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring salted water to a boil in a large pot.
Slowly whisk in cornmeal, stirring constantly to prevent lumps from forming.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring frequently, until mixture is thick and creamy.
Stir in butter and most of the shredded cheese until melted and combined.
Create three small wells in the cornmeal mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the pot and cook for 3-4 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain slightly runny.
Top with remaining cheese, black pepper, and fresh herbs if desired.
Serve hot directly from the pot or divide into bowls.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from ethnic or warehouse stores
Use any melting cheese you have on hand

recipes.name: Waffle
recipes.description: Belgian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat your waffle iron according to manufacturer's instructions.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In another bowl, beat eggs and mix in milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined; small lumps are okay.
Lightly butter the waffle iron and pour about 1/2 cup batter into the center.
Close the lid and cook according to your waffle iron's instructions, typically 3-5 minutes, until the waffle is golden brown and crispy.
Transfer finished waffles to a plate and keep warm while cooking remaining batter.
Serve hot with your choice of toppings like maple syrup, whipped cream, or fresh berries.
cheapTips: Make waffles in bulk and freeze for quick weekday breakfasts
Top with cheap syrup or cinnamon sugar instead of fresh fruit

recipes.name: Pancake
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg and mix in milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined; do not overmix as this makes tough pancakes.
Heat a griddle or large skillet over medium-high heat and lightly oil it.
Pour 1/4 cup batter onto the griddle for each pancake.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown on both sides.
Transfer cooked pancakes to a plate and keep warm while cooking remaining batter.
Serve immediately with maple syrup, butter, fresh berries, or other desired toppings.
cheapTips: Buy flour and baking powder in bulk for major savings
Serve with store-brand syrup and skip expensive toppings

recipes.name: Booza
recipes.description: Arabic breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add drained chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, cumin, and salt to a food processor.
Blend until smooth and creamy, adding water 1 tablespoon at a time if needed to reach desired consistency.
Transfer hummus to a serving bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Sprinkle paprika and fresh parsley over the top.
Warm pita bread in a skillet or directly over a flame for 30 seconds per side.
Serve hot hummus with warm pita bread for dipping, or spread onto pita and roll for a portable breakfast.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas in bulk during sales and stock up
Make large batches and refrigerate for several days of breakfasts

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix whole wheat flour with 1/2 teaspoon salt and gradually add water to form a soft dough; knead for 5 minutes.
Cover dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 15 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine mashed potatoes, minced onion, green chili, cilantro, cumin seeds, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and black pepper.
Divide dough into 3 equal parts and roll each into a thin circle about 6 inches in diameter.
Place potato filling in the center of each dough circle, bring edges together, and seal; gently flatten into a thick pancake.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and apply a small amount of ghee.
Place paratha on the skillet and cook for 2 minutes until light brown spots appear, then flip.
Apply more ghee to the second side and cook for another 2 minutes, flipping once more and cooking until golden brown and crispy.
Serve hot with yogurt, pickles, or fresh lime juice.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk and boil a large batch for the week
Use vegetable oil instead of ghee to cut costs significantly

recipes.name: Gözleme
recipes.description: Turkish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, water, and salt in a bowl until a soft dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes and let rest 20 minutes covered.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet and sauté diced onion until soft, then add chopped spinach and cook until wilted.
Remove spinach from heat and stir in crumbled feta cheese, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Divide dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into a very thin oval on a floured surface.
Spread spinach-feta filling on one half of each dough oval, fold in half, and press edges gently to seal.
Heat butter and remaining olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook each gözleme for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy, pressing gently with a spatula.
Serve hot, optionally folded into quarters, with lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Use frozen spinach if fresh is expensive; thaw and squeeze dry first
Make filling-free dough portions and freeze for later use with different fillings

recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs with Chorizo
recipes.description: Spanish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add diced chorizo, cooking for 3-4 minutes until edges crisp.
Add diced onion to the chorizo and cook for 2 minutes until softened.
Crack eggs into a bowl, whisk together with salt and pepper, then pour into the skillet.
Stir gently with a spatula, scraping from the sides to center, until eggs reach a creamy consistency after 3-4 minutes.
Remove from heat while eggs are still slightly underdone, as they will continue to cook.
Divide between two plates and garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately with warm bread.
cheapTips: Buy chorizo on sale and freeze in portions for quick weekday breakfasts
Omit the onion or use leftover diced vegetables to save money

recipes.name: Banh Mi
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss julienned carrots and daikon with rice vinegar, fish sauce, and a pinch of sugar, then let sit 10 minutes.
Slice baguette in half lengthwise and spread pâté on one side and mayonnaise on the other.
Layer sliced pork or chicken on the mayo side of the bread.
Top meat with pickled vegetables, cucumber slices, fresh cilantro, and sliced jalapeños.
Close the sandwich by pressing the two halves together gently.
Cut in half and serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken or buy pork on sale and cook it yourself
Substitute daikon with extra cucumber or cabbage if daikon is unavailable

recipes.name: Crepes
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
Create a well in the center and add eggs and half the milk, stirring until combined.
Gradually add remaining milk and melted butter, stirring until batter is smooth and thin; let rest 15 minutes.
Heat an 8-inch non-stick skillet or crepe pan over medium-high heat and lightly butter it.
Pour about 0.25 cup batter into the center and immediately tilt the pan in circular motions to spread thin.
Cook for about 1 minute until the bottom is light golden, then flip and cook the other side for 30 seconds.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
Fill each crepe with jam and fresh berries, fold into quarters, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze unfolded crepes between parchment paper for quick future breakfasts
Use seasonal berries or frozen berries instead of fresh for better prices

recipes.name: Samosas
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt together, then add 0.25 cup oil and rub with fingertips until breadcrumb texture forms.
Add water gradually while mixing until a stiff dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes and let rest 15 minutes covered.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan and add cumin seeds, then ginger-garlic paste and cook for 30 seconds.
Add diced onion and cook until golden, then add boiled potatoes, peas, garam masala, chili powder, cilantro, and lime juice.
Cook the filling for 3-4 minutes until well combined and let cool slightly.
Divide dough into 12 equal balls and roll each into a thin oval, then cut in half.
Fold each dough piece into a triangle, fill with 1 tablespoon potato mixture, and seal edges with a small dab of water.
Heat oil in a deep pan over medium heat and fry samosas in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with tamarind chutney or mint yogurt sauce.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze unbaked samosas on a baking sheet before frying, then fry directly from frozen
Buy potatoes and onions in bulk and use frozen peas to minimize costs

recipes.name: Bifanas
recipes.description: Portuguese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork loin into thin slices about 0.25 inch thick and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add minced garlic, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add pork slices and cook for 2 minutes per side until browned; season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Pour white wine or vinegar and add bay leaves, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes until sauce reduces slightly.
Toast the bread rolls lightly in a separate skillet or oven if desired.
Spoon pork and sauce generously into toasted rolls and serve immediately with hot sauce on the side if desired.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and slice thinly yourself to save 30-40% compared to pre-cut cutlets
Make a large batch of the pork marinade and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days

recipes.name: Arepas
recipes.description: Venezuelan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornmeal, salt, and warm water together in a bowl and let sit for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens.
Heat a skillet or griddle over medium heat and lightly butter or oil the surface.
Wet your hands and form about 0.25 cup of dough into a ball, then flatten into a disk about 0.5 inch thick.
Place arepas on the hot skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Remove from heat and carefully slice each arepa in half horizontally using a knife.
Fill each arepa with shredded cheese, cooked chicken, sliced avocado, tomato, and a dollop of mayonnaise.
Serve hot and enjoy immediately.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from Latin American markets for significant savings
Use rotisserie chicken to save time and cost compared to cooking chicken from scratch

recipes.name: Bao Buns
recipes.description: Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Add warm water and oil, then mix and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic; let rise in a warm place for 40 minutes until doubled.
While dough rises, cook pork in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart, until browned, then stir in hoisin sauce, soy sauce, and green onions; set aside.
Punch down dough and divide into 8 equal pieces, then roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin oval, brush lightly with oil, fold in half, and place on a small square of parchment paper.
Let folded buns rise for 20 minutes on a tray.
Bring water to a boil in a steamer and place buns (still on parchment) on a steaming rack; steam for 12-15 minutes until puffed and cooked through.
Carefully remove buns from steamer, fill each with pork mixture and cucumber slices, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Make dough in advance and refrigerate overnight, then shape and steam the next day to save time
Use ground pork instead of pork belly to reduce cost by 40% with minimal flavor difference

recipes.name: Donair
recipes.description: Canadian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make donair sauce by mixing 0.75 cup sweetened condensed milk with 2 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tbsp garlic powder, and 0.5 tsp salt; refrigerate.
Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks for 5-7 minutes.
Drain excess fat from the meat, then add donair spice mix and water, stirring well and simmering for 3 minutes until thickened.
Warm pita bread in the oven or by heating briefly in a dry skillet.
Assemble donairs by placing spiced meat mixture in the center of each warm pita.
Top generously with diced tomatoes, onion, and shredded lettuce.
Drizzle generously with donair sauce and fold the pita into a wrapper, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze portions in portions for quick donair night meals
Make donair sauce in large batches and store in a jar in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks

recipes.name: Chebab
recipes.description: Moroccan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and water to form a soft dough, then knead for 5 minutes and let rest for 20 minutes covered.
In a separate skillet, brown ground meat over medium heat, then add diced onion and cook until softened.
Stir in paprika, cumin, cilantro, parsley, and egg, cooking for 2 minutes until the filling is well combined and heated through.
Divide dough into 6 equal balls and roll each into a thin oval about 6 inches long.
Place 2 tablespoons of filling on one half of each dough oval, fold in half, and seal edges gently.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry each chebab for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot, drizzled with honey and accompanied by mint tea.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze in 0.5-pound portions for future chebab nights
Use fresh herbs from a grocery store bulk bin or grow cilantro and parsley on a windowsill to save money

recipes.name: Ceviche Tostadas
recipes.description: Peruvian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut the fish into small bite-sized cubes and place in a glass bowl.
Pour fresh lime juice over the fish until fully covered and refrigerate for 15-20 minutes.
Mix the marinated fish with diced red onion, cilantro, jalapeño, tomatoes, and salt.
Toast the tostadas in a 350°F oven for 2 minutes until warm and crispy.
Top each tostada with a spoonful of ceviche mixture.
Arrange avocado slices on top and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy fish when on sale and freeze; use within 3 months
Make your own lime juice from bulk limes instead of bottled

recipes.name: Arancini
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat chicken broth in a pot and maintain at a simmer throughout cooking.
In a large pan, melt butter and toast rice for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until each addition is mostly absorbed before adding the next (about 18 minutes total).
Stir in milk and parmesan cheese until creamy, then spread risotto on a baking sheet to cool for 20 minutes.
Form cooled risotto into golf ball-sized portions, insert a small cube of mozzarella in the center, and reshape to enclose it.
Beat eggs in one bowl, place breadcrumbs in another; coat each ball in egg then breadcrumbs.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry arancini in batches for 3 minutes until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use store-brand parmesan instead of freshly grated
Buy rice in bulk and freeze leftover risotto to make arancini later

recipes.name: Minestrone
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion, carrots, and celery for 5 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in canned tomatoes with juices and vegetable broth, bringing to a boil.
Add diced zucchini and kidney beans, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in pasta and cook for 8 minutes until al dente, stirring occasionally.
Fold in fresh spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy frozen spinach instead of fresh to save money and reduce waste
Use dried pasta ends or bulk pasta for cheaper cost per serving

recipes.name: Borscht
recipes.description: Russian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion for 3 minutes.
Add julienned beets and carrots, cooking for 5 minutes while stirring.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, then add cubed potatoes and cabbage.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in tomato paste, vinegar, and sugar, mixing well.
Simmer for another 5 minutes and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream in each bowl.
cheapTips: Buy beets in bulk when in season and freeze for year-round use
Use store-brand sour cream as a budget alternative

recipes.name: Pho
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Char onion and ginger under a broiler for 2 minutes per side until blackened.
Bring beef broth to a boil in a large pot and add charred onion, ginger, star anise, and cinnamon stick.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes to infuse flavors, then strain broth and discard solids.
Return broth to pot and bring to a boil, then add fish sauce and adjust seasoning.
Cook rice noodles according to package directions in a separate pot, then drain.
Divide cooked noodles among serving bowls and top with thinly sliced beef.
Pour hot broth over beef and noodles, cooking the meat through from residual heat.
Top each bowl with bean sprouts and serve with fresh basil, lime wedges, and jalapeño on the side for garnish.
cheapTips: Buy beef broth in bulk containers when on sale and freeze in portions
Use cheaper beef cuts like chuck and slice thin; the hot broth will cook them tender

recipes.name: Mulligatawny
recipes.description: Indian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in curry powder and turmeric, coating the onion mixture and cooking for 30 seconds.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil, then add red lentils and diced tomatoes.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until lentils soften, stirring occasionally.
Stir in shredded chicken, coconut milk, and diced apple, simmering for 5 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the grocery store to save time and reduce cost
Buy lentils in bulk bins instead of packaged for significant savings

recipes.name: Cock-a-Leekie
recipes.description: Scottish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 3 large, whites and light greens only, s

steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add chicken breast, bay leaf, and thyme.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken and shred into bite-sized pieces; discard bay leaf.
Add sliced leeks, cubed potato, carrot, celery, and pearl barley to the broth.
Simmer for 12 minutes until vegetables are tender and barley is cooked.
Stir in shredded chicken and chopped prunes, cooking for 2 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts when on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand broth and barley to reduce cost

recipes.name: Pozole
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles and soak in hot water for 10 minutes.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot, add cubed pork, onion, and garlic cloves.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes until pork is tender.
Blend softened chiles with 1/2 cup of soaking liquid until smooth, then strain through a fine sieve.
Add chile paste, hominy, cumin, and oregano to the broth, simmering for 10 minutes.
Remove onion and garlic cloves; season with salt to taste.
Serve hot in bowls with tostadas on the side and toppings of radishes, cabbage, and lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when on sale and freeze; it's one of the cheapest cuts
Buy dried chiles in bulk bins instead of packaged for significant savings

recipes.name: Menudo
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sauté onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add cubed pork belly and brown for 5 minutes on all sides.
Pour in water or broth and add bay leaves, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until pork becomes tender.
Add potatoes, carrots, and pork liver, simmering for 10 minutes.
Stir in tomato sauce and fish sauce, cooking for another 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Pork belly and liver are inexpensive cuts; watch for sales at Asian markets
Use canned tomato sauce instead of fresh tomatoes for cost savings

recipes.name: Wonton Soup
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork, minced shrimp, green onion, garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Place 1 teaspoon of filling in the center of each wonton wrapper.
Wet the edges of the wrapper with water using your finger, fold into a triangle, then bring opposite corners together and seal.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook wontons in batches for 3 minutes until they float and cook for another minute; remove with a slotted spoon.
Heat chicken broth in a pot with remaining soy sauce and minced ginger, bringing to a gentle simmer.
Add chopped bok choy to the broth and cook for 2 minutes until slightly wilted.
Divide cooked wontons among bowls and pour hot broth with bok choy over them; serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy wonton wrappers from Asian markets instead of mainstream grocery stores for better price
Use frozen shrimp when thawed instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Consommé
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground beef, egg whites, diced onion, carrot, celery, and tomato paste in a bowl to create a raft mixture.
Heat beef broth in a large pot over medium heat until it begins to steam.
Slowly stir the raft mixture into the hot broth and add thyme and bay leaf.
Increase heat to medium-high and bring to a gentle simmer without stirring once the raft forms.
Simmer for 45 minutes, allowing impurities to collect in the raft at the surface.
Carefully ladle consommé through a fine-mesh strainer lined with cheesecloth into a clean pot.
Season with salt and pepper, then gently reheat and serve in warm bowls.
cheapTips: Use store-brand beef broth to save 30% on ingredient cost
Make consommé when you have leftover ground beef on hand

recipes.name: Vichyssoise
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean leeks by slicing lengthwise and rinsing between layers, then slice into thin half-moons.
Peel and dice potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté leeks for 5 minutes until softened.
Add potatoes and vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Blend the soup in batches using an immersion blender or stand blender until completely smooth.
Stir in heavy cream and season with salt and white pepper.
Chill the soup for at least 30 minutes, then ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh chives.
cheapTips: Use regular potatoes instead of premium varieties
Skip fresh chives and use dried chives or green onion tops to save money

recipes.name: Minestra
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion, minced garlic, celery, and carrot for 8 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes and vegetable broth, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium and add diced zucchini and drained beans, simmering for 10 minutes.
Stir in pasta and cook for 8-10 minutes until tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in fresh basil just before serving and ladle into bowls.
cheapTips: Buy dried pasta in bulk and canned tomatoes on sale
Use frozen zucchini instead of fresh to save money year-round

recipes.name: Cioppino
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion, minced garlic, and fennel for 5 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, fish broth, white wine, and red pepper flakes, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Add firm fish pieces cut into 2-inch chunks and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cleaned mussels and shrimp, cover and cook for 6-8 minutes until mussels open and shrimp turn pink.
Discard any unopened mussels and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy seafood from Asian markets or when on sale, then freeze
Use frozen shrimp and mussels to reduce cost significantly

recipes.name: Scotch Broth
recipes.description: Scottish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring beef broth to a boil in a large pot and add beef stew meat, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add barley and split peas, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Add diced onion, carrot, celery, and potatoes, then simmer for 20 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Stir in fresh parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck or round cuts on sale and freeze until needed
Purchase barley and split peas from bulk bins to save 40%

recipes.name: Cuban Sandwich
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice Cuban bread or sub roll lengthwise and lightly spread mustard on both inside surfaces.
Layer roasted pork, ham, Swiss cheese, and dill pickle slices on the bottom half of bread.
Place the top half of bread over the filling.
Butter the outside of the sandwich lightly on both sides.
Press the sandwich in a hot panini maker or skillet for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese melts.
Cut diagonally and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use deli counter ham and pork instead of premium brands
Buy day-old Cuban bread at a discount

recipes.name: French Dip
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat beef broth in a small saucepan with Worcestershire sauce, beef bouillon cube, and thyme over medium heat.
Thinly slice onions and add to the broth, simmering for 8 minutes.
Remove thyme sprig from broth and keep broth warm on low heat.
Warm sliced roast beef in the broth for 3 minutes.
Split sub rolls and top each with 2 slices of Swiss cheese, then broil for 2 minutes until melted.
Pile warm roast beef onto the cheese-topped rolls and serve with small bowls of dipping broth.
cheapTips: Use store-brand beef broth and roast beef from the deli counter
Buy sub rolls from day-old bakery section

recipes.name: Falafel Wrap
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain chickpeas and pulse in a food processor with onion, garlic, parsley, and cumin until coarsely combined.
Add flour and baking powder, then pulse again until mixture holds together but is still crumbly.
Refrigerate mixture for 15 minutes, then form into 8 small balls and gently flatten.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and carefully fry falafel balls for 3-4 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Drain fried falafel on paper towels.
Spread hummus on each wrap, then add lettuce, tomatoes, and fried falafel.
Drizzle with tahini sauce, wrap tightly, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make falafel from dried chickpeas cooked at home to save 60%
Buy store-brand canned chickpeas and generic spices

recipes.name: Panini
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice focaccia bread horizontally into two halves.
Spread pesto on both cut surfaces of the bread.
Layer prosciutto, fresh mozzarella, roasted red peppers, and fresh basil on the bottom half.
Place top half of bread over the filling.
Butter the outside of the sandwich on both sides.
Press the sandwich in a preheated panini maker or skillet for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese melts.
Cut in half and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use store-brand pesto instead of fresh to save 50%
Buy prosciutto from deli counter and ask for ends/trimmings at a discount

recipes.name: Torta
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice telera roll horizontally, being careful not to cut all the way through.
Spread refried beans on the bottom inside surface of the roll.
Slice roasted chicken and arrange on top of beans with cheese slices.
Add jalapeño slices, avocado slices, tomato slices, and lettuce.
Spread mayonnaise and chipotle sauce on the top inside surface of the roll.
Close the sandwich and wrap tightly in foil or plastic wrap.
Press gently and serve at room temperature or wrap in foil and warm in a 350°F oven for 5 minutes.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the grocery store to save time and money
Buy avocados when on sale and store in a cool place to extend freshness

recipes.name: Po' Boy
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or pot.
Mix flour, cornstarch, and Cajun seasoning in a shallow bowl.
Pat catfish dry and dredge thoroughly in the flour mixture.
Carefully place fish in hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove fish and drain on paper towels.
Slice baguette lengthwise and spread mayonnaise on both sides.
Layer fried catfish, lettuce, tomato slices, and pickles on the baguette.
Slice sandwich in half and serve immediately with extra pickles on the side.
cheapTips: Use tilapia or other budget whitefish instead of catfish
Make your own Cajun seasoning with paprika, cayenne, and garlic powder

recipes.name: Italian Sub
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the sub roll in half lengthwise and gently hollow out some of the interior.
Layer salami and ham on the bottom half of the roll.
Add provolone cheese slices over the meats.
Layer roasted red peppers, fresh mozzarella, lettuce, tomato slices, and red onion.
Drizzle Italian dressing over all ingredients.
Close the sandwich with the top half of the roll.
Wrap tightly in foil and let sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Slice in half and serve.
cheapTips: Buy deli meat on sale and freeze for later use
Use regular mozzarella or skip the fresh mozzarella to save

recipes.name: Beef Bulgogi Wrap
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice beef thinly against the grain and place in a bowl.
Combine soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, minced garlic, and minced ginger in a small bowl.
Pour marinade over beef and stir well, then marinate for 20 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook beef with marinade for 5-7 minutes until caramelized.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Julienne cucumber and carrot into thin strips.
Assemble wraps by laying tortilla flat, adding lettuce, cooked beef, cucumber, and carrot.
Roll tightly and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use flank steak or chuck roast instead of sirloin
Buy pre-shredded lettuce and pre-cut vegetables to save time

recipes.name: Tandoori Chicken Wrap
recipes.description: Indian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl.
Mix yogurt, tandoori spice blend, lime juice, and minced garlic together.
Pour marinade over chicken and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook marinated chicken for 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Dice cucumber and thinly slice red onion.
Layer tortilla with cooked tandoori chicken, cucumber, red onion, and cilantro.
Drizzle mango chutney over filling and roll tightly.
cheapTips: Make your own tandoori spice with paprika, cumin, and coriander
Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for more flavor and lower cost

recipes.name: Döner Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice onion and mince garlic, then combine with ground meat, paprika, and cumin.
Knead mixture for 2-3 minutes until sticky and well combined.
Form meat mixture into a loaf shape on a baking sheet lined with foil.
Bake at 400°F for 30 minutes until cooked through and browned on top.
Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Warm pita bread in the oven or over a burner.
Dice tomato and cucumber finely.
Fill pita with sliced meat, tomato, cucumber, yogurt mixed with lemon juice, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use 80/20 ground beef instead of lamb to reduce cost significantly
Make your own yogurt sauce with plain yogurt, garlic, and salt

recipes.name: Egg McMuffin
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Split English muffin and toast in a toaster or skillet until golden.
Heat Canadian bacon in the skillet for 1 minute per side, then set aside.
Add butter to skillet and crack egg into it, cooking sunny-side up for 3-4 minutes until whites are set.
Season egg with salt and pepper.
Layer bottom muffin half with Canadian bacon, then cheddar cheese.
Top with cooked egg and place muffin top on sandwich.
Wrap in foil to keep warm and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy Canadian bacon on sale and freeze for quick weekday breakfasts
Use store-brand English muffins to save 30-40%

recipes.name: Croissant Sandwich
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice croissant horizontally to create two halves.
Lightly butter the cut sides of the croissant.
Spread Dijon mustard on the bottom half.
Layer ham and Swiss cheese on the mustard.
Add fresh lettuce leaves on top of cheese.
Place top half of croissant on sandwich.
Warm in a 350°F oven for 2-3 minutes if desired for cheese to melt slightly.
Serve immediately while croissant is still warm and buttery.
cheapTips: Buy croissants from the bakery section when they go on sale
Use regular ham instead of premium imported varieties

recipes.name: Bacon, Lettuce and Tomato
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat for 5-7 minutes until crispy.
Transfer bacon to paper towels to drain and cool.
Toast bread slices in a toaster until golden brown.
Slice tomato into 0.25-inch thick slices.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each bread slice.
Layer lettuce leaves on one slice of bread.
Top lettuce with tomato slices and season with salt and pepper.
Break bacon into pieces and layer over tomato, then top with second bread slice and serve.
cheapTips: Buy bacon in bulk packages when on sale and freeze portions
Use store-brand white bread instead of premium varieties

recipes.name: Pork Schnitzel Sandwich
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place pork cutlets between plastic wrap and pound thin with a mallet until 0.25 inches thick.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs.
Coat each cutlet in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing gently.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry schnitzel for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and squeeze fresh lemon juice over each piece.
Slice rolls horizontally and spread mayonnaise on bottom halves.
Layer arugula and tomato slices on rolls, top with schnitzel, and serve with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder and cut your own thin cutlets instead of pre-cut
Make your own breadcrumb coating from stale bread

recipes.name: Torta Ahogada
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into chunks and cook in boiling salted water for 25 minutes until tender.
Shred cooked pork with two forks and set aside.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic in oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add tomato sauce and chipotle peppers to skillet and simmer for 5 minutes.
Blend sauce until smooth using an immersion blender or transfer to blender.
Season sauce with lime juice and salt, then add shredded pork.
Slice rolls horizontally and spread refried beans on bottom halves.
Top with shredded pork, then ladle the sauce generously over sandwich until soaked, and serve immediately with extra sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Use pork butt from the sale section and cook a day ahead
Substitute canned tomato sauce with crushed tomatoes for same results at lower cost

recipes.name: Cemita
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice each cemita roll in half horizontally and lightly toast the cut sides in a skillet for 1-2 minutes.
Spread mayonnaise on both halves of each roll.
Layer turkey, Oaxaca cheese, avocado, tomato, onion, and sliced jalapeños on the bottom half of each roll.
Top with fresh cilantro and season with salt and pepper.
Place the top half of the roll on each sandwich and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular sandwich rolls if cemita rolls are unavailable
Buy deli turkey on sale or use rotisserie chicken

recipes.name: Sandwich al Pastor
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rehydrate guajillo and ancho chiles in hot water for 10 minutes, then remove seeds and stems.
Blend soaked chiles with pineapple chunks, garlic, vinegar, and cumin until smooth.
Cut pork shoulder into chunks and toss with the chile paste marinade for at least 20 minutes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the marinated pork for 15-18 minutes until cooked through and edges are slightly charred.
Warm bread rolls and fill with cooked pork, diced onion, and fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Use pork butt instead of shoulder when on sale
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for future meals

recipes.name: Pork Belly Bao
recipes.description: Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork belly into large chunks and boil in water for 30 minutes until fork-tender.
Mix soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, ginger, and garlic in a bowl to create glaze.
Cut cooked pork into bite-sized pieces and toss with glaze.
Pan-fry glazed pork in a hot skillet for 3-4 minutes until edges caramelize.
Warm bao buns according to package directions.
Spread hoisin sauce inside each bun and fill with pork, cucumber slices, and scallion pieces.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly when on sale and freeze for later use
Pre-made frozen bao buns save significant time

recipes.name: Katsu Sando
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound pork cutlets to 1/4 inch thickness and season with salt and pepper.
Set up three shallow dishes with flour, beaten egg, and panko breadcrumbs respectively.
Coat each cutlet in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing gently so breadcrumbs adhere.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan and fry cutlets for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown, then drain on paper towels.
Mix mayonnaise with tonkatsu sauce and spread on two bread slices.
Layer shredded cabbage on the sauce-coated bread, top with fried cutlet, and cover with remaining bread slice.
cheapTips: Use chicken breast cutlets instead of pork to save money
Make tonkatsu sauce by mixing ketchup and Worcestershire if unavailable

recipes.name: Lo Mein
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook lo mein noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Add minced garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add bell pepper, broccoli, and carrots and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Add cooked noodles to the pan with soy sauce and sesame oil and toss everything together for 2 minutes.
Top with chopped scallions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Add leftover cooked chicken or shrimp for extra protein without much cost
Buy vegetables in season or use frozen for better prices

recipes.name: Soba Noodles
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook soba noodles according to package directions until just tender, then drain and rinse with cold water.
In a pot, combine dashi broth, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar and bring to a simmer.
Divide cooked soba noodles between two bowls.
Pour hot broth over the noodles and top with scallions, nori strips, and cooked tempura shrimp or chicken.
Optionally, add a soft-boiled or poached egg on top.
Serve with a small dish of wasabi on the side for dipping or stirring in.
cheapTips: Make dashi from scratch using kombu and bonito flakes instead of buying pre-made
Use canned or frozen shrimp instead of fresh tempura

recipes.name: Ravioli
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pasta dough by mixing flour and eggs on a clean surface, knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover dough and let rest for 30 minutes.
Mix ricotta, parmesan, chopped spinach, salt, and pepper in a bowl to create filling.
Roll out dough very thin between two sheets of parchment paper and cut into 2-inch squares.
Place 1 teaspoon filling in the center of each square, fold diagonally, and seal edges by pressing with fork.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook ravioli until they float, then cook 2 more minutes.
Heat butter in a pan and gently toss cooked ravioli, then plate and top with marinara sauce and basil.
cheapTips: Use frozen spinach instead of fresh to save time and money
Buy store-made marinara sauce instead of making from scratch

recipes.name: Tagliatelle alla Bolognese
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook diced pancetta in a large pot over medium heat for 3 minutes until fat is rendered.
Add chopped onion, carrot, and celery (soffritto) and cook for 8 minutes until softened.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned for about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add white wine and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add milk and simmer the sauce on low heat for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook tagliatelle according to package directions, drain and reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Toss cooked tagliatelle with Bolognese sauce, adding pasta water as needed for consistency, and top with parmesan.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze extra sauce for quick future meals
Use ground chuck instead of premium beef

recipes.name: Macarons au Gratin
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and cook elbow macaroni according to package directions, drain and set aside.
In a pot, melt butter over medium heat and whisk in flour to make a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk, stirring constantly to avoid lumps, and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar and gruyere cheese until melted, then season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Fold cooked macaroni into the cheese sauce and pour into a buttered baking dish.
Mix panko breadcrumbs with 1 tbsp melted butter and sprinkle evenly over top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and bubbling at the edges.
cheapTips: Use all cheddar cheese instead of adding gruyere for lower cost
Buy pre-shredded cheese to save time

recipes.name: Rice Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a pot, bring beef broth to a boil with onion, ginger, cinnamon stick, and star anise and simmer for 10 minutes.
Strain broth to remove solids and return to pot, then stir in fish sauce.
Cook rice noodles according to package directions, drain and divide between two bowls.
Bring broth back to a boil and carefully add sliced beef, cooking for just 1-2 minutes until cooked through.
Pour hot broth and beef over noodles in bowls.
Top with fresh herbs and serve with lime wedges for squeezing.
cheapTips: Use store-bought beef broth instead of making from scratch
Buy thin-sliced beef from butcher counter for better value

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized cubes and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken until golden, about 5 minutes per side.
Combine soy sauce, mirin, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl.
Pour the teriyaki sauce over cooked chicken and simmer for 3-4 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is coated.
Divide cooked rice among bowls and top with chicken and sauce.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale and freeze for later
Use honey instead of mirin to save $2-3 per bottle

recipes.name: Pilaf
recipes.description: Persian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear, then drain well.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add carrots and cook for 2 more minutes, then stir in rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Pour in broth, add cinnamon stick and bay leaf, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 15 minutes until rice is tender.
Remove from heat, let stand covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Stir in raisins and nuts, season with salt and pepper, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy rice in bulk sections for 50% less than branded boxes
Skip nuts and increase raisins for a budget-friendly version

recipes.name: Gallo Pinto
recipes.description: Costa Rican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté onion and bell pepper until soft, about 4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in cooked rice and beans, breaking up any clumps.
Add Worcestershire sauce and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through.
Season with salt, pepper, and lime juice.
Fold in cilantro and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use canned beans or cook dried beans in bulk
Use leftover rice from previous meals

recipes.name: Risotto ai Funghi
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a separate pot and keep at a gentle simmer on the stovetop.
Sauté mushrooms in olive oil over medium-high heat until golden, then set aside.
In a large pot, melt 1 tbsp butter over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add rice and toast for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in wine and stir until absorbed, then begin adding warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until each addition is absorbed before adding more (about 18-20 minutes total).
When rice is creamy and al dente, remove from heat and stir in remaining butter, parmesan, mushrooms, salt, and pepper.
Cover and let rest for 1 minute, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular button mushrooms instead of mixed varieties
Buy arborio rice from bulk bins or ethnic markets

recipes.name: Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: Mexican-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Drain excess fat and stir in taco seasoning with 1/4 cup water; simmer for 2 minutes.
Warm black beans and corn together in a small pot over medium heat.
Divide rice among bowls and top with lettuce, seasoned beef, beans with corn, tomatoes, and cheese.
Dollop with sour cream and salsa, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on markdown near closing time
Use store-brand taco seasoning instead of name brands

recipes.name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
recipes.description: Singaporean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil with ginger and salt, then add chicken and simmer for 20-25 minutes until fully cooked.
Remove chicken and let cool, reserving 3 cups of cooking broth; shred or slice chicken meat.
Rinse rice under cold water and drain well.
In a separate pot, bring reserved broth to boil with minced garlic, then add rice and bring back to boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 15 minutes until rice is tender.
Mix soy sauce and sesame oil in a small bowl and serve as dipping sauce.
Arrange rice in bowls, top with chicken, garnish with green onions and cilantro, and serve with soy dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken instead of parts to save 30%
Use the cooking broth as base for future soups

recipes.name: Kao Man Gai
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring broth to boil in a pot with ginger, garlic, and salt, then add whole chicken breast.
Simmer for 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through, then remove and shred into bite-sized pieces.
Strain cooking broth through a fine sieve, reserving 2.5 cups of broth.
Rinse rice under cold water, add to the pot with reserved broth, and bring to boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until rice is tender.
Combine soy sauce, fish sauce, and rice vinegar in a small bowl for serving sauce.
Divide rice among bowls, top with shredded chicken, garnish with cilantro and green onions, and serve with sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chicken in bulk and freeze portions
Skip fish sauce for a lighter version if budget is tight

recipes.name: Risotto al Ragù
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp butter in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes; set aside.
In the same pot, melt 1 tbsp butter and sauté onion, carrot, and celery (soffritto) until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add cooked beef back to the pot.
Pour in wine and simmer until mostly absorbed, about 3 minutes.
Heat broth in a separate pot and keep at a gentle simmer.
Add rice to the ragù and toast for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Begin adding warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until each addition is absorbed before adding more (about 18-20 minutes total).
When rice is creamy and al dente, remove from heat and stir in remaining butter and parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and pepper, cover for 1 minute, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use ground beef scraps on sale from the butcher counter
Make a double batch and freeze portions for later use

recipes.name: Gyedon
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine soy sauce, sugar, mirin, and garlic in a small bowl.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over high heat and quickly sear beef slices until browned, about 2 minutes; set aside.
In the same skillet, cook onion over medium-high heat until softened, about 3 minutes.
Return beef to skillet, pour in sauce, and cook for 2 minutes until beef is fully cooked and sauce coats the meat.
Divide rice between bowls and top with beef and onion mixture.
Drizzle sesame oil over each bowl, then carefully crack a raw or lightly cooked egg on top (the heat will partially cook it).
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of sliced beef for cheaper alternative
Buy beef on sale and slice thinly yourself using a sharp knife

recipes.name: Kitchari
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice and mung beans together under cold water until water runs clear, then drain well.
Heat ghee in a large pot over medium heat and add cumin seeds; cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add onion and ginger, then sauté until onion is softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in turmeric powder and cook for 30 seconds.
Add rinsed rice and mung beans, stir to coat with ghee, and toast for 1 minute.
Pour in broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until rice and beans are very soft and creamy, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and fold in cilantro, then serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy mung beans and rice from Indian grocery stores in bulk
Use vegetable oil instead of ghee to cut costs in half

recipes.name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
recipes.description: Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dip each rice paper wrapper in warm water for 3-5 seconds until pliable.
Lay wrapper on a damp cloth and arrange a lettuce leaf, then carrots, cucumber, mint, cilantro, and shrimp in the center.
Fold the bottom edge over filling, fold in the sides, and roll tightly like a burrito.
Mix peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, and water in a bowl to make dipping sauce.
Serve spring rolls immediately with dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy rice paper in bulk from Asian markets for 50% cheaper
Use regular carrots and cucumber instead of shrimp to save $2 per serving

recipes.name: Pho (Vegetable)
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable broth in a large pot and add halved onion, ginger slices, cinnamon stick, and star anise.
Simmer the broth for 30 minutes to infuse flavors, then strain out solids.
Return broth to pot and add carrots, mushrooms, and soy sauce; simmer 10 minutes.
Cook rice noodles separately according to package directions and drain.
Divide noodles among bowls and ladle hot broth with vegetables over top.
Serve with lime wedges, fresh basil, and bean sprouts on the side for garnish.
cheapTips: Buy vegetable broth in bulk and freeze in portions
Substitute star anise with cloves if unavailable for same effect

recipes.name: Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: Contemporary lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Massage chopped kale with a pinch of salt and olive oil until softened, about 2 minutes.
Cube roasted sweet potato and halve the avocado.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, olive oil, and water until smooth to make dressing.
Divide quinoa evenly between two bowls as the base.
Arrange kale, chickpeas, sweet potato, beets, and avocado around each bowl.
Drizzle tahini dressing over the bowl and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use canned beets instead of fresh to save prep time and money
Buy tahini in bulk from Middle Eastern markets

recipes.name: Black Bean Burrito
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm flour tortillas in a skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds per side.
Heat black beans in a saucepan with cumin and a pinch of salt for 3 minutes.
Warm tortillas on a flat surface and spread 2 tablespoons of sour cream down the center of each.
Layer rice, black beans, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and onion on each tortilla.
Pour 1 tablespoon of salsa over filling, fold in the sides, and roll tightly.
Serve burritos wrapped in foil or on a plate with extra salsa and sour cream on the side.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans in bulk and store in the pantry
Use store-brand salsa instead of name brands to save $1

recipes.name: Enchiladas Verdes (Cheese)
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and lightly oil a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté onion, garlic, and jalapeño until softened, about 3 minutes.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet or over a flame for 10 seconds per side to make them pliable.
Dip each tortilla in salsa verde, fill with cheese and onion mixture, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in the baking dish.
Pour remaining salsa verde over the enchiladas and drizzle crema in a thin stream across the top.
Sprinkle remaining cheese over the enchiladas and bake for 25 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use store-brand salsa verde instead of fresh tomatillos
Substitute crema with sour cream thinned with milk

recipes.name: Feta Saganaki
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut feta block into 1/2 inch thick slices and pat dry with paper towels.
Beat egg in a shallow bowl and place flour in another shallow bowl.
Coat each feta slice in flour, then dip in beaten egg, then coat again in flour.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry feta slices for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy outside.
Transfer to a plate and drizzle with honey, squeeze fresh lemon juice over, and sprinkle with oregano.
Serve immediately while still warm.
cheapTips: Buy feta in bulk and freeze portions for later use
Use regular olive oil instead of extra virgin to save money

recipes.name: Greek Salad with Feta
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop romaine lettuce and place in a large bowl.
Add halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, sliced bell pepper, and sliced red onion to the bowl.
Top salad with Kalamata olives and crumbled feta cheese.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour dressing over salad just before serving and toss gently to combine.
