cheapTips: Buy romaine lettuce heads instead of pre-packaged salad mixes
Substitute Kalamata olives with store-brand green olives to save $1

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together mayonnaise, lemon juice, minced garlic, Worcestershire sauce, and anchovy paste in a small bowl.
Add black pepper and a pinch of salt to the dressing and mix well.
Chop romaine lettuce and place in a large bowl.
Pour dressing over lettuce and toss gently to coat evenly.
Top salad with grated parmesan cheese and croutons and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make homemade croutons from stale bread cubes tossed in olive oil
Omit anchovy paste and use extra Worcestershire sauce for vegetarian version

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice tomatoes into 1/4 inch thick rounds and slice mozzarella to match thickness.
Arrange tomato and mozzarella slices alternately on a plate, slightly overlapping.
Tear fresh basil leaves and scatter over the salad.
Drizzle olive oil evenly over the salad and then drizzle balsamic vinegar.
Sprinkle with salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use block mozzarella sliced fresh instead of pre-packaged mozzarella rounds
Buy basil in season or grow in a pot at home

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice tomatoes, cucumber, and bell pepper into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
Add sliced red onion and Kalamata olives to the bowl.
Top with cubed feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad just before serving and toss gently to combine.
cheapTips: Buy feta cheese in blocks and cube yourself to save 30%
Use store-brand olives instead of imported varieties

recipes.name: Riz Casimir
recipes.description: Mauritian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions and set aside.
Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and cook chicken until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes, then remove.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Stir in curry powder and cook for 1 minute until aromatic.
Return chicken to pot, add coconut milk, broth, and raisins, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Cut banana into chunks and add to pot with pineapple chunks, simmering for 5 more minutes.
Serve curry over cooked rice and garnish with a banana slice on top of each serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for similar flavor at lower cost.
Use frozen pineapple chunks to save 30-40% compared to canned.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in garam masala, turmeric, and cumin powder, cooking for 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes and bring to a simmer.
Drain and rinse chickpeas, then add to the pot and stir well.
Simmer for 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld.
Taste and adjust salt as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and with rice or naan on the side.
cheapTips: Buy spices in bulk from Indian markets for 50% savings.
Use regular onions and garlic instead of pre-minced versions.

recipes.name: Aloo Gobi
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes and cut cauliflower into florets.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add cumin seeds, cooking until they sizzle, about 30 seconds.
Add diced onion, minced garlic, and ginger, sautéing until onion is golden, about 6 minutes.
Stir in turmeric and coriander powder, cooking for 30 seconds.
Add potato cubes and stir to coat with spices, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower florets and stir well, then reduce heat to medium and cover.
Cook for 15-18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender and cauliflower is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with cilantro, and serve with rice or roti.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes and cauliflower in season or frozen for best prices.
Store spices properly to use them multiple times across recipes.

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Beat eggs in a bowl and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat, pour in eggs, and scramble until cooked through, then remove and chop.
Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil to the wok and stir-fry diced onion and garlic for 1 minute.
Add frozen peas and carrots, stirring constantly for 2 minutes until heated through.
Add chilled rice and break up any clumps, stir-frying for 3-4 minutes.
Pour soy sauce and sesame oil over rice and toss until evenly coated.
Return scrambled eggs to the wok and fold into rice gently.
Add green onions, season with salt and white pepper to taste, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make extra rice the day before to save on cooking time and gas.
Buy frozen mixed vegetables instead of fresh to save money and reduce waste.

recipes.name: Vegetable Lo Mein
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook lo mein noodles according to package directions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat and stir-fry minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add broccoli, bell peppers, and snap peas, stir-frying for 4-5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Add cooked noodles to the wok and toss to combine with vegetables.
Pour soy sauce, sesame oil, and broth over noodles and vegetables, tossing constantly for 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add green onions and toss once more.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy pre-cut vegetables from the store salad bar if bulk fresh veggies are pricey.
Use regular soy sauce instead of premium brands—taste difference is minimal in lo mein.

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmesan
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Slice eggplant lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick slices, salt both sides, and let sit for 15 minutes to release moisture, then pat dry with paper towels.
Set up three bowls with flour in one, beaten eggs in another, and panko mixed with 1/2 cup parmesan in the third.
Coat each eggplant slice with flour, then dip in egg, then coat with breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry eggplant slices in batches for 3 minutes per side until golden, then drain on paper towels.
Spread thin layer of marinara sauce on bottom of 9x13-inch baking dish.
Layer eggplant slices, sauce, and mozzarella cheese in baking dish, repeating layers and ending with sauce and remaining mozzarella on top.
Bake for 20 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly, then garnish with fresh basil and remaining parmesan before serving.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants when in season (summer-fall) for lowest prices.
Make your own breadcrumbs from stale bread instead of buying panko.

recipes.name: Coq au Vin (Mushroom)
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut bacon into small pieces and cook in a large pot over medium heat until crispy, then remove and set aside, leaving fat in pot.
Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper, then brown skin-side down in bacon fat for 6 minutes, flip and cook another 4 minutes, then remove.
In the same pot, sauté mushrooms and pearl onions over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until golden, then remove and set aside.
Add minced garlic and tomato paste to pot, stirring for 1 minute.
Pour red wine into pot and scrape up browned bits, then add chicken broth, bay leaf, and thyme.
Return chicken thighs to pot, skin-side up, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes until chicken is tender and cooked through.
Return mushrooms, pearl onions, and bacon to pot, simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes, then season with salt and pepper and serve over egg noodles or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use chicken legs instead of thighs if thighs are expensive—they cook the same way.
Buy an inexpensive dry red wine marked for cooking; save good wine for drinking.

recipes.name: Pad Thai (Vegetarian)
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice noodles in room temperature water for 20 minutes until pliable, then drain.
Press tofu between paper towels to remove excess moisture, then cut into small cubes.
Whisk eggs together in a bowl.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice in a small bowl and set aside.
Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat, stir-fry tofu cubes for 3 minutes until lightly golden, then remove.
Push oil to side of wok and pour in whisked eggs, scrambling until partially cooked, then mix with oil.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add drained noodles, bell peppers, and snap peas, stir-frying for 2 minutes.
Pour sauce over noodles and toss everything together for 2 minutes, return tofu to wok and toss once more.
Serve topped with crushed peanuts, green onions, and lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy tofu in bulk and freeze it for later—frozen tofu is cheaper and has better texture.
Use bottled lime juice instead of fresh limes if price is a concern.

recipes.name: Green Curry (Vegetarian)
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between paper towels, then cut into 3/4-inch cubes.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and stir-fry curry paste with minced garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour one can of coconut milk into pot slowly while stirring to create a smooth paste.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and tofu cubes, stirring to coat with curry sauce.
Simmer for 8 minutes until broccoli is tender-crisp.
Add remaining coconut milk, bamboo shoots, fish sauce, and brown sugar, stirring well.
Simmer for 5 more minutes, then taste and adjust with lime juice as needed.
Stir in fresh basil just before serving and serve over jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Make your own green curry paste using fresh green chilies, garlic, and herbs if you have time.
Use canned vegetables instead of fresh for shelf stability and lower cost.

recipes.name: Panang Curry (Vegetarian)
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu and cut into 3/4-inch cubes, set aside.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and stir-fry curry paste with minced garlic for 2 minutes.
Slowly add 1 can of coconut milk while stirring to form a smooth curry base.
Add tofu cubes and cauliflower, stirring gently to coat with curry sauce.
Simmer for 10 minutes until cauliflower begins to soften.
Stir in peanut butter until fully combined, then add remaining coconut milk, bell pepper, fish sauce, and brown sugar.
Simmer for 8 more minutes until all vegetables are tender and flavors meld.
Finish with lime juice, taste and adjust seasonings, garnish with sliced chili if desired, and serve with jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy peanut butter in large jars—much cheaper per ounce than small ones.
Substitute natural peanut butter for panang paste if budget is tight; flavor will be slightly different but still delicious.

recipes.name: Cobb Salad
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop romaine lettuce and place in a large bowl.
Cook bacon until crispy, then crumble into small pieces.
Dice the cooked chicken, avocado, hard-boiled eggs, and tomatoes into uniform bite-sized pieces.
Arrange lettuce on a large plate and top with rows of chicken, bacon, avocado, eggs, tomatoes, blue cheese, and red onion.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Drizzle dressing over the salad just before serving.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken instead of cooking your own to save time and money
Buy eggs in bulk and hard-boil a batch at the start of the week

recipes.name: Waldorf Salad
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the celery and apples into small uniform pieces.
Combine mayonnaise and lemon juice in a large bowl.
Add celery, apples, halved grapes, and chopped walnuts to the dressing.
Toss gently until everything is well coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over a bed of fresh romaine lettuce.
cheapTips: Buy walnuts from bulk bins instead of pre-packaged
Use any apples on hand; Fuji or Honeycrisp work just as well as Granny Smith

recipes.name: Panzanella
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cube the crusty bread and spread on a baking sheet.
Toast bread cubes at 375°F for 8-10 minutes until lightly golden.
Chop tomatoes and cucumber into bite-sized pieces.
Combine warm bread, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and fresh basil in a large bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to combine.
Let sit at room temperature for 10-15 minutes to allow flavors to meld before serving.
cheapTips: Use day-old bread from a bakery for half price
Make this salad with overripe tomatoes that are on sale

recipes.name: Insalata Tricolore
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice fresh mozzarella and tomatoes into uniform thickness.
Arrange mozzarella and tomato slices on a serving plate, alternating between them.
Place fresh basil leaves between or on top of the slices.
Drizzle extra virgin olive oil evenly over the salad.
Drizzle balsamic vinegar over the top.
Sprinkle with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Serve at room temperature immediately.
cheapTips: Buy mozzarella in bulk from warehouse stores like Costco
Use Roma tomatoes when they're cheapest in summer

recipes.name: Thai Green Salad
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Shred the green cabbage and place in a large mixing bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, minced chili peppers, and garlic.
Pour dressing over the cabbage and massage gently for 2-3 minutes to soften.
Add sliced cucumber, cilantro, and mint leaves.
Toss salad gently to combine.
Top with crushed peanuts just before serving.
cheapTips: Buy whole peanuts and crush them yourself instead of buying pre-crushed
Substitute regular peppers for Thai chilis to reduce cost

recipes.name: Quinoa Salad
recipes.description: Peruvian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse quinoa under cold water and drain well.
Bring water or broth to a boil and add quinoa.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until water is absorbed.
Fluff quinoa with a fork and let cool for 5 minutes.
Transfer cooled quinoa to a large bowl and combine with tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, and corn.
Whisk together lime juice and olive oil, then pour over the salad.
Add cilantro and toss gently to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and refrigerate until ready to serve.
cheapTips: Buy quinoa in bulk from Costco or ethnic markets for much better pricing
Use frozen corn if fresh is expensive

recipes.name: Corn Salad
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using fresh corn, cut kernels off the cob or use frozen thawed corn.
Combine corn, diced red pepper, drained black beans, red onion, and minced jalapeño in a large bowl.
Whisk together lime juice, olive oil, and salt.
Pour dressing over corn mixture and toss gently.
Add chopped cilantro and toss again.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Top with crumbled cotija cheese if desired and serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy frozen corn and canned beans on sale to build a pantry stockpile
Skip the cotija cheese to cut costs significantly

recipes.name: Kimchi Salad
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop kimchi into bite-sized pieces, reserving some juice.
Toast sesame seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Whisk together sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, minced garlic, and ginger in a small bowl.
Combine napa cabbage, chopped kimchi, and green onions in a large bowl.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Top with toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy kimchi at Asian markets which often have better prices than mainstream stores
Make large batches and store in the refrigerator for quick lunches throughout the week

recipes.name: Seaweed Salad
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried seaweed in cool water for 5-10 minutes until softened and expanded.
Drain seaweed thoroughly and gently squeeze out excess water.
Toast sesame seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat for 1-2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, brown sugar, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
Combine softened seaweed with dressing in a large bowl.
Toss gently to coat evenly.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds on top and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy dried seaweed at Asian markets or online in bulk for significant savings
This salad keeps well in the refrigerator for up to 3 days

recipes.name: Kachumbari
recipes.description: East African lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop tomatoes into bite-sized pieces and place in a mixing bowl.
Dice red onion and add to the tomatoes.
Add minced green chili and chopped cilantro.
Drizzle with lime juice and olive oil.
Season generously with salt and pepper.
Toss gently to combine all ingredients.
Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to eat.
cheapTips: Make this salad when tomatoes are in season and cheapest
This is an excellent way to use tomatoes that are slightly overripe

recipes.name: Israeli Salad
recipes.description: Israeli lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the tomatoes, cucumbers, and red bell pepper into small 1/4-inch cubes.
Finely mince the red onion and chop the fresh parsley.
Combine all vegetables and parsley in a large bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently until everything is evenly coated.
Let the salad sit for 5 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
cheapTips: Buy tomatoes and cucumbers in season for lowest prices
Use regular onion instead of red onion to save 50 cents

recipes.name: Horiatiki
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut tomatoes into quarters and slice cucumbers into thick rounds.
Slice the red onion into thin rings and rinse briefly under cold water.
Arrange tomatoes, cucumbers, and onion on a large platter.
Scatter kalamata olives over the vegetables.
Cut feta cheese into large chunks and place on top of the salad.
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad just before serving.
cheapTips: Buy feta in bulk and store in the freezer
Use store-brand kalamata olives instead of imported

recipes.name: Coleslaw
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the green cabbage very thinly using a sharp knife or mandoline.
Peel the carrots and shred them using a box grater or food processor.
Place the shredded cabbage and carrots in a large bowl.
Whisk together mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper, and celery seed in a separate bowl.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss until all pieces are evenly coated.
Let the coleslaw sit in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy cabbage when on sale and store in the crisper drawer for weeks
Make large batches and store in an airtight container for quick meals

recipes.name: Olivier Salad
recipes.description: Russian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes and carrots in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain and cool completely.
Boil eggs for 10 minutes, then peel and cool in ice water.
Dice the cooled potatoes, carrots, and eggs into small 1/4-inch cubes.
Dice the pickle and ham into similar-sized pieces.
Combine potatoes, carrots, eggs, pickles, ham, and peas in a large bowl.
Add mayonnaise, salt, and pepper, then fold gently until all ingredients are coated.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving to allow flavors to blend.
cheapTips: Use cheaper lunch meat like bologna instead of ham
Buy frozen peas in bulk and store long-term

recipes.name: Shopska Salad
recipes.description: Bulgarian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the tomatoes, cucumbers, and red bell pepper into medium chunks.
Thinly slice the red onion and rinse under cold water.
Combine all vegetables and parsley in a large serving bowl.
Cube the white cheese and add to the salad.
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Serve immediately or let sit for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
cheapTips: Use regular feta cheese instead of imported varieties
Buy tomatoes and peppers at farmer's markets in season

recipes.name: Chicken Salad
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut the cooked chicken breast into 1/2-inch cubes.
Dice the celery and finely mince the red onion.
Combine the chicken, celery, and onion in a large bowl.
Whisk together mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and herbs in a separate bowl.
Pour the dressing over the chicken mixture and fold gently until everything is evenly coated.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving on bread or lettuce wraps.
cheapTips: Buy whole rotisserie chickens and shred yourself instead of pre-cooked chicken breast
Use regular mayonnaise instead of specialty versions

recipes.name: Salade Niçoise
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 12 minutes until tender, then cool and cut into chunks.
Boil green beans for 4 minutes until tender-crisp, then drain and cool.
Boil eggs for 10 minutes, then peel and quarter.
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Arrange romaine lettuce on a large platter and create separate sections for each ingredient.
Place potatoes, green beans, tuna, eggs, olives, tomatoes, and anchovies in piles on the lettuce.
Drizzle the dressing over the entire salad and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip the anchovies if cost is a concern
Use canned tuna on sale and stock up

recipes.name: Warm Lentil Salad
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse lentils under cold water and add to a pot with vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes until lentils are tender but not mushy.
While lentils cook, finely dice the carrots, celery, red onion, and shallots.
Whisk together mustard, vinegar, and olive oil in a small bowl.
Drain the cooked lentils and transfer to a large bowl while still warm.
Add the diced vegetables and parsley to the warm lentils.
Pour the dressing over and toss gently until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and let sit for 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy dried lentils in bulk from the bins
Use regular onion instead of shallots to save money

recipes.name: Falafel Salad
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse canned chickpeas, then pulse in a food processor with onion, garlic, and parsley until mixture is coarse.
Mix in flour, cumin, coriander, baking powder, salt, and pepper; chill for 15 minutes.
Form mixture into 1-inch balls and flatten slightly into patties.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and fry falafel 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown; drain on paper towels.
Whisk together tahini, lemon juice, and water to make sauce.
Chop lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumbers into bite-sized pieces.
Arrange lettuce on a platter and top with tomatoes, cucumbers, and warm falafel.
Drizzle with tahini sauce and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas on sale and stock up
Use regular tahini instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Kale Caesar Salad
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Strip kale leaves from the tough center stems and tear into bite-sized pieces.
Mince garlic and anchovies into a paste using a knife or mortar and pestle.
Whisk together the garlic-anchovy paste, lemon juice, mayonnaise, olive oil, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl.
Season the dressing with salt and pepper to taste.
Place torn kale in a large bowl and pour dressing over it.
Massage the kale with your hands for 1-2 minutes until the leaves soften and the dressing is evenly distributed.
Add croutons and most of the Parmesan cheese, toss gently.
Divide into serving bowls and top with remaining Parmesan cheese.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand croutons instead of name-brand
Grate your own Parmesan from a block instead of buying pre-grated

recipes.name: Grilled Steak with Sweet Potato
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat grill to high heat (around 450°F).
Scrub sweet potatoes and microwave on high for 8-10 minutes until fork-tender.
Pat steaks dry and season generously with salt, pepper, and garlic powder on both sides.
Oil the grill grates and place steaks on hot grill for 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Remove steaks and let rest on a plate for 5 minutes.
Slice sweet potatoes lengthwise and top each with butter and a sprinkle of salt.
Place rosemary sprigs on steaks and serve alongside sweet potatoes.
cheapTips: Buy steaks on sale and freeze; sirloin is cheaper than ribeye
Skip fresh rosemary and use dried or omit entirely

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Bowl
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Scoop cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with fresh blueberries.
Sprinkle granola and almonds over the top.
Drizzle with honey and add a pinch of cinnamon.
Serve immediately and enjoy.
cheapTips: Buy cottage cheese at warehouse stores in bulk
Use frozen blueberries instead of fresh for year-round savings

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Asparagus
recipes.description: European dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Trim asparagus by snapping off woody ends and arrange on a baking sheet.
Drizzle asparagus with 1 tablespoon olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place cod fillets on the sheet beside asparagus, brush with remaining olive oil, and season with salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Squeeze half the lemon over both cod and asparagus.
Pour white wine around the cod and bake for 12-15 minutes until cod flakes easily with a fork.
Slice remaining lemon and garnish before serving.
cheapTips: Buy cod frozen in bulk and thaw the night before
Use frozen asparagus if fresh is expensive

recipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, and garlic.
Add chicken cubes and marinate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Thread chicken onto skewers (soak wooden skewers 30 minutes first).
Heat grill or grill pan to medium-high and cook skewers 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Warm pita bread on the grill for 30 seconds per side.
Assemble souvlaki: spread tzatziki on pita, add chicken, and top with onion, cucumber, and tomato.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy chicken on sale and freeze in portions
Make tzatziki at home with plain yogurt and cucumber for half the cost

recipes.name: Lean Ground Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and brown ground beef for 5-7 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks.
Drain excess fat from the pan.
Add taco seasoning and water to the beef and simmer for 3 minutes until sauce thickens.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a gas flame for 15 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with seasoned beef, lettuce, tomato, and cheese.
Top with salsa and a squeeze of fresh lime juice.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale in bulk and freeze in portions
Make homemade taco seasoning with chili powder, cumin, and paprika

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi with Pasta
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook pasta according to package directions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes per side until they start to pink.
Deglaze the pan with white wine and lemon juice, stirring for 1 minute.
Add butter and stir until melted, then season with salt.
Drain pasta and toss with shrimp sauce, then garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk bags and thaw as needed
Use dry white wine or skip wine and add chicken broth instead

recipes.name: Turkey Breast Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Lay both bread slices on a clean surface.
Spread mustard on one slice and mayonnaise on the other.
Layer lettuce on the mustard side, followed by turkey, tomato, onion, and avocado.
Season avocado with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Place second slice of bread on top and cut diagonally.
Serve immediately or wrap in foil for later.
cheapTips: Buy sliced turkey on sale and freeze for quick weekday lunches
Use generic mayonnaise and mustard

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Teriyaki
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together soy sauce, mirin, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil to make teriyaki sauce.
Heat grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Place chicken breasts on grill and cook 5-6 minutes on first side.
Flip chicken and brush generously with teriyaki sauce, cook another 4-5 minutes.
Brush with more sauce during last minute of cooking until chicken is cooked through.
Let rest for 3 minutes, then brush with remaining sauce.
Garnish with sliced scallions and sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Skip mirin and use honey or brown sugar instead
Buy chicken in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Egg Scramble with Vegetables
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl, add salt and pepper, and whisk until well combined.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat until foaming.
Add diced onion and pepper, cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook another 2 minutes.
Pour whisked eggs into the skillet with vegetables.
Stir gently and let eggs cook for 1-2 minutes, then add spinach and cheese.
Continue stirring until eggs are set but still slightly moist, about 2-3 minutes total, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk from warehouse stores
Use frozen spinach and mushrooms to save money

recipes.name: Beef Burrito
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks for 5-7 minutes.
Drain excess fat, then stir in cumin, salt, pepper, and cooked rice, mixing until combined.
Warm the black beans in a separate pot and add to the beef mixture, stirring well.
Warm each tortilla in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side until pliable.
Lay a tortilla flat and spread 2 tablespoons of sour cream down the center.
Add half of the beef mixture, then top with half of the cheese and salsa.
Fold the sides of the tortilla inward, then roll tightly from bottom to top.
Place burritos seam-side down in a baking dish, cover with foil, and bake at 350°F for 10 minutes to melt the cheese.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use canned beans and store-brand cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Pepperoni Pizza
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 475°F and lightly oil a 12-inch pizza pan or baking sheet.
Stretch or roll out the pizza dough to fit the pan, creating a slight rim around the edges.
Brush the dough lightly with olive oil and sprinkle garlic powder, oregano, salt, and pepper over the surface.
Spread marinara sauce evenly over the dough, leaving about a 1/2-inch border.
Distribute mozzarella cheese evenly across the sauce.
Arrange pepperoni slices on top of the cheese in a single layer.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until the crust is golden and cheese is bubbly and slightly browned.
Remove from oven and let cool for 2 minutes before slicing and serving.
cheapTips: Use pre-made pizza dough from the grocery store bakery or refrigerated section
Buy pepperoni and cheese in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Chicken Tenders
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts lengthwise into 1-inch wide strips.
Pour flour into one shallow dish, beat eggs in a second dish, and mix panko with salt, pepper, and garlic powder in a third dish.
Coat each chicken strip in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, and finally coat with panko mixture.
Heat oil in a large pot or deep skillet to 350°F, checking temperature with a thermometer.
Carefully place chicken tenders in hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Transfer cooked tenders to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with your choice of dipping sauce such as ranch or honey mustard.
cheapTips: Buy chicken on sale and freeze for later
Make your own dipping sauce with mayo and mustard instead of buying bottled

recipes.name: Nachos with Cheese
recipes.description: Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Spread tortilla chips in an even layer on a large baking sheet.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese evenly over all the chips.
Scatter jalapeños and black olives across the cheese.
Bake for 5-7 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and drizzle sour cream and salsa over the nachos.
Garnish with diced red onion and fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately with additional salsa and sour cream on the side if desired.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand tortilla chips and cheese
Use canned jalapeños and olives for lower cost than fresh

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Brown Rice
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a saucepan and add brown rice, stirring once, then reduce heat to low and cover for 25-30 minutes.
Pat chicken breasts dry with paper towels and season both sides with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Place chicken in the hot skillet and cook for 6-7 minutes on the first side without moving until golden brown.
Flip chicken, squeeze lemon juice over it, add thyme sprigs, and cook for another 6-7 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken from heat and let rest for 3 minutes before serving.
Fluff the cooked brown rice with a fork and divide between plates.
Place one chicken breast on each portion of rice and drizzle with pan juices.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts in bulk and freeze individually
Brown rice is cheaper in bulk bins than pre-packaged

recipes.name: Egg White Omelet
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk egg whites in a bowl with salt and pepper until slightly foamy.
Heat butter in an 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until it foams.
Pour egg whites into the pan and let cook undisturbed for 1 minute until the bottom begins to set.
Using a spatula, gently push the cooked edges toward the center, tilting the pan so uncooked egg flows to the edges.
When the top is mostly set but still slightly wet, sprinkle cheese, tomato, spinach, and green onion on one half of the omelet.
Fold the omelet in half over the fillings and slide onto a plate.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale
Use frozen spinach instead of fresh for lower cost

recipes.name: Grilled Salmon Fillet
recipes.description: Scandinavian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat (400°F) for 5 minutes.
Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towels and brush both sides with 1 tbsp olive oil.
Season salmon with salt, pepper, and minced garlic on the flesh side.
Place salmon skin-side up on the grill and cook for 5-6 minutes without moving.
Flip salmon carefully and cook skin-side down for another 4-5 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Meanwhile, melt butter with remaining olive oil and stir in fresh dill and juice from half the lemon.
Transfer salmon to plates and drizzle with the dill butter sauce.
Serve with lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy salmon fillets from the freezer section, which costs less than fresh
Check for sales on fatty fish like salmon

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: Greek breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spoon half of the Greek yogurt into a bowl or glass.
Layer half of the granola over the yogurt.
Add half of the blueberries on top of the granola.
Spoon the remaining yogurt over the berries.
Top with the remaining granola and blueberries.
Drizzle honey over the top and sprinkle with almonds, coconut flakes, and cinnamon.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 hours before eating.
cheapTips: Buy frozen blueberries instead of fresh for significant savings
Purchase granola and nuts in bulk sections

recipes.name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain the canned tuna in a colander and press gently to remove excess moisture.
Transfer tuna to a bowl and mix with mayonnaise, diced celery, red onion, and relish.
Season the tuna salad with salt and black pepper and stir until well combined.
Toast bread slices if desired for added texture and flavor.
Spread tuna salad evenly on two slices of bread.
Layer lettuce and tomato slices on top of the tuna salad.
Place the remaining bread slices on top to create sandwiches.
Cut diagonally and serve immediately, or wrap in foil for later.
cheapTips: Buy canned tuna in bulk when on sale for significant savings
Use store-brand mayonnaise and bread

recipes.name: Protein Pancakes
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine eggs, vanilla protein powder, oats, Greek yogurt, and milk in a blender.
Peel the banana and add to the blender along with baking powder and cinnamon.
Blend on high speed for 30-45 seconds until smooth and well combined.
Heat butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes until edges look dry and bubbles form on top.
Flip pancake carefully and cook the other side for 1-2 minutes until light golden brown.
Repeat with remaining batter to make 4 pancakes total.
Serve 2 pancakes per person topped with maple syrup and optional toppings like berries or Greek yogurt.
cheapTips: Buy protein powder in bulk or use store brands
Use overripe bananas for free flavoring and natural sweetness

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add ground beef, breaking it apart with a spoon as it cooks for 5-7 minutes until browned.
Drain excess grease from the beef using a colander.
Stir in taco seasoning and water, then simmer for 3-4 minutes until the mixture thickens.
Warm the taco shells in a 350°F oven for 3 minutes or in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Fill each shell with seasoned beef and top with cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, sour cream, and salsa.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand taco seasoning instead of name brands to save 50 cents per packet
Use iceberg lettuce instead of fancier varieties

recipes.name: Pizza Margherita
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and sugar in a bowl and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour and salt in a large bowl, then add yeast mixture and 2 tbsp olive oil, stirring until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead dough for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, then place in an oiled bowl and let rise covered for 20 minutes.
Stretch dough into a 12-inch circle on a pizza pan or baking sheet brushed with olive oil.
Spread pizza sauce evenly over dough, leaving a half-inch border, then tear mozzarella and distribute across the surface.
Bake at 475°F for 12-15 minutes until the crust is golden and cheese is bubbling.
Remove from oven and top with fresh basil leaves and grated Parmesan before serving.
cheapTips: Make dough from scratch instead of buying pre-made crusts
Use regular mozzarella instead of fresh when on a tight budget

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound to 1/2-inch thickness using a meat mallet.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour in one, beaten eggs in another, and panko mixed with 1/4 cup Parmesan in the third.
Coat each chicken breast in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, then coat in breadcrumb mixture.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden, then transfer to a baking dish.
Spread 1 cup marinara sauce over the chicken, then top with mozzarella and remaining Parmesan.
Bake at 400°F for 10-12 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly, then serve with remaining marinara sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand marinara sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Quesadilla
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat and lightly butter one side of a tortilla.
Place the tortilla buttered-side down on the skillet, then sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on half of it.
Top the cheese with 1/4 cup chicken and 1/4 of the diced peppers and onion, then fold the tortilla in half.
Cook for 3-4 minutes until the bottom is golden and crispy, then flip and cook the other side for 2-3 minutes until cheese melts.
Transfer to a cutting board and repeat with remaining tortillas and filling.
Cut quesadillas into triangles and serve with salsa and sour cream on the side.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the store instead of cooking from scratch
Buy cheese in blocks and shred it yourself to save money

recipes.name: Lasagna
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and cook lasagna noodles according to package directions, then drain and lay flat on parchment paper.
Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat with minced garlic, breaking it apart as it cooks, then drain excess fat.
Stir in marinara sauce and simmer for 5 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Mix ricotta, 1 cup mozzarella, Parmesan, and egg in a bowl until well combined.
Spread a thin layer of meat sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish, then layer 3 noodles, half the ricotta mixture, and one-third of the meat sauce.
Add 3 more noodles, remaining ricotta mixture, and another third of meat sauce, then top with final 3 noodles and remaining meat sauce.
Sprinkle remaining mozzarella over the top and cover with foil, then bake for 25 minutes covered and 10-15 minutes uncovered until cheese is bubbly.
Let rest for 10 minutes before cutting and serving.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions
Use store-brand cheese and sauce to reduce costs

recipes.name: Buffalo Wings
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Toss wings in flour until evenly coated, shaking off any excess.
Heat oil in a large pot or deep skillet to 350°F, then carefully add wings in batches and fry for 12-15 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Drain wings on paper towels for 2-3 minutes.
Combine hot sauce and melted butter in a large bowl, then add drained wings and toss until fully coated.
Cut celery into sticks and serve wings alongside celery and bleu cheese dressing for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy wings during sports season when they often go on sale
Make your own dressing by mixing sour cream with hot sauce instead of buying bottled

recipes.name: Sloppy Joe
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add ground beef with diced onion, cooking for 5-7 minutes until beef is browned and onion is softened.
Drain excess grease from the beef mixture.
Stir in ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar, and Worcestershire sauce, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes until thickened.
Lightly butter the inside of hamburger buns and toast them in a skillet or toaster oven until golden.
Spoon the beef mixture onto the toasted buns and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand ketchup and Worcestershire sauce
Use hamburger buns from the discount bread section if available

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken Bowl
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions and set aside.
Whisk together soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger in a bowl to make the teriyaki sauce.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add chicken cubes, cooking for 6-8 minutes until lightly browned on all sides.
Add broccoli florets to the skillet with chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes until broccoli is tender-crisp.
Pour teriyaki sauce over the chicken and broccoli, stirring well to coat, then cook for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Divide cooked rice among bowls and top with teriyaki chicken and broccoli mixture.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over each bowl before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts to save money with similar results
Use frozen broccoli instead of fresh to save 30-40%

recipes.name: Baked Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and cook macaroni according to package directions until al dente, then drain.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat, then whisk in flour to create a roux and cook for 2 minutes while stirring.
Gradually add milk while whisking constantly to avoid lumps, then heat until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar and Gruyere cheese until melted and smooth, then season with salt and pepper.
Combine cooked pasta with cheese sauce and transfer to a buttered 9x13 baking dish.
Mix panko breadcrumbs with melted butter and Parmesan, then sprinkle evenly over the pasta.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbling at the edges, then let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use all cheddar cheese instead of mixing with Gruyere for savings
Make your own breadcrumb topping from stale bread instead of buying panko

recipes.name: Chicken Nuggets
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into nugget-sized pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour in one, beaten eggs in another, and panko in the third.
Coat each piece in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, then coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry nuggets in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Drain cooked nuggets on paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with honey mustard and ketchup for dipping.
cheapTips: Pound chicken breasts thin and cut into more pieces to stretch further
Make dipping sauces at home by mixing mayo with honey and mustard powder

recipes.name: Tuna Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut sushi-grade tuna into 1-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and sriracha.
Pour marinade over tuna and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Divide cooked sushi rice between two bowls.
Top rice with marinated tuna and arrange cucumber, avocado, and seaweed salad around it.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and green onions over the bowl.
Drizzle extra marinade on top and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy tuna from a reputable grocery store fish counter; ask for sushi-grade and ask about sales
Make your own sushi rice the day before to save on takeout costs

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, cumin, black pepper, and olive oil in a bowl.
Cut chicken breasts into thin strips and coat with the marinade.
Refrigerate for at least 20 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook marinated chicken for 8-10 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Warm pita bread in the oven or on a skillet for 1-2 minutes.
Assemble shawarma by filling warm pita with chicken, tomato, and red onion.
Drizzle with tahini and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken and butcher it yourself instead of buying pre-cut breasts
Make tahini sauce at home by blending sesame paste with lemon juice and water

recipes.name: Beef Stir Fry with Broccoli
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss sliced beef with cornstarch and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Cook beef in batches for 2-3 minutes until browned, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry broccoli and red pepper for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return beef to the pan and add garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, and water together, then pour into the pan.
Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until sauce coats the ingredients.
Serve over cooked rice immediately.
cheapTips: Buy beef on sale and freeze it; slice it partially frozen for easier cutting
Buy pre-cut broccoli florets to save prep time and reduce waste

recipes.name: Hard Boiled Eggs with Whole Wheat Toast
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a pot and carefully add eggs.
Once boiling, remove from heat, cover, and let sit for 10 minutes.
Transfer eggs to an ice bath and let cool for 5 minutes.
Peel cooled eggs and slice them in half.
Toast whole wheat bread until golden brown.
Butter the toast while warm.
Arrange eggs and toast on a plate, season eggs with salt and pepper, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk; they're one of the cheapest proteins available
Buy store-brand whole wheat bread instead of premium varieties

recipes.name: Grilled Swordfish Steak
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat grill to medium-high heat and oil the grates.
Mix olive oil, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Brush both sides of swordfish steaks with the oil mixture.
Grill swordfish for 4-5 minutes per side until opaque and cooked through.
In the last 2 minutes, grill sliced zucchini and cherry tomatoes alongside the fish.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the cooked fish and vegetables.
Transfer to plates and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy swordfish when it's on sale and freeze for later use
Use frozen vegetables like zucchini and tomatoes to reduce cost

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix olive oil, lime juice, garlic, cumin, and chili powder in a bowl.
Toss sliced chicken with the marinade and let sit for 5 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken for 6-7 minutes until cooked through, then remove.
In the same skillet, cook sliced bell peppers and onions for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Return chicken to the pan and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a flame for 30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with the chicken mixture and serve with sour cream and salsa.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale and freeze in portions
Make your own salsa from canned tomatoes, onion, and cilantro

recipes.name: Protein Energy Balls
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rolled oats, peanut butter, honey, chocolate chips, flaxseed, vanilla, and salt in a large bowl.
Stir until everything is well combined and the mixture holds together.
Refrigerate mixture for 10 minutes to make it easier to handle.
Roll the mixture into 1-inch balls using your hands.
Place balls on a parchment-lined tray and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to one week.
cheapTips: Buy oats and peanut butter in bulk from warehouse stores
Use store-brand chocolate chips instead of name-brand

recipes.name: Baked Tilapia with Quinoa
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and cook quinoa according to package directions in a pot with water or broth.
Place tilapia fillets on a parchment-lined baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil.
Sprinkle garlic, dill, salt, and pepper over the fillets.
Squeeze lemon juice over the fish and arrange asparagus around it.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until tilapia flakes easily with a fork.
Fluff cooked quinoa with a fork and divide among plates.
Serve tilapia and asparagus alongside quinoa with extra lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy frozen tilapia when on sale; it thaws quickly and works just as well
Buy quinoa in bulk bins instead of pre-packaged boxes

recipes.name: Turkey Chili
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown ground turkey with diced onion, breaking it up as it cooks for 5-6 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes with juice and drained kidney beans.
Bring to a simmer and reduce heat to medium-low.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed, then serve with sour cream on top.
cheapTips: Buy ground turkey when on sale and freeze in 1-pound portions
Use canned beans and tomatoes; they're cheaper than fresh and very nutritious

recipes.name: Grilled Pork Tenderloin
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove pork tenderloin from refrigerator and let it come to room temperature for 10 minutes.
Mix olive oil, minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Rub the herb mixture all over the pork tenderloin.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Grill pork for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until the internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Mix honey and balsamic vinegar together and brush over the pork in the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy pork tenderloin when on sale and freeze; it's versatile and lasts a long time
Use dried herbs like rosemary and thyme instead of fresh if budget is tight

recipes.name: Whey Protein Pancakes
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, whey protein powder, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk eggs, milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract together in another bowl.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just blended; do not overmix.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook until bubbles form on top, about 2 minutes.
Flip and cook the other side until golden, about 1.5 minutes.
Transfer to a plate and serve warm with maple syrup.
cheapTips: Buy whey protein powder in bulk online for better pricing
Use store-brand flour and baking powder to reduce costs

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Kebabs with Rice
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into 1.5-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper, then pour over chicken and marinate for 15 minutes.
Thread chicken, onion, and bell pepper onto metal skewers alternately.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat and grill kebabs for 12-15 minutes, turning every 3 minutes, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, rinse rice and bring chicken broth to a boil in a pot.
Add rice to boiling broth, stir once, cover, and reduce heat to low.
Simmer rice for 18 minutes until tender and liquid is absorbed.
Serve kebabs over the rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Use budget rice varieties instead of premium options

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook pasta according to package directions until al dente.
Heat butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes, cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes per side until starting to turn pink.
Pour in white wine and lemon juice, scraping up any browned bits from the pan.
Simmer for 3-4 minutes until shrimp are fully cooked and sauce reduces slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Drain pasta and toss with shrimp and sauce, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk and thaw as needed
Substitute dry white wine or skip entirely to save money

recipes.name: Stir-Fried Beef with Broccoli
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss beef slices with cornstarch and 1 tablespoon soy sauce in a bowl.
Heat 1.5 tablespoons vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until smoking.
Add beef in batches and cook for 2 minutes per batch until browned, then set aside.
Add remaining oil to the wok and stir-fry broccoli for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add minced garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return beef to the wok and add remaining soy sauce, water, and sesame oil.
Toss everything together and cook for 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Serve over steamed white rice.
cheapTips: Buy beef when on sale and freeze for later
Use frozen broccoli to save money and prep time

recipes.name: Fish Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix olive oil, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper, then rub on fish fillets.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook fish for 4-5 minutes per side until flaky.
Break the cooked fish into bite-sized pieces.
Toss shredded cabbage with juice from 1 lime and a pinch of salt.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 20 seconds per side.
Mix sour cream with cilantro and juice from the second lime.
Assemble tacos by placing fish on each tortilla and topping with cabbage, avocado, and cilantro-lime cream.
cheapTips: Use frozen white fish fillets on sale
Buy cabbage and avocados at farmers markets for better prices

recipes.name: Chicken Piccata
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound to 1/2-inch thickness.
Season chicken with salt and pepper, then dredge lightly in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown, then transfer to a plate.
Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and capers to the same skillet and scrape up browned bits.
Simmer sauce for 2-3 minutes, then return chicken to the pan.
Cook for 1-2 minutes more until chicken is cooked through.
Plate chicken over pasta or rice, pour sauce on top, and garnish with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze individual portions
Make your own chicken broth from bones to save money

recipes.name: Carbonara
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, fry diced pancetta in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Whisk eggs in a bowl with grated cheese and freshly ground black pepper.
Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water, then drain spaghetti.
Remove skillet from heat and add hot spaghetti and pancetta, tossing quickly.
Pour egg mixture over pasta and toss constantly, adding pasta water a little at a time until creamy (do not scramble eggs).
Serve immediately with additional cheese and black pepper.
cheapTips: Use bacon instead of pancetta to reduce cost
Buy eggs and pasta in bulk for better pricing

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Asian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until very hot.
Add chicken pieces and stir-fry for 5-6 minutes until no longer pink, then remove and set aside.
Add more oil if needed and stir-fry vegetables for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return chicken to the wok and add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 30 seconds.
Mix soy sauce, cornstarch, and water together and pour into the wok.
Toss everything together and cook for 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens and coats all ingredients.
Transfer to a serving plate, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve over rice.
cheapTips: Use frozen mixed vegetables to save prep time and money
Buy chicken breasts in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Tuna Poke
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut sushi-grade tuna into 3/4-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, ginger, and garlic.
Pour marinade over tuna and gently toss to coat, then refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Divide sushi rice between two bowls.
Top each bowl with marinated tuna and arrange avocado slices on the side.
Garnish with sliced green onion and sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Buy sushi-grade tuna at Costco or Asian markets for better prices
Make rice at home instead of buying pre-cooked

recipes.name: Bruschetta
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and brush baguette slices on both sides with 1.5 tablespoons olive oil.
Toast bread slices in the oven for 5-7 minutes until golden and crispy.
Immediately rub the hot toasted bread with cut garlic cloves.
Mix diced tomatoes, fresh basil, remaining olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Let tomato mixture sit for 3-5 minutes so flavors meld.
Spoon tomato topping generously onto each garlic-rubbed toast.
Serve immediately while bread is still warm.
cheapTips: Buy tomatoes during peak season and freeze for later use
Make bruschetta with day-old bread from the bakery section

recipes.name: Pesto Pasta
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook pasta until al dente.
While pasta cooks, add basil, garlic, pine nuts, and parmesan to a food processor.
Pulse ingredients until coarsely chopped, then stream in olive oil while processing until you reach desired consistency.
Stir in lemon juice and season with salt and pepper.
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Toss pasta with pesto in a large bowl, adding pasta water a little at a time until you reach your preferred sauce consistency.
Serve immediately with extra parmesan and cracked pepper.
cheapTips: Use walnuts instead of pine nuts to save 50%
Buy basil in bulk during summer and freeze in ice cube trays with olive oil

recipes.name: Vietnamese Banh Mi
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice baguette lengthwise and lightly butter the inside.
Toast baguette in a 350°F oven for 5 minutes until lightly crispy.
Spread mayonnaise on one side and pâté on the other side of the toasted baguette.
Toss shredded chicken with soy sauce and layer it onto the baguette.
Top chicken with pickled vegetables, cucumber slices, cilantro, and jalapeño.
Cut sandwich in half and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make your own pickled vegetables with vinegar, sugar, and salt
Substitute deli ham for pâté to cut costs in half

recipes.name: Frittata
recipes.description: Italian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Heat butter in a 10-inch cast iron skillet over medium heat and sauté peppers and onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Whisk together eggs, heavy cream, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Pour egg mixture over vegetables in the skillet and sprinkle cheese on top.
Cook on stovetop for 3 minutes until edges begin to set, then transfer to oven.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until center is just set and top is lightly golden.
Slice into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use frozen spinach instead of fresh to save money
Buy eggs in bulk when on sale and store in the refrigerator

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Salmon
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove salmon from refrigerator 10 minutes before cooking to reach room temperature.
Pat salmon dry with paper towels and season both sides generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Place salmon skin-side up in the pan and cook for 4 minutes without moving until skin is crispy.
Flip salmon and add butter, thyme, and garlic to the pan.
Cook for 3 minutes, spooning butter over the fillets continuously.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over salmon and serve immediately with pan sauce.
cheapTips: Buy salmon when on sale and freeze for later use
Use frozen salmon fillets which are often cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Tiramisu
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk egg yolks with sugar over a double boiler until pale and warm (160°F), then remove from heat.
Fold in mascarpone cheese and vanilla extract until smooth.
Whip heavy cream to stiff peaks and fold gently into mascarpone mixture.
Combine cooled espresso with coffee liqueur in a shallow dish.
Quickly dip each ladyfinger into espresso mixture for 1 second per side and arrange in a single layer in a 9x13 dish.
Spread half of mascarpone cream over ladyfinger layer.
Repeat with another layer of dipped ladyfingers and remaining cream.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Dust generously with cocoa powder just before serving.
cheapTips: Skip the coffee liqueur and add instant coffee to espresso instead
Buy mascarpone when on sale and freeze for up to 3 months

recipes.name: Crème Brûlée
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale, then slowly stream in hot cream while whisking constantly.
Strain mixture through a fine sieve into a bowl, add vanilla and salt, and let cool slightly.
Pour custard into four ramekins and place in a water bath with hot water reaching halfway up the sides.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until edges are set but center jiggles slightly when shaken.
Chill ramekins for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight.
Sprinkle 1/2 tbsp sugar on each custard and caramelize with a torch until golden and crackly.
Serve immediately after caramelizing.
cheapTips: Use a kitchen torch from a hardware store instead of specialty kitchen torches
Make a homemade water bath instead of buying one

recipes.name: Baklava
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and butter a 9x13 baking dish.
Mix chopped walnuts with cinnamon in a bowl.
Lay one phyllo sheet in baking dish and brush lightly with melted butter.
Repeat with 5 more phyllo sheets, brushing each with butter.
Sprinkle 1/3 of walnut mixture evenly over phyllo.
Layer 3 more buttered phyllo sheets and another 1/3 of walnuts; repeat with final 3 phyllo sheets and remaining walnuts.
Top with 5-6 final buttered phyllo sheets.
Cut baklava into diamond or triangle shapes with a sharp knife, cutting all the way through to the bottom.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden brown.
While baking, heat honey, water, sugar, and lemon juice to a gentle simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour hot syrup over hot baked baklava immediately after removing from oven and let cool completely.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough in bulk and freeze extra sheets for future use
Use honey that's crystallized or close to expiration date when on deep discount

recipes.name: Macarons
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 300°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Pulse almond flour and 1 cup powdered sugar together until very fine, then sift to remove lumps.
Beat egg whites to soft peaks, then gradually add granulated sugar while beating to stiff peaks.
Add vanilla and food coloring to egg whites and fold gently.
Fold almond flour mixture into egg whites in three additions, stirring until mixture flows like lava and peaks disappear.
Transfer batter to piping bag with round tip and pipe 1-inch rounds onto parchment, 1 inch apart.
Tap baking sheet firmly on counter to release air bubbles, then let rest for 30 minutes.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until shells are set and have developed feet.
Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack.
Beat butter with 1/2 cup powdered sugar to make filling, then pipe between cooled shells.
cheapTips: Buy almond flour in bulk online for half the grocery store price
Use egg whites from cartons instead of separating eggs yourself

recipes.name: Black Forest Cake
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease two 9-inch round cake pans.
Whisk together flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk eggs, buttermilk, oil, and vanilla until smooth.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Stir in hot coffee until batter is thin.
Divide batter between prepared pans and bake for 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pans for 15 minutes, then turn out onto wire racks to cool completely.
Whip heavy cream with powdered sugar to stiff peaks.
Place one cake layer on a cake plate and spread with whipped cream, then layer on drained cherries.
Place second cake layer on top and frost entire cake with remaining whipped cream.
Garnish top and sides with chocolate chips and whole cherries, then refrigerate until serving.
cheapTips: Use canned cherries instead of fresh to save significantly on cost
Substitute chocolate shavings from a bar instead of expensive chocolate chips

recipes.name: Pavlova
recipes.description: Australian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 300°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Beat egg whites with an electric mixer on high speed until soft peaks form.
Gradually add granulated sugar 1 tablespoon at a time while beating, until stiff glossy peaks form.
Gently fold in vinegar, cornstarch, and vanilla extract with a spatula.
Spread or pipe meringue into a 9-inch circle on prepared baking sheet, creating a slight well in the center.
Bake for 50-60 minutes until pale golden and crispy on the outside but still soft in the center.
Turn off oven and cool pavlova in the oven for 30 minutes with door ajar.
Whip heavy cream with powdered sugar to stiff peaks.
Top cooled pavlova with whipped cream and fresh berries just before serving.
cheapTips: Buy berries when in season and freeze for year-round use
Use store brand whipped cream instead of making your own

recipes.name: Cannoli
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, and salt in a bowl, then cut in cold butter until breadcrumb texture forms.
Add egg yolk and mix until dough comes together, then knead briefly and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll dough thin on floured surface and cut into 3-inch squares.
Wrap each square around a metal cannoli form and seal edges with water.
Heat oil to 375°F and fry filled forms until golden, about 2 minutes per side.
Cool on paper towels, then carefully slide tubes off the forms.
Mix ricotta, powdered sugar, vanilla, and chocolate chips together.
Pipe ricotta filling into cooled shells just before serving.
cheapTips: Buy ricotta in bulk from warehouse stores
Make cannoli tubes from aluminum foil instead of buying forms

recipes.name: Mille-feuille
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thaw puff pastry according to package directions and preheat oven to 400°F.
Bake puff pastry sheets on lined baking sheets for 15-20 minutes until golden and crispy.
Heat milk in a saucepan until steaming, then whisk together egg yolks, sugar, and cornstarch.
Slowly add hot milk to egg mixture while whisking constantly, then return to pan and cook over medium heat until thick, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat, stir in butter and vanilla, then press plastic wrap directly onto custard and cool completely.
Mix powdered sugar and water to create a thin glaze and spread over cooled pastry sheets.
Layer pastry sheet, custard, pastry sheet, custard, then top with final pastry sheet.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, then cut into portions with a sharp serrated knife.
cheapTips: Use store-brand frozen puff pastry instead of all-butter versions
Skip the glaze and dust with powdered sugar to save time

recipes.name: Lamington
recipes.description: Australian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a square baking pan with parchment paper.
Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, then beat in eggs one at a time.
Mix flour and baking powder together, then alternately add dry ingredients and milk to the butter mixture.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely, then cut into 2-inch squares.
Sift together cocoa powder and powdered sugar, then add enough water to make a thick dipping sauce.
Place shredded coconut in a shallow dish.
Dip each cake square into chocolate mixture until coated, then immediately roll in coconut and place on parchment to set.
cheapTips: Buy unsweetened shredded coconut in bulk
Use store-brand cocoa powder

recipes.name: Profiteroles
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Bring water and butter to a boil in a saucepan, then remove from heat and stir in flour until it forms a ball.
Cool slightly, then beat in eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Transfer dough to a piping bag and pipe small mounds onto prepared baking sheets.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until puffed and golden, then cool completely on wire racks.
Slice off tops of profiteroles and fill each with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
Melt chocolate chips with cream and butter over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Replace tops and drizzle with warm chocolate sauce just before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand ice cream to reduce cost
Make chocolate sauce with cocoa powder instead of chocolate chips

recipes.name: Panettone
recipes.description: Italian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix yeast with warm milk and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy, then add to flour mixture with sugar, salt, and eggs.
Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth, then gradually add softened butter while kneading.
Continue kneading until dough is elastic and light, then fold in raisins and candied peel.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 2 hours until doubled.
Shape dough into a round loaf and place in a panettone mold or tall cake pan lined with parchment.
Cover and let rise for 90 minutes until dough rises above the pan edges.
Preheat oven to 375°F and bake panettone for 40-50 minutes until a skewer inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 15 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
cheapTips: Use dried cranberries and orange peel instead of expensive candied citrus
Substitute regular raisins for golden raisins

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix milk powder, flour, and baking powder in a bowl, then add melted butter and enough milk to form a soft dough.
Divide dough into small balls about the size of walnuts and set aside.
Bring sugar and water to a boil in a saucepan, add crushed cardamom pods, then remove from heat and stir in rose water.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan, then carefully add gulab jamun in small batches without crowding.
Fry until deep golden brown on all sides, turning occasionally, about 5-7 minutes per batch.
Remove with a slotted spoon and immediately place into warm sugar syrup.
Let soak in syrup for at least 30 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Make your own milk powder by evaporating regular milk
Skip rose water and use vanilla extract instead

recipes.name: Mochi
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix mochiko flour and sugar in a microwave-safe bowl, then add water and stir until smooth.
Microwave on high for 2 minutes, stir well, then microwave for another 2 minutes until the mixture becomes thick and glossy.
Remove from microwave and stir in coconut extract, then let cool for 5 minutes.
Dust a work surface generously with cornstarch to prevent sticking.
Pour mochi mixture onto cornstarch surface and dust the top with additional cornstarch.
Once cool enough to handle, knead gently for about 1 minute until smooth.
Roll out to about 1/4-inch thickness and cut into 1.5-inch squares or use a cookie cutter.
Roll each piece in shredded coconut to coat all sides, then place on parchment paper to cool.
cheapTips: Buy mochiko flour at Asian markets for better prices
Use unsweetened shredded coconut in bulk

recipes.name: Tres Leches Cake
recipes.description: Latin American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 baking pan.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt together in a bowl.
Beat 5 eggs with sugar until pale and thick, then gently fold in flour mixture and milk.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
