recipes.description: Okinawan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut konnyaku into rectangular pieces, blanch in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Cut carrot and daikon into bite-sized chunks.
Bring dashi stock to a boil in a pot over medium-high heat.
Add konnyaku, carrot, and daikon, then reduce heat to medium and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add soy sauce, mirin, and sugar, stirring gently.
Simmer for another 5 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with sliced green onion before serving.
cheapTips: Make dashi from kombu and bonito flakes instead of buying instant
Buy konnyaku in bulk at Asian markets

recipes.name: Tougama
recipes.description: Okinawan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork into chunks and blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse.
In a pot, combine water and kombu, bringing to a boil, then remove kombu.
Add blanched pork and sliced ginger to the broth, reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add winter melon cubes and continue simmering for 15 minutes until melon is tender.
Season with soy sauce and salt, adjusting to taste.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with sliced green onion.
cheapTips: Buy pork ribs when on sale and freeze
Winter melon is seasonal and cheapest in winter months

recipes.name: Chongqing Pork Intestines
recipes.description: Sichuan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil pork intestines in salted water for 25 minutes until tender, then slice into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and toast Sichuan peppercorns and dried chilies for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Add intestine pieces and stir-fry for 2 minutes to coat with spices.
Pour in soy sauce, chicken broth, and sugar, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional soy sauce if needed.
Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with fresh scallions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy pork intestines from Asian markets where they are significantly cheaper than Western butchers
Toast your own Sichuan peppercorns and dry chilies rather than buying pre-mixed spice blends

recipes.name: Sichuan Dumplings in Chili Oil
recipes.description: Sichuan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a large pot and add frozen dumplings, stirring gently.
Cook for 5-7 minutes until dumplings float and cook for another 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat and add dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns.
Toast spices for 2-3 minutes until fragrant, then remove from heat and stir in minced garlic.
Add soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil to the chili oil mixture.
Place cooked dumplings in a serving bowl and pour the warm chili oil mixture over them.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Use frozen dumplings from Asian markets to save significantly on prep time and cost
Make chili oil in bulk and store in a jar for multiple meals throughout the week

recipes.name: Numbing and Spicy Beef Tendon
recipes.description: Sichuan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch beef tendon in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain, and rinse thoroughly under cold water.
Heat oil in a large pot over high heat and toast Sichuan peppercorns, dried chilies, and star anise for 2 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add beef tendon pieces and cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in soy sauce and chicken broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 1.5 hours until tendon is very tender.
Check tenderness with a fork; meat should shred easily when done.
Drizzle with sesame oil, garnish with scallions, and serve hot in bowls with cooking liquid.
cheapTips: Buy beef tendon in bulk from Asian butchers at a fraction of standard butcher prices
This dish actually improves when reheated the next day, making it great for batch cooking

recipes.name: Sichuan Wontons in Chili Oil
recipes.description: Sichuan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a large pot and carefully add frozen wontons.
Stir gently and cook for 4-5 minutes until wontons float, then cook 1 additional minute.
Drain wontons and set aside in a serving bowl.
Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat and add dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns.
Toast spices for 2 minutes until fragrant, remove from heat, and stir in minced garlic.
Add soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil to the chili oil mixture and stir well.
Pour warm chili oil over wontons and garnish with scallions and cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen wontons in bulk from Asian grocery stores for the best price
Prepare the chili oil ahead of time and reheat gently when ready to eat

recipes.name: Spicy Bean Sprouts
recipes.description: Sichuan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse bean sprouts and drain thoroughly in a colander.
Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Add dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns, toasting for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add minced garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add bean sprouts and stir-fry vigorously for 3-4 minutes until heated through but still crisp.
Add soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil, tossing everything together for 1 minute.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with scallions before serving hot.
cheapTips: Bean sprouts are extremely inexpensive and cook quickly, making this one of the cheapest dishes
This recipe works well with any type of sprouts available at your grocery store

recipes.name: Chongqing Squid
recipes.description: Sichuan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat frozen squid rings dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a large wok over high heat until very hot.
Add dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns, toasting for 1-2 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger, stir-frying for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add squid rings in batches and cook for 2-3 minutes per batch until they turn opaque and slightly firm.
Return all squid to the wok and add soy sauce and rice vinegar, tossing for 1 minute.
Transfer to a serving bowl, garnish with scallions and sesame seeds, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen squid rings instead of fresh to save money and reduce prep work
Cook squid quickly over high heat to keep it tender; overcooking makes it rubbery

recipes.name: Sichuan Preserved Vegetables with Pork
recipes.description: Sichuan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add ground pork and break it apart with a spatula, cooking until browned and cooked through (about 5 minutes).
Add garlic and ginger, stir-frying for 30 seconds.
Add chopped preserved vegetables and stir-fry for 2 minutes to release flavors.
Add soy sauce, sugar, and water, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Drizzle with sesame oil and stir well.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with chopped scallions before serving.
cheapTips: Sichuan preserved vegetables are inexpensive in Asian markets and add huge flavor
Ground pork is usually cheaper than whole cuts and requires minimal preparation

recipes.name: Makki di Roti
recipes.description: Punjabi dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornmeal flour, all-purpose flour, salt, green chilies, and cumin seeds in a large bowl.
Add ghee and rub into the flour mixture until resembling breadcrumbs.
Gradually add warm water and knead into a soft dough, adding more water as needed.
Divide dough into 6-8 equal portions and shape into balls.
Heat a cast iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat until very hot.
Place a ball of dough between two pieces of plastic wrap and flatten into a thin disk about 8 inches wide.
Transfer to hot skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes until golden spots appear, then flip and cook the other side until crispy.
Brush with ghee immediately after cooking and serve hot.
cheapTips: Cornmeal flour is very affordable compared to wheat flour alternatives
Make several rotis in advance and reheat on a tawa or skillet before eating

recipes.name: Sarson da Saag
recipes.description: Punjabi dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat ghee in a large pot over medium heat and add diced onion, cooking until softened (about 3 minutes).
Add minced garlic, ginger, and green chilies, stir-frying for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chopped spinach, mustard greens, and fenugreek leaves in batches, stirring as they wilt.
Add water and salt, then bring to a boil and simmer for 20-25 minutes until greens are very soft.
Using an immersion blender, blend until greens are mostly smooth with some texture remaining.
Simmer for another 5-10 minutes and adjust salt to taste.
Serve hot in bowls with a dollop of ghee on top and crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Buy fresh greens in bulk at farmers markets or ethnic grocery stores for much lower prices
Frozen spinach works as a substitute when fresh is unavailable or too expensive

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka
recipes.description: Punjabi snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix yogurt, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, lemon juice, and salt in a bowl to create marinade.
Cut paneer into 1-inch cubes and add to marinade, coating well, then refrigerate for at least 15 minutes.
Cut bell pepper and red onion into 1-inch pieces.
Thread marinated paneer, bell pepper, and onion alternately onto metal skewers.
Heat oil in a large cast iron skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat until very hot.
Place skewers in hot pan and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning every 2 minutes until paneer develops golden-brown charred spots.
Transfer to a serving plate and serve hot with lemon wedges and mint chutney.
cheapTips: Buy paneer from Indian grocery stores instead of mainstream supermarkets for better prices
Make marinade with plain yogurt you already have at home rather than buying fancy versions

recipes.name: Amritsari Kulcha
recipes.description: Punjabi breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, yogurt, salt, baking soda, and 2 tablespoons oil in a bowl.
Add warm water gradually and knead into a smooth, soft dough; let rest 45 minutes covered.
Combine chopped onion, green chili, cilantro, and amchur powder in a small bowl for filling.
Divide dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into a thin circle.
Place 2 tablespoons filling in center of each circle, fold edges, and gently flatten.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a cast-iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Cook kulcha 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and puffed, pressing lightly with spatula.
Serve hot with butter, pickles, and chole (chickpeas).
cheapTips: Buy onions and cilantro in bulk from ethnic markets
Make your own yogurt or use store-brand plain yogurt

recipes.name: Pinni
recipes.description: Punjabi breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Add whole wheat flour and roast for 10-12 minutes, stirring constantly until golden and fragrant.
Add roasted cashews and raisins, stirring for 1 minute.
Crush jaggery into small pieces and add to the flour mixture.
Mix in ginger powder, cardamom powder, and milk powder until well combined.
Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes.
Shape mixture into small balls or patties while still warm.
Serve at room temperature as a sweet breakfast treat.
cheapTips: Use regular sugar instead of jaggery to reduce cost
Buy nuts in bulk and store in freezer

recipes.name: Halwa Puri
recipes.description: Punjabi breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and baking soda; knead with water to form stiff dough and let rest 30 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons ghee in a heavy pan over medium heat and add semolina, roasting 3-4 minutes.
Add remaining ghee and stir continuously for 8-10 minutes until semolina turns light golden brown.
In another pan, boil water with sugar and cloves for 5 minutes to make sugar syrup.
Slowly add hot syrup to roasted semolina while stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Stir in almonds and raisins, then cook for 2-3 minutes until halwa thickens; set aside.
Divide dough into 8 portions, roll into thin circles, and fry in 375°F oil until puffed and golden.
Serve hot puris with halwa on the side.
cheapTips: Buy semolina and raisins from Indian grocery stores at lower prices
Make puris ahead and store in airtight container for 2 days

recipes.name: Tandoori Fish
recipes.description: Punjabi dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat fish fillets dry with paper towels and place in a shallow dish.
Whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, tandoori masala, cayenne, and salt.
Coat fish fillets thoroughly with marinade and refrigerate for 20-30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Arrange marinated fish on baking sheet and drizzle with oil.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork.
In a pan, quickly sauté onion slices in 1 tablespoon oil until slightly charred, about 3 minutes.
Serve fish topped with sautéed onions and fresh cilantro with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy fish from Asian markets or when on sale and freeze
Make ginger-garlic paste at home in bulk

recipes.name: Pakora
recipes.description: Punjabi snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix besan, water, salt, turmeric, and red chili powder to form a thick batter.
Fold in green chili and cilantro into the batter.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan or wok.
Dip onion rings into batter, coating well on both sides.
Carefully place battered onion rings into hot oil, frying 5-6 at a time.
Fry for 2-3 minutes per batch until golden brown and crispy.
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with green chutney, tamarind chutney, or ketchup.
cheapTips: Buy besan in bulk from Indian grocery stores
Use leftover oil for future cooking to reduce waste

recipes.name: Paya
recipes.description: Punjabi lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean lamb trotters thoroughly under running water and chop into 2-inch pieces.
Blanch trotters in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse well.
Heat oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook for 5 minutes until golden, then add ginger and garlic, cooking 2 minutes.
Add tomato and cook for 3 minutes until softened, then add spices and stir for 1 minute.
Add blanched trotters to the pot and fry for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in 8 cups of water, bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 2.5-3 hours until meat is very tender.
Season with salt to taste and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving with naan or bread.
cheapTips: Buy trotters from halal or Indian butchers for better prices than regular supermarkets
Make a large batch and freeze portions for future meals

recipes.name: Nihari
recipes.description: Punjabi lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large heavy pot and brown meat on all sides for 8-10 minutes; set aside.
In the same pot, cook sliced onions until deep golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Return meat to pot and add nihari masala, stirring well for 2 minutes.
Pour in water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 90 minutes until meat is very tender.
Add lemon juice and adjust salt to taste.
Serve in bowls and top with julienned ginger, fresh cilantro, and mint.
Accompany with naan bread or rice for soaking up the rich gravy.
cheapTips: Buy chuck roast on sale and freeze in portions
Make nihari masala at home with individual spices for savings

recipes.name: Paneer Bhurji
recipes.description: Punjabi breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in minced ginger and green chili, cooking for 1 minute.
Add diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes until slightly soft.
Add crumbled paneer, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt to the skillet.
Cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring frequently until paneer is heated through and slightly browned.
Fold in fresh cilantro and cook for 30 seconds.
Serve hot with roti, paratha, or toast for breakfast.
cheapTips: Buy paneer from Indian grocery stores at lower cost than regular supermarkets
Use store-brand paneer if premium brands are too expensive

recipes.name: Lassi
recipes.description: Punjabi snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add yogurt, cold water, sugar, salt, and cardamom to a blender.
Blend until smooth and frothy, about 1-2 minutes.
Add ice cubes and blend for another 30 seconds.
Pour into tall glasses immediately.
Garnish with rose petals and almond slivers if using.
Serve immediately while cold and frothy.
cheapTips: Skip rose petals and almonds garnish to save money
Make with store-brand yogurt instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Papadum
recipes.description: Punjabi snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a deep pan or wok to 350°F.
Carefully drop one papadum wafer into the hot oil.
Within 2-3 seconds, use tongs to flip and hold it down slightly as it expands and crisps.
Remove after total of 4-5 seconds when fully puffed and light golden.
Drain on paper towels immediately.
Repeat with remaining wafers.
Serve as a crispy snack or side dish with Indian meals.
Store cooled papadums in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.
cheapTips: Buy store-made papadums from Indian stores instead of making from scratch
Reuse frying oil for future cooking to save money

recipes.name: Goya Champuru
recipes.description: Okinawan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Halve the bitter melon lengthwise, scoop out seeds, and slice thinly into half-moons.
Pat tofu dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes.
Dice the Spam into small cubes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and stir-fry the bitter melon for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add tofu cubes and Spam, cooking for 2 minutes while stirring gently.
Push ingredients to the side, crack eggs into the pan, scramble lightly, then mix everything together.
Pour soy sauce and mirin over the mixture, toss to combine, and season with salt.
Cook for 1-2 minutes more until eggs are just set, then serve immediately topped with bonito flakes if desired.
cheapTips: Buy Spam in bulk from warehouse stores to reduce cost per can
Bitter melon is cheapest at Asian markets in late summer

recipes.name: Okinawa Soba
recipes.description: Okinawan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Simmer pork in water for 25-30 minutes until tender, then slice into thin pieces.
In a pot, heat dashi or chicken broth with soy sauce, mirin, and salt, adjusting seasoning to taste.
Cook soba noodles in boiling salted water according to package directions, drain and rinse with cold water.
Divide cooked noodles between two bowls.
Ladle hot broth over the noodles, dividing equally.
Top each bowl with pork slices, fish cake, green onion, and pickled ginger.
Sprinkle bonito flakes over each bowl and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular ramen noodles instead of soba to reduce costs
Make broth from chicken bones or use store-bought broth to save time and money

recipes.name: Rafute
recipes.description: Okinawan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork belly into 2-inch cubes, keeping the skin intact.
Blanch pork cubes in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse well.
In a large pot, combine water, soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, and smashed ginger.
Add blanched pork to the pot and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer covered for 60-70 minutes until pork is very tender and skin is soft.
Add sliced green onion and mustard greens in the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Transfer pork and vegetables to a serving dish, strain cooking liquid, and pour it over as a glaze.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly at Asian markets where it is significantly cheaper than Western butchers
Make extra and freeze portions for future meals to amortize cooking time

recipes.name: Taco Rice
recipes.description: Okinawan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add taco seasoning and water to the beef, stirring well, and simmer for 5 minutes until sauce thickens.
Divide cooked rice between two bowls or plates.
Top rice with seasoned ground beef.
Layer shredded cheese, chopped lettuce, and diced tomato over the beef.
Drizzle sour cream and salsa over the top.
Serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Use store-brand taco seasoning and budget salsa to save money
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for future use

recipes.name: Mimiga
recipes.description: Okinawan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil and blanch pork ears for 2-3 minutes, then remove and scrub off any hair or residue under running water.
Return cleaned ears to fresh boiling water with salt and simmer for 30-35 minutes until very tender.
Drain ears, cool, and slice into thin strips about 1/4-inch thick.
In a bowl, combine rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and chili oil.
Add sliced ears to the dressing and mix gently but thoroughly.
Top with chopped green onion and sesame seeds.
Serve at room temperature or chilled as a salad.
cheapTips: Asian butcher shops sell pork ears for a fraction of Western butcher prices
Buy in bulk from Asian markets for additional savings

recipes.name: Umi Budo
recipes.description: Okinawan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using dried sea grapes, rehydrate in water for 5-10 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, mirin, and sesame oil to make dressing.
Gently toss sea grapes with the dressing in a serving bowl.
Sprinkle sesame seeds, green onion, and bonito flakes over the top.
Serve immediately, chilled or at room temperature, as a salad or appetizer.
cheapTips: Dried sea grapes are much cheaper than fresh and have better shelf life
Check Asian markets for the best prices on specialty seaweed products

recipes.name: Sata Andagi
recipes.description: Okinawan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, beat eggs with vanilla extract.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, stirring until a stiff dough forms.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or deep fryer.
Using a small spoon or cookie scoop, carefully drop balls of dough into hot oil.
Fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and puffed, turning occasionally.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Dust warm donuts with powdered sugar and serve.
cheapTips: Buy powdered sugar in bulk and store in an airtight container
Reuse frying oil if not too discolored by straining through cheesecloth

recipes.name: Chiragashi
recipes.description: Okinawan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: While rice is still warm, season with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, and let cool slightly.
Sauté mushrooms and carrot in a skillet with soy sauce and dashi for 3-4 minutes.
In a separate pan, lightly beat and cook egg into thin crepes, then slice into strips.
Cook green peas in boiling salted water for 2-3 minutes, then drain.
Divide seasoned rice between two bowls.
Arrange cooked mushrooms, carrot, egg strips, peas, and green onion on top of rice.
Serve warm or at room temperature with extra soy sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy mushrooms when on sale and slice them yourself to save money
Use frozen peas instead of fresh to reduce cost and prep time

recipes.name: Goya Tempura
recipes.description: Okinawan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut bitter melon in half, remove seeds, and slice into 1/4-inch thick rings.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, beat egg and mix with ice water.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, stirring until just blended; do not overmix.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or deep fryer.
Dip melon slices in batter, coating completely, and carefully place in hot oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy, turning once.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Make batter in small batches to keep it cold for crispier results
Reuse frying oil by storing in a cool, dark place between uses

recipes.name: Ishikari Nabe
recipes.description: Okinawan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut salmon into 2-inch chunks, removing any bones.
Bring broth to a boil in a large pot, then reduce to a simmer.
Stir miso paste and minced ginger into the simmering broth until dissolved.
Add cabbage, carrot, and mushrooms, simmering for 5-7 minutes until softened.
Add salmon pieces and tofu cubes, and simmer for 8-10 minutes until salmon is cooked through.
Season with sake and soy sauce to taste.
Top with sliced green onion just before serving.
Serve hot in individual bowls with broth.
cheapTips: Buy salmon on sale and freeze for use later
Use regular mushrooms instead of shiitake to reduce ingredient costs

recipes.name: Hunan Pickled Vegetables with Chili
recipes.description: Hunan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine rice vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in a pot and bring to a boil.
Add garlic, ginger, red pepper flakes, and Sichuan peppercorns to the hot liquid and stir well.
Remove from heat and let the brine cool for 10 minutes.
Pack chopped napa cabbage and sliced jalapeños into a clean glass jar.
Pour the cooled pickling liquid over the vegetables until fully submerged.
Drizzle sesame oil on top and stir gently.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving, or up to 2 weeks.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables in bulk and preserve larger batches at once
Use apple cider vinegar instead of rice vinegar for savings

recipes.name: Spicy Stir-Fried Frog Legs
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat frog legs dry with paper towels and season lightly with salt.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Add frog legs and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until lightly browned, then set aside.
In the same wok, add garlic, ginger, and red chilies, stirring constantly for 30 seconds.
Return frog legs to the wok and add soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and broth.
Stir-fry for 6-8 minutes until frog legs are cooked through and sauce reduces slightly.
Toss in green onions and stir well for 1 minute before serving.
cheapTips: Source frog legs from Asian markets for better prices than specialty shops
Buy whole dried chilies instead of fresh for longer shelf life

recipes.name: Hunan Chicken with Black Beans and Chili
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss chicken cubes with salt and cornstarch until lightly coated.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry chicken until golden, about 5 minutes, then remove.
Add garlic, ginger, red chilies, and black beans to the wok, stirring for 1 minute.
Return chicken to the wok and add soy sauce, vinegar, and broth.
Simmer for 8-10 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce slightly thickens.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze in portions for year-round savings
Use canned fermented black beans instead of jarred for cost reduction

recipes.name: Aloo Dum
recipes.description: Bengali lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and add cumin seeds until fragrant.
Add sliced onions and fry until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and green chilies, cooking for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree and all spice powders, stirring constantly for 2 minutes.
Add potatoes and coat well with the spice mixture, then add water.
Cover the pot and cook on medium heat for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender.
Add garam masala, adjust salt, and cook uncovered for 2 more minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk from warehouse stores for significant savings
Make your own ginger-garlic paste in batches instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Shorshe Ilish
recipes.description: Bengali lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak mustard seeds in water for 10 minutes, then grind to a coarse paste.
Heat oil in a shallow pan and fry onions until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add turmeric, ginger, and green chilies to the pan, stirring for 1 minute.
Gently place fish fillets into the pan without breaking them.
Spread the mustard paste over the fish and add the remaining water carefully.
Cover and cook on medium-low heat for 15 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Drizzle mustard oil over the top and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen hilsa when fresh is unavailable for consistent pricing
Make mustard paste in bulk and refrigerate for multiple meals

recipes.name: Chingri Malai Curry
recipes.description: Bengali lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pan and fry onions until light golden, about 4 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies, stirring for 1 minute.
Mix in turmeric, cumin, and coriander powders, cooking for 30 seconds.
Add tomato puree and simmer for 3 minutes until oil separates from spices.
Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes, stirring gently.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer for 8-10 minutes until shrimp are cooked.
Add salt to taste, garnish with cilantro, and serve with rice or naan.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk during sales for better value
Use lite coconut milk to reduce cost while maintaining flavor

recipes.name: Labra
recipes.description: Bengali lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan and add cumin seeds until they crackle.
Add minced ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add all diced vegetables and stir well for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle turmeric and red chili powder, mixing thoroughly.
Add water and salt, then cover and cook on medium heat for 12-15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir occasionally to ensure even cooking and prevent sticking.
Serve hot as a side dish with rice or as a light main course.
cheapTips: Use seasonal vegetables for best pricing and freshness
Buy pre-cut vegetables if time is limited, though whole vegetables save money

recipes.name: Begun Bhaja
recipes.description: Bengali snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat eggplant slices dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Mix turmeric, chili powder, salt, and nigella seeds in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a deep pan or wok until shimmering.
Coat eggplant slices lightly with the spice mixture on both sides.
Fry eggplant in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm as a side dish or snack.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants when in season for the lowest prices
Reuse frying oil multiple times if strained properly for cost savings

recipes.name: Doi Maach
recipes.description: Bengali lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk yogurt with turmeric, coriander, cumin, salt, ginger-garlic paste, and green chilies in a bowl.
Marinate fish fillets in half the yogurt mixture for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a shallow pan and fry onions until golden, about 5 minutes.
Gently place marinated fish into the pan and cook for 3 minutes on one side.
Flip fish carefully and add the remaining yogurt mixture around and over the fish.
Cover and cook on medium-low heat for 12-15 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro, alongside steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy white fish varieties like cod or tilapia on sale instead of premium types
Use plain store-brand yogurt for significant savings over specialty brands

recipes.name: Paturi
recipes.description: Bengali lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix mustard paste, ginger, green chilies, coconut, turmeric, salt, and mustard oil in a bowl.
Lightly char banana leaves over a flame to make them pliable.
Place a fish fillet in the center of each banana leaf.
Spread the mustard-coconut mixture generously over each fish fillet.
Fold the banana leaf around the fish to create a secure packet, tucking edges underneath.
Heat oil in a large pan or griddle and place packets seam-side down.
Cook for 10-12 minutes on each side until fish is cooked through, then carefully open packets and serve.
cheapTips: Buy frozen banana leaves from Asian markets in bulk at lower cost
Use frozen grated coconut instead of fresh for year-round availability and better pricing

recipes.name: Hunan Preserved Duck
recipes.description: Hunan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sear duck breast skin-side down for 4 minutes until browned.
Flip duck and sear the other side for 3 minutes, then remove and cut into bite-sized pieces.
In the same pot, fry minced ginger and crushed garlic with dried chilies for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, star anise, and water, stirring well.
Return duck pieces to the pot, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 25 minutes.
Stir occasionally until sauce thickens and duck is tender, then serve hot over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy duck breasts on sale or use chicken as a budget substitute
Use regular soy sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Spicy Fried Shredded Squid
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Score the squid body in a crosshatch pattern and cut into 2-inch pieces, leaving tentacles whole.
Toss squid with cornstarch and let sit for 5 minutes.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until smoking.
Working in batches, fry squid for 2-3 minutes per batch until golden and crispy, then remove to a plate.
In the same wok, fry dried chilies, garlic, and ginger for 1 minute until very fragrant.
Return squid to the wok with soy sauce and vinegar, toss for 2 minutes over high heat.
Drizzle with sesame oil, top with green onions, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen squid and thaw before cooking—much cheaper than fresh
Buy chilies in bulk from Asian markets

recipes.name: Hunan Sausage with Sticky Rice
recipes.description: Hunan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse glutinous rice thoroughly under cold water until water runs clear, then drain.
Slice Chinese sausages diagonally into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Bring water to a boil in a rice cooker or pot with salt and ginger slices.
Add rinsed rice and stir once, then cook covered on high until rice absorbs all water (about 20 minutes).
While rice cooks, pan-fry sausage slices in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until edges are crispy.
Once rice is done, drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil over the top, then fold in cooked sausage slices.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy sausage at Asian grocery stores instead of American supermarkets
Store-brand glutinous rice is identical to premium brands

recipes.name: Spicy Fried Eel Slices
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Have your fishmonger clean and slice the eel into ¼-inch thick diagonal pieces, or slice yourself if comfortable.
Toss eel slices with cornstarch and let sit for 5 minutes to coat.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat until very hot.
Fry eel slices in batches for 2-3 minutes per batch until golden and crispy, then drain on paper towels.
In the same wok, fry garlic, ginger, and fresh chilies for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return eel to the wok with soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar, tossing constantly for 3 minutes over high heat.
Top with green onions and serve immediately with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Ask your fishmonger to clean and slice the eel to save time and effort
Buy eel when on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Hunan Oil Tea
recipes.description: Hunan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a pot and add salt.
In a separate pan, heat oil over medium heat and fry minced garlic, ginger, and dried chilies for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour the hot aromatic oil mixture into the boiling water, stirring to combine.
Simmer the oil tea for 3-4 minutes to infuse the flavors.
Toast peanuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes for extra crunch.
Ladle the oil tea into bowls and top each with fried shallots, roasted peanuts, sesame seeds, and green onions.
Serve hot and eat with light crackers or rice cakes on the side.
cheapTips: Buy peanuts and shallots in bulk from Asian markets
Make the aromatic oil base in larger batches and refrigerate for quick breakfasts

recipes.name: Stuffed Crab with Glutinous Rice
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak shiitake mushrooms in warm water for 15 minutes, then squeeze dry and mince.
Rinse glutinous rice and cook with 1.25 cups water, soy sauce, and minced sausage until rice is sticky and cooked (about 20 minutes).
Stir sesame oil, minced ginger, and minced mushrooms into the cooked rice, then set aside to cool slightly.
Kill crabs quickly and humanely, then carefully remove the top shell and clean out gills.
Stuff each crab shell generously with the glutinous rice mixture, packing it firmly.
Place stuffed crabs shell-side up in a steamer basket over boiling water and steam for 20 minutes until crab meat is cooked.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot directly in the shell.
cheapTips: Buy live crabs at Asian fish markets instead of upscale supermarkets
Ask to pre-clean the crabs for a small fee to save prep time

recipes.name: Hunan Glutinous Rice with Durian
recipes.description: Hunan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat coconut milk, water, sugar, salt, and pandan leaves (if using) in a saucepan over medium heat until sugar dissolves.
Add frozen durian flesh and stir gently until fully incorporated and the mixture is warm (about 5 minutes).
Gently fold the durian mixture into cooked glutinous rice until evenly combined, trying not to mash the rice.
Let the rice rest for 5 minutes so flavors meld together.
Divide into bowls and top with toasted sesame seeds.
Serve at room temperature or slightly warm.
cheapTips: Buy frozen durian instead of fresh for lower cost and easier handling
Use canned coconut milk from bulk sections

recipes.name: Spicy Beef Jerky
recipes.description: Hunan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim fat from beef and slice against the grain into ¼-inch thick strips (partially freezing for 2 hours makes this easier).
Combine soy sauce, vinegar, honey, chili powder, garlic powder, ginger powder, black pepper, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Marinate beef strips in the mixture for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight in the refrigerator.
Pat beef strips dry with paper towels to remove excess marinade.
Arrange strips on oven racks lined with foil in a single layer without overlapping.
Bake at 160°F for 5-6 hours until beef is completely dry and slightly brittle but still slightly chewy.
Cool completely, then store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.
cheapTips: Buy beef on sale and make large batches; freezes well for months
Use a dehydrator if you have one—uses less electricity than oven

recipes.name: Hunan Bamboo Shoot Preserved Fish
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak preserved fish in water for 30 minutes to reduce saltiness, then drain and shred into bite-sized pieces.
If using canned bamboo shoots, drain and rinse; if using fresh, blanch for 5 minutes then slice.
Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat and fry garlic, ginger, and dried chilies for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add shredded preserved fish and stir-fry for 2 minutes to release flavors.
Add bamboo shoot slices and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then add soy sauce and water.
Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld and sauce reduces slightly.
Drizzle with sesame oil, top with green onions, and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy preserved fish and canned bamboo shoots at Asian grocery stores for 50% less
Preserved fish lasts months; buy on sale in bulk

recipes.name: Rock Sugar Stewed Pear with Tremella
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak tremella mushroom in warm water for 10 minutes until softened, then rinse and break into small florets.
Soak red dates in warm water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Peel and core pears, cutting them into quarters or chunks.
Bring 5 cups of water to a boil in a large pot with ginger slices.
Add pear chunks, tremella pieces, red dates, and rock sugar to the boiling water.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until pears are very tender.
Add goji berries in the last 2 minutes of cooking, then serve warm or chilled in bowls with the cooking liquid.
cheapTips: Buy dried tremella in bulk from Asian markets for less than half the price of Western stores
Make large batches and refrigerate for up to 5 days

recipes.name: Champuru
recipes.description: Okinawan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between paper towels with a weight for 10 minutes to remove excess water.
Cut pressed tofu into 3/4-inch cubes and dice the Spam into similar-sized pieces.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry tofu cubes until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes; set aside.
Add remaining oil and cook Spam pieces until lightly browned, about 3 minutes, then add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add cabbage and carrot, stirring constantly until cabbage is just tender, about 5 minutes.
Push vegetables to the sides, pour beaten eggs into the center, and scramble until just set.
Return tofu to the pan, add soy sauce, salt, and pepper, tossing everything gently to combine and heat through for 2 minutes.
Serve immediately over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy Spam on sale and freeze; cabbage is cheapest in winter months
Make your own pressed tofu by wrapping in cloth instead of buying pre-pressed varieties

recipes.name: Chairman Mao's Red Braised Pork Belly
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch pork belly cubes in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat and add drained pork to brown on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add ginger slices and garlic cloves, stirring constantly for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in soy sauce, rice wine, and water; add sugar, star anise, and cinnamon stick.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 90 minutes until pork is very tender.
Uncover and increase heat to medium, simmering for 10 more minutes to reduce and thicken the braising liquid.
Stir in scallions and cook for 2 minutes.
Serve hot with steamed rice, garnished with extra scallions.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly when it goes on sale and freeze for later use
Use regular soy sauce instead of premium varieties; the flavor difference is minimal in braising

recipes.name: Dong'an Chicken
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a large pot and add salt and whole chicken breasts.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer gently for 15-18 minutes until chicken is cooked through but still moist.
Remove chicken and let cool slightly, then tear or shred into bite-sized pieces.
In a bowl, whisk together soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, chili oil, garlic, ginger, and scallions.
Pour the dressing over the warm shredded chicken and toss gently to coat evenly.
Let sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Arrange on a serving plate and top with fresh cilantro.
Serve at room temperature or slightly warm.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts in bulk when on sale and freeze in portions
Skip cilantro if budget is tight; dish tastes great without it

recipes.name: Steamed Fish Head with Diced Hot Red Peppers
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse the fish head thoroughly under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Place fish head on a heatproof plate that fits in your steamer, season with salt.
Dice the red chile peppers finely, removing some seeds if you prefer less heat.
Set up a steamer pot with water and bring to a boil; place plate with fish head inside and steam for 12-15 minutes until the fish is cooked through.
While fish steams, heat vegetable oil in a small pan and toast the diced peppers, garlic, and ginger together for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil to the pepper mixture, stirring to combine.
Remove fish head from steamer and pour the hot pepper mixture evenly over the top.
Garnish with scallions and cilantro, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Ask your fishmonger for fish heads; they're often very cheap or free
Fresh peppers vary in price; use whatever red peppers are on sale

recipes.name: Hunan Smoked Pork
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rub pork all over with salt, brown sugar, and black pepper, then place in a large bowl.
Combine soy sauce, rice wine, ginger, garlic, and star anise; pour over pork and marinate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Remove pork from marinade and pat dry with paper towels.
Preheat your smoker to 225°F and add soaked wood chips to the fire box.
Place pork in smoker and smoke for 2.5-3 hours until the internal temperature reaches 190°F.
Remove pork from smoker and let rest for 15 minutes before slicing.
Slice meat thinly against the grain and arrange on a serving plate.
Serve at room temperature or warm with steamed rice and pickled vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale when whole and portions are cheapest
Use wood chips from landscaping suppliers instead of specialty smoking brands

recipes.name: Spicy Stir-Fried Beef Tripe
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch cleaned beef tripe in boiling water for 10 minutes, then drain and cool before cutting into thin 2-inch pieces.
Heat a large wok or skillet over high heat with oil until just smoking.
Add garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 15 seconds until fragrant.
Add tripe pieces and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring constantly until edges begin to crisp.
Add soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili flakes, salt, and white pepper, tossing everything together.
Stir-fry for 2-3 more minutes until sauce reduces slightly and tripe is well coated.
Add scallions and toss to combine, cooking for 30 seconds.
Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Buy beef tripe from Asian markets where it's significantly cheaper than mainstream butchers
Pre-blanched tripe saves time; check Asian grocery stores for this option

recipes.name: Changsha Stinky Tofu
recipes.description: Hunan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut extra-firm tofu into 3/4-inch cubes and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F (test with a wooden chopstick; it should sizzle immediately).
Carefully add tofu cubes in batches and fry until golden and crispy on all sides, about 6-8 minutes per batch.
Remove fried tofu with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
In a small bowl, combine stinky tofu brine, soy sauce, chili paste, garlic, and ginger.
Transfer fried tofu to a serving bowl and pour the sauce mixture over top.
Drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle Sichuan peppercorns and scallions on top.
Serve immediately while still warm and crispy.
cheapTips: Buy stinky tofu brine at Asian markets in bulk; it's cheaper than Western specialty stores
Use regular vegetable oil for frying; expensive oils waste money in high-heat cooking

recipes.name: Hunan Sour Soup with Fish
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring fish stock to a boil in a large pot over high heat.
Add minced garlic, ginger, and whole chili peppers, simmering for 5 minutes.
Stir in rice vinegar and pickled vegetables, then return to a simmer.
Cut fish fillets into bite-sized pieces and carefully add to the simmering broth.
Cook fish for 5-7 minutes until just cooked through and tender.
Season with salt and white pepper to taste.
Divide soup among bowls and top with scallions and cilantro.
Serve piping hot with steamed rice on the side.
cheapTips: Use frozen fish fillets which are cheaper than fresh and work just as well
Make your own pickled vegetables with cheap cabbage and rice vinegar

recipes.name: Spicy Fried Snake
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Kill and clean the snake, then cut into 2-inch pieces, removing all bones (or use pre-cleaned eel pieces).
Blanch snake pieces in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat until smoking, then carefully add snake pieces in batches and fry until edges are golden, about 8-10 minutes total.
Remove fried snake and set aside, leaving 2 tablespoons of oil in the wok.
Add garlic, ginger, and dried chilies to the wok and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return snake to the wok and add soy sauce, rice wine, and chili flakes, tossing constantly for 2-3 minutes.
Add scallions and Sichuan peppercorns, cooking for another minute.
Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with sesame seeds; serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Substitute with eel from Asian markets if snake is unavailable; similar taste at lower cost
Buy from specialty Asian suppliers for best prices on snake meat

recipes.name: Hunan Cured Fish Fillet
recipes.description: Hunan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat fish fillets dry and rub all over with salt and sugar, then place on a plate.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 20 minutes to cure.
Rinse the cured fish under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Layer fish fillets in a shallow serving bowl or dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili oil, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil.
Pour the dressing evenly over the fish fillets.
Cover and let sit at room temperature for 10 minutes to allow flavors to infuse.
Top with scallions and cilantro just before serving; serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use frozen fish fillets which are equally good and significantly cheaper
Make this dish with whatever affordable white fish is on sale

recipes.name: Khichdi
recipes.description: Gujarati lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash rice and moong dal together under cold water until water runs clear.
Heat ghee in a pot and add cumin seeds until they crackle.
Add minced ginger and green chili, sauté for 30 seconds.
Add the washed rice and dal, stir well for 2 minutes.
Pour 4 cups of water and add turmeric and salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 20 minutes until rice and dal are fully cooked and mushy.
Stir gently and serve hot with ghee drizzled on top.
cheapTips: Buy moong dal in bulk from Indian markets
Use vegetable oil instead of ghee to reduce cost

recipes.name: Dal Dhokli
recipes.description: Gujarati lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, salt, and turmeric; add water to form a soft dough and set aside for 15 minutes.
Boil 5 cups water with dal until dal is half cooked.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds, then ginger-garlic paste and green chili, sauté for 1 minute.
Pour this tempering into the dal pot.
Roll out dough thin and cut into 2-inch strips or diamonds.
Drop dhokli pieces into boiling dal mixture and stir gently to prevent sticking.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until dal and dhokli are completely cooked and soft.
Add lemon juice and adjust salt, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Make dough from scratch instead of buying packets
Use lemon instead of limes

recipes.name: Patrel
recipes.description: Gujarati lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean colocasia leaves and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix gram flour, coconut, sesame seeds, peanuts, green chili, ginger, jaggery, oil, salt, turmeric, and asafoetida to form a thick paste.
Lay a colocasia leaf flat and spread 2 tablespoons of the mixture on the glossy side.
Roll tightly from one end to form a long cylinder and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Repeat with remaining leaves.
Place rolled leaves in a steamer basket seam-side down and steam for 25-30 minutes until leaves are tender.
Remove from steamer and cool slightly before serving, optionally cut into pieces.
cheapTips: Buy colocasia leaves in bulk and freeze extras
Use store-brand gram flour

recipes.name: Thepla
recipes.description: Gujarati breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix whole wheat flour, turmeric, red chili powder, cumin seeds, and salt in a bowl.
Add yogurt and 2 tablespoons of oil to the dry ingredients.
Gradually add water and knead into a soft dough; let rest 10 minutes.
Divide dough into 8-10 equal portions and roll each into a thin oval.
Heat a cast iron griddle or skillet over medium-high heat.
Place a thepla on the griddle and cook for 1-2 minutes until light spots appear.
Flip and cook the other side for another minute, pressing gently with a cloth.
Drizzle remaining oil on both sides and cook until golden brown spots form.
Serve hot with pickle or yogurt.
cheapTips: Buy whole wheat flour in bulk
Use store-brand yogurt

recipes.name: Methi Thepla
recipes.description: Gujarati breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash and finely chop fresh fenugreek leaves, squeezing out excess moisture.
Mix whole wheat flour, chopped methi, turmeric, red chili powder, asafoetida, and salt in a bowl.
Add yogurt and 2 tablespoons oil to the mixture.
Gradually add water and knead into a soft dough; rest 10 minutes.
Divide dough into 8-10 portions and roll each into a thin oval.
Heat a griddle or non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Place thepla on the griddle and cook 1-2 minutes until spots appear, flip and cook the other side.
Drizzle remaining oil and cook until golden brown.
Serve immediately with pickle or yogurt.
cheapTips: Buy methi in season and freeze portions
Use oil sparingly

recipes.name: Pav Bhaji
recipes.description: Gujarati snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water until completely soft; drain and mash coarsely.
Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large pan and sauté onions until golden.
Add bell peppers, tomatoes, and peas; cook until vegetables are soft, about 8-10 minutes.
Stir in mashed potatoes and pav bhaji masala; mix well.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, crushing vegetables with the back of a spoon to create a thick paste.
Add chili powder and lemon juice; adjust salt and spices to taste.
Butter and toast bread buns on a hot griddle until golden brown.
Serve hot bhaji with buttered toasted buns on the side.
cheapTips: Buy seasonal vegetables
Make pav bhaji masala at home by blending spices

recipes.name: Ragda Patties
recipes.description: Gujarati snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix boiled white peas with tamarind chutney and salt to form the ragda gravy; set aside.
Combine mashed potatoes, crushed green peas, flour, green chili, ginger, chaat masala, and salt.
Form mixture into 6-8 small flat oval patties.
Heat oil in a shallow pan over medium heat.
Fry patties 2-3 minutes on each side until golden and crispy.
Remove and drain on paper towels.
Arrange patties on a plate and pour warm ragda gravy over them.
Top with mint chutney and additional chaat masala, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Boil and freeze peas in bulk
Make chutneys at home

recipes.name: Bhakri
recipes.description: Gujarati dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix jowar flour, salt, and cumin seeds in a bowl.
Add warm water and oil gradually, mixing until a soft dough forms.
Knead for 1-2 minutes until smooth.
Divide dough into 4-6 equal portions and shape each into a ball.
Heat a cast iron griddle or tawa over medium-high heat.
Place a portion of dough on the griddle and flatten it slightly using the back of your palm into a thick, round bread.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until the bottom turns brown, flip carefully and cook the other side for 2-3 minutes.
Flip again and press gently; cook until dark spots appear and the bhakri becomes slightly crispy.
Serve hot with dal or vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy jowar flour from Indian grocery stores in bulk
Skip oil to reduce cost

recipes.name: Rotli
recipes.description: Gujarati lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix whole wheat flour and salt in a bowl.
Add oil and gradually pour warm water while mixing with your hands.
Knead into a soft, smooth dough; cover and rest for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into 6-8 equal portions and roll each into a smooth ball.
Heat a tawa or griddle over medium-high heat.
Dust a ball with flour, flatten slightly, and roll into a thin, even circular bread.
Place on the hot tawa and cook for about 30 seconds until it puffs slightly.
Flip and cook the other side for 30 seconds until light brown spots appear.
Serve hot with dal, vegetables, or curry.
cheapTips: Buy whole wheat flour in bulk
Use minimal oil

recipes.name: Sev
recipes.description: Gujarati snack — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 4 tablespoons plus 2 cups for deep fryin

steps: Mix gram flour, rice flour, turmeric, red chili powder, asafoetida, cumin seeds, and salt in a bowl.
Add 4 tablespoons oil and water to form a thick, smooth batter.
Heat 2 cups oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fill a sev maker (murukku maker) with the batter.
Press the sev maker directly into the hot oil in circular motions to create thin noodle-like strands.
Fry for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Cool completely and store in an airtight container for up to one week.
cheapTips: Buy gram flour from Indian markets
Reuse frying oil for the next batch

recipes.name: Puri
recipes.description: Bengali breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, salt, and 3 tablespoons oil in a bowl.
Gradually add water and knead into a smooth, firm dough; rest for 20 minutes covered.
Divide dough into 12 equal balls and roll each into a thin 4-inch circle.
Heat 2 cups oil in a deep pan until it reaches 350°F.
Gently place one puri into hot oil and press with a slotted spoon until it puffs up.
Fry for 30 seconds on each side until light golden, then remove to a paper towel.
Repeat with remaining dough balls and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy flour in bulk to reduce costs
Reuse frying oil for next batch if strained

recipes.name: Jhal Muri
recipes.description: Bengali snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine puffed rice and roasted peanuts in a large mixing bowl.
Heat oil in a small pan and add chopped green chilies and onions; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour the warm oil mixture over the puffed rice and peanuts.
Add lemon juice, salt, chaat masala, and fresh cilantro; toss everything well to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve immediately in bowls while still warm.
cheapTips: Buy puffed rice and peanuts in bulk from Indian grocery stores
Use seasonal onions and chilies for better prices

recipes.name: Sukto
recipes.description: Bengali lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and add panch phoron seeds; let them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add sliced onions and minced ginger; cook until onions turn golden brown.
Add potatoes and pumpkin first, cooking for 5 minutes until slightly softened.
Stir in eggplant, bitter melon, green chilies, salt, and turmeric; cook for 10 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook covered for 15 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Adjust seasoning and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables in season and at farmers markets
Coconut milk can be substituted with regular milk for cost savings

recipes.name: Bhapa Pitha
recipes.description: Bengali breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour, salt, and crushed cardamom in a bowl.
Boil water and pour into the flour mixture while stirring continuously to form a smooth batter.
In a separate bowl, mix grated jaggery and coconut together.
Prepare banana leaf pieces or use parchment paper cut into 5-inch squares.
Place 1 tablespoon batter on each leaf, add 1 teaspoon jaggery-coconut filling, and top with another tablespoon of batter.
Fill a steamer with water, place steamer rack, and arrange wrapped pithas on it.
Steam for 10-12 minutes until cooked through, then serve warm with ghee drizzled on top.
cheapTips: Buy rice flour and jaggery from Indian grocery stores in bulk
Use parchment paper instead of banana leaves if unavailable

recipes.name: Handvo
recipes.description: Gujarati breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice and both dals together in water for 30 minutes; drain well.
Grind the soaked rice and dals with 1 cup fresh water into a coarse batter using a food processor.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a pan and add cumin seeds until they crackle.
Add ginger, green chilies, and grated vegetables; sauté for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Mix the cooked vegetables into the batter along with yogurt, salt, and baking soda.
Pour the batter into a greased round baking dish or cast iron skillet.
Bake at 375°F for 30-35 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool slightly, cut into wedges, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy dals in bulk from Indian markets
Use seasonal vegetables for better prices

recipes.name: Khichiyu
recipes.description: Gujarati breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice and moong dal together and drain well.
Heat oil in a pot and add cumin seeds; let them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add green chili and ginger; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the rinsed rice and dal mixture; stir for 1 minute to coat with oil.
Pour in water, add salt and turmeric powder, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-18 minutes until rice and dal are completely cooked and fluffy.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot with ghee or oil drizzled on top.
cheapTips: Buy rice and moong dal in bulk
Use basic pantry items with minimal waste

recipes.name: Fafda
recipes.description: Gujarati breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix gram flour, salt, turmeric, asafoetida, and carom seeds in a bowl.
Gradually add water and whisk until you have a smooth, lump-free batter similar to pancake batter.
Let the batter rest for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F; test with a small piece of batter.
Pour batter through a metal sieve or fafda maker directly into hot oil, creating thin noodle-like strands.
Fry for 2-3 minutes until golden and crisp, stirring gently to ensure even cooking.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with jaggery sauce or alongside steamed vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy gram flour in bulk from Indian stores
Reuse strained oil for multiple batches

recipes.name: Jalebi
recipes.description: Gujarati snack — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 3 cups for frying plus 2 tablespoons for

steps: Mix flour, yogurt, and 2 tablespoons oil in a bowl; beat until smooth, then add baking soda and let rest 30 minutes.
Heat sugar and water in a pan, stirring until sugar dissolves completely.
Add lemon juice, cardamom, saffron, and food coloring to the syrup; simmer for 5 minutes and keep warm.
Heat 3 cups oil in a deep pan to 350°F; transfer batter to a squeeze bottle or jalebi maker.
Carefully squeeze the batter into hot oil in spiral shapes, making 3-4 inch circles.
Fry for 1-2 minutes per side until light golden, then carefully remove with a slotted spoon.
Immediately dip the hot jalebi into warm sugar syrup for 5 seconds, then transfer to a rack to set.
Serve at room temperature or warm with tea.
cheapTips: Skip saffron and food coloring if budget is tight
Make large batches and store in airtight containers for up to 3 days

recipes.name: Khandvi
recipes.description: Gujarati snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix gram flour and yogurt in a bowl and let sit for 10 minutes.
Add water gradually to the flour mixture, whisking until smooth and lump-free.
In a heavy-bottomed pan, pour the mixture and cook on medium heat, stirring constantly for 8-10 minutes until thick and paste-like.
Add salt, turmeric, ginger, and green chili to the cooked mixture; mix well.
Pour onto a greased flat surface (marble or parchment paper) and spread thinly with a wet spatula.
Once cooled and set (about 5 minutes), roll gently into a spiral shape.
Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds and curry leaves; pour this tempering over the rolled khandvi.
Sprinkle grated coconut on top and serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy gram flour in bulk from Indian stores
Use shredded coconut from frozen bags if fresh is unavailable

recipes.name: Undhiyu
recipes.description: Gujarati lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large pan and fry cubed potatoes and yam until partially cooked; set aside.
In the same oil, fry eggplant cubes until golden; set aside.
Add remaining oil and fry onions until deep golden brown; add ginger, garlic, and green chilies, cooking for 2 minutes.
Mix gram flour with 1/4 cup water to form a smooth paste and add to the pan, stirring constantly for 2 minutes.
Add all fried vegetables back to the pan along with peanuts and green peas.
Sprinkle salt, turmeric, and Gujarati spice powder; mix thoroughly.
Add tamarind paste and stir everything together for 3-4 minutes until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a heavy-bottomed pot, cover with aluminum foil, place the lid on top, and cook on low heat for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally until vegetables are completely tender.
Serve hot with warm bread or rice.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables from farmers markets when in season
Make large batches and freeze portions for later

recipes.name: Mohanthal
recipes.description: Gujarati snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat and roast chickpea flour for 5-7 minutes, stirring constantly until fragrant and light brown.
Dissolve sugar in water and set aside, crushing cardamom pods and removing seeds.
Slowly pour the sugar water into the roasted flour while stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
Keep stirring for 5-8 minutes until the mixture thickens and starts leaving the sides of the pan.
Add cardamom seeds and nutmeg powder and mix well.
Toast cashews and raisins separately in a bit of ghee, then fold into the mixture.
Pour onto a greased plate and let cool for 15 minutes.
Cut into squares and serve when completely cooled.
cheapTips: Buy chickpea flour in bulk from Indian grocery stores
Skip the cashews and raisins if on a tight budget

recipes.name: Gharchutti
recipes.description: Gujarati snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast peanuts in a dry pan over medium heat for 5 minutes, then remove and let cool slightly before rubbing off the skin.
Dry roast sesame seeds separately in the same pan for 2-3 minutes until fragrant, then set aside.
Crush cardamom pods and extract the seeds, discarding pods.
Heat ghee in the pan and add jaggery, stirring until it melts completely.
Add roasted peanuts, sesame seeds, cardamom seeds, coconut, and salt to the melted jaggery and mix thoroughly for 2 minutes.
Pour the mixture onto a greased plate or parchment paper and spread evenly with a greased spoon.
Let cool for 20 minutes until it hardens slightly, then cut into pieces.
cheapTips: Buy peanuts in bulk and roast yourself instead of buying pre-roasted
Use gur (jaggery blocks) instead of powder form

recipes.name: Lilva Kachumbur
recipes.description: Gujarati lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil fresh lima beans or peas in salted water for 8-10 minutes until tender, then drain and let cool.
Dice the cucumber, tomato, and mince the green chili.
Combine the cooked beans with the diced vegetables in a large bowl.
Add fresh cilantro, lemon juice, salt, and cumin powder and toss well.
Let sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld together.
Taste and adjust lemon juice or salt as needed.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use frozen peas or lima beans to save money year-round
Make with seasonal vegetables like bell peppers instead of tomatoes

recipes.name: Farali Idli
recipes.description: Gujarati breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Grate potatoes and squeeze out excess water using a clean cloth.
Mix grated potatoes, water chestnut flour, rock salt, minced green chili, ginger, and yogurt in a bowl until well combined.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes to absorb moisture.
Grease idli molds with ghee and fill each cavity three-quarters full with the batter.
Heat water in an idli steamer and place the molds inside, covering with the steamer lid.
Steam for 12-15 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Remove from steamer and let cool for 2 minutes before unmolding.
Serve with ghee, cumin seeds fried in ghee, and chutney if desired.
cheapTips: Use potato starch instead of water chestnut flour if it's cheaper
Make in batches and freeze extras for quick weekday breakfasts

recipes.name: Lamprais
recipes.description: Sri Lankan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan and sauté finely chopped onions, garlic, and ginger for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add ground beef and cook over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes, breaking it apart until browned.
Stir in curry powder and cook for another minute to bloom the spices.
Dice potato and add to the meat along with green peas, cooking for 8-10 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Add cooked rice, soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the meat mixture and stir well to combine, cooking for 2-3 minutes.
Soften banana leaves by passing them over an open flame, then cut into quarters.
Divide the rice-meat mixture into 4 portions and wrap each tightly in banana leaf, sealing the edges.
Place wrapped parcels on a baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 15-20 minutes, or steam in a covered pot for 20 minutes.
Serve hot in the banana leaf wrapping.
cheapTips: Use ground chicken or pork instead of beef to reduce costs
Substitute aluminum foil for banana leaves if unavailable

recipes.name: Kottu Roti
recipes.description: Sri Lankan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice chicken breast and cook in oil over high heat until cooked through, about 5-7 minutes, then set aside.
Chop cabbage, carrot, and onion into bite-sized pieces and mince the green chili.
In the same pan or griddle, add remaining oil and toss in the onions, cooking for 1 minute.
Add carrots and cabbage and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes over high heat until slightly softened but still crisp.
Chop the roti into 1-inch pieces and add to the pan along with the cooked chicken.
Sprinkle curry powder and soy sauce over the mixture and toss everything together for 2 minutes.
Push the mixture to the side, scramble the egg in a clear space, then mix it in with the rest.
Add green chili, salt, and pepper to taste and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use leftover rotis from dinner instead of making fresh ones
Substitute vegetables based on what's on sale that week

recipes.name: Hoppers
recipes.description: Sri Lankan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour, salt, and jaggery in a large bowl.
Dissolve yeast in warm water and let sit for 5 minutes, then add to the rice flour mixture.
Stir in coconut milk, egg, and oil until smooth with no lumps.
Cover and let the batter ferment at room temperature for 2-3 hours or overnight for best results.
Heat a hopper pan (special bowl-shaped mold) over medium-high heat and lightly grease each cavity with oil.
Pour batter into each hopper mold until three-quarters full and cover with the hopper pan lid.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until the edges are golden and crispy and the center is set but still slightly soft.
Remove hoppers with a spoon and serve warm with curry or honey.
cheapTips: Buy rice flour in bulk from Asian markets
Make batter in advance and store in the fridge for up to 2 days

recipes.name: Devilled Chicken
recipes.description: Sri Lankan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
Heat oil in a large pan and sauté finely chopped onions until they become soft and translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and chopped green chilies and cook for another minute.
Stir in curry powder and tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes to combine flavors.
Add chicken pieces and cook over high heat for 5-7 minutes until the exterior is sealed.
Pour in vinegar and water, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer covered for 15-20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Taste and adjust salt, pepper, and vinegar to achieve a spicy-tangy balance.
Serve hot with rice or roti.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for better flavor and lower cost
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for easy weeknight dinners

recipes.name: Curry and Rice
recipes.description: Sri Lankan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear, then set aside.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry sliced onions until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add curry powder and turmeric and stir for 30 seconds to toast the spices.
Place chicken thighs in the pot and coat with the spice mixture, cooking for 5 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 20-25 minutes until chicken is tender.
In a separate pot, bring 3 cups salted water to boil and add rice, stirring once, then cover and simmer for 15-18 minutes until tender.
Season curry with salt and pepper to taste and serve alongside fluffy rice.
cheapTips: Buy rice in 10-pound bags from warehouse stores
Use canned coconut milk instead of fresh to save money and time

recipes.name: Wattappam
recipes.description: Sri Lankan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crush jaggery into fine pieces or grate it to help it dissolve evenly.
Mix rice flour, crushed jaggery, and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk eggs and add to the rice flour mixture along with coconut milk, stirring until smooth with no lumps.
Crush cardamom pods, extract seeds, and add to the batter.
Toast cashews and raisins lightly in butter and fold into the batter.
Grease a wattappam mold or small cake pan with butter.
Pour batter into the mold and steam in a covered pot with boiling water for 20-25 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes, then unmold and serve warm with jaggery syrup or on its own.
cheapTips: Make in a loaf pan or muffin tin if you don't have a wattappam mold
Buy jaggery online in bulk as it's significantly cheaper than specialty stores

recipes.name: Pol Sambol
recipes.description: Sri Lankan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine shredded coconut, chopped red onion, and minced fresh chili in a bowl.
Add lime juice, salt, and chili powder to the mixture.
Stir everything together until well combined.
If using, add crumbled Maldive fish and mix gently.
Serve immediately as a breakfast side dish or condiment with curry and rice.
cheapTips: Use frozen shredded coconut instead of fresh to save money
Omit Maldive fish for a budget-friendly vegetarian version

recipes.name: Mallung
recipes.description: Sri Lankan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add chopped red onion and minced green chili, sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add chopped leafy greens and turmeric powder, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until greens wilt.
Add shredded coconut and mix well, cooking for another 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add lime juice and salt.
Mix thoroughly and serve hot as a side dish with curry and rice.
cheapTips: Buy greens on sale and freeze extras for later use
Use any available leafy greens like chard or collards

recipes.name: Dhal Curry
recipes.description: Sri Lankan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse red lentils thoroughly under cold water and drain well.
Heat coconut oil in a pot over medium heat and add cumin seeds, letting them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add chopped onion, minced garlic, and ginger, sauté for 3 minutes until softened.
Add turmeric powder and dried red chili, stir for 1 minute.
Add rinsed lentils and water, bring to a boil then reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are soft and creamy.
Stir in coconut milk and salt, simmer for another 5 minutes.
Serve hot with rice or flatbread.
cheapTips: Buy lentils in bulk and store in airtight containers
Use lite coconut milk to reduce fat and cost

recipes.name: Ambul Thiyal
recipes.description: Sri Lankan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fish fillets into large chunks and season lightly with salt.
Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add sliced onion and cook for 2 minutes until translucent.
Add minced garlic, ginger, turmeric, dried chili, and curry leaves, stirring for 1 minute.
Add fish chunks and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until slightly browned.
Dissolve tamarind paste in water and add to the pan.
Bring to a simmer, cover partially, and cook for 8-10 minutes until fish is cooked through and sauce is reduced.
Taste and adjust salt as needed, then serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Use frozen fish fillets which are often cheaper than fresh
Buy tamarind concentrate instead of paste for better value

recipes.name: Chicken Curry
recipes.description: Sri Lankan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat and add chopped onion, cooking for 4 minutes until golden.
Add minced garlic, ginger, and dried chili, stirring for 2 minutes.
Add curry powder and turmeric powder, stirring constantly for 1 minute to bloom the spices.
Add chicken cubes and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until chicken is lightly browned on all sides.
Pour in coconut milk and add curry leaves, bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and lime juice, stir well.
Serve hot with steamed rice or roti.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens and cut them yourself instead of pre-cut pieces
Use lite coconut milk to reduce cost and fat content

recipes.name: Sathe
recipes.description: Sri Lankan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons of coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add rice flour and toast for 3-4 minutes, stirring constantly, until light brown and fragrant.
Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
In another pan, melt jaggery with 0.5 cup water over low heat, stirring until fully dissolved.
Add shredded coconut and crushed cardamom to the jaggery mixture, cook for 2 minutes.
Add the toasted rice flour to the jaggery-coconut mixture and stir well until combined.
Add remaining 2 tablespoons coconut oil and salt, mix thoroughly.
