Thread meat strips onto soaked wooden skewers.
Brush skewers generously with half the peanut sauce.
Grill or broil skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning halfway through, until cooked through.
Serve hot with remaining peanut sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until needed
Use natural peanut butter to reduce costs

recipes.name: Khao Samlor
recipes.description: Cambodian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a pot over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and ground pork, stirring until pork is cooked through (about 5 minutes).
Add cooked jasmine rice and stir to combine.
Season with fish sauce and white pepper to taste.
Simmer for 3-5 minutes until heated through.
Pour into bowls and top with green onions and fried shallots.
cheapTips: Use leftover cooked rice from the night before
Buy ground pork in bulk and freeze portions

recipes.name: Fish Paste Prahok
recipes.description: Cambodian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound garlic and Thai chili peppers in a mortar and pestle until broken down.
Add fish paste and salt, grinding into a coarse, fragrant paste (3-5 minutes).
Add lime juice and palm sugar, mixing until combined.
Transfer to a serving bowl and let rest for 5 minutes to develop flavors.
Arrange vegetable sticks and shredded green papaya on a plate around the paste.
Serve at room temperature as a dipping condiment.
cheapTips: Buy dried fish or anchovy paste from Asian markets for better prices
Prahok keeps in the fridge for weeks, making it an economical staple

recipes.name: Spring Rolls Niem Pang
recipes.description: Cambodian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a shallow bowl with warm water.
Dip each rice paper wrapper into warm water for 2-3 seconds until pliable.
Lay wrapper flat and place a lettuce leaf, then add noodles, shrimp, carrot, mint, and cilantro in the center.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly like a burrito.
Place seam-side down on a serving plate.
Serve with peanut sauce and fish sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp thawed instead of fresh
Make dipping sauces in bulk and store in the refrigerator

recipes.name: Beef Thinly Sliced Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Cambodian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Working in batches, sear beef slices for 1-2 minutes per side until browned; set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add bell peppers and onions, stir-frying for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return beef to the wok and add soy sauce, oyster sauce, and white pepper.
Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until heated through.
Serve over jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy flank steak when on sale and freeze for later use
Use vegetable oil instead of more expensive oils

recipes.name: Samlor Somlar Mechu
recipes.description: Cambodian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add pork or chicken and bring to a boil; simmer for 5 minutes and skim foam.
Add shallots, garlic, turmeric, and lemongrass; simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in red curry paste until dissolved.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Simmer for another 10 minutes until meat is tender.
Garnish with fresh basil or cilantro and serve in bowls.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for better flavor and lower cost
Prepare broth from scratch using chicken bones for savings

recipes.name: Num Banh Chok with Curry
recipes.description: Cambodian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice noodles according to package directions; drain and set aside.
In a large pot, sauté minced garlic in a little oil for 30 seconds.
Stir in red curry paste and turmeric, cooking for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, fish paste, and water, stirring until smooth.
Simmer for 10 minutes, then season with fish sauce to taste.
Divide cooked noodles among three bowls and ladle curry broth over top.
Garnish with fresh herbs and pickled vegetables; serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy rice noodles in bulk from Asian markets at lower prices
Make and freeze curry base in portions for quick mornings

recipes.name: Faluda
recipes.description: Burmese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prepare shaved ice and divide into two tall glasses.
Layer half of the tapioca pearls and jelly noodles into each glass over the ice.
Pour 1.5 tablespoons of rose syrup into each glass.
Mix condensed milk and evaporated milk together in a small bowl.
Pour half the milk mixture into each glass.
Top with remaining shaved ice and crushed peanuts.
Stir well before drinking and serve immediately with a spoon and straw.
cheapTips: Make tapioca pearls and jelly noodles at home in bulk and store in the fridge
Buy crushed peanuts in bulk or crush roasted peanuts yourself

recipes.name: Nom Banh Chok
recipes.description: Cambodian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Pound garlic and shallots together into a paste.
Heat a pot over medium heat and sauté the garlic-shallot paste with turmeric for 1 minute.
Add canned fish with liquid, mash slightly, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and water, bring to a gentle simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with fish sauce to taste.
Divide cooked noodles into two bowls, pour the fish curry soup over top.
Garnish with cucumber slices, fresh mint, and cilantro, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Use canned mackerel or sardines instead of fresh fish to save money
Buy rice noodles and fish sauce in bulk at Asian markets

recipes.name: Samlor Machu Teuk
recipes.description: Cambodian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound garlic and shallots together into a paste.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot.
Add the garlic-shallot paste and stir well.
Add fish sauce, tamarind paste, and palm sugar, stirring until dissolved.
Add okra and pineapple chunks, simmer for 8 minutes.
Add tomato quarters and simmer another 3 minutes until soft.
Taste and adjust seasoning with fish sauce or tamarind as needed.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy tamarind paste in bulk at Asian stores to reduce per-serving cost
Use frozen okra if fresh is unavailable or expensive

recipes.name: Samlor Korkor
recipes.description: Cambodian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried chilies in warm water for 5 minutes, then pound with garlic and shallots into a paste.
Cut long beans into 2-inch pieces, cube eggplant and pumpkin.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot.
Add the chili-garlic paste and stir until dissolved.
Add pumpkin cubes and simmer for 8 minutes until softened.
Add eggplant and long beans, simmer another 8 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and fish sauce, simmer 2 more minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then garnish with fresh basil and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables at farmers markets or discount grocers for seasonal savings
Use canned pumpkin puree if fresh pumpkin is unavailable

recipes.name: Amok
recipes.description: Cambodian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fish fillets into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Mince lemongrass and garlic finely.
In a bowl, mix red curry paste, garlic, lemongrass, and coconut milk together.
Add fish sauce, palm sugar, and lime leaves to the mixture.
Whisk in the egg until well combined.
Fold in fish pieces gently.
Pour mixture into banana leaf or foil packets and fold securely.
Steam in a pot with 2 inches of water for 20 minutes, then carefully open and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use tilapia or other affordable white fish instead of premium varieties
Make red curry paste at home if buying multiple times

recipes.name: Lok Lak
recipes.description: Cambodian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into thin bite-sized pieces and pat dry.
Mince garlic finely.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, lime juice, fish sauce, and black pepper in a bowl.
Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat until smoking.
Add minced garlic and stir for 10 seconds.
Add beef pieces and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until browned but still tender.
Pour sauce over beef and toss quickly for 1 minute.
Arrange sliced onion, tomato, and cucumber on a plate, top with beef and sauce, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck steak or round steak instead of sirloin for savings
Look for sales on bulk beef and freeze portioned pieces

recipes.name: Cha Oreу Sach Ko
recipes.description: Cambodian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound garlic, shallots, and dried chili into a paste.
Bring coconut milk and water to a simmer in a pot over medium heat.
Add the garlic-shallot paste and stir well.
Add fish sauce and palm sugar, stir until dissolved.
Roughly chop the greens and add to the pot.
Simmer for 5 minutes until greens are tender.
Add lime juice and taste, adjusting fish sauce or salt as needed.
Serve hot in bowls as a light soup course.
cheapTips: Use frozen spinach to reduce cost and waste
Buy coconut milk in bulk at Asian markets

recipes.name: Samlor Skor
recipes.description: Cambodian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef or chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Pound garlic, shallots, lemongrass, and ginger into a paste.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot.
Add the aromatic paste and stir well.
Add meat and broth powder, simmer for 10 minutes.
Cut sweet potato and long beans into 2-inch pieces and add to pot.
Simmer another 12 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Add fish sauce and taste, adjusting seasoning as needed, then garnish with cilantro and serve.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for more affordable, flavorful results
Use regular potatoes if sweet potatoes are expensive

recipes.name: Kuy Teav
recipes.description: Cambodian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch pork bones in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Place cleaned bones in a pot with fresh water and bring to boil.
Simmer bones for 20 minutes to create broth.
While broth simmers, cook rice noodles according to package directions and drain.
Pound garlic and shallots together into a paste.
Strain broth and return to pot over medium heat.
Add garlic-shallot paste and fish sauce to the broth.
Add pork liver and any meat pieces, simmer for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Divide cooked noodles into two bowls, ladle hot broth and meat over top.
Garnish generously with green onions, cilantro, and fried shallots, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy pork bones or chicken frames at discount from the butcher counter
Make broth in larger batches and freeze for multiple meals

recipes.name: Banh Mi Cambodian
recipes.description: Cambodian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice baguette in half lengthwise without cutting all the way through.
Lightly butter the inside of the baguette.
Spread mayonnaise on the bottom half and pâté on the top half.
Layer cold cuts, cucumber slices, pickled vegetables, and fresh jalapeño inside the baguette.
Sprinkle cilantro over the fillings.
Gently press the baguette together.
Slice in half and serve immediately.
Serve with a small dish of soy sauce mixed with a splash of water for dipping.
cheapTips: Use regular deli ham or processed meat instead of specialty Vietnamese cold cuts
Make your own pickled vegetables to save money

recipes.name: Braised Duck Dessert
recipes.description: Cambodian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut duck into 8 pieces and blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Pound garlic, shallots, ginger, and dried chilies into a paste using a mortar and pestle.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add duck pieces and stir-fry for 5 minutes until golden brown.
Pour in water, soy sauce, fish sauce, and palm sugar, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 1.5 hours until duck is tender and sauce thickens.
Taste and adjust seasoning with soy sauce and fish sauce as needed.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot over jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy duck when on sale and freeze; whole ducks are cheaper than parts
Use regular brown sugar if palm sugar unavailable

recipes.name: Fried Crickets Meang Meuk
recipes.description: Cambodian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a wok or deep skillet to 350°F.
Carefully add dried crickets in batches and fry for 2-3 minutes until crispy and golden.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Finely chop garlic, shallots, and dried chilies.
In a small bowl, combine fried crickets, salt, lime juice, and chopped aromatics.
Toss gently until evenly coated and serve warm as a crispy snack.
cheapTips: Buy dried crickets in bulk online
Reuse frying oil for other cooking

recipes.name: Chicken Rice
recipes.description: Hainanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil with ginger slices and salt, then poach whole chicken for 30 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken and set aside; reserve 3 cups of poaching liquid as broth.
Slice ginger and garlic, then fry in 2 tbsp oil until fragrant.
Add jasmine rice and stir-fry for 2 minutes until coated.
Pour in reserved broth and bring to boil, then reduce heat and cook covered for 15 minutes.
While rice cooks, shred cooled chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Chop scallions and cilantro; mix soy sauce and sesame oil for dipping sauce.
Fluff rice with a fork and transfer to a serving platter, top with shredded chicken, scallions, and cilantro, then serve with dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens on sale rather than parts
Use the poaching broth for the rice to save on buying separate broth

recipes.name: Roti Prata
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and sugar in a bowl; add warm water and knead into a soft dough, then cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Divide dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into a ball.
Heat a cast iron skillet or non-stick pan over medium-high heat and coat with oil.
Take one dough ball, stretch it gently on the oiled pan into a thin rectangle, then brush with ghee.
Fold the dough into layers by bringing the edges toward the center, creating a square package.
Place folded dough in the hot skillet and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Press gently with a spatula while cooking to ensure even browning and crispiness.
Serve hot with curry, dhal, or condensed milk and sugar.
cheapTips: Make dough ahead and refrigerate overnight
Use vegetable oil instead of expensive ghee

recipes.name: Fish Head Curry
recipes.description: Indian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean fish heads thoroughly under running water and cut into manageable pieces.
Blend onions, garlic, and ginger into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry curry leaves for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add onion paste and fry for 5 minutes until golden brown.
Stir in turmeric, red chili powder, and coriander powder, then cook for 1 minute.
Add fish heads and fry for 3-4 minutes until coated with spices.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer, then cook uncovered for 20 minutes until fish is tender.
Adjust seasoning with salt and serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Fish heads are inexpensive; ask the fishmonger for them
Use canned curry leaves for convenience if fresh unavailable

recipes.name: Chilli Crab
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean crabs and chop into quarters; crack the claws with a mallet for easier eating.
Mince garlic, slice red chilies, and grate ginger.
Heat oil in a wok or large pan and stir-fry garlic, chilies, and ginger for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add crab pieces and stir-fry for 3 minutes until they start to turn red.
Mix in tomato sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and water.
Cover and simmer for 12-15 minutes until crabs are fully cooked.
Mix cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir into the sauce to thicken it.
Cook for 1 more minute and serve hot with steamed rice and extra sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy live crabs at Asian markets for better prices
Use frozen crab when fresh unavailable and on sale

recipes.name: Prawn Mee
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook egg noodles according to package directions, then drain and set aside.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot, then add soy sauce and oyster sauce.
Mince garlic and shallots, then fry in oil in a separate pan for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add shrimp to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink.
Add cooked noodles to the broth and simmer for 2 minutes.
Chop scallions and slice garlic shrimp mixture, then divide noodles and broth into serving bowls.
Top each bowl with shrimp mixture, bean sprouts, and scallions.
Serve hot with extra soy sauce and chili oil on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp instead of fresh for savings
Use vegetable broth if chicken broth too expensive

recipes.name: Kaya Toast
recipes.description: Peranakan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast bread slices until golden brown on both sides.
Spread softened butter on one side of each toast slice.
Generously spread kaya on the buttered toast and sandwich two slices together.
Heat a small pan over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Crack eggs into a bowl, add salt and pepper, then beat lightly.
Pour beaten eggs into the pan and cook until soft-scrambled, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer kaya toast to a plate, place soft-scrambled eggs on the side, and drizzle with condensed milk.
Serve immediately while toast is still warm.
cheapTips: Make your own kaya spread with coconut milk and eggs if unavailable
Use day-old bread for better toasting texture

recipes.name: Lor Mee
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried mushrooms in warm water for 10 minutes, then slice and reserve liquid.
Cook noodles according to package directions, drain and divide into serving bowls.
Bring chicken broth to boil and add mushroom soaking liquid, soy sauce, and minced garlic.
Cut bok choy into chunks and add to broth with mushroom slices, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with 3 tbsp cold water and slowly stir into the broth to create a light gravy.
Simmer for 2 more minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Poach eggs until white is set but yolk is still runny (about 4 minutes).
Ladle hot broth and vegetables over noodles in each bowl, top with a poached egg, drizzle sesame oil, and garnish with chopped green onions.
cheapTips: Buy dried mushrooms in bulk at Asian markets
Substitute frozen bok choy if fresh unavailable

recipes.name: Teh Tarik
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil water in a kettle and pour into a teapot with tea bags.
Steep tea for 3-4 minutes until strong and dark.
Pour condensed milk and evaporated milk into two tall glasses.
Pour hot brewed tea into a separate pitcher or cup.
Carefully pour tea from high above the milk in a steady stream, allowing it to mix and froth (this is the traditional 'pulling' technique).
Pour the mixture back and forth between pitcher and glass 2-3 times to create foam and blend flavors.
Pour final mixture into the two serving glasses and add sugar to taste.
Serve hot immediately in tall glasses with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy black tea in bulk rather than tea bags
Use regular milk if evaporated milk unavailable

recipes.name: Pibil de Pollo
recipes.description: Yucatecan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend achiote paste, lime juice, orange juice, garlic, cumin, and salt until smooth.
Rub the marinade all over chicken thighs and let sit for 30 minutes.
Line a baking dish with banana leaves or foil and add sliced onion and halved habanero.
Place marinated chicken on top and wrap tightly with banana leaves or foil.
Bake at 350°F for 90 minutes until chicken is tender and shreds easily.
Shred the chicken and serve with the cooking juices spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze; achiote paste lasts months
Use regular juice concentrate instead of fresh-squeezed citrus

recipes.name: Xec
recipes.description: Yucatecan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice the green tomatoes and place in a bowl.
Mince the white onion and habanero pepper very finely.
Add minced onion, habanero, and cilantro to the tomatoes.
Squeeze lime juice over the mixture and add salt.
Toss everything together gently.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips for scooping.
cheapTips: Green tomatoes are often cheaper than ripe ones
Use store-brand tortilla chips to reduce cost

recipes.name: Ceviche Yucateco
recipes.description: Yucatecan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fish into small cubes and place in a glass bowl.
Pour lime and orange juice over fish until covered; refrigerate 2-3 hours until opaque.
Drain citrus liquid and add diced red onion, minced habanero, and cilantro.
Gently fold in diced tomato and avocado with salt.
Chill for 30 minutes before serving.
Serve on tostadas or in small cups.
cheapTips: Buy fish from the seafood counter on markdown days
Use frozen fish thawed; works just as well as fresh

recipes.name: Sikil Pak
recipes.description: Yucatecan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast pumpkin seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Grind toasted seeds in a food processor until paste forms.
Roast tomatoes and onion under the broiler for 8 minutes until charred.
Blend roasted vegetables with habanero, cilantro, and lime juice until smooth.
Stir the vegetable mixture into the pumpkin seed paste with salt.
Serve warm or at room temperature with tortilla chips.
cheapTips: Buy raw pumpkin seeds in bulk from the bulk bin
Skip roasting and use canned diced tomatoes in a pinch

recipes.name: Queso Relleno
recipes.description: Yucatecan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make a small hole in the top of the cheese wheel and scoop out the interior, leaving a shell.
Brown ground pork with diced onion and garlic in a skillet.
Mix cooked pork with olives, raisins, salt, and pepper; stuff inside the cheese.
Beat eggs and dip the stuffed cheese to coat, then fry in oil until golden on all sides.
Simmer tomato sauce and chicken broth together in a large pot.
Carefully place the fried cheese in the sauce and simmer for 30 minutes.
Slice into quarters and serve in the tomato broth.
cheapTips: Look for Edam cheese sales at warehouse stores
Use ground pork from budget packs rather than premium

recipes.name: Tzatziki de Tiburón
recipes.description: Yucatecan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season shark steaks with salt and lime juice; let sit 15 minutes.
Grill shark steaks over medium-high heat for 5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Flake the cooked shark into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Blend greek yogurt, grated cucumber, minced garlic, diced onion, habanero, and cilantro.
Fold the flaked shark into the yogurt mixture gently.
Chill for at least 15 minutes and serve cold with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy shark when on sale at seafood counter; freezes well
Use plain yogurt instead of Greek yogurt to save money

recipes.name: Mole Negro Oaxaqueño
recipes.description: Oaxacan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove seeds and stems from dried chiles and toast in a dry skillet for 2 minutes.
Soak toasted chiles in hot water for 15 minutes until soft.
Blend softened chiles with soaking liquid, tomatoes, sesame seeds, almonds, raisins, garlic, onion, cinnamon, and cloves until smooth.
Strain the mixture through a fine sieve to remove chile skin pieces.
Boil chicken in salted water for 30 minutes; reserve broth.
Toast the mole paste in a large pot with oil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add cooked chicken and 2 cups of reserved broth; simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with warm tortillas and extra sesame seeds on top.
cheapTips: Buy dried chiles at Latin markets instead of specialty stores
Make large batch and freeze portions for future meals

recipes.name: Tlayudas
recipes.description: Oaxacan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix masa harina, water, and salt until a soft dough forms; knead for 3 minutes.
Divide dough into 4 portions and press between plastic wrap into large thin circles.
Heat a skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and cook each tlayuda for 3 minutes per side until lightly crispy.
Spread refried beans on each cooked tlayuda and top with shredded cabbage, diced tomato, and crumbled cheese.
Return to skillet for 2 minutes to warm through and melt cheese slightly.
Garnish with oregano, sliced avocado, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy masa harina in bulk at Latin markets
Use store-brand refried beans instead of prepared

recipes.name: Chapulines
recipes.description: Oaxacan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add dried grasshoppers and toast for 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently.
Sprinkle with salt, garlic powder, and lime juice.
Toss in fresh cilantro and mix well.
Transfer to a serving dish and serve warm as a snack.
cheapTips: Buy dried chapulines online in bulk to reduce cost
Skip the oil and toast dry for a lighter snack

recipes.name: Enfrijoladas
recipes.description: Oaxacan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm refried beans in a saucepan over medium heat and thin with 1/4 cup water if too thick.
Dip each corn tortilla into the warm bean sauce to coat both sides.
Heat oil in a skillet and fry the bean-coated tortillas for 1 minute per side until slightly crispy.
Roll filled tortillas and place seam-side down on a serving plate.
Fry eggs sunny-side up in the same skillet.
Top enfrijoladas with fried eggs, remaining beans, cheese, diced onion, cilantro, and sour cream.
cheapTips: Use store-brand refried beans and cheese
Skip sour cream or use plain yogurt to save money

recipes.name: Bistek Encebollado
recipes.description: Yucatecan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the beef thinly against the grain and pound lightly with a meat mallet.
Slice onions into thick rings and mince garlic cloves.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and season beef with salt, pepper, and cumin.
Cook beef for 2-3 minutes per side until browned, then set aside on a plate.
In the same skillet, sauté garlic until fragrant, then add onions and cook until softened.
Return beef to the skillet with lime juice, tomato, and water, simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with rice or corn tortillas.
cheapTips: Use less expensive cuts like flank steak instead of sirloin
Buy onions in bulk; they keep for weeks

recipes.name: Codzito
recipes.description: Yucatecan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cube pork into 1-inch pieces and place in a bowl.
Blend onion, garlic, lime juice, orange juice, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper into a marinade.
Pour marinade over pork, add sliced habanero, and refrigerate for 30 minutes minimum.
Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Transfer pork and marinade to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 35-40 minutes until pork is tender, stirring occasionally.
Serve with lime wedges and warm corn tortillas.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when on sale and freeze for later use
Make double batch and freeze half for easy future meals

recipes.name: Huevos Motuleños
recipes.description: Yucatecan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet and fry tortillas until crispy, then place on serving plates.
In the same skillet, sauté diced onion and ham until onion softens.
Add peas to the ham mixture and cook for 2 minutes, then set aside.
Crack eggs into the skillet and fry sunny-side up or over-easy until whites set.
Make a simple sauce by blending tomato, habanero, and salt.
Place fried eggs on top of fried tortillas, spoon ham and peas mixture on the side.
Drizzle with tomato-habanero sauce and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand ham and frozen peas to reduce cost
Use day-old tortillas if available at discount

recipes.name: Panuchos
recipes.description: Yucatecan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix masa harina with warm water and salt until you have a soft dough that holds together.
Divide dough into 12 equal balls and flatten into thin 3-inch discs between plastic wrap.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and fry each disc for 30 seconds, then flip and fry until puffed but still soft.
Remove from oil and carefully cut a slit in the side of each panucho while still warm.
Stuff each panucho with 1-2 tbsp of mashed black beans using a small spoon.
Top with shredded chicken seasoned with lime juice, salt, and minced onion.
Serve with pickled onions and habanero sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Make masa dough in bulk and refrigerate or freeze for multiple batches
Use canned black beans to save cooking time

recipes.name: Salbutes
recipes.description: Yucatecan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix masa harina with warm water and salt until a soft dough forms.
Form dough into 9 small balls about the size of walnuts.
Flatten each ball gently into a thin round disc between plastic wrap, leaving slightly thicker in center.
Heat oil in a skillet to 350°F and fry discs for 1 minute per side until lightly golden and puffy.
Drain on paper towels and allow to cool slightly.
Season shredded chicken with lime juice and salt.
Top each salbute with lettuce, tomato, pickled onion, and seasoned chicken.
Drizzle with habanero pepper sauce and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy rotisserie chicken and shred at home instead of pre-shredded
Use store-brand habanero sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Empanadas Yucatecas
recipes.description: Yucatecan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground pork in a skillet over medium heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add minced onion and garlic, cook until fragrant, then season with cumin and salt.
Chop hard-boiled eggs and green olives, then mix into the cooked pork and cool slightly.
Make masa dough by mixing masa harina with warm water and salt.
Divide dough into 8 equal portions and flatten each between plastic wrap into a 4-inch disc.
Place 2 tbsp pork filling and a few chopped egg pieces in center of each disc.
Fold in half and press edges firmly to seal, creating a half-moon shape.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry empanadas 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Prepare filling ahead and refrigerate to save last-minute prep time
Make double batch and freeze uncooked empanadas for future frying

recipes.name: Marquesitas
recipes.description: Yucatecan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then add vanilla extract.
Sift flour with salt and stir into butter mixture until combined.
Drop small spoonfuls of batter onto prepared baking sheet, spacing 3 inches apart.
Bake for 6-8 minutes until edges are golden brown and centers are still soft.
Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle grated cheese and cinnamon on top.
Working quickly while warm, roll each cookie tightly around a wooden dowel or handle, then slide off onto a rack.
Cool completely before storing in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Use a dowel or pencil instead of buying specialty marquesita molds
Make a double batch since these store well for 3-4 days

recipes.name: Dulce de Papaya
recipes.description: Yucatecan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel green papaya, remove seeds, and cut into 1-inch cubes.
In a large pot, combine water and sugar to make a simple syrup, bring to boil.
Add papaya cubes, cinnamon stick, cloves, lime juice, and salt.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 45-50 minutes, stirring occasionally, until papaya becomes translucent.
Add vanilla extract and continue simmering for 5 more minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Transfer to glass jars and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Serve chilled as a dessert or sweet snack, with the syrup spooned over.
cheapTips: Buy unripe green papayas when in season at farmers markets for lower cost
Make in large batches and jar for gifts or extended storage

recipes.name: Camarones al Ajillo
recipes.description: Yucatecan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and devein shrimp, leaving tails intact if desired, and pat dry.
Slice garlic thinly or mince, depending on preference.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes on first side, then flip and cook for 2 more minutes.
Pour in white wine and lime juice, add butter, salt, and pepper.
Cook for 1 more minute until shrimp are fully opaque.
Transfer to a serving plate, garnish with fresh cilantro, and serve with rice or crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk and thaw as needed to save money
Skip the white wine and use extra lime juice for a dairy-free alternative

recipes.name: Camarones Tikinxic
recipes.description: Yucatecan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak banana leaves briefly in hot water to make them pliable.
Blend achiote paste, lime juice, orange juice, garlic, and salt into a marinade.
Peel and devein shrimp, then coat with marinade and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Prepare a sauce by blending tomato, habanero, and remaining garlic with a splash of water.
Slice onion into rings.
Lay out banana leaves and divide marinated shrimp among them.
Top each shrimp portion with tomato sauce and onion rings.
Fold banana leaves to create packets and secure with kitchen twine.
Grill packets over medium-high heat for 12-15 minutes, or bake at 400°F for 15-18 minutes until shrimp are cooked through.
Serve in banana leaf packets with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Substitute foil for banana leaves if unavailable in your area
Buy achiote paste at Hispanic markets for better prices than specialty stores

recipes.name: Gulai Tambusu
recipes.description: Sumatran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend onions, garlic, ginger, and red chili peppers into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté the spice paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add ground beef and cook for 5 minutes, breaking it up as it browns.
Stir in turmeric powder and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk and water, then bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 25 minutes until the sauce thickens and flavors meld.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use ground beef scraps or buy in bulk when on sale
Make your own spice paste instead of buying pre-made curry paste

recipes.name: Otak-Otak
recipes.description: Sumatran snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely chop onions, garlic, and red chilies, then mix with ground fish.
Whisk eggs with coconut milk, turmeric, and salt in a bowl.
Combine the fish mixture with the egg-coconut mixture and stir well.
Divide mixture evenly among banana leaf or foil squares, folding edges to create sealed packets.
Heat oil in a large skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Place packets seam-side down and cook for 8-10 minutes until golden.
Flip packets carefully and cook another 7-8 minutes.
Serve hot with sambal or chili sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Use canned mackerel instead of fresh fish for lower cost
Substitute banana leaves with parchment paper or foil if unavailable

recipes.name: Rendang Telur
recipes.description: Sumatran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Hard boil eggs for 8 minutes, then peel and set aside.
Blend onions, garlic, ginger, chilies, and lemongrass into a thick paste.
Heat oil in a wok or large pan and fry the paste for 3-4 minutes until aromatic.
Add turmeric and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally.
Add boiled eggs and simmer for 10-12 minutes until the sauce reduces and coats the eggs.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk for better pricing
Use dried lemongrass if fresh is unavailable and expensive

recipes.name: Gulai Ayam
recipes.description: Sumatran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend onions, garlic, ginger, and red chilies into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the spice paste for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add turmeric and cumin, stirring for 30 seconds.
Add chicken pieces and brown them for 5 minutes on all sides.
Pour in coconut milk and water, then bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 30-35 minutes until chicken is tender.
Uncover and simmer for 5 more minutes to reduce sauce slightly.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for lower cost and more flavor
Buy whole spices and grind at home for better prices

recipes.name: Sambal Goreng Udang
recipes.description: Sumatran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend red chilies, garlic, and onions into a coarse paste.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add the spice paste and fry for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add shrimp and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until they begin to turn pink.
Add diced tomatoes and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Season with lime juice, fish sauce, and sugar.
Cook for 1 more minute until shrimp are fully cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper, then serve immediately with rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp instead of fresh for significant savings
Use regular soy sauce instead of fish sauce if budget-conscious

recipes.name: Lemang
recipes.description: Sumatran breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse glutinous rice thoroughly under cold water until water runs clear.
Mix coconut milk with salt, sugar, and water in a large bowl.
Add rice to the coconut mixture and stir until well combined.
Line bamboo poles or foil tubes with banana leaves, folding the leaves to fit snugly.
Fill each tube three-quarters full with the rice mixture.
Fold the banana leaf tops to seal the tubes closed.
Place tubes vertically in a large pot with 2 inches of water at the bottom.
Cover pot and steam for 90 minutes, checking water level periodically and adding more if needed.
Remove from heat, cool slightly, and carefully push lemang out of tubes onto a serving plate.
Slice into rounds and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use aluminum foil tubes instead of buying bamboo if bamboo is expensive
Buy glutinous rice in bulk at Asian markets for better pricing

recipes.name: Cucur Udang
recipes.description: Sumatran snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a mixing bowl.
Create a well in the center and add the egg and water, stirring until a thick batter forms.
Fold in minced onions, garlic, and red chili peppers.
Add shrimp and stir gently to distribute throughout the batter.
Heat oil in a deep pan or wok to 350°F (175°C).
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes until golden brown on all sides.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with sweet chili sauce or sambal.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp to reduce cost and prep time
Reuse frying oil for multiple batches

recipes.name: Soto Ayam Palembang
recipes.description: Sumatran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend onions, garlic, and ginger into a paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the paste for 2 minutes until aromatic.
Add turmeric and cumin, stirring for 30 seconds.
Add chicken pieces and brown lightly for 3-4 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and add the bruised lemongrass stalk.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove lemongrass and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in bowls garnished with fresh cilantro and accompanied by steamed rice or rice crackers.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs for lower cost and richer broth flavor
Buy broth in bulk or make your own from chicken scraps

recipes.name: Rendang Jantung Pisang
recipes.description: Sumatran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend onions, garlic, ginger, chilies, and lemongrass into a thick paste.
Heat oil in a large pan or wok over medium heat.
Fry the spice paste for 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently, until fragrant and darkened.
Add turmeric powder and stir for 30 seconds.
Add sliced banana heart and toss to coat with the paste for 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and stir well to combine.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and coats the banana heart.
Season with salt to taste and serve with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Substitute canned heart of palm if fresh banana heart is unavailable
Buy coconut milk in bulk at Asian markets for better value

recipes.name: Kari Nangka
recipes.description: Sumatran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 2 cans (14 oz each) drained and shredded

steps: Blend onions, garlic, ginger, and red chilies into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the spice paste for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add turmeric and cumin, stirring for 30 seconds.
Add shredded jackfruit and stir to coat with the spice mixture for 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and water, stirring to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and flavors develop.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with steamed rice or with flat bread.
cheapTips: Buy canned young jackfruit in brine at Asian grocery stores for best prices
Substitute potatoes or mushrooms if jackfruit is unavailable

recipes.name: Guacamole Oaxaqueño
recipes.description: Oaxacan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut avocados in half lengthwise, remove the pit, and scoop flesh into a molcajete or bowl.
Gently mash avocados to desired consistency, leaving some chunks.
Add diced onion, serrano peppers, cilantro, and tomato to the avocado.
Squeeze juice from both limes over the mixture.
Season with sea salt and fold gently to combine.
Serve immediately with warm tortilla chips.
cheapTips: Buy avocados when on sale and ripen at home
Use bottled lime juice if fresh limes are expensive

recipes.name: Tasajo
recipes.description: Oaxacan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim fat from beef and slice thinly against the grain into strips about 1/4-inch thick.
Season beef strips with salt and oregano, then let sit 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry beef in batches until golden and crispy, about 15 minutes total.
Remove beef and set aside, then sauté onion and garlic in the same skillet until softened.
Add diced tomatoes and serrano peppers, cooking until tomatoes break down, about 5 minutes.
Return beef to the skillet and mix well with the tomato sauce.
Warm tortillas and serve tasajo with the sauce spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy less expensive cuts like flank steak or sirloin tip
Make extra and freeze for quick weeknight meals

recipes.name: Sopa de Hoja Santa
recipes.description: Oaxacan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add chicken cubes and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Add diced potatoes and cook for 15 minutes until nearly tender.
Stir in corn kernels and hoja santa leaves, cooking for 5 more minutes.
Season with salt and add fresh epazote or cilantro.
Simmer until all vegetables are tender and flavors meld, about 5 minutes more.
Serve hot in bowls with warm tortillas on the side.
cheapTips: Substitute fresh spinach or kale if hoja santa is unavailable
Use rotisserie chicken to save time and reduce cost

recipes.name: Alebrijes Dulces
recipes.description: Oaxacan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine sugar, water, and corn syrup in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat.
Stir until sugar dissolves, then stop stirring and let mixture boil until it reaches 300°F (hard crack stage), about 20 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla extract carefully.
Add food coloring drops if desired and stir quickly.
Pour mixture onto parchment paper in small spoonfuls forming decorative shapes.
Let cool completely, about 15 minutes.
Mix powdered sugar with cinnamon and dust over cooled candies.
Store in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Buy sugar in bulk to reduce costs significantly
Use gel food coloring sparingly as it's concentrated

recipes.name: Mole Coloradito
recipes.description: Oaxacan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil chicken thighs with onion and salt in a pot for 25 minutes, then shred and set aside with 2 cups broth.
Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles, then toast lightly in a dry skillet for 1 minute.
Soak toasted chiles in hot water for 10 minutes, then drain.
Blend soaked chiles, garlic, tomatoes, cinnamon, and 1 cup broth until smooth.
Heat oil in a large saucepan and fry the chile mixture for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in reserved chicken broth slowly, stirring to combine well.
Add shredded chicken and chocolate, simmering for 15 minutes until flavors blend and sauce thickens.
Serve over warm tortillas or with rice.
cheapTips: Buy dried chiles in bulk sections of Mexican markets
Use dark cocoa powder (1 tablespoon) if chocolate is expensive

recipes.name: Chocolate Oaxaqueño
recipes.description: Oaxacan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 2 tablets (3.5 oz each) or 7 oz chopped

steps: Combine milk and water in a saucepan and heat over medium heat until steaming but not boiling.
Add cinnamon stick and let simmer for 2 minutes to infuse.
Break chocolate into chunks and add to the hot liquid along with ground almonds and sugar.
Whisk vigorously with a molinillo (chocolate whisk) or regular whisk until chocolate dissolves and mixture becomes frothy.
Add vanilla extract and a pinch of salt, stirring to combine.
Pour into serving mugs and serve immediately with pan dulce or churros.
cheapTips: Buy chocolate tablets at Mexican markets for better prices than specialty stores
Substitute regular milk and water for expensive specialty milk

recipes.name: Gusanos de Maguey
recipes.description: Oaxacan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse canned or thawed maguey worms thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add maguey worms to the skillet and stir-fry for 5 minutes until lightly crispy.
Season with salt and oregano, tossing well.
Warm tortillas in another skillet or directly over a flame.
Serve worms in warm tortillas with lime wedges for squeezing.
cheapTips: Purchase canned gusanos de maguey from Latin markets
Buy frozen instead of fresh to reduce cost

recipes.name: Gulai Kepala Ikan
recipes.description: Sumatran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean fish head thoroughly and cut into 3-4 large pieces, discarding gills.
Blend shallots, garlic, ginger, red chiles, turmeric, and galangal with 1/2 cup coconut milk into a paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the spice paste for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add remaining coconut milk slowly and bring to a simmer.
Carefully add fish head pieces to the simmering broth.
Cook for 20-25 minutes until fish is cooked through and sauce has thickened.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot over white rice in deep bowls.
cheapTips: Ask fishmonger for fish heads as they're often discounted or free
Buy frozen fish heads at Asian markets for lower cost

recipes.name: Lumpia Goreng
recipes.description: Sumatran snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or skillet and cook minced garlic until fragrant.
Add ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Stir in cabbage, carrots, and green onions, cooking until vegetables are tender-crisp, about 5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and cool filling to room temperature.
Place 1 tablespoon filling on each lumpia wrapper near one corner, then roll tightly, folding in sides as you roll.
Seal the edge with a drop of water and your finger.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or wok and fry lumpia in batches until golden, about 3 minutes per batch.
Drain on paper towels and serve with sweet chili sauce or vinegar for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy lumpia wrappers in bulk at Asian grocery stores
Use cabbage as the main filling for vegetarian and cheaper version

recipes.name: Laksa Palembang
recipes.description: Sumatran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend shallots, garlic, red chiles, turmeric, and shrimp paste with 1/2 cup coconut milk into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the spice paste for 4 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in fish stock and remaining coconut milk, bringing to a simmer.
Add cubed fish and cook for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Cook rice noodles according to package directions, drain, and set aside.
Prepare hard boiled eggs and peel them.
Season broth with salt to taste.
Divide cooked noodles into serving bowls, ladle hot broth with fish over top, and garnish with egg halves and fried shallots.
cheapTips: Use budget white fish like tilapia or cod instead of expensive varieties
Make fish stock from bones at home if available

recipes.name: Humo de Oaxaca
recipes.description: Oaxacan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles and toast them in a dry skillet for 1 minute until fragrant.
Soak the toasted chiles in 1 cup of hot water for 10 minutes until soft, then blend with garlic, onion, and cumin until smooth.
Heat oil in a large pot and strain the chile mixture through a sieve into the hot oil, stirring constantly for 2 minutes to cook out the raw flavor.
Add chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil, then add chicken breasts and simmer for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken, shred it with two forks, and return it to the pot with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm tortillas on a griddle and serve alongside the smoky broth in bowls.
Guests assemble their own servings by dipping tortillas into the broth.
cheapTips: Buy dried chiles in bulk from Latin markets for 50% less
Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor at lower cost

recipes.name: Quesillo Oaxaqueño
recipes.description: Oaxacan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk in a large pot to 90°F (32°C), then slowly add vinegar while stirring gently until curds begin to form.
Continue heating to 104°F (40°C) over 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until a clear separation of curds and whey occurs.
Pour curds into a cheesecloth-lined colander and let drain for 10 minutes.
Gather the cheesecloth and hang it to drain for another 10 minutes until curds firm up.
Transfer curds to a microwave-safe bowl, microwave for 1 minute, drain excess whey, then microwave again for 1 minute.
Stretch the warm cheese by kneading and pulling it until it becomes smooth and shiny like mozzarella, adding salt and oregano as you work.
Form stretched cheese into a ball, cool slightly, then wrap in plastic and refrigerate.
Serve at room temperature with sautéed jalapeños and onions cooked in oil.
cheapTips: Buy milk on sale and make multiple batches at once
Use white distilled vinegar from discount stores

recipes.name: Caldo Tlalpeño Oaxaqueño
recipes.description: Oaxacan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried pasilla chiles in a dry skillet for 1 minute, remove stems and seeds, then soak in 1 cup hot water for 10 minutes.
Blend softened chiles with soaking liquid, garlic, and onion until smooth, then strain through a sieve.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add the strained chile mixture, stirring well.
Add chicken breast and simmer for 20 minutes until cooked through, then remove and shred it.
Return shredded chicken to pot with canned tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Ladle soup into bowls and top each with sliced avocado, a drizzle of crema, tortilla chips, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
cheapTips: Skip the crema topping to save $1 per serving
Buy avocados in bulk when on sale and freeze extras

recipes.name: Buñuelos Oaxaqueños
recipes.description: Oaxacan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat eggs with milk and sugar until well combined, then add to dry ingredients and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Heat oil in a deep skillet or pot to 350°F (175°C), checking temperature with a thermometer.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil, 4-5 at a time, frying for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown, then transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
While buñuelos cook, combine honey, cinnamon, and piloncillo in a small saucepan and warm over low heat.
Arrange fried buñuelos on a serving plate and drizzle generously with the warm honey-cinnamon syrup.
cheapTips: Make syrup from honey and cinnamon instead of buying bottled
Reuse frying oil by filtering and storing in the refrigerator

recipes.name: Tamales Oaxaqueños
recipes.description: Oaxacan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried corn husks in hot water for 20 minutes until pliable.
Toast dried chiles lightly, remove stems and seeds, soak in 0.5 cup broth for 10 minutes, then blend with garlic until smooth.
Beat lard with an electric mixer for 5 minutes until fluffy, then gradually add masa harina mixed with baking powder and salt, alternating with chicken broth until a light dough forms.
Spread 2 tablespoons of masa onto the smooth side of each soaked corn husk, leaving borders on all sides.
Mix shredded chicken with blended chile sauce and place 1 tablespoon in the center of each masa-covered husk.
Roll husk tightly over filling, then fold up the pointed bottom end and leave the top open.
Stand tamales upright with open end up in a steamer pot with 2 inches of water below a steamer rack, cover with extra corn husks, and steam for 45 minutes.
Check doneness by removing one tamale; the masa should pull away cleanly from the husk when ready.
cheapTips: Buy masa harina in 5 lb bags from Latin markets to cut cost in half
Make a double batch and freeze extras for quick breakfasts

recipes.name: Mole Rojo Oaxaqueño
recipes.description: Oaxacan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried chiles in a dry skillet for 1 minute per side, then remove stems and seeds and soak in 2 cups hot water for 15 minutes.
Toast cumin seeds and cinnamon stick in a dry skillet for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Blend softened chiles with soaking liquid, garlic, onion, tomatoes, and toasted spices until completely smooth.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and carefully strain the chile mixture into the hot oil, stirring constantly for 3 minutes to cook out raw flavors.
Add chicken broth to the chile sauce and bring to a simmer.
Add chicken thighs to the pot and simmer for 35 minutes until cooked through and tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and simmer for 5 more minutes.
cheapTips: Buy dried chiles in bulk from Mexican markets instead of supermarkets
Use chicken thighs instead of breasts; they're cheaper and more flavorful

recipes.name: Tejate
recipes.description: Oaxacan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix masa harina with 1 cup cold milk in a bowl, stirring until smooth and lump-free.
Heat remaining 3 cups milk with cinnamon sticks, sugar, and salt in a pot until steaming but not boiling.
Slowly pour the masa mixture into the hot milk while stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Continue cooking and stirring for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly.
Grate or chop the chocolate tablet and add it to the pot along with vanilla extract, stirring until melted.
Pour into mugs and serve hot with a cinnamon stick in each cup.
cheapTips: Substitute regular chocolate powder for Oaxacan chocolate and save 40%
Buy masa harina in bulk for consistent savings

recipes.name: Chicatanas
recipes.description: Oaxacan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean grasshoppers by removing wings and legs if desired, then rinse and pat dry.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering, then add grasshoppers and cook for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy, stirring occasionally.
Add minced garlic, onion, and chile powder to the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Remove from heat, add lime juice and salt, toss well, and serve immediately as a crunchy snack.
cheapTips: Source grasshoppers from local Mexican markets or specialty suppliers for best prices
Make in bulk during peak season and store in an airtight container

recipes.name: Empanadas Oaxaqueñas
recipes.description: Oaxacan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl, then work in shortening with your fingers until mixture resembles coarse sand.
Add egg and gradually add water while stirring until a soft dough forms, then let rest for 10 minutes covered.
Brown ground beef with onion, garlic, and oregano in a skillet over medium heat for 8 minutes, then cool.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece between two pieces of plastic wrap into a thin circle.
Place 2 tablespoons of filling on one half of each circle, then fold in half and press edges to seal, crimping with a fork.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F (175°C) and fry empanadas 2-3 at a time for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm, optionally with salsa or hot sauce.
cheapTips: Use ground beef on sale and freeze in portions before making
Reuse frying oil and filter between batches to extend its life

recipes.name: Mole Amarillo
recipes.description: Oaxacan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried chiles in a dry skillet for 1 minute per side, then remove stems and seeds and soak in 2 cups hot water for 15 minutes.
Toast cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, cloves, and peppercorns in a dry skillet for 1 minute until fragrant, then grind in a spice grinder or molcajete.
Blend softened chiles with soaking liquid, garlic, onion, and ground spices until completely smooth.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and strain the chile mixture into the hot oil, stirring constantly for 3 minutes to cook out raw flavors.
Add chicken broth to the pot and bring to a simmer, then add chicken thighs and cook for 35 minutes until tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and lime juice, then simmer for 5 more minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Toast spices in bulk and store for multiple mole batches
Buy chicken thighs on sale and use immediately or freeze

recipes.name: Pastel Goreng
recipes.description: Sumatran snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil and mash potatoes until smooth.
Brown the ground chicken with minced garlic and onion in a skillet over medium heat.
Mix mashed potatoes with cooked chicken, season with salt and pepper, and let cool.
Combine flour, water, egg, and salt to make a dough, knead until smooth.
Roll dough thin and cut into 3-inch squares.
Place a spoonful of filling on each square, fold into triangle, and seal edges.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry pastels until golden brown on both sides.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy chicken parts on sale and grind yourself
Use regular potatoes instead of waxy varieties to save cost

recipes.name: Gulai Tambusu Ayam
recipes.description: Sumatran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cube chicken into 1-inch pieces and potatoes into similar sizes.
Blend onions, garlic, ginger, turmeric, and chili with 1/4 cup water into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the spice paste for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and stir-fry for 5 minutes until partially cooked.
Pour in coconut milk, add lemongrass stalks, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add potatoes and continue simmering for 20 minutes until both chicken and potatoes are tender.
Season with salt to taste and remove lemongrass stalks.
Serve hot over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for better flavor and lower cost
Make your own curry paste to save 50% versus pre-made versions

recipes.name: Caponata
recipes.description: Sicilian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplant into 3/4-inch cubes, toss with salt, and let sit 15 minutes to remove moisture.
Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry eggplant until golden brown in batches.
In the same skillet, add remaining oil and sauté diced onion, celery, and garlic until softened.
Return eggplant to skillet and add canned tomatoes with juice, olives, and capers.
Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until flavors meld, stirring occasionally.
Stir in red wine vinegar and season with salt and pepper.
Simmer for 2 more minutes and transfer to a serving dish.
Serve at room temperature as an appetizer or side dish.
cheapTips: Buy eggplant from farmers markets when in season for 40% savings
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh year-round for better price

recipes.name: Pasta con le Sardine
recipes.description: Sicilian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook pasta until al dente.
Meanwhile, trim fennel, quarter lengthwise, and thinly slice across.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet and sauté diced onion and fennel until soft, about 8 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Drain sardines and gently fold into the skillet with raisins and pine nuts.
Dissolve saffron in 1/4 cup pasta water and add to the skillet, heating through.
Drain pasta and toss with the sardine sauce.
Serve immediately with a drizzle of olive oil.
cheapTips: Buy sardines in bulk when on sale and store indefinitely
Skip the saffron and add turmeric for similar color at 1/10 the cost

recipes.name: Panelle
recipes.description: Sicilian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 4 cups water in a large pot over medium heat.
Slowly whisk in chickpea flour, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Add salt, black pepper, and olive oil, continuing to stir.
Cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture is thick and pulls away from pot sides.
Pour mixture onto a wet parchment-lined sheet to 1/4-inch thickness and let cool completely.
Cut cooled mixture into 2-inch squares.
Heat frying oil to 350°F and fry panelle until golden and crispy, about 2 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy chickpea flour in bulk from Indian or Middle Eastern markets
Reuse frying oil multiple times for maximum economy

recipes.name: Sfincione
recipes.description: Sicilian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and 1 tbsp flour; let sit 10 minutes until foamy.
Combine remaining flour and salt, then add yeast mixture and 2 tbsp olive oil, kneading until smooth dough forms.
Let dough rise in an oiled bowl for 45 minutes until doubled.
Meanwhile, sauté sliced onions in 2 tbsp olive oil until golden, then add canned tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°F and oil a 9x13 baking pan.
Press dough into the prepared pan, creating a thick crust.
Spread tomato-onion sauce over dough, arrange anchovies, scatter cheese and breadcrumbs on top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until crust is golden and edges are crispy.
cheapTips: Make dough the night before to save time and improve flavor
Use bulk mozzarella from warehouse stores instead of specialty cheese

recipes.name: Sarde a Beccafico
recipes.description: Sicilian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean sardines by removing heads and gutting, then rinse well.
Fillet each sardine carefully by opening like a book and removing the spine.
Toast breadcrumbs in a dry skillet for 2 minutes, then mix with pine nuts, raisins, minced garlic, parsley, and parmesan.
Drizzle the breadcrumb mixture with 3 tbsp olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place a spoonful of filling on each sardine fillet, then roll tightly from tail to head.
Arrange rolled sardines seam-side down in an oiled baking dish.
Drizzle remaining olive oil and lemon juice over sardines and season lightly.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes until sardines are cooked through.
cheapTips: Buy fresh sardines from fishmonger counter instead of pre-packaged
Make breadcrumb mixture with day-old bread from bakery bins

recipes.name: Pasta alla Catanese
recipes.description: Sicilian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cube eggplant into 1-inch pieces and salt generously, let sit 15 minutes to release moisture.
Heat 1/4 cup olive oil in a large skillet and fry eggplant until golden brown, drain on paper towels.
Dice tomatoes and mince garlic.
In the same skillet with remaining oil, sauté garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes and red pepper flakes, simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Fold fried eggplant and fresh basil into tomato sauce and warm through.
Toss drained pasta with sauce and top with ricotta salata cheese and additional basil.
cheapTips: Buy eggplant in season at farmers markets for 50% savings
Use canned diced tomatoes instead of fresh for consistent pricing

recipes.name: Bucatini all'Amatriciana Siciliana
recipes.description: Sicilian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and add bucatini.
While pasta cooks, fry diced pancetta in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Remove pancetta with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving 2 tbsp fat in skillet.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in pancetta fat until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add canned tomatoes with juices and red pepper flakes, simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in crispy pancetta and season with salt and black pepper.
Drain pasta and toss with sauce.
Serve with generous amounts of grated pecorino romano cheese.
cheapTips: Buy pancetta ends and pieces instead of sliced for 30% savings
Make large batches and freeze sauce for quick weeknight meals

recipes.name: Granita con Brioche
recipes.description: Sicilian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat water and sugar in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves completely.
Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice and lemon zest.
Cool the syrup to room temperature, then transfer to a shallow freezer-safe container.
Freeze for 30 minutes, then scrape with a fork, breaking up ice crystals; repeat every 30 minutes for 4-5 hours.
Once granita reaches a slushy consistency, it's ready to serve.
Toast brioche buns lightly with butter until golden.
Spoon granita into chilled bowls and serve immediately alongside toasted brioche.
Eat by dunking brioche pieces into the granita.
cheapTips: Use generic brioche from grocery store bakery instead of specialty shops
Make granita with simple syrup and fruit juice for variety at same cost

recipes.name: Arancini al Ragù
recipes.description: Sicilian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large pot, sauté diced onion until soft, then brown the ground beef, breaking it apart.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 2 minutes, then add 1 cup broth, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes uncovered.
Heat remaining 4 cups broth in another pot, add rice, stir frequently, and cook until all liquid is absorbed, about 18 minutes.
Spread cooked rice on a baking sheet to cool for 15 minutes, then mix in Parmesan cheese.
Once rice is cool enough to handle, wet your hands, take a fist-sized portion, press a mozzarella cube in the center, form into a ball, and set on a plate.
Beat eggs in one bowl and spread breadcrumbs in another; roll each arancino in egg then breadcrumbs.
Heat 3 cups oil in a deep pan to 350°F, carefully fry arancini in batches 3–4 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with the ragù spooned over top.
cheapTips: Use long-grain white rice if Arborio is unavailable; the texture won't be identical but still works.
Make the ragù the day before and refrigerate to save time and deepen flavor.

recipes.name: Involtini di Pesce Spada
recipes.description: Sicilian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix breadcrumbs, Parmesan, parsley, garlic, pine nuts, raisins, and 1 egg in a bowl; season with salt and pepper.
Lay swordfish slices flat on a cutting board and pound gently with a mallet to even thickness.
Spoon 2 tablespoons of filling onto each swordfish slice, roll tightly, and secure with a toothpick.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Place involtini seam-side down in the pan and cook 4 minutes per side until golden.
Drizzle with lemon juice and cook 1 more minute.
Transfer to a serving plate and serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Substitute swordfish with halibut or thick cod fillets if swordfish is too expensive.
Toast pine nuts yourself in a dry pan instead of buying pre-toasted to cut costs.

recipes.name: Cavolfiore Fritto
recipes.description: Sicilian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch cauliflower florets in salted boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and pat completely dry with paper towels.
Whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and garlic powder in a bowl.
Add water to the dry ingredients and stir until a smooth, thick batter forms.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Dip each cauliflower floret into the batter, coating completely, and carefully place in hot oil.
Fry in batches for 4–5 minutes, turning once, until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, and sprinkle with salt immediately.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy whole cauliflower heads and cut them yourself instead of pre-cut florets.
Reuse the frying oil if it's still clean; strain and store in a sealed container.

recipes.name: Zuppa di Pesce
recipes.description: Sicilian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot, sauté onion and garlic until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add red pepper flakes, then pour in white wine and simmer 2 minutes to reduce slightly.
Add canned tomatoes and fish broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.
Add cubed fish and shrimp, simmer 5 minutes until partially cooked.
Stir in mussels and clams, cover, and cook 8–10 minutes until shells open, discarding any that don't.
Taste and season with salt and pepper, then stir in fresh basil.
Ladle soup into bowls and serve with sliced crusty bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy fish and shellfish on sale and freeze; thaw overnight before cooking.
Use canned fish broth or make your own from fish bones to reduce cost.

recipes.name: Anelletti al Forno
recipes.description: Sicilian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and lightly oil a 9×13 inch baking dish.
Brown ground beef in a large pot with oil, onion, and garlic, breaking meat apart as it cooks, about 8 minutes.
Stir in tomato sauce and broth, simmer 15 minutes, then fold in frozen peas and season with salt and pepper.
Cook anelletti pasta to al dente, drain, and transfer to a large bowl.
Beat eggs in a small bowl, then pour over pasta and toss to coat, then add mozzarella and half the Parmesan, tossing again.
Spread half the pasta mixture into the prepared baking dish, pour half the meat sauce over top, repeat layers with remaining pasta and sauce.
Sprinkle remaining Parmesan evenly over the top.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes until the top is lightly browned and pasta is heated through.
cheapTips: Substitute anelletti with ditalini or elbow pasta if unavailable.
Make the meat sauce a day ahead and refrigerate to simplify assembly.

recipes.name: Pasta ai Ricci di Mare
recipes.description: Sicilian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti to al dente, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, gently warm olive oil in a large skillet over low heat and add minced garlic, cooking 1 minute until fragrant but not browned.
Pour in white wine and simmer 2 minutes to reduce slightly.
Drain pasta, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water, and add pasta to the skillet with the garlic oil.
Gently fold in sea urchin roe and 1/4 cup pasta water, tossing very carefully so the roe doesn't break apart.
Remove from heat, add lemon juice, parsley, and red pepper flakes, tossing gently.
Add remaining pasta water as needed to achieve a silky sauce, season with sea salt and black pepper, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Sea urchin is expensive; check local fish markets for better prices or buy frozen uni.
Use bottled clam juice mixed with white wine if fresh uni is unavailable.

recipes.name: Crocchette di Patate
recipes.description: Sicilian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water until tender, about 20 minutes, then drain well and let cool slightly.
Pass potatoes through a ricer or mash very smoothly, then stir in 1 egg, Parmesan, and parsley; season with salt and pepper.
Shape into cylinders about 3 inches long and 1 inch wide, arranging on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Refrigerate croquettes for at least 10 minutes to firm up.
Beat remaining egg in a shallow bowl and spread breadcrumbs in another bowl.
Roll each croquette in beaten egg, then coat with breadcrumbs, pressing gently.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and fry croquettes in batches 3–4 minutes until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk; they are inexpensive and store well.
Reuse the frying oil after straining to save money.

recipes.name: Timballo di Pasta
recipes.description: Sicilian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 10-inch round baking dish.
Heat oil in a pot, brown ground beef and chicken livers with onion and garlic, then add tomato sauce and simmer 20 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Cook ditalini and penne pasta separately to al dente, drain both, and combine in a large bowl.
Stir 2 beaten eggs and 1/2 cup Parmesan into the combined pasta, then fold in mozzarella and peas.
Pour the meat sauce over pasta mixture and gently toss to combine.
Cut bread into thin slices, arrange to cover the bottom and sides of the baking dish, overlapping as needed.
Pour pasta mixture into the dish, fold bread edges over the top, brush with remaining beaten egg, and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan.
Bake uncovered for 35 minutes until top is golden brown, then let rest 5 minutes before turning out onto a serving plate and slicing into wedges.
cheapTips: Omit chicken livers if unavailable; increase ground beef to 1.25 lbs for similar flavor.
Use day-old bread, which is cheaper and works better for the crust.

recipes.name: Pani ca Meusa
recipes.description: Sicilian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slowly whisk chickpea flour into cold water with salt, stirring to avoid lumps, and let rest 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 325°F.
Pour batter slowly from a measuring cup into hot oil, using a fork to break it into irregular pieces as it fries, 3–4 minutes until golden and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Split bread rolls and gently hollow out a small amount of crumb from each half.
Stuff each roll with the fried chickpea mixture, then drizzle with lemon juice and vinegar.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve immediately while the bread is still warm and chickpea pieces are crispy.
cheapTips: Buy chickpea flour in bulk from ethnic or Middle Eastern markets for better prices.
Reuse frying oil multiple times if strained carefully.

recipes.name: Spaghetti alla Bottarga
recipes.description: Sicilian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti to al dente, about 9 minutes.
While pasta cooks, slowly warm olive oil in a large skillet over low heat and add thinly sliced garlic and red pepper flakes.
Cook garlic 1–2 minutes until fragrant but not browned, stirring occasionally.
Drain pasta, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water, and add pasta to the skillet with garlic oil.
Remove skillet from heat, then sprinkle bottarga over pasta and gently toss with 1/4 cup pasta water to create a light sauce.
Add lemon juice and zest, parsley, salt, and black pepper, tossing gently.
Add remaining pasta water as needed for a silky consistency and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Bottarga is expensive; buy smaller quantities and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
If bottarga is unavailable, substitute with grated Pecorino Romano cheese mixed with a pinch of anchovy paste for similar umami.

recipes.name: Polpo all'Olivese
recipes.description: Sicilian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thaw frozen octopus and boil in salted water for 45 minutes until tender, then drain and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté minced garlic and red pepper for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tomato paste and stir constantly for 2 minutes to caramelize slightly.
Pour in white wine and simmer for 3 minutes to reduce by half.
Add octopus pieces, olives, and capers to the skillet and stir gently.
Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally until flavors meld.
Season with salt and taste, adjusting as needed.
Garnish generously with fresh parsley and serve warm at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy frozen octopus instead of fresh—same quality, lower price
Use canned black olives instead of expensive brined varieties

recipes.name: Laksa Penang
recipes.description: Malay lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried chilies in hot water for 10 minutes, then drain and blend with shallots, garlic, turmeric, and shrimp paste into a smooth paste.
Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the chili paste for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add fish stock and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and add shrimp, simmering for 5 minutes until shrimp are cooked through.
Cook rice noodles in boiling salted water according to package directions, drain well.
Divide noodles among four bowls and ladle hot laksa broth and shrimp over top.
Top each bowl with bean sprouts and cilantro.
Serve immediately while steaming hot.
cheapTips: Buy shrimp paste in bulk Asian markets—costs half the price
Use frozen shrimp instead of fresh for better value

recipes.name: Asam Laksa
recipes.description: Malay lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried chilies in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with shallots, garlic, and galangal into a paste.
Strain tamarind paste through a fine sieve into a bowl, discarding solids, then set aside.
