Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil, then add chunked carrots and zucchini; simmer for 20 minutes.
Add chickpeas and simmer for another 10 minutes until vegetables are tender.
In a separate pot, bring 3 cups of salted water to boil and pour couscous into a heatproof bowl.
Pour the boiling water over couscous, cover with plastic wrap, and let sit for 5 minutes.
Fluff couscous with a fork and transfer to a serving platter, topping with meat stew and vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor and savings
Use dried chickpeas soaked overnight instead of canned

recipes.name: Tajine Lamb
recipes.description: Algerian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut lamb into 2-inch chunks and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large pot or tajine dish and brown lamb pieces in batches for 3-4 minutes each.
Remove lamb and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Return lamb to pot, add ginger, cinnamon stick, and cumin, stirring well.
Pour beef broth over lamb and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 45 minutes until lamb is tender, then add apricots and almonds.
Continue simmering uncovered for 15 more minutes to reduce sauce slightly.
Taste and adjust seasonings before serving.
cheapTips: Buy lamb when on sale and freeze for later
Skip almonds or use peanuts as a budget alternative

recipes.name: Mkate Tabouna
recipes.description: Algerian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water with a pinch of sugar and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt in a large bowl, then add yeast mixture and 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Knead dough for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, adding water as needed.
Cover dough and let rest for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Divide dough into 3 balls and roll each into a flat, round bread about 0.5 inch thick.
Heat a cast iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and brush with remaining olive oil.
Place bread on hot skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until puffy and golden with brown spots.
Sprinkle coriander and anise seeds on top while cooking if desired.
cheapTips: Make larger batches and freeze cooked bread for quick reheating
Skip spice seeds to reduce cost further

recipes.name: Chakhchoukha
recipes.description: Algerian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour with 1 egg and a pinch of salt, gradually adding water until a thick paste forms.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add tomato paste, harissa, and cook for 1 minute, then add beef broth and chickpeas.
Bring broth to a gentle boil and drop spoonfuls of dough mixture into the simmering liquid.
Let each dumpling cook for 2-3 minutes before adding the next batch until all dough is used.
Simmer for 15 minutes until dumplings are cooked through.
Gently stir in the remaining 3 beaten eggs, stirring constantly for 2 minutes until eggs are set.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
cheapTips: Make your own chickpea broth from dried chickpeas to save 30%
Use vegetable broth instead of beef broth

recipes.name: Calentica
recipes.description: Algerian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk chickpea flour with water until smooth, then strain through a fine sieve to remove lumps.
Heat half the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté diced onion until golden, about 4 minutes.
Pour the chickpea mixture into the pan with onions and stir constantly for 5-7 minutes until it thickens.
Add salt, pepper, and harissa, stirring well to combine.
Transfer the thick batter to an oiled 8x8 inch pan and let cool for 10 minutes.
Once cooled and set, cut into squares or triangles.
Heat remaining olive oil in a skillet and pan-fry calentica pieces until golden brown on each side, about 2 minutes per side.
Serve warm with harissa on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy chickpea flour in bulk from Indian or Middle Eastern stores
Skip harissa and use cayenne pepper for heat

recipes.name: Haricot Blanc
recipes.description: Algerian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cumin, cooking for 1 minute while stirring.
Add vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Drain and rinse canned white beans, then add to the pot.
Simmer for 15 minutes to allow flavors to meld, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer for another 10 minutes until beans are very tender and broth reduces slightly.
Stir in fresh cilantro and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use dried beans soaked overnight instead of canned to save 60%
Skip cilantro and use dried parsley from your pantry

recipes.name: Tripe Stew
recipes.description: Algerian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean tripe thoroughly under running water, scraping any impurities, then cut into 1-inch pieces.
Blanch tripe in a pot of boiling salted water for 15 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic for 3 minutes.
Add tomato paste, cumin, and paprika, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add blanched tripe and beef broth, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 90 minutes until tripe is very tender.
Add chickpeas and simmer uncovered for 15 more minutes to reduce sauce slightly.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Tripe is an affordable protein—ask your butcher for deals on bulk purchases
Make a double batch and freeze portions for future meals

recipes.name: Berkoukes
recipes.description: Algerian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown chicken pieces for 4-5 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion in the same pot until softened, about 3 minutes.
Return chicken to pot, add ginger, and pour in vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then add pearl couscous and chickpeas, stirring well.
Add zucchini chunks, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir occasionally, adding more broth if the mixture is too thick.
Finish with fresh cilantro and serve when chicken is cooked through and couscous is tender.
cheapTips: Use regular couscous instead of pearl couscous and reduce liquid slightly
Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for more flavor and lower cost

recipes.name: Ghribia
recipes.description: Algerian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cream softened butter and powdered sugar together until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.
Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Gradually fold dry ingredients into the wet mixture until a soft dough forms.
Spoon small golf ball-sized portions onto an ungreased baking sheet, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Gently flatten each cookie with the bottom of a glass or your palm.
Bake at 325°F for 12-15 minutes until edges are just lightly golden but centers remain pale.
Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
cheapTips: Buy butter on sale and freeze for multiple batches
Make a large batch and store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks

recipes.name: Boflot
recipes.description: Ghanaian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla in another bowl until combined.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until smooth batter forms.
Heat 2 cups oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Carefully drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve warm, optionally dusted with powdered sugar.
cheapTips: Make large batches and freeze extras for quick snacks
Use store-brand flour and sugar to reduce costs

recipes.name: Akple
recipes.description: Ghanaian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a large pot with salt.
Slowly sprinkle cornmeal into boiling water while stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat to low and stir frequently for 15-20 minutes until mixture thickens and pulls away from pot sides.
Heat oil in a separate pan and sauté onions until softened.
Add tomato paste, dried fish, and pepper to the onions and cook for 2 minutes.
Fold the fish mixture into the cornmeal until well combined.
Transfer to a serving dish and serve hot with soup or stew.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from ethnic markets
Use canned tomato paste for convenience and lower cost

recipes.name: Wote
recipes.description: Ghanaian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger, then sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in water or broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots, then simmer for another 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with rice or fufu.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck or stew meat when on sale and freeze
Use carrots and potatoes as budget-friendly filler vegetables

recipes.name: Nkate Cake
recipes.description: Ghanaian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix peanut butter, powdered sugar, softened butter, and vanilla in a bowl until smooth.
Press mixture firmly into a parchment-lined 8x8 inch pan.
Combine melted chocolate with coconut oil and stir until smooth.
Pour chocolate layer evenly over peanut mixture and spread to cover.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours until chocolate is set.
Cut into squares and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
cheapTips: Use store-brand peanut butter and powdered sugar
Make ahead and freeze for up to 1 month

recipes.name: Abenkwan
recipes.description: Ghanaian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat palm oil in a large pot over medium heat and fry onions, garlic, and ginger for 2 minutes.
Add tomato paste and red pepper, then cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken pieces and brown for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in water or broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add chopped okra and simmer for another 15 minutes until okra is tender and chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with rice, fufu, or cassava.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze for later
Use frozen okra to save money and preparation time

recipes.name: Azinku
recipes.description: Ghanaian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat palm oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onions, garlic, and ginger for 2 minutes.
Add bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and chili powder, then cook for 1 minute.
Add beans and broth, then bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with rice, cassava, or cornmeal.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans on sale and stock up
Use dried beans soaked overnight for maximum savings

recipes.name: Thieboudienne
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown fish fillets on both sides for 2 minutes per side, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onions and garlic until soft, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add broth and bring to a boil, then add carrots, potatoes, and whole hot peppers.
Simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Add rice and stir well, then nestle the fish back into the pot.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Stir in cabbage and cook uncovered for 5 more minutes.
Remove hot peppers, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy fish fillets on sale and freeze until needed
Use affordable vegetable broth instead of fish stock

recipes.name: Yassa Poulet
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine lemon juice, vinegar, oil, garlic, hot pepper, and mustard powder in a bowl.
Place chicken in a large dish and pour marinade over it, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to overnight.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and remove chicken from marinade, reserving the liquid.
Brown chicken on all sides in the skillet, about 8 minutes total.
Add sliced onions to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes until they begin to soften.
Pour reserved marinade and broth into the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through and onions are very tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Use budget chicken cuts like thighs instead of breasts
Marinate chicken overnight to maximize flavor and tenderness

recipes.name: Maafe
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger, then sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter with 1/2 cup hot broth until smooth, then stir into the pot.
Add sweet potatoes, carrots, and whole hot pepper, then simmer for 20-25 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Remove hot pepper and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with rice or couscous.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze in portions
Use store-brand peanut butter to reduce costs

recipes.name: Ceebu Jen
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pot and brown fish fillets for 2 minutes per side, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the pot and sauté onions and garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add broth and bring to a boil, then add carrots, potatoes, eggplant, and whole hot peppers.
Simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Add rice and stir well, making sure rice is submerged.
Place fish on top of rice, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20-25 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Remove hot peppers, fluff with a fork, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy fresh fish when on sale and freeze immediately
Use canned tomato paste for consistency and lower cost

recipes.name: Carbonada
recipes.description: Argentine lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the beef cubes on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened and fragrant.
Return beef to the pot and add beef broth, cumin, salt, and pepper, then simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Add cubed potatoes and sweet potatoes, then continue simmering for 20 minutes.
Stir in corn kernels and diced peaches, then simmer uncovered for 10 more minutes until potatoes are tender.
Taste and adjust seasonings before serving hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Use canned peaches instead of fresh to reduce cost
Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Matambre
recipes.description: Argentine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Butterfly the flank steak by slicing it horizontally without cutting all the way through, then pound to even thickness.
Season the inside of the steak with salt and pepper, then arrange egg slices, carrot strips, bell pepper, and parsley down the center.
Roll the steak tightly and tie with kitchen twine at 2-inch intervals to keep filling secure.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the matambre roll on all sides until golden.
Add sliced onion and beef broth, then cover and simmer for 60-70 minutes until meat is tender.
Remove from heat, let rest 10 minutes, then slice and serve with pan juices.
cheapTips: Buy flank steak when on sale and freeze until needed
Use store-brand beef broth

recipes.name: Provoleta
recipes.description: Argentine snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat without oil.
Place provolone slices directly on the hot pan and let them cook without moving for 2-3 minutes until golden on the bottom.
Flip the cheese slices carefully and cook the other side until melted and golden.
Transfer to a plate and drizzle with olive oil, then sprinkle oregano, red pepper flakes, and salt over the top.
Serve immediately while still warm and slightly melted.
cheapTips: Buy provolone from the deli counter in bulk rather than pre-sliced

recipes.name: Tira de Asado
recipes.description: Argentine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prepare a charcoal grill or preheat outdoor grill to medium-high heat with coals to one side.
Pat the beef short ribs dry and season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place ribs bone-side down on the cooler side of the grill away from direct flames.
Grill for 45-60 minutes, turning occasionally, until meat is tender and charred with a crust.
Crush garlic and mix with chopped parsley and lemon juice to make chimichurri sauce.
Transfer ribs to a cutting board, slice between bones, and serve with chimichurri sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy beef short ribs when marked down near closing time
Make chimichurri with parsley from your garden or a farmers market

recipes.name: Vitel Toné
recipes.description: Argentine lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place brisket and sliced onion in a pot with beef broth, salt, and pepper, then simmer covered for 60-70 minutes until very tender.
Remove meat from broth and let cool, then slice thinly against the grain.
Blend canned tuna, mayonnaise, anchovies, capers, and lemon juice until smooth to create the sauce.
Arrange sliced veal on a platter and pour the tuna sauce evenly over the top.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving cold, garnished with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Use canned tuna in oil rather than fresh to reduce cost significantly
Buy beef brisket on sale and cook ahead for meal prep

recipes.name: Choclo
recipes.description: Argentine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a large pot with water, add salt, and bring to a rolling boil.
Place whole corn cobs in the boiling water and cook for 15-20 minutes until kernels are tender and cooked through.
Drain the corn thoroughly in a colander.
Melt butter in a small saucepan and stir in chopped fresh parsley and black pepper.
Transfer corn cobs to a serving platter and drizzle generously with the parsley butter, serving any remaining butter on the side.
cheapTips: Buy corn when in season at farmers markets for best price
Grow fresh parsley in a windowsill to reduce herb costs

recipes.name: Milanesa a Caballo
recipes.description: Argentine lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Set up three shallow bowls with flour in the first, beaten eggs in the second, and bread crumbs mixed with salt and pepper in the third.
Dredge each beef cutlet in flour, then egg, then bread crumbs, pressing to coat completely.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry each breaded cutlet for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through, then transfer to paper towels.
Place each milanesa on a slice of bread, then top with a fried egg, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Ask the butcher for thin-cut beef or pound thick cuts yourself between plastic wrap
Use day-old bread from the bakery section to save money

recipes.name: Bife de Chorizo
recipes.description: Argentine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove steaks from the refrigerator 15 minutes before cooking and pat completely dry with paper towels.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat until very hot and smoking.
Season steaks generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place steaks in the hot skillet and cook 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, without moving them.
Transfer steaks to a plate and brush with mashed garlic and chopped parsley mixed together.
Let rest 5 minutes, then serve with lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy strip steak when on sale and freeze for future use
Skip expensive seasoning blends and use just salt, pepper, and fresh garlic

recipes.name: Champurrada
recipes.description: Argentine breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk in a pot over medium heat with the cinnamon stick until it just begins to steam.
In a small bowl, whisk cornmeal with 1/2 cup cold water to create a smooth slurry.
Slowly pour the cornmeal mixture into the hot milk while stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Continue stirring and cook for 5-7 minutes until the mixture thickens and the cornmeal is cooked through.
Remove from heat and stir in brown sugar, salt, vanilla extract, and butter until well combined.
Pour into mugs and serve warm, stirring occasionally as it thickens further.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from warehouse stores for major savings
Use store-brand milk and sugar

recipes.name: Pastel de Choclo
recipes.description: Chilean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until soft.
Add ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks, then season with salt, pepper, and cumin, cooking until browned about 8 minutes.
Stir in olives and sliced hard-boiled eggs, then transfer the filling to a 9x13 baking dish.
Blend corn kernels with milk and 2 tbsp butter until mostly smooth but slightly chunky, then season with salt and pepper.
Spread the corn mixture evenly over the meat filling in the baking dish.
Bake uncovered at 350°F for 30-35 minutes until the corn topping is lightly golden and set.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn instead of fresh to save money year-round
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Thieb
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Add diced onions and garlic, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to caramelize.
Pour in beef broth and add thyme, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots, simmering for 15 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Stir in rice, bring back to a simmer, cover, and cook for 20 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat, fluff with a fork, and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand broth and tomato paste to reduce costs

recipes.name: Domoda
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown the ground beef over medium-high heat, breaking it apart, about 5 minutes.
Add diced onions and garlic, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add water or broth and bring to a boil.
Add potatoes and reduce heat to a simmer, cooking for 15 minutes until potatoes are nearly tender.
Stir in peanut butter until fully combined, then add hot pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Simmer for 10 more minutes until potatoes are completely soft and sauce thickens.
Serve hot over rice.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand peanut butter in bulk
Substitute half the ground beef with lentils to stretch the dish further

recipes.name: Mafé de Poulet
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown chicken pieces, about 8 minutes total.
Add onions and garlic, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato sauce and ginger, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add sweet potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until they begin to soften.
Whisk peanut butter into the liquid until fully incorporated and smooth.
Simmer for another 10 minutes, season with salt, pepper, and cayenne, then serve over rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken drumsticks instead of thighs for lower cost
Buy peanut butter in bulk and store in an airtight container

recipes.name: Soupe Kandja
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown meat on all sides, about 10 minutes total.
Add onions and garlic, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in beef broth, add thyme, and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add carrots and continue simmering for 10 minutes.
Add okra and simmer for another 15 minutes until okra is tender and soup thickens naturally.
Season with salt and cayenne pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use frozen okra instead of fresh for better pricing year-round
Buy cheaper cuts of beef like chuck and simmer longer

recipes.name: Soupe d'Arachide
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown meat over medium-high heat, about 8 minutes.
Add onions and garlic, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add carrots and cabbage, simmering for 10 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk peanut butter with ½ cup warm broth until smooth, then stir into the pot.
Simmer for another 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until sauce thickens.
Season with salt, black pepper, and hot pepper flakes; serve hot as a thick soup.
cheapTips: Use store-brand peanut butter and broth
Add extra cabbage to stretch portions further

recipes.name: Tiebou Dieuf
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onions and garlic over medium heat until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in broth and bring to a boil; add potatoes and carrots, simmering for 15 minutes.
Gently place whole fish in the pot, season with salt, pepper, and thyme, and simmer for 15 minutes until fish is nearly cooked.
Carefully remove fish and set aside; strain the broth into another pot, reserving vegetables.
Return broth to the pot and bring to a boil; stir in rice, cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 18 minutes.
Fluff rice with a fork; arrange on a serving platter, top with cooked vegetables and flaked fish, garnish with parsley.
cheapTips: Use frozen fish steaks instead of whole fish to reduce cost
Buy rice in bulk from ethnic markets for better pricing

recipes.name: Boulettes de Viande
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, combine ground beef, onions, garlic, bread crumbs, egg, parsley, salt, black pepper, and cayenne.
Mix gently with your hands until just combined; divide into 16 meatballs.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown meatballs on all sides, about 10 minutes total.
Pour in tomato sauce and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then serve hot over rice or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use store-brand bread crumbs or make your own from stale bread
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later

recipes.name: Chicoumaré
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown beef on all sides over medium-high heat, about 8 minutes.
Add onions and garlic, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in beef broth, add thyme, and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add turnips and carrots, simmering for 15 minutes until vegetables are nearly tender.
Stir in millet, bring back to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes until millet is tender.
Remove from heat, let rest 5 minutes, fluff, season with salt and pepper, and serve.
cheapTips: Substitute millet with pearl couscous if millet is hard to find
Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for future use

recipes.name: Couscous à la Sénégalaise
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown meat over medium-high heat, about 8 minutes.
Add onions and garlic, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots, simmering for 10 minutes.
Add zucchini and chickpeas, simmering for another 10 minutes.
In a separate pot, prepare couscous according to package directions with salted water.
Season meat and vegetable mixture with salt and cayenne pepper; serve over couscous and garnish with cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas on sale in bulk
Use less meat and add extra chickpeas to stretch the dish

recipes.name: Ngalakh
recipes.description: Senegalese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a large pot; slowly whisk in millet flour to avoid lumps, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent sticking.
Stir in butter, peanut butter, salt, vanilla, and cinnamon until well combined.
Gradually add milk while stirring until the mixture reaches a thick, creamy porridge consistency.
Simmer for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drizzle honey into individual bowls and pour porridge over top; stir before serving hot.
cheapTips: Buy millet flour from bulk bins or ethnic markets for better pricing
Use store-brand honey and peanut butter

recipes.name: Basenji
recipes.description: Senegalese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat water in a large pot over medium-high heat until steaming.
Slowly whisk millet flour into the water, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Add milk gradually while continuing to stir until the mixture is smooth.
Add butter, sugar, salt, and vanilla extract, stirring well.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent sticking.
Pour into bowls and serve hot with additional milk on the side if desired.
cheapTips: Buy millet flour in bulk from international or African markets for significant savings
Use store-brand milk and butter to reduce costs

recipes.name: Bouille de Mil
recipes.description: Senegalese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a large pot over high heat.
Gradually add millet flour while whisking continuously to prevent lumps from forming.
Lower heat to medium and stir in milk slowly until fully incorporated.
Add butter, honey, cinnamon, and salt, mixing well.
Simmer for 10-12 minutes over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot in bowls, optionally drizzling extra honey on top.
cheapTips: Substitute honey with brown sugar or molasses for lower cost
Purchase millet flour from bulk bins to save money

recipes.name: Accras
recipes.description: Senegalese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak split peas in hot water for 20 minutes, then drain and rinse well.
Blend soaked peas with onion, garlic, and scotch bonnet pepper until smooth.
Transfer mixture to a bowl and stir in flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add water gradually until batter reaches a thick paste consistency.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot to 350°F (175°C).
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry until golden brown on all sides, about 4-5 minutes total.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels before serving.
cheapTips: Buy dried split peas in bulk sections; they're much cheaper than canned
Use regular jalapeños if scotch bonnets are unavailable and expensive

recipes.name: Pastels
recipes.description: Senegalese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then add water gradually to form a stiff dough; knead for 5 minutes and rest for 20 minutes covered.
Heat 3 tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium heat and brown ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add onion and garlic, cooking until softened, then stir in potatoes, tomato paste, habanero, and black pepper.
Simmer the filling for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender, then set aside to cool slightly.
Roll out dough on a floured surface to 1/8-inch thickness and cut into 4-inch squares.
Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each square, fold into a triangle, and seal edges by pressing with a fork.
Heat 2 cups oil to 350°F (175°C) and fry pastels in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use ground beef trimmings or lower-grade cuts to reduce meat costs
Make pastels in larger batches and freeze unbaked for quick future meals

recipes.name: Attiéké
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add bell pepper, tomato, and habanero pepper, cooking for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in cassava granules, salt, black pepper, and lime juice, mixing well.
Gradually pour hot water into the mixture while stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Cover the pot and cook over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until granules are tender and fluffy.
Adjust seasoning as needed and serve hot or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy cassava granules from African or Latin American markets for better prices
Use whatever vegetables are on sale; attiéké is very flexible

recipes.name: Bissap
recipes.description: Senegalese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse hibiscus flowers thoroughly under cold water and place in a large pot.
Bring 6 cups of water to a boil and pour over hibiscus flowers.
Steep for 10 minutes, then strain through a fine mesh sieve, discarding flowers.
Stir in sugar and lime juice until dissolved completely.
Add mint leaves and let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Serve chilled over ice.
cheapTips: Buy hibiscus flowers in bulk from international markets or online suppliers
Omit mint if budget is tight; it's primarily for flavor variation

recipes.name: Suukuma Wiki à la Sénégalaise
recipes.description: Senegalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion until golden.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add canned tomatoes, salt, black pepper, and habanero pepper.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Add chopped collard greens in batches, stirring after each addition until wilted.
Simmer for 15-18 minutes until greens are very tender, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust seasonings before serving hot.
cheapTips: Buy collard greens when they're in season or on sale and freeze portions
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh; they're cheaper and shelf-stable

recipes.name: Chimichurri
recipes.description: Argentine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely chop parsley and cilantro together or pulse in a food processor until coarsely chopped.
Transfer herbs to a bowl and stir in minced garlic.
Whisk in red wine vinegar, olive oil, red pepper flakes, salt, black pepper, and oregano.
Let the sauce rest for at least 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Transfer to a serving dish and drizzle with additional olive oil if desired.
cheapTips: Use regular parsley if cilantro is expensive or unavailable
Buy herbs in bulk and freeze in ice cube trays with olive oil

recipes.name: Medialunas
recipes.description: Argentine breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, and salt in a bowl; create a well in the center and add yeast and warm water.
Mix until a shaggy dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes until smooth; let rest for 10 minutes.
Roll dough into a 12x6 inch rectangle, then cut cold butter into thin slices and arrange over 2/3 of the dough.
Fold the dough into thirds (envelope fold), rotate 90 degrees, and roll out again to a 12x6 rectangle.
Repeat the butter layering and folding process 5 more times, resting between folds for 10 minutes.
Roll final dough to 1/8-inch thickness and cut into 3-inch squares, then roll each corner toward center to form crescents.
Place crescents on parchment paper, cover, and let proof for 1.5 hours until doubled.
Mix egg yolk with milk and brush onto pastries; bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze unbaked; bake directly from frozen, adding 5 minutes to bake time
Prepare laminated dough the day before and refrigerate overnight to reduce active time

recipes.name: Facturas
recipes.description: Argentine breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a bowl; add warm water and mix until a rough dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll chilled dough into a 10x8 inch rectangle; cut cold butter into thin pats and distribute over 2/3 of dough.
Fold dough in thirds (envelope fold), rotate 90 degrees, and roll to 10x8 inches; repeat folding and rolling process 4 more times with 15-minute rests between folds.
After final fold, refrigerate dough for 30 minutes, then roll to 1/8-inch thickness.
Cut into 4x3 inch rectangles; spread 1 tablespoon dulce de leche in the center and fold into thirds.
Place facturas on parchment paper, cover, and proof for 1.5 hours until puffy.
Mix beaten egg with water and brush onto pastries; bake at 400°F (200°C) for 18-20 minutes until golden.
Dust warm pastries with powdered sugar and serve.
cheapTips: Buy dulce de leche in bulk online; Argentine brands are cheaper than specialty shops
Freeze unbaked facturas for up to 2 weeks; bake directly from frozen with 5 extra minutes

recipes.name: Patacones
recipes.description: Colombian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel green plantains by cutting off ends and slicing skin lengthwise, then soak in salted water for 5 minutes.
Cut plantains into 1-inch thick rounds and pat dry completely.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and fry plantain rounds 3-4 minutes per side until light golden.
Remove with slotted spoon and flatten each round between plastic wrap using a heavy plate or glass.
Return flattened patacones to oil and fry 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and season with salt immediately.
Serve hot with garlic lime sauce made by mixing minced garlic with lime juice and salt.
cheapTips: Buy plantains in bulk at Latin markets when on sale
Reuse oil for multiple batches to reduce waste

recipes.name: Ceviche Colombiano
recipes.description: Colombian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fish into 1/2-inch cubes and place in a glass bowl.
Pour lime juice over fish until completely covered and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
While fish marinates, dice onion finely and soak in cold water for 5 minutes to reduce sharpness.
Dice tomato, bell pepper, and jalapeño into small pieces.
Drain onions and combine with fish mixture after marinating time.
Add diced vegetables, cilantro, olive oil, and salt to the fish bowl and gently toss.
Chill for at least 10 minutes more before serving in chilled bowls or glasses.
cheapTips: Use frozen white fish on sale to save money
Buy limes in bulk when in season

recipes.name: Sancocho
recipes.description: Colombian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown beef chunks on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Return beef to pot and add beef broth, cumin, salt, and pepper, then simmer 30 minutes.
Add peeled plantain chunks and diced potatoes, continuing to simmer 20 minutes.
Add corn cut into 2-inch pieces and continue cooking 15 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.
Serve hot in bowls topped with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck in bulk and freeze portions
Use frozen corn to save money year-round

recipes.name: Tinto
recipes.description: Colombian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brew strong black coffee using your preferred method.
Heat water in a small saucepan and add panela or brown sugar.
Stir until sugar is completely dissolved, about 1 minute.
Pour hot coffee into two mugs and divide the sugar syrup between them.
Stir well and add a pinch of salt to enhance flavor.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy bulk coffee beans and grind at home
Use panela instead of refined sugar for better value

recipes.name: Changua
recipes.description: Colombian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine milk and water in a pot and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Add chopped green onions and salt to the milk mixture.
Crack eggs into a small bowl and gently slide them into the simmering milk one at a time.
Cook for 3-4 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain soft.
Toast bread slices until golden and place one in each serving bowl.
Carefully ladle the hot milk soup with one egg into each bowl over the toast.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk during sales
Use day-old bread to reduce waste

recipes.name: Tamale
recipes.description: Colombian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil chicken breast in salted water until fully cooked, then shred and reserve 1 cup broth.
Soften banana leaves by running under warm water for 30 seconds.
Cream lard with salt and baking powder until fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Gradually mix masa harina and chicken broth into creamed lard until dough reaches thick spreading consistency.
Prepare filling by combining shredded chicken, diced potatoes, corn, and diced bell pepper.
Spread 2 tablespoons of dough on a banana leaf, add 1 tablespoon filling in center, then fold leaf to enclose.
Stand tamales upright in a pot with 2 inches of water and steam for 45 minutes until dough is cooked through.
Serve hot, carefully unwrapping banana leaves at the table.
cheapTips: Buy masa harina in bulk from Latin markets
Make filling with leftover rotisserie chicken

recipes.name: Mondongo
recipes.description: Colombian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean tripe thoroughly under running water and cut into 1-inch pieces.
Boil tripe in salted water for 90 minutes until very tender, then drain and reserve.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add cooked tripe and beef broth.
Bring to a boil, add cumin, salt, and pepper, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and drained chickpeas, continuing to simmer 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Taste and adjust seasonings, then serve hot topped with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy tripe from ethnic markets at lower prices
Use canned chickpeas to save time and money

recipes.name: Fritanga
recipes.description: Colombian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into 1-inch cubes and liver into smaller pieces.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown pork cubes in batches, setting aside.
Add more oil if needed and fry liver pieces until cooked through, about 4 minutes, then set aside.
In the same oil, fry diced onions and minced garlic until golden, about 3 minutes.
Cut potatoes into thin sticks like fries and add to the skillet, stirring frequently for 10 minutes.
Return pork and liver to skillet, add cumin, salt, and pepper, and cook for 5 more minutes.
Finish with lime juice and serve hot directly from the skillet with warm tortillas or arepas.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze in portions
Use chicken liver as a cheaper substitute

recipes.name: Rondón
recipes.description: Colombian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube plantains, potatoes, and yam into similar-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté sliced onion and minced garlic for 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk, water (about 4 cups), salt, and pepper, then bring to a boil.
Add plantains, potatoes, and yam, simmering for 20 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Cut fish fillets into 2-inch pieces and add to the pot along with shrimp.
Continue simmering for 10 minutes until fish and shrimp are cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust seasonings, then serve hot in bowls topped with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp and fish when fresh is expensive
Buy plantains and yam at Latin markets for better prices

recipes.name: Sobrebarriga
recipes.description: Colombian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season brisket generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sear brisket 4-5 minutes per side until browned, then remove.
Sauté diced onions and minced garlic in the same pot for 3 minutes until softened.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes, then stir in cumin.
Return brisket to pot and add beef broth and bay leaf, bringing to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 60-70 minutes until brisket is tender, turning halfway through.
Remove brisket, slice against the grain, and serve with the cooking liquid spooned over top, garnished with cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy beef brisket on sale and freeze for later
Use homemade broth to save on grocery costs

recipes.name: Cazuela
recipes.description: Chilean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the beef chunks on all sides for 5 minutes.
Add diced onion and garlic, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and add paprika and cumin, then bring to a simmer.
Add potatoes, pumpkin, and corn to the pot.
Simmer for 25-30 minutes until all vegetables are tender and beef is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for future use
Use seasonal squash instead of pumpkin for better prices

recipes.name: Completo
recipes.description: Chilean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook hot dogs by boiling or pan-frying for 5-7 minutes until heated through.
Warm the hot dog buns lightly, either by toasting or steaming.
Spread a layer of mayonnaise on each bun.
Place a cooked hot dog in each bun.
Top with diced tomatoes, onion, avocado, and sauerkraut in that order.
Drizzle with mustard and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy generic brand hot dogs and buns to save significantly
Use canned or frozen vegetables if fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Pastel de Papas
recipes.description: Chilean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes until tender, about 20 minutes, then drain and mash with butter and milk.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and brown ground beef, then add onion and garlic, cooking until softened.
Season beef mixture with cumin, salt, and pepper.
Spread half the mashed potatoes in a greased baking dish.
Layer the beef mixture over potatoes, then top with olives and hard-boiled egg slices.
Spread remaining mashed potatoes on top and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until golden.
Allow to cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Prepare hard-boiled eggs the day before to save time
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze until needed

recipes.name: Arrollado Huaso
recipes.description: Chilean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound the flank steak until thin and even, about 0.5 inch thick.
Lay carrot strips, egg halves, and parsley down the center of the steak.
Tightly roll the steak and secure with kitchen twine or toothpicks.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the roll on all sides for 8 minutes.
Remove the roll and sauté diced onion until soft, then add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add beef broth, red wine, and paprika, then return the roll to the pot.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes until beef is very tender.
Remove twine and slice the roll, then serve with pan sauce.
cheapTips: Ask the butcher for flank steak trimmings or less popular cuts for discounts
Use chicken or pork instead of beef to reduce cost significantly

recipes.name: Tallarín a la Chilena
recipes.description: Chilean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet and brown ground beef, breaking it into small pieces.
Add diced onion and garlic, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato sauce, beef broth, paprika, and cumin.
Simmer the sauce for 10 minutes to blend flavors.
Add cooked pasta to the sauce and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in bowls and top with grated cheese.
cheapTips: Buy pasta in bulk for significantly lower per-pound cost
Use generic tomato sauce instead of name brands

recipes.name: Curanto
recipes.description: Chilean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large, heavy pot or Dutch oven and brown chicken thighs for 6 minutes on each side.
Remove chicken and brown chorizo slices for 3 minutes, then set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in the pot until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add chicken broth and white wine, scraping up browned bits from bottom.
Return chicken to pot and add potatoes, corn, and chorizo.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes until potatoes are nearly tender.
Add mussels and shrimp on top, cover, and cook for 8-10 minutes until shellfish opens.
Discard any unopened mussels, season with salt and pepper, and garnish with cilantro.
cheapTips: Substitute frozen mussels or clams to reduce cost and prep time
Use frozen shrimp instead of fresh for significant savings

recipes.name: Sopaipillas
recipes.description: Chilean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Stir pumpkin puree into flour mixture until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 2 minutes until smooth.
Roll dough out to 0.25 inch thickness and cut into 3-inch squares.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet.
Fry sopaipillas in batches for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Mix cinnamon, brown sugar, and granulated sugar in a shallow bowl.
Drain fried sopaipillas on paper towels and immediately coat with cinnamon sugar while warm.
cheapTips: Make your own pumpkin puree from canned pumpkin to save money
Reuse frying oil multiple times before discarding

recipes.name: Mote con Huesillo
recipes.description: Chilean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a large pot and add dried peaches, cinnamon stick, and cloves.
Simmer for 15 minutes until peaches soften.
Add brown sugar and salt, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Remove from heat and add lemon juice.
Allow to cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Drain canned corn kernels and divide into serving bowls.
Pour the chilled peach liquid and peaches over the corn.
Serve very cold as a breakfast or light snack beverage.
cheapTips: Buy dried peaches in bulk from warehouse stores for lower prices
Use canned corn instead of fresh to reduce costs

recipes.name: Congrio a la Sal
recipes.description: Chilean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Clean and gut the fish, leaving scales intact; pat dry inside and out.
Whisk egg whites until foamy and mix with kosher salt until mixture resembles wet sand.
Spread half the salt mixture on the baking sheet and place fish on top.
Stuff fish cavity with lemon slices, herbs, and garlic cloves.
Cover fish completely with remaining salt mixture, packing gently.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until salt crust is hard and lightly golden.
Crack open salt crust carefully, peel away skin, and serve with olive oil and melted butter drizzled over flesh.
cheapTips: Substitute large sea bass or striped bass if conger eel is unavailable or expensive
Buy whole fish from fishmonger counter for better prices than pre-packaged

recipes.name: Porotos con Riendas
recipes.description: Chilean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse dried beans and soak in water overnight, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and garlic until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add drained beans and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Add cumin and paprika, then cook uncovered for 25 minutes until beans begin to soften.
Add pumpkin cubes and corn kernels to the pot.
Continue simmering for 15-20 minutes until beans are very tender and vegetables are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy dried beans in bulk from ethnic markets for 50% savings
Use canned beans instead of dried to reduce cooking time and cost slightly

recipes.name: Arepas con Queso
recipes.description: Colombian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornmeal, warm water, and salt in a bowl until a thick dough forms.
Let the dough rest for 5 minutes.
Wet your hands and form 8 balls, then flatten each into a 3-inch thick disc.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry arepas 4-5 minutes per side until golden.
Remove arepas and slice horizontally with a sharp knife.
Stuff each arepa with crumbled queso fresco and a small piece of butter.
Serve warm with butter melting inside.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from Latin markets for 50% less
Use mozzarella if queso fresco is unavailable and expensive

recipes.name: Huevos Pericos
recipes.description: Colombian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook 3 minutes until softened.
Add diced tomato and cook 2 minutes until slightly softened.
Whisk eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper, then pour into the skillet.
Scramble eggs gently with the vegetables until fully cooked, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale
Use onion and tomato scraps from other meals

recipes.name: Flan Colombiano
recipes.description: Colombian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a saucepan, combine 1/2 cup sugar and water, heat over medium until amber caramel forms, about 5 minutes.
Pour caramel into a 9-inch round baking dish, coating the bottom and sides.
Blend remaining sugar, condensed milk, evaporated milk, eggs, and vanilla in a blender until smooth.
Pour custard mixture into the caramel-lined dish.
Place the baking dish in a larger roasting pan filled with 1 inch of hot water.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until custard is set but slightly jiggly in the center.
Cool completely, then refrigerate for 4 hours.
Run a knife around edges and invert onto a serving plate.
cheapTips: Buy condensed and evaporated milk on sale and store
Make extra and freeze for dessert throughout the month

recipes.name: Buñuelos
recipes.description: Colombian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cassava flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk eggs and stir in shredded cheese.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until a thick dough forms.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Form dough into golf ball-sized spheres and carefully place in hot oil.
Fry 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and puffy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot, optionally with cheese sauce or honey.
cheapTips: Buy cassava flour at Latin grocery stores, cheaper than specialty stores
Use oil multiple times by straining between batches

recipes.name: Congri
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion and garlic for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes to toast lightly.
Pour in chicken broth and add bay leaf, salt, and cumin.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 15 minutes, then stir in black beans.
Cover and cook another 5 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat, let stand 5 minutes, remove bay leaf, and fluff with a fork.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans in bulk and rice from discount stores
Make large batches and freeze portions for quick meals

recipes.name: Yuca con Mojo
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 2 lbs, peeled and cut into 3-inch pieces

steps: Bring 2 quarts of salted water to a boil in a large pot.
Add yuca pieces and boil for 20-25 minutes until fork-tender.
While yuca cooks, combine minced garlic, olive oil, lime juice, and cumin in a saucepan over low heat for 3 minutes.
Do not let garlic brown; just warm the mojo gently.
Drain yuca well and transfer to a serving platter.
Pour hot mojo sauce over yuca and stir gently.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy yuca in bulk from Latin markets
Freeze extra mojo sauce for quick use on other vegetables

recipes.name: Tostones
recipes.description: Cuban snack — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 3 medium, peeled and cut into 2-inch rou

steps: Heat oil in a deep skillet or pot to 350°F.
Fry plantain rounds 2 minutes per side until light golden and tender.
Remove and place between two pieces of plastic wrap or in a tostonera (wooden press).
Press flat until about 1/4 inch thick.
Reheat oil back to 350°F and fry pressed tostones 1-2 minutes per side until crispy and golden.
Mix salt and minced garlic with 2 tablespoons water to make a paste.
Drain tostones on paper towels and serve hot with garlic sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy plantains in bulk when on sale and freeze for later
Use a small plate or bowl instead of a tostonera for pressing

recipes.name: Rabo Encendido
recipes.description: Cuban dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat oxtail dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown oxtail on all sides, 8 minutes total.
Remove oxtail and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion and garlic for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add tomato sauce and cumin, stir for 1 minute.
Return oxtail to pot and add beef broth and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 60 minutes.
Add potatoes and olives, cover, and simmer another 20 minutes until meat is tender and potatoes are cooked.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy oxtail on sale and freeze; it's cheaper than other cuts
Use canned tomato sauce instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Ajiaco Cubano
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Season beef and chicken with salt and pepper, then brown in batches for 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove meat and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onion and garlic for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add cumin and oregano, stir for 1 minute.
Return meat to pot and pour in beef broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 20 minutes until meat is partially cooked.
Add potatoes, yam, and plantain; simmer for 15 minutes.
Add corn kernels and simmer another 5 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning; garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Use cheaper cuts of beef like chuck roast
Buy vegetables at farmers markets in bulk

recipes.name: Bistec Encebollado
recipes.description: Cuban dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season steaks with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear steaks 3-4 minutes per side until browned, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, reduce heat to medium and sauté sliced onions for 5 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cumin, stirring for 1 minute.
Pour in beef broth and vinegar, scraping the bottom of the pan.
Return steaks to skillet and simmer for 5 minutes until cooked to desired doneness.
Serve steaks topped with onion sauce.
cheapTips: Buy round steak when on sale and freeze for later
Use regular onions instead of sweet onions to save 30%

recipes.name: Charquicán
recipes.description: Chilean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add diced onion, garlic, and bell pepper to the pot and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Add diced potatoes and stir to coat with oil, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth and add cumin, salt, and pepper, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are nearly tender.
Stir in corn and green peas and cook for another 5 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Adjust seasoning and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy frozen corn and peas instead of fresh to save 30%
Use budget ground beef cuts or ground chuck instead of premium

recipes.name: Humita
recipes.description: Chilean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak corn husks in warm water for 10 minutes to soften them.
Melt butter in a pan and sauté onion and garlic until soft, about 3 minutes.
Blend corn kernels with milk until chunky-smooth texture forms.
Mix corn mixture into the pan with onion, then stir in corn flour and cook for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, cool slightly, then stir in beaten eggs, basil, salt, and pepper.
Place 2 overlapping corn husks flat and spoon corn mixture into center.
Fold husks over to enclose filling, then fold ends under to seal.
Place humitas seam-side down in a steamer basket over boiling water and steam for 25 minutes.
Serve warm with additional butter or salsa if desired.
cheapTips: Frozen corn works just as well as fresh at half the price
Save corn husks from fresh corn you buy for other meals

recipes.name: Pastel de Jaiba
recipes.description: Chilean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water until fork-tender, about 15 minutes, then drain and mash.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a pan and sauté onion and garlic until golden, about 4 minutes.
Stir crab meat into the onion mixture, season with paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add milk to the mashed potatoes and whip until creamy, then fold in crab mixture gently.
Spread potato-crab mixture into a buttered baking dish and create an even surface.
Beat eggs with a fork and brush over the top layer.
Mix Parmesan and bread crumbs, then sprinkle evenly over eggs.
Dot with remaining 1 tablespoon butter and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until golden.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use canned crab meat instead of fresh to save significantly
Buy potatoes in bulk and use store-brand cheese

recipes.name: Tacacho
recipes.description: Chilean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel plantains by cutting ends and slicing skin lengthwise, then remove outer skin carefully.
Cut plantains diagonally into 1/2-inch thick slices.
Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry plantain slices 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy, working in batches.
Remove fried plantains to a paper towel-lined plate and season with salt immediately.
Sauté onion slices in remaining oil until softened and slightly caramelized, about 4 minutes.
Arrange plantain slices on a plate, top with sautéed onion and cilantro, then squeeze lime over top.
Serve immediately while crispy.
cheapTips: Buy plantains when on sale and freeze them for later use
Use cheaper vegetable oil like canola instead of olive oil for frying

recipes.name: Estofado de Res
recipes.description: Chilean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and season beef with salt and pepper.
Brown beef in batches, about 3 minutes per side, then remove and set aside.
Add onion, garlic, and carrot to the pot and sauté for 4 minutes until aromatic.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then deglaze with wine if using.
Return beef to pot, add beef broth, bay leaves, and cumin.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add potatoes and continue simmering for 20 minutes until potatoes and beef are tender.
Remove bay leaves, adjust seasoning with salt and pepper, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck or round cuts on sale instead of premium cuts
Skip the wine and use extra beef broth instead

recipes.name: Locos a la Parmesana
recipes.description: Chilean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using fresh clams, scrub them under cold water and discard any that don't close.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large pot and add clams with white wine, cooking covered until they open, about 8 minutes.
Remove clams, discard any unopened, and strain cooking liquid through cheesecloth.
Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in a pan and sauté onion and garlic until soft, about 5 minutes.
Mix bread crumbs, Parmesan, and parsley in a bowl.
Remove clams from shells, chop roughly, and return to shells.
Top each clam with onion-garlic mixture, then sprinkle bread crumb-cheese mixture generously.
Arrange clams on a baking sheet and bake at 400°F for 10 minutes until topping is golden.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and reserved clam broth for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy canned clams instead of fresh to reduce cost by 40%
Use store-brand Parmesan and bread crumbs

recipes.name: Chancho en Piedra
recipes.description: Chilean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Using a mortar and pestle, crush tomatoes with garlic until chunky texture forms.
Add minced onion and green chile, crushing lightly to combine.
Stir in cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper by hand.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more lime or salt as needed.
Let sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Transfer to a serving bowl and serve immediately with tortilla chips for scooping.
cheapTips: Make with canned tomatoes in winter months to save 50%
Buy store-brand tortilla chips

recipes.name: Pernil de Cerdo
recipes.description: Chilean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and combine with cumin, paprika, oregano, salt, pepper, and olive oil to create paste.
Score pork skin in a crosshatch pattern without cutting into meat.
Rub spice paste all over pork, including in crevices, and let rest for at least 2 hours at room temperature.
Place pork skin-side up in a roasting pan and pour broth around it.
Roast at 375°F for 2.5 to 3 hours, basting every 30 minutes with pan juices.
When skin is crackling and internal temperature reaches 160°F, remove from oven.
Let rest for 20 minutes before carving.
Serve hot with pan drippings spooned over meat.
cheapTips: Buy bone-in pork shoulder when on sale; it's cheaper than leg
Use water instead of broth to reduce cost

recipes.name: Ajiaco Santafereño
recipes.description: Colombian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sauté onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken pieces and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add potatoes and corn, reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in green beans and cilantro, then simmer for another 8 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle soup into bowls and serve topped with avocado slices and a squeeze of fresh lime juice.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for lower cost and better flavor
Buy frozen corn and green beans to reduce cost by 30%

recipes.name: Bandeja Paisa
recipes.description: Colombian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry plantain slices until golden on both sides, about 4 minutes total.
Remove plantain to a plate and fry bacon in the same oil until crispy, about 5 minutes, then set aside.
Cook chorizo slices in the skillet for 3 minutes per side until browned, then remove.
Brown ground pork in the skillet, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Warm the red beans in a small pot and season with salt.
Warm the arepa in a dry skillet, about 2 minutes per side.
Fry eggs to desired doneness in the remaining oil.
Arrange rice, beans, plantain, bacon, chorizo, pork, arepa, fried egg, tomato slice, and onion slice on a large plate.
Serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand canned beans instead of fresh cooked
Use cheaper pork cuts or ground beef instead of chorizo if needed

recipes.name: Mangú
recipes.description: Dominican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel green plantains and cut into 2-inch chunks, removing the fibrous core.
Boil plantain chunks in salted water for 12-15 minutes until very tender.
Drain plantains and mash with butter and milk until creamy and smooth.
Dice onion and fry in oil until golden brown and crispy.
Top mangú with fried onions, salt, and black pepper before serving.
cheapTips: Buy plantains in bulk when on sale and freeze extras
Use regular onions from the bulk bin instead of pre-packaged

recipes.name: Los Tres Golpes
recipes.description: Dominican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut salami into thin slices and cheese into thick slabs.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry salami slices 2-3 minutes per side until edges curl, then remove to paper towels.
Fry cheese slabs 2-3 minutes per side until golden, then remove to plate.
Fry eggs sunny-side up in remaining oil until whites set and yolks are runny.
Serve fried eggs with salami and cheese on the side, seasoned with salt and pepper.
cheapTips: Buy Dominican salami at ethnic markets for better prices than specialty shops
Look for queso de freír at Latin markets; it's cheaper than US cheese brands

recipes.name: Salami y Queso
recipes.description: Dominican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice salami into thin rounds and cut cheese into thick rectangular slabs.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry salami slices 2 minutes per side until edges crisp, transfer to paper towels.
Fry cheese slabs 2-3 minutes per side until golden on outside but soft inside.
Plate together with salt and black pepper, serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy larger packages and portion into freezer bags
Shop at Dominican or Latin markets for authentic salami at lower cost

recipes.name: Huevos a la Dominicana
recipes.description: Dominican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onion and tomato into small pieces.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté onion until translucent.
Add diced tomato and cook 2-3 minutes until softened.
Break eggs into the skillet with the onion-tomato mixture, stirring gently until eggs are scrambled and cooked through.
Season with salt, pepper, and cilantro, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk from warehouse stores
Use dried cilantro if fresh is expensive

recipes.name: La Bandera Dominicana
recipes.description: Dominican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper, then cook in oil over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until browned, remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant.
Add tomato sauce and cook 2 minutes, then add rice and stir to coat with oil.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to boil, place chicken on top, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 18-20 minutes.
Warm kidney beans in a separate pot with a splash of their liquid.
Serve rice on one side of plate, beans on another, and sliced chicken on the third to form the flag colors.
cheapTips: Buy chicken on sale and freeze portions
Use canned beans instead of dried to save prep time

recipes.name: Guisado de Carne
recipes.description: Dominican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef on all sides, 8-10 minutes total, then remove.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic until golden, about 3 minutes.
Add tomato sauce and cook 2 minutes, then return beef to pot.
Pour in beef broth, add bay leaf, salt, and pepper, then bring to simmer, cover and cook 25 minutes.
Cut potatoes and carrots into chunks and add to pot, simmer covered 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning, remove bay leaf, then serve hot in bowls with broth.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck or bottom round on sale and freeze
Use generic tomato sauce instead of branded

recipes.name: Habichuelas Guisadas
recipes.description: Dominican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant.
Add sofrito and tomato sauce, cook 2 minutes while stirring.
Add drained and rinsed beans with 1 cup of reserved bean liquid or water.
Add bay leaf, salt, and pepper, then simmer uncovered for 15-20 minutes until flavors meld.
Stir occasionally, adding more liquid if beans seem dry.
Remove bay leaf and serve as a side dish or over rice.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans in bulk when on sale
Make sofrito in batches and freeze in ice cube trays

recipes.name: Pescado a la Sal
recipes.description: Dominican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Clean fish by removing scales and entrails, pat dry inside and out with paper towels.
Mix egg whites with sea salt to form a paste, add lemon juice and chopped herbs.
Spread a third of salt mixture on parchment, place fish on top, cover completely with remaining salt mixture.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until salt crust is golden and fish is cooked through.
Crack open salt crust at the table, carefully fillet fish and discard skin, serve with olive oil and lemon.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish when on sale rather than fillets
Use cheaper sea salt from warehouse clubs

recipes.name: Caldo de Res
recipes.description: Dominican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in large pot and brown beef chunks on all sides, 8-10 minutes total.
Add diced onion and minced garlic, sauté 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in beef broth, add salt and pepper, bring to simmer, cover and cook 20 minutes.
Cut potatoes, carrots, yuca, and plantain into chunks and add to pot.
Simmer covered 25-30 minutes until all vegetables are fork-tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning, garnish with fresh cilantro, serve hot in deep bowls with broth.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck in bulk and freeze portions
Buy root vegetables in season for best prices

recipes.name: Asopao de Pollo
recipes.description: Dominican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in large pot and season chicken thighs with salt and pepper, brown on both sides 6-8 minutes, remove and set aside.
In same pot, sauté diced onion and minced garlic until golden, then add sofrito and tomato sauce.
Cook 2 minutes, then return chicken to pot and pour in chicken broth.
Add bay leaf, bring to boil, reduce heat to medium, cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Add rice and stir well, simmer uncovered 15-18 minutes until rice is tender and broth is mostly absorbed.
Stir in frozen peas and carrots, cook 2 more minutes, then remove from heat and let sit 3 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale; they're cheaper than breasts and more flavorful
Use frozen vegetables instead of fresh to reduce cost

recipes.name: Masitas de Cerdo
recipes.description: Cuban dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix sour orange juice, minced garlic, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Add pork cubes to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Remove pork from marinade (reserve marinade) and brown the meat on all sides for 8 minutes.
Add sliced onions and bay leaves to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour reserved marinade and water into the skillet, then reduce heat to medium-low.
Cover and simmer for 25-30 minutes until pork is tender and sauce reduces.
Uncover and cook for 5 more minutes to concentrate the sauce before serving.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when on sale and freeze until needed.
Use bottled lime juice if sour oranges are unavailable and hard to find.

recipes.name: Camarones Enchilados
recipes.description: Cuban dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté diced onion and red pepper until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cumin, stirring constantly for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in tomato sauce and white wine, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Add shrimp to the sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Cook shrimp for 3-4 minutes until they start to turn pink.
Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes until shrimp are fully cooked and curled.
Stir in fresh cilantro and taste for seasoning adjustments.
Serve immediately over rice or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp when on sale; thaw before cooking.
Skip cilantro if expensive; fresh parsley is a cheaper substitute.

recipes.name: Sandwich Cubano
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut the Cuban bread in half lengthwise and open it like a book.
Spread mustard on both inside halves of the bread.
Layer roast pork, ham, Swiss cheese, and pickle chips on the bottom half.
Close the sandwich and cut diagonally into two portions.
Butter the outside of the sandwich on both sides.
Heat a skillet or panini press over medium heat.
Toast the sandwich for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Serve hot and enjoy immediately.
cheapTips: Buy deli meats on sale and portion into freezer bags.
Use regular sandwich bread if Cuban bread is unavailable.

recipes.name: Frita Cubana
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced onion and garlic, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add ground beef and break it apart with a spoon, cooking until browned, about 5 minutes.
Season with cumin, salt, and pepper, then stir well.
Toast hamburger buns lightly in the skillet or toaster.
Spread mustard and ketchup on both buns.
Fill each bun with half the cooked ground beef mixture.
Top generously with fried potato sticks and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make your own fried potato sticks by cutting potatoes and deep-frying.
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions.

recipes.name: Tamales en Cazuela
recipes.description: Cuban dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and garlic until soft, about 4 minutes.
Add pork cubes and brown on all sides for 8 minutes.
Add sofrito, cumin, bay leaves, salt, and pepper, then simmer for 20 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix masa harina with chicken broth until a thick dough forms.
Spread half the masa mixture on the bottom of a baking dish.
Top with the cooked pork and its sauce.
Spread remaining masa mixture over the pork layer.
