recipes.name: Moro de Queso
recipes.description: Ecuadorian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add uncooked rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Drain and rinse black beans, then stir into the rice.
Add cumin and salt, then continue cooking covered for 5 more minutes.
Remove from heat and fold in cheese cubes gently, letting them soften in the residual heat.
Fluff with a fork and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use canned beans to save prep time and cost
Buy rice in bulk from ethnic markets for better prices

recipes.name: Yahuarlocro
recipes.description: Ecuadorian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown diced beef chunks on all sides.
Add onion and garlic, sauté until softened.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a simmer.
Add potatoes and cumin, cook covered for 20 minutes until potatoes are nearly tender.
Carefully add the beef blood (which may be sold as frozen packages) to the pot.
Stir gently and simmer for 10-15 minutes, allowing the blood to cook through and thicken the broth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in bowls garnished with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Call ahead to butcher shops to find beef blood availability
Buy beef chuck when on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Chitlins
recipes.description: Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse chitterlings thoroughly multiple times under cold water, removing any impurities.
Place chitterlings in a large pot with 8 cups of water and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil and cook for 45 minutes, skimming off any foam.
Drain and rinse again, then return to the pot with fresh water.
Add onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Simmer for another 45 minutes until very tender.
Drain chitterlings, reserving about 1 cup of cooking liquid.
Season with hot sauce and cayenne pepper, adding reserved liquid if needed for desired consistency.
cheapTips: Buy chitterlings from stores with high turnover in soul food sections
Pre-cleaned versions save time but cost slightly more

recipes.name: Okra
recipes.description: Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crispy, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté onion and garlic in bacon grease until softened.
Add trimmed okra and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in canned diced tomatoes with their juice and add corn.
Season with salt, black pepper, and cayenne.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes until okra is tender.
Crumble cooked bacon over the top and stir gently.
Taste and adjust seasonings before serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen okra for year-round availability at lower cost
Canned tomatoes are cheaper than fresh and work perfectly

recipes.name: Catfish
recipes.description: Soul Food lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornmeal, flour, salt, black pepper, and cayenne in a shallow bowl.
Whisk together eggs and milk in another shallow bowl.
Pat catfish fillets dry with paper towels.
Dip each fillet into egg mixture, then dredge thoroughly in cornmeal mixture.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or Dutch oven.
Carefully place breaded fillets into hot oil and fry for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove fillets and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and your choice of sides.
cheapTips: Buy catfish fillets when they are on sale and freeze
Make your own seasoning blend instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Pie
recipes.description: Soul Food snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and place pie crust in a 9-inch pie pan.
Peel and cube sweet potatoes, then boil until very soft (15-20 minutes).
Drain sweet potatoes and place in a blender with butter, sugar, eggs, and evaporated milk.
Blend until completely smooth and creamy.
Add vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt, then blend briefly to combine.
Pour filling into the pie crust.
Bake for 50-60 minutes until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.
Cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before slicing.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pie crust to save time and cost
Buy sweet potatoes in bulk when in season

recipes.name: Peach Cobbler
recipes.description: Soul Food snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and melt 3 tablespoons butter in a 9x13 baking dish.
Toss peach slices with sugar, brown sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla in a bowl.
Spread peach mixture evenly in the prepared baking dish.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl.
Stir milk into the dry ingredients until just combined (batter will be thick).
Drop spoonfuls of batter over the peaches, leaving some gaps.
Dot the cobbler topping with remaining 3 tablespoons butter.
Bake for 35-45 minutes until the topping is golden brown and peaches are bubbling at the edges.
cheapTips: Use frozen peaches when fresh are expensive
Make this when peaches are in season for best prices

recipes.name: Pique a lo Macho
recipes.description: Bolivian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef sirloin and sausage into bite-sized cubes and set aside.
Peel and cut potatoes into small cubes, then boil in salted water until tender, about 12 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the beef and sausage, about 8 minutes.
Add diced onions, minced garlic, and sliced jalapeños to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes and beef broth, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cooked potatoes and season with salt and pepper, cooking for another 3 minutes.
Serve hot in bowls, ensuring each serving has meat, potatoes, and broth.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck instead of sirloin for significant savings
Use regular potatoes instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Quinua Rellena
recipes.description: Bolivian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook quinoa in vegetable broth according to package directions, about 15 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and brown ground beef over medium-high heat, breaking apart as it cooks, about 6 minutes.
Add diced onions, minced garlic, and diced bell peppers to the beef and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
In a bowl, combine cooked quinoa with the beef mixture, beaten eggs, and cheese, then season with salt and pepper.
Transfer mixture to a greased baking dish and shape into a dome or compact form.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until the top is golden and set.
Cool for 3 minutes, then slice and serve with the pan drippings spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy quinoa in bulk at warehouse stores
Use ground turkey instead of beef to reduce cost

recipes.name: Lagua
recipes.description: Bolivian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine water and milk in a pot and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Slowly whisk in cornmeal while stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat to low and continue stirring frequently for 10 minutes as the mixture thickens.
Add sugar, butter, salt, vanilla, and cinnamon, stirring until well combined.
Simmer for another 3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy and smooth.
Pour into bowls and serve hot, optionally topped with additional cinnamon or a splash of milk.
cheapTips: Buy bulk cornmeal from international or Latin markets
Use store-brand milk to reduce costs

recipes.name: Tucumanas
recipes.description: Bolivian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and softened butter until crumbly, then add water gradually to form a dough; refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Brown ground beef in a skillet, add diced onion, then stir in chopped hard-boiled eggs, olives, and raisins; season and cool.
Divide dough into 8 pieces and roll each into a thin circle about 4 inches wide.
Place 2 tablespoons of filling on one half of each dough circle, then fold into a half-moon shape and seal edges.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan or fryer.
Fry tucumanas in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown, then drain on paper towels.
Serve warm, optionally with hot sauce or chimichurri on the side.
cheapTips: Make the dough from scratch instead of buying pre-made empanada wrappers
Use canned olives instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Chicharrón
recipes.description: Bolivian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into 1-inch cubes and place in a large pot with water, bringing to a boil; simmer for 45 minutes until tender.
Heat oil in a separate skillet and sauté diced onions and minced garlic until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add the sautéed onion mixture to the pot with pork, along with cumin and bay leaves.
Cut potatoes into chunks and add to the pot, simmering for 15 minutes until potatoes are nearly tender.
Add corn kernels and cook for another 5 minutes until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, adjusting the broth consistency as needed.
Ladle into bowls, ensuring each serving has pork, potatoes, corn, and broth, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when on sale and freeze for later use
Use frozen corn instead of fresh to reduce costs

recipes.name: Sopa de Maní
recipes.description: Bolivian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and brown the beef pieces on all sides over medium-high heat, about 8 minutes, then set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onions and minced garlic until golden, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cumin, cooking for 1 minute to combine.
Return beef to the pot and pour in beef broth, then bring to a simmer and cook covered for 20 minutes.
Cut potatoes into small cubes and add to the pot, cooking for another 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Whisk peanut butter with a cup of warm broth to smooth it, then stir into the pot and mix well.
Simmer for 5 more minutes, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use generic peanut butter instead of name brands
Buy beef chuck as a budget-friendly alternative to stewing meat

recipes.name: Étouffée
recipes.description: Cajun dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onions, celery, and bell pepper until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato sauce, chicken broth, and cayenne pepper, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add shrimp to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes until they turn pink and are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, adjusting spice level as desired.
Serve étouffée over hot cooked rice, spooning sauce generously over each serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp when on sale instead of fresh
Use store-brand tomato sauce and broth to cut costs

recipes.name: Andouille Sausage
recipes.description: Cajun dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Grind pork shoulder and fatback together in a food processor until finely minced, working in batches if needed.
Add minced garlic, cayenne, black pepper, salt, thyme, and pink curing salt to the ground pork and mix thoroughly until sticky.
Chill the mixture and casings in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Soak casings in warm water for 10 minutes to soften, then carefully stuff using a sausage stuffer or pastry bag.
Tie casings at 4-inch intervals to create individual links, prickling any air pockets with a needle.
Hang sausages in a cool place (55-65°F) for 24-48 hours to dry slightly and develop flavor, if possible.
Cook in a skillet over medium heat, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through, about 20 minutes.
cheapTips: Check with local butchers about obtaining casings and scraps at reduced prices
Split costs with friends when buying in bulk for sausage-making

recipes.name: Gumbo Z'herbes
recipes.description: Cajun lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make a roux by heating oil in a large pot over medium heat and whisking in flour, stirring constantly for 8-10 minutes until golden brown.
Add diced onions, celery, bell pepper, and minced garlic to the roux, sautéing for 5 minutes until softened.
Gradually pour in vegetable broth while stirring to avoid lumps, then bring to a simmer.
Add chopped mixed greens and okra, stirring well to combine.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until greens are very tender and flavors meld.
Remove from heat and stir in file powder, then season generously with salt and pepper.
Serve gumbo over hot rice, adjusting broth thickness with additional water if needed.
cheapTips: Use frozen greens and okra to save money year-round
Buy file powder online in bulk from Cajun specialty retailers

recipes.name: Crawfish Bisque
recipes.description: Cajun lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make crawfish stock by boiling crawfish heads in chicken broth for 20 minutes, then strain and discard heads; reserve stock.
Melt butter in a large pot and make a roux by whisking in flour, stirring constantly for 8-10 minutes until dark brown.
Add diced onions, celery, bell pepper, and minced garlic to the roux, cooking for 5 minutes until softened.
Pour in the reserved crawfish stock gradually while stirring to avoid lumps, then add bay leaves and cayenne.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes to allow flavors to develop.
Add crawfish tails and heavy cream, stirring well and simmering for another 10 minutes until crawfish are heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, remove bay leaves, and serve hot in bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen crawfish tails in bulk online from Louisiana vendors
Ask seafood counters for heads and scraps at discount prices for stock

recipes.name: King Cake
recipes.description: Cajun snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk and butter to 110°F, then dissolve yeast in the warm mixture and let sit 5 minutes.
Mix flour, sugar, salt, and vanilla in a large bowl, then add yeast mixture and eggs, kneading for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise 90 minutes until doubled.
Punch down dough, roll into a long rope, shape into a ring on a greased baking sheet, seal edges, and let rise 30 minutes.
Bake at 350°F for 25-30 minutes until golden brown and hollow-sounding when tapped.
Cool completely, then mix powdered sugar with 2 tablespoons water and divide into three portions with food coloring.
Frost cooled cake with the colored icings in alternating stripes in Mardi Gras colors.
cheapTips: Make your own food coloring with beets and spinach to save money
Use store-brand yeast and powdered sugar for significant savings

recipes.name: Encebollado
recipes.description: Ecuadorian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced yellow onions until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add fish broth and bring to a boil, then season with salt and pepper.
Add fish fillets and simmer for 8-10 minutes until fish is cooked through and flakes easily.
In a separate bowl, combine diced red onions, tomatoes, and cilantro with lime juice to make a fresh salsa.
Carefully remove cooked fish and shred it into bite-sized pieces with two forks.
Return shredded fish to broth and stir gently to combine.
Serve hot fish stew in bowls with a generous spoonful of the onion-tomato salsa and white rice on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish fillets instead of fresh for 40% savings
Use homemade or store-brand broth instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Humitas
recipes.description: Ecuadorian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried corn husks in hot water for 15 minutes until pliable.
Blend corn kernels with milk until you reach a chunky puree, then strain if desired.
Sauté diced onion in butter until soft, then mix into corn puree along with cheese, eggs, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Spread 2 tablespoons of corn mixture onto each softened corn husk and fold sides inward, leaving top slightly open.
Bundle 2-3 wrapped humitas together by tying with corn husk strips.
Stand bundles upright in a pot with vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Cover and steam for 25-30 minutes until corn mixture is set and pulls away from husks easily.
cheapTips: Buy corn in bulk during summer and freeze kernels for year-round use
Use regular cheddar cheese if queso fresco is unavailable

recipes.name: Llapingachos
recipes.description: Ecuadorian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil peeled and diced potatoes in salted water until very tender, about 15 minutes.
Drain potatoes well, then mash them with salt, pepper, and cumin until creamy but not gluey.
Dice onion very finely and mix into potato mixture along with shredded cheese.
Form mixture into 8 round patties about 3 inches wide and 1/2 inch thick.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry patties 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Fry eggs sunny-side up in a separate pan until whites are set but yolk is runny.
Serve two llapingachos per plate topped with one fried egg and sliced avocado on the side.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk from warehouse stores
Substitute eggs with any available cheese if cost is concern

recipes.name: Bolón de Verde
recipes.description: Ecuadorian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel green plantains and chop into 2-inch chunks.
Boil plantain chunks in salted water for 12-15 minutes until tender.
Drain plantains well and mash with 1 tablespoon oil, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Mix shredded cheese and diced bacon into mashed plantain.
Form mixture into 4 large balls, flattening slightly into thick discs.
Heat remaining oil in a skillet and fry plantain balls 4-5 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Serve hot with fried onions on top or alongside.
cheapTips: Buy plantains when on sale and freeze for later
Use American cheese or any melting cheese you have

recipes.name: Caldo de Patas
recipes.description: Ecuadorian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean feet thoroughly under running water, scraping off any hair.
Place feet in a large pot with 8 cups water, bring to boil, drain, and rinse to remove impurities.
Add cleaned feet to a fresh pot with beef broth, halved onions, and garlic cloves; simmer 2 hours until meat is tender.
Remove feet, let cool slightly, shred meat from bones, and discard bones.
Return shredded meat to broth and add diced potatoes and drained hominy.
Simmer for 25-30 minutes until potatoes are tender, then season with salt, pepper, and cumin.
Serve hot in bowls garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy pork feet from ethnic markets for 50% less than regular butchers
Use canned hominy to save time and money

recipes.name: Seco de Chivo
recipes.description: Ecuadorian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend 1 onion, garlic, cilantro, and 1/2 cup water into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and brown meat chunks on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Add diced remaining onion and cook until soft, then add cilantro-garlic paste and cook 2 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth, bring to simmer, cover, and cook 60-75 minutes until meat is very tender.
Add cubed potatoes and continue simmering 20-25 minutes until potatoes are cooked.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve stew over white rice with the meat and potatoes in a rich cilantro sauce.
cheapTips: Substitute lamb or beef chuck for goat meat availability
Buy cilantro from farmers markets for half the price

recipes.name: Fritada
recipes.description: Ecuadorian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Marinate pork cubes in orange juice, lime juice, minced garlic, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large pot and brown marinated pork pieces on all sides, about 10 minutes total.
Remove pork and sauté diced onions in the same pot until softened, about 5 minutes.
Return pork to pot with marinade, add broth and cumin, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes until pork is tender.
Add cubed potatoes and simmer additional 20-25 minutes until potatoes are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve hot with corn tortillas or white rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze portions for later
Use bottled citrus juice to save time and money

recipes.name: Caldo de Bolas
recipes.description: Ecuadorian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef with minced onion and garlic, breaking apart as it cooks, about 6 minutes total.
Boil and mash peeled green plantains with salt until smooth, then mix in cooked beef.
Form mixture into 8 balls about 2 inches in diameter.
Bring beef broth to a boil in a large pot.
Carefully drop plantain balls into boiling broth and add diced potatoes.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until potatoes are tender and balls float to surface.
Season with cumin, salt, and pepper, then garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for weeknight cooking
Use store-brand broth for 30% savings

recipes.name: Empanadas de Viento
recipes.description: Ecuadorian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, cut in butter, then add warm water and knead until a soft dough forms.
Divide dough into 12 equal portions and roll each into a thin circle.
Combine shredded cheese with finely diced onion and cilantro for filling.
Place 2 tablespoons filling on one half of each dough circle, fold in half, and press edges firmly to seal.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or pot.
Carefully fry empanadas 2-3 minutes per side until puffed and golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with aji sauce or hot sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Make dough from scratch instead of using premade wrappers for 60% savings
Use cheaper melting cheeses like mozzarella instead of imported varieties

recipes.name: Nachos
recipes.description: Tex-Mex snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown the ground beef with diced onion and garlic in a skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Stir in cumin, salt, pepper, and drained black beans, cooking for 2 minutes.
Spread tortilla chips on a baking sheet and top with the beef mixture and jalapeños.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese evenly over the chips and bake at 375°F for 5-7 minutes until cheese melts.
Remove from oven and drizzle with salsa and dollops of sour cream before serving.
Serve immediately while hot and crispy.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand tortilla chips and ground beef on sale
Use block cheddar cheese and shred it yourself for 30% savings

recipes.name: Enchiladas Rojas
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove seeds and stems from dried red chilies and toast them in a dry skillet for 1 minute.
Boil the toasted chilies with onion and garlic in 2 cups water for 10 minutes until soft.
Blend the chili mixture until smooth, then strain through a sieve and mix with chicken broth and salt.
Heat oil in a shallow pan and quickly dip each tortilla to soften, then dip in the red chili sauce.
Place 2 tablespoons of shredded chicken and 1 tablespoon cheese in each tortilla, roll, and place seam-side down in a greased baking dish.
Pour remaining red sauce over the enchiladas and drizzle with crema.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and bake at 350°F for 25 minutes until bubbly.
cheapTips: Buy dried chilies in bulk from Latin markets for half the supermarket price
Use rotisserie chicken instead of cooking your own

recipes.name: Burrito
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown the ground beef with diced onion and garlic in a skillet over medium-high heat for 8 minutes.
Season with cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper, then stir in salsa and remove from heat.
Warm the refried beans in a small saucepan and heat the tortillas in a dry skillet until pliable.
Lay a tortilla flat and spread a line of refried beans down the center, leaving 2 inches on each end.
Top the beans with half the cooked rice, half the seasoned beef, and half the cheese.
Fold the sides of the tortilla inward and roll tightly from bottom to top, keeping fillings contained.
Repeat with the second tortilla and serve with sour cream on the side.
cheapTips: Cook rice in bulk and refrigerate for quick assembly
Buy ground beef when on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Taco Salad
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and fry the flour tortilla shell in a tortilla fryer or draped over a heat-safe bowl for 2-3 minutes until crispy.
Drain the shell on paper towels and set aside.
Brown the ground beef with diced onion and garlic over medium-high heat for 8 minutes.
Add taco seasoning and drained black beans to the beef, cooking for 2 minutes.
Combine chopped romaine, tomatoes, corn, and half the cheese in a large bowl.
Place the crispy tortilla shell on a plate and fill with the lettuce mixture.
Top with the seasoned beef mixture, remaining cheese, and drizzle with ranch dressing before serving.
cheapTips: Buy pre-shredded lettuce to save prep time
Use store-brand taco seasoning instead of packets

recipes.name: Chalupas
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix masa harina with warm water and salt to form a soft dough, then let rest for 5 minutes.
Form 9 small balls of dough and flatten each into a thick disc about 2 inches across.
Pinch up the edges of each disc to form a small boat shape with raised edges.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and fry the chalupas for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and warm the refried beans in a saucepan.
Warm the shredded chicken with salsa roja in another pan.
Spread a layer of refried beans on each chalupa, top with chicken mixture, lettuce, cheese, crema, and jalapeños.
cheapTips: Buy masa harina in bulk from Mexican markets for better prices
Use rotisserie chicken to skip cooking time and expense

recipes.name: Chile Relleno de Rajas
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast 3 whole poblano peppers over an open flame or under a broiler until charred all over, then place in a plastic bag for 10 minutes to steam.
Peel off the charred skin under running water and carefully make a slit to remove seeds while keeping the pepper whole.
Sauté sliced poblanos and onion in oil until soft, then remove from heat and stir in heavy cream, crema, salt, and pepper to make the rajas sauce.
Stuff each whole roasted pepper with oaxaca cheese and carefully coat with flour.
Beat eggs until frothy and heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Dip each stuffed pepper in beaten egg, then fry until golden on both sides, about 3-4 minutes total.
Pour rajas sauce into a baking dish, place fried peppers on top, sprinkle with remaining cheese, and bake at 350°F for 10 minutes until heated through.
cheapTips: Roast peppers under a broiler instead of over a flame to avoid gas use
Use regular mozzarella instead of oaxaca cheese for savings

recipes.name: Tourtière du Lac-Saint-Jean
recipes.description: Québécois dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown the ground pork, beef, and veal in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking apart as it cooks, about 10 minutes.
Add diced onion and garlic, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in diced potato, beef broth, allspice, salt, and pepper, then simmer for 20 minutes until potatoes are very tender.
Preheat oven to 400°F and place one pie crust in a 9-inch pie pan.
Pour the meat mixture into the crust, spreading evenly.
Top with the second pie crust, seal edges by pressing with a fork, trim excess dough, and cut steam vents.
Brush with beaten egg and bake for 30-35 minutes until golden brown.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy ground meats in bulk and freeze for 2-3 months
Use store-bought pie crust to save 30 minutes of prep time

recipes.name: Cipâte du Lac-Saint-Jean
recipes.description: Québécois dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fry diced salt pork in a large pot over medium heat until fat renders, about 5 minutes.
Add cubed pork and beef, browning on all sides, about 10 minutes total.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in beef broth, add bay leaves and thyme, then simmer for 30 minutes until meat is partially tender.
Add cubed potatoes and simmer another 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper, then divide meat mixture between two layers of pie crust in a deep 9-inch pie dish.
Top with final pie crust, seal edges, cut steam vents, brush with beaten egg, and bake at 375°F for 40 minutes until golden.
Let rest 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck and pork shoulder on sale and freeze in portions
Use homemade broth from chicken bones saved in the freezer

recipes.name: Pâté Chinois
recipes.description: Québécois dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown the ground beef with diced onion and garlic in a large skillet over medium-high heat until fully cooked, about 8 minutes.
Stir in corn, beef broth, and Worcestershire sauce, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil sliced potatoes in salted water until tender, about 10 minutes, then drain and mash with butter and milk until smooth.
Preheat oven to 375°F and spread the beef and corn mixture in the bottom of a greased 9x13 baking dish.
Spread the mashed potatoes evenly over the meat layer, smoothing the top.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the potatoes and bake for 15 minutes until golden and heated through.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn instead of canned to save money
Buy potatoes in bulk and store in a cool dark place

recipes.name: Cretons
recipes.description: Québécois breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown the ground pork in a large heavy pot over medium heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 10 minutes.
Add diced onion and minced garlic, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in breadcrumbs and water, mixing well to combine.
Add salt, pepper, cloves, nutmeg, and cinnamon, stirring to distribute spices evenly.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is thick and the liquid is absorbed.
Pour the cretons into a terrine or loaf pan and let cool completely.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving on toast or crackers.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork in large quantities and freeze
Use homemade breadcrumbs from stale bread instead of store-bought

recipes.name: Tarte au Sucre
recipes.description: Québécois snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add ice water one tablespoon at a time until dough just comes together, then chill for 20 minutes.
Roll out dough and press into a 9-inch tart pan, then bake blind at 375°F for 10 minutes.
Combine brown sugar, cream, butter, and vanilla in a saucepan and heat until sugar dissolves, stirring constantly.
Pour warm filling into pre-baked crust and bake at 375°F for 15-18 minutes until golden.
Cool completely before slicing and serving.
cheapTips: Make your own pie crust instead of buying pre-made to save 50 cents per serving
Use light brown sugar instead of dark for same flavor at lower cost

recipes.name: Tire d'Érable sur la Neige
recipes.description: Québécois snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat maple syrup in a heavy-bottomed saucepan to 235°F (soft-ball stage), about 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in butter, cream, vanilla, and salt.
Place clean snow in a shallow pan or on parchment paper in a long line.
Pour hot syrup in a thin ribbon along the snow in a spiral pattern.
Wait 2-3 minutes for syrup to set slightly, then roll up with a wooden stick while still warm.
Serve immediately with plain yogurt or cream for dipping.
cheapTips: Use grocery store maple syrup instead of pure for half the cost
Make this outdoors in winter to avoid buying snow

recipes.name: Ragoût de Pattes de Cochon
recipes.description: Québécois dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch pig feet in boiling salted water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse thoroughly.
Chop onions, carrots, and celery into large chunks.
Place pig feet, vegetables, broth, tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaf in a large pot and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 2 hours until meat is very tender.
Cut potatoes into chunks and add to pot, then simmer for another 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, remove bay leaf and thyme, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy pig feet from Asian or butcher counters for half the price of pre-packaged meat
Use chicken broth if beef is unavailable for same flavor at lower cost

recipes.name: Soupe aux Pois
recipes.description: Québécois lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse split peas under cold water and remove any debris.
Chop onion, carrots, and celery into small pieces.
Place ham bone, peas, water, and vegetables in a large pot and bring to boil.
Reduce heat, add thyme, and simmer covered for 60-70 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove ham bone and shred any meat back into the soup.
If desired, blend half the soup for creamier texture, then season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy split peas in bulk bins for 60% less than pre-packaged
Save vegetable scraps to make free broth instead of using water

recipes.name: Crème de Maïs Québécoise
recipes.description: Québécois lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot and sauté diced onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and corn, then pour in chicken broth and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 12-15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in cream and thyme, then simmer for 2 more minutes.
Blend half the soup for partial creaminess using an immersion blender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn year-round instead of fresh for 40% savings
Replace heavy cream with evaporated milk for half the cost

recipes.name: Bottine de Chocolat
recipes.description: Québécois snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then add vanilla extract.
Whisk together flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl.
Alternate adding dry ingredients and milk to butter mixture, beginning and ending with dry.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 35-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
cheapTips: Use cocoa powder instead of chocolate chips to save 75 cents per loaf
Buy store-brand flour and sugar in bulk to reduce costs by 30%

recipes.name: Pouding Chômeur
recipes.description: Québécois dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and butter a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Cream butter and sugar, then beat in egg and vanilla.
Alternate adding dry mixture and milk to butter mixture, beginning and ending with dry.
Spread batter in prepared dish and sprinkle brown sugar evenly over top.
Pour hot water carefully over entire surface without stirring.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until cake is set but syrup remains underneath.
Let cool 10 minutes and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
cheapTips: Make your own vanilla extract by splitting a vanilla bean in vodka weeks ahead
Use light brown sugar instead of dark for the same result at lower cost

recipes.name: Tourtière de Kamouraska
recipes.description: Québécois dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground pork and beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking apart as it cooks, about 8 minutes.
Dice potatoes and onion finely, then add to meat along with water, cinnamon, and cloves.
Simmer uncovered for 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender and liquid reduces, then season with salt and pepper.
Preheat oven to 400°F and let meat filling cool slightly.
Place one pie crust in a 9-inch pie dish and fill with meat mixture.
Top with second crust, seal edges, cut vents, brush with beaten egg, and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze to use later when prices are high
Make your own pie crust to save 1.50 per pie compared to store-bought

recipes.name: Tarte au Sirop d'Érable
recipes.description: Québécois snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and place pie crust in a 9-inch pie dish.
Combine maple syrup, brown sugar, cornstarch, and salt in a saucepan.
Heat over medium, stirring constantly until mixture thickens, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in butter, cream, and vanilla.
Pour filling into pie crust and bake for 25-30 minutes until crust is golden and filling is set.
Cool completely on a wire rack before slicing and serving.
cheapTips: Use light maple-flavored syrup instead of pure maple to cut cost by 60%
Replace heavy cream with evaporated milk for half the price

recipes.name: Pâté à la Viande
recipes.description: Québécois lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and finely grind or chop pork liver into paste.
Mix ground pork, liver paste, minced onion, minced garlic, bread crumbs, eggs, salt, pepper, and thyme until combined.
Line a loaf pan with bacon strips, letting them hang over the sides.
Fill pan with pâté mixture and fold bacon over top, placing bay leaves on surface.
Cover with foil and place in a hot water bath, then bake for 60-70 minutes until internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Cool completely, then refrigerate overnight before serving with crusty bread and cornichons.
cheapTips: Buy pork liver from butcher counter for 70% less than pre-packaged
Make bread crumbs from day-old bread instead of buying packaged

recipes.name: Fruits de Mer à la Québécoise
recipes.description: Québécois dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean mussels by scrubbing shells and removing beards under cold water.
Melt butter in a large pot and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Pour in white wine and bring to a simmer, then add mussels and cook covered for 5-7 minutes until they open.
Remove mussels with a slotted spoon and strain cooking liquid through cheesecloth.
In the same pot, add fish fillets and shrimp with the strained liquid and thyme, simmering for 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in heavy cream and season with salt and pepper.
Return mussels to the pot and gently combine all seafood.
Divide into bowls, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve immediately with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen mussels and shrimp on sale instead of fresh for 30% savings
Use regular fish stock instead of white wine to reduce cost by $2 per serving

recipes.name: Carotte Rapée
recipes.description: Québécois lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel carrots and use a box grater or food processor to shred them into thin matchsticks.
Place shredded carrots in a large bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, salt, pepper, and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Pour dressing over shredded carrots and toss well to combine.
Let sit for 15 minutes at room temperature to allow flavors to meld.
Adjust seasoning if needed and serve chilled or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy loose carrots from bulk bins instead of pre-packaged
Use white vinegar instead of apple cider vinegar to save 50 cents per serving

recipes.name: Bagel de Montréal
recipes.description: Québécois breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, honey, and yeast together and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Add flour, salt, and oil to the yeast mixture and knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover dough with a damp towel and let rise for 30 minutes.
Divide dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a ball, then poke a hole in the center and stretch into a bagel shape with a 2-inch hole.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add 2 tablespoons honey.
Boil bagels 1-2 minutes per side until they float and sink again, then remove with a slotted spoon.
Place bagels on a parchment-lined baking sheet, brush with beaten egg yolk, and sprinkle with seeds.
Bake at 425°F for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Make a larger batch and freeze bagels for multiple breakfasts
Skip seeds or use cheaper alternative like everything bagel seasoning

recipes.name: Salade de Chou
recipes.description: Québécois lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove outer leaves from cabbage and discard.
Thinly slice green and red cabbage using a knife or mandoline and place in a large bowl.
Peel and grate carrot into the bowl with cabbage.
In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, white vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over cabbage mixture and toss thoroughly until evenly coated.
Let sit for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow flavors to develop.
cheapTips: Buy whole cabbages instead of pre-cut to save 40%
Use store-brand mayonnaise instead of name brands

recipes.name: Jambon Glacé à l'Érable
recipes.description: Québécois dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and score the surface of ham in a crosshatch pattern.
Place ham cut-side down in a roasting pan and add water to the bottom of the pan.
Cover with foil and bake for 2.5-3 hours, allowing 20 minutes per pound.
While ham cooks, whisk together maple syrup, mustard, vinegar, and brown sugar in a small saucepan over low heat.
Remove ham from oven and stud the surface with whole cloves in a decorative pattern.
Brush generously with maple glaze, return to oven uncovered, and bake for 30 more minutes, basting with glaze every 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and let rest for 15 minutes before carving.
Serve with remaining warm glaze on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ham on sale after holidays like Christmas and Easter
Substitute with maple extract and regular syrup if pure maple syrup is expensive

recipes.name: Pain de Maïs Québécois
recipes.description: Québécois breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and grease a 9-inch square baking pan.
Whisk together cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat eggs and mix with milk and melted butter.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and fold together gently until just combined.
Fold in corn kernels and pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and the top is golden brown.
Cool in pan for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn instead of fresh to save 30 cents per serving
Buy store-brand cornmeal and flour

recipes.name: Tarte aux Bleuets
recipes.description: Québécois snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and place pie crust in a 9-inch pie pan.
In a large bowl, gently toss blueberries with sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, and vanilla extract.
Pour blueberry mixture into pie crust and dot with butter.
Mix egg yolk with water to create an egg wash.
If using a double-crust pie, place second crust on top and seal edges, then brush with egg wash.
Bake for 45-50 minutes until crust is golden brown and filling bubbles at the edges.
Cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before slicing and serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen blueberries instead of fresh, which are 40% cheaper
Make your own pie crust from scratch to save $1.50 per tart

recipes.name: Chivito
recipes.description: Uruguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet until crispy, then remove and set aside on paper towels.
In the same skillet, cook fried eggs sunny-side up and set aside.
Pat beef steak dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
Sear steak in the hot skillet for 3-4 minutes per side for medium, then slice thinly.
Slice bread rolls in half and toast lightly if desired.
Spread mayonnaise on both sides of each roll.
Layer cheese, sliced steak, tomato, lettuce, bacon, and fried egg on each sandwich.
Serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of steak and form thin patties
Skip one of the cheeses to save $0.75 per sandwich

recipes.name: Empanada Criolla
recipes.description: Uruguayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prepare dough by mixing flour and salt, then cutting in cold butter until crumbly, then adding water and kneading until smooth.
Wrap dough in plastic and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook diced onion and garlic in oil until softened, then add ground beef and cook until browned.
Stir in cumin, salt, and pepper, then remove from heat and let cool.
Chop hard-boiled eggs and olives, then fold into beef mixture.
Roll dough out thin and cut 12 circles with a 3-inch cutter.
Place a spoonful of filling on each circle, fold in half, and crimp edges with a fork.
Place on a greased baking sheet, brush with egg yolk, and bake at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until golden.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze extras for up to 3 months
Use cheaper ground beef and omit olives to save $0.50 per empanada

recipes.name: Chopp
recipes.description: Uruguayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice fresh mozzarella into 0.5-inch thick pieces and arrange on a serving platter.
Slice ripe tomatoes into thin rounds and intersperse with the mozzarella.
Scatter fresh basil leaves over the cheese and tomatoes.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Drizzle olive oil mixture over the chopp and season with salt and pepper.
Let sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve immediately with sliced crusty bread on the side for scooping.
cheapTips: Use regular mozzarella instead of fresh for half the cost
Buy tomatoes when on sale and use within 2 days

recipes.name: Tereré
recipes.description: Uruguayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a glass gourd or cup halfway with ice cubes.
Add 2 tablespoons of yerba mate to the gourd.
Pour cold water over the yerba mate until nearly full.
Add fresh mint leaves and lemon juice to taste.
Insert the filtered metal straw (bombilla) and sip directly from the gourd.
cheapTips: Buy yerba mate in bulk from Latin American markets
Use tap water and homegrown mint to minimize costs

recipes.name: Mate
recipes.description: Uruguayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat water to 160-180°F (not boiling).
Fill a ceramic or metal gourd halfway with yerba mate.
Pour a small amount of hot water to dampen the yerba mate.
Add sugar if desired and stir gently.
Fill the gourd with remaining hot water.
Insert the bombilla (metal straw with filter) and drink, passing the gourd to share with others.
cheapTips: Purchase yerba mate at discount Latin grocers
Reuse loose yerba mate 2-3 times for additional infusions

recipes.name: Canelones
recipes.description: Uruguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté diced onion and garlic until softened.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks, then season with salt and pepper.
Lay crepes flat and divide the beef mixture evenly among them, placing filling on one end.
Roll each crepe tightly and place seam-side down in a buttered baking dish.
Pour béchamel sauce over the canelones, then drizzle tomato sauce on top.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese generously over the entire dish.
Bake at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until the top is golden and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let rest 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Make your own béchamel with butter, flour, and milk instead of buying prepared sauce
Use ground beef on sale or ground chuck instead of premium cuts

recipes.name: Flan con Dulce de Leche
recipes.description: Uruguayan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Heat sugar and water in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves into a light amber caramel, then quickly pour into a round baking dish to coat the bottom.
Blend whole milk, condensed milk, eggs, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Pour the milk mixture over the dulce de leche in the caramel-lined dish.
Place the baking dish in a larger roasting pan filled with hot water halfway up the sides (water bath).
Bake for 35-40 minutes until the flan is set but slightly jiggly in the center.
Cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Run a thin knife around the edges and invert onto a serving plate to release.
cheapTips: Buy dulce de leche in bulk or make your own by slow-cooking sweetened condensed milk
Use store-brand condensed milk and eggs to reduce cost

recipes.name: Alfajor
recipes.description: Uruguayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg yolks one at a time, then add vanilla extract.
Sift together flour, cornstarch, and baking powder, then fold into the butter mixture until combined.
Roll dough between parchment paper to 1/8-inch thickness and cut into 2-inch rounds.
Bake at 350°F for 12-15 minutes until lightly golden.
Cool cookies completely.
Spread dulce de leche on the flat side of one cookie and top with another to form a sandwich.
Roll the edges in shredded coconut and let set for 30 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Make dulce de leche at home by boiling sweetened condensed milk in a water bath for 2-3 hours
Use unsweetened shredded coconut from bulk bins instead of packaged

recipes.name: Chajá
recipes.description: Uruguayan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the sponge cake horizontally into two layers.
Whip heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Drain peaches and reserve the syrup for brushing.
Place the bottom cake layer on a serving plate and brush with peach syrup.
Spread a layer of dulce de leche on the cake, then a thick layer of whipped cream.
Arrange peach slices on top of the cream.
Place the second cake layer on top and brush with peach syrup.
Cover the entire cake with remaining whipped cream and decorate with peach slices and maraschino cherries.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Use a store-bought sponge cake to save time and money
Buy canned peaches on sale or use frozen peaches thawed and drained

recipes.name: Bizcochos de Grasa
recipes.description: Uruguayan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cream together lard and sugar until light.
Beat in eggs one at a time until well combined.
Sift together flour, baking powder, salt, and anise seeds.
Alternate adding the flour mixture and milk to the lard mixture, stirring until a soft dough forms.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto a greased baking sheet, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
Cool on a wire rack and serve warm with coffee or milk.
cheapTips: Use lard or vegetable shortening instead of butter for authenticity and savings
Buy anise seeds in bulk from spice sections or ethnic markets

recipes.name: Boina Irlandesa
recipes.description: Uruguayan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a round 8-inch cake pan with parchment paper.
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in eggs one at a time.
Sift flour and baking powder together, then fold into the wet ingredients.
Pour batter into the prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool the cake completely and slice horizontally into two layers.
Spread dulce de leche on the bottom layer and top with the second layer.
Mix powdered sugar and cocoa powder, then dust generously over the top of the cake.
Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.
cheapTips: Make dulce de leche at home instead of buying canned
Use store-brand butter and eggs to reduce ingredient costs

recipes.name: Sándwich de Miga
recipes.description: Uruguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread mayonnaise on two slices of white bread.
Layer ham, cheese, tomato, and lettuce on one slice.
Top with the second slice of bread, mayonnaise side down.
Butter the outer surfaces of the sandwich.
Trim the crusts using a sharp serrated knife.
Cut diagonally into triangles and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ham on sale and slice it yourself from deli counters rather than pre-packaged
Use store-brand mayonnaise and cheese to save money

recipes.name: Tortilla a la Paisana
recipes.description: Uruguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and dice potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes, then boil until just tender and drain.
Heat olive oil in a 10-inch non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion and bell pepper until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add boiled potatoes, corn, and peas to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Whisk together eggs with salt and pepper, then pour over the vegetables in the skillet.
Cook over medium heat without stirring until the edges begin to set, about 5 minutes.
Once the bottom is set but the top is still slightly wet, slide the tortilla onto a plate, flip it back into the skillet, and cook the other side for 3-4 minutes until fully set.
Slide onto a serving plate and cut into wedges.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn and peas instead of fresh to save money
Buy eggs in bulk when on sale and store them for later use

recipes.name: Guiso de Mondongo
recipes.description: Uruguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the tripe thoroughly under cold running water, then cut into small 1-inch cubes.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sauté diced onion, garlic, and bell pepper until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the tripe cubes and brown them for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes until tripe is tender.
Add diced tomatoes, carrots, potatoes, and cumin, then simmer for another 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and stir in fresh parsley before serving.
Serve hot in bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy tripe from ethnic markets or butcher sections where it's cheaper than specialty stores
Use frozen mixed vegetables if fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Puchero
recipes.description: Uruguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté chopped onions and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add beef chuck and chicken breast, browning on all sides for 8 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 60 minutes.
Add potatoes, carrots, and zucchini, continuing to simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in corn kernels and oregano, then simmer for another 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the broth with meat and vegetables in large bowls.
cheapTips: Buy cheaper cuts of beef like chuck roast rather than prime cuts
Use frozen corn and carrots to reduce costs

recipes.name: Revoltijo
recipes.description: Uruguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean liver and intestines thoroughly, then cut into small bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté onion, garlic, and bell pepper for 5 minutes.
Add liver and intestine pieces, browning them for 8 minutes while stirring frequently.
Sprinkle paprika over the meat and stir well, then add diced tomatoes and beef broth.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer covered for 35 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and continue simmering for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Organ meats like liver and intestines are very inexpensive at butcher shops
Buy from ethnic markets for the best prices on offal

recipes.name: Flor de Ceibo
recipes.description: Uruguayan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut puff pastry into flower petal shapes using a cookie cutter or knife, creating petals that overlap.
Brush pastry with egg wash made from mixed egg yolk and water.
Bake pastry petals for 12-15 minutes until golden brown, then cool completely.
Whip heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form.
Spread a thin layer of dulce de leche on the cooled pastry base, then top with whipped cream.
Dust with cocoa powder and confectioners sugar, arranging petals to resemble a flower before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand puff pastry and dulce de leche to save significantly
Make whipped cream from regular whipping cream instead of pre-made varieties

recipes.name: Buñuelos de Algas
recipes.description: Uruguayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop dried seaweed into small pieces and place in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk together eggs, water, salt, and combine with flour, cornstarch, and baking powder to create a smooth batter.
Fold seaweed pieces into the batter until evenly distributed.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or pot.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove buñuelos with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle with sea salt while still warm and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy nori sheets in bulk from Asian markets and chop them yourself
Reuse frying oil by straining and storing for next use

recipes.name: Lobster Roll
recipes.description: New England lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop cooked lobster meat into bite-sized chunks and place in a bowl.
Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, diced celery, salt, pepper, and paprika in a separate bowl.
Fold the mayonnaise mixture gently into the lobster meat until well combined.
Butter the inside of hot dog buns and toast them in a skillet over medium heat until lightly golden.
Fill each toasted bun generously with the lobster salad mixture.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and extra paprika for garnish.
cheapTips: Use frozen cooked lobster meat instead of fresh to save significantly
Buy buns from day-old bakery sections

recipes.name: Boston Cream Pie
recipes.description: New England dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease two 9-inch round cake pans.
Cream together 0.5 cup butter and 1 cup sugar, then beat in eggs one at a time, adding 1 tsp vanilla.
Combine flour, baking powder, and salt, then alternate adding dry ingredients and milk to the butter mixture.
Divide batter between pans and bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean, then cool.
Make pastry cream by heating 0.75 cup milk with 0.5 cup sugar and cornstarch, then whisk in egg yolks and 1 tsp vanilla before cooling.
Whip heavy cream to stiff peaks and fold into cooled pastry cream.
Spread pastry cream between the two cooled cake layers.
Melt 4 oz dark chocolate with 2 tbsp butter and spread over the top as ganache.
Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand chocolate instead of premium brands
Make pastry cream from scratch rather than using instant pudding

recipes.name: Oyster Cracker
recipes.description: New England snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Create a well and add water and vegetable oil, stirring until a stiff dough forms.
Knead dough for 2 minutes on a floured surface, then roll out to 0.125-inch thickness.
Cut dough into small bite-sized squares or circles using a knife or cookie cutter.
Place crackers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush lightly with olive oil and sprinkle with sea salt.
Bake at 400°F for 12-15 minutes until light golden brown and crispy.
Cool on a wire rack and serve with seafood chowder or soup.
cheapTips: Make homemade crackers instead of buying packages—much cheaper
Store in an airtight container to keep fresh for a week

recipes.name: Codfish Cakes
recipes.description: New England lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod in cold water for 24 hours, changing water every 6 hours, then cook in fresh water for 20 minutes until tender.
Boil potatoes until fork-tender, then peel and mash in a bowl.
Flake cooked cod into small pieces, removing any bones, then mix with mashed potatoes and finely diced onion.
Stir in beaten egg and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Form mixture into patties about 2 inches wide and 0.5 inch thick.
Set up breading station with flour, beaten egg, and bread crumbs in separate shallow bowls.
Coat each patty with flour, then egg, then bread crumbs, pressing gently so coating adheres.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep skillet and fry cakes for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with tartar sauce.
cheapTips: Buy salt cod at ethnic markets for cheaper prices than specialty food stores
Use panko bread crumbs in bulk to reduce breading costs

recipes.name: Clam Cake
recipes.description: New England snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain canned clams, reserving 0.25 cup of the juice, then chop clams into small pieces.
Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk together egg, milk, and reserved clam juice in another bowl.
Fold wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined, then fold in chopped clams gently.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or pot.
Drop rounded tablespoons of batter into hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve warm with tartar sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Use canned clams year-round instead of fresh for consistent low pricing
Reuse frying oil for your next batch if properly strained

recipes.name: Fried Clams
recipes.description: New England lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil to 375°F in a heavy pot or deep fryer.
Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and black pepper in a shallow bowl.
Whisk together egg and milk in another bowl until combined.
Pat clams dry with paper towels, then dip into egg mixture, then dredge in flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Fry clams in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and tartar sauce.
cheapTips: Use canned clams instead of fresh to save 40% on cost
Buy vegetable oil in bulk and reuse for multiple frying sessions

recipes.name: Steamed Lobster
recipes.description: New England dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a large pot with water and add salt, thyme, and bay leaf; bring to a rolling boil.
Carefully place lobsters head-first into boiling water.
Cover and return to a boil, then reduce heat slightly and steam for 15-18 minutes for 1.25-1.5 lb lobsters.
Remove lobsters with tongs and place on a cutting board to cool for 5 minutes.
Melt butter in a small saucepan with lemon juice and black pepper.
Split lobsters in half lengthwise and remove the dark vein running down the tail.
Serve immediately with warm melted butter for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy lobsters on sale in off-season (winter) for 20-30% savings
Substitute clarified butter or olive oil instead of whole butter

recipes.name: Scallop Roll
recipes.description: New England lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat scallops dry with paper towels and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear scallops for 2-3 minutes per side until opaque; let cool and roughly chop.
Mix mayonnaise with lemon juice, celery, scallions, salt, pepper, and paprika in a bowl.
Fold chopped scallops into the mayo mixture until well combined.
Lightly butter the insides of split-top rolls and toast in a skillet or under a broiler for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Fill each toasted roll with the scallop mixture.
Serve immediately with extra lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Use frozen scallops (thawed) instead of fresh to save 30%
Make mayo-based dressing yourself instead of buying prepared versions

recipes.name: Shrimp Roll
recipes.description: New England lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and add shrimp; cook for 2-3 minutes until pink, then drain and cool.
Chop cooked shrimp into bite-sized pieces.
Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, celery, red onion, salt, pepper, and Old Bay seasoning in a bowl.
Fold shrimp into the mayo mixture until evenly coated.
Lightly butter the insides of split-top rolls and toast in a skillet for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Fill each toasted roll with the shrimp mixture.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and extra Old Bay on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk during sales and thaw as needed
Use 2% mayo instead of full-fat to reduce fat and cost slightly

recipes.name: New England Pot Roast
recipes.description: New England dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and heat olive oil in a heavy Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Pat roast dry and season generously with salt and pepper, then brown on all sides for 3-4 minutes per side; set aside.
In the same pot, briefly sauté onion, carrots, and celery for 2 minutes.
Return roast to pot and add beef broth, water, bay leaves, and thyme.
Cover and transfer to oven; braise for 2 hours, turning roast halfway through.
Add potatoes and celery pieces, cover, and continue cooking for 45 minutes to 1 hour until vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaves and thyme sprigs, season with additional salt and pepper if needed, and serve hot in bowls with broth.
cheapTips: Buy chuck roast on sale and freeze until needed
Use store-brand beef broth instead of name brands

recipes.name: Corn Chowder
recipes.description: New England lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion and celery for 5 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir for 1-2 minutes to create a roux.
Add diced potatoes, corn, and broth; bring to a simmer.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally.
Add thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Slowly pour in heavy cream while stirring to combine.
Simmer for another 5 minutes without boiling, then taste and adjust seasonings as needed; serve hot.
cheapTips: Use frozen or canned corn instead of fresh to save 50%
Make with half-and-half instead of heavy cream to reduce cost by 25%

recipes.name: Johnnycakes
recipes.description: New England breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk together milk, egg, and melted butter in a separate bowl.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined; don't overmix.
Heat a griddle or skillet over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Drop batter by 1/4 cup portions onto the griddle, flattening slightly with the back of a spoon.
Cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy at the edges.
Serve warm with maple syrup, butter, and jam on the side.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from bulk bins to save 40%
Use store-brand flour and baking powder to minimize costs

recipes.name: Baked Beans
recipes.description: New England dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, remove and chop; cook onion in bacon fat for 3 minutes until softened.
In a large baking dish, combine beans, cooked bacon, onion, molasses, maple syrup, tomato paste, brown sugar, mustard, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Stir well to combine all ingredients evenly.
Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour, stirring occasionally and adding water if mixture dries out.
Remove foil and bake an additional 15-20 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasonings, then serve hot as a side dish.
cheapTips: Use canned beans instead of dried beans to eliminate soaking/cooking time
Buy molasses and maple syrup on sale and stock up

recipes.name: Parker House Roll
recipes.description: New England dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm milk, 2 tablespoons melted butter, egg, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Add yeast and let sit for 5 minutes, then add flour and mix until a dough forms.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a buttered bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 45 minutes until doubled in size.
Punch down dough, roll out to 1/4-inch thickness, cut into 4-inch rounds, and brush each with melted butter.
Fold each round in half and place on a buttered baking sheet; cover and let rise 30-40 minutes until puffy.
Preheat oven to 400°F, brush rolls with egg white wash, and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Make dough in bulk and freeze shaped rolls for quick reheating later
Use instant yeast from a jar rather than packets to save 60%

recipes.name: Clam Strip
recipes.description: New England snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil to 375°F in a deep pot or fryer.
Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and pepper in a shallow bowl.
Whisk egg and milk together in another bowl.
Pat clam strips dry with paper towels, then dip into egg mixture and dredge in flour mixture.
Fry clam strips in batches for 2 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with tartar sauce and lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Use budget-friendly canned clam strips instead of fresh
Reuse frying oil multiple times for cost efficiency

recipes.name: Shave Ice
recipes.description: Hawaiian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix water with syrups in a small bowl until smooth.
Crush or shave ice finely using a blender or ice shaver into 4 small bowls.
Pour syrup mixture evenly over the shaved ice.
Drizzle condensed milk on top of each serving.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy syrups in bulk at Asian markets for half the supermarket price
Make your own syrup by boiling sugar with water and food coloring

recipes.name: Manapua
recipes.description: Hawaiian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
Add warm water and oil, then knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Let dough rise covered for 45 minutes until doubled.
Brown diced onion in a skillet, then add canned pork, soy sauce, and brown sugar to make filling.
Divide dough into 8 balls and flatten each into a 4-inch circle.
Place 2 tablespoons of filling in the center of each circle and wrap dough around it, sealing the seams.
Place seam-side down on parchment paper and let rise 20 minutes.
Bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Use canned pork instead of fresh for affordability
Make filling the day before to save morning prep time

recipes.name: Kalua Chicken
recipes.description: Hawaiian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken dry and rub inside and outside with salt, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Place chicken in a slow cooker with quartered onion inside the cavity.
Pour chicken broth around the chicken and drizzle liquid smoke over it.
Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours until meat shreds easily with a fork.
Remove chicken from slow cooker and shred meat using two forks.
Discard skin and bones, then toss shredded meat with cooking liquid.
Serve warm with rice or as filling for sandwiches.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens on sale and freeze them
Use homemade broth made from previous chicken bones

recipes.name: Limu Seaweed Salad
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried seaweed in cold water for 10 minutes until tender, then drain.
Whisk together rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and red pepper flakes.
Combine seaweed, cucumber, and sesame seeds in a serving bowl.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to coat.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
cheapTips: Buy dried seaweed at Asian markets for less than specialty stores
Make large batches to eat throughout the week

recipes.name: Dungeness Crab Cioppino
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean and crack crab, setting aside meat and shell pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in white wine and simmer for 3 minutes to reduce slightly.
Add crushed tomatoes, broth, bay leaf, and red pepper flakes, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Add crab meat and shell pieces to the broth and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove bay leaf and stir in fresh parsley, then season with salt and pepper.
Ladle into bowls and serve with crusty bread for soaking up the broth.
cheapTips: Buy whole crabs at farmers markets when in season
Use canned crab meat if fresh is unavailable

recipes.name: Salmon en Papillote
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and lay out 2 large pieces of parchment paper.
Place a salmon fillet on each sheet and arrange 4 asparagus spears alongside.
Top each fillet with 1 tablespoon butter, half the dill, and lemon slices.
Pour 2 tablespoons white wine around each salmon fillet and season with salt and pepper.
Fold parchment paper in half lengthwise and crimp the edges tightly to seal.
Place packets on a baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Carefully open packets and transfer contents to serving plates, pouring cooking liquid over the top.
cheapTips: Buy salmon when on sale and freeze for later
Use frozen asparagus to cut costs

recipes.name: Geoduck Sashimi
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Keep geoduck on ice and clean the shell under cold running water.
Using a sharp knife, open the geoduck shell by cutting the adductor muscle.
Remove the meat and cut off the tough neck skin, then rinse thoroughly.
Slice the tender body meat very thinly against the grain using a sharp sashimi knife.
Arrange sliced geoduck on a chilled plate with wasabi and ginger.
Serve immediately with soy sauce in a small bowl and lemon wedges on the side for squeezing.
cheapTips: Purchase live geoduck directly from coastal seafood markets
Ask the fishmonger to clean and prepare it for you

recipes.name: Razor Clam Pasta
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions, then drain.
Clean razor clams under cold water and remove the tough neck skin if desired.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet and sauté garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add razor clams and white wine, then cover and cook for 3-4 minutes until clams open.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and red pepper flakes, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Discard any clams that did not open.
Toss cooked spaghetti with clam sauce and top with fresh parsley, salt, and pepper.
Serve immediately with extra sauce spooned over the top.
cheapTips: Buy razor clams in season at coastal fish markets for better prices
Substitute with littleneck clams if razor clams are unavailable

recipes.name: Wild Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a separate pot and keep at a gentle simmer.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet and sauté mushrooms with thyme until golden, about 8 minutes, then set aside.
In the same skillet, melt 1 tablespoon butter and sauté diced onion and garlic until softened.
Add arborio rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes to toast.
Pour white wine over rice and stir until mostly absorbed.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly and waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding the next, about 18-20 minutes total.
When rice is creamy and tender, stir in remaining 3 tablespoons butter, parmesan cheese, and cooked mushrooms.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve immediately in shallow bowls.
cheapTips: Use a mix of cremini and button mushrooms if wild mushrooms are expensive
Make broth from vegetable scraps or buy store-brand broth

recipes.name: Cedar Plank Salmon
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak cedar plank in water for at least 2 hours before cooking.
Preheat grill or oven to 400°F.
Place soaked plank directly on grill grates or in oven and heat for 5 minutes until it begins to smoke lightly.
Place salmon skin-side down on the hot plank and drizzle with olive oil.
Top salmon with minced garlic, fresh dill, and lemon slices, then season with salt and pepper.
Return plank to grill or oven and cook for 20-25 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork.
Carefully remove plank using heat-resistant gloves and transfer salmon to serving plates.
cheapTips: Reuse cedar planks by soaking and cleaning after each use
Buy salmon in bulk when on sale and freeze for later

recipes.name: Indian Pudding
recipes.description: New England dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and butter a 2-quart baking dish.
Heat 3 cups of milk in a saucepan until steam rises, then whisk in cornmeal slowly to avoid lumps.
Stir in molasses, butter, ginger, cinnamon, and salt, cooking for 2 minutes until combined.
Beat eggs in a bowl and temper them by slowly adding the hot milk mixture while whisking constantly.
Pour everything into the prepared baking dish and top with the remaining 1 cup cold milk without stirring.
Bake for 60-75 minutes until the top is browned and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes and serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.
cheapTips: Buy molasses in bulk at discount grocery stores
Use store-brand milk and eggs

recipes.name: Lobster Pie
recipes.description: New England dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and place pie crust in a 9-inch pie dish.
Melt butter in a saucepan and sauté diced onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over the onions and stir constantly for 1 minute to create a roux.
Gradually whisk in milk and white wine, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Stir in mustard, salt, pepper, and lobster meat, heating through for 2 minutes.
Pour the lobster filling into the pie crust and brush edges with beaten egg yolk.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until the crust is golden brown and filling bubbles at the edges.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen lobster meat when on sale instead of fresh
Use a store-bought frozen pie crust to save time and money

recipes.name: Roasted Turkey
recipes.description: New England dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and remove turkey from refrigerator 1 hour before cooking.
Pat turkey dry with paper towels and place breast-side up in a roasting pan.
Mix softened butter with chopped thyme and sage, then rub under and over the turkey skin.
Season inside and out with salt and pepper, then stuff cavity with lemon and onion halves.
