Pour broth into the bottom of the roasting pan and cover turkey loosely with foil.
Roast for approximately 13-15 minutes per pound, removing foil for the last 45 minutes to brown the skin.
Check for doneness when a thermometer in the thickest thigh reaches 165°F.
Rest turkey for 20 minutes before carving and serving.
cheapTips: Buy turkey after-holiday sales for deep discounts
Save bones for homemade stock

recipes.name: Maple Syrup Candy
recipes.description: New England snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Line a baking sheet with wax paper and place popsicle sticks on the paper spaced apart.
Pour maple syrup into a heavy-bottomed saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Clip a candy thermometer to the pan and allow syrup to reach 235°F (soft ball stage), about 15-20 minutes without stirring.
Remove from heat and stir in butter and salt until combined.
Spoon the hot syrup onto the wax paper in strips onto each popsicle stick.
Allow candies to cool completely until hardened, about 5 minutes.
Wrap each candy in wax paper and serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy maple syrup in bulk during fall harvest
Use popsicle sticks from craft stores instead of specialty candy suppliers

recipes.name: Crab Cakes
recipes.description: Louisiana Creole lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine crab meat, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, mayonnaise, egg, Old Bay, mustard, and Worcestershire in a bowl, mixing gently.
Form mixture into 4 patties about 3 inches wide and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Place remaining breadcrumbs in a shallow dish and coat each patty evenly.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry crab cakes for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and remoulade sauce or tartar sauce.
cheapTips: Buy crab meat on sale and freeze for later use
Use panko breadcrumbs for extra crunch at similar cost

recipes.name: Pralines
recipes.description: Louisiana Creole snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or wax paper.
Combine brown sugar, granulated sugar, butter, and evaporated milk in a heavy-bottomed saucepan.
Stir over medium heat until mixture reaches 238°F on a candy thermometer, about 10-12 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in pecans, vanilla, and salt until the mixture begins to thicken.
Working quickly, drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet.
Allow pralines to cool and harden at room temperature, about 20 minutes.
Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to one week.
cheapTips: Buy pecans in bulk from warehouse stores
Use evaporated milk from canned goods on sale

recipes.name: Turtle Soup
recipes.description: Louisiana Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown beef chunks on all sides, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onion, celery, and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to caramelize slightly.
Return beef to pot and add broth, bay leaves, thyme, and Worcestershire sauce.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 60-90 minutes until beef is tender.
Add sherry and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle soup into bowls and garnish with chopped hard-boiled eggs before serving.
cheapTips: Use beef broth instead of specialty turtle stock for authenticity and affordability
Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze until needed

recipes.name: Mirliton Gratin
recipes.description: Louisiana Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and cut mirlitons in half lengthwise, then boil in salted water for 20 minutes until tender.
Cool slightly and scoop out flesh with a spoon, leaving a thin shell, then chop the flesh into small pieces.
Melt butter in a skillet and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, about 3-4 minutes, then stir in mirliton flesh and cayenne.
Combine breadcrumbs and parmesan in a small bowl and mix in 2 tablespoons melted butter.
Spoon shrimp mixture into mirliton shells in a baking dish, drizzle with milk, and top with breadcrumb mixture.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and bubbling at the edges.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy shrimp on sale and freeze individually on a baking sheet
Substitute zucchini if mirlitons are unavailable

recipes.name: Bread Pudding with Whiskey Sauce
recipes.description: Louisiana Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and butter a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Place bread cubes in the baking dish and scatter raisins throughout.
Whisk together milk, eggs, melted butter, brown sugar, vanilla, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Pour custard mixture over bread, pressing gently so bread absorbs the liquid, then let sit 15 minutes.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until set and golden on top.
While pudding bakes, melt 2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan and stir in sugar.
Remove from heat, allow to cool slightly, then add whiskey carefully and stir.
Pour warm whiskey sauce over warm bread pudding before serving.
cheapTips: Use day-old French bread from the bakery section at discount
Buy inexpensive whiskey for cooking instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Bananas Foster
recipes.description: Louisiana Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add brown sugar and cinnamon, stirring until the sugar dissolves and mixture becomes bubbly, about 1 minute.
Add banana slices to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes per side until golden.
Carefully add rum to the pan (it may flame briefly) and gently shake the pan to incorporate.
Cook for 30 seconds more to allow alcohol to cook off and sauce to thicken.
Place a scoop of vanilla ice cream in each serving bowl.
Pour warm banana sauce and bananas over ice cream and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy bananas when slightly overripe on sale
Use cooking rum instead of premium dark rum

recipes.name: Andouille Sausage Gumbo
recipes.description: Louisiana Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the andouille sausage into 0.5-inch rounds and brown in a large pot over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, whisk together oil and flour over medium heat, stirring constantly for 10-12 minutes until the roux reaches a dark chocolate color.
Add diced onion, celery, and bell pepper to the roux and sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth slowly while stirring to avoid lumps, then add the browned sausage back to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add okra and diced tomatoes with juice, and simmer for another 15 minutes until okra is tender.
Season with salt and cayenne pepper to taste, then stir in file powder just before serving.
Serve hot over white rice.
cheapTips: Buy sausage on sale and freeze for later use
Okra is cheaper frozen and works just as well in gumbo

recipes.name: Poke
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut sushi-grade ahi tuna into 0.75-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, minced ginger, and minced garlic.
Pour the marinade over the tuna and gently toss to coat evenly.
Add red pepper flakes and sliced green onion, then fold gently to combine.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 10 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve over rice or with seaweed salad.
cheapTips: Buy ahi from Costco for better pricing on sushi-grade fish
Make poke bowls by adding rice and cheaper vegetable toppings

recipes.name: Poi
recipes.description: Hawaiian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and dice taro root into 2-inch chunks, removing the fibrous skin completely.
Place taro chunks in a large pot and cover with water.
Bring to a boil and cook for 20-25 minutes until taro is very soft and fork-tender.
Drain the taro, reserving 1 cup of the cooking water.
Mash the taro in a bowl using a potato masher, gradually adding reserved cooking water until reaching a smooth, pudding-like consistency.
Stir in salt to taste and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy taro root at Asian markets for cheaper prices than regular grocery stores
Make a larger batch and refrigerate for several days

recipes.name: Kalua Pork Tacos
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rub pork shoulder generously with sea salt, garlic powder, and black pepper on all sides.
Place pork in a slow cooker or large oven-safe pot and drizzle with liquid smoke.
Cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours in a slow cooker, or covered in a 300°F oven for 4-5 hours until meat shreds easily.
Remove pork from heat and shred with two forks, mixing in any pan drippings.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for about 1 minute per side.
Assemble tacos by placing shredded kalua pork on each tortilla, then top with shredded cabbage and green onion.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over each taco and serve with salsa on the side.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until needed
Use a slow cooker to save on energy costs and cook overnight

recipes.name: Ahi Poke
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut sushi-grade ahi tuna into 1-inch cubes and transfer to a glass bowl.
Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, sriracha, minced ginger, and minced garlic in a small bowl.
Pour marinade over tuna and gently fold to coat all pieces evenly.
Slice green onion and tear nori into small pieces, then add both to the poke.
Fold gently to combine all ingredients and refrigerate for 15-30 minutes.
Transfer poke to a serving bowl and sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Check Costco for sushi-grade ahi at lower prices than specialty fish markets
Make extra and store in an airtight container for up to 2 days

recipes.name: Opihi
recipes.description: Hawaiian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean opihi by rinsing under cold water and removing any debris with a brush.
Place opihi in a small pot with just enough water to cover them.
Bring to a boil and cook for 2-3 minutes until the meat releases easily from the shell.
Drain the opihi and remove the meat from each shell using a small fork.
Place opihi meat in a bowl and drizzle with lemon juice and white vinegar.
Season with sea salt and a pinch of chili powder, then serve immediately while still warm or chilled.
cheapTips: Buy frozen opihi at Asian markets if fresh are unavailable
Opihi is naturally low in fat and high in protein, making it a budget-friendly protein source

recipes.name: Loco Moco with Gravy
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions and set aside.
Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into small crumbles, about 5-7 minutes, then season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Form the cooked ground beef into two patties and set aside.
In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté diced onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over the onions and stir constantly for 1 minute to create a roux.
Slowly pour in beef broth while stirring to create a smooth gravy, then simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
In a separate skillet, fry the two eggs sunny-side up until the whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Divide rice between two bowls, place a beef patty on top of each, then top with a fried egg and generous amount of gravy.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for future loco moco meals
Make extra gravy and refrigerate for up to 3 days

recipes.name: Musubi
recipes.description: Hawaiian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook sushi rice according to package directions and set aside.
Slice spam into 8 thin slices and pan-fry in a skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until edges are slightly caramelized.
In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, sugar, and mirin together.
Brush the soy mixture over the fried spam slices.
Cut nori sheets in half to create strips approximately 2 inches wide and 7 inches long.
Place a musubi mold (or improvise with a small rectangular container) on a sheet of nori, then fill with a layer of rice, a spam slice, and another layer of rice.
Press down firmly and slide the musubi out onto a plate, then wrap the nori around the sides to hold it together.
Sprinkle sesame seeds on top and serve at room temperature or slightly warmed.
cheapTips: Spam is inexpensive and shelf-stable, making musubi a budget-friendly snack
Use a can or plastic container as a musubi mold instead of buying specialty equipment

recipes.name: Ono Wrapped in Ti Leaf
recipes.description: Hawaiian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch ti leaves in boiling water for 1 minute to soften, then drain and set aside.
Pat ono fillets dry with paper towels and season both sides with salt and white pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together coconut milk, minced garlic, minced ginger, and juice from one lemon.
Lay out two ti leaves in an overlapping pattern to create a large sheet.
Place an ono fillet in the center of the ti leaves and spoon the coconut milk mixture over the top.
Sprinkle with sliced green onion and fold the ti leaves up and around the fish, tucking the ends securely.
Repeat with remaining three fillets and ti leaf pairs.
Place wrapped fish bundles on a sheet of banana leaf or parchment paper and steam in a covered pot with 1 inch of water for 15-18 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Serve immediately in the unopened ti leaf wraps.
cheapTips: Buy ono fillets on sale and freeze until ready to cook
Ti leaves are reusable; rinse and store in the refrigerator for future cooking

recipes.name: Squid Luau
recipes.description: Hawaiian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean and slice squid into 0.5-inch rings, removing any remaining beak or hard portions.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch taro leaves for 2-3 minutes to remove bitterness, then drain and chop coarsely.
Heat butter in a large pot over medium-high heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.
Add squid rings and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly firmed.
Stir in minced ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk and chicken broth, then add the blanched taro leaves.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 25-30 minutes until squid is tender and flavors meld.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste and serve hot over white rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen squid, which is cheaper than fresh and works just as well
Taro leaves are usually inexpensive at Asian markets; buy extra to freeze

recipes.name: Marionberry Pie
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix 2.5 cups flour, 0.5 tsp salt, and 1 cup cold cubed butter with a pastry cutter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add ice water 1 tbsp at a time, mixing gently until dough just comes together, then divide in half, wrap, and chill for 30 minutes.
Combine 5 cups marionberries, 0.75 cup sugar, 2 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tbsp lemon juice in a bowl and let sit 15 minutes.
Roll out one dough portion, transfer to a 9-inch pie pan, and pour in berry filling.
Roll out remaining dough and place on top, seal edges, trim excess, and cut vents.
Beat 1 egg with 1 tbsp water and brush over the top crust.
Bake at 375°F for 50-60 minutes until crust is golden brown and filling bubbles at edges.
Cool completely on a wire rack for at least 2 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Buy marionberries in season (July-August) and freeze for year-round use.
Make pie crust from scratch instead of buying pre-made to save $2 per pie.

recipes.name: Spot Prawn Tempura
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat prawns dry and devein if needed, leaving tails intact.
Heat 3 cups vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep pot or fryer.
Whisk together 0.5 cup flour, 0.5 cup cornstarch, 1 egg, 0.75 cup ice water, and 0.25 tsp salt until smooth.
Working in batches, dip prawns in batter and fry for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy.
Transfer to paper towels and season immediately with salt.
Mix 0.25 cup soy sauce and 2 tbsp mirin in a small bowl for dipping sauce.
Serve tempura hot with lemon wedges and dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Use frozen spot prawns when fresh are unavailable and thaw before cooking.
Buy prawns at Asian markets often 20% cheaper than mainstream groceries.

recipes.name: Blackberry Cobbler
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and place 4 cups blackberries in a 9x13 baking dish, sprinkling with 0.25 cup sugar and 1 tsp lemon zest.
In a bowl, whisk together 1.5 cups flour, 1.5 tsp baking powder, 0.25 tsp salt, and 0.25 cup sugar.
Melt 6 tbsp butter and stir in 0.75 cup milk and 0.5 tsp vanilla until combined.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined, creating a thick batter.
Drop spoonfuls of batter over the blackberries, spreading gently and leaving some berries visible.
Sprinkle 3 tbsp brown sugar evenly over the batter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until the topping is golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes before serving warm, optionally with vanilla ice cream.
cheapTips: Use frozen blackberries year-round at half the cost of fresh.
Make large batch and freeze individual portions for weeks of dessert.

recipes.name: Coffee-Crusted Beef
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix 3 tbsp ground coffee, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1.5 tsp salt, 0.75 tsp pepper, and 0.5 tsp garlic powder in a small bowl.
Pat beef dry with paper towels and rub the coffee mixture evenly on all sides.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until just smoking.
Sear steak for 3-4 minutes per side until crust forms, then reduce heat to medium.
Add 2 tbsp butter and 2 rosemary sprigs, tilting pan and basting steak with foaming butter for 2 minutes.
Transfer steak to a cutting board and rest for 5 minutes while you pour 0.5 cup beef broth into the pan, scraping up browned bits.
Simmer pan sauce for 2 minutes, then pour over sliced steak and serve.
cheapTips: Use chuck roast instead of ribeye, seared then braised low and slow for half the cost.
Buy coffee grounds in bulk from costco and grind fresh for better flavor and savings.

recipes.name: Halibut and Chips
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut 1 lb potatoes into 0.5-inch thick fries and soak in cold water for 30 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Heat 4 cups oil to 325°F and fry potatoes in batches for 5-6 minutes until pale but not brown, then drain on paper towels.
Increase oil temperature to 350°F and prepare batter by whisking 0.75 cup flour, 0.75 tsp baking powder, 0.5 tsp salt, and 0.25 tsp white pepper, then stirring in 0.75 cup cold beer until smooth.
Season 10 oz halibut with 0.5 tsp salt, coat in batter, and fry for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy.
Briefly fry potatoes again in batches at 375°F for 1-2 minutes until golden, then drain on paper towels and season with salt.
Serve hot fish and chips with lemon wedges and tartar sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Use cod or pollock instead of halibut for 40% cost savings with similar texture.
Make tartar sauce at home with mayo, pickle relish, and lemon for $1 vs $3 store-bought.

recipes.name: Nettle Soup
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wearing gloves, rinse nettles thoroughly and roughly chop, discarding thick stems.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add 1 diced medium potato and 4 cups vegetable broth, bringing to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes until potato is tender.
Stir in 3 cups chopped nettles and simmer for 2 minutes until wilted and bright green.
Blend soup using an immersion blender or transfer to a blender in batches until smooth.
Stir in 0.5 cup heavy cream, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.25 tsp pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg, heating through without boiling.
Ladle into bowls and top each with a dollop of sour cream and a crack of black pepper.
cheapTips: Forage young nettles in spring from public lands free, wearing gloves to avoid stings.
Substitute spinach or kale if nettles unavailable for same result at similar cost.

recipes.name: Roasted Beet Salad with Goat Cheese
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and wrap whole beets in foil, roasting for 35-40 minutes until tender when pierced.
Cool beets, then peel under running water using your fingers or a paper towel, and cut into wedges.
Toast 0.5 cup walnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3-4 minutes until fragrant, then set aside to cool.
Whisk together 3 tbsp olive oil, 1.5 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 0.5 tsp mustard, 0.5 tsp salt, and 0.25 tsp pepper in a small bowl.
Toss 4 cups mixed greens with half the vinaigrette and divide among serving plates.
Arrange beet wedges and sliced red onion on top of greens.
Crumble 4 oz goat cheese and scatter over each salad with walnuts, then drizzle remaining vinaigrette.
cheapTips: Buy beets at farmers markets in fall when 70% cheaper than year-round grocery store prices.
Use crumbled feta instead of goat cheese for more affordable tangy cheese option.

recipes.name: Elk Steak
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove elk steaks from refrigerator 20 minutes before cooking and pat dry with paper towels.
Season both sides generously with 0.75 tsp salt and 0.5 tsp black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Sear elk steaks for 3 minutes per side for medium-rare, then transfer to a warm plate.
Reduce heat to medium, add 3 tbsp butter, minced shallot, 2 minced garlic cloves, and 3 thyme sprigs, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Pour in 0.25 cup red wine and 0.25 cup beef broth, scraping up browned bits and simmering for 2 minutes.
Return steaks to pan for 30 seconds to coat in sauce, then plate steaks and drizzle pan sauce over top.
cheapTips: Buy elk steaks during hunting season (fall/winter) when prices drop 30%.
Substitute beef sirloin if elk unavailable and cook same method for similar results.

recipes.name: Butter-Poached Lobster
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut lobster tails in half lengthwise, removing the digestive vein and keeping the shell intact.
In a heavy-bottomed pot, melt 1 cup butter over low heat, then add 2 minced garlic cloves, 0.5 minced shallot, and thyme sprigs, stirring gently for 2 minutes without browning.
Add 0.25 cup white wine and bring to a gentle simmer, then reduce heat to the lowest setting to maintain 160-170°F.
Submerge lobster tails meat-side down in the butter bath, adding 1 tsp salt and 0.25 tsp pepper.
Poach gently for 12-15 minutes until meat is opaque and reaches 140°F, basting occasionally.
Remove lobster from butter with a slotted spoon and arrange on serving plates with shells up.
Strain butter through cheesecloth into a serving bowl, season with fleur de sel, and serve alongside lobster with fresh lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy lobster tails on sale or slightly past date, use immediately for 20-30% savings.
Make clarified butter at home instead of using whole butter to improve poaching results cheaply.

recipes.name: Almond Roca
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set near your cooking area.
Combine 0.75 cup butter, 1 cup sugar, and 1 tbsp water in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Stop stirring, clip a candy thermometer to the pan, and cook until mixture reaches 300°F (hard-crack stage), about 8-10 minutes, swirling occasionally.
Remove from heat and immediately stir in 1 cup whole almonds and 0.25 tsp salt, then pour onto prepared baking sheet and spread thin.
Chop 8 oz semi-sweet chocolate and melt in a microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until smooth.
Spread melted chocolate evenly over cooled toffee, then sprinkle 0.5 cup sliced almonds and 2 tbsp cocoa powder over top, pressing gently.
Let set at room temperature for 30 minutes, then break into pieces and store in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Make large batches and gift portions as holiday presents to replace expensive store candy.
Buy chocolate and almonds in bulk at costco for 40% savings on ingredients.

recipes.name: Sockeye Salmon Burger
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove skin and any bones from salmon, then finely chop or pulse in food processor until mixture resembles coarse meal.
In a bowl, combine salmon with panko, egg, mustard, lemon juice, dill, salt, and pepper until just combined.
Form mixture into 4 patties about 3/4-inch thick and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Toast buns lightly in the same skillet or toaster oven.
Assemble burgers with your choice of toppings such as lettuce, tomato, and aioli.
cheapTips: Buy salmon on sale and freeze it for later use
Skip specialty sauces and use standard mustard and mayo instead

recipes.name: Chanterelle Mushroom Tart
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thaw puff pastry according to package directions and preheat oven to 400°F.
Clean mushrooms with a damp cloth and slice them into bite-sized pieces.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté shallots and garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add mushrooms and thyme, cooking for 5-7 minutes until liquid releases and evaporates, then stir in cream and cheese.
Season with salt and pepper and simmer for 2 minutes until slightly thickened.
Place puff pastry on a baking sheet and spread mushroom mixture evenly, leaving a half-inch border.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until pastry is golden brown and puffed.
Cool for 2 minutes, slice into portions, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use regular button mushrooms instead of chanterelles for significant savings
Buy store-brand puff pastry instead of name brands

recipes.name: Apple Fritter
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon in a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat egg and mix with milk.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed, then gently fold in diced apples.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or Dutch oven.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove fritters with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Dust warm fritters with powdered sugar and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make your own powdered sugar by blending granulated sugar with cornstarch
Use whatever apples are on sale at your grocery store

recipes.name: Miso-Glazed Black Cod
recipes.description: Pacific Northwest dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together miso, mirin, sake, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic in a small bowl.
Pat black cod fillets dry with paper towels and place skin-side down on a lined baking sheet.
Spread miso glaze evenly over each fillet and let marinate for 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°F and bake fillets for 12-14 minutes until flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
Transfer to serving plates and garnish with green onion and sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed rice and seasonal vegetables.
cheapTips: Substitute sablefish or halibut if black cod is unavailable
Make a larger batch of miso glaze and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Bacalhau à Brás
recipes.description: Portuguese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod in cold water for 24 hours, changing water several times until desalted.
Remove skin and bones from cod and shred meat into small, thin strands.
Cut potatoes into thin matchsticks and soak in water for 10 minutes, then drain and pat very dry.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan and fry potatoes in batches for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy, then drain on paper towels.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil and sauté onion and garlic until softened and lightly golden.
Add shredded cod and cook for 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Combine cod mixture with fried potatoes and olives in a large bowl, then season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy salt cod in bulk sections at Portuguese markets for better pricing
Reuse frying oil for multiple batches to reduce cooking costs

recipes.name: Francesinha
recipes.description: Portuguese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Layer each of 4 bread slices with ham, roast beef, turkey, and cheese.
Top each with another bread slice to form a sandwich and press gently.
Whisk together eggs and milk in a shallow dish.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat and dip sandwiches in egg mixture, coating both sides.
Fry sandwiches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese begins to melt.
In a saucepan, heat beer and beef broth together for 3 minutes.
Pour warm sauce over sandwiches on serving plates.
Serve immediately while hot and saucy.
cheapTips: Use store-brand deli meats instead of premium brands
Substitute cheaper cuts of roast beef for a more budget-friendly version

recipes.name: Arroz de Marisco
recipes.description: Portuguese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat fish stock in a separate pot and keep at a gentle simmer throughout cooking.
Heat olive oil in a wide paella pan or large skillet over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add rice and toast for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour in white wine and let it reduce by half, then add bay leaves.
Begin adding warm stock one cup at a time, stirring occasionally and waiting for liquid to absorb before adding more.
After 15 minutes of cooking, nestle clams and mussels into rice, then add shrimp.
Continue cooking for 8-10 minutes until rice is tender, shellfish opens, and shrimp turns pink.
Discard any unopened shells, remove bay leaves, and garnish generously with fresh parsley before serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp instead of fresh to reduce costs significantly
Use bottled clam juice mixed with chicken broth instead of fish stock

recipes.name: Sardinas Assadas
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat grill or grill pan to high heat.
Rinse sardines and pat dry, then use scissors to remove guts through the belly.
Combine olive oil, garlic, parsley, kosher salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes in a small bowl.
Place sardines on a grill grate that has been oiled and lightly brushed with the oil mixture.
Grill for 3-4 minutes per side until skin chars slightly and flesh is cooked through.
Transfer sardines to a serving platter and drizzle with remaining oil mixture.
Sprinkle with sea salt and serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges and crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy sardines in bulk when on sale and freeze for later
Cook sardines in a cast iron skillet on the stovetop if no grill is available

recipes.name: Alheira
recipes.description: Portuguese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine bread pieces and chicken broth in a large bowl and let soak for 10 minutes until bread is very soft.
In a skillet, cook sausage and turkey over medium heat for 5 minutes, then add onion and garlic and cook for 3 more minutes.
Add the cooked meat mixture to the soaked bread along with parsley and salt, mixing well.
Cool mixture to room temperature, then fold in beaten eggs.
With wet hands, form mixture into 12 log-shaped patties about 3 inches long.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet and carefully fry alheiras in batches for 4-5 minutes until golden brown all over.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with crusty bread and mustard.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze uncooked alheiras for quick future meals
Substitute chicken sausage for Portuguese sausage if unavailable

recipes.name: Arroz de Pato
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat duck legs dry and season with salt and pepper, then heat olive oil in a wide pot or paella pan over medium-high heat.
Brown duck legs on both sides for 5-7 minutes total, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onion and garlic for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Deglaze with red wine and let it reduce by half, then add bay leaves and return duck to pot.
Pour in broth and bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 30-35 minutes until rice is tender and duck is very tender.
Stir in olives, remove bay leaves, and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Garnish generously with fresh parsley and serve directly from the pot.
cheapTips: Buy duck legs on sale and freeze them for future meals
Use store-brand broth instead of premium brands to save money

recipes.name: Bacalhau à Gomes de Sá
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak the salt cod in cold water for 24 hours, changing water every 8 hours to desalt.
Boil the desalted cod for 15 minutes until flaky, then flake into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Cut potatoes into thin matchsticks and fry in olive oil until golden and crispy, then drain on paper towels.
Slice onions thinly and sauté in olive oil with minced garlic until softened.
Combine the flaked cod, fried potatoes, sautéed onions, and olives in a large bowl.
Dress with remaining olive oil, fresh parsley, salt, and pepper, then toss gently.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with sliced hard-boiled eggs and extra parsley.
cheapTips: Buy salt cod from ethnic markets, much cheaper than regular grocery stores.
Use regular potatoes instead of frying—boil and mash for savings.

recipes.name: Cataplana de Marisco
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a cataplana or large covered skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant, then add tomato paste and stir.
Add clams, mussels, and squid pieces, then pour in white wine.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally.
Add shrimp, re-cover, and cook for 3-4 minutes until shrimp are pink and shells have opened.
Discard any unopened shellfish, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve directly from the cataplana or transfer to a large bowl, garnished with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy seafood on sale and freeze; use frozen shrimp and squid.
Skip wine and use chicken broth mixed with white vinegar.

recipes.name: Pastéis de Bacalhau
recipes.description: Portuguese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod in cold water for 24 hours, changing water every 8 hours.
Boil desalted cod for 10 minutes until tender, then flake finely and set aside.
Boil potatoes until soft, peel, and mash until smooth.
Combine mashed potatoes with flaked cod, minced onion, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Form mixture into oval patties roughly 3 inches long and 1 inch thick.
Beat eggs in a bowl, then coat each patty with flour, dip in egg, and coat with flour again.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry patties 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown, then drain on paper towels.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze unbaked patties for quick snacks later.
Use all-purpose flour breading instead of double-coating to save flour.

recipes.name: Arroz de Polvo
recipes.description: Portuguese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil octopus in salted water for 45 minutes until tender, then drain and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onions and garlic until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add the cooked octopus pieces.
Pour in white wine and cook for 2 minutes to reduce slightly.
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes to toast lightly, then add chicken broth and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender.
Remove from heat, stir in parsley, season with salt and pepper, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy frozen octopus instead of fresh—it's cheaper and already tenderized.
Replace half the chicken broth with octopus cooking water for extra flavor at no cost.

recipes.name: Caldo de Carne
recipes.description: Portuguese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim fat from beef chuck and cut into large chunks, then place in a large pot with cold beef broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes, skimming any foam that rises.
Add chopped onions, carrots, celery, and bay leaves, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and chopped cabbage, then simmer for 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then stir in fresh parsley.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot with crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Use beef neck bones or shanks instead of chuck—much cheaper and equally flavorful.
Add rice or barley to make it more filling and stretch the meat further.

recipes.name: Espetada
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef sirloin into 1.5-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Combine olive oil, vinegar, minced garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns in a bowl to make marinade.
Pour marinade over beef, toss to coat, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread marinated beef cubes onto metal skewers, alternating with bay leaves from the marinade.
Heat a grill or grill pan to high heat and cook skewers 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Remove from heat, season with salt, and let rest for 2 minutes.
Serve hot on the skewers, garnished with fresh parsley and with crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Buy sirloin tips or chuck when on sale and freeze until needed.
Skip the marinade and simply season with salt, garlic, and olive oil right before grilling.

recipes.name: Peixada à Transmontana
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod for 24 hours changing water every 8 hours, then boil for 15 minutes until tender and flake.
Peel and cube potatoes, then boil in salted water for 15 minutes until half-cooked and drain.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté sliced onions and minced garlic until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add white wine and bay leaf.
Add the flaked salt cod and half-cooked potatoes, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add fresh fish fillets and simmer gently for 8-10 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve in deep bowls.
cheapTips: Use frozen fish fillets instead of fresh—same taste and cheaper.
Buy salt cod from ethnic markets where prices are lower.

recipes.name: Migas à Alentejana
recipes.description: Portuguese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut day-old bread into bite-sized cubes and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add minced garlic, sautéing until fragrant.
Add water or broth to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Add bread cubes and stir constantly for 5-7 minutes until bread absorbs liquid and becomes creamy.
Season with salt and pepper, then push migas to the sides of the pan.
Crack eggs into the center of the pan and cook until whites set but yolks remain runny.
Serve migas with fried eggs on top, garnished with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Use leftover bread instead of buying new—perfect way to use stale bread.
Skip the cilantro and use parsley from the garden or frozen.

recipes.name: Açorda de Marisco
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring fish broth and white wine to a boil in a large pot, then add shrimp and mussels.
Cook for 4-5 minutes until shrimp are pink and mussels open, then remove seafood and strain broth.
Cut day-old bread into cubes and heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat.
Add minced garlic to oil and sauté for 1 minute, then add bread cubes and toss until coated.
Pour the strained broth over the bread mixture and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper, then crack eggs directly into the pot and stir gently until cooked.
Return shrimp and mussels to the pot, stir in cilantro, and serve in deep bowls.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and mussels instead of fresh to save significantly.
Use homemade seafood broth made from fish heads and bones.

recipes.name: Pato no Vinho d'Alhos
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine red wine, vinegar, garlic cloves, bay leaves, and peppercorns in a bowl to make marinade.
Place duck parts in a large container, pour marinade over, cover, and refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours.
Remove duck from marinade, pat dry, and reserve marinade separately.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown duck pieces on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Pour the reserved marinade over the duck, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Peel and quarter potatoes, add to the pot with the duck, and continue simmering for 25 minutes until tender.
Season with salt, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve hot with the rich sauce spooned over.
cheapTips: Buy duck legs and thighs instead of whole bird—cheaper and better for braising.
Use red wine vinegar and water instead of expensive wine.

recipes.name: Tripe à Moda do Porto
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the tripe thoroughly under cold running water and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Soak dried beans in water for 8 hours or overnight, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and garlic until softened.
Add tripe and beef chuck pieces, browning them on all sides for 10 minutes.
Pour in white wine to deglaze the pot, then add broth, beans, carrots, and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 2.5 hours until tripe is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy tripe from ethnic butchers where it's cheaper than regular supermarkets.
Dried beans cost pennies compared to canned alternatives.

recipes.name: Broa de Milho
recipes.description: Portuguese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix cornmeal, all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, and salt in a large bowl.
Slowly pour boiling water while stirring constantly to form a thick dough.
Add olive oil and stir until fully incorporated.
Form dough into a round loaf on the prepared baking sheet.
Score the top with a knife in a cross pattern.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal and flour in bulk from discount grocery stores.
This bread stays fresh for several days, reducing daily breakfast costs.

recipes.name: Pastéis de Queijo
recipes.description: Portuguese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then cut in cold butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add egg yolk and enough cold water to form a ball of dough, then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Combine ricotta, egg, and nutmeg in a bowl for the filling.
Roll out dough thinly and cut into 3-inch squares.
Place a small spoonful of cheese filling on each square.
Fold dough diagonally and press edges with a fork to seal.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry pastries 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use store-brand butter and ricotta to cut ingredient costs.
Fry in batches to minimize oil usage.

recipes.name: Gravlax
recipes.description: Scandinavian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat salmon dry with paper towels and place skin-side down on a sheet of plastic wrap.
Mix salt, sugar, peppercorns, and lemon zest in a small bowl.
Spread half the salt mixture on the salmon flesh, then cover with fresh dill.
Spread remaining salt mixture over the dill.
Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and place on a plate.
Refrigerate for 24-48 hours, turning once halfway through and pressing gently.
Unwrap, rinse lightly, pat dry, and slice thinly on an angle before serving.
cheapTips: Buy salmon when on sale and freeze until ready to cure.
One batch makes 8+ servings when sliced thinly.

recipes.name: Frikadeller
recipes.description: Danish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince onion finely and soak breadcrumbs in milk for 5 minutes.
Mix ground pork, soaked breadcrumbs, minced onion, egg, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Form mixture into 12-16 oblong patties about 2 inches long.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry patties 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove patties and set aside, then add broth to the pan to deglaze.
Simmer for 2 minutes and return patties to coat with pan sauce, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Ground pork is usually cheaper than beef at most supermarkets.
Make extra and freeze uncooked patties for quick future meals.

recipes.name: Köttbullar
recipes.description: Swedish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince onion very finely and mix with ground beef, ground pork, egg, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper.
Roll mixture into 1.5-inch balls.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown meatballs in batches, about 10 minutes total.
Remove meatballs and set aside, then add broth to the pan, stirring to loosen browned bits.
Stir in heavy cream and lingonberry jam until smooth.
Return meatballs to the pan and simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve over egg noodles or mashed potatoes.
cheapTips: Substitute heavy cream with evaporated milk to save 30% on sauce cost.
Use regular jam if lingonberry jam is unavailable or expensive.

recipes.name: Janssons frestelse
recipes.description: Swedish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Peel potatoes and cut into thin matchstick pieces about 2 inches long.
Slice onions thinly and chop anchovies into small pieces.
Layer half the potatoes in the baking dish, then half the onions and anchovies.
Repeat with remaining potatoes, onions, and anchovies.
Pour heavy cream over the layers and season with salt and pepper.
Mix breadcrumbs with melted butter and sprinkle on top.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until potatoes are tender and top is golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes and onions in bulk bags for significant savings.
Tinned anchovies are cheaper than fresh and have a longer shelf life.

recipes.name: Lutfisk
recipes.description: Scandinavian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring salted water to a gentle boil in a large pot.
Cut prepared lutfisk into serving-sized pieces and place in a poaching basket or cheesecloth.
Submerge in boiling water and simmer for 8-10 minutes until fish is tender and flakes easily.
Carefully remove fish and arrange on a serving platter.
Melt butter in a saucepan and whisk in flour to create a roux.
Gradually stir in cream while whisking until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Season sauce with salt, white pepper, and mustard, then pour over fish and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Pre-processed lutfisk is convenient; dry lutfisk requires 5-6 days of preparation.
Look for sales on frozen fish during December holiday season.

recipes.name: Meatballs in cream sauce
recipes.description: Swedish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely mince onion and mix with ground beef, egg, milk, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper.
Roll mixture into 1-inch balls.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown meatballs in batches, about 8 minutes total.
Pour beef broth into the pan and simmer meatballs for 8 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and stir in sour cream until fully incorporated.
Simmer for 3 minutes without boiling, stirring gently.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve over egg noodles or potatoes.
cheapTips: Use plain yogurt instead of sour cream to save money and add protein.
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze until needed.

recipes.name: Pöltö
recipes.description: Finnish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef chuck into 1.5-inch cubes and pat dry with paper towels.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches, about 8 minutes total.
Add broth, bay leaves, juniper berries, and allspice berries to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Cut potatoes into chunks and carrots into 1-inch pieces.
Add vegetables and pearl onions to the pot and simmer for another 30 minutes until everything is tender.
Remove bay leaves, season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve in bowls.
cheapTips: Substitute pearl onions with regular onion quarters to reduce cost by 50%.
Buy beef chuck roast on sale and freeze for later use.

recipes.name: Karelian pasty
recipes.description: Finnish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then add water and melted butter to form a soft dough, kneading until smooth.
Roll dough thin between two sheets of parchment paper, then cut into 3-inch circles.
Combine cooked rice, milk, egg, and black pepper to make the filling.
Place 1 tablespoon of filling on each dough circle, then fold in half and seal edges by crimping with a fork.
Place pastries on a buttered baking sheet and bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
Serve hot with butter and a thin egg-butter spread on the side.
cheapTips: Rice and flour are inexpensive staples
Make filling ahead of time to reduce prep

recipes.name: Rømmegrøt
recipes.description: Norwegian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat sour cream in a large pot over medium heat, stirring occasionally until it begins to separate.
In a separate bowl, mix flour with a little cold milk to make a smooth paste.
Slowly whisk the flour paste into the hot sour cream, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Add remaining milk, butter, salt, pepper, and cinnamon, stirring until the mixture reaches a thick porridge consistency.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring frequently until the sauce rises to the top.
Divide into bowls and top each serving with jam.
cheapTips: Buy sour cream on sale and stock the freezer
Use store-brand jam to reduce cost

recipes.name: Rakfisk
recipes.description: Norwegian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix salt, sugar, peppercorns, bay leaves, and dill in a bowl.
Place fish fillets skin-side down in a shallow glass dish and rub the salt mixture evenly over both sides.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 24-48 hours, turning halfway through.
Remove fish from brine and rinse briefly under cold water, patting dry with paper towels.
Slice fish thinly on the bias and arrange on a platter with lemon slices.
Serve chilled with dark rye bread, mustard, and pickled onions.
cheapTips: Buy fish on sale and cure immediately
Buy whole fish and fillet yourself to save money

recipes.name: Raspeballer
recipes.description: Norwegian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and grate potatoes into a bowl, then squeeze out excess moisture using a clean kitchen towel.
Brown ground pork with diced onion in a large pot until cooked through, then season with salt and pepper.
Mix grated potatoes with flour in a separate bowl to coat evenly.
Form potato mixture into balls around small portions of the cooked pork mixture, making 12-16 balls.
Bring beef broth to a boil and carefully drop in the potato balls, then reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes until they float.
Serve hot in bowls with broth, butter, and lingonberry jam on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze
Make ahead and reheat for weeknight dinners

recipes.name: Flødeboller
recipes.description: Danish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fold whipped cream and vanilla into sweetened condensed milk until well combined.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and use an ice cream scoop to drop 12 mounds onto it.
Freeze for at least 30 minutes until firm.
Melt chocolate chips with coconut oil in a microwave-safe bowl in 30-second intervals, stirring between.
Melt butter and mix with graham cracker crumbs to make a coating.
Roll each frozen mound in the crumb mixture, then immediately dip into melted chocolate, holding by a fork.
Place on parchment and freeze for 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chocolate chips in bulk
Use store-brand condensed milk

recipes.name: Krumkake
recipes.description: Norwegian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Beat eggs and sugar together until pale and creamy, then stir in melted butter and vanilla.
In a separate bowl, mix flour with cardamom, then fold into the egg mixture.
Heat a krumkake iron (waffle-style) over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Drop 1 tablespoon batter onto the iron, close, and cook 1-2 minutes until golden, flipping halfway through.
Immediately roll the hot cookie around a cone-shaped form or into a cylinder while still warm and flexible.
Cool on a wire rack and repeat with remaining batter.
Mix whipped cream with powdered sugar and pipe into each cooled cookie just before serving.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk
Make filling just before serving to save whipped cream

recipes.name: Lussekatt
recipes.description: Swedish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk to 110°F, then dissolve yeast and let sit for 5 minutes.
Steep saffron threads in the warm milk and yeast mixture for 10 minutes.
Mix in butter, sugar, and salt, then gradually add flour until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, then fold in raisins.
Let dough rise in an oiled bowl covered with a towel for 1 hour until doubled.
Divide dough into 12 pieces, roll each into a rope, and coil into an S-shape on a baking sheet.
Let rise for 30 minutes, brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with pearl sugar, and bake at 375°F for 12-15 minutes until golden.
cheapTips: Buy saffron on sale or use a small amount
Make dough night before and refrigerate

recipes.name: Dill pickle herring
recipes.description: Scandinavian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain herring fillets and rinse thoroughly under cold running water.
Cut herring into bite-sized pieces and layer in a clean glass jar with sliced onions.
Combine vinegar, water, sugar, pickling spices, dill seeds, and fresh dill in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Pour the hot pickling liquid over the herring and onions, then cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or up to 2 weeks before serving.
Serve chilled on rye bread with fresh dill and sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy herring in bulk on sale
Use basic white vinegar instead of specialty types

recipes.name: Fårikål
recipes.description: Norwegian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into chunks and season with salt and pepper.
Layer lamb chops, sliced onions, and potato chunks alternately in a large heavy pot.
Add bay leaves and remaining salt and pepper between the layers.
Pour broth over all ingredients until just covered.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer gently for 1.5 hours until lamb is very tender.
Skim fat from surface if desired, then garnish with fresh parsley and serve directly from the pot.
cheapTips: Buy lamb when on sale and freeze
Use lower-cost lamb neck instead of shoulder

recipes.name: Aebleskiver
recipes.description: Danish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Beat eggs and mix with buttermilk and melted butter, then stir into dry ingredients until combined.
Heat an aebleskiver pan (special mold with ball-shaped cups) and lightly butter each cavity.
Fill each cup halfway with batter, then add 1 teaspoon of jam, then cover with more batter.
Cook over medium heat for 3-4 minutes on each side, rotating with a skewer or fork to achieve round shape.
Transfer to a plate and dust with powdered sugar while still warm.
Serve immediately with jam or lemon curd for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk
Use inexpensive jam from sales

recipes.name: Sild på lørdag
recipes.description: Danish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the red onion thinly and cut the apple into matchsticks.
Mix sour cream with diced herring, capers, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Fold in the dill and gently combine with onion and apple.
Butter the rye bread slices and top each with a generous portion of the herring mixture.
Arrange on a platter and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand pickled herring in bulk from discount grocers
Use regular bread if rye is unavailable

recipes.name: Reindeer stew
recipes.description: Scandinavian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into 2-inch cubes and coat with seasoned flour.
Heat oil in a large pot and brown the meat on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add diced onion and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Pour in wine and broth, then add crushed juniper berries and bay leaves.
Simmer covered for 60 minutes until meat is tender.
Add chopped carrots and potatoes, then simmer for another 30 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and season with salt and pepper.
Simmer for 5 minutes and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use beef as a readily available substitute for reindeer
Buy potatoes and carrots from bulk bins to save 30%

recipes.name: Cinnamon bun
recipes.description: Swedish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk with 2 tbsp butter until warm (110°F), then add yeast and sugar; let sit 5 minutes.
Mix in egg, salt, and flour until a soft dough forms; knead for 8 minutes by hand.
Let dough rise in an oiled bowl for 1 hour until doubled.
Roll dough into a 12x8 inch rectangle and spread with softened butter.
Mix cinnamon and brown sugar together, then sprinkle evenly over dough.
Roll tightly from the long side and cut into 8 equal pieces.
Place on a buttered baking sheet, cover, and let rise 45 minutes.
Brush with egg wash, sprinkle pearl sugar, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until golden.
cheapTips: Skip pearl sugar and use regular granulated sugar on top
Buy yeast in bulk and store in freezer for longer shelf life

recipes.name: Moules-Frites
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for 30 minutes.
Clean mussels under cold running water, removing beards and discarding any open shells.
Heat butter in a large pot and sauté minced garlic and shallot for 2 minutes.
Add wine and bay leaf, then bring to a boil and add mussels.
Cover and cook for 5-7 minutes, shaking occasionally, until shells open; discard any closed ones.
Meanwhile, heat oil to 350°F and fry drained potatoes in batches until golden, 3-4 minutes.
Drain fries on paper towels and season with salt.
Divide mussels and broth between two bowls, garnish with parsley, and serve with fries and mayo or aioli.
cheapTips: Buy mussels on sale or at fish counter late in the day
Make mayo at home instead of buying a jar

recipes.name: Carbonnade Flamande
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into 2-inch cubes and coat with seasoned flour.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven and brown meat on all sides, about 10 minutes; remove and set aside.
Sauté sliced onions until caramelized, about 15 minutes, then add minced garlic.
Stir in tomato paste, brown sugar, and cook for 2 minutes.
Deglaze with beer, scraping up browned bits, then add broth, bay leaves, thyme, and meat.
Cover and braise in a 325°F oven for 2 hours until beef is fork-tender.
Remove from oven, discard bay leaves, and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with crusty bread or boiled potatoes.
cheapTips: Use store-brand dark beer instead of premium Belgian ale
Buy chuck roast on sale and freeze until needed

recipes.name: Waterzooi
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into 1.5-inch pieces and chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Bring broth to a boil in a large pot and add chicken pieces, then reduce heat and simmer.
Add carrots, celery, leek, parsnips, and onion; simmer for 40 minutes until chicken and vegetables are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together egg yolks and cream.
Remove pot from heat slightly and slowly temper the egg mixture by adding a ladle of hot broth while whisking.
Pour the egg mixture back into the pot while whisking constantly.
Stir in butter and season generously with salt and pepper.
Return to low heat for 2 minutes, stirring gently, then serve in shallow bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use store-brand chicken broth instead of homemade
Buy chicken on sale and parsnips from the root vegetable bin for savings

recipes.name: Stoemp
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube potatoes and carrots into equal-sized pieces.
Boil potatoes and carrots together in salted water for 20 minutes until very tender.
While vegetables cook, finely dice onion and sauté in butter until golden.
Drain the cooked vegetables and return to the pot.
Add milk, butter, and the sautéed onion mixture to the pot.
Mash vigorously with a potato masher until fluffy, leaving small chunks if desired.
Season generously with salt and pepper, stir in parsley, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in 5-lb bags at bulk prices
Use carrots nearing the end of shelf life for deep discount

recipes.name: Croquettes aux Crevettes
recipes.description: Belgian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make a béchamel sauce by melting butter, whisking in flour, and gradually adding milk while stirring until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Chop shrimp into small pieces and fold into the béchamel with nutmeg, salt, and pepper; let cool to room temperature.
Fold in egg yolks and transfer mixture to a piping bag; refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Pipe 3-inch logs onto parchment paper and freeze for 30 minutes.
Set up three bowls with beaten egg, flour, and bread crumbs for breading.
Coat each frozen croquette in flour, then egg, then bread crumbs.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry croquettes in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with lemon wedges and tartar sauce.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp on sale and thaw before preparing
Make your own bread crumbs from stale bread

recipes.name: Pâté de Foie Gras Belge
recipes.description: Belgian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Sauté finely diced shallots in 2 tbsp butter until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add chicken livers and cook until just cooked through but still pink inside, about 6 minutes.
Deglaze with cognac and let simmer for 2 minutes.
Transfer liver mixture to a food processor and blend until smooth.
Add softened butter, thyme, salt, and pepper; pulse until creamy.
Fold in heavy cream and egg yolk by hand.
Pour into a terrine or loaf pan lined with plastic wrap and smooth the top.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight before unmolding and serving with bread.
cheapTips: Substitute chicken liver for expensive foie gras
Buy liver from butcher counter for fresh, affordable product

recipes.name: Gaufres Liégeoises
recipes.description: Belgian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk to 110°F and stir in yeast with a pinch of sugar; let sit 5 minutes.
Cream together butter and both sugars until fluffy, then beat in eggs.
Fold in yeast mixture, then gently combine flour and salt into the wet ingredients.
Let batter rest for 30 minutes covered in a warm place.
Fold pearl sugar into batter gently.
Preheat a Belgian waffle iron and lightly butter the plates.
Pour batter into the iron and cook until golden, about 4-5 minutes, repeating until batter is used.
Serve hot with whipped cream, chocolate sauce, or jam.
cheapTips: Buy pearl sugar online in bulk for big savings versus specialty shops
Use regular granulated sugar if pearl sugar is unavailable

recipes.name: Gaufres Bruxelloises
recipes.description: Belgian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat your waffle iron and brush lightly with butter.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat eggs with sugar until pale, then add melted butter and vanilla.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed, then stir in milk to reach batter consistency.
Pour batter into the hot waffle iron and cook until golden brown and crispy, about 4-5 minutes.
Transfer cooked waffles to a wire rack to cool slightly.
Dust generously with powdered sugar and serve warm with jam or chocolate sauce.
cheapTips: Use store-brand flour and eggs to reduce costs
Powdered sugar lasts longer than jam toppings

recipes.name: Chicorée au Gratin
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and boil endive heads in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain well.
Wrap each endive head with one ham slice and arrange in a buttered baking dish.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat, whisk in flour to make a roux, and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add milk while whisking constantly to avoid lumps, then season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Simmer sauce for 5 minutes until thickened, then stir in three-quarters of the cheese.
Pour sauce over the endive and ham rolls, sprinkle remaining cheese on top, and bake for 20 minutes until bubbly and golden.
Let cool for 2 minutes before serving hot.
cheapTips: Buy ham on sale and freeze for later use
Use cheddar instead of gruyere to save 30%

recipes.name: Oeufs à la Neige
recipes.description: Belgian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Separate eggs, reserving yolks for custard and placing whites in a clean bowl.
Heat milk with vanilla in a large saucepan until small bubbles form around the edges.
Beat egg whites with 0.5 cup sugar and salt until stiff peaks form using an electric mixer.
Drop spoonfuls of meringue into the hot milk and poach gently for 2 minutes per side, then transfer to a plate with a slotted spoon.
Whisk egg yolks with remaining sugar until pale, mix cornstarch with water, then combine them.
Strain 1.5 cups of the poaching milk into the yolk mixture and whisk constantly over medium heat until it thickens, about 5 minutes.
Divide custard sauce among four bowls and top each with poached meringue eggs, then chill for 15 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale
Make the day before and refrigerate to save time

recipes.name: Escalope à l'Anversoise
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound veal cutlets to quarter-inch thickness between plastic wrap using a meat mallet.
Set up three bowls: flour in one, beaten eggs in another, and breadcrumbs in the third.
Coat each cutlet in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, and press into breadcrumbs on both sides.
Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear cutlets for 3 minutes per side until golden, then transfer to a plate.
In the same skillet, melt remaining butter, sauté mushrooms for 3 minutes, then add shrimp and cook 2 minutes until pink.
Return veal to the skillet, season everything with salt and pepper, and cook together for 1 minute.
Transfer to serving plates and squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top before serving.
cheapTips: Substitute chicken for veal to cut cost by 50%
Buy shrimp frozen and thaw to save money

recipes.name: Tomate Crevettes
recipes.description: Belgian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the tops off tomatoes and scoop out seeds and pulp with a spoon, leaving a shell about 0.5-inch thick.
Lightly salt the inside of each tomato shell and invert on a paper towel for 5 minutes to drain.
In a bowl, combine shrimp, mayonnaise, lemon juice, parsley, salt, and pepper and mix gently.
Place lettuce leaves on four serving plates and set a tomato shell on each.
Fill each tomato with the shrimp mixture and top with a cucumber slice.
Serve immediately with extra mayonnaise on the side if desired.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk when on sale
Use store-brand mayonnaise to reduce costs

recipes.name: Pot-au-Feu Flamand
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut vegetables into chunks: carrots into 2-inch pieces, potatoes into quarters, onions into quarters, and celery into 2-inch pieces.
Heat a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef chunks in batches for 3-4 minutes per side, then remove.
Return beef to pot and add broth, bay leaves, and thyme, then bring to a boil and reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, skimming foam as it rises to the surface.
Add carrots, celery, and onions, then simmer for 20 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Add potatoes and simmer for additional 15 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve in bowls with broth.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for later
Use store-brand broth instead of homemade

recipes.name: Lapin à la Kriek
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat rabbit pieces dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown rabbit pieces for 4 minutes per side, then remove.
In the same pot, sauté pearl onions and mushrooms until lightly browned, then add tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add kriek beer, broth, bay leaves, and thyme, then return rabbit to the pot.
Bring to a simmer, cover partially, and cook for 45 minutes until rabbit is nearly tender.
Add carrots cut into chunks and simmer uncovered for 15 more minutes until rabbit is very tender.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste and serve in bowls with sauce and vegetables.
cheapTips: Order rabbit from butcher ahead of time for better pricing
Use regular brown ale instead of kriek beer to save 40%

recipes.name: Hutspot
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes and carrots into 1-inch cubes and dice onions into small pieces.
Boil potatoes, carrots, and onions together in salted water for 20 minutes until very tender, then drain well.
Return vegetables to the pot, add butter and milk, and mash until chunky-smooth consistency forms.
Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, stirring well to combine.
In a separate skillet, brown kielbasa slices for 3-4 minutes until edges are crispy.
Divide hutspot among four plates and top with warm kielbasa slices.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy kielbasa on sale and freeze for later use
Use regular potatoes instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Mitraillette
recipes.description: Belgian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook french fries according to package directions until golden and crispy, then drain on paper towels.
Split baguettes in half lengthwise, being careful not to cut all the way through.
Spread mayonnaise on the bottom half and mustard on the top half of each baguette.
Layer lettuce, tomato, onion, ham, and cheese on the bottom half of each baguette.
Pack cooked fries into each sandwich, pressing them down gently.
Close the sandwich by placing the top half of the baguette over the fries.
Wrap each sandwich in paper and serve immediately while fries are still warm.
cheapTips: Make fries at home from potatoes to save 50%
Buy cheese and ham on sale and use frozen fries

recipes.name: Crème Brûlée Belge
recipes.description: Belgian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and heat cream and milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar and salt for 2 minutes until pale, then slowly add vanilla extract.
Slowly pour hot cream mixture into yolk mixture while whisking constantly to temper the eggs.
Pour custard through a fine-mesh strainer into a bowl to remove any bits, then divide among four ramekins.
Place ramekins in a baking dish, add hot water to the dish until it reaches halfway up the sides of the ramekins, and bake for 25-30 minutes until set but still slightly jiggly in the center.
Remove from water bath, let cool to room temperature, then chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle brown sugar evenly on top of each ramekin and use a kitchen torch to caramelize until golden and bubbly, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy heavy cream in bulk when on sale and freeze
Use regular white sugar for most of the recipe, brown sugar only on top

recipes.name: Pralines Belges
recipes.description: Belgian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat heavy cream until steaming, then pour over chopped dark chocolate and let sit for 2 minutes.
Stir the chocolate and cream mixture until smooth, then add butter and vanilla extract.
Chill the ganache in the refrigerator for 1 hour until firm enough to scoop.
Scoop ganache into small balls using a melon baller or teaspoon and place on parchment paper.
Melt milk chocolate with coconut oil in a double boiler.
Dip each ganache ball into melted milk chocolate using a fork, coating completely.
Return coated pralines to parchment paper and chill for 30 minutes until set.
Dust with cocoa powder or powdered sugar before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chocolate chips instead of bars to reduce waste
Use store-brand cocoa powder instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Speculoos
recipes.description: Belgian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cream together butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, cinnamon, cloves, ginger, baking powder, and salt.
Mix the dry ingredients into the butter mixture until a dough forms.
Roll dough between parchment paper to 1/4-inch thickness and chill for 20 minutes.
Cut into rectangles or holiday shapes and place on baking sheets.
Bake at 350°F for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and firm.
Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze dough for quick baking later
Buy spices in bulk from discount stores

recipes.name: Pain d'Épices Belge
recipes.description: Belgian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine honey, butter, and brown sugar in a saucepan over low heat and stir until melted.
Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes, then beat in the egg.
In a bowl, mix together flour, cinnamon, anise, baking soda, salt, and nutmeg.
Add dry ingredients to the honey mixture and stir until a thick batter forms.
Pour into a greased 8x4 inch loaf pan and smooth the top.
Bake at 325°F for 35-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 15 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
Slice and serve with butter or jam.
cheapTips: Use store-brand honey instead of specialty varieties
Buy spices at international markets for better prices

recipes.name: Andouillette Flamande
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onions into thick rings and set aside.
Prick each sausage with a fork in 3-4 places to prevent bursting.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the sausages on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Remove sausages and set aside, then sauté onions in the same skillet until golden, about 5 minutes.
Stir in mustard and cook for 1 minute, then add beer and beef broth.
Return sausages to the skillet and add thyme and bay leaf.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until sausages are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with crusty bread or potatoes.
cheapTips: Use regular smoked sausage if andouillette is unavailable
Buy onions in bulk and store in cool, dark place

recipes.name: Choucroute à la Flamande
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onions thinly and slice kielbasa into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Melt butter in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium heat.
Sauté onions until softened, about 4 minutes.
Drain sauerkraut and add to the pot along with caraway seeds and bay leaf.
Nestle pork chops and kielbasa pieces into the sauerkraut.
Pour beer and chicken broth over the mixture.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 40 minutes until pork is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy sauerkraut in bulk bins instead of cans
Use inexpensive beer for cooking rather than premium brands

recipes.name: Poffertjes
recipes.description: Dutch snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk together milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined with some lumps remaining.
Heat oil in a poffertjes pan (or small round skillet) over medium-high heat.
Fill each small cup about 3/4 full with batter and cook for 1-2 minutes per side until golden.
Transfer to a plate and dust with powdered sugar.
Serve warm with additional powdered sugar or jam on the side.
cheapTips: Make batter the night before and refrigerate
Use a regular muffin tin if poffertjes pan is unavailable

recipes.name: Bitterballen
recipes.description: Dutch snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan and whisk in flour to create a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly add beef broth while whisking constantly until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Stir in ham and mustard, then season with salt and pepper.
Spread the mixture on a plate to cool for 15 minutes, then chill in refrigerator for 20 minutes.
Shape into 12 balls approximately 1.5 inches in diameter.
Beat eggs in a shallow bowl and place breadcrumbs in another shallow bowl.
Roll each ball in egg, then coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F and fry bitterballen in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with mustard.
cheapTips: Use deli ham scraps instead of sliced ham
Reuse frying oil by straining and storing in a glass container

recipes.name: Kroket
recipes.description: Dutch snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef with diced onion in a skillet over medium heat, breaking apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Melt butter in a saucepan and whisk in flour to create a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly add beef broth while whisking constantly until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in cooked beef mixture and season with salt and pepper.
