Spread mixture on a plate to cool for 15 minutes, then chill in refrigerator for 20 minutes.
Shape into 8-10 cylinders approximately 3 inches long.
Beat eggs in a shallow bowl and place breadcrumbs in another.
Roll each kroket in egg, then coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry kroketten in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden brown, then drain on paper towels.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Make filling in bulk and freeze uncooked kroketten

recipes.name: Croquette
recipes.description: Dutch snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan and whisk in flour, cooking for 1 minute to create a roux.
Slowly add milk while whisking constantly until sauce thickens, about 4 minutes.
Fold in mashed potatoes and shredded cheese, stirring until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper, then spread on a plate to cool for 15 minutes.
Chill mixture in refrigerator for 20 minutes until firm.
Shape into 8-10 cylinders or squares.
Beat eggs in a shallow bowl and place breadcrumbs in another bowl.
Roll each croquette in egg, then coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden brown, then drain on paper towels.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cheese instead of specialty varieties
Buy potatoes in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Pannenkoeken
recipes.description: Dutch breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and melted butter until combined.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until smooth batter forms.
Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter onto the hot skillet and tilt to spread into a thin, even circle.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until the bottom is light brown, then flip and cook the other side for 1 minute.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
Serve warm topped with powdered sugar, jam, Nutella, or fresh fruit.
cheapTips: Make extra batter and refrigerate for quick breakfasts
Use store-brand jam instead of premium varieties

recipes.name: Patatje Oorlog
recipes.description: Dutch lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin fries about 1/4 inch thick and soak in cold water for 15 minutes.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or fryer and fry potatoes in batches for 3-4 minutes until light golden.
Remove fries and increase heat to 375°F, then fry again for 2-3 minutes until deep golden and crispy.
Drain fries on paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Finely dice the onion into very small pieces.
Transfer fries to a serving container and drizzle with mayonnaise and peanut sauce.
Top generously with diced raw onion and serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk and store in a cool dark place for weeks
Make your own peanut sauce with peanut butter, soy sauce, and water instead of bottled

recipes.name: Friet
recipes.description: Dutch snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thick fries about 3/8 inch wide.
Soak cut fries in cold water for 20 minutes to remove excess starch.
Heat oil to 325°F in a deep pot and fry drained potatoes for 5-6 minutes until tender but not brown.
Remove fries and let cool for 2 minutes on paper towels.
Increase oil temperature to 375°F and fry fries again for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle generously with salt while still hot.
Serve with mayonnaise for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes on sale and store in bulk
Reuse frying oil several times before discarding

recipes.name: Haring
recipes.description: Dutch lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse fresh herring fillets under cold water and pat dry.
In a small bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt, stirring until salt dissolves.
Thinly slice the onion into rings and roughly chop the pickled gherkins.
Place herring fillets on a cutting board and arrange onion rings and gherkins on top.
Pour vinegar mixture over the fish and let sit for 5 minutes.
Place each herring fillet on a slice of rye bread and serve open-faced with the onions and gherkins on top.
cheapTips: Buy herring from the seafood counter in bulk portions and freeze
Make your own pickling vinegar with vinegar and spices instead of buying prepared

recipes.name: Kibbeling
recipes.description: Dutch snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fish fillets into bite-sized pieces about 2 inches long.
Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, pepper, and baking powder in a bowl.
Whisk in cold water to create a smooth, thin batter similar to pancake batter.
Heat oil to 375°F in a deep pot or fryer.
Dip fish pieces in batter to coat completely, then carefully place in hot oil in small batches.
Fry for 2-3 minutes until golden brown and crispy, stirring occasionally.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and mayonnaise or tartar sauce.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish fillets on sale and use throughout the week
Make tartar sauce at home with mayonnaise and pickles instead of buying bottled

recipes.name: Pea Soup
recipes.description: Dutch dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse dried split peas under cold water and drain.
Chop onion, carrots, celery, and potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Place broth and ham hock in a large pot and bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add split peas, onion, carrots, and celery to the pot.
Simmer for 45 minutes until peas begin to break down and thicken the soup.
Add potatoes and thyme and continue simmering for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Remove ham hock, shred any meat from the bone, and return meat to soup.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy split peas in bulk from the dry goods section for significant savings
Use bacon ends instead of whole bacon or ham hock for cheaper protein

recipes.name: Boerenkoolstamppot
recipes.description: Dutch dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into quarters and boil in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Remove kale stems and chop leaves into bite-sized pieces.
In the last 5 minutes of potato cooking, add chopped kale to the boiling water.
Dice the onion and cook in butter in a separate skillet until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pan-fry bratwurst sausages in a skillet for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Drain potatoes and kale, reserving 1/4 cup cooking water.
Mash potatoes and kale together with butter, milk, reserved cooking water, and sautéed onion until creamy.
Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, then serve topped with bratwurst sausages.
cheapTips: Buy kale when in season or frozen for significant price reduction
Use store-brand bratwurst instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Sauerkraut Stamppot
recipes.description: Dutch dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into quarters and boil in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Chop onion and fry with bacon in a skillet until bacon is crispy and onion is soft, about 8 minutes.
Remove bacon and chop it, then add sauerkraut and caraway seeds to the pan and warm through.
Season pork chops with salt and pepper on both sides.
In a separate skillet, cook pork chops over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Drain potatoes and mash with butter, milk, salt, pepper, and chopped bacon.
Fold sauerkraut mixture into mashed potatoes until combined.
Serve stamppot on plates topped with a pork chop.
cheapTips: Buy sauerkraut in bulk jars from the condiment aisle rather than individual packages
Purchase bone-in pork chops for cheaper pricing and better flavor

recipes.name: Mashed Potato Stamppot
recipes.description: Dutch dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and chop potatoes and carrots into equal-sized pieces.
Boil potatoes and carrots together in salted water for 15 minutes until very tender.
Dice onion and cook in butter in a separate skillet until golden and soft, about 6 minutes.
Brown ground beef in another skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 8 minutes.
Drain potatoes and carrots and mash together with butter, milk, sautéed onion, salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Stir cooked ground beef into the mashed potatoes and carrots until evenly combined.
Transfer to a serving dish and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions for later use
Mix carrots with potatoes to extend portions and add nutrition without much extra cost

recipes.name: Broodnodig
recipes.description: Dutch lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thinly slice the onion into rings.
Spread butter on one side of each rye bread slice.
Spread mustard on the other side of each slice.
Layer salami and cheese on two slices of bread.
Top each with onion rings and pickled gherkins.
Place the remaining bread slices on top with butter and mustard sides facing down.
Cut diagonally and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy sliced salami and cheese from the deli counter in bulk and slice at home
Use store-brand mustard and pickles for significant savings

recipes.name: Pindakaas Sandwich
recipes.description: Dutch lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread butter lightly on one side of each bread slice.
Spread peanut butter generously on the buttered side of two slices.
Peel banana and slice into thin rounds.
Arrange banana slices evenly over the peanut butter on both slices.
Drizzle honey over the banana slices on each sandwich.
Top with remaining bread slices with buttered side facing down.
Cut diagonally and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy peanut butter in bulk jars instead of individual packages
Use store-brand honey or replace with maple syrup if cheaper

recipes.name: Kaas en Ham Sandwich
recipes.description: Dutch lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Butter both sides of the bread slices lightly.
Spread mustard on two bread slices.
Layer ham and cheese on the mustard-covered slices.
Add tomato slices and lettuce on top.
Top with remaining bread slices and cut diagonally.
cheapTips: Buy cheese and ham on sale and slice yourself
Use store-brand white bread

recipes.name: Erwtensoep
recipes.description: Dutch dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak split peas in water for 1 hour, then drain.
In a large pot, brown ham hock in a bit of oil over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add diced onion, carrots, and celery; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add drained peas, chicken broth, and thyme; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes until peas break down.
Add diced potatoes and simmer 20 more minutes until tender.
Remove ham hock, shred any meat, and return to pot.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy split peas in bulk bins
Use bacon instead of ham hock to save cost

recipes.name: Tompoes
recipes.description: Dutch snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake puff pastry sheets at 400°F for 12 minutes until golden, then cool.
Heat milk in a saucepan until steaming.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar and cornstarch until pale.
Slowly pour hot milk into egg mixture while whisking constantly.
Return mixture to saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring, until thick (about 3 minutes); add vanilla.
Let custard cool completely.
Mix white icing with pink food coloring.
Cut pastry sheets in half, spread custard on bottom layers, top with remaining pastry, and frost with pink icing.
cheapTips: Buy frozen puff pastry instead of fresh
Use store-bought icing and tint it yourself

recipes.name: Advocaat
recipes.description: Dutch snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a heatproof bowl over simmering water, whisk egg yolks until they reach 160°F (about 10 minutes).
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Stir in condensed milk until smooth.
Add brandy and vanilla extract and whisk until combined.
Pour into serving glasses and dust with nutmeg; serve chilled or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk
Use cheaper brandy rather than premium

recipes.name: Goulash Suppe
recipes.description: Austrian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into 1-inch cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown beef in batches, about 3 minutes per side; set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onions and minced garlic until golden, about 4 minutes.
Stir in paprika powder and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Return beef to pot, add beef broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 40 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and carrots; simmer 20 more minutes until vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust seasonings with salt and pepper.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze
Use generic paprika powder

recipes.name: Erdäpfelpuffer
recipes.description: Austrian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and grate potatoes and onion into a clean kitchen towel; squeeze out excess moisture.
Transfer to a bowl and immediately mix in eggs, flour, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Drop spoonfuls of mixture into hot oil and flatten with the back of a spatula to form pancakes.
Fry 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy on the bottom, then flip.
Fry another 3 minutes until the other side is golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk
Use store-brand oil

recipes.name: Wiener Würstl
recipes.description: Austrian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Place sausages in the pan and cook, turning occasionally, until browned all over (about 8 minutes).
In a separate pan, melt butter and sauté thinly sliced onion until soft.
Warm sauerkraut in a small pot.
Slice open the bread rolls and spread mustard on both sides.
Place one sausage in each roll and top with warm sauerkraut and sautéed onion.
cheapTips: Buy sausages on sale and freeze
Use canned sauerkraut

recipes.name: Bosna
recipes.description: Austrian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onion into thin rings and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook sausages, turning often, until browned (about 8 minutes).
Toast the bread rolls in a toaster or oven.
Spread mustard and ketchup on the toasted rolls.
Place a sausage in each roll.
Top with sliced onion and sprinkle curry powder over each sausage.
cheapTips: Buy sausages at discount stores
Use store-brand condiments

recipes.name: Palatschinken
recipes.description: Austrian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and sugar.
In another bowl, beat eggs with milk until combined.
Combine wet and dry ingredients and whisk until smooth; let batter rest 5 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter and immediately tilt pan to spread thin; cook 2 minutes until light golden.
Flip and cook 30 seconds on the other side; transfer to a plate.
Repeat with remaining batter, adding butter as needed.
Fill each pancake with jam or Nutella, roll up, dust with powdered sugar, and serve.
cheapTips: Make your own jam instead of buying
Use store-brand chocolate hazelnut spread

recipes.name: Erdäpfelpuffer mit Applesauce
recipes.description: Austrian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and grate potatoes and onion into a clean towel; squeeze out excess moisture thoroughly.
Transfer grated mixture to a bowl and immediately mix in eggs, flour, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Drop spoonfuls of potato mixture into hot oil and flatten to form pancakes.
Fry 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy, then flip and fry another 3 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
Warm applesauce in a small pot and stir in cinnamon.
Serve potato pancakes hot with warm cinnamon applesauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy applesauce in bulk or make your own
Use bulk potatoes

recipes.name: Backhendl
recipes.description: Austrian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken pieces dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs mixed with paprika respectively.
Coat each chicken piece in flour, then dip in egg, then coat thoroughly in breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a large skillet to 350°F.
Fry chicken pieces 6-8 minutes per side until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Transfer to paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and a fresh salad or potato sides.
cheapTips: Buy chicken pieces on sale or in bulk; they're cheaper than breasts.
Make your own breadcrumbs from stale bread.

recipes.name: Kasnocken
recipes.description: Austrian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, eggs, milk, and salt in a bowl until a thick, sticky batter forms.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil.
Using a kasnocken maker or slotted spoon, push small dumplings from the batter directly into boiling water.
Boil dumplings until they float and cook another 2 minutes, then remove with a slotted spoon.
In a baking dish, layer half the cooked kasnocken, half the cheese, and all the caramelized onions.
Add remaining kasnocken and cheese on top, dot with butter.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes until golden and bubbly, then garnish with chives and serve.
cheapTips: Use affordable cheddar instead of gruyere for similar melting quality.
Caramelize onions yourself rather than buying pre-made.

recipes.name: Frittatensuppe
recipes.description: Austrian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk eggs, flour, milk, butter, salt, pepper, and nutmeg together until smooth.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Pour a thin layer of batter into the hot skillet and cook 2 minutes per side until set and light golden; repeat to make 3-4 thin crepes.
Roll each crepe and slice into thin ribbon strips about 0.5 inches wide.
Heat beef broth in a large pot until simmering.
Add the crepe strips to the simmering broth and cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Use store-brand beef broth to save significantly.
Make the crepes ahead and refrigerate to save time on soup day.

recipes.name: Wiener Melange
recipes.description: Austrian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour 1 shot of espresso into each cup.
Heat milk in a small saucepan or milk frother until steaming but not boiling.
Add sugar to the espresso if desired.
Pour hot milk into each cup with espresso, filling about three-quarters full.
Top with a dollop of whipped cream.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Use instant coffee if espresso maker unavailable.
Skip whipped cream and use milk foam for a lighter, cheaper version.

recipes.name: Vanillekipferl
recipes.description: Austrian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in egg yolk and vanilla extract.
In another bowl, whisk together flour, ground nuts, and salt.
Fold dry ingredients into wet ingredients until just combined.
Roll dough into small balls and shape into crescents on parchment-lined baking sheets.
Bake at 350°F for 12-14 minutes until pale golden.
While still warm, roll cookies in powdered sugar mixed with vanilla sugar.
Cool on wire rack and store in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Buy nuts in bulk from discount stores or online.
Make vanilla sugar by splitting a vanilla bean into powdered sugar weeks ahead.

recipes.name: Mozartkugel
recipes.description: Austrian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine softened marzipan, nougat, and nut paste, kneading until smooth.
Roll mixture into 16 balls about 1.5 inches in diameter.
Place on parchment and refrigerate for 30 minutes until firm.
Chop and melt dark chocolate with coconut oil in a double boiler over gentle heat.
Dip each ball halfway into melted dark chocolate, coating completely with a fork.
Place on fresh parchment and refrigerate until chocolate sets, about 20 minutes.
Melt milk chocolate and drizzle thin lines across each bonbon for decoration.
Store in an airtight container in a cool place.
cheapTips: Use affordable chocolate chips instead of premium bars.
Skip the decorative milk chocolate drizzle to reduce cost by 30%.

recipes.name: Fondue
recipes.description: Swiss dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rub the inside of a fondue pot with the cut garlic clove.
Heat wine in the pot over medium heat until steaming but not boiling.
Toss shredded cheeses with cornstarch in a bowl.
Gradually add cheese mixture to the wine, stirring constantly in a figure-8 pattern until melted and smooth.
Stir in kirsch, nutmeg, and black pepper.
Transfer pot to fondue burner set to low heat.
Arrange bread cubes, apple slices, and other dippers on a serving board.
Guests spear bread with fondue forks, dip into cheese, and eat; stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
cheapTips: Use a 50/50 blend of gruyere and sharp cheddar instead of all gruyere.
Substitute homemade bread cubes for store-bought.

recipes.name: Raclette
recipes.description: Swiss dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes and pearl onions together in salted water for 15-18 minutes until fork-tender.
Arrange sliced raclette cheese, ham, and prepared vegetables on a platter.
Heat a raclette griddle or cast-iron pan over medium-high heat.
Place cheese slices or small wheel sections on the hot surface to melt, about 2-3 minutes.
Once melted and bubbly, scrape the melted cheese onto a warm plate.
Accompany with boiled potatoes, onions, cornichons, ham, and fresh pepper.
Repeat for each guest, refilling the griddle continuously throughout the meal.
cheapTips: Buy raclette cheese in bulk from warehouse clubs.
Use regular sharp cheddar or fontina as a budget substitute.

recipes.name: Rösti
recipes.description: Swiss breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and finely grate them into a colander; press out excess moisture with paper towels.
Finely mince the onion half.
Toss grated potatoes with minced onion, salt, and pepper.
Heat 1.5 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Press half the potato mixture firmly into the skillet, forming a flat, even pancake.
Cook for 6-8 minutes without stirring until the bottom is golden and crispy.
Slide onto a plate, add remaining butter and oil to pan, flip rösti back into skillet, and cook other side 6-8 minutes.
Slide onto a serving plate, cut into wedges, and sprinkle with chives; serve hot with applesauce or sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk at farmers markets.
Use vegetable oil only to reduce butter cost.

recipes.name: Älplermagronen
recipes.description: Swiss dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and dice potatoes into small cubes; cook in salted boiling water for 8 minutes.
Add macaroni to the same pot and cook together until both are tender, about 8 more minutes; drain and set aside.
Slice onions thinly and cook in 2 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat until golden, about 8 minutes.
In the same pot, combine cooked pasta and potatoes, remaining butter, cream, and shredded cheese.
Heat gently over low heat, stirring frequently, until the cheese melts and everything is creamy and hot, about 5 minutes.
Fold in the caramelized onions and season with salt and pepper.
Transfer to serving bowls, top with fresh chives, and serve alongside applesauce on the side.
cheapTips: Use sharp cheddar instead of gruyere to cut cheese cost by 40%.
Buy pasta in bulk; it's significantly cheaper per pound.

recipes.name: Papet Vaudois
recipes.description: Swiss dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and cut into 1-inch cubes.
Clean leeks, remove dark green parts, and slice into 1-inch rounds.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and add potatoes and leeks.
Simmer for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Drain vegetables and return to pot.
Add butter and milk, then mash until creamy but slightly chunky.
Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes and leeks in bulk during fall for savings
Use store-brand butter to reduce costs

recipes.name: Malakoff
recipes.description: Swiss lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Grate Gruyère cheese and set aside.
Cut crusts off bread slices and cut into cubes.
Whisk together eggs and milk in a bowl.
Layer bread cubes and cheese in alternating layers in a loaf pan, ending with cheese.
Pour egg mixture over bread and let sit for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Turn loaf out onto cutting board and cut into 4 thick slices.
Fry slices until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cheese and bread for lower cost
Buy bread near closing time for discounts

recipes.name: Capuns
recipes.description: Swiss dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch chard leaves in boiling salted water for 2 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Soak bread in milk for 2 minutes, then squeeze out excess liquid.
Finely chop onion and sauté in a pan until softened.
Mix ground pork, soaked bread, cooked onion, and egg in a bowl; season with salt and pepper.
Place 2 tablespoons of filling on each chard leaf and roll up, tucking in sides.
Bring beef broth to a simmer in a pot.
Gently place capuns into simmering broth and cook for 20 minutes.
Serve capuns in broth.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze for later
Use homemade broth if available

recipes.name: Cholera
recipes.description: Swiss lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and slice potatoes into thin rounds.
Peel and slice onions into rings.
Layer potato slices and onion rings alternately in a buttered skillet.
Dot with butter and pour milk over the layers.
Cover and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes and onions in bulk from discount stores
Use store-brand butter

recipes.name: Älplermagronen mit Apfelmus
recipes.description: Swiss dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into small cubes.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook pasta and potatoes together for 12 minutes until both are tender.
Slice onions and sauté in a skillet with 2 tablespoons butter until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Drain pasta and potatoes, then return to pot.
Grate cheese and add to pot with remaining butter, caramelized onions, salt, and pepper.
Toss gently to combine and warm through.
Transfer to a serving dish and serve with applesauce on the side or spooned over the top.
cheapTips: Buy pasta in bulk for savings
Use store-brand applesauce

recipes.name: Raclette mit Cornichons
recipes.description: Swiss dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15-20 minutes until tender, then drain.
If using a raclette grill, set it up according to manufacturer instructions; otherwise use a cast iron skillet.
Cut raclette cheese into slices.
Arrange potatoes and pearl onions on a serving platter.
Place ham slices and cornichons around the platter.
Melt cheese slices in grill pans or skillet until bubbly, about 3-4 minutes.
Scrape melted cheese onto potatoes and bread, and serve with cornichons and ham.
cheapTips: Buy raclette cheese during sales and freeze
Use store-brand cornichons

recipes.name: Grilled Octopus
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and add octopus; simmer for 45 minutes until tender.
Drain octopus and let cool slightly, then cut tentacles into pieces.
Mince garlic and whisk together with olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Marinate octopus in olive oil mixture for at least 15 minutes.
Preheat grill or grill pan over high heat.
Grill octopus pieces for 2-3 minutes per side until lightly charred.
Transfer to a serving plate and drizzle with remaining marinade.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.
cheapTips: Buy frozen octopus for better prices
Use bottled lemon juice

recipes.name: Fava
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse dried peas under cold water.
Dice onion and heat with olive oil in a large pot over medium heat, cooking until softened.
Add peas and vegetable broth to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes until peas are completely soft.
Blend soup until smooth using an immersion blender or food processor.
Stir in lemon juice, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Heat through and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve as a dip with pita chips or crackers.
cheapTips: Buy dried peas in bulk from Middle Eastern markets
Make large batch and freeze portions

recipes.name: Papoutsakia
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cut eggplants in half lengthwise and scoop out flesh, leaving a 1/4-inch shell.
Brush eggplant halves with olive oil and place on a baking sheet; bake for 15 minutes.
Chop eggplant flesh, onion, and garlic.
Brown ground lamb in a skillet, then add onion and garlic; cook until softened.
Add chopped eggplant flesh, tomato sauce, oregano, salt, and pepper; simmer for 10 minutes.
Fill eggplant halves with meat mixture and top with crumbled feta cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until eggplant is tender and filling is heated through.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants at farmers markets for better prices
Use store-brand tomato sauce

recipes.name: Revithokeftedes
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse canned chickpeas.
Finely chop onion, garlic, parsley, and mint.
Place chickpeas, chopped vegetables, and herbs in a food processor and pulse until combined but slightly chunky.
Transfer mixture to a bowl and fold in flour, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Form mixture into 12 small patties, about 2 inches wide.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry patties for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with tzatziki sauce or lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas in bulk when on sale
Use dried herbs instead of fresh to save

recipes.name: Geschnetzeltes Kalbfleisch
recipes.description: Swiss dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut the veal into thin strips about 2 inches long and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the veal strips in batches for 2-3 minutes per side, then set aside.
In the same pan, melt remaining butter and sauté minced shallots until softened, then add sliced mushrooms and cook 4 minutes until golden.
Sprinkle flour over the mushrooms and shallots, stir well, and cook 1 minute to create a roux.
Pour in white wine and beef broth, scraping up browned bits from the pan bottom, then simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in mustard and return veal to the pan, then reduce heat and simmer 8 minutes until veal is tender.
Remove from heat and stir in cream, heating gently without boiling for 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve garnished with fresh parsley over egg noodles or rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken breast instead of veal to reduce cost by 50%
Buy mushrooms and shallots in bulk or frozen to save money

recipes.name: Bircher Muesli
recipes.description: Swiss breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Grate the apple on the large holes of a box grater and immediately toss with lemon juice to prevent browning.
In a bowl, combine rolled oats, milk, yogurt, honey, and vanilla extract.
Stir in the grated apple, hazelnuts, and raisins until evenly mixed.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours, stirring occasionally.
Divide into bowls and add extra milk if needed for desired consistency before serving.
cheapTips: Buy oats and nuts in bulk bins for better pricing
Use store-brand yogurt instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Appenzeller Käsekuchen
recipes.description: Swiss snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a 9-inch round baking pan.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and caraway seeds in a bowl.
Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, then beat in eggs one at a time.
Fold flour mixture into egg mixture, then fold in shredded cheese and sour cream until combined.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Allow to cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
cheapTips: Use standard sharp cheddar instead of imported Appenzeller cheese
Buy eggs in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Basler Läckerli
recipes.description: Swiss snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat honey and butter together until melted, then cool slightly and whisk in eggs and brown sugar.
Mix flour, cinnamon, cloves, and nutmeg in a separate bowl, then fold into honey mixture.
Stir in candied citrus peel and almonds until evenly distributed, then refrigerate dough for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Roll dough to 0.5-inch thickness between parchment sheets and cut into 1.5-inch squares.
Place on baking sheets and bake for 12-15 minutes until lightly browned.
Mix powdered sugar and water to make a thin glaze and brush over warm cookies.
Allow to cool completely before storing in an airtight container for at least 1 week to develop flavor.
cheapTips: Use regular citrus zest mixed with sugar instead of expensive candied peel
Buy spices at ethnic markets for 60% less

recipes.name: Tirggel
recipes.description: Swiss snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat honey and butter together until melted and combined, then cool to room temperature.
Whisk in eggs one at a time until fully incorporated, then stir in lemon zest and kirsch.
Mix rye flour with ginger, cinnamon, and cloves in a separate bowl.
Fold flour mixture into honey mixture until a thick dough forms, then refrigerate for 2 hours.
Preheat oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Roll dough to 0.75-inch thickness and cut into rectangles or decorative shapes with cookie cutters.
Bake for 12-16 minutes until edges are dark brown, then cool completely.
Mix powdered sugar with water to create a thick icing and brush or pipe onto cooled cookies.
cheapTips: Skip kirsch and substitute with orange juice or skip entirely
Buy spices from bulk bins at 50% less than small containers

recipes.name: Zuger Kirschtorte
recipes.description: Swiss snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and grease two 8-inch round cake pans.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form, gradually adding 0.75 cup sugar until glossy meringue forms.
In another bowl, beat egg yolks with remaining sugar until pale, then fold into meringue gently.
Fold ground almonds and flour into egg mixture, divide between pans, and bake 35-40 minutes until golden.
Cool cakes completely, then carefully split each layer horizontally to create 4 thin layers.
Mix 0.25 cup kirschwasser with 0.25 cup water and brush onto each cake layer.
Whip heavy cream with powdered sugar until stiff, fold in halved cherries and remaining kirsch.
Layer cakes with cherry cream mixture, stack carefully, coat outside with cream, then top with chocolate shavings and whole cherries.
cheapTips: Use canned sour cherries instead of maraschino cherries
Substitute kirschwasser with brandy or omit for non-alcoholic version

recipes.name: Luxemburgerli
recipes.description: Swiss snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 300°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Beat egg whites with a pinch of salt until soft peaks form, then gradually add powdered sugar while beating until stiff and glossy.
Fold almond flour gently into meringue in 3 additions, then divide and tint portions with food coloring as desired.
Pipe batter into 0.75-inch domes on baking sheets using a piping bag with round tip, spaced 1 inch apart.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until set but not browned, then cool on baking sheets for 5 minutes before transferring to racks.
Beat heavy cream with butter and vanilla until fluffy to make buttercream filling.
Match cookies by size and sandwich 2 shells with buttercream filling, pressing gently.
Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator until serving.
cheapTips: Make buttercream with just butter and powdered sugar without cream to save 40%
Use natural lemon juice for coloring instead of purchased food coloring

recipes.name: Emmentaler Käse
recipes.description: Swiss snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk to 90°F, then sprinkle in lipase powder and starter culture, stirring for 1 minute and allowing 10 minutes contact time.
Dilute rennet in cool water and add to milk, stirring gently for 1 minute, then let set undisturbed for 30 minutes.
Cut curd into rice-grain-sized pieces using a curd knife, making cuts in three directions, then let settle for 5 minutes.
Slowly heat curds to 102°F over 30 minutes while stirring occasionally, then maintain temperature for 5 minutes.
Line a colander with cheesecloth, pour curds and whey through, then gather cloth corners and hang to drain for 15 minutes.
Place curd mass in a mold lined with cheesecloth and press under increasing weight for 12 hours.
Remove cheese from mold, rub with salt, place on a shelf to air-dry at 60°F and 85% humidity for 3-4 weeks, turning daily.
Wrap in cloth and age in a cool cellar at 55°F for 3-6 months, turning occasionally until ready to eat.
cheapTips: Buy cultures and supplies in bulk from cheesemaking suppliers
Use regular milk instead of raw milk to reduce bacterial contamination risks

recipes.name: Gruyère
recipes.description: Swiss snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk to 90°F, sprinkle in starter culture, stir well, and let ripen for 30 minutes.
Dilute rennet in cool water, add to milk while stirring slowly for 1 minute, then let set for 40 minutes undisturbed.
Cut curds into small pea-sized pieces using a long-bladed knife, then let rest 5 minutes.
Slowly heat curds to 104°F over 40 minutes while stirring gently and continuously, then maintain temperature for 20 minutes.
Line a colander with cheesecloth, strain curds, then hang cloth to drain for 12 hours.
Transfer drained curds to a mold lined with cloth and press under weight for 16 hours, turning once halfway through.
Remove from mold, salt the surface, and air-dry at 55°F for 2 weeks, turning daily.
Age cheese in a cool cave at 50-55°F for 6-12 months, turning weekly until desired flavor develops and rind becomes hard.
cheapTips: Source cultures and rennet from online cheesemaking suppliers at bulk discounts
Use pasteurized milk instead of raw milk for easier and safer home production

recipes.name: Appenzeller Käse
recipes.description: Swiss snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk to 92°F, sprinkle thermophilic culture over surface, wait 1 minute, then stir gently for 1 minute and allow 15 minutes contact time.
Dilute rennet in cool water, add to milk while stirring for 1 minute, then let set undisturbed for 30 minutes.
Cut curd into small rice-grain-sized pieces, stirring gently, then let settle for 5 minutes.
Slowly heat curds to 104°F over 30 minutes while stirring frequently, then cook at this temperature for 10 minutes.
Line a colander with cheesecloth, pour curds through, then hang to drain for 18 hours.
Transfer drained curds to a mold lined with cloth and press under moderate weight for 12 hours, turning once.
Remove from mold, salt the surface, and air-dry at 58°F for 2 weeks, turning daily.
Age in a cool cellar at 50°F for 3-6 months, washing the rind weekly with brine if desired to develop characteristic flavor and natural rind.
cheapTips: Buy thermophilic cultures from cheesemaking suppliers in bulk
Substitute brine wash with salt water instead of specialty rinses

recipes.name: Jagnje pod Pekom
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb pieces on all sides, about 8 minutes total, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onions and minced garlic until softened, about 4 minutes.
Deglaze the pot with white wine, scraping up browned bits, and let it reduce for 2 minutes.
Return lamb to the pot, add beef broth, bay leaves, and rosemary, then bring to a simmer.
Cover the pot and cook over low heat for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add diced potatoes to the pot and continue cooking covered for 30 more minutes until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shoulder instead of premium cuts; it becomes tender with slow cooking
Use chicken broth instead of beef broth to reduce cost by 20%

recipes.name: Crni Rizot
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean squid by removing the ink sac carefully and reserving the ink; chop squid into small pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add chopped squid and cook for 3 minutes, then add rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes to toast it.
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed, about 1 minute.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding more, about 18-20 minutes total.
When rice is tender, stir in the reserved squid ink and butter, mixing well until the risotto turns black.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen squid instead of fresh to save 30% and avoid waste
Substitute half the seafood broth with chicken broth to reduce cost

recipes.name: Buzara
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes, then deglaze with white wine and let it reduce by half, about 3 minutes.
Pour in the fish broth and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add shellfish to the pot, cover, and cook for 8-10 minutes, discarding any that don't open.
Stir in fresh parsley, season with salt and pepper, and finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
Divide shellfish among bowls and pour the sauce over top, serving immediately.
cheapTips: Buy shellfish on sale and freeze; thaw before cooking for best prices
Use clams and mussels instead of expensive scallops

recipes.name: Dagnje na Buzaru
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean mussels under cold running water, pulling off beards and discarding any with broken shells.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté minced garlic and diced onion for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add white wine and crushed tomatoes, then bring to a simmer for 2 minutes.
Add cleaned mussels to the pot, cover with a lid, and cook for 8-10 minutes until all mussels open, discarding any that remain closed.
Stir in fresh parsley and season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve mussels in bowls with the sauce spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy mussels from the seafood counter when they're on sale, usually mid-week
Skip expensive additions and let the mussel flavor shine through

recipes.name: Vobla
recipes.description: Croatian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the fish thoroughly, removing guts and scales, and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the inside and outside of the fish generously with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until foaming.
Place the fish in the hot skillet and cook for 8 minutes on the first side without moving it.
Carefully flip the fish, add sliced garlic and herb sprigs around it, and cook for another 6-7 minutes until the flesh is opaque.
Transfer the fish to a plate and drizzle with fresh lemon juice before serving.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish from the counter and ask the fishmonger to clean it for you
Choose seasonal local fish rather than imported varieties

recipes.name: Orada na Gradele
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the fish thoroughly, removing guts and scales, and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the inside and outside of the fish with salt and pepper, then stuff with lemon slices, garlic, and herb sprigs.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Brush the fish generously with olive oil on both sides and place on the hot grill.
Grill for 7-8 minutes on the first side without moving it, then flip carefully and grill the other side for another 6-7 minutes.
Transfer to a serving plate, drizzle with melted butter and fresh lemon juice, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish on sale and freeze for later use
Use less expensive fish like snapper or mackerel as a substitute

recipes.name: Brudet od Jegulja
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Ask the fishmonger to clean and skin the eel, then cut it into 2-inch pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onions and minced garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes, then deglaze with white wine and let it reduce by half.
Pour in fish broth, add bay leaves, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Carefully add eel pieces to the pot and simmer covered for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the eel is very tender.
Season with salt and pepper, stir in fresh parsley, and finish with lemon juice.
Serve the brudet in bowls with plenty of sauce and crusty bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy eel from specialty seafood markets where it's often cheaper than grocery stores
Substitute with catfish if eel is unavailable

recipes.name: Punjena Trostuka
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the fish thoroughly, removing guts and scales, and pat dry with paper towels.
Finely chop shrimp and mix with breadcrumbs, egg, minced garlic, diced onion, and fresh parsley to make the stuffing, season with salt and pepper.
Carefully stuff the fish cavity with the shrimp mixture, using your fingers to distribute it evenly.
Heat olive oil in a large baking dish over medium-high heat on the stovetop and carefully place the stuffed fish in the dish.
Brown the fish for 3 minutes on each side, then add white wine and fish broth to the dish.
Transfer the baking dish to a preheated 400°F oven and bake for 25-30 minutes until the fish is cooked through.
Carefully transfer the fish to a serving platter, drizzle with pan juices and lemon juice, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp instead of fresh to save 25% on filling
Choose a whole fish on sale and use cheaper varieties like mackerel

recipes.name: Makaruli
recipes.description: Croatian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package directions until al dente, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown ground beef with diced onion and minced garlic, breaking up the meat as it cooks, about 6 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add crushed tomatoes and beef broth.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the sauce for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the cooked pasta and mix well to coat with the sauce, then simmer for another 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef when on sale and freeze in portions
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh sauce; they're cheaper and year-round available

recipes.name: Njoki od Krumpira
recipes.description: Croatian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water until very tender, about 20 minutes, then drain and peel while still warm.
Press the warm potatoes through a ricer or food mill onto a clean work surface.
Create a well in the center of the potatoes and add egg and salt, then gradually incorporate flour while gently mixing with your hands until a soft dough forms.
Divide the dough into 4 portions and roll each into a long rope about 0.5-inch thick, then cut into 1-inch pieces.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently drop in the gnocchi, cooking until they float to the surface and then for another 2 minutes.
While gnocchi cook, melt butter in a skillet over medium heat with minced garlic and fresh sage leaves, cooking until fragrant and slightly brown, about 3 minutes.
Scoop cooked gnocchi out of the water with a slotted spoon and transfer to the butter mixture, tossing gently to coat.
Divide among serving bowls, top with grated parmesan cheese and fresh black pepper, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk; they store well and are inexpensive
Skip the parmesan or use a cheaper hard cheese substitute

recipes.name: Tomato Fritters
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix drained tomatoes, flour, feta, egg, parsley, onion, salt, pepper, and baking powder in a bowl until combined.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F over medium-high heat.
Carefully drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil, frying 3-4 fritters at a time.
Fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown, then transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve warm with tzatziki sauce or plain yogurt if desired.
cheapTips: Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh to reduce cost and prep time
Buy feta in bulk and freeze portions for later use

recipes.name: Horiatiko Pita
recipes.description: Greek breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm pita bread in a skillet or toaster oven for 2 minutes until soft and pliable.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Layer tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives, and feta cheese on each warm pita.
Drizzle the dressing over the fillings.
Fold pita in half and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand pita and feta to save significantly
Use whatever fresh vegetables are in season for best prices

recipes.name: Galaktoboureko
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk in a saucepan over medium heat until steaming, then whisk in cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water.
Cook custard for 3-4 minutes until thickened, stirring constantly, then remove from heat and cool slightly.
Whisk egg yolk and sugar together, then fold into cooled custard with vanilla extract.
Brush a 9x9 baking dish with melted butter, layer 3 phyllo sheets, brushing between each with butter.
Spread custard over phyllo, then layer remaining 3 phyllo sheets on top, brushing each with butter.
Cut into squares, brush top with remaining butter, and bake at 350°F for 25-30 minutes until golden.
While baking, combine water, honey, and cinnamon in a saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour warm syrup over hot pastry immediately after removing from oven and let cool.
cheapTips: Phyllo dough is often cheaper in bulk frozen packages at ethnic markets
Make your own honey syrup instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Cevapcici
recipes.description: Croatian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine beef, pork, onion, garlic, salt, pepper, paprika, bread crumbs, and egg in a bowl and mix gently until just combined.
Divide mixture into 12 equal portions and shape each into a small sausage about 3 inches long.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Grill cevapcici for 10-12 minutes, rolling every 2-3 minutes until cooked through and lightly charred.
Serve immediately in warm pita bread with onions and mustard or ajvar sauce.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef and pork on sale and freeze in portions
Use a regular skillet instead of a grill to save on charcoal or gas

recipes.name: Peka
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and tear off a large sheet of heavy-duty aluminum foil (about 24 inches).
Toss meat, potatoes, peppers, zucchini, onion, and garlic with olive oil, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Divide mixture between two foil packets, sealing the edges tightly by folding the foil.
Place packets on a baking sheet and roast for 75 minutes until meat is tender and vegetables are cooked through.
Carefully open packets (steam will be hot) and transfer contents to serving plates, pouring juices over top.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck instead of lamb for lower cost
Buy vegetables in bulk and freeze what you won't use immediately

recipes.name: Pasticada
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat bacon in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat until crispy, then remove and set aside.
Sear beef roast in bacon fat on all sides until browned, about 10 minutes total, then remove and set aside.
Sauté onion, carrot, and garlic in the same pot for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then deglaze with red wine, scraping up browned bits.
Return beef to pot, add broth, bacon, prunes, and bay leaf, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in a 300°F oven for 2.5-3 hours until beef is fork-tender.
Remove beef and slice, then strain cooking liquid and serve sauce over meat with noodles or polenta.
cheapTips: Make this dish a day ahead and refrigerate overnight for even better flavor
Use cheaper red wine designated for cooking to save money

recipes.name: Risotto od Liganja
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add squid to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in rice and toast for 1-2 minutes while stirring constantly.
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed, then begin adding warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently.
Continue adding broth and stirring for 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy and tender but still al dente.
Stir in butter, salt, and pepper, then serve immediately in warm bowls.
cheapTips: Make your own broth from fish scraps or use store-bought chicken broth as a substitute
Buy squid from Asian markets where it's often cheaper than specialty seafood shops

recipes.name: Brodet
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add crushed tomatoes, fish broth, and white wine, then bring to a simmer.
Add fish fillets and simmer for 5 minutes, then add shrimp and mussels.
Continue simmering for 8-10 minutes until shrimp is pink, mussels have opened, and fish flakes easily.
Discard any unopened mussels, season with salt and pepper, and serve in bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen seafood which is cheaper and just as nutritious as fresh
Purchase fish fillets when on sale and freeze in individual portions

recipes.name: Strukli
recipes.description: Croatian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, create a well, and add water and egg, then mix until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth, cover with plastic wrap, and rest for 30 minutes.
Combine ricotta, cheddar, pepper, and dill in a separate bowl.
On a floured surface, stretch dough very thin using your hands until nearly transparent.
Spread ricotta mixture evenly over dough, then roll up tightly and coil into a spiral shape.
Place spiral seam-side down in a buttered baking dish and brush generously with melted butter.
Bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes until golden brown, then serve with a dollop of sour cream.
cheapTips: Use store-brand ricotta instead of specialty brands to reduce cost
Make filling ahead and refrigerate to save time during assembly

recipes.name: Sarma
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and carefully blanch cabbage leaves for 2-3 minutes until pliable, then drain and cool.
Mix beef, pork, onion, rice, egg, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Place about 3 tablespoons filling on each cabbage leaf, fold in sides, and roll tightly.
Arrange rolls seam-side down in a baking dish and pour crushed tomatoes and broth over them.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 60 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes more until sauce reduces slightly.
Serve hot, drizzling extra sauce over each roll.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze in portions for future use
Substitute tomato sauce for canned tomatoes to save a dollar or two per serving

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop fresh mango into chunks and add to blender.
Pour in yogurt and milk.
Add sugar and cardamom powder.
Add ice cubes and blend until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy mangoes in season (May-August) for best price
Use plain yogurt instead of Greek yogurt to save money

recipes.name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Hull and halve fresh strawberries.
Peel and slice banana into chunks.
Add strawberries, banana, yogurt, and milk to blender.
Add honey and ice cubes.
Blend until smooth and creamy, then pour into glasses.
cheapTips: Buy frozen strawberries in bulk instead of fresh for year-round savings
Use store-brand yogurt to reduce costs

recipes.name: Protein Shake
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add milk to blender.
Measure and add one scoop of protein powder.
Slice banana and add to blender.
Add peanut butter and ice cubes.
Blend until smooth and drink immediately.
cheapTips: Buy protein powder in bulk online for better price per scoop
Use generic store brands instead of name brands

recipes.name: Pitaya Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thaw pitaya packet in warm water for 2 minutes or use frozen packets directly.
Blend pitaya with almond milk and Greek yogurt until smooth.
Pour mixture into a bowl.
Drizzle honey over the base.
Arrange granola, coconut flakes, banana slices, and blueberries on top.
Serve immediately and eat with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy frozen pitaya packets from Costco or Asian markets for better pricing
Skip fresh toppings and use frozen fruit mixed into the base instead

recipes.name: Orange Julius
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Squeeze fresh oranges to get 1.5 cups of juice or use store-bought fresh juice.
Add orange juice, milk, egg, vanilla, and sugar to blender.
Add ice cubes.
Blend until frothy and smooth, about 30 seconds.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-bought fresh orange juice instead of squeezing by hand
Buy oranges on sale and freeze juice for later use

recipes.name: Frappuccino
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brew strong coffee and let it cool to room temperature, or use leftover cold coffee.
Add cooled coffee, milk, sugar, and vanilla to blender.
Fill blender with ice cubes.
Blend until slushy and smooth, about 1 minute.
Pour into a tall glass and top with whipped cream if desired.
cheapTips: Skip the whipped cream to save 50 cents per drink
Make coffee at home instead of buying from a cafe

recipes.name: Wheatgrass Shot
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using fresh wheatgrass, run it through a juicer or high-speed blender to extract juice.
Strain wheatgrass juice through cheesecloth into a shot glass.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice and add to the shot glass.
Add ginger juice if desired and top with a tablespoon of water.
Drink immediately as a single shot.
cheapTips: Grow your own wheatgrass at home in a tray (costs pennies per ounce)
Buy shots from health food stores in bulk instead of individual servings

recipes.name: Sugarcane Juice
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel off the outer green skin of sugarcane stalks with a knife.
Cut peeled stalks into 3-inch chunks.
Feed chunks through a sugarcane juicer (or blender) to extract juice.
Strain extracted juice through a fine mesh sieve into a pitcher.
Peel and finely grate fresh ginger.
Pour juice into glasses, add ginger, lemon juice, ice, and water.
Stir well and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy sugarcane from Latin or Asian grocery stores where prices are lower
Use a blender as a juicer alternative if you don't have a sugarcane press

recipes.name: Avocado Smoothie
recipes.description: Brazilian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut avocado in half, remove the pit, and scoop flesh into blender.
Add whole milk and sweetened condensed milk.
Add honey and vanilla extract.
Add ice cubes.
Blend until smooth and creamy, then pour into glasses and serve.
cheapTips: Buy avocados in bulk when on sale and freeze the puree in ice trays
Use regular evaporated milk instead of condensed milk to reduce sweetness and cost

recipes.name: Beet Smoothie
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using fresh beets, peel and chop into chunks; or use pre-roasted beets from grocery store.
Core and chop apple into chunks.
Peel and slice banana.
Add beets, apple, banana, yogurt, and orange juice to blender.
Add honey and ice cubes.
Blend until smooth, then pour into glasses and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy pre-roasted canned or packaged beets to save prep time and money
Use frozen banana slices instead of fresh to reduce waste

recipes.name: Bakalar na Pjenu
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod in cold water for 24 hours, changing water every 8 hours.
Boil soaked cod in fresh water for 20 minutes until tender, then flake into bite-sized pieces.
Peel and boil potatoes until soft, then mash with butter and warm milk until creamy.
Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Gently fold flaked cod into the garlic oil without breaking it apart.
Whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form, then fold gently into the mashed potatoes.
Layer half the potato mixture in a baking dish, add the cod mixture, then top with remaining potatoes.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes until golden and puffed, then garnish with parsley and serve.
cheapTips: Buy salt cod at Mediterranean markets for better prices than supermarkets
Use regular russet potatoes instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Gregada
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice potatoes into 0.5-inch cubes and peel and chop onion and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in white wine and let it reduce by half, about 3 minutes.
Add broth and bay leaf, bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Cut fish into chunks and add to the pot with shrimp, simmering for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper, then remove from heat and stir in fresh parsley.
Ladle into bowls and serve immediately with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use frozen fish and shrimp instead of fresh for significant savings
Skip the wine and use extra broth

recipes.name: Ronjeni Krumpirici
recipes.description: Croatian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and slice them into thin rounds using a mandoline or sharp knife.
Soak sliced potatoes in cold water for 10 minutes to remove starch.
Drain potatoes thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a deep heavy pan to 350°F.
Fry potatoes in batches for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy, stirring occasionally.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle with salt, garlic powder, and paprika while still warm.
Top with fresh chopped parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk from farmers markets
Use the cheapest oil available for frying

recipes.name: Gradela od Liganja
recipes.description: Croatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean squid by removing tentacles and slicing body into rings, then chop tentacles into pieces.
Chop onions and mince garlic cloves.
Heat olive oil in a large heavy pan and sauté onions and garlic until soft.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add squid rings and tentacles, cooking for 3 minutes until they start to release liquid.
Pour in red wine and let it reduce by half, about 5 minutes.
Add broth and bay leaf, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes until squid is tender.
Season with salt and pepper, stir in parsley, and serve hot with polenta or crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen squid which is cheaper and pre-cleaned
Use affordable red table wine instead of quality wine

recipes.name: Çilbir
recipes.description: Turkish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together yogurt and water in a bowl, then mince garlic and fold into yogurt mixture with salt and dill.
Spread yogurt mixture on a serving plate or into shallow bowls.
Bring a small pot of water with vinegar to a simmer.
Gently slide eggs into simmering water and poach for 3-4 minutes until whites are set but yolks are runny.
Melt butter in a small pan, then add red pepper flakes and toast for 1 minute.
Place poached eggs on top of yogurt sauce.
Drizzle the red pepper butter over the eggs.
Serve immediately with warm bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Use regular yogurt thinned with water instead of Greek yogurt
Buy eggs from discount stores

recipes.name: Sucuk ve Yumurta
recipes.description: Turkish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice sucuk into thin rounds and dice onion and bell pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sucuk slices and cook for 2-3 minutes until the edges curl and oil releases.
Add diced onion and bell pepper, sauté for 2 minutes until softened.
Crack eggs directly into the skillet, spacing them among the sucuk.
Cook until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny, about 3-4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, then sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Serve directly from the skillet with warm pita bread.
cheapTips: Find Turkish sausage at international markets for cheaper prices
Use regular beef pepperoni if sucuk is unavailable

recipes.name: Börek
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop spinach and onion finely, then sauté in 1 tbsp butter until onion is soft.
Crumble feta cheese into a bowl and beat in eggs, then fold in cooked spinach mixture with dill.
Season filling with salt and pepper to taste.
Melt remaining butter and lay out one phyllo sheet on a baking pan, brushing lightly with melted butter.
Layer three more phyllo sheets on top, brushing each with butter.
Spread half the filling evenly over phyllo, then layer and butter four more sheets on top.
Spread remaining filling, then top with final phyllo sheet brushed with butter.
Cut into squares with a sharp knife and bake at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough from discount stores, usually cheaper than bakeries
Use frozen spinach which costs less than fresh

recipes.name: Şiş Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into 1.5-inch cubes and mince garlic cloves.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Toss beef cubes in marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Cut onions and bell peppers into 1-inch pieces.
Thread beef, onion, and pepper pieces alternately onto skewers.
Heat a grill or grill pan to high heat.
Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes, until beef reaches desired doneness.
Let rest for 2 minutes, then serve with pita bread, yogurt sauce, and fresh salad.
cheapTips: Buy beef sirloin on sale and freeze for later
Use wooden skewers soaked in water to save money

recipes.name: Testi Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and cut meat, potatoes, and carrots into 1-inch cubes, then dice onion and mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a pot and brown meat cubes on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Add diced onion and garlic, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste, cumin, and paprika, cooking for 1 minute.
Add potatoes and carrots, tossing to coat with spices and oil.
If using a clay pot (testi), seal it with foil and dough around the edges; if not, use a covered Dutch oven.
Place pot in oven and cook for 60 minutes until meat is tender and vegetables are cooked through.
Carefully break the clay seal and serve hot with fresh bread.
cheapTips: Use a regular covered pot instead of buying clay vessels
Buy beef chuck instead of sirloin for more budget-friendly option

recipes.name: Kol Böreği
recipes.description: Turkish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix crumbled feta cheese with 1 beaten egg, fresh parsley, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Lay one phyllo sheet on a work surface and brush lightly with melted butter.
Spread 2 tbsp filling along the bottom edge of phyllo sheet.
Roll the phyllo tightly from the filled edge, tucking in sides as you roll to form a cylinder.
Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets and filling.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Beat remaining egg and brush over each rolled börek.
Fry börek for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crispy, then drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough on sale and freeze for future use
Use the cheapest oil available for frying

recipes.name: Simit
recipes.description: Turkish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water with yeast and sugar, let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour and salt in a large bowl, then add yeast mixture and oil, kneading for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover dough with a damp towel and let rise for 45 minutes until doubled.
Divide dough into 6 equal pieces and roll each into a long rope about 12 inches.
Form each rope into a circle, overlapping the ends, and place on a greased baking sheet.
Mix molasses with 1 tablespoon water and brush onto each simit ring.
Roll molasses-coated simits in sesame seeds until fully coated.
Bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy sesame seeds in bulk from Middle Eastern markets for half the price
Use regular molasses instead of grape syrup to save money

recipes.name: Çiğ Köfte
recipes.description: Turkish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour boiling water over bulgur wheat and let soak for 15 minutes until softened.
Mix raw ground beef, minced onion, parsley, tomato paste, pepper flakes, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Add the softened bulgur to the meat mixture and knead with your hands until well combined.
Wet your hands and shape the mixture into small oval patties about 2 inches long.
Arrange lettuce leaves on a serving plate and place çiğ köfte on top.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges on the side for squeezing over.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze until needed
Use frozen onions to save prep time and money

recipes.name: Mercimek Köftesi
recipes.description: Turkish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring vegetable broth to a boil and add red lentils, cooking for 12 minutes until very soft.
Stir in bulgur wheat and cook for another 5 minutes until absorbed.
Remove from heat and stir in minced onion, mint, parsley, salt, and red pepper flakes.
Let cool for 5 minutes until handleable, then drizzle in olive oil and lemon juice.
Wet your hands and shape mixture into small oval patties about 1.5 inches long.
Arrange on a serving plate and serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy lentils and bulgur in bulk for 50% savings
Use homemade vegetable broth instead of store-bought

recipes.name: Mezze
recipes.description: Turkish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Arrange hummus, tzatziki, and baba ganoush in small bowls on a large platter.
Place kalamata olives and crumbled feta cheese in small dishes.
Arrange sliced tomatoes and cucumbers around the dips in an organized pattern.
Drizzle olive oil over the hummus and sprinkle fresh parsley on top.
Warm pita bread in a dry skillet for 1 minute per side or wrap in foil and warm at 350°F for 5 minutes.
Serve warm pita bread alongside the platter for dipping and wrapping.
cheapTips: Make hummus and baba ganoush from scratch instead of buying prepared
Buy store-brand tzatziki to save 40%

recipes.name: Kısır
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour boiling water over bulgur in a large bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap.
Let sit for 15 minutes until water is absorbed and bulgur is tender.
Whisk together tomato paste, olive oil, and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Pour the dressing over the bulgur and fluff with a fork to combine.
Fold in fresh parsley, mint, red onion, red bell pepper, salt, and red pepper flakes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more lemon juice or salt as needed.
Serve at room temperature, refrigerating up to 2 hours before serving if desired.
cheapTips: Buy bulgur in bulk bins to save 60% versus boxed
Use frozen chopped parsley in winter for budget savings

recipes.name: Karnıyarık
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplants in half lengthwise and score the flesh in a crosshatch pattern without cutting the skin.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry eggplant halves skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and fry for 3 minutes until softened, working in batches.
Scoop out eggplant flesh leaving a 0.5 inch shell, then chop the scooped flesh and set aside.
In the same skillet, brown ground beef with diced onion for 5 minutes, then add garlic and tomato paste, cooking for 2 minutes.
Stir in chopped eggplant flesh, parsley, salt, and pepper, then cook for 3 minutes.
Fill eggplant shells with the meat mixture and place in a baking dish, pour tomato sauce around them.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 more minutes.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants during summer peak season when prices drop
Use ground beef on sale and freeze until needed

recipes.name: Green Smoothie
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add spinach and almond milk to a blender first to make blending easier.
Add banana, Greek yogurt, honey, and lemon juice to the blender.
Add ice cubes and blend on high speed for 45 seconds until completely smooth.
Pour into two glasses and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen spinach instead of fresh for 40% savings
Use store-brand Greek yogurt instead of name brands

recipes.name: Horchata
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak white rice in 2 cups of water for 30 minutes until softened, then drain.
Add soaked rice to a blender with remaining 2 cups of fresh water and blend until milky.
Strain the mixture through a fine mesh strainer into a pitcher, pressing to extract all liquid.
Stir in milk, sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla extract until sugar dissolves completely.
Pour into glasses filled with ice cubes and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make a big batch and refrigerate up to 4 days for multiple servings
Use evaporated milk instead of whole milk to save 30%

recipes.name: Smoothie King Banana Boat
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add banana, peanut butter, and chocolate syrup to a blender.
Pour in milk and add Greek yogurt and honey.
Add ice cubes and blend on high speed for 60 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Pour into two glasses and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand peanut butter and chocolate syrup to save 50%
Buy bananas in bulk when on sale and freeze for smoothies

recipes.name: Tropical Smoothie
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add frozen mango and pineapple chunks to a blender first.
Add banana, coconut milk, Greek yogurt, orange juice, and honey.
Blend on high speed for 60 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Pour into two glasses and serve immediately for best texture.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fruit from Costco in bulk for 40% savings
Use store-brand orange juice instead of fresh-squeezed

recipes.name: Piña Colada Smoothie
recipes.description: Hawaiian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add frozen pineapple chunks and coconut milk to a blender.
Pour in Greek yogurt and coconut cream.
Add honey and ice cubes to the blender.
Blend on high speed for 60-90 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen pineapple in bulk when on sale
Use canned coconut milk instead of fresh coconut cream to save money

recipes.name: Breakfast Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend frozen berries, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and honey until thick and creamy.
Pour the smoothie base evenly into two bowls.
Top each bowl with granola, banana slices, coconut flakes, and chia seeds.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Make your own granola with oats, honey, and oil to save 50%
Buy frozen berries instead of fresh for consistent low prices

recipes.name: Detox Smoothie
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash the fresh spinach thoroughly and roughly chop it.
Core and chop the green apple into chunks.
Add spinach, apple, lemon juice, and grated ginger to a blender.
Pour in filtered water and add ice cubes.
Blend on high speed for 90 seconds until completely smooth.
Strain through a fine mesh if desired for smoother texture.
Stir in honey and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy spinach and ginger in bulk sections of grocery stores
Use conventional apples instead of organic when on budget

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Smoothie
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel bananas and break them into chunks.
Add peanut butter and banana chunks to the blender.
Pour in whole milk and add honey.
Add vanilla extract and ice cubes.
Blend on high speed for 90 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy generic store-brand peanut butter instead of name brands
Use regular bananas that are slightly overripe for better sweetness

recipes.name: Açai Berry Smoothie
recipes.description: Brazilian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove frozen açai packets from freezer and let soften for 1 minute.
