Break açai into chunks and add to blender with frozen blueberries.
Peel and add banana to the blender.
Add Greek yogurt, almond milk, and honey.
Blend on high speed for 90-120 seconds until creamy and thick.
Pour into bowls and top with granola before serving.
cheapTips: Buy açai packets from Costco in bulk for better pricing
Substitute half the açai with regular frozen blackberries to reduce cost

recipes.name: Carrot Orange Smoothie
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash and peel carrots, then chop into small pieces.
Juice fresh oranges or use bottled fresh orange juice.
Add chopped carrots and orange juice to the blender.
Add frozen mango chunks, Greek yogurt, honey, and ice cubes.
Blend on high speed for 2 minutes until completely smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy carrots from bulk bins or farmer's markets for better prices
Use frozen mango instead of fresh for year-round affordability

recipes.name: Papaya Smoothie
recipes.description: Caribbean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash papaya, cut in half lengthwise, and scoop out seeds.
Peel the skin and cut papaya flesh into cubes.
Peel banana and break into chunks.
Add papaya cubes and banana to blender with coconut milk.
Squeeze fresh lime juice into the blender.
Add honey and ice cubes, then blend on high for 90 seconds.
Pour into glasses and serve with fresh mint if desired.
cheapTips: Buy papayas when they are on sale and freeze for later use
Use bottled lime juice instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Kale Smoothie
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash kale thoroughly, remove the tough center stems, and roughly chop.
Core and chop the green apple into chunks.
Peel banana and break into pieces.
Add kale to blender first, then apple and banana.
Pour in Greek yogurt and almond milk.
Add honey and ice cubes to the blender.
Blend on high speed for 2 minutes until completely smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy kale in large bunches from farmer's markets instead of pre-bagged
Use store-brand Greek yogurt for significant savings

recipes.name: Watermelon Smoothie
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut watermelon in half, remove seeds, and cut flesh into chunks.
Add watermelon chunks to blender.
Squeeze fresh lime juice into the blender.
Add honey and fresh mint leaves.
Add ice cubes to the blender.
Blend on high speed for 90 seconds until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately with mint garnish.
cheapTips: Buy whole watermelons when in season for the best prices
Use bottled lime juice instead of fresh limes to reduce cost

recipes.name: Almond Milk Smoothie
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour unsweetened almond milk into the blender.
Add frozen strawberries to the blender.
Peel and add banana chunks.
Stir in almond butter, honey, and vanilla extract.
Blend on high speed for 90 seconds until creamy and smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy almond milk in bulk boxes from warehouse stores
Use generic almond butter instead of name-brand versions

recipes.name: Bánh Cuốn
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour with water and salt to create a thin batter, let rest 15 minutes.
Soak dried mushrooms in warm water for 10 minutes, then chop finely.
Heat oil in a pan and cook minced shallots until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add ground pork and cook until browned, then stir in chopped mushrooms, fish sauce, and herbs.
Heat a non-stick pan or crepe pan over medium-high heat and lightly oil it.
Pour thin layer of batter onto pan, tilt to spread evenly, and cook for 30 seconds until set.
Place a spoonful of pork filling on the cooked crepe and roll tightly into a cylinder.
Serve warm with dipping sauce made from fish sauce, water, lime juice, and minced chilies.
cheapTips: Buy mushrooms dried in bulk from Asian markets
Use ground pork shoulder instead of premium cuts

recipes.name: Overnight Oats with Berries and Yogurt
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine oats, yogurt, milk, honey, vanilla extract, and cinnamon in a mason jar or container.
Stir well to combine all ingredients evenly.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours.
Remove from refrigerator and stir, adding more milk if too thick.
Fold in frozen berries and top with sliced almonds.
Serve cold or heat in microwave for 1-2 minutes if preferred warm.
cheapTips: Use store-brand Greek yogurt and milk
Buy frozen berries instead of fresh for better value

recipes.name: Acai Bowl
recipes.description: Brazilian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine frozen acai puree, sliced banana, and coconut milk in a blender.
Blend until smooth and thick, like soft-serve consistency.
Divide between two bowls.
Arrange granola, strawberries, and blueberries on top of acai base.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle coconut flakes and chia seeds.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy acai puree in bulk from Costco or warehouse stores
Make your own granola instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Chia Pudding
recipes.description: Modern American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together almond milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and cocoa powder in a bowl.
Stir well to prevent clumping of chia seeds.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Stir again before serving, adding more milk if too thick.
Divide into bowls and top with fresh raspberries and sliced almonds.
Serve chilled.
cheapTips: Buy chia seeds in bulk from health food stores or online
Use frozen raspberries if fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Granola Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Divide yogurt between two bowls.
Top each bowl with granola, creating an even layer.
Arrange sliced banana and mixed berries on top.
Drizzle honey over the bowl.
Sprinkle chopped walnuts and cinnamon.
Serve immediately to keep granola crispy.
cheapTips: Make your own granola with oats, honey, and oil
Buy store-brand yogurt in large containers

recipes.name: Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: Australian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add frozen berries, frozen banana, yogurt, almond milk, and honey to a blender.
Blend until smooth and thick, thicker than a regular smoothie.
Divide between two bowls.
Arrange granola, coconut flakes, and kiwi slices on top in an aesthetically pleasing pattern.
Add any additional toppings like seeds or edible flowers.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Freeze your own bananas when on sale
Use store-brand yogurt to save money

recipes.name: Oatmeal with Maple Syrup and Walnuts
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a saucepan.
Stir in rolled oats and reduce heat to medium.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oats are tender and water is absorbed.
Stir in butter and cinnamon.
Toast walnuts in a dry pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Divide oatmeal between two bowls and drizzle with maple syrup.
Top with toasted walnuts and a splash of milk or cream.
Serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy oats and walnuts in bulk from warehouse stores
Use pure maple syrup alternatives if budget-conscious

recipes.name: Cacao Nibs Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Modern American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix oats, milk, almond butter, honey, cocoa powder, and vanilla extract in a container.
Stir until almond butter is fully incorporated.
Fold in half of the cacao nibs.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours.
Stir well in the morning, adding more milk if needed.
Top with sliced banana and remaining cacao nibs.
Serve cold or heat briefly in microwave if preferred warm.
cheapTips: Buy cacao nibs in bulk from health food stores
Use natural almond butter instead of name brands

recipes.name: Quinoa Bowl with Roasted Vegetables
recipes.description: Modern American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse quinoa under cool water and combine with 2 cups water in a saucepan.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 15 minutes until water is absorbed.
Chop zucchini, bell pepper into 1-inch pieces and halve cherry tomatoes.
Toss vegetables with 2 tbsp olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread vegetables on a baking sheet and roast at 425°F for 20 minutes until tender and browned.
Drain and rinse canned chickpeas, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and roast for last 10 minutes with vegetables.
Divide cooked quinoa between two bowls and top with roasted vegetables and chickpeas.
Drizzle with lemon juice, top with fresh spinach and feta cheese, and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas in bulk and on sale
Use seasonal vegetables for better pricing

recipes.name: Açai na Tigela
recipes.description: Brazilian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Break frozen acai puree into chunks and add to blender with 1 sliced banana and milk.
Blend until creamy and smooth, like soft ice cream consistency.
Divide between two bowls.
Layer granola on top of acai base in the center of each bowl.
Arrange fresh strawberries and banana slices around the granola.
Drizzle honey over the bowl and sprinkle coconut flakes.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Purchase acai in bulk from warehouse clubs
Make homemade granola to save significantly

recipes.name: Shumai
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground pork, minced shrimp, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and cornstarch in a bowl and mix well.
Place a shumai wrapper in your palm and add about 1 tablespoon of filling in the center.
Gather the wrapper edges around the filling and gently press the sides to create an open-top pouch shape.
Line a steamer basket with parchment paper and arrange shumai seam-side up, leaving space between each piece.
Add water to a pot, place steamer basket on top, cover, and bring to a boil.
Steam for 12-15 minutes until the wrappers become translucent and filling is cooked through.
Serve hot with soy sauce, rice vinegar, and chili oil for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions.
Use regular dumpling wrappers if shumai wrappers unavailable.

recipes.name: Gyoza
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Salt the minced napa cabbage, let sit for 5 minutes, then squeeze out excess moisture with paper towels.
Mix pork, cabbage, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Place a gyoza wrapper on your palm and add 1 teaspoon of filling to the center.
Wet the wrapper edge with water, fold in half, then create 3-4 pleats on the top side and press to seal.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and arrange gyoza flat-side down.
Pan-fry for 2-3 minutes until the bottoms are golden and crispy.
Add 0.25 cup water to the pan, immediately cover with a lid, and steam for 5-7 minutes until liquid evaporates.
Serve with a dipping sauce of soy sauce, rice vinegar, and chili oil.
cheapTips: Make filling in bulk and freeze on a tray before storing in bags.
Substitute ground chicken for pork to reduce cost.

recipes.name: Potsticker
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop cabbage finely, salt it, let sit 3 minutes, then squeeze out excess liquid with paper towels.
Mix pork, cabbage, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic until well combined.
Place a dumpling wrapper on your work surface and add 1 teaspoon of filling to the center.
Wet the wrapper edge with water, fold in half to create a semicircle, then pleat one side and press to seal.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and arrange potstickers flat-side down in a single layer.
Pan-fry for 2-3 minutes until bottoms turn golden brown.
Add 0.33 cup water, cover the skillet with a lid, and steam for 6-8 minutes until water evaporates.
Remove lid and cook 1 more minute to re-crisp the bottoms, then serve with dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy cabbage in bulk when on sale and freeze shredded in portions.
Reuse potsticker oil for future batches to save on oil costs.

recipes.name: Jiaozi
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop napa cabbage finely, salt it, let sit 5 minutes, then squeeze out excess water thoroughly.
In a bowl, combine pork, cabbage, chives, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic and mix well.
Place a wrapper on your work surface and spoon about 1 teaspoon of filling into the center.
Wet half the wrapper edge with water, fold in half, then pleat and press the edges to seal completely.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and carefully drop in the jiaozi a few at a time.
Once jiaozi float to the surface, add 0.5 cup cold water to the pot.
Return to a boil and let cook 2-3 more minutes, then remove with a slotted spoon.
Serve hot with a dipping sauce of soy sauce, black vinegar, chili oil, and minced ginger.
cheapTips: Buy dumpling wrappers in bulk from Asian markets for better prices.
Freeze raw jiaozi on trays and store in bags for quick future meals.

recipes.name: Tortellini
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make a mound of flour on a clean counter, create a well in the center, crack eggs into it, and gradually mix flour into eggs until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover with plastic wrap and rest for 30 minutes.
Mix ricotta, Parmesan, ground meat or spinach, salt, pepper, and nutmeg in a bowl to make the filling.
Roll dough as thin as possible with a rolling pin or pasta machine into sheets about 3mm thick.
Cut dough into 2-inch squares using a knife or pastry cutter.
Place 0.5 teaspoon of filling in the center of each square, fold diagonally to form a triangle, then fold the two pointed corners together to form a ring shape.
Bring salted water to a boil in a large pot and add tortellini in batches, stirring gently.
Cook for 3-5 minutes until they float and cook 1-2 minutes more, then remove with a slotted spoon and serve with butter, sage, or your favorite sauce.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pasta sheets to save 30 minutes and reduce difficulty.
Make filling with frozen spinach instead of meat for lower cost.

recipes.name: Dumpling
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wood ear mushrooms in warm water for 5 minutes, then drain and mince finely.
Combine pork, mushrooms, green onions, fish sauce, sesame oil, and garlic in a bowl and mix thoroughly.
Place a round wrapper on your work surface and add 1 teaspoon of filling slightly off-center.
Wet the wrapper edge with water, fold in half to create a semicircle, then pleat and press to seal.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and place dumplings flat-side down.
Pan-fry for 2-3 minutes until golden, then flip each dumpling and cook the other side for 1 minute.
Pour water into the skillet, immediately cover with a lid, and steam for 5-6 minutes until water evaporates.
Serve hot with a Vietnamese dipping sauce of fish sauce, lime juice, water, sugar, and minced chilies.
cheapTips: Skip soaking mushrooms and use minced canned mushrooms to save time and cost.
Buy pork shoulder on sale and grind it yourself with a food processor.

recipes.name: Chiaozi
recipes.description: Taiwanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince napa cabbage, salt it lightly, wait 3 minutes, then squeeze out excess moisture with paper towels.
Mix pork, cabbage, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic together in a bowl.
Place a wrapper on your work surface and add about 1 teaspoon of filling to the center.
Fold the wrapper in half and seal the edges by pleating and pressing firmly.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and place chiaozi flat-side down in the pan.
Pan-fry for 2-3 minutes until the bottoms are golden and crispy.
Add 0.33 cup water to the pan, cover with a lid, and steam for 6-7 minutes until water evaporates completely.
Serve immediately with a dipping sauce of soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and minced green onions.
cheapTips: Make double batches and freeze extras for quick weeknight dinners.
Use a dumpling mold or cup to speed up the wrapping process.

recipes.name: Matzo Ball
recipes.description: Jewish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk eggs in a large bowl, then mix in vegetable oil.
In another bowl, combine matzo meal, salt, black pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder.
Fold the matzo mixture into the egg mixture until combined, then cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Wet your hands and form the matzo mixture into 12 golf-ball-sized portions and gently place them into the boiling broth.
Return broth to a gentle boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer uncovered for 30-40 minutes.
The matzo balls will puff up and float when done.
Serve in bowls of hot broth, garnished with fresh dill.
cheapTips: Use store-brand matzo meal and eggs to reduce overall cost.
Make broth ahead by boiling chicken bones and store in freezer.

recipes.name: Wonton
recipes.description: Cantonese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix pork, shrimp, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl until well combined.
Place a wonton wrapper on your work surface in a diamond orientation.
Add about 0.5 teaspoon of filling to the center of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper in half to create a triangle, press edges to seal, then fold the two corners of the triangle together and press to secure.
Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil.
Carefully drop wontons into boiling water a few at a time, stirring gently to prevent sticking.
Once wontons float to the surface, cook for 2-3 more minutes until they float steadily.
Serve in bowls with hot broth or with a soy-vinegar dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and thaw, then mince in a food processor to save money.
Make filling in advance and freeze for quick assembly later.

recipes.name: Modak
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a skillet and lightly toast the rice flour over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until fragrant, stirring constantly, then set aside to cool.
In the same skillet, melt remaining ghee and add shredded coconut, stirring for 2-3 minutes until lightly golden.
Add jaggery or brown sugar to the coconut and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring until jaggery dissolves and mixture is combined.
Stir in crushed cardamom seeds, toasted rice flour, salt, cashews, and raisins until well mixed, then let cool slightly.
In a separate bowl, mix rice flour with water to create a soft, moldable dough for the outer shell.
Grease a modak mold with ghee and press a thin layer of dough into the mold cavity.
Fill the mold with a spoonful of the coconut-jaggery filling, then add another layer of dough on top and press the mold closed.
Push the modak out onto a greased plate and repeat until all dough and filling are used, then steam in a steamer basket for 10-12 minutes until set.
cheapTips: Buy jaggery in bulk from Indian grocery stores for better pricing.
Use brown sugar instead of jaggery for easier availability and lower cost.

recipes.name: Detox Bowl
recipes.description: Modern American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash all produce thoroughly under running water.
Cut cucumber, apple, and celery into chunks.
Peel ginger root and chop into small pieces.
Add spinach, cucumber, apple, celery, ginger, lemon juice, and water to a blender.
Blend on high speed until completely smooth.
Pour into glasses over ice and serve immediately.
Adjust sweetness with honey if desired.
cheapTips: Buy apples and celery on sale and store in the fridge
Use frozen spinach to reduce waste and cost

recipes.name: Power Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring milk to a simmer in a pot over medium heat.
Add rolled oats and stir constantly for 5 minutes until creamy.
While oats cook, heat a non-stick skillet and fry 2 eggs to your preference.
Divide cooked oats between two bowls.
Top each bowl with one fried egg, sliced banana, and blueberries.
Drizzle with almond butter and honey.
Sprinkle flaxseed on top and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale
Use frozen blueberries instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Overnight Oats with Peanut Butter and Banana
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a mason jar or container, combine oats, milk, Greek yogurt, peanut butter, and honey.
Stir well to break up the peanut butter and combine ingredients evenly.
Add vanilla extract and chia seeds and stir again.
Cover with a lid and refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours.
In the morning, stir and add more milk if too thick.
Slice banana and top the oats.
Eat cold from the jar or microwave for 1-2 minutes if preferred warm.
cheapTips: Buy peanut butter in bulk containers
Use store-brand oats and Greek yogurt

recipes.name: Muesli with Fresh Fruit
recipes.description: Swiss breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, combine rolled oats, almonds, raisins, and coconut flakes.
Pour milk over the muesli and stir well.
Let sit for 2 minutes to soften slightly.
Dice the apple and chop strawberries into bite-sized pieces.
Top each serving with fresh fruit.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make a large batch of dry muesli mix and store in an airtight container
Use seasonal fruit when on sale

recipes.name: Breakfast Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: Mexican-American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions and set aside.
Brown breakfast sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Dice bell pepper and onion, then add to the sausage and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Drain and warm black beans in a small pot.
In another pan, scramble 4 eggs until cooked through.
Divide cooked rice between two bowls.
Top each bowl with sausage-vegetable mixture, beans, scrambled eggs, cheese, and salsa.
Add a dollop of sour cream and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy sausage when on sale and freeze
Use canned black beans instead of dried to save time and money

recipes.name: Falafel Bowl
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse canned chickpeas thoroughly.
Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, and flour in a food processor until combined but still textured.
Form mixture into 8-10 balls and flatten slightly into patties.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry falafel patties 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Chop lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumber.
Divide lettuce between two bowls and top with vegetables.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to create dressing.
Top bowls with falafel and drizzle with tahini dressing.
cheapTips: Buy dried chickpeas in bulk and soak overnight instead of canned
Parsley and cilantro are cheapest at ethnic markets

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble Bowl
recipes.description: Vegan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press firm tofu between paper towels to remove excess water, then crumble into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Dice bell pepper, onion, and mushrooms, then add to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add crumbled tofu, turmeric, and nutritional yeast to the skillet and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes.
Add fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Divide cooked hash browns or potatoes between two bowls.
Top with tofu scramble mixture and drizzle with hot sauce.
Serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy tofu in bulk when on sale and freeze
Use mushrooms from the discount section

recipes.name: Coconut Chia Pudding
recipes.description: Modern American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour coconut milk into a bowl and whisk to combine any separated fat.
Add chia seeds, maple syrup, and vanilla extract to the coconut milk.
Stir well and let sit for 2-3 minutes, then stir again to prevent clumping.
Divide mixture between two jars or bowls.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours.
Before serving, stir and add more milk if too thick.
Dice fresh mango and top puddings with mango, coconut flakes, and granola.
cheapTips: Buy chia seeds at warehouse stores like Costco in bulk
Use frozen mango instead of fresh to reduce cost

recipes.name: Mediterranean Grain Bowl
recipes.description: Mediterranean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook quinoa according to package directions and let cool slightly.
While quinoa cooks, dice cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
Drain and rinse canned chickpeas.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, tomatoes, cucumber, onion, olives, and chickpeas.
Pour dressing over the mixture and toss well.
Divide between two bowls and top with crumbled feta cheese.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.
cheapTips: Buy quinoa in bulk at warehouse stores
Use canned chickpeas instead of cooking dried beans

recipes.name: Green Goddess Bowl
recipes.description: Modern American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Massage kale with a pinch of salt until softened, about 1 minute.
Cut broccoli into small florets and slice zucchini into half-moons.
Toss broccoli and zucchini with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast vegetables at 425°F for 15 minutes until lightly charred.
While vegetables roast, make dressing by blending lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, basil, and salt in a blender.
In a large bowl, combine massaged kale and spinach.
Top with roasted vegetables, sliced avocado, pumpkin seeds, and feta.
Drizzle with green goddess dressing and serve.
cheapTips: Buy kale and spinach when on sale and freeze for later
Use pumpkin seeds from the bulk section instead of packaged

recipes.name: Berry and Almond Overnight Oats
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine oats, milk, Greek yogurt, honey, and vanilla extract in a large mason jar or container.
Stir well to combine all ingredients evenly.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours.
In the morning, stir and add more milk if the mixture is too thick.
Transfer to a bowl and top with fresh blueberries, sliced almonds, and chia seeds.
Serve cold or heat in the microwave for 1-2 minutes if preferred.
cheapTips: Buy frozen berries instead of fresh to save 30-40%
Use store-brand Greek yogurt and oats for significant savings

recipes.name: Chirashi Bowl
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook sushi rice according to package directions and let cool slightly.
Mix rice vinegar, sugar, and salt together, then fold into the warm rice until combined.
Beat eggs lightly and scramble in a non-stick skillet over medium heat, then set aside to cool.
Slice cucumber into thin strips and shred or julienne carrots.
Divide rice between two bowls and top with scrambled egg, shrimp, imitation crab, cucumber, and carrots.
Crumble nori seaweed over the top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with soy sauce for drizzling or on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Substitute imitation crab with canned tuna to reduce cost by $1.50 per serving
Use rotisserie chicken instead of shrimp

recipes.name: Poutine Bowl
recipes.description: Canadian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch thick fries and soak in cold water for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F and fry potatoes in batches until golden brown, about 8-10 minutes.
Drain fries on paper towels and season with salt.
Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Prepare beef gravy according to package directions and stir in cooked ground beef.
Divide fries between two bowls and top with cheese curds.
Pour hot gravy over fries and cheese, allowing some cheese to melt slightly.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Use regular shredded mozzarella instead of cheese curds to save $2 per serving
Make gravy from scratch with beef broth and flour instead of using packets

recipes.name: Grain Bowls with Quinoa
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse quinoa under cold water and combine with 2 cups water in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until water is absorbed.
Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
While quinoa cooks, chop tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, and red onion.
Drain and rinse canned black beans.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper for dressing.
Divide cooked quinoa among three bowls and top with vegetables, beans, and corn.
Drizzle dressing over each bowl and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn and canned tomatoes instead of fresh to reduce cost by $0.50
Buy quinoa in bulk from warehouse stores for 30% savings

recipes.name: Chia Pudding Bowl
recipes.description: Health Food breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine chia seeds, almond milk, maple syrup, and vanilla extract in a bowl.
Stir well to distribute the chia seeds evenly throughout the liquid.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight until pudding forms.
Divide pudding between two bowls.
Top each bowl with granola, fresh strawberries, shredded coconut, and sliced almonds.
Add more almond milk if the pudding is too thick for your preference.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy chia seeds from bulk sections at natural food stores for 20% savings
Use store-brand granola instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Oatmeal Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a medium pot.
Add steel-cut oats and salt, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add milk and brown sugar, stirring until combined.
Divide oatmeal into two bowls.
Slice bananas and arrange on top of each bowl.
Sprinkle with walnuts and cinnamon, then drizzle with honey.
Serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy oats in bulk for less than $0.50 per cup
Use frozen bananas which are cheaper and last longer

recipes.name: Tahini Bowl
recipes.description: Mediterranean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prepare tahini sauce by whisking together tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, and 2 tablespoons water until smooth.
Mix falafel according to package directions using the recommended water.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry falafel balls until golden brown on all sides, about 8-10 minutes.
Drain falafel on paper towels.
Chop cucumber and halve cherry tomatoes.
Divide cooked brown rice between two bowls.
Top with falafel, cucumber, tomatoes, and fresh parsley.
Drizzle tahini sauce generously over each bowl and serve.
cheapTips: Make falafel from dried chickpeas instead of using mix packets
Use homemade tahini sauce made from tahini paste and lemon juice

recipes.name: Chickpea Bowl
recipes.description: Indian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in curry powder and cumin, coating the vegetables.
Drain and rinse canned chickpeas, then add to the pot.
Pour in coconut milk and canned tomatoes with their juice.
Simmer for 15 minutes until flavors blend.
Stir in fresh spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve over basmati rice.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas in bulk at warehouse stores for $0.50 per can
Use frozen spinach which is cheaper and less waste

recipes.name: Lentil Bowl
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse brown lentils under cold water to remove debris.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Dice onion, carrot, and celery, then sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Add cumin and dried thyme to the pot and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add rinsed lentils and vegetable broth to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are tender.
Add canned diced tomatoes and lemon juice, simmer for 5 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, then garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
cheapTips: Buy dried lentils in bulk for less than $1 per pound
Use vegetable broth from a can rather than boxed for better value

recipes.name: Grain Salad Bowl
recipes.description: Mediterranean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil and add farro, stirring occasionally.
Simmer for 30-35 minutes until farro is tender, then drain any excess liquid.
Transfer cooked farro to a large bowl and let cool to room temperature.
Halve cherry tomatoes and chop cucumber and red onion into bite-sized pieces.
Add vegetables, kalamata olives, and fresh basil to the farro.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice.
Pour dressing over the grain mixture and toss to combine.
Stir in crumbled feta cheese, season with salt and pepper, and serve.
cheapTips: Substitute feta with store-brand mozzarella to save $0.75 per serving
Buy farro in bulk sections instead of packaged for better pricing

recipes.name: Farro Bowl
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring vegetable broth to a boil in a pot and add farro, stirring occasionally.
Simmer for 30 minutes until farro is tender but chewy, then drain and let cool.
Dice cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and mince red onion in a large bowl.
Add cooled farro to the vegetables and toss with olive oil, lemon juice, and basil.
Season with salt and pepper, top with crumbled feta cheese, and serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy farro in bulk from the bin section to save 30%
Use store-brand vegetable broth and frozen tomatoes if fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Barley Bowl
recipes.description: Scandinavian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring vegetable broth to a boil, add barley, and simmer for 35 minutes until tender.
Peel and cube beets and carrots, then roast at 400°F for 25 minutes until caramelized.
Drain cooked barley and toss with butter, salt, and pepper.
Mix sour cream with fresh dill and lemon juice to make a dressing.
Divide barley among bowls, top with roasted vegetables, sunflower seeds, and dollop of dill cream.
cheapTips: Buy pearl barley in bulk for less than $0.50 per cup
Use canned beets if fresh beets are out of season

recipes.name: Couscous Bowl
recipes.description: Moroccan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté diced onion with cumin and cinnamon for 2 minutes.
Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil, then stir in couscous and remove from heat.
Cover the pot for 5 minutes to let couscous absorb the liquid.
Drain and rinse canned chickpeas, then toss with couscous, chopped apricots, and almonds.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh cilantro, and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy dried apricots from bulk bins instead of packaged
Canned chickpeas are usually cheaper than dried when on sale

recipes.name: Rice and Beans Bowl
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onion and bell pepper, then sauté in olive oil with minced garlic and cumin for 3 minutes.
Rinse and drain black beans, add to the pan with salt and pepper, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook rice in 3 cups of water according to package directions, about 18 minutes.
Combine cooked rice and beans, squeezing lime juice over the mixture and stirring.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy rice and beans in bulk for maximum savings on this budget-friendly dish
Use dried beans soaked overnight instead of canned to cut cost by 60%

recipes.name: Panzanella Bowl
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cube day-old bread and toss with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, then toast at 375°F for 8 minutes until golden.
Dice tomatoes, cucumber, and thinly slice red onion into a large bowl.
Mash garlic cloves with salt and whisk with remaining olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Pour dressing over vegetables and let sit for 5 minutes to release juices.
Add toasted bread cubes and torn basil, toss gently, season with pepper, and let rest 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy bread at the bakery day-old counter for 50% off
Use whatever fresh vegetables are on sale that week

recipes.name: Farro e Verdure
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice zucchini, eggplant, bell pepper, and onion into uniform pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté vegetables with minced garlic until softened, about 10 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil, then add farro and stir.
Simmer covered for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until farro is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Stir in fresh parsley, season with salt and pepper, top with grated parmesan, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy seasonal vegetables at farmers markets for better prices
Use pre-grated store-brand parmesan instead of fresh for savings

recipes.name: Tabbouleh Bowl
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour boiling water over bulgur in a bowl, cover with foil, and let sit for 15 minutes to soften.
Finely chop parsley, mint, tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion into small, uniform pieces.
Fluff bulgur with a fork and transfer to a large mixing bowl.
Add herbs and vegetables to bulgur, then drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil.
Toss everything together gently, season with salt and pepper, and refrigerate until serving.
cheapTips: Buy bulgur and herbs from bulk bins to reduce packaging waste and cost
Make this in summer when tomatoes and fresh herbs are cheapest

recipes.name: Miso Bowl
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a simmer with dashi powder, then remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Slice tofu into cubes and tear nori into small pieces, then slice mushrooms thinly.
In a separate small pot, bring water to boil and poach eggs until whites are set but yolks are runny.
Ladle miso paste into each bowl, pour hot dashi broth carefully while stirring, and add tofu cubes.
Top each bowl with spinach, mushrooms, a poached egg, green onion, nori strips, and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy miso paste in larger containers from Asian markets for half the price
Frozen spinach works just as well as fresh and costs less

recipes.name: Congee Bowl
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add rinsed rice and sliced ginger.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down into porridge.
While congee cooks, whisk eggs in a bowl and thinly slice green onion and cilantro.
Drizzle beaten eggs into the simmering congee while stirring gently to create ribbons, then cook 1 minute.
Season with soy sauce, sesame oil, and white pepper, ladle into bowls, and top with green onion and cilantro.
cheapTips: Use vegetable broth or water instead of chicken broth to save 30%
Buy ginger in bulk and freeze for later use in many dishes

recipes.name: Naan
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and baking powder in a large bowl, then create a well in the center.
Add yogurt and warm water to the well, mix with hands until a soft dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes.
Coat dough lightly with oil, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise at room temperature for 1 hour.
Divide dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into a thin oval about 0.25 inch thick.

Heat a skillet or cast iron on high heat and cook each naan 2-3 minutes per side until puffed and charred, brushing with butter and sprinkling with minced garlic, cilantro, and nigella seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Use plain Greek yogurt or regular yogurt interchangeably for cost savings
Make a larger batch and freeze extras for quick reheating later

recipes.name: Paratha
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and 1 tablespoon oil in a bowl, then gradually add water to form a soft dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth, cover with a damp cloth, and let rest for 20 minutes.
Divide dough into 4 balls and roll each into a thin circle about 6 inches wide.
Mix chopped onion, chili, cilantro, and a pinch of salt, then spread onto each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half, then in half again to form a triangle, and gently press.
Heat a skillet or tawa over medium-high heat and brush with ghee or oil.
Cook each paratha for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown spots appear, pressing gently with a spatula.
Brush cooked parathas with melted butter and serve hot with yogurt or curry.
cheapTips: Buy oil in bulk to reduce per-serving cost
Use seasonal onions and fresh cilantro from discount stores

recipes.name: Pita
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water, let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt in a large bowl, create a well, and pour in yeast mixture and olive oil.
Knead the dough for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, then place in an oiled bowl.
Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Divide dough into 6 equal balls and flatten each to about 1/4 inch thickness.
Place flattened doughs on parchment paper, cover, and let rest for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 475°F and heat a baking sheet inside for 10 minutes.
Place 2-3 pita breads on hot baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes until puffed and lightly golden.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze extras for later use
Buy yeast in bulk packets instead of individual envelopes

recipes.name: Flatbread
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then make a well and pour in water and 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Stir with a fork until a shaggy dough forms, then knead by hand for 5 minutes until smooth.
Let dough rest for 10 minutes covered with a damp towel.
Divide dough into 4 portions and roll each into a thin circle about 6 inches across.
Heat a cast iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat until very hot.
Place a flatbread on the hot surface and cook for 1-2 minutes, flip and cook another 1-2 minutes until light brown spots appear.
Brush cooked flatbreads with remaining olive oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve warm with hummus, yogurt, or as a wrap.
cheapTips: Skip sesame seeds to reduce cost, or buy from bulk bins
Use basic all-purpose flour for best value

recipes.name: Focaccia
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt, then add yeast mixture and 3 tablespoons olive oil, stirring until combined.
Knead the dough for 8 minutes until smooth, place in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise 1 hour.
Pour remaining olive oil onto a 9x13 inch baking sheet and spread with your fingers.
Transfer risen dough to the oiled sheet and gently stretch to fill, using oiled fingers to dimple the surface.
Sprinkle rosemary and sea salt over the top and let rest for 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°F and bake focaccia for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Use dried rosemary instead of fresh to save money
Buy flour in 5-pound bags for better per-unit pricing

recipes.name: Flammekuchen
recipes.description: Alsatian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water with a pinch of sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix flour and salt, then combine with yeast mixture and 1 tablespoon oil to form a soft dough.
Knead for 5 minutes, place in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise for 45 minutes.
While dough rises, fry bacon until crispy, remove and set aside, then sauté sliced onions in bacon fat until golden.
Preheat oven to 500°F and divide dough into 3 portions, rolling each very thin into a rectangular shape.
Place dough on a hot baking sheet, spread a thin layer of crème fraîche on each, leaving a small border.
Top with caramelized onions, crispy bacon, and shredded gruyere cheese.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until crust is crispy and edges are golden brown, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular sour cream instead of crème fraîche to reduce cost
Substitute gruyere with sharp cheddar for savings

recipes.name: Scaccia
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water with a pinch of sugar and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt, add yeast mixture and 3 tablespoons olive oil, knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
Place dough in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Sauté zucchini slices in 2 tablespoons olive oil for 5 minutes until tender, then season with salt.
Divide dough into 2 pieces, roll first piece thin, place on an oiled baking sheet, then spread half the tomato sauce.
Layer half the cooked zucchini, half the mozzarella, and half the basil on the dough.
Roll and stretch second piece of dough to cover filling, seal edges by pressing with a fork, brush with oil.
Let rest for 20 minutes, then bake at 400°F for 30-35 minutes until golden brown, slice into wedges and serve.
cheapTips: Use canned tomato sauce instead of fresh for consistency and cost savings
Buy zucchini during peak season and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Xacuti
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried red chilies, coriander seeds, and cumin seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes, then grind into a fine powder.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté diced onions until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add cubed chicken and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned.
Stir in the ground spice mixture and turmeric powder, cooking for 1 minute to bloom the spices.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt as needed, then simmer uncovered for another 10 minutes to thicken the sauce.
Serve hot with rice or flatbread.
cheapTips: Buy whole spices and toast at home instead of pre-ground for better flavor and value
Use chicken thighs instead of breast for savings and more flavor

recipes.name: Pupusa
recipes.description: Salvadoran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix masa harina, salt, and warm water in a bowl until you have a soft, pliable dough similar to Play-Doh consistency.
Brown ground beef with diced onion in a skillet for 5 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks, then set aside.
Form a small ball of masa in your hand, flatten it slightly, add a spoonful of cooked beef, beans, and cheese in the center.
Fold the edges up and seal the filling inside, gently patting into a thick disc about 3 inches wide and 3/4 inch thick.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Carefully place 2-3 pupusas in the hot oil and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and slightly crispy.
Remove with a slotted spatula and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with tomato salsa and pickled cabbage slaw.
cheapTips: Buy masa harina from Latin markets or bulk sections for better pricing
Substitute mozzarella with Oaxaca cheese or use regular cheddar to adjust cost

recipes.name: Murtabak
recipes.description: Southeast Asian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and 1 tablespoon oil with warm water to form a soft dough, knead for 5 minutes.
Let dough rest covered for 15 minutes, then divide into 4 balls.
Flatten each ball very thin on an oiled surface until nearly translucent, stretching gently with your hands.
Brown ground beef with minced garlic and chopped onion in a skillet for 5 minutes, season with salt.
Scramble the eggs in the same skillet until cooked through, then combine with the beef mixture and coriander.
Spread 2-3 tablespoons of filling on one half of each stretched dough circle.
Fold the dough in half to enclose the filling and press edges to seal.
Heat remaining oil in a skillet over medium heat and fry murtabak for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crispy, serve hot with sweet chili sauce.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions for later use
Skip fresh coriander and use dried cilantro to reduce cost

recipes.name: Crepe
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour and salt in a large mixing bowl and create a well in the center.
Add eggs, milk, and water to the well, whisking together gently until smooth and no lumps remain.
Stir in melted butter, sugar, and vanilla extract until fully combined.
Let batter rest for 30 minutes at room temperature for best results.
Heat an 8-inch nonstick skillet or crepe pan over medium-high heat and lightly butter it.
Pour 1/4 cup batter into the center and immediately tilt and rotate the pan to spread it thin and evenly.
Cook for about 1-2 minutes until the bottom is light golden, then flip and cook the other side for about 30 seconds.
Transfer cooked crepe to a plate and repeat with remaining batter, serving warm with your choice of fillings like fruit, Nutella, or jam.
cheapTips: Buy eggs from discount stores or buy larger quantities for better per-unit pricing
Use store-brand vanilla extract instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Chuan
recipes.description: Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bamboo skewers in water for 20 minutes.
Cut pork shoulder into 1-inch cubes.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, chili flakes, sugar, and white pepper in a bowl.
Thread pork cubes onto skewers and brush with marinade.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill skewers 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes until cooked through.
Brush with remaining marinade halfway through cooking.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for later use
Use regular canola oil instead of sesame oil to reduce cost

recipes.name: Keba
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground beef, onion, garlic, red pepper, parsley, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Divide mixture into 6 equal portions and shape each into an oblong patty around a wooden stick or shape into logs.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook keba 4-5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Serve warm keba in pita bread with fresh tomatoes and onions if desired.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk and freeze portions
Use store-brand spices instead of name brands

recipes.name: Meatball Skewer
recipes.description: Swedish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes.
Combine breadcrumbs and milk in a small bowl and let sit 5 minutes.
Mix ground beef, ground pork, breadcrumb mixture, onion, egg, salt, pepper, and nutmeg until just combined.
Form mixture into 16 meatballs and thread 2 meatballs onto each skewer.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Cook meatball skewers 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally until browned and cooked through.
Serve hot with lingonberry jam and sour cream on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and make meatballs to freeze
Skip lingonberry jam and use affordable canned cranberry sauce

recipes.name: Tandoori Chicken Skewer
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into 1.5-inch cubes.
Mix yogurt, lime juice, garlic, ginger, tandoori masala, paprika, and salt in a bowl.
Add chicken cubes to marinade and coat well, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread marinated chicken onto metal skewers.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill skewers 12-15 minutes, turning every 3-4 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts to save money
Make your own tandoori spice blend with turmeric, cumin, and coriander

recipes.name: Kofta Kebab
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes.
Mix ground lamb, onion, garlic, parsley, mint, cumin, cinnamon, salt, and pepper until combined.
Divide mixture into 8 portions and mold each around a skewer, pressing firmly.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill kofta kebabs 12-15 minutes, rotating every 3 minutes until cooked through.
Serve in warm pita bread with tzatziki sauce, tomatoes, and cucumber.
cheapTips: Substitute ground beef for lamb to reduce cost significantly
Make tzatziki at home with yogurt and cucumber instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Grilled Fish Skewer
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fish fillets into 1.5-inch chunks.
Mix lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, scallions, and cilantro in a bowl.
Add fish to marinade and gently toss to coat, then refrigerate 15 minutes.
Thread marinated fish onto metal skewers.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat and brush with oil.
Grill fish skewers 8-10 minutes, turning once, until fish flakes easily with a fork.
Serve with rice and dipping sauce made from fish sauce, lime, and chile.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish fillets on sale and thaw before cooking
Skip lemongrass and use lime zest with garlic for similar flavor

recipes.name: Pinchos Morunos
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes.
Cut pork into 1-inch cubes.
Mix paprika, cumin, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Toss pork with marinade and let sit 15 minutes.
Thread pork onto skewers.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat.
Grill skewers 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes until cooked through.
Squeeze lemon over cooked pinchos and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy pork on sale and marinate ahead of time
Use basic paprika instead of smoked paprika to save money

recipes.name: Negima
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken thighs into 1-inch cubes.
Cut green onions into 1.5-inch pieces.
Whisk soy sauce, sake, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl.
Thread chicken and green onion pieces alternately onto metal skewers.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill skewers 10-12 minutes, turning every 3 minutes.
Brush skewers with sauce during last 3 minutes of cooking until glazed and cooked through.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor and lower cost
Substitute water with a pinch of sugar if sake is unavailable

recipes.name: Lechon Skewer
recipes.description: Filipino snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes.
Cut pork belly into 1-inch cubes.
Combine soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, salt, pepper, and water in a pot.
Add pork cubes and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes until pork is tender.
Drain pork and pat dry with paper towels.
Thread cooked pork onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry skewers over medium-high heat 5-7 minutes until skin crisps and browns.
Serve with liver sauce or vinegar dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly when it goes on sale and freeze
Make simple vinegar dip at home with calamansi or lime juice

recipes.name: Lamb Kofta
recipes.description: Lebanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes.
Toast pine nuts in a dry skillet over medium heat 3-4 minutes until fragrant, then set aside.
Mix ground lamb, onion, garlic, parsley, toasted pine nuts, allspice, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Divide mixture into 8 portions and mold each firmly around a skewer.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill kofta 14-16 minutes, rotating every 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
Serve in warm flatbread with tahini sauce, tomatoes, cucumbers, and red onion.
cheapTips: Substitute ground beef for lamb to reduce cost by 40 percent
Make tahini sauce at home with tahini, lemon, and garlic instead of buying

recipes.name: Jianbing
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, cornstarch, and salt in a bowl, then gradually whisk in water until smooth with no lumps.
Heat a 10-inch non-stick skillet or crepe pan over medium-high heat and lightly oil it.
Pour 1/2 cup batter into the center and immediately tilt and rotate the pan to spread it into a thin, even circle.
Crack an egg onto the crepe and spread it gently with a spatula, then sprinkle scallions and crispy wonton strips over it.
Drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil over the toppings, then fold the crepe in half when the egg is mostly set.
Cook for another 30 seconds until golden, then transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
Serve hot, optionally drizzled with more sesame oil.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk and use store-brand flour to reduce costs
Make your own crispy wonton strips by frying wonton wrappers instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Galette
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then cut in cold butter with a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add ice water 1 tablespoon at a time, stirring gently until dough just comes together, then chill for 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Roll dough into a 10-inch circle on parchment and spread a thin layer of Dijon mustard over it.
Layer ham, sautéed spinach, and half the gruyere cheese on the dough, leaving a 2-inch border.
Beat eggs with 1 tablespoon water and brush edges of dough, then fold edges up over filling and brush with egg wash.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and bake for 20-25 minutes until crust is golden and center is warm.
Cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
cheapTips: Use block cheddar instead of expensive gruyere if budget is tight
Substitute fresh spinach with frozen spinach (thawed and drained) to save money

recipes.name: Bhaji
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add cumin seeds, letting them sizzle for 10 seconds.
Add sliced onions and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened and starting to turn golden.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add potato matchsticks, turmeric, chili powder, and salt, then stir well to coat all vegetables.
Cook uncovered for 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender and onions are deeply caramelized and crispy.
Remove from heat and stir in cilantro and lime juice.
Serve hot as a side dish or snack.
cheapTips: Buy onions and potatoes in bulk from discount stores for significant savings
Store-brand spices are identical in quality and much cheaper than name brands

recipes.name: Farinata
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and place a 10-inch cast iron skillet or round baking pan in the oven with 3 tablespoons olive oil for 5 minutes.
Whisk chickpea flour with water in a bowl until smooth and lump-free, then stir in salt, pepper, garlic, and rosemary.
Carefully pour batter into the hot oiled pan and drizzle remaining olive oil over the top.
Scatter thinly sliced onion over the batter if desired.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until the top is golden brown and edges are dark and crispy.
Remove from oven and let cool for 2-3 minutes before slicing into wedges.
Serve warm with a squeeze of lemon juice and extra pepper if desired.
cheapTips: Buy chickpea flour in bulk from Indian or Middle Eastern markets for 50% savings
Use basic olive oil rather than premium extra-virgin for cooking

recipes.name: Plintz
recipes.description: Yiddish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, eggs, milk, salt, and sugar in a bowl until batter is smooth and thin, like crepe batter.
Heat a non-stick skillet or crepe pan over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Pour about 1/4 cup batter into the pan and quickly tilt and rotate to spread into a thin circle.
Cook for about 1-2 minutes until the bottom is light golden, then flip and cook the other side for 30-45 seconds.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter, stacking the finished plintz.
Serve warm folded or rolled, topped with sour cream and jam.
Dust with powdered sugar if desired.
cheapTips: Use store-brand jam and sour cream instead of premium brands
Make large batches and freeze extras for quick breakfasts later

recipes.name: Tempeh Goreng
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Steam tempeh slices for 10 minutes to remove bitterness, then let cool slightly.
Mix turmeric, salt, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl to form a paste.
Rub the turmeric paste onto both sides of each tempeh slice.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and carefully fry tempeh slices in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy, then remove to a paper towel.
In the same oil, fry shallots and chili slices until fragrant and lightly crispy, about 2 minutes, then remove.
Arrange fried tempeh on a plate, top with shallots and chilies, then drizzle with soy sauce and lime juice.
Serve immediately with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy tempeh in bulk at Asian markets for 30% savings vs. mainstream stores
Make your own spice paste rather than buying pre-made versions

recipes.name: Lachha Paratha
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, salt, cumin, and carom seeds in a bowl.
Add oil and water gradually, kneading until a soft, smooth dough forms, then let rest for 15 minutes.
Divide dough into 6 equal portions and roll each into a thin circle about 8 inches across.
Brush melted butter on the dough circle, sprinkle cilantro, then roll it tightly into a log and coil it into a spiral.
Flatten the coil gently with your hand and roll into a 1/4-inch thick circle.
Heat a cast iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and place a paratha on it.
Cook for about 1-2 minutes until light brown spots appear, then flip and brush with butter, pressing with a spatula until puffed and golden.
Flip again, brush with butter, and cook for another 30 seconds until crispy.
Transfer to a plate and serve hot with curry or yogurt.
cheapTips: Buy flour in 5-10 lb bags from bulk or Indian stores for major savings
Use butter sparingly and reserve for the final cooking stage to reduce costs

recipes.name: Papadums
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F, testing with a single piece of papadum to ensure proper temperature.
Carefully place one papadum into the hot oil; it will instantly puff and expand in 1-2 seconds.
Use tongs or a slotted spoon to flip it over for another second, then immediately remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Repeat with each papadum, allowing oil to return to temperature between batches.
Cool completely before serving, as they will crisp up further as they cool.
Serve plain or with Indian pickles and chutneys as an accompaniment to meals.
cheapTips: Buy dried papadums in bulk from Indian grocery stores for 50% less than specialty shops
Reuse frying oil multiple times by straining; it keeps for weeks when stored properly

recipes.name: Crumpet
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then pour in yeast mixture and melted butter, stirring until a thick batter forms.
Cover with a damp towel and let rise at room temperature for 20 minutes until bubbly and airy.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and lightly oil it, then place greased crumpet rings on the surface.
Pour 1/4 cup batter into each ring and cook for 4-5 minutes until the top is set and bottom is golden brown.
Carefully remove the rings and flip crumpets, cooking for another 1-2 minutes until golden on the other side.
Transfer to a plate and serve warm with butter and jam or honey.
cheapTips: Substitute crumpet rings with tuna cans with both ends removed to save money
Make a large batch and freeze extras for up to 3 months

recipes.name: Zucchini Fritters
recipes.description: Mediterranean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss grated zucchini with salt and let sit in a colander for 5 minutes to release water, then squeeze out excess moisture with a clean towel.
Beat eggs in a bowl, then stir in flour, feta, dill, garlic, pepper, and drained zucchini until well combined.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the hot oil, flattening them slightly into patties about 2-3 inches wide.
Fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy on both sides, working in batches without crowding the pan.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve warm with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice and yogurt for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy zucchini at farmers markets in summer when they're at peak season and cheapest
Use regular cheddar or mozzarella instead of feta to reduce costs by $1 per serving

recipes.name: Pork Satay
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Cut pork tenderloin into thin strips and thread onto skewers.
Mix coconut milk, peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, minced garlic, ginger, and brown sugar in a bowl for the sauce.
Reserve half the sauce for serving and brush the other half generously on the skewers.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook skewers 3-4 minutes per side until pork is cooked through and lightly charred.
Transfer to a serving plate and drizzle with reserved sauce.
Serve warm with remaining sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder instead of tenderloin and slice thinly to save 30%
Use generic peanut butter instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Arrosticini
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut meat into 1-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Chop onion and mince garlic, then add to meat with rosemary leaves, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Marinate for at least 15 minutes at room temperature.
Thread meat onto skewers, alternating with onion pieces.
Preheat grill or grill pan to high heat.
Cook skewers 2-3 minutes per side for medium-rare, turning occasionally.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over skewers immediately after cooking.
Serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck instead of sirloin and cube it yourself
Skip expensive rosemary and use dried oregano from the pantry

recipes.name: Murg Malaiwala Tikka
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
Mix Greek yogurt, cream, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, cumin, chili powder, lemon juice, and salt in a bowl.
Add chicken pieces and coat evenly with marinade; refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Working in batches, cook marinated chicken 6-8 minutes until golden and cooked through, stirring occasionally.
Return all chicken to the pan and simmer for 3-4 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and spices as needed.
Serve hot with basmati rice or naan.
cheapTips: Use boneless chicken thighs instead of breast for richer flavor at lower cost
Buy spices from bulk section instead of pre-packaged bottles

recipes.name: Brocheta
recipes.description: Moroccan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice onion and chop cilantro.
Combine ground beef, onion, cilantro, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Divide mixture into 8 equal portions and mold each around a metal skewer, forming long cylinders.
Refrigerate molded brochetas for 15 minutes if time allows.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook brochetas 8-10 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes until meat is cooked through and browned on all sides.
Serve immediately on skewers with lemon wedges and bread.
cheapTips: Use 80/20 ground beef instead of lean to reduce cost
Skip fresh cilantro and use dried parsley from pantry

recipes.name: Piquillo Peppers
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic cloves finely.
Mix ricotta, grated manchego, minced garlic, salt, and pepper in a bowl until well combined.
Carefully open piquillo peppers and drain any liquid.
Spoon cheese mixture into each pepper using a small spoon, filling gently to avoid tearing.
Arrange filled peppers in a shallow baking dish.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Bake at 375°F for 12-15 minutes until heated through and tops are lightly golden.
Serve warm as an appetizer or light main course.
cheapTips: Use jarred roasted red peppers instead of piquillo for 40% savings
Substitute ricotta with cream cheese mixed with a bit of milk

recipes.name: Bharwan Baingan
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash eggplants and make a slit lengthwise without cutting completely through, leaving stem intact.
Dice onions finely and chop green chilies.
Heat oil in a large pan and add cumin seeds until they crackle.
Add onions and fry until golden brown, then add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies.
Stir in coriander powder, turmeric powder, and salt, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Divide the filling evenly and stuff each eggplant slit generously with the cooked mixture.
Arrange stuffed eggplants in the same pan and cover with a lid.
Cook over medium heat for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until eggplants are soft and tender.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with rice or roti.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants in season at farmer's markets for 50% less
Make ginger-garlic paste at home by blending fresh ingredients

recipes.name: Kousa Mahshi
recipes.description: Syrian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash zucchini and use a melon baller or small knife to hollow out the centers, leaving thin walls intact.
Finely chop the scooped zucchini flesh.
Brown ground beef with diced onion and minced garlic in a skillet, then stir in rice and chopped zucchini.
Season the filling with salt and pepper, then stuff mixture into hollowed zucchini using a spoon.
Arrange stuffed zucchini seam-side down in a large pot.
Mix tomato sauce and beef broth together and pour over the zucchini.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and cover with a lid.
Simmer for 35-40 minutes until zucchini is tender and rice is fully cooked.
Serve hot in bowls with some broth.
cheapTips: Use ground turkey instead of beef to save money
Buy rice in bulk and use generic tomato sauce

recipes.name: Tomates Farcies
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cut off tomato tops and hollow out centers with a spoon, reserving pulp; sprinkle interiors with salt.
Dice onion and mince garlic, then sauté in olive oil until softened.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into small pieces.
Mix in breadcrumbs, cheese, egg, reserved tomato pulp, salt, and pepper.
Divide filling evenly among hollowed tomatoes and place in a greased baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until tomatoes are tender and filling is cooked through.
Serve warm, optionally garnished with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Use ground chuck instead of premium ground beef
Substitute Gruyère with cheddar or even mozzarella

recipes.name: Poivrons Farcis
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cut off pepper tops and remove seeds and membranes, reserving tops.
Dice onion and mince garlic, then sauté in olive oil until fragrant.
Add ground pork and cook until browned, breaking into pieces.
Stir in cooked rice, tomato sauce, salt, and pepper; simmer for 5 minutes.
Fill each pepper cavity with the meat and rice mixture.
Place peppers upright in a baking dish, top each with cheese, and cover loosely with foil.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until peppers are tender and tops are golden brown.
Serve hot.
cheapTips: Use ground beef or turkey instead of pork
Skip cheese topping or use budget cheddar instead of Emmental

recipes.name: Melanzane alla Siciliana
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplants into 0.5-inch thick slices and salt generously; let sit 15 minutes to remove moisture.
Pat eggplant slices dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry eggplant slices in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden; drain on paper towels.
Mince garlic and chop olives and capers.
In the same skillet, sauté garlic until fragrant, then add tomato sauce, olives, capers, and red wine vinegar.
Simmer sauce for 5 minutes, then layer eggplant slices back into the sauce.
Cook together for 5 more minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with fresh basil.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants when on sale and freeze portioned slices
Use generic canned tomato sauce instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Tomatoes Stuffed with Rice and Meat
recipes.description: Palestinian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut off the top of each tomato and scoop out the insides with a spoon, reserving the pulp and setting hollowed tomatoes aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pan and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant.
Add ground beef to the pan, breaking it apart as it browns, then stir in tomato paste and cumin.
Mix in uncooked rice and reserved tomato pulp, stirring constantly for 2 minutes.
Stuff each tomato cavity generously with the meat and rice mixture and arrange them upright in a baking dish.
Pour vegetable broth around the tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, cover with foil, and bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes until tomatoes are tender.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use ground turkey instead of beef to reduce cost
Buy tomatoes in season or on sale and freeze the pulp for later use

recipes.name: Meat Pie
recipes.description: Australian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan and sauté diced onion until softened.
Add ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks until browned, then dust with flour and stir well.
Pour in beef broth and tomato sauce, add worcestershire sauce, and simmer for 15 minutes until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper, then transfer the filling to a pie dish and let cool slightly.
Cover the filling with the top pie crust, pressing edges to seal, and cut steam vents on top.
Beat the egg and brush over the crust for a golden finish.
Bake at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until the crust is golden brown and filling bubbles at the edges.
cheapTips: Buy store-bought pie crust to save time and money
Use ground chuck instead of premium beef cuts

recipes.name: Chicken Pot Pie
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Poach chicken breasts in water for 15 minutes, remove, cool, and shred into bite-sized pieces.
Melt butter in a large pot and sauté diced onion until translucent.
Whisk in flour to create a roux, cooking for 1 minute while stirring constantly.
Gradually add chicken broth and cream, whisking to avoid lumps, and simmer until thickened.
Stir in shredded chicken, frozen vegetables, thyme, salt, and pepper, and transfer to a pie dish.
Top with pie crust, seal edges, and cut vents for steam to escape.
Bake at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until crust is golden and filling bubbles at edges.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the store instead of poaching fresh breasts
Make filling a day ahead to save time on cooking day

recipes.name: Tourte
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder, veal, and liver into small cubes and mince shallots and garlic.
Sauté minced aromatics in a pan until fragrant, then add meats and brown on all sides.
Deglaze the pan with brandy, scraping up browned bits, then add thyme and bay leaf.
Simmer the mixture for 20 minutes until cooked through, then stir in cream and cool completely.
Divide the filling into a terrine or loaf pan lined with some of the puff pastry.
Top with remaining pastry, seal edges by pressing firmly, and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 375°F for 45-50 minutes until the pastry is golden and a meat thermometer reads 165°F.
Cool to room temperature before slicing and serving.
cheapTips: Substitute store-bought puff pastry to save preparation time and money
Use chicken thighs instead of veal for a cheaper option

recipes.name: Moussaka Pie
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice eggplants lengthwise and fry in olive oil until golden, then set on paper towels.
Brown ground beef with diced onion and garlic, then add tomato sauce and cinnamon, simmering for 10 minutes.
Make béchamel sauce by melting butter, whisking in flour, then gradually adding milk while stirring constantly.
Remove béchamel from heat, whisk in beaten eggs and crumbled feta cheese until smooth.
Layer eggplant slices in a baking dish, spread meat sauce over them, then pour béchamel on top.
Bake at 375°F for 40-45 minutes until the top is golden and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.
cheapTips: Use ground turkey instead of lamb to reduce costs
Buy eggplants when they're in season for better prices

recipes.name: Chicken Parmo
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Set up three bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs, then coat each chicken breast in order.
Heat oil in a large skillet and fry breaded chicken for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown.
Warm tomato sauce in a saucepan with minced garlic and oregano for 5 minutes.
Place fried chicken on a baking sheet, top each with tomato sauce and mozzarella cheese.
