cheapTips: Buy vegetables in season or from the clearance section for significant savings.
Buy pre-cut vegetables at a budget grocery store to save time without premium pricing.

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Meatballs and Vegetables
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a large sheet pan with foil.
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, diced onion, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl until just combined.
Form mixture into 16 meatballs and arrange on one side of the prepared sheet pan.
Toss bell peppers and zucchini with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread on the other side of the pan.
Roast for 15 minutes, then add marinara sauce to the meatballs and stir vegetables.
Roast for another 10-12 minutes until meatballs are cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Serve meatballs with vegetables and sauce over rice or pasta if desired.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand marinara sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Pork Chops and Apples
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with foil.
Pat pork chops dry and season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear pork chops for 2 minutes per side.
Transfer pork chops to the sheet pan and arrange sliced apples and onions around them.
Whisk together brown sugar, vinegar, mustard, and thyme, then drizzle over pork and apples.
Roast for 12-15 minutes until pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let rest for 3 minutes before serving with apples and pan juices.
cheapTips: Buy pork chops in bulk when on sale and freeze
Use regular apples instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Chicken Shawarma
recipes.description: Middle Eastern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with foil.
Combine olive oil, lemon juice, paprika, cumin, coriander, garlic, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Toss chicken strips with half the marinade and let sit for 10 minutes while preparing vegetables.
Spread onions on the sheet pan, drizzle with remaining marinade, and arrange chicken on top.
Roast for 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway through, until chicken is cooked through.
Warm pita bread in the oven during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Serve chicken and onions in warm pita with hummus, tahini sauce, and fresh vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts in bulk and freeze portions
Make your own tahini sauce instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Turkey Meatballs
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with foil.
Combine ground turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, garlic, onion, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Form mixture into 20 meatballs and arrange evenly on the prepared sheet pan.
Roast for 15 minutes until meatballs are mostly cooked through.
Pour marinara sauce over meatballs and top with shredded mozzarella.
Roast for another 8-10 minutes until cheese is melted and meatballs are fully cooked.
Serve with pasta, zucchini noodles, or crusty bread.
cheapTips: Ground turkey is often cheaper than ground beef
Use store-brand marinara and mozzarella to save money

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Cod with Lemon
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with parchment paper.
Toss green beans with 1.5 tbsp olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper, then spread on the sheet pan.
Roast green beans for 8 minutes until they start to soften.
Place cod fillets on top of green beans, arrange lemon slices on the fish, and surround with tomatoes.
Drizzle cod and tomatoes with remaining olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and add fresh lemon juice.
Roast for 10-12 minutes until cod is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy cod when it's on sale and freeze in portions
Use frozen green beans instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with foil.
Mix Greek yogurt, garam masala, paprika, turmeric, half the garlic, and salt in a bowl.
Coat chicken cubes with yogurt mixture and arrange on the prepared sheet pan.
Roast chicken for 15-18 minutes until partially cooked.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté onion, remaining garlic, and ginger until softened.
Stir in coconut milk and tomato sauce, simmer for 5 minutes, then pour sauce over roasted chicken.
Roast for another 10-12 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Serve with basmati rice or naan bread.
cheapTips: Buy spices from bulk sections instead of pre-packaged
Use regular yogurt instead of Greek yogurt if needed

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Roasted Chicken and Root Vegetables
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a large sheet pan with foil.
Toss potatoes, carrots, and parsnips with 1.5 tbsp olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper, then spread on the sheet pan.
Roast vegetables for 15 minutes to start cooking.
Pat chicken thighs dry and rub with remaining olive oil, salt, pepper, and fresh rosemary.
Arrange chicken thighs among the vegetables on the sheet pan.
Roast for 25-30 minutes until chicken skin is crispy and an instant-read thermometer reads 165°F in the thickest part.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Chicken thighs are cheaper than breasts and more flavorful
Buy root vegetables when in season for best prices

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Sausage and Broccoli
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a large sheet pan with foil.
Pierce sausage links and arrange on the prepared sheet pan.
Toss broccoli, bell pepper, onion, and garlic with olive oil, Italian seasoning, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Arrange vegetables around the sausages on the sheet pan.
Roast for 20-25 minutes, stirring vegetables halfway through, until sausages are browned and vegetables are tender.
Top with grated parmesan cheese and roast for another 2 minutes until cheese melts.
Serve immediately with crusty bread or over pasta.
cheapTips: Buy sausage in bulk and freeze for later
Skip the parmesan or use store-brand to save money

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Beef Taco Bowls
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a large sheet pan with foil.
Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into crumbles, then drain excess fat.
Toss bell pepper, onion, black beans, and corn with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread on the sheet pan.
Add cooked ground beef to the vegetables and sprinkle taco seasoning over everything, mixing well.
Roast for 10-15 minutes, stirring halfway through, until vegetables are tender.
Top with fresh cilantro and serve in bowls with desired toppings like cheese, salsa, sour cream, and avocado.
Squeeze lime juice over each bowl before eating.
cheapTips: Make homemade taco seasoning with spices instead of buying packets
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Lamb and Potatoes
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a large sheet pan with foil.
Toss potatoes, bell pepper, and red onion with 1.5 tbsp olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Spread vegetables on the prepared sheet pan and roast for 15 minutes until starting to soften.
Pat lamb chops dry and rub with remaining olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Arrange lamb chops on top of the partially roasted vegetables.
Roast for 15-20 minutes until lamb reaches desired doneness (internal temperature of 160°F for medium) and vegetables are tender.
Garnish with fresh mint and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy lamb when on sale and freeze for later use
Skip the fresh mint garnish if budget is tight

recipes.name: Italian Beef Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sear the beef chuck roast on all sides until browned, about 10 minutes total.
Add minced garlic, oregano, and red pepper flakes to the pot and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in beef broth, season with salt and pepper, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for 2.5 hours until the beef is extremely tender and shreds easily with a fork.
Remove beef and shred it finely, then return to the cooking liquid to absorb the flavors for 15 minutes.
Lightly toast the sub rolls and place a slice of provolone cheese on each.
Fill each roll with shredded beef using a slotted spoon to drain excess liquid, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck roast on sale and freeze for later
Use store-brand sub rolls instead of bakery options

recipes.name: Torta Mexicana
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the bolillo roll horizontally and spread mayonnaise on both cut sides.
Warm the refried beans and spread a thin layer on the bottom half of the roll.
Layer shredded roasted chicken, sliced oaxaca cheese, sliced avocado, tomato, and jalapeños on top of the beans.
Top with fresh cilantro and squeeze lime juice over the filling.
Close the sandwich with the top half of the roll and cut diagonally.
cheapTips: Buy rotisserie chicken and shred it yourself instead of deli counter
Use regular mozzarella if oaxaca cheese is unavailable

recipes.name: Milanesa Sandwich
recipes.description: Latin American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound to 1/4-inch thickness using a meat mallet.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour in the first, beaten eggs in the second, and panko breadcrumbs mixed with salt and pepper in the third.
Coat each chicken breast in flour, then dip in egg, then coat completely in seasoned panko breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry the breaded chicken for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and slice each milanesa into strips if desired.
Slice the rolls and spread mayonnaise on both halves.
Layer lettuce and tomato on the bottom half, top with milanesa, and close with the top half.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and pound yourself instead of buying pre-pounded cutlets
Use regular breadcrumbs instead of panko to save 20%

recipes.name: Panini al Tartufo
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice each ciabatta roll in half horizontally and lightly butter the inside surfaces.
Spread 1 tbsp of black truffle paste on the bottom half of each roll.
Layer 3 slices of prosciutto and 4 oz of fresh mozzarella di bufala on each bottom half.
Toss arugula with lemon juice, salt, and pepper, then distribute evenly on top of the cheese.
Close the sandwiches with the top halves of the rolls.
Heat a panini press or griddle to medium-high heat and cook sandwiches for 3-4 minutes, pressing gently, until bread is golden and cheese begins to melt.
cheapTips: Buy less expensive prosciutto from the deli counter instead of packaged slices
Use regular mozzarella instead of buffalo mozzarella to cut cost in half

recipes.name: Porchetta Sandwich
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Score the pork skin in a crosshatch pattern and pat dry with paper towels.
Chop rosemary, sage, and garlic together and mix with 2 tbsp olive oil, fennel seeds, salt, and pepper to create a paste.
Rub the herb mixture under and over the pork skin, then roll tightly and tie with kitchen twine at 2-inch intervals.
Place on a roasting pan, rub skin with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and salt, and roast at 450°F for 30 minutes until skin begins to crackle.
Reduce heat to 325°F and continue roasting for 3.5-4 hours until internal temperature reaches 190°F and skin is very crispy.
Rest for 15 minutes, then slice thinly and serve on toasted ciabatta rolls with fresh fennel greens.
Squeeze lemon over the meat before serving.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until needed
Make the full porchetta and freeze portions for multiple meals

recipes.name: Bocadillo de Jamón Ibérico
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the baguette in half horizontally and lightly brush the inside with olive oil.
Layer 4 slices of jamón ibérico on the bottom half of the bread.
Add sliced manchego cheese and roasted red peppers on top of the jamón.
Season with a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Close the sandwich with the top half of the baguette and press gently.
Cut into two portions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular Spanish ham instead of jamón ibérico to save $3 per serving
Buy roasted peppers from a jar instead of fresh to save time and money

recipes.name: Cacio e Pepe Panini
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat and add minced garlic, cooking until fragrant about 1 minute.
Add heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer, then slowly whisk in grated pecorino romano cheese and coarsely ground black pepper until smooth and creamy.
Season with salt to taste and remove from heat.
Slice the focaccia bread in half horizontally and layer prosciutto on the bottom half.
Pour the warm cacio e pepe sauce over the prosciutto and top with the other half of the bread.
Heat a panini press or skillet to medium-high heat and cook the sandwich for 3-4 minutes per side until bread is golden and cheese is hot.
cheapTips: Buy pre-grated pecorino romano instead of whole cheese to save 15%
Use less prosciutto to reduce cost without sacrificing much flavor

recipes.name: BLT
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon strips in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8-10 minutes, then drain on paper towels.
Toast the bread slices until golden brown and lightly butter them while still warm.
Spread mayonnaise on the inside of each bread slice.
Layer lettuce, tomato slices, and crispy bacon on two slices of bread, seasoning the tomato with salt and pepper.
Top with the remaining toasted bread slices, cut diagonally, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale in bulk and freeze for later
Use store-brand bread and mayo instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Katsu Sandwich
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place pork cutlets between plastic wrap and pound to 1/4-inch thickness using a meat mallet.
Season with salt and pepper, then set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and panko breadcrumbs respectively.
Coat each cutlet in flour, then egg, then panko breadcrumbs, pressing gently so coating adheres.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry the breaded pork for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and cut the katsu into strips.
Lightly butter the milk bread slices and toast if desired, then spread tonkatsu sauce on both slices.
Layer shredded cabbage and katsu strips on the bottom slice, top with the other slice, cut diagonally, and serve with extra tonkatsu sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Use chicken cutlets instead of pork to save $1 per serving
Make your own tonkatsu sauce by mixing ketchup, soy sauce, and Worcestershire sauce

recipes.name: Jibaritos
recipes.description: Puerto Rican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and slice green plantains lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick slabs.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and fry plantain slabs for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crispy, then drain on paper towels.
Season steak with recaíto, garlic powder, cumin, salt, and pepper, then pan-fry in a separate skillet for 2-3 minutes per side until cooked through.
Slice the cooked steak thinly.
While plantains are still warm and pliable, place two slices together and gently press to create a flat sandwich base.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each plantain sandwich, then layer with lettuce, tomato, cheese, and steak strips.
Close each sandwich and serve immediately while plantains are still warm.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of steak to save 30% on protein costs
Buy plantains in bulk when on sale and freeze sliced portions

recipes.name: Salmon Salad
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain the canned salmon and place it in a bowl, breaking it apart with a fork.
Finely dice the celery and red onion and add to the salmon.
Mix in mayonnaise, lemon juice, and dill until combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Divide mixed greens between two plates and top with salmon salad.
Serve alongside toasted whole wheat bread.
cheapTips: Buy canned salmon on sale and stock up; it lasts months.
Use store-brand mayo to reduce costs by 30%.

recipes.name: Tonnato
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain the canned tuna and place it in a food processor with mayonnaise, anchovies, lemon juice, capers, vinegar, and garlic.
Blend until smooth and creamy, adding a splash of water if too thick.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Arrange sliced veal or chicken on a serving platter.
Pour the tonnato sauce over the meat and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Garnish with fresh parsley and extra capers before serving.
cheapTips: Use chicken breast instead of veal to save 40% on protein cost.
Buy canned tuna in bulk online for better pricing.

recipes.name: Krab Salad
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop the crab meat into bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl.
Dice the bell pepper, cucumber, and red onion finely and add to the crab.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, and chopped cilantro.
Slice the Thai chili or jalapeño thinly and add to the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the crab mixture and toss gently.
Let it chill for 5 minutes, then serve on a bed of romaine lettuce.
cheapTips: Buy imitation crab on sale; it's significantly cheaper than real crab.
Use bottled lime juice if fresh limes are expensive.

recipes.name: Steak Salad
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season the sirloin steak generously with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the steak for 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare, then rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
While the steak rests, whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and minced garlic to make the dressing.
Combine mixed greens, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced red onion, and diced cucumber in a large bowl.
Toss the greens with the vinaigrette and divide between two plates.
Slice the steak and arrange on top of each salad, then sprinkle with cheddar cheese.
cheapTips: Buy sirloin when it's on sale and freeze for later use.
Use store-brand balsamic vinegar instead of premium brands.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
recipes.description: Mediterranean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse the canned chickpeas and place in a large bowl.
Dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, and chop the bell pepper and red onion.
Add the chopped vegetables, olives, and feta cheese to the chickpeas.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and let sit for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas in bulk; they're a budget protein staple.
Skip fresh feta and use a cheaper crumbled feta alternative.

recipes.name: Salad Nicoise with Tuna
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, about 12 minutes, then cut into quarters.
Trim the green beans and boil for 4 minutes until tender-crisp, then drain.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool and halve them.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, and Dijon mustard to make the dressing.
Arrange lettuce on two plates and create sections of potatoes, green beans, halved eggs, tomatoes, and onion.
Drain the tuna and place on top of each salad, drizzle with dressing, and scatter olives over everything.
cheapTips: Use canned tuna instead of fresh; it's significantly cheaper and works perfectly.
Buy potatoes and green beans on sale and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken Salad
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until golden and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes, then set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, minced garlic, chili flakes, and honey.
Chop the romaine lettuce and place in a large bowl with diced bell pepper and cucumber.
Add the cooked chicken and peanuts to the lettuce mixture.
Pour the dressing over the salad, toss well, and top with sliced green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale and freeze in portions.
Use store-brand soy sauce and sesame oil to cut costs.

recipes.name: Bento Box
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place cooked rice in one compartment of the bento box.
Cut the rotisserie chicken into bite-sized pieces and place in another compartment.
Slice the cucumber and julienne the carrot into thin strips.
Arrange the cucumber, carrot, edamame, and cherry tomatoes in separate compartments.
Cut the nori sheet into strips and place in the box.
Add a small cup for soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger on the side.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the grocery store deli instead of cooking your own.
Buy frozen edamame instead of fresh; it's cheaper and just as nutritious.

recipes.name: Fajita Bowl
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and chop the bell peppers and onion.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add the chicken, cooking until golden, about 6 minutes.
Add the peppers and onion to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle chili powder and cumin over the vegetables, stir well, and cook for 1 minute.
Drain and warm the black beans, then divide rice and beans between two bowls.
Top each bowl with the chicken and pepper mixture, then add cheese and cilantro, finishing with a squeeze of lime.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale and portion it before freezing.
Use canned black beans instead of cooking dried beans to save time and money.

recipes.name: Sushi Roll
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook sushi rice according to package directions and let cool to room temperature.
Mix rice vinegar, sugar, and salt together and stir into the cooled rice until well combined.
Lay a sheet of nori shiny side down on a bamboo sushi mat.
Spread a thin layer of seasoned rice evenly over the nori, leaving a ½-inch border at the top.
Arrange sliced cucumber, avocado, and crab meat in a line horizontally across the middle of the rice.
Using the mat, tightly roll the sushi away from you, sealing the edge with water.
Using a sharp, damp knife, cut the roll into 6-8 pieces and arrange on a plate.
Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger on the side.
cheapTips: Use imitation crab meat instead of real crab to save significantly.
Buy nori sheets and sushi rice in bulk at an Asian grocery store for better prices.

recipes.name: Empanadilla
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and 6 tablespoons butter until breadcrumb texture, then add warm water until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes, rest 15 minutes covered.
Sauté minced onion and garlic until soft, add ground beef and cook until browned.
Stir in chopped olives, raisins, paprika, and salt; cool completely.
Divide dough into 6 pieces and roll each thin into a circle.
Place 2 tablespoons filling on each circle, fold in half, and seal edges with a fork.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until golden.
Cool 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use ground beef on sale or substitute with ground chicken
Make larger batches and freeze unbaked empanadillas for later

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to boil in a large pot with diced onion, carrots, celery, and garlic.
Add whole chicken breast and simmer 15 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken, shred with forks, and set aside.
Add egg noodles to broth and cook 8 minutes until al dente.
Return shredded chicken to pot and stir in salt, pepper, and thyme.
Simmer 2 minutes, taste, and adjust seasoning.
Serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens on sale and use for both broth and meat
Use store-brand broth and noodles to save 30%

recipes.name: Dashi Broth
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wipe kombu gently with a damp cloth but do not wash.
Bring 4 cups water to a simmer in a pot, add kombu, and maintain gentle simmer for 8 minutes.
Remove kombu just before water boils vigorously.
Increase heat until small bubbles form, then turn off heat and add bonito flakes.
Let bonito flakes sink for 3 minutes without stirring.
Strain through fine mesh or cheesecloth, discarding solids.
Stir in salt and mirin, adjust to taste.
Use immediately or store refrigerated up to 3 days.
cheapTips: Buy kombu and bonito flakes from Asian markets for half the price of specialty stores
Save kombu and bonito solids to make a second weaker broth

recipes.name: Caldo de Pollo
recipes.description: Latin American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to boil in a large pot, add chicken thighs, diced onion, and minced garlic.
Simmer 15 minutes, skimming any foam from surface.
Dice potatoes and carrots, add to broth with cumin, salt, and pepper.
Simmer 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Add corn kernels and simmer 5 minutes more.
Remove chicken thighs and shred meat, discarding bones and skin.
Return shredded chicken to pot, stir in fresh cilantro.
Serve hot with lime wedges and extra cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts; they are cheaper and more flavorful in broth
Use frozen corn if fresh is expensive

recipes.name: Avgolemono
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to boil with diced onion, garlic, and whole chicken breast.
Simmer 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through, then remove and shred.
Add rice to broth and simmer 15 minutes until tender.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs and juice from 2 lemons.
Slowly ladle 1 cup hot broth into egg mixture while whisking constantly.
Remove pot from heat and pour egg mixture back into broth slowly while stirring.
Return shredded chicken to pot, add salt and white pepper, stir gently.
Serve garnished with fresh dill and lemon slices.
cheapTips: Buy eggs on sale and stock up for this economical protein-rich dish
Use bottled lemon juice if fresh lemons are expensive

recipes.name: Niçoise Salad
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes until fork-tender, about 10 minutes; cool and cut into chunks.
Trim green beans and boil 4 minutes until crisp-tender; drain and cool.
Boil eggs 10 minutes, cool, peel, and quarter.
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, mustard, and salt to make dressing.
Arrange romaine lettuce on plates or a large platter.
Arrange potatoes, green beans, tuna, eggs, tomatoes, onion, and olives in sections on lettuce.
Drizzle dressing over salad or serve on the side.
Toss gently and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned tuna in bulk when on sale
Substitute fresh green beans with frozen if fresher and cheaper

recipes.name: Salade Composée
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together mustard, vinegar, oil, and salt to make vinaigrette.
Boil eggs 10 minutes if not already done, cool, peel, and quarter.
Toss salad greens with half the vinaigrette and divide between plates.
Arrange ham strips, cheese cubes, egg quarters, diced tomato, sliced cucumber, and red onion on top of greens.
Drizzle remaining vinaigrette over salad.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use a more affordable Swiss cheese instead of Gruyere
Buy deli ham on sale and slice at home

recipes.name: Vietnamese Beef Salad
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season flank steak with salt and pepper, grill or pan-sear over high heat 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest steak 5 minutes, then slice against the grain into thin pieces.
Whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, minced garlic, sugar, and chile flakes for dressing.
Thinly slice red onion and submerge in cold water 5 minutes to reduce sharpness.
Toss salad greens with dressing and divide between plates.
Arrange warm beef slices, drained onion, jalapeño slices on top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and mint.
Serve immediately with extra lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy flank steak when on sale and freeze; it thaws quickly for this dish
Skip fresh herbs if expensive; dried versions work in dressing

recipes.name: Thai Larb
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast rice powder in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes until fragrant, then set aside.
Heat a large skillet over high heat and cook ground pork, breaking it apart, until fully cooked and no pink remains.
Mince garlic, serrano chile, and red onion very finely.
In a bowl, whisk together lime juice, fish sauce, and coconut milk.
Pour dressing over cooked pork and stir in minced garlic, chile, onion, and toasted rice powder.
Remove from heat and fold in fresh cilantro and mint.
Arrange lettuce leaves on a plate and spoon larb mixture into each leaf.
Serve immediately with extra lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale or grind your own from pork shoulder
Use regular breadcrumbs toasted in place of rice powder if unavailable

recipes.name: Salade Méridionale
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Chop tomatoes into chunks, removing excess seeds and juice.
Dice bell pepper and cucumber into bite-sized pieces.
Thinly slice red onion and soak in cold water 5 minutes.
Combine tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, drained onion, and olives in a large bowl.
Pour dressing over vegetables and gently toss.
Crumble feta cheese on top and tear fresh basil over salad.
Serve immediately or chill up to 2 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables in season at farmers' markets for better prices
Use store-brand feta cheese and olives

recipes.name: Omelette
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk together with salt, pepper, and chives until well combined.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until foaming.
Pour eggs into the skillet and let them set for 30 seconds without stirring.
Using a spatula, gently push cooked eggs toward the center, tilting the pan so uncooked eggs flow to the edges.
When eggs are mostly set but still slightly wet on top, sprinkle cheese over one half.
Fold the omelette in half and slide onto a plate.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale and store in the fridge.
Use any cheese scraps you have instead of pre-shredded.

recipes.name: Scotch Eggs
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a pot of water to boil and carefully add 8 eggs, cooking for 6 minutes until soft-boiled; cool in ice water and peel.
Mix ground sausage with salt and pepper in a bowl until evenly combined.
Divide sausage into 8 portions and flatten each into a thin patty on plastic wrap.
Place a peeled egg in the center of each patty and wrap sausage around it completely, sealing the seams.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten egg wash, and breadcrumbs respectively.
Roll each sausage-wrapped egg in flour, then egg wash, then breadcrumbs, pressing gently.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or pot and carefully fry eggs 3-4 minutes until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
cheapTips: Buy sausage in bulk and freeze portions.
Make your own breadcrumbs from stale bread.

recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs with Smoked Salmon
recipes.description: Scandinavian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together eggs, cream, salt, and pepper in a bowl until well combined.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour in egg mixture and let sit for 20 seconds without stirring.
Gently push eggs from the edges toward the center with a spatula, stirring slowly and continuously.
When eggs are almost set but still slightly creamy, remove from heat and stir in dill.
Fold in smoked salmon pieces gently and divide between two plates, topping with capers.
cheapTips: Buy smoked salmon trimmings instead of sliced for 30% savings.
Look for canned capers which are cheaper than jarred.

recipes.name: Congee with Century Egg
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse jasmine rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add rice.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add minced ginger, salt, and white pepper, stirring to combine.
Peel and quarter century eggs and divide among serving bowls.
Ladle hot congee over eggs and drizzle with sesame oil.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use vegetable broth instead of chicken broth to reduce cost.
Cook rice the night before and use leftover rice for faster prep.

recipes.name: Turkish Menemen with Cheese
recipes.description: Turkish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add chopped onions.
Cook onions for 2 minutes until softened, then add chopped peppers.
Sauté peppers for 3 minutes, then add diced tomatoes and cook for 3 more minutes.
Season the vegetable mixture with salt and pepper.
Create wells in the vegetable mixture and crack eggs directly into them.
Cover the skillet and cook until eggs are just set, about 5-7 minutes.
Scatter cheese over the top and cover for 1 minute until melted.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use whatever cheese you have on hand instead of kaseri.
Buy peppers and tomatoes when in season or on sale and freeze.

recipes.name: Sabich
recipes.description: Israeli breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil eggs for 8-10 minutes until hard-boiled, cool, peel, and slice.
Cut potato into thin rounds and fry in olive oil until golden and tender, about 15 minutes; drain on paper towels.
Cut eggplant lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices and brush with olive oil.
Roast eggplant slices at 400°F for 20 minutes until soft and lightly browned.
Whisk together tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and water to create a smooth sauce.
Warm pita bread in a skillet or oven for 1 minute until soft.
Arrange fried potatoes, roasted eggplant, and hard-boiled egg slices on opened pita.
Drizzle tahini sauce generously over the filling and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make tahini sauce from sesame seeds if tahini is unavailable.
Use store-brand pita and tahini to cut costs.

recipes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice with Egg
recipes.description: Korean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and chopped kimchi, stir-frying for 1 minute.
Add day-old rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce and sesame oil, tossing everything together for 1 minute.
Push rice to the sides of the skillet, creating a well in the center.
Add remaining oil and crack eggs into the well, scrambling until just cooked.
Mix scrambled eggs into the rice and stir in green onions.
Taste and adjust salt if needed, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Cook rice in bulk and refrigerate to always have cold rice ready.
Use kimchi liquid in the rice for extra flavor instead of discarding.

recipes.name: Irish Coddle
recipes.description: Irish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crispy, about 5 minutes; remove and set aside.
Brown sausages in the same pot for 5 minutes on all sides; remove and set aside.
Add diced potatoes and sliced onions to the pot and sauté for 3 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and season with salt and pepper.
Return bacon and sausages to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy bacon ends and pieces instead of whole slices for 40% savings.
Use bulk sausages instead of individual links.

recipes.name: Steak and Eggs
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove steaks from refrigerator 15 minutes before cooking and pat dry with paper towels.
Season both sides of steaks generously with salt and pepper.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until very hot.
Sear steaks for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, basting with 1 tablespoon butter, garlic, and thyme.
Transfer steaks to a plate and tent with foil to rest for 5 minutes.
In the same skillet, melt remaining butter over medium heat.
Crack eggs into the skillet and cook until whites are set but yolks remain runny, about 4 minutes.
Divide steaks and eggs between two plates and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy cheaper cuts like sirloin tip instead of ribeye.
Purchase steaks at warehouse clubs like Costco for better pricing.

recipes.name: Feta and Spinach Pie
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and brush a 9x13 inch baking dish with melted butter.
Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet and sauté diced onion until softened.
Add fresh spinach to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until wilted and any liquid has evaporated; cool slightly.
Mix cooled spinach, crumbled feta, ricotta, egg, salt, pepper, and nutmeg in a large bowl until well combined.
Layer 3-4 sheets of phyllo dough in the baking dish, brushing each lightly with melted butter.
Spread spinach-cheese filling evenly over the phyllo layer.
Layer remaining phyllo sheets on top, brushing each with melted butter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Cool for 10 minutes before cutting into squares and serving.
cheapTips: Substitute frozen spinach for fresh to save 50% and reduce prep time.
Buy phyllo dough at discount grocers or ethnic markets for better prices.

recipes.name: Cheddar Jalapeño Burger
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Divide ground beef into 4 equal portions and form into patties about 3/4 inch thick, making a small indent in the center with your thumb.
Slice jalapeños into thin rings and remove seeds for less heat if desired.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side until a thermometer reads 160°F.
Place one cheddar slice on each patty during the last minute of cooking and cover to melt.
Toast hamburger buns lightly in the skillet or toaster.
Spread mayonnaise on both bun halves and layer lettuce, tomato slice, and red onion on the bottom half.
Top with the cheeseburger patty and jalapeño slices, then add the top bun and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand cheddar cheese instead of name brands

recipes.name: Wrap
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 15 seconds per side until pliable.
Lay each tortilla flat and spread 2 tablespoons of hummus evenly across the surface.
Layer half of the turkey slices and one cheese slice on each tortilla.
Add mixed greens, sliced cucumber, diced bell pepper, and tomato slices in a line down the center.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Fold in the left and right sides of the tortilla about 2 inches, then roll tightly from the bottom up.
Wrap in foil if eating later, or serve immediately cut in half diagonally.
cheapTips: Buy deli turkey on sale and slice it yourself instead of pre-sliced
Use store-brand hummus to save 30-40%

recipes.name: Enchilada
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Brown ground beef in a skillet with diced onion and minced garlic over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, then drain excess fat and season with salt and pepper.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for about 15 seconds each to make them pliable.
Pour 1/2 cup of enchilada sauce into the bottom of the prepared baking dish.
Fill each tortilla with 2-3 tablespoons of the meat mixture and 2 tablespoons of cheese, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in the baking dish.
Pour remaining enchilada sauce over the rolled tortillas and sprinkle remaining cheese evenly on top.
Bake uncovered for 20-25 minutes until bubbly and golden, then top with sour cream and cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Make your own enchilada sauce with canned tomatoes and chili powder to save money
Buy cheese in bulk and shred it yourself instead of pre-shredded

recipes.name: Maki
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cooked sushi rice with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt while still warm and let cool to room temperature.
Place a nori sheet shiny-side down on a bamboo sushi mat.
Spread a thin layer of cooled sushi rice over the nori, leaving a 1/2 inch strip at the top.
Mix drained tuna with mayonnaise, then arrange tuna and thin cucumber strips in a line in the center of the rice.
Roll tightly using the bamboo mat, wetting the exposed nori strip with water to seal the roll.
Remove from mat and slice the roll into 6-8 pieces with a sharp wet knife using a gentle sawing motion.
Serve with soy sauce and wasabi on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy canned tuna instead of fresh to cut costs significantly
Purchase nori sheets and rice vinegar at Asian markets for better prices

recipes.name: Bánh Mì
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice daikon and carrot into thin matchsticks and toss with soy sauce, then let sit for 5 minutes to soften.
Cut the baguette in half lengthwise and hollow out some of the soft interior to make room for fillings.
Spread mayonnaise on the top half and pâté on the bottom half of the baguette.
Layer ham slices on the bottom half, then add the pickled daikon and carrot mixture.
Arrange thin cucumber slices and fresh cilantro on top, then add sliced jalapeño.
Close the sandwich by pressing the top half onto the bottom half firmly.
Wrap in parchment paper and cut in half diagonally to serve.
cheapTips: Buy day-old baguettes from the bakery section for 50% off
Use liverwurst instead of pâté for significant savings

recipes.name: Taco
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, for about 5-7 minutes.
Drain excess fat from the beef and add taco seasoning with 1/4 cup water, stirring until evenly coated.
Simmer for 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Warm taco shells according to package directions, either in the oven or in a dry skillet.
Dice onion and tomato and set all toppings in separate small bowls for easy assembly.
Fill each warm shell with 2-3 tablespoons of seasoned beef.
Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, and other desired toppings, then serve with salsa and sour cream on the side.
cheapTips: Make your own taco seasoning with cumin, chili powder, and paprika to save 70%
Buy ground beef in bulk when on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Crêpe Suzette
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour and salt in a bowl, then create a well in the center and add eggs.
Gradually add milk while stirring from the center outward until smooth, then whisk in 2 tablespoons melted butter and vanilla extract.
Let batter rest for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Heat an 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat, lightly butter it, and pour 1/4 cup batter, tilting the pan to spread evenly.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until the bottom is light golden, then flip and cook the other side for 15 seconds, then transfer to a plate.
Repeat with remaining batter, stacking the finished crêpes.
Zest the orange and combine with remaining butter, sugar, lemon juice, and brandy if using in a saucepan over low heat until melted and warm.
Fold each crêpe into quarters and arrange on serving plates, pour the warm sauce over them, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip the brandy and add extra orange zest for the same flavor without the cost
Make crêpes ahead and freeze between parchment paper for easy reheating

recipes.name: Egg Roll
recipes.description: Chinese-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown ground pork, breaking it apart, for 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger to the pork and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Shred carrot and add cabbage and carrots to the skillet with soy sauce and sesame oil, cooking for 3-4 minutes until softened but still slightly crisp.
Cool the filling slightly, then place about 2 tablespoons in the corner of each egg roll wrapper.
Fold the corner over the filling, fold in the left and right sides, then roll tightly and seal with a dab of water on the final edge.
Heat 2 cups vegetable oil in a deep skillet or pot to 350°F.
Carefully place egg rolls in the hot oil, frying in batches of 3-4 until golden brown on all sides, about 3-4 minutes total, then drain on paper towels.
cheapTips: Use ground turkey or chicken instead of pork for a lower-cost option
Buy egg roll wrappers at Asian markets for cheaper prices than mainstream grocery stores

recipes.name: Crepinette
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely mince pork liver and onion, then combine with ground pork in a bowl.
Add minced garlic, breadcrumbs, egg, thyme, salt, and pepper, mixing gently until just combined without overworking.
Soak caul fat in warm water for 3-4 minutes to soften, then gently spread out on a cutting board.
Divide the pork mixture into 6 portions and shape each into a small oval patty about 3 inches long.
Wrap each patty in a piece of caul fat, tucking the edges underneath to secure.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and cook the crepinettes for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to a 350°F oven and bake for 10-12 minutes until cooked through to an internal temperature of 160°F, then serve with a pan sauce or mustard.
cheapTips: Ask your butcher counter for caul fat scraps, which are often free or very cheap
Use ground pork from budget packs and add chicken liver instead of pork liver for savings

recipes.name: Roti Canai Roll
recipes.description: Malaysian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and sugar in a bowl, then add warm water and 1 tablespoon oil to form a soft dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, then cover and let rest for 15 minutes.
Divide dough into 2 portions and roll each into a thin circle on an oiled surface.
Drizzle 1 tablespoon oil over each circle and spread evenly, then roll up tightly and coil into a spiral shape.
Let the coiled dough rest for 5 minutes, then gently flatten each coil into a thin pancake on an oiled surface.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook each roti for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy, brushing with butter.
Brush with sweetened condensed milk while warm and sprinkle with sesame seeds, or serve plain for savory use with diced onions.
cheapTips: Skip sesame seeds or use a small amount to save money
Make plain with salt only instead of sweet condensed milk for even cheaper breakfast

recipes.name: Vegetable Tempura
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a large pot or deep fryer.
Whisk together flour, cornstarch, salt, and egg in a bowl, then gradually add ice water until batter is thin and smooth.
Cut zucchini, sweet potato, carrot into 1/4-inch thick slices and break broccoli into florets.
Dip vegetables into batter until fully coated and carefully place into hot oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy, turning once.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with soy sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy seasonal vegetables at discount stores like Aldi to save 30-40%
Use neutral oil like canola instead of specialty tempura oil

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cut the tops off peppers and remove seeds and membranes.
Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat with diced onion and minced garlic for 5 minutes.
Stir in cooked rice, canned tomatoes, and 1/2 cup beef broth, then simmer for 3 minutes.
Fill each pepper with the meat and rice mixture, then place in a greased baking dish.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Top with shredded cheddar cheese and bake uncovered for 5 more minutes until cheese melts.
cheapTips: Use ground beef on sale and freeze until ready to cook
Buy generic canned tomatoes instead of name brands

recipes.name: Saag Aloo
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes and boil for 10 minutes until partially cooked, then drain.
Heat oil in a large pan and add cumin seeds, letting them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add diced onion and sauté for 3 minutes until soft, then add minced garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute more.
Add diced tomatoes, turmeric, and garam masala, cooking for 3 minutes until tomatoes break down.
Add the boiled potatoes and stir well, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add fresh spinach in batches, stirring until wilted, then pour in coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy spinach frozen instead of fresh to save money
Purchase whole spices in bulk from Indian markets

recipes.name: Vegetable Pad Thai
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 10 minutes until softened, then drain.
Press tofu with paper towels and cut into 1/2-inch cubes.
Heat 2 tablespoons peanut oil in a wok or large pan over high heat and add minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add tofu cubes and cook for 3 minutes until lightly browned, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry bell pepper, carrots, and broccoli for 4 minutes.
Add soaked noodles, tamarind paste, fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar, stirring constantly for 3 minutes.
Add cooked tofu back in and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Garnish with crushed peanuts and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy tamarind concentrate in bulk from Asian markets instead of small jars
Substitute fish sauce with soy sauce if budget is tight

recipes.name: Halloumi Saganaki
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice halloumi cheese into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Beat egg in a shallow bowl and place flour in another shallow bowl.
Dip each cheese slice into flour, then into beaten egg, then back into flour.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry coated cheese slices for 1-2 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over warm cheese and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy halloumi from warehouse clubs like Costco for better pricing
Use canola oil instead of olive oil for frying to save cost

recipes.name: Minestrone Soup
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and add diced onion, carrots, and celery, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in vegetable broth and canned tomatoes with juice, bringing to a boil.
Add diced zucchini and drained white beans, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add pasta and cook for 8 minutes until al dente.
Stir in fresh spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand vegetables and canned goods to reduce cost
Use frozen spinach instead of fresh to save money and reduce waste

recipes.name: Vegetable Moussaka
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and slice eggplant and zucchini lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick strips.
Brush vegetable slices with olive oil and bake on two baking sheets for 20 minutes until softened.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Make béchamel sauce by melting butter, whisking in flour to form a paste, then slowly add milk while stirring constantly, cooking until thickened, then season with nutmeg.
Layer half the eggplant and zucchini in a 9x13 baking dish, spread tomato sauce over it, then layer remaining vegetables.
Pour béchamel sauce over the top, sprinkle feta cheese, and bake for 30-35 minutes until golden and bubbly.
cheapTips: Skip feta and use ricotta cheese as a cheaper alternative
Buy store-brand canned tomatoes to cut costs in half

recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs with Toast
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast bread in a toaster until golden brown and set aside.
Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk together with milk, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour egg mixture into the skillet and let sit for 20 seconds, then gently push eggs from edges toward center using a spatula.
Continue stirring every 20 seconds for 2-3 minutes until eggs are creamy and just set.
Divide scrambled eggs between two plates and serve alongside toast.
Garnish with fresh chives if desired.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk from warehouse stores to reduce cost per egg
Use store-brand bread on sale instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk together with milk, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until foamy.
Pour egg mixture into the skillet and wait 20 seconds without stirring.
Using a spatula, gently push cooked eggs from the edges toward the center, allowing uncooked liquid to flow to the edges.
Continue folding and stirring every 20 seconds for 2-3 minutes until eggs are creamy and just set.
Transfer to plates and serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale and store in refrigerator
Use margarine instead of butter to save money

recipes.name: Eggs Royale
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast English muffins until golden brown and divide between two plates.
Place a poaching pan with water and a splash of vinegar over medium heat until simmering.

Make hollandaise sauce by whisking 2 tablespoons melted butter, flour, and milk together in a saucepan over medium heat until thickened, then remove from heat and whisk in 1 tablespoon cold butter and lemon juice, season with salt and cayenne.
Crack each egg into a small cup and gently slide into the simmering water, poaching for 3-4 minutes until whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Layer smoked salmon on each toasted muffin half.
Top each with a poached egg using a slotted spoon.
Pour hollandaise sauce over the eggs, garnish with fresh dill, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use farmed salmon instead of wild-caught to reduce cost significantly
Make hollandaise ahead of time and reheat gently in double boiler

recipes.name: Tom Yum Soup
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot over high heat.
Bruise lemongrass stalks and add to broth along with galangal slices and whole chilies; simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp and mushrooms, cooking 3-4 minutes until shrimp turn pink.
Stir in diced tomatoes and simmer 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add lime juice and fish sauce, tasting and adjusting seasonings.
Strain out solids if desired or leave in for texture.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp instead of fresh to save 30%
Use powdered galangal if fresh is unavailable and cheaper

recipes.name: Boeuf à la Stroganoff
recipes.description: Russian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil for noodles.
Season beef cubes with salt and pepper, then brown in batches in 2 tablespoons butter over medium-high heat; set aside.
In the same pot, sauté sliced onions and mushrooms in remaining butter for 5 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables, stir well, and cook 1 minute.
Add beef broth and tomato paste, stirring to combine, then return beef to pot.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 30 minutes until beef is tender.
Meanwhile, cook egg noodles according to package directions; drain and set aside.
Remove stroganoff from heat, stir in sour cream and Worcestershire sauce without boiling.
Serve stroganoff over warm noodles with fresh parsley if available.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of cubed chuck to reduce cost by 40%
Buy mushrooms in bulk and freeze extras

recipes.name: Tagine de Mouton aux Pruneaux
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot or tagine over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb cubes in batches, about 3 minutes per side; set aside.
Add diced onions to the pot and sauté 5 minutes until golden.
Stir in ginger, cumin, and coriander, cooking 1 minute until fragrant.
Return lamb to pot and add broth, cinnamon stick, salt, and pepper; bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low heat for 45 minutes until lamb is nearly tender.
Add prunes and honey, then cook uncovered for 15 minutes to allow sauce to reduce slightly.
Taste and adjust seasonings, then serve hot with couscous or bread.
cheapTips: Substitute lamb with beef chuck to save 50% on cost
Buy prunes in bulk from Middle Eastern markets

recipes.name: Braised Oxtail
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat oxtail dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, then brown oxtail pieces in batches for 3-4 minutes per side; set aside.
Add diced onion, carrots, and celery to the pot; sauté 5 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables, stir well, and cook 1 minute.
Add tomato paste and stir, cooking 2 minutes, then deglaze with red wine scraping up browned bits.
Return oxtail to pot and add beef broth, bay leaves, and thyme sprigs; bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook in a 325°F oven for 2.5 to 3 hours until meat is very tender and falling off the bone.
Skim fat from surface, discard bay leaves and thyme, then serve hot with mashed potatoes or crusty bread.
cheapTips: Oxtail is naturally affordable; buy in bulk and freeze portions
Skip wine and use extra broth to reduce cost by $2

recipes.name: Mole Negro
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from dried chilies, then toast in a dry skillet 30 seconds per side; soak in 1 cup hot water for 15 minutes.
Blend soaked chilies with their soaking liquid, onion, garlic, cocoa powder, peanut butter, cumin, and cinnamon until smooth.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and strain the chile mixture through it, pressing solids with a spoon; discard pulp.
Cook the mole paste in oil for 5 minutes, stirring often, until darkened and fragrant.
Add chicken broth and salt, stirring well to combine.
Add chicken thighs and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer 40 minutes until chicken is cooked through and tender.
Serve with rice and warm tortillas, garnishing with sesame seeds if available.
cheapTips: Buy dried chilies in bulk from Mexican markets to save 50%
Make large batches and freeze extra mole sauce for future meals

recipes.name: Jjigae
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat sesame oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add sliced pork and cook 3 minutes until no longer pink; push to the side.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds, then add diced onion and sauté 2 minutes.
Stir in gochugaru and sauté 1 minute until fragrant.
Add kimchi and kimchi juice, stirring well and cooking 3 minutes.
Pour in water or broth and soy sauce, then bring to a simmer.
Add tofu cubes and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
Taste and adjust seasonings, then top with sliced green onions and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy store-made kimchi rather than making from scratch to save time and cost
Use ground pork instead of sliced belly to save 30%

recipes.name: Polenta
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring milk and broth to a boil in a large pot with onion and garlic; strain out solids.
Slowly whisk in polenta cornmeal in a thin stream, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat to low and continue stirring frequently for 30-35 minutes until polenta pulls away from the sides of the pot.
Stir in butter and parmesan cheese until fully incorporated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté mushrooms until golden; season with salt and pepper.
Pour creamy polenta into bowls or spread on a platter, top with sautéed mushrooms, and drizzle with olive oil.
cheapTips: Buy polenta cornmeal in bulk from ethnic markets for 60% less
Skip mushrooms and top with canned tomato sauce to save $1

recipes.name: Paella Negra
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 1 lb cleaned and cut into rings

steps: Heat broth in a separate pot and keep warm; steep saffron threads in 1/4 cup of warm broth.
Heat olive oil in a 14-inch paella pan over medium-high heat and sauté squid for 2-3 minutes until it releases its ink and begins to cook; remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté diced onion and garlic for 3 minutes until softened.
Add rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes to toast lightly.
Pour in white wine and stir until mostly absorbed.
Add warm broth one cup at a time, stirring occasionally and allowing rice to absorb liquid before adding more, about 15-20 minutes total.
Stir in squid ink, cooked squid, paprika, and the saffron with its soaking liquid; arrange mussels on top.
Cook 5 minutes until mussels open (discard any that don't), rice is tender, and liquid is mostly absorbed.
Remove from heat, cover with foil, let rest 5 minutes, then serve with fresh lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Substitute half the squid with shrimp to reduce cost by 30%
Skip saffron and use additional paprika for similar color at fraction of cost

recipes.name: Dolmas
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using fresh grape leaves, blanch in boiling water for 30 seconds and cool; if jarred, rinse and pat dry.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil and sauté diced onion and garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in ground meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes; drain fat if needed.
Remove from heat and mix in rice, mint, dill, salt, and pepper.
Place a grape leaf shiny-side down and spoon 2 tablespoons filling near the stem end; fold sides over filling and roll tightly.
Arrange seam-side down in a baking dish, stacking in rows.
Pour broth and remaining olive oil mixed with lemon juice over dolmas.
Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 45-50 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Serve warm or at room temperature with plain yogurt if desired.
cheapTips: Buy jarred grape leaves instead of fresh to save 50% and eliminate prep time
Use ground beef instead of lamb to reduce cost by 35%

recipes.name: Agedashi Tofu
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat tofu blocks completely dry with paper towels, then cut into 8 cubes.
Dust tofu pieces evenly with potato starch until fully coated; shake off excess.
Heat oil in a deep pan or wok to 350°F; fry tofu cubes in batches 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy; drain on paper towels.
In a small saucepan, whisk together dashi broth, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar; bring to a simmer.
Arrange fried tofu cubes in a serving bowl and pour hot sauce over top.
Garnish with sliced green onion, grated ginger, and bonito flakes; serve immediately while hot and crispy.
cheapTips: Use cornstarch instead of potato starch to save cost with same result
Skip bonito flakes or use less; tofu is delicious without them

recipes.name: Scotch Egg
recipes.description: British snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil 4 eggs for 7 minutes until soft-boiled, then cool in ice water and peel carefully.
Mix ground pork with salt, pepper, sage, and breadcrumbs until combined.
Divide pork mixture into 4 portions and wrap each around a peeled egg, sealing completely.
Set up three bowls with flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs respectively.
Roll each pork-wrapped egg in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan or use a deep fryer.
Carefully fry each Scotch egg for 4-5 minutes until golden brown, turning occasionally.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy eggs on sale and freeze unused ones boiled for later use
Use store-brand breadcrumbs instead of panko to save 30%

recipes.name: Tamago Sushi
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a non-stick tamagoyaki pan or small skillet over medium heat and lightly oil it.
Whisk 2 eggs with 1 tbsp mirin and 1 tbsp soy sauce until smooth.
Pour a thin layer of egg mixture into the hot pan and let it cook for 30 seconds until set.
Roll the cooked egg layer toward you, then push back to the far end and pour more mixture underneath, repeating until all egg is used.
Let the rolled tamago cool slightly, then wrap in nori and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Mix cooked sushi rice with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Form rice into small oval mounds and top each with a tamago slice, securing with a thin nori strip.
Serve immediately with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger on the side.
cheapTips: Buy rice vinegar and mirin in bulk from Asian markets for 50% less
Make sushi rice at home instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Soufflé
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 2-cup soufflé dish or ramekins.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a saucepan, then whisk in flour to create a roux and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add milk while whisking constantly to avoid lumps, then simmer for 2 minutes until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in cheese, salt, pepper, and nutmeg until melted.
Separate eggs and whisk yolks into the cheese sauce until combined.
In a clean bowl, beat egg whites with a pinch of salt until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold egg whites into the cheese mixture in two additions until no white streaks remain.
Pour into prepared dish and bake 20-25 minutes until puffed and lightly golden on top.
Serve immediately while still puffed.
cheapTips: Substitute gruyere with sharp cheddar for 40% savings
Buy eggs from a discount grocer or farmer's market

recipes.name: Huevos al Nido
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a muffin tin with butter.
Flatten each bread slice with a rolling pin to make it pliable.
Press one flattened bread slice into each muffin cup, creating a nest shape.
Divide half the shredded cheese evenly among the bread nests.
Carefully crack one egg into the center of each nest over the cheese.
Top with remaining cheese, salt, pepper, and green onions.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Cool for 2 minutes before removing from tin with a fork and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use day-old or discount bread from bakery clearance
Substitute cheddar with store-brand cheese or leftover scraps

recipes.name: Eggs en Cocotte
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Butter two ramekins or small baking dishes generously.
Pour 2 tbsp heavy cream into each ramekin.
Carefully crack 2 eggs into each ramekin over the cream.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and half the cheese.
Place ramekins in a baking dish filled with hot water halfway up their sides (water bath).
Bake for 12-15 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain soft.
Top with remaining cheese and chives, then serve immediately in the ramekin with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use half-and-half instead of heavy cream to cut cost by 30%
Buy eggs in bulk when on sale and store in the fridge

recipes.name: Tortilla Española
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and slice thinly into 0.125-inch rounds using a mandoline or knife.
Slice onion into thin half-moons.
Heat olive oil in a 10-inch non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add potatoes and onions to the hot oil, season with salt and pepper, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until potatoes begin to soften but are not browned.
While potatoes cook, beat 6 eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt.
Drain potatoes and onions through a colander, reserving 2 tbsp of the oil in the pan.
Return drained potatoes to the skillet with reserved oil, pour beaten eggs over them, and cook on medium-low for 5 minutes without stirring until edges set.
Place a plate over the skillet and carefully flip the tortilla onto the plate, then slide it back into the pan to cook the other side for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Slide onto a serving plate, garnish with parsley, cool slightly, cut into wedges, and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in 5-lb bags for 50% less per pound
Use store-brand olive oil instead of premium varieties

recipes.name: Ashta Bil Bayd
recipes.description: Lebanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together milk and cornstarch in a saucepan until smooth.
Add heavy cream, sugar, and salt, then heat over medium, stirring constantly until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in rose water, then pour ashta onto a plate to cool.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Gently crack all 4 eggs into the skillet and cook until egg whites are set but yolks are still soft, about 4 minutes.
Divide cooled ashta among three serving bowls or plates.
Top each with an egg, then sprinkle crushed pistachios over the top.
Serve warm with flatbread or pita for scooping.
cheapTips: Skip rose water and use vanilla extract as a cheaper substitute
Buy crushed pistachios from the bulk section for 40% savings

recipes.name: Chawan Mushi
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and salt in a bowl and let cool to room temperature.
Lightly beat 3 eggs in a separate bowl without creating bubbles.
Slowly pour cooled dashi mixture into beaten eggs while stirring gently.
Strain mixture through fine mesh to remove any bits and bubbles.
Divide chicken, mushrooms, and green onions between two heatproof bowls or tea cups.
Gently pour egg and dashi mixture over ingredients until bowls are three-quarters full.
Place bowls in a steamer basket over boiling water, cover, and steam for 12-15 minutes until egg is just set but still slightly soft in the center.
Serve immediately in the cooking vessel while hot.
cheapTips: Make dashi from scratch using kelp and bonito flakes for 60% savings
Use chicken thighs instead of breast for better flavor at lower cost

recipes.name: Tzatziki with Fried Eggs
recipes.description: Greek breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Grate cucumber and squeeze out excess liquid with a clean kitchen towel.
Mince garlic clove finely.
Combine greek yogurt with grated cucumber, garlic, lemon juice, dill, salt, and pepper in a bowl and refrigerate until serving.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Crack 4 eggs into the hot oil and cook until whites are set and edges are crispy, about 4 minutes.
Season fried eggs with salt and pepper.
Warm pita bread in a dry skillet or over a flame for 30 seconds per side.
Divide tzatziki between two plates, top with 2 fried eggs each, and serve with warm pita bread on the side.
cheapTips: Make pita bread at home instead of buying it for 70% savings
Use regular yogurt mixed with a bit of sour cream instead of greek yogurt

recipes.name: Pigs in a Blanket
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Remove crescent dough from tube and unroll along the perforations to separate into 8 triangles.
Cut each triangle into two thin strips lengthwise.
Wrap one dough strip around each hot dog, slightly overlapping the seam side and leaving a small portion of the hot dog exposed.
Place wrapped hot dogs seam-side down on prepared baking sheet.
Brush wrapped hot dogs lightly with melted butter and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until dough is golden brown.
Mix mustard and ketchup for serving, then serve pigs in a blanket hot with dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy cocktail hot dogs in bulk packs for 40% less per hot dog
Use store-brand refrigerated crescent rolls instead of name brand

recipes.name: Khao Tom
recipes.description: Thai breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a pot over medium-high heat.
Add ginger slices and garlic, simmering for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in cooked jasmine rice and fish sauce, breaking up any clumps.
Simmer for 5 minutes until the rice softens and creates a porridge consistency.
Season with white pepper and adjust fish sauce to taste.
Pour into bowls and top with sliced green onions and cilantro.
Serve hot with lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Use leftover cooked rice to save time and money on rice cooking
Buy garlic and ginger in bulk and freeze for extended use

recipes.name: Khao Tom Goong
recipes.description: Thai breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a pot with ginger and garlic.
Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes until they just turn pink.
Stir in cooked jasmine rice and fish sauce, mixing well.
Simmer for 5 minutes until rice softens into porridge.
Season with white pepper and adjust fish sauce as needed.
Divide into bowls and garnish with green onions and cilantro.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp on sale and thaw before cooking
Use shrimp shells to make homemade broth if available

recipes.name: Congee with Pork Offal
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice thoroughly under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add ginger and rice.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down into porridge.
Blanch pork liver and kidney in boiling water for 1 minute to clean, then drain.
Add offal to the congee and simmer for 3 minutes until cooked through.
Season with soy sauce, white pepper, and sesame oil.
Serve hot in bowls topped with green onions.
cheapTips: Buy offal from Asian markets where it's significantly cheaper
Make extra and freeze in portions for quick future meals

recipes.name: Jook
recipes.description: Cantonese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring chicken broth to a boil with ginger slices in a large pot.
Add rice and return to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice completely breaks down.
Add diced chicken and cook for 5 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Season with soy sauce, salt, white pepper, and sesame oil.
Ladle into bowls and top with chopped green onions.
Serve hot with any desired toppings.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken for faster prep and no additional cooking
Buy rice in bulk from Asian markets for significant savings

recipes.name: Arroz Caldo
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté garlic, ginger, and onion until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add chicken pieces and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned on all sides.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add rice and stir well, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes.
Stir in fish sauce and green peas, simmering for 10 more minutes until rice softens into porridge.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in bowls topped with hard-boiled egg halves.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for cheaper and more flavorful results
Use frozen peas to cut costs significantly

recipes.name: Lugao
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice thoroughly under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot.
Add rinsed rice and stir well, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 30-35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice completely breaks down into porridge.
Stir in minced ginger and garlic, cooking for 2 minutes.
Season with salt, white pepper, and fish sauce.
Serve in bowls topped with chopped green onions.
Add more water if too thick or simmer longer if too thin.
cheapTips: This is one of the cheapest Filipino breakfast options using basic pantry staples
Make a large batch and reheat portions throughout the week

recipes.name: Bubur Ayam
recipes.description: Indonesian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté minced garlic and ginger for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add turmeric powder and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil with diced chicken.
Add rice and stir well, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down completely and chicken is tender.
