Season with salt and adjust to taste.
Serve hot in bowls garnished with sliced green onions.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breast for more flavor and lower cost
Make turmeric paste at home from fresh turmeric root if available at Asian markets

recipes.name: Bubur Kuah
recipes.description: Indonesian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice thoroughly under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot.
Add rice and minced garlic and ginger, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 35-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice completely breaks down into a smooth porridge.
Season with salt and sugar, stirring well.
Adjust consistency by adding more water if needed.
Serve hot in bowls and top with chopped green onions and fried shallots.
cheapTips: Fried shallots can be made at home by frying thinly sliced shallots until crispy
This economical breakfast uses only basic ingredients found in most pantries

recipes.name: Cháo Cua Cà Chua
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté minced garlic and shallot for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes until softened.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add rice and stir well, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down.
Stir in crab meat and fish sauce, simmering for 3 more minutes.
Serve hot in bowls and garnish with green onions and cilantro.
cheapTips: Use canned crab meat as it's much cheaper than fresh and works perfectly
Buy tomatoes when in season and freeze for year-round use

recipes.name: Congee with Salted Pork
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice thoroughly under cold water until water runs clear.
Blanch salted pork in boiling water for 2 minutes to reduce saltiness, then drain and set aside.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot with ginger slices.
Add rice and stir well, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice completely breaks down.
Add blanched pork and minced garlic, cooking for 3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and white pepper, then drizzle with sesame oil.
Serve hot in bowls topped with chopped green onions.
cheapTips: Salted pork is inexpensive and lasts long when stored properly in the freezer
Buy rice in bulk from Asian markets to reduce per-serving costs

recipes.name: Century Egg Congee
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse the rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring water and chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add rinsed rice and stir, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 35-40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Peel the century eggs and cut them into small chunks.
When congee reaches a creamy consistency, add minced ginger and salt, stirring well.
Add century egg chunks and simmer for 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and white pepper.
Drizzle with sesame oil and top with chopped green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy century eggs in bulk from Asian markets for better prices
Use vegetable broth instead of chicken broth to reduce cost

recipes.name: Fish Congee
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot and add rice, stirring occasionally.
Simmer for 35-40 minutes until rice breaks down into a creamy porridge.
Season fish fillet with salt and white pepper on both sides.
Add ginger slices to the congee, then gently place the fish fillet on top.
Cover and simmer for 5-7 minutes until fish is cooked through and flakes easily.
Remove fish, break into bite-sized pieces, and return to congee.
Stir in soy sauce, drizzle with sesame oil, and garnish with chopped green onions.
cheapTips: Use affordable white fish like tilapia or cod instead of premium options
Buy frozen fish fillets which are typically cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Pork and Preserved Vegetable Congee
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring water to a boil and add rice, stirring to prevent sticking.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 35-40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Rinse preserved mustard greens and chop them finely to remove excess salt.
In a separate pan, brown the ground pork over medium heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add ginger and preserved mustard greens to the pork and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir the pork mixture into the congee and simmer for 3 minutes.
Season with salt and white pepper, drizzle with sesame oil, and top with green onions.
cheapTips: Buy preserved mustard greens from Asian markets in bulk
Use the cheapest ground pork available; fat content doesn't matter here

recipes.name: Congee with Youtiao
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and baking powder together, then gradually add water to form a soft dough.
Knead dough for 5 minutes, cover with plastic wrap, and let rest for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Meanwhile, rinse rice and bring 8 cups of water to boil, add rice and simmer for 40 minutes until creamy.
Roll dough into a thin rectangle about 1/4 inch thick on an oiled surface.
Cut dough lengthwise into strips about 1 inch wide and 8 inches long.
Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F, then carefully fry dough strips until golden and puffed, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain fried youtiao on paper towels and cut diagonally into pieces.
Season congee with white pepper, salt, and sesame oil, then top with youtiao pieces and green onions.
cheapTips: Make youtiao from scratch as shown; store-bought is expensive
Cook extra youtiao and store in an airtight container for 2-3 days

recipes.name: Okayu
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Combine rice and water in a pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Add dashi broth and salt, then simmer uncovered for another 10 minutes until rice is very soft and porridge-like.
Place an umeboshi plum in the center of each bowl of okayu.
Cut nori seaweed into strips and chop green onion finely.
Ladle hot okayu into bowls and top with nori strips and green onion.
cheapTips: Make dashi from kombu and bonito flakes instead of using dashi powder
Omit umeboshi for a simpler, cheaper version

recipes.name: Chicken Okayu
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring 4 cups water to a boil, add rice, and reduce heat to low.
Simmer rice for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it begins to break down.
Dice chicken breast into small cubes and add to the pot with ginger.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then add dashi broth and salt.
Continue simmering for 10 more minutes until rice is very soft and chicken is fully cooked.
Stir in soy sauce and adjust seasoning to taste.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with chopped green onion.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for more flavor and lower cost
Poach chicken in the okayu liquid to infuse flavor and save a pan

recipes.name: Umeboshi Okayu
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice thoroughly under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring water to a boil in a pot and add rice.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Add dashi broth and salt, then continue simmering uncovered for 10 minutes.
Pit the umeboshi plums and lightly crush them with a fork or spoon.
Stir the crushed umeboshi into the okayu and cook for 1 more minute.
Ladle into bowls, top with chopped green onion and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy umeboshi in bulk from Asian markets
One umeboshi can flavor the entire pot; use it sparingly

recipes.name: Cháo Gà
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a large pot and add salt and ginger slices.
Add whole chicken breast and simmer for 15 minutes until fully cooked.
Remove chicken, let cool slightly, then shred the meat and set aside; keep the cooking liquid in the pot.
Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Add rice to the chicken cooking liquid and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 35-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down into a creamy porridge.
Return shredded chicken to the pot and stir in fish sauce and white pepper.
Simmer for 2 more minutes, then drizzle with sesame oil and top with fried shallots and sliced green onions.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breast for better flavor and lower cost
Make fried shallots at home by thinly slicing and frying shallots in oil

recipes.name: Cháo Cua
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil with salt and ginger slices.
Rinse rice under cold water and add to boiling water.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 35-40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Shred or flake the crab meat, removing any shell pieces carefully.
When rice is very soft and creamy, add the crab meat and ginger pieces to the pot.
Stir in fish sauce and white pepper, then simmer for 3 more minutes.
Drizzle with sesame oil and taste for seasoning adjustments.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with chopped green onions and fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Use imitation crab meat (surimi) for significant savings
Buy fresh crab when in season and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Cháo Lươn
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil with salt, ginger slices, and minced garlic.
Cut eel fillet into 2-inch pieces and carefully add to the boiling water.
Simmer eel for 10 minutes, skimming any foam from the surface.
Rinse rice under cold water and add to the pot.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice is very soft.
Stir in fish sauce and white pepper, tasting for seasoning.
Drizzle sesame oil over the congee and stir gently to distribute.
Ladle into bowls and garnish generously with sliced green onions.
cheapTips: Find eel at Asian fish markets which often have better prices than regular supermarkets
Use catfish as a substitute for a less expensive but similar result

recipes.name: Stromboli
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and salt; let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Add flour and olive oil to yeast mixture; knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Let dough rise in oiled bowl for 20 minutes until doubled.
Roll dough into a 12x10 inch rectangle on parchment paper.
Spread ricotta evenly over dough, leaving 1-inch border; layer meats and mozzarella on top.
Roll tightly from long side and seal seam by pinching; place seam-side down.
Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle Italian seasoning; bake at 400°F for 25 minutes until golden brown.
Cool 5 minutes before slicing and serving with marinara sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy deli meat on sale and freeze; use budget mozzarella blends
Make your own marinara sauce instead of buying jarred

recipes.name: Focaccia col Formaggio
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine warm water, yeast, and salt; let bloom for 5 minutes.
Add flour and 2 tbsp olive oil; knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Let dough rise in oiled bowl for 25 minutes until doubled.
Press dough into a 9x13 inch oiled baking pan; poke dimples with fingertips.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and scatter mozzarella cubes and rosemary on top.
Sprinkle with sea salt and let rise 10 minutes.
Bake at 425°F for 20 minutes until golden and cheese is melted.
Cool 5 minutes before serving warm.
cheapTips: Use part-skim mozzarella to reduce cost without sacrificing much flavor
Dry rosemary works fine if fresh is unavailable

recipes.name: Bánh Bao
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm milk, yeast, and 1 tbsp sugar; let bloom for 5 minutes.
Combine flour, remaining sugar, and salt; add yeast mixture and 2 tbsp melted butter, knead 10 minutes.
Let dough rise 45 minutes in oiled bowl until doubled.
Brown pork with onion and fish sauce in a pan for 8 minutes; cool and mix with green onions.
Divide dough into 8 portions; roll each flat and fill with pork mixture and egg half.
Seal bao tightly, place seam-side down on parchment squares, and let rise 20 minutes.
Steam in bamboo steamer or pot with rack over boiling water for 15 minutes.
Remove and brush with remaining melted butter; serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions
Use regular eggs instead of century eggs to save money

recipes.name: Siopao
recipes.description: Filipino snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine warm water, yeast, and sugar; let bloom 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt; add yeast mixture and oil, knead 10 minutes until smooth.
Let dough rise 40 minutes in oiled bowl until doubled.
Brown pork with garlic and onion; add soy sauce and brown sugar, simmer 5 minutes and cool.
Divide dough into 8 pieces; roll each into a thin disk and fill with 2 tbsp pork mixture.
Seal edges tightly and place seam-side down on parchment squares.
Let rise 15 minutes uncovered at room temperature.
Steam in bamboo steamer or pot with rack for 12 minutes until puffy and cooked through.
cheapTips: Use soy sauce instead of pricier seasonings for authentic flavor
Make filling in bulk and refrigerate for quick assembly

recipes.name: Za'atar Bread
recipes.description: Middle Eastern breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water with yeast and let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour and salt; add yeast mixture and 1 tbsp olive oil, knead 8 minutes.
Let dough rise 20 minutes in an oiled bowl until puffy.
Divide dough into 3 pieces and shape into oval flatbreads.
Place on oiled baking sheet; brush tops with remaining olive oil.
Mix za'atar with sea salt and sprinkle generously over bread.
Bake at 425°F for 12 minutes until golden and crispy.
Serve warm, optionally drizzling with additional olive oil.
cheapTips: Make your own za'atar mix with thyme, sumac, and sesame seeds
Store-bought za'atar lasts months, buy once for multiple uses

recipes.name: Pita Gyros
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Add sliced chicken and marinate for 20 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken in batches for 6 minutes until golden.
Warm pita bread in a dry skillet or over a flame for 30 seconds per side.
Spread tzatziki sauce on each warm pita bread.
Fill pitas with cooked chicken, tomato, cucumber, and red onion.
Roll up tightly, wrap in foil, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and marinate in bulk, refrigerate
Make homemade tzatziki with yogurt, cucumber, and garlic

recipes.name: Hot Pocket
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line baking sheet with parchment paper.
Unroll crescent dough and separate into 4 rectangles, sealing perforations with your fingers.
Divide ham, pepperoni, and cheese into 4 portions; place on half of each rectangle.
Spoon 2 tbsp pizza sauce over filling on each dough piece.
Fold dough in half over filling and crimp edges with a fork to seal tightly.
Beat egg with 1 tbsp water; brush over pockets and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes until golden brown.
Let cool 2 minutes before serving with additional marinara sauce.
cheapTips: Use budget deli ham and cheese blends instead of premium cuts
Buy crescent rolls on sale and store in freezer

recipes.name: Sausage Roll
recipes.description: British snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix ground sausage, breadcrumbs, egg, onion powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Roll out puff pastry and divide in half lengthwise.
Form sausage mixture into 2 long logs and place one on each pastry strip.
Wrap pastry around sausage, sealing seam with water; cut into 4 portions per log.
Place rolls seam-side down on baking sheet.
Beat egg yolk with 1 tbsp water and brush over rolls.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes until golden brown; serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy puff pastry on sale and store in freezer
Use ground pork on sale or leftover sausage from other dishes

recipes.name: Cantonese Congee
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring broth and water to boil in a large pot.
Rinse rice and add to boiling broth; stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 40 minutes, stirring frequently, until rice breaks down into creamy porridge.
Add salt, white pepper, and cooked pork; simmer 5 minutes.
Serve in bowls topped with green onions, ginger, and diced century egg.
Drizzle with soy sauce or sesame oil as desired.
cheapTips: Use leftover cooked rice from previous meals and simmer 20 minutes instead
Skip century egg and use cooked diced chicken or char siu for savings

recipes.name: Chicken and Ginger Congee
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring broth and water to boil with ginger slices in a large pot.
Add whole chicken breast and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked; remove and shred chicken.
Rinse rice and add to broth; stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Simmer for 40 minutes on low heat, stirring frequently, until rice becomes creamy.
Return shredded chicken to pot and add salt and white pepper; simmer 3 minutes.
Serve in bowls drizzled with sesame oil and topped with chopped green onions.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for richer flavor at lower cost
Buy whole ginger root and freeze for future use

recipes.name: Mozzarella Melt
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a skillet over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon of butter.
Place 2 bread slices in the skillet and toast for 2 minutes until lightly golden.
Top each slice with 3 oz of fresh mozzarella cheese.
Cover the skillet with a lid and cook for 3 minutes until cheese melts.
Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Remove from heat and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy mozzarella in bulk when on sale and freeze for later
Use store-brand bread to reduce costs

recipes.name: Cheddar and Bacon Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon strips in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, about 5 minutes, then set aside.
Tear bacon into bite-sized pieces.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Heat the skillet over medium heat and place 2 bread slices butter-side down.
Top each slice with 2 cheddar slices, half the bacon pieces, and 2 tomato slices.
Cover with remaining bread slices butter-side up, and cook for 3 minutes until golden.
Flip and cook the other side for 3 minutes until golden and cheese melts.
Cut in half and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale and cook a full package to use throughout the week
Use store-brand cheddar slices instead of name brands

recipes.name: Chicken Parm Melt
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breast flat to 1/4 inch thickness between plastic wrap.
Mix bread crumbs with 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese and salt in a shallow bowl.
Beat egg in another bowl and dip chicken, then coat with breadcrumb mixture.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken for 6 minutes per side until golden.
Reduce heat to medium and spread marinara sauce on chicken.
Top with mozzarella and remaining parmesan, cover skillet, and cook for 3 minutes until cheese melts.
Toast bread slices and place coated chicken on bread.
Serve immediately with extra marinara sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and pound and freeze in portions
Use store-brand marinara sauce

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmesan Melt
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice eggplant lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices and salt both sides, let sit 15 minutes.
Pat eggplant dry with paper towels to remove moisture.
Mix bread crumbs with 2 tablespoons parmesan in a shallow bowl.
Beat egg in another bowl and dip eggplant slices, then coat with breadcrumb mixture.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook eggplant 4 minutes per side until golden.
Spread marinara on eggplant slices, top with mozzarella, cover, and cook 3 minutes until cheese melts.
Toast bread slices and place eggplant on bread.
Drizzle with remaining marinara and parmesan, then serve.
cheapTips: Buy eggplant when in season for better prices
Make marinara from canned tomatoes if sauce is expensive

recipes.name: Tomato and Mozzarella Melt
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice tomato into 1/4 inch thick slices and pat dry.
Slice fresh mozzarella into 1/4 inch thick slices.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Place bread slices in skillet and toast for 2 minutes until lightly golden.
Layer mozzarella and tomato slices on each bread slice.
Cover skillet with a lid and cook for 3 minutes until cheese softens.
Top with fresh basil, drizzle with balsamic vinegar, season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy basil in bulk and freeze in ice cube trays with olive oil
Use Roma tomatoes for better flavor at lower cost

recipes.name: Pastrami Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat pastrami slices in a skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes until warm.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Spread mustard on the unbuttered side of 2 bread slices.
Layer pastrami, swiss cheese, and pickles on the mustard side.
Top with remaining bread slices, butter-side out.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and place sandwich in it.
Cook for 3 minutes until bread is golden, then flip and cook the other side for 3 minutes.
Serve hot with extra mustard on the side.
cheapTips: Buy pastrami from the deli counter when on sale and freeze portions
Use store-brand rye bread

recipes.name: Tuna Noodle Casserole
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cook egg noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Drain tuna and flake into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, mix soup, milk, tuna, peas, and cooked noodles together.
Stir in 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, salt, and pepper.
Pour mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Mix bread crumbs with 2 tablespoons melted butter and remaining 1/4 cup cheese, sprinkle on top.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbly and topping is golden.
cheapTips: Buy canned tuna in bulk when on sale
Use store-brand condensed soup

recipes.name: Green Bean Casserole
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, mix cream of mushroom soup and milk together.
Stir in frozen green beans, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Reserve 1 cup of fried onions and fold the remainder into the green bean mixture.
Pour mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 20 minutes until hot and bubbly.
Top with reserved fried onions and bake for 5 more minutes until onions are heated.
Serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy frozen vegetables in bulk at warehouse stores
Use store-brand soup and onions

recipes.name: Chicken Divan
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Boil chicken breasts in salted water for 15 minutes until cooked through, then shred into bite-sized pieces.
Cook frozen broccoli according to package directions, drain well.
In a large bowl, mix soup, mayonnaise, and milk together.
Stir in 3/4 cup cheese, shredded chicken, and broccoli.
Pour mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Mix bread crumbs with 2 tablespoons melted butter and remaining 1/4 cup cheese, sprinkle on top.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbly and topping is golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and cook in bulk for freezing
Use frozen broccoli instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Breakfast Strata
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon strips until crispy, then chop into bite-sized pieces.
Dice onion and sauté in butter over medium heat for 3 minutes until softened.
Place bread cubes in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle bacon, sautéed onion, and 1 cup cheese over bread cubes.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Pour egg mixture over bread, pressing gently to soak bread.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight.
Preheat oven to 350°F, remove plastic wrap, top with remaining cheese.
Bake for 35 minutes until set and golden, let cool 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use day-old bread from bakery or store discount section
Cook bacon ahead and freeze for convenient breakfast prep

recipes.name: Congee with Abalone
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring chicken broth to boil in a large pot with ginger slices.
Add rice and stir to prevent sticking, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 60-70 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down into creamy congee.
Drain canned abalone and slice thinly, then add to congee in final 5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, salt, and white pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and drizzle with sesame oil.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Skip canned abalone and use frozen squid or shrimp for similar texture at half the cost
Make broth from chicken bones instead of buying boxed broth

recipes.name: Chicken and Mushroom Congee
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice until water runs clear, then add to boiling chicken broth with ginger slices.
Simmer rice for 50-60 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally, until very soft and creamy.
Slice mushrooms thinly and cut chicken breast into small bite-sized pieces.
Add chicken and mushrooms to congee during final 10 minutes of cooking.
Stir in soy sauce and season with salt and white pepper.
Drizzle with sesame oil just before serving.
Ladle into bowls and top with sliced green onions.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for more flavor at lower cost
Buy whole mushrooms and slice yourself rather than pre-sliced

recipes.name: Seafood Congee
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice thoroughly and add to boiling seafood broth with ginger slices.
Simmer on low heat for 60-70 minutes, stirring frequently, until rice becomes creamy congee.
Peel and devein shrimp, then pat dry along with scallops.
Add shrimp and scallops to congee in final 5 minutes of cooking.
Season with soy sauce, salt, and white pepper to taste.
Stir in sesame oil just before serving.
Ladle into bowls and garnish generously with green onions and cilantro.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp and scallops to save 30-40% versus fresh
Substitute chicken broth for seafood broth and use frozen fish fillets instead

recipes.name: Congee with Pickled Mustard Greens
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring chicken broth to boil and add rice with ginger slices.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 60-65 minutes, stirring often, until rice is very soft and creamy.
Rinse pickled mustard greens to reduce saltiness, then chop into bite-sized pieces.
Stir pickled greens into congee and heat through for 2 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, salt, and white pepper as needed.
Drizzle with sesame oil and ladle into bowls.
Top with crushed peanuts and sliced green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy pickled mustard greens in bulk at Asian markets for 60% less than supermarkets
Use vegetable broth instead of chicken broth to reduce cost further

recipes.name: Quesadilla Oaxaca
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add 1 tablespoon butter.
Warm one corn tortilla in the skillet for 20 seconds, then flip and add a handful of torn Oaxaca cheese and a few epazote leaves to one half.
Fold tortilla in half over the cheese and press gently with a spatula.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until golden and cheese begins to melt, then flip and cook the other side until golden and crispy.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining tortillas and cheese.
Serve immediately with diced onion and sliced jalapeño on the side.
cheapTips: Substitute fresh mozzarella for Oaxaca cheese if unavailable
Skip epazote and use cilantro instead for a similar herbal note

recipes.name: Quesadilla de Flor de Calabaza
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté sliced onion until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add frozen squash blossoms and cook for 3-4 minutes until thawed and any excess moisture evaporates.
Season with salt, pepper, and torn epazote leaves, then transfer to a bowl.
Warm a tortilla in a dry skillet for 20 seconds, then flip and add a handful of cheese to one half.
Spoon 2-3 tablespoons of squash blossom mixture over the cheese and fold tortilla in half.
Cook for 1-2 minutes per side until golden and crispy, pressing gently with spatula.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling, then serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy frozen squash blossoms in bulk at Mexican markets for half the cost
Use zucchini cut into thin strips if squash blossoms unavailable

recipes.name: Quesadilla de Huitlacoche
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion until translucent, about 2 minutes.
Add canned huitlacoche (drained of excess liquid) and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt, pepper, and torn epazote leaves.
Warm a corn tortilla in a dry skillet for 15 seconds, flip, and add a handful of cheese to one half.
Spoon 2-3 tablespoons huitlacoche mixture over cheese and fold tortilla in half.
Cook for 1-2 minutes per side until cheese melts and tortilla is golden, pressing gently.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy huitlacoche in bulk online for 30% cheaper than specialty stores
Make from fresh corn if in season by removing the fungus gall and cooking with onions

recipes.name: Quesadilla de Rajas con Queso
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Char poblano peppers directly over a gas flame or under a broiler until blackened on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Place charred peppers in a plastic bag for 5 minutes to steam, then peel off blackened skin under cool running water.
Remove stem and seeds, then slice peppers into strips (rajas).
Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet and sauté sliced onion until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add poblano strips and cook for 2 minutes, season with salt, then stir in crema.
Warm a tortilla in a dry skillet for 15 seconds, flip, and add cheese to one half.
Spoon 2-3 tablespoons rajas mixture over cheese and fold tortilla in half.
Cook for 1-2 minutes per side until golden and crispy, then repeat with remaining tortillas.
cheapTips: Use frozen roasted poblano strips if available to skip charring step
Substitute regular sour cream for Mexican crema to save cost

recipes.name: Quesadilla de Chorizo
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove chorizo from casing and crumble into a skillet over medium heat.
Cook chorizo for 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently, until fully cooked and browned.
Add sliced onion and cook for 2 more minutes until soft, then remove from heat.
Warm a corn tortilla in a dry skillet for 15 seconds, flip, and add a handful of cheese to one half.
Spoon 2-3 tablespoons chorizo mixture over cheese and fold tortilla in half.
Cook for 1-2 minutes per side until cheese melts and tortilla is golden brown.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling, then serve hot with cilantro if desired.
cheapTips: Buy chorizo in bulk at Mexican markets for 25% savings
Use chicken chorizo instead for leaner, cheaper option

recipes.name: Crispy Chicken Quesadilla
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper, then grill or pan-fry over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then dice into bite-sized pieces.
Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet and sauté diced onion and bell pepper until softened, about 4 minutes.
Stir diced chicken into vegetables and season with salt and pepper.
Place one flour tortilla in a dry skillet over medium-high heat and warm for 20 seconds.
Spread chicken-vegetable mixture on half the tortilla, top with cheddar cheese, then fold in half.
Brush top with melted butter and cook for 2 minutes until golden and crispy, then flip and cook the other side for 2 minutes.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling, then cut into triangles and serve with sour cream.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the store to save time and money
Buy shredded cheese in bulk or use block cheddar and grate yourself

recipes.name: Tamale Pie
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown the ground beef with diced onion and garlic in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes.
Stir in chili powder and cook for 1 minute, then add corn and olives, season with salt and pepper.
Whisk cornmeal into chicken broth slowly to avoid lumps, then pour into the skillet and stir well.
Simmer the mixture for 5 minutes until thickened, then transfer to a buttered 9x13 baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese evenly over the top.
Bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and golden.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn instead of fresh to save money
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Chiles Rellenos Casserole
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast poblano peppers directly over a gas flame or under the broiler until charred, then place in a plastic bag for 10 minutes to steam.
Peel off the charred skin, make a slit, and carefully remove seeds while keeping the pepper intact.
Stuff each pepper with cheese pieces, then set aside.
Whisk eggs with flour until smooth, heat oil in a skillet, and fry each stuffed pepper until golden on both sides.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in a separate pan, add tomato sauce and cumin, simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour half the tomato sauce into a baking dish, arrange fried peppers on top, then cover with remaining sauce.
Bake at 350°F for 15-20 minutes until heated through and sauce is bubbly.
cheapTips: Buy poblanos when in season for better prices
Substitute store-brand cheese to reduce cost

recipes.name: Seafood Gratin
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large pan and sauté shallots and garlic for 2 minutes over medium heat.
Add white wine and simmer until reduced by half, about 3 minutes.
Add shrimp, scallops, and fish, poaching gently for 4-5 minutes until just cooked through.
Stir in heavy cream and lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, simmer for 2 minutes.
Transfer seafood mixture to a gratin dish, top with shredded Gruyère cheese.
Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter and toss with breadcrumbs, sprinkle over cheese.
Bake at 400°F for 12-15 minutes until golden and bubbly.
cheapTips: Buy seafood that is on sale or frozen to reduce cost
Use a mix of cheaper white fish varieties

recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Pie
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thaw spinach and squeeze dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in olive oil for 3 minutes, then add spinach and cook for 2 minutes more.
Mix spinach mixture with crumbled feta, eggs, dill, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Brush a 9-inch pie dish with melted butter, then layer 4 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter.
Spread spinach-feta filling evenly over phyllo base.
Top with remaining 4 phyllo sheets, brushing each with butter and tucking edges under.
Brush the top generously with butter and bake at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until golden.
cheapTips: Buy feta on sale and store in the freezer
Use store-brand phyllo dough instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Cornbread Casserole
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef with diced onion in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, then add frozen corn and tomato sauce, season with salt and pepper.
Simmer the meat mixture for 5 minutes, then transfer to a buttered 9x13 baking dish and spread evenly.
Combine cornbread mix, eggs, milk, and shredded cheese in a bowl, stirring until just combined.
Pour cornbread batter over the meat mixture, smoothing the top gently.
Bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until the cornbread is golden and a toothpick inserted in the topping comes out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use a box mix to save time and money on cornbread
Buy ground beef in bulk and portion before freezing

recipes.name: Gratinée à l'Oignon
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter with olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and add sliced onions.
Cook onions for 25-30 minutes, stirring frequently, until deeply caramelized and golden brown.
Add white wine and scrape up browned bits from the pot, then simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour in beef broth, add bay leaf and thyme sprig, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toast baguette slices in a toaster or oven until golden, then place one slice in the bottom of each oven-safe bowl.
Ladle hot onion soup into bowls over the bread, top with shredded Gruyère cheese.
Broil for 2-3 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
cheapTips: Buy onions in bulk when on sale and store in a cool place
Use day-old baguette from the bakery section for discounts

recipes.name: Baked Rigatoni al Forno
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rigatoni according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Brown ground beef with diced onion and garlic in a large pan over medium-high heat for 5 minutes.
Add canned tomatoes with juice, break them up with a spoon, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and basil, season with salt and pepper, then simmer for 2 minutes.
Combine cooked pasta with sauce in a buttered 9x13 baking dish.
Top with mixed mozzarella and Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 15-20 minutes until cheese is melted and golden.
cheapTips: Buy canned tomatoes in bulk when on sale
Use block cheese and shred it yourself for savings

recipes.name: Cold Ramen
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook ramen noodles according to package directions, drain, and rinse with ice water until completely cooled.
Whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and sugar in a small bowl to make dressing.
Arrange cooled noodles in serving bowls and top with julienned cucumber, carrot, and green onion.
Pour dressing over noodles and toss gently to combine.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy instant ramen in bulk from Asian markets for cheaper prices
Use whatever vegetables you have on hand for variety

recipes.name: Crab Salad
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, and chili flakes in a small bowl.
Combine crab meat, cucumber, bell pepper, and red onion in a large bowl.
Pour dressing over crab mixture and gently toss to combine.
Add fresh mint and cilantro and toss lightly.
Arrange lettuce leaves on a plate and top with crab salad, serving immediately.
cheapTips: Buy crab meat when on sale and freeze portions
Use imitation crab as a budget-friendly alternative

recipes.name: Sashimi Platter
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Ensure all fish is sushi-grade and handled with proper food safety precautions.
Pat fish dry with paper towels and keep cold until ready to serve.
Slice salmon, tuna, and yellowtail against the grain into ⅛-inch thick pieces.
Arrange fish slices on a chilled platter in overlapping rows, grouping by type.
Create a bed of daikon radish slices on the platter as a garnish.
Place small mounds of wasabi, pickled ginger, and soy sauce in small dishes on the platter.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and green onion over the fish, and serve immediately with nori strips on the side.
cheapTips: Buy sashimi-grade fish from Japanese markets for better prices than specialty stores
Purchase seasonal fish varieties which are cheaper when abundant

recipes.name: Shrimp Quesadilla
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add diced onion and bell pepper, cooking until softened about 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp, lime juice, cumin, salt, and pepper, cooking for 3-4 minutes until shrimp turns pink and is cooked through.
Lay one tortilla on a clean surface and spread half the shrimp mixture on one half, then top with 1/2 cup cheese folded in half.
Fold tortilla in half and place in a clean skillet with 1/2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat, cooking 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Repeat with remaining two tortillas and filling.
Cut quesadillas into triangles and serve immediately with sour cream on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk and thaw as needed to save 30%
Use store-brand cheese instead of name brands

recipes.name: Spinach and Cheese Quesadilla
recipes.description: Tex-Mex lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Season spinach mixture with salt and pepper, then transfer to a plate.
Wipe out the skillet, lay one tortilla on a clean surface, and spread half the spinach mixture on one side.
Top spinach with 1/2 cup cheese and jalapeño slices if using, then fold tortilla in half.
Melt 1/2 tbsp butter in the skillet over medium heat and cook the quesadilla 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Repeat with remaining two tortillas and filling, then slice into triangles and serve with salsa.
cheapTips: Buy frozen spinach instead of fresh to save 50%
Use mild cheddar instead of Monterey Jack for savings

recipes.name: Steak Quesadilla
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season steak generously with salt and pepper, then sear in a hot skillet with 1 tbsp olive oil for 3-4 minutes per side until medium-rare.
Remove steak to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
In the same skillet, heat 1 tbsp olive oil and sauté sliced onion and bell pepper until tender, about 6 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then return steak to pan with cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Lay one tortilla flat and spread half the steak mixture on one side, then top with 1/2 cup cheese and fold in half.
Heat 1/2 tbsp olive oil in the skillet over medium heat and cook the quesadilla 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Repeat with remaining two tortillas and filling, top with cilantro, slice into triangles, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use round steak or flank steak instead of sirloin
Buy whole peppers and onions rather than pre-sliced

recipes.name: Black Bean Quesadilla
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion and bell pepper until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in black beans, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Cook the bean mixture for 2 minutes to warm through, then transfer to a plate.
Lay one tortilla flat and spread half the bean mixture on one side, then top with 1/2 cup cheese and fold in half.
Wipe out the skillet, melt 1/2 tbsp butter over medium heat, and cook the quesadilla 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Repeat with remaining two tortillas and filling.
Slice into triangles and serve immediately with salsa on the side.
cheapTips: Canned beans are significantly cheaper than fresh or frozen
Skip the bell pepper and just use onions to cut costs further

recipes.name: Mushroom and Cheese Quesadilla
recipes.description: Vegetarian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 1.5 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté sliced mushrooms until they release their moisture and begin to brown, about 6 minutes.
Add sliced onion and fresh thyme, cooking for another 4 minutes until onion softens.
Add minced garlic, salt, and pepper, cooking for 30 seconds, then remove from heat and discard thyme sprigs.
Lay one tortilla flat and spread half the mushroom mixture on one side, then top with 1/2 cup cheese and fold in half.
Wipe out the skillet, melt 1/2 tbsp butter over medium heat, and cook the quesadilla 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Repeat with remaining two tortillas and filling.
Slice into triangles and serve immediately with sour cream on the side.
cheapTips: Use white button mushrooms instead of cremini to save 40%
Buy sharp cheddar instead of Gruyère for similar taste at lower cost

recipes.name: Philly Cheesesteak Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Freeze the steak for 15 minutes to make slicing easier, then slice as thin as possible against the grain.
Heat 1.5 tbsp butter in a large skillet over high heat and sauté the thin steak slices for 2-3 minutes total until cooked through, then transfer to a plate.
In the same skillet, heat the remaining 1.5 tbsp butter and sauté sliced onion and bell pepper until soft and slightly caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then return the cooked steak to the pan, mix together, and season with salt and pepper.
Spread mayonnaise on the inside of each bread slice, then fill two slices with the steak mixture and top each with 2 slices provolone.
Place the melts in a skillet or griddle over medium heat, cover loosely, and cook until the bread is golden and cheese melts, about 3 minutes per side.
Slice in half and serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Use round steak instead of sirloin to reduce cost by 30%
Make your own caramelized onions in bulk and freeze them

recipes.name: Patty Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook the sliced onion slowly for 8-10 minutes until deeply caramelized and soft.
Season the ground beef with salt, pepper, and Worcestershire sauce, then form into 2 thin patties.
In a separate skillet, cook the beef patties over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side until browned, then place a slice of Swiss cheese on each patty and let melt.
Spread mayonnaise on the inside of each bread slice and layer one slice with caramelized onions and a cheesy patty.
Top with another slice of bread and place the sandwich in a clean skillet or griddle with 1 tbsp butter over medium heat.
Cook for 3-4 minutes until the bread is golden, then carefully flip and cook the other side for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use regular sandwich bread instead of rye to save 50 cents

recipes.name: Turkey Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread mayonnaise on the inside of each bread slice.
Layer 2 slices of bread with 1/4 lb turkey, 2 slices cheese, tomato slices, and lettuce leaves on each, then top with the remaining bread slices.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Place one sandwich in the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes until the bread is golden brown and the cheese begins to melt.
Flip carefully and cook the other side for another 3-4 minutes until golden and the cheese is fully melted.
Remove to a plate and repeat with the remaining sandwich and butter.
Slice in half diagonally and serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy turkey from the deli counter in bulk to save versus packaged slices
Skip the tomato and lettuce to reduce cost to under $2 per serving

recipes.name: French Dip Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp butter in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté sliced onion until golden, about 6 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add beef broth and Worcestershire sauce, bringing to a simmer and cooking for 5 minutes.
If using raw roast, slice the beef thin and add to the broth to cook through, or if using deli roast beef, add and warm through.
Split the hoagie rolls and place provolone cheese on the bottom half of each roll.
Divide the hot beef mixture evenly between the two rolls, placing the beef on top of the cheese and drizzling with some of the hot broth.
Top each with the upper half of the roll and place on a baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F for 5 minutes to warm the rolls and melt the cheese, then remove and serve immediately with the remaining hot broth on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Use deli roast beef instead of raw roast to save time and money
Buy beef broth in bulk when on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Reuben Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread 1 tbsp Thousand Island dressing on the inside of each slice of bread.
Layer 2 slices of bread with 1/4 lb corned beef, 2 slices of Swiss cheese, and 1/2 cup drained sauerkraut on each.
Top each sandwich with the remaining bread slices, pressing gently.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Place one sandwich in the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes until the bread is golden brown and the cheese begins to melt.
Flip carefully and cook the other side for another 3-4 minutes until golden and the cheese is fully melted.
Remove to a plate, repeat with the remaining sandwich and butter, then slice diagonally and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make your own Thousand Island dressing with mayo and ketchup to save money
Buy sauerkraut in jars from the deli section rather than canned

recipes.name: Shrimp Cocktail
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring salted water to a boil in a large pot.
Add shrimp and cook for 3-4 minutes until pink and cooked through.
Drain shrimp and transfer to an ice bath to cool completely.
Combine ketchup, horseradish, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, and hot sauce in a bowl to make cocktail sauce.
Place a lettuce leaf in each serving glass and arrange chilled shrimp around the rim.
Spoon cocktail sauce into the center of each glass and serve with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp on sale and thaw overnight
Make cocktail sauce from scratch instead of buying prepared

recipes.name: Aspic
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bloom gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes, then dissolve over low heat.
Heat broth with shallots, tarragon, and wine until simmering.
Whisk egg whites and add to the broth to clarify it, simmering 10 minutes then straining through cheesecloth.
Combine clarified broth with dissolved gelatin and season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Pour a thin layer of aspic into a terrine or loaf pan and refrigerate until set.
Arrange cooked vegetables or meat on the set aspic layer.
Pour remaining aspic over carefully and refrigerate at least 4 hours until fully set.
Unmold by dipping the bottom in hot water and serve chilled in slices.
cheapTips: Use homemade stock or budget broth instead of premium brands
Use leftover cooked chicken or vegetables for filling

recipes.name: Insalata di Riso
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring salted water to a boil and add rice, stirring occasionally until cooked through, about 18 minutes.
Drain rice and spread on a baking sheet to cool to room temperature.
Transfer cooled rice to a large bowl.
Add tomatoes, mozzarella, corn, cucumbers, and red onion to the rice.
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to combine.
Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy mozzarella in bulk when on sale and cube it yourself
Use frozen corn instead of canned to save money

recipes.name: Salade de Betteraves
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beet greens off and place whole beets in a pot with water and salt.
Bring to a boil and cook for 30-40 minutes until a knife pierces easily.
Drain beets and cool until handleable, then peel and cut into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Whisk together shallots, mustard, vinegar, and olive oil in a bowl.
Add warm beets to the dressing and toss gently.
Fold in parsley and walnuts, then transfer to a serving platter.
Top with crumbled goat cheese and serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy canned beets if fresh are expensive and skip cooking step
Make dressing in bulk and use for other salads

recipes.name: Nicoise Sandwich
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice baguette lengthwise and lightly toast if desired.
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper to make a vinaigrette.
Lightly brush the cut sides of the baguette with vinaigrette.
Layer lettuce, tuna, sliced hard-boiled eggs, olives, tomatoes, and anchovies if using.
Drizzle with remaining vinaigrette and close sandwich.
Slice diagonally and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned tuna on sale and stock up
Use store-brand baguettes to save on bread costs

recipes.name: Aguachile
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fish or shrimp into small bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl.
Combine jalapeños, serranos, and cilantro in a blender with 1/4 cup lime juice, 1/4 cup water, and salt.
Blend until a rough green sauce forms.
Pour the aguachile sauce over the raw seafood and add ice.
Let sit for 10-15 minutes while the seafood firms up slightly.
Add onion, cucumber slices, and remaining lime juice.
Serve immediately in a bowl with avocado slices on the side.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp instead of fresh fish to reduce cost
Buy limes when on sale and juice them yourself

recipes.name: Cold Buckwheat Noodles
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring salted water to a boil and cook buckwheat noodles according to package directions.
Drain noodles and rinse under cold water until completely chilled.
Whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, gochugaru, and garlic.
Divide noodles between two bowls.
Arrange cucumber, carrot, and egg halves on top of the noodles.
Pour sauce over noodles and toss gently to combine.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy buckwheat noodles in bulk from Asian markets
Use store-brand soy sauce and rice vinegar to save

recipes.name: Ramen with Miso Broth
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring broth to a simmer with ginger and garlic for 10 minutes to infuse flavors.
Remove ginger and garlic, then whisk in miso paste, soy sauce, and mirin until combined.
Bring a separate pot of water to boil and cook fresh ramen noodles according to package directions.
Drain noodles and divide between two bowls.
Sauté mushrooms in a separate pan until tender, about 5 minutes.
Ladle hot miso broth over the noodles.
Top with mushrooms, corn, soft-boiled egg halves, green onions, and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately and eat while hot.
cheapTips: Make your own soft-boiled eggs instead of buying prepared
Use frozen mushrooms and corn to reduce cost

recipes.name: Bun Oc
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using fresh snails, blanch them for 10 minutes to clean, then remove from shells if desired.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté garlic, shallots, and lemongrass until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add water and bring to a boil, then add snails and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season broth with fish sauce, salt, and pepper to taste.
Cook rice vermicelli noodles in boiling salted water until tender, then drain.
Divide noodles between two bowls and pour hot snail broth over them.
Top with fresh herbs and serve with lime wedges, chili paste, and extra fish sauce on the side.
Customers mix in condiments to taste.
cheapTips: Buy canned snails instead of fresh to save money and prep time
Use store-brand fish sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Sichuan Hot Pot Broth
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast Sichuan peppercorns and dried chilies in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Bring broth to a boil in a hot pot or large pot.
Add toasted peppercorns, chilies, star anise, cinnamon, ginger, and garlic.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes to infuse flavors deeply.
Strain if you prefer a clearer broth, or leave spices in for more intensity.
Season with soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt.
Transfer to a hot pot burner or keep simmering on the stove for dipping ingredients.
Serve with plates of thinly sliced raw proteins, vegetables, and noodles for guests to cook at the table.
cheapTips: Buy Sichuan peppercorns and dried chilies in bulk from Asian markets
Make double and freeze leftover broth for future hot pots

recipes.name: Chocolate Truffles
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat heavy cream in a small saucepan over medium heat until steaming but not boiling.
Pour cream over chocolate chips in a bowl and let sit for 2 minutes to soften.
Stir until smooth, then add butter, vanilla, and salt, stirring until fully incorporated.
Refrigerate the mixture for 20 minutes until cool enough to scoop.
Dust cocoa powder onto a plate, then roll tablespoon-sized portions of chocolate mixture into balls.
Roll each ball in cocoa powder to coat evenly.
Refrigerate finished truffles for at least 1 hour before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chocolate chips on sale or use a store brand instead of premium brands
Cocoa powder is inexpensive and a little goes a long way

recipes.name: No-Bake Cookies
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine butter, sugar, cocoa powder, and milk in a medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly, and boil for exactly 1 minute.
Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and vanilla extract until smooth.
Add oats to the mixture and stir until evenly combined.
Drop heaping tablespoons of mixture onto parchment paper.
Let cookies cool at room temperature for 15-20 minutes until set.
cheapTips: Oats and peanut butter are inexpensive pantry staples
This recipe uses basic ingredients you likely already have at home

recipes.name: Chocolate Pudding
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together cocoa powder, sugar, cornstarch, and salt in a medium saucepan.
Gradually whisk in milk until smooth and no lumps remain.
Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mixture thickens and comes to a boil, about 8 minutes.
Boil for 1 minute while stirring constantly, then remove from heat.
Stir in butter and vanilla extract until butter is fully melted.
Divide pudding into serving cups and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use regular cocoa powder instead of Dutch-processed cocoa to save money
Whole milk can be replaced with 2% milk without affecting the recipe much

recipes.name: Affogato
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brew 1 cup of fresh espresso or very strong hot coffee.
Place one or two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each serving glass or small bowl.
Pour the hot espresso slowly over the ice cream, allowing it to partially melt.
Optionally drizzle with coffee liqueur if desired.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Use store-brand vanilla ice cream to reduce costs
Make your own strong coffee instead of buying espresso shots

recipes.name: Pâté de Fruits
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bloom gelatin by sprinkling it over water and letting sit for 5 minutes.
Heat fruit juice and sugar in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Add bloomed gelatin to the warm juice mixture and stir until fully dissolved.
Pour mixture into an 8x8 inch parchment-lined baking pan and refrigerate for 4 hours until firm.
Cut the gel into small cubes or rectangles using a wet knife.
Mix corn starch and powdered sugar on a plate, then roll each piece to coat evenly.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
cheapTips: Use store-brand fruit juice instead of premium brands
Look for gelatin sales or buy in bulk

recipes.name: Chocolate Bark
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Melt chocolate chips and coconut oil together in a microwave-safe bowl in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until smooth.
Pour melted chocolate onto prepared baking sheet and spread into a thin, even layer using a spatula.
Sprinkle cranberries, almonds, and sea salt evenly over the chocolate.
Refrigerate for 15 minutes until completely hardened.
Break into uneven pieces and store in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Use a mix of chocolate chips and nuts on sale
Dried fruit on clearance works just as well as fresh purchases

recipes.name: Panacotta al Caffè
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bloom gelatin by sprinkling it over water and letting sit for 5 minutes.
Heat cream and milk in a saucepan over medium heat until steaming but not boiling.
Whisk in sugar and espresso powder until fully dissolved and smooth.
Remove from heat and add bloomed gelatin, stirring until completely dissolved.
Stir in vanilla extract, then pour mixture evenly into four serving glasses or ramekins.
Refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight until set.
Serve chilled, optionally with a drizzle of chocolate sauce.
cheapTips: Buy instant espresso powder in bulk from international or specialty stores
Use store-brand cream and milk to reduce costs

recipes.name: Lemon Icebox Pie
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press firmly into a 9-inch pie pan to form crust.
Bake crust at 350°F for 8 minutes until lightly golden, then remove and cool slightly.
Whisk together egg yolks, sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice, and lemon zest in a bowl until combined.
Pour filling into prepared crust and smooth the top.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours until set, or freeze for 2 hours for a firmer texture.
Top with whipped cream just before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand sweetened condensed milk and graham crackers
Skip the whipped cream topping and use Cool Whip to save money

recipes.name: Zabaglione
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a medium saucepan with about 2 inches of water and bring to a gentle simmer.
Create a double boiler by placing a heat-safe bowl over the simmering water without touching the water.
Combine egg yolks and sugar in the bowl and whisk constantly for 3 minutes until pale.
Gradually whisk in marsala wine and continue whisking for 5-7 minutes until mixture is thick, foamy, and reaches 160°F on a thermometer.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract.
Divide into serving glasses and serve immediately while warm, or chill for a mousse-like texture.
cheapTips: Use dry marsala wine from a lower-priced brand
Serve with store-bought cookies or ladyfingers instead of making your own

recipes.name: Muesli
recipes.description: Swiss breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine oats, dried fruit, nuts, and cinnamon in a large bowl.
Stir in honey until evenly distributed throughout the dry mixture.
Divide muesli mixture among serving bowls.
Pour milk or yogurt over each serving and stir gently to combine.
Top with fresh berries.
Serve immediately, or let soak for 5 minutes for softer texture.
cheapTips: Buy oats and dried fruit in bulk from bulk bins to save significantly
Use frozen berries instead of fresh for cheaper year-round options

recipes.name: Yentafo
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Cut tofu into cubes, fish cake into slices, and prepare fish balls.
Add tofu, fish balls, and fish cake to the boiling broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in fish sauce, tamarind paste, and palm sugar until dissolved.
Cook rice noodles according to package directions and divide between bowls.
Ladle the hot broth and ingredients over the noodles.
Garnish with green onions, lime juice, and chili flakes, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy fish balls frozen in bulk from Asian markets—much cheaper than fresh
Make your own tamarind paste from concentrate to save money

recipes.name: Chow Mein with Spicy Sauce
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook chow mein noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and slice bell pepper and onion into strips.
Heat vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Add garlic and ginger, stirring constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook until golden, about 5-7 minutes.
Toss in bell pepper and onion, stir-frying for 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add cooked noodles, soy sauce, sriracha, and sesame oil, tossing until evenly coated.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast—they're cheaper and stay moist
Buy pre-minced garlic in jars to save prep time

recipes.name: Bun Mam
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice vermicelli according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Whisk together fish sauce, water, sugar, and lime juice to make the dipping sauce.
Heat oil in a skillet and fry pork belly cubes until crispy and golden, about 8 minutes.
Remove pork and set aside, then pan-fry fish fillets until cooked through, about 6-8 minutes.
In the same skillet, sauté minced garlic and sliced shallots until fragrant.
Return pork to the skillet and toss with the garlic and shallots.
Divide rice vermicelli and lettuce into bowls, top with fish and pork mixture.
Pour the fish sauce dipping sauce over everything and serve with fresh herbs.
cheapTips: Buy catfish—it's often cheaper than other fish and more authentic
Use iceberg lettuce instead of specialty greens to cut costs

recipes.name: Granola Parfait
recipes.description: Modern Health breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spoon half of the Greek yogurt into two serving glasses or bowls.
Layer with half of the berries and half of the granola.
Top with remaining yogurt, then arrange remaining berries on top.
Drizzle honey over each parfait.
Sprinkle sliced almonds and coconut flakes over the top.
Arrange banana slices on the side and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand Greek yogurt—tastes the same as name brands
Use frozen berries instead of fresh to reduce cost significantly

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Bowl
recipes.description: Mediterranean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Divide Greek yogurt equally between two bowls.
Drizzle each bowl with honey and a small amount of olive oil.
Top with chopped walnuts and dried figs.
Scatter fresh berries over each bowl.
Sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt and lemon zest.
Serve immediately or chill until ready to eat.
cheapTips: Buy walnuts from the bulk section instead of pre-packaged
Use regular dried figs from the produce section instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Modern Health breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a mason jar or container, combine oats, milk, Greek yogurt, and honey.
Stir in mashed banana, chia seeds, and vanilla extract until well combined.
Gently fold in half of the blueberries.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours.
In the morning, stir and add more milk if too thick.
Top with remaining blueberries and serve cold or heat in microwave for 1-2 minutes.
cheapTips: Make a big batch on Sunday for the whole week
Use frozen blueberries—they're cheaper and work just as well

recipes.name: Fruit Salad
recipes.description: International snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut watermelon and pineapple into bite-sized cubes.
Rinse and halve the grapes; slice strawberries in half.
Combine all fruit in a large bowl.
Whisk together lime juice and honey in a small bowl.
Pour the lime-honey mixture over the fruit and toss gently.
Sprinkle fresh mint over the top.
Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy fruit that's in season—watermelon and pineapple are cheapest in summer
Purchase pre-cut fruit from the store to save prep time if budget allows

recipes.name: Quinoa Bowl
recipes.description: Modern Health lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse quinoa and cook in water according to package directions, then set aside to cool.
Drain and rinse canned chickpeas, then toss with half the olive oil.
Dice cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and bell pepper into bite-sized pieces.
Whisk together remaining olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, and parsley.
In a large bowl, combine cooled quinoa, chickpeas, and all chopped vegetables.
Pour dressing over the bowl and toss until well coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then divide between two bowls and serve.
cheapTips: Buy quinoa in bulk from the health food section
Use canned chickpeas—they're cheaper than dried and already cooked

recipes.name: Panda Bowl
recipes.description: Modern Health lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook brown rice in water according to package directions.
While rice cooks, cut chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add minced garlic and ginger, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and cook until golden and cooked through, about 7 minutes.
Add broccoli florets and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Whisk together soy sauce, sriracha, honey, and sesame oil, then pour over the chicken and broccoli.
Toss until evenly coated, then serve over cooked brown rice with green onions on top.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breast for more flavor at lower cost
Use frozen broccoli to save money and prep time

recipes.name: Fruit Bowl with Honey and Nuts
recipes.description: Mediterranean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Core and slice apples into bite-sized pieces, core and slice pears similarly.
Toss apple and pear slices with lemon juice to prevent browning.
Add grapes to the fruit mixture in a large bowl.
Combine almonds, walnuts, and pistachios in a small bowl.
Drizzle honey over the fruit and gently toss.
Top with mixed nuts and fresh mint leaves.
Serve immediately or chill until ready to serve.
cheapTips: Buy nuts from the bulk bin instead of pre-packaged portions
Use store-brand honey to save a dollar or two per bottle

recipes.name: Fruit Tart
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, 0.25 cup sugar, and salt, then cut in cold butter until crumbly and work in egg yolk until dough forms.
Press dough into a 9-inch tart pan and bake at 375°F for 12-15 minutes until light golden, then cool completely.
Heat milk with cornstarch whisked smooth, stirring constantly until thickened, then remove from heat and stir in vanilla and 1 tablespoon sugar.
Pour warm pastry cream into cooled crust and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Arrange fresh strawberries and blueberries on top of pastry cream in a decorative pattern.
Heat apricot jam with 1 tablespoon water and brush gently over fruit to create shine.
Refrigerate tart for at least 1 hour before serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen berries instead of fresh to save 40% on fruit costs
Make pastry cream with condensed milk instead of fresh for budget option

recipes.name: Plum Pudding
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried fruit in brandy for 2 hours or overnight to plump.
Mix flour, breadcrumbs, baking soda, mixed spice, and salt in a large bowl.
Cream butter and brown sugar together, then beat in eggs one at a time.
Stir butter mixture into dry ingredients alternately with milk, then fold in soaked fruit with liquid.
Grease a 2-quart pudding mold and fill three-quarters full with batter.
Cover with foil and place in a steamer pot with 2 inches of boiling water, steaming for 3-4 hours, adding water as needed.
Cool pudding for 10 minutes before turning out onto a plate.
cheapTips: Buy dried fruit in bulk from ethnic markets for 30% savings
Substitute brandy with orange juice for non-alcoholic version at lower cost

recipes.name: Baozi
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water, then mix with flour and salt to form dough, kneading for 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover dough and let rise in warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Cook ground pork in skillet with oil over medium heat until browned, then add garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir soy sauce, sesame oil, and chopped green onions into cooked pork and cool completely.
Divide dough into 12 pieces and roll each into a 3-inch circle, keeping edges thinner than center.
Place 1 tablespoon filling in center of each circle, then fold edges up and pinch to seal at top.
Place baozi seam-side down on parchment squares and let rest 20 minutes, then steam in basket for 12-15 minutes until fluffy.
cheapTips: Use ground chicken instead of pork to save 25% on filling cost
Make filling with cabbage and mushrooms mixed with pork to stretch meat further

recipes.name: Creole Beignets
recipes.description: New Orleans breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl.
Beat egg with milk and vanilla, then stir into dry ingredients until a soft dough forms.
Turn dough onto floured surface and roll to 0.25-inch thickness, then cut into 3-inch squares.
Heat oil to 375°F in a deep pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Carefully place dough squares into hot oil a few at a time and fry for 1-2 minutes per side until puffed and golden.
Remove beignets with slotted spoon and drain briefly on paper towels.
Dust generously with powdered sugar while still warm and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Reuse frying oil multiple times before discarding to save money
Use regular sugar mixed with cornstarch instead of expensive powdered sugar

recipes.name: Hotteok
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast and 1 tablespoon granulated sugar in warm water, then mix with flour and salt until shaggy dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Mix brown sugar, cinnamon, and chopped peanuts in a small bowl for filling.
Divide risen dough into 8 pieces and roll each into a circle about 4 inches across.
Place 1 tablespoon filling in center of each circle, then fold edges up and seal by pinching.
cheapTips: Skip peanuts and use brown sugar with sesame seeds for budget filling
Reuse frying oil three to four times before replacing

recipes.name: Corn Dogs
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Beat egg with milk in another bowl, then stir into dry ingredients until smooth batter forms.
Insert a wooden skewer into the end of each hot dog.
Heat oil to 375°F in a deep pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Dip each hot dog into batter to coat completely, then carefully place into hot oil.
Fry 3-4 at a time for 2-3 minutes, turning once, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove corn dogs with tongs and drain on paper towels, then serve warm with mustard or ketchup.
cheapTips: Buy hot dogs on sale and freeze for bulk savings
Reuse frying oil multiple times to reduce per-serving oil cost

recipes.name: Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Divide yogurt evenly between two glasses.
Layer half the granola on top of the yogurt in each glass.
Add blueberries and strawberries over the granola.
Top with remaining yogurt and granola.
Drizzle honey over the top of each parfait.
Sprinkle coconut and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use frozen berries instead of fresh to save 40%
Buy granola in bulk or make your own

recipes.name: Trifle
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pound cake into 1-inch cubes and layer half in a large trifle bowl.
Brush cake cubes with sherry or juice.
Prepare vanilla pudding according to package directions using milk.
Pour half the pudding over cake layer and scatter half the raspberries on top.
Add remaining cake cubes and pudding, then remaining raspberries.
Whip heavy cream with sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Top trifle with whipped cream layer and sprinkle almonds over the top.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pound cake instead of homemade
Substitute whipped cream with Cool Whip to save $1 per serving

recipes.name: Chocolate Ganache Tart
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then cut in cold butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Combine egg yolk with cold water and stir into dough until just combined.
Form dough into a disk, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll out dough and press into a 9-inch tart pan; prick with fork and bake at 375°F for 12 minutes until light golden.
