Heat cream until steaming, then pour over chocolate chips and let sit 1 minute.
Whisk chocolate mixture until smooth, then stir in corn syrup and vanilla.
Pour ganache into warm crust and let cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate until ganache is set, about 2 hours, then serve.
cheapTips: Use chocolate chips instead of premium chocolate bars
Make crust from scratch instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Icebox Cake
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whip heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Lightly dip each chocolate wafer into cold water for 1 second.
Layer one wafer on a serving plate, spread 1 tablespoon whipped cream on top.
Continue layering dipped wafers and cream, creating a log shape with 6 layers per row.
Wrap finished cake in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight.
Dust with cocoa powder and slice diagonally to serve.
cheapTips: Buy chocolate wafers from the generic store brand
Use Cool Whip instead of whipping cream to save $2

recipes.name: Raspberry Fool
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine raspberries with 2 tablespoons sugar and lemon juice, then gently mash with a fork leaving some texture.
Whip heavy cream with remaining sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form.
Gently fold raspberry mixture into whipped cream, leaving visible swirls of fruit.
Divide into serving glasses and serve immediately or refrigerate until ready.
cheapTips: Use frozen raspberries when fresh are expensive
Substitute half the cream with Greek yogurt to cut cost in half

recipes.name: Strawberry Shortcake
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix flour, 2 tablespoons granulated sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs, then stir in milk until just combined.
Drop 4 equal portions of dough onto baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden.
Meanwhile, slice strawberries and toss with remaining granulated sugar; let sit 10 minutes.
Whip heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Split warm shortcakes horizontally and layer with strawberries, whipped cream, and shortcake top.
Serve immediately while shortcakes are still warm.
cheapTips: Use store-bought biscuits instead of homemade shortcakes
Buy strawberries during peak season and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Lemon Meringue Pie
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and bake pie crust for 10 minutes until lightly golden.
Whisk condensed milk, lemon juice, lemon zest, and 4 egg yolks until combined.
In a small bowl, mix cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water until smooth, then fold into lemon filling.
Pour filling into partially baked crust and bake for 15 minutes.
While filling bakes, beat 4 egg whites with cream of tartar until foamy, then gradually add sugar until stiff peaks form.
Remove pie from oven and spread meringue over hot filling, sealing edges to crust.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until meringue is golden brown.
Cool on wire rack for 1 hour, then refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pie crust instead of making from scratch
Buy lemons on sale and juice them at home instead of bottled juice

recipes.name: Crème Brûlée aux Fruits Rouges
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat cream and milk with vanilla until steaming but not boiling; let cool 5 minutes.
Whisk egg yolks with 0.33 cup sugar and salt until pale, about 2 minutes.
Slowly whisk hot cream mixture into yolks while whisking constantly.
Strain custard through fine sieve and divide berries among 4 ramekins.
Pour custard over berries into ramekins and place in a water bath with hot water halfway up sides.
Bake at 325°F for 20-25 minutes until edges are set but center still jiggles slightly.
Remove from oven and water bath, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Before serving, sprinkle remaining sugar on top and use a torch to caramelize until amber.
cheapTips: Use frozen berries instead of fresh to save $3 per serving
Make without a kitchen torch by caramelizing under the broiler

recipes.name: Fruit Salad with Cointreau
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prepare all fruit by washing and cutting into uniform pieces.
Combine all fruit in a large glass bowl.
Whisk together Cointreau and honey until honey dissolves.
Pour Cointreau mixture over fruit and gently toss to combine.
Tear fresh mint leaves and fold into salad.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
cheapTips: Skip the Cointreau and use fresh orange juice instead to save $4
Buy fruit in season and reduce liqueur amount

recipes.name: Clafoutis
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 9-inch round baking dish.
Distribute cherries evenly in the prepared dish.
Blend flour, milk, eggs, sugar, vanilla, and salt in a blender until smooth, about 1 minute.
Pour batter over cherries and bake for 30-35 minutes until golden and a knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Dust top generously with powdered sugar and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use canned cherries instead of fresh to save $2 per serving
Substitute with other fruit like apples or berries

recipes.name: Canh Chua
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté minced garlic and shallots until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add water and bring to a boil, then stir in tamarind paste and fish sauce.
Add pineapple chunks and tomato quarters, simmering for 8 minutes.
Add okra and fish fillets, cooking for 5-7 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more fish sauce or tamarind as needed.
Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with fresh dill before serving.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish and ask the butcher to fillet it for cheaper bulk pricing
Use frozen okra and pineapple to reduce costs by 30%

recipes.name: Yu Xiang Shrimp
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, chili paste, and water in a small bowl to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Add garlic and ginger, stirring constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes per side until pink.
Pour the sauce into the wok and toss shrimp to coat evenly for 1-2 minutes.
Add sliced green onions and drizzle with sesame oil.
Transfer to a serving plate and serve immediately over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk at warehouse stores for 40% savings
Substitute sriracha with cheaper generic chili paste

recipes.name: Pho Bo with Chili
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Char onion and ginger under broiler for 5 minutes until blackened, then add to a pot with water and bones.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2-3 hours, skimming impurities from the surface.
Toast cinnamon, star anise, cloves, and coriander in a dry pan for 1 minute, then add to broth.
Add beef chuck roast and fish sauce, simmering for 1 more hour until beef is tender.
Remove beef, slice thinly, and strain broth through fine mesh.
Cook rice noodles according to package directions and divide among serving bowls.
Pour hot broth over noodles and arrange beef slices on top.
Serve with fresh chili, basil, lime wedges, and additional fish sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy beef bones from the meat counter; they're often cheaper than pre-packaged
Make large batches and freeze broth in portions for future use

recipes.name: Assam Laksa
recipes.description: Malaysian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried chilies in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with garlic, shallots, galangal, and a splash of water to make a paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the spice paste for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.
Add fish pieces and cook for 5 minutes, breaking them apart into smaller pieces.
Add water, fish sauce, and tamarind paste, bringing to a boil and simmering for 15 minutes.
Strain the broth through a fine mesh, discarding solids, and return to pot.
Cook rice noodles separately according to package directions.
Divide noodles among bowls, pour hot broth over them, and top with cucumber slices and pineapple.
Serve immediately with lime wedges and additional fish sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish instead of fillets for 50% cost savings
Use dried chili flakes instead of whole dried chilies

recipes.name: Chiang Mai Khao Soi
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté minced garlic and shallots for 2 minutes.
Add red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add coconut milk and turmeric, stirring to combine, then add chicken pieces.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a simmer, cooking chicken for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Cook noodles according to package directions in a separate pot and drain.
Stir fish sauce and sugar into the curry, tasting and adjusting seasonings.
Divide noodles among bowls and ladle curry with chicken over them.
Serve with lime wedges and crispy fried shallots on top if available.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken and cut it yourself instead of breast pieces
Make your own curry paste from scratch using dried chilies and spices

recipes.name: Creamy Tom Yum
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crush lemongrass stalks and galangal slightly, then add to a pot with chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes to infuse flavors.
Add sliced mushrooms and minced chilies, cooking for 3 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes until pink.
Stir in coconut milk, fish sauce, and lime juice, simmering for 2 more minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more fish sauce or lime as needed.
Remove from heat and strain out large pieces of lemongrass and galangal if desired.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp instead of fresh for better pricing
Use bottled minced garlic instead of fresh garlic to save prep time

recipes.name: Penang Laksa
recipes.description: Malaysian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried chilies in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with garlic, shallots, galangal, turmeric, and shrimp paste to make a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the spice paste for 5 minutes, stirring constantly until fragrant.
Add fish pieces and cook for 3-4 minutes, breaking them into smaller pieces.
Pour in water and bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Strain the broth through fine mesh, discarding solids, and return to pot.
Stir in tamarind paste, fish sauce, and coconut milk, simmering for 5 more minutes.
Cook rice noodles separately according to package directions.
Divide noodles among bowls, ladle broth over them, and top with cucumber slices and additional condiments like fish sauce and lime.
cheapTips: Use red chili flakes instead of whole dried chilies to save money
Buy whole fish and fillet yourself for significant cost reduction

recipes.name: Mala Hotpot Broth
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast Sichuan peppercorns in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes until fragrant, then crush lightly with the back of a spoon.
Heat vegetable oil in a large pot and sauté crushed garlic and sliced ginger for 2 minutes.
Add toasted peppercorns, dried chilies, and star anise, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in broth and water, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes to allow flavors to develop.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil, tasting and adjusting seasoning as desired.
Strain if you prefer a cleaner broth, or leave peppercorns and chilies in for more flavor.
Transfer to a hotpot or keep warm in the pot for dipping thinly sliced meats and vegetables.
cheapTips: Make broth from scratch using chicken bones instead of buying prepared broth
Buy Sichuan peppercorns in bulk from Asian markets for 70% savings

recipes.name: Bun Rieu Crab
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean crab and extract meat from body and legs, setting aside both meat and shells.
Soak dried shrimp in hot water for 10 minutes, then drain and mince.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté minced garlic and shallots for 2 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add crab shells and dried shrimp, cooking for 3 minutes, then add water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes to extract crab flavor, then strain through fine mesh.
Return broth to pot and stir in fish sauce and sugar, adding crab meat back in.
Cook rice vermicelli according to package directions, cube tofu and simmer briefly in the broth.
Divide noodles among bowls, ladle crab broth over them, and top with tofu cubes.
Serve with fresh herbs, lime wedges, and additional fish sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy live crabs directly from Asian markets rather than pre-cooked for 30% savings
Substitute with shrimp shells if crab is too expensive in your area

recipes.name: Tonkotsu Ramen with Chili Oil
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch pork bones and butt in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse clean under cold water.
In a large pot, bring water to boil and add cleaned bones, pork butt, halved onion, smashed ginger, and garlic cloves.
Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 3-4 hours, skimming fat and impurities periodically.
Remove pork butt after 1.5 hours, slice thinly, and set aside for toppings.
After 3-4 hours total, strain broth through fine mesh and season with soy sauce, mirin, and salt.
Cook ramen noodles according to package directions (typically 3-4 minutes) and drain.
Boil eggs for 7 minutes for soft-boiled consistency, then peel and halve.
Divide noodles between two large bowls and ladle hot tonkotsu broth over them.
Top each bowl with pork slices, soft-boiled egg halves, nori strips, green onion slices, and sesame seeds.
Drizzle chili oil over the top and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy pork bones in bulk from ethnic markets for 60% cheaper than specialty butchers
Make large batches of broth and freeze in portions to amortize the long cooking time

recipes.name: Tres Leches
recipes.description: Latin American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Whisk eggs and sugar until pale and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Fold in flour, baking powder, salt, and vanilla until just combined.
Pour batter into pan and bake 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Poke holes all over the warm cake with a fork.
Combine condensed milk, evaporated milk, and heavy cream, then pour slowly over cake.
Cool completely, then refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Top with whipped cream and maraschino cherries before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand evaporated and condensed milk to save $1-2
Skip the maraschino cherries and top with fresh fruit instead

recipes.name: Vacherin aux Framboises
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 250°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form, then gradually add powdered sugar and cornstarch.
Pipe two 4-inch meringue circles onto parchment and bake 1 hour until dry and crisp.
Whip heavy cream with granulated sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form.
Warm raspberry jam slightly and fold in 1 cup of fresh raspberries.
Place one meringue on a plate, top with half the whipped cream, then half the raspberry mixture.
Add second meringue layer, remaining cream, and remaining raspberries.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 2 hours.
cheapTips: Buy frozen raspberries off-season and thaw for jam filling
Make meringues a day ahead to save time

recipes.name: Panna Cotta con Frutti di Bosco
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat cream, milk, and sugar in a saucepan until steaming, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract.
Sprinkle gelatin over water and let sit 2 minutes, then add to warm cream mixture and stir until dissolved.
Strain through a fine sieve and pour into 4 ramekins or glasses.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight until set.
Toss mixed berries with honey and let sit 10 minutes at room temperature.
Run a small knife around edges of ramekins and invert onto plates, or serve in glasses.
Top with honeyed berries and juice before serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen mixed berries instead of fresh for half the cost
Buy unflavored gelatin in bulk from the baking aisle

recipes.name: Apple Crumble
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter an 8x8 inch baking dish.
Peel, core, and slice apples, then toss with granulated sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice.
Spread apples evenly in baking dish.
Mix oats, flour, brown sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Cut cold butter into small cubes and rub into oat mixture until breadcrumb texture forms.
Spread crumble topping evenly over apples.
Bake 30-35 minutes until golden brown and apples are tender.
Cool 10 minutes before serving with ice cream or custard.
cheapTips: Buy apples in bulk when on sale and freeze for later
Use store-brand oats instead of name-brand

recipes.name: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Melt 0.5 cup butter in a 9-inch round cake pan, add brown sugar and 2 tablespoons pineapple juice, stirring until smooth.
Arrange pineapple slices in the sugar mixture and place a cherry in each ring center.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cream together granulated sugar and remaining butter, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
Fold flour mixture into batter alternately with 0.5 cup reserved pineapple juice, starting and ending with flour.
Pour batter gently over pineapple arrangement.
Bake 35-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean, then immediately invert onto a serving plate.
cheapTips: Use canned pineapple instead of fresh to save $2-3
Store-brand canned pineapple tastes identical to name brands

recipes.name: Charlotte Russe
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Lightly brush ladyfingers with raspberry jam thinned with 1 tablespoon water.
Line a round 6-inch mold or bowl with plastic wrap, then stand ladyfingers upright around sides.
Sprinkle gelatin over water and let sit 2 minutes.
Heat cream and sugar until steaming, remove from heat, add gelatin and vanilla, and stir until dissolved.
Chill cream mixture 20 minutes until slightly thickened, then whip to soft peaks.
Fold raspberries into whipped cream.
Pour filling into lined mold and fold ladyfinger ends over top.
Refrigerate at least 6 hours, then unmold, remove plastic, and serve chilled.
cheapTips: Buy ladyfinger cookies at discount stores like Aldi or Costco
Use frozen raspberries to reduce cost by half

recipes.name: Rhubarb Pie
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cold butter into flour and salt until breadcrumb texture forms, then add ice water until dough comes together.
Divide dough in half, flatten into disks, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375°F and roll out one dough disk to fit a 9-inch pie pan.
Mix rhubarb, sugar, cornstarch, and lemon juice, then pour into pie shell.
Roll out second dough disk and place on top, pressing edges to seal and crimping decoratively.
Beat egg with 1 tablespoon water and brush over top crust.
Cut vents in top and bake 50-60 minutes until golden and filling bubbles at edges.
Cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before slicing.
cheapTips: Buy rhubarb frozen in spring and use all year
Make pie dough from scratch instead of using pre-made crusts

recipes.name: Peach Melba
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water and granulated sugar to boil, add vanilla, and simmer 2 minutes.
Score peaches, place in syrup, and simmer 8-10 minutes until skin loosens.
Remove peaches with a slotted spoon and cool in ice water, then peel carefully.
Blend frozen raspberries with powdered sugar and push through a strainer to make coulis.
Halve peaches and remove pits, then nestle each pair around a scoop of vanilla ice cream in a serving bowl.
Pour raspberry coulis over peaches and ice cream.
Top with toasted sliced almonds and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use canned peaches in light syrup instead of fresh to save $2 per serving
Skip the almonds to reduce cost

recipes.name: Profiteroles aux Fruits
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
Bring butter and water to boil, remove from heat, and stir in flour and salt until ball forms.
Beat in eggs one at a time until batter is smooth and glossy.
Pipe 1-inch mounds onto baking sheets and bake 30-35 minutes until puffed and golden.
Cool completely on wire racks.
Whip heavy cream with powdered sugar until stiff peaks form.
Slice profiteroles in half and fill with whipped cream and fresh berries.
Stack on a serving plate, drizzle with warm chocolate sauce, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make choux pastry shells ahead and freeze for up to 2 weeks
Use store-brand chocolate sauce instead of homemade

recipes.name: Passion Fruit Cheesecake
recipes.description: Modern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and wrap a 7-inch springform pan with foil.
Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press firmly into pan bottom.
Beat cream cheese until smooth, then gradually add sugar and mix for 2 minutes.
Add eggs one at a time, beating after each, then stir in sour cream, passion fruit puree, vanilla, and lemon juice.
Pour batter over crust and place springform pan in a larger roasting pan filled with 1 inch of hot water.
Bake 45-50 minutes until edges are set but center jiggles slightly when shaken.
Turn off oven and crack door open 4 inches; let cheesecake rest in oven 1 hour.
Remove from oven and water bath, cool completely, then refrigerate at least 6 hours before unmolding and slicing.
cheapTips: Buy cream cheese on sale and freeze until needed
Use frozen passion fruit puree instead of fresh to save $3-4

recipes.name: Avocado Mousse
recipes.description: Latin American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut avocados in half, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a blender.
Add lime juice, honey, salt, and cinnamon to the blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy, about 1 minute.
In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream to soft peaks using an electric mixer.
Gently fold the whipped cream into the avocado mixture until fully combined.
Divide into serving bowls and top with fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 hours.
cheapTips: Buy avocados on sale and use within 2-3 days
Substitute heavy cream with Greek yogurt for lower cost

recipes.name: Coconut Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse jasmine rice under cold water until the water runs clear.
In a pot, combine rice, coconut milk, water, salt, and sugar.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes until rice is tender.
While rice cooks, slice cucumber into thin rounds and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Chop cilantro and green onions, and cut lime into wedges.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and divide into bowls.
Top each bowl with cucumber slices, tomatoes, cilantro, and green onions.
Serve with lime wedges on the side for squeezing.
cheapTips: Buy jasmine rice in bulk to reduce per-serving cost
Use seasonal vegetables instead of cherry tomatoes if available

recipes.name: Pumpkin Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: Modern Health lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix pumpkin puree with 1 tablespoon olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Spread pumpkin mixture on the baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes until slightly caramelized.
Cook quinoa according to package directions if not already prepared.
Toss chickpeas with remaining olive oil, salt, and pepper, then roast on a separate pan for 15 minutes until crispy.
Divide quinoa and spinach between two bowls.
Top with roasted pumpkin, crispy chickpeas, pepitas, and feta cheese.
Whisk tahini and lemon juice together and drizzle over the bowls.
cheapTips: Buy canned pumpkin in bulk after fall season for lower prices
Use spinach from frozen bags for convenience and lower cost

recipes.name: Grain Bowl
recipes.description: Modern Health lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook farro or brown rice according to package directions and set aside.
Preheat oven to 425°F and toss broccoli florets with 2 tablespoons olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Roast broccoli for 15 minutes until tender and lightly charred.
While broccoli roasts, combine red onion slices with balsamic vinegar in a small bowl and let sit.
Divide cooked grain between two bowls.
Top with roasted broccoli, pickled red onion, cherry tomatoes, and sliced almonds.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and sprinkle parmesan cheese and parsley over each bowl.
cheapTips: Buy farro in bulk bins instead of pre-packaged
Substitute almonds with cheaper sunflower seeds if needed

recipes.name: Muesli Bowl
recipes.description: Swiss breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, combine rolled oats, milk, Greek yogurt, honey, cinnamon, and salt.
Stir well and let sit for 5 minutes to allow oats to soften.
Core and slice the apple into thin pieces.
Slice the banana into coins.
Divide the muesli mixture between two bowls.
Top each bowl with apple slices, banana, sliced almonds, and raisins.
Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight for a make-ahead breakfast.
cheapTips: Buy rolled oats from bulk bins at grocery stores
Use seasonal fruit like bananas year-round for lowest cost

recipes.name: Watermelon Feta Salad
recipes.description: Mediterranean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut watermelon into cubes, removing excess seeds, and place in a large bowl.
Add crumbled feta cheese and thinly sliced red onion to the watermelon.
Tear fresh mint leaves by hand and add to the bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the watermelon mixture and toss gently to combine.
Squeeze lime juice over the salad for brightness.
Serve immediately while watermelon is cold.
cheapTips: Buy watermelon during peak summer season for best prices
Use store-brand feta cheese for cost savings

recipes.name: Beet and Goat Cheese Bowl
recipes.description: Modern Health lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and wrap beets in foil.
Roast beets for 35-40 minutes until tender when pierced with a fork.
Remove beets from oven and let cool slightly, then peel and cut into wedges.
While beets roast, make the vinaigrette by whisking together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, mustard, honey, salt, and pepper.
Toast chopped walnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Divide mixed greens between two bowls.
Top with roasted beets, walnuts, crumbled goat cheese, and fresh thyme.
Drizzle with vinaigrette and serve.
cheapTips: Buy beets when on sale and roast several at once to store
Use pre-mixed salad greens from bulk bins to reduce cost

recipes.name: Kale Caesar Bowl
recipes.description: Modern Health lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash and thoroughly dry the kale, then chop into bite-sized pieces.
In a bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, lemon juice, anchovy paste, minced garlic, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper.
Place chopped kale in a large bowl and drizzle with half of the dressing.
Massage the kale with your hands for 2 minutes to soften it.
Add remaining dressing and toss to coat.
Divide between two bowls.
Top each bowl with grated parmesan cheese and croutons.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make your own croutons from stale bread instead of buying
Buy pre-grated parmesan in bulk to reduce cost per serving

recipes.name: Chocolate Mousse
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop dark chocolate into small pieces and place in a microwave-safe bowl with butter.
Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until melted and smooth.
Let chocolate cool for 5 minutes, then whisk in egg yolks one at a time until well combined.
Stir in vanilla extract and salt.
In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream to medium peaks using an electric mixer.
Gently fold whipped cream into the chocolate mixture in two additions until no streaks remain.
Divide mousse into serving glasses or bowls.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, then dust with cocoa powder before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chocolate chips instead of chopped chocolate to save time
Use store-brand cocoa powder for topping instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Banoffee Pie
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a 9-inch pie pan with parchment paper.
Combine graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and salt, then press firmly into the bottom of the pie pan.
Bake the crust for 8 minutes until lightly golden, then remove and let cool completely.
Spread dulce de leche evenly over the cooled crust.
Slice bananas into coins and arrange them in a single layer over the dulce de leche.
In a bowl, whip heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form.
Spread whipped cream over the banana layer.
Grate dark chocolate over the top using a microplane or box grater, then refrigerate until serving.
cheapTips: Make your own dulce de leche by boiling sweetened condensed milk instead of buying canned
Use store-brand graham crackers to reduce crust cost

recipes.name: Baked Feta
recipes.description: Mediterranean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and place feta block in a small baking dish.
Toss cherry tomatoes with olive oil, minced garlic, oregano, and red pepper flakes.
Pour tomato mixture around the feta cheese.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until tomatoes burst and feta softens.
Top with fresh basil and serve warm with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy feta in bulk from warehouse stores for better pricing
Use canned tomatoes if fresh ones are expensive

recipes.name: Skibidi Toilet Cake
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a round 9-inch cake pan.
Mix flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk together eggs, oil, and vanilla, then combine with dry ingredients.
Stir in hot water until batter is smooth.
Pour into pan and bake 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely, then frost with blue-tinted cream cheese frosting.
Shape frosting into a toilet bowl on top with a piping bag.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cocoa powder and sugar
Skip decorative details to save on specialty frosting supplies

recipes.name: Corn in a Cup
recipes.description: Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a pan and add corn kernels, cooking for 3-4 minutes until lightly charred.
Remove from heat and stir in mayonnaise.
Mix in crumbled cotija cheese, juice of half a lime, and chili powder.
Divide into serving cups and top with fresh cilantro.
Serve warm with an extra lime wedge and sprinkle of chili powder.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn which is cheaper and equally delicious
Substitute cotija with feta or even parmesan for savings

recipes.name: Dalgona Coffee
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add instant coffee, sugar, and 2 tablespoons hot water to a bowl.
Whisk vigorously for 5-7 minutes until the mixture becomes thick and fluffy with a light brown color.
Fill two glasses with ice cubes and divide milk between them.
Spoon the fluffy coffee mixture on top of the milk.
Stir before drinking to combine, or sip the foam first.
cheapTips: Use any instant coffee brand, even store-brand works great
Make without cocoa powder to save on ingredients

recipes.name: Butter Board
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread softened butter evenly across a wooden board or serving platter.
Chop fresh herbs and sprinkle over the butter along with garlic powder.
Add lemon zest, sea salt, and red pepper flakes across the board.
Using a knife, lightly swirl the toppings into the butter.
Finish with a pinch of fleur de sel and serve with sliced crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy butter on sale and freeze until needed
Use dried herbs if fresh are not available

recipes.name: Gyatt Skibidi Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Drain excess fat and add taco seasoning with 1/4 cup water.
Simmer for 5 minutes until sauce thickens.
Warm taco shells according to package directions.
Dice onion and tomatoes finely.
Fill each shell with seasoned beef, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and onion.
Top with sour cream and salsa and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk and portion into freezer bags
Use store-brand taco seasoning instead of packets

recipes.name: Viral Lemon Pound Cake
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and grease a loaf pan.
Cream softened butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl.
Alternate adding flour mixture and sour cream to the butter mixture, beginning and ending with flour.
Fold in lemon juice and zest until just combined.
Pour into pan and bake 50-55 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 15 minutes in pan, then turn out onto a wire rack.
Make glaze with powdered sugar and 2-3 tablespoons lemon juice, then drizzle over cooled cake.
cheapTips: Buy lemons in bulk during peak season and zest/juice to freeze
Use bottled lemon juice if fresh lemons are expensive

recipes.name: Seafood Boil
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a large pot with water, add salt, and bring to a rolling boil.
Add Old Bay seasoning, halved lemons, and smashed garlic cloves.
Cut sausage into chunks and add to the pot.
Add quartered potatoes and corn, cooking for 15 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook for 3-4 minutes until pink and cooked through.
Drain in a colander and transfer to a large serving platter.
Top with melted butter and serve immediately with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp instead of fresh to save 30-40%
Use chicken sausage instead of smoked sausage for cost savings

recipes.name: Charcuterie Board
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Arrange cured meats in loose folds across a large wooden board.
Place chunks of different cheeses around the board with some space between.
Add olives, cornichons, nuts, and grapes in small clusters.
Arrange crackers and bread slices along the edges.
Drizzle honey over one section of cheese and serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy cured meats and cheese from deli counter in bulk rather than pre-packaged
Use store-brand olives and nuts to reduce costs

recipes.name: Cloud Bread
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 300°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Beat egg whites with a pinch of salt until stiff peaks form.
In another bowl, blend egg yolks, softened cream cheese, vanilla, and sugar until smooth.
Gently fold egg white mixture into the yolk mixture in two additions.
Spoon six mounds onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until light golden and set but still spongy.
Cool on a wire rack and serve plain or with jam and whipped cream.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk from warehouse stores
Skip sugar topping to save on ingredients

recipes.name: Matcha Latte
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Sift 2 teaspoons of matcha powder into a bowl to remove lumps.
Add 1/4 cup of hot water (about 160°F) to the matcha and whisk vigorously with a bamboo whisk or fork until smooth and frothy.
Heat 1 1/2 cups of milk in a saucepan over medium heat until steaming but not boiling.
Pour the matcha mixture into two cups and divide the hot milk between them.
Stir in honey or sugar to taste and add vanilla extract if desired, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy matcha powder in bulk from Asian markets instead of specialty coffee shops
Use regular milk instead of almond or oat milk to save 30-40%

recipes.name: Caprese Sandwich
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the ciabatta bread in half horizontally and lightly brush the interior with olive oil.
Slice the fresh mozzarella and tomatoes into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
Layer alternating slices of mozzarella and tomato on the bottom half of the bread.
Tear fresh basil leaves and scatter them over the mozzarella and tomato layers.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then season with salt and pepper.
Top with the bread's upper half and press gently together before cutting in half and serving.
cheapTips: Buy fresh mozzarella at Italian delis or grocery store produce sections rather than specialty shops
Use Roma tomatoes when in season for better flavor at lower cost

recipes.name: Burrata and Tomato
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice heirloom tomatoes into 1/4-inch thick rounds and arrange on a platter.
Gently place burrata balls on top of the tomato slices.
Tear fresh basil leaves and scatter them around the cheese and tomatoes.
Drizzle the entire plate with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Season with sea salt and black pepper and serve immediately at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy burrata from Italian markets when on sale and use within 1-2 days
Use regular tomatoes mixed with one heirloom tomato to reduce cost while maintaining flavor

recipes.name: Smashed Peas on Toast
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a pot of salted water to boil and cook frozen peas for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Drain peas in a colander and return to the pot.
Mash peas coarsely with a fork while adding butter, minced garlic, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Toast the bread slices until golden brown and lightly spread with butter.
Spoon the smashed peas onto each toast slice and garnish with fresh mint before serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen peas in bulk during sales to save 20-30% compared to fresh
Use store-brand bread and butter to keep costs down

recipes.name: Ricotta Pancakes
recipes.description: Australian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ricotta cheese, eggs, honey, and vanilla extract in a bowl and mix until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Fold the dry ingredients into the ricotta mixture until just combined with no lumps.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until foaming.
Drop spoonfuls of batter onto the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer cooked pancakes to a plate and serve warm with maple syrup or honey.
cheapTips: Buy ricotta cheese at warehouse stores like Costco for significant savings
Use store-brand honey instead of pure maple syrup to reduce topping costs

recipes.name: Cold Brew Coffee
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add 1 cup of coarse ground coffee to a large jar or pitcher.
Pour 4 cups of cold water over the coffee grounds and stir to combine.
Cover the jar and let it sit at room temperature or in the refrigerator for 12-24 hours.
Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh strainer or cheesecloth into a clean container, discarding grounds.
Dilute the cold brew concentrate with water or milk to taste and sweeten with honey or sugar as desired.
cheapTips: Buy bulk coffee beans and grind yourself to save 40-50%
Make large batches to last a week and save on daily coffee shop purchases

recipes.name: Acai with Granola
recipes.description: Brazilian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend frozen acai packets with almond milk and half of the banana until smooth and thick.
Pour the acai mixture evenly into two bowls.
Slice the remaining banana and arrange on top of each bowl.
Sprinkle granola, fresh berries, and coconut flakes over the acai.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy frozen acai packets in bulk at Costco or Trader Joe's for 30-40% savings
Make your own granola with oats, nuts, and honey instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Halloumi Fries
recipes.description: Mediterranean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut halloumi cheese into 1/2-inch thick sticks about 3 inches long.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs mixed with salt and pepper.
Coat each halloumi stick first in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing gently.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan or skillet to 350°F.
Carefully fry halloumi sticks in batches for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon to paper towels and serve immediately with lemon wedges and marinara sauce.
cheapTips: Buy halloumi from Mediterranean or Middle Eastern markets instead of mainstream supermarkets
Make your own breadcrumb coating from day-old bread to save money

recipes.name: Truffle Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook elbow pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and whisk in flour to create a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Gradually add milk while whisking constantly to avoid lumps, then simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in shredded cheddar and gruyere cheese until melted and smooth.
Add cooked pasta to the cheese sauce, season with salt and pepper, then drizzle in truffle oil.
Transfer to a serving dish and top with panko breadcrumbs mixed with fresh thyme before serving.
cheapTips: Use inexpensive truffle-flavored oil instead of real truffle oil to save 80%
Buy cheese blocks and grate them yourself instead of pre-shredded for better melting and lower cost

recipes.name: Cauliflower Toast
recipes.description: Modern breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pulse cauliflower rice in a food processor until finely minced, then squeeze excess moisture using paper towels or a clean kitchen towel.
In a bowl, beat eggs and combine with cauliflower rice, almond flour, parmesan, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat and spread the cauliflower mixture into two flat patties about 1/2-inch thick.
Cook for 5-6 minutes per side until golden brown and set, then transfer to a plate.
Halve the avocado, slice it thinly, and arrange on top of each cauliflower toast along with halved cherry tomatoes.
Drizzle with lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen cauliflower rice in bulk and thaw before using to save 40% versus fresh
Use regular all-purpose flour mixed with a bit of cornstarch instead of almond flour to reduce cost

recipes.name: Hummus with Pita
recipes.description: Middle Eastern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add drained chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and minced garlic to a food processor.
Blend until smooth, adding water 1 tablespoon at a time until reaching desired consistency.
Season with salt and adjust lemon juice to taste.
Transfer hummus to a serving bowl and drizzle with olive oil and paprika.
Warm pita bread in a skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Cut pitas into triangles and serve with hummus.
cheapTips: Buy tahini and canned chickpeas in bulk to reduce per-serving cost
Use lemon juice from concentrate instead of fresh lemons

recipes.name: Crispy Shallot Noodles
recipes.description: Vietnamese-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook ramen noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a small pan over medium-high heat and fry shallots until golden and crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove crispy shallots with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels, reserving 2 tablespoons of the shallot oil.
Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and minced garlic in a bowl.
Toss cooked noodles with the sauce and reserved shallot oil.
Top with crispy shallots, green onions, and sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Buy shallots at an Asian market for better prices
Use vegetable oil from bulk containers rather than small bottles

recipes.name: Korean Fried Chicken Sandwich
recipes.description: Korean-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix gochujang, honey, and soy sauce in a small bowl to create a glaze.
Mix cornstarch and flour in a shallow dish.
Pound chicken breasts to even thickness, coat in cornstarch-flour mixture.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a heavy pot or Dutch oven.
Fry chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until golden and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Brush fried chicken with gochujang glaze while still hot.
Toast brioche buns and spread mayo on both sides.
Assemble sandwich with pickles and glazed chicken, serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Make your own gochujang mayo blend instead of buying pre-made condiments

recipes.name: Ramen Burger
recipes.description: Japanese-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook ramen noodles according to package directions, drain well.
Toss warm noodles with beaten egg and sesame oil until coated.
Form noodles into 2 patty shapes and pan-fry in vegetable oil until crispy on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Season ground beef with soy sauce and form into 2 patties, cook in same skillet until done, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Spread mayo on one noodle patty and top with lettuce, tomato, and beef patty.
Top with second noodle patty and garnish with green onion.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk packs and portion into freezer bags
Use instant ramen from dollar stores for significant savings

recipes.name: Sushi Burrito
recipes.description: Japanese-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm sushi rice with rice vinegar and let cool slightly.
Lay a tortilla on a sheet of plastic wrap and spread thin layer of sushi rice on it.
Arrange crab, avocado, cucumber, and nori strips horizontally in the center.
Spread sriracha mayo over filling.
Using plastic wrap, roll tortilla tightly from bottom to top, keeping filling secure.
Slice burrito in half with a sharp knife and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with soy sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Use imitation crab (pollock) instead of real crab for major savings
Buy sushi rice at Asian markets at half the price of specialty stores

recipes.name: Dynamite Roll
recipes.description: Japanese-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cooked shrimp with sriracha and mayo to create spicy filling.
Place nori shiny-side down on a bamboo sushi mat.
Spread thin layer of sushi rice on nori, leaving ½ inch at the top.
Add shrimp mixture, avocado, and cucumber in a line across the rice.
Roll tightly using the mat, sealing the seam with water if needed.
Sprinkle sesame seeds on outside and slice with a sharp wet knife into 6-8 pieces.
Serve with soy sauce and wasabi on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk and thaw the night before
Use sushi rice cooker to batch cook and freeze portions

recipes.name: Peruvian Ceviche
recipes.description: Peruvian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fish into ½-inch cubes and place in a non-reactive bowl.
Pour lime juice over fish until fully submerged and let sit for 15-20 minutes.
Add sliced red onion, cilantro, and minced jalapeño to the fish.
Season with salt and pepper and gently mix.
Divide ceviche into bowls and top each with sliced avocado.
Serve with boiled sweet potato cubes and corn kernels on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen white fish and thaw instead of fresh for 30% savings
Use bottled lime juice instead of fresh when fresh limes are expensive

recipes.name: Korean Tacos
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar, simmer for 2 minutes.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or over a flame for 30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with lettuce and spiced beef.
Top each taco with sriracha mayo and sesame seeds, serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk 5 lb packs when on sale
Make your own sriracha mayo by mixing store-bought versions

recipes.name: Miso Caramel Chocolate Cake
recipes.description: Japanese-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9-inch cake pan.
Mix flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk together eggs, oil, miso paste, and hot water in another bowl.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool cake for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
Drizzle caramel sauce over cooled cake before serving.
cheapTips: Buy cocoa powder from bulk bins instead of branded boxes
Use store-brand caramel sauce rather than artisanal brands

recipes.name: Tandoori Salmon
recipes.description: Indian-British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix Greek yogurt, tandoori paste, lemon juice, minced garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Pat salmon fillets dry and coat both sides generously with tandoori mixture.
Let marinate for 10-15 minutes at room temperature.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Place salmon skin-side up in the skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes without moving.
Flip salmon and cook for another 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
Transfer to plates and garnish with cilantro and lime wedges, serve with cucumber slices.
cheapTips: Buy salmon on sale and freeze immediately for later use
Make your own tandoori spice mix from individual spices instead of paste

recipes.name: Chilli Chicken
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and toss with cornstarch, flour, salt, and pepper until coated.
Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Add chicken pieces and fry until golden brown on all sides, about 8-10 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same wok, add minced garlic and ginger, stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced onions and whole red chillies, cook for 2 minutes until softened.
Return chicken to wok and add soy sauce, vinegar, and chicken broth.
Toss everything together for 2-3 minutes until sauce coats the chicken evenly.
Serve hot with steamed rice or noodles.
cheapTips: Buy chicken in bulk when on sale and freeze portions.
Use regular onions instead of scallions to save money.

recipes.name: Garlic Chicken
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into cubes and coat with cornstarch and white pepper.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and fry chicken until golden, about 7 minutes, then set aside.
Mince garlic cloves finely and add to the wok with remaining oil.
Stir-fry garlic for 1 minute until it begins to turn golden brown.
Return chicken to wok and add soy sauce, ginger, and chicken broth.
Toss for 2-3 minutes until chicken is fully coated with garlic sauce.
Drizzle with sesame oil and garnish with chopped green onion.
Serve immediately over rice.
cheapTips: Buy pre-minced garlic from jars instead of fresh when budget is tight.
Skip sesame oil if not available; it's optional.

recipes.name: Chilli Paneer
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut paneer into 1-inch cubes and coat lightly with cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat and shallow fry paneer until light golden on all sides, about 5 minutes total, then remove.
Add minced garlic and ginger to the wok and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add diced onion and whole chilli peppers, cook for 2 minutes until softened.
Return paneer to wok and add soy sauce and vinegar.
Toss gently for 2 minutes until paneer is well coated.
Garnish with chopped green onion and serve hot.
Serve with fried rice or noodles.
cheapTips: Buy paneer from Indian grocery stores; it's cheaper than regular cheese shops.
Make your own paneer at home using milk and lemon juice to save significantly.

recipes.name: Black Pepper Chicken
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into thin strips or bite-sized pieces.
Coat chicken with cornstarch and 1 tablespoon of black pepper, then let sit for 5 minutes.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry chicken until cooked through, about 6-7 minutes, then set aside.
Add minced garlic and ginger to wok and stir for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Add diced onion and cook for 1-2 minutes until translucent.
Return chicken to wok and add soy sauce, remaining black pepper, and chicken broth.
Toss for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens and coats chicken.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve over rice.
cheapTips: Buy black pepper in bulk; a small amount goes a long way.
Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor on a budget.

recipes.name: Honey Chilli Potato
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes and soak in cold water for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Coat potatoes with cornstarch and salt.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and deep fry potato cubes until golden and crispy, about 8-10 minutes, then drain on paper towels.
Mince garlic and slice red chillies.
In a small bowl, mix honey, soy sauce, and vinegar together.
Add minced garlic and sliced chillies to the wok with a little oil and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add fried potatoes to wok and pour in honey-soy mixture, toss for 1-2 minutes until coated.
Garnish with chopped green onion and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk; they last for weeks and are very affordable.
Use regular sugar mixed with water if honey is unavailable.

recipes.name: Vegetable Manchurian Gravy
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix chopped cabbage, grated carrot, peas, cornstarch, and flour in a bowl with salt and pepper.
Form mixture into balls about 1.5 inches in diameter.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and fry vegetable balls until golden brown on all sides, about 8 minutes total, then set aside.
In the same wok, add minced garlic and ginger, stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a simmer, then add soy sauce and vinegar.
Gently return vegetable balls to the gravy and simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Thicken gravy if needed by mixing 1 tablespoon cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water and stirring in.
Garnish with chopped green onion and serve with rice or noodles.
cheapTips: Buy cabbage in bulk; it's one of the cheapest vegetables.
Use frozen peas instead of fresh to save money and reduce prep time.

recipes.name: Chow Bhel
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat and add minced garlic, cook for 20 seconds.
Add diced onion, carrot, and cabbage, stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Add minced green chilli and cook for 30 seconds.
Add puffed rice to the wok and toss gently to avoid breaking it too much.
Pour soy sauce and vinegar over the mixture and toss well for 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately while puffed rice is still crispy.
cheapTips: Buy puffed rice in bulk sections; it's very inexpensive.
Use whatever vegetables you have on hand to reduce costs.

recipes.name: Crispy Noodles
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook ramen noodles according to package directions, then drain and spread on a clean kitchen towel to dry completely, about 5 minutes.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and add minced garlic and chopped red chilli, stir for 20 seconds.
Add diced onion and cook for 1 minute until softened.
Add the dried noodles to the wok and toss gently for 2-3 minutes until heated through and slightly crispy.
Drizzle soy sauce and vinegar over noodles and toss well for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped green onion and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy ramen noodles in bulk; they're extremely affordable.
Skip any seasoning packet and make your own sauce for more flavor control and savings.

recipes.name: Dragon Chicken
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized cubes and coat with cornstarch, flour, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat until very hot.
Add chicken and fry until golden brown and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same wok, add minced garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add red chilli flakes and stir for 20 seconds to release their heat.
Return chicken to wok and add soy sauce, vinegar, and chicken broth.
Toss for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens and coats chicken.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve immediately over steamed rice or noodles.
cheapTips: Use dried red chilli flakes instead of fresh chillies to save money.
Buy chicken in bulk when discounted and freeze for later use.

recipes.name: Feta Pasta
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package directions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and add minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add halved cherry tomatoes, oregano, and red pepper flakes to the pan, cook for 5-7 minutes until tomatoes begin to blister and break down.
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water, then add pasta to the tomato mixture.
Crumble feta cheese over the pasta and toss gently, adding pasta water a little at a time to create a light sauce.
Add lemon juice and fresh basil, tossing to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, drizzling extra olive oil if desired.
cheapTips: Use canned diced tomatoes instead of fresh cherry tomatoes to save money year-round.
Buy feta cheese at warehouse stores like Costco for better pricing.

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and a pinch of sugar in a bowl, then let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour and salt in a large bowl, then add yeast mixture and 1 tablespoon olive oil, stirring until a shaky dough forms.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise for 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 475°F and stretch dough into a thin round on a pizza pan or baking sheet.
Spread crushed tomatoes mixed with minced garlic on dough, leaving a 1-inch border.
Tear mozzarella into pieces and distribute over sauce, then drizzle with remaining olive oil and black pepper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
Top with fresh basil leaves immediately after removing from oven.
cheapTips: Buy mozzarella in bulk or use block cheese instead of fresh for lower cost
Make dough from scratch rather than buying pre-made pizza dough

recipes.name: Pad Woon Sen
recipes.description: Thai-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak glass noodles in hot water for 10 minutes until soft, then drain.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and shrimp in half lengthwise.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and add minced garlic and chilies, stirring for 30 seconds.
Add chicken and shrimp, cooking for 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
Add diced onion and bell pepper, stir-frying for 2 minutes until slightly softened.
Add drained noodles and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Pour soy sauce and lime juice over the mixture, toss well, and cook for 1 more minute.
Transfer to serving plates and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use only shrimp or only chicken to reduce cost
Buy glass noodles in bulk at Asian markets for significant savings

recipes.name: Pad Cashew Chicken
recipes.description: Thai-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
Dice onion and bell pepper into 1-inch pieces, mince garlic and ginger, and slice Thai chilies.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until very hot.
Add chicken and stir-fry for 5-6 minutes until cooked through, then transfer to a plate.
Add remaining oil and cook garlic, ginger, and chilies for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced onion and bell pepper, stir-frying for 2-3 minutes until beginning to soften.
Return chicken to the wok and add soy sauce and oyster sauce, tossing well.
Add cashews and toss everything together for 1 minute, then serve immediately over rice.
cheapTips: Buy cashews from bulk bins rather than pre-packaged containers
Use chicken thighs instead of breast for cheaper cuts

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken
recipes.description: Thai-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and mince garlic and Thai chilies.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until smoking.
Add minced garlic and chilies, stirring constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and stir-fry for 5-6 minutes until cooked through.
Dice onion and add to the wok along with soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, and chicken broth.
Stir-fry for 2 minutes until onion begins to soften and sauce comes together.
Remove from heat and add fresh basil leaves, tossing gently until wilted.
Serve immediately over jasmine rice with the sauce spooned over top.
cheapTips: Substitute regular basil if Thai basil is unavailable
Buy Thai chilies at Asian markets for better prices

recipes.name: Crispy Tofu
recipes.description: Thai-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Cut pressed tofu into 1-inch cubes.
Mix cornstarch, salt, and black pepper in a shallow bowl.
Toss tofu cubes in cornstarch mixture until evenly coated.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Working in batches, fry tofu cubes for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crispy, then transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
Whisk together soy sauce, lime juice, minced garlic, minced chili, and water in a small bowl to make a dipping sauce.
Serve crispy tofu with dipping sauce and vegetables or rice.
cheapTips: Buy tofu in bulk packs when on sale
Reuse cooking oil for future batches of fried foods

recipes.name: Pad Broccoli
recipes.description: Thai-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into thin bite-sized pieces.
Mince garlic and mix cornstarch with water in a small bowl to create a slurry.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add chicken and stir-fry for 4 minutes until nearly cooked through, then set aside.
Add remaining oil and minced garlic to the wok, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add broccoli florets and stir-fry for 3 minutes until bright green.
Return chicken to the wok and add soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, and chicken broth.
Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook for 1 minute until sauce thickens, then serve over rice.
cheapTips: Use frozen broccoli to reduce cost and prep time
Buy chicken in bulk and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Thai Fried Rice
recipes.description: Thai-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice chicken breast into small pieces and mince garlic.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add diced chicken and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until cooked through, then set aside.
Add remaining oil and scramble eggs in the wok, breaking them into small pieces as they cook, then remove.
Add minced garlic and diced minced chili to the wok, stirring for 20 seconds until fragrant.
Add chilled rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Return chicken and eggs to the wok and add frozen peas and carrots, soy sauce, and oyster sauce, tossing everything together.
Stir-fry for 1 minute until vegetables are heated through, then top with sliced green onions and serve.
cheapTips: Cook rice the day before and refrigerate for best fried rice results
Buy frozen mixed vegetables instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Shrimp Pad Thai
recipes.description: Thai-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice noodles in room temperature water for 30 minutes until softened, then drain.
Whisk together tamarind paste, fish sauce, and palm sugar in a small bowl, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 20 seconds, then add shrimp and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until pink.
Push shrimp to the side and crack eggs into the wok, scrambling them until partially cooked.
Add drained noodles and tamarind sauce, tossing everything together for 2 minutes.
Add bean sprouts and toss for 1 minute until heated through.
Transfer to serving plates, top with crushed peanuts, lime wedges, and fresh herbs.
cheapTips: Buy shrimp frozen and thaw before cooking for better pricing
Substitute peanut butter mixed with a little water if tamarind paste is unavailable

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
recipes.description: Australian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast bread slices until golden brown and crispy.
Cut avocado in half, remove the pit, and scoop flesh into a small bowl.
Mash avocado with a fork until slightly chunky, then mix in lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and fry eggs to your preferred doneness.
Spread mashed avocado evenly on toasted bread slices.
Top each slice with a fried egg, then scatter cherry tomato halves and microgreens over top.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and sprinkle with red pepper flakes.
Serve immediately while toast is still warm.
cheapTips: Buy avocados on sale and ripen at home for better prices
Use regular whole wheat bread instead of sourdough to reduce costs

recipes.name: Whipped Coffee Dalgona
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add instant coffee, sugar, and hot water to a bowl.
Whisk vigorously with a fork or electric mixer for 3-4 minutes until the mixture becomes thick, fluffy, and light brown.
Fill two glasses with milk and ice cubes.
Spoon the whipped coffee mixture evenly on top of each glass.
Stir gently before drinking to combine the fluffy coffee with the cold milk.
cheapTips: Buy instant coffee in bulk at warehouse stores to save 30%
Use regular milk instead of specialty creamers

recipes.name: Chicken Parm
recipes.description: Italian-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breasts to 1/2-inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin.
Set up three shallow dishes with flour in one, beaten eggs in another, and breadcrumbs mixed with salt and pepper in the third.
Coat each chicken breast in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing gently so coating adheres.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry chicken for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown.
Spread 1/2 cup marinara sauce in a baking dish and arrange fried chicken on top.
Pour remaining sauce over chicken, then top with mozzarella and Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 400°F for 15-20 minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand marinara sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Baked Beans Pasta
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook penne according to package directions in salted boiling water, then drain and set aside.
Melt butter in a large pan over medium heat and sauté diced onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in baked beans with their sauce and add Worcestershire sauce, stirring well.
Mix in cooked pasta and stir until evenly coated with the bean sauce.
Stir in three-quarters of the cheddar cheese until melted, then season with salt and pepper.
Transfer to a baking dish, top with remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 10 minutes until cheese is golden.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans in bulk during sales
Use block cheese and shred it yourself instead of pre-shredded

recipes.name: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes, then boil in salted water for 12-15 minutes until fork-tender.
Drain potatoes thoroughly and return to pot, shaking gently to remove excess moisture.
Add butter, milk, sour cream, salt, pepper, and garlic powder to potatoes.
Mash until smooth or leave slightly chunky depending on preference.
Spread mashed potatoes onto a parchment-lined baking sheet in a thin, even layer.
Drizzle vegetable oil evenly over the potatoes.
Bake at 425°F for 15-20 minutes, stirring halfway through, until edges are golden brown and crispy.
Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with fresh chives.
cheapTips: Buy russet potatoes in 5-lb bags for bulk pricing
Use milk instead of cream to save money

recipes.name: Kimchi Tacos
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or over a gas flame for 20 seconds per side until pliable.
Mix cooked pork or chicken with kimchi and sesame oil in a bowl.
Spread 1 tablespoon of gochujang mayo on each warm tortilla.
Divide the kimchi-meat mixture among the tortillas.
Top each taco with avocado slices, cilantro, and green onions.
Serve immediately with lime wedges for squeezing.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the deli counter to save time and money
Buy kimchi in bulk jars instead of small containers

recipes.name: Bulgogi Burrito
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger in a bowl to make marinade.
Add thinly sliced beef to marinade and let sit for at least 15 minutes.
Heat a skillet over high heat and cook marinated beef for 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently, until cooked through.
Warm flour tortillas in a dry skillet or over a flame for 20 seconds per side.
Lay out a tortilla and add 1/2 cup rice as a base in the center.
Top with cooked bulgogi, kimchi, lettuce, and green onions.
Fold in sides of tortilla and roll tightly, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy beef sirloin on sale and slice it yourself or ask the butcher
Make rice in bulk at the beginning of the week

recipes.name: Gochujang Enchiladas
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, then drain excess fat.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to beef and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in gochujang paste and soy sauce, mixing well with the meat.
In a separate bowl, whisk gochujang paste with beef broth to create sauce.
Spread a thin layer of gochujang sauce in the bottom of a baking dish.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet to make them pliable.
Fill each tortilla with meat mixture, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in baking dish.
Pour remaining sauce over enchiladas and top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 20-25 minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden, then garnish with green onions.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale in bulk and freeze portions
Make your own gochujang sauce with gochujang paste and broth instead of buying premade

recipes.name: Korean BBQ Quesadilla
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread 1/2 tablespoon gochujang mayo on each of four tortillas.
Layer cheese, Korean BBQ beef, and caramelized onions on two of the tortillas.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over the fillings.
Top with remaining tortillas, mayo-side down, pressing gently.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Cook quesadillas for 3-4 minutes per side until cheese melts and tortilla is golden brown and crispy.
Cut into quarters and serve hot with sour cream and cilantro for garnish.
cheapTips: Use store-bought rotisserie beef or leftover grilled beef
Caramelize onions in bulk and refrigerate for multiple uses

recipes.name: Bibimbap Taco
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook ground beef in a skillet with soy sauce and minced garlic over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes, then set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté spinach with 1 teaspoon sesame oil for 2 minutes until wilted, then set aside.
Sauté sliced mushrooms with 1 teaspoon sesame oil for 3-4 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Lightly cook shredded carrots in the skillet for 2 minutes, then set aside.
Fry three eggs sunny-side up or over-easy.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 20 seconds per side until pliable.
Mix gochujang with remaining sesame oil to create sauce.
Build tacos by layering rice, beef, spinach, mushrooms, carrots, and a fried egg on each tortilla.
Drizzle gochujang sauce over filling, sprinkle with green onions, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy mushrooms and spinach at discount grocers or ethnic markets
Use pre-cooked rotisserie beef to cut cooking time

recipes.name: Tteokbokki Nachos
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook frozen tteokbokki according to package directions, then drain well.
In a small bowl, whisk together gochujang, sugar, water, and sesame oil to create sauce.
Pour gochujang sauce over cooked tteokbokki and toss until evenly coated.
Spread tortilla chips on a large baking sheet or serving platter.
Distribute tteokbokki and sauce over chips.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese and diced jalapeño over the top.
Bake at 375°F for 8-10 minutes until cheese is melted.
Remove from oven and garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.
Serve immediately with sour cream on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy frozen tteokbokki at Asian markets for significantly less than specialty stores
Use store-brand tortilla chips instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Black Garlic Beef
recipes.description: Chinese-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into thin slices and coat with cornstarch mixed with 1 tsp soy sauce.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until smoking.
Cook beef in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until browned, then set aside.
Add remaining 1 tbsp oil to the wok and fry garlic and ginger for 1 minute until fragrant.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, and water together in a bowl.
Pour sauce into the wok and stir for 1 minute until thickened.
Return beef to the wok and toss to coat evenly with the sauce for 2 minutes.
Garnish with sliced scallions and serve immediately over rice.
cheapTips: Buy beef on sale and freeze; use cheaper cuts like flank steak.
Make garlic paste at home instead of buying jarred versions.

recipes.name: Hakka Noodles
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil noodles according to package directions, drain, and set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add onion, bell pepper, and cabbage, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until slightly softened.
Push vegetables to the side and add remaining 1 tbsp oil, then add noodles.
Toss noodles with vegetables and add soy sauce, oyster sauce, and white pepper.
Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until everything is well combined and heated through.
Add vinegar and sliced scallions, toss once more, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use budget ramen packets instead of egg noodles for even lower cost.
Buy pre-shredded cabbage to save prep time and money.

recipes.name: Manchurian
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground chicken with half the garlic, ginger, chopped onion, cornstarch, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and salt to form a dough.
Shape chicken mixture into small balls about 1 inch in diameter.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a deep pan and fry chicken balls in batches until golden brown on all sides, about 8-10 minutes total; set aside.
Heat remaining 1 tbsp oil in the same pan and add remaining garlic, ginger, and green chili; stir for 30 seconds.
Add tomato sauce, remaining soy sauce, vinegar, and water; stir well.
Return chicken balls to the pan and simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.
Garnish with sliced scallions and serve with rice or noodles.
cheapTips: Use ground chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor at lower cost.
Make tomato sauce from canned tomatoes if fresh tomato sauce is expensive.

recipes.name: Schezwan Fried Rice
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Beat eggs with a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and scramble eggs until cooked through; set aside.
Add remaining 2 tbsp oil to the wok and add garlic; stir-fry for 20 seconds.
Add onion, bell pepper, and carrot; stir-fry for 2 minutes until vegetables start to soften.
Add chilled rice and break up any clumps with a spatula, stirring constantly for 2 minutes.
Mix soy sauce and schezwan sauce together and drizzle over rice.
Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until rice is well coated and heated through.
Add scrambled eggs back and top with sesame oil and sliced scallions; serve hot.
cheapTips: Cook extra rice the day before and refrigerate to save cooking time.
Use frozen mixed vegetables instead of fresh for year-round savings.
