recipes.name: Gobi Manchurian
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornstarch, flour, salt, and water to create a coating batter.
Dip cauliflower florets in the batter until fully coated.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a deep pan and fry coated cauliflower in batches until golden and crispy, about 10-12 minutes; set aside.
Heat remaining 1 tbsp oil in a pan and add minced garlic; stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add diced onion and stir-fry for 1 minute until softened.
Mix soy sauce, tomato sauce, and vinegar together and pour into the pan; simmer for 1 minute.
Add fried cauliflower to the sauce and toss gently for 2 minutes until coated.
Garnish with sliced scallions and serve hot with rice or noodles.
cheapTips: Buy cauliflower when in season or frozen for better prices.
Make your own tomato sauce from canned tomatoes to save money.

recipes.name: Chicken Lollipop
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken pieces dry with paper towels.
Mix ginger-garlic paste, soy sauce, vinegar, and red chili powder together and marinate chicken for 15 minutes.
Mix cornstarch, flour, and salt in a bowl and beat egg in another bowl.
Dip each chicken piece in egg, then dredge thoroughly in cornstarch-flour mixture.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F (or until a small piece of chicken sizzles immediately when dropped in).
Fry chicken pieces in batches for 6-8 minutes until deep golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and toss with sliced scallions and sesame seeds while still warm.
Serve immediately with a spicy dipping sauce like sriracha mayo or sweet chili sauce.
cheapTips: Buy chicken drumettes on sale and freeze for future use.
Make your own dipping sauce instead of buying bottled versions.

recipes.name: Momos
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt together, then add water gradually to form a soft dough; knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
Cover dough and let rest for 20 minutes.
Mix ground meat with chopped onion, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, green chili, cilantro, and salt to make filling.
Divide dough into 12-16 equal pieces and roll each into a thin circular wrapper about 3 inches wide.
Place 1 tbsp filling in the center of each wrapper and fold edges together to create a pouch shape, pinching at the top.
Bring a pot of water to boil and cook momos in batches until they float and continue cooking for 2 more minutes.
Remove with a slotted spoon and arrange on a plate.
Serve hot with a dipping sauce made from soy sauce, vinegar, minced garlic, and chopped green chili.
cheapTips: Make momos in large batches and freeze uncooked ones for quick future meals.
Use ground chicken thighs instead of pork for better moisture and lower cost.

recipes.name: Paneer Manchurian
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornstarch and flour with a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Toss paneer cubes in the cornstarch-flour mixture until evenly coated.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a deep pan and fry coated paneer cubes in batches until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes total; set aside.
Heat remaining 1 tbsp oil and add garlic; stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced onion and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Mix soy sauce, tomato sauce, vinegar, and water together and pour into the pan.
Return paneer to the pan and simmer for 3-4 minutes until sauce thickens slightly and paneer is heated through.
Garnish with sliced scallions and serve hot with rice or noodles.
cheapTips: Make paneer at home using milk and lemon juice for significant savings.
Buy paneer from Indian markets which often offer better prices than supermarkets.

recipes.name: Chilli Garlic Noodles
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil noodles according to package directions, drain well, and set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and red chili flakes; stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant and garlic is slightly golden.
Increase heat to high and add bell pepper and onion; stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Push vegetables aside and add remaining 1 tbsp oil, then add noodles.
Toss noodles with vegetables and add soy sauce, oyster sauce, and vinegar; stir-fry for 2 minutes until well combined.
Drizzle with sesame oil and toss once more.
Garnish with sliced scallions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy ramen noodles in bulk packs for significant per-serving savings.
Use frozen diced peppers and onions to save on prep time and spoilage costs.

recipes.name: Soy Sauce Fried Rice
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Beat eggs with a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and scramble eggs until cooked; remove and set aside.
Add remaining 2 tbsp oil to the wok and add minced garlic; stir for 20 seconds until fragrant.
Add onion, carrot, and peas; stir-fry for 2 minutes until vegetables are slightly softened.
Add chilled rice and break up any clumps with a spatula, stirring constantly for 2-3 minutes.
Pour soy sauce over rice and add white pepper, then toss everything together for 1 minute.
Return scrambled eggs to the wok and mix well.
Add sesame oil and sliced scallions, toss once, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Cook rice in bulk the previous day to reduce cooking time and energy costs.
Use frozen vegetables exclusively to eliminate waste and reduce spoilage costs.

recipes.name: Galbi Tacos al Pastor
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and minced garlic in a bowl to create the marinade.
Add beef short ribs to the marinade, coat thoroughly, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a grill or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat and cook the marinated ribs for 4-5 minutes per side until caramelized.
In a separate skillet, sauté pineapple chunks and sliced onion for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Warm corn tortillas over an open flame or in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Slice cooked ribs into bite-sized pieces and combine with the pineapple-onion mixture.
Assemble tacos with the meat mixture, top with cilantro, and serve with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy beef short ribs on sale and freeze; marinate frozen ribs overnight for deeper flavor
Use canned pineapple instead of fresh to save $1-2 per serving

recipes.name: Kimchi Fajitas
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix gochujang, sesame oil, and minced garlic in a small bowl.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook sliced chicken until no pink remains, about 6 minutes.
Add bell peppers, onion, and kimchi to the skillet with the chicken.
Pour the gochujang mixture over the vegetables and chicken, stir well, and cook for 4-5 minutes until vegetables soften.
Warm flour tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Divide the filling among the tortillas and top each with a dollop of sour cream and chopped scallions.
Serve immediately with extra kimchi and lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chicken in bulk when on sale and freeze in portions
Make your own kimchi 2 weeks ahead to save $3 per serving

recipes.name: Korean Chicken Flautas
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix shredded chicken with gochujang, soy sauce, sesame oil, and green onions in a bowl.
Lay out tortillas and divide the chicken mixture evenly among them, adding a small handful of cheddar cheese to each.
Roll each tortilla tightly, tucking in the sides, and place seam-side down.
Heat 2 inches of vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Carefully place flautas in hot oil, a few at a time, and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer cooked flautas to paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve with sour cream mixed with lime juice as a dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy rotisserie chicken on clearance in late evening for 30-50% off
Use store-brand cheddar cheese instead of name brands

recipes.name: Gochujang Salsa
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice roma tomatoes and place in a medium bowl.
Add minced onion, cilantro, jalapeño, and garlic to the tomatoes.
Stir in gochujang and lime juice until well combined.
Season with salt to taste and let sit for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with tortilla chips or as a topping for grilled meats and fish.
cheapTips: Buy tomatoes when in season (summer/fall) for 50 cents per pound
Substitute lime juice with vinegar to save 30 cents per batch

recipes.name: Soy-Lime Ceviche
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice fresh white fish into 1/2-inch cubes and place in a glass bowl.
Pour fresh lime juice over the fish, ensuring it is completely submerged.
Cover and refrigerate for 15-20 minutes until the fish turns opaque.
Drain excess lime juice, then add soy sauce, sesame oil, minced onion, jalapeño, and cilantro.
Gently fold in diced cucumber and season with salt.
Spoon ceviche into serving bowls and top with sliced avocado.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips or tostadas.
cheapTips: Buy frozen white fish and thaw in the refrigerator—same quality, 40% cheaper
Use bottled lime juice if fresh limes cost more than 50 cents each

recipes.name: Spicy Pork Belly Torta
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and minced garlic in a bowl.
Coat pork belly strips with the marinade and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat and cook marinated pork belly for 4-5 minutes per side until caramelized and crispy.
Reduce heat to medium-low and continue cooking uncovered for 30-40 minutes until pork is tender and fat is rendered, turning occasionally.
Slice bolillo rolls in half lengthwise and spread mayonnaise on both sides.
Layer cooked pork belly, pickled jalapeños, and sliced onion inside each roll.
Serve immediately, optionally warming rolls on the griddle with the pork drippings.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly when on sale and freeze; it becomes more tender when thawed slowly
Make your own pickled jalapeños 1 week ahead to save $1 per serving

recipes.name: Jjajangmyeon Taco Bowl
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook ground beef until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and diced onion to the beef and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in black bean paste, soy sauce, and brown sugar, mixing thoroughly.
Add diced potato to the mixture and cook covered over medium heat for 8-10 minutes until potato is tender, stirring occasionally.
Divide cooked rice among four bowls and create a well in the center.
Top each rice bowl with shredded lettuce as a base.
Spoon the black bean sauce and beef mixture into the center of each bowl and top with crispy tortilla strips.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in 1-lb portions for consistent pricing
Use store-brand black bean paste instead of imported brands to save 60 cents

recipes.name: Kimchi Tamale
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine masa harina, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Beat softened lard until fluffy, then gradually add to masa mixture alternately with warm chicken broth, mixing until dough reaches a spreadable consistency.
Mix shredded chicken with gochujang, chopped kimchi, and sesame oil in a separate bowl.
Drain corn husks and spread 2 tablespoons of masa dough on each husk in the center.
Place 1 tablespoon of the kimchi-chicken filling in the center of each dough portion.
Fold husks around the filling to enclose it, then stand tamales upright in a steamer basket with open ends facing up.
Steam for 45-50 minutes until masa pulls away easily from the husks, keeping water level consistent throughout cooking.
cheapTips: Buy corn husks in bulk from Latin markets for 50 cents per pound instead of 3 dollars
Use store-brand lard instead of name-brand shortening to save 40 percent

recipes.name: Galbijjim Mole
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried guajillo and ancho chiles in a dry skillet for 2 minutes until fragrant, then soak in hot water for 15 minutes.
Blend softened chiles, almonds, garlic, half the onion, and sesame seeds with 1 cup of the chile soaking liquid until smooth.
Heat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown beef short ribs on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Dice remaining onion and sauté in the pot with the browned ribs for 3 minutes.
Strain chile-almond mixture into the pot, add soy sauce and remaining beef broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 90 minutes until beef is fork-tender.
Add sliced plantains in the last 20 minutes of cooking and continue simmering until plantains are soft and sauce thickens.
cheapTips: Buy dried chiles from bulk bins at Latin markets instead of packaged for 70 percent savings
Use plantains near their expiration date at the grocery store for 40 percent discount

recipes.name: Tteok Street Tacos
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix gochujang, soy sauce, sesame oil, and minced garlic in a small bowl.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add sliced tteok rice cakes.
Cook rice cakes for 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently, until they begin to soften and slightly brown.
Add sliced onion and pour the gochujang sauce over the rice cakes.
Continue cooking for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until rice cakes are chewy and coated evenly with sauce.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Divide rice cake mixture among tortillas, top with chopped scallions and sesame seeds, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen rice cakes from Asian markets for half the price of fresh
Make your own gochujang-soy sauce base in large batches to use throughout the week

recipes.name: Tempura Burrata
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut burrata into 4 equal pieces and freeze for 10 minutes.
Whisk together flour, cornstarch, salt, and ice water until smooth.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan or wok.
Wrap each burrata piece in a basil leaf, then dip into tempura batter.
Fry for 45-60 seconds per side until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels immediately.
Serve hot with soy sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy burrata from warehouse clubs when on sale
Use neutral oil like canola instead of premium oils

recipes.name: Miso Panna Cotta
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bloom gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes until softened.
Heat cream and milk in a saucepan until steaming, then remove from heat.
Whisk miso paste with sugar until smooth, then add to warm cream mixture.
Stir in bloomed gelatin and vanilla extract until completely dissolved.
Strain mixture through fine mesh into a bowl.
Pour into ramekins or small serving glasses.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours until set.
Serve chilled with a pinch of sea salt on top.
cheapTips: Buy miso in bulk at Asian markets
Use unflavored gelatin packets from standard grocery stores

recipes.name: Uni Pasta al Dashi
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook pasta until al dente.
Warm dashi in a separate saucepan over medium heat.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain pasta.
Whisk egg yolk in a bowl with parmesan cheese.
Add butter to warm dashi and remove from heat.
Add warm pasta to dashi mixture and toss gently.
Pour egg and cheese mixture over pasta while tossing constantly to create creamy sauce.
Top with uni, fresh chives, and season with salt and white pepper.
cheapTips: Use instant dashi packets from Asian markets instead of bottled
Look for uni on sale at Japanese markets or substitute with good quality canned

recipes.name: Nori Parmesan Crisps
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Line baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut nori sheets into 2-inch squares.
Mix melted butter with garlic powder.
Place nori squares on baking sheet and brush lightly with garlic butter.
Top each square with about 1 teaspoon parmesan, sesame seeds, and pinch of salt.
Bake for 5-7 minutes until parmesan is golden and nori edges curl.
Cool on baking sheet for 2 minutes, then transfer to wire rack.
cheapTips: Buy nori sheets in bulk packs from Asian markets
Use block parmesan and grate yourself rather than pre-grated

recipes.name: Wagyu Ragu alla Bolognese
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook pancetta until crispy.
Add diced onion, carrot, and celery; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add ground wagyu and brown, breaking up meat as it cooks, about 8 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in red wine and simmer until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Add canned tomatoes and beef broth, then stir in milk.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 45-60 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve over cooked pasta.
cheapTips: Use regular ground beef if wagyu is too expensive
Make extra and freeze portions for future meals

recipes.name: Takoyaki Arancini
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook risotto by slowly adding warm dashi to rice, stirring frequently, until creamy, about 18 minutes.
Stir takoyaki sauce into cooked risotto and let cool to room temperature.
Cut mozzarella into 12 small cubes.
Form risotto into 12 balls, pressing octopus and cheese cube into center of each.
Set up three bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and panko breadcrumbs.
Coat each ball in flour, then egg, then panko.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry balls until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and top with bonito flakes while hot.
cheapTips: Use pre-cooked octopus from seafood counter or frozen
Make risotto base in advance and refrigerate overnight

recipes.name: Mozzarella with Wasabi
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice mozzarella into 1/4-inch thick rounds and arrange on a plate.
Mix wasabi powder with water to form a smooth paste.
Whisk together olive oil, soy sauce, and rice vinegar in a small bowl.
Drizzle dressing over mozzarella slices.
Add small dots of wasabi paste on each slice.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy mozzarella at warehouse stores in bulk
Use wasabi powder instead of tube paste for better value

recipes.name: Ramen Lasagna
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook ramen noodles according to package directions, drain and rinse.
Brown ground pork in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger to pork, cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Mix miso paste with beef broth, then add to pork with soy sauce and sake.
Simmer sauce for 10 minutes.
In a bowl, combine mozzarella with beaten egg.
In a 9x9 baking dish, layer noodles, sauce, and cheese mixture; repeat layers.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until cheese melts and edges bubble, then top with nori strips.
cheapTips: Buy ramen in bulk from Asian markets
Use regular shredded mozzarella instead of fresh

recipes.name: Salmon Carpaccio with Yuzu Kosho
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Ensure salmon is sushi-grade and very cold.
With a sharp knife, slice salmon as thinly as possible, about 1/8 inch.
Arrange salmon slices on two chilled plates in overlapping pattern.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and yuzu kosho.
Drizzle yuzu-oil mixture over salmon.
Sprinkle with sea salt and arrange microgreens and radish slices.
Garnish with capers and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Check with fishmonger for sushi-grade salmon discounts
Buy yuzu kosho in Asian markets, much cheaper than specialty grocers

recipes.name: Ossobuco with Miso Glaze
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat veal shanks dry and season with salt and pepper.
Dredge in flour and shake off excess.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown veal on all sides, about 12 minutes total.
Remove veal and set aside, then sauté vegetables in same pot until lightly browned.
Whisk miso paste with mirin and beef broth, then add to pot with wine.
Return veal to pot, cover, and braise in 325°F oven for 2 hours until meat is tender.
Remove veal carefully, strain braising liquid, and reduce on stovetop until slightly thickened.
Serve veal shanks with sauce and gremolata garnish.
cheapTips: Buy veal shanks from local butchers rather than supermarkets for better pricing
Make extra braise liquid and freeze for future use

recipes.name: Doenjang Guacamole
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut avocados in half, remove pits, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Add doenjang, lime juice, and minced garlic to the avocados.
Mash with a fork until you reach your desired consistency.
Fold in diced jalapeño and cilantro gently.
Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle sesame seeds on top.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.
cheapTips: Buy avocados in season or frozen for lower cost
Make your own tortilla chips by frying corn tortillas

recipes.name: Samgyeopsal Chimichangas
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook pork belly until crispy, about 10 minutes.
Add soy sauce, garlic, and green onions to pork, then mix in kimchi and cook for 3 more minutes.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet to make them pliable.
Divide pork mixture and cheese among tortillas, roll tightly, and seal edges with water.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan to 350°F and fry chimichangas until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve with sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand tortillas and cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Dakgangjeong Taco
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, garlic, and gochujang in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until very hot.
Fry chicken cubes until cooked through and edges are crispy, about 8 minutes.
Pour sauce over chicken and toss until evenly coated and slightly caramelized, about 3 minutes.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet until pliable.
Fill each tortilla with glazed chicken, then top with sesame seeds and green onions.
cheapTips: Buy chicken when on sale and freeze for meal prep
Corn tortillas are cheaper than flour alternatives

recipes.name: Korean Pozole
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat sesame oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown pork shoulder in batches, about 8 minutes total.
Add garlic, ginger, and gochugaru, stirring constantly for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth and soy sauce, bringing to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add hominy and shredded cabbage to the pot and simmer for another 15 minutes.
Season to taste and stir in most of the green onions.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with remaining green onions.
cheapTips: Pork shoulder is an affordable cut, buy larger quantity for freezing
Canned hominy is budget-friendly compared to fresh

recipes.name: Ojingeochae Tostada
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, gochujang, and garlic in a bowl.
Boil squid in salted water for 1 minute until just cooked, then drain.
Toss hot squid with the sauce mixture and let marinate for 5 minutes.
Heat tostada shells in a 350°F oven for 3 minutes until warmed.
Layer shredded cabbage on each tostada shell.
Top with squid salad, sesame seeds, and green onions, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy whole squid and clean it yourself instead of pre-cleaned
Purchase tostada shells at discount stores

recipes.name: Gochujang Chiles Rellenos
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast poblano peppers over a gas flame or under the broiler until charred, then place in a plastic bag for 10 minutes to steam.
Peel off the charred skin, then carefully slit the pepper lengthwise and remove seeds without tearing.
Mix gochujang, soy sauce, and water in a small saucepan, heating until it simmers, then set aside.
Stuff each pepper with mozzarella cheese, then dredge lightly in flour.
Beat eggs in a shallow bowl and dip each stuffed pepper to coat completely.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and fry peppers until golden, about 3 minutes per side.
Arrange on a plate, pour gochujang sauce over top, and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy poblanos when in season for better prices
Use store-brand mozzarella to cut cheese costs

recipes.name: Okonomiyaki Carbonara
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Fry bacon in a large pan until crispy, then remove and chop coarsely.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, parmesan, and black pepper.
Mix shredded cabbage with flour and dashi broth to create a batter.
Add cooked spaghetti and bacon to the cabbage batter and mix well.
Cook the mixture in the pan with bacon fat over medium heat until golden on bottom, about 5 minutes.
Pour egg mixture over the top, then flip to cook the other side for 3 minutes.
Slide onto a plate and top with bonito flakes, which will dance from residual heat.
cheapTips: Buy regular store-brand pasta instead of premium brands
Use bacon ends and pieces which are cheaper

recipes.name: Pasta al Tartufo Nero with Yuzu
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 1 oz, thinly shaved (or black truffle sa

steps: Cook fettuccine in salted boiling water until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add cooked pasta to the skillet along with 1/4 cup pasta water.
Remove from heat and drizzle truffle oil and yuzu juice over pasta.
Toss gently, adding pasta water as needed to create a silky sauce.
Stir in parmesan cheese until incorporated.
Plate pasta and top with shaved black truffle, white pepper, and fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Substitute black truffle salt if fresh truffles are unavailable
Use yuzu juice concentrate instead of fresh-squeezed yuzu

recipes.name: Risotto ai Funghi Porcini and Maitake
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour 1 cup warm broth over dried porcini mushrooms and let soak for 15 minutes, then strain (reserve liquid) and chop.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté maitake mushrooms until golden, about 5 minutes, then set aside.
In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon butter and sauté diced onion until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add arborio rice to the onion and stir constantly for 2 minutes to toast slightly.
Pour in white wine and stir until fully absorbed.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and allowing liquid to absorb before adding more, about 18 minutes total.
When rice is creamy but al dente, stir in chopped porcini, porcini liquid, remaining butter, and parmesan cheese.
Fold in cooked maitake mushrooms, season with salt and pepper, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy maitake mushrooms at Asian markets for lower cost
Substitute chicken broth if vegetable broth is expensive

recipes.name: Spaghetti alle Vongole with Sake
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak clams in cold salted water for 20 minutes to purge sand, then rinse well.
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté garlic and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add clams, sake, and white wine to the skillet, cover, and cook for 5-7 minutes until clams open (discard any that don't).
Remove clams from shells and set aside, leaving some in shell for garnish if desired.
Add cooked spaghetti and 1/2 cup pasta water to the skillet with clam liquid.
Toss gently, adding more pasta water as needed to create a light sauce, then stir in butter.
Fold in shelled clams, season with salt and pepper, and serve garnished with fresh parsley and clams in shell.
cheapTips: Buy clams on sale and use frozen clams as alternative
Use budget pasta brand instead of premium imported pasta

recipes.name: Tiramisu with Matcha
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk egg yolks and sugar together over a double boiler until pale and warm (about 5 minutes), then remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Fold mascarpone cheese gently into the cooled egg mixture until smooth.
Whisk matcha powder with milk until dissolved, then fold into the mascarpone mixture along with vanilla extract.
Quickly dip each ladyfinger into a shallow dish of remaining milk and arrange in a single layer in an 8x8 inch dish.
Spread half the matcha-mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers.
Arrange another layer of dipped ladyfingers on top, then cover with remaining cream.
Dust the entire surface with cocoa powder and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Serve chilled, dusting with additional cocoa powder if desired.
cheapTips: Buy mascarpone in bulk and freeze extra portions
Use store-brand ladyfingers instead of Italian imports

recipes.name: Polpo al Dashi
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring dashi stock to a boil in a large pot and add cleaned octopus, then reduce heat and simmer gently for 45 minutes until tender.
Remove octopus from dashi and let cool slightly, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add minced garlic and red pepper flakes, cooking until fragrant (about 1 minute).
Add the cooked octopus pieces to the skillet and toss to coat with the garlic oil.
Squeeze lemon juice over the octopus and season with sea salt to taste.
Cook for 3-4 minutes until heated through and lightly browned on edges.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with fresh parsley.
Serve warm or at room temperature with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen octopus instead of fresh for significant savings
Make your own dashi from kombu and bonito flakes if possible

recipes.name: Panettone with Yuzu
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, and salt in a large bowl, then create a well in the center.
Add eggs, sugar, and yuzu juice to the well and mix with a fork until shaggy, then knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
Incorporate softened butter gradually while kneading, working until fully incorporated (about 5 minutes), then fold in dried cranberries.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise for 2 hours until doubled.
Shape dough into a ball, place in a panettone mold or tall cake pan, cover loosely, and let rise for 1.5 hours.
Bake at 375°F for 40-50 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Brush warm panettone with honey glaze immediately after removing from oven.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely (at least 2 hours).
cheapTips: Use a regular round cake pan instead of expensive panettone mold
Substitute yuzu juice with lemon juice if yuzu is unavailable

recipes.name: Fettuccine Katsuobushi
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook fettuccine according to package directions until al dente, then drain and reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add minced garlic, cooking until fragrant (about 1 minute).
Add drained pasta to the skillet with garlic and toss to coat.
Pour soy sauce over pasta and add butter, stirring constantly while adding pasta water gradually until a light sauce forms (about 2 minutes).
Remove from heat and quickly top with bonito flakes, which will dance and wave from the residual heat.
Toss gently to incorporate some flakes while leaving others visible on top.
Divide among serving bowls and garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately while bonito flakes are still active.
cheapTips: Buy bonito flakes in bulk from Asian markets for better pricing
Use regular soy sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Burrata with Shiso and Tamari
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place burrata cheese on a serving plate and gently tear open to expose the creamy center.
Arrange fresh shiso leaves around and on top of the burrata.
Drizzle olive oil and tamari sauce evenly over the cheese.
Scatter microgreens over the top of the burrata.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over everything.
Season lightly with sea salt and black pepper.
Serve immediately at room temperature with crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Use regular basil if shiso leaves are unavailable
Buy burrata from warehouse clubs for better pricing

recipes.name: Vitello Tonnato with Sakura Miso
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sear the veal on all sides until golden (about 8 minutes total).
Add diced onion and white wine to the pot, then bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 45 minutes until veal is tender.
Remove veal from pot and let cool completely, then slice thinly.
Blend drained tuna, sakura miso, mayonnaise, capers, and juice from half the lemon in a food processor until smooth.
Arrange veal slices on a serving platter and spoon tuna-miso sauce over each slice.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Garnish with additional capers and thin lemon slices.
Serve cold or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use chicken breast instead of veal for significant savings
Make sauce with regular miso paste if sakura miso unavailable

recipes.name: Zabaglione with Sake
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Separate eggs, placing yolks in a heatproof bowl and reserving whites for another use.
Whisk egg yolks and sugar together over a double boiler with gently simmering water, whisking constantly for 8-10 minutes until pale, thick, and reaching 160°F internal temperature.
Remove from heat and slowly whisk in sake and vanilla extract while whisking continuously.
Let mixture cool for 5 minutes while whisking occasionally.
In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream to stiff peaks.
Gently fold whipped cream into the cooled zabaglione in two additions.
Divide among serving glasses and dust with cocoa powder.
Top with fresh strawberries and serve immediately or chill for up to 2 hours.
cheapTips: Use inexpensive sake for cooking rather than premium varieties
Buy strawberries in season or use frozen for lower cost

recipes.name: Cacio e Pepe with Aonori
recipes.description: Japanese-Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook pasta according to package directions until al dente, then drain and reserve 2 cups pasta water.
Toast black pepper in a large skillet over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 1 cup reserved pasta water to the skillet with toasted pepper and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add drained pasta to the skillet and toss constantly, adding more pasta water as needed to create a creamy sauce (about 3-4 minutes).
Remove from heat and add butter, stirring until melted and combined.
Sprinkle half the grated pecorino cheese over pasta and toss constantly until cheese melts and coats pasta evenly.
Divide pasta between two bowls and top with remaining cheese and aonori powder.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy pecorino Romano in blocks and grate yourself instead of pre-grated
Aonori powder can be omitted or replaced with nori powder if needed

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place pork shoulder in a slow cooker and season generously with salt and pepper on all sides.
Mix barbecue sauce, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl.
Pour half the sauce mixture over the pork shoulder in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours until pork is very tender and shreds easily with a fork.
Remove pork from slow cooker and shred using two forks, discarding any excess fat.
Return shredded pork to slow cooker and stir in remaining sauce mixture.
Cook on low for an additional 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Toast buns lightly and top each with pulled pork, coleslaw, and pickles, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for later use
Make homemade barbecue sauce instead of buying bottled

recipes.name: Hungarian Goulash
recipes.description: Hungarian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches on all sides (about 12 minutes total), then remove and set aside.
Add diced onions to the pot and cook until soft and translucent (about 5 minutes), then add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in Hungarian paprika and tomato paste, cooking for 2 minutes while stirring constantly.
Return beef to the pot and add beef broth and caraway seeds, then bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 45 minutes.
Add cubed potatoes to the pot and continue simmering covered for another 25-30 minutes until potatoes are tender and beef is very soft.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer uncovered for the final 10 minutes to thicken the sauce slightly.
Serve hot in bowls, optionally topped with a dollop of sour cream.
cheapTips: Use beef stew meat which is typically less expensive than chuck
Buy paprika in bulk from specialty stores for better value

recipes.name: Pita Bread
recipes.description: Middle Eastern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and sugar in a bowl and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Add flour, salt, and olive oil to the yeast mixture and knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in an oiled bowl, cover with a damp towel, and let rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Let balls rest for 15 minutes, then roll each into a 1/4-inch thick circle.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat for 2 minutes.
Cook each pita for 3-4 minutes per side until puffed and light brown spots appear.
Wrap finished pitas in a clean towel to keep them soft and warm.
cheapTips: Buy flour and yeast in bulk to reduce cost significantly.
Make multiple batches and freeze extras for later use.

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Falafel
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment paper.
Pulse chickpeas, onion, parsley, and garlic in a food processor until finely chopped but not pureed.
Mix the chickpea mixture with flour, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper until combined.
Form mixture into 16 balls and flatten slightly into patties.
Toss patties with olive oil and arrange on the prepared sheet pan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway through, until golden and crispy.
cheapTips: Use canned chickpeas instead of dried to save time and money.
Buy spices in bulk from Middle Eastern markets for better prices.

recipes.name: Crispy Chicken Wings
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Mix cornstarch, flour, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper in a shallow bowl.
Coat each wing thoroughly in the cornstarch mixture and place on a plate.
Heat oil to 350°F in a large pot or deep skillet.
Carefully fry wings in batches for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and crispy, turning halfway through.
Remove wings with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
cheapTips: Buy chicken wings in bulk or on sale and freeze for later.
Use generic cornstarch and flour brands to cut costs.

recipes.name: Mozzarella Sticks
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Freeze mozzarella sticks for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and panko mixed with Italian seasoning and salt.
Coat each frozen mozzarella stick in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing gently so coating adheres.
Place coated sticks on a plate and freeze again for 15-20 minutes.
Heat oil to 350°F in a pot or deep skillet.
Fry mozzarella sticks for 45-60 seconds per side until golden brown—do not overcook or cheese will leak.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels for 1 minute before serving with marinara sauce.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand mozzarella sticks instead of name brands.
Make panko coating from crushed regular bread if panko is unavailable.

recipes.name: Chicken Katsu Curry
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breasts to 1/2-inch thickness and season with salt and pepper.
Boil potatoes and onion in 2 cups water until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.
Coat chicken in flour, then beaten egg, then panko, pressing gently.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken for 5-6 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain chicken on paper towels and slice into strips.
Remove potato and onion from water and set aside; lower heat to medium.
Add curry roux blocks to the hot broth and stir until dissolved and thickened.
Return potatoes and onion to the curry sauce and simmer for 2 minutes.
Serve curry over steamed rice with katsu chicken on top.
cheapTips: Buy curry roux blocks at Asian markets for half the price of regular grocers.
Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for a cheaper cut with better flavor.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line two sheet pans with parchment paper.
Wash and peel sweet potatoes, then cut into 1/4-inch thick fries.
Pat fries dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Toss fries with olive oil, salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder until evenly coated.
Spread fries in a single layer on the prepared sheet pans.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway through, until crispy and golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy sweet potatoes on sale or at farmers markets for better prices.
Use whatever spices you have on hand instead of buying specialty seasonings.

recipes.name: Onion Rings
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut onions into 1/2-inch thick rings and separate them.
Whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Combine egg and cold water in another bowl and whisk until smooth.
Mix wet ingredients into dry ingredients until a thick batter forms.
Heat oil to 350°F in a large pot or deep skillet.
Dip onion rings into batter, letting excess drip off, then carefully place in hot oil.
Fry in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
cheapTips: Use regular onions from bulk bins instead of sweet onions.
Reuse frying oil by straining through cheesecloth and storing in a sealed container.

recipes.name: Croquettes
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat and whisk in flour to form a roux.
Gradually add milk while whisking constantly until a thick béchamel sauce forms.
Stir in diced ham, salt, white pepper, and nutmeg, then remove from heat.
Pour mixture onto a parchment paper-lined baking sheet and refrigerate for 1 hour until firm.
Form chilled mixture into cylinder shapes and place on a plate.
Set up bowls with beaten eggs and panko breadcrumbs.
Coat each croquette in egg, then roll in panko, pressing gently.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry croquettes for 2-3 minutes until golden brown on all sides, turning carefully.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use budget deli ham instead of expensive Spanish jamón.
Make croquettes in advance and refrigerate unbaked for several days.

recipes.name: Corn Dog
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Insert wooden sticks into the end of each hot dog, pushing about 3 inches deep.
Mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
Whisk together egg and milk in another bowl until smooth.
Combine wet and dry ingredients and stir until a thick batter forms.
Heat oil to 350°F in a large pot or deep skillet.
Dip each hot dog into batter until fully coated.
Carefully place in hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Remove with tongs and drain on paper towels before serving.
cheapTips: Buy hot dogs on sale and freeze for future use.
Use a meat thermometer to confirm done-ness if uncertain about frying time.

recipes.name: Risotto Milanese
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a separate pot and keep at a gentle simmer throughout cooking.
Steep saffron threads in 1/4 cup of warm broth for 5 minutes.
Heat olive oil and 2 tablespoons butter in a large, heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Sauté onion until translucent, about 2 minutes, then add rice and stir constantly for 1 minute.
Pour in white wine and stir until fully absorbed.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting for liquid to absorb before adding more, about 18-20 minutes total.
Add saffron broth in the final 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove from heat, stir in remaining butter and parmesan cheese until creamy, then season with salt and white pepper.
cheapTips: Omit saffron for budget risotto; use turmeric or skip for classic risotto bianco.
Make your own broth by simmering vegetable scraps instead of buying boxes.

recipes.name: Hard Boiled Eggs
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place eggs in a pot and cover with cold water by 1 inch.
Add salt to the water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.
Remove from heat, cover with a lid, and let sit for 10 minutes.
Transfer eggs to an ice bath and let cool for 5 minutes.
Peel eggs under cool running water, starting from the wider end.
Slice eggs in half, season with salt and pepper, and serve with butter if desired.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk from warehouse stores for lowest per-unit cost
Reuse ice bath water for other cooking purposes

recipes.name: Shredded Chicken
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add chicken broth and water to a large pot and bring to a boil.
Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Place seasoned chicken in the boiling broth and reduce heat to medium.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken from broth and let cool for 5 minutes.
Use two forks to shred the chicken by pulling it apart into fine strands.
Use immediately or store in an airtight container with reserved cooking broth for moisture.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze until needed
Use the leftover cooking broth as a base for soups or rice

recipes.name: Salsa Chicken
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Mince garlic and place in a baking dish with salsa, onion, lime juice, cumin, and chili powder.
Place chicken breasts in the baking dish and coat thoroughly with the salsa mixture.
Cover with foil and bake for 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove foil and shred the chicken directly in the pan using two forks.
Stir to combine shredded chicken with the salsa sauce and season with salt to taste.
Serve with rice, tortillas, or over lettuce as a salad.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand salsa instead of premium brands for same quality at lower cost
Use frozen chicken breasts which are usually cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Guacamole
recipes.description: Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut avocados in half lengthwise and remove the pit.
Scoop the avocado flesh into a bowl and immediately squeeze lime juice over it.
Mash with a fork until desired consistency is reached, leaving some small chunks.
Finely dice the jalapeño and add to the guacamole with salt.
Fold in the cilantro, tomato, and onion until just combined.
Taste and adjust salt and lime juice as needed.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips or fresh vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy avocados when on sale and store in the fridge until ready to use
Skip the cilantro if budget is tight; it's optional but adds flavor

recipes.name: Salsa Fresca
recipes.description: Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice tomatoes into small, uniform pieces and place in a bowl.
Finely dice the onion and add to the tomatoes.
Mince the garlic and jalapeño, removing seeds for less heat if preferred.
Add garlic, jalapeño, and cilantro to the tomato mixture.
Squeeze lime juice over everything and sprinkle with salt.
Stir well to combine and let sit for 10 minutes to allow flavors to blend.
Taste and adjust lime juice or salt as needed before serving with tortilla chips.
cheapTips: Make salsa when tomatoes are in season and cheapest at farmers markets
Use leftover salsa as a topping for eggs, rice, or beans the next day

recipes.name: Salad Niçoise
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes until just tender, about 15 minutes, then cut into quarters.
Trim green beans and boil for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp, then drain and cool.
Hard boil eggs according to basic recipe and cut into quarters.
Drain tuna and flake into bite-sized pieces with a fork.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, and dijon mustard in a small bowl for dressing.
Arrange salad greens on two plates and arrange potatoes, green beans, tuna, eggs, tomatoes, and olives on top.
Drizzle dressing over salad, season with salt and pepper, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned tuna on sale and stock up for multiple meals
Use frozen green beans to save prep time and money

recipes.name: Vietnamese Spring Rolls
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice vermicelli according to package directions, drain, and cool.
Prepare a shallow bowl of warm water for softening rice papers.
Peel and halve cooked shrimp lengthwise.
Cut cucumber into thin matchsticks and tear lettuce into strips.
Make dipping sauce by whisking together peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, water, and minced garlic until smooth.
Dip one rice paper in warm water for 3-4 seconds until pliable and lay on a clean surface.
Layer lettuce, mint, cilantro, noodles, cucumber, and shrimp on the lower third of the rice paper.
Fold sides in and roll tightly away from you, keeping the seam side down.
Serve immediately with peanut dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy shrimp when on sale and freeze for later use
Substitute cooked chicken for shrimp to reduce costs

recipes.name: Instant Ramen
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 4 cups of water to a rolling boil in a large pot.
Add ramen noodles and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, minced garlic, and sesame oil.
Add frozen vegetables to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Reduce heat slightly and carefully crack eggs into the boiling broth to poach for 2 minutes.
Pour soy sauce mixture into the pot and stir gently.
Divide ramen between two bowls, top with green onions, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ramen in bulk at discount stores for under $0.30 per package
Use frozen vegetables instead of fresh to save money and reduce prep time

recipes.name: Peanut Butter and Jelly Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Lightly butter both slices of bread on one side each.
Spread peanut butter evenly on one slice of buttered bread.
Spread jelly or jam evenly on the other slice of buttered bread.
Press the two slices together with peanut butter and jelly facing inward.
Cut diagonally and serve immediately or wrap for later.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand peanut butter and jelly for significant savings
Use whole wheat bread for added nutrition at similar cost

recipes.name: Eggs on Toast
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast bread slices until golden brown and place on a serving plate.
Butter the warm toast generously on both sides.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Crack eggs into a bowl, add milk, salt, and pepper, and whisk together.
Pour the egg mixture into the hot skillet and scramble with a spatula until just cooked through, about 3-4 minutes.
Spoon the scrambled eggs onto the buttered toast.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk and store in the fridge for the week
Use store-brand bread for lower cost

recipes.name: Puttanesca
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente.
Mince the garlic cloves and chop anchovies into small pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add minced garlic, red pepper flakes, and anchovies, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes with their juice, olives, and capers to the skillet and simmer for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain cooked pasta and add to the sauce, tossing to coat evenly.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy olives and capers from bulk bins to save money
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh for year-round affordability

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Quinoa
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse quinoa under cold water and combine with chicken broth in a pot, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer quinoa for 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed.
Pat chicken breasts dry and season both sides with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Brush a grill or grill pan with olive oil and heat over medium-high heat.
Grill chicken breasts for 6-7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken from grill and drizzle with lemon juice.
Fluff cooked quinoa with a fork and divide among plates with chicken.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Buy quinoa in bulk to reduce per-pound cost

recipes.name: Greek Salad with Grilled Chicken
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon oregano on both sides.
Grill or pan-sear chicken over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Remove chicken from heat, let rest 5 minutes, then slice into bite-sized pieces.
Chop romaine lettuce and place in a large bowl.
Dice cucumber, halve cherry tomatoes, and thinly slice red onion, adding all to the bowl with olives.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, and remaining oregano in a small bowl.
Toss salad with dressing, top with sliced chicken and feta cheese, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy feta cheese in bulk and store in brine for extended shelf life
Use budget-friendly romaine instead of specialty lettuces

recipes.name: Grilled Salmon with Asparagus
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat grill to medium-high heat and brush grates with oil.
Trim asparagus by snapping off woody ends and toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Pat salmon fillets dry and brush with remaining olive oil, then season with salt, pepper, and dill.
Grill asparagus for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally until tender-crisp.
Grill salmon skin-side up for 4-5 minutes, then flip and grill for another 3-4 minutes until opaque.
Mince garlic and squeeze juice from lemons, combining to make a quick sauce.
Plate salmon and asparagus, drizzle with lemon-garlic sauce, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy salmon on sale and freeze immediately for future use
Pair with seasonal asparagus for best prices

recipes.name: Tofu Stir-Fry with Broccoli
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between paper towels to remove excess moisture, then cut into 3/4-inch cubes.
Mince garlic and ginger, and whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, and water in a small bowl.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add tofu cubes and cook for 4-5 minutes until golden on most sides, stirring occasionally.
Push tofu to the sides and add broccoli to the center, stir-frying for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes, stirring constantly for 30 seconds.
Pour sauce over tofu and broccoli, stirring gently for 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens and coats vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy tofu in bulk and freeze for later use
Use frozen broccoli instead of fresh to save money and reduce prep time

recipes.name: Turkey Meatballs
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Finely mince garlic and onion, and combine in a large bowl with ground turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, salt, and pepper.
Mix gently with your hands until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Roll mixture into 1.5-inch meatballs and place on prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle meatballs with olive oil and bake for 15-18 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Heat marinara sauce in a pot over medium heat.
Transfer cooked meatballs to marinara sauce and simmer for 5 minutes to blend flavors.
cheapTips: Buy ground turkey on sale and freeze in portions
Make a double batch and freeze unbaked meatballs for quick meals

recipes.name: Grilled Tilapia with Brown Rice
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse brown rice and combine with vegetable broth in a pot, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer rice for 25-30 minutes until tender and liquid is absorbed.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Pat tilapia fillets dry and brush with olive oil, then season with garlic powder, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Grill tilapia for 3-4 minutes per side until flesh is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
Cut lemons in half and grill cut-side down for 2 minutes until softened.
Plate rice with tilapia and serve with grilled lemon halves on the side.
cheapTips: Tilapia is an affordable white fish option compared to other varieties
Buy brown rice in bulk to reduce costs significantly

recipes.name: Chickpea Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut sweet potatoes into cubes and roast at 425°F for 20 minutes until tender and lightly caramelized.
Drain and rinse canned chickpeas, then toss with 1/2 teaspoon salt and roast with sweet potatoes for the last 10 minutes.
Make tahini dressing by whisking together tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, olive oil, and water until smooth and pourable.
Arrange spinach as a base in bowls and top with roasted sweet potatoes and chickpeas.
Add halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, and thinly sliced red onion to each bowl.
Drizzle tahini dressing generously over each bowl and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas in bulk or use dried chickpeas for major savings
Use seasonal produce to minimize ingredient costs

recipes.name: Pulled Pork
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rub pork shoulder on all sides with mixture of paprika, brown sugar, salt, and pepper.
Cut onion into chunks and place in slow cooker with crushed garlic cloves.
Set pork shoulder on top of onions and pour chicken broth and apple cider vinegar around it.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours until meat is very tender and shreds easily with a fork.
Remove pork from slow cooker and let rest for 10 minutes, then shred using two forks.
Drain cooking liquid from slow cooker and discard solids.
Return shredded pork to slow cooker and stir in barbecue sauce, cooking on low for 30 minutes.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for future use
Make large batches and freeze portions for quick reheating

recipes.name: Boeuf Stroganoff
recipes.description: Russian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook egg noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Cut beef sirloin against the grain into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches, 2-3 minutes per side, transferring to a plate.
In the same skillet, sauté diced onion until softened, then add minced garlic and sliced mushrooms, cooking for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and paprika, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return beef to skillet and add beef broth, bringing to a simmer and cooking for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in sour cream until smooth, heating gently without boiling.
Serve stroganoff over cooked egg noodles.
cheapTips: Buy sirloin on sale and freeze for future meal prep
Use budget-friendly mushrooms like cremini or button varieties

recipes.name: Ragu Bolognese
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice the onion, celery, and carrot and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and add the beef and pork, breaking apart with a spoon until browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the diced vegetables and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the white wine and simmer until reduced by half, about 3 minutes.
Add the canned tomatoes and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 1.5 hours, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the milk and season with salt and pepper, then simmer for 15 more minutes.
Serve over freshly cooked pasta.
cheapTips: Use a mix of beef and pork scraps or bulk-bin ground meat to save money
Buy whole tomatoes in bulk cans rather than pre-made sauce

recipes.name: Tagine of Lamb
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot or tagine over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb pieces on all sides, about 8 minutes total, then remove and set aside.
Add diced onions to the pot and cook until softened, about 4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic, ginger, cumin, and cinnamon and cook for 1 minute.
Return the lamb to the pot and add the chicken broth, bringing to a simmer.
Cover and reduce heat to low, simmering for 45 minutes.
Add the apricots and olives and simmer covered for another 15 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve over couscous or with flatbread.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shoulder or chuck cuts instead of premium stew meat
Use dried fruit from the bulk bins to save on packaged apricots

recipes.name: Boeuf à la Mode
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Chop bacon and cook in a large Dutch oven over medium heat until crispy, then remove and set aside.
Pat the beef dry and brown on all sides in the bacon fat, about 10 minutes total, then set aside.
Sauté diced onion, carrots, and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Deglaze with red wine, scraping up browned bits, and simmer for 2 minutes.
Return beef to pot, add beef broth, bay leaves, thyme, and cooked bacon, bringing to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven for 2.5 to 3 hours, until beef is very tender.
Remove beef, strain vegetables and sauce, and serve beef with vegetables and sauce spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy chuck roast on sale and freeze until needed
Use store-brand red wine for cooking rather than expensive bottles

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Salmon and Vegetables
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment paper.
Cut the bell pepper into chunks and arrange broccoli, tomatoes, and pepper on the pan.
Drizzle vegetables with 2 tbsp olive oil, sprinkle with salt, pepper, and oregano, and toss to coat.
Roast vegetables for 10 minutes.
Pat salmon fillets dry and place on the pan, brush with 1 tbsp olive oil, and season with salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Return pan to oven and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until salmon is cooked through.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over everything.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy salmon on sale and freeze for later use
Use frozen broccoli to save money and reduce prep time

recipes.name: Flammkuchen
recipes.description: Alsatian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Chop bacon into small pieces and cook until crispy in a skillet, then drain on paper towels.
Thinly slice the onion and cook in the same skillet with a bit of bacon fat until soft, about 5 minutes.
Roll out the pizza dough into a thin rectangle on a baking sheet, stretching to fit.
Spread sour cream evenly over the dough, leaving a small border.
Top with cooked bacon, caramelized onions, and shredded gruyere, then sprinkle with thyme, salt, and pepper.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the crust is golden and cheese is melted.
Slice into strips and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pizza dough to save time and money
Substitute cheddar for gruyere if budget is tight

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Paella
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Warm the chicken broth and steep the saffron threads in it for 5 minutes.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces, slice sausage, and dice peppers and onion.
Heat olive oil on a large sheet pan or paella pan over medium-high heat, then brown chicken and sausage, about 5 minutes, and remove.
Sauté peppers and onion until soft, about 4 minutes, then add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Pour in the saffron broth, return chicken and sausage to the pan, and bring to a simmer.
Transfer to the oven and bake uncovered for 20 minutes.
Stir in shrimp and peas, then bake for another 8 to 10 minutes until shrimp is pink and rice is tender.
cheapTips: Skip the saffron and use turmeric for color and flavor at a fraction of the cost
Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for a richer flavor at lower cost

recipes.name: Pissalat Bread
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Finely mince the anchovies, olives, and garlic together to form a paste.
Stir together the anchovy-olive mixture with 2 tbsp olive oil and the fresh rosemary.
Stretch the focaccia dough onto a baking sheet.
Spread the pissalat mixture evenly over the dough.
Drizzle with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and sprinkle with coarse sea salt.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until the edges are golden.
Cool slightly, cut into pieces, and serve.
cheapTips: Use store-bought focaccia or pizza dough instead of making from scratch
Buy anchovies in bulk tins rather than small jars

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Chicken and Root Vegetables
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.
Cut sweet potatoes, carrots, and parsnips into 1-inch chunks and quarter the onion.
Arrange vegetables on the sheet pan, drizzle with 2 tbsp olive oil, and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and rosemary.
Roast vegetables for 15 minutes.
Pat chicken thighs dry and place skin-side up on the pan among the vegetables.
Brush chicken with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and sprinkle with minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Return pan to oven and roast for 15 to 18 minutes until chicken skin is golden and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs in bulk and freeze individual portions
Use whatever root vegetables are on sale that week

recipes.name: Barbecue Chicken Sheet Pan
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment paper.
Chop red onions and zucchini into bite-sized pieces and arrange on the sheet pan.
Drizzle vegetables with 1 tbsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and spread into a single layer.
Roast vegetables for 10 minutes.
Pat chicken dry and place on the pan, brush with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Brush chicken with barbecue sauce and scatter corn around the pan.
Return to oven and bake for 15 to 18 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F internal temperature.
Brush chicken with additional barbecue sauce if desired, sprinkle with cilantro, and serve.
cheapTips: Use store-brand barbecue sauce to save money
Buy frozen corn to reduce cost and eliminate waste

recipes.name: Fajita Sheet Pan
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.
Slice chicken breasts into thin strips and chop peppers and onions into bite-sized pieces.
Arrange chicken and vegetables on the sheet pan.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat evenly.
Spread into a single layer and roast for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring halfway through, until chicken is cooked through.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over everything.
Warm tortillas according to package directions.
Serve fajita mixture with warm tortillas and desired toppings such as sour cream, guacamole, or salsa.
cheapTips: Buy chicken in bulk and slice yourself instead of buying pre-cut
Use whatever bell peppers are on sale that week

recipes.name: Baked Beans on Toast
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden brown and crispy.
Spread butter evenly on each slice of hot toast.
Pour the baked beans into a small saucepan and heat over medium heat for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season the beans with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Spoon the warm beans generously over each slice of buttered toast and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand canned beans in bulk
Use day-old bread on sale

recipes.name: Rice and Beans
recipes.description: Latin American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the onion and mince the garlic cloves.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté the onion until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cumin, stirring constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the rice and stir to coat with oil, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in 2 cups of water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes until rice is tender.
Drain and rinse the canned beans, then stir them into the cooked rice.
Cook for 2 more minutes over low heat until beans are warmed through.
Finish with a squeeze of lime juice and fresh cilantro, then season with salt to taste.
cheapTips: Buy rice in bulk from bulk bins
Use canned beans instead of dried to save time

recipes.name: Hummus and Pita
recipes.description: Middle Eastern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse the canned chickpeas well under cold water.
Add the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and minced garlic to a food processor.
Pulse while slowly drizzling in olive oil and water until the mixture reaches a smooth, creamy consistency.
Season with salt and adjust lemon juice or water to reach desired thickness.
Transfer hummus to a serving bowl and drizzle with a bit more olive oil, then sprinkle paprika on top.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating in a 350°F oven for 5 minutes, or warm in a skillet.
Serve the warm pita alongside the hummus for dipping.
cheapTips: Make your own hummus instead of buying pre-made
Buy tahini in bulk or use peanut butter as a substitute

recipes.name: Cereal
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour one cup of your chosen breakfast cereal into a bowl.
Pour one cup of milk over the cereal until it is mostly covered.
Stir gently to combine and add honey or sugar if desired for extra sweetness.
Eat immediately while the cereal is still crunchy.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand cereal
Watch for sales and buy in bulk

recipes.name: Ramen with Egg
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 4 cups of water to a rolling boil in a large pot.
While water heats, gently lower eggs into a separate pot of boiling water and cook for 6-7 minutes for soft-boiled eggs, then peel and set aside.
Add ramen noodles to the boiling water and cook for 3 minutes, breaking apart the noodle block as it cooks.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and stir well.
Drain most of the water from the noodles, leaving about 2 cups of broth, then stir in soy sauce and sesame oil.
Pour the ramen and broth into bowls and top each with a halved soft-boiled egg.
Garnish with chopped green onions and drizzle with sriracha if desired, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy instant ramen in bulk at discount stores
Use basic soy sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Oatmeal
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 1 cup of water or milk to a boil in a small saucepan over medium-high heat.
Stir in rolled oats and a pinch of salt, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the oatmeal reaches your desired thickness.
Pour the cooked oatmeal into a bowl and drizzle with honey.
Top with sliced banana and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Stir well and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy oats in bulk from bulk bins
Use frozen bananas instead of fresh

recipes.name: Chili
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the ground beef, breaking it up as it cooks for 5-7 minutes.
Dice the onion and mince the garlic, then add both to the pot and cook for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and chili powder, cooking for 1 minute to bloom the spices.
Add the canned diced tomatoes with their juice, then drain and rinse both cans of beans and add them to the pot.
Stir in cumin and bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in bowls, optionally topped with shredded cheese or sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze it
Use store-brand canned tomatoes and beans

recipes.name: Buttered Noodles
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat.
Add egg noodles and cook according to package directions until al dente, about 8-10 minutes.
While noodles cook, melt butter in a small skillet over low heat and add minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Drain the cooked noodles, reserving 1/4 cup of pasta water.
Return the noodles to the pot and pour the garlic butter over them, tossing to coat evenly.
Add a splash of reserved pasta water if the noodles seem dry, and season generously with salt and pepper.
Transfer to serving bowls and top with grated parmesan cheese and fresh parsley if desired.
cheapTips: Buy noodles in bulk
Use store-brand butter and parmesan

recipes.name: Dal Rice
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse red lentils under cold water until the water runs clear, then set aside.
Heat ghee in a large pot over medium heat and add cumin seeds, letting them crackle for 30 seconds.
Dice the onion and add it to the pot, cooking until golden brown, about 4-5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Dice the tomato and add it to the pot along with turmeric powder, stirring well.
Add the rinsed lentils and rice to the pot along with 5 cups of water, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 25-30 minutes until both lentils and rice are completely tender.
Stir well, season with salt to taste, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy lentils and rice in bulk
Skip ghee and use vegetable oil instead

recipes.name: Cronut
recipes.description: French-American Fusion snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a large bowl, then add warm milk and beaten egg, stirring until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes by hand or in a mixer until smooth, then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll the dough into a 1/4-inch thick rectangle on a floured surface, then place cold cubed butter on half the dough.
Fold the dough in half over the butter and seal the edges, then roll out again to 1/4-inch thickness.
Fold into thirds (like a letter), wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for 20 minutes; repeat this folding process two more times.
After the final fold and 20-minute rest, roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness and cut into donut shapes using a donut cutter or two round cutters.
Let cut doughnuts rise on parchment paper for 30-45 minutes until puffy.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan and carefully fry each cronut for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, dust with powdered sugar, and serve while warm.
cheapTips: Use store-brand butter and flour
Make a large batch and freeze for later

recipes.name: Steak and Cheese Omelette
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat and cook the diced sirloin steak until browned, about 3-4 minutes, then set aside.
In a bowl, whisk together 4 eggs with salt and pepper until well combined.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in the skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the diced bell pepper and onion for 2 minutes until softened.
