Push vegetables to the side and pour half the whisked eggs into the skillet, tilting to spread evenly.
When the eggs begin to set at the edges, add half the cooked steak and half the cheese to one half of the omelette.
Fold the omelette in half and slide onto a plate, then repeat with remaining ingredients for the second omelette.
cheapTips: Buy cheaper cuts of steak like round or chuck and cook longer for tenderness
Use store-brand eggs and cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Black-eyed Pea Fritters
recipes.description: Soul Food snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mash the drained black-eyed peas in a bowl until mostly smooth with some texture remaining.
Mix in the minced onion, flour, egg, baking powder, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 350°F (test by dropping a small piece of mixture in oil).
Drop spoonfuls of the mixture carefully into hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes until golden brown on all sides.
Use a slotted spoon to transfer fritters to a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
cheapTips: Buy canned black-eyed peas in bulk at discount stores
Make a large batch and freeze extras for quick snacks later

recipes.name: Black-eyed Pea Soup
recipes.description: Soul Food lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large pot over medium heat and sauté the diced onion, celery, and garlic for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the vegetable broth, black-eyed peas, canned tomatoes with juice, salt, pepper, and bay leaf.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes to allow flavors to blend.
Remove the bay leaf and ladle the soup into bowls, serving hot.
cheapTips: Buy canned black-eyed peas and tomatoes on sale and stock up
Use vegetable scraps like onion tops and celery ends for extra flavor

recipes.name: Vegetable Gumbo
recipes.description: Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make a roux by heating oil in a large pot over medium heat and whisking in flour, stirring constantly for 8-10 minutes until it turns dark brown.
Add the diced onion, bell pepper, celery, and garlic to the roux and cook for 5 minutes until vegetables soften.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add the frozen okra, canned tomatoes, salt, and cayenne pepper, then simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve the gumbo over cooked rice in bowls.
cheapTips: Use frozen okra which is cheaper and just as good as fresh
Buy store-brand vegetable broth in bulk

recipes.name: Cornmeal Porridge
recipes.description: Soul Food breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring the water to a boil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Slowly whisk the cornmeal into the boiling water, stirring constantly to prevent lumps from forming.
Reduce heat to low and add the milk gradually while stirring, then add sugar, butter, salt, and cinnamon.
Simmer the porridge for 10-12 minutes, stirring frequently, until it thickens and the cornmeal is tender.
Stir in the vanilla extract and serve hot in bowls, optionally with additional milk or sugar to taste.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from discount grocery stores
Use regular milk instead of specialty milk to save money

recipes.name: Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: Soul Food lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat the vegetable broth in a large pot over medium-high heat until simmering.
Add the diced carrots, celery, onion, and potatoes, then bring to a boil and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the green beans, canned tomatoes with juice, salt, and black pepper.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until all vegetables are tender, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy carrots and potatoes in bulk when on sale
Use frozen green beans which are cheaper and last longer

recipes.name: Black Beans and Rice
recipes.description: Soul Food lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the diced onion and minced garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the drained black beans, vegetable broth, cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid reduces slightly and flavors blend.
Divide the cooked rice among bowls and top with the black bean mixture, serving hot.
cheapTips: Buy canned black beans in bulk packs at warehouse stores
Cook a large batch of rice at the beginning of the week

recipes.name: Squash Casserole
recipes.description: Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with butter.
Boil the sliced squash and diced onion in salted water for 8 minutes until tender, then drain well.
Whisk together the milk and eggs, then mix with the cooked squash, onion, 3/4 cup cheese, salt, and pepper.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish, sprinkle breadcrumbs and remaining cheese on top, and dot with 1 tbsp butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set, then let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy squash when in season at farmers markets for better prices
Use store-brand cheese and milk to reduce costs

recipes.name: Lima Bean Stew
recipes.description: Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large pot over medium heat and sauté the diced onion, carrot, celery, and garlic for 4 minutes until softened.
Add the vegetable broth and diced potatoes, bring to a boil, and cook for 8 minutes until potatoes begin to soften.
Stir in the lima beans, canned tomatoes with juice, salt, and black pepper.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until all vegetables are tender and flavors are blended, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy canned lima beans in bulk during sales
Use frozen carrots and celery as budget-friendly alternatives

recipes.name: Cabbage and Beans
recipes.description: Soul Food lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté the diced onion and minced garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped cabbage and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it begins to soften.
Pour in the vegetable broth, kidney beans, canned tomatoes with juice, salt, and black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until cabbage is very tender and flavors meld, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy whole cabbage heads which are cheaper per serving than pre-chopped
Use canned beans on sale and freeze extras for future meals

recipes.name: Loaded Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut sweet potatoes into 0.25-inch thick fries and pat dry with paper towels.
Toss fries with oil, salt, pepper, and paprika in a bowl until evenly coated.
Spread fries in a single layer on the baking sheet.
Bake for 15-18 minutes, stirring halfway through, until golden and crispy at edges.
Transfer fries to a serving dish and immediately top with cheese, bacon bits, and sour cream drizzle.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy bacon bits in bulk or use leftover bacon cooked and crumbled
Use store-brand sour cream and cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Burrata Tomato Salad
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Halve the cherry tomatoes and place them in a bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Pour dressing over tomatoes and toss gently to combine.
Let tomatoes marinate for 2-3 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Divide dressed tomatoes between two plates.
Place burrata cheese in the center of each plate, breaking it gently to expose the creamy center.
Tear basil leaves and scatter over the salad and cheese.
Drizzle any remaining dressing around the plate and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute fresh mozzarella if burrata is unavailable or too expensive
Buy tomatoes in season or use canned San Marzano tomatoes when fresh are pricey

recipes.name: Charcoal Ice Cream
recipes.description: Modern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale and thick, about 2 minutes.
Heat cream and milk in a saucepan over medium heat until steaming but not boiling.
Slowly pour hot cream mixture into egg yolks while whisking constantly to temper the eggs.
Return mixture to saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until it reaches 160°F and coats the back of a spoon.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl and let cool to room temperature.
Whisk charcoal powder into cooled custard until completely blended with no lumps.
Stir in vanilla extract and salt.
Chill mixture in refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Churn in an ice cream maker according to manufacturer's instructions, then freeze for 4 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Order activated charcoal powder in bulk online rather than specialty stores
Skip the ice cream maker by freezing mixture in a shallow pan and stirring every 30 minutes for 3 hours

recipes.name: Whopper
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Divide ground beef into two equal portions and gently form into patties slightly larger than your buns, making a shallow indent in the center with your thumb.
Season both sides of patties generously with salt and pepper.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill to high heat until very hot.
Cook patties for 2-3 minutes per side for medium, resisting the urge to press down, until charred on exterior.
Toast brioche buns cut-side down on the hot grill for 1-2 minutes until golden.
Spread mayonnaise on bottom bun and ketchup on top bun.
Layer bottom bun with lettuce, tomato slice, cooked patty, onion slice, and pickles.
Top with upper bun and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef when on sale and freeze in portions
Make your own pickles from cucumbers to save money long-term

recipes.name: Chicken McNuggets
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized nugget pieces, approximately 1.5 inches each.
Mix flour, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper in a shallow bowl.
Beat eggs in another shallow bowl.
Place panko breadcrumbs in a third shallow bowl.
Coat each nugget in flour mixture, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, then coat thoroughly in panko breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot or deep skillet to 350°F.
Carefully fry nuggets in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with your choice of dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens and butcher them yourself instead of buying breasts
Make your own panko by pulsing stale bread in a food processor

recipes.name: Filet-O-Fish
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat fish fillets dry with paper towels and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten egg, and panko breadcrumbs mixed with a pinch of salt.
Dredge each fillet in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, then coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Carefully fry breaded fillets for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and fish flakes easily.
Toast English muffins in a toaster or oven until lightly golden.
Spread tartar sauce on both halves of each muffin.
Place one cooked fillet on the bottom muffin half, top with cheese slice, then cover with top muffin half and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish fillets in bulk and thaw as needed
Make your own tartar sauce by mixing mayo with minced pickles and lemon juice

recipes.name: McFlurry
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place vanilla ice cream in a blender or food processor.
Add crushed Oreo cookies to the ice cream.
Blend on low speed for 10-15 seconds just until combined, creating a soft-serve consistency.
Divide mixture between two cups or bowls.
Drizzle chocolate syrup over each serving.
Top with a dollop of whipped cream.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Use store-brand ice cream and cookies to reduce cost
Skip whipped cream topping or make your own from heavy cream and sugar

recipes.name: KFC Original Recipe Chicken
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, combine flour, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, black pepper, and salt.
Pat chicken pieces dry with paper towels.
Working in batches, coat each chicken piece thoroughly in the flour mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Let coated chicken rest on a plate for 5 minutes to set the coating.
Heat oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot or deep fryer to 325°F.
Carefully add 3-4 chicken pieces at a time to the hot oil.
Fry for 12-15 minutes for dark meat and 10-12 minutes for white meat, turning halfway through, until deep golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens and butcher them yourself for better value than individual pieces
Reuse cooking oil multiple times by straining it through cheesecloth

recipes.name: Popcorn Chicken
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into small bite-sized pieces, roughly 0.75 to 1 inch each.
Combine flour, salt, pepper, and garlic powder in a shallow bowl.
Beat eggs in another shallow bowl.
Place panko breadcrumbs in a third shallow bowl.
Coat chicken pieces in flour, then egg, then panko breadcrumbs, shaking off excess at each step.
Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot or deep skillet to 350°F.
Fry chicken pieces in batches for 2-3 minutes per batch until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with dipping sauce of choice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts in bulk when on sale and freeze individually
Make panko by blending stale bread instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Chick-fil-A Chicken Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound to 0.5-inch thickness using a meat mallet.
Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Whisk together eggs and milk in a shallow bowl.
Place flour in another shallow bowl.
Dip each chicken breast in egg mixture, then dredge in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat oil in a skillet to 350°F and fry chicken for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Lightly toast buns in the oven or on the grill.
Place one cooked chicken breast on each bun, top with two pickle chips, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts in bulk packs at warehouse clubs like Costco
Make your own pickles or buy budget pickle slices instead of gourmet brands

recipes.name: Chia Seed Pudding
recipes.description: Modern American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine chia seeds, almond milk, maple syrup, and vanilla extract in a bowl.
Stir well to prevent clumping and let sit for 5 minutes.
Stir again to break up any clumps.
Divide mixture between two bowls and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight.
Top each serving with fresh berries, granola, and coconut flakes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chia seeds in bulk at discount stores to cut costs in half
Use frozen berries instead of fresh for better value year-round

recipes.name: Grilled Vegetable Skewers
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Mix olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Thread vegetables alternately onto skewers, dividing evenly among all four.
Brush the vegetable skewers generously with the olive oil mixture on all sides.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat and grill skewers for 12-15 minutes, turning every 3-4 minutes until vegetables are charred and tender.
Remove from grill and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables on sale and prep multiple skewers at once for meal prep
Use seasonal vegetables to reduce costs

recipes.name: Grilled Salmon with Hollandaise
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a small saucepan until melted and keep warm.
Whisk egg yolks in a heatproof bowl over simmering water (double boiler) until pale and foamy, about 3 minutes.
Slowly drizzle warm butter into egg yolks while whisking constantly until hollandaise thickens, then add lemon juice, salt, white pepper, and cayenne; remove from heat.
Pat salmon dry and brush with olive oil, seasoning both sides with salt and pepper.
Preheat grill to medium-high and grill salmon skin-side up for 5-6 minutes, then flip and cook skin-side down for 4-5 minutes until cooked through.
Plate salmon and spoon hollandaise sauce over the top, garnishing with fresh dill.
cheapTips: Buy salmon on sale and freeze for later use
Make hollandaise in smaller batches to reduce egg yolk waste

recipes.name: Ribeye Steak
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove steaks from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking to bring to room temperature.
Pat steaks completely dry with paper towels and season generously with sea salt and black pepper on both sides.
Heat olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over high heat until just smoking.
Sear steaks for 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare, resisting the urge to move them.
Add butter, crushed garlic, and rosemary to the pan, tilting and basting steaks with the foaming butter for 2 minutes.
Transfer steaks to a warm plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy ribeye in bulk when on sale and freeze individually wrapped portions
Skip expensive seasoning blends and use salt and pepper only

recipes.name: Bunless BLT
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat for 6-8 minutes until crispy, then transfer to a paper towel to drain.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each lettuce leaf.
Layer bacon strips on the lettuce leaves.
Top with tomato slices and season with salt and pepper.
Roll up the lettuce leaves to enclose the filling and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy bacon in bulk and freeze for quick meal prep
Use cheaper lettuce varieties like iceberg instead of premium greens

recipes.name: Deviled Eggs
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil eggs in a pot of salted water for 10-12 minutes until hard-cooked.
Transfer eggs to an ice bath and let cool for 5 minutes, then peel carefully under running water.
Slice each egg in half lengthwise and scoop the yolks into a bowl.
Mix yolks with mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, vinegar, half the paprika, salt, and pepper until creamy.
Transfer mixture to a piping bag or zip-top bag with corner cut off and pipe into egg white halves.
Sprinkle remaining paprika and chopped chives on top and refrigerate until serving.
cheapTips: Buy eggs from warehouse clubs for significant savings
Make large batches and store in the fridge for easy grab-and-go snacks

recipes.name: Pork Belly
recipes.description: Asian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Score the pork belly skin in a crosshatch pattern without cutting into the meat.
Bring a large pot of water to boil and blanch pork belly for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Mix soy sauce, ginger, garlic, honey, rice vinegar, 1 cup water, and star anise in a large pot or Dutch oven.
Add pork belly skin-side up, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 90 minutes until tender.
Remove cover, increase heat, and simmer for 10-15 minutes until sauce reduces and becomes glazy.
Transfer pork belly to a cutting board, let rest for 5 minutes, then slice and arrange on a serving platter.
Pour remaining sauce over pork belly and garnish with chopped scallions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly when on sale and freeze for later braising
Use basic pantry staples like soy sauce and honey instead of specialty ingredients

recipes.name: Lobster Tail with Butter
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Using kitchen shears, cut the top shell of each lobster tail lengthwise and gently pull the meat through and on top of the shell.
Mix butter, minced garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Place lobster tails on the prepared baking sheet and brush generously with garlic butter.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until lobster meat is opaque and cooked through.
Transfer to serving plates, drizzle with remaining melted butter, and garnish with parsley and paprika.
cheapTips: Buy lobster tails when seafood is on sale, often around holidays
Use frozen lobster tails which are significantly cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Cauliflower Pizza
recipes.description: Italian-Modern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Microwave riced cauliflower for 5 minutes, then squeeze out excess moisture using a kitchen towel.
Mix cauliflower, 3/4 cup mozzarella, egg, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Spread mixture into a thin round shape on the prepared baking sheet, about 1/4-inch thick.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until the crust is golden and set.
Remove from oven and spread pizza sauce over the crust, then add cherry tomatoes, remaining mozzarella, and fresh basil.
Bake for another 8-10 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly, then slice and serve.
cheapTips: Buy pre-riced cauliflower in bulk sections to save time and money
Use store-brand pizza sauce and mozzarella instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
recipes.description: Italian-Modern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spiralize zucchini into noodles using a spiralizer or julienne peeler.
Place basil, garlic, and pine nuts in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped.
While pulsing, slowly drizzle in olive oil until pesto reaches desired consistency.
Stir in parmesan cheese, lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and lightly sauté zucchini noodles for 2-3 minutes until just softened.
Toss warm zucchini noodles with pesto sauce and cherry tomatoes, mixing gently to coat evenly.
Divide between two plates and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make pesto in larger batches and freeze in ice cube trays for quick meals
Substitute walnuts or almonds for expensive pine nuts

recipes.name: Salted Caramel Brownies
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease an 8x8 baking pan.
Melt butter and mix with sugar, then whisk in eggs and vanilla extract.
Sift together flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and 1/4 tsp salt, then fold into wet ingredients.
Pour half the batter into the prepared pan, then drizzle with half the caramel sauce.
Add remaining batter and top with remaining caramel sauce, then sprinkle with chocolate chips and sea salt.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs.
Cool completely before cutting into 12 squares.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cocoa powder and caramel sauce to save 30%
Make caramel from scratch using butter, sugar, and cream for half the cost

recipes.name: Cronuts
recipes.description: French-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a bowl, then add warm milk and egg to form dough.
Knead dough for 8 minutes, then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll dough into a rectangle and fold in cold butter using lamination technique (3 folds with 20-minute rests between each).
Roll final dough to 1/4-inch thickness and cut into donut shapes using a donut cutter.
Let shaped cronuts proof for 45 minutes until puffy.
Heat oil to 350°F and carefully fry cronuts for 1-2 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper towels and immediately coat with cinnamon sugar while warm.
cheapTips: Use budget butter brands instead of European butter to save $3-4
Make cinnamon sugar topping at home instead of buying flavored varieties

recipes.name: Unicorn Frappuccino
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add ice, milk, and vanilla syrup to a blender.
Divide mixture between two cups, adding blue coloring to one and pink to the other.
Blend each separately until smooth.
Pour blue layer into a glass first, then carefully pour pink layer on top to create ombré effect.
Top with generous whipped cream and drizzle with white chocolate syrup.
Garnish rim with colored sugar or sprinkles before serving.
cheapTips: Skip the white chocolate syrup and just use store-brand whipped cream
Buy food coloring in bulk from cake decorating stores

recipes.name: Rainbow Bagel
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: red, orange, yellow, green, blue drops

steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and sugar, then add warm water and knead into smooth dough for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into 4 equal portions and color each with different food coloring while kneading.
Roll each colored portion into thin ropes and braid or layer them together.
Shape braided dough into a bagel ring and let proof for 30 minutes.
Boil water with baking soda and honey, then boil bagels for 1 minute per side.
Place on greased baking sheet, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until golden.
Cool on wire rack before slicing and serving.
cheapTips: Buy food coloring in bulk and skip the sesame seed topping to save $0.50
Make multiple bagels at once to reduce per-unit cost

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season pork shoulder with chili powder, cumin, and oregano on all sides.
Place pork in slow cooker with diced onion, minced garlic, vinegar, and broth.
Cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours until meat shreds easily with a fork.
Remove pork and shred with two forks, discarding excess fat.
Return shredded pork to slow cooker with cooking liquid and stir to combine.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with pulled pork and top with fresh cilantro and lime juice.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until needed
Make a large batch and freeze portions for future meals

recipes.name: Korean Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper.
Mix flour and cornstarch, then dredge chicken pieces thoroughly.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken in batches for 8-10 minutes until golden, then drain on paper towels.
Make sauce by combining gochujang, honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and minced garlic in a saucepan.
Heat sauce gently for 2-3 minutes over medium heat until slightly thickened.
Toss fried chicken in sauce until well coated.
Serve topped with sesame seeds and chopped scallions.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of wings for better value
Buy gochujang from Asian markets instead of grocery stores

recipes.name: Miso Caramel Salmon
recipes.description: Japanese Fusion dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix miso paste, honey, soy sauce, mirin, minced garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Place salmon fillets on baking sheet and brush generously with miso caramel mixture.
Roast for 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.
Drizzle with sesame oil and garnish with chopped scallions and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately with steamed rice or vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy salmon fillets on discount when they're approaching sell-by date
Use regular paste miso if white miso is unavailable

recipes.name: Crispy Prosciutto Brussels Sprouts
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Trim brussels sprouts, halve them, and toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Spread on a baking sheet in single layer and roast for 20 minutes until cut sides are golden.
Meanwhile, lay prosciutto on a separate baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes until crispy, then crumble.
Whisk together balsamic vinegar and honey.
Remove brussels sprouts from oven, drizzle with balsamic glaze, and top with crispy prosciutto and parmesan.
Return to oven for 2 minutes and serve hot.
cheapTips: Skip the parmesan or use a lesser amount to reduce cost
Buy prosciutto from the deli counter instead of pre-packaged

recipes.name: Baked Feta Pasta
recipes.description: Mediterranean Fusion dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place feta block in a baking dish, surround with cherry tomatoes, and drizzle with olive oil.
Sprinkle minced garlic, oregano, and red pepper flakes over the cheese and tomatoes.
Bake for 25 minutes until cheese is soft and tomatoes begin to burst.
Meanwhile, cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Remove feta dish from oven and stir to create a creamy sauce, breaking cheese into pieces.
Toss hot pasta with baked feta mixture, adding pasta water as needed for creaminess, then top with fresh basil and lemon zest.
cheapTips: Use a whole block of feta instead of crumbled to save 40%
Buy cherry tomatoes when in season or use canned tomatoes

recipes.name: Rainbow Layer Cake
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: red, orange, yellow, green, blue drops

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease three 9-inch round cake pans.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in eggs one at a time and add vanilla extract.
Alternate adding dry ingredients and milk to the wet mixture, starting and ending with dry ingredients.
Divide batter evenly among five bowls and color each with different food coloring.
Distribute colored batters across the three pans to create rainbow layers within each cake (one pan gets red and orange, one gets yellow and green, one gets blue and one repeat color).
Bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean, then cool completely.
Beat butter with powdered sugar and heavy cream until fluffy, then frost between layers and on outside of stacked cakes.
Decorate with additional sprinkles or fondant as desired.
cheapTips: Use store-brand flour and sugar instead of name brands
Skip decorative fondant and use only buttercream frosting

recipes.name: Pasta à la Carbonara
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 4 quarts of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package directions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, dice pancetta and fry in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, grated Pecorino Romano, and freshly cracked black pepper.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain pasta.
Remove skillet from heat and add hot pasta to pancetta, tossing quickly.
Pour egg mixture over pasta while tossing constantly; add reserved pasta water 2-3 tablespoons at a time until creamy.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper.
cheapTips: Buy pancetta on sale and freeze, or use cheaper bacon as substitute
Purchase blocks of Pecorino Romano and grate yourself rather than pre-grated

recipes.name: Feta Salade
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash and chop romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
Dice cucumber and tomatoes, then thinly slice red onion.
Add cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion to the lettuce.
Scatter Kalamata olives and crumbled feta cheese over the vegetables.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to combine.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy feta in blocks and crumble yourself, or use store-brand feta
Use whatever tomatoes and cucumbers are in season for better prices

recipes.name: Grilled Salmon
recipes.description: Scandinavian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat grill to medium-high heat (about 375-400°F) or heat a grill pan over medium-high on stovetop.
Pat salmon fillets dry and brush both sides with olive oil.
Season salmon with salt, pepper, minced garlic, and half the fresh dill.
Place salmon skin-side up on the grill and cook for 6 minutes without moving.
Flip salmon and cook for another 4-5 minutes until flesh flakes easily with a fork.
Transfer to a plate and squeeze fresh lemon juice over each fillet.
Garnish with remaining fresh dill and serve.
cheapTips: Buy salmon when on sale and freeze for later use
Use frozen salmon fillets which are often cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Roast Chicken
recipes.description: European dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Pat chicken dry inside and out with paper towels.
Cut lemon in half and place inside chicken cavity along with 2 garlic cloves, rosemary, and thyme.
Place chicken breast-side up in a roasting pan, brush with olive oil, and season generously with salt and pepper.
Quarter the onion and scatter around the pan along with remaining garlic cloves.
Roast for 1 hour and 15 minutes to 1 hour and 30 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F at the thickest part of the thigh.
Let rest for 10 minutes before carving and serve with pan juices.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens on sale instead of individual parts; much more economical
Use dried herbs if fresh are unavailable or expensive

recipes.name: Shrimp Tempura
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 3 cups oil in a deep pot or fryer to 350°F.
Combine dashi, soy sauce, and mirin in a small bowl for dipping sauce.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, and salt.
In another bowl, beat egg yolk and mix with ice water until combined.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined; batter should be slightly lumpy.
Pat shrimp dry and dip into batter to coat completely.
Carefully place shrimp in hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy, working in batches.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and thaw before use; much cheaper than fresh
Skip mirin and use honey or brown sugar mixed with soy sauce instead

recipes.name: Beef Carpaccio
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place beef tenderloin in the freezer for 30-40 minutes until it becomes partially frozen and easier to slice thinly.
Using a very sharp knife or meat slicer, cut beef into paper-thin slices.
Arrange beef slices on a chilled plate in a single layer, slightly overlapping if needed.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and lemon juice.
Scatter capers over the beef and season with salt and pepper.
Using a vegetable peeler or sharp knife, shave thin pieces of Parmigiano-Reggiano over the top.
Serve immediately on a bed of fresh arugula.
cheapTips: Buy beef tenderloin when on sale and partially freeze to use later
Omit Parmigiano-Reggiano to reduce cost significantly

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Roasted Vegetables
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat grill to medium-high heat and oven to 400°F.
Cut bell peppers into large chunks and slice zucchini into spears; toss with broccoli, 3 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Spread vegetables on a baking sheet and roast for 25-30 minutes until golden and tender.
Pat chicken breasts dry and brush with remaining olive oil; season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Place chicken on hot grill and cook for 6-7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice if desired.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over chicken and vegetables, then serve together.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts when on sale and freeze for later use
Use whatever vegetables are cheapest in season instead of those listed

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Lemon and Herbs
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place cod fillets in a baking dish and drizzle with olive oil.
Scatter minced garlic, cherry tomatoes, and fresh herbs over the fish.
Squeeze juice from 1 lemon over the cod and season with salt and pepper.
Pour white wine around the fish and slice the remaining lemon thinly over the top.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until cod is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve immediately with the baking pan juices spooned over each fillet.
cheapTips: Buy frozen cod fillets which are often cheaper and convenient
Skip white wine and use extra lemon juice or chicken broth instead

recipes.name: Cauliflower Rice Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Asian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Beat eggs in a bowl with a fork until well mixed.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat.
Scramble eggs until cooked through, then remove from the pan and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the pan and stir-fry minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add cauliflower rice and frozen vegetables, stirring constantly for 5-7 minutes until heated through.
Return eggs to the pan and add soy sauce and sesame oil, tossing to combine.
Top with sliced green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen cauliflower rice which is cheaper than fresh-riced cauliflower
Use frozen mixed vegetables instead of fresh for better prices

recipes.name: Roasted Chicken
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Pat chicken dry inside and out using paper towels.
Rub chicken inside and out with olive oil, then season generously with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Cut carrots and potatoes into large chunks and place around the chicken in a roasting pan.
Place chicken breast-side up in the pan and roast for 1 hour and 15 minutes to 1 hour and 30 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Let chicken rest for 10 minutes before carving.
Serve chicken with the roasted vegetables and pan drippings.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens on sale and freeze for future meals
Carrots and potatoes are inexpensive and store well for long periods

recipes.name: Waffle Fries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes lengthwise into thin slices about 1/8 inch thick.
Rotate each slice 90 degrees and cut again to create waffle pattern pieces.
Soak cut potatoes in cold water for 30 minutes to remove starch.
Pat potatoes completely dry with paper towels.
Heat oil to 350°F in a heavy pot or deep fryer.
Fry potatoes in batches for 4-5 minutes until golden and crispy.
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Season immediately with salt, pepper, and paprika while hot.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk and store in cool dark place
Reuse frying oil multiple times before discarding

recipes.name: Taco Bell Crunchwrap Supreme
recipes.description: Mexican-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat and stir in taco seasoning with 3 tablespoons water.
Lay one tortilla flat and spread nacho cheese sauce on half of it.
Layer crushed Tostitos, cooked beef, sour cream, shredded cheese, tomatoes, and lettuce in that order.
Fold tortilla in half to create a triangle, then fold in half again.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat and pan-fry the wrapped crunchwrap until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove from skillet and let cool for 1 minute before serving.
Repeat with remaining tortilla and fillings.
cheapTips: Use store-brand taco seasoning instead of packets
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Doritos Locos Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown ground beef and mix in taco seasoning with 2 tablespoons water, then simmer for 3 minutes.
Heat tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side to make them pliable.
Pour crushed Doritos into a shallow bowl.
Dip one side of each warm tortilla into the crushed Doritos, pressing gently so chips adhere.
Fry tortillas Doritos-side down in the oil for 1-2 minutes until crispy.
Flip and fry other side for another minute.
Fill tacos with seasoned beef, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, and sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy Doritos on promotion and stock up
Use 80/20 ground beef for extra flavor and value

recipes.name: Qdoba Burrito
recipes.description: Mexican-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice with cilantro and lime juice according to package directions.
Brown ground beef in a skillet and add taco seasoning with 3 tablespoons water, simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm black beans in a small saucepan over low heat.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Lay tortilla flat and arrange rice in a line down the center, leaving 2 inches on each side.
Layer beef, beans, corn, cheese, tomatoes, lettuce, sour cream, and salsa on top of rice.
Fold in left and right sides of tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom up.
Wrap in foil if desired to keep warm and contain any spillage.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans in bulk and use on multiple meals
Make rice in large batches and portion for the week

recipes.name: Subway Six-Inch Sub
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut sub roll in half lengthwise with a serrated knife.
Spread mayo on bottom half and mustard on top half.
Layer turkey breast slices on the bottom half.
Add swiss cheese slice on top of turkey.
Arrange lettuce, tomato, onion, cucumber, and banana peppers on top.
Close sandwich by placing top half over fillings.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and cut in half diagonally if desired.
cheapTips: Buy deli turkey on sale and slice it yourself for better value
Purchase sub rolls from bakery section instead of prepackaged

recipes.name: Wendy's Baconator
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 7-8 minutes, then break into pieces.
Form ground beef into 4 thin patties about 0.5 inches thick and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and cook patties for 2-3 minutes per side until cooked through.
Top each patty with 2 slices of American cheese and cover skillet briefly to melt.
Toast hamburger buns lightly in the skillet.
Spread mayo on bottom bun, then layer patties with cheese, bacon, lettuce, tomato, and onion.
Mix ketchup and mustard and spread on top bun.
Close sandwich and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy bacon when on sale and freeze in portions
Use store-brand ground beef and American cheese

recipes.name: Arby's Roast Beef Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown beef chuck roast on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Remove roast and add onion and garlic to skillet, cooking for 2 minutes.
Return roast to skillet and add beef broth, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2-3 hours until meat is very tender and shreds easily.
Remove roast and let cool enough to handle, then shred into thin slices.
Toast sesame seed buns in a skillet or toaster.
Spread horseradish sauce on bottom bun and add shredded roast beef.
Top with fresh arugula and close sandwich with top bun.
cheapTips: Buy chuck roast from bulk section for better pricing
Make extra and freeze leftover shredded roast for future meals

recipes.name: Five Guys Burger
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Form ground beef into 2 patties slightly larger than the buns, creating a small indent in the center of each.
Heat a griddle or skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Place cheese slices on patties during last minute of cooking and cover to melt.
Lightly butter buns and toast cut-side down in a separate skillet until golden.
Spread mayo on bottom bun and mustard on top bun.
Layer lettuce, patty with cheese, tomato, and onion on bottom bun.
Close sandwich with top bun and wrap in foil to keep warm.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk and freeze in quarter-pound portions
Toast buns in oven at once instead of individually

recipes.name: In-N-Out Double-Double
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Form ground beef into 2 thin patties seasoned lightly with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 2-3 minutes per side.
Place one cheese slice on each patty during the last minute of cooking.
Toast bun lightly in the skillet.
Spread mayo on bottom bun and a combination of mustard and ketchup on top bun.
Layer one patty with cheese, lettuce, tomato slice, and onion on bottom bun.
Place second patty with cheese, remaining tomato, and lettuce on top of first patty.
Close sandwich with top bun.
cheapTips: Use 80/20 ground beef for juicier burgers
Buy onions and tomatoes in season for better prices

recipes.name: Shake Shack ShackBurger
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Form ground beef into 2 patties slightly larger than buns with a slight dimple in center.
Season generously with salt and pepper just before cooking.
Heat a skillet or griddle over medium-high heat until very hot, about 2 minutes.
Cook patties for 3 minutes on first side without moving them, then flip and cook 2-3 minutes on second side.
Top each patty with cheddar cheese in the last minute and cover to melt.
Butter potato buns and toast cut-side down until golden brown.
Spread mayo on bottom bun and whole grain mustard on top bun.
Layer lettuce, tomato, patty with cheese, pickles, and shallots on bottom bun and close with top bun.
cheapTips: Buy quality ground beef with good fat content for better flavor
Make pickled shallots at home in advance to save money

recipes.name: Spaghetti Squash Bolognese
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut spaghetti squash in half lengthwise and scoop out seeds.
Place squash cut-side down on a baking sheet and roast at 400°F for 35-40 minutes until fork-tender.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks for 5 minutes.
Add diced onion and garlic, sauté for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, salt, pepper, and basil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Use a fork to scrape the roasted squash into noodle-like strands.
Divide squash among plates, top with meat sauce, and garnish with parmesan cheese.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later.
Use store-brand canned tomatoes and tomato paste to cut costs.

recipes.name: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
recipes.description: Asian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add ground chicken and cook for 5-7 minutes, breaking it apart, until no longer pink.
Add minced garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in soy sauce and sesame oil, mixing well.
Stir in water chestnuts and green onions, cooking for 2 minutes.
Carefully separate lettuce leaves and arrange on a serving plate.
Spoon chicken mixture into each lettuce leaf and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground chicken when on sale and portion into freezer bags.
Skip water chestnuts or substitute with diced bell peppers.

recipes.name: Guacamole with Vegetable Crudités
recipes.description: Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut avocados in half, remove the pit, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash avocado with a fork until desired consistency is reached.
Squeeze lime juice over the avocado and stir to combine.
Season with salt, pepper, and add fresh cilantro, mixing gently.
Transfer guacamole to a serving bowl.
Arrange sliced carrots, celery, bell peppers, cherry tomatoes, and cucumber around the guacamole.
cheapTips: Buy avocados when on sale and ripen at home for optimal cost.
Use whatever fresh vegetables are in season for vegetables.

recipes.name: Grilled Lamb Chops
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat lamb chops dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, combine olive oil, minced garlic, juice from half the lemon, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Rub lamb chops generously with the marinade and let sit for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Preheat grill to high heat (or use a cast-iron skillet on the stovetop).
Grill lamb chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare doneness.
Transfer to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
Squeeze remaining lemon juice over the chops before serving.
cheapTips: Buy lamb chops when on sale and freeze for later use.
Use dried herbs instead of fresh if budget is tight.

recipes.name: Grilled Salmon with Lemon
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat salmon fillets dry and place on a sheet of aluminum foil.
Drizzle salmon with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle minced garlic and fresh dill evenly over each fillet.
Slice lemon into thin rounds and place on top of each fillet.
Fold foil to create a sealed packet and grill over medium-high heat for 12-15 minutes.
Carefully open foil packet (watch for steam) and check that salmon flakes easily with a fork.
Transfer to plates and serve with any pan juices drizzled on top.
cheapTips: Buy salmon when on sale and freeze for convenient weeknight dinners.
Use frozen lemon slices if fresh lemons are expensive.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken breasts dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Grill chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Transfer to a cutting board, let rest for 5 minutes, then slice into strips.
Place chopped romaine in a large bowl and drizzle with caesar dressing, tossing to coat.
Divide salad between two plates and top with sliced chicken, croutons, and shaved parmesan.
Squeeze lemon juice over each salad and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for meal prep.
Make your own croutons from stale bread to save money.

recipes.name: Miso Soup with Tofu
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a pot and add dashi powder, stirring to dissolve.
Add wakame seaweed and simmer for 2 minutes.
Gently add tofu cubes and let simmer for another 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk miso paste with 2 tbsp warm broth to dissolve.
Remove pot from heat and stir in dissolved miso paste (do not boil).
Ladle soup into bowls and garnish with green onions and nori strips.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy miso paste and dashi in bulk at Asian markets for significant savings.
Substitute seaweed with sliced mushrooms if unavailable.

recipes.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat.
Add shrimp and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until pink, then transfer to a plate.
Add remaining oil and scramble beaten eggs in the same pan, then remove.
Add minced garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add chilled rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Return shrimp and eggs to the pan, add frozen vegetables, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Toss everything together for 2 minutes and finish with green onions.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp, which is cheaper than fresh and thaws quickly.
Make rice the night before to ensure it is chilled and grains separate.

recipes.name: Korean Beef Bibimbap
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, marinate ground beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, and 1 minced garlic clove for 10 minutes.
Blanch chopped spinach for 1 minute, drain, and toss with remaining minced garlic, 0.5 tbsp sesame oil, and salt.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté mushrooms until golden, then remove.
In the same skillet, sauté grated carrot for 2 minutes, then zucchini for 2 minutes, remove.
Brown marinated beef in the skillet for 4-5 minutes, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Fry eggs sunny-side up in a separate pan.
Divide cooked rice between two bowls and arrange cooked vegetables and beef on top in sections.
Make gochujang sauce by mixing gochujang with 1 tbsp sesame oil and 1 tbsp water, then drizzle on rice.
Top each bowl with a fried egg and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip shiitake mushrooms and use button or cremini mushrooms instead.
Buy gochujang at Asian markets where it is cheaper than specialty stores.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese with Berries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Divide cottage cheese evenly between two bowls.
Top each bowl with 0.5 cup mixed berries.
Drizzle 0.5 tbsp honey over each bowl.
Sprinkle granola and almonds on top of each serving.
Serve immediately and enjoy.
cheapTips: Buy frozen berries on sale and thaw for a cheaper alternative to fresh.
Make your own granola at home to cut costs significantly.

recipes.name: Chipotle Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: Mexican-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook brown rice according to package directions and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks for 5-7 minutes.
Drain excess fat from the beef and season with cumin, salt, and pepper.
Warm the black beans and corn together in a saucepan over medium heat for 3-4 minutes.
Divide cooked rice between two bowls and arrange lettuce, seasoned beef, beans, corn, and cheese on top.
Add a dollop of sour cream and salsa to each bowl.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the bowls and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions to save 20-30%
Use dried beans cooked in bulk instead of canned to reduce cost by half

recipes.name: Panera Broccoli Cheddar Soup
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in vegetable broth and add diced potatoes, then bring to a boil.
Add chopped broccoli and reduce heat to medium, simmering for 12-15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in heavy cream and thyme, heating through without boiling.
Remove from heat and gradually stir in shredded cheddar cheese until completely melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy broccoli crowns in bulk or frozen to cut vegetable costs in half
Use half-and-half instead of heavy cream to reduce fat and save money

recipes.name: Chick-fil-A Chicken Biscuit
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breast to even 0.5-inch thickness and cut into 2 equal portions.
Pour buttermilk into one shallow dish and combine flour, salt, pepper, and paprika in another.
Dip chicken pieces in buttermilk, then coat thoroughly in seasoned flour.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and carefully place breaded chicken in hot oil.
Fry for 6-8 minutes total, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Place chicken on a paper towel to drain while you bake biscuits according to package directions.
Split warm biscuits, add a pat of butter and a slice of cheese, then place fried chicken inside and serve.
cheapTips: Make your own buttermilk by mixing 1 tbsp vinegar with milk and letting sit 5 minutes
Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later to save 30-40%

recipes.name: McDonald's Egg McMuffin
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Split English muffins and lightly toast them in a toaster or toaster oven.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add butter.
Crack eggs into the skillet and cook sunny-side up or to your preference, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Warm Canadian bacon slices in the same skillet or a separate pan for 1-2 minutes per side.
Butter the toasted English muffin halves lightly.
Assemble each sandwich by placing a slice of Canadian bacon, one cooked egg, and a slice of American cheese on each muffin bottom.
Top with the muffin top and serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand English muffins and cheese slices instead of name brands
Watch for sales on eggs and stock up to save significantly on this recurring breakfast

recipes.name: Grilled Salmon with Quinoa
recipes.description: Scandinavian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse quinoa under cold water and cook in 1.5 cups water for 15 minutes, then let sit covered for 5 minutes.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Pat salmon fillets dry and brush with 1 tbsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper.
Place salmon skin-side down on grill and cook for 5-6 minutes without moving, then flip and cook 3-4 minutes more until cooked through.
Toss asparagus with remaining olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then grill for 4-5 minutes, turning occasionally.
Fluff quinoa with a fork and divide between two plates.
Place grilled salmon and asparagus on plates, garnish with fresh dill and lemon slices, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy frozen salmon fillets instead of fresh to save 40-50% and they thaw quickly
Buy quinoa in bulk bins rather than pre-packaged for 30% savings

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Roasted Vegetables
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss zucchini, bell pepper, and cherry tomatoes with 2 tbsp olive oil, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Spread vegetables on one side of the baking sheet and roast for 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, brush cod fillets with remaining olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Push roasted vegetables to the side and place cod fillets on the baking sheet.
Roast everything together for 10-12 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
Garnish with fresh parsley and lemon slices, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen cod fillets which are usually cheaper and last longer than fresh
Use seasonal vegetables like zucchini and peppers to save 20-30% on costs

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Sweet Potato
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube sweet potatoes into 1-inch pieces and toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper, and thyme.
Spread sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast at 425°F for 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Pat chicken breasts dry and brush with remaining olive oil.
Season chicken with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper on both sides.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and grill chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken and let rest for 3-4 minutes before serving.
Top roasted sweet potatoes with a small pat of butter and drizzle of honey, then plate with grilled chicken and serve.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts in bulk when on sale and freeze to save 25-35%
Buy sweet potatoes in 5-lb bags rather than individually for better pricing

recipes.name: Hummus and Vegetable Platter
recipes.description: Middle Eastern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse canned chickpeas thoroughly under cold water.
Combine drained chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, olive oil, and salt in a food processor.
Blend until smooth and creamy, adding 1-2 tbsp water if needed to reach desired consistency.
Transfer hummus to a serving bowl and arrange on a platter with carrots, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and bell pepper.
Warm pita bread in a toaster or pan and cut into triangles.
Arrange pita around the vegetables on the platter and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make hummus from canned chickpeas instead of fresh to save significantly
Buy vegetables in season and locally to reduce costs by 20-30%

recipes.name: Steamed Broccoli with Garlic
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a pot with 2 inches of water and bring to a boil, then place a steamer basket on top.
Add broccoli florets to the steamer basket and steam covered for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
While broccoli steams, heat vegetable oil in a small pan over medium heat and add minced garlic.
Cook garlic for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant and lightly golden.
Add red pepper flakes and cook for another 30 seconds.
Transfer steamed broccoli to a serving dish and drizzle with sesame oil and soy sauce.
Pour garlic oil mixture over the broccoli and toss gently to coat, then sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy broccoli crowns rather than pre-cut florets to save 30-40%
Use regular soy sauce instead of tamari or low-sodium versions to cut costs

recipes.name: Zucchini Noodles with Marinara
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Use a vegetable spiralizer or julienne peeler to create noodles from the zucchini.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add minced garlic.
Cook garlic for about 1 minute until fragrant, then add marinara sauce and red pepper flakes.
Simmer sauce for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add zucchini noodles to the skillet and gently toss to combine with the sauce.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until zucchini is heated through but still has slight firmness.
Season with salt and black pepper, then divide between two plates and top with fresh basil and grated parmesan cheese before serving.
cheapTips: Make your own marinara sauce with canned tomatoes to save 50% versus jarred sauce
Buy zucchini in bulk during summer when prices are lowest and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Pan con Tomate
recipes.description: Spanish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the bread about half an inch thick and toast it lightly in a toaster or skillet until golden.
Cut the tomatoes in half and rub the cut side directly onto the warm toast until the flesh soaks in.
Peel and rub the garlic clove over the tomato-rubbed toast.
Drizzle generously with olive oil and sprinkle with sea salt to taste.
cheapTips: Buy tomatoes in season at farmers markets for best price and flavor
Use affordable rustic bread or day-old bread from the bakery section

recipes.name: Feta Toast
recipes.description: Greek breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden brown.
Toss cherry tomatoes with olive oil, lemon juice, dill, and black pepper.
Spread crumbled feta cheese evenly on each warm slice of toast.
Top with the tomato mixture and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy feta in bulk and store in brine in the refrigerator for weeks
Use regular tomatoes diced instead of cherry tomatoes to save money

recipes.name: Tostada
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry each tortilla until crispy and golden on both sides.
Drain and warm the black beans in a small saucepan.
Spread warm beans on each crispy tortilla base.
Layer cheese, lettuce, and tomato on top of the beans.
Add a dollop of sour cream and salsa to each tostada and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand canned beans and salsa instead of name brands
Use iceberg lettuce which is cheaper than specialty greens

recipes.name: Ricotta Toast with Honey
recipes.description: Italian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until light golden and crispy.
Spread a generous layer of ricotta cheese on each warm slice.
Scatter fresh berries over the ricotta.
Drizzle with honey, sprinkle with lemon zest and a pinch of salt, then serve.
cheapTips: Use frozen berries instead of fresh for consistent lower pricing
Buy ricotta on sale and freeze in portions for later use

recipes.name: Pâté en Croûte on Toast
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice onion and garlic, then sauté in a skillet until soft and cool slightly.
Grind the chicken liver and mix with ground pork, cooked onion, garlic, pistachio nuts, and brandy seasoned with salt and pepper.
Line a terrine mold with thin slices of pork fat and fill with the pâté mixture, pressing down firmly.
Cover the top with remaining pork fat slices and wrap tightly with foil.
Place the terrine in a water bath and bake at 325°F for 90 minutes until an internal thermometer reads 160°F.
Cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 12 hours before unmolding.
Slice the pâté and serve on toasted bread with cornichons and Dijon mustard.
cheapTips: Buy pork liver instead of chicken liver to reduce cost significantly
Make in larger batches and freeze for up to 3 months

recipes.name: Anchovy Toast
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
Mash the butter with minced garlic and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Spread garlic butter on each warm slice of toast.
Arrange 2 anchovy fillets on each slice, sprinkle with parsley and black pepper, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned anchovies in bulk from ethnic markets for better pricing
Store opened cans in the refrigerator covered with oil for weeks

recipes.name: Caviar on Toast
recipes.description: Russian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices lightly until just warm but still soft.
Spread a thin layer of butter on each slice.
Add a small dollop of crème fraîche to each piece.
Top with a spoonful of caviar, garnish with fresh chives, and serve with lemon.
cheapTips: Use affordable lumpfish or whitefish caviar instead of sturgeon for significant savings
Purchase from online retailers that specialize in caviar for better pricing

recipes.name: Soparnik
recipes.description: Croatian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Sauté diced onion and garlic in butter until soft, then add fresh spinach and cook until wilted.
Mix cooked spinach with ricotta, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Brush a baking sheet with olive oil and layer 3 phyllo sheets, brushing between each with melted butter.
Spread spinach and cheese mixture evenly over the phyllo base.
Top with remaining 3 phyllo sheets, brushing between each with melted butter.
Brush the top layer with remaining butter and score into squares with a sharp knife.
Bake at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
cheapTips: Buy frozen spinach instead of fresh to reduce prep time and cost
Phyllo dough lasts weeks in the refrigerator once opened

recipes.name: Tapenade Toast
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pit the Kalamata olives and place in a food processor with capers and anchovies.
Add minced garlic and pulse until roughly chopped but not fully smooth.
Add olive oil and lemon juice and pulse a few more times to combine.
Toast the bread slices until golden, top with tapenade, sprinkle with black pepper, and serve.
cheapTips: Make tapenade in bulk and store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks
Buy olives from the bulk bin rather than pre-packaged for better pricing

recipes.name: Burrata Toast
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden on the outside but still slightly soft inside.
Slice the tomatoes and season with salt and pepper.
Place warm toast on a plate and gently tear burrata cheese on top.
Arrange tomato slices over the burrata, add fresh basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy burrata when on sale and consume within 2-3 days for best quality
Use mozzarella di bufala as a more affordable burrata alternative

recipes.name: Soufflé Pancakes
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, whisk egg yolks with 1.5 tablespoons sugar, milk, vanilla, and flour until smooth.
In another bowl, beat egg whites with remaining sugar until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold egg white mixture into yolk mixture in two additions.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over low heat.
Pour batter to form 3-inch circles and cook covered for 4 minutes until bottoms are golden.
Flip gently and cook uncovered for 2 minutes.
Stack pancakes and serve immediately with maple syrup.
cheapTips: Buy eggs on sale and stock your freezer.
Use store-brand flour and milk to reduce costs.

recipes.name: Burrata Salad
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Halve cherry tomatoes and place in a bowl.
Toss arugula with 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Arrange arugula on two plates as a base.
Top each plate with halved tomatoes.
Place burrata in the center of each salad.
Drizzle remaining olive oil and balsamic vinegar over everything.
Tear fresh basil and scatter over the salad.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy burrata when on sale and use within 2-3 days.
Use regular mozzarella as a cheaper alternative if burrata is unavailable.

recipes.name: Whipped Feta
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add feta, yogurt, lemon juice, and minced garlic to a food processor.
Blend until creamy and light, about 1-2 minutes.
Transfer to a serving bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with red pepper flakes and dill.
Serve with warm pita bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy feta in bulk and store in brine to extend freshness.
Use store-brand Greek yogurt instead of premium brands.

recipes.name: Chicken Schnitzel
recipes.description: Austrian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound to 1/4-inch thickness.
Set up three bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and panko breadcrumbs mixed with salt and pepper.
Coat each chicken piece in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing gently.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry schnitzel 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later.
Use regular breadcrumbs instead of panko to save money.

recipes.name: Ube Pancakes
recipes.description: Filipino breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour, ube powder, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk milk, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined; some lumps are fine.
Heat a non-stick griddle or skillet over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake and cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on top.
Flip and cook another 1-2 minutes until golden.
Serve with condensed milk or maple syrup.
cheapTips: Buy ube powder online in bulk for significant savings.
Use regular milk instead of specialty alternatives.

recipes.name: Dirty Martini
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice.
Add gin, dry vermouth, and olive brine to the shaker.
Stir vigorously for 10 seconds.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with three green olives on a cocktail pick.
cheapTips: Use mid-range gin rather than premium brands.
Buy olives in bulk from warehouse stores.

recipes.name: Wendy's Square Hamburger
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Divide ground beef into two portions and gently form into square patties slightly larger than the buns.
Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat a flat griddle or skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook patties 2.5-3 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Top each patty with a cheese slice in the last 30 seconds of cooking.
Toast buns lightly on the griddle.
Assemble burgers with mustard and ketchup on bottom bun, then patty with cheese, tomato, lettuce, and pickles.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for quick meals.
Use store-brand cheese and condiments.

recipes.name: Chipotle Bowl
recipes.description: Mexican-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions and fluff with a fork.
Slice chicken breast into strips and cook in olive oil over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes until golden.
Blend chipotle peppers with sour cream and juice of 1/2 lime to make a sauce.
Warm black beans and corn together in a small pot.
Divide cooked rice between two bowls.
Top each bowl with chicken, beans, corn, cheese, and a dollop of chipotle cream.
Garnish with cilantro and lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts in bulk when on sale.
Use canned beans and frozen vegetables for consistent pricing.

recipes.name: Chick-fil-A Waffle Fries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and cut into 1/4-inch thick waffle-cut slices using a waffle cutter or crinkle cutter.
Soak cut potatoes in ice water for 30 minutes to remove starch.
Drain potatoes thoroughly and pat completely dry with paper towels.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or fryer.
Fry potatoes in batches for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy, stirring occasionally.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Season immediately with salt and pepper while hot.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in 5-lb bags for the best per-pound price.
Reuse frying oil by straining and storing for future use.

recipes.name: McDonald's French Fries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch thick sticks and place in a bowl of cold water.
Let soak for at least 15 minutes to remove excess starch.
Drain and pat potatoes completely dry with paper towels.
Heat oil to 325°F in a deep pot or fryer.
Blanch potatoes in oil for 5 minutes until they start to turn golden but are still soft.
Remove potatoes with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Increase oil temperature to 375°F and fry potatoes again for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and season with salt immediately.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes at discount stores or farmers markets.
Use the double-fry technique to maximize crispiness and reduce waste.

recipes.name: Whipped Goat Cheese Toast
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine goat cheese and heavy cream in a bowl and whip with a fork until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.
Season the whipped mixture with salt, pepper, and fresh thyme.
Toast the bread slices until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side.
Spread the whipped goat cheese generously on each toast.
Drizzle with honey and a small amount of olive oil, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand goat cheese instead of premium brands
Use day-old bread for toasting

recipes.name: Mushroom Toast
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and add minced garlic, stirring for 30 seconds.
Add sliced mushrooms and sauté for 5-7 minutes until golden and liquid has mostly evaporated.
Season mushrooms with salt, pepper, and fresh parsley.
Toast the bread slices until golden brown.
Top each toast with sautéed mushrooms and sprinkle gruyere cheese over the top, then serve.
cheapTips: Buy mushrooms in bulk when on sale and freeze
Use cheddar instead of gruyere to save money

recipes.name: Alligator Gar on Toast
recipes.description: Creole lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté celery, onion, and bell pepper for 3 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, then remove vegetables and set aside.
Season fish fillet with salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Add remaining butter to the skillet and pan-fry the fish for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and flaky.
Toast bread until golden brown.
Return vegetables to the skillet with the fish and warm through, then squeeze lemon juice over everything.
Top each toast with fish and creole vegetable mixture and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy frozen white fish fillets when on sale
Use regular bread instead of fancy varieties

recipes.name: Sea Urchin Toast
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast bread slices until golden brown and crispy.
Lightly butter each toast slice.
Carefully place uni (sea urchin roe) on top of each buttered toast slice.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and top with a strip of nori.
Drizzle lightly with soy sauce and serve immediately with a lemon wedge on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen uni instead of fresh to save significantly
Make your own nori strips from full sheets

recipes.name: White Truffle Toast
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast bread slices until golden and crispy, about 2 minutes per side.
Spread 1 tablespoon of butter on each warm toast slice.
Drizzle each toast with white truffle oil.
Using a vegetable peeler, shave thin slices of parmigiano-reggiano over each toast.
Season with a pinch of salt and fresh black pepper, garnish with parsley, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use affordable truffle oil instead of fresh white truffles
Buy parmigiano-reggiano in blocks and shave yourself

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Toast
recipes.description: Jewish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast bagels or bread slices until warm and slightly crispy.
Spread 2 tablespoons of cream cheese evenly on each toasted bagel or pair of bread slices.
Layer smoked salmon generously over the cream cheese.
Top with thinly sliced red onion and capers.
Sprinkle fresh dill over the top and serve with lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy smoked salmon on sale and freeze
Use store-brand cream cheese to save money

recipes.name: Skillet Cookie
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and place a 10-inch cast iron skillet inside to heat.
Cream together butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar in a bowl until light and fluffy.
Beat in the egg yolk and vanilla extract until combined.
In another bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt, then fold into the wet ingredients.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Carefully pour dough into the hot skillet and spread evenly.
