Bake for 12-15 minutes until the edges are set but the center is slightly underdone.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes, then serve warm with ice cream if desired.
cheapTips: Use store-brand chocolate chips
Buy brown sugar in bulk for better pricing

recipes.name: Whipped Coffee
recipes.description: Italian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add instant coffee, sugar, and hot water to a medium bowl.
Whisk vigorously for 2-3 minutes until the mixture becomes thick, light, and foamy with a mousse-like texture.
Divide the whipped coffee mixture between two cups.
Pour hot milk into each cup, stirring well to incorporate the whipped coffee.
Dust lightly with cocoa powder if desired and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use generic instant coffee instead of name brands
Use regular milk instead of specialty options

recipes.name: Birria Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles and toast in a dry skillet for 1 minute.
Place toasted chiles in a pot with beef broth, half the onion, garlic cloves, cumin, oregano, and vinegar, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the chile mixture until smooth and strain through a fine sieve.
Place beef chuck roast in a large pot and pour the strained chile sauce over it.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 1.5 hours until meat is very tender and shreds easily.
Remove beef and shred with two forks, then return to the broth.
Heat tortillas in a dry skillet, dip each into the warm broth for 2 seconds, then fill with shredded beef.
Serve tacos with diced onion, cilantro, and a small cup of broth for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy dried chiles in bulk from a Mexican grocery store
Use chuck roast on sale and freeze until needed

recipes.name: Milk Tea
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil water in a pot and add black tea leaves or tea bags.
Steep for 5-7 minutes until the tea is strong and dark.
Strain the tea into a pitcher and let cool to room temperature, about 5 minutes.
Add evaporated milk and sweetened condensed milk to the cooled tea and stir well.
Fill two glasses with ice and pour the milk tea mixture over the ice.
Stir well and serve immediately with a straw.
cheapTips: Buy condensed and evaporated milk when on sale
Use black tea bags instead of loose leaf

recipes.name: Feta Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil water in a large pot with salt and cook penne according to package directions until al dente.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add cherry tomatoes and red onion to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, gently crushing tomatoes as they soften.
Drain pasta and add it to the skillet with the tomato mixture, stirring gently.
Remove from heat and fold in crumbled feta cheese, fresh basil, and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy feta in bulk from warehouse stores or ethnic markets for better pricing
Use canned tomatoes if cherry tomatoes are expensive

recipes.name: Tiktok Ramen
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a large pot and add ramen noodles, cooking for 2-3 minutes until softened.
While noodles cook, heat butter in a separate skillet over medium-high heat and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Crack eggs into the buttered skillet and fry sunny-side up until whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Drain ramen noodles, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid, and add noodles back to the pot.
Stir in soy sauce, sriracha, sesame oil, and the reserved cooking liquid into the noodles.
Pour noodles into serving bowls and top with fried eggs and mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle green onions on top and serve immediately while cheese melts slightly.
cheapTips: Buy instant ramen in bulk from discount stores for under $0.25 per package
Use vegetable oil instead of sesame oil to reduce costs

recipes.name: Strawberry Shortcake Rolls
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Unroll crescent dough and separate into triangles, then roll each triangle tightly starting from the wide end.
Place rolls on the prepared baking sheet, brush with melted butter, and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown, then remove and let cool for 5 minutes.
While rolls cool, toss sliced strawberries with sugar and vanilla extract and let sit for 5 minutes.
Slice each cooled roll horizontally and fill with whipped cream and strawberry mixture.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand crescent rolls and whipped cream in cans instead of fresh
Buy strawberries in season or frozen for better prices

recipes.name: Gyatt Cereal
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour milk into two bowls.
Add 1 cup cereal to each bowl.
Drizzle honey over each bowl and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Top with sliced banana and strawberries.
Add a dollop of whipped cream to each bowl and serve immediately before cereal becomes soggy.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cornflakes instead of name brands
Buy seasonal fruit or use frozen berries to save money

recipes.name: Soft Serve Ice Cream Hack
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour heavy cream into a mixing bowl and whip on high speed until soft peaks form, about 3-4 minutes.
Fold in sweetened condensed milk, vanilla extract, and sugar gently until combined.
Divide the mixture into two serving bowls.
Drizzle chocolate syrup on top of each serving.
Serve immediately for a soft serve texture, or freeze for 1-2 hours for a firmer consistency.
cheapTips: Buy heavy cream on sale and freeze until needed
Use store-brand chocolate syrup instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Boba Tea
recipes.description: Taiwanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a pot and add tapioca pearls, stirring occasionally for 25-30 minutes until translucent.
Drain cooked pearls and rinse with cold water, then toss with 1 tablespoon brown sugar.
In another pot, bring 2 cups of water to a boil and steep black tea bags for 5 minutes, then remove bags.
Stir brown sugar and honey into the brewed tea until dissolved, then let cool to room temperature.
Fill two glasses with ice cubes and divide cooked tapioca pearls between glasses.
Pour cooled tea into each glass, leaving room for milk.
Top each glass with milk and vanilla extract, stir well, and serve immediately with a wide straw.
cheapTips: Buy tapioca pearls in bulk from Asian markets for much cheaper prices
Use store-brand black tea bags instead of specialty teas

recipes.name: Cornflake Tart
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and place pie crust in a 9-inch tart pan, trimming excess.
Prick the crust with a fork and bake for 8-10 minutes until light golden, then remove and let cool slightly.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat and add crushed corn flakes, honey, and salt, stirring until combined.
Spread caramel sauce evenly over the cooled pie crust.
Press the cornflake mixture firmly over the caramel layer.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until the cornflake topping is golden brown.
Cool for 10 minutes, then drizzle with sweetened condensed milk before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cereal and caramel sauce
Buy pie crusts in bulk when on sale and freeze them

recipes.name: Honey Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken in batches until golden and cooked through, about 12-15 minutes total.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside, then reduce heat to medium.
Add butter to the skillet and sauté garlic and ginger until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Return chicken to skillet and stir in soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil.
Cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, then serve over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze them until ready to use
Use chicken drumsticks instead for a cheaper cut

recipes.name: Crispy Chicken Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound to 1/2-inch thickness using a meat mallet.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour mixed with salt and pepper, beaten egg, and panko breadcrumbs.
Coat each chicken breast in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing gently so breadcrumbs adhere.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or Dutch oven and carefully place breaded chicken in hot oil.
Fry for 6-8 minutes per side until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Toast brioche buns and spread mayonnaise on each, then layer lettuce, chicken, tomato, and pickles.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts in bulk and freeze when on sale
Use store-brand mayo and breadcrumbs to reduce costs

recipes.name: Whipped Feta Dip
recipes.description: Mediterranean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add crumbled feta cheese and Greek yogurt to a food processor.
Add olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, and dill.
Blend on high speed for 2-3 minutes until light, fluffy, and creamy, scraping down sides as needed.
Transfer to a serving bowl and drizzle with additional olive oil.
Sprinkle red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper on top.
Serve immediately with pita chips, crackers, or fresh vegetables for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy feta in bulk from warehouse clubs and freeze in portions
Use store-brand Greek yogurt instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Chickpea Curry
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, stirring constantly for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in curry powder and cook for another minute to toast the spices.
Add drained chickpeas, canned tomatoes with juice, coconut milk, and vegetable broth to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
cheapTips: Buy curry powder in bulk from Indian markets for half the price of supermarket brands.
Use frozen spinach instead of fresh to save money and reduce waste.

recipes.name: Grilled Fish Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix lime juice, olive oil, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Place fish fillets in a shallow dish and coat with the lime marinade, let sit for 10 minutes.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and oil the grates.
Grill marinated fish for 3-4 minutes per side until opaque and flaky.
Warm tortillas on the grill for about 30 seconds per side.
Flake grilled fish into bite-sized pieces using a fork.
Assemble tacos by filling tortillas with shredded cabbage, fish, avocado, cilantro, and salsa.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish fillets on sale and thaw overnight—equally good and often cheaper.
Use green cabbage instead of red cabbage to save about 50 cents per serving.

recipes.name: Chicken Breast with Quinoa
recipes.description: South American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse quinoa under cold water and cook in chicken broth according to package directions, about 15 minutes.
Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and cumin on both sides.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until golden and internal temperature reaches 165°F; remove and let rest 5 minutes.
In the same skillet, add remaining olive oil and garlic, cooking for 30 seconds.
Stir in cooked quinoa, black beans, and corn, heating through for 2 minutes.
Drizzle with lime juice, top with cilantro, and serve chicken alongside the quinoa mixture.
cheapTips: Buy chicken in bulk when on sale and freeze for future meals.
Use canned beans and frozen corn to reduce prep time and cost.

recipes.name: Hummus and Pita Bread
recipes.description: Middle Eastern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add drained chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and minced garlic to a food processor.
Pulse until roughly combined, then add 2 tablespoons olive oil and blend until smooth.
Gradually add water one tablespoon at a time while blending until hummus reaches desired consistency—it should be creamy but not too thin.
Season with salt and adjust lemon juice or garlic to taste.
Transfer hummus to a serving bowl and drizzle with remaining olive oil, then sprinkle with paprika.
Warm pita bread in a 350°F oven for 5 minutes or heat briefly in a skillet.
Cut pita into triangles and serve alongside hummus for dipping.
cheapTips: Make hummus in bulk and refrigerate for up to 5 days for multiple snacking occasions.
Skip store-bought pita and buy larger packs from discount grocery stores.

recipes.name: Eggs Florentine
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté spinach until wilted, about 3 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Toast the English muffins until golden and place on a baking sheet.
Divide wilted spinach evenly between the two toasted muffins.
Make a béchamel sauce by melting 2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan, whisking in flour for 1 minute, then gradually adding milk while whisking until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Season béchamel with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, then stir in grated cheese.
Poach or bake the 4 eggs to your preference (poaching takes about 4 minutes in simmering water).
Top each muffin with 2 poached eggs, then pour hollandaise or the cheese sauce over the eggs and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand English muffins instead of name brands to save 30-40 cents.
Skip gruyere and use sharp cheddar for a similar flavor at lower cost.

recipes.name: Lox and Cream Cheese Platter
recipes.description: Jewish American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice bagels in half horizontally and toast lightly in a toaster oven until warm, about 3 minutes.
Spread 2 tablespoons of cream cheese on each bagel half.
Layer 2 ounces of lox on top of the cream cheese on each bagel.
Arrange sliced tomato and cucumber on a serving platter alongside the prepared bagels.
Add small mounds of capers and sliced red onion to the platter.
Garnish with fresh dill and lemon wedges.
Serve immediately and let guests customize their plates with desired toppings.
cheapTips: Buy bagels from day-old bakery sections for 50% off.
Use smoked salmon trim (less expensive than lox slices) for similar flavor.

recipes.name: Florentine Omelette
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together eggs with salt, pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg in a bowl until fully combined.
Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat and sauté minced onion and garlic for 1 minute.
Add spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes; season lightly with salt and pepper, then set aside.
Add remaining tablespoon of butter to the skillet over medium-high heat and let it foam.
Pour in the whisked eggs and let them set for 2-3 minutes without stirring until edges begin to firm up.
Gently push cooked egg toward the center while tilting the pan to allow uncooked egg to flow to the edges.
When the top is still slightly wet, arrange the wilted spinach and cheese on one half of the omelette.
Fold the omelette in half over the filling and slide onto a serving plate.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk from warehouse stores like Costco for 30% savings.
Use sharp cheddar instead of gruyere for a similar taste at lower cost.

recipes.name: Burrata and Heirloom Tomato Salad
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Arrange sliced heirloom tomatoes on a serving platter, slightly overlapping the slices.
Gently tear each burrata ball in half to expose the creamy center and place on top of the tomatoes.
Distribute torn fresh basil leaves throughout the platter.
Whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, minced garlic (if using), salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Drizzle the dressing evenly over the tomatoes and burrata.
Finish with an extra pinch of fleur de sel and cracked black pepper.
Serve immediately at room temperature for best flavor.
cheapTips: Buy burrata from Trader Joe's or Costco for better prices than specialty markets.
Make this in summer when local heirloom tomatoes are in season and less expensive.

recipes.name: Tartine
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Lightly toast the bread slices until golden and crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Spread 1 tablespoon butter generously across each warm slice of toast.
Top each slice with 1 tablespoon of jam or preserves, spreading to distribute evenly.
Drizzle with honey if desired and serve immediately while still warm.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand jam instead of premium brands for 40% savings.
Use day-old bread from the bakery section for half the price.

recipes.name: Crostini al Tartufo
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and arrange baguette slices on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Brush both sides of each slice lightly with extra virgin olive oil.
Bake until golden and crispy, about 8 minutes, turning halfway through.
While still warm, rub each crostini lightly with the cut side of a garlic clove.
Spread 1 tablespoon of ricotta cheese on each warm crostini.
Drizzle with a small amount of truffle oil over the ricotta.
Sprinkle with fleur de sel, black pepper, and fresh thyme if desired, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip authentic truffle oil and use garlic-infused oil mixed with a drop of balsamic vinegar for 70% cost savings.
Use store-brand ricotta or even cream cheese as an alternative to save money.

recipes.name: KFC Biscuit
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 475°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Cut cold butter into small cubes and work into flour mixture with your fingertips until it resembles coarse breadcrumbs.
Pour in buttermilk and gently fold until a shaggy dough just comes together without overworking.
Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and gently pat to 0.75-inch thickness.
Cut out biscuits using a 2.5-inch round cutter and place on prepared baking sheet.
Brush tops with melted butter and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
Remove from oven and brush with additional melted butter while still warm.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand buttermilk and butter in bulk
Use a drinking glass to cut biscuits if you don't have a cutter

recipes.name: Popeyes Biscuit
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a mixing bowl.
Cut cold butter into cubes and blend into flour until mixture resembles coarse meal with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
Add buttermilk slowly, stirring gently until dough just comes together.
Turn dough onto a floured surface and fold gently 4-5 times, then pat to 1-inch thickness.
Cut biscuits with a floured 2.75-inch round cutter and place on baking sheet.
Brush generously with melted butter and bake for 13-16 minutes until golden.
Brush with more butter immediately after removing from oven.
cheapTips: Make extra and freeze for quick reheating
Substitute half the butter with shortening for flakier results

recipes.name: Dunkin' Boston Cream Donut
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pot to 350°F for frying.
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk together egg and milk, then combine with dry ingredients until smooth batter forms.
Transfer batter to a piping bag and carefully pipe 3-inch rings directly into hot oil, frying 1-2 minutes per side until golden.
Remove donuts with a slotted spoon and cool on paper towels.
Heat chocolate chips with heavy cream over low heat until smooth, then cool slightly.
Fill cooled donuts with vanilla pudding using a piping bag inserted into the side.
Dip the top of each donut into chocolate glaze and let set on a wire rack.
cheapTips: Use instant vanilla pudding mix instead of fresh
Buy chocolate chips on sale and store long-term

recipes.name: Taco Bell Breakfast Crunchwrap
recipes.description: Mexican-American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook frozen hash browns in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, then set aside.
Brown sausage patties in the same skillet and set aside.
Scramble eggs in butter with salt and pepper until fully cooked.
Lay out a flour tortilla and spread nacho cheese sauce in the center.
Layer ingredients in the center: eggs, sausage, hash browns, and cheese.
Fold the four corners of the tortilla toward the center to create a square, then flip seam-side down.
Heat a skillet or griddle and cook the wrapped burrito for 2-3 minutes per side until the tortilla is crispy and golden.
Cut diagonally and serve immediately with salsa or additional cheese sauce.
cheapTips: Buy generic frozen hash browns and sausage patties
Make multiple and wrap in foil for meal prep

recipes.name: Chipotle Barbacoa Burrito
recipes.description: Mexican-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Sear chuck roast in hot oil on all sides in a heavy pot until browned.
Blend chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, vinegar, cumin, salt, and pepper into a paste.
Coat the seared roast with the chipotle paste, then add beef broth to the pot.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 1.5 hours until meat shreds easily with a fork.
Shred the cooked meat with two forks, mixing back into the braising liquid.
Warm the cooked rice and heat the drained black beans separately.
Warm each tortilla over a flame or in a skillet to make it pliable.
Layer each tortilla with rice, beans, barbacoa meat, cheese, and salsa, then roll tightly.
cheapTips: Buy chuck roast on sale and freeze until needed
Use canned beans instead of cooking dried

recipes.name: Loaded Nachos
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Drain excess fat and season beef with salt, pepper, and taco seasoning.
Spread tortilla chips on a large oven-safe plate or shallow baking dish.
Distribute cooked beef over the chips, then sprinkle cheese evenly across the top.
Broil on high for 3-4 minutes until cheese is fully melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and top with jalapeños, olives, green onions, and a drizzle of salsa.
Serve immediately with sour cream on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand tortilla chips and ground beef on sale
Use pre-shredded cheese to save prep time

recipes.name: Kimchi Fries
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin matchstick fries and soak in cold water for 30 minutes to remove starch.
Heat oil in a heavy pot to 325°F and fry soaked fries for 5 minutes until light golden.
Increase heat to 375°F and fry again for 2-3 minutes until crispy and golden brown.
Drain fries on paper towels and season lightly with salt.
Mix mayonnaise with gochujang and kimchi juice to make a spicy mayo sauce.
Toss hot fries with chopped kimchi in a bowl.
Transfer to a serving plate and drizzle with gochujang mayo.
Top with green onions and sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Buy kimchi at an Asian market for better price than mainstream stores
Use store-bought gochujang mayo to save time

recipes.name: Truffle Fries
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a heavy pot to 325°F and fry fries for 4-5 minutes until just cooked through.
Increase heat to 375°F and fry again for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain fries well on paper towels and season immediately with salt.
Toss hot fries in a bowl with truffle oil, minced garlic, and black pepper.
Transfer to a serving dish and top generously with grated parmesan cheese.
Garnish with fresh chopped parsley and serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Use regular olive oil infused with garlic if truffle oil is too expensive
Buy pre-grated parmesan to save prep time

recipes.name: Disco Fries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook frozen french fries according to package directions until crispy and golden.
While fries cook, warm gravy in a saucepan over medium heat.
Transfer hot cooked fries to a serving dish and season with salt and pepper.
Pour hot gravy over the fries evenly.
Top immediately with cold or warm mozzarella cheese curds (or shredded cheese).
Serve immediately while fries and gravy are still hot and cheese begins to melt slightly.
cheapTips: Use frozen fries and canned/packet gravy to minimize cost and prep
Substitute shredded cheddar for mozzarella if curds unavailable

recipes.name: Carne Asada Fries
recipes.description: Mexican-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix lime juice, olive oil, minced garlic, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl for marinade.
Marinate flank steak in the mixture for at least 15 minutes (or up to 4 hours).
Heat a skillet or grill to high heat and cook steak 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Let steak rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
Cook frozen french fries according to package directions until crispy.
Spread hot fries on a platter and top with sliced carne asada meat.
Dollop with guacamole and scatter pico de gallo, cotija cheese, and cilantro over the top.
Serve immediately while fries and meat are still hot.
cheapTips: Buy flank steak on sale and freeze until needed
Use store-bought salsa instead of fresh pico de gallo to save time

recipes.name: Smashburger Fries
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin fries, soak in cold water for 30 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Form two thin beef patties and place in skillet, immediately smash with a spatula for 30 seconds until flat.
Cook for 2 minutes without moving, flip, add cheese, and cook 1 more minute until melted.
Fry potatoes in batches until golden and crispy, about 8-10 minutes, salting immediately after.
Toast buns lightly and build burgers with lettuce, tomato, and patties.
Serve burgers with fries on the side, seasoned with salt and pepper.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze; use store-brand cheese
Make fries from scratch instead of frozen to save 50%

recipes.name: Loaded Waffle Fries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Spread waffle fries in a single layer on the baking sheet.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden and crispy, shaking halfway through.
Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle cheese and bacon bits over hot fries.
Return to oven for 2 minutes until cheese melts.
Transfer to a serving plate and top with dollops of sour cream and chopped chives.
Season with salt and pepper, serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip bacon bits and use crumbled fried bacon or skip entirely to save $1
Use store-brand frozen fries and cheese

recipes.name: Korean Corn Cheese Fries
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake frozen fries according to package directions until crispy and golden.
In a small skillet, melt butter over medium heat and add corn kernels, stirring for 3 minutes.
Mix mayonnaise with garlic powder in a bowl.
Transfer hot fries to a serving plate and top with the cooked corn.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese generously over the fries and corn.
Drizzle mayo-garlic mixture over the top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve hot while cheese is still melting.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn you already have or canned corn, drained
Buy block mozzarella and shred yourself instead of pre-shredded

recipes.name: Poutine Gravy
recipes.description: Canadian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake fries according to package directions until golden and crispy.
Heat beef broth in a saucepan over medium heat and whisk in butter.
Mix cornstarch with water to form a slurry and slowly whisk into the hot broth.
Simmer for 3-5 minutes, stirring constantly, until gravy thickens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Arrange hot fries in a serving dish and top with cheese curds.
Pour hot gravy over the fries and cheese curds immediately and serve.
cheapTips: Use chicken broth instead of beef broth to save 40 cents
Substitute mozzarella cheese curds if fresh curds unavailable

recipes.name: Nachos al Pastor
recipes.description: Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from dried chilies, toast in a dry skillet for 1 minute, then soak in hot water for 15 minutes.
Blend soaked chilies with 0.5 cup soaking liquid, garlic, and vinegar to make a paste.
Coat pork slices in the chili paste and let marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook pork slices until browned and crispy, about 8-10 minutes.
In the final 2 minutes of cooking, add pineapple and onion to warm through.
Arrange tortilla chips on a plate, top with al pastor pork mixture and pineapple, then sprinkle cotija cheese.
Garnish with cilantro and squeeze lime juice over everything, serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze; use canned pineapple if fresh unavailable
Skip cotija and use queso fresco or shredded mozzarella instead

recipes.name: Birria Fries
recipes.description: Mexican-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried chilies in a dry skillet for 1 minute, remove seeds, and soak in hot water for 20 minutes.
Blend softened chilies with 1 cup soaking liquid, tomato paste, vinegar, and cumin to create sauce.
Season beef chuck with salt and pepper, sear in a hot skillet until browned on all sides.
Place beef in a slow cooker with beef broth and pour chili sauce over top, cook on low for 6-8 hours until tender.
Shred beef directly in the cooking liquid, this is your birria consomé.
Bake fries according to package directions until golden and crispy.
Top hot fries with shredded birria beef, melted cheese, diced onion, and cilantro, serve with a cup of consomé on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Make birria in bulk and freeze portions to amortize slow cooker time
Use a Dutch oven in the oven instead of a slow cooker at 325°F for 3-4 hours

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Nachos
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm pulled pork in a saucepan over medium heat and stir in BBQ sauce until combined.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Spread tortilla chips on a baking sheet and top evenly with half the shredded cheese.
Bake for 4-5 minutes until cheese begins to melt.
Remove from oven and top with BBQ pork, black beans, remaining cheese, and jalapeños.
Return to oven for 3-4 minutes until cheese fully melts.
Serve immediately topped with sour cream, green onions, and remaining jalapeños.
cheapTips: Buy pre-cooked pulled pork from the grocery store deli to save time
Use store-brand canned black beans instead of fresh

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Nachos
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Toss shredded chicken with buffalo sauce in a bowl until fully coated.
Spread tortilla chips on a baking sheet and sprinkle half the cheddar cheese over them.
Top with buffalo chicken mixture and remaining cheddar cheese.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until cheese melts completely.
Remove from oven and drizzle with ranch dressing.
Top with blue cheese crumbles, diced celery, and green onions, serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip blue cheese crumbles and use an extra dollop of ranch to save $1.50
Buy chicken already shredded from the rotisserie counter

recipes.name: Loaded BBQ Fries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake frozen fries according to package directions until golden and crispy.
Warm cooked beef in a saucepan with BBQ sauce over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Transfer hot fries to a serving plate and sprinkle cheddar cheese over them.
Top with warm BBQ beef mixture and crispy fried onions.
Dollop sour cream on top and sprinkle with fresh chives.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately while everything is hot.
cheapTips: Use canned or leftover cooked beef from another meal instead of buying fresh
Skip fried onions and use raw onions to save 60 cents

recipes.name: Jojo Potatoes
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut russet potatoes into thick wedges, leaving skin on, and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a large heavy pot or Dutch oven to 350°F, checking temperature with a thermometer.
Working in batches, fry potato wedges for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and tender inside.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Mix garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Toss warm jojos in the spice mix while still hot and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and parsley.
Serve immediately with ketchup or ranch dip.
cheapTips: Buy russet potatoes in bulk when on sale and store in a cool dark place
Reuse frying oil 2-3 times by straining through cheesecloth

recipes.name: Loaded Steak Fries
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 0.25-inch sticks and soak in cold water for 15 minutes.
Pat potatoes dry thoroughly with paper towels.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or Dutch oven.
Fry potatoes in batches for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Transfer fries to serving plates and top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Drizzle sour cream over fries and sprinkle with bacon bits and chopped green onions.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand bacon bits instead of premium brands to save 30%
Use regular cheddar instead of aged varieties

recipes.name: Crab Nachos
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Spread tortilla chips on a large baking sheet.
Scatter crab meat evenly over chips and top with monterey jack cheese.
Sprinkle jalapeños over the cheese layer.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and dollop sour cream over the nachos.
Top with diced avocado, halved cherry tomatoes, cilantro, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute canned crab meat for fresh to cut costs in half
Buy pre-shredded cheese in bulk

recipes.name: Carnitas Nachos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into 2-inch cubes and place in a large pot with lard, salt, garlic, and oregano.
Cook on medium-low heat uncovered for 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until pork is very tender and fat is rendered.
Increase heat to medium-high and cook for 30 more minutes, stirring frequently, until edges are crispy and golden.
Drain carnitas on paper towels and shred into bite-sized pieces.
Preheat oven to 375°F and arrange tortilla chips on a baking sheet.
Layer chips with shredded carnitas and oaxaca cheese.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until cheese is melted.
Top with pickled jalapeños, diced onion, cilantro, and lime juice before serving.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze; it's cheapest cut for carnitas
Make full batch and refrigerate extra for tacos or burritos later

recipes.name: Loaded Cajun Fries
recipes.description: Cajun snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into fries and soak in cold water for 15 minutes.
Slice andouille sausage into 0.25-inch rounds and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes; set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté diced bell peppers and onion until softened, about 4 minutes.
Pat potatoes dry and heat oil to 350°F.
Fry potatoes in batches for 12-15 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain fries on paper towels and season with cajun seasoning and salt.
Top fries with cooked sausage, peppers, onions, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular breakfast sausage instead of andouille to save $2 per serving
Buy frozen diced peppers and onions to save prep time and money

recipes.name: Korean Bulgogi Fries
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Add sliced beef and marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Cut potatoes into fries, soak in cold water for 15 minutes, and pat dry.
Heat 2 cups oil to 350°F and fry potatoes in batches for 12-15 minutes until golden; drain on paper towels.
Heat a large skillet over high heat and cook marinated beef, stirring constantly, for 4-5 minutes until cooked through.
Transfer fries to a serving plate and top with cooked bulgogi beef.
Drizzle with remaining marinade and garnish with sesame seeds and chopped green onions.
Serve immediately with extra sesame seeds on the side.
cheapTips: Use beef eye of round instead of sirloin for 40% cost savings
Buy pre-minced garlic and ginger to save time

recipes.name: Loaded Breakfast Fries
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet until crispy, drain on paper towels, and crumble.
Cut potatoes into fries, soak in cold water for 15 minutes, and pat dry.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry potatoes in batches for 12-15 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain fries on paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
In the same bacon skillet, melt butter and scramble eggs over medium heat until fluffy, about 4 minutes.
Transfer fries to serving plates and top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Spoon scrambled eggs over the cheese and sprinkle with crumbled bacon and fresh chives.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand bacon instead of premium brands to save $1.50
Make fries ahead and reheat in oven while cooking eggs

recipes.name: Barbacoa Nachos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place beef chuck roast in a slow cooker with beef broth, apple cider vinegar, cumin, and oregano.
Cook on low for 6 hours or high for 4 hours until meat shreds easily with a fork.
Remove beef from slow cooker and shred using two forks.
Preheat oven to 375°F and arrange tortilla chips on a baking sheet.
Layer chips with shredded barbacoa and oaxaca cheese.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Top with pickled onions, jalapeños, cilantro, and lime juice.
Serve immediately with extra lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze; it's the cheapest cut for barbacoa
Use store-brand tortilla chips instead of name brands

recipes.name: Loaded Five Guys Fries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thick steak fries and soak in cold water for 15 minutes.
Pat potatoes completely dry with paper towels.
Heat oil to 325°F in a deep pot.
Fry potatoes for 5 minutes, remove, let cool 5 minutes, then fry again for 8-10 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain fries on paper towels and season with salt and cajun seasoning.
Layer fries in a serving container and top with american cheese slices.
Add crumbled hamburger, bacon bits, grilled onions, and a dollop of mayonnaise.
Serve immediately with extra napkins.
cheapTips: Cook ground beef in bulk and freeze in portions to save money
Use store-brand american cheese instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Monte Cristo
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Layer turkey, ham, and swiss cheese between two slices of bread to make two sandwiches.
Whisk together eggs and milk in a shallow bowl.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Dip each sandwich into the egg mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place sandwiches in the hot skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes until golden brown.
Flip sandwiches carefully and cook the other side for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy.
Transfer to a cutting board and dust with powdered sugar.
Cut diagonally and serve with warm strawberry jam for dipping.
cheapTips: Use store-brand deli meats instead of premium brands
Buy day-old bread from the bakery section at 50% off

recipes.name: Hallumi Saganaki
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut halloumi block into 0.5-inch thick slices, approximately 8 slices total.
Place flour in a shallow bowl and coat each cheese slice lightly on both sides.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Carefully place cheese slices in the hot oil and fry for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown and slightly softened.
Remove from oil with a slotted spoon and place on a serving plate lined with paper towels.
Immediately drizzle with honey and squeeze fresh lemon juice over the warm cheese.
Sprinkle with oregano, sea salt, and black pepper.
Serve immediately while still warm and slightly crispy on the outside.
cheapTips: Buy halloumi from warehouse stores like Costco for better pricing
Use bottled lemon juice instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Fairlife Core Power Shake
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour Fairlife Core Power milk into a blender.
Add ice cubes.
Crumble vanilla wafer cookies and add to blender.
Blend on medium speed for 30 seconds.
Serve immediately in a glass.
cheapTips: Purchase multi-packs at warehouse clubs for per-unit savings
Skip add-ins and drink straight from bottle for zero prep cost

recipes.name: EAS AdvantEdge Carb Control Shake
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add water and ice cubes to blender.
Pour one scoop of EAS AdvantEdge powder.
Sprinkle cocoa powder for enhanced chocolate flavor.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until smooth.
Pour into glass and enjoy immediately.
cheapTips: Compare prices at multiple retailers for powder bulk deals
Use tap water instead of buying bottled water

recipes.name: Almased Wellness Shake
recipes.description: German breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat water to warm temperature without boiling.
Pour warm water into blender.
Add Almased powder and honey.
Add ground flaxseed for nutrition.
Blend on medium for 45 seconds until smooth and frothy.
Pour into mug and consume warm.
cheapTips: Buy honey in bulk containers to reduce cost
Purchase flaxseed from bulk sections at natural food stores

recipes.name: Herbalife Nutrition Shake
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add milk and ice cubes to blender.
Measure two scoops of Herbalife Formula 1 powder.
Add fresh strawberry pieces.
Blend on high speed for 60 seconds until smooth.
Pour into glass and drink immediately while cold.
cheapTips: Buy seasonal strawberries when cheaper and freeze for later use
Purchase the largest available container of shake mix for unit savings

recipes.name: Lobster Roll Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain the canned lobster meat and flake it into a bowl.
Mix in mayonnaise, diced celery, lemon juice, salt, and pepper until combined.
Butter the outside of each roll and place on a skillet over medium heat.
Toast the rolls for 2-3 minutes until golden brown on the outside.
Open the toasted rolls and divide the lobster mixture between them.
Top each with a slice of cheddar cheese.
Close the rolls and return to the skillet for 2 minutes until the cheese melts.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Use canned lobster instead of fresh to save significantly
Buy store-brand mayo and butter for lower costs

recipes.name: Bacon and Cheddar Melt
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8 minutes.
Transfer bacon to a paper towel to drain.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Heat the skillet over medium heat and place two bread slices buttered-side down.
Top each bread slice with a cheddar cheese slice and 3 bacon pieces.
Top with remaining bread slices, buttered-side up.
Cook for 3 minutes until golden, then flip and cook another 2 minutes until the cheese melts.
Serve hot and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand cheddar cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop broccoli florets into small pieces.
Steam broccoli in a pot with 1 inch of water for 5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Drain broccoli and mix with diced onion, salt, and pepper.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and place two bread slices buttered-side down.
Divide broccoli mixture between the two bread slices and top each with 1.5 cheese slices.
Place remaining bread slices on top, buttered-side up, and cook 3 minutes until golden.
Flip and cook another 2 minutes until cheese melts and bread is golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy frozen broccoli for lower cost and longer shelf life
Use generic store-brand cheese slices

recipes.name: Apple Brie Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the apple thinly and remove the seeds.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and place two bread slices buttered-side down.
Layer half the brie cheese on each bread slice, then divide apple slices evenly between them.
Top with remaining brie and remaining bread slices, buttered-side up.
Cook for 3 minutes until the bottom is golden brown.
Carefully flip and cook another 2-3 minutes until cheese is melted and bread is golden.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy brie from the deli counter loose rather than pre-packaged
Use any apple variety on sale instead of Granny Smith

recipes.name: Burrata and Prosciutto Toast
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brush bread slices with olive oil on both sides.
Toast bread in a skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Arrange toasted bread on a serving plate.
Tear prosciutto into pieces and scatter over each toast.
Cut burrata in half and place one half on each toast.
Arrange halved cherry tomatoes around the burrata.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then season with salt and pepper.
Top with fresh basil and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy burrata from specialty or Italian markets for better prices
Use store-brand olive oil for toasting

recipes.name: Protein Waffles
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat a waffle iron according to manufacturer's instructions.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, protein powder, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, beat eggs, milk, honey, and melted butter until combined.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined with some lumps remaining.
Lightly grease the waffle iron with cooking spray.
Pour 1/4 cup batter into the center of the waffle iron.
Close the iron and cook for 3-4 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Remove waffles and serve with your choice of toppings such as maple syrup, berries, or yogurt.
cheapTips: Buy protein powder in bulk to reduce per-serving cost
Make a double batch and freeze extras for quick future breakfasts

recipes.name: Amazing Grass Green Superfood Shake
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour coconut water into blender with green superfood powder.
Add frozen pineapple and Greek yogurt.
Add fresh lime juice.
Add ice and blend on high for 60 seconds until completely smooth.
Serve immediately in a tall glass.
cheapTips: Buy frozen pineapple at discount stores like Aldi for 30% savings
Make yogurt at home using milk cultures to reduce dairy costs

recipes.name: Shoyu Ramen
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add minced garlic and ginger, simmer for 5 minutes to infuse flavors.
Stir in soy sauce and mirin, taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
In a separate pot, boil water and cook ramen noodles according to package directions, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain cooked noodles and divide between two bowls.
Pour hot broth over noodles, dividing evenly between bowls.
Top each bowl with sliced chicken, one soft-boiled egg, green onions, and nori strips.
Serve immediately while broth is steaming hot.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from grocery store instead of buying and cooking separate breast
Buy ramen noodles in bulk packages (24-pack) at Asian markets for half the price

recipes.name: Pan con Queso
recipes.description: Spanish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the bread in half lengthwise and butter each cut side lightly.
Slice the manchego cheese into thin pieces and distribute evenly over both bread halves.
Heat a skillet or griddle over medium heat and place the bread halves cut-side down.
Toast until the cheese melts and the bread is golden and crispy, about 4-5 minutes.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper, slice into portions, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use white cheddar instead of manchego for savings
Buy day-old bread from the bakery section

recipes.name: Open-faced Danish Cheese Toast
recipes.description: Danish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the rye bread slices until golden brown.
Butter each slice while still warm.
Slice the havarti cheese and layer on top of each bread slice.
Place under the broiler for 3-4 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Top with fresh tomato slices and sprinkle with fresh dill, salt, and pepper.
Serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Substitute havarti with Swiss or provolone cheese
Use dried dill if fresh is unavailable

recipes.name: Cubano Pressed Sandwich
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the bread in half horizontally and spread mustard on the inside of both halves.
Layer roasted pork, ham, Swiss cheese, and pickles on the bottom half.
Close the sandwich with the top half.
Butter the outside of both the top and bottom of the sandwich generously.
Heat a skillet or panini press over medium heat and cook the sandwich for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Cut diagonally and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use grocery store rotisserie chicken instead of roasted pork
Buy ham on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan Melt
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness and season with salt and pepper.
Mix breadcrumbs and parmesan in one bowl and beat egg in another.
Dip chicken in egg, then coat with breadcrumb mixture.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden.
Slice bread in half and toast lightly, then spread marinara sauce on both halves.
Place cooked chicken on bottom bread half and top with mozzarella and more sauce.
Broil for 3-4 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Top with bread lid and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy chicken on sale and freeze
Use store-brand marinara sauce

recipes.name: Steak and Cheese Melt
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat with 1 tablespoon butter.
Sauté diced onions and bell peppers until softened, about 5 minutes, then set aside.
Add steak to the skillet and cook 3-4 minutes until browned, season with salt and pepper.
Return vegetables to the skillet with the steak and top with provolone cheese slices.
Cover and cook until cheese melts, about 1-2 minutes.
Butter and toast the hoagie rolls, then spread mayonnaise on each.
Divide the steak and cheese mixture between the two rolls and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use chuck steak or sirloin tips instead of premium cuts
Buy onions in bulk

recipes.name: Raclette Melt
recipes.description: Swiss dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the raclette cheese into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Warm the boiled potatoes in a pot until heated through.
Toast the bread slices lightly and place on a serving board.
Heat a skillet or raclette pan over medium-high heat and place cheese slices on it.
Once the cheese begins to melt and bubble at the edges, scrape it onto the toasted bread using a wooden spatula or knife.
Arrange potatoes, ham, and pickles on the same board.
Repeat the melting and scraping process until all cheese is used, garnishing with black pepper.
cheapTips: Substitute raclette with fontina or gruyère cheese
Use russet potatoes which are cheaper than specialty varieties

recipes.name: Fondue Bread Bowl
recipes.description: Swiss dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut the top off the bread loaf and scoop out the inside, leaving a 1-inch shell to create a bowl.
Dice the scooped bread into bite-sized cubes and set aside.
Shred both cheeses and toss together with cornstarch.
Rub the inside of a fondue pot or heavy pot with the cut garlic clove.
Pour wine into the pot and heat over medium until small bubbles form.
Gradually add cheese mixture, stirring constantly in a figure-eight pattern until smooth.
Season with black pepper and a pinch of nutmeg, then place the bread bowl on the table with bread cubes for dipping.
cheapTips: Use Swiss cheese blend instead of separate gruyère and emmental
Replace wine with chicken broth

recipes.name: Cacio e Pepe Toast
recipes.description: Italian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
Butter each slice while still warm.
Coarsely grate the pecorino romano cheese over all slices.
Sprinkle generously with freshly ground black pepper.
Return to the toaster oven or broiler for 1-2 minutes until cheese begins to melt.
Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use Parmesan cheese if pecorino is unavailable
Buy pre-grated cheese to save prep time

recipes.name: Kaas Kroket
recipes.description: Dutch snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat and whisk in flour to make a roux.
Slowly add milk while whisking constantly until a thick sauce forms, about 3 minutes.
Dice the cheese and stir into the sauce until melted, then season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Spread the mixture on a plate and refrigerate for at least 2 hours until firm.
Shape the cooled mixture into cylindrical croquettes about 3 inches long.
Beat the egg in one bowl and place breadcrumbs in another, then coat each croquette in egg and breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a deep pan or fryer to 350°F and fry croquettes 2-3 minutes until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with mustard or mayonnaise.
cheapTips: Use cheddar cheese instead of gouda for savings
Make ahead and freeze before frying

recipes.name: Jambon de Paris Gratinée
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make a béchamel sauce by melting butter in a saucepan and whisking in flour, then slowly adding milk and stirring until thick.
Stir in Dijon mustard and season with salt and white pepper.
Toast the bread slices lightly and arrange them in a buttered baking dish.
Top each bread slice with a folded ham slice.
Pour the béchamel sauce evenly over the ham and bread.
Grate the cheese over the top and bake at 425°F for 12-15 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Broil for 1-2 minutes if additional browning is desired, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular deli ham instead of Paris ham
Substitute gruyère with cheddar cheese

recipes.name: Bulgogi Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice chicken breasts thinly against the grain.
Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and rice vinegar in a bowl.
Add chicken to the marinade and let sit for 15 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken with marinade for 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken on sale and freeze until needed
Use regular soy sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Seasoned Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Beat 1 egg in a bowl and pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels.
Dip chicken in egg, then coat thoroughly in mixture of flour, cornstarch, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or Dutch oven.
Carefully place chicken pieces in hot oil and fry for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken and drain on paper towels before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for better value
Reuse frying oil for multiple batches

recipes.name: Spicy Basket Chicken
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized cubes and pat dry.
Mix flour, cornstarch, gochugaru, garlic powder, and salt in a shallow bowl.
Coat chicken pieces in the spiced flour mixture.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken pieces for 8-10 minutes until golden and crispy.
Mix gochujang, honey, and soy sauce in a bowl and toss fried chicken with the sauce before serving.
cheapTips: Make your own gochugaru blend with chili powder and paprika
Skip expensive specialty spice blends and use basic seasonings

recipes.name: Korean Fried Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and separate into flats and drumettes.
Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Dredge wings in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry wings in batches for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
Combine soy sauce and honey, toss fried wings in the glaze, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy chicken wings on sale and freeze in advance
Use simple soy sauce glaze instead of multiple specialty sauces

recipes.name: Dakgangjeong with Peanuts
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and pat dry.
Mix flour and cornstarch, then coat chicken pieces evenly.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken for 8-10 minutes until golden brown.
In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, and garlic over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Toss fried chicken with the glaze, peanuts, and sesame seeds, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy unsalted roasted peanuts in bulk and store in an airtight container
Make glaze with basic pantry staples instead of specialty sauces

recipes.name: Gyeran Mari Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breast thin and cut into bite-sized pieces, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Quickly pan-fry chicken pieces in oil until cooked through, then set aside.
Beat eggs thoroughly and strain through a fine sieve for a smooth texture.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in a thin layer of beaten egg, letting it just set.
Place a line of cooked chicken in the center of each egg layer and roll tightly, then slice into pinwheels and arrange on a plate.
Mix soy sauce and rice vinegar for a light dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Use regular eggs instead of expensive pastured varieties
Skip specialty soy sauces and use standard brands

recipes.name: Sweet and Spicy Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and pat completely dry.
Combine flour, cornstarch, and salt, then coat chicken pieces thoroughly.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken for 8-10 minutes until golden and crispy.
In a saucepan, whisk together gochujang, honey, soy sauce, and sesame oil over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Toss hot fried chicken in the sweet and spicy glaze and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale and freeze for later use
Make large batches and freeze extras for quick meals

recipes.name: Double Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, pepper, and garlic powder in a bowl.
Coat chicken thighs thoroughly in the flour mixture and let rest for 5 minutes.
Heat oil to 320°F and fry chicken for 10 minutes until light golden, then remove and drain.
Increase oil temperature to 350°F and fry chicken again for 3-4 minutes until deeply golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately for maximum crispness.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and portion them yourself
Save and strain oil between batches to reduce cooking oil costs

recipes.name: Korean Fried Chicken Thighs
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken thighs dry and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Mix flour, potato starch, salt, and pepper in a shallow dish.
Coat chicken thighs completely in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken for 14-16 minutes until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Drain on paper towels, brush with glaze made from soy sauce and honey, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Use potato starch or cornstarch interchangeably to save money
Buy chicken thighs in bulk and freeze individual portions

recipes.name: Crispy Seasoned Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix flour, cornstarch, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Coat chicken pieces evenly in the seasoned flour mixture.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken for 8-10 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and garnish with green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale and freeze to stock pantry
Mix your own seasoning blend instead of buying pre-mixed

recipes.name: Baked Cheese Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Butterfly each chicken breast horizontally and pound flat to 1/2-inch thickness.
Mix mayonnaise, minced garlic, soy sauce, and honey in a bowl.
Beat eggs in a shallow bowl and place panko breadcrumbs in another bowl.
Spread mayo mixture on chicken, top with mozzarella, fold and secure with toothpicks.
Dip folded chicken in egg, then coat with panko breadcrumbs.
Place on greased baking sheet and bake for 22-25 minutes until golden and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand mayonnaise and cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Korean Soy Marinated Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil in a large bowl.
Add chicken thighs and coat thoroughly with marinade.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Transfer chicken and marinade to a baking dish.
Bake uncovered for 45-50 minutes until skin is caramelized and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Garnish with sliced scallions and sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Chicken thighs are cheaper than breasts and more flavorful
Make large batches and freeze portions for meal prep

recipes.name: Marinara
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, basil, oregano, salt, pepper, and sugar.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions in salted boiling water.
Drain pasta and toss with marinara sauce.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed before serving.
cheapTips: Buy canned tomatoes in bulk when on sale
Use dried herbs instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Alfredo
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook fettuccine in salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to low and gradually stir in grated parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Drain pasta and toss with alfredo sauce, adding pasta water 1-2 tablespoons at a time to reach desired consistency.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make your own sauce instead of using jarred versions
Buy parmesan blocks and grate fresh for better flavor and value

recipes.name: Arabiata
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water according to package directions.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes, stirring constantly for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Toss pasta with sauce, adding pasta water as needed to reach desired consistency, garnish with parsley and parmesan, and serve.
cheapTips: Red pepper flakes last a long time, making this inexpensive to make repeatedly
Buy pasta in bulk when discounted

recipes.name: Drunken Noodles
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice noodles according to package directions, then drain and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add minced garlic and sliced chili peppers, stir-frying for 30 seconds.
Add ground chicken and stir-fry until cooked through, breaking it apart, about 5-6 minutes.
Add diced bell pepper and continue cooking for 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, fish sauce, and lime juice.
Add cooked noodles to the wok along with the sauce mixture and toss everything together for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and fold in fresh basil leaves just before serving.
cheapTips: Ground chicken is cheaper than whole chicken breasts
Buy fresh basil from the farmer's market or grow your own

recipes.name: Macaroni and Cheese
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cook macaroni in salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than package directions, then drain.
Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat and whisk in flour to create a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk, stirring constantly until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in shredded cheddar cheese until melted and smooth, then season with salt and pepper.
Fold cooked macaroni into the cheese sauce.
Transfer to a greased 9x13 baking dish.
Mix panko breadcrumbs with parmesan cheese and sprinkle over top, then bake for 15-18 minutes until golden and bubbly.
cheapTips: Buy block cheddar cheese and shred it yourself to save 30-40%
Make in bulk and freeze individual portions for quick meals

recipes.name: Sesame Noodles
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook noodles according to package directions in salted boiling water, then drain and rinse with cold water.
In a small bowl, whisk together sesame paste, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and minced garlic until smooth.
In a large bowl, toss cooked noodles with the sesame sauce until evenly coated.
Let cool to room temperature, about 5 minutes.
Divide noodles among serving bowls.
Top each bowl with sliced green onions, julienned cucumber, and sesame seeds.
Serve cold or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy sesame paste in Asian markets for 50% less than specialty stores
Substitute peanut butter if sesame paste is unavailable

recipes.name: Ahi Tuna Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, sriracha, minced ginger, and minced garlic.
Add cubed ahi tuna to the marinade and gently toss to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for 15-20 minutes to marinate.
Divide cooked sushi rice between two bowls.
Top rice with marinated ahi tuna and arrange edamame, cucumber slices, and avocado slices around the bowl.
Drizzle extra marinade over the bowl.
Garnish with sesame seeds and nori strips.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Ask for sushi-grade tuna trimmings from the fish counter, often 20-30% cheaper
Buy edamame frozen for year-round availability at lower cost

recipes.name: California Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian-Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, combine soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil to make the marinade.
Add cubed salmon to the marinade and gently toss, then refrigerate for 10-15 minutes.
Divide cooked sushi rice between two bowls.
Arrange marinated salmon and chopped imitation crab on top of rice.
Add avocado slices, cucumber slices, and seaweed salad around the bowl.
Drizzle with mayo and extra marinade.
Garnish generously with sesame seeds.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Imitation crab is significantly cheaper than real crab and widely available
Buy salmon on sale and freeze immediately for later use

recipes.name: Korean Spicy Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix gochugaru, soy sauce, sesame oil, minced garlic, brown sugar, and rice vinegar in a bowl to create the sauce.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add chicken pieces and cook until golden and cooked through, about 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour the gochugaru sauce over the chicken and stir well to coat evenly.
Cook for another 3-4 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.
Serve immediately over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken in bulk when on sale and freeze for later use
Use regular chili powder as a gochugaru substitute to save 50%

recipes.name: Cheese Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into 1-inch thick medallions and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Pan-fry chicken for 5-6 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside on a plate.
In the same skillet, melt remaining 1 tbsp butter and sauté minced garlic for 1 minute.
Add soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil to create a glaze, stirring for 1 minute.
Return chicken to skillet, top each piece with shredded mozzarella, and cover with a lid.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until cheese melts completely.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy pre-shredded mozzarella to save prep time and cost
Use American cheese slices instead of mozzarella for a more budget-friendly option

recipes.name: Gochujang Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken thighs dry and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown chicken thighs for 4-5 minutes per side until golden, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, and water in a bowl.
Pour the gochujang mixture into the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic.
Return chicken thighs to the skillet, coating well with sauce.
Reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer for 15-18 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor and lower cost
Make your own gochujang sauce base to reduce specialty ingredient costs

recipes.name: Black Garlic Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into 1-inch cubes and pat dry.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and stir-fry until mostly cooked through, about 6-7 minutes.
Add minced ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in soy sauce, sesame oil, mirin, rice vinegar, and broth.
Add whole black garlic cloves and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer for 10-12 minutes until chicken is fully cooked and sauce reduces.
Adjust seasoning to taste and transfer to a serving bowl.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve over rice.
cheapTips: Regular garlic can substitute for black garlic in a pinch, reducing cost significantly
Buy black garlic from Asian markets instead of specialty stores for better pricing

recipes.name: Jjajang Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized chunks and pat dry.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken pieces until golden and cooked through, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Push chicken to the side and add sesame oil and minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute.
Mix jjajang sauce with water and cornstarch in a small bowl until smooth.
Pour the jjajang mixture over chicken and add soy sauce and brown sugar.
Stir constantly for 4-5 minutes until sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve hot over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Make your own black bean sauce with black beans and cornstarch instead of buying jjajang
Buy jjajang from Korean markets in bulk to save money on specialty ingredients

recipes.name: Crimson Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into 1-inch cubes.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until mostly golden, about 8 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Mix ketchup, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, and soy sauce in a bowl.
Pour the crimson sauce over chicken and stir well to coat evenly.
Reduce heat to medium and cook for 3-4 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is fully cooked.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately over rice or with vegetables.
cheapTips: Ketchup makes this sauce budget-friendly compared to other Korean sauces
Skip the sesame seeds garnish if needed to reduce cost further

recipes.name: Snow Cheese Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into 1-inch thick medallions.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Pan-fry chicken for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, melt remaining 1 tbsp butter and sauté garlic for 1 minute.
Add cream cheese, breaking it apart as it melts, and stir constantly.
Add honey, soy sauce, and white pepper, stirring until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
Return chicken to skillet and top each piece with shredded mozzarella.
Cover with a lid and cook for 3-4 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand cream cheese and mozzarella to reduce costs
Use evaporated milk mixed with butter instead of cream cheese for a cheaper cream sauce

recipes.name: Half Half Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and pat dry.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken until mostly golden, about 8 minutes, stirring frequently.
Remove half of the chicken and place on a separate plate.
To the remaining chicken in the skillet, add minced garlic and gochujang, cooking for 2 minutes to make the spicy half.
In another small skillet, melt butter and add minced garlic, cream cheese, soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil for the creamy half.
Return removed chicken to the spicy skillet and mix well.
Plate both the spicy and creamy chicken halves on the same dish to create the half-and-half presentation.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Prep both sauces in advance to speed up the cooking process
Use one skillet to cook chicken and divide between two bowls of sauce to save cleanup

recipes.name: Garlic Soy Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and pat dry.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken until golden and cooked through, about 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add minced garlic and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant and slightly golden.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and water.
Pour the garlic-soy sauce over the chicken and stir well to coat evenly.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until the sauce reduces slightly and coats the chicken.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.
Serve hot over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy minced garlic in bulk from the produce section instead of using jarred garlic
This simple recipe uses pantry staples, making it one of the cheapest Korean chicken dishes

recipes.name: Korean Fried Chicken Boneless
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat boneless chicken thighs dry and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and black pepper in a shallow bowl.
Coat each chicken piece thoroughly in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or pot to 350°F (175°C).
Carefully add floured chicken pieces to hot oil in batches, frying for 5-6 minutes until golden and crispy.
