Transfer cooked chicken to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, honey, and minced garlic over low heat, stirring for 1-2 minutes.
Toss crispy chicken with the soy-honey glaze until well coated.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve immediately over rice or with vegetables.
cheapTips: Reuse frying oil by straining it through cheesecloth after cooling to save on oil costs
Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze them for when you want to make this dish

recipes.name: Miso Ramen
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large pot of water and cook ramen noodles until al dente, then drain and set aside.
In another pot, heat chicken broth over medium heat and add minced garlic and ginger, simmering for 5 minutes.
Dissolve miso paste in a ladle with a small amount of hot broth, then stir into the pot along with soy sauce and mirin.
Add butter and sesame oil to the broth and simmer for 2 minutes.
Divide cooked noodles between two bowls and pour hot miso broth over them.
Top with halved soft-boiled eggs, sliced green onions, bamboo shoots, and any desired protein or vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy instant ramen and upgrade with store-bought broth to save money
Use eggs and canned bamboo shoots instead of premium protein toppings

recipes.name: Shio Ramen
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil and cook ramen noodles according to package directions until tender, then drain.
In a separate pot, heat chicken broth with smashed garlic cloves and minced ginger over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Strain the broth through a fine sieve to remove garlic and ginger solids.
Season the clear broth with salt, soy sauce, and white pepper, tasting and adjusting as needed.
Divide noodles between two bowls and pour hot shio broth over each.
Top with halved soft-boiled eggs, sliced green onions, nori strips, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Use vegetable or chicken broth from a carton to skip making stock
Buy nori sheets in bulk online for significant savings

recipes.name: Tsukemen
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a small pot and sauté minced garlic and ginger until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in sesame oil and season to taste.
Bring a large pot of water to boil and cook ramen noodles until al dente, then drain and rinse with cold water.
Divide noodles between two bowls, arrange halved soft-boiled eggs on top, and place the bowl over a cup of hot dipping broth.
Dip noodles in the warm broth before eating and garnish with sliced green onions.
cheapTips: Use ground turkey instead of pork for a leaner and often cheaper option
Make a larger batch of dipping sauce to use for multiple servings

recipes.name: Tantanmen
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a pot and cook minced garlic and ginger for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add ground pork and brown it completely, breaking it into small pieces, about 5 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Mix tahini and chili oil in a small bowl, then slowly whisk into the simmering broth.
Add soy sauce and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, boil ramen noodles according to package directions until tender, then drain.
Divide cooked noodles between two bowls and pour the spicy sesame broth over them.
Top with halved soft-boiled eggs, sliced green onions, and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Replace tahini with peanut butter mixed with a splash of oil for a similar flavor at lower cost
Use hot sauce instead of specialty chili oil to reduce expenses

recipes.name: Ramen Carbonara
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop bacon into small pieces and cook in a large pan over medium heat until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Remove bacon and set aside, keeping about 1 tablespoon of bacon fat in the pan.
Whisk together eggs and grated parmesan cheese in a small bowl with black pepper.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook ramen noodles until al dente, then drain well.
Add cooked noodles and vegetable broth to the bacon pan over medium-low heat, tossing gently.
Remove pan from heat, quickly pour in the egg-cheese mixture while stirring constantly to avoid scrambling.
Divide between bowls, top with cooked bacon, sliced green onions, and extra black pepper.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale and freeze it to use later
Use a less expensive hard cheese or grated parmesan from a container instead of freshly grated

recipes.name: Mazesoba
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, mirin, sugar, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and minced garlic to make the tare sauce.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook ramen noodles until al dente, then drain thoroughly.
Divide the hot noodles into two bowls.
Pour half the tare sauce over each bowl of noodles.
Toss the noodles vigorously with tongs or chopsticks to coat evenly in the sauce.
Top each bowl with a halved soft-boiled egg, torn nori strips, sliced green onions, and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately while noodles are still warm, mixing again just before eating if desired.
cheapTips: Make a large batch of the tare sauce to store in the fridge for multiple meals
Skip the nori and use extra green onions to save money

recipes.name: Pad Kee Mao
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice chicken breast thinly and cut bell peppers into bite-sized pieces; slice chili peppers into thin rounds.
Cook wide rice noodles according to package directions, drain, and set aside.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until very hot.
Add minced garlic and sliced chilies, stir-frying for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and cook until golden and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add bell peppers and cooked noodles, then pour in soy sauce, fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar.
Toss everything together for 2-3 minutes over high heat.
Tear fresh basil leaves and fold them in just before serving, reserving some for garnish.
cheapTips: Buy chicken on sale and freeze it in portion sizes for future meals
Use dried basil and increase the amount slightly if fresh basil is unavailable or expensive

recipes.name: Yu Po Noodles
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook egg noodles according to package directions until tender, then drain and toss with a small amount of sesame oil.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and ginger, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add pork and cook, stirring constantly and breaking it into small pieces, until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in chili paste or chili oil, soy sauce, and chicken broth.
Add cooked noodles to the pan and toss everything together for 2-3 minutes.
Divide between bowls and top with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Use ground pork instead of shoulder cut for better value
Buy chili paste in bulk and store in the pantry for multiple recipes

recipes.name: Yangnyeom Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized cubes or thin strips.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, minced garlic, minced ginger, sesame oil, and gochugaru to make the yangnyeom sauce.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chicken pieces and cook until golden brown and cooked through, stirring occasionally, about 10-12 minutes.
Pour the yangnyeom sauce over the cooked chicken and toss to coat evenly.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes over high heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and caramelizes slightly.
Transfer to serving plates and garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens and cut your own breasts to save significantly
Substitute regular hot sauce for gochugaru if unavailable

recipes.name: Soy Garlic Chicken
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized chunks or strips.
In a bowl, combine soy sauce, sugar, minced garlic, minced ginger, sesame oil, and rice vinegar to create the marinade.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until the pieces are golden and cooked through, stirring occasionally, about 10-12 minutes.
Pour the soy garlic sauce over the cooked chicken and toss well to coat.
Continue cooking for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the sauce reduces and becomes sticky.
Serve immediately, garnished with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy chicken drumsticks or thighs instead of breasts for better value and richer flavor
Make a larger batch and freeze for quick future meals

recipes.name: Matcha Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk matcha powder with 2 tablespoons hot water until smooth and frothy.
Combine Greek yogurt, almond milk, banana, and matcha mixture in a blender.
Blend until smooth and thick enough to hold a spoon.
Pour mixture into two bowls and arrange granola, blueberries, almonds, and coconut flakes on top.
cheapTips: Buy matcha powder in bulk online for better pricing
Use frozen bananas instead of fresh to reduce waste

recipes.name: Blueberry Acai Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add frozen acai packets, frozen blueberries, almond milk, and banana to a blender.
Blend until thick and creamy, stopping to stir if needed.
Pour the acai mixture into two bowls.
Top each bowl with granola, fresh blueberries, almonds, and a drizzle of honey.
cheapTips: Buy acai in bulk from Costco or Amazon for significant savings
Make your own granola to cut costs in half

recipes.name: Chia Seed Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine Greek yogurt, frozen mango, and coconut milk in a blender.
Blend until smooth and thick.
Pour into two bowls and sprinkle chia seeds evenly over each.
Top with granola, coconut, fresh berries, and a honey drizzle.
cheapTips: Buy chia seeds in bulk from warehouse stores
Use store-brand yogurt instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Açaí Sorbet with Toppings
recipes.description: Brazilian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine frozen acai, almond milk, honey, and frozen banana in a blender.
Blend until thick and creamy, like soft-serve ice cream.
Divide mixture into two bowls immediately, as it melts quickly.
Top with granola, strawberries, banana slices, and coconut flakes.
cheapTips: Use frozen fruit you already have instead of specialty acai sometimes
Buy toppings in bulk and store in airtight containers

recipes.name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add frozen strawberries, frozen banana, Greek yogurt, and almond milk to a blender.
Blend until thick and creamy.
Divide smoothie base evenly into two bowls.
Arrange granola, fresh strawberries, banana slices, and almonds on top.
cheapTips: Buy strawberries and bananas when on sale and freeze yourself
Use store-brand yogurt to save 30-40%

recipes.name: Superfood Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine frozen spinach, blueberries, Greek yogurt, and almond milk in a blender.
Blend until smooth and fully combined, about 1-2 minutes.
Divide into two bowls and sprinkle flax seed evenly over each.
Top with granola, fresh berries, honey drizzle, and chia seeds.
cheapTips: Buy frozen spinach in bulk; it's cheaper than fresh
Mix your own seed blend instead of buying pre-mixed

recipes.name: Acai Sunrise Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend frozen acai, coconut milk, banana, and mango nectar until smooth.
Pour the acai mixture into two bowls.
Arrange granola, pineapple, mango, and coconut flakes decoratively on top.
Drizzle with honey before serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen mango and pineapple instead of fresh to save money
Buy acai in multi-packs at warehouse clubs

recipes.name: Kale Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend chopped kale, frozen mango, Greek yogurt, orange juice, and banana until very smooth.
Divide mixture into two bowls.
Top each bowl with granola, kiwi slices, mango slices, and pumpkin seeds.
cheapTips: Buy kale in season from farmers markets for half the price
Use frozen mango year-round for consistency and savings

recipes.name: Rainbow Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine frozen mixed berries, frozen mango, Greek yogurt, and almond milk in a blender.
Blend until smooth and thick.
Divide into two bowls.
Arrange granola and fresh fruits in colorful rows on top of each bowl for a rainbow effect, finishing with coconut flakes.
cheapTips: Buy mixed frozen berries instead of individual packs
Use whatever fresh fruit is on sale for variety

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend Greek yogurt, frozen banana, peanut butter, almond milk, and honey until smooth.
Divide smoothie between two bowls.
Top with granola, banana slices, chocolate chips, and crushed peanuts.
cheapTips: Buy peanut butter in bulk from warehouse stores for best value
Use store-brand chocolate chips instead of premium

recipes.name: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: Modern Health lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse quinoa and cook according to package directions, about 15 minutes.
Peel and cube sweet potato, toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt and pepper, then roast at 400°F for 15 minutes until tender.
Drain and rinse canned chickpeas, toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil and roast at 400°F for 12 minutes alongside sweet potato until crispy.
Massage kale with 1 tablespoon olive oil and a pinch of salt until softened.
Chop cucumber and halve cherry tomatoes.
Whisk together lemon juice, minced garlic, remaining olive oil, salt and pepper for dressing.
Divide cooked quinoa between bowls and arrange sweet potato, chickpeas, kale, cucumber, and tomatoes on top.
Drizzle with dressing and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy quinoa in bulk for savings
Use frozen sweet potato if fresh is expensive

recipes.name: Berry Blast Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine frozen mixed berries, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and honey in a blender.
Blend until thick and creamy, about 1-2 minutes.
Pour smoothie mixture into two bowls.
Top with granola, fresh blueberries, sliced almonds, and coconut flakes.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy frozen berries in bulk—they're cheaper than fresh year-round
Make your own granola instead of buying

recipes.name: Tropical Acai Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place acai packets, coconut milk, banana, and frozen mango chunks in a blender.
Blend until smooth and thick, about 60-90 seconds.
Divide mixture evenly between two bowls.
Arrange granola, shredded coconut, and fresh pineapple chunks on top of each bowl.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy acai packets in bulk online for cheaper pricing
Use canned pineapple instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Pitaya Power Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine pitaya packets, almond milk, banana, and frozen strawberries in a blender.
Blend until thick and creamy, about 90 seconds.
Divide between two bowls.
Top each bowl with granola, sliced kiwi, chopped almonds, and chia seeds.
Drizzle with honey and serve with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy pitaya in bulk packets when on sale
Substitute regular granola for homemade oats and honey mixture

recipes.name: Green Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Add spinach, frozen banana, frozen pineapple, Greek yogurt, and almond milk to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy, about 90 seconds.
Pour into two bowls.
Top with granola, sliced kiwi, and coconut flakes.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen pineapple instead of fresh for year-round savings
Use store-brand Greek yogurt

recipes.name: Dragonfruit Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine dragonfruit packets, coconut yogurt, coconut milk, and banana in a blender.
Blend until smooth and thick, about 90 seconds.
Pour smoothie base into two bowls.
Arrange granola, raspberries, and mango slices on top.
Sprinkle sesame seeds, drizzle honey, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy dragonfruit packets in bulk online for better pricing
Use canned mango instead of fresh

recipes.name: Protein Power Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend frozen banana, frozen berries, protein powder, Greek yogurt, and almond milk until thick and smooth.
Divide between two bowls.
Top with granola and sliced almonds.
Swirl peanut butter on top of each bowl.
Drizzle with honey and serve with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy protein powder in bulk containers
Use natural peanut butter instead of branded versions

recipes.name: Coconut Acai Bowl
recipes.description: Brazilian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place acai packets, coconut milk, and frozen banana in a blender.
Blend until smooth and thick, about 60-90 seconds.
Divide between two bowls.
Top each bowl with granola, shredded coconut, blueberries, and strawberries.
Sprinkle toasted coconut flakes, drizzle honey, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Toast your own coconut flakes at home instead of buying pre-toasted
Buy acai in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Mango Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine frozen mango chunks, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and honey in a blender.
Blend until creamy and thick, about 90 seconds.
Pour into two bowls.
Top with granola, sliced fresh mango, coconut flakes, almonds, and chia seeds.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy frozen mango in bulk year-round for consistency and savings
Use store-brand Greek yogurt instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Banana Split Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend frozen banana, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and cocoa powder until smooth and creamy.
Divide between two bowls.
Arrange granola, strawberries, and pineapple in sections on top.
Sprinkle chocolate chips and add a dollop of whipped cream.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Use store-brand chocolate chips instead of premium brands
Buy frozen bananas when they're overripe and on sale

recipes.name: Unagidon
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions and set aside.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, sugar, sake, and water in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat eel fillets dry and cook skin-side down for 3 minutes until crispy, then flip and cook 2 more minutes.
Pour the sauce mixture over the eel and simmer for 3-4 minutes, basting occasionally until the sauce reduces and coats the fish.
Divide cooked rice between two bowls and top each with an eel fillet and sauce.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and sliced green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Substitute catfish or mackerel for expensive eel to save $3 per serving
Make glaze from soy sauce and brown sugar if mirin is unavailable

recipes.name: Karaage Don
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken thighs into bite-sized chunks and mix with soy sauce, ginger, and garlic in a bowl for 10 minutes.
Combine flour and potato starch in a shallow dish.
Heat oil to 350°F in a heavy pot or deep skillet.
Pat chicken dry and coat each piece in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Fry chicken in batches for 4-5 minutes until golden and cooked through, draining on paper towels.
Cook rice according to package directions.
Divide rice between two bowls and top with fried chicken pieces.
Drizzle with mayo mixed with a bit of soy sauce and sprinkle with green onions.
cheapTips: Use chicken drumsticks instead of thighs for $0.50 less per serving
Reuse frying oil up to 3 times to reduce oil costs

recipes.name: Poke Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian-Mexican Fusion lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine soy sauce and sesame oil in a small bowl with minced jalapeño.
Toss cubed tuna with the soy mixture and let marinate for 5 minutes.
Cook rice according to package directions.
Heat black beans and corn together in a small pot for 3 minutes.
Divide rice between two bowls and arrange beans, corn, and marinated tuna on top.
Slice avocado and place alongside other toppings.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over everything and sprinkle with cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Buy sushi-grade tuna on sale and freeze for up to 3 months
Use canned beans and frozen corn for consistent low pricing

recipes.name: Korean Beef Bowl
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions.
Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks for 5 minutes, then drain excess fat.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil to the beef and stir for 1 minute.
In another skillet, quickly wilt spinach over medium heat for 2 minutes and season lightly with salt.
Fry eggs sunny-side up in a small skillet or divide rice and top with raw yolks.
Divide cooked rice between two bowls and top with beef mixture and wilted spinach.
Place one fried egg on top of each bowl and garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions for quick weeknight meals
Skip the egg topping to save $0.30 per serving

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki Grain Bowl
recipes.description: Japanese-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook brown rice according to package directions.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken cubes for 6-7 minutes until cooked through, stirring occasionally.
Add broccoli florets to the skillet and stir-fry for 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Pour the teriyaki sauce over chicken and broccoli, stirring for 1-2 minutes until everything is coated and sauce thickens slightly.
Divide brown rice between two bowls and top with chicken-broccoli mixture.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute white rice for brown rice to save $0.50 per serving
Buy chicken on sale and marinate before freezing for convenient meal prep

recipes.name: Tofu Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Vegan Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Cut pressed tofu into 1-inch cubes.
Combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and sriracha in a bowl.
Toss tofu cubes gently with the marinade and let sit for 10 minutes.
Cook rice according to package directions.
Divide rice between two bowls and top with marinated tofu, cucumber, sliced avocado, and edamame.
Cut nori sheet into thin strips and scatter over bowls.
Drizzle extra marinade over top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy tofu in bulk at Asian markets for $1 less per block
Skip the nori and save $0.50 per serving

recipes.name: Shrimp Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions.
Boil water in a pot and add shrimp, cooking for 2 minutes until they turn pink, then drain and cool slightly.
Combine soy sauce, lime juice, sesame oil, and minced jalapeño in a bowl.
Toss warm shrimp with the marinade and let sit for 5 minutes.
Divide rice between two bowls.
Arrange marinated shrimp, cucumber, mango, and red onion on top of rice.
Drizzle any extra marinade over the bowls and sprinkle with cilantro and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and thaw before cooking to save $1.50 per serving
Use diced canned pineapple instead of fresh mango to save $0.75

recipes.name: Mixed Seafood Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions.
Boil shrimp for 2 minutes until pink, drain, and cool.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl.
Combine tuna, salmon, and cooled shrimp in a separate bowl.
Pour marinade over seafood and let sit for 5 minutes.
Divide rice between two bowls and top with marinated seafood mixture.
Add a scoop of seaweed salad to each bowl and arrange avocado slices on the side.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over top and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy seafood on sale and use within 1 day or freeze immediately
Skip seaweed salad and use nori strips to save $1.50 per serving

recipes.name: Spicy Salmon Grain Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian-Modern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Mix sriracha, mayo, and lime juice to make spicy mayo sauce.
Place salmon skin-side down on a baking sheet, brush with half the spicy mayo, and bake for 12-14 minutes until cooked through.
While salmon cooks, prepare quinoa according to package directions.
Chop kale and massage with a bit of olive oil and salt for 1 minute to soften.
Cube and roast sweet potato at 400°F for 20 minutes until tender.
Divide quinoa between two bowls and arrange kale, sweet potato, and bell pepper on top.
Flake salmon and place on each bowl, drizzle with remaining spicy mayo.
cheapTips: Buy salmon fillets in bulk on sale and freeze individually for meal prep
Use regular white rice instead of quinoa to save $1 per serving

recipes.name: Miso Glazed Cod Bowl
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix white miso paste, mirin, and sake in a small bowl until smooth.
Place cod fillets on prepared baking sheet and spread miso mixture evenly over the top.
Bake for 12-14 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork.
While fish bakes, cook brown rice according to package directions.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté mushrooms for 3 minutes until golden.
Add chopped bok choy to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Divide rice between two bowls, top with miso-glazed cod and sautéed vegetables, garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.
cheapTips: Buy cod on sale and freeze for up to 3 months without quality loss
Use regular mushrooms instead of shiitake to save $0.80 per serving

recipes.name: Carob Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend frozen banana, carob powder, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and honey until smooth.
Pour the smoothie mixture into a bowl.
Sprinkle granola over the smoothie base.
Top with shredded coconut, sliced almonds, and fresh berries.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Buy carob powder in bulk from the baking aisle
Use frozen bananas you've saved from overripe ones instead of buying frozen packs

recipes.name: Tahitian Acai Bowl
recipes.description: Hawaiian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend acai puree with coconut milk until creamy and thick.
Divide the acai mixture between two bowls.
Arrange banana slices, diced mango, and macadamia nuts on top.
Drizzle with honey.
Sprinkle granola and shredded coconut over the bowl.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute macadamia nuts with cheaper almonds or cashews
Buy acai puree frozen in bulk online to save 30%

recipes.name: Granola Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend frozen berries, Greek yogurt, banana, honey, and milk until thick and creamy.
Divide smoothie between two bowls.
Top each bowl with 1/2 cup granola.
Arrange fresh strawberry slices on top.
Sprinkle coconut and chia seeds over the bowls.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
cheapTips: Make your own granola to save 50% versus store-bought brands
Buy frozen berries in bulk during off-season sales

recipes.name: Lemon Pepper Wings
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and season with salt.
Toss wings with 2 tablespoons olive oil and arrange on a baking sheet.
Bake at 425°F for 30-35 minutes, stirring halfway through, until crispy.
Mix lemon juice, remaining olive oil, black pepper, garlic powder, and butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
In a large bowl, toss baked wings with the lemon pepper sauce.
Return wings to baking sheet and sprinkle with lemon zest.
Bake for 3-5 more minutes until sauce adheres.
Serve hot with extra lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy chicken wings when on sale and freeze for later use
Skip the butter and use more lemon juice for a lighter (cheaper) version

recipes.name: Teriyaki Wings
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat wings dry and toss with olive oil and salt on a baking sheet.
Bake at 425°F for 30 minutes until golden, stirring halfway through.
Whisk soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, minced garlic, and grated ginger in a saucepan.
Heat the teriyaki sauce over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Toss the baked wings with the teriyaki sauce in a large bowl.
Return coated wings to the baking sheet.
Bake for another 8-10 minutes until sauce caramelizes.
Garnish with sesame seeds and chopped green onion before serving.
cheapTips: Use regular soy sauce if mirin is unavailable or too expensive
Buy wings in bulk and make large batches to freeze

recipes.name: Soy Garlic Wings
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake chicken wings at 425°F for 30 minutes until partially cooked.
Mix soy sauce, minced garlic, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Whisk cornstarch with water until smooth and add to the soy mixture.
Heat the sauce in a saucepan over medium heat for 2 minutes until it thickens.
Toss baked wings with the soy garlic sauce in a large bowl.
Arrange sauced wings back on the baking sheet.
Bake for 15-20 minutes more until crispy and caramelized.
Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Mince your own garlic instead of buying pre-minced to save money
Rice vinegar can be replaced with regular white vinegar

recipes.name: Barbecue Wings
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat wings dry and toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Arrange wings on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake at 400°F for 30 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Mix barbecue sauce with honey in a small bowl.
Remove wings from oven and toss with the barbecue sauce mixture.
Return to oven and bake for an additional 8-10 minutes until caramelized.
Transfer to a serving platter.
Serve with extra barbecue sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand barbecue sauce instead of name brands
Use chicken thighs instead of wings for a cheaper alternative

recipes.name: Thai Chili Wings
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake wings at 425°F for 25 minutes until partially cooked.
Whisk Thai red curry paste with coconut milk in a bowl until smooth.
Add fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, and minced garlic to the curry mixture.
Heat the sauce in a saucepan over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Toss baked wings with the Thai chili sauce.
Return wings to the baking sheet and top with sliced red chili peppers.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until the sauce coats the wings.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Make your own curry paste to save money if you cook Thai often
Substitute fresh cilantro with dried when fresh is expensive

recipes.name: Honey Sriracha Wings
recipes.description: Fusion snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat wings dry and toss with olive oil and salt.
Bake at 425°F for 30 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Mix sriracha, honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and minced garlic in a small saucepan.
Heat the sauce over medium heat for 1-2 minutes until combined.
Toss baked wings with the honey sriracha sauce.
Return to baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes more.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and green onion over wings.
Serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy sriracha at Asian markets for 30-40% less than supermarkets
Use store-brand honey for the same results at lower cost

recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Wings
recipes.description: Italian-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss wings with olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Bake at 425°F for 32-35 minutes until golden and crispy.
Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic to the butter and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese and fresh parsley.
Transfer baked wings to a large bowl and toss with the garlic parmesan butter.
Return coated wings to the baking sheet.
Bake for 3 more minutes and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use pre-grated Parmesan to save time, or grate your own block cheese for savings
Buy garlic in bulk and mince ahead of time for convenience

recipes.name: Cajun Wings
recipes.description: Creole snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Pat chicken wings dry and toss with olive oil in a large bowl.
Mix paprika, cayenne, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt in a small bowl.
Coat wings evenly with the spice mixture and arrange on the baking sheet.
Bake for 25 minutes until wings are golden and crispy.
Melt butter with hot sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
Toss baked wings with the butter-hot sauce mixture and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy wings in bulk when on sale and freeze for later
Use basic pantry spices instead of pre-made Cajun seasoning packets

recipes.name: Boneless Wings
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized nugget pieces and season with salt and black pepper.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour in the first, beaten eggs in the second, and panko mixed with garlic powder in the third.
Coat each chicken piece in flour, then egg, then panko breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet to 350°F.
Fry chicken pieces in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with your favorite sauce.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale and portion it yourself instead of buying pre-cut pieces
Use store-brand panko and eggs to reduce costs

recipes.name: Mango Habanero Wings
recipes.description: Caribbean-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Pat wings dry and arrange on the baking sheet, then bake for 20 minutes.
While wings cook, blend mango puree, habanero peppers, lime juice, honey, minced garlic, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Strain the sauce through a fine mesh if you prefer less pulp.
Remove partially cooked wings from oven and brush generously with mango-habanero sauce.
Bake for another 15 minutes until wings are caramelized and cooked through.
Toss with remaining sauce before serving.
cheapTips: Make your own mango puree by freezing fresh mangos when in season
Use fresh habaneros from the farmer's market instead of specialty grocery stores

recipes.name: Vietnamese Fish Sauce Wings
recipes.description: Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat wings dry and toss with cornstarch and black pepper to coat lightly.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown wings on all sides for 8 minutes total.
Mince garlic, shallots, and Thai chilies together into a fine paste.
In a bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, honey, and the garlic-shallot-chili paste.
Pour the sauce over browned wings and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes until wings are fully cooked and sauce thickens slightly.
Uncover and simmer for 3 more minutes to reduce sauce and caramelize wings.
cheapTips: Buy fish sauce in larger bottles at Asian markets—much cheaper than supermarkets
Use regular chilies if Thai chilies are unavailable

recipes.name: Nashville Hot Chicken
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Marinate chicken thighs in buttermilk for at least 2 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.
Mix flour, cayenne, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Remove chicken from buttermilk and dredge thoroughly in the spiced flour mixture.
Heat vegetable oil to 325°F in a deep skillet or Dutch oven.
Fry chicken thighs for 12-15 minutes per side until deep golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with white bread and pickles.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts—cheaper and more flavorful
Save buttermilk from previous recipes or use milk curdled with lemon juice

recipes.name: Korean Gochujang Wings
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and arrange wings on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Bake wings for 25 minutes until lightly golden.
While wings bake, whisk together gochujang, honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Melt butter in a small saucepan and stir in the gochujang mixture over low heat.
Remove wings from oven and toss with the gochujang-butter sauce.
Return to oven for 10 more minutes to caramelize.
Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy gochujang in bulk at Korean markets—cheaper than specialty sections
Substitute with sriracha and hot sauce if gochujang is unavailable

recipes.name: Honey Mustard Wings
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and pat wings dry.
Toss wings with olive oil, salt, and black pepper, then spread on a baking sheet.
Bake for 20 minutes until wings are partially cooked and browned.
Whisk together honey, Dijon mustard, yellow mustard, apple cider vinegar, and garlic powder in a bowl.
Melt butter into the honey-mustard mixture over low heat.
Remove wings from oven and brush generously with the sauce.
Bake for another 12 minutes until wings are caramelized and cooked through.
cheapTips: Use store-brand mustards to save money
Buy honey from bulk bins instead of jars

recipes.name: Crispy Chicken Tenders
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice chicken breasts horizontally to create thin tenders, about 0.75 inches thick.
Season tenders with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Set up three bowls: flour in the first, beaten eggs in the second, panko in the third.
Coat each tender in flour, then egg, then panko breadcrumbs, pressing gently.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a large skillet.
Fry tenders for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken breasts on sale and slice them yourself
Reuse oil between batches to save money

recipes.name: Sesame Ginger Chicken
recipes.description: Asian-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized chunks and season with salt and pepper.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken pieces for 5-7 minutes until no longer pink, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add minced ginger and garlic, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, honey, and cornstarch in a bowl.
Pour sauce into the skillet and simmer for 2-3 minutes until thickened slightly.
Return chicken to the skillet and toss to coat evenly.
Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions before serving over rice.
cheapTips: Use ground ginger if fresh ginger is too expensive
Buy sesame oil in bulk and store in a cool place

recipes.name: Korean Black Garlic Wings
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and arrange wings on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Bake wings for 20 minutes until lightly browned.
While wings cook, mince black garlic cloves finely into a paste.
Whisk together soy sauce, mirin, honey, sesame oil, rice vinegar, water, and cornstarch with the black garlic paste.
Remove wings from oven and brush with half the sauce.
Bake for another 12 minutes until wings are caramelized.
Toss wings with remaining sauce and garnish with sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Buy black garlic in bulk online—often cheaper than specialty stores
Substitute with regular garlic if black garlic is unavailable

recipes.name: Western Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté the diced onion and bell pepper until softened, about 3 minutes.
Whisk together eggs with salt and pepper, then pour into the skillet and scramble until cooked through.
Toast bread slices lightly in a separate pan with remaining butter.
Layer ham and cheese on one slice of bread, top with the egg mixture.
Cover with second bread slice and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand ham and cheese to save 30%
Use white bread instead of premium varieties

recipes.name: White Castle Slider
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the onion into thin rings and separate them.
Form ground beef into 8 thin, small patties about 2 inches wide and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 1-2 minutes per side until mostly cooked through.
Place a cheese slice on each patty, cover pan with a lid for 30 seconds to melt.
Toast slider buns lightly in the same pan with a touch of butter.
Assemble sliders by placing each patty with cheese on a bun and top with a few onion rings.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk when on sale and freeze
Use regular cheese slices instead of specialty American cheese

recipes.name: Krystal Burger
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice the onion into small pieces.
Form ground beef into 8 thin patties, about 2 ounces each, and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a griddle or skillet over high heat and cook patties for about 1.5 minutes per side.
Toast the small burger buns on the griddle until lightly golden.
Spread a thin layer of mustard on each bun bottom.
Place a patty on each bun, top with diced onion and 2-3 pickle slices, then close with the top bun.
cheapTips: Buy the cheapest ground beef available; the thin patties don't require quality cuts
Make your own diced onions instead of buying pre-diced

recipes.name: Kobe Slider
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix together soy sauce, mirin, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl.
Gently form ground beef into 6 thin patties without overworking the meat.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for about 2 minutes per side, then brush generously with the soy-mirin glaze.
Toast slider buns lightly with remaining butter until golden.
Assemble sliders by placing each patty on a bun, drizzling any remaining glaze on top.
Garnish with sliced green onion and sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Use regular soy sauce instead of premium brands
Skip the mirin and use honey or brown sugar as a substitute

recipes.name: Slider Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a saucepan and whisk in flour to create a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly add milk while whisking constantly until the sauce thickens, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar cheese until melted and smooth, then fold in cooked pasta.
Toast slider buns lightly and spread 1 tbsp melted butter mixed with breadcrumbs on the insides.
Scoop mac and cheese mixture onto the bottom half of each bun, top with the bun lid, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use store-brand elbow pasta and block cheddar cheese shredded yourself
Make roux-based sauce instead of using evaporated milk for better value

recipes.name: Chicken Slider
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into 6 equal pieces and pound gently to an even 1-inch thickness.
Season chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken for 5-6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
While chicken cooks, toss coleslaw mix with vinegar, sugar, and a pinch of salt to create a quick slaw.
Toast slider buns lightly and spread mayonnaise on the bottom half of each.
Place a chicken piece on each bun, top with coleslaw and the bun lid.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale and freeze for later use
Make coleslaw from shredded cabbage (cheaper than pre-made mix)

recipes.name: Beef Wellington Slider
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef tenderloin into 8 equal cubes and sear quickly in a hot skillet for 1-2 minutes per side, season with salt and pepper, then cool.
Finely chop mushrooms, shallot, and garlic, then sauté in butter until all liquid evaporates, about 8 minutes, add thyme and cool completely.
Cut puff pastry into 8 small squares, place a spoonful of mushroom mixture on each, top with a beef cube, then wrap pastry around and seal edges.
Brush wrapped pastry with beaten egg yolk and place on a baking sheet.
Bake at 400°F for 15-18 minutes until pastry is golden brown and puffed.
Allow to cool slightly before serving as elegant sliders.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck instead of tenderloin and braise briefly before sealing
Make puff pastry from scratch or use cheaper frozen sheets

recipes.name: Fish and Chips Slider
recipes.description: British lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or deep fryer.
Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, and pepper in a bowl, then whisk in beer to create a thick batter.
Cut cod into 6 equal pieces, pat dry, and season lightly with salt.
Dip fish pieces into batter and carefully place into hot oil, frying 4-5 minutes until golden and crispy.
Toast slider buns lightly and spread tartar sauce on the bottom half of each.
Place a fried fish piece on each bun and close with the top bun.
cheapTips: Use frozen cod fillets which are typically cheaper than fresh
Make tartar sauce at home with mayo and diced pickles

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Slider
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onion and mince garlic, place in a slow cooker with the pork shoulder.
Combine paprika, brown sugar, vinegar, salt, and pepper, then rub over the pork.
Cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours until pork is very tender and shreds easily.
Remove pork from slow cooker and use two forks to shred it into bite-sized pieces.
Mix shredded pork with barbecue sauce and 1 cup of the cooking liquid.
Toast slider buns lightly and fill with pulled pork mixture, serving warm.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder at budget grocery stores; it's often the cheapest meat cut
Use store-brand barbecue sauce to save 40%

recipes.name: Lamb Burger
recipes.description: Mediterranean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground lamb with diced red onion, feta cheese, mint, garlic, salt, and pepper, mixing gently.
Form mixture into 3 burger patties about 3/4-inch thick.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Toast burger buns lightly in the same skillet.
Slice tomato thinly and layer on the bun bottoms.
Top tomato with the cooked lamb patty and close with the bun top.
cheapTips: Look for ground lamb sales at specialty grocers or ethnic markets
Crumble your own lamb from lamb shoulder for significant savings

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros Burrito
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the onion, mince the jalapeño and garlic, then cook in oil in a skillet over medium heat until softened.
Add canned tomatoes with juice to the skillet and simmer for 5 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Heat black beans separately in a saucepan and warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
In a separate skillet, fry the eggs sunny-side up until whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Spread black beans down the center of each tortilla, then top with a fried egg and half the cheese.
Pour the ranchero sauce over the eggs and sprinkle with remaining cheese and cilantro.
Fold the tortilla burrito-style and serve immediately with sauce spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy canned tomatoes in bulk when on sale
Use dried beans cooked at home instead of canned to cut cost in half

recipes.name: Chilaquiles Burrito
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add tortilla chips, stirring for 1-2 minutes.
Pour salsa verde over chips and stir gently until chips are coated and slightly softened but still crispy, about 2 minutes.
Remove chilaquiles to a plate and keep warm.
Add remaining oil to the skillet and crack eggs into it, frying to your preference and seasoning with salt and pepper.
Warm flour tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Divide chilaquiles between tortillas, top each with 2 fried eggs and a dollop of sour cream.
Sprinkle with queso fresco and cilantro, then roll burrito-style and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand tortilla chips—they work just as well as name brands
Make your own salsa verde with tomatillos, onion, and jalapeños when in season

recipes.name: Montreal Bagel with Lox and Cream Cheese
recipes.description: Jewish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice Montreal bagels in half and toast them in a toaster or toaster oven until lightly golden.
Spread 2 oz of softened cream cheese on the cut side of each bagel half.
Layer 2 oz of smoked salmon on top of each bagel, folding it slightly.
Thinly slice the red onion and sprinkle over the lox on each bagel.
Add a sprinkle of capers and fresh dill to each bagel.
Serve immediately with a lemon wedge on the side for squeezing.
cheapTips: Buy lox in bulk and freeze portions to use throughout the month
Use regular bagels from the grocery store if Montreal bagels are unavailable

recipes.name: Bagel and Schmear
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the bagel in half.
Toast the bagel halves until golden brown and crispy.
Spread 1 oz of cream cheese on each warm bagel half.
Serve immediately while the bagel is still warm.
cheapTips: Buy bagels on sale and freeze them for later use
Store-brand cream cheese is significantly cheaper than name brands

recipes.name: Lox Bagel Sandwich
recipes.description: Jewish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the bagel in half and toast until lightly golden.
Spread 1.25 oz cream cheese on each toasted bagel half.
Layer the smoked salmon evenly on both halves, using about 1.25 oz per side.
Place red onion slices on top of the lox.
Sprinkle capers and fresh dill over the sandwich.
Press the two halves together gently and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Watch for sales on smoked salmon and buy when discounted
Use a vegetable peeler to thin the onion slices if you don't have a mandoline

recipes.name: Breakfast Sandwich with Avocado
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon strips in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5-7 minutes, then set aside on paper towels.
Melt butter in the same skillet and crack both eggs into it, cooking to your preference and seasoning with salt and pepper.
Toast the English muffin until golden brown.
Slice the avocado in half and scoop half of it onto one side of the toasted muffin.
Layer the fried egg, then cheese slice, then bacon strips on top of the avocado.
Top with the other half of the muffin and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale and store in the coldest part of your fridge
Check for browning spots on avocados at the grocery store for discounts

recipes.name: Belgian Waffle Breakfast Sandwich
recipes.description: Belgian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat your waffle iron and preheat oven to 200°F.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
In another bowl, beat eggs with milk and melted butter until well combined.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, stirring until just blended with some small lumps remaining.
Pour batter into a greased waffle iron and cook until golden and crispy, about 4-5 minutes per waffle.
Keep cooked waffles warm in the oven as you finish cooking all batter.
Warm ham slices in a skillet for 1-2 minutes per side.
Assemble sandwiches by placing ham and cheese between two waffles, then drizzle with maple syrup and serve.
cheapTips: Use store-brand ham instead of premium brands to save 30-40%
Make the batter ahead and refrigerate overnight to save time in the morning

recipes.name: English Breakfast Butty
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice mushrooms and cook them in 0.5 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat until golden, about 5 minutes, then set aside.
Cook bacon rashers in the same skillet until crispy, about 5-7 minutes, then set aside.
Slice tomato in half and cook cut-side down in the skillet for 2 minutes.
Add remaining butter to the skillet and crack both eggs into it, cooking to your preference and seasoning with salt and pepper.
Toast the bread slices until golden brown and spread remaining butter on them while hot.
Layer one slice of bread with cooked bacon, egg, mushrooms, and tomato.
Top with second slice of bread and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk to keep costs low
Use whatever mushrooms are on sale that week

recipes.name: Breakfast Roll
recipes.description: Irish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon rashers in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5-7 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Add sausage patties to the same skillet and cook until browned on both sides, about 6-8 minutes total.
Add black pudding slices and cook 2 minutes per side, then push all meat to the side of the pan.
Slice tomato and cook cut-side down in the pan for 1-2 minutes.
Crack eggs into the pan and cook to your preference, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Slice rolls in half and warm them in the oven or directly in the skillet for 30 seconds.
Butter the warm rolls and fill each with bacon, sausage, black pudding, tomato, and one fried egg.
cheapTips: Look for black pudding in the international foods aisle—it's cheaper there than specialty butchers
Buy sausage in bulk and freeze portions to extend your supply

recipes.name: Spicy Chorizo Breakfast Sandwich
recipes.description: Spanish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the chorizo into thin rounds and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes until edges are browned and oil is released.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Add roasted red peppers and paprika, stirring well, then push mixture to the side of the pan.
Add eggs to the other side of the pan and scramble until set, about 3-4 minutes.
Slice hoagie rolls in half and toast them in a dry skillet or oven until lightly golden.
Divide the chorizo and egg mixture between the two rolls.
Serve immediately with extra paprika and hot sauce on the side if desired.
cheapTips: Buy chorizo on sale and freeze in portions to use throughout the month
Use jarred roasted red peppers to save time and money compared to fresh

recipes.name: Slider BLT
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, about 8 minutes.
Toast the slider buns lightly in a separate pan or toaster for 2 minutes.
Spread mayonnaise on the bottom half of each bun.
Layer lettuce, two bacon strips, and a tomato slice on each bun.
Top with the upper bun half and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand mayo and budget buns

recipes.name: Wagyu Slider
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince the onion finely and mix with wagyu beef, soy sauce, and mirin until just combined.
Divide meat into 2 equal portions and gently form into patties slightly larger than your buns.
Heat a cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking and sear patties for 2 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Toast the slider buns lightly in the pan drippings.
Place patties on buns, top with sesame seeds and sliced scallion, then serve.
cheapTips: Look for wagyu at Costco for better pricing than specialty butchers
Skip the mirin and use honey as a substitute

recipes.name: Turkey Slider
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Form ground turkey into 2 thin patties about 3 inches wide and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Place a cheese slice on each patty and cover with a lid to melt for 1 minute.
Toast slider buns lightly for 2 minutes.
Layer lettuce and tomato on bottom bun, add patty with cheese, and top with bun.
cheapTips: Ground turkey is usually cheaper than beef
Buy store-brand cheese and basic buns

recipes.name: Venison Burger
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground venison and pork with minced garlic and Worcestershire sauce, then form into 2 patties.
Heat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat and sear patties 3-4 minutes per side, keeping rare to medium-rare.
In a separate pan, sauté mushroom slices in butter until golden, about 5 minutes.
Top each patty with Swiss cheese and mushrooms, cover to melt for 2 minutes.
Toast slider buns and assemble with patties, mushrooms, and cheese.
cheapTips: Ask the butcher to grind venison fresh for best texture
Add pork fat to prevent venison from being too dry

recipes.name: Tater Tot Slider
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake frozen tater tots according to package directions until crispy, about 18 minutes at 400°F.
Form ground beef into 2 thin patties and season generously with salt and pepper.
Cook patties in a skillet over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side, top with cheese and cover to melt.
Toast slider buns lightly for 1-2 minutes.
Place patty on bottom bun, top with 4 tater tots, spread ketchup on top bun, and assemble.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand frozen tater tots in bulk
Use basic ketchup and budget ground beef

recipes.name: Slider Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread mustard evenly on both halves of each slider bun.
Layer lettuce on the bottom bun of each slider.
Add 2 ounces of ham and 2 ounces of turkey to each sandwich.
Place tomato slice and Swiss cheese on top of the meat.
Close with the top bun and serve immediately or wrap in foil to eat later.
cheapTips: Buy deli meat from the counter and ask for day-old discounts
Skip expensive specialty mustards and use classic yellow mustard

recipes.name: Pork Belly Slider
recipes.description: Asian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork belly into 2-inch cubes and blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain.
In a pot, combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, and ginger with 1 cup water and bring to boil.
Add pork belly cubes and simmer covered for 60 minutes until tender and caramelized.
Toast slider buns lightly in a dry skillet for 2 minutes.
Place braised pork belly pieces on bottom bun, garnish with scallion and sesame seeds, and top with bun.
cheapTips: Pork belly is often cheaper than premium cuts at Asian markets
Make extra braised pork belly for other meals during the week

recipes.name: Chorizo Slider
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice red bell pepper and onion into thin strips.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and cook chorizo links for 6-7 minutes, turning occasionally until browned.
Remove chorizo and sauté pepper and onion strips in the remaining oil until softened, about 4 minutes, sprinkle with paprika.
Toast slider buns lightly for 1-2 minutes.
Spread garlic aioli on buns, place chorizo link on bottom, top with peppers and onions, and close with top bun.
cheapTips: Buy chorizo at Latin markets for better prices than supermarkets
Make simple aioli at home with mayo and minced garlic

recipes.name: Falafel Slider
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, flour, and cumin in a food processor until mixture resembles coarse sand.
Divide mixture into 2 portions and form into patties slightly larger than slider buns.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry patties for 4 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Toast slider buns lightly for 1-2 minutes.
Spread tahini sauce on both buns, layer with falafel patty, tomato slices, and cucumber slices, then assemble.
cheapTips: Canned chickpeas are much cheaper than dried and require no soaking
Make tahini sauce from store-bought tahini with lemon juice and water

recipes.name: Slider Breakfast Sandwich
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook sausage patties in a skillet over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side, then set aside.
In the same skillet, scramble two eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper until cooked through, about 2 minutes.
Toast slider buns lightly in the skillet for 1 minute per side.
Place a sausage patty on bottom bun, top with scrambled egg portion and a cheese slice.
Close with top bun and serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk and sausage when on sale for freezer storage
Use store-brand ingredients across the board

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Slider
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil chicken breasts in salted water for 12-15 minutes until fully cooked through.
Shred the cooked chicken with two forks in a large bowl.
Mix shredded chicken with buffalo sauce and stir until evenly coated.
Butter the slider buns and toast them in a skillet for 2 minutes per side.
Fill each bun with buffalo chicken and top with blue cheese crumbles.
Serve with celery sticks and ranch dressing on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze them.
Make ranch dressing from scratch with Greek yogurt.

recipes.name: Mushroom Swiss Slider
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice mushrooms and dice onion into small pieces.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a skillet and sauté mushrooms and onions for 8 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Form ground beef into 8 small patties and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Cook patties in the same skillet over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side.
Top each patty with a slice of Swiss cheese and cover to melt for 1 minute.
Toast slider buns with remaining butter, then assemble with beef, cheese, and mushroom mixture.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk when on sale.
Use baby bella mushrooms instead of premium varieties.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Slider
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together soy sauce, mirin, honey, ginger, and garlic in a small bowl to make teriyaki glaze.
Cut pork chops into slider-sized pieces about 0.5 inch thick.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook pork for 4 minutes per side until mostly cooked.
Pour teriyaki glaze over pork and simmer for 3-4 minutes until caramelized and fully cooked.
Toast slider buns lightly in the skillet.
Assemble sliders with glazed pork, green onion slices, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Substitute honey with brown sugar if mirin is unavailable.
Buy pork chops on sale and slice them yourself.

recipes.name: Gourmet Beef Slider
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground beef, egg, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper in a bowl and gently mix.
Form mixture into 8 small patties and make a small indent in the center of each.
Cook patties in a skillet over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side until medium doneness.
Top each patty with Gruyere cheese and cover to melt for 1 minute.
Toast slider buns and spread with Dijon mustard on the inside.
Layer each bun with beef patty, melted cheese, and caramelized onions before serving.
cheapTips: Caramelize onions ahead of time in bulk.
Use American cheese instead of Gruyere to save money.

recipes.name: Crab Cake Slider
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix crab meat, mayonnaise, egg, 0.25 cup breadcrumbs, mustard, Old Bay, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Form mixture into 8 patties and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Place remaining breadcrumbs on a plate and coat each crab cake on both sides.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook crab cakes for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Toast slider buns lightly.
Serve crab cakes on buns with tartar sauce or additional mayo if desired.
cheapTips: Buy crab meat from the frozen section for savings.
Make tartar sauce at home with mayo and relish.

recipes.name: Spicy Tuna Slider
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain tuna cans thoroughly and flake tuna into a bowl.
Mix mayo, sriracha, and wasabi together in a small bowl to make spicy mayo.
Combine tuna with spicy mayo, chopped green onions, and soy sauce.
Slice cucumber into thin rounds.
Toast slider buns lightly.
Assemble each slider with tuna mixture, cucumber slices, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy canned tuna in bulk when on sale.
Use jalapeños instead of wasabi for heat.

recipes.name: Twice-Baked Potato
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake potatoes at 400°F for 35 minutes until tender.
Cook bacon until crispy, crumble, and set aside.
Cut potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop out insides, leaving a 0.25-inch shell.
Mash scooped potato with butter, sour cream, milk, salt, and pepper.
Fold in 0.75 cup cheese, bacon, and chopped green onions into the mashed mixture.
Fill potato shells with mixture, top with remaining cheese, and bake at 350°F for 12 minutes until heated through.
cheapTips: Use store-brand sour cream and cheese.
Buy bacon ends and pieces for cheaper bacon.

recipes.name: Jacket Potato with Beans and Cheese
recipes.description: British lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prick potatoes several times with a fork and bake at 400°F for 30 minutes until tender.
Heat baked beans in a saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Remove potatoes from oven and cut them in half lengthwise.
Fluff the insides with a fork and top each half with a pat of butter, salt, and pepper.
Spoon warm baked beans over each potato half and generously top with shredded cheese.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans in bulk.
Use store-brand cheese to save money.

recipes.name: Potato Skin
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake potatoes at 400°F for 25 minutes until tender.
Cook bacon until crispy, crumble, and set aside.
Cut cooled potatoes in half and scoop out most of the insides, leaving 0.25-inch shell.
Brush potato skins with olive oil and arrange on a baking sheet.
Bake skins at 400°F for 8 minutes until crispy, then top with cheese and bacon.
Bake for 3 more minutes until cheese melts, then top with sour cream and green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Save potato insides for mashed potatoes.
Use imitation bacon bits instead of real bacon.

recipes.name: Hasselback Potato
recipes.description: Swedish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice potatoes thinly (0.125 inches) starting from one side, cutting about three-quarters through each potato.
Mix melted butter with minced garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Place potatoes on a baking sheet, brush with olive oil, then generously brush garlic butter between the slices.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and rosemary over the top of each potato.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 40 minutes.
Remove foil and bake for 8 more minutes until potatoes are tender and tops are golden.
cheapTips: Use dried thyme instead of fresh.
Buy potatoes in bulk from discount stores.

recipes.name: Kartoffel im Schlafrock
recipes.description: German dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil whole potatoes in salted water for 20-25 minutes until just tender, then drain and cool slightly.
Brown ground beef with diced onion in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, beef broth, and season with salt and pepper, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Make a roux by melting butter and whisking in flour, then stir into the meat mixture to thicken.
Slice the top off each cooled potato and scoop out centers, leaving a thin shell.
Fill each potato with the meat mixture and replace the tops.
Place stuffed potatoes in a baking dish, cover with foil, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until heated through.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use ground chuck instead of leaner beef to save money
Make the filling a day ahead to save time during dinner prep

recipes.name: Potato Farcie
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake potatoes at 400°F for 40 minutes until tender.
Cut potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop out insides, leaving a thin shell.
Mash the scooped potato with butter, milk, and minced shallot until creamy.
Fold in diced ham, gruyere cheese, egg yolk, nutmeg, salt, and white pepper.
Fill potato shells generously with the mixture and place on a baking sheet.
Bake at 375°F for 12-15 minutes until golden and heated through.
Sprinkle with fresh chives and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute cheddar for gruyere to reduce cost
Buy ham from the deli counter in bulk and dice yourself

recipes.name: Pommes Anna
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and thinly slice potatoes on a mandoline into uniform 1/8-inch rounds.
Melt 8 tbsp butter gently and skim off the milk solids to clarify it.
Layer sliced potatoes in a well-buttered 9-inch skillet, seasoning each layer with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Press down gently with a spatula as you layer, using about half the clarified butter.
Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes without stirring until the bottom forms a golden crust.
Transfer the skillet to a 375°F oven and bake for 25-30 minutes until potatoes are tender inside.
Invert the pommes anna onto a serving plate to reveal the crispy golden exterior.
Drizzle with remaining melted butter and serve hot.
cheapTips: Make your own clarified butter instead of buying it pre-made
Use regular potatoes instead of fingerlings to save money

recipes.name: Patatas Rellenas
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake potatoes at 400°F for 35 minutes until just tender.
While potatoes cook, heat olive oil and sauté onion, garlic, and red pepper until softened.
Add ground pork and chorizo to the pan and cook until pork is browned, about 8 minutes.
Stir in smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, then remove from heat and stir in manchego cheese.
Cut potatoes in half and scoop out centers, reserving shells.
Fill each potato shell with the meat mixture and place on a baking sheet.
Bake at 375°F for 12 minutes until filling is heated through and potatoes are tender.
Serve immediately with extra cheese if desired.
cheapTips: Use regular cheddar instead of manchego cheese
Buy chorizo on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Batata Recheada
recipes.description: Portuguese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake sweet potatoes at 400°F for 30 minutes until tender.
Heat olive oil and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into small pieces.
Stir in diced tomato, olives, cumin, salt, and pepper, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Add lime juice and taste for seasoning.
Cut cooled potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop out centers slightly.
Fill each potato half with the beef mixture and arrange on a serving platter.
Serve warm or at room temperature with fresh cilantro if desired.
cheapTips: Use canned diced tomatoes instead of fresh when out of season
Buy sweet potatoes in bulk bags for better price per pound

recipes.name: Patate Ripiene
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes until partially cooked, then drain and cool.
Sauté pancetta and onion in olive oil until the onion is soft, about 4 minutes.
Add ground veal and cook until no longer pink, about 6 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in ricotta, parmesan, egg, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Cut cooled potatoes in half and scoop out centers, leaving a thin shell.
Fill each potato shell with the meat mixture and arrange in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes until potatoes are tender and tops are golden.
Serve hot, garnished with extra parmesan and fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Substitute ground beef for veal to save significantly
Use store-brand ricotta and parmesan instead of imported

recipes.name: Pampushky
recipes.description: Ukrainian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and grate potatoes, then squeeze out excess moisture using a kitchen towel.
Mix grated potato with flour, egg, salt, and pepper to form a dough.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Drop spoonfuls of potato mixture carefully into hot oil and fry until golden brown on all sides, about 3 minutes total.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Combine sour cream, fresh dill, and minced garlic in a small bowl.
Serve warm pampushky with the garlic-dill sour cream for dipping.
cheapTips: Use potatoes from bulk bins instead of pre-packaged bags
Make sour cream dip with store-brand sour cream and save on herbs

recipes.name: Farcito
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake potatoes at 400°F for 35 minutes until nearly cooked through.
Heat olive oil and sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Stir in chopped prosciutto, salt, pepper, and fresh basil, then remove from heat.
Cool the mixture slightly and fold in mozzarella cubes.
Cut cooled potatoes in half and carefully hollow out centers.
Fill potato halves with meat and cheese mixture and place in a baking dish.
Pour marinara sauce around potatoes and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender and cheese melts.
Serve hot with extra marinara sauce and basil.
cheapTips: Use bacon bits instead of prosciutto for a budget alternative
Buy marinara sauce in bulk when on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Potato Nest
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil diced potatoes in salted water for 12-15 minutes until very tender, then drain well.
Mash potatoes with butter, milk, salt, and pepper until creamy.
Fold in cheddar cheese, bacon, half the green onions, and sour cream.
Spoon mashed potato mixture into 4 mounds on a buttered baking sheet, using the back of a spoon to create a nest shape with a slight depression.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes until lightly golden.
Top each nest with remaining green onions and serve immediately.
Optional: fill the center with a fried egg or ground beef mixture before serving.
cheapTips: Cook bacon in the oven with potatoes to save time and cleanup
Use mild cheddar instead of sharp for better budget pricing

recipes.name: Duchess Potato
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil diced potatoes in salted water for 12-15 minutes until very tender, then drain and return to pot.
Mash potatoes until very smooth, then beat in butter until incorporated.
Add 3 egg yolks one at a time, beating well after each addition until creamy.
Season with nutmeg, salt, and white pepper to taste.
Transfer mixture to a piping bag fitted with a large star tip.
Pipe rosettes onto a greased baking sheet, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Beat 1 whole egg and brush lightly over each rosette.
Bake at 400°F for 12-15 minutes until golden brown on top, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Save egg whites to use in other recipes and reduce waste
Use a zip-top bag with corner cut off instead of piping bag for equipment savings

recipes.name: Fondant Potato
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and cut into 2-inch cylinders using a knife or cylindrical cutter.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until foaming.
Sear potato cylinders on all flat sides until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side.
Add broth, thyme, and garlic to the skillet, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise for 20-25 minutes until potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife.
Remove lid and reduce liquid by half over medium heat, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, then plate with reduced sauce drizzled over top.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk during sales and store in cool, dark places
Use vegetable broth instead of beef or chicken to reduce cost

recipes.name: Dauphinoise
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13 baking dish.
Peel and thinly slice potatoes using a mandoline or sharp knife into 1/8-inch slices.
Heat cream and milk in a saucepan with smashed garlic cloves until steaming, then remove from heat.
Layer half the potatoes in the baking dish, seasoning each layer with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Pour half the cream mixture over the potatoes, then layer remaining potatoes and cream.
