Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes, then remove foil and bake uncovered for 15-20 minutes until golden.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand cream and milk instead of premium brands
Slice potatoes by hand to save the cost of a mandoline

recipes.name: Gratin Dauphinois
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13 baking dish.
Peel and thinly slice potatoes into 1/8-inch slices using a mandoline or knife.
Heat cream and milk with smashed garlic until steaming, then season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Layer half the potatoes in the dish, sprinkle with half the cheese, then add remaining potatoes.
Pour cream mixture over potatoes and top with remaining cheese.
Bake covered with foil for 35 minutes, then uncovered for 20-25 minutes until top is golden and bubbling.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use sharp cheddar instead of Gruyère to save 30-40%
Buy potatoes on sale and freeze sliced portions for later use

recipes.name: Potato Pavé
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil peeled and cubed potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until very tender, then drain completely.
Press potatoes through a ricer into a bowl, then fold in hot cream and 4 tablespoons butter until smooth.
Gently fold foie gras and truffle into potato purée, season with salt and pepper.
Line a small loaf pan with plastic wrap and press potato mixture firmly inside, then refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.
Unmold pavé and slice into 1-inch thick rectangles.
Pan-sear each slice in remaining butter over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes per side until golden crust forms.
Serve immediately while warm and crispy outside.
cheapTips: Substitute pâté or liver mousse for foie gras to cut cost in half
Skip truffle oil or use a very small amount; flavor is strong

recipes.name: Stuffed Idaho Potato
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and bake potatoes on a sheet pan for 40 minutes until tender.
While potatoes cook, fry bacon until crispy, then chop into pieces.
Cut cooled potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop out insides, leaving a thin shell.
Mix scooped potato with butter, sour cream, half the cheese, and bacon, then season with salt and pepper.
Spoon mixture back into potato skins and top with remaining cheese.
Bake for 10 minutes until heated through and cheese melts.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use store-brand sour cream and cheddar to save 25%
Cook bacon in the oven at 400°F for 12 minutes to save time and energy

recipes.name: Potato Wellington
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil diced potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, drain and mash with 2 tablespoons butter.
Sauté finely chopped mushrooms, shallots, and garlic in remaining butter until liquid evaporates, about 10 minutes, then stir in parsley.
Cool mashed potatoes and mushroom mixture to room temperature.
Roll out puff pastry and cut into 4 rectangles, then spread mushroom-potato mixture on each.
Fold pastry corners up and seal edges with water, brush top with beaten egg yolk.
Place on parchment-lined baking sheet and bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy frozen puff pastry on sale and stock in freezer
Use regular button mushrooms instead of cremini to save money

recipes.name: Pommes Sarladaises
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch thick slices and cut bacon into small pieces.
Fry bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, then remove with a slotted spoon.
Add potato slices to bacon fat and cook in batches without crowding, stirring occasionally, for 15-20 minutes until golden and tender.
Return bacon to skillet and add minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Remove from heat and toss with chopped parsley and truffle or extra parsley.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip the truffle entirely and use fresh parsley for authentic flavor at 90% less cost
Buy bacon on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Bravas Potatoes
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes and pat dry thoroughly with paper towels.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or fryer, then fry potatoes in batches for 10-12 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt.
Mix mayonnaise with minced garlic, ketchup, and hot sauce to make bravas sauce.
Plate hot potatoes and drizzle sauce over top or serve alongside for dipping.
Garnish with fresh chopped parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand mayo and ketchup instead of premium brands
Reuse frying oil by straining through cheesecloth and storing in a cool place

recipes.name: Baked Potato Bar Special
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and bake potatoes for 40 minutes until very tender.
Blanch broccoli in boiling salted water for 3-4 minutes, drain well.
Slice baked potatoes in half lengthwise and fluff interior with a fork.
Top each potato half with butter, sour cream, cheese, broccoli, and bacon bits.
Return to oven for 5 minutes to melt cheese.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve hot with additional toppings on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen broccoli instead of fresh to save 40%
Use imitation bacon bits instead of real bacon to cut cost significantly

recipes.name: Pommes Boulangère
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and butter a 9x13 baking dish.
Peel and thinly slice potatoes into 1/8-inch slices, and slice onions into thin half-moons.
Layer half the potatoes in the dish, season with salt and pepper, then layer onions, then remaining potatoes.
Heat broth with thyme and bay leaf, then pour over potatoes until just covered.
Dot top with butter and bake covered with foil for 35-40 minutes until potatoes are very tender.
Remove foil and bake 5-10 minutes more until top begins to brown.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.
cheapTips: Use onions and potatoes from bulk bins to minimize packaging waste and cost
Substitute vegetable broth for beef or chicken broth

recipes.name: Spicy Dry Rub Wings
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl.
Mix paprika, cayenne, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt in a small bowl.
Drizzle olive oil over wings and toss to coat evenly.
Sprinkle dry rub mixture over wings and toss until fully coated.
Spread wings in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until crispy and golden brown, stirring halfway through.
Drizzle honey over finished wings and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy wings in bulk when on sale and freeze for later
Make your own spice blend instead of buying pre-mixed seasoning packets

recipes.name: Bacon, Egg & Cheese
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon strips in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, about 5 minutes, then set aside on paper towels.
Split and toast the English muffins until golden brown.
Melt butter in the same skillet over medium heat and crack both eggs into it.
Cook eggs to your preference, breaking yolks if desired, and season with salt and pepper.
Place one cheese slice on the bottom half of each toasted muffin.
Top cheese with a cooked egg, then 2 strips of bacon per sandwich.
Cover with muffin tops and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale and freeze it for quick breakfasts
Use store-brand cheese and English muffins to save 30%

recipes.name: Sausage McMuffin with Egg
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook sausage patties in a skillet over medium heat for 4-5 minutes per side until browned, then set aside.
Split and toast English muffins until lightly golden.
Melt butter in the skillet over medium heat and crack both eggs into it.
Cook eggs sunny-side up or to your preference, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Place one cheese slice on the bottom half of each toasted muffin.
Top cheese with a cooked sausage patty, then an egg.
Cover with muffin tops and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy sausage in bulk and cook ahead for the week
Look for English muffin sales at discount grocers

recipes.name: Breakfast Baconator
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon strips in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, about 5-6 minutes, then drain on paper towels.
Cook frozen hash browns in the same skillet according to package directions until golden and crispy.
Split and toast English muffins until golden.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in the skillet and crack both eggs into it, cooking to your preference.
Assemble each sandwich: muffin bottom, 2 cheese slices, portion of hash browns, 4 bacon strips, one cooked egg.
Top with remaining cheese slice and muffin top.
Serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Use store-brand frozen hash browns and bacon
Buy eggs in bulk and cook multiple sandwiches at once

recipes.name: Croissanwich
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake frozen croissants according to package directions until golden and flaky.
Meanwhile, cook bacon strips in a skillet until crispy, about 5 minutes, then set aside on paper towels.
Melt butter in the skillet over medium heat and crack both eggs into it.
Cook eggs to your preference, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Carefully split the warm croissants in half horizontally.
Layer on bottom croissant half: cheese slice, one cooked egg, 2 bacon strips.
Top with croissant half and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen croissants in bulk from warehouse stores
Cook bacon the night before to save morning time

recipes.name: Crunchwrap Slider Breakfast
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake frozen tater tots according to package directions until golden and crispy.
Cook bacon strips in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, then chop into bite-sized pieces.
Melt butter in the skillet and crack both eggs into it, cooking to your preference.
Heat the flour tortillas in a dry skillet for about 30 seconds per side until warm and pliable.
On each tortilla, layer: cheese slice, portion of tater tots, one cooked egg, bacon pieces, remaining cheese.
Fold tortilla into a square by folding opposite corners to center, then wrap tightly in foil.
Toast wrapped tortillas in a skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes per side until the outer tortilla is crispy, then serve.
cheapTips: Buy tater tots and tortillas on sale and freeze
Use store-brand ingredients throughout

recipes.name: Breakfast Chimichanga
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a deep skillet or Dutch oven to 350°F for frying.
Cook diced potatoes in a separate skillet over medium heat for 8 minutes until softened, then set aside.
Brown breakfast sausage in the same skillet, breaking it into small pieces, then drain excess fat.
Scramble eggs in the skillet until fully cooked, then combine with cooked sausage and potatoes.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side to make them pliable.
Place filling (eggs, sausage, potatoes, cheese, onion) in center of each tortilla, fold in sides, then roll tightly.
Carefully place rolled chimichangas seam-side down in hot oil and fry 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand tortillas and cheese to save 25%
Cook and freeze assembled chimichangas, then fry from frozen

recipes.name: Migas Taco
recipes.description: Tex-Mex breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds per side, then set aside.
Melt butter in the skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion and jalapeño for 2 minutes until softened.
Crack eggs into the skillet and scramble them until partially cooked.
Add crushed tortilla chips to the eggs and stir constantly for 1-2 minutes until eggs are fully cooked and chips are slightly softened.
Stir in shredded cheese and season with salt and pepper.
Divide migas mixture between warm tortillas.
Top with salsa and additional cheese if desired, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use stale tortilla chips you already have at home
Buy eggs and cheese in bulk for this budget-friendly dish

recipes.name: Breakfast Al Pastor
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix achiote paste with lime juice and 1 tbsp olive oil to create a marinade, then rub over pork tenderloin.
Let pork marinate for 10 minutes while you warm tortillas in a dry skillet and set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear marinated pork for 4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Remove pork and let rest for 2 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
In the same skillet, sauté diced onion for 2 minutes until softened, then add pineapple and cook for 1 minute.
Push mixture to the side and scramble eggs in the skillet until cooked through, then combine with pork and pineapple mixture.
Divide filling evenly among warm tortillas and serve with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder instead of tenderloin and cook longer for same flavor
Use canned pineapple to save money

recipes.name: Breakfast Torta
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook sausage patties in a skillet over medium heat for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through, then set aside.
Melt butter in the same skillet and fry both eggs sunny-side up or to your preference, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Slice bolillo rolls in half and hollow out some of the inside crumb to make room for filling.
Spread mayonnaise on the bottom half of each roll.
Layer on each roll bottom: cooked sausage patty, fried egg, sliced cheese, avocado slices, tomato slices.
Sprinkle with fresh cilantro and season with salt and pepper.
Close torta with top half of roll and serve immediately, or wrap in foil to keep warm.
cheapTips: Use regular mozzarella if oaxaca cheese is unavailable
Buy avocados on sale and store in fridge until ready to use

recipes.name: Shui Jiao
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and water until a shaggy dough forms, then knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover dough and let rest for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine ground pork, cabbage, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, and salt in a bowl.
Divide dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each into a thin circle about 3 inches wide.
Place 1 tablespoon filling in center of each wrapper and fold into a crescent, sealing edges tightly.
Bring a large pot of water to boil and drop dumplings in gently.
Simmer for 5-7 minutes until dumplings float, then cook 2 minutes longer.
Remove with a slotted spoon and serve hot with soy sauce or vinegar for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy cabbage in bulk and freeze extras for later use
Use ground pork on sale or substitute with ground chicken to save 30%

recipes.name: Nikuman
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and sugar in a bowl, then add warm water and knead into a smooth dough for 5 minutes.
Let dough rest covered for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and cook ground pork with diced onion until browned, about 4 minutes.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil to the pork mixture, stir well, and let cool.
Divide dough into 6 equal pieces and flatten each into a 3-inch circle.
Place 1 tablespoon filling in the center of each circle and fold edges up to seal, pinching at the top.
Place nikuman on parchment squares in a bamboo steamer and steam for 12-15 minutes until fluffy.
Serve warm as a snack or light meal.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze uncooked nikuman for later steaming
Use store-brand soy sauce instead of premium brands to cut costs

recipes.name: Pork Bun
recipes.description: Hong Kong breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, and baking powder together, then add warm water and oil, kneading into a smooth dough.
Let dough rest covered for 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a wok or pan and stir-fry diced pork until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add diced onion and cook 2 minutes more, then stir in hoisin sauce, soy sauce, and sesame oil, cooking until sauce thickens.
Cool the pork filling completely.
Divide dough into 8 pieces and flatten each into a 3-inch circle.
Place 2 tablespoons filling in center of each circle, fold edges up and pinch to seal into a round bun.
Place buns seam-side down on parchment in a bamboo steamer and steam for 12 minutes until risen and fluffy.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and cut it yourself instead of pre-cubed
Make filling in larger batches and freeze for quick assembly later

recipes.name: Chive Dumpling
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Scramble eggs in a pan and set aside to cool, then chop into small pieces.
Combine cooled scrambled eggs, chives, crumbled tofu, sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic, salt, and white pepper in a bowl.
Place 1 tablespoon of filling in the center of each wonton wrapper.
Wet the edges of the wrapper with water and fold into a triangle, then bring the two corners together and seal.
Bring a large pot of water to boil and carefully drop dumplings in.
Simmer for 5 minutes or until dumplings float and cook 1-2 minutes longer.
Remove with a slotted spoon and serve hot with soy sauce, vinegar, or chili oil.
cheapTips: Buy wonton wrappers in bulk frozen sections for 40% savings
Grow chives on a windowsill to cut fresh herb costs significantly

recipes.name: Soup Dumpling
recipes.description: Shanghainese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and water until shaggy, then knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic, resting 20 minutes covered.
Heat chicken stock and dissolve gelatin in it, then let cool and refrigerate until it becomes a jelly, about 1 hour.
Combine ground pork, minced ginger, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt in a bowl.
Cut the chilled gelatin jelly into small cubes and fold gently into the pork mixture.
Divide dough into 12 pieces and roll each into a thin 3-inch circle.
Place 1 tablespoon pork-gelatin mixture in center of each wrapper and gather edges up, twisting to seal at the top.
Carefully place dumplings in a bamboo steamer lined with parchment and steam for 10-12 minutes.
Serve immediately in bamboo steamers with black vinegar and soy sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Make aspic (gelatin jelly) in batches and freeze in ice cube trays for future use
Use store-brand gelatin instead of name brands to save 50%

recipes.name: Chive Bao
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and sugar, then add warm water and 1 tablespoon oil, kneading into a soft dough.
Let dough rest covered for 20 minutes.
Scramble eggs in a pan and set aside to cool slightly.
Combine scrambled eggs, chopped chives, sesame oil, salt, and white pepper in a bowl.
Divide dough into 8 pieces and roll each into a thin oval about 4 inches long.
Brush each oval with oil and sprinkle filling down the center, then fold in half and seal edges.
Heat remaining oil in a pan over medium heat and pan-fry bao for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve hot with soy sauce or vinegar for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy chives in bulk bunches and freeze chopped in portions
Use vegetable oil instead of specialty oils for significant savings

recipes.name: Vegetable Dumpling
recipes.description: Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine chopped cabbage, grated carrots, minced mushrooms, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and salt in a bowl.
Place about 1 tablespoon filling in the center of each wonton wrapper.
Wet the edges with water and fold into a triangle, then bring the two corners together and seal tightly.
Bring a pot of water to boil and add dumplings carefully.
Simmer for 5-6 minutes until dumplings float, then cook 1 minute longer.
Remove with a slotted spoon and serve hot with dipping sauce like soy sauce or chili oil.
cheapTips: Buy pre-shredded carrots to save time and effort
Purchase vegetables on sale and freeze for dumpling making later

recipes.name: Shrimp Dumpling
recipes.description: Cantonese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince shrimp coarsely and combine with minced pork fat, water chestnuts, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper, and cornstarch.
Place about 1 tablespoon filling in the center of each wonton wrapper.
Wet edges with water and fold into a triangle, then gently bring the two corners together and seal.
Bring a large pot of water to boil and add dumplings carefully.
Simmer for 6-7 minutes until dumplings float and cook 1-2 minutes longer.
Remove with a slotted spoon and serve hot with soy sauce, vinegar, or chili oil.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp on sale and thaw before use for 30% savings
Substitute half the shrimp with finely minced white fish to reduce cost

recipes.name: Guo Tie
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground pork, chopped cabbage, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic in a bowl.
Place 1 tablespoon filling on each wrapper and fold into a half-moon, sealing edges tightly.
Heat oil in a large flat-bottomed pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Arrange dumplings flat-side down in the pan and fry for 2-3 minutes until the bottoms turn golden brown.
Pour water carefully around the dumplings and cover with a lid immediately.
Steam for 5-6 minutes until water is mostly absorbed and dumplings are cooked through.
Remove lid and fry uncovered for 1-2 minutes until bottoms crisp up again.
Serve hot with soy sauce and black vinegar for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy dumpling wrappers in bulk frozen sections and store for weeks
Use ground chicken as a budget-friendly substitute for pork

recipes.name: Mandu
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crumble pressed tofu and combine with ground beef, chopped cabbage, green onions, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt in a bowl.
Place about 1 tablespoon filling in the center of each dumpling wrapper.
Fold the wrapper in half to form a semicircle and press edges to seal, then optionally fold the two corners together.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and arrange mandu in a single layer.
Fry for 2-3 minutes until bottoms are golden, then flip and fry the other side for 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot with soy sauce or a Korean dipping sauce made from soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in meal-sized portions
Make large batches and freeze uncooked mandu for quick weeknight dinners

recipes.name: Bao
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, sugar, and yeast; let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour and baking powder in a bowl, then add yeast mixture and knead until smooth dough forms.
Let dough rise covered for 45 minutes until doubled.
Dice pork and cook with minced garlic, hoisin sauce, and soy sauce until caramelized, then stir in chopped green onions.
Divide dough into 8 pieces and roll each into 3-inch circles.
Place 2 tablespoons filling on each circle, fold in half, and pinch edges to seal.
Place baos on parchment squares and steam in a bamboo steamer or pot with boiling water for 12 minutes until puffy.
Serve immediately while still warm.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for later use
Make dough ahead and refrigerate to save time during meal prep

recipes.name: Dolsot Bibimbap
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice in water until fluffy, about 18 minutes.
Slice beef thinly and marinate in 1 tablespoon soy sauce and sesame oil for 10 minutes.
Blanch spinach briefly, squeeze dry, and toss with minced garlic and salt.
Julienne carrots and zucchini; sauté separately until tender-crisp, season with salt.
Slice mushrooms and sauté until golden with remaining soy sauce.
Heat a stone bowl or cast iron skillet on high heat until very hot.
Add cooked rice to the hot bowl, then arrange all vegetables and cooked beef in sections on top.
Fry an egg sunny-side up and place in the center, then serve with gochujang mixed with sesame oil on the side.
cheapTips: Use mixed vegetables on sale instead of fresh; frozen spinach and mushrooms work well
Buy beef in bulk and portion it yourself rather than pre-sliced

recipes.name: Bulgogi Bowl
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice beef very thinly against the grain.
Combine soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, and sesame oil to make marinade.
Marinate beef for at least 15 minutes while you prepare other ingredients.
Slice onion into thin half-moons.
Heat a large skillet over high heat and cook beef and onions in batches until caramelized, about 3-4 minutes.
Slice cucumber into thin rounds.
Divide cooked rice among bowls and top with lettuce, bulgogi beef, cucumber, and onions.
Sprinkle sesame seeds on top and drizzle with extra sesame oil if desired.
cheapTips: Buy tougher cuts of beef on sale and freeze, then slice partially frozen for thinner slices
Use cabbage instead of lettuce for a cheaper vegetable option

recipes.name: Tteokbokki Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using frozen rice cakes, thaw them in a bowl of warm water for 5 minutes.
Slice fish cake and onion into bite-sized pieces.
Combine gochujang, sugar, soy sauce, minced garlic, and water in a sauce pot.
Bring sauce to a simmer over medium heat.
Add rice cakes and fish cake to the sauce and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add onion and cook for 2 more minutes until softened.
Divide cooked rice between bowls and top with tteokbokki mixture.
Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy rice cakes in bulk from Asian markets for better prices
Omit fish cake and add more vegetables like carrots or cabbage to reduce cost

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized cubes and toss with cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over high heat and stir-fry chicken until cooked through, about 6 minutes; remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, stir-fry minced garlic and dried chilies until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add diced bell pepper and cook until tender-crisp, about 3 minutes.
Return chicken to the skillet and add peanuts and sauce mixture.
Toss everything together until well coated and heated through, about 2 minutes.
Divide cooked rice among bowls and top with kung pao chicken mixture.
cheapTips: Buy peanuts in bulk or use cheaper generic brands
Substitute bell pepper with cheaper vegetables like zucchini or broccoli

recipes.name: Bánh Mì Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, and minced garlic to make marinade.
Slice pork thin and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Julienne carrots and daikon; place in a bowl with vinegar, a pinch of salt, and let sit to pickle.
Heat oil in a skillet over high heat and cook marinated pork until caramelized on edges, about 5 minutes.
Slice cucumber into thin rounds.
Divide cooked rice between bowls and spread a thin layer of pâté on top.
Top rice with cooked pork, pickled vegetables, cucumber slices, and fresh cilantro.
Drizzle with extra fish sauce or lime juice if desired and serve.
cheapTips: Skip the pâté and save $1-2 per serving while keeping the dish authentic
Use chicken thighs instead of pork for similar flavor at lower cost

recipes.name: Pad Khrapow Moo
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat.
Slice shallots and add to the pan with minced garlic and sliced chilies, stirring until fragrant.
Add ground pork and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar; cook for 1 minute.
Tear basil leaves and add to the pork mixture, stirring just until wilted.
Divide cooked rice between bowls and make a well in the center of each portion.
Fry eggs sunny-side up in a separate pan until yolks are still runny.
Top rice with pad khrapow pork and place a fried egg on top of each bowl; serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular basil if thai basil is unavailable or expensive
Buy ground pork in bulk and freeze for future meals

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki Donburi
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces.
Combine soy sauce, mirin, sugar, water, minced garlic, and minced ginger in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken until golden on all sides, about 7 minutes.
Pour teriyaki sauce over chicken and bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through.
Divide cooked rice between donburi bowls.
Spoon teriyaki chicken and sauce over rice.
Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions; serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts; they're cheaper and more flavorful
Substitute honey for mirin if needed (use slightly less)

recipes.name: Tori Soboro Don
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Scramble eggs in a separate pan until just cooked through; set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and ginger, stirring until fragrant.
Add ground chicken and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink, about 6 minutes.
Combine soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and water in a small bowl.
Pour sauce over chicken and add peas, simmering for 3-4 minutes until peas are heated through.
Divide cooked rice between bowls.
Top rice with chicken soboro on one side and scrambled egg on the other side; serve warm.
cheapTips: Use frozen peas instead of fresh to save money
Ground chicken is often cheaper than breasts; buy on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Tamago Gohan
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine soy sauce, mirin, and water in a small bowl to make a sauce.
Place warm cooked rice in a bowl.
Crack eggs directly into the rice and mix vigorously with chopsticks until the eggs are partially cooked by the hot rice.
Pour the sauce over the egg-rice mixture and stir to combine.
Chop green onion and sprinkle over the top.
Tear nori seaweed into small pieces and scatter over the bowl.
Sprinkle sesame seeds on top and serve immediately while still warm.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk; this is one of the cheapest meals you can make
Use homemade soy sauce mixture instead of buying pre-made flavored sauces

recipes.name: Gyu Soboro Don
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions and divide between two bowls.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks for 5-7 minutes until browned.
Add minced ginger and cook for 1 minute, then pour in soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and dashi stock.
Simmer the beef mixture for 3-4 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Push the beef mixture to the sides of the skillet and scramble the eggs in the center for 2-3 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the green peas and cook for 1 minute.
Divide the beef and egg mixture between the rice bowls and pour any remaining sauce over the top.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular soy sauce instead of premium brands.
Substitute peas with frozen mixed vegetables for variety at similar cost.

recipes.name: Shabu Shabu Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring dashi stock to a simmer in a large pot over medium heat.
Add soy sauce and mirin to the broth and stir to combine.
Add napa cabbage, mushrooms, carrots, and tofu to the simmering broth and cook for 5-7 minutes.
Using chopsticks or a small fork, swish thin slices of beef in the hot broth for 10-15 seconds until cooked through and place in a bowl.
Ladle vegetables and broth into a serving bowl over the cooked rice.
Top with cooked beef slices and garnish with scallions.
Serve with ponzu sauce on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck and freeze until partially frozen, then slice thinly instead of pricier sirloin.
Use regular mushrooms instead of shiitake to reduce costs.

recipes.name: Birria de Jalisco
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles and toast them in a dry skillet for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Soak toasted chiles in hot water for 10 minutes until softened.
Blend softened chiles with 1 cup soaking liquid, onion, garlic, vinegar, cumin, and oregano until smooth.
Season beef chuck with salt and pepper, then brown in a large pot over medium-high heat for 8-10 minutes on all sides.
Strain chile sauce and pour over beef, add beef broth and bay leaves, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2.5-3 hours until beef is fall-apart tender.
Remove beef, shred it with forks, and return to the broth to simmer for 15 more minutes.
Warm tortillas and serve birria in shallow bowls with shredded beef and broth, accompanied by lime and onion.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for future use.
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for quick meals later.

recipes.name: Birria Tapatía
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried guajillo and chipotle chiles in a dry skillet for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Soak toasted chiles in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with 1.5 cups soaking liquid, tomato paste, onion, garlic, vinegar, cumin, oregano, and cloves until smooth.
Season beef chuck with salt and pepper and brown in a large pot for 8-10 minutes on all sides.
Strain the chile-tomato sauce and pour over beef, add beef broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2.5-3 hours until beef shreds easily.
Remove beef, shred it, and return to the pot for 15 minutes to absorb flavors.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet until pliable.
Serve birria in shallow bowls with shredded beef, broth, and warm tortillas on the side with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Use tomato paste from a can rather than a tube to save money.
Buy chiles in bulk from a Latin market for better pricing.

recipes.name: Birria de Res
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried guajillo and ancho chiles in a dry skillet for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Soak chiles in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with 1.5 cups soaking liquid, onion, garlic, vinegar, cumin, and oregano until completely smooth.
Cut beef chuck into large chunks and season generously with salt and pepper.
Brown beef in a large pot over medium-high heat for 8-10 minutes on all sides.
Strain chile sauce through a fine mesh sieve into the pot with beef, add beef broth and bay leaves, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2.5-3 hours until beef is very tender.
Shred the beef with two forks and return to the pot, simmering for 10 more minutes.
Serve in bowls with generous amounts of both shredded beef and consomé (broth), accompanied by warm tortillas, lime, and diced onion.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck when on sale and freeze for later cooking.
The consomé keeps for up to 5 days refrigerated, making it great for meal prep.

recipes.name: Birria de Chivo
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried guajillo and pasilla chiles in a dry skillet for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Soak toasted chiles in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with 1.5 cups soaking liquid, onion, garlic, vinegar, cumin, and oregano until smooth.
Season goat meat with salt and pepper and brown in a large pot over medium-high heat for 10-12 minutes on all sides.
Strain chile sauce through a fine sieve over the meat, add chicken broth and bay leaves, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 3-3.5 hours until goat meat is completely tender.
Remove meat, shred it, and return to the pot to simmer for 10 minutes.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet until pliable.
Serve in shallow bowls with shredded goat meat and consomé, accompanied by warm tortillas, lime, and onion.
cheapTips: Check Latin or Middle Eastern markets for better goat meat prices than regular grocery stores.
Make a double batch and freeze portions for future meals.

recipes.name: Birria de Borrego
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried guajillo, ancho, and pasilla chiles in a dry skillet for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Soak chiles in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with 1.5 cups soaking liquid, onion, garlic, vinegar, cumin, and oregano until completely smooth.
Season lamb shoulder pieces with salt and pepper and brown in a large pot over medium-high heat for 10-12 minutes on all sides.
Strain the chile sauce through a fine sieve into the pot with lamb, add beef broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover with a lid, and simmer for 3-3.5 hours until lamb is fall-apart tender.
Shred the cooked lamb with two forks and return to the pot to cook for 10 more minutes.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet until pliable.
Serve in shallow bowls with shredded lamb and rich consomé (broth), accompanied by warm tortillas, lime wedges, and diced white onion.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shoulder instead of more expensive cuts like lamb leg.
The leftover consomé is excellent for rice or soups; refrigerate and use within 4-5 days.

recipes.name: Pozole Blanco
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place pork shoulder cubes in a large pot with chicken broth, half the onion (quartered), and 3 garlic cloves, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes until pork is nearly cooked through.
Add drained hominy, oregano, and cumin to the pot and simmer for 20 more minutes until pork is very tender.
Season the pozole with salt and pepper to taste.
Prepare a serving platter with sliced radishes, shredded cabbage, remaining minced garlic and onion, lime wedges, and tostadas.
Ladle the hot pozole into bowls and allow diners to customize with toppings from the platter.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the top just before eating.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for later use.
Use canned hominy instead of dried to save significant cooking time.

recipes.name: Caldo Tlalpeño
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add quartered onion and crushed garlic cloves.
Add cubed chicken breast and diced carrots and potatoes, then reduce heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Remove 1 cup of hot broth and blend it with chipotle chiles and adobo sauce until smooth, then strain back into the pot.
Season the caldo with salt and pepper to taste and stir in sour cream until fully incorporated.
Add fresh cilantro to the pot and squeeze juice from one lime into the broth.
Ladle caldo into bowls and top with tortilla strips, sliced avocado, additional cilantro, and a lime wedge.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for more flavor at a lower cost.
Buy canned chipotles in bulk and portion into ice cube trays for freezing.

recipes.name: Barbacoa de Borrego
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried guajillo and ancho chiles in a dry skillet for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Soak toasted chiles in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with 1 cup soaking liquid, onion, garlic, vinegar, cumin, and oregano until smooth.
Strain the chile paste through a fine sieve into a large roasting pan.
Season large pieces of lamb shoulder with salt and pepper and place in the pan, coating with the chile paste.
Add broth and bay leaves, cover tightly with foil, and place in a preheated 325°F oven.
Roast for 4-4.5 hours until lamb is extremely tender and shreds easily.
Remove lamb from the pan and shred with forks, then return to the pan to absorb the juices for 15 minutes.
Serve shredded barbacoa on warm tortillas with lime, onion, and cilantro, accompanied by the reduced cooking liquid.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shoulder when on sale and freeze up to 3 months.
Make a large batch and freeze portions of the shredded meat with its cooking liquid for quick tacos throughout the month.

recipes.name: Coquito
recipes.description: Puerto Rican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend coconut milk, evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, and egg yolks in a blender until completely smooth.
Pour mixture into a pitcher and add rum, vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves.
Stir well to combine all ingredients thoroughly.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 2 weeks.
Shake or stir before serving and pour into small glasses over ice.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand evaporated and condensed milk instead of name brands
Use cheaper rum brands; the spices and milk flavors dominate

recipes.name: Bingsu
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crush ice cubes into small, fine shards using a blender or food processor.
Thaw frozen mochi pieces if needed and cut into small cubes.
Drain and rinse canned red beans and corn kernels.
Divide crushed ice evenly between two bowls.
Pour sweetened condensed milk and evaporated milk over the ice in each bowl.
Top with red beans, mochi, and corn kernels.
Sprinkle injeolmi powder over the top and drizzle with additional condensed milk.
cheapTips: Use canned or frozen mochi instead of fresh; it's cheaper and lasts longer
Buy generic canned beans and corn at discount stores

recipes.name: Rolled Ice Cream
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whip heavy cream until soft peaks form, then gently fold in condensed milk and vanilla extract.
Chill a metal baking sheet in the freezer for at least 2 hours.
Pour the ice cream mixture onto the pre-chilled sheet and spread evenly, about 0.5 inch thick.
Freeze for 1-2 hours until the mixture is set but still slightly pliable.
Arrange strawberries in a line on the frozen sheet and sprinkle with sugar and graham cracker crumbs.
Using a metal spatula or bench scraper, gently push and roll the ice cream mixture toward the fruit to create a roll.
Transfer the rolled ice cream to a serving plate and top with chocolate chips and additional toppings if desired.
cheapTips: Use store-brand condensed milk instead of specialty brands
Substitute expensive toppings with budget-friendly options like cereal or crushed cookies

recipes.name: Freakshake
recipes.description: Australian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend vanilla ice cream with whole milk and chocolate syrup until smooth and thick.
Pour the shake into a tall glass.
Top generously with whipped cream.
Layer the chocolate cookie crumbs, chopped chocolate bar, and rainbow sprinkles on top of the whipped cream.
Place the maraschino cherry on the very top and insert a straw.
cheapTips: Use store-brand ice cream and chocolate syrup
Make your own whipped cream from heavy cream instead of buying canned

recipes.name: Unicorn Cake
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a round 8-inch cake pan.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, then beat in eggs one at a time.
Alternate adding flour mixture and milk to the butter mixture, starting and ending with flour.
Divide batter into 3-4 portions and tint each with different gel food coloring.
Layer the colored batters in the pan by spooning each color in a circular pattern, then bake for 35-40 minutes.
Cool completely, then slice the cake horizontally into 2-3 layers.
Stack layers with cream cheese frosting between each, then frost the top and sides.
Decorate with whipped cream piped in horn shape, sprinkles, and edible glitter.
cheapTips: Buy gel food coloring in bulk at craft stores instead of grocery stores
Use store-brand cream cheese frosting instead of making from scratch

recipes.name: Sushi Donut
recipes.description: Japanese-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cooked sushi rice with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, then let cool to room temperature.
Cut nori sheets in half and arrange them on a clean work surface.
Spread seasoned rice evenly on each nori strip, leaving a thin border.
Layer crab, cucumber, avocado, and cream cheese in a line across the rice.
Roll the nori tightly into a cylinder, then form into a donut ring shape and press edges together.
Mix sriracha and soy sauce in a small bowl for dipping sauce.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over the sushi donuts and serve with the dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Use imitation crab instead of real crab to save money
Buy nori sheets in bulk at Asian markets for better prices

recipes.name: Dragon's Breath
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix whole milk, heavy cream, sweetened condensed milk, vanilla extract, and blue food coloring in a bowl.
Stir in fruity cereal pieces.
Carefully pour the mixture into a shallow pan or bowl.
Slowly add liquid nitrogen to the milk mixture while stirring constantly with a wooden spoon (do not use metal).
Continue stirring until the mixture freezes into a creamy ice cream consistency.
Scoop the frozen mixture into serving bowls using a spoon.
Top with whipped cream and serve immediately while still smoking.
cheapTips: Source liquid nitrogen from specialty suppliers or restaurant supply stores
Use cheaper cereal brands for the mix-in pieces

recipes.name: Molten Chocolate Cake
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and grease two 4-oz ramekins generously with butter.
Melt butter and chopped chocolate together in a microwave or double boiler.
Whisk eggs, egg yolks, and granulated sugar together until light and pale.
Gently fold the chocolate mixture into the eggs, then fold in flour, salt, and vanilla extract.
Divide the batter evenly between the prepared ramekins.
Bake for 12-14 minutes until the edges are firm but the center jiggles slightly when tapped.
Run a knife around the edge of each ramekin and invert onto a serving plate.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Use store-brand semi-sweet chocolate instead of expensive imported brands
Buy eggs in bulk for better value

recipes.name: Cronuts au Nutella
recipes.description: French-American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, sugar, and yeast in a bowl, then add warm water and knead until a dough forms.
Laminate the dough by rolling it out, spreading cold butter pieces on top, folding, and repeating 6 times over 30 minutes with rest periods.
Roll the laminated dough to 0.5 inch thickness and cut into donut shapes using a donut cutter.
Let the cronut dough pieces proof for 1-2 hours until puffy.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep pan and fry each cronut for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain fried cronuts on paper towels.
Mix Nutella with 1 tablespoon warm milk to make a spreadable filling, then fill a piping bag.
Whisk powdered sugar with 1 tablespoon milk to make a glaze.
Inject Nutella filling into each warm cronut using the piping bag, then dip the top in powdered sugar glaze.
cheapTips: Use store-brand Nutella instead of the imported version
Make multiple batches and freeze unbaked cronuts to use throughout the week

recipes.name: Black Sesame Ice Cream
recipes.description: Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together heavy cream, whole milk, and egg yolks in a saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring constantly until it reaches 160°F.
Remove from heat and stir in black sesame paste until smooth and fully incorporated.
Add sweetened condensed milk, vanilla extract, and salt, stirring until combined.
Pour the mixture through a fine mesh strainer to remove any lumps.
Chill the mixture completely in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Pour the chilled mixture into an ice cream maker and churn according to manufacturer's instructions, typically 20-25 minutes.
Transfer the soft-serve ice cream to a freezer-safe container and freeze for at least 4 hours until firm.
cheapTips: Buy black sesame paste at Asian grocery stores instead of specialty stores
Make your own ice cream base instead of buying pre-made custard

recipes.name: Matcha Cheesecake
recipes.description: Japanese-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and line a 6-inch springform pan with parchment paper.
Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press into the bottom of the pan to form a crust.
Beat softened cream cheese and sugar together until smooth, then add matcha powder and whisk until no lumps remain.
Add eggs one at a time, beating on low speed after each addition, then stir in sour cream, vanilla, and salt.
Pour filling over crust and place the springform pan in a larger baking dish filled with 1 inch of hot water.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly.
Turn off the oven and crack the door open 4 inches; let the cheesecake cool for 1 hour.
Remove from oven and cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Buy matcha powder in bulk from Asian grocery stores instead of specialty tea shops
Use store-brand cream cheese and sour cream to save 20-30%

recipes.name: Taro Bubble Tea Cake
recipes.description: Taiwanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook tapioca pearls according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 7-inch round cake pan.
Whisk together flour, taro powder, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Beat eggs and sugar together until pale and fluffy, then add oil slowly while mixing.
Alternate adding flour mixture and milk to the egg mixture, starting and ending with flour.
Fold in cooled tapioca pearls and pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes, then invert onto a wire rack to cool completely.
Whip heavy cream with condensed milk and spread over cooled cake before serving.
cheapTips: Find taro powder at Asian markets for $3-5 per bag versus $8+ at specialty stores
Use regular milk instead of specialty milk to reduce cost

recipes.name: Tartine aux Anchois
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the baguette in half lengthwise and lightly toast it in a 400°F oven for 3 minutes.
Spread butter evenly on each toasted baguette half.
Arrange anchovy fillets on top of the buttered bread in a decorative pattern.
Drizzle lightly with lemon juice and sprinkle with fresh parsley, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Cut into serving pieces and serve immediately while still warm.
cheapTips: Buy anchovies in bulk cans from discount grocery stores
Use store-brand butter instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Tartine aux Œufs de Poisson
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the baguette in half lengthwise and toast lightly in a 400°F oven for 3 minutes.
Spread softened butter generously on each warm baguette half.
Spoon fish roe evenly over the buttered bread.
Sprinkle with fresh dill, sea salt, and cracked black pepper.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges on the side for squeezing.
cheapTips: Buy affordable cod roe instead of premium salmon roe
Purchase deli-section baguettes on clearance late in the day

recipes.name: Smørrebrød med Roastbeef
recipes.description: Danish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread softened butter evenly on both slices of rye bread.
Spread a thin layer of horseradish sauce on each buttered slice.
Layer roast beef slices neatly on top of the horseradish.
Thinly slice red onion and scatter over the roast beef.
Sprinkle with fresh parsley, sea salt, and cracked black pepper and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy roast beef from the deli counter on sale rather than pre-packaged
Use store-brand horseradish sauce

recipes.name: Smørrebrød med Leverpostej
recipes.description: Danish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread butter thinly on both slices of rye bread.
Spread liver pâté generously over the buttered bread.
Crumble crispy bacon and sprinkle over the pâté.
Slice cornichons lengthwise and arrange decoratively on top.
Garnish with fresh thyme leaves, fleur de sel, and cracked pepper and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand liver pâté instead of imported varieties
Cook bacon at home and save over buying pre-cooked bacon

recipes.name: Open Sandwich med Räkor
recipes.description: Swedish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread softened butter on both slices of bread.
Mix cooked shrimp with lemon juice, fresh dill, and sea salt in a small bowl.
Spread mayonnaise lightly on each buttered slice.
Distribute shrimp mixture evenly over both slices.
Thinly slice cucumber and red onion and arrange on top of the shrimp.
Season with white pepper and serve chilled or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk and thaw as needed
Use store-brand mayo and butter

recipes.name: Tartine de Pâté de Foie Gras
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the baguette in half lengthwise and toast lightly at 400°F for 3 minutes.
Let the warm bread cool slightly, then spread foie gras pâté generously on each half.
Slice cornichons lengthwise and arrange decoratively on top of the pâté.
Sprinkle with fleur de sel and cracked black pepper.
Garnish with fresh thyme and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy less expensive duck liver pâté as a foie gras substitute
Purchase from French specialty shops during sales

recipes.name: Tartine Jambon Beurre
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the baguette in half lengthwise and lightly toast at 400°F for 3 minutes.
Spread softened butter evenly on both warm halves.
Spread a thin layer of Dijon mustard on the butter.
Layer French ham slices neatly on top of the mustard.
Sprinkle with sea salt and cracked pepper and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use deli-counter ham instead of pricey imported French ham
Buy day-old baguettes at discount prices

recipes.name: Tartine Fromage Chèvre Miel
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the baguette in half lengthwise and lightly toast at 400°F for 3 minutes.
Spread soft goat cheese evenly on both warm baguette halves.
Drizzle honey generously over the goat cheese.
Sprinkle chopped walnuts, fresh thyme leaves, sea salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes on top.
Cut into serving portions and serve immediately while bread is still warm.
cheapTips: Buy goat cheese from the bulk cheese section instead of pre-packaged
Use store-brand honey and raw walnuts

recipes.name: Tartine Crevettes Sauce Rose
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the baguette diagonally into 1/2-inch slices and toast lightly under the broiler until golden.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes per side until pink and cooked through, then set aside.
Mix mayonnaise with tomato paste, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and pepper to make the sauce rosé.
Spread the pink sauce generously on each toasted bread slice.
Top each tartine with 2-3 shrimp and garnish with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp on sale and thaw before cooking to save 20-30%.
Use store-brand mayonnaise and tomato paste to reduce costs.

recipes.name: Tartine Cornichons Moutarde Saucisson
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the baguette diagonally into 1/2-inch slices and lightly toast them.
Spread a thin layer of butter on each warm slice of bread.
Spread Dijon mustard generously over the butter on each slice.
Arrange 2-3 slices of saucisson on each tartine.
Top with 3-4 cornichons, a few capers, and a sprinkle of fresh tarragon.
Serve immediately while the bread is still warm.
cheapTips: Buy saucisson or salami from the deli counter—often cheaper per ounce than pre-packaged.
Make your own cornichons from cucumbers and vinegar if you have time.

recipes.name: Tartine Betterave Chèvre Pistache
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the baguette diagonally and lightly toast the slices until golden.
Spread 1.5 oz of soft goat cheese on each toasted slice.
Dice the beets into small cubes and toss with olive oil, balsamic vinegar, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Spoon the seasoned beets evenly on top of the goat cheese.
Sprinkle the chopped pistachios generously over the beets.
Serve immediately while bread is still warm.
cheapTips: Buy canned beets instead of fresh—often cheaper and no prep work needed.
Use regular roasted peanuts instead of pistachios to reduce cost by 50%.

recipes.name: Tartine Artichauts à la Romaine
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using canned artichokes, drain well and pat dry; if fresh, trim and halve them.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté garlic for 30 seconds.
Add artichoke hearts and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally until lightly browned.
Add fresh parsley, oregano, lemon juice, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper; cook 1 minute more.
Slice the baguette diagonally and brush each slice with remaining olive oil, then toast lightly.
Spoon the warm artichoke mixture onto each toasted slice and top with grated Parmesan cheese.
cheapTips: Use canned artichokes instead of fresh to save time and money.
Skip the Parmesan or use a smaller amount to reduce costs.

recipes.name: Smørrebrød med Spegepølse og Remoulade
recipes.description: Danish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread a generous layer of butter on each slice of rye bread.
Mix mayonnaise, whole grain mustard, cornichons, capers, and parsley together to make remoulade sauce.
Spread the remoulade sauce evenly over the buttered bread.
Layer the sliced spiced salami on top of the remoulade, folding slices slightly for visual appeal.
Arrange thin radish slices on top of the salami.
Season with salt and pepper and serve cold or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy salami from a European deli counter rather than pre-packaged to save money.
Make your own remoulade instead of buying pre-made condiments.

recipes.name: Tartine Crème de Champignons
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the baguette diagonally into 1/2-inch slices and toast lightly until golden.
Heat 2 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté shallots and garlic for 1 minute.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they release their liquid and begin to brown.
Reduce heat to medium, add cream, Dijon mustard, and thyme, and simmer for 2-3 minutes until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Spread the remaining 1 tbsp butter on each toasted bread slice, then top with the mushroom cream sauce and garnish with fresh chives.
cheapTips: Use button mushrooms instead of specialty mushrooms to keep costs down.
Substitute heavy cream with sour cream or Greek yogurt for a cheaper, tangier sauce.

recipes.name: Birria Estilo Nayarit
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef chuck roast on all sides until deeply caramelized, about 10 minutes total.
Remove stems and seeds from guajillo and ancho chiles, then soak them in hot water for 10 minutes until softened.
Blend the softened chiles with garlic, onion, tomato paste, vinegar, oregano, and cumin until smooth, then strain through a fine sieve.
Return the browned beef to the pot and pour the chile sauce and beef broth over it.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 2.5 hours until meat shreds easily.
Shred the beef using two forks and return it to the broth.
Serve the birria in bowls with the broth, topped with diced onion and cilantro, with warm tortillas on the side for dipping.
For birria tacos, dip tortillas in the hot broth and fill with shredded beef, then pan-fry until crispy.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for later use
Dried chiles are often cheaper in bulk at Latin markets than supermarkets

recipes.name: Escudella
recipes.description: Catalan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch chicken thighs, pork shoulder, and beef shank for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Place the blanched meats back in the pot with fresh chicken broth, halved onion, and thyme sprigs.
Bring to a gentle boil, skim foam from the surface, then reduce heat and simmer for 1.5 hours until meat is tender.
Slice chorizo and add to the broth, then simmer for 10 minutes to infuse flavor.
Cut cabbage into wedges, chop carrots, peel and quarter potatoes, and cube turnips.
Add all vegetables to the pot and simmer for 30-40 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Remove meat from bones if desired, season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in deep bowls with both meat and vegetables in broth, with crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for better flavor and lower cost
Buy vegetables in season and frozen options are fine for this dish

recipes.name: Cassoeula
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the pork ribs and sausage on all sides until golden, about 12 minutes.
Remove meat and set aside, then sauté diced onion, carrots, and celery in the same pot until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add minced garlic and tomato paste, stirring constantly for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Deglaze the pot with white wine, scraping up browned bits, then let it reduce by half.
Return the meat to the pot and add canned tomatoes with their juice and beef broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 1 hour until meat is tender.
Roughly chop the cabbage and stir it into the pot, then simmer uncovered for another 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot in bowls with crusty bread to soak up the sauce.
cheapTips: Buy pork ribs on sale or from a butcher counter for better pricing
Use fresh cabbage rather than pre-cut for better value

recipes.name: Tagine de Cordero
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot or tagine over medium-high heat and brown the lamb cubes in batches until golden on all sides, about 10 minutes total.
Remove lamb and set aside, then sauté diced onions and garlic in the same pot until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced ginger, cumin, cinnamon, and turmeric, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return the lamb to the pot and add chicken broth, then bring to a boil and skim any foam from the surface.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours until lamb is very tender.
Add dried apricots and dates to the pot along with honey, then simmer uncovered for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper as needed.
Serve the tagine over couscous or with crusty bread, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
cheapTips: Buy dried apricots and dates from bulk bins rather than packaged
Lamb shoulder is much cheaper than lamb chops or legs for this braised dish

recipes.name: Puchero Andaluz
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch beef cubes and chicken thighs for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Return the meat to the pot with beef broth, halved onions, garlic, paprika, and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil, skim foam, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 1 hour.
Slice chorizo and add to the pot along with drained chickpeas, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Cut potatoes into quarters, cube the pumpkin, and chop cabbage into wedges.
Add all vegetables to the pot and simmer for 45 minutes until vegetables are tender and meat is very soft.
Remove bay leaves and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in deep bowls with equal amounts of meat, chickpeas, vegetables, and broth.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas instead of dried to save soaking time and effort
Use frozen pumpkin if fresh is unavailable

recipes.name: Birria de Adobo
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place beef chuck roast in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil, then simmer for 30 minutes and drain.
Toast ancho chiles in a dry skillet for 30 seconds on each side, then soak in hot water for 10 minutes.
Blend softened ancho chiles, chipotle peppers with sauce, garlic, half the onion, vinegar, cumin, and oregano until smooth.
Strain the chile mixture through a fine sieve to remove solids.
Return the par-cooked beef to a clean pot and pour the strained chile sauce and beef broth over it.
Add bay leaves, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 2.5 hours until meat shreds easily with a fork.
Shred the beef and return it to the broth, then simmer for 15 more minutes.
Serve in bowls with the cooking liquid, diced onion, and fresh lime wedges, with warm tortillas for dipping.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze portions for future quick meals
Buy canned chipotle peppers in bulk and store for multiple recipes

recipes.name: Caldillo de Congrio
recipes.description: Chilean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onions and minced garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and paprika, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in white wine and let it reduce by half, about 3 minutes.
Add fish broth and bring to a boil, then add cubed potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are almost tender.
Cut the fish into large chunks and carefully add to the pot, then reduce heat to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 8-10 minutes until fish is opaque and cooked through, being careful not to overcook.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh lime juice to taste.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley, serving with crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Use inexpensive white fish like cod or pollock if conger eel is unavailable or expensive
Buy fish from the counter near closing time for potential discounts

recipes.name: Basque Burnt Cheesecake
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a 9-inch round springform pan with parchment paper, allowing it to come up the sides.
Beat room-temperature cream cheese and heavy cream together until smooth, about 2 minutes.
Add sugar and beat until combined, then add eggs one at a time, beating just until incorporated after each addition.
Stir in vanilla extract and salt until fully combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes until the edges are deep brown but the center still jiggles slightly when shaken.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature on the counter, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Release from the springform and peel back the parchment paper.
Slice with a hot knife wiped between cuts, and serve cold or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy cream cheese on sale and freeze for later use
Make your own vanilla extract or use imitation vanilla to save money

recipes.name: Mochi Donut
recipes.description: Japanese-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together mochiko flour, all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat egg and mix with milk until combined.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until a soft dough forms, being careful not to overmix.
Transfer dough to a piping bag fitted with a large round tip and heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot.
Pipe dough into ring shapes directly into the hot oil, frying 3-4 donuts at a time without crowding.
Fry for 1-1.5 minutes per side until light golden brown, then remove with a slotted spoon to a paper towel-lined plate.
While still warm, toss the donuts in a mixture of powdered sugar and cinnamon.
Serve warm or at room temperature within a few hours of frying.
cheapTips: Find mochiko flour at Asian markets for much cheaper than specialty stores
Reuse frying oil multiple times before discarding to save money

recipes.name: Ube Dessert
recipes.description: Filipino snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat and stir in crushed graham crackers until fully coated.
Press the graham cracker mixture into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish to form a crust.
In the same saucepan, combine condensed milk, evaporated milk, ube extract, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt.
Heat the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring constantly for 8-10 minutes until it thickens slightly.
Add food coloring if desired to enhance the purple color, stirring well.
Pour the ube mixture over the graham cracker crust, spreading evenly.
Allow to cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours until set.
Cut into squares and serve chilled, storing leftovers covered in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
cheapTips: Use ube powder from Asian markets which is much cheaper than specialty food stores
Buy condensed and evaporated milk on sale and stock up

recipes.name: Tostas de Jamón Ibérico
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the bread into ½-inch thick pieces and arrange on a baking sheet.
Brush both sides lightly with olive oil and toast in a 400°F oven for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
While warm, rub the cut garlic clove over the surface of each toast.
Halve the tomato and rub it gently across the toasted bread to leave juice and pulp.
Drizzle lightly with olive oil and sprinkle with sea salt.
Tear the jamón into pieces and arrange on top of each tosta.
Serve immediately while the bread is still warm.
cheapTips: Substitute jamón with regular prosciutto to save 40%
Use day-old bread from a bakery discount bin

recipes.name: Tartine Saumon Fumé Crème Fraîche
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy, about 3 minutes per side.
While warm, spread a thin layer of butter on each slice, then generously spread crème fraîche on top.
Arrange thin slices of smoked salmon over the crème fraîche.
Top with red onion slices and sprinkle capers over the salmon.
Finish with a small sprinkle of fresh dill and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy smoked salmon ends and pieces instead of sliced—same flavor at half the price
Make crème fraîche at home with heavy cream and lemon juice

recipes.name: Tartine Tapenade Olives Noires
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine pitted black olives, capers, anchovy fillets, and minced garlic in a food processor.
Pulse until roughly chopped but still slightly textured, not a smooth paste.
Add lemon juice, thyme, and olive oil, then pulse 2-3 more times until combined.
Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
Spread a generous layer of tapenade on each warm toast.
Drizzle with a little extra olive oil and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned or jarred black olives in bulk—they're much cheaper than fresh
Make a double batch and refrigerate in a jar for 1-2 weeks

recipes.name: Tartine Rillettes
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork into 1-inch cubes and place in a pot with quartered onion, garlic, bay leaf, thyme, salt, and water to cover.
Bring to a simmer and cook covered for 25-30 minutes until pork is very tender.
Drain the pork, reserving ¼ cup cooking liquid, and discard aromatics.
Shred the warm pork with two forks until it resembles pulled meat.
Transfer to a bowl and mix in softened butter, salt, pepper, and cornichons if using, adding reserved cooking liquid 1 tbsp at a time until spreadable.
Toast bread slices until golden and spread rillettes generously on each.
Serve warm or at room temperature with cornichons on the side.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for later—it's always affordable
Skip cornichons and use diced pickles from the jar instead

recipes.name: Tartine Camembert Pomme
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
Spread a thin layer of soft butter on each warm slice.
Slice or crumble the camembert cheese and arrange on the toast.
Core and thinly slice the apple, then arrange the slices over the cheese.
Drizzle lightly with honey and top with fresh thyme leaves.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately while the cheese is still warm and melting.
cheapTips: Use honeycrisp or gala apples on sale instead of premium varieties
Buy camembert near its sell-by date for 30% off

recipes.name: Tartine Mozzarella Tomate Basilic
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
Lightly drizzle one side of each toast with olive oil.
Slice the tomato into ¼-inch thick rounds and pat dry with a paper towel.
Tear the fresh mozzarella into bite-sized pieces.
Layer tomato slices and mozzarella on each toast, then top with fresh basil leaves.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy pre-made mozzarella balls from the salad bar in bulk
Use Roma or on-sale tomatoes instead of heirloom varieties

recipes.name: Tartine Roquefort Noix Miel
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
Spread softened butter thinly on each slice.
Crumble roquefort cheese evenly over the buttered toast.
Scatter chopped walnuts over the cheese.
Drizzle honey generously over each tartine.
Top with fresh thyme and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy roquefort from the cheese counter crumbled instead of blocks—same price, no waste
Use raw walnuts in bulk bins instead of packaged

recipes.name: Tartine Ricotta Œuf Poché
recipes.description: Italian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
Bring 4 cups water and 1 tbsp vinegar to a gentle simmer in a shallow pan.
Spread 2 tbsp ricotta on each toast and drizzle with ½ tbsp olive oil.
Crack one egg into a small cup, then gently slide it into the simmering water.
Cook the poached egg for 3-4 minutes until the white is set but the yolk remains soft.
Using a slotted spoon, gently transfer the egg to the ricotta toast.
Repeat with the second egg, then top both with red pepper flakes, salt, pepper, lemon juice, and remaining olive oil.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ricotta in bulk and use cheaper store brands—flavor is nearly identical
Use eggs on sale and store in the fridge up to 4 weeks

recipes.name: Tartine Aïoli Œuf Dur
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place 2 eggs in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil, then remove from heat and let sit 10 minutes for hard-boiled eggs.
While eggs cook, make aïoli by mincing garlic finely and whisking with 1 egg yolk in a bowl.
Add olive oil drop by drop while whisking constantly until the mixture emulsifies and thickens.
Once half the oil is incorporated, add oil in a thin stream while continuing to whisk.
Finish by whisking in lemon juice and season with salt and pepper.
Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
Peel and slice the hard-boiled eggs, then spread aïoli generously on each toast.
Arrange egg slices on top, sprinkle with paprika, and serve.
cheapTips: Make aïoli in a food processor if whisking by hand is difficult—works just as well
Buy eggs on sale and hard-boil a dozen to use all week

recipes.name: Tartine Thon Mayonnaise Œuf
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place eggs in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil, then remove from heat and let sit 10 minutes.
Drain tuna thoroughly and flake it into a bowl.
Mix tuna with mayonnaise, lemon juice, diced red onion, cornichons, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Toast bread slices until golden and crispy.
Peel and slice the hard-boiled eggs.
Spread the tuna mixture generously on each toast.
Top with sliced hard-boiled eggs and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned tuna on sale and stock up—shelf-stable for 2+ years
Use store-brand mayonnaise instead of name brands—taste is nearly identical

recipes.name: Fish Sticks
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Line a baking sheet with foil and lightly brush with vegetable oil.
Arrange frozen fish sticks on the baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden and crispy.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with tartar sauce and lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand frozen fish sticks instead of name brands to save 30%
Skip the tartar sauce and use ketchup or mayo to reduce costs

recipes.name: Cheese Pizza
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and a pinch of sugar and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour and salt in a bowl, then pour in yeast mixture and olive oil.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth, then let rise for 15 minutes covered.
Preheat oven to 475°F and grease a 12-inch pizza pan.
Press dough into the pan, spread pizza sauce evenly, and top with mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle oregano over cheese and bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden and cheese bubbles.
