Mix soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and water together in a small bowl.
Combine ground sesame seeds with the sauce mixture.
Toss okra with the sesame sauce until well coated.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy okra when in season for the best prices
Toast your own sesame seeds instead of buying pre-ground

recipes.name: Inari Sushi
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm cooked rice with vinegar, sugar, and salt until fully combined.
Finely dice carrot and cucumber into small pieces and fold into the rice with sesame seeds.
Carefully open each tofu pouch by gently separating the layers at the top.
Fill each pouch with about 2 tablespoons of the sushi rice mixture, pressing gently so it stays full.
Arrange filled pouches on a plate seam-side down.
Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.
cheapTips: Buy canned fried tofu pouches in bulk online
Use leftover rice to reduce cooking time

recipes.name: Meatball Nikomi
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince onion finely and mix with ground beef, panko, and egg until just combined.
Roll mixture into 12-16 meatballs about 1.5 inches in diameter.
Heat a pot over medium-high heat and brown meatballs on all sides for 6-8 minutes total.
Pour off excess fat, then add water, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar to the pot.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15-18 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve hot over rice.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for future use
Make a double batch and freeze extras for quick meals

recipes.name: Honey Walnut Prawns
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss shrimp with cornstarch, salt, and pepper.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat and cook shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side until pink, then remove and set aside.
In the same pan, toast walnuts in the remaining oil for 2-3 minutes until fragrant, stirring constantly.
Mix mayonnaise, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, and minced garlic in a small bowl.
Return shrimp to the pan and add the honey-mayo sauce, tossing quickly for 1-2 minutes until coated and heated through.
Serve immediately over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and thaw before cooking to save money
Use raw walnuts from bulk bins instead of pre-packaged

recipes.name: Char Siu Pork
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine soy sauce, honey, hoisin, vinegar, minced garlic, minced ginger, and food coloring in a bowl to make the marinade.
Place pork in a zip-lock bag, pour marinade over, seal, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Place pork on the baking sheet and brush generously with marinade.
Roast for 25-30 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F, basting with remaining marinade halfway through.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain and serve with steamed vegetables and rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork tenderloin on sale and freeze for later use
Make a larger batch and use leftovers for fried rice

recipes.name: Potluck Casserole
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and cook egg noodles according to package directions, then drain.
Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, then add diced onion and cook until softened.
In a large bowl, combine cooked noodles, cooked beef and onion, cream of mushroom soup, milk, frozen vegetables, and 1 cup of cheese.
Transfer mixture to a greased 9x13 inch baking dish and season with salt and pepper.
Mix breadcrumbs with 2 tablespoons melted butter and remaining 0.5 cup cheese, then sprinkle over top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until heated through and topping is golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze; use store-brand soup and cheese
Substitute frozen mixed vegetables for fresh to save money

recipes.name: Tater Tot Casserole
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat with diced onion, then drain excess fat.
Stir in both cans of soup and milk, then season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Pour beef mixture into a 9x13 inch greased baking dish and spread evenly.
Arrange frozen tater tots in a single layer over the beef mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until tater tots are golden and crispy, then sprinkle cheese on top.
Return to oven for 2-3 minutes until cheese is melted.
cheapTips: Buy frozen tater tots in bulk and ground beef on sale
Use store-brand soups to reduce costs significantly

recipes.name: Brioche French Toast
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together eggs, milk, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt in a shallow bowl.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat until foaming.
Dip each brioche slice into the egg mixture for 1-2 seconds per side, allowing excess to drip off.
Place coated slices in the hot skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer cooked french toast to a serving plate.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with maple syrup.
cheapTips: Use day-old brioche from the bakery section or day-old bread sales
Make your own cinnamon sugar topping instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Eggs Blackstone
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prepare hollandaise sauce by whisking 3 egg yolks with 1 tablespoon lemon juice over gentle heat, slowly adding 6 tablespoons melted butter and seasoning with salt and cayenne.
Toast English muffin halves and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet, add minced garlic and fresh spinach, cooking until wilted, then season with salt and pepper.
Heat 2 tablespoons butter in the same skillet and fry eggs sunny-side up until whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Layer each muffin half with sautéed spinach, followed by a tomato slice and a fried egg.
Pour hollandaise sauce generously over each assembled egg and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand English muffins and buy eggs in bulk
Make hollandaise ahead and reheat gently to save time

recipes.name: Sausage Rolls
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix sausage meat with breadcrumbs, chopped sage, mustard powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Roll out thawed puff pastry and cut lengthwise into two long strips.
Divide sausage mixture in half and shape into two long logs, placing one on each pastry strip.
Roll pastry around sausage, sealing the edge with water, then cut into 6 equal pieces per roll.
Beat egg with 1 tablespoon water and brush over each sausage roll.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until pastry is golden brown and cooked through.
cheapTips: Buy bulk pork sausage and make your own instead of using pre-made rolls
Use store-brand puff pastry; quality is identical at lower cost

recipes.name: Avgolemono Soup
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add diced onion and rice.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15-18 minutes until rice is tender.
Whisk eggs and lemon juice together in a bowl until well combined.
Slowly ladle hot broth into the egg-lemon mixture while whisking constantly to temper the eggs.
Pour the egg-lemon mixture back into the pot, stirring gently to combine.
Add shredded cooked chicken and fresh dill, then season with salt and white pepper.
Heat through without boiling and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the grocery store for convenience and value
Make your own chicken broth from bones if available

recipes.name: Soft Pretzel
recipes.description: German snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and sugar in a bowl and let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Add flour and salt to the yeast mixture and knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth dough forms.
Cover dough and let rise in a warm place for 45 minutes until doubled.
Divide dough into 6 equal pieces and roll each into a long rope, then twist into a pretzel shape.
Bring 2 quarts water to a boil and add baking soda, then boil each pretzel for 30 seconds on each side.
Place boiled pretzels on a greased baking sheet, brush with melted butter, and sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake at 425°F for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and serve with mustard.
cheapTips: Buy instant yeast in bulk from warehouse stores
Make several pretzels at once and freeze extras for later

recipes.name: Toast with Butter and Jam
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast bread slices in a toaster until golden brown on both sides.
Immediately spread warm toast with butter, allowing it to melt into the bread.
Spread jam generously over the buttered toast.
Serve warm and enjoy immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand bread and jam to minimize costs
Purchase bread on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Matzo Ball Soup
recipes.description: Jewish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk eggs with oil in a bowl, then fold in matzo meal, dill, salt, and pepper.
Cover mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add sliced carrots and chopped celery.
Wet your hands and shape matzo mixture into balls about 1.5 inches in diameter.
Carefully drop matzo balls into boiling broth and reduce heat to a simmer.
Cover pot and simmer for 35-40 minutes until matzo balls are cooked through and tender.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand chicken broth in bulk when on sale
Make matzo ball mixture ahead and refrigerate up to 24 hours

recipes.name: Risotto
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable broth in a separate pot and keep it simmering throughout cooking.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large, heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 2-3 minutes.
Add Arborio rice and stir constantly for 1-2 minutes until rice becomes translucent at edges.
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed by the rice.
Add hot broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding more, about 18-20 minutes total.
When rice is creamy and tender, remove from heat and stir in remaining butter and Parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy Arborio rice in bulk from warehouse stores or Italian markets
Use vegetable scraps to make your own broth instead of buying

recipes.name: Skewered Meat Kebabs
recipes.description: Middle Eastern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes to prevent burning.
Cut beef into 1.5-inch cubes and mix with olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Marinate meat for at least 15 minutes while you cut onions and peppers into chunks.
Thread meat onto skewers alternating with onion and pepper pieces.
Preheat grill or grill pan to high heat.
Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes until meat is cooked through.
Remove from heat and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use seasonal bell peppers for better pricing

recipes.name: Paella Campera
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large paella pan or wide skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and chorizo into slices, then brown both in the pan for 5-7 minutes and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté diced onion, garlic, and peppers for 3 minutes until softened.
Add rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes until slightly toasted.
Steep saffron in warm broth for 2 minutes, then add all broth to the pan along with cooked chicken and chorizo.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes without stirring.
Check that rice is tender and liquid is absorbed; if needed, cook 2-3 more minutes.
Remove from heat, cover with foil, and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Skip saffron and use turmeric for similar color and save $3
Buy chicken in bulk and freeze portions ahead of time

recipes.name: Grilled Trout
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat grill to medium-high heat and oil the grates lightly.
Pat trout fillets dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Slice lemon and mince garlic, then scatter on top of fillets along with fresh dill.
Place small pats of butter on each fillet.
Grill fillets skin-side up for 8-10 minutes until flesh is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
Carefully transfer to plates and serve immediately with remaining lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy frozen trout fillets instead of fresh to save $2-3 per serving
Substitute dried dill if fresh is unavailable

recipes.name: Sausage and Peppers
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown sausages on all sides for 8 minutes, then remove and slice into 2-inch pieces.
In the same skillet, sauté sliced peppers, onion, and garlic for 5 minutes until softened.
Return sausage pieces to the pan and add tomato sauce and oregano.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve on crusty bread or over pasta.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand sausages to save $1-2 per pound
Use canned tomato sauce instead of fresh tomatoes for year-round affordability

recipes.name: Dutch Oven Bread
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, water, salt, and yeast in a large bowl until a shaggy dough forms; cover and let rest 12-24 hours at room temperature.
Preheat Dutch oven in a 500°F oven for 30 minutes.
Shape dough into a round ball on a floured surface.
Carefully place dough into the preheated Dutch oven and score the top with a sharp knife.
Cover with the lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and bake another 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
Remove from Dutch oven and cool on a wire rack for at least 1 hour before slicing.
cheapTips: Buy flour in bulk from warehouse stores
One package of yeast lasts months and costs under $5

recipes.name: Foil Packet Potatoes
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice potatoes into 0.5-inch cubes and divide equally among 4 pieces of heavy-duty foil.
Top each portion with butter, minced garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Fold foil into sealed packets, making sure steam can circulate inside.
Place packets on grill or campfire coals at medium-high heat for 20-25 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Carefully open packets to avoid steam burns.
Top with cheese and bacon bits, then fold packets closed for 1 minute to melt cheese.
Transfer to plates and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip bacon bits and use imitation bacon for half the price
Buy potatoes in 10-lb bags for better per-pound cost

recipes.name: Campfire Pizza
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Divide pizza dough into 4 equal portions and stretch each into a thin round.
Oil a cast-iron skillet or pizza pan and place over campfire grate at medium heat.
Place one pizza dough round in the skillet and cook 2-3 minutes until lightly golden on the bottom.
Flip dough and quickly add sauce, cheese, pepperoni, peppers, and onion.
Cover with foil and cook 5-7 minutes until cheese melts and bottom is crispy.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining dough and toppings.
Sprinkle oregano over each pizza and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand pizza dough instead of making from scratch
Use grocery store brand cheese to save $2-3 per pizza

recipes.name: Trail Mix
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine almonds, cashews, and sunflower seeds in a large bowl.
Add dried cranberries and raisins and mix well.
Stir in chocolate chips and coconut flakes.
Transfer to a resealable container or individual snack bags for portability.
Store in a cool, dry place for up to 2 weeks.
cheapTips: Buy nuts from bulk bins instead of pre-packaged
Use store-brand chocolate chips and dried fruit

recipes.name: Campfire Stew
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a large pot or Dutch oven, brown beef pieces over medium-high heat for 8 minutes on all sides.
Add diced onion and celery and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Pour in beef broth and tomato paste, stirring well to combine.
Add diced potatoes, carrots, and thyme, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 40 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy beef stew meat on sale and freeze for future camp trips
Use carrot and potato scraps to reduce waste

recipes.name: Roasted Marshmallows
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place a marshmallow on a roasting stick or long fork.
Hold the marshmallow 4-6 inches above medium-hot campfire coals, rotating slowly for even browning.
Roast for 2-3 minutes until the exterior is golden and the inside is soft.
Break a piece of chocolate in half and place on a graham cracker.
Slide the roasted marshmallow off the stick onto the chocolate.
Top with another graham cracker to form a sandwich, pressing gently so the marshmallow melts the chocolate.
Let cool for 10 seconds before eating.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand marshmallows instead of name-brand
Purchase graham crackers and chocolate when on sale and stock up

recipes.name: Croissant
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a large bowl.
Add milk and water, mixing until a shaggy dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
Wrap dough in plastic and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Pound cold butter between plastic wrap into a 6x8 inch rectangle, keeping it pliable but cool.
Roll dough into a 12x8 inch rectangle, place butter in center, fold dough over butter, seal edges, then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll dough to 12x24 inches, fold into thirds, rotate 90 degrees, roll and fold again; repeat this process 3 times total with 30-minute rests between folds.
After final fold, refrigerate overnight, then cut into triangles, roll each into a crescent shape, and place on parchment paper.
Let croissants proof at room temperature for 1.5-2 hours until puffy.
Brush with beaten egg wash and bake at 400°F for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand butter in bulk when on sale and freeze
Make 8-12 croissants at once to reduce per-unit cost

recipes.name: Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized chunks and marinate in yogurt, garam masala, cumin, paprika, half the garlic, and salt for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken until golden, about 8-10 minutes; set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté onion, remaining garlic, and ginger until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes to reduce slightly.
Return chicken to skillet, add cream, and simmer for 10-12 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce thickens.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve over cooked basmati rice with cilantro and lime if desired.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for better value
Use canned tomatoes and make spice blends at bulk stores

recipes.name: Texas Brisket
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix black pepper, salt, and garlic powder to create a dry rub and coat entire brisket generously.
Place brisket fat-side up on a large piece of foil in a roasting pan.
Mix beef broth, vinegar, brown sugar, and liquid smoke, then pour around (not over) the brisket.
Wrap foil tightly around brisket, seal completely, and place in a 325°F oven.
Cook for approximately 14-15 hours (about 2 hours per pound) until fork-tender; check at 12 hours by piercing foil.
Remove from oven and let rest in foil for 30 minutes.
Unwrap carefully, slice against the grain into 0.5-inch thick pieces, and serve with pan drippings.
cheapTips: Buy brisket when on sale at warehouse clubs
Use the rendered fat for future cooking to maximize value

recipes.name: Argentinian Asado
recipes.description: Argentine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix garlic, parsley, oregano, cumin, olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper to create chimichurri sauce.
Reserve half the chimichurri for serving and brush remaining sauce over both sides of ribs and steaks.
Prepare a charcoal grill for medium heat or heat a grill pan over medium-high heat.
Grill short ribs first for 25-30 minutes, turning every 5 minutes and basting with chimichurri.
Add steaks to grill and cook 8-10 minutes per side for medium-rare, basting frequently.
Transfer meat to a cutting board and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with reserved chimichurri sauce on the side and crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy beef ribs from a butcher counter, often cheaper than packaged
Make extra chimichurri and freeze in ice cube trays for future use

recipes.name: Korean Bulgogi
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice beef very thinly (partially freeze for 1 hour first for easier slicing) and place in a bowl.
Combine soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger, and scallion to make marinade.
Pour marinade over beef, toss to coat evenly, and let sit for 10-15 minutes.
Heat a large skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat until very hot.
Working in batches to avoid crowding, cook beef for 2-3 minutes per side until caramelized.
Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve immediately with steamed rice and lettuce wraps if desired.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck roast instead of sirloin and thinly slice for 30% savings
Buy soy sauce and sesame oil at Asian markets for half the price

recipes.name: Brazilian Churrasco
recipes.description: Brazilian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef picanha into 1.5-inch thick steaks and score the fat cap in a crosshatch pattern.
Mix garlic, cilantro, parsley, lime juice, and olive oil to create chimichurri marinade.
Coat steaks generously with salt on both sides and brush with half the chimichurri.
Prepare a charcoal grill for high heat, or heat a grill pan over medium-high heat.
Grill steaks for 5-7 minutes per side for medium-rare, basting with marinade and rotating for grill marks.
Let meat rest for 10 minutes, then slice against the grain into strips.
Serve with remaining chimichurri, grilled onions, and rice or beans.
cheapTips: Substitute with beef chuck roast cut into steaks if picanha unavailable
Buy at Brazilian or Latin markets for better cuts and prices

recipes.name: Japanese Yakitori
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, and garlic in a small saucepan and heat until sugar dissolves; let cool.
Thread chicken pieces and 1-inch scallion pieces alternately onto skewers.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Grill yakitori skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, brushing with glaze during the last minute of cooking.
Continue rotating and basting until chicken is cooked through and glaze is caramelized, about 8-10 minutes total.
Transfer to a serving plate, sprinkle with sesame seeds and extra scallion, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs in bulk frozen and break down yourself
Make double batch of glaze and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks

recipes.name: Turkish Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground beef with onion, parsley, mint, garlic, paprika, cumin, and egg until well combined.
Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Divide mixture into 8 portions and mold each around a skewer in an elongated shape.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat and brush with oil.
Grill kebabs for 10-12 minutes, rotating every 2-3 minutes to cook evenly.
Kebabs are done when no longer pink in the center and caramelized on outside.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving with flatbread, tomato, cucumber, and yogurt sauce.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions
Grow fresh herbs like parsley and mint to cut costs significantly

recipes.name: Greek Souvlaki
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper to create marinade.
Toss pork with marinade and let sit for 15 minutes.
Thread pork, bell pepper, and onion pieces alternately onto skewers.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat.
Grill skewers for 12-15 minutes, rotating every 3 minutes, until pork is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Serve with tzatziki sauce, pita bread, and Greek salad.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder instead of tenderloin and cube yourself for savings
Use seasonal vegetables like zucchini to cut costs

recipes.name: Moroccan Brochettes
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground lamb with onion, cilantro, parsley, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, garlic, and egg until well blended.
Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Divide mixture into 8 portions and mold each around a skewer into a long, compact shape.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat.
Grill brochettes for 10-12 minutes, rotating every 2-3 minutes until cooked through and browned.
Transfer to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve with hummus, couscous, harissa, and fresh lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of lamb to reduce cost by 40%
Buy spices from Middle Eastern or Indian markets in bulk

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut flank steak against the grain into thin slices and coat with 1 tablespoon cornstarch and salt.
Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat and cook beef in batches until browned, about 2-3 minutes per batch; set aside.
Add remaining oil to the skillet and stir-fry broccoli florets for 3-4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Return beef to the skillet and add minced garlic and ginger, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, water, and remaining cornstarch in a bowl, then pour into the skillet and stir constantly until sauce thickens, about 2 minutes.
Drizzle with sesame oil, toss to combine, and serve over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy flank steak on sale and freeze for later use
Use frozen broccoli instead of fresh to save 30-40%

recipes.name: Sesame Chicken
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix flour and cornstarch in a shallow bowl, season with salt and pepper, then coat chicken pieces evenly.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry chicken in batches until golden and cooked through, about 4-5 minutes per batch; set aside.
In the same skillet, add remaining oil and sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and honey in a bowl, then pour into skillet and stir until combined.
Return chicken to skillet and toss to coat in sauce, cooking for 2 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and green onions over chicken and serve immediately with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken breast instead of thighs to save 20 cents per serving
Toast sesame seeds at home in bulk for 70% less cost

recipes.name: Tikka Masala Chicken
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and marinate in yogurt, 2 minced garlic cloves, half the ginger, and 1/2 teaspoon garam masala for 15-30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and cook marinated chicken in batches until golden, about 4 minutes per batch; set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion until softened, about 4 minutes, then add remaining garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in paprika and cumin and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in tomato sauce and bring to a simmer, then return chicken to the pot.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes to blend flavors.
Stir in heavy cream and remaining garam masala, and simmer for 5 more minutes without boiling.
Taste and adjust seasonings, then garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with basmati rice or naan.
cheapTips: Use plain yogurt from a large container instead of individual cups
Buy garam masala from Indian markets instead of supermarkets to save 60%

recipes.name: Tuna Sashimi
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove tuna from refrigerator 5 minutes before serving to bring to proper temperature.
Use a very sharp knife dipped in hot water and wiped dry between each cut to slice tuna against the grain into 1/4-inch thick pieces.
Arrange tuna slices on a chilled plate overlapping slightly.
Mix soy sauce and wasabi in a small bowl to create dipping sauce.
Garnish the plate with pickled ginger, sesame seeds, and green onion.
Serve immediately with soy sauce mixture and enjoy with pickled ginger between bites.
cheapTips: Check for sales on sushi-grade tuna at Japanese markets or Costco
Pickled ginger from bulk bins costs 50% less than packaged

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Kebab
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken thighs into 1.5-inch cubes and chop onion and bell peppers into 1.5-inch pieces.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Toss chicken pieces in marinade and let sit for 15-20 minutes at room temperature.
Thread chicken alternately with onion and bell pepper pieces onto metal skewers, dividing evenly.
Heat grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Grill kebabs for 12-15 minutes, turning every 3 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are slightly charred.
Rest for 2 minutes and serve with pita bread, cucumber, tomato, and tzatziki sauce.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze individually in portions
Use bamboo skewers soaked in water instead of metal for 90% less

recipes.name: Steak Fajitas
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together olive oil, lime juice, minced garlic, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Place skirt steak in a zip-top bag, pour in half the marinade, seal, and marinate for 15-20 minutes at room temperature.
Heat a large cast-iron skillet over high heat until very hot and lightly oil the surface.
Remove steak from marinade and cook for 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare, then transfer to a cutting board and tent with foil.
Add sliced bell peppers and onions to the same skillet with remaining marinade and cook for 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender and slightly charred.
Slice steak against the grain into thin strips.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Assemble fajitas by placing steak and vegetable mixture on each tortilla and garnish with cilantro, sour cream, guacamole, and salsa.
cheapTips: Buy skirt steak when marked down and freeze in individual portions
Make your own tortillas with flour and water instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Teriyaki Salmon
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together soy sauce, mirin, sugar, minced garlic, and minced ginger in a small bowl until sugar dissolves.
Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towels and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook salmon skin-side up for 4 minutes.
Flip salmon and cook for 2 more minutes until mostly cooked through.
Pour teriyaki sauce over salmon and reduce heat to medium-low, then simmer for 2-3 minutes until sauce glazes the fish and it flakes easily with a fork.
Transfer salmon to serving plates and spoon remaining sauce over top.
Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onion, then serve with steamed rice and steamed vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy salmon on sale and freeze portions individually for up to 3 months
Substitute sake or water for mirin if unavailable at minimal cost

recipes.name: Ragu alla Bolognese
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat and cook ground beef and pork, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned, about 8 minutes; drain excess fat.
Add diced onion, carrot, and celery and cook until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes to deepen flavor.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and beef broth, then bring to a simmer and reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 60-90 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and flavors meld.
Stir in milk and oregano and simmer for 10 more minutes, then season to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve over freshly cooked pasta such as tagliatelle or pappardelle with grated Parmesan cheese.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef and pork on sale and freeze half the recipe for later
Make large batch and freeze portions for quick dinners later

recipes.name: Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pasta dough by mounding flour on a clean surface, creating a well in center, adding eggs, and mixing with a fork until a shaggy dough forms; knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic, then wrap and rest 30 minutes.
Sauté fresh spinach with minced garlic over medium heat until wilted and any excess moisture evaporates, about 4 minutes; let cool slightly.
Mix ricotta, cooked spinach, half the Parmesan, lemon zest, salt, and pepper in a bowl until well combined.
Roll out dough thinly using a pasta machine or rolling pin to about 1/16-inch thickness.
Cut dough into 2-inch squares and place 1 teaspoon ricotta filling in the center of every other square.
Brush edges of filled squares with water and place empty squares on top, pressing edges firmly to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook ravioli in batches until they float plus 30 seconds more, about 3-4 minutes total.
Melt butter with sage leaves in a small skillet over medium heat and toss drained ravioli gently in sage butter.
Serve immediately topped with remaining Parmesan and fresh cracked pepper.
cheapTips: Buy ricotta and Parmesan from bulk sections for 40% savings
Use frozen spinach thawed instead of fresh for 60% less cost

recipes.name: Chop Suey
recipes.description: Chinese-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into thin bite-sized pieces and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat and cook chicken until golden and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes; transfer to a plate.
Add remaining oil to the skillet and add minced garlic and ginger, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add celery, carrots, cabbage, and green beans, stirring and cooking for 4-5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Return chicken to the skillet and add soy sauce and chicken broth, bringing to a simmer.
Mix cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the skillet and simmer for 2 minutes until sauce thickens.
Taste and adjust seasoning with soy sauce or salt as needed.
Serve over steamed rice topped with crispy chow mein noodles for textural contrast.
cheapTips: Use whatever vegetables are on sale that week in place of specified ones
Buy pre-shredded cabbage instead of whole to save chopping time

recipes.name: Thai Satay
recipes.description: Thai snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bamboo skewers in water for 15 minutes.
Cut chicken breast into bite-sized cubes and thread onto skewers.
Blend peanut butter, coconut milk, lime juice, soy sauce, minced garlic, ginger, brown sugar, and curry paste in a bowl until smooth.
Reserve half the sauce for serving and brush the remaining sauce onto the skewers.
Grill skewers over medium-high heat for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot with reserved peanut sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast—cheaper and more flavorful
Buy peanut butter in bulk; it's shelf-stable and economical

recipes.name: Indian Tandoori Chicken
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix yogurt, lime juice, minced garlic, ginger, garam masala, paprika, cayenne, and turmeric in a large bowl.
Score chicken thighs with shallow cuts and coat thoroughly with the marinade; cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 450°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Arrange marinated chicken on the baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Slice onion and grill or char briefly if desired for serving.
Serve hot with lime wedges and sliced onion.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze; they're more affordable than breasts
Use store-brand yogurt and spices from the bulk section

recipes.name: Lebanese Shawarma
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, minced garlic, paprika, cumin, and black pepper.
Slice chicken breast into thin strips and coat with the marinade; refrigerate for 30 minutes minimum.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken strips for 8-10 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Warm pita bread in a dry skillet or over a flame for 30 seconds per side.
Dice tomatoes and cucumbers and place in a serving bowl.
Spread tahini on warm pita, fill with chicken, vegetables, and extra sauce, then roll tightly and serve.
cheapTips: Make tahini sauce from sesame seeds and oil instead of buying pre-made
Buy pita bread from Middle Eastern grocery stores or Costco for better value

recipes.name: Spanish Espetos
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the fish by removing guts and gills; rinse thoroughly and pat dry.
Thread two fish onto each wooden skewer, piercing through the mouth and out the tail.
Season generously with sea salt on both sides.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add minced garlic.
Grill or pan-fry the fish skewers for 2-3 minutes per side until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque.
Serve hot with fresh lemon wedges and chopped parsley.
cheapTips: Buy whole fresh sardines from fish counters rather than packaged versions
Ask the fishmonger to clean them for free to save prep time

recipes.name: Portuguese Frango Assado
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound garlic with salt until it forms a paste and mix with paprika, vinegar, wine, olive oil, bay leaves, and black pepper.
Pat chicken dry and place in a large roasting pan, then rub the marinade inside and outside the cavity and skin.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight for best flavor.
Preheat oven to 400°F and place marinated chicken in the oven uncovered.
Roast for 40-45 minutes, basting every 15 minutes with pan juices, until skin is golden and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the chicken and let rest for 5 minutes before carving and serving.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens on sale and freeze; they're cheaper per pound than parts
Use inexpensive white wine labeled 'cooking wine'

recipes.name: South African Boerewors
recipes.description: South African dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast coriander seeds in a dry pan for 1 minute, then grind with black pepper in a mortar and pestle.
Combine ground pork, beef, finely minced fat, minced garlic, coriander mixture, salt, breadcrumbs, and egg in a large bowl.
Mix thoroughly until the texture is uniform and sticky.
Flush pork casings with cold water and soak for 5 minutes.
Using a sausage stuffer or a piping bag fitted with a large nozzle, fill casings while twisting every 4-5 inches to form links.
Grill over medium-high heat for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
Serve hot with grilled onions and traditional African pap or bread.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork and beef from ethnic butchers; quality is often better and prices lower
Skip fresh casing and use dried ones from online, which are cheaper and last longer

recipes.name: Hawaiian Kalua Pork
recipes.description: Hawaiian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Score the skin of the pork shoulder with shallow diagonal cuts in a crosshatch pattern.
Combine sea salt, liquid smoke, minced garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and brown sugar to form a paste; rub all over the pork.
Wrap the pork in ti leaves or banana leaves to secure the marinade.
Place pork fat-side up in a slow cooker, add water to the bottom, and cook on low for 6-8 hours until meat shreds easily.
Remove from slow cooker and let cool slightly, then shred the meat with two forks, discarding excess fat.
Pour cooking liquid over shredded pork and serve warm in buns or with rice.
cheapTips: Skip leaves and use foil; wrap tightly for the same effect at no extra cost
Buy pork shoulder when on sale and freeze in portions for later

recipes.name: Jamaican Jerk Chicken
recipes.description: Jamaican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend scallions, garlic, ginger, habanero, thyme, allspice, cinnamon, lime juice, coconut milk, soy sauce, and brown sugar until smooth.
Score chicken thighs with shallow cuts and coat completely with the jerk marinade.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 425°F and place marinated chicken skin-side up on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Roast for 30-35 minutes until skin is charred and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lime wedges and rice or plantains.
cheapTips: Substitute Scotch bonnet pepper if habanero is unavailable or expensive
Use canned coconut milk from discount stores for better pricing

recipes.name: Philippine Inihaw na Liempo
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork belly into 2-inch cubes and place in a large pot with water, garlic, bay leaves, and black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes until pork is tender.
Drain the pork and reserve the liquid.
In the same pot, combine soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, and 0.5 cup of reserved cooking liquid; stir to dissolve sugar.
Return pork cubes to the pot, add sliced onion, and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes to reduce sauce.
Grill the pork cubes in a skillet or over charcoal until the edges are caramelized and crispy, about 3-5 minutes.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly from Filipino or Asian markets; cheaper than Western butchers
Use basic soy sauce and vinegar; no premium brands needed

recipes.name: Vietnamese Thit Nuong
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and shallots finely and combine with soy sauce, fish sauce, honey, lime juice, and black pepper.
Cut pork into 0.5-inch thick strips and coat with the marinade; let sit for 15 minutes minimum.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook marinated pork in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until caramelized and cooked through.
Transfer cooked pork to a plate and pour any remaining marinade into the skillet; simmer for 1 minute to reduce slightly.
Arrange lettuce leaves on a serving platter and place rice and pork on top.
Pour reduced sauce over pork and serve immediately, optionally with pickled vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when discounted and freeze; it's a budget-friendly cut
Use store-brand fish sauce and honey to reduce costs

recipes.name: Smoked Ham
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat smoker to 225°F with hickory or apple wood chips soaked for 30 minutes.
Score the ham skin in a crosshatch pattern and insert whole cloves into the scoring.
Whisk together brown sugar, mustard, vinegar, honey, and pepper to make a glaze.
Place ham on smoker grates and smoke for 2.5 to 3 hours, or until internal temperature reaches 140°F.
Brush glaze over ham every 45 minutes during smoking.
Remove ham from smoker, tent with foil, and let rest for 15 minutes before carving.
cheapTips: Buy bone-in hams on sale during holidays for significant savings.
Use water pan in smoker to reduce moisture loss and extend cook time evenly.

recipes.name: Pastrami on Rye
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast black peppercorns and coriander seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes, then coarsely grind them.
Mix brown sugar, ground spices, garlic powder, and kosher salt to create the dry rub.
Coat the brisket evenly with the dry rub and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Bring water to boil in a large pot, add the rubbed brisket, and simmer covered for 3 hours until fork-tender.
Remove pastrami from broth, slice thin against the grain, and warm briefly in broth.
Toast rye bread, spread mustard on each slice, layer warm pastrami and pickles, then close sandwich.
cheapTips: Buy brisket on sale and make several batches to freeze extra pastrami.
Skip the smoker and use the boiling method for authentic results without special equipment.

recipes.name: Smoked Trout
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix salt, brown sugar, and peppercorns together to create a cure.
Clean trout inside and out, then rub the cure all over the fish inside and out.
Stuff cavity of each trout with dill sprigs and lemon slices.
Refrigerate trout for 1 hour to allow salt to penetrate.
Preheat smoker to 175°F with alder wood chips and place water pan with bay leaves inside.
Place trout on smoker grates and smoke for 45 to 60 minutes until flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
cheapTips: Buy frozen whole trout and thaw overnight to save money versus fresh.
Substitute oak or hickory wood if alder is unavailable.

recipes.name: Carolina Pulled Pork
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, and black pepper into a dry rub.
Rub the mixture all over the pork shoulder and let sit for 1 hour at room temperature.
Preheat smoker to 250°F with hickory wood chips.
Place pork shoulder on smoker and smoke for 5 to 6 hours until internal temperature reaches 190°F and meat shreds easily.
Remove pork from smoker, wrap in foil, and rest for 20 minutes.
Shred pork with two forks and mix with a sauce made from vinegar and mustard.
Toast buns and serve pulled pork with coleslaw on top.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until ready to smoke.
Make your own vinegar sauce instead of buying bottled BBQ sauce.

recipes.name: Smoked Chicken
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken dry and combine paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, and salt into a rub.
Rub mixture all over chicken, inside and out, and stuff cavity with lemon halves.
Place butter under the skin of the chicken breasts.
Preheat smoker to 225°F with oak wood chips and water pan.
Place chicken on smoker grates breast-side up and smoke for 2.5 to 3 hours until thigh temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken from smoker, tent with foil, and rest for 10 minutes before carving.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens instead of individual pieces for better value.
Use chicken bones to make broth after smoking.

recipes.name: Smoked Swordfish
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and mix with olive oil, lemon juice, rosemary, salt, and pepper to create a marinade.
Place swordfish steaks in a shallow dish and coat with marinade, then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat smoker to 200°F with cherry wood chips.
Place swordfish on oiled smoker grates and smoke for 40 to 50 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork.
Remove swordfish from smoker and drizzle with any remaining marinade before serving.
cheapTips: Buy swordfish steaks on sale and freeze for later use.
Substitute maple wood for cherry wood if preferred.

recipes.name: Smoked Tofu
recipes.description: Asian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between clean towels for 15 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Cut tofu into 1-inch thick slabs and arrange on a plate.
Whisk together soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic.
Pour marinade over tofu slabs and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat smoker to 175°F with apple wood chips.
Place tofu on oiled smoker grates and smoke for 45 to 60 minutes until edges are lightly browned.
Remove from smoker and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy tofu in bulk and freeze extra blocks for later smoking.
Use leftover marinade to make a dipping sauce for other meals.

recipes.name: Smoked Oysters
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Shuck oysters carefully by inserting a knife under the hinge and twisting until the shell opens.
Mix butter, minced garlic, parsley, lemon juice, and pepper to create compound butter.
Place a small spoonful of compound butter on each oyster.
Preheat smoker to 150°F with oak wood chips.
Place oyster shells on smoker grates and smoke for 15 to 20 minutes until oysters are hot and slightly firmed.
Carefully remove oysters from smoker and serve immediately with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy oysters from the seafood counter when on sale.
Shuck oysters yourself to save money versus pre-shucked.

recipes.name: Smoked Duck Breast
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Score the skin of duck breasts in a crosshatch pattern and season generously with salt and pepper.
Sear duck breasts skin-side down in a hot pan for 3 minutes until skin is rendered and golden.
Mix honey and orange juice together to create a glaze.
Preheat smoker to 200°F with cherry wood chips.
Place duck breasts on smoker grates skin-side up and smoke for 45 to 60 minutes until internal temperature reaches 130°F.
Brush glaze over duck during last 15 minutes of smoking.
Remove duck from smoker, tent with foil, and rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
cheapTips: Look for duck breasts on sale at specialty markets and freeze until ready to cook.
Save duck fat from rendering skin for cooking other dishes.

recipes.name: Smoked Cheese
recipes.description: German snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cheddar and gouda into blocks about 4 inches by 2 inches by 1 inch thick.
Wrap each cheese block loosely in parchment paper, leaving the top exposed.
Preheat smoker to 80-90°F with apple wood chips and a pan of ice on the bottom rack.
Place wrapped cheese blocks on the upper smoker rack and smoke for 30 to 40 minutes until the surface is golden and slightly soft.
Remove cheese from smoker and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving to allow the smoke flavor to set.
Serve with crackers and prosciutto on a charcuterie board.
cheapTips: Use blocks of cheese on sale instead of pre-sliced varieties.
Make smoked cheese in batches and refrigerate for up to two weeks.

recipes.name: Argentinian Choripán
recipes.description: Argentine lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make chimichurri by finely chopping parsley, mincing garlic, and whisking with olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper until combined.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook chorizo sausages for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally until browned and cooked through.
Dice the red onion and tomato into small pieces.
Slice the sandwich rolls lengthwise and lightly toast them if desired.
Remove chorizo from skillet and place one sausage in each roll.
Top each choripán with a spoonful of chimichurri, diced onion, and diced tomato.
Serve immediately with extra chimichurri sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chorizo when on sale and freeze for later use
Make chimichurri in bulk and store in the refrigerator for up to two weeks

recipes.name: Indonesian Sate Ayam
recipes.description: Indonesian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
Make marinade by blending peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, lime juice, minced garlic, ginger, chili powder, and brown sugar until smooth.
Reserve half the marinade for serving sauce and thread chicken pieces onto skewers.
Coat skewered chicken thoroughly with the other half of the marinade and let sit for 15 minutes.
Heat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat and cook skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning every few minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Warm the reserved sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
Serve skewers hot with warm peanut sauce on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy chicken in bulk when on sale and freeze portions
Use natural peanut butter or store-brand peanut butter to reduce costs

recipes.name: Uruguayan Asado de Tira
recipes.description: Uruguayan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat the beef short ribs dry with paper towels and generously season both sides with coarse salt and black pepper.
Make chimichurri by finely chopping parsley and oregano, mincing garlic, and mixing with olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Reserve half the chimichurri for serving and brush the other half onto the ribs.
Heat a grill or cast iron grill pan over high heat until very hot.
Place ribs on the grill and sear for 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare, or 6-7 minutes per side for medium.
Transfer ribs to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with reserved chimichurri drizzled on top and alongside for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy beef ribs in bulk or as a whole rack when on sale
Make extra chimichurri and freeze in ice cube trays for future use

recipes.name: Middle Eastern Kafta
recipes.description: Middle Eastern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Finely chop parsley, mint, onion, and mince garlic into a fine paste.
Combine ground lamb with herb mixture, cinnamon, cumin, allspice, salt, and pepper in a bowl and mix until just combined.
Divide meat mixture into 8 portions and mold each around a skewer in a long cylindrical shape.
Heat a grill or grill pan over high heat and cook kafta skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning every 2 minutes until cooked through.
Warm pita bread on the grill for 1 minute per side.
Serve kafta inside warm pita bread with tomato, lettuce, and tahini sauce.
cheapTips: Buy ground lamb in bulk when on sale and freeze in portions
Use store-brand pita bread to reduce costs

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and season chicken pieces with salt and pepper.
Brown chicken on all sides in batches, about 4 minutes per side, then remove and set aside.
Dice onion, bell peppers, mince garlic, and slice mushrooms.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and sauté for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add bell peppers and mushrooms, cooking for 5 minutes until softened.
Pour in white wine and scrape up browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Return chicken to the skillet, add canned tomatoes with juice and Italian seasoning, then simmer covered for 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Cook pasta according to package directions and serve topped with chicken cacciatore.
cheapTips: Buy chicken when on sale and freeze for future use
Use canned tomatoes from store brands instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Tagine of Lamb with Prunes
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut lamb shoulder into 2-inch cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large pot or tagine over medium-high heat and brown lamb in batches, about 4 minutes per side, then set aside.
Dice onions and mince garlic, then sauté in the same pot for 4 minutes until softened.
Add ground ginger, cinnamon, and turmeric to the pot and stir constantly for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return lamb to the pot and add beef broth, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 45 minutes until lamb is tender.
Add prunes to the pot and simmer uncovered for 10 more minutes until prunes are plump.
Taste and adjust seasonings, then garnish with fresh cilantro and serve over couscous or rice.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shoulder when on sale and freeze for up to three months
Purchase prunes in bulk from a Middle Eastern or specialty grocer

recipes.name: Lamb Stifado
recipes.description: Greek dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut lamb shoulder into 2-inch cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown lamb in batches, about 4 minutes per side, then set aside.
Peel pearl onions by blanching in boiling water for 2 minutes, then cooling and sliding skins off.
Mince garlic and add to the pot with the pearl onions, sautéing for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add red wine and scrape up browned bits.
Return lamb to the pot and add beef broth and bay leaves, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for 45-50 minutes until lamb is tender and onions are very soft.
Stir in red wine vinegar, taste and adjust seasonings, then serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shoulder when on sale and freeze for later use
Use frozen pearl onions if fresh onions are expensive or hard to peel

recipes.name: Pork and Beans
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into 1-inch cubes, season with salt and pepper.
Heat a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown pork cubes on all sides, about 5-6 minutes total, then set aside.
Dice onion and add to the pan, sautéing for 3 minutes until softened.
In a bowl, whisk together ketchup, molasses, brown sugar, vinegar, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce.
Return pork to the pan and pour sauce over it, stirring to combine.
Drain and rinse canned beans, then add to the pan and stir well.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until pork is cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasonings with salt and pepper, then serve hot over rice or with cornbread.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when on sale and freeze portions for future use
Use store-brand canned beans to reduce costs significantly

recipes.name: Khash
recipes.description: Armenian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean beef bones and feet thoroughly under cold running water, scrubbing well.
Place bones and feet in a large stock pot and cover with cold water, bringing to a boil.
Drain the water, rinse the bones and feet, and refill the pot with 3 quarts of fresh water.
Return to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer gently for 8-10 hours, skimming foam as it rises.
Add salt and black pepper and continue simmering until the broth is rich and gelatinous.
Mince garlic cloves and divide among serving bowls.
Ladle the hot broth and tender meat pieces into bowls, seasoning with additional salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately with crusty bread and fresh herbs on the side for garnish.
cheapTips: Buy beef bones and feet at Middle Eastern or ethnic butchers for lower prices than regular supermarkets
Make a large batch and freeze portions for future breakfasts

recipes.name: Carbonnade à la Flamande
recipes.description: Belgian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef chuck into 2-inch cubes and pat dry with paper towels, then season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches, about 4 minutes per side, then set aside.
Slice onions and mince garlic, then sauté in the same pot for 4 minutes until softened.
Add tomato paste and brown mustard, stirring constantly for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in beer and beef broth, scraping up browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return beef to the pot and add bay leaves and thyme, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook in a 325°F oven for 60-75 minutes until beef is very tender.
Remove from oven, discard bay leaves, taste and adjust seasonings, then serve over egg noodles or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck when on sale and freeze for later use
Use inexpensive domestic beer instead of expensive Belgian beer

recipes.name: Smoked Pork Shoulder
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and onion powder in a bowl to create a dry rub.
Coat the pork shoulder generously on all sides with the dry rub and let sit at room temperature for 1 hour.
Soak wood chips in water for 30 minutes, then add to your smoker and preheat to 225°F.
Place pork shoulder on the smoker rack and smoke for 6-8 hours, maintaining temperature and adding wood chips every hour.
Wrap the shoulder tightly in foil and place back on smoker for the final 2 hours until internal temperature reaches 190°F.
Remove from smoker and let rest for 20 minutes before shredding with two forks.
Mix shredded meat with apple cider vinegar and chicken broth for serving.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until ready to use
Use regular charcoal instead of specialty smoking wood for budget option

recipes.name: Red Braised Pork Belly
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork belly into 2-inch cubes and blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Heat oil in a large pot and sear the pork belly on all sides until browned, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, add ginger slices and garlic cloves, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return pork belly to pot and add soy sauce, dark soy sauce, rock sugar, star anise, and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover, simmering for 90 minutes until meat is tender.
Remove star anise and ginger slices, then stir in chopped green onions.
Serve over steamed rice with some of the braising liquid spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly in bulk from Asian markets where it's often cheaper
Rock sugar can be replaced with regular white sugar in equal amount

recipes.name: Braised Short Ribs
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season short ribs with salt and pepper, then coat lightly with flour.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear ribs on all sides until browned, then remove and set aside.
Add chopped onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add wine and beef broth, scraping up browned bits from the bottom.
Return ribs to pot, cover with a lid, and transfer to a 325°F oven for 2.5-3 hours until meat is very tender.
Remove pot from oven and skim fat from the braising liquid surface.
Serve ribs with vegetables and braising liquid over mashed potatoes or rice.
cheapTips: Buy short ribs when on sale and freeze for later use
Skip the wine and use an extra cup of beef broth for budget version

recipes.name: Braised Lamb Shanks
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season lamb shanks with salt and pepper on all sides.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown shanks on all sides for 8 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the pot and sauté for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in red wine and scrape up browned bits, then add chicken broth, canned tomatoes with juice, and rosemary sprigs.
Return lamb shanks to pot, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover, simmering for 2 hours until meat is very tender.
Remove rosemary sprigs and squeeze lemon juice into the pot, stirring to combine.
Serve shanks with braising liquid spooned over top alongside polenta or crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shanks from Middle Eastern or Mediterranean markets for better prices
Use dried rosemary (1 tsp) if fresh is not available

recipes.name: Duroc Pork Braised in Soy
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork into 2-inch cubes and heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown pork cubes on all sides for 8 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Add ginger slices and smashed garlic to the pot, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return pork to pot and add soy sauce, water, brown sugar, star anise, and 2 chopped green onions.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours until pork is very tender.
Stir in rice vinegar and simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes to reduce sauce slightly.
Garnish with remaining chopped green onions and serve over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Regular pork shoulder works just as well as Duroc and is usually cheaper
Buy soy sauce in bulk from Asian markets for significant savings

recipes.name: Estofado
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sauté minced garlic and diced onion for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add cubed beef and brown on all sides for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in tomato sauce, soy sauce, beef broth, salt, pepper, and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes until beef is mostly tender.
Add diced potatoes and continue simmering covered for another 25 minutes until potatoes are cooked through.
Remove bay leaves and adjust seasoning to taste.
Serve hot over steamed rice with sauce spooned over top.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck instead of sirloin - it's cheaper and more flavorful when braised
Buy potatoes in bulk and store in cool place for extended freshness

recipes.name: Tajine d'Agneau
recipes.description: Moroccan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut lamb into 1.5-inch cubes and heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb pieces on all sides for 8 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Add sliced onion and minced garlic to the pot, sautéing for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in ginger powder, cinnamon, turmeric, and cumin, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return lamb to pot and add chicken broth and dried apricots, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours until lamb is very tender, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve over couscous or rice.
cheapTips: Buy dried apricots from bulk bins instead of packaged for 30% savings
Use lamb neck or stew meat instead of shoulder for budget option

recipes.name: Galinhada
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into 8 pieces and heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Season chicken with salt and pepper, then brown on all sides for 10 minutes and remove.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the pot, sautéing for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add rice and stir for 1 minute to coat with oil, then pour in chicken broth and return chicken to pot.
Add bay leaves and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 35 minutes until rice is cooked and chicken is tender.
Remove bay leaves and stir in chopped parsley.
Serve hot directly from the pot as a one-dish meal.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken instead of parts - significantly cheaper per pound
Use parsley stems instead of leaves if budget is tight

recipes.name: Braised Eggplant in Garlic Sauce
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplant into long strips about 3 inches long and 1 inch thick.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and fry eggplant strips in batches for 4 minutes per side until softened and lightly browned, then transfer to a plate.
In the same pan, add minced garlic and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and water in a small bowl, then pour into the pan with garlic.
Return eggplant to pan and bring sauce to a simmer, cooking uncovered for 10 minutes until eggplant is very tender.
Mix cornstarch with 1 tbsp water and stir into the sauce to thicken, cooking for 1 minute.
Drizzle with sesame oil and garnish with sliced green onions, then serve over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy eggplant in season (summer) for best prices
Use regular oil instead of sesame oil for part of the cooking oil to save money

recipes.name: Roast Beef with Yorkshire Pudding
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F and place oven-safe pan with 1 tbsp oil inside to preheat for 10 minutes.
Season beef roast with salt, pepper, thyme, and garlic, then sear on all sides in the hot pan for 8 minutes.
Transfer pan to oven and roast for 60-75 minutes until internal temperature reaches 130°F for medium-rare, then remove roast and let rest.
While roast rests, whisk together flour, eggs, milk, salt, and pepper in a bowl to make Yorkshire pudding batter.
Pour 2 tbsp oil into a baking pan and place in 425°F oven for 5 minutes until very hot.
Pour batter into the hot oil pan and bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and puffed.
Slice roast beef and serve alongside Yorkshire pudding with pan drippings mixed with beef broth as gravy.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck roast instead of rib roast for similar results at lower cost
Make gravy from pan drippings instead of buying canned gravy

recipes.name: Smoked Brisket
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim brisket fat cap to ¼-inch thickness and pat completely dry with paper towels.
Mix salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and onion powder together, then rub generously all over the brisket.
Place brisket fat-side up on a smoker preheated to 225°F with hickory or oak wood.
Smoke brisket for 6-7 hours until it reaches 165°F internal temperature, spritzing with apple cider vinegar and broth every hour.
Wrap brisket tightly in butcher paper with beef broth inside and continue smoking until it reaches 203°F internal temperature (3-4 hours more).
Remove brisket from smoker and rest wrapped for 30-45 minutes before unwrapping.
Slice against the grain into ¼-inch slices and serve with pan drippings as sauce.
cheapTips: Buy brisket on sale at warehouse stores for 2-3x savings
Use free wood chips from local tree trimming services

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon
recipes.description: Scandinavian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine salt, brown sugar, pepper, dill, and lemon zest in a small bowl.
Rub cure mixture all over salmon flesh side and place skin-side down on a baking sheet lined with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate uncovered for 6-8 hours until liquid pools around fish.
Rinse salmon under cold water and pat dry with paper towels, then place skin-side up on a wire rack.
Air-dry uncovered in refrigerator for 2-3 hours until surface is tacky (pellicle forms).
Smoke salmon at 150°F with maple wood for 3-4 hours until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Brush lightly with maple syrup in final 30 minutes of smoking, then cool and refrigerate before slicing.
cheapTips: Buy salmon when on sale and freeze until ready to cure
Use apple wood chips as free alternative to expensive maple

recipes.name: Arbroath Smokie
recipes.description: Scottish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Create brine by dissolving 2 tbsp salt in 4 cups water and submerge haddock for 30 minutes.
Remove haddock from brine and pat dry, then split each fish open along the backbone without separating halves.
Secure each split fish open with wooden skewers through the sides to maintain butterfly shape.
Preheat smoker to 80°C (175°F) and add soaked oak chips to produce dense, cool smoke.
Place haddock skin-side down on smoker rack and smoke for 30-40 minutes until flesh is firm and lightly golden.
Remove skewers and transfer smoked fish to a serving plate while still warm.
Dot with butter, squeeze fresh lemon juice over top, and season with sea salt and pepper before serving.
cheapTips: Buy whole haddock from fishmonger cheaper than pre-cut fillets
Smoke multiple fish at once to reduce per-unit energy cost

recipes.name: Smoked Mackerel
recipes.description: British lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix salt, brown sugar, and pepper together and rub over mackerel flesh side.
Place mackerel skin-side down on a wire rack and refrigerate uncovered for 30 minutes.
Pat mackerel dry and place skin-side down on smoker rack lined with thyme sprigs.
Smoke at 160°F with apple wood for 25-30 minutes until flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
Drizzle finished mackerel with olive oil and squeeze fresh lemon juice over top.
Serve warm or at room temperature with crusty bread and horseradish cream.
cheapTips: Buy mackerel in bulk and freeze for year-round affordable smoking
Reuse soaking liquid from wood chips for multiple batches

recipes.name: Bacon
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine kosher salt, brown sugar, pepper, pink curing salt, and garlic powder to create cure rub.
Rub cure mixture thoroughly over entire pork belly slab, then wrap tightly in plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for 5-7 days, turning slab every 2 days and redistributing accumulated liquid.
Rinse pork belly under cold water to remove cure, then pat dry and place on wire rack.
Air-dry uncovered in refrigerator for 2-3 hours until pellicle forms on surface.
Smoke pork belly at 225°F with hickory wood for 90 minutes, brushing with maple syrup at 45-minute mark.
Cool completely, slice into ¼-inch strips, then fry in skillet until crispy or freeze for later use.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly on sale in bulk and freeze unsmoked for months
Make 3-5 lbs at once to amortize prep and smoking time

recipes.name: Smoked Turkey
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove turkey from refrigerator 2 hours before smoking and pat completely dry inside and out.
Mix salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder together, then rub generously under skin and inside cavity.
Place turkey breast-up on a smoker rack at 225°F with oak wood smoke.
Smoke for approximately 3-4 hours (13-15 minutes per pound), spritzing every 45 minutes with apple cider vinegar and broth mixture.
Check temperature at thickest part of thigh; remove turkey when internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Tent turkey loosely with foil and rest for 20-30 minutes before carving.
Carve turkey into breasts, thighs, and drumsticks, then serve with pan drippings as gravy.
cheapTips: Smoke turkey the day after Thanksgiving when prices drop 50%+
Save bones and skin for homemade stock to reduce waste

recipes.name: Kippered Herring
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve salt in 4 cups water to create brine, then submerge herring for 30 minutes.
Remove herring from brine and pat dry, then butterfly each fish by cutting along the backbone without separating halves.
Secure each butterflied herring open with wooden toothpicks to maintain shape during smoking.
Smoke herring at 80°C (175°F) with oak wood for 30-35 minutes until flesh is firm and golden brown.
Remove toothpicks and transfer herring to a serving plate while warm.
Top each kipper with a small knob of butter, sprinkle fresh parsley over top, and drizzle with lemon juice.
Serve immediately with toasted bread and a poached egg if desired.
cheapTips: Buy whole herring from fishmonger for half the cost of pre-filleted versions
Make multiple batches on same smoking day to reduce prep time per fish

recipes.name: Smoked Eel
recipes.description: Dutch snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cleaned eel into 6-inch segments and pat completely dry with paper towels.
Mix salt, brown sugar, pepper, and crushed juniper berries together, then rub over all eel pieces.
Place eel segments on wire rack and refrigerate uncovered for 2-3 hours until tacky.
Smoke eel at 160°F with oak wood and thyme sprigs for 45-50 minutes until flesh is opaque and firm.
Brush finished eel lightly with melted butter while still warm.
Serve hot or cool to room temperature with rye bread and horseradish cream.
cheapTips: Order eel from specialty seafood suppliers online for better prices than local fishmongers
Freeze smoked eel portions for up to 3 months to extend shelf life

recipes.name: Kansas City Burnt Ends
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim brisket point to uniform thickness and pat completely dry with paper towels.
Mix salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and 1 tbsp brown sugar together, then apply generously to all surfaces.
Smoke brisket point at 225°F with hickory wood for 3-3.5 hours until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove brisket from smoker and cut into 1-inch cubes, discarding any excessively fatty pieces.
Toss cubes in a disposable aluminum pan with barbecue sauce, butter, and remaining brown sugar.
Return pan to 275°F smoker for 45-60 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes until exterior is caramelized and sticky.
Remove from smoker when bark is dark and crusty, then serve hot in small portions as appetizer or sandwich filling.
cheapTips: Use brisket point trim scraps or request butcher discount on odd-shaped cuts
Make homemade barbecue sauce to save $3-4 per batch

recipes.name: Texas Smoked Ribs
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove ribs from refrigerator 1 hour before smoking and peel off membrane from bone side using a paper towel.
Mix salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and cayenne together, then apply generously to all surfaces of ribs.
Place ribs bone-side down on a smoker rack at 225°F with oak or hickory wood.
Smoke ribs for 4-5 hours, spritzing with apple cider vinegar and beef broth mixture every 45 minutes.
Check ribs at 4 hours; they are done when meat pulls back ½-inch from the bone ends and reaches 203°F internal temperature.
Remove ribs from smoker and wrap loosely in foil with butter, letting them rest for 15 minutes.
Slice ribs between bones and serve hot with extra spritzing liquid or light sauce on the side.
