cheapTips: Buy beef short ribs in bulk when marked down and freeze until ready to smoke
Reuse broth and vinegar spritz mixture for multiple smoking sessions

recipes.name: Porchetta
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Score the pork skin in a crosshatch pattern with a sharp knife, cutting through the skin but not into the meat.
Finely chop rosemary, sage, garlic, and fennel seeds, then mix with salt, pepper, and olive oil to form a paste.
Rub the herb paste all over the meat side of the pork belly, then roll it tightly skin-side out and tie with kitchen twine every 2 inches.
Place the rolled porchetta in a roasting pan, pour wine and water around it, and roast at 350°F for 3 hours, basting every 30 minutes.
Increase oven temperature to 450°F and roast for another 30 minutes until the skin is golden and crispy.
Rest the porchetta for 15 minutes, then slice into 1-inch thick pieces and serve with pan drippings.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly on sale and freeze it until needed to save 20-30%
Use dried herbs if fresh rosemary and sage are expensive

recipes.name: Rotisserie Chicken
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat the chicken dry inside and out with paper towels, then season the cavity and exterior generously with salt and pepper.
Stuff the chicken cavity with lemon halves, garlic cloves, thyme, and rosemary sprigs.
Rub softened butter all over the chicken skin and truss the legs with kitchen twine.
Place the chicken on a roasting rack in a pan, pour broth into the bottom, and roast at 425°F for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Baste the chicken with pan juices every 20 minutes until the skin is golden brown and a meat thermometer reads 165°F at the thigh.
Rest the chicken for 10 minutes, then carve and serve with pan juices spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens on sale instead of rotisserie for half the price
Save the bones for homemade broth later

recipes.name: Shao Kao
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes, then thread lamb cubes onto skewers.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger, cumin, and chili flakes in a bowl.
Brush the marinade generously over the lamb skewers and let sit for 15 minutes.
Heat a grill or grill pan to high heat and cook the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes and brushing with remaining marinade.
Chop scallions and sprinkle over the cooked skewers along with extra cumin.
Serve immediately with extra sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Use beef instead of lamb to save $2-3 per pound
Buy pre-cubed meat from the store to avoid waste

recipes.name: Cheeseburger Steamed Buns
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and sugar, let sit 5 minutes until foamy, then combine with flour and salt to form a soft dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth, cover with a damp towel, and let rise for 30 minutes until doubled.
Divide dough into 6 equal pieces, shape each into a ball, and flatten slightly into 3-inch rounds.
Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, then season with salt and pepper.
Place a portion of cooked beef and a quarter cheese slice in the center of 3 dough rounds, then top with remaining dough rounds and seal edges by pressing together.
Steam the buns on parchment paper in a steamer basket for 12-15 minutes until puffy and cooked through.
Slice open each bun and fill with lettuce, tomato, mayonnaise, and additional cooked beef and cheese.
cheapTips: Make double the batch and freeze uncooked buns for quick future meals
Use ground chuck instead of premium beef to cut costs

recipes.name: Chow Mei Fun
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice vermicelli in room temperature water for 15 minutes until pliable, then drain well.
Beat eggs in a bowl and scramble in a hot wok with 1 tablespoon oil, then set aside.
Add remaining oil to the wok and stir-fry shrimp over high heat until pink, about 3 minutes, then push to the side.
Add garlic to the wok and cook for 30 seconds, then add the drained noodles and toss constantly for 2-3 minutes.
Pour soy sauce and sesame oil over noodles, add bean sprouts, scrambled eggs, and chopped scallions, then toss everything together for 1-2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute frozen shrimp (cheaper) for fresh, and thaw before cooking
Use chicken or pork instead of shrimp to reduce cost by $2 per serving

recipes.name: Steamed Fish with Ginger and Scallions
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the fish thoroughly and pat dry, then score the skin diagonally on both sides.
Place the fish on a piece of parchment paper in a steamer basket and scatter half the ginger and 2 chopped scallions over the top.
Pour 0.5 cup water into the steamer pot and bring to a boil, then place the basket over boiling water and steam for 10-12 minutes until the fish is cooked through.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar in a small bowl.
Heat vegetable oil in a small pan until just smoking, then carefully pour over the steamed fish.
Top the fish with remaining ginger and scallions, drizzle with the soy mixture, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish from the fish counter and ask them to clean it for free
Use frozen fish fillets if whole fish is unavailable, reducing time and cost

recipes.name: Steamed Pork Ribs with Black Bean Sauce
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork ribs into 2-inch pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
Rinse fermented black beans under cold water for 30 seconds to reduce saltiness, then roughly chop.
Mix black beans, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, and cornstarch in a bowl.
Toss the pork ribs with the black bean mixture and let marinate for 10 minutes.
Arrange the marinated ribs in a single layer on a plate that fits inside a steamer basket.
Steam the ribs over boiling water for 25-30 minutes until tender and cooked through.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy ribs on sale and freeze to use later at a discount
Make extra and eat leftovers cold as a snack or lunch

recipes.name: Tamago Dopu
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crack 2 eggs into a bowl, add milk, sugar, and a pinch of salt, then whisk until well combined.
Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat and pour in the egg mixture.
Gently push the eggs from the edges toward the center with a spatula as they cook, creating a soft, creamy scramble about 3-4 minutes.
Toast the bread slices lightly in a separate pan or toaster until golden.
Butter the toast and place on serving plates, then top each slice with a generous portion of the scrambled eggs.
Crack the remaining egg into a small bowl and fry it in a clean pan, then place on top of each toast, drizzle with ketchup, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk from warehouse stores for the lowest price
Use store-brand butter and bread to cut costs further

recipes.name: Tteokkochi
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes, then cut rice cakes and fish cakes into 1-inch cubes.
Alternately thread rice cake and fish cake pieces onto skewers until full.
Mix soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and gochugaru in a small bowl.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then cook the skewers for 3-4 minutes per side until the rice cakes are lightly browned.
Brush the sauce generously over the skewers and continue cooking for 2-3 more minutes, turning occasionally and coating well.
Transfer to a serving plate, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy rice cakes in bulk from Asian markets for much cheaper prices
Skip the fish cakes and use only rice cakes to save 50% on cost

recipes.name: Kimchi
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss chopped napa cabbage with kosher salt in a large bowl and let sit for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until the cabbage softens and releases liquid.
Rinse the salted cabbage under cold water 2-3 times and squeeze out excess water.
Mix garlic, ginger, gochugaru, fish sauce, and sugar in a small bowl to form a paste.
Add the paste to the drained cabbage along with chopped scallions and sesame seeds, tossing everything together thoroughly.
Transfer the kimchi to a clean glass jar, pressing down so the vegetables are submerged in their own liquid.
Cover loosely and let ferment at room temperature for 2-7 days (taste daily to reach desired spice level), then refrigerate when satisfied.
cheapTips: Buy napa cabbage during sales and make large batches to freeze
Omit fish sauce to make vegetarian kimchi and save 10%

recipes.name: Takuan
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel the daikon radish and cut into 1/4-inch thick matchsticks or thin rounds.
Toss daikon with salt and let sit for 30 minutes, then rinse and squeeze out excess moisture.
In a saucepan, combine rice vinegar, sugar, turmeric, and kombu, bringing to a simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and add red chili flake, then let cool completely.
Pack daikon into a clean glass jar and pour the cooled brine over it, ensuring all pieces are submerged.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 days before serving.
Takuan keeps for up to 2 months refrigerated.
cheapTips: Buy daikon in bulk when on sale and make large batches
Use white vinegar instead of rice vinegar to cut costs further

recipes.name: Rejuvelac
recipes.description: Raw Vegan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wheat berries in water for 8-12 hours, then drain and rinse thoroughly.
Spread on a damp cloth and allow to sprout for 3-5 days, rinsing twice daily until small tails appear.
Push sprouted berries through a cold-press juicer or blend with 2 cups filtered water until very liquidy.
Strain through a fine mesh strainer or nut milk bag, pressing to extract all liquid.
Add lemon juice and agave syrup to taste and serve immediately over ice.
cheapTips: Buy wheat berries in bulk from health food stores
Make large batches and freeze for up to one week

recipes.name: Kombucha
recipes.description: International snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil filtered water and steep black tea bags for 5-7 minutes, then remove bags.
Stir in sugar until dissolved completely and allow tea to cool to room temperature.
Pour cooled sweet tea into a clean glass jar and add SCOBY and starter liquid.
Cover jar with a coffee filter or cloth secured with a rubber band to allow breathing while blocking dust.
Place in a warm, dark location (68-85°F) away from direct sunlight for 7-30 days.
Taste after 7 days and continue fermenting until desired tartness is reached.
Strain kombucha into bottles and store in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
cheapTips: SCOBY can be reused indefinitely, making subsequent batches very cheap
Buy tea in bulk to reduce per-batch costs

recipes.name: Carpaccio
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim any exterior fat from the beef tenderloin and wrap tightly in plastic wrap.
Freeze for 30-45 minutes until firm but not completely frozen for easier slicing.
Using a sharp knife or meat slicer, cut beef into paper-thin slices and arrange on a chilled plate.
Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice evenly over the beef slices.
Sprinkle with salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste.
Scatter capers over the meat and top with thin shavings of fresh parmesan.
Serve immediately on a bed of fresh arugula.
cheapTips: Buy beef tenderloin on sale and freeze until ready to use
Use a vegetable peeler to shave parmesan for even distribution

recipes.name: Crudo
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Ensure fish is sushi-grade and ask butcher to verify quality for raw consumption.
Using a sharp knife, slice fish as thinly as possible and arrange on a chilled plate.
Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and red chili flake to create a dressing.
Pour dressing over fish slices just before serving.
Garnish with fresh herbs and thinly sliced radishes.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Ask at the fish counter for sushi-grade fish on sale or nearing use-by date
Make larger batches and serve to guests to spread cost

recipes.name: Tartare
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Hand-chop beef tenderloin into small, uniform pieces using a sharp knife.
Place beef in a chilled bowl and add minced shallots, parsley, and capers.
Whisk Dijon mustard and Worcestershire sauce together, then add to beef mixture.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, then gently fold to combine without over-mixing.
Season with sea salt and pepper to taste.
Divide tartare among chilled plates and create an indent in the center if serving with raw egg yolk.
Serve immediately with crostini or crackers.
cheapTips: Buy beef on sale and freeze immediately for food safety
Skip the egg yolk to cut costs and reduce food safety concerns

recipes.name: Crab Louie
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash and chop romaine lettuce, then arrange on four large plates.
Arrange hard-boiled eggs, tomato wedges, and cucumber slices around the lettuce.
In a bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, ketchup, lemon juice, and Worcestershire sauce to make Louie dressing.
Gently toss crab meat with half of the Louie dressing and mound onto the center of each plate.
Scatter black olives around each salad.
Drizzle remaining Louie dressing over the salad and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute imitation crab to reduce costs significantly
Buy eggs on sale and hard-boil several at once

recipes.name: Vitello Tonnato
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season veal with salt and pepper and sear in a hot pan until browned on all sides, about 3 minutes per side.
Add white wine and beef broth to the pan, then cover and simmer for 20-25 minutes until cooked through.
Remove veal and let cool completely, then refrigerate until chilled.
Combine canned tuna, anchovies, egg yolks, and lemon juice in a food processor.
Slowly drizzle olive oil while processing until sauce is smooth and creamy.
Thin sauce with reserved veal cooking liquid to reach desired consistency.
Slice chilled veal thinly and arrange on a platter, then pour tonnato sauce over meat and refrigerate.
Garnish with capers and serve chilled.
cheapTips: Use beef tenderloin instead of veal to save 30-40%
Buy canned tuna on sale and stock up

recipes.name: Crudités
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch green beans in salted boiling water for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp, then shock in ice water.
Slice carrots and celery into sticks approximately 3-4 inches long.
Cut cucumber into sticks, slice bell pepper into strips, and quarter radishes.
Cut cauliflower into small florets.
Arrange all vegetables on a large platter or cutting board with cherry tomatoes in the center.
Make a simple vinaigrette by whisking together mayonnaise, minced garlic, Dijon mustard, and lemon juice.
Serve crudités with the dip on the side.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables in season and in bulk
Make dip with Greek yogurt instead of all mayo to save costs

recipes.name: Béchamel
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat without browning.
Whisk in flour to create a smooth paste (roux) and cook for 1-2 minutes while stirring constantly.
Gradually add milk while whisking constantly to prevent lumps from forming.
Add bay leaf and continue cooking over medium heat for 5-7 minutes until sauce thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
Remove from heat and stir in salt, white pepper, and nutmeg to taste.
Remove bay leaf and use sauce immediately as a base for gratins, pasta dishes, or lasagna.
cheapTips: Buy milk on sale and freeze for later use
Make large batches and freeze in ice cube trays for portions

recipes.name: Pickled Herring
recipes.description: Scandinavian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut herring fillets into 2-inch pieces and place in a clean glass jar with the sliced onion.
In a saucepan, combine vinegar, water, sugar, and salt, then bring to a boil.
Add bay leaves, peppercorns, and mustard seeds to the boiling liquid and stir well.
Pour the hot brine over the herring and onions in the jar.
Let cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving.
Serve chilled with rye bread and sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy herring in bulk from ethnic markets; store-bought jars are 2-3x more expensive
Make larger batches and keep refrigerated for up to 3 weeks

recipes.name: Tempeh
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried soybeans in water overnight, then drain and cook in fresh water for 30 minutes until softened but not fully cooked.
Drain beans and spread on clean cloths to cool and dry completely.
Mix cooled beans with tempeh starter culture and salt in a clean container.
Wrap mixture in perforated plastic or cheesecloth and incubate at 86-88°F in a warm place for 24 hours.
Check when a white mycelium layer binds the beans into a solid cake.
Cool completely, then slice and steam or fry before eating.
cheapTips: Buy soybeans in bulk from Asian markets for 50% less than specialty stores
Tempeh starter can be ordered online; one package makes 5+ batches

recipes.name: Nukazuke
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice bran, salt, and water in a clean jar or container to form a paste-like consistency.
Add kombu and dried chili, then stir well to distribute evenly.
Bury cucumber and daikon pieces in the nuka paste, pressing down firmly.
Cover the container loosely and store at room temperature away from direct sunlight.
After 12-24 hours, remove vegetables, rinse under cold water, and slice to serve.
Stir the nuka mixture daily to maintain fermentation and prevent mold.
cheapTips: Rice bran is a byproduct; buy from Japanese markets for under $5 per large bag
Nuka bed lasts months with proper daily stirring; vegetables are added repeatedly

recipes.name: Torshi
recipes.description: Persian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash cucumbers and pack them upright into a clean mason jar with garlic and dill sprigs.
In a pot, bring vinegar, water, salt, turmeric, and all seeds to a boil.
Pour the hot brine carefully over the cucumbers until fully covered.
Let the jar cool completely, then cover and refrigerate for at least 3 days before eating.
Serve cold as a side condiment with Persian meals.
cheapTips: Buy cucumbers in bulk when in season and freeze brine separately to preserve
Make large batches in big jars; lasts 2+ months refrigerated

recipes.name: Gurken
recipes.description: German snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cucumber ends off and pack cucumbers vertically into clean sterilized jars with dill and onion slices.
In a pot, combine vinegar, water, sugar, salt, peppercorns, and mustard seeds, then bring to a boil.
Pour the hot brine over cucumbers until fully submerged.
Place lids on jars and let cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate for at least 2 days before serving; they taste best after 1 week.
cheapTips: Buy pickling cucumbers at farmers markets; they're cheaper than grocery stores in season
Reuse brine; just add fresh cucumbers and reheat

recipes.name: Achar
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds until they pop.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in turmeric and red chili powder, then add mango slices and salt.
Cook on low heat for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mangoes soften and darken.
Cool completely, transfer to sterilized jars, cover with plastic wrap and oil to seal.
Store in a cool, dark place for 2-3 weeks before eating to allow flavors to develop.
cheapTips: Buy unripe mangoes at Indian markets when they are in bulk supply
Make large batches; achar keeps for months and tastes better with age

recipes.name: Kaeng Som
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat coconut milk in a large pot over medium heat and stir in red curry paste and turmeric until smooth.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Cut fish fillets into chunks and add to the pot with fish sauce; simmer for 3 minutes.
Add shrimp, green beans, pineapple chunks, and cherry tomatoes, then simmer for 5 minutes until shrimp turns pink.
Stir in lime juice and adjust seasoning with additional fish sauce if needed.
Serve hot in bowls over jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp instead of fresh; same quality at 40% less cost
Make curry paste from scratch with dried chilies and garlic instead of canned

recipes.name: Natto
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried soybeans overnight in water, then drain and cook in fresh water for 1 hour until very soft.
Drain cooked beans and spread on clean paper towels to cool slightly.
Mix warm beans with natto starter culture in a sterile container and wrap tightly in cloth.
Incubate in a warm place (around 104°F) for 18-24 hours until a sticky, stringy texture develops.
Transfer to refrigerator and let cure for 1-2 days to develop full flavor.
Serve over warm rice with soy sauce, wasabi, and green onion; mix vigorously before eating.
cheapTips: Buy dried soybeans from bulk bins at Asian markets for 80% less than packaged
One natto culture starter makes multiple batches

recipes.name: Funazushi
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the whole fish thoroughly and pack tightly with salt, storing in a cool place for 3-4 weeks to cure.
After curing, rinse fish and carefully debone while keeping the body intact.
Combine cooked sushi rice with vinegar, water, and sugar to make sushi rice.
Stuff the fish cavity completely with vinegared rice, packing it tightly.
Wrap the entire fish in kombu seaweed and place in a clean container.
Ferment at room temperature for 6 months to 1 year, turning occasionally.
Unwrap, slice into thin pieces, and serve at room temperature as a delicacy.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish from Asian markets during winter months when prices drop
This recipe is an investment; cost per serving spreads across many months of fermentation

recipes.name: Sour Cream Cucumber Salad
recipes.description: Russian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thinly slice cucumbers and onion, then place in a serving bowl.
Sprinkle with salt and let sit for 5 minutes to allow cucumbers to release liquid.
In a separate bowl, mix sour cream, minced garlic, fresh dill, vinegar, and black pepper until smooth.
Pour the sour cream dressing over the cucumbers and onions.
Toss gently to combine and coat all vegetables evenly.
Serve cold immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve.
cheapTips: Buy sour cream in large containers instead of individual cups; 50% cheaper per ounce
Use store-brand sour cream; quality is identical to premium brands

recipes.name: Hollandaise
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a saucepan with 2 inches of water and bring to a simmer, then place a heatproof bowl on top without touching the water.
Whisk egg yolks with water in the bowl over gentle heat for 2-3 minutes until pale and warm.
Remove bowl from heat and slowly whisk in melted butter a few drops at a time until emulsified.
Whisk in lemon juice, salt, and cayenne pepper until smooth.
If sauce breaks, place a fresh egg yolk in a clean bowl and slowly whisk in the broken sauce to rescue it.
cheapTips: Buy eggs on sale and freeze extras for later use
Use salted butter instead of unsalted to save 20-30 cents

recipes.name: Risotto al Tartufo
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a pot and keep at a gentle simmer throughout cooking.
Dice onion and sauté in 2 tablespoons butter in a large heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add rice and toast for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly until edges are translucent.
Pour in wine and stir until absorbed, then add broth one ladle at a time, waiting for each addition to absorb before adding the next.
Continue adding broth and stirring for 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy and al dente.
Remove from heat and stir in remaining butter, parmesan, truffle oil, salt, and pepper.
cheapTips: Use truffle-flavored oil instead of real truffle shavings to save $15+ per serving
Substitute vegetable broth with homemade or store-brand budget broth

recipes.name: Sabayon
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a saucepan with 2 inches of water and bring to a simmer, then place a large heatproof bowl on top without touching water.
Combine egg yolks and sugar in the bowl and whisk constantly over gentle heat for 8-10 minutes until pale and tripled in volume.
Slowly whisk in marsala wine and vanilla extract while continuing to whisk over heat for 2-3 more minutes.
Remove bowl from heat and whisk for another 1-2 minutes until cooled slightly and fluffy.
Divide ladyfingers among serving glasses and drizzle with a small amount of marsala, then top with warm sabayon and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Replace marsala with cheap dry sherry or sweet vermouth
Buy store-brand ladyfingers instead of imported Italian ones

recipes.name: Piri Piri Chicken
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend red chili peppers, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper until smooth to make piri piri marinade.
Place chicken thighs in a large bowl and coat thoroughly with marinade, reserving 2 tablespoons for basting.
Marinate chicken for at least 30 minutes at room temperature or up to 8 hours in the refrigerator.
Preheat oven to 425°F and place chicken skin-side up on a baking sheet.
Roast chicken for 30-35 minutes until skin is golden and internal temperature reaches 165°F, basting with reserved marinade halfway through.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze for later use
Use bottled lemon juice instead of fresh lemons

recipes.name: Harissa Pasta
recipes.description: Tunisian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, mince garlic and sauté in olive oil over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in harissa paste and caraway seeds and cook for 30 seconds.
Add canned tomatoes with juice and simmer for 8-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Drain pasta and toss with sauce, then serve topped with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy harissa in bulk or at Middle Eastern markets for half the supermarket price
Use dried cilantro instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Sriracha Shakshuka
recipes.description: Middle Eastern breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion and garlic for 2 minutes until softened.
Add sriracha sauce and cumin and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in canned tomatoes with juice and simmer for 5-7 minutes until sauce reduces slightly.
Make 4 shallow wells in the sauce and crack one egg into each well.
Cover skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are still runny, then season with salt, pepper, and parsley.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale
Use generic sriracha brand instead of Huy Fong

recipes.name: Korean Tteokbokki
recipes.description: Korean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice cakes in warm water for 5 minutes until softened, then drain.
Mince garlic and stir together with gochujang, sugar, and water to make sauce.
Heat sesame oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat and add gochujang sauce.
Bring sauce to a simmer and add rice cakes, stirring gently for 5-7 minutes until coated and heated through.
Slice green onion and toss with rice cakes, then transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy rice cakes at Asian markets for $2-3 instead of specialty stores
Gochujang lasts months in the fridge, buy once and use multiple times

recipes.name: Suicide Wings
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place on a baking sheet.
Preheat oven to 425°F and bake wings for 25-30 minutes until golden and crispy.
While wings bake, combine ghost pepper sauce, butter, garlic powder, cayenne, honey, and lime juice in a small saucepan over low heat.
Remove wings from oven and transfer to a large bowl.
Pour hot sauce mixture over wings and toss to coat thoroughly, then transfer to a serving plate and season with salt.
cheapTips: Buy chicken wings on sale and freeze for later
Make your own hot sauce from dried peppers instead of buying premium brands

recipes.name: Ceviche with Aji
recipes.description: Peruvian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut white fish into 1/2-inch cubes and place in a glass bowl.
Squeeze juice from 6 limes over fish and stir gently, making sure fish is fully submerged in juice, then refrigerate for 15-20 minutes until fish turns opaque.
While fish cures, puree aji amarillo peppers with 1/4 cup lime juice to make aji sauce.
Dice red onion finely and chop cilantro.
Drain excess lime juice from fish, then fold in aji sauce, diced onion, cilantro, corn, salt, and black pepper and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy fish from wholesale markets or ask for discounts on same-day closing sales
Use frozen corn instead of fresh to save 30-40 cents

recipes.name: Sambal Oelek Fried Rice
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat and scramble eggs until cooked through, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the wok and stir-fry minced garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add sambal oelek and cook for 30 seconds, then add cooked rice breaking up any clumps.
Stir-fry rice for 3-4 minutes until heated through and coated with sambal, then add frozen vegetables and soy sauce.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until vegetables are warmed, then fold in scrambled eggs and sliced green onion and serve.
cheapTips: Cook rice a day ahead and refrigerate to save cooking time and money
Use leftover rice from takeout orders instead of cooking fresh

recipes.name: Habanero Hot Sauce
recipes.description: Caribbean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wear gloves and remove stems from habanero peppers, leaving seeds intact for heat.
Roughly chop peppers, garlic, and onion.
Combine peppers, garlic, onion, vinegar, lime juice, salt, and mustard powder in a blender.
Blend until smooth, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer to a saucepan and simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Cool completely and pour into clean bottles or jars for storage.
cheapTips: Buy habaneros in bulk during peak season and freeze extras
Use regular white vinegar instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Szechuan Hot Pot
recipes.description: Sichuan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a large pot over high heat with Sichuan peppercorns, dried chilies, star anise, ginger, and garlic.
Simmer for 15 minutes to infuse flavors, then strain out solids and return broth to pot.
Arrange thinly sliced beef, cabbage, mushrooms, and cubed tofu on separate plates.
Bring broth to a rolling boil at the table in a hot pot or fondue pot.
Guests cook their chosen ingredients in the broth for 30-60 seconds for meat and 2-3 minutes for vegetables.
Serve with dipping sauce made from sesame oil, soy sauce, and minced garlic.
cheapTips: Buy beef from cheaper cuts like sirloin tip and slice partially frozen meat yourself
Use frozen mushrooms and vegetables to reduce cost

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Platter
recipes.description: Scandinavian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice bagels in half and lightly toast them until golden.
Spread 2 tablespoons of cream cheese onto each bagel half.
Layer 2 oz of smoked salmon over the cream cheese on each bagel.
Thinly slice red onion and arrange on top of salmon.
Sprinkle capers and fresh dill over each bagel.
Slice cucumber into rounds and arrange on the side of the platter with lemon wedges.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy smoked salmon ends and pieces instead of premium sliced varieties
Make your own cream cheese spread with Greek yogurt to stretch portions

recipes.name: Dukkah Eggs
recipes.description: Egyptian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast hazelnuts, sesame seeds, cumin, and coriander in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Let cool slightly, then finely chop and mix with salt and pepper to create dukkah spice blend.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat.
Carefully crack eggs into the skillet and cook until whites are set but yolks remain runny, about 4-5 minutes.
Sprinkle dukkah generously over the cooked eggs.
Warm pita bread in a separate skillet or oven.
Serve eggs with warm pita for dipping.
cheapTips: Make large batches of dukkah spice blend and store in jars for multiple meals
Substitute almonds or sunflower seeds for hazelnuts

recipes.name: Burrata with Heirloom Tomatoes
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice heirloom tomatoes into 1/4-inch thick pieces and arrange on a serving platter.
Lightly mince the garlic clove and scatter over tomatoes.
Place burrata ball in the center of the tomatoes.
Drizzle entire platter with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Sprinkle with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Tear fresh basil leaves and scatter over the top.
Serve immediately at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy burrata when on sale and serve the same day
Use regular tomatoes if heirlooms are expensive, or buy at farmers market

recipes.name: Chicken Parmigiana
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breasts to 1/2-inch thickness between plastic wrap.
Set up breading station with flour in one bowl, beaten eggs in another, and breadcrumbs in a third.
Season chicken with salt and pepper, then coat each piece in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs in sequence.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry breaded chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden, working in batches.
Spread thin layer of marinara sauce on bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.
Layer breaded chicken, remaining marinara sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan in the dish.
Bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze, or use thighs instead
Use store-brand marinara sauce and shredded mozzarella

recipes.name: Chicken Korma
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onion finely and mince garlic and ginger.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and toast cumin seeds for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced onion and cook for 5-7 minutes until golden, stirring occasionally.
Stir in garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then stir in garam masala and turmeric.
Add diced chicken and cook for 5 minutes, stirring to coat with spices.
Pour in coconut milk and stir in yogurt slowly to avoid curdling.
Simmer for 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce is creamy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve.
cheapTips: Buy whole spices at Indian grocery stores for significant savings
Use regular yogurt or sour cream instead of Greek yogurt

recipes.name: Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook diced chicken in a pot with water, diced onion, and garlic until cooked through, about 15 minutes; shred the chicken.
Mix shredded chicken with 1/2 cup enchilada sauce, sour cream, half the cheese, minced jalapeño, cilantro, and lime juice.
Warm tortillas in a skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds per side to make them pliable.
Spread thin layer of enchilada sauce on bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.
Fill each tortilla with 3 tablespoons of chicken mixture, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in the baking dish.
Pour remaining enchilada sauce evenly over rolled tortillas and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes until sauce bubbles and cheese melts.
Garnish with additional cilantro and serve with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Use store-brand canned enchilada sauce
Buy chicken thighs or breasts on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Chicken Satay
recipes.description: Indonesian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Cut chicken breast into 1-inch cubes.
Make peanut sauce by blending peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, minced garlic, ginger, brown sugar, chili flakes, and coconut milk until smooth.
Thread chicken cubes onto skewers, 4-5 pieces per skewer.
Reserve half of peanut sauce for dipping and toss chicken skewers with remaining sauce.
Grill skewers over medium-high heat for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot with reserved peanut sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for more flavor and lower cost
Make peanut sauce from scratch rather than buying pre-made

recipes.name: Chicken Yakitori
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Make glaze by combining soy sauce, mirin, sake, brown sugar, and minced garlic in a small saucepan; simmer for 2 minutes.
Cut chicken thighs into 1.5-inch cubes and cut green onions into 2-inch pieces.
Thread chicken and green onions alternately onto skewers.
Grill skewers over medium-high heat for 8-10 minutes, turning frequently.
During last 2 minutes of cooking, brush both sides of skewers with the glaze.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and shichimi spice.
Serve immediately with small dish of remaining glaze for dipping.
cheapTips: Skip the mirin and use 2 more tablespoons of brown sugar mixed with water
Buy chicken thighs in bulk and freeze for multiple batches

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
recipes.description: Indian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, minced garlic, ginger, garam masala, and turmeric for 30 minutes.
Heat ghee in a large pot and fry sliced onions until golden brown, then remove and set aside.
Brown the marinated chicken in the same ghee for 5 minutes, then remove.
Boil water with bay leaf and cumin seeds, then add rinsed basmati rice and cook until 70% done.
In the same pot, layer half the rice, then all the chicken, then remaining rice on top.
Sprinkle fried onions over the top layer and cover tightly with foil and a lid.
Cook on high heat for 2 minutes until steam forms, then reduce to low heat for 30 minutes.
Let rest 10 minutes without opening, then gently fluff with a fork and serve.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breast to save 30%
Use regular rice if basmati is too expensive

recipes.name: Poulet Rôti
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F and pat chicken dry with paper towels.
Mix softened butter with minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then rub under and over chicken skin.
Stuff cavity with halved lemons and herb sprigs, then tie legs together with kitchen twine.
Place chicken on a roasting pan and pour broth into the bottom.
Roast for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes, basting with pan juices every 20 minutes.
Chicken is done when thigh reaches 165°F and juices run clear.
Rest for 10 minutes before carving, then serve with pan juices as gravy.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken instead of parts to save 40%
Skip fresh herbs and use dried (1 teaspoon each) to cut cost in half

recipes.name: Lemon Chicken
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and coat with egg, then dredge in cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or deep pan to 350°F and fry chicken in batches until golden, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Remove fried chicken and drain on paper towels.
In a saucepan, combine sugar, lemon juice, water, soy sauce, and minced garlic, and bring to a simmer.
Simmer sauce for 5 minutes until slightly thickened, then pour over fried chicken.
Toss gently to coat and garnish with sliced green onion and lemon slices.
Serve immediately over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs for deeper flavor and save money
Make sauce with bottled lemon juice to save prep time

recipes.name: Chicken Shaslyk
recipes.description: Russian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into 1.5-inch cubes and slice onions into thick rings.
Whisk together oil, vinegar, water, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and bay leaf for marinade.
Combine chicken and onion in a bowl, pour marinade over, and refrigerate for 2-4 hours or overnight.
Thread chicken and onion alternately onto metal or wooden skewers (soak wood 30 minutes first).
Heat grill or grill pan to high heat and cook skewers 8-10 minutes, turning every 2 minutes until cooked through.
Chicken should reach 165°F internal temperature and have light charring.
Serve hot with remaining marinade as a dipping sauce and lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breast for more flavor and lower cost
Marinate overnight to maximize tenderness and flavor

recipes.name: Steak Tartare
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Use the freshest, highest-quality beef from a trusted butcher and ask for it to be ground very finely.
Finely mince shallot and parsley, and chop capers into small pieces.
Place ground beef in a bowl and create a well in the center for the egg yolk.
Add egg yolk, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper to the beef.
Using a fork, gently fold ingredients together until just combined, being careful not to overwork the meat.
Fold in capers, shallot, and parsley until evenly distributed.
Divide into two portions, shape into quenelles or mounds on serving plates, and serve immediately with toasted bread or crackers.
cheapTips: Use ground sirloin instead of filet to save 30%
Buy ingredients from a warehouse club to reduce cost

recipes.name: Chimichurri Steak
recipes.description: Argentine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roughly chop parsley, oregano, and garlic, then add to a food processor with vinegar and olive oil.
Pulse until chimichurri reaches a chunky consistency, then season with red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Let chimichurri rest at room temperature for at least 15 minutes.
Pat steaks dry with paper towels and season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill to very high heat until smoking hot.
Sear steaks 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare, adjusting based on thickness and desired doneness.
Transfer steaks to a plate and let rest 5 minutes, then serve topped with generous spoonfuls of chimichurri.
cheapTips: Use flank steak instead of ribeye to save 40%
Make chimichurri with dried oregano if fresh is unavailable

recipes.name: Flank Steak with Chimichurri
recipes.description: Argentine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pulse parsley, oregano, garlic, vinegar, and olive oil in a food processor until chunky, then season with red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Let chimichurri rest at room temperature for 15 minutes while preparing the steak.
Pat flank steak dry and season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill to very high heat until smoking.
Sear steak 6-7 minutes per side for medium-rare, maintaining medium-high heat throughout.
Transfer to a cutting board and rest for 5-10 minutes.
Slice against the grain into thin strips and arrange on a serving plate, then drizzle generously with chimichurri sauce.
cheapTips: Buy flank steak on sale and freeze for later use
Make double chimichurri and store in the fridge for other dishes

recipes.name: Camarones a la Diabla
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles, then toast in a dry skillet for 30 seconds.
Soak toasted chiles in hot water for 10 minutes to soften, then drain and blend with garlic, vinegar, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Pour chile sauce into the hot oil and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent sticking.
Add shrimp and stir to coat with sauce, then cook for 4-5 minutes until shrimp turns pink and is cooked through.
Taste sauce and adjust seasoning with more salt or vinegar as needed.
Transfer to a serving bowl and squeeze fresh lime juice over the top, then serve immediately with rice or warm tortillas.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp to save 30% and thaw before cooking
Make sauce in advance to save time during cooking

recipes.name: Huachinango a la Veracruzana
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes, bay leaves, salt, and pepper, then simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Stir in olives and capers, then taste and adjust seasoning.
Arrange fish fillets in a single layer in the sauce, nestling them in gently.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer covered for 12-15 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
Carefully transfer fish and sauce to a serving platter, being careful not to break the fillets.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately with lime wedges and rice.
cheapTips: Use canned tomatoes to save on prep time and cost
Substitute frozen snapper fillets for fresh to reduce expense

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Parsley Sauce
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and peel and slice potatoes into thin rounds.
Mince parsley and garlic together to create a gremolata-like mixture.
Arrange sliced potatoes and onions in a baking dish, drizzle with 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast potatoes for 15 minutes until they begin to soften.
Place cod fillets on top of potatoes, season with salt and pepper, and pour white wine around (not over) the fish.
Mix remaining 4 tablespoons olive oil with minced parsley and garlic, then drizzle over fish and sprinkle on potatoes.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until cod is opaque and flakes easily, then squeeze fresh lemon juice over everything and serve.
cheapTips: Use frozen cod fillets to save 25% and maintain quality
Skip wine and use extra lemon juice and broth instead

recipes.name: Calamari Fritti
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the squid by removing the head and ink sac, then cut the bodies into 0.5-inch rings.
Whisk together eggs and milk in a shallow bowl.
Combine flour, salt, and pepper in another shallow bowl.
Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F.
Dip squid rings in egg mixture, then dredge in flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Fry squid in batches for 1-2 minutes until golden and crispy.
Transfer to paper towels to drain.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy frozen squid tubes in bulk and thaw—much cheaper than fresh
Make your own breading mix instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Pad Thai with Shrimp
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 30 minutes until pliable, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and stir-fry minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes until beginning to turn pink.
Push ingredients to the side, crack eggs into the pan, scramble briefly, then mix with shrimp.
Add drained noodles, tamarind paste, fish sauce, and palm sugar; toss constantly for 3-4 minutes.
Stir in half the bean sprouts and green onions.
Transfer to plates and top with crushed peanuts, remaining bean sprouts, green onions, and lime wedges.
cheapTips: Use shrimp paste instead of tamarind for a cheaper sauce base
Buy peanuts in bulk and crush them yourself

recipes.name: Char Siu
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into 2-inch thick strips, about 8 inches long.
Mix soy sauce, hoisin, honey, rice vinegar, minced garlic, ginger, and food coloring in a bowl.
Marinate pork in the sauce for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight in the refrigerator.
Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Place marinated pork on the prepared sheet and reserve the marinade sauce.
Roast for 40-50 minutes, brushing with reserved marinade every 15 minutes.
Turn meat halfway through cooking for even browning and caramelization.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze—it's often less expensive than other cuts
Skip red food coloring; it tastes the same without it

recipes.name: Crispy Pata
recipes.description: Filipino dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place pork leg in a large pot with water, salt, garlic, peppercorns, and bay leaves; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 1.5 hours until pork is very tender and skin is soft.
Remove pork and let cool completely, then pat skin dry thoroughly with paper towels.
Rub cornstarch all over the skin to help it crisp.
Heat oil in a deep pot or wok to 350°F.
Carefully lower pork into hot oil and fry for 10-15 minutes, rotating occasionally, until skin is golden and blistered.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Serve hot with vinegar dipping sauce and steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork knuckle from a butcher counter—often cheaper than pre-packaged
Reuse the boiling broth for soups or stock

recipes.name: Cotoletta alla Milanese
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place veal cutlets between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 0.25-inch thickness.
Set up three shallow bowls: one with flour, one with beaten eggs, and one with bread crumbs mixed with salt and pepper.
Dredge each cutlet in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, then coat thoroughly in bread crumbs.
Heat butter and oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once foaming, carefully place cutlets in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and a simple arugula salad.
cheapTips: Substitute chicken breasts for veal—tastes similar and costs half as much
Make your own bread crumbs from stale bread

recipes.name: Dong Po Rou
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork belly into 2-inch cubes, then blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes to remove impurities.
Drain and rinse the pork under cold water.
Heat a wok or large pot over medium heat and dry-fry the pork cubes until lightly browned on all sides.
Add soy sauce, rock sugar, rice wine, water, ginger slices, garlic cloves, and star anise.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 1.5 hours, stirring occasionally.
Add green onions and simmer uncovered for another 15 minutes until sauce is thickened.
Serve in a bowl with the braising sauce over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use brown sugar instead of rock sugar—same sweetness at half the cost
Buy pork belly on sale and freeze for later

recipes.name: Lechon Kawali
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork belly into 3-inch cubes, keeping skin intact.
Place pork in a large pot with water, salt, garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45-60 minutes until pork is tender and cooked through.
Remove pork and pat completely dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F.
Carefully lower pork pieces into hot oil, working in batches, and fry for 5-8 minutes until skin is golden and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve with vinegar dipping sauce and steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly from warehouse stores in bulk for significant savings
Save the cooking broth to use as stock

recipes.name: Mu Pad Krapow
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and chilies together into a paste.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add garlic-chili paste and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add ground pork and cook for 3-4 minutes, breaking it apart, until no longer pink.
Stir in fish sauce, oyster sauce, and palm sugar.
Add holy basil leaves and toss gently for 1 minute until wilted.
Serve immediately over jasmine rice with a fried egg on top.
cheapTips: Substitute regular basil for holy basil if unavailable—different but delicious
Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Loukoumades with Pork
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine warm water and yeast; let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then add yeast mixture and stir until a thick batter forms.
Cover and let rise for 20 minutes.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot.
Brown ground pork in a skillet with cinnamon and walnuts; set aside.
Using two wet spoons, drop batter by tablespoons into hot oil and fry until golden on all sides, about 2 minutes per batch.
Drain loukoumades on paper towels.
Drizzle warm honey over loukoumades and top with pork mixture and crushed walnuts.
cheapTips: Use honey left over from other recipes instead of buying new
Buy walnuts in bulk and freeze

recipes.name: Boiled Pork with Shrimp Paste
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a large pot with salt.
Add pork shoulder and return to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 35-40 minutes until cooked through.
Remove pork and let cool slightly, then slice into 0.5-inch thick pieces.
Pound garlic and chilies together in a mortar and pestle to form a paste.
Mix shrimp paste with the garlic-chili paste, fish sauce, and lime juice in a small bowl.
Arrange sliced pork on a serving platter.
Pour shrimp paste sauce over the pork and sprinkle with cilantro and green onions.
cheapTips: Use the boiling broth as stock for other recipes
Buy pork shoulder when on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Adobong Baboy
recipes.description: Filipino lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into 1.5-inch cubes and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown pork on all sides for 5 minutes total.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in soy sauce, vinegar, and water, then add bay leaves and peppercorns.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 35 minutes.
Stir in brown sugar and simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes until sauce reduces slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning with soy sauce or vinegar as needed.
Serve over steamed white rice with sauce spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when on sale and freeze for later
Use store-brand soy sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Socarrat de Cerdo
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork into 1-inch cubes and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large paella pan or wide skillet over medium-high heat and brown pork on all sides for 8 minutes.
Remove pork and set aside, then sauté diced onion and garlic in the same pan for 3 minutes.
Stir in smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes to toast lightly.
Pour in warm broth and return pork to pan, add bay leaf, then bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered without stirring for 18-20 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is mostly absorbed.
Increase heat to high for the last 2-3 minutes to create a crispy bottom layer (socarrat), listening for light crackling sounds.
Remove from heat and let rest 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Make your own broth by simmering chicken bones with onion and carrot
Buy rice in bulk from ethnic markets for significant savings

recipes.name: Moo Pad Mamuang
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and slice red bell pepper and onion into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat until just smoking.
Add minced garlic and sliced chili and cook for 20 seconds until fragrant.
Add ground pork and break apart with a spatula, cooking for 4-5 minutes until cooked through.
Add bell pepper and onion, then toss everything together and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and water, stirring constantly.
Add cashews and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then serve immediately over steamed jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy cashews from bulk bins instead of packaged
Use frozen bell peppers to save money

recipes.name: Shaoxing Pork Belly
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork belly into 1.5-inch cubes and blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Heat oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown pork cubes on all sides for 8 minutes total.
Add ginger slices, garlic cloves, and star anise, stirring for 1 minute.
Deglaze pan with Shaoxing wine, scraping up browned bits, and let simmer for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, rock sugar, and water, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover partially, and simmer for 60 minutes until pork is very tender.
Uncover and increase heat to medium, simmering for 10 more minutes to reduce and thicken sauce.
Serve in bowls with sauce, garnished with sliced scallion and steamed rice on the side.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly from Asian markets where it's usually cheaper
Rock sugar can be found in the Asian section of most supermarkets

recipes.name: Omelette Soufflé
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Separate eggs carefully, putting whites in one bowl and yolks in another.
Add salt, white pepper, chives, and half the cheese to egg yolks and whisk together.
Add cream of tartar to egg whites and beat with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold one-third of whites into yolk mixture, then fold in remaining whites until just combined.
Melt butter in a 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Pour mixture into skillet and cook without stirring for 4 minutes until bottom is set but top is still wet.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and transfer skillet to a preheated 375°F oven for 6-8 minutes until top is golden and puffed.
Slide onto a plate, fold in half, and serve immediately while still puffy.
cheapTips: Use cheddar instead of gruyere if budget is tight
Farm-fresh eggs from local sources are often cheaper per dozen

recipes.name: Oeuf Cocotte
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and place two ramekins on a baking sheet.
Butter the inside of each ramekin generously.
Divide cream between the two ramekins, then sprinkle half the cheese into each.
Carefully crack two eggs into each ramekin without breaking the yolks.
Season with salt, white pepper, and sprinkle remaining cheese on top.
Add a knob of butter to each ramekin and place baking sheet in oven.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are still slightly runny.
Remove from oven, garnish with chives and parsley, and serve immediately in the ramekins with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Skip the gruyere and use sharp cheddar for half the cost
Buy heavy cream on sale and freeze in ice cube trays

recipes.name: Ramen with Ajitsuke Tamago
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil eggs for exactly 6.5 minutes for soft-boiled centers, then ice bath immediately and peel carefully when cool.
Marinate peeled eggs in a mixture of 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp mirin, and 1 tbsp sake for at least 20 minutes.
Heat chicken broth in a large pot with smashed garlic, ginger slice, and remaining soy sauce and mirin for 10 minutes.
Bring a separate pot of water to boil and cook ramen noodles according to package directions, then drain.
Divide noodles between two bowls and ladle hot broth over them.
Place one marinated egg in the center of each bowl, halved if desired.
Top with sliced green onion, strips of nori, and a drizzle of sesame oil.
Serve immediately while broth is still steaming.
cheapTips: Use vegetable broth instead of chicken broth
Buy ramen noodles in bulk from Asian markets for pennies per package

recipes.name: Custard Tart
recipes.description: Portuguese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a muffin tin with puff pastry pieces.
Whisk together egg yolks, sweetened condensed milk, heavy cream, vanilla, and half the cinnamon until smooth.
Pour custard mixture evenly into pastry-lined cups, filling about three-quarters full.
Mix remaining cinnamon with nutmeg and lightly dust over the top of each tart.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until pastry is golden brown and custard is set but still slightly jiggly in the center.
Remove from oven and let cool in the tin for 5 minutes before carefully removing.
Serve warm or at room temperature; tarts are best eaten the day they're made.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand puff pastry and sweetened condensed milk on sale
Make a double batch and freeze extras for quick desserts

recipes.name: Shirred Eggs
recipes.description: French breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and generously butter two shallow baking dishes or ramekins.
Finely chop ham into small pieces and divide between the two dishes.
Divide cream evenly between the two dishes.
Carefully crack two eggs into each dish without breaking the yolks.
Season lightly with salt and pepper, then sprinkle cheese evenly on top of each.
Place a small dot of butter on top of each.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain slightly runny.
Serve immediately in the baking dish with crusty bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Use deli ham that's on sale rather than premium varieties
Replace emmental with cheddar cheese for cost savings

recipes.name: Balut
recipes.description: Filipino snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place fertilized duck egg in a pot and cover completely with water.
Add salt, ginger, and garlic to the water for flavoring.
Bring water to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 16-18 minutes depending on the age of the embryo (older eggs cook longer).
Remove egg with a slotted spoon and place on a plate to cool for 2-3 minutes until handleable.
Gently tap and crack open the larger end of the eggshell.
Sip the warm broth from inside the egg, then scoop out the soft contents with a small spoon and eat with salt and vinegar dip.
Discard the shell and any remaining hard parts.
cheapTips: Buy balut from Filipino markets where they're cheaper and fresher
Often sold by the dozen, which reduces per-egg cost significantly

recipes.name: Tofu Skin Rolls
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak tofu skin sheets in warm water for 5 minutes until pliable, then pat dry.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan and cook ground pork with garlic and ginger until browned.
Add diced mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes, then stir in 2 tbsp soy sauce and sesame oil.
Place 2-3 tbsp filling on each tofu skin sheet, roll tightly, and fold in sides.
Place rolls seam-side down in a greased baking dish and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.
Mix 1/2 cup water, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and cornstarch into a sauce.
Pour sauce over rolls and bake for another 10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy tofu skin in bulk from Asian markets for significant savings
Use ground chicken instead of pork to reduce cost

recipes.name: Yudofu
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring dashi broth to a simmer in a large pot with kombu seaweed.
Add napa cabbage, mushrooms, and carrots to the broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir miso paste into the broth until fully dissolved.
Gently add tofu cubes and green onions to the pot.
Simmer for 8-10 minutes, allowing flavors to blend but keeping tofu intact.
Serve in individual bowls with broth, arranging vegetables and tofu.
Pour ponzu sauce into small dipping bowls for each guest.
Garnish with scallions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Make dashi from kombu and bonito flakes instead of buying pre-made
Buy mushrooms from discount grocery stores for better prices

recipes.name: Tofu Pudding
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend silken tofu until very smooth and creamy.
Heat ginger syrup with water in a small saucepan until warm.
Divide blended tofu into serving bowls.
Pour warm ginger syrup over each bowl of tofu.
Drizzle with honey and sesame oil.
Top with crushed peanuts and goji berries.
Stir gently before eating to incorporate all flavors.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy ginger syrup in bulk from Asian markets
Use unsalted raw peanuts instead of pre-roasted to save money

recipes.name: Matcha Tofu Cheesecake
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press firmly into the bottom of a 6-inch springform pan.
Whisk matcha powder with hot water until smooth with no lumps.
Blend pressed silken tofu with cream cheese until completely smooth.
Add sugar, egg, vanilla, and matcha mixture to the tofu blend and mix until combined.
Pour filling over crust and smooth the top.
Bake at 325°F for 30-35 minutes until set but slightly jiggly in the center.
Cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Run a knife around edges and release from springform pan before serving.
cheapTips: Buy matcha powder from bulk online retailers instead of specialty shops
Substitute some cream cheese with additional silken tofu to reduce cost

recipes.name: Tofu Steak
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between paper towels under heavy weight for 20 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Cut pressed tofu into 1-inch thick rectangular steaks.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Carefully place tofu steaks in the hot oil and cook for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown.
Pour the marinade mixture into the pan around the tofu.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes, basting tofu with sauce occasionally.
Transfer to plates, pour remaining sauce over top, and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy extra-firm tofu on sale and freeze for later use
Make your own marinade instead of buying pre-made teriyaki sauce

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu under weight for 15 minutes to remove moisture, then crumble with your hands into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and bell pepper, sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add crumbled tofu to the pan and stir well.
Sprinkle turmeric, garlic powder, nutritional yeast, and black pepper over the tofu.
Stir frequently and cook for 8-10 minutes until tofu is heated through and slightly browned.
Add soy sauce and mix until evenly distributed.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy tofu in bulk and freeze to save money
Skip nutritional yeast or use less if budget is tight

recipes.name: Crispy Tofu with Garlic Sauce
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu for 20 minutes, then cut into 1-inch cubes.
Coat tofu cubes evenly in cornstarch by shaking in a bowl.
Heat oil in a deep pan or wok to 350°F and carefully fry tofu in batches for 4-5 minutes until golden and crispy.
Remove tofu with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
In a small saucepan, heat 1 tbsp oil and sauté minced garlic for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and water to create the sauce, simmer for 2 minutes.
Stir in sesame oil and red pepper flakes.
Toss crispy tofu with garlic sauce until evenly coated and transfer to serving dish.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Reuse frying oil by straining and storing in a glass jar
Buy garlic in bulk and mince ahead to save time and money

recipes.name: Tofu Satay
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Press tofu, cut into 1-inch cubes, and thread onto soaked skewers.
Whisk together peanut butter, coconut milk, lime juice, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, and red pepper flakes until smooth.
Brush tofu skewers with half the peanut sauce.
Heat grill or grill pan over medium-high heat and cook skewers for 4-5 minutes per side until lightly charred.
Warm remaining peanut sauce in a small saucepan over low heat for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer skewers to a serving platter and drizzle with warm peanut sauce.
Serve with extra sauce on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Use store-brand peanut butter instead of specialty brands
Buy coconut milk from bulk stores or discount retailers

recipes.name: Silken Tofu with Century Egg
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Gently remove silken tofu from container and place on a serving plate.
Peel century eggs and cut into small pieces.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, ginger, and chili oil in a small bowl.
Arrange century egg pieces over the tofu.
Pour sauce mixture over the tofu and century egg.
Garnish generously with chopped green onions.
Let sit for 2 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled or at room temperature with rice on the side.
cheapTips: Buy century eggs in bulk from Asian markets
Make your own sauce instead of buying premixed dressings

recipes.name: Tofu Skin Soup
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried tofu skin in warm water for 10 minutes until softened, then drain and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Heat sesame oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté garlic and ginger for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add softened tofu skin pieces and sliced mushrooms, simmer for 10 minutes.
Add bok choy and simmer for an additional 5 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with soy sauce and adjust to taste.
Remove from heat and stir in additional sesame oil if desired.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with sliced green onions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy dried tofu skin in bulk from Asian grocery stores
Use vegetable broth instead of chicken broth to make it vegetarian and cheaper

recipes.name: Tempeh Stir-fry with Kecap Manis
recipes.description: Indonesian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut tempeh into ½-inch cubes and pan-fry in 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes total, then set aside.
Add remaining oil to the same pan and sauté garlic, ginger, and red chili for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add sliced onions and bell peppers, stir-frying for 4-5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Return tempeh to the pan and add kecap manis and lime juice, tossing to coat everything evenly.
Cook for another 2 minutes until sauce is glossy and ingredients are well combined.
Serve immediately over cooked rice.
cheapTips: Buy tempeh in bulk when on sale; it freezes well for months
Use whatever bell peppers are cheapest that week

recipes.name: Gado-gado with Tempeh
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut tempeh into thin slices and pan-fry in 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side until crispy, then set aside.
Blanch cabbage and carrots in boiling water for 2 minutes, drain and set aside.
Make the peanut sauce by mixing peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, minced garlic, brown sugar, and 3 tablespoons water until smooth.
Arrange boiled potatoes, blanched vegetables, cucumber slices, and tempeh on a serving plate.
Halve the hard-boiled eggs and place on the plate.
Drizzle peanut sauce generously over all components and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Boil potatoes ahead and store in the fridge for quick assembly
Use store-brand peanut butter to save 30-40 cents

recipes.name: Tempeh Burger
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice tempeh horizontally into two ½-inch-thick patties.
Mix soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, and garlic powder in a shallow dish and marinate tempeh patties for 5 minutes on each side.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook marinated tempeh for 4-5 minutes per side until browned.
Toast burger buns lightly in the same skillet if desired.
Spread mayo on both bun halves and layer with lettuce, tempeh patty, tomato slices, and onion.
Serve immediately with your choice of condiments.
cheapTips: Buy tempeh when it's on sale and freeze extras for future burgers
Skip the vegan mayo and use regular mayo to cut cost by 50 cents

recipes.name: Tempeh Bacon
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice tempeh lengthwise into thin strips about ¼ inch thick.
Mix maple syrup, soy sauce, smoked paprika, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Brush tempeh strips with the maple-soy mixture on both sides.
Fry tempeh strips for 3-4 minutes per side until edges are crispy and caramelized.
Serve hot alongside eggs and toast or on its own.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and store in the fridge for quick breakfasts all week
Use regular soy sauce instead of low-sodium to save money

recipes.name: Chilled Tofu with Dipping Sauce
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Gently drain silken tofu and place on a serving plate.
Combine soy sauce, mirin, and dashi in a small bowl and whisk together.
Pour the dipping sauce into individual small bowls.
Top the tofu with sliced green onions, grated ginger, and bonito flakes.
Serve tofu chilled with ice cubes on or beside the plate for cooling.
Diners dip tofu pieces into the sauce before eating.
cheapTips: Skip bonito flakes if not available; the dish is just as good without
Use water instead of dashi stock to cut cost in half

recipes.name: Tofu Miso Soup
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring dashi stock to a gentle simmer in a pot over medium heat.
Add seaweed and simmer for 2 minutes until soft.
In a small bowl, dissolve miso paste with a few tablespoons of hot broth to prevent clumping.
Gently pour the dissolved miso back into the pot and stir well.
Add tofu cubes and simmer for 2 minutes without letting it boil hard.
Remove from heat and ladle into bowls, garnishing with green onions and optional bonito flakes.
cheapTips: Buy miso paste in bulk from Asian markets at half the price of supermarkets
Use vegetable broth instead of dashi to save 75 cents per serving

recipes.name: Tofu Kimchi Jjim
recipes.description: Korean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut firm tofu into 1-inch cubes and press gently between paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Heat vegetable oil in a large shallow pan or skillet over medium heat and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add chopped kimchi and gochugaru, stirring for 1 minute to release flavors.
Pour in kimchi juice and soy sauce, then gently place tofu cubes into the liquid.
Simmer uncovered for 12-15 minutes until sauce reduces slightly and tofu absorbs flavors.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, then serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy kimchi from Korean grocery stores at half the price of mainstream supermarkets
Make your own kimchi to save significantly on repeated purchases

recipes.name: Tofu Donburi
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between paper towels to remove excess moisture, then cut into ½-inch cubes.
Heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium-high heat and pan-fry tofu cubes until edges are golden, about 5 minutes, then remove.
In the same pan, sauté sliced onion until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Return tofu to the pan and simmer together for 3-4 minutes until flavors meld.
Divide cooked rice between two bowls and top each with tofu and sauce, garnishing with green onions and sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Buy tofu in bulk at Asian markets for 40% less than supermarkets
Cook rice in large batches and freeze portions for quick meal assembly

recipes.name: Tempeh Rendang
recipes.description: Malaysian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut tempeh into 1-inch cubes and pan-fry in 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes, then set aside.
Heat remaining oil and sauté garlic, ginger, galangal, and red chili for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sliced onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened.
Stir in turmeric powder and cook for 30 seconds.
Add coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer, then add fried tempeh cubes.
Simmer uncovered for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce reduces and coats the tempeh and oil separates slightly (characteristic of true rendang).
Finish with lime juice, salt, and pepper to taste, then serve with rice.
cheapTips: Buy canned coconut milk in bulk when on sale; it keeps for over a year
Substitute galangal with extra ginger to save 40 cents per serving

recipes.name: Tofu and Vegetable Dumplings
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between paper towels to remove excess moisture, then crumble into small pieces.
Salt chopped napa cabbage lightly and let sit 5 minutes, then squeeze out excess liquid.
Mix crumbled tofu, squeezed cabbage, green onions, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Place 1 teaspoon filling in the center of each dumpling wrapper, wet the edge with water, fold in half, then crimp the edges to seal.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and place dumplings flat-side down in the pan in a single layer.
