Fry for 2-3 minutes until bottoms are golden, then add ¼ cup water to the pan and cover immediately.
Steam for 5-6 minutes until water evaporates and dumplings are cooked through, then serve hot with soy sauce or chili oil.
cheapTips: Buy dumpling wrappers from Asian markets at 50% the price of mainstream stores
Make large batches and freeze uncooked dumplings for weeks of easy meals

recipes.name: Mushroom Soup
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice mushrooms and finely dice onion and garlic.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add garlic and mushrooms, cooking for 5 minutes until mushrooms release their liquid.
Pour in vegetable broth and add thyme, bringing to a simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in sherry and heavy cream, simmering for 3 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy button mushrooms instead of specialty varieties
Use chicken broth instead of vegetable broth for better value

recipes.name: Mushroom Pasta Carbonara
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain.
Whisk eggs with parmesan cheese and black pepper in a bowl.
Cut pancetta into small pieces and cook in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté mushrooms with minced garlic until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add cooked pasta to the mushroom mixture and remove from heat.
Pour egg mixture over pasta and toss quickly, adding pasta water a little at a time until creamy.
Stir in pancetta and season with salt and pepper, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use bacon instead of pancetta to save money
Buy pre-sliced mushrooms to save prep time

recipes.name: Porcini Tagliatelle
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried porcini mushrooms in 1 cup hot water for 15 minutes, then strain and reserve liquid.
Cook tagliatelle in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Melt butter in a large skillet and sauté diced onion until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and fresh mushrooms, cooking until golden, about 6 minutes.
Chop soaked porcini mushrooms and add to skillet with reserved soaking liquid, simmering for 5 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and simmer for 3 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Toss cooked pasta with sauce and parmesan cheese, season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy dried porcini in bulk from ethnic grocery stores
Skip fresh mushrooms if porcini flavor is strong enough

recipes.name: Mushroom Tempura
recipes.description: Japanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan or wok to 350°F.
Clean mushrooms with a damp cloth and trim stems, leaving whole or halving large ones.
Whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, beat egg and mix with ice water.
Combine wet and dry ingredients gently to form a lumpy batter.
Dip mushrooms in batter and carefully place in hot oil, frying until golden, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Mix soy sauce, dashi, and mirin to make dipping sauce.
Serve tempura immediately with warm dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Use regular button mushrooms instead of specialty varieties
Make dipping sauce from scratch with pantry staples

recipes.name: Shiitake Donburi
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice with 2.5 cups water according to package directions, then fluff with a fork.
Slice shiitake mushrooms and dice onion.
In a saucepan, combine dashi, soy sauce, and mirin, bringing to a simmer.
Add mushrooms and onion to the simmering broth and cook for 5 minutes.
In a bowl, beat eggs lightly, then slowly pour into the broth while stirring gently to create threads.
Cook eggs until just set, about 1-2 minutes.
Divide cooked rice among three bowls and ladle mushroom-egg mixture over top.
Garnish with sliced green onions and nori if desired, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular button mushrooms if shiitake are too expensive
Skip nori garnish to reduce cost

recipes.name: Miso Soup with Enoki
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring dashi broth to a simmer in a pot over medium heat.
Cut tofu into small cubes and trim the base of enoki mushrooms.
Add enoki mushrooms to the simmering broth and cook for 2 minutes.
Add tofu cubes and gently heat through for 1 minute without boiling.
Dissolve miso paste in a small bowl with a ladle of hot broth, then stir back into the pot.
Remove from heat immediately to avoid killing beneficial probiotic cultures.
Slice green onions and ladle soup into bowls.
Garnish with green onions and bonito flakes if using, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make your own dashi from kombu and bonito, much cheaper than store broth
Buy miso in bulk from Asian markets

recipes.name: Mushroom Biryani
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak basmati rice in water for 30 minutes, then drain.
Heat 2 tablespoons ghee in a large pot and fry sliced onions until deep golden, reserving half for garnish.
In a bowl, mix mushrooms with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, diced tomato, and chopped green chili.
Boil water in a large pot with whole spices (cumin, cinnamon, cardamom, bay leaves) and salt.
Add soaked rice to boiling water and cook until 70% done (rice should still have bite), then drain.
Layer rice and mushroom mixture in the ghee-coated pot, starting and ending with rice.
Sprinkle reserved fried onions and cilantro on top, then drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons ghee.
Cover pot with foil, place a tight lid on top, and cook over low heat for 20-25 minutes until rice is tender and fluffy.
cheapTips: Use vegetable oil instead of ghee for significant savings
Buy whole spices in bulk from Indian grocery stores

recipes.name: Mushroom Masala
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sauté diced onions until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in tomato paste, turmeric, cumin, red chili, and garam masala, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Mix in yogurt and coconut milk, then reduce heat to medium-low.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender and sauce thickens.
Season with salt to taste and garnish with fresh cilantro.
Serve hot with rice or naan bread.
cheapTips: Buy spices in bulk from ethnic markets instead of small jars
Use light coconut milk instead of full-fat to reduce cost and calories

recipes.name: Chanterelle Quiche
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and place pie crust in a 9-inch tart pan.
Clean chanterelle mushrooms with a brush and slice them; finely dice onion.
Melt butter in a skillet and sauté onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook until liquid evaporates, about 5 minutes, then let cool slightly.
Whisk together eggs, heavy cream, salt, pepper, nutmeg, and thyme.
Spread cooled mushroom mixture on pie crust and sprinkle gruyere cheese evenly.
Pour egg mixture over mushrooms and cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until center is just set and top is golden.
Cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
cheapTips: Use cremini mushrooms instead of chanterelles for budget version
Buy pre-made pie crust to save time and prep effort

recipes.name: Morel Sauce
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté minced shallots until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add halved morel mushrooms and cook for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Deglaze pan with white wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add broth and simmer for 8 minutes until mushrooms are tender and flavors meld.
Stir in mustard and heavy cream, simmering for 3-4 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Season with lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste.
Stir in fresh tarragon or parsley just before serving.
Serve sauce over grilled steak, chicken, or pasta.
cheapTips: Use cremini or button mushrooms if morels are unavailable or too expensive
Skip heavy cream and use half-and-half to reduce cost

recipes.name: Mushroom Empanada
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then cut in cold butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add ice water gradually and form dough into a ball, then refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Dice mushrooms, onion, and garlic, then sauté in olive oil over medium-high heat until golden.
Stir in paprika and cook for 1 minute, then cool the filling completely.
Roll dough thin on a floured surface and cut into 4-inch circles.
Place 1 tablespoon filling on each circle, fold in half, and seal edges with a fork.
Beat egg and brush onto empanadas, then bake at 375°F for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Use regular button mushrooms instead of specialty varieties
Make dough from scratch to save versus pre-made empanada wrappers

recipes.name: Papas a la Huancaína con Hongos
recipes.description: Peruvian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then peel and slice into rounds.
Soak aji amarillo peppers in warm water for 5 minutes to soften.
Blend softened peppers with garlic, cheese, evaporated milk, crackers, and lime juice until smooth.
Slice mushrooms and sauté in oil over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes until golden.
Arrange potato slices on a serving platter.
Pour aji amarillo sauce over potatoes.
Top with sautéed mushrooms and serve at room temperature or slightly warm.
cheapTips: Buy dried aji amarillo in bulk at Latin markets for significant savings
Use store-brand evaporated milk instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Mushroom Ceviche
recipes.description: Peruvian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Tear oyster mushrooms into bite-sized pieces.
Combine mushrooms with lime juice in a bowl and let sit for 15 minutes to soften and marinate.
Dice red onion, bell pepper, and jalapeño into small pieces.
Mince garlic and add to mushroom mixture along with diced vegetables and cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper, then stir well and let marinate for 5 more minutes.
Serve chilled in small bowls with tortilla chips on the side.
cheapTips: Make during lime season when prices drop at markets
Oyster mushrooms are inexpensive compared to other mushroom varieties

recipes.name: Mushroom Bourguignon
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Toss mushrooms with flour and brown in batches for 4-5 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Add pearl onions to pot and brown for 3 minutes, then remove.
Sauté carrots and garlic for 3 minutes, stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Deglaze pot with red wine, scraping up brown bits, then add broth, bay leaf, and thyme.
Return mushrooms and onions to pot, bring to simmer, cover, and cook for 60 minutes on low heat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve over egg noodles or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy wine on sale or use a cheaper red wine—the long cooking mellows harsh flavors
Use regular button mushrooms supplemented with one portobello for depth at lower cost

recipes.name: Creamed Morels on Toast
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using dried morels, soak in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain and chop; if fresh, halve lengthwise.
Toast bread slices until golden and set aside.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté minced shallot and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add morels and cook for 3-4 minutes until they start to soften.
Deglaze with white wine and scrape up any brown bits, then simmer for 1 minute.
Reduce heat to low, pour in heavy cream, add thyme, and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Season with salt and pepper, remove thyme sprig, and spoon creamed morels over toasted bread.
Garnish with fresh chives and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy dried morels in spring when fresh ones are in season to preserve for later use
Use half-and-half instead of heavy cream for a lighter and cheaper option

recipes.name: Mushroom Ragu
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely chop mushrooms, onion, garlic, carrots, and celery into small dice.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sauté vegetables for 8-10 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then deglaze with red wine.
Add crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt, and pepper, then reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook pasta according to package directions in salted boiling water until al dente.
Drain pasta and divide among bowls.
Top each pasta portion generously with mushroom ragu and serve with grated Parmesan cheese.
cheapTips: Use button mushrooms as the base with one cremini or portobello for depth
Buy canned tomatoes on sale and stock up when prices are lowest

recipes.name: Porcini Polenta
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Steep dried porcini mushrooms in 1 cup hot broth for 10 minutes, then strain and chop mushrooms, reserving liquid.
Heat remaining 3 cups broth mixed with porcini soaking liquid in a pot until simmering.
Slowly whisk polenta into simmering liquid while stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring frequently, until polenta is creamy and pulls away from pot sides.
Slice fresh mushrooms and sauté with minced garlic in olive oil over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes until golden.
Stir butter, parmesan, salt, and pepper into cooked polenta until smooth.
Divide polenta among bowls, top with sautéed fresh mushrooms and chopped porcini, then garnish with sage.
cheapTips: Buy polenta in bulk bins for significant savings versus pre-packaged
Use mushroom soaking liquid to replace vegetable broth for deeper flavor at no extra cost

recipes.name: Mushroom Consommé
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roughly chop all mushrooms, onion, carrot, celery, and garlic into small pieces.
Heat broth in a pot and add mushroom mixture with thyme, simmering for 20 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes, then stir in beaten egg whites slowly while stirring gently.
Return to low heat and simmer without stirring for 30 minutes while the egg white mixture forms a raft that clarifies the broth.
Carefully ladle clear consommé through a fine strainer lined with cheesecloth, avoiding the raft.
Return strained consommé to pot and add sherry, then season with salt and pepper.
Gently heat and serve in warm bowls with thin mushroom slices if desired.
cheapTips: Use the mushroom solids left in the raft for another dish to minimize waste
Make when mushrooms are on sale and freeze broth for later use

recipes.name: Truffle Risotto
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a separate pot and keep at a gentle simmer throughout cooking.
Mince onion and garlic, then sauté in butter in a large, wide pan over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add arborio rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes until slightly translucent at edges.
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed, then add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently.
Slice mushrooms thinly and sauté separately in a small pan over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes until golden.
Continue adding broth and stirring for about 18-20 minutes total until rice is creamy and al dente.
Remove from heat, stir in butter, parmesan, truffle oil, and sautéed mushrooms, then season with salt and white pepper.
Divide among bowls and serve immediately with additional parmesan and a truffle oil drizzle.
cheapTips: Use truffle-infused oil instead of fresh truffles for dramatic cost savings
Buy arborio rice in bulk at Italian markets for better prices

recipes.name: Mushroom Goulash
recipes.description: Hungarian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut mushrooms into chunks and potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Dice onions and mince garlic, then sauté in olive oil in a large pot over medium heat for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in paprika and tomato paste, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add mushrooms and potatoes, stirring well to coat, and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in broth and add bay leaf and caraway seeds, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 40 minutes until potatoes and mushrooms are very tender.
Stir in sour cream just before serving and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in bowls with crusty bread or egg noodles on the side.
cheapTips: Use regular button mushrooms mixed with one cremini for authentic flavor at lower cost
Buy Hungarian paprika at ethnic markets where it is fresher and cheaper than supermarkets

recipes.name: Lion's Mane Steak
recipes.description: Modern American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut the lion's mane mushroom into thick steaks about 1 inch wide.
Pat dry with paper towels and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Place mushroom steaks in the pan and sear for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown.
Add butter, garlic, and thyme, then baste the steaks with the foaming butter for 2 minutes.
Transfer to plates and drizzle with fresh lemon juice.
cheapTips: Buy lion's mane at farmer's markets or bulk stores for better prices than specialty shops.
Skip the fresh thyme and use dried thyme at half the amount to reduce cost.

recipes.name: Mushroom Vol-au-Vent
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bake puff pastry shells according to package directions until golden.
Chop mushrooms and shallot finely, mince garlic.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté shallot and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add mushrooms and thyme, cook for 5-6 minutes until mushrooms release moisture and brown lightly.
Stir in heavy cream and simmer for 2 minutes until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper, fold in fresh parsley.
Spoon mushroom mixture into baked pastry shells and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use cheaper button mushrooms instead of fancy varieties.
Buy frozen pastry shells in bulk from warehouse stores.

recipes.name: Melanzane alla Parmigiana
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice eggplants lengthwise into 0.25-inch thick slabs and salt heavily; let sit 20 minutes to release moisture.
Pat eggplant slices dry with paper towels.
Beat egg in a shallow bowl, place flour in another; coat eggplant slices in flour, then egg.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet and fry eggplant slices in batches until golden on both sides, about 3 minutes per side.
Spread a thin layer of marinara sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.
Layer eggplant slices, sauce, torn mozzarella, and parmesan, repeating until all ingredients are used, ending with sauce and parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.
Garnish with fresh basil before serving.
cheapTips: Make your own marinara sauce from canned tomatoes for significant savings.
Buy mozzarella from the deli counter and slice it fresh instead of pre-shredded.

recipes.name: Brinjal Fry
recipes.description: Indian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplant into bite-sized cubes and soak in salt water for 10 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Mince onion, garlic, and green chili.
Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced onion, garlic, and green chili; sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add eggplant pieces and stir-fry for 8-10 minutes until softened and starting to brown.
Sprinkle turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt; toss well to coat.
Continue cooking for 3-4 minutes until eggplant is tender and spices are fragrant.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy spices from Indian grocery stores instead of mainstream supermarkets.
Use regular oil instead of specialty oils for significant savings.

recipes.name: Shahi Baingan
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prick eggplants with a fork and roast them directly over a gas flame or under a broiler for 8-10 minutes until charred and soft, turning occasionally.
Scoop out the soft eggplant flesh and mash it in a bowl.
Finely dice onion; mince garlic and ginger; dice tomato.
Heat oil in a large pan and add cumin seeds; let them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add onion and sauté until golden, about 5 minutes, then add garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute.
Add tomato and cook until softened, about 3 minutes; stir in red chili powder and garam masala.
Fold in mashed eggplant, yogurt, and coconut milk; simmer for 8-10 minutes until creamy and well combined.
Season with salt and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Skip the coconut milk and use additional yogurt for a budget-friendly version.
Buy eggplants when in season for lower prices.

recipes.name: Yu Xiang Qie Zi
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplant into 2-inch pieces.
Mince garlic and ginger; chop scallions, keeping white and green parts separate.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until very hot.
Add eggplant pieces in batches and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until softened and edges are slightly charred; set aside.
Add garlic, ginger, and white parts of scallions to the wok; stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in chili paste and cook for 15 seconds.
Return eggplant to the wok and add soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and broth; toss to combine and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with green scallions and serve hot over rice.
cheapTips: Make your own chili paste from dried chilies ground with salt to save money.
Use affordable soy sauce from Asian markets rather than premium brands.

recipes.name: Makali
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean squid by removing the head and tentacles, discarding the quill and ink sac; cut the body into rings about 0.5 inches thick.
Dice onion and mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and tomato paste; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add squid rings and tentacles; sauté for 3-4 minutes to partially cook.
Pour in red wine and scrape the bottom of the pot; let simmer for 2 minutes.
Add water, bay leaf, oregano, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 25-30 minutes until squid is tender.
Stir in lemon juice and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy squid from the seafood counter when it's on sale or approaching closing time.
Use inexpensive table wine instead of premium wine for cooking.

recipes.name: Matboucha
recipes.description: Moroccan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roughly chop tomatoes and bell peppers; mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and add garlic; sauté for 30 seconds.
Add chopped tomatoes and peppers; cook uncovered for 15-18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are very soft and mixture reduces.
Add paprika, cumin, and red chili powder; stir well and cook for 2 minutes.
Mash the mixture with a wooden spoon until it reaches a chunky sauce consistency.
Stir in fresh cilantro and lemon juice; season with salt.
Serve warm or at room temperature with bread or crackers.
cheapTips: Buy tomatoes and peppers in bulk when in season and freeze portions for later use.
Use regular grocery store spices instead of specialty Moroccan brands.

recipes.name: Musakhan with Eggplant
recipes.description: Palestinian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice eggplant into 0.25-inch thick rounds; salt them and let sit for 15 minutes to release moisture, then pat dry.
Fry eggplant slices in 3 tbsp olive oil until golden on both sides, about 3 minutes per side; set aside.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces; season with salt, pepper, and cumin.
Heat remaining olive oil in a large pan and cook chicken over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes until no longer pink.
Slice onions thinly and add to the pan with the chicken; cook for 8-10 minutes until onions are very soft and caramelized.
Stir in sumac and chicken broth; simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Toast pine nuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Warm flatbread and layer with eggplant slices, chicken-onion mixture, and toasted pine nuts; serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip the pine nuts and use peanuts or sunflower seeds as a cheaper alternative.
Buy chicken thighs instead of breast for better flavor at a lower price.

recipes.name: Karniyarik
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Halve eggplants lengthwise and scoop out the soft interior, leaving a 0.25-inch thick shell; chop the scooped flesh finely.
Dice onion, garlic, tomato, and green pepper; mince parsley.
Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and brown ground meat for 4-5 minutes, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add diced onion and garlic; cook for 3 minutes until softened, then add tomato paste and diced pepper and tomato.
Stir in chopped eggplant flesh, parsley, salt, and pepper; cook for 5 minutes until mixture is well combined.
Brush eggplant shells with remaining olive oil and place cut-side up in a baking dish; season with salt and pepper.
Fill eggplant shells with the meat mixture and pour water around the eggplants.
Bake covered at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until eggplants are tender.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of lamb to reduce costs significantly.
Buy eggplants from discount grocery stores or farmers markets for better prices.

recipes.name: Hunkar Begendi
recipes.description: Turkish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Char eggplants directly over a gas flame or under a broiler for 8-10 minutes until blackened all over, then wrap in foil for 5 minutes.
Peel away the charred skin, scoop flesh into a bowl, mash until smooth, and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the cubed meat with diced onion until golden, about 8 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add 1.5 cups water, salt, and pepper; simmer for 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour to form a roux, then gradually add milk while whisking constantly until thick.
Remove from heat and stir in mashed eggplant and cheese until smooth.
Divide the meat stew among serving bowls and top generously with the eggplant purée.
Serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants when in season (late summer) for better prices
Use ground lamb instead of cubes to reduce cost by 15-20%

recipes.name: Nasu Dengaku
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplants in half lengthwise and score the flesh in a crosshatch pattern without cutting through the skin.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook eggplant halves flesh-side down for 5 minutes until golden, then flip and cook 3-4 minutes more.
In a small bowl, whisk together miso, mirin, sugar, soy sauce, and minced garlic until smooth.
Spread the miso mixture evenly over the cooked flesh of each eggplant half.
Return eggplants to the skillet flesh-side up and cook for another 2-3 minutes until the topping is slightly caramelized.
Transfer to a serving plate, sprinkle with sesame seeds and chopped green onion, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Make your own mirin by mixing equal parts honey and rice vinegar if unavailable
White miso lasts months in the fridge, buy once for multiple recipes

recipes.name: Agedashi Nasu
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplants into 3-inch pieces and coat thoroughly with cornstarch.
Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F and fry eggplant pieces in batches for 3-4 minutes until golden and tender, then drain on paper towels.
In a saucepan, combine dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sugar, minced garlic, and ginger; bring to a simmer for 2 minutes.
Arrange fried eggplant on a serving plate and pour the hot dipping sauce over it.
Garnish immediately with bonito flakes, chopped green onion, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use chicken broth instead of dashi to save $1-2 per serving
Reuse frying oil 2-3 times if strained properly

recipes.name: Eggplant Steak
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice eggplant lengthwise into 0.75-inch thick steaks.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, minced garlic, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Brush both sides of eggplant steaks generously with the oil mixture.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and cook steaks for 4-5 minutes per side until charred and tender.
Transfer to a serving plate, top with crumbled feta and fresh parsley, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip feta and use nutritional yeast for a vegan version at half the cost
Buy eggplant at farmers markets near closing time for 20-30% discount

recipes.name: Shakshuka with Eggplant
recipes.description: Israeli breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté diced eggplant for 5 minutes until softened.
Add diced onion and cook for another 3 minutes, then stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper; simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Create four small wells in the tomato sauce and crack one egg into each well.
Cover the skillet and cook on medium heat for 6-8 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve directly from the skillet with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy canned tomatoes in bulk at warehouse stores for 30% savings
Use store-brand spices instead of name brands

recipes.name: Sabzi Khordan ba Kashk-e Bademjan
recipes.description: Persian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel eggplants, cut into cubes, and fry in oil over medium-high heat until golden and soft, about 12 minutes; drain on paper towels.
In the same oil, caramelize the sliced onions over medium heat for 8-10 minutes until deep brown, then add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Return eggplant to the pan, add salt and pepper, and toss to combine.
Transfer the eggplant mixture to a serving plate and drizzle with kashk whey.
Scatter fresh mint, parsley, dill, and walnuts over the top, drizzle with pomegranate molasses, and serve at room temperature with lavash bread.
Arrange fresh herbs (mint, parsley, dill sprigs), radishes, and scallions on a platter on the side as part of the traditional sabzi khordan accompaniment.
cheapTips: Skip kashk and drizzle with thick Greek yogurt mixed with salt instead
Buy walnuts from bulk bins to reduce cost by 40%

recipes.name: Khoresht-e Bademjan
recipes.description: Persian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown the cubed meat on all sides for 8 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion until softened, about 5 minutes, then stir in tomato paste and turmeric and cook for 1 minute.
Return the meat to the pot, add water, salt, and pepper, then bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer for 30 minutes.
While the stew cooks, cut eggplants into cubes and fry in a separate skillet with oil until golden, then set aside.
Add the fried eggplant and prunes to the stew and continue simmering for another 15 minutes until flavors meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve hot over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use ground meat instead of cubes to reduce total cooking time and cost
Buy prunes in bulk bins for 50% savings versus packaged

recipes.name: Aloo Baingan
recipes.description: Indian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add cumin seeds, letting them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 4 minutes, then stir in ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add turmeric, coriander powder, and chili powder, stirring constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add cubed potatoes and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften.
Stir in cubed eggplant and salt, then cover and cook for 10-12 minutes until both vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust seasoning, garnish with fresh cilantro, and serve hot with rice or flatbread.
cheapTips: Buy spices from Indian markets at 30-40% less than supermarket prices
Buy potatoes and eggplant in season (fall) for maximum savings

recipes.name: Sabra Hummus
recipes.description: Israeli snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and minced garlic in a food processor.
Blend until combined, then slowly add ice water while processing until you reach a creamy, smooth consistency.
Season with salt and white pepper to taste.
Transfer hummus to a serving bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Sprinkle paprika on top and serve with pita chips, fresh vegetables, or flatbread.
cheapTips: Buy tahini in bulk from Middle Eastern markets for 40% savings
Make large batches and freeze in ice cube trays for 2-3 weeks

recipes.name: Hummus Masabacha
recipes.description: Middle Eastern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Reserve one can of chickpeas whole; blend the second can with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and ice water until completely smooth.
Season the blended hummus with salt and transfer to a serving bowl.
Heat olive oil in a small pan and toast the paprika and cumin for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Gently warm the reserved whole chickpeas in a separate pan for 2 minutes.
Pour the warm spiced oil and whole chickpeas into a shallow well in the center of the blended hummus.
Sprinkle with fresh parsley, drizzle remaining oil, and serve warm with pita bread.
cheapTips: Use dried chickpeas soaked overnight instead of canned to save 50%
Toast whole spices yourself instead of buying pre-ground for better flavor and lower cost

recipes.name: Tabil
recipes.description: Tunisian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast caraway and coriander seeds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Grind toasted seeds in a mortar and pestle into a coarse powder.
Mince garlic cloves and red chili peppers finely.
Combine ground seeds, garlic, chili, and salt in a bowl.
Stir in olive oil until a paste forms.
Transfer to a jar and refrigerate until ready to serve.
cheapTips: Buy seeds in bulk from ethnic markets for lower cost
Make large batches and store in jars for weeks

recipes.name: Shakshuka with Chickpeas
recipes.description: Middle Eastern breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in canned tomatoes with juice, cumin, and paprika, and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add drained chickpeas to the tomato mixture and season with salt and pepper.
Make 6 small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet and cook for 6-8 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately with warm bread.
cheapTips: Buy canned tomatoes and chickpeas on sale and stock up
Use store-brand eggs for savings

recipes.name: Chikhalwali Curry
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and add cumin seeds, letting them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add diced onions and cook for 8 minutes until golden brown.
Stir in minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add turmeric and coriander powder, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Pour in canned tomatoes with juice and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add drained chickpeas and coconut milk, bringing to a simmer.
Cook for 15 minutes on medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle garam masala and adjust salt to taste.
Simmer for 5 more minutes and serve with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy spices in bulk from Indian markets instead of supermarkets
Use regular canned chickpeas instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Chole Puri
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then add 2 tablespoons oil and rub together with fingertips until breadcrumb texture forms.
Add water gradually and knead into a stiff dough, then cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil in a pan and add minced onion, ginger, and garlic, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add drained chickpeas, coriander, cumin, amchur, and chili powder, cooking for 5 minutes to create filling.
Divide dough into 6 balls and roll each into a thin circle.
Heat oil for deep frying in a deep pan until shimmering at 350°F.
Carefully place dough circles in hot oil one at a time, pressing gently with a spoon to create a puffed bread.
Fry for 1-2 minutes per side until golden and crispy, then drain on paper towels.
Serve hot puris topped with spiced chickpea mixture.
cheapTips: Make dough the night before to save morning time
Buy chickpeas in bulk dried form and soak overnight for cheaper option

recipes.name: Bhel Puri
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice boiled potatoes, onion, and tomato into small cubes.
Finely chop fresh cilantro.
In a large bowl, combine puffed rice, sev, and diced vegetables.
Add tamarind chutney and mint chutney, tossing gently to coat.
Sprinkle chaat masala and salt, mixing well.
Serve immediately in small bowls or paper cones for authentic presentation.
cheapTips: Buy puffed rice from Indian markets instead of health food stores
Make chutneys at home using fresh mint and tamarind paste

recipes.name: Aloo Chaat
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut boiled potatoes into small cubes, keeping some skin on for texture.
Heat oil in a pan and add potato cubes, frying until golden edges form, about 8 minutes.
Transfer fried potatoes to a serving bowl.
Finely dice onion and tomato, then add to the potatoes along with fresh cilantro.
Drizzle tamarind chutney and mint chutney over the potatoes and toss gently.
Sprinkle chaat masala, cumin powder, salt, and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately while potatoes are still warm.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk and boil multiple servings ahead
Use homemade chutneys instead of bottled versions

recipes.name: Chana Dal
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse chana dal thoroughly under running water and drain well.
In a pot, bring water to boil and add chana dal with turmeric powder.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30-35 minutes until dal is completely soft and breaking down.
While dal cooks, heat oil in a separate pan and add mustard seeds, waiting for them to pop.
Add cumin seeds, dried red chilies, and curry leaves to the tempering oil, cooking for 1 minute.
Add thinly sliced onion to the tempering and fry until golden, about 4 minutes.
Pour the tempering mixture into cooked dal and stir well.
Adjust salt to taste and simmer for 2 more minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy chana dal from Indian grocery stores in bulk for significant savings
Cook large batches and freeze for quick reheating later

recipes.name: Loukoumades with Chickpea Flour
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine chickpea flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Gradually add water while stirring until a thick, sticky batter forms.
Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F.
Using two spoons, drop walnut-sized portions of batter into hot oil carefully.
Fry for 2-3 minutes, turning once, until golden brown on both sides.
Remove fried loukoumades with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
While still warm, drizzle with honey and sprinkle cinnamon and chopped walnuts.
Serve immediately for best texture and warmth.
cheapTips: Buy chickpea flour in bulk from Mediterranean or Indian markets
Use generic honey instead of premium raw honey

recipes.name: Chickpea Salad
recipes.description: Mediterranean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse chickpeas thoroughly under cold water.
Dice cucumber, tomatoes, and bell pepper into bite-sized pieces.
Finely mince red onion and fresh parsley.
In a large bowl, combine chickpeas, all prepared vegetables, and parsley.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to coat evenly.
Fold in crumbled feta cheese just before serving.
Refrigerate for 15 minutes to allow flavors to meld, then serve chilled.
cheapTips: Buy seasonal produce at farmers markets for better prices
Use store-brand canned chickpeas instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Risotto Nero
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat chicken broth in a separate pot and keep warm on the stove.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté diced onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add arborio rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes until rice begins to turn translucent at edges.
Pour in white wine and stir until almost completely absorbed.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently, waiting for liquid to absorb before adding more (about 18-20 minutes total).
When rice is creamy and tender but still slightly firm, stir in squid ink until evenly incorporated and rice turns black.
Remove from heat and stir in butter and parmesan cheese until creamy.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve immediately in warm bowls.
cheapTips: Buy arborio rice in bulk from Italian markets
Substitute squid ink with cuttlefish ink if squid ink is unavailable and potentially cheaper

recipes.name: Lemon Pasta
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente.
Mince garlic cloves and heat butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour lemon juice into the skillet and stir in lemon zest, simmering for 2 minutes.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the cooked spaghetti.
Add the drained pasta to the lemon butter sauce and toss well.
Add pasta water a little at a time to reach desired consistency, then season with salt and pepper.
Divide pasta among bowls, top with fresh parsley and grated Parmesan cheese, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand pasta and Parmesan to save 30%
Skip the fresh parsley garnish or use dried parsley for budget savings

recipes.name: Toor Dal
recipes.description: Indian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse toor dal under cold water until water runs clear.
In a pot, bring 4 cups of water to boil and add rinsed dal and turmeric powder.
Cook dal over medium heat for 25-30 minutes until soft and mushy, stirring occasionally.
Season the cooked dal with salt to taste.
Heat oil in a small skillet and add mustard seeds, dried red chili, and curry leaves.
When mustard seeds pop, finely chop onion and garlic and add to the skillet, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour the tempering mixture into the cooked dal and stir well.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy toor dal in bulk from Indian markets for 40% less
Omit curry leaves if unavailable; substitute with dried oregano

recipes.name: Rajma
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak kidney beans in water for at least 6 hours or overnight, then drain.
Boil soaked beans in fresh water for 45-50 minutes until tender, then drain and set aside.
Chop onions, tomatoes, garlic, and ginger finely.
Heat oil in a large pot and add cumin seeds, allowing them to sizzle for 30 seconds.
Add chopped onions and cook for 3-4 minutes until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute, then add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in turmeric, chili powder, and salt, then add cooked beans and simmer for 10 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Use canned kidney beans (drained) instead of dried to save 30 minutes
Buy spices from bulk bins instead of packaged to reduce cost by 50%

recipes.name: Mujadarah
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse brown lentils and add to a pot with 3 cups of water, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer lentils for 20 minutes until partially cooked.
Slice onions thinly and heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a skillet.
Cook half the sliced onions over medium heat for 8-10 minutes until golden and caramelized, then set aside.
Add remaining onions to the lentil pot along with bulgur, vegetable broth, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Simmer together for 15-20 minutes until lentils and bulgur are tender and liquid is absorbed.
Stir in lemon juice and remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Transfer to a serving dish and top with caramelized onions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy lentils and bulgur in bulk for 40% savings
Caramelize all onions at once to save fuel and time

recipes.name: Refried Beans
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse canned pinto beans thoroughly under cold water.
Dice onion and mince garlic cloves finely.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add diced onion.
Cook onion for 3-4 minutes until softened, then add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add drained beans, cumin, chili powder, and salt to the skillet.
Mash beans with a potato masher while cooking for 8-10 minutes, leaving some beans chunky.
Stir in lime juice and diced jalapeño if using, adjusting salt to taste.
Cook for another 2 minutes until heated through, then garnish with cilantro and serve.
cheapTips: Use store-brand canned beans instead of name brands to save 20%
Skip the jalapeño and cilantro garnish to reduce cost further

recipes.name: Dhal Puri
recipes.description: Trinidadian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak split yellow peas in water for 30 minutes, then drain and grind into a coarse paste.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a skillet and add cumin seeds, allowing them to sizzle for 20 seconds.
Add minced garlic, diced onion, and diced green chili to the seeds and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the ground dhal paste and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently until dry, then set aside to cool.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl, then add ½ cup water and knead into a soft dough.
Divide dough into 6 portions and roll each into a thin circle on a floured surface.
Spread cooled dhal mixture on half of each circle, fold in half, and seal edges gently.
Heat remaining oil in a skillet and fry each dhal puri for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy split yellow peas in bulk from Caribbean markets for 50% less
Reuse oil for frying multiple batches to minimize waste

recipes.name: Loukoumades with Lentils
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil red lentils in water for 15-20 minutes until very soft, then drain completely and mash.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl, then add mashed lentils and water to form a thick, sticky batter.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F (test with a small piece of dough).
Using a spoon, carefully drop walnut-sized portions of batter into hot oil.
Fry loukoumades for 2-3 minutes, turning once, until golden brown on all sides.
Remove fried loukoumades with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
Warm honey in a small saucepan with cinnamon and lemon zest for 2 minutes.
Drizzle the warm honey mixture over the hot loukoumades and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy red lentils and honey in bulk for 35% savings
Use vegetable oil you've already used for cooking to reduce oil costs

recipes.name: Dal Baati Churma
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil toor dal in 5 cups water with a pinch of turmeric for 35-40 minutes until tender, then set aside.
Mix flours with 3 tablespoons of ghee, salt, and water to form a stiff dough, knead well, and divide into 3 balls.
Bake baati balls in a preheated 400°F oven directly on the rack for 20-25 minutes until golden and hardened.
While baati bakes, heat remaining ghee in a skillet and cook finely sliced onions until deep golden.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute, then add chopped tomatoes and spices.
Pour the dal into the spiced tomato mixture, add jaggery, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove baati from oven and roll in the cooked dal until coated on all sides.
Serve baati immediately, drizzled with extra ghee and accompanied by the remaining dal.
cheapTips: Replace ghee with regular oil to save 40%
Skip jaggery and use regular sugar or skip sweetness entirely

recipes.name: Red Lentil Kibbeh
recipes.description: Lebanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil red lentils in water for 12-15 minutes until very soft, then drain if excess water remains.
Mix cooked lentils with bulgur, finely minced onions, 4 tablespoons olive oil, salt, pepper, and cayenne.
Knead the mixture for 2-3 minutes until it holds together like a dough.
Wet your hands and form the mixture into oval or pointed football shapes about 3 inches long.
Heat 2 cups of olive oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Carefully place kibbeh into the hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes, turning once, until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve warm garnished with fresh mint leaves.
cheapTips: Buy red lentils and bulgur in bulk from Middle Eastern markets for 50% less
Reuse frying oil for multiple batches to reduce waste

recipes.name: Puy Lentil Salad
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse Puy lentils and add to a pot with 3 cups of water, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer lentils for 20-25 minutes until tender but still firm, then drain and cool slightly.
While lentils cook, finely dice red onion, cucumber, and halve cherry tomatoes.
Whisk together Dijon mustard, balsamic vinegar, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Combine cooled lentils with diced vegetables in a large bowl.
Pour dressing over the lentil mixture and toss gently to combine.
Stir in fresh parsley and mint leaves.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, then serve at room temperature or chilled.
cheapTips: Buy Puy lentils in bulk online for 30% savings compared to specialty stores
Use regular green lentils as a budget substitute for Puy lentils

recipes.name: Tig Adeemed
recipes.description: Moroccan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried chickpeas in water for 6 hours or overnight, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the chicken thighs on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in the same pot until softened, then add ginger and spices, stirring for 1 minute.
Return chicken to the pot and add soaked chickpeas and vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 30-35 minutes until chicken is tender and chickpeas are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Buy dried chickpeas in bulk instead of canned to save 50%
Use bone-in thighs instead of breasts for better flavor and lower cost

recipes.name: Seafood Paella
recipes.description: Spanish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Steep saffron threads in 0.25 cup hot broth for 10 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a 12-inch paella pan or large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté diced onion and garlic until softened.
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Pour in saffron-infused broth plus remaining broth, diced tomato, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer uncovered for 18-20 minutes without stirring until rice is nearly tender.
Nestle shrimp, mussels, and squid into the rice, scatter peas over top, and cook for 5-7 minutes until seafood is cooked and shells open.
Discard any unopened mussels, squeeze lemon juice over the paella, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip saffron and use turmeric plus a pinch of smoked paprika for similar color at 1/10 the cost
Use frozen shrimp instead of fresh and skip mussels to reduce cost to $3.50/serving

recipes.name: Buriyani Hyderabadi
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil basmati rice with 4 cups salted water, cumin seeds, cinnamon, and bay leaves for 6-7 minutes until 70% cooked, then drain and set aside.
Marinate chicken pieces in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, and turmeric for 20 minutes.
Slice onions and deep fry in 2 tbsp ghee until golden and crispy, removing half for garnish and crushing the rest.
Layer in a heavy-bottomed pot: half the marinated chicken, crushed fried onions, mint and cilantro, then rice, remaining chicken, remaining rice, and top with crispy onions.
Drizzle remaining ghee over the top and cover the pot with foil then a tight-fitting lid.
Cook on high heat for 2 minutes until steam forms, then reduce to low heat and cook for 45 minutes undisturbed.
Turn off heat and let rest for 5 minutes without opening the lid, then carefully open and mix gently with a fork before serving.
cheapTips: Use cooking oil instead of ghee to save $1.50 per serving while maintaining similar results
Buy whole spices in bulk from Indian markets instead of pre-ground for 40% savings

recipes.name: Risotto ai Tartufi
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable broth in a separate pot and keep at a gentle simmer throughout cooking.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a large pan over medium heat and sauté minced shallot and garlic until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add arborio rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes until slightly translucent at the edges.
Pour in white wine and stir until fully absorbed by the rice.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding the next, for about 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy and al dente.
Remove from heat and stir in remaining butter, grated parmesan, truffle oil, and fresh thyme.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately in warm bowls.
cheapTips: Skip truffle oil and add 2 tbsp grated Pecorino Romano with a pinch of black truffle salt for 75% savings
Use half arborio and half regular long-grain rice to reduce cost without major texture loss

recipes.name: Ceviche Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Peruvian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut firm white fish into 0.5-inch cubes and place in a glass or ceramic bowl.
Squeeze juice from 6 limes over the fish, ensuring it is fully covered, and let sit for 15-20 minutes until the fish becomes opaque and firm.
Dice red onion, mince jalapeño, and chop cilantro, then add to the cured fish along with diced tomato.
Gently fold in olive oil, salt, and pepper, being careful not to break up the fish pieces.
Divide cooked rice among four bowls and top each with a scoop of ceviche.
Garnish with avocado slices, corn, and extra cilantro before serving immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish and thaw it for 20% savings with same results
Omit avocado and use extra corn and tomato to reduce cost to $2.50/serving

recipes.name: Pad Krapow Moo Tod
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and red chilies together into a paste.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until just smoking.
Add garlic-chili paste and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add ground pork and break it up as it cooks, stirring constantly for 5-6 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in fish sauce, oyster sauce, lime juice, and sugar, then add fresh basil and toss quickly for 1 minute.
Divide jasmine rice between two bowls and top with the pork mixture and a fried egg on each.
cheapTips: Regular basil works if Thai basil is unavailable and costs half as much
Make two servings at once and save prep time rather than cooking individual portions

recipes.name: Lanzhou Lamian
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour with salt and gradually add water while stirring until a shaggy dough forms, then knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Coat dough with 2 tbsp oil, cover with plastic wrap, and rest for 30 minutes.
Heat remaining oil in a small pot and add dried chilies, sichuan peppercorns, minced garlic, and ginger to make chili oil, infusing for 5 minutes, then strain.
Bring beef broth to a simmer in a large pot and season with salt, chili oil, and minced scallions.
Divide rested dough in half, stretch each piece into a long rope, then hold both ends and slap it against the counter repeatedly to create laminated layers, about 15 times.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and carefully pull and stretch the dough rope into thin strands, dropping them into the boiling water.
Cook noodles for 2-3 minutes until they float and become tender, then remove with a slotted spoon into bowls of hot broth.
Garnish with cilantro, bean sprouts, and a drizzle of chili oil, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use vegetable broth instead of beef to reduce cost by $1 per serving
Make the dough ahead and refrigerate overnight to save morning prep time

recipes.name: Jjajangmyeon
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onion, potato, and zucchini into 0.5-inch cubes and mince garlic.
Heat vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat and cook diced meat until browned, then remove and set aside.
In the same pan, stir-fry black bean paste for 1-2 minutes over medium heat until it darkens slightly.
Add diced vegetables and garlic, stir-frying for 3-4 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Return cooked meat to the pan, add water, soy sauce, and sugar, and simmer for 5 minutes until vegetables are tender and sauce thickens.
Cook wheat noodles in boiling salted water according to package directions, then drain well.
Divide noodles between two bowls, ladle sauce over top, and serve with a fried egg on the side if desired.
cheapTips: Buy black bean paste in bulk at Asian markets for 40% savings versus grocery stores
Substitute ground meat for diced meat to reduce prep time and cost slightly

recipes.name: Mie Goreng
recipes.description: Indonesian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook egg noodles in boiling salted water until just tender, then drain and set aside.
Mince garlic, onion, and red chili together into a paste.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and stir-fry the garlic-chili paste for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp or chicken and cook for 2-3 minutes until just cooked through.
Add cooked noodles and shredded cabbage to the pan, breaking up the noodles as you toss.
Pour in sweet soy sauce, fish sauce, and lime juice, tossing everything together for 2-3 minutes until well coated and heated through.
Divide between two bowls and garnish with sliced scallions and fried shallots before serving.
cheapTips: Use ground pork instead of shrimp to save $1.50 per serving with similar results
Buy fried shallots from Asian markets for half the price of grocery store versions

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala Noodles
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into 1.5-inch pieces and marinate in 0.75 cup yogurt mixed with 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 0.5 tsp chili powder, and 0.25 tsp turmeric for at least 20 minutes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook marinated chicken pieces in batches until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per batch, then set aside.
Cook egg noodles in boiling salted water according to package directions, drain, and set aside.
In the same skillet, heat remaining oil and sauté diced onion until golden, then add minced garlic and remaining ginger-garlic paste, stirring for 1 minute.
Stir in remaining garam masala, chili powder, and turmeric, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in tomato sauce and bring to a simmer, then return cooked chicken to the pan and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and cooked noodles, tossing gently to coat everything evenly, and simmer for 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh cilantro, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use Greek yogurt instead of heavy cream to reduce fat and cost by $0.75 per serving
Substitute boneless thighs for breast meat to save 30% and add more flavor

recipes.name: Cauliflower Manchurian
recipes.description: Indian-Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, cornstarch, water, and salt to make a thick batter.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and carefully fry cauliflower florets until golden and crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
Drain fried cauliflower on paper towels.
In a wok or large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil over high heat and sauté garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add soy sauce, ketchup, chili flakes, and 0.25 cup water, bringing to a boil.
Toss fried cauliflower into the sauce and stir until evenly coated.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy cauliflower in season or frozen to reduce cost
Use neutral vegetable oil instead of specialty oils

recipes.name: Gobi 65
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour, cornstarch, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt in a bowl.
Add 0.5 cup water to the dry mixture and whisk until smooth batter forms.
Dip cauliflower florets into batter and coat evenly.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and fry coated florets until golden and crispy, about 6-8 minutes.
In a separate small pan, heat 1 tablespoon oil and sauté minced garlic and curry leaves for 1 minute.
Toss fried cauliflower with garlic oil mixture and lemon juice.
Serve hot as a standalone snack or with green chutney.
cheapTips: Rice flour is cheaper than all-purpose flour and adds authentic texture
Buy whole cauliflower and chop yourself rather than pre-cut florets

recipes.name: Shahi Gobi
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat ghee in a large pan and add cumin seeds, letting them crackle for 20 seconds.
Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tomato puree and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add cauliflower and potato pieces, stirring to coat with the mixture, and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in heavy cream and coconut milk, add garam masala, salt, and black pepper.
Cover and simmer for 15-18 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with rice or naan bread.
cheapTips: Use regular yogurt instead of heavy cream to reduce cost by 30%
Buy pre-made ginger-garlic paste from the Asian section

recipes.name: Gobi Matar
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan and add cumin seeds, letting them sizzle for 20 seconds.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 4 minutes.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add turmeric and coriander powder, cooking for 30 seconds.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until they break down.
Add cauliflower florets and frozen peas, stirring to combine.
Cover and cook on medium heat for 15 minutes until cauliflower is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper, garnish with cilantro, and serve with rice or roti.
cheapTips: Frozen peas are cheaper than fresh and work perfectly
Use canned tomatoes if fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Pork and Cauliflower Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toss pork slices with 0.5 tablespoon cornstarch and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until smoking.
Add pork and stir-fry until cooked through, about 5-6 minutes, then transfer to a plate.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry cauliflower florets until lightly browned, about 4-5 minutes.
Add onion, bell pepper, garlic, and ginger, cooking for 2 minutes.
Return pork to the wok and add soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, and chili flakes.
Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until heated through.
Serve immediately over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for later use
Use vegetable oil instead of specialty peanut oil

recipes.name: Cauliflower Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Modern American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season diced chicken with garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, then cook until no longer pink, about 6-7 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine cauliflower rice with remaining olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Drain and add roasted chickpeas to the cauliflower rice mixture.
Add cherry tomatoes and cucumber, tossing to combine.
Divide the rice mixture between two bowls and top each with cooked chicken and avocado slices.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen riced cauliflower instead of fresh, it's cheaper and pre-prepped
Use canned chickpeas drained and pan-fried for a budget-friendly option

recipes.name: Whole Roasted Cauliflower
recipes.description: Mediterranean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Trim the leaves from the cauliflower head and place stem-side down on the baking sheet.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, minced garlic, oregano, paprika, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Brush the entire cauliflower head with the oil mixture, coating all sides evenly.
Place fresh rosemary sprigs on top of the cauliflower.
Roast for 35-40 minutes until the cauliflower is golden brown and tender when pierced with a fork.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the cauliflower and serve whole or cut into wedges.
cheapTips: Buy whole cauliflower heads on sale; they're less expensive than florets
Use dried herbs you already have instead of fresh

recipes.name: Crispy Cauliflower Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, cornstarch, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Add 0.5 cup water to the flour mixture and whisk to form a batter.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and dip cauliflower florets in batter.
Fry battered florets until golden and crispy, about 5-6 minutes total, then drain on paper towels.
Toss shredded cabbage with lime juice and cilantro in a small bowl.
Warm tortillas in a skillet for 20 seconds per side.
Assemble tacos by placing crispy cauliflower on each tortilla, topping with cabbage slaw and a dollop of sour cream.
Serve with lime wedges and hot sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Shred cabbage yourself from a head instead of buying pre-shredded
Buy tortillas on sale and freeze for later

recipes.name: Cauliflower Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, 0.5 teaspoon turmeric, and salt to create a marinade.
Toss cauliflower florets in the marinade and let sit for 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F and roast marinated cauliflower on a baking sheet for 20 minutes until lightly charred.
Heat ghee in a large pan and add cumin seeds, letting them crackle for 20 seconds.
Add diced onion and cook until golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and red chili powder, cooking for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree and 0.5 cup water, simmering for 5 minutes.
Add roasted cauliflower and heavy cream to the sauce and simmer for 5-8 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with cilantro, and serve with rice or naan.
cheapTips: Use regular yogurt instead of Greek yogurt for marinade
Skip the cream step and use more yogurt to reduce cost by 40%

recipes.name: Cauliflower Curry
recipes.description: Thai dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add red curry paste and stir for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in coconut milk and vegetable broth, stirring to combine.
Bring to a simmer and add cauliflower florets, onion, and bell peppers.
Simmer for 12-15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in lime juice, fish sauce, and brown sugar.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.
Remove from heat, stir in fresh basil, and serve with jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy canned coconut milk in bulk when on sale
Use store-brand curry paste instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Cauliflower Couscous
recipes.description: Moroccan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop cauliflower into small florets and finely dice onion and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add garlic and cumin, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cauliflower florets and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil, then add couscous, drained chickpeas, and chopped apricots.
Remove from heat, cover, and let sit for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and season with salt and pepper.
Top with fresh cilantro and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy cauliflower when on sale and freeze for later use
Use dried chickpeas soaked overnight instead of canned to save 40%

recipes.name: Roasted Cauliflower with Tahini
recipes.description: Middle Eastern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and chop cauliflower into florets.
Toss cauliflower with 2 tablespoons olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast for 20-25 minutes until golden and crispy, stirring halfway through.
Mince garlic and whisk together tahini, lemon juice, remaining olive oil, water, and minced garlic to create sauce.
Season sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer roasted cauliflower to a serving platter and drizzle tahini sauce over top.
Sprinkle with pomegranate seeds and fresh parsley before serving.
cheapTips: Substitute pomegranate seeds with diced tomatoes or red onion
Buy tahini in bulk from Middle Eastern markets for 30% savings

recipes.name: Cauliflower Fritters
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop cauliflower into small florets and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Finely chop onion, green chili, and cilantro.
In a mixing bowl, combine besan flour, turmeric, cumin seeds, and salt.
Add minced ginger, chopped onion, green chili, cilantro, and cauliflower florets to the bowl.
Add water gradually and mix until you have a thick batter that coats the cauliflower pieces.
Heat oil in a deep pan or wok to 350°F and carefully drop spoonfuls of battered cauliflower into the hot oil.
Fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch, turning halfway through.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels before serving with chutney.
cheapTips: Buy cauliflower heads in bulk when discounted and prep the night before
Use canola or vegetable oil instead of specialty oils

recipes.name: Sicilian Cavolfiore Fritta
recipes.description: Italian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cauliflower into medium florets and boil in salted water for 5 minutes until just tender, then drain completely.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, water, salt, and pepper until smooth batter forms.
Heat olive oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Dip each cauliflower floret into batter, coating fully, and carefully place into hot oil.
Fry for 3-4 minutes until golden brown on all sides, working in batches to avoid overcrowding.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with minced garlic and fresh parsley.
Serve hot with fresh lemon wedges squeezed over top.
cheapTips: Pre-boil cauliflower day before to save time and reduce oil absorption
Buy eggs from bulk stores or farmers markets for better pricing

recipes.name: Chou-Fleur à la Polonaise
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring vegetable broth to boil in a large pot and cut cauliflower into florets.
Boil cauliflower florets for 8-10 minutes until just tender, then drain well and transfer to a serving dish.
While cauliflower cooks, peel and finely chop hard-boiled eggs and mince garlic.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and add panko breadcrumbs, stirring constantly for 3-4 minutes until golden.
Add minced garlic to breadcrumbs and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Remove from heat and stir in chopped hard-boiled eggs and fresh parsley.
Spoon breadcrumb and egg mixture over warm cauliflower florets and drizzle with lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand breadcrumbs and make eggs in bulk for the week
Buy cauliflower at farmers markets late in the day for discounts

recipes.name: Cauliflower Vindaloo
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend together garlic, ginger, red chilis, and vinegar into a paste with 2 tablespoons water.
Chop cauliflower into florets and dice onions.
Heat coconut oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and add diced onions, cooking until deeply browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic-ginger-chili paste to the pot and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add cumin and turmeric, stir for 30 seconds, then add canned tomatoes with juice.
Add cauliflower florets and bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and cook covered for 20 minutes until cauliflower is tender.
Season with salt and pepper, stir in fresh cilantro, and serve over rice.
cheapTips: Buy canned tomatoes and dried spices from Indian markets for 40% savings
Substitute coconut oil with vegetable oil to reduce costs

recipes.name: Kung Pao Cauliflower
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cauliflower into bite-sized florets and mince garlic and ginger.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, and cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add cauliflower florets and stir-fry for 5-6 minutes until lightly browned and tender-crisp.
Add minced garlic, ginger, and whole dried chilies to the wok and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour sauce over cauliflower and stir constantly for 2 minutes until sauce thickens and coats the florets.
Add roasted peanuts and toss to combine, then cook for 1 minute.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with sliced green onions before serving with rice.
cheapTips: Buy peanuts in bulk from warehouse stores and store in freezer
Use soy sauce from larger bottles which cost less per ounce

recipes.name: Cauliflower Pakora
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cauliflower into medium-sized florets.
In a mixing bowl, combine chickpea flour, turmeric, cumin seeds, and salt.
Finely chop onion, green chili, and cilantro.
Add chopped vegetables, minced ginger, and cilantro to the flour mixture.
Gradually add water while stirring until you achieve a thick batter that coats the cauliflower.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan or wok.
Dip cauliflower florets into batter and fry in batches for 4-5 minutes until golden brown, turning occasionally.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with tamarind chutney or yogurt sauce.
cheapTips: Make batter in larger batches and freeze for quick midweek snacks
Buy chickpea flour from Indian markets instead of health food stores

recipes.name: Tabbouleh with Cauliflower
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour boiling water over bulgur wheat in a bowl, cover, and let sit for 15 minutes until tender.
While bulgur soaks, chop cauliflower into small florets and blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain.
Finely chop fresh parsley, mint, tomatoes, cucumber, and green onions into a large bowl.
Fluff bulgur with a fork and add to the vegetable mixture along with cooled cauliflower florets.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and olive oil.
Pour lemon-olive oil dressing over tabbouleh and toss gently to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy fresh herbs at farmers markets the day before for better prices
Use frozen cauliflower to save 30% and reduce prep time

recipes.name: Harissa Roasted Cauliflower
recipes.description: North African dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and cut cauliflower into florets.
Mince garlic and whisk together harissa paste, olive oil, honey, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and cumin in a bowl.
Toss cauliflower florets in the harissa mixture until well coated.
Spread coated cauliflower on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast for 22-25 minutes, stirring halfway through, until golden brown and crispy at the edges.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with sesame seeds and fresh cilantro.
Serve warm as a side dish or over couscous or rice.
cheapTips: Make harissa paste in bulk and freeze in ice cube trays for future use
Buy whole sesame seeds in bulk and toast them yourself for freshness and savings

recipes.name: Cauliflower Gratin
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and cut cauliflower into florets, then boil in salted water for 5 minutes until partially tender and drain.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat, whisk in flour to create a roux, and cook for 1 minute while stirring.
Gradually whisk in milk, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes, then remove from heat.
Stir gruyere cheese, salt, pepper, and nutmeg into the sauce until cheese melts completely.
Pour cauliflower into a buttered baking dish and cover with the cheese sauce, stirring gently to combine.
Mix panko breadcrumbs with parmesan cheese and scatter evenly over the top.
Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbling at the edges.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cheese and milk to reduce costs
Buy cauliflower when on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Chilled Cauliflower Salad
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cauliflower into small florets and boil in salted water for 3 minutes until just tender-crisp, then drain and cool.
Finely dice red onion and chop parsley and mint into small pieces.
