Mince garlic cloves and whisk together with olive oil, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Combine cooled cauliflower, onion, parsley, and mint in a serving bowl.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss gently to coat all vegetables evenly.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
cheapTips: Buy cauliflower at farmers markets at the end of the day for discounts
Use dried mint and parsley if fresh herbs are unavailable

recipes.name: Cauliflower Bhaji
recipes.description: Indian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cauliflower into small florets, slice onion thinly, and chop green chili finely.
Heat oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat and add cumin seeds, letting them sizzle for 30 seconds.
Add diced onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened, then add ginger and green chili and stir for 1 minute.
Add cauliflower florets and stir-fry for 3 minutes until they start to soften.
Sprinkle turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt over the cauliflower and mix well.
Cover the pan and cook for 8-10 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender and edges are lightly browned.
Stir in fresh cilantro and lemon juice just before serving.
cheapTips: Buy spices in bulk from Indian markets for significant savings
Use frozen cauliflower if fresh is expensive

recipes.name: Crispy Chili Cauliflower
recipes.description: Chinese-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cauliflower into bite-sized florets and pat dry thoroughly with paper towels.
Whisk together flour, cornstarch, and water to create a light batter and coat each floret thoroughly.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan or wok and carefully fry cauliflower in batches for 4 minutes until golden and crispy, then drain on paper towels.
In a small saucepan, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sriracha, then add minced garlic and ginger and simmer for 2 minutes.
Toss the crispy cauliflower with the sauce in a large bowl until well coated.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with sliced scallions and sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Reuse cooking oil by straining it after frying
Buy cauliflower from bulk produce sections for better pricing

recipes.name: Creamed Cauliflower with Bacon
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop bacon into small pieces and cook in a large skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, about 6 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Chop cauliflower into florets and dice onion, then add both to the bacon fat and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Mince garlic and add to the pan along with butter, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in heavy cream and chicken broth, season with salt and pepper, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium and cook uncovered for 10 minutes until cauliflower is tender.
Stir in cheddar cheese until melted completely, then fold in the cooked bacon and adjust seasoning if needed.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand cream and cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Aloo Tikki
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until soft, then drain, cool, and peel before mashing.
Finely dice onion and green chili, then chop cilantro and mix with mashed potatoes.
Add ginger, flour, salt, pepper, and tamarind paste to the potato mixture and mix well.
Divide mixture into 8 equal portions and form into patties about 2 inches in diameter.
Heat oil in a shallow pan over medium-high heat and carefully place patties in the oil.
Fry for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy on the outside, working in batches if needed.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with yogurt or tamarind chutney.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk bags for better value
Make a larger batch and freeze uncooked patties for quick future snacks

recipes.name: Croquetas de Papa
recipes.description: Spanish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until soft, then drain and peel before mashing thoroughly.
Melt butter in a saucepan and sauté finely diced onion until soft, about 2 minutes.
Stir in mashed potatoes and milk, cooking over medium heat for 3 minutes while stirring, then fold in diced ham.
Season with salt and pepper, spread onto a plate to cool completely, then refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Form the mixture into cylinders about 2 inches long and place on parchment paper.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs, then dredge each croqueta in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry croquetas for 2 minutes until golden brown on all sides, then drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use store-brand ham and freeze croquetas before frying for easier handling
Reuse cooking oil by straining it through cheesecloth

recipes.name: Fondant Potatoes
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and cut each one into a cylinder about 2 inches tall using a small round cutter or knife.
Heat butter in a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat and place potato cylinders flat-side down.
Sear potatoes for 2 minutes on the bottom side until golden brown, then flip and sear the other side for 2 minutes.
Pour chicken broth around the potatoes, add thyme sprigs and minced garlic, then season with salt and pepper.
Cover the pan with foil and transfer to a preheated 375°F oven for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender and liquid has reduced by half.
Remove foil and continue baking for 5 minutes until the tops are golden and the liquid is mostly evaporated.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk and store in a cool place
Use low-sodium broth and add your own seasonings

recipes.name: Gratén de Papas
recipes.description: Chilean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and slice potatoes thinly with a knife or mandoline and slice onions into thin rings.
Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Layer half the potatoes on the bottom of the prepared baking dish, season with salt and pepper, and layer half the onions on top.
Repeat with remaining potatoes, salt, pepper, and onions, then sprinkle nutmeg evenly over the layers.
Heat milk in a saucepan until steaming, then pour carefully over the potato and onion layers.
Sprinkle shredded cheese evenly over the top and dot with small pieces of butter.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove foil and bake for 15 more minutes until the top is golden and the milk is bubbling at edges.
Cool for 5 minutes, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk bags for better pricing
Use store-brand milk and cheese to reduce overall cost

recipes.name: Hasselback Potatoes
recipes.description: Swedish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and peel potatoes, then place each potato on a cutting board with a wooden spoon alongside it to act as a guide.
Slice each potato thinly from the top, about every quarter inch, being careful to cut only three-quarters of the way through (the wooden spoon prevents you from cutting all the way).
Place potatoes cut-side up in a baking dish and brush generously with a mixture of melted butter and olive oil.
Distribute minced garlic between the potato slices, then insert a small piece of rosemary sprig and a thin slice of butter between some of the slices.
Season the tops generously with salt and pepper, then pour broth around the potatoes.
Add thyme sprigs to the broth and cover the baking dish with foil.
Bake covered for 35 minutes, then remove foil and bake for 10 more minutes until potatoes are tender and the tops are golden brown.
Serve hot directly from the baking dish.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk and use woody herb stems for broth if fresh rosemary is expensive
Substitute dried herbs for fresh to reduce costs

recipes.name: Hómar og Kartöflur
recipes.description: Icelandic dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil.
Add lobsters headfirst and cover, boiling for 12-15 minutes until shells turn bright red.
Meanwhile, peel potatoes, cut into 2-inch chunks, and boil in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Remove lobsters and let cool slightly, then split lengthwise and remove the meat.
Drain potatoes and toss with melted butter, salt, and pepper.
Arrange potatoes on plates with lobster meat, garnish with parsley and lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Use smaller lobsters (under 1 lb) to reduce cost significantly
Buy frozen lobster tails instead of whole lobsters

recipes.name: Irish Colcannon
recipes.description: Irish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and quarter potatoes, boil in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Chop cabbage into thin shreds and boil in the same pot for the last 5 minutes.
Drain potatoes and cabbage, reserving 0.25 cup of cooking water.
Mash potatoes and cabbage together with butter and milk until creamy, adding cooking water if needed.
Chop green onions and fold into the mixture, season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately with extra butter melting on top.
cheapTips: Buy cabbage in bulk from farmers markets
Use regular butter instead of salted for better value

recipes.name: Jackets with Beans and Cheese
recipes.description: British lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and prick potatoes all over with a fork.
Bake potatoes directly on oven rack for 45-50 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, heat baked beans in a saucepan over medium heat until warmed through.
Remove potatoes from oven and cut in half lengthwise.
Scoop a small amount of potato flesh from each half and discard.
Place potatoes on plates, top each half with spoonful of baked beans and sprinkle cheese generously.
Return to oven for 3-5 minutes until cheese melts, then top with butter, chives, salt, and pepper.
cheapTips: Store brand baked beans are just as good and cheaper
Buy block cheese and shred it yourself

recipes.name: Kartoffelpuffer
recipes.description: German breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and grate them finely, then squeeze out excess moisture using a clean kitchen towel.
Finely grate onion and combine with grated potatoes in a bowl.
Beat egg and mix into potato mixture along with flour, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Drop spoonfuls of mixture into oil and flatten with spatula into thin patties about 3 inches wide.
Fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with applesauce and sour cream.
cheapTips: Use generic vegetable oil instead of premium brands
Buy potatoes in 5-lb bags for better value

recipes.name: Kugel
recipes.description: Jewish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Boil noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.
Whisk together eggs, sour cream, cottage cheese, 2 tablespoons melted butter, sugar, cinnamon, salt, and vanilla.
Combine noodles with egg mixture and transfer to prepared baking dish.
Toss cornflakes with remaining 2 tablespoons melted butter and sprinkle evenly over top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden brown and set in the center.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy store brand cottage cheese and sour cream
Crush your own cornflakes instead of buying crushed cereal

recipes.name: Papas a la Huancaína
recipes.description: Peruvian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes until tender, then peel and slice into rounds.
Remove stems from ají peppers and soak in hot water for 10 minutes until soft, then drain.
Blend softened peppers, cheese, milk, peanuts, garlic, and crackers until smooth, adding salt and pepper to taste.
Heat oil in a small pan and lightly fry the sauce for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Arrange warm potato slices on a serving platter and pour sauce over them.
Top with sliced hard boiled eggs and olives, then serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use ají amarillo paste instead of fresh peppers for convenience and cost savings
Buy peanuts in bulk and grind them yourself

recipes.name: Vada
recipes.description: South Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak urad dal in water for 4 hours, then drain and grind into a thick batter with just enough water to form a smooth paste.
Transfer batter to a bowl and fold in onion, green chilies, ginger, curry leaves, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Wet your fingers and shape batter into balls about 2 inches in diameter with a hole in the center using your thumb.
Carefully slide vadas into hot oil and fry 4-5 at a time until golden brown on all sides, about 4-5 minutes.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with coconut chutney or sambar sauce.
cheapTips: Buy urad dal from Indian grocery stores in bulk for much lower cost
Reuse frying oil multiple times by straining it through cheesecloth

recipes.name: Vichy Carrots and Potatoes
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel carrots and cut into thin rounds, peel potatoes and cut into thin rounds of similar size.
Melt butter in a large shallow skillet over medium heat.
Add carrot and potato rounds, salt, sugar, and water.
Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and liquid is mostly absorbed.
Uncover and cook for 2-3 more minutes to lightly brown the vegetables.
Season with black pepper and garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
cheapTips: Buy carrots and potatoes in bulk bags for significant savings
Use unsalted butter for better value

recipes.name: Memphis Dry Ribs
recipes.description: American BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove the thin membrane from the back of each rib rack by sliding a knife underneath and peeling it away.
Mix brown sugar, paprika, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, salt, and cayenne in a bowl.
Rub the spice mixture generously all over both sides of the ribs, pressing it in firmly.
Preheat oven to 275°F and place ribs on a foil-lined baking sheet meat side up.
Bake for 4.5-5 hours until meat is very tender and pulls away from the bone easily.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then cut between bones and serve.
cheapTips: Buy ribs on sale and freeze them for later use
Buy spices in bulk from warehouse stores

recipes.name: St. Louis Style Ribs
recipes.description: American BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove membrane from back of ribs and trim the flap from the underside to create the signature St. Louis shape.
Mix brown sugar, paprika, black pepper, garlic powder, and salt in a bowl.
Rub yellow mustard on both sides of ribs, then coat generously with spice mixture.
Preheat grill or oven to 300°F and place ribs meat side up.
Cook for 2-2.5 hours until meat is tender but not falling off the bone.
Mix BBQ sauce with apple cider vinegar and brush over ribs.
Grill or bake for 15-20 more minutes until sauce is caramelized, then remove and let rest 5 minutes.
cheapTips: Make your own BBQ sauce instead of buying expensive brands
Look for pork ribs marked down on their sell-by date

recipes.name: Cheburekki
recipes.description: Tatar lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, water, salt, and 1 tablespoon melted butter until a soft dough forms, then knead for 3 minutes and let rest 15 minutes covered.
Combine ground beef, minced onion, salt, and black pepper in a bowl and mix well.
Divide dough into 8 equal balls, roll each thin into a 6-inch circle, and place 2 tablespoons filling on half of each circle.
Fold dough in half over filling, press edges firmly to seal, then crimp with a fork.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet and fry cheburekki 2-3 minutes per side until deep golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with sour cream on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze it ahead
Use vegetable oil for frying instead of specialty oils

recipes.name: Baghrir
recipes.description: Moroccan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour, cornmeal, yeast, salt, and warm water in a bowl and stir until a thin batter forms, then let rest 15 minutes.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and lightly oil it.
Pour 1/4 cup batter onto the hot skillet and let cook undisturbed for 2-3 minutes until the top is covered with small holes.
Flip carefully and cook the other side for 30 seconds until lightly golden, then transfer to a plate.
Repeat with remaining batter to make 6-9 pancakes total.
Serve baghrir warm drizzled with melted butter and honey.
cheapTips: Cornmeal is inexpensive; buy in bulk at discount stores
Make ahead and reheat gently before serving

recipes.name: Palacinke
recipes.description: Serbian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, eggs, milk, salt, sugar, and 2 tablespoons melted butter until smooth batter forms.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and lightly oil it.
Pour 1/4 cup batter into the center and immediately tilt and swirl the pan to spread it thin into a 7-inch circle.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until the bottom is light golden, then flip and cook the other side for 30 seconds.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter to make 8-10 palacinke.
Spread 1-2 tablespoons jam or Nutella on each warm palacinke, fold into quarters, and dust with powdered sugar before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand jam or hazelnut spread instead of premium brands
Make and freeze unfilled palacinke for quick future breakfasts

recipes.name: Galette Bretonne
recipes.description: French lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk buckwheat flour with water, salt, and 2 tablespoons melted butter until a thin, smooth batter forms, then let rest 10 minutes.
Heat a non-stick skillet or crepe pan over medium-high heat and lightly butter it.
Pour 1/2 cup batter into the center and tilt the pan immediately to spread it into a thin 10-inch circle.
Cook for about 2 minutes until the bottom is set and lightly speckled, then crack an egg into the center and sprinkle with cheese and ham.
Cook until the egg white is set but yolk remains slightly runny, about 3 minutes total, then fold the galette into quarters.
Transfer to a plate and repeat to make a second galette, then serve immediately with black pepper.
cheapTips: Buy buckwheat flour in bulk at health food stores
Use store-brand ham and cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Blintzes
recipes.description: Jewish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, eggs, milk, salt, and 1 tablespoon melted butter to make a smooth batter, then let rest 10 minutes.
Combine farmer cheese, 1/4 cup sour cream, and 2 tablespoons sugar in a bowl for the filling.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and lightly oil it.
Pour 1/4 cup batter into the skillet and cook 1 minute until the bottom is set, then flip and cook 30 seconds more until lightly golden.
Transfer to a plate with cooked side up, place 2 tablespoons filling in the center, fold edges over to create a rectangle, and set aside.
Repeat with remaining batter and filling to make 12-16 blintzes.
Add 1 tablespoon butter to the skillet and fry the filled blintzes 1-2 minutes per side until golden and heated through.
Serve hot topped with sour cream and jam.
cheapTips: Ricotta is usually cheaper than farmer cheese as a substitute
Make blintzes ahead and reheat in a 350°F oven for 8-10 minutes

recipes.name: Cachapas
recipes.description: Venezuelan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend corn kernels with egg until mostly smooth with some small corn pieces remaining.
Stir in flour, sugar, salt, and 3 tablespoons melted butter until batter is thick but pourable.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and lightly oil it.
Pour 1/3 cup batter onto the hot surface and cook for 2-3 minutes until the bottom is golden and edges look set.
Flip carefully and cook the other side for 1-2 minutes until light golden.
Place a slice of queso de mano or mozzarella on half of each cachapa while still hot, fold in half, and top with a small pat of butter.
Serve warm, repeating with remaining batter to make 6-9 cachapas total.
cheapTips: Buy frozen corn kernels in bulk; they work just as well as fresh
Use regular mozzarella if queso de mano is unavailable and expensive

recipes.name: Alabama White BBQ Chicken
recipes.description: American BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat grill to medium-high heat and oil grates well.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and season inside and out with salt and pepper.
Place chicken breast-side up on grill, cover, and cook for 35-40 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
While chicken cooks, whisk together mayo, vinegar, lemon juice, worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, and hot sauce in a bowl.
During the last 10 minutes of cooking, brush the white BBQ sauce generously over the chicken.
Remove chicken from grill and let rest for 5 minutes, then carve into pieces.
Toast bread slices on grill for 1 minute per side.
Serve chicken on toasted bread with extra sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken instead of parts to save 30%
Make sauce with store-brand mayo and vinegar you likely have at home

recipes.name: Lexington Style Pulled Pork
recipes.description: American BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim excess fat from pork shoulder and rub all over with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat smoker or grill to 225°F and place pork shoulder fat-side up; smoke for 6-8 hours until internal temperature reaches 190°F.
Mix apple cider vinegar, ketchup, brown sugar, black pepper, and red pepper flakes in a saucepan and heat on low for 5 minutes.
Remove pork from smoker and let rest for 15 minutes, then shred with two forks until completely pulled apart.
Toss pulled pork with Lexington sauce until well coated.
Toast hamburger buns lightly on grill.
Serve pulled pork on toasted buns topped with coleslaw mix.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until ready to cook
Skip expensive coleslaw mixes and shred cabbage yourself

recipes.name: Texas Hill Country Sausage
recipes.description: American BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice sausage into 1/2-inch thick coins and score the surface with a knife in a crosshatch pattern.
Heat grill to medium-high and place sausage slices directly on grates for 3-4 minutes per side until charred and heated through.
Melt butter in a cast iron skillet on grill and sauté sliced onions and jalapeños until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Toast bread slices on grill for 1 minute per side until golden.
Spread mustard on toasted bread and top with charred sausage, onion-jalapeño mixture, and cheddar cheese.
Place bread back on grill for 1 minute to melt cheese.
Serve immediately with coarse black pepper sprinkled on top.
cheapTips: Buy sausage on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand mustard and skip expensive specialty sauces

recipes.name: Oklahoma Smoked Brisket
recipes.description: American BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix black pepper, kosher salt, garlic powder, paprika, and onion powder in a bowl to create dry rub.
Trim fat from brisket to 1/4-inch thickness and rub generously all over with dry rub, pressing into meat.
Place brisket fat-side up in smoker preheated to 225°F and smoke for 10-12 hours until internal temperature reaches 203°F.
Wrap brisket tightly in foil, add beef broth, apple cider vinegar, and butter, and continue cooking for 1-2 hours until fork-tender.
Remove brisket from foil and let rest for 20 minutes before slicing against the grain.
Toast bread slices on grill or in oven.
Serve sliced brisket on toasted bread with pan drippings spooned on top.
cheapTips: Buy brisket when on sale and freeze—it improves with time
Use charcoal instead of wood pellets for cheaper smoking

recipes.name: Jamaican Jerk Pork
recipes.description: Caribbean BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend scotch bonnet pepper, allspice, thyme, garlic, ginger, lime juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, and coconut milk in a food processor until smooth.
Make deep cuts into pork shoulder and rub jerk marinade generously all over and into cuts; refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat and oil grates well.
Place marinated pork shoulder on grill, cover, and cook for 4-5 hours, turning every 30 minutes, until internal temperature reaches 190°F.
Transfer pork to a cutting board and shred with two forks until completely pulled apart.
Mix any remaining marinade with pan drippings to create sauce.
Toss shredded pork with jerk sauce and serve hot with rice and beans.
cheapTips: Substitute habanero pepper if scotch bonnet is unavailable
Make large batch and freeze portions for later use

recipes.name: Argentine Asado
recipes.description: South American BBQ dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Light charcoal grill and let coals burn down to medium temperature, about 350°F.
Pat all meats dry with paper towels and season generously with salt and black pepper on both sides.
Place short ribs on grill first, skin-side down, and cook for 30 minutes until deeply charred.
Add ribeye steaks and sausage links to grill and cook steaks for 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare; cook sausages for 10-12 minutes total, turning frequently.
Mix minced garlic, parsley, and olive oil in a small bowl to create chimichurri sauce.
Transfer all cooked meat to a wooden board and brush generously with chimichurri.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over all meats and serve immediately with red wine.
cheapTips: Buy beef when on sale and freeze; quality cuts are worth the investment
Make chimichurri with fresh herbs from the garden if available

recipes.name: Uruguayan Parrillada
recipes.description: South American BBQ dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prepare grill with medium-high heat and arrange meats in piles: ribs, chicken, lamb, and chorizo in separate sections.
Season all meats with salt, black pepper, and oregano on both sides.
Place beef ribs on hottest part of grill first and cook for 20 minutes, turning every 5 minutes.
Move ribs to cooler side and add chicken breasts and lamb chops; cook chicken for 12-15 minutes and lamb for 8-10 minutes, turning frequently.
Add chorizo and red onion slices to grill and cook for 8-10 minutes until sausage is cooked through and onion is charred.
Brush mozzarella cheese slices with olive oil and grill for 1 minute per side until lightly charred and starting to melt.
Arrange all grilled meats and cheese on a large platter and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Mix expensive lamb with cheaper cuts of beef to reduce cost
Use store-brand chorizo instead of specialty imported versions

recipes.name: Korean Galbi
recipes.description: Korean BBQ dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, grated pear, garlic, sesame oil, ginger, and rice vinegar in a bowl.
Place beef short ribs in a large dish and pour marinade over them, turning to coat evenly; refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Remove beef from refrigerator 30 minutes before grilling and preheat grill to high heat.
Place marinated ribs on oiled grates and grill for 2-3 minutes per side for medium-rare, watching carefully to avoid flare-ups.
Transfer cooked galbi to a serving plate and sprinkle with chopped green onion and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately with steamed rice and pickled vegetables on the side.
cheapTips: Ask butcher to slice short ribs thin, or buy pre-cut korean galbi
Substitute apple juice for grated pear if fresh pears are expensive

recipes.name: Japanese Yakiniku
recipes.description: Japanese BBQ dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil in a small bowl to create yakiniku sauce.
Place thin beef slices on a platter and short ribs on another platter; refrigerate until 15 minutes before serving.
Heat a tabletop grill or outdoor grill to medium-high temperature.
Grill beef slices for 30 seconds per side until lightly charred, then dip in yakiniku sauce and eat immediately.
Grill short ribs for 3-4 minutes per side until charred on outside and cooked to medium-rare.
Grill scallion pieces for 1-2 minutes per side until charred and tender.
Arrange all grilled items on a platter, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve with extra sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy beef on sale and freeze in thin-sliced portions for future use
Mirin can be skipped or replaced with honey for savings

recipes.name: Lebanese Shish Kebab
recipes.description: Middle Eastern BBQ dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, and salt in a bowl to create marinade.
Place beef cubes in a large dish and pour marinade over them, turning to coat evenly; refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Thread beef, onion, and bell pepper alternately onto 8 metal skewers, dividing ingredients evenly.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat and oil grates well.
Place skewers on grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes until beef reaches desired doneness and vegetables are charred.
Warm pita bread on grill for 1 minute per side.
Slide kebab meat and vegetables off skewers onto warm pita bread and serve with tahini sauce and tomato-cucumber salad.
cheapTips: Buy beef sirloin when on sale and cut into cubes yourself
Use wooden skewers soaked in water instead of metal for cheaper option

recipes.name: Turkish Adana Kebab
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground lamb, ground beef, minced onion, red pepper flakes, parsley, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Mix the meat mixture thoroughly with your hands until well combined, about 2 minutes.
Divide the mixture into 8 portions and mold each around a metal skewer, creating elongated kebabs.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and brush with olive oil.
Grill the kebabs for 12-15 minutes, rotating every 3 minutes, until cooked through and charred.
Warm the pita bread on the grill for 1 minute per side.
Serve the kebabs on warm pita with lemon wedges and desired toppings like tomatoes and onions.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze it; use a 3:1 lamb to beef ratio to stretch lamb.
Use store-brand pita and skip expensive restaurant condiments by making your own yogurt sauce.

recipes.name: Persian Koobideh
recipes.description: Middle Eastern dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground beef, grated onion, parsley, salt, and black pepper in a bowl and mix until sticky.
Divide mixture into 8 portions and mold each around a metal skewer in an elongated shape.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil.
Grill koobideh for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes, until cooked through with charred edges.
Transfer cooked koobideh to a platter, pour melted butter mixed with saffron over them.
Serve on a bed of fluffy basmati rice with lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Skip the saffron for a budget version; use turmeric instead for similar color.
Cook rice in bulk and reheat to save time and money on multiple servings.

recipes.name: Portuguese Piri Piri Chicken
recipes.description: Portuguese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine chili peppers, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, paprika, and bay leaves in a food processor and blend until smooth.
Place chicken thighs in a large bowl and coat thoroughly with the piri piri marinade.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and brush with oil.
Grill chicken thighs skin-side down for 6-7 minutes until skin is charred, then flip.
Continue grilling for 8-10 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve hot with grilled vegetables or rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken drumsticks instead of thighs to save 20-30% on cost.
Make large batches of marinade and freeze for future use.

recipes.name: Spanish Chorizo a la Plancha
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large flat griddle or skillet over medium-high heat.
Place chorizo slices on the griddle in a single layer and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until browned.
Push chorizo to the side, add minced garlic to the center, and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour white wine over the chorizo and let it simmer for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Toast bread slices on the griddle for 1 minute per side until golden.
Season chorizo mixture with salt, pepper, and smoked paprika.
Serve chorizo and sauce on toasted bread, garnished with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy chorizo in bulk from Spanish delis or ethnic markets for better prices.
Skip the wine and use chicken broth for a similar flavor at lower cost.

recipes.name: Texas Red
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried chilies in a dry skillet for 1-2 minutes, then soak in hot water for 15 minutes and blend into a smooth paste.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef cubes in batches for 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove beef and sauté diced onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Return beef to pot, add chili paste, cumin, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Pour beef broth into the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours until beef is very tender.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed, then serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze until ready to use.
Make a double batch and freeze portions for easy future meals.

recipes.name: Cincinnati Chili
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat and brown ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 8 minutes.
Drain excess fat, then add diced onion and garlic, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, cinnamon, and worcestershire sauce, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add tomato sauce, beef broth, and salt, then bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While chili simmers, cook spaghetti according to package directions and drain.
Serve chili over spaghetti topped with shredded cheddar cheese.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in 3+ lb packages for per-pound savings.
Use store-brand tomato sauce and worcestershire for significant savings.

recipes.name: Curry
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and cook diced onion until golden, about 6 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, stirring constantly for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in curry powder and tomato paste, cooking for 2 minutes to bloom the spices.
Add chicken cubes to the pot and stir to coat with the curry mixture, cooking for 5 minutes.
Pour coconut milk into the pot and bring to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 30-35 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in fresh spinach and salt, cooking for 2-3 minutes until spinach wilts, then serve over basmati rice.
cheapTips: Buy curry powder in bulk from Indian markets and freeze to maintain freshness.
Use frozen spinach instead of fresh for better cost and convenience.

recipes.name: Braised Pork Belly
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch pork belly cubes in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown pork belly on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Add ginger slices and scallions, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour soy sauce, vinegar, and water into the pot, then add star anise and cinnamon stick.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 90 minutes until pork is very tender.
Stir in rock sugar and simmer uncovered for 15 more minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Serve hot with steamed rice, ladling sauce over each portion.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly in bulk when on sale and freeze in portions.
Use brown sugar if rock sugar is unavailable for similar results.

recipes.name: Momocha
recipes.description: Tibetan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make dough by mixing flour, water, and salt, kneading until smooth and elastic, about 8 minutes.
Let dough rest covered for 30 minutes, then divide into 16 equal pieces.
Mix ground meat with minced onion, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt.
Roll each dough piece into a thin circle, place 1 tbsp filling in the center, and fold into a half-moon, pleating the edges to seal.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Working in batches, pan-fry momos flat-side down for 3-4 minutes until golden, then flip and cook 2 minutes more.
Serve hot with a dipping sauce of soy sauce mixed with minced ginger and sesame oil.
cheapTips: Prepare filling and dough ahead and freeze uncooked momos for quick weeknight meals.
Use ground pork or chicken instead of beef for significant cost savings.

recipes.name: Shengjianbao
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water, let sit 5 minutes until foamy, then mix with flour and salt to form dough.
Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth, cover, and let rise 45 minutes until doubled.
Heat chicken broth and dissolve gelatin in it, mix with ground pork, soy sauce, sesame oil, and green onions, then refrigerate until jelly-like.
Divide dough into 12 equal pieces, roll each into a thin circle about 3 inches wide.
Place 1 tbsp pork-jelly filling in the center of each circle and gather edges to form a pouch, pleating as you go.
Place bao seam-side up on parchment squares and let rise 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat, place bao flat-side down, and pan-fry for 3-4 minutes until bottoms are golden and crispy.
cheapTips: Skip gelatin and use gelatin-rich pork stock boiled down for similar effect at lower cost.
Prepare dough and filling ahead; freeze assembled bao for easy preparation.

recipes.name: Pineapple Fried Rice
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat.
Scramble the eggs, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil, stir-fry garlic and onion until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add bell pepper and cook for 1 minute until slightly softened.
Add cold cooked rice and break up any clumps, stir-frying for 2 minutes.
Stir in pineapple, fish sauce, and soy sauce, tossing everything together for 1 minute.
Return eggs to the skillet and add cashews and most of the green onions.
Toss everything for 1 minute until heated through, then serve in a hollowed pineapple half if desired, garnished with remaining green onions.
cheapTips: Use canned pineapple in juice to save money year-round
Make fried rice with leftover rice to avoid waste and reduce costs

recipes.name: Basil Fried Rice
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Scramble the eggs until cooked, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry diced chicken until cooked through, about 4 minutes, then remove.
Add more oil if needed, then stir-fry garlic and onion for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cold rice and break up clumps, stir-frying for 2 minutes.
Return chicken and eggs to the pan, then add fish sauce, soy sauce, and chili flakes.
Toss everything for 1 minute until combined.
Remove from heat and stir in fresh basil just before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken on sale and freeze to use later
Regular basil works fine if Thai basil is unavailable or expensive

recipes.name: Omurice
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pan and stir-fry diced chicken until cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Add onion and carrots, cook for 2 minutes, then add peas and cook 1 minute more.
Stir in rice, ketchup, and soy sauce, breaking up any clumps, and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Divide fried rice between two plates, forming into mounds.
Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat, beat 2 eggs with a splash of water, then pour into the pan.
When the eggs are just set on top but still slightly runny, slide onto a mound of fried rice, folding gently.
Repeat step 5-6 with remaining butter and eggs for the second serving.
Drizzle ketchup on top of each omurice in a decorative pattern and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use day-old rice for better texture and easier fried rice preparation
Buy diced chicken thighs instead of breast for lower cost

recipes.name: Arroz Frito
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and scramble the eggs, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the pan and stir-fry minced garlic and diced onion until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add diced ham and cook for 1 minute until heated through.
Add cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas and cook for 1 minute until heated through.
Return scrambled eggs to the pan and fold everything together gently.
Season with salt, pepper, and lime juice, then toss to combine.
Serve hot as a main dish or side.
cheapTips: Buy ham on sale at the deli counter and dice yourself instead of buying pre-packaged
Use leftover rice and ham from dinner to make this budget-friendly lunch

recipes.name: Arroz Chaufa
recipes.description: Peruvian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and stir-fry diced chicken until cooked through, about 4 minutes, then set aside.
Add 1 tablespoon oil, beat eggs with a splash of water, pour into the pan and scramble until cooked, then set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry garlic and onion for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cold rice and break up clumps, stir-frying constantly for 2-3 minutes.
Return chicken and eggs to the pan, then add soy sauce and sesame oil, tossing everything together.
Stir in most of the green onions and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook for 1 minute until heated through and well combined.
Serve garnished with remaining green onions.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breast for less money and more flavor
Make double the recipe for easy meal prep throughout the week

recipes.name: Tsingtao Fried Rice
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry minced garlic and diced onion for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes until pink and cooked through.
Add cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas and carrots, cooking for 1 minute.
Return eggs to the pan, add soy sauce and sesame oil, tossing everything together.
Season with salt and white pepper, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk and thaw only what you need
Use canned shrimp if frozen is expensive; drain well before using

recipes.name: Crab Fried Rice
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry minced garlic and diced onion for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas and cook for 1 minute until heated through.
Gently fold in crab meat, being careful not to break it up too much, and cook for 1 minute.
Return eggs to the pan, add soy sauce, and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with green onions, and serve.
cheapTips: Canned crab is much cheaper than fresh and works great for fried rice
Check the clearance section for discounted frozen crab meat

recipes.name: Fried Rice with Sausage
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry diced Chinese sausage for 2 minutes until the fat renders out.
Add minced garlic and diced onion, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced carrots and cook for 1 minute until slightly softened.
Add cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas and soy sauce, cooking for 1 minute.
Return eggs to the pan, toss everything together, garnish with green onions, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy Chinese sausage at an Asian market for half the price of supermarkets
Use less sausage and add more vegetables to stretch portions further

recipes.name: Cashew Fried Rice
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry diced chicken until cooked through, about 4 minutes, then remove.
Stir-fry minced garlic and diced onion for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Return chicken and eggs to the pan, then add soy sauce and fish sauce, tossing for 1 minute.
Fold in cashews and most of the green onions, cooking for 1 minute until heated through.
Serve garnished with remaining green onions.
cheapTips: Buy roasted, unsalted cashews in bulk from warehouse stores for better prices
Use peanuts instead of cashews to save money if needed

recipes.name: Diced Meat Fried Rice
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and cook ground meat, breaking it apart as it cooks, until no longer pink, about 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and diced onion, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in diced carrots and cook for 1 minute until slightly softened.
Add cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas and soy sauce, cooking for 1 minute.
Return eggs to the pan, toss everything together, garnish with green onions, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze in portions for quick weeknight meals
Ground pork is often cheaper than ground beef at most stores

recipes.name: Khuushuur
recipes.description: Mongolian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and ½ tbsp oil in a bowl, then add warm water gradually while kneading until a soft dough forms.
Let dough rest for 20 minutes covered with a damp cloth.
Brown ground beef with minced onion, garlic powder, pepper, and salt in a skillet, then drain and cool slightly.
Divide dough into 8 balls and roll each flat into a thin 4-inch circle.
Place 2 tbsp meat filling on one half of each circle, fold in half, and press edges firmly to seal.
Heat ¼ inch of oil in a deep skillet until shimmering.
Fry khuushuur 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with vinegar or soy sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Make a larger batch and freeze uncooked khuushuur to fry later

recipes.name: Buuz
recipes.description: Mongolian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour and salt, then add warm water and oil while mixing until a smooth dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until elastic, then let rest covered for 20 minutes.
Mix ground beef with diced onion, black pepper, garlic powder, and salt.
Divide dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each into a thin 3-inch circle.
Place 1½ tbsp filling in the center of each circle and fold edges up to create a purse shape, pinching top to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil.
Gently place buuz in boiling water and cook 8-10 minutes until they float and continue cooking for 2 more minutes.
Remove with a slotted spoon and serve hot with soy sauce and a dab of butter.
cheapTips: Purchase ground beef in bulk when on sale
Buuz freezes well before cooking; prepare a batch and freeze for quick meals

recipes.name: Chuchvara
recipes.description: Uzbek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, egg, water, and ½ tsp salt until a firm dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes and rest 15 minutes covered.
Combine ground beef with minced onion, remaining salt, and black pepper.
Roll dough thin on a floured surface and cut into 1-inch squares.
Place a small pinch of filling in the center of each square and fold into a triangle, then fold corners together to create a small pouch.
Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Carefully drop chuchvara into boiling broth and stir to prevent sticking.
Cook for 8-10 minutes until dumplings float and continue cooking 2 more minutes.
Serve hot in bowls with the broth and a sprinkle of fresh herbs if available.
cheapTips: Use affordable ground beef or substitute with ground lamb
Make a large batch and freeze raw dumplings in a single layer before bagging

recipes.name: Matzo
recipes.description: Jewish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine matzo meal, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl.
Whisk eggs and water together, then pour into the matzo meal mixture and stir until a thick batter forms.
Let batter rest for 5-10 minutes at room temperature.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until a drop of batter sizzles immediately.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the hot oil, flattening slightly with the back of the spoon.
Fry 3-4 minutes until the bottom is golden brown and crispy.
Flip carefully and fry the other side for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels, then serve warm with applesauce or sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy matzo meal in bulk during Passover sales
Serve with inexpensive applesauce instead of buying specialty toppings

recipes.name: Tortilla
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a large bowl.
Add warm water and oil, stirring until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead dough on a lightly floured surface for 5-8 minutes until soft and smooth.
Divide into 8 equal balls, cover with a damp cloth, and let rest 10 minutes.
Heat an ungreased skillet or cast iron griddle over medium-high heat.
Working with one ball at a time, roll or press each ball very thin between two pieces of plastic wrap or parchment.
Place tortilla on the hot skillet and cook 1-2 minutes per side, watching for small bubbles or light browning.
Stack finished tortillas in a kitchen towel to keep warm and soft.
cheapTips: Flour and oil are very inexpensive staples
Make a double batch and freeze wrapped tortillas for quick future meals

recipes.name: Parathas
recipes.description: Indian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, and salt in a bowl.
Add warm water and 1 tbsp oil, mixing and kneading until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms.
Let dough rest covered for 15-20 minutes.
Divide dough into 6 equal balls and cover with a damp cloth.
Roll one ball into a thin 6-inch circle on an oiled surface, brush lightly with ghee or oil, then fold into quarters.
Roll the folded triangle into a thin triangle shape, about ¼ inch thick.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and place paratha in the dry pan, cooking 1-2 minutes until light spots appear.
Flip, brush with ghee, cook 1 minute, flip again, brush with ghee, and cook until golden brown and crispy; repeat with remaining dough.
cheapTips: Use vegetable oil instead of expensive ghee for frying
Buy whole wheat flour in bulk for better price per pound

recipes.name: Piadina
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Add lard and mix with your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs.
Gradually add warm water while stirring until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough for 2-3 minutes until smooth, then let rest 10 minutes covered.
Divide dough into 4 balls and roll each into a thin oval about ¼ inch thick.
Heat an ungreased skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Place piadina on the hot skillet and cook 2-3 minutes until light brown spots appear on the bottom.
Flip and cook the other side for 2-3 minutes until lightly browned, then serve warm with cheese, cured meats, or vegetables.
cheapTips: Use affordable vegetable shortening instead of lard
Fill with budget-friendly toppings like basic cheese or tomatoes

recipes.name: Matzah Brei
recipes.description: Jewish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Break matzo into bite-sized pieces and place in a shallow bowl.
Pour warm water over the matzo pieces until they are moistened but not soggy, then drain excess water.
Whisk eggs together with salt and pepper in another bowl.
Add the softened matzo to the eggs and stir gently to combine.
Heat butter or oil in a large skillet over medium heat until foaming.
Pour the matzo and egg mixture into the skillet and stir frequently, breaking up any large clumps.
Cook 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is golden brown and cooked through.
Serve immediately with applesauce, sour cream, or cinnamon sugar.
cheapTips: Buy matzo on sale during Passover and store for year-round use
Serve with inexpensive applesauce instead of pricey toppings

recipes.name: Bazlama
recipes.description: Turkish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a large bowl, then add warm water and oil, stirring until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide dough into 8 equal balls, coat lightly with oil, and place in a covered bowl to rest 15 minutes.
Heat a cast iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat until very hot but not smoking.
Working with one ball at a time, roll or press each ball very thin, about 6 inches in diameter.
Place bazlama on the hot dry skillet and cook 1-2 minutes until it puffs slightly and gets light golden spots.
Flip and cook the other side for 1-2 minutes until light brown.
Stack finished bazlama on a plate and cover with a clean kitchen towel to keep warm and soft.
cheapTips: This recipe uses only basic pantry staples
Bazlama keeps well and can be reheated in a skillet the next day

recipes.name: Yang Chow Fried Rice
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat and scramble the eggs, then set aside.
Add remaining oil to the wok and stir-fry shrimp over high heat for 2-3 minutes until pink, then set aside.
Add minced garlic to the wok and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chilled rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the peas, carrots, ham, cooked shrimp, and cooked eggs, then toss together for 2 minutes.
Pour soy sauce and sesame oil over the rice and stir well to combine evenly.
Add most of the green onion and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with remaining green onion, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Use frozen vegetables instead of fresh for better prices and less waste
Substitute shrimp with chicken or canned tuna to reduce costs

recipes.name: Seafood Fried Rice
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Scramble the eggs, remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry shrimp and squid until cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add cold rice and break up clumps, stirring constantly for 2 minutes.
Add frozen vegetables and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Pour soy sauce and sesame oil over rice, toss in cooked eggs, and mix everything thoroughly for 1 minute.
Top with green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use frozen seafood instead of fresh to save 30-40%
Cook rice a day ahead and refrigerate to use cheaper day-old rice

recipes.name: Teriyaki Fried Rice
recipes.description: Japanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat and scramble eggs, remove and set aside.
Add 1 tablespoon oil and cook diced chicken until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Push chicken to the side, add remaining oil and garlic, stir for 30 seconds.
Add cold rice and break up clumps, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add frozen vegetables and stir everything together for 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, mirin, and sugar.
Pour teriyaki sauce over rice and toss continuously for 1 minute until well coated.
Return eggs to pan, mix gently, top with green onions, and serve.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for better value
Substitute honey for mirin to save on Asian ingredients

recipes.name: Tom Yum Fried Rice
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil and scramble eggs, set aside.
Add 1 tablespoon oil and stir-fry shrimp until pink, about 3 minutes.
Add onion and bell pepper, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Mix in tom yum paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cold rice and break up clumps, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce, lime juice, and fish sauce, toss everything well for 1 minute.
Return eggs to pan and mix gently.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy tom yum paste at Asian markets instead of regular grocery stores
Skip cilantro and use green onions instead for savings

recipes.name: Garlic Fried Rice
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over medium-high heat and add minced garlic.
Cook garlic for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until light golden and fragrant.
Push garlic to the side, crack eggs into pan, scramble them, and set aside.
Add 1.5 tablespoons oil, pour in cold rice, and break up clumps while stir-frying for 2 minutes.
Add frozen vegetables and stir-fry for 2 minutes until heated through.
Pour soy sauce and fish sauce over rice and toss well for 1 minute.
Return eggs to pan, sprinkle with black pepper, and mix gently.
Top with green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy garlic in bulk and peel at home instead of pre-minced
Use frozen mixed vegetables to avoid waste and reduce cost

recipes.name: Spam Fried Rice
recipes.description: Hawaiian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok and cook diced Spam until edges are slightly crispy, about 3 minutes.
Remove Spam and set aside, leaving oil in the pan.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Push ingredients to the side and scramble eggs, then mix everything together.
Add cold rice and break up clumps, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add frozen vegetables and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Pour soy sauce and sesame oil over rice, return Spam to pan, and mix well for 1 minute.
Top with green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy Spam on sale and stock up, it keeps for months
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for quick breakfasts

recipes.name: Ginger Fried Rice
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok and cook diced chicken until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Push chicken to the side, add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Scramble eggs, remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and cold rice, break up clumps, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add frozen vegetables and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Return chicken and eggs to pan, pour soy sauce over, and toss everything well for 1 minute.
Top with green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy fresh ginger in bulk at Asian markets for half the price
Store unused ginger in the freezer for months

recipes.name: Black Garlic Fried Rice
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil and stir-fry chicken until cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add black garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Scramble eggs, remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and cold rice, break up clumps, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add chopped green beans and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Return chicken and eggs to pan, pour soy sauce and fish sauce, toss well for 1 minute.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Find black garlic at Asian markets or online in bulk for better pricing
Regular garlic works as a substitute if black garlic is unavailable

recipes.name: Scrapple
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add ground pork and liver, breaking it up as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Add diced onion, salt, pepper, and sage, simmer for 10 minutes.
Slowly whisk in cornmeal while stirring constantly to avoid lumps, about 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and stir frequently for 20 minutes until very thick.
Line a loaf pan with plastic wrap and pour mixture in, smooth the top, and refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours.
Remove scrapple from pan and slice into 0.5-inch thick pieces.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and pan-fry slices until golden brown on both sides, about 3 minutes per side.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder and liver at butcher counters for bulk discounts
Make a double batch and freeze extra portions for weeks of easy breakfasts

recipes.name: Palatscinta
recipes.description: Hungarian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, eggs, milk, salt, and vanilla to create a thin batter.
Heat 0.5 tablespoon oil in an 8-inch non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Pour 0.25 cup batter into center, immediately tilt and swirl pan to spread thinly, cook 1 minute until golden, flip and cook 30 seconds more.
Transfer crepe to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
Spread 1 tablespoon jam on the cooked side of each crepe.
Roll crepe tightly and place seam-side down on a serving plate.
Top each rolled crepe with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of powdered sugar.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use store-brand jam instead of premium fruit preserves
Substitute Greek yogurt for sour cream to save money

recipes.name: Pfannkuchen
recipes.description: German breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, eggs, milk, salt, and sugar in a large bowl until smooth batter forms.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a 10-inch non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour 0.5 cup batter into center and immediately tilt skillet to spread thinly across bottom, cook 2 minutes until light golden.
Flip pancake and cook other side for 1 minute until set.
Transfer to plate and repeat with remaining batter.
Melt butter and lightly brush over warm pancakes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar and drizzle with lemon juice.
Fold pancakes into quarters and serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Use vegetable oil instead of butter for frying to save costs
Dust with plain sugar instead of powdered sugar if preferred

recipes.name: Hakka Sesame Ball
recipes.description: Hakka snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix glutinous rice flour, warm water, sugar, and salt until a soft dough forms.
Divide dough into 12 equal portions and roll each into a ball.
Make an indent in each ball and fill with 1 tablespoon of red bean paste, then seal and roll smooth.
Place sesame seeds in a shallow bowl and roll each filled ball in sesame seeds to coat completely.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and carefully place 3-4 balls at a time in the hot oil.
Fry for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and balls float to the surface.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels before serving.
cheapTips: Buy glutinous rice flour in bulk from Asian markets
Make your own red bean paste to save money

recipes.name: Stewed Beef with Radish
recipes.description: Hakka dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown beef chunks on all sides in batches, then set aside.
In the same pot, fry ginger slices and onion halves until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Return beef to pot and add soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, star anise, and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add cubed radish and continue simmering for another 20-25 minutes until radish is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck which is affordable and perfect for stewing
Buy radish in season for better prices

recipes.name: Hakka Fried Tofu with Vegetables
recipes.description: Hakka lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Press tofu between paper towels for 15 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Pan-fry tofu cubes until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry garlic and onion until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add bell pepper and stir-fry for 3 minutes until slightly softened.
Return tofu to the wok and add soy sauce and sesame oil, tossing to combine evenly.
Season with salt and white pepper, cook for 2 more minutes, and serve over rice.
cheapTips: Buy tofu from Asian markets for better prices
Use affordable seasonal vegetables

recipes.name: Hakka Flower Rolls
recipes.description: Hakka breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Add warm water and oil, knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic dough forms.
Cover and let rise at room temperature for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Divide dough into 8 equal portions and roll each flat into a thin rectangle.
Brush each rectangle with sesame oil and sprinkle chopped scallions and salt evenly.
Roll each rectangle tightly into a long cylinder, then coil from one end like a spiral and tuck the end underneath.
Place coiled rolls on parchment paper and let rise for 30 minutes.
Steam in a steamer basket for 12-15 minutes until cooked through, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy flour in bulk
Use fresh scallions from farmers markets when in season

recipes.name: Wind-Dried Sausage and Chestnut Rice
recipes.description: Hakka lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear and drain.
In a rice cooker or heavy pot, combine rice, water, soy sauce, and oil.
Add ginger slices and arrange lap cheong slices and chestnuts on top.
If using rice cooker, start the cycle; if using pot, bring to boil then cover and simmer on low heat for 15-18 minutes.
Once rice is cooked and water is absorbed, let rest covered for 5 minutes.
Fluff rice with a fork and top with chopped scallions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy lap cheong at Asian markets which is much cheaper than Western sausages
Roasted chestnuts from bulk bins save money

recipes.name: Ambot Tik
recipes.description: Goan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan and fry onions until golden and soft, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger, garlic, and green chiles, frying for another minute until fragrant.
Add fish pieces and sauté for 2-3 minutes on each side without breaking them.
Dissolve tamarind paste in water and pour into the pan along with salt and pepper.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 10-12 minutes until fish is cooked through and flavors meld.
Sprinkle with coriander leaves and serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Use affordable mackerel instead of expensive fish
Buy tamarind paste in bulk from Indian/Asian stores

recipes.name: Sorpotel
recipes.description: Goan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried red chiles in warm water for 10 minutes, then grind into a paste with garlic and ginger.
Heat oil in a large pot and brown pork pieces on all sides, then set aside.
In the same pot, fry onions until golden, then add chile paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Return pork to pot and add turmeric powder, stirring to coat.
Add tamarind paste, vinegar, salt, and water, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 40 minutes until pork is very tender and sauce thickens.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt or vinegar as needed, then serve with rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder which is much cheaper than other cuts
Dry red chiles last a long time in storage

recipes.name: Caldinho de Sapateira
recipes.description: Goan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and crackle cumin seeds until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add diced onions and fry until soft and translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in garlic, turmeric, and chopped green chiles, cooking for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes and cook until soft and broken down, about 5 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer, stirring gently.
Add crab meat and salt, simmering for 10-12 minutes until flavors combine.
Finish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot in bowls as a soup or with rice.
cheapTips: Use canned crab meat which is cheaper than fresh
Buy coconut milk in bulk from stores

recipes.name: Recheado de Peixe
recipes.description: Goan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Have the fishmonger clean the fish and slit it lengthwise from head to tail along one side, creating a pocket without cutting through.
Soak dried chiles in warm water for 10 minutes, then grind with garlic, ginger, onion, and cumin into a smooth paste.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil and fry the spice paste for 2-3 minutes until fragrant, then cool slightly.
Mix cooked paste with tamarind paste, salt, and vinegar.
Stuff the fish cavity generously with the spice mixture from the slit side.
Heat remaining 3 tablespoons oil in a shallow pan and carefully place the stuffed fish in it.
Pan-fry on medium heat for 8-10 minutes on the first side without moving, then carefully flip and cook another 8-10 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish which is cheaper per pound than fillets
Ask fishmonger to clean and slit the fish for free

recipes.name: Prawn Balchão
recipes.description: Goan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried red chiles in warm water for 10 minutes, then grind into a paste with garlic and ginger.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet and fry sliced onions until golden and caramelized, about 6 minutes.
Add chile paste and turmeric powder, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add prawns and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until they begin to turn pink.
Pour in vinegar and cook for another 2-3 minutes until prawns are fully cooked and opaque.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen prawns which are cheaper than fresh
Dried chiles can be bought in bulk and stored for months

recipes.name: Abacus Beads
recipes.description: Hakka lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried shiitake mushrooms in warm water for 20 minutes, then drain and dice them.
Dice pork belly into small cubes and cook in a wok until fat renders, about 5 minutes.
Add minced ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Mix glutinous rice flour with water to form a thick batter, stirring until smooth.
Spoon batter into small balls directly into the wok with cooked pork and mushrooms, stirring gently.
Add soy sauce, salt, and diced mushrooms to the wok, tossing to coat all beads evenly.
Cook for 8-10 minutes over medium heat until beads are translucent and cooked through.
Drizzle with sesame oil and top with chopped scallions before serving.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of pork belly for savings
Buy dried mushrooms in bulk at Asian markets

recipes.name: Hakka Spring Rolls
recipes.description: Hakka snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak glass noodles in warm water for 5 minutes, drain, and chop into 2-inch pieces.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok and stir-fry ground pork until cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add shredded cabbage, carrots, and ginger to the wok, cooking for 3 minutes until softened.
Mix in soaked glass noodles, soy sauce, and sesame oil, then remove from heat and cool slightly.
Place 1 tbsp filling on each spring roll wrapper, fold in sides, roll tightly, and seal with water on the edge.
Heat 3 cups oil in a deep pot to 350°F.
Carefully fry spring rolls in batches for 3-4 minutes until golden brown on all sides.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with sweet and sour sauce or chili oil.
cheapTips: Make filling ahead and refrigerate to save time
Buy cabbage whole instead of pre-shredded

recipes.name: Braised Duck with Chinese Herbs
recipes.description: Hakka dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut duck into large chunks and blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Heat oil in a large braising pot and briefly sear duck pieces until golden, about 4 minutes.
Add ginger slices and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in water, soy sauce, and rock sugar, stirring to combine and dissolve sugar.
Add ginseng slices and dried mushrooms, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours until duck is very tender.
Add goji berries in the last 10 minutes of cooking.
Garnish with scallions and serve hot with the braising liquid.
cheapTips: Buy ginseng and goji berries at Asian markets for better prices
Use duck legs and thighs instead of whole duck

recipes.name: Hakka Fried Rice Cakes
recipes.description: Hakka lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large wok over high heat.
Scramble eggs and remove from wok, then add remaining oil and cook ground pork until done, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add shredded cabbage and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add rice cakes and soy sauce, tossing gently to coat all cakes and prevent sticking, about 4 minutes.
Return scrambled eggs to the wok and mix everything together.
Drizzle with sesame oil and top with chopped scallions before serving.
cheapTips: Buy rice cakes from Asian grocery stores instead of specialty shops
Substitute ground chicken for pork to reduce cost

recipes.name: Stir-Fried Fern Fronds
recipes.description: Hakka lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch fresh fern fronds in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain and squeeze out excess moisture.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and add minced garlic and dried chili peppers.
Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant, then add blanched fern fronds.
Stir-fry for 2 minutes, then add soy sauce, salt, and water.
Continue cooking for another 3 minutes, tossing frequently until ferns are tender and well-coated.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve hot immediately.
cheapTips: Buy fern fronds in season at farmers markets for best prices
Skip dried chilies if unavailable; use chili flakes instead

recipes.name: Hakka Lion's Head Meatballs
recipes.description: Hakka dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground pork, chopped water chestnuts, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, egg, and cornstarch in a bowl and mix until just combined.
Form mixture into 12-16 large meatballs, about 2 inches in diameter.
Chop napa cabbage into large chunks and arrange in a braising pot or large skillet.
Place meatballs on top of cabbage, then pour chicken broth around them.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.
Taste broth and adjust seasoning with soy sauce if needed.
Serve meatballs and cabbage in bowls with the braising liquid.
cheapTips: Use ground beef or chicken instead of pork for variety
Substitute canned water chestnuts for fresh to save money

recipes.name: Mixed Vegetable Stir-Fry with Bean Paste
recipes.description: Hakka lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large wok over high heat until shimmering.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in doubanjiang and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add broccoli florets and mushrooms, stir-frying for 3 minutes.
Add bell peppers and snap peas, continuing to stir-fry for another 3 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce and water, mixing well to coat all vegetables.
Cook for 2-3 more minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Serve immediately over rice.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables in season for best prices
Use frozen broccoli and snap peas to reduce cost

recipes.name: Hakka Turnip Cake
recipes.description: Hakka breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and grate daikon radish, then squeeze out excess moisture using cheesecloth or a clean kitchen towel.
Dice Chinese sausage and soak dried shrimp in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain and chop.
Mix rice flour with water until smooth, then combine with grated daikon, sausage, shrimp, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and chopped scallions.
Pour mixture into a parchment-lined 8-inch square baking pan, smoothing the top.
Place pan in a steamer basket and steam for 30 minutes until cake is set and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a cutting board and cut into 8 squares.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Pan-fry each cake square for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Serve hot with soy sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy daikon radish in bulk when on sale and freeze extras
Omit Chinese sausage and dried shrimp for a vegetarian version

recipes.name: Braised Pork with Preserved Mustard Green
recipes.description: Hakka dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork belly into 2-inch cubes and blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Rinse preserved mustard greens thoroughly under cold water to remove excess salt, then chop into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a large braising pot and sear pork cubes until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add ginger slices, garlic, and scallions to the pot and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in water, soy sauce, rock sugar, and star anise, stirring to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes until pork is tender.
Add chopped preserved mustard greens and cook for another 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with soy sauce if needed, then serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy preserved mustard greens at Asian markets for significant savings
Use pork shoulder instead of belly for leaner, cheaper option

recipes.name: Hakka Long Beans with Minced Pork
recipes.description: Hakka lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim long beans and cut into 3-inch pieces.
