Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry beans for 4 minutes until edges are blistered and pods are tender, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the wok and cook ground pork, breaking it apart, until cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic, ginger, and dried chili peppers to the pork and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return beans to the wok and toss to combine with pork mixture.
Add soy sauce and water, stirring well and cooking for another 2 minutes.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve hot.
cheapTips: Substitute regular green beans if long beans are unavailable
Buy ground pork in bulk and freeze portions

recipes.name: Stir-fried Rice Cakes
recipes.description: Shanghainese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add minced garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add rice cakes and stir-fry for 2 minutes, breaking them apart gently.
Add mushrooms and bok choy, stir-frying for 2 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce, oyster sauce, and water, tossing everything together.
Cook for 2 more minutes until the vegetables are tender and sauce coats the rice cakes.
Add green onions and sesame oil, tossing once more.
Serve immediately on a plate.
cheapTips: Buy rice cakes in bulk from Asian markets for 40% less
Use frozen mushrooms instead of fresh to reduce cost

recipes.name: Thick Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Shanghainese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add diced chicken and ginger, simmering for 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and noodles, cooking for 4 minutes until noodles are tender.
Mix cornstarch with water to create a slurry.
Slowly pour the cornstarch slurry into the soup while stirring to thicken.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil, stirring well.
Simmer for 1 more minute until the soup reaches desired thickness.
Top with green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use canned chicken broth instead of fresh for half the price
Buy dried egg noodles and rehydrate them to save money

recipes.name: Fried Wonton
recipes.description: Shanghainese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and water in a bowl.
Place 1 teaspoon of filling in the center of each wonton wrapper.
Wet the edges of the wrapper with water using your finger.
Fold the wrapper in half diagonally to form a triangle, then bring the two corners together and pinch.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep pan or wok.
Carefully place wontons in the hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Remove wontons with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve warm with sweet and sour sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy wonton wrappers at Asian grocery stores for $1-1.50 per package
Make your own dipping sauce with ketchup and vinegar instead of buying

recipes.name: Oil Cake
recipes.description: Shanghainese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, water, and salt together until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 3 minutes, then let rest for 5 minutes.
Roll the dough into a thin rectangle on a floured surface.
Brush 3 tablespoons of oil over the dough, then sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and green onions.
Roll the dough tightly from one end to create a spiral log.
Coil the log into a flat spiral shape and let rest for 3 minutes.
Heat 1 cup of oil to 350°F in a deep pan.
Carefully place the coiled dough in the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
cheapTips: Make extra dough and freeze for quick future breakfasts
Use inexpensive vegetable oil from bulk stores

recipes.name: Youtiao
recipes.description: Shanghainese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in a large bowl.
Add warm water and 2 tablespoons of oil, kneading until a smooth dough forms.
Let the dough rest covered for 2 hours at room temperature.
Divide dough into 6 pieces and roll each into a thin rectangle.
Heat 2 cups of oil to 350°F in a deep pan.
Stretch one piece of dough slightly and carefully place in hot oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes, turning once, until golden brown and puffy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Repeat with remaining dough pieces and serve warm.
cheapTips: Make dough the night before to save morning time
Reuse frying oil for 2-3 more batches

recipes.name: Tofu Skin Roll
recipes.description: Shanghainese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork, mushrooms, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl.
Soften tofu skin sheets by briefly soaking in warm water for 30 seconds.
Lay a tofu skin sheet flat and place 2 tablespoons of filling in the center.
Fold the sides inward and roll tightly into a cylinder.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Place tofu skin rolls seam-side down in the hot oil.
Pan-fry for 3-4 minutes per side until the exterior is lightly browned and crispy.
Remove and serve warm with soy sauce or chili sauce for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy tofu skin sheets from Asian markets for significantly less than specialty stores
Use ground chicken instead of pork to reduce costs

recipes.name: Wazwan
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and add cumin seeds, cinnamon, and cardamom until fragrant.
Add ground onions and cook for 5 minutes until softened and slightly caramelized.
Add ginger and garlic, cooking for 2 more minutes.
Add lamb cubes and brown on all sides for 5-7 minutes.
Stir in red chili powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add yogurt slowly while stirring to prevent curdling, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add water and salt, bringing to a boil then reducing to low heat.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour until lamb is tender, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy lamb from bulk meat suppliers for 20% savings
Use Greek yogurt from discount stores instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Rista
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground lamb with half the chopped onions, ginger, garlic, and salt until well combined.
Form the mixture into 12-16 meatballs and set aside.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the remaining onions until golden brown.
Add fennel seeds and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add yogurt and red chili powder, stirring well.
Carefully add the meatballs to the gravy, rolling them gently.
Add water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Stir occasionally and check that meatballs are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy ground lamb in bulk and freeze in portions
Use plain yogurt from supermarket brands instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Gustaba
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground lamb with half the onion, ginger, garlic, and red chili powder until well combined.
Form the mixture into 8 oval patties, slightly flattened.
Heat oil in a large pan and fry the remaining onions until golden.
Add cumin powder and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add yogurt and stir well, cooking for 2 minutes.
Carefully place the meat patties in the gravy.
Add water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Gently flip the patties halfway through cooking.
Season with salt and serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Make patties ahead and refrigerate for convenience
Use plain yogurt from bulk containers for savings

recipes.name: Dum Aloo
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and prick with a fork in several places.
Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and add cumin seeds and bay leaves.
Add ground onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Add ginger and garlic, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in red chili powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add yogurt slowly while stirring to prevent curdling.
Add potatoes and water, stirring gently.
Cover the pot with aluminum foil, then place the lid on top (dum cooking method).
Cook on low heat for 30-35 minutes until potatoes are tender, shaking the pot occasionally.
Remove foil and lid carefully, season with salt, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk when on sale and store in cool place
Use plain yogurt from supermarket brands instead of specialty types

recipes.name: Chakuli
recipes.description: Goan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour, grated coconut, cumin seeds, salt, chili powder, and turmeric powder in a bowl.
Add water gradually and mix into a stiff dough that holds shape.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Transfer dough to a chakuli press or piping bag with ridged nozzle tip.
Press dough spirals directly into hot oil, making 3-4 inch coils.
Fry each chakuli for 2 minutes per side until golden brown and crisp.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy rice flour in bulk
Use unsweetened shredded coconut from baking aisle

recipes.name: Gatte ki Sabzi
recipes.description: Rajasthani lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix chickpea flour, yogurt, and salt into a thick dough, knead well, and divide into 4 equal balls.
Boil water in a large pot and gently roll each ball into a long cylindrical shape (gatte) directly into the boiling water.
Cook gattas for 8-10 minutes until they float to the surface, then drain and cool.
Cut cooled gattas into 1-inch pieces.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds and let them crackle.
Add ginger-garlic paste, onions, and sauté until onions are golden brown.
Add tomatoes, chili powder, and turmeric, cook until tomatoes break down into a paste.
Add gatta pieces and 1 cup water, simmer for 8-10 minutes until gravy thickens.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with bajra roti.
cheapTips: Buy chickpea flour in bulk from Indian stores
Use canned tomatoes if fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Laal Maas
recipes.description: Rajasthani dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried red chili peppers in warm water for 15 minutes, then grind into a fine paste with 2 tablespoons water.
Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot, add cumin seeds and let them crackle.
Add chopped onions and fry until deep golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add meat pieces and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add yogurt, chili paste, coriander powder, and turmeric; mix well and cook for 3 minutes.
Add water and salt, bring to boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 45-50 minutes until meat is very tender and gravy is thick and dark red.
Serve hot with bajra roti or rice.
cheapTips: Buy meat on sale and freeze
Use chicken as cheaper substitute

recipes.name: Ker Sangri
recipes.description: Rajasthani lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried ker berries and sangri pods in warm water for 30 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds and let them crackle.
Add chopped onions and fry until light golden, about 4 minutes.
Add soaked ker and sangri, stir well and cook for 3 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, and chili powder, mix well.
Cook on medium heat for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender.
Add amchur powder and salt, mix well and cook for 1 more minute.
Serve hot as a side dish with bread or rice.
cheapTips: Order dried ker and sangri online in bulk
This is a seasonal desert vegetable dish

recipes.name: Bajra Roti
recipes.description: Rajasthani lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix bajra flour and salt in a bowl.
Add warm water gradually and knead into a soft dough, using more water if needed.
Divide dough into 6-8 equal balls.
Heat a cast iron griddle or tawa over medium-high heat.
Place a dough ball between two pieces of plastic wrap and flatten into a thin circle with your palm.
Place roti on hot griddle and cook for 1-2 minutes until light brown spots appear.
Flip and cook the other side for 1-2 minutes, pressing gently with a cloth.
Apply ghee on both sides and fold, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy bajra flour from Indian grocery stores in bulk
One batch makes multiple rotis for extended freshness

recipes.name: Pyaaz ki Kachumbari
recipes.description: Rajasthani lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thinly slice red onions and place them in a bowl.
Sprinkle salt on the onions and let them rest for 2-3 minutes.
Add fresh lemon juice and mix well.
Sprinkle chili powder, toasted cumin seeds, and chopped cilantro over the onions.
Toss everything together gently.
Serve immediately as a fresh side salad with any meal.
cheapTips: Use whatever onions are on sale
This is a quick, no-cook side dish

recipes.name: Missi Roti
recipes.description: Rajasthani breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix chickpea flour, wheat flour, onion, green chili, cilantro, salt, and carom seeds in a bowl.
Add water gradually and knead into a soft dough.
Let dough rest for 5 minutes.
Divide into 6-8 equal balls.
Heat a tawa or griddle over medium-high heat.
Flatten each ball between plastic wrap into a thin circle and place on hot griddle.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until light brown spots appear, flip and cook other side.
Apply oil on both sides and serve hot with pickles or yogurt.
cheapTips: Buy chickpea flour in bulk
Batch cook and refrigerate for quick breakfasts

recipes.name: Mangodi
recipes.description: Rajasthani lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak moong dal in water for 30 minutes, then drain completely.
Grind soaked moong dal to a thick paste (not too smooth, should have slight texture).
Add crushed black peppercorns, cumin seeds, green chili, ginger, and salt to the paste, mix well.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Transfer mixture to a piping bag with small round tip.
Pipe small balls (about marble-sized) directly into hot oil.
Fry for 3-4 minutes until golden brown and crispy, stirring occasionally.
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Cool completely; mangodis will become crispy as they cool (store in airtight container for up to 2 weeks).
Use in curries or eat as a snack.
cheapTips: Buy moong dal in bulk from Indian stores
Make large batches and store for multiple uses

recipes.name: Mirchi Bada
recipes.description: Rajasthani snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make a small slit on the side of each green chili and remove seeds carefully, keeping the stem intact.
Mix mashed potatoes, onion, ginger-garlic paste, chaat masala, and salt.
Stuff each chili with 1-2 tablespoons of the potato mixture.
Mix gram flour with water to make a thick batter.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Dip each stuffed chili in gram flour batter, coating well.
Carefully place in hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes until golden brown on all sides.
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with sweet and spicy tamarind chutney.
cheapTips: Buy green chilies in bulk when in season and freeze
Use any potato variety on sale

recipes.name: Mohan Maas
recipes.description: Rajasthani dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Marinate meat with yogurt, salt, and 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste for 30 minutes.
Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot, add thinly sliced onions and fry until deep golden brown (10 minutes), remove half for garnish.
Add remaining ginger-garlic paste to onions in pot, cook for 2 minutes.
Add marinated meat and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Mix all spice powders (coriander, cumin, chili, turmeric, garam masala) with 2 tablespoons water to make a paste.
Add spice paste to meat and cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add water, bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 50-60 minutes until meat is very tender.
Soak saffron in 0.25 cup warm water for 10 minutes, then add to the curry.
Stir in fresh cream, add reserved fried onions, and cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve hot with rice or bajra roti.
cheapTips: Buy meat on sale and freeze until needed
Use evaporated milk instead of fresh cream to save money

recipes.name: Soup Dumplings
recipes.description: Shanghainese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour with boiling water and knead until smooth, then rest dough 30 minutes covered.
Heat broth with gelatin until dissolved, then mix with pork, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, scallions, sugar, and white pepper; refrigerate until set into jelly.
Divide dough into 12 pieces and roll each into a thin 3-inch circle.
Place 1 tbsp filling in center of each wrapper and pleat edges upward, twisting at top to seal.
Place dumplings seam-side up in a steamer lined with parchment and steam 8-10 minutes until wrappers are translucent.
Serve immediately with black vinegar and chili oil for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze until ready to use
Make dough from scratch rather than buying pre-made wrappers

recipes.name: Pork and Chive Dumplings
recipes.description: Shanghainese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground pork with soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, water, and salt in a bowl.
Fold in chopped chives gently just before assembling to prevent excess moisture.
Place 1 tbsp filling in center of each wrapper and fold in half, creating pleats along one edge.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and pan-fry dumplings flat-side down until bottoms are golden.
Add 1/4 cup water to skillet and cover immediately, steaming dumplings 5-6 minutes until water evaporates.
Serve hot with soy sauce, black vinegar, and chili oil for dipping.
cheapTips: Use regular scallions if Chinese chives are unavailable
Buy dumpling wrappers at Asian markets for lower cost

recipes.name: Crab Shell Pastry
recipes.description: Shanghainese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour with water and 2 tbsp lard to form a dough; knead for 5 minutes and rest 20 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix remaining 2 tbsp lard with flour to create a paste for layering.
Roll dough thin, spread lard-flour paste, roll into a log, coil, and flatten into a 4-inch circle.
Combine crab meat, diced pork belly, scallions, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, salt, and pepper for filling.
Place 2 tbsp filling in center of each dough circle, fold edges over filling, and flatten gently.
Pan-fry over medium heat in oiled skillet for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Serve hot while shell is still crispy.
cheapTips: Use imitation crab meat to reduce cost significantly
Substitute lard with vegetable oil if preferred

recipes.name: Scallion Oil Noodles
recipes.description: Shanghainese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil fresh noodles in salted water for 3-5 minutes until tender, then drain well.
Heat vegetable oil in a small saucepan over medium heat and add sliced scallions.
Cook scallions for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and beginning to soften.
Place hot noodles in a serving bowl and pour scallion oil and all scallions over top.
Add soy sauce, sesame oil, black pepper, and sugar; toss thoroughly to combine.
Serve immediately while noodles are hot.
cheapTips: Buy dried noodles instead of fresh to save money
Use scallion whites and reserve greens for garnish

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Pork Ribs
recipes.description: Shanghainese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Parboil ribs in boiling water for 10 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat and brown ribs on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Add ginger and garlic, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, ketchup, and water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes until ribs are tender.
Mix cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir into sauce to thicken, cooking 2 minutes more.
Garnish with scallions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy ribs on sale or from warehouse clubs
Use white vinegar instead of rice vinegar if needed

recipes.name: Braised Eel in Brown Sauce
recipes.description: Shanghainese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Ask the fishmonger to clean and cut the eel into 2-inch pieces; rinse well.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry eel pieces for 3-4 minutes until lightly browned.
Add ginger and garlic, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Deglaze with Shaoxing wine and add soy sauce, dark soy sauce, rock sugar, and chicken broth.
Bring to a boil, then add scallion pieces and reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer for 45-50 minutes until eel is very tender and sauce thickens.
Serve hot over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Order eel from Asian fish markets for better pricing
Use regular soy sauce and omit dark soy if unavailable

recipes.name: Hairy Crab
recipes.description: Shanghainese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse crabs thoroughly under cold water, scrubbing with a soft brush to remove dirt.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot with ginger, scallions, Shaoxing wine, and salt.
Carefully place crabs in boiling water and cover pot immediately.
Return to boil and steam for 15-18 minutes depending on crab size, until shells turn bright orange-red.
Mix rice vinegar, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a small dipping bowl.
Remove crabs with tongs and serve hot with dipping sauce and small forks for eating.
cheapTips: Buy hairy crabs during peak season (autumn) for better prices
Look for smaller crabs which are more affordable

recipes.name: Eight Treasure Duck
recipes.description: Shanghainese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch duck in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and pat dry completely.
Stir-fry mushrooms, sausage, peanuts, chestnuts, and shrimp in oil for 3 minutes, then mix into sticky rice.
Stuff duck cavity loosely with rice mixture, then sew opening closed with kitchen twine.
Place duck breast-up in a roasting pan, add ginger, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, and chicken broth.
Cover tightly with foil and braise in a 350°F oven for 90 minutes.
Remove foil, increase heat to 400°F, and roast 15 minutes more to crisp skin.
Rest duck 10 minutes, then transfer to cutting board and cut into pieces.
cheapTips: Buy whole duck from Asian markets instead of specialty butchers
Omit expensive chestnuts and use only mushrooms and peanuts

recipes.name: Smoked Fish
recipes.description: Shanghainese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring soy sauce, dark soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar, ginger, scallions, star anise, and water to a boil.
Simmer broth for 5 minutes to meld flavors, then cool completely.
Pat fish fillets dry and place in a shallow dish, then pour cooled broth over fish.
Cover and marinate in refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Heat oil in a wok to smoking temperature and carefully place marinated fish in wok.
Fry fish for 2-3 minutes per side until exterior is caramelized and smoky.
Transfer to serving plate and drizzle with marinade; serve at room temperature or chilled.
cheapTips: Use frozen white fish fillets to reduce cost
Save leftover marinade for future batches

recipes.name: Drunken Shrimp
recipes.description: Shanghainese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse shrimp and remove legs but leave shells intact; pat dry.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot with ginger, scallions, and salt.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes until they just turn pink and curl up.
Transfer shrimp to a glass container and discard cooking water.
Pour Shaoxing wine over shrimp, then add soy sauce, sesame oil, and sugar.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight.
Serve chilled as an appetizer or snack with the cooking liquid spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and thaw before cooking
Use frozen rather than fresh shrimp for significant savings

recipes.name: Kabab
recipes.description: Kashmiri snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground meat, onion, green chilies, ginger, garlic, and cilantro in a bowl.
Add egg and breadcrumbs and mix until the mixture holds together.
Divide into 8 equal portions and shape each into an oval patty about 3 inches long.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry kababs for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with chutney or lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze for later
Use regular breadcrumbs instead of panko to save money

recipes.name: Anchar Chutney
recipes.description: Kashmiri snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a saucepan and add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds; let them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add diced mango, green chilies, and ginger to the pan and stir well.
Add salt, sugar, and turmeric powder and mix thoroughly.
Cook over medium heat for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mango softens.
Let the chutney cool completely before transferring to a glass jar.
Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
cheapTips: Buy unripe mangoes in bulk during season and freeze for off-season use
Use seeds from your own mustard plants if available

recipes.name: Kesar Peda
recipes.description: Kashmiri snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak saffron strands in warm milk for 10 minutes.
Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat and add milk powder, stirring constantly.
Pour in condensed milk and continue stirring for 5-7 minutes until the mixture thickens and pulls away from the pan.
Add saffron with milk and cardamom powder, mixing well.
Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes until handleable.
Wet your hands slightly and shape the mixture into small round balls about 1 inch in diameter.
Garnish each peda with chopped pistachios and almonds, gently pressing them into the surface.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.
cheapTips: Buy saffron from bulk spice stores instead of pre-packaged
Use regular nuts and chop them yourself instead of buying pre-chopped

recipes.name: Hakka Stuffed Tofu
recipes.description: Hakka lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut tofu into 3-inch cubes and gently hollow out the center of each with a small spoon, creating a pocket for stuffing.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or skillet and cook ground meat with shallots and garlic until browned; drain excess fat.
Mix soy sauce and sesame oil into the cooked meat and let cool slightly, then stuff each tofu cube with the mixture.
Heat remaining oil in the wok over medium-high heat and carefully place stuffed tofu cubes in the pan.
Pan-fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden, then pour water around the tofu.
Cover and simmer for 8-10 minutes until tofu is tender.
Mix cornstarch with 1 tablespoon water and stir into the sauce to thicken.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy tofu from Asian grocery stores where it's cheaper
Use ground mushrooms or lentils instead of meat for a budget-friendly vegan option

recipes.name: Salt Baked Chicken
recipes.description: Hakka dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and rinse the chicken thoroughly, patting it dry.
Stuff the chicken cavity with ginger slices and green onion pieces.
Mix salt with water to create a paste that holds together when squeezed.
Spread a layer of salt paste on the bottom of a large baking dish, then place the chicken on top.
Cover the entire chicken completely with the remaining salt paste, pressing it firmly to seal.
Bake for 1 hour until the salt crust is hard and the chicken is cooked through (internal temperature 165°F).
Carefully crack open the salt crust and remove the chicken; brush away excess salt.
Mix soy sauce and sesame oil, and serve as a dipping sauce with the chicken.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens on sale and freeze for later
Use table salt mixed with water instead of kosher salt if needed

recipes.name: Hakka Stir-Fried Pork with Preserved Vegetables
recipes.description: Hakka lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Add pork slices and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until no longer pink; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and red chili flakes to the wok and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add preserved vegetables and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Return pork to the wok and pour in soy sauce, rice wine, and sugar.
Stir-fry everything together for 2-3 minutes until well combined and heated through.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve immediately over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when on sale and slice thinly; freezing makes slicing easier
Find preserved vegetables at Asian markets for much cheaper prices

recipes.name: Pounded Tea
recipes.description: Hakka snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dry roast green tea leaves in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes over low heat, stirring gently.
Add peanuts, sesame seeds, sunflower seeds, and coconut to the pan and continue roasting for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Transfer all ingredients to a mortar and pestle.
Pound the mixture gently for 5-7 minutes, breaking down nuts and seeds but not creating a fine powder.
Divide the pounded mixture into 4 cups.
Pour 1/2 cup hot water into each cup and stir well to combine.
Let steep for 2 minutes before drinking; some sediment will remain at the bottom.
cheapTips: Buy nuts and seeds in bulk from grocery store bulk sections
Store the dry pounded mixture in an airtight container for 2 weeks

recipes.name: Hakka Glutinous Rice Balls
recipes.description: Hakka snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix glutinous rice flour with warm water gradually, stirring until a soft dough forms.
Knead the dough for 2-3 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Mix peanut butter, brown sugar, oil, ground peanuts, and salt in a small bowl to create the filling.
Divide dough into 12 equal portions and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin disc, add 1 teaspoon filling in the center, then wrap edges and roll into a smooth ball.
Bring water to a boil in a pot and carefully add rice balls.
Stir gently and let them cook for 5-7 minutes until they float to the surface and stay there for 2 minutes.
Serve hot in the cooking liquid or drain and serve plain.
cheapTips: Buy glutinous rice flour from Asian grocery stores where it's much cheaper
Use leftover filling mixture as a snack with crackers

recipes.name: Braised Pork Belly with Taro
recipes.description: Hakka dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch pork belly cubes in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Heat oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and briefly sear the blanched pork until lightly browned.
Add garlic and ginger slices and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in soy sauce and water, then add star anise and cinnamon stick.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes until pork is tender.
Add taro cubes and rock sugar, stir well, and continue simmering for 20-25 minutes until taro is tender.
Adjust seasoning with additional soy sauce if needed and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly on sale and freeze; it becomes cheaper when bought in larger quantities
Find taro at Asian markets for better prices than specialty stores

recipes.name: Hakka Stir-Fried Leeks with Dried Shrimp
recipes.description: Hakka lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried shrimp in warm water for 5-10 minutes until softened, then drain well.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Add garlic and dried shrimp and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add leek slices and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent burning.
Pour in soy sauce and rice wine, and continue stir-frying for 2-3 minutes until leeks are tender-crisp.
Drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle white pepper over the dish.
Serve immediately as a side dish with rice or noodles.
cheapTips: Buy dried shrimp from Asian markets where they are significantly cheaper
Choose larger leeks that are on sale; they offer better value per pound

recipes.name: Mackerel Fry
recipes.description: Goan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat the mackerel fillets dry with paper towels.
Mix turmeric, red chili powder, minced garlic, minced ginger, lime juice, and salt in a small bowl to form a paste.
Rub the paste generously on both sides of each mackerel fillet and let sit for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry the mackerel fillets for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Remove the fillets and set aside on a plate.
In the same oil, fry the sliced onions until soft and golden, about 3 minutes.
Return the mackerel to the pan, top with fried onions and green chili, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy mackerel during sales; it's an affordable oily fish
Use basic pantry spices instead of pre-mixed masala blends

recipes.name: Toddy Fry
recipes.description: Goan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet and toast cumin seeds until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until aromatic.
Add turmeric and red chili powder, stirring constantly for 30 seconds to bloom the spices.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally.
Add shrimp and salt, cooking for 5-7 minutes until shrimp turn pink and are cooked through.
Remove from heat and finish with lime juice.
Serve hot over rice or with bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk and thaw as needed
Substitute canned coconut milk to reduce costs slightly

recipes.name: Kokum Curry
recipes.description: Goan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and toast cumin seeds for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced onion and sauté until soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic, turmeric, and red chili powder; cook for 1 minute.
Add the pumpkin cubes and stir to coat with spices.
Pour in water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 12 minutes until pumpkin is tender.
Add dried kokum pieces or tamarind paste and coconut milk, stirring well.
Simmer for 5 more minutes, allowing flavors to blend; season with salt to taste.
Serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Pumpkin and squash are inexpensive; buy seasonal for best prices
Tamarind paste is a budget-friendly kokum substitute

recipes.name: Crab Xec Xec
recipes.description: Goan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried red chilies, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, and peppercorns in a dry pan for 1 minute until fragrant.
Transfer toasted spices to a blender with grated coconut, garlic, and ginger; blend with minimal water to form a thick paste.
Heat oil in a skillet and sauté diced onion until golden, about 4 minutes.
Add the coconut-spice paste and fry for 2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent sticking.
Add the crab meat and salt, stirring gently to combine without breaking up the meat too much.
Cook for 8-10 minutes on medium heat, stirring occasionally, allowing the flavors to infuse.
Finish with lime juice and adjust salt to taste.
Serve hot as a dry curry with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy canned crab meat when fresh is unavailable; drain and use the same way
Frozen grated coconut saves prep time and is similar in price to fresh

recipes.name: Pork Cafreal
recipes.description: Goan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend cilantro, mint, green chili, garlic, ginger, cumin, lime juice, and salt into a smooth green paste.
Coat the pork cubes with the green paste and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Working in batches if needed, fry the marinated pork pieces until browned on all sides, about 8-10 minutes total.
Reduce heat to medium, add any remaining marinade, and continue cooking covered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the lid and cook uncovered for 5 more minutes until the sauce reduces slightly.
Adjust seasoning with additional salt and lime juice as needed.
Serve hot with rice or flatbread.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder when on sale and freeze for later use
Use the abundant green herbs from a grocery store's bulk section

recipes.name: Bebinca
recipes.description: Goan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix coconut milk and cornstarch in a bowl, stirring until lumps dissolve.
Heat ghee in a large pan over medium heat and add the coconut-cornstarch mixture, stirring constantly.
Cook, stirring continuously, for 8-10 minutes until the mixture thickens and turns golden.
In a separate bowl, whisk egg yolks with sugar, nutmeg, vanilla, and salt.
Slowly pour the egg mixture into the cooked coconut mixture, stirring rapidly to avoid lumps.
Continue cooking and stirring for 3-4 minutes until fully incorporated and thickened.
Pour the mixture into a greased 8-inch square baking dish and smooth the top.
Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours until set; cut into squares and serve cold.
cheapTips: Substitute regular butter for ghee to reduce costs
Buy cornstarch in bulk at warehouse stores

recipes.name: Sannas
recipes.description: Goan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak rice and urad dal separately in water for 4 hours; drain well.
Grind soaked rice and urad dal together with 0.5 cup water into a smooth, thick batter.
In a blender, combine grated coconut, jaggery, and cardamom with the remaining water; blend until smooth.
Pour the coconut-jaggery mixture into the rice batter and fold gently until combined; add salt.
Grease small stainless steel or bamboo molds (or idli molds) with oil.
Fill each mold three-quarters full with the batter.
Steam in a steamer or idli maker for 8-10 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Cool slightly, then invert the molds to remove the steamed cakes; serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy rice and lentils in bulk to reduce per-unit costs
Use coconut frozen in trays if fresh is expensive

recipes.name: Poori Bhaji
recipes.description: Goan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, semolina, salt, and baking soda in a bowl; add water gradually and knead into soft dough.
Cover dough and let rest for 15 minutes.
While dough rests, heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan and fry diced potatoes until golden and soft, about 8 minutes.
Add diced onion, green chili, cumin seeds, turmeric, and red chili powder to the potatoes; cook for 3 minutes until aromatic; set aside as bhaji.
Divide dough into 8 equal portions and shape each into a ball.
Heat oil for frying in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C).
On a greased surface, flatten each dough ball into a thin circle about 5 inches across.
Fry each poori in hot oil for 1-2 minutes per side until golden and puffed, flipping once.
Serve hot pooris alongside the warm bhaji.
cheapTips: Use basic all-purpose flour instead of specialty flour blends
Buy potatoes in bulk when inexpensive and store well

recipes.name: Dodol
recipes.description: Goan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat ghee in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Add rice flour and roast, stirring constantly, for 5-7 minutes until fragrant and slightly golden.
Slowly add coconut milk while stirring continuously to avoid lumps; keep stirring to prevent sticking.
Add grated jaggery, cardamom, and salt; continue stirring as the mixture thickens, about 15-20 minutes.
When the mixture is very thick and pulls away from the sides of the pan, fold in cashews and raisins.
Cook for 2 more minutes while stirring.
Pour the mixture onto a greased baking sheet and spread evenly to about 0.75 inches thick.
Cool completely, then cut into squares or rectangles; store in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Use regular sugar mixed with molasses as a jaggery substitute to save money
Buy cashews and raisins from bulk bins for better pricing

recipes.name: Nevrio
recipes.description: Goan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour, grated coconut, cardamom powder, and salt in a bowl.
Heat ghee and pour it into the rice flour mixture; mix well with your fingers until it resembles coarse breadcrumbs.
In a small pan, heat water and dissolve grated jaggery over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Pour the warm jaggery liquid into the flour mixture and stir until it comes together as a soft dough.
Divide the dough into 12 equal portions and shape each into a small oval or round patty, about 2 inches.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry the patties in hot oil, a few at a time, for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm; the insides will be slightly soft and the outsides crispy.
cheapTips: Buy rice flour in bulk from Indian grocery stores for better prices
Use coconut frozen from bulk bins to save on cost

recipes.name: Yakhni
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut lamb meat into 2-inch cubes and rinse under cold water.
Bring 8 cups of water to a boil in a large pot.
Add meat, quartered onions, ginger slices, garlic, and cardamom; boil for 20 minutes and skim impurities.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes until meat is tender.
Add cinnamon, bay leaves, salt, and pepper; simmer for 10 more minutes.
Strain the broth through cheesecloth, discarding solids, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use meat bones with a bit of meat attached instead of premium cuts
Dry-roast spices at home instead of buying pre-ground

recipes.name: Modur Pulao
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak basmati rice in water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Cut meat into 1-inch pieces; slice onions thinly.
Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot and fry half the onions until golden; set aside.
In the same ghee, cook remaining onions until soft, add ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute.
Add meat and cook on high heat for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in yogurt and spices; simmer meat for 15 minutes until partially cooked.
Add drained rice, mix gently, pour 4 cups boiling water, cover tightly and cook on high heat 3 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and cook covered for 20 minutes until rice is tender and water is absorbed.
Top with fried onions, cover for 2 minutes, then fluff with a fork and serve.
cheapTips: Buy whole spices in bulk from Asian markets
Use regular onions instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Goshtaba
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely mince one onion and knead with ground lamb, ginger, garlic, cardamom, cinnamon, salt, and pepper until sticky.
Form mixture into 8-10 smooth, elongated balls about 3 inches long.
Slice the second onion and fry in ghee over medium heat until golden brown; remove and set aside.
In the same ghee, gently place meatballs and brown on all sides for 5-7 minutes.
Whisk yogurt with chili powder and pour over meatballs.
Add water and fried onions, bring to a simmer, cover and cook on low heat for 35-40 minutes.
The gravy should reduce and meatballs should be tender; taste and adjust salt.
Serve hot in a shallow dish with the rich, creamy gravy.
cheapTips: Make meatballs a day ahead and refrigerate
Use plain yogurt instead of Greek yogurt to save cost

recipes.name: Aab Gosht
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat ghee in a heavy pot and fry 2 sliced onions until golden; remove and set aside.
In the same ghee, add the third onion finely chopped with ginger and garlic; cook until fragrant.
Add meat cubes and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add yogurt and red chili powder, stir well and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour in water, add cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaves, and salt; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 60 minutes until meat is very tender.
The curry should have a pale, light gravy; top with fried onions and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy meat on sale and freeze for later use
Make a double batch and freeze half for quick meals

recipes.name: Halwa
recipes.description: Kashmiri snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast whole wheat flour in a dry pan over medium heat for 8-10 minutes, stirring constantly until fragrant and golden; set aside.
In a heavy-bottomed pot, heat ghee and fry almonds, cashews, and raisins until golden; remove with a slotted spoon and reserve.
In the same ghee, add toasted flour and roast on medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring continuously until brown and fragrant.
Slowly add water while stirring constantly to avoid lumps and cook for 10 minutes until thick.
Add sugar, cardamom, and salt; stir well and cook for another 8-10 minutes until the mixture becomes dense and leaves the sides of the pan.
Fold in the fried nuts and raisins, mix well, and transfer to a greased plate.
Cool slightly, cut into squares, and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use regular flour instead of specialty varieties
Buy nuts in bulk and store in the freezer

recipes.name: Sheermal
recipes.description: Kashmiri breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak saffron in 0.25 cup warm milk for 10 minutes.
In a bowl, mix yeast with 0.25 cup warm milk and 1 tsp sugar; let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
In a large bowl, combine flour, salt, and 2 tbsp sugar; make a well in the center.
Pour yeast mixture, remaining warm milk with saffron, 2 tbsp melted ghee, 1 beaten egg, and cardamom into the well.
Knead into a soft dough for 10 minutes; cover and let rise in a warm place for 60-90 minutes until doubled.
Divide dough into 4 portions and shape into thick oval discs; place on a baking sheet.
Brush tops with 2 tbsp melted ghee, press almonds and poppy seeds on top, and let rise 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F and bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
Cool slightly and serve warm with butter or jam.
cheapTips: Skip the saffron and use turmeric or food coloring for color
Use all-purpose flour; specialty flour is unnecessary

recipes.name: Noon Chai
recipes.description: Kashmiri breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour water into a pot and bring to a boil; add tea leaves and boil for 2 minutes.
Add milk and bring back to a simmer; add baking soda (mixture will foam slightly).
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add salt and cardamom powder; stir well.
Strain through a fine strainer into serving cups.
Top each cup with crushed pistachios and almonds, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use regular black tea bags instead of loose leaf tea
Skip nuts or use just one type to reduce cost

recipes.name: Paneer Chaman
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch spinach in boiling salted water for 2 minutes; drain, cool, and blend into a smooth paste.
Heat ghee in a pan and fry paneer cubes on all sides until light golden; set aside.
In the same ghee, fry sliced onions until golden; remove and set aside.
Add minced ginger and garlic to remaining ghee and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in red chili powder and cook for 30 seconds, then add yogurt and mix well.
Pour in the spinach paste and cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add water, cardamom, cinnamon, and salt; bring to a simmer.
Gently add fried paneer and fried onions, simmer for 15-20 minutes until flavors blend.
Serve hot with basmati rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy paneer from Indian markets instead of premium brands
Use frozen spinach if fresh is unavailable or expensive

recipes.name: Tchot Pulao
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak basmati rice in water for 20 minutes; drain.
Slice 2 onions thinly and fry in ghee until golden brown; set aside.
Finely mince the third onion and cook in remaining ghee until soft.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute; add minced meat and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, breaking it apart.
Stir in yogurt and red chili powder; simmer for 10 minutes until meat is partially cooked.
Add drained rice and green peas, mix gently, then pour 4 cups boiling water and add cardamom and cinnamon.
Cover tightly, bring to a boil for 3 minutes, then reduce heat to low and cook for 20 minutes until rice is tender.
Top with fried onions, cover for 2 minutes, then fluff with a fork and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use ground meat on sale and freeze in portions
Substitute fresh peas with frozen, which is cheaper and just as nutritious

recipes.name: Lal Maas
recipes.description: Kashmiri lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onions; fry 2 onions in ghee until golden brown and set aside.
Finely mince the third onion and cook in remaining ghee with ginger and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add meat and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Mix yogurt with red chili powder in a bowl; add to meat and stir well.
Simmer the meat and yogurt mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add water, cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaves, and salt; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 45-50 minutes until meat is very tender.
Top with fried onions and serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy mutton or tougher cuts of lamb on sale; slow cooking tenderizes them
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for future meals

recipes.name: Fried Goat Cheese
recipes.description: Yunnan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut goat cheese into 1-inch cubes and place in freezer for 30 minutes.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten egg, and panko breadcrumbs mixed with salt and pepper.
Coat each cheese cube in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing gently so coating adheres.
Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F and fry cheese cubes for 1-2 minutes until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately while warm and crispy.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand goat cheese instead of premium brands
Use generic panko breadcrumbs rather than specialty versions

recipes.name: Bamboo Shoot Salad
recipes.description: Yunnan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse canned bamboo shoots, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Mince red chilies and garlic cloves together into a fine paste.
In a large bowl, combine lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, and sesame oil.
Add bamboo shoots, chili-garlic paste, and cilantro to the dressing and toss well.
Let salad marinate for 10 minutes to allow flavors to blend.
Top with crushed peanuts and serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy canned bamboo shoots instead of fresh for year-round availability
Use roasted peanuts from bulk bins for cheaper cost

recipes.name: Yunnan Ham
recipes.description: Yunnan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Score the skin of pork shoulder in a crosshatch pattern with a sharp knife.
Combine salt, sugar, garlic, peppercorns, star anise, and bay leaves with water in a large pot.
Bring brine to a boil, then remove from heat and cool completely.
Submerge pork shoulder in cooled brine and refrigerate for 5-7 days, turning occasionally.
Remove pork from brine and roast at 325°F for 2.5-3 hours until internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Cool, slice thinly, and serve at room temperature with pickled vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and make a larger batch to freeze portions
Use whole spices from bulk bins rather than pre-packaged

recipes.name: Grilled Fish with Lemongrass
recipes.description: Yunnan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean and gut fish, pat dry with paper towels, and make 3 diagonal slits on each side.
Chop lemongrass, garlic, and red chilies finely and mix with fish sauce, lime juice, and oil.
Stuff cavity of fish with lemongrass mixture and rub remaining mixture all over the exterior.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat and oil grates well to prevent sticking.
Grill fish for 8-10 minutes per side until flesh is opaque and skin is charred.
Transfer to serving plate and serve immediately with steamed jasmine rice.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish at Asian markets for better prices than specialty stores
Use frozen lemongrass if fresh is unavailable and expensive

recipes.name: Taro Cake
recipes.description: Yunnan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube taro root, then boil in salted water for 15 minutes until tender and drain well.
Mash cooked taro in a bowl until smooth, then cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla together in another bowl until well combined.
Mix flour, tapioca starch, sugar, and baking powder in a dry bowl.
Combine wet and dry ingredients with mashed taro until batter is smooth with no lumps.
Pour batter into greased 9-inch round cake pan and bake at 350°F for 50-60 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 15 minutes, then turn out onto wire rack to cool completely.
cheapTips: Buy taro root from Asian markets where it's much cheaper than supermarkets
Make full recipe and freeze portions for quick breakfasts

recipes.name: Mushroom Hot Pot
recipes.description: Yunnan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean mushrooms and cut larger varieties in half, leaving smaller ones whole.
Cube tofu into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
In a large pot, bring broth to boil with ginger, garlic, star anise, and dried chilies.
Simmer broth for 10 minutes to infuse flavors, then add soy sauce and sesame oil.
Add mushrooms and tofu, maintaining a gentle simmer for 12-15 minutes.
Top with chopped green onions and serve in individual bowls with slotted spoons and broth.
cheapTips: Buy mixed mushrooms from bulk bins or discount produce sections
Use store-brand vegetable broth instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Fried Dough Sticks with Sesame
recipes.description: Yunnan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and baking soda in a large bowl.
Gradually add warm water and knead until dough is soft and elastic, about 10 minutes.
Cover dough and let rise at room temperature for 1 hour.
Roll out dough to 1/4-inch thickness and cut into 4-inch-long strips.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry dough strips in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and puffed.
Remove with slotted spoon and immediately toss with sesame seeds and sugar while still warm.
cheapTips: Buy sesame seeds in bulk for significant savings
Make dough in advance and refrigerate up to 2 days before frying

recipes.name: Roasted Free-range Chicken
recipes.description: Yunnan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove chicken from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking and pat dry inside and outside.
Season cavity and exterior generously with salt and pepper.
Stuff cavity with garlic cloves, thyme sprigs, and lemon halves.
Rub chicken skin with softened butter and place breast-side up in roasting pan.
Pour broth into pan around chicken and roast at 425°F for 60-75 minutes until juices run clear and skin is golden.
Rest chicken for 10 minutes before carving and serve with pan drippings as jus.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken instead of parts for better value per pound
Check sales at discount grocer chains for better poultry prices

recipes.name: Sticky Rice in Bamboo
recipes.description: Yunnan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak glutinous rice in water for 30 minutes, then drain well.
Cube pork belly and marinate with soy sauce, sugar, and minced garlic for 15 minutes.
Soak bamboo leaves in warm water for 10 minutes to soften.
Layer soaked rice and marinated pork in bamboo leaf bundles, top with salted egg yolk in center.
Fold bamboo leaves to enclose filling and tie with kitchen twine.
Steam packets over boiling water for 50-60 minutes until rice is fully cooked through.
Carefully unfold and serve warm directly in bamboo leaf wrapping.
cheapTips: Buy glutinous rice in bulk from Asian markets instead of supermarkets
Prepare multiple packets at once and freeze for quick future breakfasts

recipes.name: Pickled Fish
recipes.description: Yunnan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fish fillets into 2-inch pieces and arrange in a glass container.
Combine vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in a pot and bring to boil.
Add chilies, garlic, ginger, and star anise to pickling liquid and simmer 5 minutes.
Cool pickling liquid to room temperature, then pour over fish pieces.
Cover container and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving.
Serve chilled fish pieces with some pickling liquid and aromatics in individual bowls.
cheapTips: Buy tilapia fillets on sale and make multiple batches to store for weeks
Use white vinegar instead of specialty vinegars for significant cost savings

recipes.name: Poha
recipes.description: Assamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse the flattened rice gently under cold water for 30 seconds and drain well.
Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds if available, then add chopped onions and cook until translucent.
Add ginger and green chili, stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the drained poha, turmeric powder, and salt, then stir constantly for 2-3 minutes.
Add water gradually while stirring to combine and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy flattened rice in bulk from Indian grocery stores
Use basic pantry spices to minimize costs

recipes.name: Doodhpuli
recipes.description: Assamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, and salt in a bowl, then add oil and knead into a soft dough with water.
Let the dough rest for 15 minutes covered.
Mix jaggery and grated coconut in a bowl to make the filling.
Divide dough into 6 portions and roll each into a thin circle, then place filling in the center.
Fold the edges to the center and seal to create a pouch shape.
Boil milk in a pan and gently place the pouches into the boiling milk.
Cook for 8-10 minutes until the pouches float and the dough is cooked through.
Serve warm in the sweetened milk.
cheapTips: Make your own grated coconut from fresh coconut when available
Use jaggery instead of brown sugar for authenticity and value

recipes.name: Fish Tenga
recipes.description: Assamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and add sliced onions, cooking until golden brown.
Add minced ginger and green chilies, then stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add turmeric powder and chopped tomatoes, cooking until tomatoes soften.
Add water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and let simmer for 5 minutes.
Add tamarind pulp and stir well to combine, then add salt to taste.
Carefully place fish fillets into the broth and simmer for 10-12 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy fish fillets from warehouse stores or frozen for better prices
Use concentrate tamarind from Indian grocers instead of fresh

recipes.name: Masor Jol
recipes.description: Assamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and add sliced ginger and whole green chilies, cooking for 1 minute.
Add sliced onions and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Pour water into the pot and bring to a boil.
Add turmeric powder and salt, then gently place fish fillets into the boiling water.
Simmer for 10-12 minutes until fish is tender and cooked through, being careful not to break the fish.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve in bowls with the broth.
cheapTips: Choose less expensive fish varieties like catfish
Skip premium garnishes to keep costs low

recipes.name: Masor Tenga
recipes.description: Assamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds, allowing them to splutter for 30 seconds.
Add sliced onions and cook until light golden, then add minced ginger and green chilies.
Add turmeric powder and chopped tomatoes, cooking until tomatoes are soft.
Pour water and bring to a boil, then add tamarind concentrate and salt.
Carefully add fish fillets to the simmering broth and cook for 12-15 minutes until fully cooked.
Serve hot with steamed rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy tamarind concentrate from Indian stores instead of fresh tamarind
Purchase whole fish and fillet at home to save money

recipes.name: Bhekueli
recipes.description: Assamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan and add sliced onions, cooking until golden brown.
Add minced ginger and garlic, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add duck or chicken pieces and cook over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes until browned on all sides.
Sprinkle turmeric powder and black pepper, then stir well to coat the meat.
Add green chilies and pour water, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 25-30 minutes until meat is tender and liquid reduces.
Adjust seasoning and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of premium cuts for budget cooking
Buy meat on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Aloo Pitika
recipes.description: Assamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes until completely soft, then drain and peel while still warm.
Mash potatoes roughly in a large bowl, leaving some texture.
Heat oil in a pan and add chopped onions, cooking until golden.
Add minced ginger and green chilies, stirring for 30 seconds.
Pour the onion mixture into the mashed potatoes and add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt.
Mix everything together gently until well combined.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk from warehouse stores
Use basic spices to minimize costs

recipes.name: Doi Chira
recipes.description: Assamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour plain yogurt into a bowl.
Add flattened rice and mix gently to coat with yogurt.
Crumble jaggery and sprinkle over the mixture, then stir to combine.
Top with banana slices and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand yogurt to save money
Buy flattened rice in bulk

recipes.name: Chira Dahi
recipes.description: Assamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour plain yogurt into a serving bowl.
Add flattened rice and stir gently to combine.
Sprinkle sugar and crushed cardamom over the mixture.
Mix everything together and serve chilled or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Make your own yogurt at home to save significantly
Buy cardamom in bulk and grind as needed

recipes.name: Jolpan
recipes.description: Assamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then add oil and mix with fingers until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add water gradually and knead into a soft dough.
Mix jaggery and grated coconut in a separate bowl to make the filling.
Divide dough into 6 portions and roll each into a thin circle.
Place filling in the center of each circle, fold edges over, and gently flatten into a patty.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and cook patties for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Cool slightly and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Make fresh grated coconut when available instead of buying packaged
Use basic all-purpose flour instead of specialty flours

recipes.name: Oil Tea
recipes.description: Yunnan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a wok over medium heat and add dried chilies, garlic, and ginger, frying until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in salt and toast sesame seeds and peanuts in a dry pan until golden, about 3 minutes.
Pour the infused oil and broth into bowls and top with toasted seeds, peanuts, scallions, and fried shallots.
Serve hot as a breakfast soup.
cheapTips: Buy sesame seeds and peanuts in bulk from Asian markets
Make crispy fried shallots at home by frying thin-sliced shallots in oil

recipes.name: Water-Boiled Fish
recipes.description: Yunnan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and season with soy sauce, white pepper, and salt.
Add sliced ginger and minced garlic to the broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
Gently place fish fillets into the simmering broth and poach until cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.
Heat oil in a separate wok and add dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns, toasting for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour the hot chili oil over the cooked fish in the broth.
Garnish with sliced scallions and serve immediately with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use tilapia or catfish instead of premium white fish to reduce cost
Buy dried chilies in bulk from Asian grocery stores

recipes.name: Dai Bamboo Rice
recipes.description: Yunnan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse jasmine rice thoroughly under cold water until water runs clear.
Mix rice with coconut milk, water, salt, and coconut oil in a bowl.
Divide rice mixture equally among three pieces of banana leaf or parchment paper, folding to create sealed packets.
Place packets on a steamer rack over boiling water and steam for 30 minutes until rice is tender.
Carefully open packets and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions.
Serve hot directly from the leaf packets.
cheapTips: Use parchment paper instead of banana leaves to save money
Buy jasmine rice in 10-lb bags from Asian markets for better pricing

recipes.name: Grilled Skewered Meat
recipes.description: Yunnan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Mix soy sauce, vegetable oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, chili powder, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Add meat cubes to marinade and let sit for 10 minutes.
Thread marinated meat onto skewers, leaving small gaps between pieces.
Grill over medium-high heat or in a grill pan for 8-10 minutes, turning every 2 minutes for even cooking.
Transfer to a plate and garnish with chopped scallions and additional cumin powder.
Serve hot with steamed rice or flatbread.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze in portions
Make your own spice mix instead of buying pre-made marinades

recipes.name: Yunnan White Cheese Pastry
recipes.description: Yunnan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then rub in softened butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add water gradually and knead until dough comes together, then rest for 10 minutes.
Combine crumbled cheese and honey in a bowl for the filling.
Divide dough into 4 portions and roll each into a thin rectangle.
Spread cheese filling on each rectangle, roll tightly, and coil into a spiral shape.
Place on a baking sheet, brush with beaten egg, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake at 375°F for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Use ricotta instead of paneer for significant savings
Buy all-purpose flour in bulk and store in airtight containers

recipes.name: Stir-fried Wild Vegetables
recipes.description: Yunnan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat until shimmering.
Add garlic and ginger, stirring constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add broccoli and mushrooms, stir-frying for 4-5 minutes until nearly tender.
Add leafy greens and soy sauce, tossing continuously for 2-3 minutes until greens wilt.
Season with salt and finish with sesame oil.
Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve immediately with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy seasonal vegetables at farmers markets for the best prices
Use whatever leafy greens are on sale such as bok choy or spinach

recipes.name: Bai Ethnic Congee
recipes.description: Yunnan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice briefly and add to a large pot with chicken broth and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add minced ginger, salt, and white pepper, stirring to combine.
Continue cooking for 5 more minutes until rice is very soft and creamy.
Stir in chopped preserved vegetables.
Ladle congee into bowls and top with roasted peanuts, scallions, and a drizzle of sesame oil.
Serve hot.
cheapTips: Use vegetable broth instead of chicken broth to reduce cost
Buy peanuts in bulk from discount grocery stores

recipes.name: Grilled Eggplant with Sauce
recipes.description: Yunnan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1/2-inch thick pieces and brush both sides with vegetable oil.
Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat and grill eggplant slices for 4-5 minutes per side until tender and marked.
Whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, chili flakes, and honey in a bowl.
Arrange grilled eggplant on a serving plate and pour the sauce over top.
Garnish with scallions and sesame seeds.
Serve at room temperature or warm with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants when in season for the best prices
Make sauce in larger batches to freeze for future use

recipes.name: Mung Bean Cake
recipes.description: Yunnan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse mung beans and boil in water for 20-25 minutes until very soft, then drain well.
Mash cooked mung beans until smooth, then mix in sugar, melted butter, flour, and salt until well combined.
Lightly oil a baking sheet and spread mung bean mixture evenly to about 1/2-inch thickness.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over the top and press gently.
Bake at 350°F for 15-18 minutes until golden brown and edges are slightly crispy.
Cool for 10 minutes, then cut into squares with an oiled knife.
Serve at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy dried mung beans in bulk from Asian grocery stores
Make large batches and store in an airtight container for several days

recipes.name: Chettinad Mutton Curry
recipes.description: Chettinad lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dry roast coriander seeds, cumin seeds, dried chilies, and peppercorns in a pan for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Grind the roasted spices with grated coconut and 1/4 cup water into a coarse paste using a food processor or blender.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry sliced onions until golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add meat cubes and cook on medium-high heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the ground spice paste and fry for 3 minutes, stirring continuously.
Pour in coconut milk and add salt and curry leaves, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 35-40 minutes until meat is tender.
Adjust salt and serve hot with rice or flatbread.
cheapTips: Buy meat from ethnic markets where goat/lamb is cheaper
Substitute with chicken thighs to significantly reduce cost

recipes.name: Sukhe Kaju Ki Sabzi
recipes.description: Rajasthani lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast raw cashews in a dry pan over medium heat for 3-4 minutes until lightly golden, then set aside.
Heat oil in a large pan and add cumin seeds, letting them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add minced onions and sauté until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and chopped green chilies, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add turmeric powder and red chili powder, mix well for 30 seconds.
Add roasted cashews to the pan and toss to coat evenly.
Cook on medium-low heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent burning.
Season with salt to taste and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Buy cashews in bulk from warehouse stores
Use frozen ginger-garlic paste to save prep time

recipes.name: Rajasthani Kadhi
recipes.description: Rajasthani lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk yogurt with gram flour in a bowl until smooth, then add 4 cups water and whisk again to remove lumps.
Heat oil in a large pan and add mustard seeds, letting them pop for about 1 minute.
Add fenugreek seeds and dried red chilies, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add minced onion and ginger to the pan, sauté for 3-4 minutes until onions soften.
Slowly pour the yogurt-gram flour mixture into the pan while stirring continuously to prevent lumping.
Add turmeric powder and salt, stir well.
Bring the kadhi to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
The kadhi should thicken slightly and turn a pale yellow color; serve hot garnished with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Make your own gram flour from split chickpeas if buying in bulk
Use store-brand yogurt instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Ghugni
recipes.description: Rajasthani snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If using dried peas, soak overnight and boil until tender, then drain; or use canned white peas drained and rinsed.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds, letting them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add diced onion and cook for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Add diced tomato and minced green chili, cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in turmeric powder and red chili powder, mix well.
Add cooked peas and stir gently to combine all ingredients.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Add lemon juice and salt to taste, garnish with fresh cilantro and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy dried peas in bulk and cook in batches
Use canned peas for convenience and consistent results

recipes.name: Maas Pedha
recipes.description: Rajasthani dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice 2 onions thinly and fry in oil until deep golden brown, then remove and set aside for garnish.
In the same oil, add cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, and bay leaf, letting them infuse for 1 minute.
Add diced remaining onion and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add meat pieces and cook on high heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently to seal the meat.
Add yogurt in batches while stirring, then add turmeric, red chili powder, and coriander powder.
Add water and salt, bring to boil, then cover and reduce heat to low, simmering for 45-50 minutes until meat is tender.
Remove lid, let liquid reduce by half for 10-15 minutes, then garnish with reserved fried onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy meat when on sale and freeze for later use
Use beef as a cheaper substitute for lamb

recipes.name: Jodhpuri Maas
recipes.description: Rajasthani dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and toast whole dried red chilies, cinnamon, cloves, and cardamom for 2 minutes; remove and coarsely grind.
In same oil, fry thinly sliced onions until deeply golden and crispy, remove and reserve half for garnish.
Add meat to remaining oil and onions, cook on high heat for 8 minutes, stirring to seal the meat.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2-3 minutes, then add chopped tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in ground spice mixture, coriander powder, and turmeric powder, cooking for 1 minute.
Add yogurt gradually while stirring constantly to prevent curdling.
Add water and salt, bring to boil, then cover, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer for 50-60 minutes until meat is very tender.
Remove lid and cook for 10 minutes to reduce liquid and concentrate flavors, then garnish with reserved fried onions and serve.
cheapTips: Toast whole spices yourself instead of buying pre-ground
Make this dish in larger batches and freeze portions

recipes.name: Alu Tikki
recipes.description: Rajasthani snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes until fully cooked, then peel and mash them in a bowl.
Add finely diced onion, chopped green chilies, minced ginger, fresh cilantro, cumin powder, and salt to the mashed potatoes.
Mix everything thoroughly and divide into 9-10 portions, rolling each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a round patty about 0.5 inch thick.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat until hot and shimmering.
Place tikkis in the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes until the bottom is golden and crispy.
Carefully flip and fry the other side for another 3-4 minutes until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with yogurt and chutney.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk bags
Pan-fry instead of deep-fry to use less oil

recipes.name: Bajra Khichdi
recipes.description: Rajasthani lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse bajra and moong dal separately under cold water until water runs clear.
Dice potato and carrot into small 0.5-inch pieces.
Heat oil in a large pot and add cumin seeds, letting them crackle for 30 seconds.
Add minced ginger and chopped green chili, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add bajra and moong dal to the pot, stir and cook for 2 minutes.
Add diced potato, carrot, peas, turmeric powder, and salt, then stir well.
Pour in 4 cups water, bring to boil, then cover and reduce heat to medium-low, cooking for 20-25 minutes until bajra and dal are tender.
Stir occasionally and add more water if needed; the khichdi should be thick and creamy when done.
cheapTips: Buy bajra and moong dal in bulk from Indian markets
Use frozen vegetables to reduce prep time

recipes.name: Crossing the Bridge Noodles
recipes.description: Yunnan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a rolling boil in a large pot, keeping it at a vigorous boil throughout the meal.
Arrange sliced chicken, shrimp, fish, mushrooms, bok choy, ginger, and sliced green onions on separate plates.
Cook rice noodles in boiling water according to package directions, then drain and divide between two serving bowls.
Pour the boiling hot broth into each bowl, creating a deep pool of liquid.
Quickly add the sliced chicken to the hot broth first, stirring to separate pieces; let cook for 2 minutes.
Add shrimp and fish slices, cooking for 1-2 minutes until they turn opaque.
Add mushrooms and bok choy, cooking for 1-2 minutes until tender.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil, garnish with green onion slices, and serve immediately while steaming hot.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp and fish instead of fresh to save money
Replace some seafood with more mushrooms to reduce cost

recipes.name: Steam Pot Chicken
recipes.description: Yunnan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces, then blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes to remove impurities, drain and set aside.
Cut ham into thin slices, cut carrots and potatoes into bite-sized chunks, and slice mushrooms.
In a special Yunnan steam pot or covered clay pot, layer chicken pieces, ham, ginger slices, and vegetables.
Add 4 cups water, soy sauce, and rice wine to the pot.
Cover tightly and place the pot in a larger pot of boiling water (water bath) reaching halfway up the sides.
Steam for 35-40 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Carefully remove from heat and open the lid to release steam.
Season with salt and sesame oil, garnish with green onion slices, and serve directly from the pot.
cheapTips: Use chicken drumsticks instead of thighs for better value
Omit ham and add more mushrooms to reduce costs

recipes.name: Yunnan Rice Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Yunnan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot with sliced ginger, then add thinly sliced meat and let simmer for 5-7 minutes until cooked through.
