Blend red chilies, garlic, and shallots with 2 tablespoons water into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pan and fry the chili paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the parboiled liver and gizzards to the pan and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk, lime juice, salt, and palm sugar, then simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and lime juice as needed, then serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken liver and gizzards fresh from the butcher counter—often cheaper than packaged
Use regular sugar instead of palm sugar if unavailable

recipes.name: Sambal Goreng Kentang
recipes.description: Padang lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes, then deep fry in oil until golden and set aside.
Blend red chilies, garlic, and shallots with 2 tablespoons water into a paste.
Heat 2 tablespoons fresh oil in a wok and fry the chili paste for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add fried potatoes to the chili paste and toss to coat for 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk, lime juice, salt, and palm sugar, then simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir occasionally until sauce thickens and clings to potatoes, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Use regular potatoes instead of waxy varieties—cheaper and works just as well
Substitute coconut milk with canned budget brand or diluted coconut cream

recipes.name: Sambal Goreng Jantung
recipes.description: Padang lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean chicken hearts by removing fat and blood vessels, then cut in half lengthwise.
Boil hearts in water with salt for 15 minutes until partially cooked, then drain.
Blend red chilies, garlic, and shallots with 2 tablespoons water into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a pan and fry the chili paste for 2 minutes until fragrant, then add turmeric.
Add boiled chicken hearts and stir-fry for 5 minutes to coat evenly.
Pour in coconut milk, lime juice, salt, and palm sugar, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot when hearts are tender and sauce is thick.
cheapTips: Ask the butcher for fresh chicken hearts—usually inexpensive and high in protein
Buy chili peppers in bulk during summer and freeze for year-round use

recipes.name: Lumpia Padang
recipes.description: Padang snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince garlic and shallots, then heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it apart with a spoon for 5 minutes.
Add diced carrots and chopped cabbage, then stir-fry for 5 minutes until vegetables soften.
Season with soy sauce and salt, then cook for 2 more minutes and let cool slightly.
Place 2 tablespoons of filling on each lumpia wrapper, roll tightly, and seal the edge with water-moistened fingertips.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan and fry lumpia in batches for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with sweet chili sauce.
cheapTips: Substitute ground pork with ground chicken or skip meat for vegetarian version
Use store-brand lumpia wrappers instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Martabak Padang
recipes.description: Padang snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and water in a bowl to form a sticky dough, then let rest for 20 minutes.
Mince garlic and onion, then brown ground beef with garlic and onion for 6 minutes in a pan.
Season beef filling with white pepper and salt, then cool to room temperature.
Divide dough into 2 portions and stretch one portion on a flat surface until very thin and large.
Spread half the filling on one half of the dough and fold the other half over it, then seal edges.
Heat a nonstick skillet with oil over medium heat and cook the martabak for 4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Place an egg on top of the cooked martabak, fold it in half, then cook briefly until the egg is set.
Cut into squares and serve hot with sweet soy sauce.
cheapTips: Make dough from scratch—buying pre-made martabak dough is expensive
Use ground beef from budget packages or mixes with leaner cuts

recipes.name: Gado-Gado Padang
recipes.description: Padang lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes and carrots separately until tender, about 12 minutes each, then cut into pieces.
Blanch cabbage and bean sprouts in boiling water for 2 minutes each, then drain well.
Cut tofu into cubes and shallow-fry in oil until golden on all sides, then drain.
Blend red chilies and garlic with 3 tablespoons water into a paste.
Mix peanut butter, chili-garlic paste, lime juice, coconut milk, and salt in a bowl to make sauce.
Arrange blanched vegetables, potatoes, carrots, and fried tofu on a plate.
Pour warm peanut sauce over the vegetables and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy seasonal vegetables at farmers markets for cheaper fresh produce
Use store-brand peanut butter instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Pariaman Gulai
recipes.description: Padang lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into 1.5-inch chunks and set aside.
Blend onions, garlic, red chilies, and ginger with 3 tablespoons water into a paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the spice paste for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add turmeric powder and stir for 30 seconds, then add beef chunks and cook for 8 minutes until browned.
Pour in coconut milk and beef broth, then bring to a boil and reduce heat to low.
Simmer covered for 35 minutes until beef is very tender, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and lime juice, then serve hot over rice.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze in portions for later use
Make your own broth from beef bones if available at the butcher

recipes.name: Ayam Pop
recipes.description: Padang lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend garlic, shallots, red chilies, and ginger with 3 tablespoons water into a paste.
Pat dry chicken pieces with paper towels to help them brown better.
Heat oil in a large pan and brown chicken pieces for 5 minutes on each side, then set aside.
In the same pan, fry the spice paste for 2 minutes until fragrant and darkened.
Return chicken to the pan and add turmeric, salt, palm sugar, and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until chicken is tender and sauce reduces.
Continue cooking until liquid is mostly absorbed and chicken is caramelized and browned, about 10 more minutes.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs and drumsticks on sale—darker meat is cheaper and more flavorful
Use regular sugar if palm sugar is unavailable

recipes.name: Balado Terung
recipes.description: Padang lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut eggplants lengthwise into halves, then cut each half into 2-inch pieces.
Deep fry eggplant pieces in batches in oil at 350°F for 4 minutes until tender and lightly golden, then drain.
Blend red chilies, garlic, and shallots with 2 tablespoons water into a smooth paste.
Heat 2 tablespoons fresh oil in a wok and fry the chili paste for 1.5 minutes until fragrant.
Add fried eggplant to the chili paste and toss gently for 2 minutes to coat.
Add salt, palm sugar, lime juice, and water, then simmer for 5 minutes until sauce thickens.
Serve hot as a side dish with rice and other dishes.
cheapTips: Buy eggplants when in season for the cheapest prices
Reuse oil from frying if strained well to save money

recipes.name: Balado Layur
recipes.description: Padang lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Scale, gut, and clean the fish, then cut into 2-inch thick steaks across the body.
Blend red chilies, garlic, shallots, and ginger with 2 tablespoons water into a paste.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry fish steaks for 3 minutes per side until golden, then set aside.
In the same skillet, fry the chili paste for 2 minutes until fragrant and darkened.
Return fish steaks to the pan and add salt, lime juice, and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 8 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Serve hot with steamed rice, spooning the spicy sauce over the fish.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish from the fish counter and ask them to cut it into steaks—cheaper than pre-cut
Use frozen mackerel if fresh is unavailable or expensive

recipes.name: Rendang Paru
recipes.description: Padang lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the beef lung thoroughly under running water and cut into 1-inch cubes.
Blend shallots, garlic, red chilies, ginger, and turmeric with 1/4 cup water into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the paste for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add beef lung pieces and stir-fry for 5 minutes until browned on all sides.
Pour in coconut milk and water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes.
Continue cooking uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the sauce reduces and coats the meat.
Season with salt to taste and cook for another 10 minutes until the rendang is dark and oily.
Transfer to a serving plate and serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Beef lung is very affordable compared to other cuts; buy from Asian or halal butchers
Make a double batch and freeze portions for future meals

recipes.name: Karambia Belado
recipes.description: Padang lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Carefully open the young coconut and scoop out the tender white flesh into bite-sized pieces, reserving the coconut water.
Blend red chilies, shallots, garlic, and ginger into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a wok or large pan and fry the spice paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the coconut flesh and stir well, cooking for 3 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and 1/2 cup reserved coconut water, add lemongrass and salt.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce reduces slightly.
Remove lemongrass and taste for seasoning, adjusting salt as needed.
Serve hot as a side dish with rice or other Padang dishes.
cheapTips: Buy young coconuts at Asian markets for half the price of regular supermarkets
Use frozen young coconut meat if fresh is unavailable

recipes.name: Soto Padang
recipes.description: Padang lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté minced garlic and ginger for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced onion and cook for 2 minutes, then stir in turmeric powder and mix well.
Add beef cubes and brown them on all sides for 5 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and continue simmering for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle soup into bowls and top with fresh cilantro and crispy fried shallots.
Serve hot with lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck instead of brisket for even lower cost with similar results
Make fried shallots at home by thinly slicing and frying in oil until golden

recipes.name: Bánh Khoái
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour, turmeric, salt, coconut milk, and water in a bowl until a thin batter forms.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Pour a thin layer of batter into the skillet and tilt to create a small crepe about 4-5 inches.
Quickly add a few shrimp and pork slices onto half the crepe, sprinkle cooked mung beans, then fold.
Cook until the edges are crispy and golden, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer to a serving plate and repeat with remaining batter and fillings.
Serve hot with fresh lettuce, herbs, and dipping sauce made from fish sauce, water, sugar, and lime.
cheapTips: Use shrimp paste instead of whole shrimp to stretch the protein further
Buy mung beans dried and cook in bulk for multiple dishes

recipes.name: Bánh Nước Lèo
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour with 2 cups water to create a smooth batter, then strain through a fine sieve.
Pour batter into a greased 9-inch round pan and steam for 15-20 minutes until cooked through.
Cool slightly, then cut into bite-sized squares.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté garlic for 1 minute, then add ground pork and shrimp, breaking apart the meat.
Cook for 5 minutes until the pork is no longer pink, then stir in fish sauce and coconut milk.
Simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Place bánh nước pieces in bowls and ladle the pork-shrimp sauce over them.
Garnish with scallions and fried shallots, then serve hot.
cheapTips: Use a simple steamer setup with a covered pot and water instead of buying a steamer
Buy shrimp and pork on sale and freeze for breakfast meal prep

recipes.name: Bánh Bèo
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rice flour, water, and salt in a bowl to create a thin, smooth batter.
Pour batter into small shallow bowls or round molds (about 3 inches wide) to half-full.
Steam the bánh bèo for 10-12 minutes until the cake is set and pale.
Meanwhile, rehydrate dried shrimp in warm water for 5 minutes, then finely chop.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté ground pork until cooked through, about 4 minutes.
Add chopped shrimp, fish sauce, and scallions, then cook for 1 more minute.
Top each bánh bèo cake with a spoonful of the pork-shrimp mixture and fried shallots.
Serve immediately while warm with fresh herbs and pickled vegetables on the side.
cheapTips: Dried shrimp is very affordable and lasts months in the pantry
Use silicone muffin cups or ramekins instead of buying special bánh bèo molds

recipes.name: Bánh Cuốn Hue
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine rice flour, water, and salt to create a thin, smooth batter.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat and sauté diced onion for 2 minutes.
Add ground pork and cook until no longer pink, breaking it into small pieces.
Stir in chopped mushrooms, fish sauce, and black pepper, cooking for 3 more minutes, then set aside.
Lightly oil a non-stick skillet and heat over medium-high heat.
Pour a thin layer of batter into the skillet, tilting to spread evenly, and cook for 1-2 minutes until set.
Spoon a line of filling down the center of the crepe, then roll tightly and transfer to a plate.
Repeat with remaining batter and filling, then serve hot with dipping sauce made from fish sauce, lime, and water.
cheapTips: Use button mushrooms instead of specialty varieties to cut costs
Prepare filling the night before and store in the refrigerator

recipes.name: Cơm Hến
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté minced garlic and diced onion for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add diced pork belly and cook until slightly browned, about 4 minutes.
Add clams and water, cover the pot, and cook for 8-10 minutes until clams open, discarding any that don't.
Remove clams and set aside, then stir fish sauce into the broth.
Divide cooked rice among bowls and ladle the clam broth over it.
Top with the cooked clams, pour the remaining sauce over the rice.
Garnish generously with scallions and fresh dill.
Serve hot with lime wedges and additional fish sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy clams at farmers markets or Asian markets for better prices than supermarkets
Use canned clams in a pinch, though fresh is preferred for authentic flavor

recipes.name: Bún Chả Cá Hue
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound shallots and garlic together with turmeric powder and salt to create a paste.
Cut fish into chunks and coat thoroughly with the spice paste, then let sit for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a pot over medium-high heat and carefully add coated fish pieces.
Pour water into the pot around the fish and bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook rice vermicelli according to package directions, then drain and divide into bowls.
Season the broth with fish sauce and taste for seasoning, adjusting as needed.
Ladle the fish and flavorful broth over the vermicelli in each bowl.
Top with chopped scallions and fresh dill, then serve with lime wedges and herbs.
cheapTips: Use tilapia or catfish instead of premium fish varieties for savings
Buy dried rice vermicelli in bulk from Asian markets

recipes.name: Bún Bò Hue
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch beef shank and pork bone in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Blend shallots, garlic, red chilies, and lemongrass into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry the spice paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add blanched meat and bones, then pour in 8 cups fresh water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 60 minutes until the meat is tender and broth is flavorful.
Strain broth and return to pot, then season with fish sauce and salt to taste.
Cook rice vermicelli according to package directions, then divide into serving bowls.
Shred the tender beef and pork, then ladle hot broth over vermicelli and top with shredded meat.
Garnish with fresh herbs, sliced red chilies, and crispy fried shallots, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy beef shank from the butcher counter; it's much cheaper than premade portions
Ask for pork neck bones or leg bones with attached meat for excellent broth flavor at low cost

recipes.name: Bún Riêu Cua Cà Chua
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add shrimp paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in broth and bring to a boil, then add tomatoes and crab meat.
Simmer for 15 minutes to develop flavors.
In a small bowl, beat eggs with 2 tbsp water, then slowly drizzle into the pot while stirring to create egg ribbons.
Season with fish sauce, salt, and pepper.
Cook rice noodles separately according to package directions, then drain.
Divide noodles among bowls and ladle the hot crab tomato soup over them.
cheapTips: Use canned crab meat instead of fresh to save $3-4 per serving
Regular tomatoes work fine; no need for premium varieties

recipes.name: Canh Chua Cá
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and sauté garlic and shallots until golden.
Add tamarind paste dissolved in 1/4 cup water and stir well.
Pour in broth and bring to a boil, then add fish fillets and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add pineapple, okra, and tomatoes, then simmer for 10 minutes until okra is tender.
Season with fish sauce, salt, and a pinch of sugar to balance flavors.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed before serving in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish and filet it yourself to save 40% vs pre-cut fillets
Use frozen okra and pineapple when fresh is expensive

recipes.name: Mắm Tôm
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a small bowl, combine shrimp paste with water to loosen the consistency.
Add minced garlic and chili, then stir well.
Pour in lime juice and add sugar, mixing thoroughly.
Taste and adjust salt, lime, and sugar to achieve a balance of salty, sour, and slightly sweet.
cheapTips: Buy shrimp paste at Asian markets for half the price of Western supermarkets
This condiment lasts 2+ months refrigerated, making it cost-effective

recipes.name: Chả Cua
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, combine crab meat, ground pork, breadcrumbs, eggs, fish sauce, garlic, onion, salt, and pepper.
Mix thoroughly with your hands until the mixture is well combined and sticky.
Shape mixture into 12-16 oval patties or logs.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry patties 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil before serving.
cheapTips: Use canned crab meat instead of fresh to reduce costs significantly
Make a double batch and freeze extras for quick meals later

recipes.name: Giò Lụa
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork, pork fat, fish sauce, garlic, sugar, salt, and pepper in a bowl until well combined and sticky.
Lay cheesecloth flat and spread pork mixture evenly into a log shape about 2 inches in diameter.
Roll tightly using the cheesecloth and twist the ends to compress the log.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot and carefully place the wrapped log inside.
Simmer for 45-50 minutes, keeping the water at a gentle boil.
Remove log and let cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours before unwrapping.
Slice into 1/4-inch thick pieces and serve cold or at room temperature with pickled vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder and ask the butcher to grind it fresh for better quality
Make a large batch and freeze individual slices for up to 3 months

recipes.name: Nem Lụi Hue
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork, garlic, shallots, lemongrass, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper in a bowl until sticky.
Divide mixture into 8 equal portions and mold each onto a bamboo skewer, pressing firmly.
Let skewers rest for 10 minutes to help the meat set.
Heat grill or grill pan over medium-high heat until hot.
Brush meat with oil and grill for 8-10 minutes, rotating frequently for even browning.
Serve hot with cucumber, fresh herbs, lettuce, and dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Use regular ground pork instead of premium cuts for 30% savings
Grill over charcoal instead of using a grill pan to enhance smoky flavor

recipes.name: Chả Lụa
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground pork, pork fat, fish sauce, garlic, sugar, salt, and pepper; mix until the texture is very sticky and paste-like.
Lay plastic wrap and spread the mixture into a tight, compact log approximately 2.5 inches in diameter.
Roll tightly using plastic wrap, twisting ends firmly to compress the mixture.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot and carefully lower the wrapped log inside.
Maintain a gentle boil and cook for 55-60 minutes; the log should feel firm when done.
Remove and let cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
Unwrap and slice thinly; serve cold with pickled daikon and carrot, or with rice and soy sauce.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder and trim fat yourself to save $1.50 per serving
This loaf keeps refrigerated for 5-7 days and freezes well for 2 months

recipes.name: Thịt Nướng Lá Chuối
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine garlic, lemongrass, fish sauce, sugar, oil, salt, and pepper in a bowl to make a marinade.
Toss pork slices in the marinade and let sit for 15 minutes.
Blanch banana leaves briefly in hot water to soften them.
Layer a spoonful of marinated pork on each banana leaf, then fold to create a secure package.
Grill packages over medium-high heat for 10-12 minutes per side until the pork is cooked through.
Carefully open packages at the table, as steam will be hot, and serve with rice and fresh herbs.
cheapTips: Use pork neck or shoulder instead of premium cuts for 35% savings
Buy banana leaves frozen at Asian markets for year-round availability

recipes.name: Bánh Tráng Nướng
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix minced garlic, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Brush both sides of each rice paper with the oil and sauce mixture.
Sprinkle sesame seeds evenly on one side of each sheet.
Heat a grill or grill pan over medium heat until hot.
Grill rice papers for 2-3 minutes per side until they become crispy and lightly charred.
Cut into triangles or bite-sized pieces and serve hot or at room temperature with dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy rice paper in bulk from Asian markets to reduce cost to $0.15 per sheet
Make a large batch and store in an airtight container for 3-4 days

recipes.name: Bánh Hỏi
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it into small pieces.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes until they begin to turn pink.
Pour in chicken broth, fish sauce, sugar, and black pepper; bring to a simmer.
Thaw bánh hỏi noodles if frozen and gently separate them.
Add noodles to the pan and stir gently to combine with the broth and toppings.
Cook for 3-4 minutes until noodles are heated through.
Garnish with scallions and serve hot in shallow bowls with broth.
cheapTips: Buy frozen bánh hỏi noodles at Asian markets instead of fresh for 50% savings
Use shrimp paste instead of fresh shrimp to reduce costs significantly

recipes.name: Humba
recipes.description: Visayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into 2-inch cubes and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork on all sides for 8 minutes total.
Add minced garlic and sliced onions, stirring for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in soy sauce, vinegar, and water, then add bay leaves and peppercorns.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 60 minutes until pork is tender.
Stir in brown sugar and simmer uncovered for 10 more minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning with soy sauce or vinegar as needed.
Serve hot over steamed white rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze; it's often cheaper than other cuts.
Use basic soy sauce and vinegar instead of premium brands—taste is identical in this dish.

recipes.name: Lumpiang Shanghai
recipes.description: Visayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add ground pork and cook for 5 minutes, breaking it apart until no pink remains.
Stir in diced carrots and shredded cabbage, cooking for 4 minutes until vegetables soften slightly.
Add soy sauce, salt, and pepper, then remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes.
Place 2 tablespoons filling in the center of each wrapper, fold corners in, roll tightly, and seal the edge with a bit of water.
Heat 3 cups oil in a deep pot or wok to 350°F and fry lumpia 2-3 at a time for 3 minutes per batch until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with sweet and sour sauce or vinegar for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions for future batches.
Make filling in bulk and freeze; you can fry fresh when needed.

recipes.name: Okoy
recipes.description: Visayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, water, minced garlic, salt, and pepper until you have a smooth batter.
Stir in shrimp and chopped green onions, mixing until evenly distributed.
Heat oil in a large skillet to 350°F over medium-high heat.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the hot oil, flattening gently with the back of the spoon to form thin patties.
Fry for 2 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with vinegar for dipping.
cheapTips: Use frozen small shrimp; they're cheaper than fresh and work perfectly.
Buy all-purpose flour in bulk for lower per-unit cost.

recipes.name: Suman
recipes.description: Visayan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix sweet rice flour, brown sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
Gradually pour in coconut milk while stirring until the mixture forms a smooth, thick paste.
Cut banana leaves into 6x8 inch rectangles and gently heat them over a flame to make them pliable.
Place 3 tablespoons of batter in the center of each banana leaf piece.
Fold the leaf sides over the filling and roll tightly to create a cylinder.
Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a large pot and carefully place wrapped suman seam-side down.
Boil for 20 minutes until the parcels float and are firm when pressed.
Remove with a slotted spoon and let cool slightly before serving.
cheapTips: Buy sweet rice flour from Asian markets; it's much cheaper than regular grocery stores.
Collect and freeze banana leaves from Asian supermarkets; they're often free or very cheap.

recipes.name: Tinubig
recipes.description: Visayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim excess fat from pork ribs and cut into individual pieces.
Bring 6 cups salted water to a boil in a large pot and add pork ribs.
Simmer for 20 minutes, skimming off any scum that rises to the surface.
Add quartered onions, minced garlic, and cubed radish to the pot.
Continue simmering for 15 minutes until radish is tender and pork is cooked through.
Season with patis, salt, and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in bowls with the broth.
cheapTips: Buy pork ribs when on sale; they're inexpensive and freeze well for months.
Use regular daikon radish if labanos isn't available—identical flavor at lower cost.

recipes.name: Inubaran
recipes.description: Visayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork into 1.5-inch cubes and pat dry.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown pork on all sides for 6 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in sliced onions and cook for 2 minutes until slightly softened.
Pour in vinegar, soy sauce, and coconut milk, then add bay leaves.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and cook covered for 40 minutes until pork is very tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over steamed white rice.
cheapTips: Substitute evaporated milk mixed with a bit of oil if canned coconut milk is unavailable.
Buy pork shoulder in bulk when it's on sale and freeze in meal-sized portions.

recipes.name: Sardines Guisado
recipes.description: Visayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat the oil from the sardine cans in a large pan over medium heat.
Sauté minced garlic and sliced onions for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add water and vinegar.
Add the sardines carefully, keeping them whole as much as possible.
Drop in the bay leaf and simmer gently for 8 minutes without stirring much.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over steamed white rice or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand canned sardines; they're much cheaper than name brands and taste the same.
Use tomato paste from a tube instead of a can to reduce waste and cost.

recipes.name: Tuslob Buwa
recipes.description: Visayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine liver spread, condensed milk, mayonnaise, and calamansi juice in a bowl and whisk until smooth.
Stir in minced garlic and patis.
Pour the mixture into a shallow serving dish.
Arrange chicharon pieces around the dish or serve on the side.
Use chicharon or crackers to scoop and dip into the liver spread mixture.
Serve immediately while the dip is fresh.
cheapTips: Buy chicharon from local Filipino markets or online; it's cheaper in bulk.
Use regular lemon juice if calamansi isn't available.

recipes.name: Lininutad
recipes.description: Visayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork into 1-inch cubes and heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork for 5 minutes, then add minced garlic and sliced onions, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in water and patis, then simmer covered for 30 minutes until pork is almost tender.
Slice bitter melon lengthwise, remove the center pith, and cut into half-moons; do the same with eggplant.
Add bitter melon and eggplant to the pot and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes until vegetables are just tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with steamed white rice.
cheapTips: Buy bitter melon and eggplant when in season for significant savings.
Trim pork shoulder of excess fat yourself rather than buying pre-cut pieces.

recipes.name: Pane Carasau
recipes.description: Sardinian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix all-purpose flour and salt in a large bowl, create a well in the center, and pour in warm water and 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic, adding water by the teaspoon if too dry.
Let dough rest covered for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Divide dough into 4 equal balls and roll each extremely thin on a semolina-dusted surface until nearly transparent.
Preheat oven to 425°F and place rolled dough on baking sheets.
Brush lightly with olive oil and bake for 5-8 minutes until crispy and very pale golden (do not brown).
Remove from oven and cool completely—the bread will crisp further as it cools.
Break into pieces and serve with cheese, toppings, or as a standalone snack.
cheapTips: Buy flour and olive oil in bulk at wholesale stores for significant savings.
Make large batches and store in airtight containers for weeks.

recipes.name: Bánh Chưng Hue
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak glutinous rice and mung beans separately in water for 2 hours, then drain well.
Cut pork belly into thick strips and cook in boiling salted water for 30 minutes until partially cooked, then drain and season with fish sauce and pepper.
Mix cooked rice and mung beans together with 1 tbsp fish sauce and salt.
Blanch banana leaves over a flame to soften them, then overlap two pieces to form a large square.
Layer the rice mixture, pork, and halved duck egg in the center of the banana leaf square.
Fold the banana leaves to create a neat square package and tie with string to seal.
Boil packages in water for 2 hours, keeping them submerged with a plate on top.
Cool for 30 minutes, then unwrap and slice into portions to serve.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly on sale and freeze it for later use
Source banana leaves from Asian markets instead of specialty stores for better prices

recipes.name: Cơm Rượu
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rehydrate dried mushrooms in warm water for 15 minutes, then slice them and slice the Chinese sausage.
Heat sesame oil in a pot over medium heat and sauté the mushrooms and sausage for 3 minutes.
Add the cooked rice and stir-fry for 2 minutes to break up clumps.
Pour in the cooking wine and chicken broth, stirring continuously for 1 minute.
Simmer over low heat for 5 minutes until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Season with salt, garnish with sliced green onion, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use leftover rice from dinner to save time and energy costs
Buy Chinese sausage at Asian markets where it's cheaper than specialty shops

recipes.name: Chè Ba Màu
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make the yellow layer: Mix mung bean powder with ½ cup water and ¼ cup sugar, then cook over medium heat while stirring for 5 minutes until thickened, then pour into a greased pan and cool.
Make the green layer: Combine pandan extract with ½ cup water and ¼ cup sugar, dissolve agar-agar in this mixture, then pour into another greased pan and cool.
Make the coconut layer: Heat coconut milk with 2 tbsp sugar and salt just until warm, do not boil.
Cut the cooled yellow and green layers into small cubes.
Fill each glass halfway with shaved ice.
Add a spoonful each of yellow and green cubes on top of the ice.
Pour the warm coconut milk mixture over the cubes until the glass is full.
cheapTips: Make agar-agar layers in bulk and freeze for quick assembly later
Buy coconut milk in bulk at warehouse stores for significant savings

recipes.name: Bún Thang Hue
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil the whole chicken in 6 cups water with turmeric and salt for 35 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken, let cool slightly, then shred meat and discard bones.
Strain broth into a pot and return to heat, then rehydrate dried shrimp in warm water and add to broth.
Simmer broth for 10 minutes, then season with fish sauce and adjust salt.
Cook rice noodles according to package directions, then drain and divide among bowls.
Ladle hot broth over noodles in each bowl.
Top each bowl with shredded chicken, fried shallots, sliced green onion, and fresh herbs.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens on sale instead of breasts for better value
Make fried shallots at home by frying sliced shallots in oil instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Bánh Lọc
recipes.description: Hue Vietnamese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour boiling water into tapioca starch slowly while mixing with a chopstick until a hot dough forms, then knead for 2 minutes until smooth.
Dice pork belly finely and devein shrimp, then chop shrimp roughly and mix with pork, green onion, fish sauce, salt, and sugar.
Dampen your hands and take 1 tbsp of tapioca dough, flatten it in your palm, and place 1 tsp filling in the center.
Fold the dough over to create a half-moon shape and seal the edges firmly by pinching.
Line a bamboo steamer with parchment paper and arrange dumplings without touching.
Steam over boiling water for 12 minutes until the dumplings become translucent.
Serve hot with a simple dipping sauce of fish sauce mixed with water, sugar, and lime juice.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly and shrimp when on sale and freeze for later use
Make dumplings in large batches and freeze uncooked for quick meals throughout the week

recipes.name: Lechon Cebu
recipes.description: Visayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean and gut the suckling pig thoroughly, then pat dry inside and out with paper towels.
Combine salt, pepper, minced garlic, bay leaves, thyme, and onion pieces, then stuff the cavity generously with this mixture.
Tie the legs with kitchen twine and secure the mouth with a bamboo stick to maintain shape during roasting.
Set up a charcoal grill or rotisserie and place pig on a spit, securing it tightly.
Roast over medium-hot coals for 3-4 hours, turning occasionally and basting with pan drippings every 30 minutes.
The skin should become golden brown and crackling crisp while the meat reaches 160°F internal temperature.
Rest for 15 minutes, then quarter the pig and serve with liver sauce made from pureed liver, vinegar, and broth.
cheapTips: Order suckling pigs directly from local farms or Asian butchers weeks in advance for better pricing
Split the cost and pig with friends or family to make it more affordable per serving

recipes.name: Sinuglaw
recipes.description: Visayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut fish fillets into bite-sized pieces and devein the shrimp.
In a large bowl, combine fish, shrimp, and lime juice, then let sit for 10 minutes until the seafood is partially cured by the acid.
Heat coconut milk in a pot over medium heat and add minced garlic and ginger, stirring for 1 minute.
Add the lime-cured fish and shrimp with their liquid to the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add sliced red onion and chopped chili pepper, then simmer for another 3 minutes until shrimp is cooked through.
Season with salt and taste for balance between lime and coconut.
Serve hot or at room temperature, garnished with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Use cheaper white fish like tilapia or catfish instead of pricier options
Buy seafood from Asian markets where prices are often lower than supermarkets

recipes.name: Inasal na Manok
recipes.description: Visayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine calamansi juice, minced garlic, ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, and brown sugar in a bowl to make the marinade.
Place chicken pieces in a container and pour marinade over them, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Heat annatto oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Remove chicken from marinade (reserving liquid) and place in the hot oil, cooking for 5 minutes per side until golden brown.
Pour the reserved marinade into the skillet and bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce reduces and thickens slightly.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve with rice and charred calamansi or lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs and drumsticks which are cheaper than breast meat and stay juicier
Make annatto oil at home by steeping annatto seeds in neutral oil instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Puso ng Saging
recipes.description: Visayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel away the tough purple outer layers of banana blossoms and remove the small florets from the tender pale inner core, then soak in salt water for 10 minutes.
Drain and cut the banana blossom florets into bite-sized pieces, discarding the tough stem parts.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté garlic, ginger, and sliced onion for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add ground pork and cook for 5 minutes, breaking it apart with a spoon until no longer pink.
Add prepared banana blossom pieces and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then add shrimp and cook until pink.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer, then season with fish sauce, salt, and black pepper.
Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the banana blossom is tender and flavors meld.
cheapTips: Buy banana blossoms from Asian markets in season when prices are lowest
Buy coconut milk in bulk cans to reduce per-unit cost

recipes.name: Ginutò
recipes.description: Visayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork ribs into individual pieces and blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes to remove impurities, then drain and rinse.
Heat oil in a large pot and fry sliced ginger and minced garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant and slightly golden.
Add turmeric powder and stir for 30 seconds, then add the blanched ribs and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in 4 cups of fresh water and bring to a boil, then skim off any remaining foam.
Add rock sugar, fish sauce, and peppercorns, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes.
Continue simmering until pork is tender and the broth has reduced to a rich amber color with concentrated flavor.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot with rice, ladle the flavorful broth over each portion.
cheapTips: Buy pork ribs on sale and freeze for later use to get better pricing
Make large batches and freeze portions for quick reheating on busy weekdays

recipes.name: Panada
recipes.description: Sardinian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the day-old bread into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté finely diced onion until softened.
Add ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it into small pieces.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a simmer.
Add bread cubes and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until bread breaks down and soup thickens.
Beat the egg in a small bowl and slowly stir into the pot while simmering.
Stir in grated Pecorino Romano and season with salt and pepper to taste.
cheapTips: Use day-old bread from a bakery discount bin
Buy ground pork on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Cassola
recipes.description: Sardinian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut squid into rings and pat all seafood dry with paper towels.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant.
Add squid and cook for 5 minutes until it begins to soften.
Pour in white wine and simmer for 3 minutes to reduce slightly.
Add canned tomatoes with their juice and saffron, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Add fish fillets and shrimp, nestle them into the sauce, and simmer for 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
Season with sea salt and taste for seasoning.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve in bowls with crusty bread for soaking up the sauce.
cheapTips: Buy squid and shrimp from Asian markets for lower prices
Use whatever white fish is on sale that day

recipes.name: Anguilla alla Vernaccia
recipes.description: Sardinian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean and skin the eel carefully, then cut into 2-inch pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large heavy pan and sauté sliced onion and smashed garlic until golden.
Add eel pieces and cook for 5 minutes, turning occasionally.
Pour in Vernaccia wine and simmer for 5 minutes to reduce slightly.
Add canned tomatoes with their juice, bay leaf, and rosemary sprig.
Cover and simmer gently for 40-45 minutes until eel is very tender.
Remove bay leaf and rosemary sprig.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot with the sauce spooned over the eel.
cheapTips: Ask the fishmonger to clean the eel for you (saves time)
Substitute catfish if eel is unavailable or expensive

recipes.name: Arrosto di Capra
recipes.description: Sardinian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season the goat meat generously with salt and pepper on all sides.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the meat on all sides, about 10 minutes total.
Remove meat and sauté quartered onions and whole garlic cloves until lightly browned.
Return meat to the pot and add rosemary sprigs and juniper berries.
Pour in white wine and let it reduce by half, about 5 minutes.
Add beef broth and bring to a simmer, then cover and braise in a 325°F oven for 2.5 to 3 hours until very tender.
Remove meat to a cutting board and tent with foil.
Strain cooking liquid, discard solids, and skim fat; serve sauce alongside sliced meat.
cheapTips: Use lamb as a substitute if goat is unavailable
Buy meat on sale and freeze; braise directly from frozen (add 30 minutes cooking time)

recipes.name: Su Filindeu
recipes.description: Sardinian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, water, and salt to form a soft dough; knead for 10 minutes until elastic.
Let dough rest covered for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Meanwhile, sauté diced onion and garlic, add ground pork, and cook until browned, seasoning with cinnamon and saffron.
Stretch dough into very thin sheets (nearly transparent) and layer them in a buttered baking dish with the meat mixture between layers.
Drizzle melted butter over the layers as you build.
Pour beef broth around (not over) the layered dough.
Bake covered at 375°F for 45 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes more until golden.
Sprinkle with grated Pecorino Romano and let rest 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: This is traditionally labor-intensive but uses inexpensive pantry ingredients
Make the dough a day ahead to save time on cooking day

recipes.name: Pardulas
recipes.description: Sardinian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pastry dough by cutting cold butter into flour and salt, then add water until dough just comes together; chill 30 minutes.
Mix ricotta, honey, lemon zest, and dissolved saffron in a bowl for the filling.
Roll out dough thin and cut into 3-inch squares.
Place 1 tbsp filling on each square and fold into a triangle, pressing edges to seal.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan and fry pardulas a few at a time until golden on both sides, about 2-3 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
Dust warm pardulas with powdered sugar if desired.
cheapTips: Buy ricotta in bulk from warehouse stores
Reuse frying oil for multiple batches to save money

recipes.name: Sebadas
recipes.description: Sardinian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix all-purpose flour, semolina, water, salt, and lard until a soft dough forms; let rest 20 minutes.
Cut cheese into small cubes.
Roll dough very thin between parchment paper and cut into 4-inch squares.
Place a few cubes of cheese in the center of each square and fold into a sealed rectangle.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry sebadas until golden on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels.
Warm honey in a small saucepan.
Drizzle warm honey generously over each sebada and dust with powdered sugar; serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy honey at discount stores in bulk
Use less expensive mild cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Amaretti Sardi
recipes.description: Sardinian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Whisk egg whites until foamy, then gently fold in powdered sugar.
Fold in almond flour, vanilla, salt, and lemon zest until combined.
Drop teaspoon-sized portions onto prepared baking sheets.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until cookies are set but still chewy inside.
Cool completely on baking sheets before transferring to an airtight container.
cheapTips: Buy almond flour from bulk bins or online
Make a double batch and freeze in an airtight container for weeks

recipes.name: Cannonau Wine Stew
recipes.description: Sardinian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown beef cubes on all sides in batches, about 8 minutes total.
Remove beef and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Deglaze pot with Cannonau wine, scraping up browned bits.
Return beef to pot, add broth and bay leaf, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes until beef is nearly tender.
Add chunks of carrot and potato, then continue simmering covered for 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaf, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use less expensive beef chuck instead of premium cuts
Buy wine on sale and use for cooking; any dry red wine works

recipes.name: Casu Marzu
recipes.description: Sardinian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Source authentic Casu Marzu cheese (extremely difficult outside Sardinia due to legal restrictions).
If available and legal, slice the cheese into thin pieces.
Spread generously on freshly toasted crusty bread.
Serve immediately while the living larvae are active, traditionally paired with strong red wine.
cheapTips: This cheese is virtually impossible to legally obtain outside Sardinia
Consider visiting Sardinia to experience this authentic delicacy where it is legal

recipes.name: Malloreddus
recipes.description: Sardinian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Steep saffron threads in 2 tablespoons of warm water for 5 minutes.
Mix semolina flour and salt in a large bowl, then add saffron water and remaining warm water gradually until a stiff dough forms.
Roll dough into a 0.5-inch thick rope and cut into 0.75-inch pieces, then press each piece with a fork to create ridges.
Brown crumbled sausage with minced garlic in olive oil, then add tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook malloreddus for 8-10 minutes until they float.
Drain malloreddus and toss with the sausage sauce.
Serve topped with grated pecorino romano and fresh basil.
Drizzle with additional olive oil if desired.
cheapTips: Buy sausage on sale and freeze; use affordable canned tomato sauce instead of fresh
Make pasta dough ahead and freeze for weeknight cooking

recipes.name: Culurgiones
recipes.description: Sardinian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Knead flour, water, salt, and 1 tablespoon olive oil into a soft dough; rest for 30 minutes covered.
Boil and mash potato, then combine with minced garlic, mint, pecorino, and saffron to make filling.
Roll dough into thin sheets and cut into 3-inch squares.
Place 1 tablespoon filling on each square, fold into triangle, then bring corners together and seal.
Bring salted water to boil and cook culurgiones for 4-5 minutes until they float and hold for 1 minute more.
Drain carefully and transfer to a serving dish.
Toss with tomato sauce warmed with minced garlic and remaining olive oil.
Serve warm with additional pecorino romano on top.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cheese and canned tomato sauce to reduce cost
Make large batches and freeze uncooked culurgiones for future meals

recipes.name: Fregola con Arselle
recipes.description: Sardinian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Scrub clams under cold water to remove sand and discard any that won't close.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté minced garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add clams and white wine, cover and cook for 5-7 minutes until clams open; discard any unopened clams.
Remove clams with a slotted spoon and set aside; strain cooking liquid into a measuring cup.
In the same pot, add fregola and toast for 2-3 minutes while stirring.
Add fish stock, clam liquid, cherry tomatoes, and red pepper flakes; simmer for 12-15 minutes until fregola is tender and most liquid is absorbed.
Return clams to pot, add reserved parsley, and stir gently for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve immediately in shallow bowls with remaining parsley and olive oil drizzle.
cheapTips: Buy clams on sale or from a fishmonger's daily deals section
Substitute chicken broth for fish stock if budget is tight

recipes.name: Bottarga di Muggine
recipes.description: Sardinian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice bottarga very thinly using a sharp knife or vegetable peeler.
Arrange crackers or grissini on a serving platter.
Drizzle each cracker lightly with olive oil.
Layer thin slices of bottarga on top of each cracker.
Grate a small amount of lemon zest over the bottarga.
Sprinkle with sea salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges on the side.
Allow guests to squeeze fresh lemon juice over bottarga just before eating.
cheapTips: Buy bottarga in bulk online rather than specialty stores
Use affordable plain crackers instead of fancy artisanal varieties

recipes.name: Pani ca Meiga
recipes.description: Sardinian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté sliced onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cubed potatoes and cherry tomatoes, stirring to coat with oil for 2 minutes.
Pour in fish stock and bring to a simmer; cook potatoes for 15 minutes until nearly tender.
Cut fish fillets into large chunks and gently add to the pot along with red pepper flakes.
Simmer gently for 8-10 minutes until fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Taste and season with salt and black pepper as needed.
Ladle into bowls and top with fresh parsley; serve with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy fish on sale or ask fishmonger for day-old specials
Use water instead of fish stock to reduce cost significantly

recipes.name: Su Pani e Orcidau
recipes.description: Sardinian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a heavy pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add cubed potatoes and stir to coat with oil; cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in broth and crushed tomatoes with saffron threads; bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes begin to soften.
Cut eel or fish into large pieces, removing any remaining bones.
Gently add fish pieces to the pot, stirring carefully to avoid breaking them apart.
Simmer for 10-12 minutes until fish is opaque and potatoes are very tender.
Add fresh basil, then taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve hot in deep bowls with crusty bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Substitute frozen fish when fresh eel is unavailable or expensive
Make in larger batches and freeze portions for quick meals

recipes.name: Carasau Bread with Tomato
recipes.description: Sardinian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine diced tomatoes, minced garlic, torn basil, olive oil, and red wine vinegar in a bowl.
Season tomato mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Let mixture rest for 5 minutes to allow flavors to blend.
Arrange carasau bread pieces on a serving platter.
Spoon tomato mixture generously onto each bread piece.
Top each piece with shaved pecorino romano cheese.
Serve immediately at room temperature.
Optional: drizzle additional olive oil over top before serving.
cheapTips: Use regular crackers or pita chips if carasau bread is unavailable
Buy tomatoes on sale when in season and use any extra for fresh sauce

recipes.name: Porcheddus
recipes.description: Sardinian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat pork dry with paper towels and score the skin in a crosshatch pattern.
Make slits in the meat and insert halved garlic cloves, rosemary sprigs, and sage leaves into the cuts.
Rub pork generously with salt, black pepper, and olive oil on all surfaces.
Place pork in a large roasting pan and surround with bay leaves.
Add white wine and broth to the bottom of the pan.
Roast at 325°F for 3 hours, basting every 30 minutes with pan juices.
Increase heat to 400°F and roast an additional 15-20 minutes until skin is crispy and meat reaches an internal temperature of 160°F.
Rest meat for 15 minutes, then carve and serve with pan drippings spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder instead of whole young pig from regular grocery stores
Ask butcher for bones and trimmings to make broth for basting

recipes.name: Cordula
recipes.description: Sardinian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thoroughly clean intestines and liver under running water; blanch intestines for 3 minutes and cut into 2-inch pieces.
Dice liver finely and combine with minced parsley, garlic, pecorino romano, salt, and black pepper.
Form mixture into small balls and wrap each with intestine pieces, securing with butcher's twine.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown cordula bundles on all sides for 5-7 minutes.
Remove cordula and sauté diced onion in the same pot until softened.
Return cordula to pot, add white wine and tomato sauce.
Simmer covered for 1.5 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until cordula is very tender.
Remove twine and serve hot with crusty bread and additional grated cheese.
cheapTips: Special order offal from butcher at least a day in advance for better pricing
Buy when butcher has sales on organ meats or ask for discounted 'nose to tail' cuts

recipes.name: Pappas al Pomodoro
recipes.description: Sardinian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, red pepper flakes, and broth; bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook pappas for 12-15 minutes until tender but still firm.
Drain pappas and add directly to the tomato sauce, stirring gently to combine.
Simmer together for 3-4 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Tear fresh basil and stir into the pasta gently.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and black pepper.
Serve in shallow bowls topped generously with grated pecorino romano and additional olive oil.
cheapTips: Use store-brand canned tomatoes and grate your own cheese to save significantly
Make double batch and freeze sauce portions for quick future meals

recipes.name: Zuppa di Pesce alla Sarda
recipes.description: Sardinian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until soft.
Add canned tomatoes and white wine, simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour in fish stock and bring to a boil.
Add fish pieces and mussels, reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Toast bread slices and place one in the bottom of each bowl.
Ladle hot soup over bread and garnish with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy frozen mixed seafood instead of fresh for significant savings
Use canned fish stock instead of homemade

recipes.name: Pesto alla Genovese
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop basil roughly and add to a food processor with garlic cloves.
Pulse until basil and garlic are broken down into small pieces.
Add pine nuts and pulse until mixture is coarse.
Add both cheeses and pulse to combine.
With processor running, slowly drizzle olive oil until desired consistency is reached.
Season with salt and mix by hand with a wooden spoon to finish.
cheapTips: Make pesto when basil is in season (summer) and freeze in ice cube trays
Substitute walnuts for pine nuts to cut cost in half

recipes.name: Trofie al Pesto
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice potatoes into small cubes and trim green beans into 1-inch pieces.
Boil salted water in a large pot and add potatoes, cook for 3 minutes.
Add green beans to the pot with potatoes and cook for 2 more minutes.
Add trofie pasta to the same pot and cook according to package directions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, make pesto by blending basil, garlic, pine nuts, and slowly adding olive oil, then stir in cheeses.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Return drained pasta and vegetables to pot, add pesto and 1/2 cup pasta water, toss gently to coat.
cheapTips: Buy basil from farmers market in summer when cheapest
Use regular pasta if trofie is unavailable

recipes.name: Pansotti
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pasta dough: mound flour on a clean surface, create a well in center, crack eggs into well, add pinch of salt, and gradually mix flour into eggs until dough forms.
Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic, wrap in plastic, and let rest 30 minutes.
Blanch spinach in boiling salted water for 2 minutes, squeeze dry, and chop finely.
Mix spinach, ricotta, Parmigiano, pine nuts, nutmeg, and minced garlic in a bowl to make filling.
Roll out dough very thin, cut into 2-inch squares, place 1 teaspoon filling on each square, fold into triangle, then bring corners together.
Blend walnuts with butter and cream in a saucepan to make sauce, warm gently.
Boil pansotti in salted water for 3-4 minutes until they float, drain gently, and toss with walnut sauce.
cheapTips: Buy frozen spinach instead of fresh to save money
Make filling and dough a day ahead to save time on cooking day

recipes.name: Trenette al Pesto
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin matchsticks and trim green beans into short pieces.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and add potatoes, simmer for 2 minutes.
Add green beans to the pot and cook for 2 more minutes.
Add trenette pasta to the boiling water and cook according to package directions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, make pesto by pulsing basil, garlic, and pine nuts in a food processor, then slowly add olive oil and stir in both cheeses.
Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water before draining pasta and vegetables.
Toss hot pasta with pesto and vegetables, adding pasta water a little at a time to reach desired sauce consistency.
cheapTips: Make larger batches of pesto and freeze for future meals
Substitute spaghetti if trenette is not available

recipes.name: Lasagne alla Genovese
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook lasagne noodles in salted boiling water until just al dente, drain and lay flat on parchment paper.
Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 8 minutes.
Make pesto by pulsing basil, pine nuts, and garlic in food processor, slowly add olive oil, then mix in half the Parmigiano.
Make béchamel sauce by melting butter, whisking in flour to make a roux, then slowly adding milk while whisking until thickened, about 10 minutes.
In a bowl, mix ricotta with pesto and remaining Parmigiano.
Spread thin layer of béchamel on bottom of 9x13 baking dish, layer noodles, then beef, then ricotta-pesto mixture, repeat layers.
Top final layer with béchamel sauce and bake uncovered at 375°F for 30-35 minutes until golden and bubbly.
cheapTips: Make béchamel sauce from scratch instead of buying prepared sauce
Buy fresh basil at farmers market in summer and freeze pesto batches

recipes.name: Focaccia di Recco
recipes.description: Ligurian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, create a well, add warm water and 2 tbsp olive oil, stir until dough forms.
Knead dough for 8 minutes until smooth, divide into 2 equal pieces, and let rest 15 minutes.
Roll out first piece of dough very thin onto parchment paper, then transfer to an oiled 9x13 baking pan.
Spread stracchino cheese over dough, sprinkle Parmigiano on top.
Roll out second piece of dough equally thin and lay it over the cheese layer.
Brush top with remaining olive oil, sprinkle coarse sea salt and rosemary, poke small holes all over with a fork.
Bake at 425°F for 15-20 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
cheapTips: Substitute cream cheese or mozzarella if stracchino is unavailable
Buy cheese from bulk sections for better pricing

recipes.name: Frisceu
recipes.description: Ligurian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, water, and salt in a bowl to make a thin, pancake-like batter.
Finely mince onion, anchovies, garlic, and parsley, then fold into batter with black pepper.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F, checking temperature with a thermometer or bread cube test.
Spoon small portions of batter (about 2 tbsp each) into hot oil carefully.
Fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer fritters to paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve warm as a snack, sprinkled lightly with coarse salt.
cheapTips: Buy canned anchovies in bulk or find Italian import stores for savings
Use vegetable oil instead of olive oil for frying to reduce cost

recipes.name: Acciughe Ripiene
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Gently clean fresh anchovies by rinsing them and removing the backbone by splitting belly-side up and carefully detaching the spine.
Mix breadcrumbs, Parmigiano, minced parsley, minced garlic, and egg in a bowl to create filling.
Place a small spoonful of filling between two anchovy fillets to create sandwiches, pressing gently.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Arrange filled anchovies in the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until just cooked through.
Warm tomato sauce in a separate saucepan and add lemon juice.
Plate anchovies and spoon warm tomato sauce over them, season with salt and pepper.
cheapTips: Buy fresh anchovies when in season at fish markets for best prices
Canned anchovies can substitute if fresh are unavailable

recipes.name: Brandacujun
recipes.description: Ligurian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod in cold water for 12-24 hours, changing water several times to remove excess salt.
Peel and cube potatoes, boil in salted water for 15 minutes until very tender.
Cook soaked cod in simmering water for 8-10 minutes, then drain, remove any bones, and flake into small pieces.
Mash cooked potatoes in a bowl, then add flaked cod and minced garlic.
Slowly add olive oil and milk alternately while beating the mixture until light and fluffy.
Season with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to taste.
Transfer to a serving dish, garnish with parsley, and serve warm or at room temperature with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy salt cod in bulk from Mediterranean or Portuguese markets
Make ahead as it tastes better the next day and can be reheated

recipes.name: Trofie alle Noci
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast walnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.
Pulse toasted walnuts, basil, garlic, and salt in a food processor until coarsely chopped.
Transfer walnut mixture to a bowl and stir in olive oil, Parmesan, pepper, and water until creamy.
Bring salted water to boil and cook trofie pasta until al dente, about 11-13 minutes.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain the pasta.
Toss hot pasta with walnut sauce in a large bowl, adding pasta water a splash at a time to reach desired consistency.
Serve immediately with extra Parmesan and black pepper.
cheapTips: Buy walnuts in bulk from discount grocers
Use store-brand pasta and cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Minestrone alla Genovese
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion, celery, and carrots for 5 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in broth and bring to a boil, then add zucchini, green beans, and tomatoes with their juice.
Simmer for 10 minutes, then add drained cannellini beans and pasta.
Cook for 8-10 minutes until pasta is tender and beans are heated through.
Stir in fresh basil, salt, and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables in season for better prices
Use canned beans instead of dried to save time

recipes.name: Pasta alla Pistou
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast pine nuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Pulse basil, garlic, and pine nuts in a food processor until coarsely chopped.
With the processor running, slowly pour in olive oil until combined, then mix in Parmesan.
Cut zucchini into half-moons and green beans into 1-inch pieces.
Bring broth to boil in a large pot, add zucchini and green beans, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add pasta directly to broth and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes.
Stir in drained cannellini beans and cook for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in pistou sauce, adjusting seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Make pistou in batches and freeze for future use
Substitute sunflower seeds for pine nuts to save money

recipes.name: Corzetti
recipes.description: Ligurian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, aniseed, and salt in a large bowl.
Cream softened butter with sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in egg yolk, white wine, and vanilla extract until combined.
Fold butter mixture into flour mixture until a stiff dough forms.
Knead dough on a lightly floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth.
Roll dough between parchment paper to 0.25-inch thickness and cut into coin-shaped pieces with a glass or ring mold.
Press decorative patterns onto coins using a fork or traditional corzetti stamp if available.
Beat egg white and brush lightly onto cookies.
Bake on parchment-lined baking sheets at 350°F for 12-15 minutes until golden.
cheapTips: Aniseed is cheaper in bulk spice sections
Skip expensive molds and use glass rim to cut shapes

recipes.name: Panissa
recipes.description: Ligurian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk chickpea flour with 1 cup water in a bowl until smooth, with no lumps.
Bring remaining 2 cups water to boil in a large pot with salt and rosemary.
Slowly pour flour mixture into boiling water while stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring frequently, until very thick.
Pour mixture into a parchment-lined 8x8-inch pan and let cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for 1 hour.
Cut cooled panissa into squares or triangles.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté minced garlic and onion for 2 minutes.
Fry panissa pieces until golden and crispy on both sides, about 3 minutes per side.
Season with black pepper and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy chickpea flour from bulk bins to save 20-30%
Store-brand olive oil works well here

recipes.name: Tanselle
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour with water and salt to form a soft dough, then knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
Cover dough and let rest for 20 minutes.
Wash and chop Swiss chard, discarding thick stems; sauté with minced garlic in 1 tablespoon butter for 5 minutes.
Mix cooked chard with ricotta, Parmesan, black pepper, and nutmeg in a bowl.
Roll dough between parchment paper into a very thin sheet.
Cut dough into 3-inch squares and place 1 tablespoon filling in center of each.
Fold each square in half diagonally to create triangles, then press edges firmly to seal.
Bring salted water to boil in a large pot and cook tanselle until they float and cook for 2 minutes more.
Melt remaining 3 tablespoons butter in a pan and toss drained tanselle with melted butter and extra Parmesan.
cheapTips: Buy ricotta from the day-old section for discounts
Use regular cheese instead of premium Parmesan

recipes.name: Buridda
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic for 5 minutes until softened.
Add tomatoes with their juice and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour in broth and bring to a simmer.
Add cubed fish, green olives, and capers to the pan and gently simmer for 8-10 minutes until fish is cooked through and flakes easily.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Stir in fresh parsley just before serving.
Ladle into bowls and serve with crusty bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish when fresh is expensive
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh

recipes.name: Stoccafisso alla Genovese
recipes.description: Ligurian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried salt cod in cold water for 24-48 hours, changing water every 8 hours, until rehydrated and desalted.
Drain and rinse the fish, then cut into chunks and remove any remaining bones.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven and sauté sliced onion and minced garlic for 5 minutes until softened.
Add tomatoes with their juice and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes and add to the pot with the broth.
Nestle fish chunks into the liquid and add olives and capers.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 45-60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fish is tender and potatoes are very soft.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve in bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy salt cod from ethnic markets for better prices than specialty fishmongers
Make in bulk and freeze portions

recipes.name: Ciuppin
recipes.description: Ligurian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté sliced onion and minced garlic for 5 minutes until softened.
Add tomatoes with their juice, oregano, and red pepper flakes, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Pour in fish broth and bring to a simmer.
Clean and prepare seafood: peel shrimp, remove beards from mussels, and scrub clams.
Add heartier seafood first (like firm white fish chunks), simmer for 5 minutes.
Add remaining seafood (shrimp, mussels, clams) and cook for 8-10 minutes until shrimp are pink, mussels and clams have opened (discard any that don't).
Stir in half the fresh parsley and season with salt and black pepper.
Ladle into bowls, garnish with remaining parsley, and serve with toasted crusty bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy whole fish from Asian markets and ask for cleaning
Use canned clams if fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Picagge
recipes.description: Ligurian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour with warm water and salt to form a soft dough, then knead for 8 minutes until very smooth and elastic.
Cover dough with a damp cloth and let rest for 20 minutes.
Wash and chop Swiss chard; sauté with minced garlic in 1 tablespoon butter for 8 minutes until tender.
Mix cooked greens with ricotta, Parmesan, black pepper, and nutmeg in a bowl.
Divide dough into small portions and roll each portion very thin between parchment paper into rectangles.
Spread 1 tablespoon filling along the center of each dough rectangle.
Roll dough tightly around filling and seal edges by pinching or pressing with a fork to create a long cylinder.
Coil the filled rolls into spiral or crescent shapes.
Bring salted water to boil in a large pot and cook picagge until they float and cook 2-3 minutes more.
Drain and toss with remaining 4 tablespoons melted butter and extra Parmesan.
cheapTips: Make filling in advance and refrigerate up to 2 days
Use store-brand ricotta and cheese to save money

recipes.name: Laing
recipes.description: Bicolano lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté garlic, onion, ginger, and chilies for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add dried shrimp and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add taro leaves gradually, stirring until they begin to wilt.
Pour in coconut milk slowly while stirring to combine evenly.
Add fish sauce and salt, then simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes until leaves are tender and sauce reduces slightly.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking and ensure even cooking.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional fish sauce or salt as needed.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
cheapTips: Buy dried shrimp in bulk from Asian markets for better prices
Use regular coconut milk rather than premium brands

recipes.name: Pinangat
recipes.description: Bicolano lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pan and sauté garlic, ginger, and onion for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Arrange taro leaves in the pan, layering them to create a bed.
Place fish fillets on top of the taro leaves.
Pour coconut milk evenly over the fish, add fish sauce, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 20-25 minutes.
Add green chili peppers in the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Check that fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve immediately with the taro leaves and sauce over steamed rice.
cheapTips: Use tilapia or catfish instead of premium white fish varieties
Buy pre-packaged taro leaves to save prep time

recipes.name: Camarones Rebosado
recipes.description: Bicolano lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and white pepper in a bowl.
Beat eggs in another bowl, then add to dry mixture with water, stirring until a smooth batter forms.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F (medium-high heat).
Coat each shrimp thoroughly in batter, allowing excess to drip off.
Carefully place battered shrimp in hot oil and fry 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer cooked shrimp to a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Serve hot with sweet and sour sauce or vinegar dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp on sale and thaw before breading
Reuse oil for multiple batches if straining well between uses

recipes.name: Tinutong Bicolano
recipes.description: Bicolano breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse glutinous rice under cold water until water runs clear.
Bring water to a boil in a pot and add rice, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes until rice is nearly cooked.
Pour in coconut milk and stir to combine thoroughly.
Add brown sugar, salt, and butter, mixing until dissolved.
Continue cooking on low heat for 5-8 minutes, stirring frequently, until mixture becomes creamy and thick.
Transfer to serving bowls and top with toasted sesame seeds and crushed peanuts.
Serve hot as a sweet breakfast or snack.
cheapTips: Buy glutinous rice in bulk from Asian grocery stores
Use canned coconut milk on sale and store long-term

recipes.name: Kinilao
recipes.description: Bicolano lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine cubed fish in a non-metal bowl with lime juice, ensuring all pieces are submerged.
Let sit for 10 minutes to 'cook' the fish in the acid; it should become opaque.
Drain most of the lime juice from the fish, leaving about 2 tablespoons.
Add coconut milk, onion, chili peppers, ginger, garlic, and fish sauce to the fish.
Toss gently to combine all ingredients evenly.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and additional fish sauce.
