steps: Thaw frozen spinach completely and squeeze dry using a clean kitchen towel until no moisture remains.
Mix ricotta, squeezed spinach, 1/2 cup Parmesan, egg, nutmeg, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Gently fold in flour until a soft dough forms without overworking.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle simmer.
Using two spoons, form gnocchi by dropping spoonfuls of dough into the simmering water.
Cook for 3-4 minutes after gnocchi float to the surface, then remove with a slotted spoon.
In a small pan, melt butter with sage leaves until fragrant and lightly browned.
Toss cooked gnocchi with butter sauce and remaining Parmesan, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ricotta in bulk when on sale and freeze portions for future use
Skip fresh sage and use dried sage from your spice rack if budget is tight

recipes.name: Plin
recipes.description: Piedmontese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pasta dough by combining flour and 3 eggs, kneading until smooth, then rest for 30 minutes wrapped in plastic.
Finely chop onion and garlic, then sauté in 1 tablespoon butter for 3 minutes until soft.
Add ground meat and cook for 5 minutes, breaking apart, then cool slightly and mix with 1/4 cup Parmesan and 1 egg.
Roll out pasta dough very thin on a floured surface, cutting into 2-inch squares.
Place 1 teaspoon of filling on half of each square, fold into triangle, then bring corners together.
Bring broth to a gentle boil in a large pot.
Drop plin into boiling broth and cook for 3-4 minutes until they float and stay afloat for 1 minute.
Divide plin among bowls and ladle broth over them, then drizzle with browned butter and sage.
cheapTips: Make pasta dough at home instead of buying pre-made to save significantly
Use ground beef instead of veal to reduce meat costs while maintaining flavor

recipes.name: Zabaione
recipes.description: Piedmontese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a large bowl with ice water and set a metal bowl on top, ensuring the bottom doesn't touch water.
Whisk together egg yolks and sugar in the metal bowl until pale and thick, about 2 minutes.
Place bowl over ice and slowly pour in Marsala wine while whisking constantly for 8-10 minutes.
Continue whisking until mixture reaches 160°F on a thermometer or becomes thick and fluffy.
Remove from heat and whisk in vanilla extract.
Divide zabaione into serving glasses and serve immediately with ladyfinger cookies for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy eggs on sale and store them properly to get fresh yolks
Substitute sweet vermouth or sherry if Marsala wine is unavailable

recipes.name: Bonet
recipes.description: Piedmontese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and butter a 6-cup baking dish or ramekins.
Heat milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling, then remove from heat.
Whisk together egg yolks and sugar until pale and ribbony, about 3 minutes.
Sift cocoa powder into egg mixture and whisk until combined.
Slowly pour hot milk into egg mixture while whisking constantly to temper the yolks.
Stir in crushed amaretto cookies and a pinch of salt.
Pour mixture into prepared baking dish and place in a larger roasting pan.
Fill roasting pan with hot water until it reaches halfway up the sides of the baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until custard is set but slightly jiggly in the center, then cool and chill for at least 2 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand cocoa powder and amaretto cookies to save on ingredient costs
Make this dessert a day ahead to save time and reduce stress

recipes.name: Torta di Nocciole
recipes.description: Piedmontese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and butter and flour a 9-inch round cake pan.
Pulse roasted hazelnuts in a food processor until finely ground, being careful not to create hazelnut butter.
Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition until fully incorporated.
Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a small bowl, then fold into wet mixture.
Fold in ground hazelnuts and vanilla extract until just combined.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool in pan for 15 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely before dusting with powdered sugar.
cheapTips: Buy hazelnuts in bulk from the baking aisle or online to reduce per-pound cost
Skip the powdered sugar dusting to save money while maintaining great taste

recipes.name: Amaretti di Saluzzo
recipes.description: Piedmontese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whip egg whites and salt in a clean bowl until stiff peaks form, about 3 minutes.
Gradually add sugar while whisking, creating a glossy meringue that holds peaks.
Gently fold in almond flour, vanilla, and almond extract until just combined.
Spoon mixture into small mounds about 1.5 inches apart on prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and cookies are set but still slightly soft inside.
Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
cheapTips: Buy almond flour in bulk from warehouse stores or online to reduce cost significantly
Buy eggs in bulk and use whites immediately or freeze for later

recipes.name: Bunet Piemontese
recipes.description: Piedmontese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 300°F and lightly butter six ramekins or a 6-cup baking dish.
Heat milk and cream together in a saucepan until steaming, then remove from heat.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale and thick, about 3 minutes.
Crush amaretto cookies into small pieces and add to egg mixture.
Sift cocoa powder into mixture and whisk until smooth.
Slowly pour hot milk into egg mixture while whisking constantly to temper.
Strain mixture through a fine sieve to remove any egg lumps.
Stir in rum and vanilla extract.
Pour into prepared ramekins or baking dish and place in a roasting pan filled with hot water halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until custard is set but slightly jiggly, then chill for at least 4 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Skip the rum and use more vanilla extract to reduce alcohol cost
Buy store-brand amaretto cookies instead of premium brands to save money

recipes.name: Crêpe au Sarrasin
recipes.description: Breton lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix buckwheat flour, all-purpose flour, and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk in water and eggs until smooth batter forms, then let rest 15 minutes.
Heat a 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and lightly butter it.
Pour 1/4 cup batter into the center and immediately tilt skillet to spread thinly.
Cook until bottom is light golden, about 1 minute, then flip and cook 30 seconds more.
Place ham slice and handful of cheese on one half of the crêpe.
Fold crêpe in half and transfer to plate.
Repeat with remaining batter, ham, and cheese.
cheapTips: Buy buckwheat flour in bulk from ethnic or health food stores for lower cost
Use store-brand ham and cheese to reduce expenses

recipes.name: Kig Ha Farz
recipes.description: Breton dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into 2-inch chunks and sausage into 2-inch pieces.
Bring broth to boil in large pot and add pork shoulder, sausage, onion, and bay leaf.
Simmer 45 minutes, then add carrots, potatoes, and chopped cabbage.
Continue simmering another 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Mix buckwheat flour, all-purpose flour, and 2 tablespoons melted butter with salt.
Wrap flour mixture in cheesecloth to form a ball and tie tightly.
Add dumpling ball to broth and simmer 25 minutes until cooked through.
Remove dumpling, slice it, and arrange on plates with meat and vegetables, ladling broth over all.
cheapTips: Use pork butt instead of shoulder for lower cost
Buy whole cabbage and potatoes which are cheaper per pound than precut versions

recipes.name: Cotriade
recipes.description: Breton dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch chunks and slice onions thinly.
Melt butter in large pot over medium heat and sauté onions until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add fish broth, bay leaves, thyme, and diced potatoes and bring to simmer.
Simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are almost tender.
Cut fish into 2-inch chunks, removing any bones.
Add all fish pieces to the pot and simmer gently 10 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in bowls with crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Ask the fish counter for less expensive white fish varieties in place of mackerel
Use vegetable broth instead of fish broth if unavailable

recipes.name: Homard Thermidor
recipes.description: Breton dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil lobster tails in salted water for 8 minutes, then cool slightly and remove meat, reserving shells.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet and sauté shallots and mushrooms until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add white wine and fish broth, simmer until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Whisk together cream, egg yolk, and mustard in bowl, then slowly add to sauce while stirring constantly.
Stir in remaining 2 tablespoons butter, salt, and cayenne, then fold in lobster meat.
Divide lobster mixture between reserved shells and top with gruyere cheese.
Bake at 400°F for 8 minutes until tops are golden and bubbling.
Serve immediately on warmed plates.
cheapTips: Substitute frozen lobster tails which are usually cheaper than fresh
Make this dish for special occasions only to manage food budget

recipes.name: Palourdes Farcies
recipes.description: Breton dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Scrub clams under cold running water to remove sand and grit.
Steam clams in pot with 1/4 cup water until shells open, about 8 minutes, discarding any unopened clams.
Remove clams from shells, reserving 12 deepest shell halves, and chop clam meat coarsely.
Melt butter in skillet and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Stir in bread crumbs, parsley, chopped clam meat, white wine, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Arrange clam shells on baking sheet and fill each with approximately 2 tablespoons of mixture.
Bake at 425°F for 12 minutes until topping is golden brown.
Serve hot with extra lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy clams on sale at seafood markets or use frozen chopped clams when live clams are expensive
Make your own bread crumbs from stale bread instead of buying packaged

recipes.name: Huîtres de Belon
recipes.description: Breton lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Scrub oyster shells thoroughly under cold running water with a stiff brush.
Hold oyster flat-side-up in a towel and insert oyster knife near the hinge.
Twist knife to pop open the shell, keeping liquid in the bottom half.
Run knife under the oyster meat to loosen it from the shell.
Mince shallots finely and combine with red wine vinegar and a pinch each of salt and pepper.
Place opened oysters on a bed of ice and spoon a small amount of shallot vinaigrette over each.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy oysters from fishmongers rather than upscale restaurants for better pricing
Choose Eastern oysters which are typically less expensive than Pacific varieties

recipes.name: Pâté de Campagne Breton
recipes.description: Breton lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pulse pork liver in food processor until coarsely chopped, then combine with ground pork and fatback.
Sauté shallots and garlic in skillet until soft, about 3 minutes, then add to meat mixture.
Stir in thyme, cognac, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Line a loaf pan or terrine with pork belly strips, overlapping slightly.
Pack pâté mixture into pan, pressing down firmly to remove air pockets.
Fold pork belly strips over the top and place bay leaf on surface.
Cover with foil and place in water bath, then bake at 325°F for 50 minutes.
Remove from oven, cool to room temperature, then refrigerate at least 8 hours before serving with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Ask the butcher counter for liver trimmings which are often discounted
Buy pork fatback in bulk when on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Crêpe Dentelle
recipes.description: Breton snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Melt butter in saucepan over low heat, then stir in sugar, flour, salt, and honey until smooth.
Remove from heat and fold in heavy cream gently.
Drop teaspoon-sized portions of batter onto prepared baking sheets, spacing 3 inches apart.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until edges are golden but centers are still slightly soft.
Cool for 30 seconds on baking sheet, then quickly roll each crêpe around a wooden spoon handle to form a cylinder.
Allow to cool completely and harden on a wire rack.
Store in airtight container for up to 5 days.
cheapTips: Buy butter on sale and freeze for future baking projects
Use store-brand sugar which is cheaper than specialty brands

recipes.name: Bugale
recipes.description: Breton dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix buckwheat flour, all-purpose flour, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk in melted butter, eggs, and milk until smooth batter forms.
Peel, core, and slice apples thinly into 1/8-inch slices.
Grease an 8-inch baking dish and pour thin layer of batter into bottom.
Arrange apple slices evenly over batter and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Pour remaining batter over apples to cover completely.
Bake at 375°F for 35 minutes until center is set and top is golden brown.
Cool for 10 minutes, slice into wedges, and serve warm with powdered sugar.
cheapTips: Use seasonal apples which are significantly cheaper than out-of-season varieties
Buy buckwheat flour in bulk bins at health food stores for lower cost

recipes.name: Gâteau Breton
recipes.description: Breton snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes with electric mixer.
Beat in 4 egg yolks one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
Fold in flour and salt just until combined, being careful not to overmix.
Press dough evenly into a 9-inch round cake pan or tart tin.
Beat remaining egg white with 1 tablespoon water and brush over dough surface.
Score the surface lightly in a crosshatch pattern with a knife.
Bake at 350°F for 25-30 minutes until golden brown and firm.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto wire rack to cool completely before slicing.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale to save on egg yolks for this recipe
Use store-brand butter and flour which cost less than name brands

recipes.name: Falscher Hase
recipes.description: Saxon dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the onion finely and sauté in butter until soft, then let cool.
Combine ground beef, sautéed onion, eggs, bread crumbs, milk, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Shape the mixture into a loaf and place in a buttered baking dish.
Pour beef broth around the loaf and bake at 375°F for 40-45 minutes until cooked through.
Remove from oven and arrange anchovy fillets in a cross pattern on top.
Return to oven for 2 minutes, then serve hot with pan drippings as sauce.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later
Make your own bread crumbs from stale bread

recipes.name: Sächsisches Rehragout
recipes.description: Saxon dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut venison into 1.5-inch cubes and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat butter in a large pot and brown venison on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion until golden, then sprinkle flour and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in red wine and beef broth, scraping up browned bits from the bottom.
Return venison to pot with juniper berries, bay leaves, and thyme.
Simmer covered for 90 minutes until venison is tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in sour cream and season with salt and pepper, then simmer 5 more minutes.
Serve hot with egg noodles or red cabbage.
cheapTips: Substitute beef chuck if venison is unavailable
Buy spices in bulk for significant savings

recipes.name: Zwiebelkuchen
recipes.description: Saxon lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and warm water to form a dough and knead for 8 minutes.
Let dough rise in an oiled bowl for 45 minutes until doubled.
Dice bacon and cook in a skillet until crispy, then remove and set aside.
Slice onions thinly and sauté in bacon fat until soft and golden.
Whisk eggs and sour cream together, then mix with onions, bacon, and caraway seeds.
Stretch dough onto an oiled 9-inch pie pan.
Spread onion mixture evenly over dough.
Bake at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until crust is golden brown.
cheapTips: Use store-brand sour cream instead of name brands
Buy onions in bulk when in season

recipes.name: Rinderzunge mit Kapernsoße
recipes.description: Saxon dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place beef tongue in a large pot with onion, carrot, bay leaf, and salt.
Cover with water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2.5 hours until tender.
Remove tongue from broth, let cool slightly, then peel away the outer skin with a knife.
Slice tongue into 0.25-inch thick pieces.
Make roux by melting butter and stirring in flour for 2 minutes.
Whisk in beef broth slowly to avoid lumps.
Add capers, mustard, and lemon juice, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Add sliced tongue to sauce and heat through before serving.
cheapTips: Buy beef tongue when on sale at specialty butchers
Save the cooking broth to use as stock for other dishes

recipes.name: Sächsischer Erdäpfelsuppe
recipes.description: Saxon lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube potatoes into 0.5-inch pieces.
Dice onion and sauté in butter until soft.
Add potatoes, vegetable broth, caraway seeds, salt, pepper, and marjoram.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in sour cream gently and heat through without boiling.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk bags for better value
Use homemade vegetable broth or bouillon cubes to save money

recipes.name: Quarkkeulchen
recipes.description: Saxon snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine quark, eggs, flour, sugar, salt, and vanilla in a bowl and mix until smooth.
Fold in raisins gently.
Heat oil in a skillet to 350°F.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Mix powdered sugar and cinnamon together.
Dust warm quarkkeulchen with cinnamon sugar mixture while still warm.
cheapTips: Buy ricotta on sale if quark is unavailable
Use dried cranberries or currants instead of raisins for variety

recipes.name: Sächsischer Stollen
recipes.description: Saxon snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix yeast with warm milk and let stand for 5 minutes.
Cream butter and sugar together, then add eggs and yeast mixture.
Fold in flour and salt to form a soft dough.
Knead for 10 minutes, then let rise for 1.5 hours until doubled.
Mix raisins, almonds, and candied citrus peel into dough.
Shape dough into a rectangle and place marzipan log down the center.
Fold dough over marzipan and shape into a large oval loaf.
Place on parchment paper and let rise 1 hour.
Bake at 375°F for 50-60 minutes until golden and sounds hollow when tapped.
cheapTips: Make your own candied peel from citrus scraps
Buy nuts and dried fruit from bulk bins for savings

recipes.name: Letscho
recipes.description: Saxon dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Core and slice bell peppers into strips.
Slice onions into rings and mince garlic.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onions and garlic until fragrant.
Add bell peppers and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Dice tomatoes and add to pot with paprika, salt, and pepper.
Simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes until peppers are tender.
Adjust seasonings to taste and serve hot or warm.
cheapTips: Buy bell peppers when on sale and freeze for later
Use canned tomatoes if fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Schmorgurken
recipes.description: Saxon dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel cucumbers and cut in half lengthwise, then slice into 0.5-inch thick pieces.
Dice onion finely.
Melt butter in a large pan and sauté onion until soft.
Add cucumber pieces and cook for 3 minutes, stirring gently.
Pour in beef broth, vinegar, and sugar, then season with salt and pepper.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until cucumbers are tender but still slightly firm.
Stir in dill and sour cream gently, then heat through without boiling.
Serve warm as a side dish or light main course.
cheapTips: Buy cucumbers at farmers markets at end of day for discounts
Use Greek yogurt instead of sour cream to save money

recipes.name: Sächsische Ente
recipes.description: Saxon dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and pat duck dry inside and out with paper towels.
Stuff duck cavity with quartered onions, carrot chunks, and apple pieces.
Season duck skin with salt and pepper, then place breast-up on a roasting rack.
Roast for 30 minutes, then reduce heat to 350°F and continue roasting for 90 minutes, draining fat periodically.
Transfer duck to cutting board and let rest for 10 minutes, then quarter the bird.
Place roasting pan over stovetop, deglaze with beef broth, add thyme and bay leaf, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Strain sauce and serve with carved duck pieces and boiled potatoes.
cheapTips: Buy whole duck instead of parts to save 20-30%
Save rendered duck fat for cooking future meals

recipes.name: Clafoutis Breton
recipes.description: Breton dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat your oven to 350°F and butter a 9-inch round baking dish.
Pit fresh cherries or use canned prunes and drain them well, then spread evenly in the buttered dish.
In a blender, combine flour, eggs, milk, sugar, melted butter, vanilla, and salt, then blend until smooth.
Pour the batter over the fruit, ensuring even coverage.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until the clafoutis is golden brown and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes, then dust generously with powdered sugar before serving warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use frozen or canned cherries instead of fresh for year-round savings
Make with prunes or plums when in season for lowest cost

recipes.name: Andouille de Guémené
recipes.description: Breton lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the pork stomach lining and intestines thoroughly under cold running water.
Cut the pork shoulder and intestines into small chunks and grind together with minced garlic and shallots.
Mix the ground meat with salt, pepper, wine, and thyme leaves until well combined.
Stuff the mixture tightly into the prepared stomach lining or large intestines using a sausage stuffer.
Tie off the ends securely with kitchen twine.
Poach the andouille in simmering water for 90 minutes until cooked through.
Cool completely, then refrigerate before slicing and serving grilled or with mustard.
cheapTips: Ask your butcher for discounted organ meats and trimmings
Make several at once and freeze for future meals

recipes.name: Crêpe Complète aux Œufs
recipes.description: Breton breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix buckwheat flour, all-purpose flour, and salt in a large bowl.
Create a well in the center and whisk in 2 eggs, then gradually add milk and water while stirring until smooth batter forms.
Let batter rest for 15 minutes.
Heat a non-stick crêpe pan or skillet over medium-high heat and lightly butter it.
Pour 0.25 cup batter into the pan and tilt immediately to spread evenly, cooking for about 1 minute until the bottom is light golden.
Flip the crêpe and place a ham slice and 3 tablespoons of cheese on one half, then crack an egg onto the other half.
Cook until the egg whites are set (about 2-3 minutes), then fold the crêpe in half and slide onto a plate.
cheapTips: Buy ham on sale and slice it yourself instead of pre-packaged
Use sharp cheddar instead of gruyere for similar taste at lower cost

recipes.name: Moules à la Marinière
recipes.description: Breton dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the mussels by scrubbing under cold water and removing any beards with a knife.
Mince the shallots and garlic finely.
Heat butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté shallots and garlic for 2 minutes until softened.
Add the white wine and bring to a simmer.
Add the cleaned mussels and cover the pot with a tight-fitting lid.
Steam for 7-10 minutes, shaking the pot occasionally, until all mussels have opened (discard any that remain closed).
Stir in most of the fresh parsley and season with salt and pepper, then serve immediately in bowls with the broth and crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy mussels when they are on sale at grocery store seafood counters
Use frozen mussels if fresh are unavailable for similar results

recipes.name: Rillettes de Bretagne
recipes.description: Breton lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder and belly into 2-inch chunks and place in a heavy pot with minced garlic and shallots.
Season with salt, pepper, thyme, and bay leaf.
Cover and cook over low heat for 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until the pork is very tender and falling apart.
Remove from heat and discard thyme sprigs and bay leaf.
Using two forks, shred and mix the pork with its cooking juices until well combined and spreadable.
Pack the rillettes into a terrine or small crock, smoothing the top.
Cover with a thin layer of melted lard or clarified butter to seal and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving on crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder and belly when marked down and freeze for later use
Make larger batches to divide cooking time per serving cost

recipes.name: Crêpe Jambon Fromage
recipes.description: Breton lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour and salt in a mixing bowl and make a well in the center.
Whisk together eggs and milk, then pour into the well while stirring until a smooth batter forms.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter into the batter and let it rest for 15 minutes.
Heat a non-stick crêpe pan or skillet over medium-high heat and lightly butter it.
Pour 0.25 cup batter into the pan and tilt to spread evenly, cooking for 1 minute on the first side until light golden.
Flip the crêpe and spread a thin layer of mustard on the cooked side, then place one ham slice and 0.25 cup cheese on one half.
Fold the crêpe in half and cook for another 30 seconds until the cheese begins to melt, then slide onto a plate and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use leftover ham from a roast and shred it instead of buying sliced ham
Substitute sharp cheddar for emmental to save 30-40%

recipes.name: Sablés Bretons
recipes.description: Breton snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cream together softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy (about 3 minutes).
Beat in the egg yolk and vanilla extract until fully incorporated.
Mix in flour and salt until a dough just comes together without overworking.
Roll dough between two sheets of parchment paper to 0.25-inch thickness.
Cut into circles or rectangles using a cutter or knife, then place on prepared baking sheet.
Brush lightly with beaten egg and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden at the edges.
Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
cheapTips: Buy butter on sale and freeze for future baking
Make large batches and freeze dough for up to 3 months

recipes.name: Eierschecke
recipes.description: Saxon breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine warm milk, yeast, and 1 teaspoon sugar, then let sit for 10 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour, remaining sugar, and salt in a large bowl, then make a well and add the yeast mixture, 3 eggs, and softened butter.
Knead for 10 minutes until a smooth, elastic dough forms, then cover and let rise for 45 minutes until doubled.
Divide dough in half and press one half into a greased 9x13-inch baking pan.
Whisk 2 eggs with custard powder and pour evenly over the dough layer.
Press the remaining dough into a flat sheet and place it over the custard layer, sealing the edges.
Cover and let rise for 30 minutes, then beat 1 egg and brush on top.
Bake at 350°F for 35-40 minutes until golden brown, cool completely, then dust with powdered sugar and slice.
cheapTips: Buy eggs when on sale and store in the refrigerator for several weeks
Make custard from scratch with milk and cornstarch to save on custard powder

recipes.name: Quarkkäulchen
recipes.description: Saxon breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix quark, eggs, and sugar together in a bowl until smooth.
Sift in flour, baking powder, and salt, then fold gently until just combined.
Stir in raisins until evenly distributed throughout the batter.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer to a paper towel to drain excess oil.
Dust with powdered sugar while still warm and serve immediately with jam or fresh berries.
cheapTips: Use plain yogurt instead of quark for substantial savings and similar results
Make your own raisin mix by buying dried fruit on sale at bulk stores

recipes.name: Sächsische Kartoffelsuppe
recipes.description: Saxon lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and dice potatoes into 0.5-inch cubes.
Chop onion, celery, and carrots into small pieces.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion, celery, and carrots for 5 minutes until softened.
Add beef broth and bring to a boil, then add diced potatoes and reduce heat to simmer for 15 minutes.
Add sauerkraut and sliced smoked sausage, then simmer for another 10 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh dill to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in 5-lb bags and store in a cool dark place for extended freshness
Use store-brand sausage and sauerkraut for significant savings without sacrificing taste

recipes.name: Agnolotti del Plin
recipes.description: Piedmontese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and eggs on a work surface until a smooth dough forms, knead for 10 minutes until elastic, then rest covered for 30 minutes.
Brown ground beef and pork in a skillet over medium-high heat, then stir in 2 tablespoons parmesan, salt, and pepper until combined.
Roll pasta dough very thin with a pasta machine, cut into 2-inch squares, place a small spoonful of filling in the center of each square, and fold diagonally to form triangles.
Pinch the two corners together to form the characteristic plin shape, then place on a floured surface.
Bring salted water to a boil in a large pot, add agnolotti in batches, and cook until they float and then 1 minute more.
Heat beef broth and butter with sage leaves in a large shallow bowl.
Transfer cooked agnolotti to the broth mixture using a slotted spoon and gently toss.
Serve hot topped with remaining parmesan cheese and fresh black pepper.
cheapTips: Use a 50/50 beef and pork blend to stretch meat further while keeping flavor rich
Make extra agnolotti and freeze uncooked for quick future meals

recipes.name: Ossobuco alla Piemontese
recipes.description: Piedmontese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat veal shanks dry with paper towels, season with salt and pepper, then dredge lightly in flour shaking off excess.
Heat olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown veal shanks on all sides for 3 minutes per side, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion, celery, and carrot until softened, about 5 minutes, then stir in minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Deglaze the pot with white wine, scraping up browned bits, then simmer for 3 minutes until slightly reduced.
Return veal shanks to pot, add diced tomatoes and beef broth, bring to a simmer, then cover and cook in a 325°F oven for 2 hours until meat is very tender.
Remove from oven, transfer veal to a serving platter, and tent with foil to keep warm.
Simmer the braising liquid on the stovetop over medium heat for 5 minutes to concentrate flavors, then spoon sauce over veal.
Top with gremolata made by mixing chopped fresh parsley, lemon zest, and minced garlic, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute beef chuck roast cut into thick chunks if veal shank is unavailable or expensive
Use chicken or vegetable broth instead of beef broth to reduce cost without sacrificing much flavor

recipes.name: Carne Cruda all'Albese
recipes.description: Piedmontese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice beef tenderloin into very thin sheets using a sharp knife or meat slicer, or ask the butcher to slice it paper-thin.
Arrange beef slices in a single overlapping layer on a chilled platter.
Whisk together extra virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, sea salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Drizzle olive oil mixture evenly over beef slices.
Using a vegetable peeler, shave thin curls of parmesan cheese directly over the beef.
Sprinkle with fresh minced parsley and a light drizzle of white truffle oil if using.
Serve immediately at room temperature with crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Ask the butcher for beef scraps or trim pieces to reduce cost, though quality matters here
Omit truffle oil to reduce cost while keeping the dish authentic

recipes.name: Tondone di Chieri
recipes.description: Piedmontese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cream together softened butter and sugar in a bowl until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
In another bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Alternate adding dry ingredients and milk to the butter mixture, stirring gently until just combined into a thick dough.
Spoon heaping tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheet, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
cheapTips: Buy butter on sale and freeze it for later baking projects
Use store-brand flour and sugar to reduce ingredient costs significantly

recipes.name: Grissini Torinesi
recipes.description: Piedmontese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and salt in a bowl, then let sit for 2 minutes until foamy.
Stir in olive oil, then gradually add flour while mixing until a stiff dough forms.
Knead dough by hand for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic, then let rest covered for 15 minutes.
Divide dough into 24 equal pieces, roll each piece into a thin rope about 10 inches long and 0.5 inch thick.
Place grissini on oiled baking sheets, brush lightly with olive oil, and sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired.
Let rise uncovered for 15 minutes while preheating oven to 400°F.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown and crisp, turning once halfway through baking.
Cool on wire racks, then store in an airtight container to maintain crispness.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze extras for long shelf-life snacking
Skip sesame seeds to reduce cost further while maintaining authentic flavor

recipes.name: Rana Ripiena
recipes.description: Piedmontese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prepare frogs by patting dry and seasoning inside and out with salt and pepper.
Mix ground veal, chopped prosciutto, fresh herbs, parmesan, and egg in a bowl until combined, then stuff each frog cavity with this mixture.
Heat butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then carefully place stuffed frogs breast-side down and brown for 4 minutes per side.
Pour white wine around the frogs, scraping up any browned bits, then simmer for 3 minutes until wine reduces slightly.
Add chicken broth around the frogs, bring to a simmer, cover loosely, and cook for 45-50 minutes until frogs are tender and cooked through.
Carefully transfer frogs to a serving platter and tent with foil to keep warm.
Simmer the braising liquid over medium heat for 5 minutes to concentrate flavors slightly.
Pour reduced sauce over frogs and serve hot with crusty bread for soaking up the broth.
cheapTips: Source frogs from specialty butchers or farmers markets for better pricing than restaurants
Substitute chicken thighs and drumsticks if frogs are unavailable

recipes.name: Ciabrenette
recipes.description: Piedmontese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice tomatoes into small pieces, discarding excess juice, and transfer to a bowl.
Add minced garlic, chopped fresh basil, salt, and pepper to the tomato mixture.
Drizzle in extra virgin olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then toss gently to combine.
Let tomato mixture sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Slice ciabatta bread on the bias into 0.5-inch thick pieces.
Lightly toast bread slices in a skillet over medium heat for 1 minute per side until just colored but still slightly soft inside.
Top each warm bread slice with a generous spoonful of tomato mixture.
Serve immediately while bread is still warm and tomatoes are fresh.
cheapTips: Use the cheapest day-old or discounted bread from the bakery section
Buy tomatoes in season at farmers markets for the best price and flavor

recipes.name: Galette Complète
recipes.description: Breton lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine buckwheat flour, all-purpose flour, and salt in a bowl.
Gradually whisk in water, stirring constantly, until a smooth thin batter forms with the consistency of heavy cream.
Heat a lightly buttered 8-inch nonstick skillet or crêpe maker over medium-high heat until hot.
Pour 0.5 cup batter into the center and immediately tilt and rotate the pan to spread batter into a thin even circle.
Cook for 1 minute until the bottom is set but the top is still slightly wet, then place a slice of ham in the center, sprinkle cheese around it, and crack an egg into the middle.
Fold the four corners of the galette over the egg like an envelope, creating a square shape with the egg visible in the center.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until the egg white is set but the yolk remains runny, then slide onto a plate.
Repeat with remaining batter and fillings, seasoning each galette with black pepper before serving hot.
cheapTips: Buy buckwheat flour in bulk from specialty stores or online for significant savings
Use less expensive cheese like sharp cheddar in place of gruyere

recipes.name: Kouign-Amann
recipes.description: Breton snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and warm water to form a rough dough, knead for 5 minutes, then cover and let rise for 30 minutes.
Cut cold butter into 12 thin slices and flatten them between plastic wrap with a rolling pin.

Roll out dough on a floured surface into a thin rectangle, place butter slices across two-thirds of the dough, fold the uncovered third over butter, fold again to enclose butter, then roll again gently to seal.
Repeat the folding and rolling process 3 more times at 10-minute intervals, wrapping dough in plastic and resting in the refrigerator between folds.
After the final fold, roll dough into a large rectangle, spread apple jam evenly over the surface, then sprinkle dark brown sugar over the jam.
Cut dough into 12 equal squares, place each square in a buttered muffin tin with the corner pointing up, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F and bake for 25-30 minutes until the pastry is golden brown and sugar has caramelized on the edges.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then carefully remove and cool on a wire rack, serving while still warm.
cheapTips: Make and freeze the laminated dough base in advance to save time on baking day
Use cheaper fruit preserves like apple butter instead of premium jams

recipes.name: Far Breton
recipes.description: Breton dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak pitted prunes in rum or water for 10 minutes until softened, then drain and set aside.
Whisk together flour, sugar, and salt in a large bowl, then make a well in the center.
Add eggs one at a time to the flour mixture, whisking gently to incorporate without creating lumps.
Gradually whisk in milk while stirring, then stir in melted butter and vanilla extract until smooth.
Butter a 9-inch round baking dish or similar-sized pan, pour in half the batter, scatter prunes evenly over the batter, then pour remaining batter over the prunes.
Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 40-45 minutes until the pudding is set around the edges but still slightly jiggly in the center.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Serve warm or at room temperature, as the custard will continue to set as it cools.
cheapTips: Buy prunes in bulk from the dried fruit section or online for significant savings
Use water instead of rum to reduce cost further while maintaining authentic texture

recipes.name: Schwäbische Maultaschsuppe
recipes.description: Swabian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely chop onion and sauté in a pan until softened, then add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Chop spinach finely and mix with cooked beef, bread crumbs, egg, salt, pepper, and nutmeg to form filling.
Make dough by combining flour, 3/4 cup water, 1 egg, and salt; knead until smooth and let rest 20 minutes.
Roll dough thin between plastic wrap, cut into 3-inch squares, fill each with 1 tablespoon meat mixture, fold into triangles and seal edges.
Bring beef broth to boil and gently drop in maultaschen, cooking for 8-10 minutes until they float to surface.
Serve maultaschen in hot broth, garnished with grated Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use frozen spinach instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Schupfnudel
recipes.description: Swabian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes until tender, drain, peel, and mash while still warm until completely smooth.
Mix mashed potatoes with flour, egg, and salt until a soft dough forms.
Shape dough into small finger-like pieces about 3 inches long and 1/2 inch thick.
Boil schupfnudel in salted water until they float and cook 2-3 minutes longer, then drain.
Slice onion thinly and sauté in butter until golden brown, then add sauerkraut and heat through.
Fry cooked schupfnudel in remaining butter until golden on all sides, then toss with sauerkraut mixture and serve.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk when on sale
Use store-brand sauerkraut to reduce costs

recipes.name: Gaisburger Marsch
recipes.description: Swabian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in large pot and brown beef cubes on all sides in batches, then set aside.
Dice onions and sauté in same pot until softened, then stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Return beef to pot, add broth, marjoram, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper, then bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes until beef is nearly tender.
Add diced potatoes to pot and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until potatoes are cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve hot in bowls with crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Use chuck roast on sale and cut into cubes yourself
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for later

recipes.name: Schwäbische Seele
recipes.description: Swabian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix yeast, warm water, and sugar; let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Add flour, salt, and oil to yeast mixture and knead until smooth dough forms; let rise 20 minutes.
Divide dough into 12 pieces and roll each into a rope, then form into pretzel shape.
Bring lye or baking soda solution to simmer (or boil water with 1 tbsp baking soda per cup).
Dip each pretzel briefly in hot lye solution for 30 seconds, then place on parchment paper.
Sprinkle pretzel salt generously on each pretzel and bake at 425°F for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze extras for later
Use baking soda solution instead of lye for safety and lower cost

recipes.name: Laugenbrezel mit Laugenbrezelkäse
recipes.description: Swabian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice pretzels horizontally to open them up without fully separating.
Slice cheese into thin pieces and layer between pretzel halves.
Wrap each filled pretzel loosely in foil and warm in 350°F oven for 5-7 minutes until cheese begins to melt.
Remove from oven and brush warm pretzels with butter.
Sprinkle with caraway seeds and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately while warm and cheese is soft.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand pretzels and cheddar cheese on sale
Make with day-old pretzels from bakery section for discounts

recipes.name: Schwäbischer Wurstsalat
recipes.description: Swabian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice liverwurst into thin matchstick strips or cubes and place in large bowl.
Slice red onions very thinly and add to liverwurst.
Whisk together vinegar, oil, salt, pepper, and caraway seeds in small bowl.
Pour dressing over liverwurst and onions and toss gently to combine.
Slice radishes thinly and add to salad, then let marinate 10 minutes.
Divide salad among plates, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve with crusty bread and mustard.
cheapTips: Buy liverwurst from deli counter by the pound instead of pre-packaged
Use white vinegar instead of apple cider vinegar to save money

recipes.name: Zwetschgenmännle
recipes.description: Swabian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pit each prune plum by cutting lengthwise and removing stone, keeping fruit intact as much as possible.
Place one almond inside each plum where pit was removed.
Cut bacon strips in half crosswise and wrap one piece around each stuffed plum, securing with toothpick if needed.
Heat butter in large skillet over medium-high heat until melted.
Add wrapped plums and cook 3-4 minutes on each side until bacon is crispy and plums are heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy plums at farmers market when in season for best prices
Use cheaper bacon ends and pieces instead of whole strips

recipes.name: Apfelschmarrn
recipes.description: Swabian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and core apples, then slice into thin wedges and toss with cinnamon and 1 tbsp sugar.
Whisk together eggs, milk, flour, sugar, and salt until smooth batter forms.
Heat 2 tbsp butter in large skillet over medium-high heat until foaming.
Add apple slices and sauté 3-4 minutes until softened and light golden.
Pour batter over apples and cook without stirring for 2-3 minutes until bottom is set.
Tear pancake into bite-sized pieces using wooden spoon, then cook 3-4 minutes more until golden and crispy.
Transfer to plate, dust with powdered sugar, and serve warm with applesauce or whipped cream.
cheapTips: Buy apples on sale or at farmers market and freeze extra applesauce
Use generic powdered sugar instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Traubenmostsuppe
recipes.description: Swabian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine grape juice, water, sugar, cinnamon stick, and cloves in pot and bring to simmer.
Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes to infuse spices, then remove cinnamon stick and cloves.
Mix cornstarch with cold water to form slurry and stir into simmering grape soup.
Cook 2-3 minutes while stirring constantly until soup thickens slightly.
Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice to balance sweetness.
Serve warm in bowls, optionally garnished with a thin cinnamon stick or small apple slice.
cheapTips: Use store-brand grape juice instead of fresh must
Buy spices in bulk bins for significant savings

recipes.name: Hefezopf
recipes.description: Swabian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix yeast, warm milk, and 1 tbsp sugar; let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Add flour, remaining sugar, salt, eggs, and softened butter to yeast mixture and knead 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Fold raisins into dough and let rise in oiled bowl covered for 60 minutes until doubled in size.
Punch down dough and divide into three equal strands; roll each strand to 16-inch length.
Braid the three strands together on parchment-lined baking sheet and let rise 30 minutes.
Brush braid with beaten egg yolk, sprinkle with sliced almonds, and bake at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing and serving warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy raisins in bulk bins to save 30% versus pre-packaged
Make two loaves at once and freeze one for later

recipes.name: Rinderroulade
recipes.description: Saxon dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound the beef steaks thin between plastic wrap using a meat mallet.
Spread mustard on each steak, then layer with bacon, onion, and one pickle in the center.
Roll tightly and secure with toothpicks or kitchen twine.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the roulades on all sides for 3 minutes per side.
Sprinkle flour over the roulades and stir to coat.
Pour in red wine and beef broth, then simmer covered for 45-50 minutes until beef is tender.
Remove roulades and tent with foil to keep warm.
Reduce sauce by simmering 10 minutes, then pour over roulades and serve.
cheapTips: Use beef chuck instead of round steaks for lower cost
Buy dill pickles in bulk and freeze bacon ends for later use

recipes.name: Sächsischer Hefekuchen
recipes.description: Saxon breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm milk with 1 tablespoon sugar and let sit 5 minutes.
Mix flour, salt, and remaining sugar in a large bowl.
Add yeast mixture, egg, melted butter, and vanilla to flour mixture and knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth.
Cover bowl and let rise in warm place for 1 hour until doubled.
Punch down dough and spread into a greased 9x13 inch baking pan.
Cover and let rise again for 30-40 minutes.
Bake at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
Mix powdered sugar and water, then drizzle over warm cake.
cheapTips: Make your own powdered sugar by blending granulated sugar
Buy yeast in bulk and store in freezer for long shelf life

recipes.name: Krautwickel
recipes.description: Saxon dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and blanch cabbage leaves for 3-4 minutes until pliable, then set aside.
Brown onion in butter, then mix with ground beef, cooked rice, egg, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Place 2-3 tablespoons of filling on each cabbage leaf and roll tightly, tucking in the sides.
Pour beef broth into a baking dish and arrange cabbage rolls seam-side down.
Mix tomato sauce with 1/2 cup water and pour over rolls.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 50-60 minutes.
Remove foil and bake additional 10 minutes until lightly browned.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use ground chuck instead of lean beef
Save outer cabbage leaves for soup instead of discarding

recipes.name: Sächsische Blasewurst
recipes.description: Saxon lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chill all meat and grinder parts in freezer for 30 minutes.
Grind pork shoulder, fat, and liver through a fine grinder into a cold bowl.
Mix in salt, pepper, marjoram, garlic, and ice water until sticky and well combined.
Soak hog casings in warm water for 10 minutes to soften.
Stuff casings with meat mixture using a sausage stuffer, making links about 4 inches long.
Bring broth to a gentle simmer and carefully add sausages.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until sausages float and are cooked through.
Remove and serve hot with mustard and bread, or pan-fry until browned.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze; ask butcher for liver scraps
Purchase hog casings in bulk from specialty butcher for savings

recipes.name: Laugenbrezel
recipes.description: Swabian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water with sugar, let sit 5 minutes.
Mix flour and salt in a large bowl, add yeast mixture and melted butter, knead 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise 1 hour until doubled in size.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces, roll each into a rope and twist into pretzel shape.
Place pretzels on parchment paper and let rise 30 minutes.
Bring 4 cups water to boil, dissolve baking soda (simulates lye bath), then dip each pretzel for 15 seconds.
Place dipped pretzels on baking sheet, brush with egg wash, sprinkle coarse salt.
Bake at 425°F for 15-18 minutes until deep golden brown.
cheapTips: Use baking soda instead of food-grade lye for safety and cost
Buy yeast in bulk packets and freeze for multiple batches

recipes.name: Linsen mit Spätzle
recipes.description: Swabian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring vegetable broth to boil, add lentils, onion, and carrot, simmer 30-35 minutes until lentils are tender.
While lentils cook, whisk together flour, eggs, 1/4 cup water, and salt to form a thick batter.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and fill a colander with small holes with batter.
Hold colander over boiling water and scrape batter through holes to create small noodles, boil 2-3 minutes until they float.
Remove spätzle with a slotted spoon and toss with 1 tablespoon butter in a bowl.
Season lentils with remaining butter, nutmeg, salt, and pepper to taste.
Divide spätzle among bowls and ladle lentil mixture over top.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy lentils in bulk from the bin section
Make spätzle using a cheese grater if you don't have a colander

recipes.name: Schwäbischer Kartoffelsalat
recipes.description: Swabian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15-18 minutes until just tender, then drain and cool slightly.
Peel warm potatoes and slice into 1/4 inch thick rounds.
Combine beef broth, vinegar, and sugar in a saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Place sliced potatoes in a large bowl, pour warm broth mixture over them, and gently toss to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together oil, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Pour mustard vinaigrette over potatoes and fold gently until coated.
Add diced onion, chives, and parsley, then toss carefully to combine.
Let salad rest 10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to blend.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk bags and store in cool, dark place
Use homemade vegetable scraps broth instead of store-bought

recipes.name: Linseneintopf
recipes.description: Swabian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté onion, carrot, and celery for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, potatoes, tomato paste, and bay leaf, stir well.
Pour vegetable broth into pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 40-45 minutes until lentils and vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Remove bay leaf and serve hot as a hearty soup-stew.
Ladle into bowls and accompany with crusty bread.
Leftover stew can be refrigerated and reheated for up to 4 days.
cheapTips: Buy lentils and vegetables in bulk or seasonal sales
Make large batches and freeze portions for quick weeknight meals

recipes.name: Schwäbischer Sauerbraten
recipes.description: Swabian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine vinegar, wine, onion, carrot, celery, juniper berries, and bay leaves in a large bowl with beef.
Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 24-48 hours, turning occasionally.
Remove beef from marinade and pat dry with paper towels, reserve marinade.
Strain marinade, reserving liquid and vegetables separately, discard bay leaves and juniper berries.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown beef on all sides, 3-4 minutes per side.
Sprinkle flour over beef and brown for 1 minute, add reserved vegetables and sauté 3 minutes.
Pour marinade liquid and beef broth over beef, bring to simmer, cover and cook 2-2.5 hours until very tender.
Remove beef and tent with foil, strain sauce and stir in sugar, then simmer 5 minutes and pour over beef.
cheapTips: Buy chuck roast on sale and freeze up to 3 months
Make entire dish one day ahead for better flavor development

recipes.name: Flädle
recipes.description: Swabian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until smooth batter forms, let rest 15 minutes.
Heat 1/2 tablespoon oil in a 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter into skillet and quickly tilt to spread thin, cook 1 minute until light golden, flip and cook 30 seconds.
Slide crepe onto a cutting board and repeat with remaining batter, stacking crepes between parchment paper.
Cut each cooled crepe into strips about 1/2 inch wide.
Melt butter in pot and sauté minced onion for 2 minutes, add chopped parsley.
Bring beef broth to simmer and add crepe strips, cook 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot as a comforting soup.
cheapTips: Make crepes ahead and refrigerate up to 2 days
Use homemade broth made from vegetable scraps and chicken bones

recipes.name: Taramosalata
recipes.description: Cypriot snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove crusts from bread and soak in water for 2 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Place fish roe and soaked bread in a food processor with minced garlic and salt.
Pulse until combined, then slowly drizzle in olive oil while processing until creamy.
Add lemon juice and water alternately, continuing to blend until pale and fluffy.
Season with white pepper and adjust salt to taste.
Transfer to a serving bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish roe when available for lower cost
Use day-old bread from bakery discount sections

recipes.name: Youvetsi
recipes.description: Cypriot dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown beef pieces on all sides for 8 minutes total, then remove.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in the same pot until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, beef broth, cinnamon stick, and bay leaf back with the meat.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes until meat is tender.
Stir in orzo pasta and simmer for 15 minutes until pasta is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper, remove cinnamon stick and bay leaf.
Serve hot with grated Pecorino Romano cheese on top.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck roast and cut into cubes for savings versus pre-cut stew meat
Use store-brand pasta and canned tomatoes

recipes.name: Sheftalia
recipes.description: Cypriot lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak caul fat or bacon strips in warm water for 10 minutes to soften.
Combine ground pork and beef with finely diced onion, minced parsley, coriander seeds, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Form meat mixture into 8 oblong patties about 3 inches long and 1 inch thick.
Wrap each patty with caul fat or bacon strips, overlapping to enclose completely.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook sheftalia for 6-7 minutes per side until golden brown.
Cook until internal temperature reaches 160°F when checked with a meat thermometer.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and pita bread.
cheapTips: Substitute bacon for hard-to-find caul fat
Buy meat from bulk bins or butcher section for discounts

recipes.name: Soupa Avgolemo
recipes.description: Cypriot lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot with halved onion and add chicken breast.
Simmer chicken for 15 minutes until cooked through, then remove and shred into bite-sized pieces.
Return shredded chicken to broth, add rice, and simmer for 15 minutes until rice is tender.
Whisk eggs in a bowl until pale, then slowly whisk in lemon juice.
Remove pot from heat and very slowly drizzle egg mixture into hot broth while stirring constantly to create ribbons.
Season with salt, white pepper, and fresh dill.
Serve immediately while hot, being careful not to boil after adding egg mixture.
cheapTips: Use store-brand chicken broth and rice
Buy whole chicken and use breasts, freeze bones for homemade broth

recipes.name: Gliko Koutaliou
recipes.description: Cypriot snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine sugar, water, lemon juice, cinnamon stick, and cloves in a saucepan and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until sugar fully dissolves.
Add walnuts to the syrup and stir gently, simmering for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in honey.
Let cool to room temperature while still in syrup for at least 20 minutes.
Spoon walnut preserves into serving glasses with some syrup.
Serve at room temperature as a spoon sweet with coffee or Greek yogurt.
cheapTips: Buy walnuts from bulk bins to save significantly
Make large batches to store in jars for weeks

recipes.name: Maftoul
recipes.description: Druze lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cumin, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add maftoul to the pot and toast for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer for 12-15 minutes until maftoul is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy maftoul in bulk from Middle Eastern markets
Use vegetable broth from cartons or homemade instead of bouillon

recipes.name: Halva
recipes.description: Druze snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour tahini into a large mixing bowl and stir until smooth and creamy.
Gradually mix in oil, one tablespoon at a time, stirring continuously until fully incorporated and light colored.
Add vanilla extract and salt, stirring well.
Sift in powdered sugar gradually while continuing to mix until the mixture becomes thick and dough-like.
Transfer to a greased 8x8 inch pan and press down firmly with an oiled spatula.
Smooth the top and garnish with chopped pistachios, pressing them gently into the surface.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small squares and serve chilled.
cheapTips: Buy tahini and oil from bulk bins to reduce cost
Use regular crushed peanuts instead of pistachios for savings

recipes.name: Fattah
recipes.description: Druze lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and cut pita bread into triangles.
Toss pita triangles with 1 tablespoon olive oil, spread on baking sheet, and bake for 10 minutes until crispy.
Rinse and drain chickpeas, then warm in a pot with 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Blend tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, water, and salt in a food processor until creamy.
Spread tahini sauce on a serving platter in a shallow bowl shape.
Spoon warm chickpeas into the center of the tahini sauce.
Top with crispy pita chips, drizzle with remaining olive oil, sprinkle paprika and parsley, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas on sale and stock up
Use store-brand tahini and lemon juice concentrate

recipes.name: Maftoul with Chicken
recipes.description: Druze lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and cook chicken breasts for 5-6 minutes per side until golden, then remove and cut into bite-sized pieces.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion and minced garlic in remaining oil until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add maftoul and toast for 2 minutes while stirring.
Pour in chicken broth and return chicken to the pot, adding cinnamon and allspice.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until maftoul is tender.
In a small skillet, lightly toast pine nuts over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until fragrant and golden.
Season with salt and pepper, top with toasted pine nuts, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Toast sunflower seeds instead of pine nuts for significant savings

recipes.name: Zaatar Manakish
recipes.description: Druze breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and a pinch of sugar in a bowl, let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour and salt in a large bowl, make a well in the center, and pour in yeast mixture and 2 tablespoons olive oil.
Mix and knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, adding water if needed.
Let dough rise covered for 20 minutes until puffy.
Divide dough into 8 pieces and flatten each into thin ovals about 8 inches long.
Mix zaatar with lemon juice and 1 tablespoon olive oil, spread generously on each dough piece.
Bake on a preheated 425°F baking sheet for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and crispy on edges.
cheapTips: Make zaatar blend at home from dried thyme, sumac, and sesame seeds
Buy all-purpose flour in bulk from wholesale stores

recipes.name: Warak Enab
recipes.description: Druze lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion until translucent.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Stir in rice, tomato paste, mint, parsley, salt, and pepper, cooking for 2 minutes.
Rinse grape leaves and lay one flat, placing 2 tablespoons of filling in the center.
Roll the leaf tightly, folding in the sides, and place seam-side down in the pot.
Arrange rolls in layers, pour vegetable broth over them, and cover with remaining leaves.
Cover the pot and simmer for 45 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy jarred grape leaves instead of fresh for consistent availability and cost
Use ground beef on sale or substitute with ground lamb for authentic flavor

recipes.name: Tocană de Ciuperci
recipes.description: Transylvanian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pan over medium-high heat and sauté onion until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they release moisture.
Sprinkle flour over mushrooms and stir well to coat evenly.
Pour in vegetable broth and paprika, bring to a simmer, and cook for 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and stir in sour cream until fully combined and smooth.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh dill, and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Serve hot over egg noodles or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy mushrooms in bulk and slice them yourself rather than pre-sliced
Use frozen mushrooms if fresh are unavailable or expensive

recipes.name: Fasole cu Ciorbă
recipes.description: Transylvanian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried beans in water overnight, then drain and rinse.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown pork cubes on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Sauté onion, carrots, and garlic in the same pot until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and paprika, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return pork to the pot with beans, beef broth, and bay leaf, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 60 minutes until beans are tender and pork is cooked through.
Stir in apple cider vinegar for a tangy flavor characteristic of the dish.
Season with salt and pepper, and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy dried beans in bulk from the store's bulk section for lowest cost
Use pork shoulder on sale or substitute with beef chuck for similar results

recipes.name: Mâncare de Burtă
recipes.description: Transylvanian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil tripe in salted water for 30 minutes to remove odor and soften, then drain and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Melt butter in a large pot and sauté onion until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tripe cubes and brown them lightly for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and paprika, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in beef broth, add bay leaf and thyme, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes until tripe is tender.
Stir in sour cream and vinegar, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Remove herbs and serve hot with polenta or crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy tripe from ethnic markets or butcher shops where it is significantly cheaper
Ask the butcher to pre-clean the tripe to save significant preparation time

recipes.name: Cordon Bleu à la Roumaine
recipes.description: Transylvanian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breasts until thin and even, about 0.25 inch thick.
Place one slice of ham and one slice of cheese on each chicken breast.
Roll tightly and secure with toothpicks if needed.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour in the first, beaten eggs in the second, and breadcrumbs mixed with salt and pepper in the third.
Coat each roll in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing gently so coating adheres.
Heat oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry each cordon bleu for 8 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Use deli ham slices instead of specialty cuts to save cost

recipes.name: Plăcintă cu Mere
recipes.description: Transylvanian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in sour cream and egg until dough comes together, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Toss apple slices with sugar and cinnamon in a bowl.
Divide dough into two portions and roll each between parchment paper to about 0.125 inch thickness.
Transfer one dough sheet to a greased baking sheet.
Arrange apple mixture evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border.
Top with the second dough sheet, pressing edges to seal, and brush with water or milk.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes until golden brown.
Cool slightly, dust with powdered sugar, and cut into squares before serving.
cheapTips: Buy apples in season or use canned apple pie filling for lower cost
Make dough in advance and freeze for quick assembly later

recipes.name: Friptură cu Sos de Smântână
recipes.description: Transylvanian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season beef steaks generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over high heat and sear steaks for 4 minutes per side until browned, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, melt remaining butter and sauté onion and mushrooms until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir to coat, cooking for 1 minute.
Pour in beef broth, scraping up browned bits, and bring to a simmer.
Return steaks to the pan and simmer for 5 minutes to finish cooking.
Remove pan from heat, stir in sour cream until smooth, season with salt and pepper, and garnish with parsley.
Serve immediately with egg noodles or mashed potatoes.
cheapTips: Use sirloin steak instead of ribeye to reduce cost while maintaining quality
Buy mushrooms on sale and freeze for later use in this dish

recipes.name: Parjoale
recipes.description: Transylvanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Squeeze milk from the soaked bread and add bread to a bowl with ground meat, onion, garlic, egg, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Mix until well combined but do not overmix.
Shape mixture into oval patties about 2 inches long and 1 inch thick.
Dust patties lightly with flour on both sides.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry patties for 4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with mustard, bread, and fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze in portions for easy weeknight meals
Use day-old bread to stretch the budget further

recipes.name: Ciorba de Burtă cu Smântână
recipes.description: Transylvanian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blanch tripe in boiling salted water for 20 minutes to remove odor, drain and rinse well.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté onion, carrots, celery, and garlic for 8 minutes until softened.
Add diced tripe and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in tomato paste and paprika, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in beef broth, add bay leaves and thyme, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 90 minutes until tripe is very tender.
Remove from heat and cool slightly, then stir in sour cream gently until fully incorporated.
Stir in vinegar for the characteristic sour flavor, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy tripe from an ethnic butcher or specialty market for best prices
Make a double batch and freeze portions for quick meals later

recipes.name: Salată de Burtă
recipes.description: Transylvanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil tripe in salted water for 40 minutes until tender, then drain and cool.
Cut cooled tripe into small cubes and place in a large bowl.
Add diced onion, carrot, and pickles to the tripe.
Whisk together oil, vinegar, pickle juice, paprika, salt, and pepper in a separate bowl.
Pour dressing over tripe mixture and toss gently but thoroughly.
Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in fresh parsley and gently fold in chopped hard-boiled eggs.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, then serve chilled or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy tripe in bulk and make multiple batches of this dish for meal prep
Use budget-friendly dill pickle spears and chop them yourself

recipes.name: Kaminwurzer
recipes.description: Tyrolean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the smoked sausage into thick rounds about 1/2 inch thick.
Dice the onion finely and heat butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and caraway seeds to the pot and cook until onion is golden, about 4 minutes.
Add the sausage slices and brown them lightly on both sides, about 3 minutes.
Pour in the beef broth and bring to a simmer.
Toast the dark bread slices and place them in serving bowls.
Ladle the hot sausage broth over the bread and season with salt and pepper.
cheapTips: Use budget smoked sausage brands instead of premium varieties
Buy day-old bread at a discount

recipes.name: Tyrolean Sauerkraut
recipes.description: Tyrolean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop bacon into small pieces and cook in a large pot until crispy, then set aside.
Dice the onion and sauté it in the bacon fat over medium heat until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the drained sauerkraut and caraway seeds to the pot.
Peel and slice the apple and add it along with juniper berries and bay leaf.
Pour in the beef broth and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Return the bacon to the pot and season with salt and pepper to taste.
cheapTips: Buy sauerkraut in bulk from the deli section rather than canned
Use regular bacon ends which are cheaper than sliced bacon

recipes.name: Tiroler Fleischknödel
recipes.description: Tyrolean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice the onion and mix it with ground beef, bread crumbs, eggs, parmesan, milk, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Let the mixture rest for 10 minutes.
Bring the beef broth to a boil in a large pot.
Using wet hands, form the meat mixture into 8 large balls about 3 inches in diameter.
Carefully drop the knödel into the boiling broth and reduce heat to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 20-25 minutes until the knödel float to the surface and are cooked through.
Serve in bowls with broth and garnish with fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Use store-brand ground beef instead of premium cuts
Make your own bread crumbs from stale bread

recipes.name: Erdäpfelsuppe mit Sauerrahm
recipes.description: Tyrolean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube the potatoes into 1/2-inch pieces.
Dice the onion, celery, and carrot.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté the onion, celery, and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add the potato cubes and vegetable broth, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in the sour cream and fresh chives, heating through without boiling.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk and store in a cool place
Use plain yogurt instead of sour cream to save money

recipes.name: Zuppa d'Orzo
recipes.description: Tyrolean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and mince the garlic.
Dice the onion, carrot, and celery and sauté in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the pearl barley and stir to coat with oil, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in the beef broth and canned tomatoes with their juice.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 35-40 minutes until barley is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy pearl barley in bulk from the grains section
Use canned diced tomatoes instead of whole for easier prep

recipes.name: Buchweizenpuffer
recipes.description: Tyrolean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix buckwheat flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Whisk together the milk and eggs, then pour into the dry ingredients.
Stir until just combined, leaving the batter slightly lumpy.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drop large spoonfuls of batter into the skillet and flatten slightly.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve warm with applesauce and a dollop of sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy buckwheat flour in bulk from health food stores
Make your own applesauce instead of buying jarred

recipes.name: Taktouka
recipes.description: Berber snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the zucchini, tomatoes, and onion into 1/2-inch pieces.
Mince the garlic finely.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic, cooking until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the zucchini and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the tomatoes, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper, and stir well.
Simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender and flavors meld.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy seasonal zucchini and tomatoes from farmers markets
Use dried cilantro if fresh is expensive

recipes.name: Tfeztout
recipes.description: Berber lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried chickpeas in water for at least 8 hours, then drain.
Dice the onions and mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onions and garlic for 4 minutes.
