Add coriander, cumin, and paprika, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Add the drained chickpeas and 6 cups of fresh water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes until chickpeas are tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve in bowls as a thick stew.
cheapTips: Buy dried chickpeas in bulk instead of canned
Make large batches and freeze for future meals

recipes.name: Amina
recipes.description: Berber lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut lamb into 1.5-inch cubes and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 3 minutes per side.
Remove lamb and set aside, then sauté diced onions and minced garlic until golden, about 4 minutes.
Add ginger, cinnamon, and cumin to the pot and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return the lamb to the pot and pour in the chicken broth.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 30 minutes.
Add the dried apricots and cook for another 15 minutes until lamb is very tender.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy lamb stew meat from bulk sections rather than pre-packaged
Use dried fruit sold in bulk bins instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Kabab Mkalli
recipes.description: Berber lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince the onions and garlic finely, and chop the cilantro and parsley.
Mix ground beef with onion, garlic, herbs, cinnamon, paprika, cumin, and egg in a bowl.
Knead the mixture for 2 minutes until it holds together well.
Divide into 12 equal portions and shape into thick, oval patties.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Place the kabab patties in the skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes on the first side until brown.
Flip carefully and cook the other side for another 4 minutes until cooked through.
Serve hot with bread or over couscous.
cheapTips: Use store-brand ground beef instead of premium cuts
Buy fresh herbs in bulk and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Mici cu Mustață
recipes.description: Transylvanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground beef, pork, bread crumbs, garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Add egg and water, mix until the mixture holds together.
Shape into 8-10 small oblong sausages with your hands, wetting hands to prevent sticking.
Heat oil in a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Grill mici for 3-4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Serve hot with mustard and fresh bread.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze for later
Use store-brand paprika instead of imported brands

recipes.name: Ghiveci Transilvănean
recipes.description: Transylvanian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté onion and garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add bell peppers and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Add eggplant and zucchini, cook for 5 minutes stirring occasionally.
Stir in canned tomatoes, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 30-35 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving hot.
cheapTips: Buy seasonal vegetables at farmers markets
Use canned tomatoes year-round for consistent pricing

recipes.name: Kebab Koobideh
recipes.description: Kurdish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground lamb, minced onion, parsley, garlic, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Divide mixture into 8 portions and mold each onto metal skewers in a long oval shape.
Heat oil in a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat.
Grill kebabs for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and browned.
Serve immediately on warm flatbread with tomatoes and onions.
cheapTips: Buy lamb when on sale and freeze portions
Use regular onions instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Tikka
recipes.description: Kurdish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Add chicken cubes and coat thoroughly with marinade.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a grill pan over medium-high heat.
Thread chicken pieces onto skewers and grill for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Serve hot with rice or flatbread and lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy chicken when on sale and marinate before freezing
Make your own yogurt marinade instead of buying prepared versions

recipes.name: Tishtrip
recipes.description: Kurdish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight, then drain and rinse.
Heat oil in a large pot and brown beef cubes on all sides, remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onions and garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Return beef to pot with chickpeas, cumin, salt, pepper, and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 60-70 minutes until beef and chickpeas are tender.
Adjust seasoning and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy dried chickpeas in bulk and prepare large batches
Use chuck roast on sale and freeze portioned cubes

recipes.name: Kubbeh
recipes.description: Kurdish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bulgur in warm water for 15 minutes until softened, then drain excess water.
Brown ground lamb with half the onion and garlic, add cumin, salt, and pepper; set filling aside and cool.
Sauté remaining onion and garlic in oil until golden, set aside for sauce.
Mix bulgur with ground meat and remaining seasonings to form a dough.
Wet your hands and form small oval shells, fill each with lamb mixture and seal carefully.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry kubbeh in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden and floating.
Drain on paper towels and serve with the onion-garlic sauce or broth.
cheapTips: Buy bulgur in bulk from Middle Eastern markets
Toast your own pine nuts to save money

recipes.name: Flatbread with Cheese
recipes.description: Kurdish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 2 tablespoons for dough plus more for co

steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, create a well in the center.
Add water and oil, mix until a shaggy dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide dough into 8 pieces and roll into thin discs.
Combine feta cheese, mint, and nigella seeds in a bowl.
Place cheese mixture on one half of each disc and fold in half.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook each flatbread for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Serve warm with plain yogurt or labneh.
cheapTips: Buy feta cheese from bulk bins for better pricing
Use dried mint if fresh is unavailable and expensive

recipes.name: Dushbara
recipes.description: Kurdish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, water, and salt to form a stiff dough; knead until smooth and rest for 15 minutes.
Brown ground meat with onion and garlic, season with turmeric and pepper; cool slightly.
Roll dough thin and cut into small squares, place a teaspoon of meat mixture in center of each.
Fold each square into a triangle and press edges to seal, then fold corners together to form a pouch.
Bring broth to a boil and add dumplings in batches.
Cook for 8-10 minutes until dumplings float and are tender.
Add chickpeas and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Serve hot in broth with fresh herbs.
cheapTips: Make dumplings in advance and freeze before cooking
Use store-brand broth instead of making homemade

recipes.name: Shorba
recipes.description: Kurdish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown beef on all sides, remove and set aside.
Sauté onions and garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return beef to pot with broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 35-40 minutes until beef is tender.
Add chickpeas and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Taste and adjust seasonings, serve hot in bowls with bread.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck and cube it yourself for better value
Use dried chickpeas soaked overnight instead of canned

recipes.name: Kubideh
recipes.description: Kurdish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground beef, minced onion, parsley, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper until combined.
Divide mixture into 8 portions and mold each onto flat metal skewers in an elongated oval shape.
Heat oil in a grill pan over medium-high heat.
Grill kubideh for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and lightly charred.
Slide kubideh off skewers onto warm flatbread.
Top with diced tomatoes, onions, and fresh herbs.
Serve immediately with plain yogurt on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk when on sale and freeze portions
Skip specialty flatbreads and use regular white bread

recipes.name: Lakror
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13 inch baking pan.
Sauté leeks and potatoes in butter over medium heat for 10 minutes until softened.
Season vegetables with salt and pepper, add water, and simmer 5 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Brush each phyllo sheet with melted butter and layer 6-8 sheets in the pan.
Spread vegetable mixture evenly over phyllo, then layer remaining 6-8 phyllo sheets with butter between each.
Beat eggs and brush over top layer of phyllo.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
Cool for 5 minutes, cut into squares, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough at discount grocery stores or ethnic markets for 30% less
Use regular potatoes instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Qofte
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine ground beef, onion, garlic, bread crumbs, egg, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Mix gently with your hands until just combined, being careful not to overwork the meat.
Form mixture into 12-16 oval-shaped meatballs, about 2 inches long.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add meatballs and cook 3-4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and serve warm with fresh bread or yogurt.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Substitute half the meat with finely chopped mushrooms to stretch the recipe

recipes.name: Pani i Mëlçisë
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté onions until soft.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Season liver slices with salt and pepper, then add to skillet and cook 2 minutes per side until browned.
Remove liver from pan and set aside.
Stir tomato paste into the pan, cook 1 minute, then add beef broth and paprika.
Return liver to pan, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.
Serve hot with rice or crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy liver from the butcher counter for better prices than packaged varieties
Use homemade or less expensive broth rather than premium brands

recipes.name: Speca të Mbushur
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cut tops off peppers and remove seeds and membranes, leaving pepper walls intact.
Brown ground beef with chopped onion in olive oil, then stir in uncooked rice.
Mix in 1/2 cup tomato sauce, salt, and pepper.
Stuff each pepper with meat-rice mixture and place upright in a baking dish.
Combine remaining tomato sauce with beef broth and pour around the peppers.
Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes until peppers are tender.
Remove foil, let rest 5 minutes, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use red or yellow bell peppers when on sale instead of always buying green
Substitute canned diced tomatoes mixed with tomato paste for tomato sauce

recipes.name: Fasule të Kuqe
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion until softened.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add drained beans, vegetable broth, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Mash some beans against the side of the pot to thicken the stew.
Taste and adjust seasonings if needed.
Serve hot with crusty bread or over rice.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans in bulk or on sale and store in the pantry
Use water instead of vegetable broth to reduce costs further

recipes.name: Këfte të Përziera
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix beef, pork, onion, bread crumbs, egg, garlic, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Form mixture into 16-20 oval meatballs, about 1.5 inches long.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add meatballs in a single layer and cook 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Work in batches if needed to avoid crowding the pan.
Transfer cooked meatballs to a serving plate.
Serve warm with yogurt, fresh onions, and bread.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork when on sale and freeze until needed
Make bread crumbs from stale bread in a food processor

recipes.name: Pite me Spinaq
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13 inch baking pan.
Mix drained spinach, feta, onion, eggs, salt, pepper, and nutmeg in a bowl.
Brush each phyllo sheet with melted butter and layer 6 sheets in the pan.
Spread spinach-feta mixture evenly over phyllo.
Layer remaining phyllo sheets on top, brushing each with butter.
Brush final layer generously with butter and cut into diagonal or square portions.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Cool 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough at ethnic markets for better prices
Use store-brand feta cheese instead of imported varieties

recipes.name: Burek me Mish
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Brown ground beef with onion and garlic over medium-high heat, breaking apart as it cooks.
Season with salt and pepper, stir in water, and simmer 5 minutes until slightly reduced.
Cool meat mixture slightly.
Melt butter in a small pan.
Brush a 9x13 inch baking pan with butter and layer 4-5 phyllo sheets with butter between each.
Spread meat mixture evenly over phyllo.
Layer remaining phyllo sheets on top, brushing each with butter.
Brush top with beaten egg, score into portions, and bake 35-40 minutes until golden.
Cool 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use 80/20 ground beef instead of leaner varieties to save money
Buy butter at discount stores or use vegetable oil as a partial substitute

recipes.name: Pershesh
recipes.description: Albanian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt in a bowl, then add water and 1/4 cup oil.
Knead for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide dough into 8 equal portions and let rest 10 minutes.
Roll each portion very thin into a 6-inch round.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Fry each round 1-2 minutes per side until puffed and golden.
Drain on paper towels, then brush with melted butter.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with walnuts, then serve warm.
cheapTips: Use vegetable oil instead of expensive specialty oils
Buy walnuts in bulk from the baking aisle

recipes.name: Petulla
recipes.description: Albanian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk milk, eggs, and 1/4 cup oil together in another bowl.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and stir until a thick batter forms.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Drop batter by spoonfuls into hot oil, frying 2-3 minutes per side until puffed and golden.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Drizzle warm petulla with honey and dust with powdered sugar.
Serve immediately while still warm.
cheapTips: Buy baking powder in bulk packages from warehouse stores
Use store-brand honey instead of premium varieties

recipes.name: Wali wa Tangawizi
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then drain thoroughly.
Heat butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté the minced ginger for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the rinsed rice to the pot and stir to coat with butter, toasting for 2 minutes.
Pour in the water and coconut milk, add salt, pepper, and cardamom pods, then stir well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-18 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat and let sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and serve.
cheapTips: Buy ginger root in bulk and freeze for later use
Use canned coconut milk which is cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Boudin Créole
recipes.description: Antillean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak the sausage casings in warm water for 30 minutes according to package directions.
Heat oil in a large skillet and sauté onions and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add ground pork to the pan, breaking it up as it cooks until browned, about 8 minutes.
Stir in thyme, scallions, habanero pepper, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper, cooking for 3 more minutes.
Allow the mixture to cool slightly, then carefully stuff into the prepared casings using a piping bag or sausage stuffer.
Coil the boudin and secure with toothpicks if needed.
Pan-fry the boudin in a skillet over medium-high heat for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze for later
Omit casings and form into patties to save money

recipes.name: Callaloo
recipes.description: Antillean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped callaloo or spinach and stir until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and coconut milk, then add the whole scotch bonnet pepper and okra.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 15-20 minutes until okra is tender and flavors meld.
Remove the scotch bonnet pepper carefully, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use frozen spinach instead of fresh callaloo for significant savings
Buy okra during peak season and freeze

recipes.name: Cou-Cou
recipes.description: Barbadian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a large pot and sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add sliced okra and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally until it releases its starch and thickens slightly.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a boil, add thyme, salt, and pepper.
Slowly whisk in cornmeal in a steady stream to avoid lumps, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat to low and stir continuously for 10-15 minutes until the mixture is thick and pulls away from the sides of the pot.
Transfer to a serving dish or shape onto a plate and serve hot, traditionally with a tomato-based sauce.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from ethnic or wholesale stores
Use frozen okra which is cheaper and equally good

recipes.name: Fried Bakes
recipes.description: Trinidadian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt together in a large bowl.
Cut in the butter with a fork or your fingers until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Gradually add warm water while stirring until a soft dough forms, being careful not to overwork it.
Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead gently for 2-3 minutes.
Divide dough into 6 pieces and roll each into an oval about 1/4 inch thick.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and carefully fry bakes until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with cheese, saltfish, or jam.
cheapTips: Make dough in batches and freeze for quick breakfasts
Use vegetable oil instead of specialty oils

recipes.name: Goat Stew
recipes.description: Antillean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown the goat meat in batches on all sides, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onion, garlic, and celery for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add beef broth and return the meat to the pot.
Add thyme, hot pepper, salt, and pepper, then bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 45 minutes until the meat is tender, stirring occasionally.
Add potatoes and carrots, then cover and simmer for another 20-25 minutes until vegetables are soft.
Remove the hot pepper, adjust seasonings, and serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy goat meat from ethnic butchers where it's cheaper
Substitute with beef stew meat if goat is unavailable

recipes.name: Lambi
recipes.description: Haitian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chopped conch in a bowl and marinate with lime juice for 15 minutes to tenderize.
Drain conch and rinse well under cold water, then pat dry.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté onion, garlic, and bell peppers for 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the conch meat and brown it for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in vegetable broth, add thyme, hot pepper, salt, and pepper, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45-50 minutes until conch is tender, stirring occasionally.
Adjust seasonings and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Check ethnic markets for frozen conch which is cheaper than fresh
Substitute with squid if conch is unavailable

recipes.name: Pepperpot
recipes.description: Guyanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large heavy pot and brown beef cubes on all sides in batches, then remove and set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in the same pot for 5 minutes, then add hot peppers.
Return beef to pot and add cassareep, stirring well to coat all meat.
Add beef broth, cinnamon stick, cloves, and thyme, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 60 minutes until beef is tender, stirring occasionally.
Add potatoes and continue simmering for 25-30 minutes until vegetables are soft.
Season with salt and pepper, remove cinnamon stick, and serve hot as a stew.
cheapTips: Buy cassareep online in bulk to reduce per-serving cost
Use beef chuck which is an economical cut

recipes.name: Pigeon Peas and Rice
recipes.description: Antillean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear, then drain well.
Heat butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add rice to the pot and stir to coat with butter, toasting for 2 minutes.
Pour in water and coconut milk, add drained pigeon peas, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-18 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat, let sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and serve.
cheapTips: Buy canned pigeon peas in bulk from ethnic markets
Use regular coconut milk which is less expensive than premium brands

recipes.name: Salt Cod Fritters
recipes.description: Antillean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod in water for 12-24 hours, changing water every 6 hours to remove excess salt.
Drain and shred the desalted cod with a fork, removing any bones or skin.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
In another bowl, combine shredded cod, onion, garlic, hot pepper, and cilantro.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, then gradually stir in water until a thick batter forms.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and drop spoonfuls of batter into the hot oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy, then drain on paper towels and serve hot with lime.
cheapTips: Buy salt cod from ethnic markets which have better prices
Make larger batches and freeze uncooked fritters

recipes.name: Krofne
recipes.description: Albanian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk to 110°F and dissolve yeast with 1 teaspoon sugar in it, then let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour, remaining sugar, and salt in a bowl, then make a well and add yeast mixture, 2 eggs, 2 tablespoons oil, and vanilla.
Knead dough for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and let rise 45 minutes until doubled.
Divide dough into 12 pieces and roll each into a ball, then flatten slightly and place on parchment paper.
Let dough balls rise uncovered for 20 minutes until puffy.
Heat 2 cups oil to 350°F in a deep pan, then carefully fry krofne 2-3 at a time for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Transfer to paper towels to drain, then immediately coat in a mixture of cinnamon and powdered sugar while warm.
cheapTips: Use store-brand flour and sugar to reduce costs
Make a larger batch to freeze unbaked balls

recipes.name: Revani
recipes.description: Albanian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix semolina, flour, yogurt, oil, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, and salt until combined, then pour into a greased 8x8 baking pan.
Smooth the batter and cut into 12 squares, then place one almond on top of each square.
Bake at 350°F for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
While cake bakes, combine water, remaining sugar, and lemon juice in a saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour hot syrup over hot cake immediately after removing from oven and let cool completely before serving.
cheapTips: Skip the almonds or use chopped peanuts as a budget alternative
Buy semolina in bulk from ethnic markets

recipes.name: Kadaif
recipes.description: Albanian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix chopped walnuts with 1/4 cup sugar, cinnamon, salt, and cloves in a bowl.
Layer 2 phyllo sheets in a 9x13 baking pan, brushing each lightly with melted butter.
Spread half the walnut mixture over the phyllo, then layer 2 more buttered phyllo sheets on top.
Spread remaining walnut mixture and top with final 4 phyllo sheets, brushing butter between each layer and on top.
Cut into diamond shapes with a sharp knife, then bake at 350°F for 25-30 minutes until golden.
While kadaif bakes, combine remaining sugar, water, and honey in a saucepan and simmer 10 minutes.
Pour hot syrup over hot kadaif immediately after removing from oven and let cool before serving.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough on sale and freeze for later use
Use chopped pecans or almonds if walnuts are expensive

recipes.name: Ashure
recipes.description: Albanian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak chickpeas and beans overnight, then drain.
Combine soaked chickpeas, beans, wheat grains, and water in a large pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until legumes and wheat are very tender.
Stir in sugar, raisins, walnuts, hazelnuts, cinnamon, and salt.
Simmer for 10 more minutes until flavors combine, then divide into serving bowls and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy dried beans and grains in bulk bins for significant savings
Skip expensive nuts or use peanuts instead

recipes.name: Urojo
recipes.description: Zanzibari snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add cassava and potato cubes, then stir and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in tamarind paste, salt, and hot pepper, then simmer 3 more minutes.
Ladle into bowls, garnish with cilantro, and serve hot with lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Use regular potatoes only if cassava is unavailable
Make tamarind paste by soaking dried tamarind in hot water

recipes.name: Pilau
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown chicken pieces on all sides, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onion until softened, then add garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Add cumin seeds, cardamom pods, and cinnamon stick, stirring constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return chicken to pot, add rice, and stir to coat with oil.
Pour in broth and salt, bring to a boil, then cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 20 minutes until rice is tender.
Remove from heat and let rest 5 minutes covered, then fluff with a fork and garnish with cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken in bulk when on sale and freeze
Skip cardamom if too expensive and use more cumin

recipes.name: Octopus Curry
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil octopus pieces in salted water for 45 minutes until very tender, then drain and cut into smaller chunks.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion until soft, then add garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in curry powder and turmeric, cooking 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add cooked octopus, coconut milk, water, salt, and hot pepper, then bring to a simmer.
Simmer gently for 15 minutes to combine flavors, then garnish with cilantro and serve over rice.
cheapTips: Buy frozen octopus which is cheaper than fresh
Use regular coconut milk from a can instead of fresh

recipes.name: Pweza wa Kumimina
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil octopus in salted water for 40 minutes until tender, then drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onion until soft, then add garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes and hot peppers, cooking and stirring for 5 minutes until tomatoes break down.
Add cooked octopus, water, and salt, then simmer for 10 minutes to meld flavors.
Stir in cilantro and lime juice just before serving over rice or with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen octopus to save money
Use canned tomatoes if fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Mchuzi wa Samaki
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat fish dry and season lightly with salt on both sides.
Heat oil in a wide pot and carefully fry fish 3 minutes per side until golden, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onion until soft, then add garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in diced tomatoes and hot pepper, cooking 5 minutes until tomatoes soften.
Pour in coconut milk and gently nestle fish back into the sauce, then simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.
Stir in cilantro and lime juice, then carefully transfer to a serving platter and serve hot with rice.
cheapTips: Buy cheaper fish varieties like mackerel or tilapia
Use canned tomatoes to reduce prep time

recipes.name: Urumbande
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion and garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add cassava and sweet potato chunks, stirring to coat with oil, and cook 3 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and water, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, add salt and hot pepper, and simmer for 20-25 minutes until vegetables are very tender.
Mash or blend part of the mixture to create a creamy consistency, then garnish with cilantro and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy cassava and sweet potatoes when in season for lowest prices
Skip hot pepper if budget is tight

recipes.name: Mkate wa Kumimina
recipes.description: Zanzibari breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Whisk eggs with milk and oil in a separate bowl until combined.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until a thick batter forms.
Fold in cumin seeds and sesame seeds into the batter.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and lightly oil it.
Drop spoonfuls of batter onto the hot skillet and flatten slightly with the back of the spoon.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until golden brown, then flip and cook another 2 minutes on the other side.
Transfer to a plate and serve warm with honey or jam.
cheapTips: Buy cumin and sesame seeds from bulk bins instead of pre-packaged
Use basic all-purpose flour rather than specialty blends

recipes.name: Ndizi Nyama
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef cubes on all sides, then set aside.
Sauté diced onions, minced garlic, and ginger in the same pot until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Return the beef to the pot and add turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Peel and cube the green plantains and add them to the pot.
Continue simmering for 15 minutes until plantains are tender and beef is cooked through.
Adjust seasoning and serve hot with rice or ugali.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for later use
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh if out of season

recipes.name: Pweza wa Nazi
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil octopus pieces in salted water for 20 minutes to tenderize, then drain well.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté diced onions, minced garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the boiled octopus pieces to the pot and stir well.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Season with lemon juice, salt, and pepper, and simmer for 10-12 minutes uncovered.
Stir in fresh cilantro just before serving.
Serve hot with rice or flatbread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen octopus instead of fresh for better prices
Shop for coconut milk at Asian markets where it's cheaper

recipes.name: Zanzibar Pizza
recipes.description: Zanzibari snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté diced onion and tomato until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add minced meat or tuna and cook until heated through, stirring often.
Season the mixture with salt, pepper, and chili flakes.
Push the cooked mixture to the sides of the skillet and crack eggs into the center.
Scramble the eggs lightly and mix with the meat mixture once partially cooked.
Place the naan bread directly on top of the egg-meat mixture and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Flip the naan and cook the other side until golden, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use canned tuna or ground beef on sale instead of fresh meat
Buy naan bread from a bakery section where it may be discounted

recipes.name: Wali wa Nazi
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then drain thoroughly.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and add cumin seeds, cardamom pods, and bay leaf.
Toast spices for about 1 minute until fragrant, stirring gently.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 2 minutes.
Add the rinsed rice and stir to coat with butter for 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and water, then add salt and stir once.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes without lifting the lid.
Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and serve.
cheapTips: Buy rice in bulk for significant savings
Use light coconut milk instead of full-fat to reduce cost

recipes.name: Mshkaki
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix minced garlic, ginger, lime juice, oil, salt, pepper, and cumin powder in a bowl for the marinade.
Add beef cubes to the marinade and toss to coat evenly, then let sit for 10 minutes.
Cut onions, bell peppers, and tomatoes into chunky pieces.
Thread marinated beef alternately with vegetable pieces onto skewers.
Heat a grill pan or barbecue to medium-high heat.
Place skewers on the hot grill and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, turning occasionally for even cooking.
Continue cooking until meat is cooked through and vegetables are lightly charred, about 12-15 minutes total.
Serve hot with lime wedges and a side of rice or salad.
cheapTips: Buy meat on sale and freeze until ready to marinate
Use cheaper cuts like chuck steak for skewers

recipes.name: Samaki wa Kupaka
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté diced onions, minced garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Carefully place fish fillets into the simmering sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Cook for 8-10 minutes until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Stir in lemon juice and adjust seasoning as needed.
Gently fold in fresh cilantro just before serving.
Serve over rice or with flatbread and a side vegetable.
cheapTips: Buy frozen fish fillets instead of fresh for lower cost
Use tilapia or cod which are typically more affordable

recipes.name: Chips Mayai
recipes.description: Zanzibari breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin matchstick fries, about 1/4-inch thick.
Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add potato fries and cook stirring often until golden and crispy, about 8-10 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Push potatoes to the sides of the skillet.
Add remaining oil to the center and sauté diced onion for 1 minute.
Crack eggs into the center of the skillet and scramble lightly, mixing gradually with the onions.
Once eggs are partially set, fold in the potatoes and continue cooking until eggs are fully cooked through, about 2 minutes.
Season with hot sauce, salt, and pepper, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk and store in a cool, dark place
Use eggs on sale for significant savings on this affordable dish

recipes.name: Mgate wa Kumimina
recipes.description: Zanzibari snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and cumin seeds in a bowl.
Rub butter into the flour mixture until it resembles breadcrumbs.
Whisk egg with milk and add to the flour mixture, stirring until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough gently for 1-2 minutes on a floured surface until smooth.
Roll dough out to about 1/4-inch thickness and cut into strips or small squares.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C).
Carefully fry dough pieces in batches for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm or at room temperature with tea.
cheapTips: Make in batches and store in an airtight container for several days
Use basic all-purpose flour to keep costs down

recipes.name: Biryani ya Pweza
recipes.description: Zanzibari lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil octopus in salted water for 25 minutes to tenderize, then drain and set aside.
Rinse basmati rice under cold water until water runs clear and let soak for 15 minutes.
Slice onions thinly and deep fry in 2 tablespoons of oil until golden and crispy, then remove and drain.
Mix yogurt with minced garlic, ginger, salt, and pepper, then marinate octopus in this mixture for 10 minutes.
Heat remaining oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and add whole spices (cumin, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves), cooking for 30 seconds.
Boil water in a separate pot with salt and add the drained rice, cooking until 70% done, then drain.
Layer half the cooked rice on the bottom of the pot with spices.
Add the marinated octopus as the middle layer, then top with remaining rice.
Sprinkle fried onions on top and cover the pot tightly with foil then place a lid on top.
Cook on high heat for 2-3 minutes until steam forms, then reduce to low heat and cook for 15 minutes without opening.
Turn off heat and let rest for 5 minutes, then gently fluff with a fork and garnish with cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Buy octopus frozen in bulk for better pricing
Look for basmati rice sales or buy from ethnic markets

recipes.name: Kefta Tagine
recipes.description: Berber lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground beef with half the onions, cilantro, parsley, eggs, paprika, cumin, salt and pepper to form meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot over medium-high heat.
Sauté remaining onions for 3 minutes until softened, then stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes, water, and remaining spices, bringing to a simmer.
Gently place meatballs into the sauce, ensuring they are partially submerged.
Cover and simmer for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze; use 80/20 blend for more flavor
Fresh herbs from farmer's market are cheaper than grocery store

recipes.name: Sefenj
recipes.description: Berber snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and anise in a bowl.
Gradually add water while mixing until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough for 2 minutes until smooth, then rest 10 minutes covered.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan or wok.
Divide dough into walnut-sized balls and gently press into flat discs.
Fry discs 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and puffy.
Transfer to paper towels to drain.
Drizzle warm honey over fried pastries and sprinkle sesame seeds while still warm.
cheapTips: Make larger batches and freeze uncooked dough balls for later
Buy honey in bulk containers for significant savings

recipes.name: Briouat
recipes.description: Berber snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef with onion in a skillet over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, breaking it into small pieces.
Stir in cilantro, paprika, cinnamon, salt and pepper, then remove from heat and cool slightly.
Beat 1 egg in a bowl and mix into cooled meat mixture.
Lay one phyllo sheet on a work surface and brush lightly with olive oil.
Place 2 tablespoons of meat filling on the lower left corner of the sheet.
Fold phyllo into a triangle by folding the bottom corner over the filling, then continue folding up and over to create a triangular pastry.
Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets and filling.
Heat remaining olive oil in a pan over medium heat and fry briouat 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar and cinnamon before serving.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough at international markets instead of regular grocery stores
Use ground beef on sale and freeze until needed

recipes.name: Tagine de Poisson
recipes.description: Berber dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot over medium heat.
Sauté onions, peppers, and garlic for 5 minutes until softened.
Add ginger, cumin, paprika, and turmeric, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and olives, bringing to a gentle simmer.
Season fish with salt and pepper, then nestle fillets into the sauce.
Arrange lemon slices over the fish.
Cover and simmer 15-20 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork.
Serve directly from the tagine with warm bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen white fish when on sale instead of fresh
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh for lower cost year-round

recipes.name: Tangia Marrakchia
recipes.description: Berber lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a heavy pot or clay tagine over medium-high heat.
Sear beef cubes for 3-4 minutes per side until browned, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, cook garlic and ginger for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add paprika and turmeric, stirring for 30 seconds.
Return beef to the pot and add water, preserved lemons, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours until beef is very tender.
Stir in cilantro, parsley, and olives, and simmer uncovered for 15 more minutes.
Adjust seasonings and serve in a shallow bowl with crusty bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck in bulk and freeze portions for later use
Substitute fresh lemon juice for expensive preserved lemons

recipes.name: Byrek
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown meat with onions and garlic in a skillet over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, breaking meat into small pieces.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly, then stir in 1 beaten egg, mint, salt, and pepper.
Preheat oven to 375°F and brush a 9x13 baking dish with melted butter.
Layer 3 phyllo sheets in the baking dish, brushing each with melted butter.
Spread meat mixture evenly over phyllo, then sprinkle feta cheese on top.
Layer 4 more phyllo sheets over filling, brushing each with melted butter.
Beat remaining 2 eggs and brush over the top phyllo sheet.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Cool for 5 minutes, then cut into squares and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy phyllo dough at international markets for better pricing
Use ground beef instead of lamb to reduce costs

recipes.name: Fërgesë
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion and garlic for 3 minutes until softened.
Add diced peppers and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in tomatoes, mint, salt, pepper, and water.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until vegetables are very soft.
Crumble cheese over the top and stir gently until just combined.
Cook 2 more minutes until cheese is slightly warmed through.
Serve warm as a side dish or light main course.
cheapTips: Buy bell peppers when in season or on sale and freeze
Use store-brand feta cheese for better value

recipes.name: Tavë Kosi
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13 baking dish.
Layer uncooked rice evenly across the bottom of the baking dish.
In a pot, boil water with salt and cook meat with sliced onions for 20 minutes until partially cooked, then drain.
Arrange partially cooked meat over the rice.
Whisk yogurt, eggs, flour, salt, and pepper together until smooth.
Pour yogurt mixture evenly over meat and rice.
Dot the top with small pieces of butter.
Bake uncovered for 45-50 minutes until rice is tender and top is golden.
Cool for 10 minutes before serving directly from the dish.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck instead of lamb for significant savings
Use plain yogurt from bulk containers rather than individual cups

recipes.name: Sofra e Printit
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches, about 3 minutes per batch, then set aside.
Add onions, garlic, carrots, and celery to the pot and sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Return beef to the pot and add beef broth, bay leaves, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add potatoes and simmer covered for another 25-30 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Remove bay leaves, adjust seasonings, and garnish with fresh parsley.
Serve hot in bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand beef broth instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Flija
recipes.description: Albanian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, milk, eggs, 1/2 cup melted butter, and salt to create a thin batter.
Preheat oven to 375°F and brush a 10-inch cast iron skillet or baking pan with melted butter.
Sauté meat with onions and garlic in a separate pan over medium heat for 5 minutes, then set aside.
Pour a thin layer of batter into the hot buttered skillet (about 1/4 cup), tilting to coat the bottom.
Cook for 2 minutes until the bottom sets, then spread a thin layer of meat mixture over it.
Pour another thin layer of batter over the meat.
Repeat layering batter and meat 4-5 times, ending with batter, drizzling butter between each layer.
Transfer skillet to oven and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden and set.
Cool for 5 minutes, top with yogurt, and cut into wedges.
cheapTips: Use ground beef instead of premium cuts to reduce cost
Buy milk and eggs when on sale and freeze if needed

recipes.name: Goat Cheese Pastry
recipes.description: Kurdish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Sauté minced onion in 1 tablespoon butter until soft, then mix with goat cheese, fresh herbs, salt, and pepper.
Brush one phyllo sheet lightly with melted butter and place on the baking sheet.
Spread 2 tablespoons of goat cheese mixture along one long edge, leaving a 1-inch border.
Roll tightly and coil into a spiral, tucking the end underneath.
Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets and filling to make 4 pastries.
Brush all pastries with remaining butter and bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
Drizzle with honey while warm and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy goat cheese from the bulk section to save 30%
Use dried herbs if fresh are unavailable

recipes.name: Speckknödel
recipes.description: Tyrolean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fry bacon pieces until crispy, then set aside, reserving 1 tablespoon fat in pan.
Sauté diced onion in bacon fat until golden, about 5 minutes.
Combine bread cubes in a large bowl with bacon, cooked onion, eggs, milk, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Let mixture rest for 15 minutes until bread absorbs liquid.
Form mixture into 8 dumplings, about the size of tennis balls.
Bring beef broth to a gentle simmer in a large pot.
Carefully add dumplings to simmering broth and cook for 15-20 minutes until they float and are cooked through.
Serve dumplings in bowls with hot broth and crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use day-old bread from bakery discount bin
Make broth from bones or use reduced-sodium canned broth

recipes.name: Schlutzkrapfen
recipes.description: Tyrolean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, create a well, add eggs and gradually incorporate flour to form a smooth dough; rest 30 minutes.
Combine drained spinach, ricotta, Parmesan, nutmeg, pepper, and sautéed onion for filling.
Roll dough thin between two pieces of parchment paper into a large rectangle.
Spread filling evenly over dough, leaving a 1-inch border on all sides.
Roll dough tightly into a log, sealing seam with water.
Wrap roll in cheesecloth and tie ends, then place in pot of boiling salted water.
Simmer for 30-35 minutes until roll floats and is firm.
Remove, unwrap, slice into 1-inch thick portions, then pan-fry in butter until edges are crispy.
Serve hot with melted butter and grated cheese.
cheapTips: Buy frozen spinach in bulk for lower cost
Use store-brand ricotta and Parmesan

recipes.name: Canederli
recipes.description: Tyrolean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak bread cubes in milk for 10 minutes until absorbed.
Mix soaked bread with eggs, ham, parsley, 2 tablespoons flour, salt, and pepper.
Form into 12 dumplings about 1.5 inches in diameter.
Lightly dust dumplings with remaining flour to help them hold together.
Bring beef broth to a gentle simmer in a large pot.
Add dumplings to simmering broth and cook for 15-20 minutes until they float and are cooked through.
Serve dumplings in bowls with hot broth and fresh parsley garnish.
Optional: top with melted butter and crispy sage.
cheapTips: Use leftover bread ends instead of fresh loaves
Substitute bacon for ham if cheaper at your store

recipes.name: Gröstl
recipes.description: Tyrolean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Parboil diced potatoes in salted water for 8 minutes, then drain well.
Fry bacon pieces in a large skillet until crispy, then remove and set aside.
Add oil to bacon fat, then sauté diced onion and bell pepper for 3 minutes.
Add potatoes to skillet and cook undisturbed for 5 minutes to develop a crust on bottom.
Stir and continue cooking for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are golden.
Stir in bacon, salt, pepper, and caraway seeds.
Push hash to sides of skillet and crack eggs into center, cooking until whites set.
Serve immediately with a fried egg on top and crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in 5 lb bags for better price per pound
Use ends of bacon package that are cheaper

recipes.name: Tiroler Erdäpfelpuffer
recipes.description: Tyrolean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel potatoes and grate them finely into a clean kitchen towel.
Squeeze grated potatoes firmly over sink to remove excess moisture.
Transfer squeezed potatoes to a bowl and immediately mix with eggs, flour, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Drop heaping tablespoons of potato mixture into oil and flatten slightly with spatula.
Fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer to paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Mix sour cream with chives and serve as topping with warm potato pancakes.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand sour cream and chives
Use regular vegetable oil instead of specialty oils

recipes.name: Rindsuppe
recipes.description: Tyrolean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place beef chunks and bones in large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to boil.
Drain, rinse meat and bones, and return to cleaned pot with 8 cups fresh water.
Add onion quarters and bring to simmer; skim foam from surface for 5 minutes.
Add carrots, celery, and parsnips; simmer uncovered for 60 minutes.
Add potatoes and season with salt and pepper; simmer for 20 more minutes.
Remove meat and bones, shred any meat, and return shredded meat to pot.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then simmer for 10 more minutes.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley and crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy beef bones from butcher counter for cheap broth base
Use chuck roast which becomes tender during long cooking

recipes.name: Strauben
recipes.description: Tyrolean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, eggs, milk, salt, and sugar until smooth batter forms; let rest 15 minutes.
Heat oil in deep pan or fryer to 350°F, testing temperature with a piece of bread.
Pour batter into a funnel or squeeze bottle with large opening held over hot oil.
Create spiral or irregular shaped pastry directly in oil by moving funnel around.
Fry for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Mix powdered sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Dust warm strauben with cinnamon sugar and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Reuse frying oil multiple times by straining it between uses
Buy powdered sugar in bulk for better value

recipes.name: Vinschger Paarln
recipes.description: Tyrolean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water with yeast and let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flours, salt, fennel seeds, and caraway seeds in large bowl.
Add yeast mixture and oil to flour; knead for 10 minutes until smooth elastic dough forms.
Place dough in oiled bowl, cover with towel, and let rise 1 hour until doubled.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a long oval shape.
Place shaped loaves on oiled baking sheet, cover with towel, and let rise 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°F and make lengthwise slits in top of each loaf.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown with crispy crust.
Cool on wire rack before serving with butter, cheese, or cured meats.
cheapTips: Make your own yeast by saving starter culture
Buy flour in 5-10 lb bags from restaurant supply stores

recipes.name: Tiroler Speck
recipes.description: Tyrolean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix salt, sugar, curing salt, pepper, juniper, garlic, and rosemary in small bowl.
Rub curing mixture thoroughly over all sides of pork belly, massaging into meat.
Place in glass container, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 3 weeks.
Turn meat daily for first week, then every other day for remaining time.
After 3 weeks, rinse meat under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Hang meat in cool, well-ventilated space at 50-60°F for 2-4 weeks to dry.
Slice thinly with sharp knife and serve at room temperature.
Store wrapped in paper in cool, dry place for up to 3 months.
cheapTips: Buy pork belly when on sale and freeze until ready to cure
Make larger batches to spread cost over more servings

recipes.name: Mish-Mash
recipes.description: Macedonian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and sauté until softened, about 2 minutes.
Brown the ground beef, breaking it apart with a spoon, for 5-6 minutes.
Stir in diced bell pepper and tomato, cooking for 3 minutes.
Push the mixture to the sides and pour beaten eggs into the center.
Scramble the eggs and mix everything together until eggs are cooked through, about 3-4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use ground beef scraps or less expensive cuts
Buy eggs in bulk during sales

recipes.name: Gibanica
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix ricotta, crumbled feta, eggs, salt, and pepper in a bowl until combined.
Brush a 9x13 baking dish with melted butter.
Layer 3-4 sheets of phyllo dough, brushing each with butter.
Spread half the cheese mixture evenly over the phyllo.
Layer 3-4 more phyllo sheets with butter between each, then add remaining cheese.
Top with 4-5 final phyllo sheets, buttering each layer.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden brown.
Cool for 5 minutes, cut into squares, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Make your own phyllo dough if budget allows
Mix ricotta with cheaper farmer's cheese

recipes.name: Krompiruša
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and dice potatoes into small cubes, then boil until tender but not falling apart, about 8 minutes.
Dice onion and sauté in 2 tbsp butter until golden, about 3 minutes.
Drain potatoes and mix with sautéed onion, salt, and black pepper.
Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 baking dish with oil.
Layer 3-4 phyllo sheets, brushing each with melted butter.
Spread potato mixture evenly over phyllo.
Top with remaining phyllo sheets, buttering between each layer.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until crust is golden brown.
Let cool 5 minutes, cut into portions, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in 5-lb bags for better value
Use oil instead of all butter to reduce fat cost

recipes.name: Banitza
recipes.description: Macedonian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Whisk together eggs, yogurt, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Melt butter and use to brush a 9x13 baking dish.
Layer 2 phyllo sheets, brushing each with melted butter.
Pour half the egg mixture over phyllo.
Layer 2 more phyllo sheets with butter, add remaining egg mixture.
Top with 4-5 final phyllo sheets, buttering each one.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden and set.
Let cool 5 minutes, cut into squares, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use plain store-brand yogurt instead of Greek yogurt
Buy butter on sale and freeze it

recipes.name: Mlinci
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make dough: combine flour, eggs, water, and 0.5 tsp salt, knead until smooth and elastic.
Roll dough very thin on a floured surface, then let it dry for 10 minutes.
Cut dried dough into 2-inch squares or rectangles.
Bring beef broth to boil in a large pot.
Fry mlinci squares in butter in a skillet until lightly golden, about 2 minutes per batch.
Drop fried squares into boiling broth in batches.
Add remaining salt and paprika, simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir gently and serve hot as a soup-like dish.
cheapTips: Use homemade beef broth from bones if available
Make dough from scratch to save on cost

recipes.name: Tetovska Pita
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make dough: mix flour, water, and salt, knead for 10 minutes until elastic.
Divide dough into 4 balls, cover, and let rest 15 minutes.
Brown ground beef with diced onion, add tomato, season with salt and pepper, cook 5 minutes.
Roll each dough ball very thin to cover a 9x13 baking dish.
Layer in baking dish: dough sheet, butter brush, meat filling, repeat with remaining sheets.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden brown.
Cut into squares and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use ground chuck instead of leaner cuts
Buy onions and tomatoes in season

recipes.name: Sopska Pita
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Chop cabbage finely and sauté with diced onion in 2 tbsp butter for 8 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and caraway seeds, then remove from heat.
Brush a 9x13 baking dish with melted butter.
Layer 3-4 phyllo sheets, brushing each with butter.
Spread cabbage mixture evenly over phyllo.
Top with 4-5 remaining phyllo sheets, buttering between layers.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
Cool 5 minutes, cut into squares, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy cabbage in bulk; it lasts for weeks
Skip caraway seeds if budget is tight

recipes.name: Zelnik
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Sauté diced onion in 1 tbsp butter for 2 minutes.
Add chopped spinach and cook until wilted and liquid evaporates, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and cool, then mix in crumbled feta, eggs, salt, and pepper.
Brush a 9x13 baking dish with melted butter.
Layer 3-4 phyllo sheets, buttering each one.
Spread spinach filling evenly over phyllo.
Top with 4-5 remaining phyllo sheets, buttering between layers.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden, cool 5 minutes, cut and serve.
cheapTips: Use frozen spinach if fresh is expensive; thaw and squeeze dry
Buy feta on sale and crumble it yourself

recipes.name: Rakija
recipes.description: Macedonian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash and pit the fruit, then chop coarsely.
Combine fruit, sugar, water, and yeast in a clean glass jar.
Stir well, cover loosely with cheesecloth, and let ferment at room temperature for 3-4 weeks.
Stir once daily for the first week, then every 2-3 days.
Strain through fine cheesecloth into a clean jar after 4 weeks.
Let liquid clear for another 1-2 weeks, then bottle carefully without disturbing sediment.
Store in a cool, dark place for at least 2 months before consuming.
Serve in small shot glasses as a digestif.
cheapTips: Use overripe fruit from farmers markets at discount
Make large batches to reduce per-unit cost

recipes.name: Turli Tava
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cut eggplant, zucchini, bell peppers, tomatoes, and onion into 1-inch cubes.
Mince garlic and combine with olive oil in a small bowl.
Layer vegetables in a 9x13 baking dish, starting with eggplant.
Drizzle garlic oil over vegetables, season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Cover with foil and bake for 35-40 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Remove foil for the last 5 minutes to allow some browning.
Stir gently and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables in season at farmers markets
Use generic olive oil instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Stamp and Go
recipes.description: Jamaican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod in cold water for 2-3 hours, changing water halfway through.
Flake the soaked cod into small pieces, removing any bones.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Finely chop onion, pepper, and garlic, then add to flour mixture with flaked cod.
Add water gradually to form a thick, pasty batter.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy salt cod in bulk from Caribbean markets for better prices
Reuse frying oil multiple times to reduce costs

recipes.name: Stewed Chicken
recipes.description: Antillean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 4-5 minutes per side.
Remove chicken and set aside on a plate.
In the same pot, sauté diced onions and minced garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add broth and Worcestershire sauce.
Return chicken to pot with thyme and bay leaf, then simmer for 25-30 minutes until chicken is tender.
Remove thyme sprigs and bay leaf, then adjust seasoning to taste.
Serve hot with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Use cheaper chicken thighs instead of breasts
Buy garlic and onions in bulk from discount grocers

recipes.name: Turtle Stew
recipes.description: Antillean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown beef pieces in batches, about 4 minutes per side.
Remove beef and set aside, then sauté diced onion, garlic, carrot, and celery for 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Return beef to pot and add broth, thyme, and bay leaf.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 60 minutes covered.
Add diced potatoes and continue simmering for 25-30 minutes until vegetables and meat are tender.
Remove thyme and bay leaf, then adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve in bowls with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use regular beef stew meat instead of specialty proteins
Buy vegetables on sale and freeze them for later use

recipes.name: Yaniqueques
recipes.description: Dominican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Add 3 tablespoons oil and water, stirring until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough gently for 2-3 minutes until smooth.
Divide dough into 12 balls and let rest for 5 minutes.
Flatten each ball into a disk about 0.25 inch thick.
Heat frying oil to 350°F in a deep skillet.
Fry each yaniqueque for 2-3 minutes per side until puffy and golden brown.
Drain on paper towels, drizzle with honey, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Make a big batch and freeze extras for quick breakfast
Reuse frying oil multiple times

recipes.name: Tavče Gravče
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried beans in water for 8 hours or overnight.
Drain beans and place in a pot with 6 cups fresh water.
Bring to boil, then simmer for 45 minutes until beans begin to soften.
In a separate skillet, heat oil and sauté diced onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add paprika and tomato paste to onion mixture, stirring for 1 minute.
Pour onion mixture into bean pot and add bay leaf.
Continue simmering for 30-40 minutes until beans are very tender and sauce thickens.
Remove bay leaf and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve hot, drizzled with olive oil if desired.
cheapTips: Buy dried beans in bulk from the bins section
Prep beans the night before for faster cooking day-of

recipes.name: Ajvar
recipes.description: Macedonian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Wash and halve the bell peppers, removing seeds and membranes.
Place pepper halves skin-side up on a baking sheet and broil 8-10 minutes until blackened.
Transfer peppers to a plastic bag for 10 minutes to steam, then peel off the charred skin.
Chop eggplant into chunks, place on a baking sheet, and roast at 400°F for 20 minutes until soft.
Transfer cooled peppers and eggplant to a blender with minced garlic, vinegar, oil, and paprika.
Pulse until desired consistency is reached—chunky or smooth.
Season with salt and pepper, then transfer to a serving bowl.
Serve at room temperature with bread, crackers, or as a condiment.
cheapTips: Make in late summer when bell peppers are cheapest
Freeze extra in ice cube trays for year-round use

recipes.name: Pastrmajlija
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet and sauté thinly sliced onion until soft and golden, about 8 minutes.
Chop pastrami into small pieces and add to onion, cooking for 3 minutes.
Stir in paprika and black pepper, then remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Preheat oven to 425°F and stretch pizza dough into a rectangular shape on a baking sheet.
Spread pastrami-onion mixture evenly over the dough, leaving a 0.5-inch border.
Roll the dough tightly from one long side to create a spiral log.
Coil the log into a spiral shape on the baking sheet, brush with water.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Cool for 5 minutes, slice, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pizza dough to save time and money
Buy pastrami on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Kuftija
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely chop onion and mix with ground beef, flour, egg, paprika, salt, and pepper until combined.
Form mixture into a large round patty and place in a greased baking dish.
Heat oil in a skillet and brown the top of the patty for 4-5 minutes, then carefully flip and brown the other side.
Return browned patty to baking dish and pour water or broth around it.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes covered with foil.
Remove foil and bake an additional 10 minutes to reduce the sauce slightly.
Cool for 5 minutes, then cut into wedges.
Serve hot with the pan sauce spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk and freeze portions
Skip browning step to save on oil

recipes.name: Pljeskavica
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince onion and garlic, then combine with ground beef, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Divide mixture into 3 equal portions and form each into a thick, flattened patty.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook patties for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and browned.
Toast hamburger buns lightly in the skillet or under a broiler.
Slice tomato and separate onion slices.
Assemble burgers by placing patty on bun bottom, then topping with tomato and onion slices.
Top with bun and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in patty portions
Skip expensive toppings and use basic vegetables

recipes.name: Ćevapčići
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince onion and garlic finely and combine with ground beef, ground pork, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add bread crumbs and egg to mixture and knead gently until well combined.
Divide into 12 equal portions and roll each into a short sausage shape about 3 inches long.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Arrange ćevapčići in skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Transfer to a serving platter and drizzle with any pan juices.
Serve hot with grilled onions, bread, and ajvar or sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze in portioned packages
Use day-old bread for homemade bread crumbs

recipes.name: Tamarind Ball
recipes.description: Trinidadian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix tamarind pulp with brown sugar and finely minced habanero pepper in a heavy saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly for 15-20 minutes until the mixture thickens and pulls away from the sides.
Add salt and butter, stirring until well combined.
Cool slightly, then roll into golf ball-sized spheres with wet hands and place on parchment paper to set for 2 hours.
cheapTips: Buy tamarind pulp in bulk from international markets
Make larger batches to reduce per-serving cost

recipes.name: Colombo
recipes.description: Trinidadian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown chicken pieces on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onions and minced garlic until fragrant, then add colombo seasoning powder and cook for 1 minute.
Return chicken to the pot with chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Add diced potatoes and simmer for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in drained chickpeas and coconut milk, simmer for 10 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot over rice.
cheapTips: Use chicken legs and thighs instead of breasts
Make your own colombo powder blend or buy from bulk sections

recipes.name: Bredie
recipes.description: Cape Malay dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large heavy pot and brown lamb pieces on all sides in batches, then remove.
Sauté diced onions, minced garlic, and ginger until golden.
Add turmeric and coriander, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return lamb to the pot with canned tomatoes and beef broth.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 1.5 hours until lamb is very tender, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shoulder when on sale and freeze
Use whole tomatoes instead of diced for savings

recipes.name: Atchar
recipes.description: Cape Malay snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and julienne green mangoes, then soak in salt water for 30 minutes and drain well.
Heat oil in a pot and add mustard seeds, letting them pop for 30 seconds.
Add finely chopped onions, garlic, ginger, and sliced chili peppers, sauté until softened.
Stir in turmeric, then add mangoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add vinegar and salt, simmer for 10 minutes until mangoes are tender but crisp.
Cool and transfer to jars for storage.
cheapTips: Buy green mangoes when in season from ethnic markets
Make large batches to preserve and share

recipes.name: Kofta
recipes.description: Cape Malay dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Process onion, garlic, and ginger until finely minced in a food processor.
Mix ground beef with minced aromatics, coriander, cumin, chili powder, breadcrumbs, egg, salt, and pepper.
Form mixture into 12-16 oval-shaped kofta and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown kofta on all sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with rice and a yogurt dipping sauce.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions
Use store-brand breadcrumbs

recipes.name: Dhaltji
recipes.description: Cape Malay dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak split peas in water for 1 hour, then drain.
Heat oil in a large pot and add cumin seeds, letting them pop for 30 seconds.
Sauté diced onions, minced garlic, ginger, and sliced chili until softened.
Add turmeric and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add drained split peas and 6 cups fresh water, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45-50 minutes, stirring occasionally, until peas break down into a thick dal.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with rice.
cheapTips: Buy split peas in bulk from ethnic or warehouse stores
Make double portions to freeze

recipes.name: Kingklip Curry
recipes.description: Cape Malay dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet and sauté diced onions, minced garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add curry powder and turmeric, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Place fish fillets into the curry sauce and poach for 10-12 minutes until cooked through.
Squeeze lemon juice over the fish and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with rice and chutney.
cheapTips: Use cod or haddock if kingklip is unavailable
Buy frozen fish fillets on sale

recipes.name: Snoek Curry
recipes.description: Cape Malay dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and add mustard seeds, letting them pop for 30 seconds.
Sauté diced onions, minced garlic, and ginger until softened.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in canned tomatoes with juice and vinegar, simmer for 10 minutes.
Add fish fillets and poach gently for 12-15 minutes until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve over rice.
cheapTips: Substitute mackerel or canned fish if fresh snoek unavailable
Buy in-season fresh fish at lower prices

recipes.name: Gelato
recipes.description: Cape Malay snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat cream and milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale and thick, about 3 minutes.
Slowly pour hot cream into egg mixture while whisking constantly to temper eggs.
Return mixture to saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it coats the back of a spoon.
Strain through a fine sieve, then stir in vanilla and salt.
Cool completely, then churn in an ice cream maker according to manufacturer's directions.
Transfer to a container and freeze for at least 4 hours before serving.
cheapTips: Make during summer when eggs are cheapest
Share ice cream maker with friends to split cost

recipes.name: Konfyt
recipes.description: Cape Malay snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine water and sugar in a heavy pot and bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Add dried apricots, cinnamon stick, ginger, and cloves to the syrup.
Reduce heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until apricots are tender and syrup thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice.
Cool slightly and transfer to sterilized jars.
Seal and store in a cool dark place for up to 3 months.
cheapTips: Buy dried apricots in bulk from wholesale clubs
Use homemade jars from other preserves

recipes.name: Sapodilla Balls
recipes.description: Guyanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine brown sugar and water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes until syrupy.
Stir in vanilla, cinnamon, and nutmeg into the syrup and set aside to cool.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, cream butter with eggs and milk.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until a thick batter forms.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the warm syrup and simmer for 15-20 minutes until they float.
Remove with a slotted spoon and cool on parchment paper before serving.
cheapTips: Buy brown sugar in bulk when on sale
Use basic all-purpose flour instead of specialty flours

recipes.name: Pepper Pot Soup
recipes.description: Guyanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown beef in a large pot over medium-high heat until seared on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onions and minced garlic in the same pot until fragrant.
Return beef to pot, add beef broth, cinnamon stick, thyme, and whole scotch bonnet pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 90 minutes until beef is tender.
Peel and cube cassava and potatoes, then add to the soup and cook for 20 minutes.
Chop callaloo, stir in coconut milk, and simmer for 10 more minutes.
Remove scotch bonnet pepper whole, season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy beef stew meat on sale and freeze for later
Use canned coconut milk instead of fresh

recipes.name: Channa
recipes.description: Guyanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried chickpeas overnight or for at least 8 hours, then drain.
Boil chickpeas in fresh water with turmeric for 45 minutes until tender, then drain.
Dice onion, mince garlic, and finely chop green chili.
Mix cooked chickpeas with onion, garlic, chili, cumin, cilantro, salt, and pepper.
Toss gently and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy dried chickpeas in bulk instead of canned
