Use ground cumin and turmeric from the spice aisle bulk section

recipes.name: Tamarind Balls
recipes.description: Guyanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine brown sugar and water in a pot, heat until sugar dissolves into a syrup.
Stir in tamarind paste, chili powder, and salt, mixing well.
Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Spread mixture on parchment paper and let cool until it can be handled.
Roll mixture into small balls about the size of walnuts.
Roll each ball in flour to coat evenly.
Store in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Make tamarind paste from whole tamarind pods if available at international markets
Buy brown sugar in bulk for savings

recipes.name: Cassava Pone
recipes.description: Guyanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel cassava and grate finely using a box grater or food processor.
If using fresh coconut, grate the meat; otherwise use pre-shredded coconut.
Cream butter and brown sugar together until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then add vanilla extract.
Mix in grated cassava, shredded coconut, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, and raisins.
Pour batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking pan.
Bake at 350°F for 50-60 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool slightly, cut into squares, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy cassava in bulk when available at ethnic markets
Use unsweetened shredded coconut from bulk bins

recipes.name: Doubles
recipes.description: Trinidadian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, turmeric, and salt, then add water to form a soft dough.
Knead dough for 2 minutes and let rest for 10 minutes covered.
Drain and rinse canned chickpeas, then mash roughly.
Sauté diced onion and garlic, add mashed chickpeas, diced chili, cilantro, and salt.
Cook chickpea mixture for 5 minutes and set aside to cool slightly.
Divide dough into 6 balls, then flatten each into a thin oval.
Heat oil in a deep pan and fry each oval until golden and puffed on both sides.
Sandwich chickpea filling between two fried ovals and serve with tamarind sauce.
cheapTips: Buy canned chickpeas on sale and stock up
Use affordable vegetable oil for frying

recipes.name: Curry Duck
recipes.description: Trinidadian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut duck into pieces, removing excess skin and fat.
Heat oil in a large heavy pot and brown duck pieces until golden.
Remove duck and set aside, leaving 2 tablespoons of fat in the pot.
Dice onions and garlic, then fry in the pot until softened and browned.
Stir in curry powder and turmeric, cooking for 2 minutes to bloom the spices.
Return duck to pot, add water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 60 minutes.
Add diced potatoes, sliced chili, cilantro, and coconut milk, then simmer for 30 more minutes until duck is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve with roti or rice.
cheapTips: Buy duck when on sale and freeze until ready to cook
Use standard curry powder blends instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Fried Bake and Shark
recipes.description: Trinidadian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt, then add water to form a soft dough.
Knead dough for 2 minutes, let rest 15 minutes covered.
Rub fish with lime juice and marinate for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into 3 balls and flatten into thin ovals.
Heat oil in a deep pan and fry dough ovals until golden and puffed, then drain.
In the same oil, fry marinated fish pieces until cooked through and golden.
Make a quick sauce by mixing tomato sauce with diced onion, garlic, and cilantro.
Serve fish on top of or inside a fried bake, drizzled with sauce.
cheapTips: Buy shark or other firm fish when on sale at ethnic markets
Use canned tomato sauce instead of fresh

recipes.name: Pelau
recipes.description: Trinidadian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cube chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a large pot and caramelize brown sugar until dark.
Add chicken and brown on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in the same pot until softened.
Return chicken to pot, add pigeon peas, cilantro, and thyme.
Pour in chicken broth and water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes.
Stir in rice and simmer covered for 20-25 minutes until rice is cooked and liquid is absorbed.
Season with salt and pepper, fluff with a fork, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use dried pigeon peas soaked overnight instead of canned for savings
Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts for more flavor at lower cost

recipes.name: Buljol
recipes.description: Trinidadian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salted cod in water for at least 1 hour, changing water once to remove excess salt.
Boil softened cod for 10 minutes, drain, and let cool slightly.
Flake cooked cod with a fork, removing any bones.
Dice tomatoes, onion, and chili finely.
Chop cilantro roughly.
Combine flaked cod, diced vegetables, cilantro, lime juice, and olive oil in a bowl.
Season with black pepper and salt to taste.
Peel and slice avocado just before serving and arrange on plates with buljol.
cheapTips: Buy salted cod in bulk at ethnic markets for better prices
Use lime juice concentrate if fresh limes are expensive

recipes.name: Paprika Salad
recipes.description: Macedonian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast the red bell peppers over an open flame or under the broiler until the skin blackens completely.
Place the charred peppers in a plastic bag for 10 minutes to steam and loosen the skin.
Peel off the blackened skin and remove the seeds from the peppers.
Dice the roasted peppers, tomatoes, and onion into bite-sized pieces.
Combine the diced vegetables in a bowl and sprinkle with paprika powder, salt, and pepper.
Drizzle with olive oil and red wine vinegar and toss gently.
Let the salad rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow flavors to blend.
cheapTips: Buy peppers when in season or on sale and roast extra to freeze for later
Use basic vinegar instead of specialty red wine vinegar to save 50 cents

recipes.name: Macedonian Bean Soup
recipes.description: Macedonian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak the dried kidney beans in water overnight, then drain and rinse thoroughly.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion, carrots, celery, and minced garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the drained beans and vegetable broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45-60 minutes until beans are completely tender.
Season with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Mash some beans against the pot side to thicken the soup slightly.
Simmer for another 5 minutes and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy dried beans in bulk instead of canned to save 60%
Use vegetable scraps (carrot tops, celery leaves) if available to add to broth

recipes.name: Cook-up Rice
recipes.description: Guyanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large pot and sauté minced garlic and diced onion until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add diced carrots and cook for 3 minutes, then add the rice and stir to coat with oil.
Toast the rice for 2 minutes while stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk, water, and add turmeric and salt.
Bring to a boil, then add the kidney beans and green peas.
Reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 20-25 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and let rest covered for 5 minutes.
Serve hot as a complete one-pot meal.
cheapTips: Use canned beans and frozen vegetables instead of fresh to reduce cost and prep time
Buy coconut milk in bulk or use lite coconut milk to save money

recipes.name: Metemout
recipes.description: Guyanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel the green plantains, green bananas, and potatoes under running water to prevent staining.
Cut all vegetables into 2-inch chunks and place in a large pot of salted water.
Bring to a boil and cook for 25-30 minutes until all vegetables are fork-tender.
Drain the vegetables well in a colander.
Heat butter in a skillet and sauté minced garlic and diced onion until golden, about 3 minutes.
Add the drained vegetables to the butter mixture and mash together until creamy with some lumps remaining.
Season with black pepper and additional salt to taste.
Serve hot with salt cod or other protein on the side.
cheapTips: Buy plantains and green bananas when discounted at Latin markets
Use vegetable oil instead of butter to save 40 cents per serving

recipes.name: Cassava Bread
recipes.description: Guyanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel the cassava root using a sharp knife and remove the brown outer layer completely.
Rinse the peeled cassava under cold water and cut into chunks.
Grate the cassava chunks finely using a box grater or food processor until completely shredded.
Place shredded cassava in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze firmly to remove excess moisture, working in batches.
Spread the dried cassava pulp on a clean surface and break up any large clumps.
Heat a large griddle or cast iron skillet over medium-high heat with a light coating of oil.
Spread the cassava mixture evenly on the hot griddle, pressing gently with a spatula to form a flat cake about 1/4 inch thick.
Cook for 8-10 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy, breaking into pieces if needed.
Cool on paper towels and store in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Buy cassava root in bulk at Latin markets where it costs less than specialty stores
Make multiple batches at once to amortize prep effort and store for the week

recipes.name: Cutters
recipes.description: Guyanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Cut cold butter into small cubes and work into the flour mixture with your fingertips until it resembles breadcrumbs.
Add minced garlic, diced onion, and cilantro to the mixture and stir well.
Gradually add water while mixing until a soft dough forms that's not sticky.
Knead the dough gently for 2 minutes on a floured surface.
Roll out dough to 1/8 inch thickness and cut into 2x2 inch squares using a knife.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep skillet or pot.
Fry the cutters in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and puffed.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with curry or stew.
cheapTips: Make dough from scratch instead of using prepared mixes to save 50%
Fry multiple batches at once to minimize oil use and time

recipes.name: Duckanoo
recipes.description: Guyanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornmeal, grated coconut, brown sugar, raisins, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a large bowl.
Stir in melted butter and vanilla extract until the mixture is evenly moistened.
Scald banana leaves or prepare foil squares by softening them briefly over heat if using banana leaves.
Divide the cornmeal mixture into 8 equal portions and place each on a banana leaf or foil square.
Fold the banana leaves or foil to create sealed packets, folding edges tightly.
Place packets seam-side down in a large pot with about 1 inch of water at the bottom.
Cover the pot and steam for 45-50 minutes until the duckanoo is firm and cooked through.
Carefully unwrap and serve warm, as a sweet breakfast or dessert treat.
cheapTips: Use shredded coconut from bulk bins instead of fresh to save significantly
Skip raisins or use less expensive dried fruit like chopped dates as substitute

recipes.name: Farine
recipes.description: Guyanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine milk and water in a large saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the cinnamon stick and stir in brown sugar.
In a small bowl, mix cassava flour with 1/4 cup of cold water until smooth to prevent lumps.
Slowly pour the cassava flour mixture into the simmering liquid while stirring constantly.
Continue stirring to prevent clumping and cook for 10-12 minutes until the mixture thickens.
Stir in butter, nutmeg, and vanilla extract.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes while stirring until the farine reaches a thick, creamy consistency.
Remove cinnamon stick and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy cassava flour at Latin markets instead of specialty stores to cut cost by 40%
Use evaporated milk instead of whole milk for a richer taste at lower cost

recipes.name: Fish Cakes
recipes.description: Guyanese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak saltfish in water for 2-4 hours, changing water halfway through, then drain and flake into small pieces.
Boil potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain and mash.
Mix mashed potatoes with flaked saltfish, minced garlic, diced onion, and chopped cilantro.
In a separate bowl, mix flour and baking powder, then add to the fish mixture.
Beat eggs and add to the mixture, stirring until well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep skillet.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with lime wedges or hot sauce.
cheapTips: Buy saltfish on sale and freeze for later use throughout the month
Use cheaper vegetable oil like canola instead of specialty oils for frying

recipes.name: Crab Back
recipes.description: Guyanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the crabs thoroughly by scrubbing under cold running water and removing the top shell carefully.
Scoop out the brown meat from inside the shell and set aside, keeping the shell halves.
Remove the legs and claws from the crab body and set aside.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté minced garlic and diced onion until golden, about 3 minutes.
Add the crab body pieces and legs, stirring to coat with the oil, then cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and water, then add the reserved brown meat, whole scotch bonnet pepper, and cilantro.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 25-30 minutes until crab is fully cooked.
Remove the scotch bonnet pepper and season with salt and black pepper.
Transfer crab to shells if desired, pour sauce over top, and serve with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy live crabs at markets the day of cooking for the best price
Use lite coconut milk to reduce cost by 20% without sacrificing much flavor

recipes.name: Garnaches
recipes.description: Belizean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Add warm water and 1 tbsp oil, kneading until a soft dough forms.
Divide dough into 8 balls and let rest 10 minutes.
Heat remaining oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Flatten each dough ball into a thin disc and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Warm refried beans in a small pot, then spread onto each fried disc.
Top with cheese, onion, habanero, and cilantro, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy dried beans in bulk and cook yourself instead of canned.
Use store-brand cheese to reduce cost by 30%.

recipes.name: Rcado
recipes.description: Belizean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut avocados in half lengthwise and remove the pit.
Scoop avocado flesh into a bowl and mash with a fork until desired consistency.
Juice both limes and add to the avocado mixture.
Fold in onion, jalapeño, cilantro, salt, and black pepper.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy avocados when on sale and store in the fridge to extend freshness.
Skip expensive chips and serve with sliced tortillas instead.

recipes.name: Coconut Bread
recipes.description: Belizean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and nutmeg in a bowl.
Cream butter and brown sugar together until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then add vanilla extract.
Alternate adding flour mixture and milk, beginning and ending with flour.
Fold in shredded coconut gently.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 45-50 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
cheapTips: Use store-brand brown sugar and coconut.
Buy unsweetened shredded coconut in bulk bins for half the price of packaged.

recipes.name: Baleadas
recipes.description: Honduran breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt; add warm water and 1 tbsp oil, kneading until soft dough forms.
Divide dough into 4 balls and let rest 10 minutes.
Heat remaining oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Flatten each dough ball into a thin oval and fry 2 minutes per side until golden.
Warm refried beans and spread onto each tortilla while still warm.
Top with queso fresco, sour cream, sliced avocado, and cilantro.
Fold tortilla in half and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Cook dried beans from scratch instead of using canned.
Buy queso fresco from a Latin market instead of specialty stores.

recipes.name: Enchiladas Hondureñas
recipes.description: Honduran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a saucepan; sauté onion and garlic until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add tomato sauce and cumin, simmer for 5 minutes, season with salt and pepper.
Heat remaining oil in a skillet and warm each tortilla briefly on both sides.
Mix shredded chicken with 0.5 cup sour cream and 0.5 cup cheese.
Fill each warm tortilla with chicken mixture, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a greased baking dish.
Pour sauce over enchiladas and top with remaining cheese.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly, then drizzle with remaining sour cream and cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the deli for quick shredding.
Make your own tomato sauce from canned tomatoes to save 40%.

recipes.name: Garnachas
recipes.description: Honduran snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt; add warm water, kneading until soft dough forms.
Divide dough into 8 balls and let rest 10 minutes.
Brown ground beef in a skillet with onion and cumin over medium heat, 5-7 minutes, then drain.
Stir tomato into beef and simmer 2 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet to 350°F.
Flatten each dough ball into a thin disc and fry 2-3 minutes per side until golden and puffy.
Top each fried disc with beef mixture, lettuce, cheese, and jalapeños, then serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions.
Use store-brand oil and seasoning to reduce costs.

recipes.name: Sopa de Res
recipes.description: Honduran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown beef cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes total, then remove and set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in the same pot until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Return beef to pot and add broth; bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots; simmer 15 minutes until partially tender.
Stir in corn and cabbage, then simmer 10-15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper, stir in cilantro, and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck in bulk and freeze; it becomes tender with long cooking.
Use store-brand broth and frozen vegetables to save significantly.

recipes.name: Pollo con Chimol
recipes.description: Honduran dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and cumin on both sides.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken 6-7 minutes per side until golden and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken to a plate and let rest 5 minutes.
In a bowl, combine tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, garlic, and lime juice.
Season chimol with salt and pepper to taste.
Slice chicken and serve topped with chimol.
cheapTips: Buy chicken in family packs and portion into freezer bags.
Make chimol with seasonal tomatoes for better flavor and lower cost.

recipes.name: Chimol
recipes.description: Honduran snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice tomatoes and drain excess liquid in a colander, pressing gently.
Transfer drained tomatoes to a mixing bowl.
Add onion, jalapeños, cilantro, and garlic to the bowl.
Pour lime juice over the mixture and toss gently.
Season with salt and black pepper, then taste and adjust as needed.
Let chimol sit 5 minutes to allow flavors to blend.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips for dipping.
cheapTips: Make with fresh seasonal tomatoes instead of winter hothouse varieties.
Buy lime by the bag when in season and juice yourself.

recipes.name: Plátanos Fritos
recipes.description: Honduran breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.

ingredients.note: 3 green or yellow, peeled and sliced

steps: Peel plantains and slice diagonally into 0.5-inch thick pieces.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F over medium-high heat.
Carefully place plantain slices into hot oil in batches, avoiding crowding.
Fry 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle with salt immediately after frying.
Serve hot topped with sour cream, queso fresco, and cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy plantains when on sale and freeze unpeeled for future use.
Reuse frying oil by straining and storing in a cool place.

recipes.name: Hudut
recipes.description: Belizean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt together, then knead with water until a soft dough forms.
Divide dough into 8 equal portions and roll each flat between plastic wrap.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onions and habanero pepper until softened.
Add chopped tomatoes and cilantro to the pot and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cod fillets and coconut milk to create the sauce, simmering for 10 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Bring water in a separate pot to boil and carefully drop flattened dough rounds into the boiling water.
Remove dumplings when they float and cook 2 minutes longer, then transfer to a serving bowl.
Pour the fish and tomato coconut sauce over the dumplings and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy frozen cod fillets instead of fresh to save money
Use regular milk mixed with water instead of coconut milk

recipes.name: Conch Soup
recipes.description: Belizean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onions, carrots, and celery for 5 minutes.
Add chopped conch meat to the pot and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and continue simmering for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in cilantro and lime juice, then season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Simmer for an additional 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Ladle soup into bowls and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Substitute conch with diced squid or shrimp if conch is unavailable or expensive
Make your own broth from chicken bones

recipes.name: Codfish and Fry Jacks
recipes.description: Belizean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make fry jack dough by mixing flour, baking powder, and salt, then knead with water until smooth.
Divide dough into 8 portions, cover, and let rest for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons oil in a pan and sauté onions until soft, then add cod fillets and cook 5-7 minutes per side.
Add tomatoes, cilantro, and lime juice to the cooked cod and simmer for 5 minutes.
Heat 3 cups oil in a deep pan to 350°F and flatten each dough portion thin.
Fry dough pieces 2-3 minutes per side until golden and puffy, then drain on paper towels.
Serve hot fry jacks alongside the codfish stew.
cheapTips: Buy frozen cod to reduce cost
Use canola oil instead of specialty oils for frying

recipes.name: Fry Jacks
recipes.description: Belizean breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl and mix well.
Slowly add water while kneading until a soft, smooth dough forms.
Cover dough and let rest for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into 8 equal portions and roll each flat between plastic wrap to about 1/4 inch thickness.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan and carefully fry each dough piece 2-3 minutes per side until puffed and golden.
Drain fried jacks on paper towels.
Serve hot with a drizzle of honey, sprinkle of cheese, and warm refried beans on the side.
cheapTips: Make your own refried beans from dried beans instead of canned
Drizzle with jam instead of honey

recipes.name: Stew Beef
recipes.description: Belizean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown beef cubes on all sides in batches, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Remove beef and set aside, then sauté onions and garlic in the same pot for 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return beef to the pot and pour in beef broth, then add whole habanero pepper and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes until beef is tender.
Add potatoes and carrots, then continue simmering for 25 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Remove habanero pepper, stir in cilantro, and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Simmer for 5 more minutes and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck in bulk when on sale and freeze in portions
Use vegetable broth instead of beef broth to reduce cost

recipes.name: Lobster Tail
recipes.description: Belizean dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Using kitchen scissors, cut the top shell of each lobster tail lengthwise and spread open.
Combine melted butter, garlic, lime juice, cilantro, salt, pepper, and paprika in a small bowl.
Brush the butter mixture generously over the exposed lobster meat.
Place lobster tails on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes until the meat is opaque and cooked through.
Transfer lobster tails to serving plates and drizzle with any remaining butter sauce.
Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy frozen lobster tails instead of fresh for significant savings
Use olive oil instead of butter to reduce cost

recipes.name: Creole Boil
recipes.description: Belizean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil and add salt, the whole habanero pepper, and one sliced onion.
Add potatoes and green plantain to the boiling water and cook for 15 minutes.
Add corn cobs and carrots to the pot and continue cooking for 10 minutes.
Add shrimp and remaining sliced onion to the pot and cook for 5 minutes until shrimp turn pink.
Remove habanero pepper and stir in butter, cilantro, and lime juice.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Drain if desired and serve hot in bowls with the broth.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp instead of fresh to save money and reduce prep time
Substitute plantain with regular potato to reduce cost

recipes.name: Boil Up
recipes.description: Belizean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod in water for 4 hours or overnight, changing water periodically, then drain and shred.
Bring a large pot of water to boil and add green plantains, potatoes, and cassava.
Cook for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender but not falling apart.
Add shredded salt cod and sliced onions to the pot and cook for 5 more minutes.
Stir in coconut milk, cilantro, and black pepper, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in butter until melted and well combined.
Serve hot in bowls with the broth and vegetables.
cheapTips: Skip the overnight soaking by using quick-soak method of boiling cod for 10 minutes
Use regular milk mixed with water instead of coconut milk

recipes.name: Panades
recipes.description: Belizean snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt together, then knead with water until a smooth dough forms.
Divide dough into 12 equal portions and let rest for 10 minutes covered.
In a bowl, combine cooked flaked cod, chopped onions, cilantro, and minced habanero pepper.
Flatten each dough portion into a thin oval, add 1 tablespoon of filling to one side, then fold and seal edges.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan and fry panades in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with hot sauce or salsa on the side.
cheapTips: Use frozen cod fillets that are already cooked and flaked
Make filling from canned tuna instead of fresh cod

recipes.name: Tacos
recipes.description: Belizean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté onions and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add ground beef to the skillet and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, for 8-10 minutes until browned.
Stir in cilantro and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan or over a flame for 30 seconds per side.
Place warm tortillas on serving plates and fill each with a spoonful of cooked ground beef.
Top each taco with diced tomatoes and shredded cabbage.
Sprinkle with lime juice and serve with hot sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef when on sale and freeze in meal-sized portions
Make your own tortillas from masa harina flour to save significantly

recipes.name: Aloo Pie
recipes.description: Trinidadian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl, then add oil and warm water until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth, cover and let rest 30 minutes.
Boil potatoes and split peas until tender, drain and mash together with minced onion, garlic, green seasoning, and turmeric.
Divide dough into 4 portions and roll each into a thin circle on oiled surface.
Place filling on one half of each dough circle, fold over and seal edges by pressing with a fork.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and fry pies until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes total.
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels before serving.
cheapTips: Buy dried split peas in bulk from Indian or ethnic markets for half the price
Use regular russet potatoes instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Crab and Callaloo
recipes.description: Trinidadian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onion, garlic, green seasoning, and thyme for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add chopped callaloo and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally until slightly wilted.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer, then add crab meat and hot pepper if using.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until callaloo is very tender and flavors meld together.
Stir in scallion and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Simmer for another 2 minutes and serve hot with roti or dhal and rice.
cheapTips: Use canned crab meat instead of fresh—it's cheaper and works perfectly
Substitute spinach for callaloo if you can't find it at your local store

recipes.name: Provision and Saltfish
recipes.description: Trinidadian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak saltfish in water overnight or at least 8 hours, changing water twice to remove salt.
Boil saltfish for 15 minutes, then drain and flake into bite-sized pieces, removing any bones.
Peel and cut green bananas, dasheen, and yam into 2-inch pieces and boil in salted water for 25 minutes until tender.
While provisions cook, heat oil in a pan and sauté onion and garlic for 2 minutes until soft.
Add tomato, green seasoning, flaked saltfish, and hot pepper if using, cooking for 5 minutes.
Drain provisions and add to the saltfish mixture, gently stirring to combine and warm through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy saltfish at Caribbean or ethnic markets for better prices than supermarkets
Use regular potatoes instead of dasheen if unavailable

recipes.name: Stew Chicken
recipes.description: Trinidadian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot on medium-high heat and add brown sugar, stirring until it caramelizes to a dark brown color.
Add chicken pieces to the caramelized sugar and brown them on all sides for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add diced onion and minced garlic, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste, green seasoning, and thyme, mixing well to coat the chicken.
Pour in chicken broth and add hot pepper if using, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30-35 minutes until chicken is tender and cooked through.
Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper and serve hot with roti, rice, or provisions.
cheapTips: Buy bone-in chicken thighs instead of breasts—they're cheaper and more flavorful
Make your own green seasoning by blending cilantro and chives at home

recipes.name: Channa Bread
recipes.description: Trinidadian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
Add oil and warm water, mixing until a soft dough forms, then knead for 2 minutes.
Mash chickpeas roughly and mix with diced onion, garlic, and green seasoning.
Divide dough into 4 portions, roll thin, and place a spoonful of chickpea mixture in the center.
Fold dough over filling and seal edges by pressing gently with your fingers.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F and fry bread until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes total.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm as a snack or light meal.
cheapTips: Use dried chickpeas that you cook yourself instead of canned to save 50%
Buy flour and oil in bulk for better unit prices

recipes.name: Phlourie
recipes.description: Trinidadian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil yellow split peas in water for 20 minutes until very soft, then drain and mash into a paste.
Mix mashed peas with flour, diced onion, garlic, green seasoning, turmeric, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Let mixture sit for 5 minutes to firm up slightly.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Drop spoonfuls of pea mixture into hot oil, gently flattening them slightly with the back of the spoon.
Fry for 2-3 minutes until golden brown on each side, turning once.
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels, serving hot with tamarind or mango sauce.
cheapTips: Buy dried split peas in bulk from Indian markets at a fraction of supermarket prices
Use cheaper vegetable oil like canola instead of premium oils

recipes.name: Coo-Coo
recipes.description: Trinidadian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion and garlic for 2 minutes until softened.
Add chopped okra, thyme, and hot pepper if using, cooking for 5 minutes until okra releases its liquid.
Bring water or broth to a boil with salt and pepper, then slowly whisk in cornmeal to avoid lumps.
Stir constantly while adding cornmeal to ensure a smooth consistency.
Once all cornmeal is incorporated, reduce heat to low and stir in the cooked okra mixture.
Continue stirring frequently for 10-12 minutes until the mixture thickens and pulls away from the sides of the pot.
Pour onto a serving plate and shape into a mound, serving hot with stew chicken or saltfish.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from ethnic markets or wholesale stores
Use frozen okra instead of fresh for year-round availability at lower cost

recipes.name: Sada Roti
recipes.description: Trinidadian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Add oil and rub into flour with your fingers until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Gradually add warm water while mixing until a soft dough forms, kneading for 3-5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover dough with a damp cloth and let rest for 15 minutes.
Divide dough into 3 equal portions and roll each into a ball, then flatten into thin circular disks on an oiled surface.
Heat a heavy skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and cook each roti for 1-2 minutes per side until light brown spots appear.
Brush lightly with oil while cooking and serve warm with curry, stew, or vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy flour in bulk at warehouse stores for significant savings
This recipe makes its own baking soda—no need to buy expensive leavening agents separately

recipes.name: Stew Pork
recipes.description: Trinidadian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot on medium-high heat and add brown sugar, stirring until dark brown and caramelized.
Working in batches, brown pork cubes in the caramelized sugar for 3-4 minutes per batch on all sides.
Once all pork is browned, add diced onion and garlic, sautéing for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste, green seasoning, and thyme, cooking for 1 minute to combine flavors.
Pour in beef broth and add hot pepper if using, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover with a lid, and simmer for 45 minutes until pork is tender.
Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper and serve hot with roti, rice, or dhal and rice.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder in bulk and freeze—it's significantly cheaper than other cuts
Skip premium brands of tomato paste and use store brands

recipes.name: Oil Down
recipes.description: Trinidadian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cut green bananas and dasheen into 1-inch pieces and dice carrots.
In a large pot, combine bananas, dasheen, carrots, and 2 cups water with 1 teaspoon salt.
Bring to a boil and cook for 15 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Add chopped cabbage, chickpeas, coconut milk, onion, garlic, green seasoning, thyme, and hot pepper if using.
Stir well and bring back to a boil, then reduce heat to medium.
Cook uncovered for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until most liquid has evaporated and ingredients are combined.
Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper and serve hot as a main course or side dish.
cheapTips: Use carrots and cabbage in season or on sale for lowest prices
Buy coconut milk in bulk at Asian markets instead of regular supermarkets

recipes.name: Punta
recipes.description: Honduran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the tripe thoroughly under cold running water, scrubbing away any residue.
Cut the tripe into bite-sized pieces and boil in salted water for 45 minutes until tender.
Dice the onions, garlic, jalapeños, and tomatoes into small pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté the onions and garlic until fragrant.
Add the diced jalapeños and tomatoes, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked tripe and 6 cups of broth to the pot and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in fresh cilantro and lime juice, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in bowls with tortillas on the side.
cheapTips: Buy tripe from ethnic markets for better prices
Make your own broth from bones instead of buying canned

recipes.name: Requeson
recipes.description: Honduran snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat the milk to 180°F in a large pot, stirring occasionally to prevent scorching.
Remove from heat and slowly add vinegar while stirring gently until curds separate from whey.
Let sit for 5 minutes, then pour through cheesecloth to collect the curds.
Rinse the curds under cool water and transfer to a fine mesh strainer.
Add salt to the curds and mix gently.
Heat banana leaves over a flame to make them pliable, then line a mold or cup.
Fill the banana leaf-lined mold with curds and fold the leaves over the top.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and serve with honey drizzled on top.
cheapTips: Use store-brand milk for cost savings
Substitute parchment paper for banana leaves if unavailable

recipes.name: Sopa de Mariscos
recipes.description: Honduran lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onions and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add tomato sauce and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour in the broth and bring to a boil.
Add the fish fillets cut into chunks and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and simmer for 3 minutes until they begin to turn pink.
Add mussels and clams, cover, and cook for 5 minutes until shells open.
Discard any unopened shells and stir in cilantro and lime juice.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy frozen seafood instead of fresh to reduce costs
Use canned clams if fresh are expensive

recipes.name: Elote Loco
recipes.description: Honduran snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil corn in salted water for 8 minutes until tender, then drain.
Melt butter and brush it evenly on the hot corn.
Spread mayonnaise generously over the buttered corn.
Roll the corn in crumbled cotija cheese until well-coated.
Sprinkle chili powder and fresh cilantro over the top.
Squeeze lime juice over the corn just before serving.
Serve immediately on wooden sticks or holders.
cheapTips: Use regular cheddar instead of cotija cheese
Buy corn when in season for better prices

recipes.name: Bollos de Maíz
recipes.description: Honduran breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak corn husks in warm water for 10 minutes until softened and pliable.
Blend corn kernels with milk until you have a coarse paste.
Cream butter and sugar together, then mix in the corn mixture.
Fold in baking powder, salt, and cinnamon until just combined.
Lay a corn husk flat and place 2 tablespoons of batter in the center.
Fold the husk sides over the batter and fold up the bottom to create a packet.
Stand the bollos upright in a pot with 1 inch of water and steam for 20 minutes covered.
Remove and let cool for 5 minutes before carefully unwrapping and serving.
cheapTips: Buy corn in bulk and freeze kernels for year-round use
Use canned corn if fresh is unavailable

recipes.name: Nacatamal
recipes.description: Nicaraguan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice and season pork with salt, pepper, and paprika, then brown in a pot.
Add diced onions and potatoes to the pork and cook until vegetables soften, about 10 minutes.
Mix masa dough with softened butter and broth until light and fluffy.
Heat banana leaves over a flame to make pliable, then lay flat.
Spread a portion of masa on each banana leaf, then add a spoonful of pork mixture in the center.
Top with olives and raisins, then fold the leaf edges over the filling.
Stand the nacatamales upright in a pot with 2 inches of water and steam for 45 minutes.
Serve hot in their banana leaf wrapping.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze uncooked for later
Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until ready to use

recipes.name: Vigorón
recipes.description: Nicaraguan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel yuca and cut into 3-inch pieces, removing the woody core.
Boil yuca in salted water for 20 minutes until very tender.
While yuca cooks, combine shredded cabbage, diced tomatoes, and sliced onion in a bowl.
Add lime juice, olive oil, diced jalapeño, salt, and pepper to the cabbage mixture.
Let the slaw sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Drain the cooked yuca and arrange on a banana leaf.
Top the yuca with the cabbage slaw mixture.
Fold the banana leaf around the ingredients and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy yuca from Latin markets for better prices
Use regular cabbage variety instead of specialty types

recipes.name: Indio Viejo
recipes.description: Nicaraguan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak chiles guajillo in hot water for 10 minutes, then blend with 1/4 cup water.
Brown ground beef in a large pot, then remove and set aside.
Sauté diced onions and minced garlic in the same pot until fragrant.
Add tomato sauce and chile paste, cooking for 3 minutes while stirring.
Return meat to the pot and add broth, simmering for 15 minutes.
Tear tortillas into strips and add to the pot, stirring to break them down.
Simmer for 10 more minutes until the stew thickens.
Beat eggs and slowly stir into the hot mixture off heat, then add cilantro and season with salt and pepper.
cheapTips: Use ground beef from value packs on sale
Substitute dried ancho peppers if guajillos are unavailable

recipes.name: Baho
recipes.description: Nicaraguan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat banana leaves over a flame to make pliable.
Line a large pot with banana leaves.
Cut beef into chunks and layer at the bottom of the pot.
Peel and cut plantains, yuca, and potatoes into chunks, then layer over the meat.
Scatter diced onions, garlic, and cilantro over the vegetables.
Pour beef broth over everything to cover.
Fold banana leaves over the top to cover, then cover pot with lid.
Simmer for 60 minutes until meat is very tender and vegetables are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper before serving.
cheapTips: Buy beef brisket when on sale and freeze
Use store-brand broth instead of homemade

recipes.name: Quesillo
recipes.description: Nicaraguan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk to 185°F in a large pot, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and slowly add vinegar, stirring gently until curds separate.
Let sit for 5 minutes, then pour through cheesecloth to drain.
Rinse curds under cool water and transfer to a strainer to drain completely.
Gently mix curds with salt, minced onion, cilantro, and minced jalapeño.
Heat banana leaves over a flame to soften them.
Line a mold or small bowl with banana leaves.
Fill with the cheese mixture and fold leaves over the top.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and serve at room temperature or slightly warmed.
cheapTips: Use generic white vinegar instead of specialty vinegars
Make a batch and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days

recipes.name: Enchiladas Nicaragüeñas
recipes.description: Nicaraguan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil chicken breast with half the onion, salt, and pepper for 15 minutes until cooked through, then shred the meat and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pan and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until soft.
Add tomato sauce and beef broth to the pan, simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in shredded chicken and season with salt and pepper.
Warm tortillas in a skillet until pliable, then dip each tortilla briefly in the sauce.
Fill each tortilla with chicken mixture, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
Pour remaining sauce over the enchiladas and bake at 350°F for 20 minutes until heated through.
Top with crumbled queso fresco and fresh cilantro before serving.
cheapTips: Buy rotisserie chicken instead of chicken breast to save prep time and money
Use store-brand tomato sauce and broth to reduce costs

recipes.name: Rondon
recipes.description: Nicaraguan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel yuca and cut into 2-inch chunks, boil in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain.
Peel green plantains and cut into thick rounds, boil separately for 10 minutes until softened.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add fish stock and bring to a simmer, then add fish fillets and cook for 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook for another 3 minutes until pink and cooked through.
Pour in coconut milk and gently stir, then add boiled yuca and plantain.
Simmer for 5 more minutes, season with salt and pepper, and garnish with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Substitute shrimp with canned fish or skip it to reduce cost
Buy frozen fish fillets instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Tamales Nicaragüeños
recipes.description: Nicaraguan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak corn husks or plantain leaves in warm water for 30 minutes to soften them.
Boil chicken with half the onion and salt until cooked through, then shred and set aside.
Beat butter with salt until creamy, then gradually add masa harina and warm broth, mixing until light and fluffy.
Sauté remaining onion and garlic in a pan, add shredded chicken, olives, and raisins, cooking for 5 minutes.
Lay a softened leaf flat, spread a thin layer of masa in the center, top with chicken filling, then fold sides in.
Tie the tamales with strips of corn husk and stand them upright in a steamer pot with about 2 inches of water at the bottom.
Cover with extra husks and steam for 45 minutes until the masa pulls away easily from the leaf.
cheapTips: Buy masa harina in bulk at Hispanic markets for better prices
Use canned olives and raisins to save prep time and money

recipes.name: Sopa de Queso
recipes.description: Nicaraguan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into small cubes, then set aside.
Melt butter in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until soft.
Add beef broth and bring to a boil, then add potato cubes and simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are very tender.
Reduce heat to low and slowly add shredded mozzarella while stirring constantly until melted and creamy.
Stir in milk and simmer for 2 more minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with warm corn tortillas on the side.
cheapTips: Use generic shredded mozzarella or mild cheddar instead of expensive imported cheese
Buy potatoes in bulk during sales and store in cool places to save money

recipes.name: Gallina Guisada
recipes.description: Nicaraguan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large, heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs on all sides, about 8 minutes total, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened and fragrant.
Add tomato sauce, chicken broth, cumin, salt, and pepper to the pot and stir well.
Return chicken to the pot, cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in olives and raisins, then continue simmering uncovered for another 10 minutes until chicken is very tender.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs instead of breasts as they are cheaper and more flavorful
Use store-brand tomato sauce and olives to reduce overall cost

recipes.name: Carne Asada Nicaragüeña
recipes.description: Nicaraguan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine orange juice, lime juice, minced garlic, olive oil, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl to make the marinade.
Place beef in a large zip-lock bag or shallow dish and pour marinade over it, rubbing to coat evenly, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove beef from marinade 30 minutes before cooking to bring to room temperature.
Heat a large skillet or grill to high heat, then cook the steak for 6-7 minutes per side for medium-rare, basting occasionally with leftover marinade.
Let the meat rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Serve with grilled onion slices and garnish with fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy beef during sales and freeze it to use later for better prices
Skip the fresh herbs and use dried cumin and garlic powder to save money

recipes.name: Pan de Yuca
recipes.description: Nicaraguan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix yuca flour, crumbled queso fresco, salt, sugar, and baking powder in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, melted butter, and milk.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, stirring until a dough forms.
Scoop dough onto the prepared baking sheet in small mounds, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
cheapTips: Buy yuca flour in bulk from Hispanic or Latin markets for better pricing
Use store-brand queso fresco or mild cheddar as a substitute

recipes.name: Buñuelos de Yuca
recipes.description: Nicaraguan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel yuca and boil in salted water for 20 minutes until very tender, then drain thoroughly.
Mash the cooked yuca with a fork until smooth, then let cool slightly.
Mix in beaten eggs, minced onion, minced garlic, flour, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F, then carefully drop spoonfuls of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown, turning once, then remove with a slotted spoon.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with sour cream on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy yuca at discount produce markets or stores with large Latin sections
Use vegetable oil instead of premium oils and reuse frying oil for cost savings

recipes.name: Cajeta de Coco
recipes.description: Nicaraguan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Line a small baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine brown sugar, butter, and milk in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat, stirring occasionally until butter melts and sugar dissolves.
Add shredded coconut and vanilla extract, then increase heat to medium-high and stir constantly for 15-20 minutes until the mixture thickens and becomes caramel-colored.
The mixture should pull away from the sides of the pot when it's ready; test by dropping a small spoonful in cold water—it should form a soft ball.
Remove from heat and let cool for 2 minutes, then drop small spoonfuls onto the prepared parchment paper.
Allow to cool and harden for 30 minutes before storing in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Buy shredded coconut in bulk from warehouse stores or bulk bins
Use regular granulated sugar instead of brown sugar if on a tight budget

recipes.name: Almíbar de Piña
recipes.description: Nicaraguan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel, core, and cut fresh pineapple into small cubes, discarding the core.
Combine sugar and water in a heavy pot over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves completely.
Add cinnamon stick, cloves, and a pinch of salt, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Add pineapple cubes and lime juice, then simmer for 12-15 minutes until the pineapple is very soft and the syrup thickens slightly.
Remove cinnamon stick and cloves with a fork or slotted spoon.
Let cool completely, then serve as a dessert topping, side dish, or condiment with rice or bread.
cheapTips: Buy pineapples on sale or at discount produce stores and cut yourself
Use whole spices bought in bulk instead of small pre-packaged containers

recipes.name: Locro Paraguayo
recipes.description: Paraguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown the beef chunks on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Add diced onions and minced garlic, sauté until softened, about 3 minutes.
Sprinkle paprika over the meat and stir to coat evenly.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and corn kernels to the pot.
Continue simmering until potatoes are tender and beef is fork-tender, about 25 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot in bowls with the broth.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn instead of fresh to save money.
Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for later use.

recipes.name: Bife Encebollado
recipes.description: Paraguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onions into thick rings and set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steaks with salt and pepper, then sear them for 4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Remove steaks and set aside on a plate.
Add remaining oil to the pan and cook onions and minced garlic until caramelized, about 12 minutes, stirring often.
Return steaks to the pan and top with caramelized onions.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy sirloin steak on sale and trim excess fat yourself.
Use yellow onions instead of sweet onions to reduce cost.

recipes.name: Cazuela Paraguaya
recipes.description: Paraguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a baking dish.
Heat oil in a skillet and brown the ground beef with diced onions, about 8 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Bring milk to a simmer in a pot, then slowly whisk in cornmeal to avoid lumps, stirring constantly for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cooked beef, 1 cup cheese, eggs, and butter until well combined.
Pour mixture into the baking dish and spread evenly.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden and set in the center.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cornmeal and milk to reduce costs.
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use.

recipes.name: Puchero Paraguayo
recipes.description: Paraguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Add quartered onions and garlic, sauté for 3 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Cut potatoes into chunks and carrots into rounds, add to the pot.
Cut corn ears in half and add to the pot.
Simmer for another 35-40 minutes until vegetables are tender and beef is very tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve in bowls with generous broth and vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck in bulk and freeze portions.
Use frozen corn to save money while maintaining flavor.

recipes.name: Arepas Paraguayas
recipes.description: Paraguayan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix cornmeal, milk, eggs, cheese, and salt in a bowl until a thick dough forms.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat until hot.
Drop spoonfuls of dough into the oil and flatten slightly with the back of the spoon.
Fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to a paper towel to drain excess oil.
Serve warm, optionally with fried cheese or meat on top.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from Latin markets for better prices.
Use block cheese and grate it yourself to save money.

recipes.name: Mbeju
recipes.description: Paraguayan breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the cheese and onion finely.
In a bowl, combine cassava starch, eggs, diced cheese, onion, salt, and pepper until mixture holds together.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Form dough into 3-inch discs and place gently in the hot oil.
Fry for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy on the edges.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.
cheapTips: Find cassava starch at Latin grocery stores for cheaper prices.
Use regular mozzarella if queso de freír is unavailable.

recipes.name: Chipa Almidón
recipes.description: Paraguayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a baking sheet.
Mix cornstarch, milk, grated cheese, eggs, and salt in a bowl until a thick batter forms.
Drop rounded tablespoons of batter onto the baking sheet, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Dot each with a small piece of butter.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown and set.
Cool for 2 minutes before serving warm.
cheapTips: Buy cornstarch in bulk for significant savings.
Use store-brand cheese for budget-friendly meals.

recipes.name: Soja Paraguay
recipes.description: Paraguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot and brown ground beef with diced onions and garlic, about 8 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and paprika, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced potatoes and beef broth, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 35-40 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot as a hearty stew.
cheapTips: Use 80/20 ground beef for better flavor at lower cost.
Buy potatoes in bulk from warehouse stores.

recipes.name: Chipa Chipá
recipes.description: Paraguayan snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine cassava starch, cheese, cornmeal, salt, and melted butter in a bowl.
Beat eggs with milk and mix into the starch mixture until a thick dough forms.
Shape dough into small balls or ring shapes.
Place on baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes until golden.
Cool for 5 minutes and serve warm.
cheapTips: Visit Latin markets for cheaper cassava starch prices.
Make double batch and freeze extras for quick snacks.

recipes.name: Guiso de Lentejas
recipes.description: Paraguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse lentils under cold water and pick through for debris.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté diced onions and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add diced carrots and potatoes, cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cumin, cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils and vegetable broth, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 40-45 minutes until lentils are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot as a vegetarian main dish.
cheapTips: Buy lentils in bulk from bulk bins for cheapest price.
Use vegetable broth or water to further reduce costs.

recipes.name: Tamago Kake Gohan
recipes.description: Japanese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour the warm cooked rice into a bowl.
Crack the raw egg directly into the center of the rice.
Mix soy sauce and mirin together in a small bowl.
Pour the soy-mirin mixture over the egg and rice.
Stir everything together vigorously until the egg is fully incorporated and the rice is glossy.
Tear the nori into small pieces and sprinkle over the top.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds before serving.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk during sales and store in refrigerator for weeks.
Use leftover rice from dinner the night before to save cooking time.

recipes.name: Medames
recipes.description: Egyptian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain and rinse the canned fava beans thoroughly under cold water.
Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and add minced garlic.
Add the fava beans and cumin, stirring constantly for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Mash the beans roughly with the back of a spoon, leaving some whole for texture.
Stir in lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a serving bowl and drizzle with additional olive oil.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm with pita bread and hard boiled eggs on the side.
cheapTips: Buy canned fava beans instead of dried to skip overnight soaking and cooking time.
Use jarred minced garlic if you don't have fresh garlic on hand.

recipes.name: Bagel with Lox
recipes.description: Jewish American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the bagel in half and toast it until golden brown on both sides.
Spread cream cheese evenly on both halves of the toasted bagel.
Layer the smoked salmon over the cream cheese on one or both halves.
Arrange thin red onion slices and tomato slices on top of the lox.
Sprinkle capers over the top and garnish with fresh dill.
Serve immediately with a lemon wedge on the side for squeezing over if desired.
cheapTips: Buy regular smoked salmon instead of premium lox to reduce costs.
Make your own capers substitute by using diced pickles for a sharper flavor.

recipes.name: Labneh with Za'atar
recipes.description: Levantine breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Line a fine mesh strainer with cheesecloth and place over a bowl.
Mix yogurt with salt in a bowl, then pour into the cheesecloth-lined strainer.
Fold the cheesecloth over the yogurt and refrigerate for 12-24 hours to drain completely.
Remove the labneh from the cheesecloth and place in a serving bowl.
Make a well in the center of the labneh with the back of a spoon.
Pour olive oil into the well and sprinkle za'atar generously on top.
Garnish with fresh thyme and lemon juice, serving with warm pita bread for dipping.
cheapTips: Use Greek yogurt as a shortcut to skip the overnight draining step.
Buy za'atar in bulk from Middle Eastern markets instead of specialty grocers for better prices.

recipes.name: Crumpets
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine flour, salt, sugar, and yeast in a large bowl.
Add warm water and melted butter, stirring until a thick batter forms.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature for 30 minutes until bubbly.
Stir baking soda into the batter just before cooking.
Heat a non-stick griddle or skillet over medium-low heat and lightly butter it.
Pour batter into crumpet rings or a 2-inch tall metal circle mold, filling halfway up the sides.
Cook for 5-7 minutes until the tops appear dry and pale, then flip and cook 2 more minutes until golden.
Remove from the rings and serve warm with jam, honey, or butter.
cheapTips: Make crumpet rings at home by cutting the top and bottom off aluminum cans.
Prepare the batter the night before and cook fresh in the morning for convenience.

recipes.name: Mooncake
recipes.description: Chinese snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together golden syrup, alkaline water, and vegetable oil until fully combined.
Add the mooncake flour blend to the wet ingredients and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and rest at room temperature for 2 hours.
Divide dough into 8 portions and red bean paste into 8 portions of equal size.
Flatten a dough portion, place a red bean paste portion and one egg yolk in the center, then seal by gently pulling the dough edges up and around the filling.
Place the filled dough ball into a mooncake mold and press firmly to create a decorative pattern, then press the mold release to eject the shaped mooncake.
Place mooncakes on a baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 15 minutes until golden brown.
Cool completely and store in an airtight container for 3-5 days before serving to allow flavors to develop.
cheapTips: Buy salted duck egg yolks in bulk from Asian markets instead of specialty food shops.
Make your own red bean paste by boiling dried red beans with sugar to save significantly on cost.

recipes.name: Zongzi
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak dried bamboo leaves in hot water for 30 minutes until soft and pliable.
Rinse glutinous rice and cook with salt and oil until just tender but still slightly firm.
Lay two bamboo leaves perpendicular to each other to form a cross on a work surface.
Place a spoonful of rice in the center, add a small amount of red bean paste, a piece of duck egg yolk, and diced sausage, then top with more rice.
Fold the bamboo leaves up and over the filling to create a pyramid or tetrahedral shape, tucking ends in securely.
Place all zongzi in a large pot of boiling water and simmer for 45 minutes until the rice is fully cooked.
Remove zongzi with a slotted spoon and cool slightly before serving.
cheapTips: Buy bamboo leaves in bulk from Asian markets dried for long-term storage.
Substitute Chinese sausage with diced pork belly or omit entirely to reduce costs.

recipes.name: Hamantash
recipes.description: Jewish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cream together softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until fully incorporated.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Mix the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until a soft dough forms.
Roll dough out to 0.25 inch thickness and cut into 3-inch rounds using a cookie cutter.
Place 1 teaspoon of poppy seed filling in the center of each round and fold three edges up to form a triangle, pinching the corners to seal.
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake at 375°F for 12-15 minutes until edges are lightly golden.
cheapTips: Buy poppy seed filling in bulk or make your own with ground poppy seeds and honey.
Make dough in batches and freeze for up to 3 months to bake fresh throughout the year.

recipes.name: Peppernuts
recipes.description: German snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Cream butter and brown sugar together until light and fluffy.
Beat in the egg until fully incorporated.
Whisk together flour, black pepper, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt in a separate bowl.
Mix dry ingredients into the wet mixture until a stiff dough forms.
Roll small portions of dough into pea-sized balls and place on baking sheets.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until firm but not brown, then cool on baking sheets before transferring to an airtight container.
cheapTips: Buy spices in bulk from ethnic markets instead of supermarket jars.
Store finished peppernuts in an airtight container with a slice of bread to keep them soft.

recipes.name: Matzah
recipes.description: Jewish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt together in a large bowl.
Add water and olive oil, stirring until a stiff dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal balls and roll each ball out to a very thin 0.125 inch thickness on a floured surface.
Heat a dry skillet or griddle over high heat until very hot.
Place one thin dough sheet onto the hot skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes per side until the surface shows dark spots but remains pliable.
Stack the finished matzah on a clean towel to keep warm while cooking the remaining sheets.
cheapTips: Store finished matzah in an airtight container to maintain crispness for several days.
Use water that is at room temperature rather than warm to prevent dough activation.

recipes.name: Rondón de Mariscos
recipes.description: Nicaraguan dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and chop plantains and yams into 2-inch chunks, then boil in salted water for 15 minutes until partially tender.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the partially cooked plantains and yams to the pot with 2 cups of water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir well, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the fish fillets cut into chunks, then the shrimp and crab legs, stirring gently.
Simmer for 8-10 minutes until the seafood is cooked through and opaque.
Stir in fresh cilantro and lime juice, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls with vegetables and broth, serving immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen seafood instead of fresh to save 20-30%
Use canned coconut milk for better budget control

recipes.name: Wontons in Chili Oil
recipes.description: Cantonese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely mince shrimp and mix with ground pork, chopped green onions, minced garlic, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Place 1 teaspoon of filling in the center of each wonton wrapper.
Wet edges with water, fold into a triangle, then bring corners together and seal to form traditional wonton shape.
Bring 8 cups of water to a boil in a large pot with a pinch of salt.
Carefully drop wontons into boiling water and stir gently to prevent sticking.
Cook for 4-5 minutes until wontons float and maintain position for 1 minute.
Ladle wontons and broth into bowls, then drizzle with chili oil and rice vinegar.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy wonton wrappers in bulk frozen sections
Use pork shoulder instead of premium cuts

recipes.name: Chive and Egg Dumplings
recipes.description: Chinese breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour with warm water and knead for 8 minutes until smooth dough forms, then let rest 10 minutes covered.
Scramble eggs with 1 tablespoon oil, breaking into small pieces, then mix with chopped chives and salt.
Divide dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each into a thin 4-inch circle.
Place 2 tablespoons filling in center of each wrapper, then fold and pleat edges to seal into half-moon shape.
Bring 6 cups of water to boil in a large pot.
Drop dumplings into boiling water and stir gently; cook 5 minutes until they float, then 2 more minutes.
Remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to bowls.
Serve with dipping sauce of soy sauce mixed with sesame oil.
cheapTips: Make dough from scratch instead of buying premade wrappers
Buy fresh chives from farmers markets in bulk

recipes.name: Shrimp and Chive Dumplings
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely chop shrimp and mix with minced chives, minced garlic, sesame oil, soy sauce, and white pepper.
Place 1 teaspoon filling in center of each wonton wrapper.
Wet edges with water and fold into triangle, then bring bottom corners together and press to seal.
Bring 8 cups of water to boil in a pot.
Gently add dumplings in batches, stirring to prevent sticking.
Cook for 4-5 minutes until dumplings float and stay floating for 1 minute.
Transfer to serving bowls with broth using a slotted spoon.
Serve with dipping sauce of rice vinegar and soy sauce mixed together.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp on sale and store in freezer
Purchase wonton wrappers in bulk

recipes.name: Vegetable Dumplings
recipes.description: Chinese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely chop cabbage, carrots, mushrooms, and green onions, then squeeze out excess moisture using paper towels.
Mix vegetables with minced garlic, minced ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt in a bowl.
Place 1 teaspoon filling in center of each wonton wrapper.
Wet edges with water and fold into triangle, then bring corners together to seal.
Bring 8 cups of water to a rolling boil in a large pot.
Carefully add dumplings and stir gently to prevent sticking.
Cook for 5 minutes until they float, then 2 more minutes until they maintain position.
Serve in bowls with broth and drizzle with additional sesame oil if desired.
cheapTips: Use cabbage as base since it's cheap year-round
Buy mushrooms on sale and use immediately

recipes.name: Lamb Dumplings
recipes.description: Northern Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground lamb with chopped green onions, minced garlic, minced ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Place 1 teaspoon filling in center of each wonton wrapper.
Wet edges with water and fold into triangle, then bring corners together and press firmly to seal.
Bring 8 cups of water to a boil in a large pot.
Add dumplings carefully in batches, stirring gently to prevent sticking.
Cook for 5-6 minutes until dumplings float and stay floating for 1 minute.
Transfer to serving bowls with broth using a slotted spoon.
Serve immediately with soy sauce or chili oil for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy ground lamb when on sale and freeze
Use regular onions instead of green onions if budget is tight

recipes.name: Momos with Meat
recipes.description: Nepalese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour with warm water and knead until smooth dough forms, then cover and rest for 15 minutes.
Sauté diced onion in oil until softened, then add meat, minced garlic, and ginger, cooking until browned; season with salt and pepper.
Stir in cilantro and let filling cool for 5 minutes.
Divide dough into 20 pieces and roll each into 3-inch circle.
Place 1 tablespoon filling in center, then fold and pleat edges to form pouch shape, pinching top closed.
Bring 6 cups of water to boil in a pot.
Add momos carefully and stir gently; cook for 8-10 minutes until they float and stay floating for 2 minutes.
Serve in bowls with broth and optionally with sesame oil or hot sauce.
cheapTips: Make dough from scratch to save on wrapper costs
Use ground pork instead of beef for better value

recipes.name: Chicken Soup with Matzo Balls
recipes.description: Jewish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place whole chicken in a large pot with 12 cups of water, diced onion, carrots, celery, and bring to boil.
Skim foam from top, then reduce heat and simmer for 60 minutes until chicken is very tender.
Remove chicken and vegetables; strain broth and return to pot, discarding solids except carrots.
While broth simmers, whisk together matzo meal, eggs, oil, salt, and pepper until combined.
Let matzo mixture rest for 15 minutes until thickened.
Bring broth back to gentle boil and drop tablespoon-sized portions of matzo mixture into broth.
Simmer matzo balls for 25-30 minutes until fluffy and cooked through.
Serve matzo balls with broth, shredded chicken, and cooked carrots, garnished with fresh dill.
cheapTips: Buy whole chicken instead of parts for better value
Make extra matzo balls and freeze for later

recipes.name: Olla Podrida
recipes.description: Spanish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop bacon and cook in a large pot until crispy, then remove and set aside.
Cut beef and chorizo into 1-inch chunks, then brown in bacon fat for 5 minutes.
Add diced onion and minced garlic, sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in beef broth and add bay leaves, diced potatoes, and carrots; simmer for 45 minutes.
Drain and rinse chickpeas, then add to pot with chopped cabbage and cooked bacon.
Simmer for another 20 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in bowls as a hearty stew with crusty bread on the side.
cheapTips: Use canned chickpeas instead of dried to save time
Buy beef chuck on sale and use tougher cuts for stewing

recipes.name: Haggis
recipes.description: Scottish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil lamb liver, heart, lungs, and shoulder in water for 60 minutes until tender, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid.
Finely chop or grind all cooked meat with minced onion and garlic.
Toast oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes, stirring constantly until lightly browned.
Mix ground meat with suet, toasted oats, salt, pepper, cayenne, and thyme in a large bowl.
Add reserved cooking liquid gradually until mixture is moist but not wet.
Rinse casing thoroughly and stuff with meat mixture, then tie both ends securely.
Place haggis in boiling water and simmer for 90 minutes, maintaining gentle boil.
Remove carefully, let rest 5 minutes, then slice and serve with mashed potatoes and rutabaga.
cheapTips: Source offal from specialty butchers or farmers markets for best prices
Ask butcher if they have lamb trim or less popular cuts on sale

recipes.name: Paella Paraguaya
recipes.description: Paraguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a 9-inch baking dish.
Sauté diced onion in a skillet with 2 tablespoons butter until soft, then add ground beef and cook until browned.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs and milk with salt and pepper.
Combine corn kernels, cooked beef mixture, and cheese in the prepared baking dish.
Pour the egg mixture over the corn and beef, stirring gently to distribute evenly.
Dot the top with remaining 2 tablespoons butter and bake for 30 minutes until golden and set.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn to save money and eliminate prep work
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Reviro
recipes.description: Paraguayan lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
In a bowl, combine cassava starch, shredded cheese, eggs, milk, and salt until a thick batter forms.
Drop spoonfuls of the mixture into the hot skillet, flattening each slightly with the back of the spoon.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy at the edges.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and serve warm.
cheapTips: Cassava starch is inexpensive at Latin markets and online
