Top with red onion slices and tomato slices.
Sprinkle capers over each bagel.
Serve immediately while bagel is still warm.
cheapTips: Buy lox from the grocery store deli counter instead of specialty shops
Use regular smoked salmon instead of premium lox varieties

recipes.name: Eggs and Onions
recipes.description: Jewish Deli breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onions into thin rounds and cook in 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until very soft and caramelized.
Crack eggs into a bowl and beat with salt and pepper until well combined.
Push caramelized onions to the side of the pan and add remaining butter.
Pour beaten eggs into the pan and stir gently, folding in onions as eggs begin to set, about 4-5 minutes.
Cook until eggs are soft and creamy but not dry.
Serve immediately on warm buttered rye bread or challah.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale and store for up to 4 weeks
Use regular yellow onions instead of sweet onions to save 30%

recipes.name: Egg Cream
recipes.description: Jewish Deli snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour milk into two tall glasses, filling each about three-quarters full.
Add 1 tablespoon of chocolate syrup to each glass.
Stir vigorously with a long spoon or whisk until chocolate is completely dissolved and mixture is smooth.
Slowly add seltzer water while stirring gently, pouring down the side of the glass to create foam.
Serve immediately while still cold and fizzy.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand chocolate syrup instead of name brands
Use generic seltzer water from discount stores for best value

recipes.name: Tri-Tip Sandwich
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak wood chips in water for 30 minutes.
Pat tri-tip dry and apply dry rub evenly on all sides.
Set up smoker to 225°F and add soaked wood chips.
Place tri-tip on grate and smoke for 2–2.5 hours until internal temperature reaches 135°F.
Remove and let rest for 10 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Mix coleslaw with mayonnaise and vinegar.
Toast sandwich rolls lightly on a griddle.
Layer meat on rolls, top with coleslaw and BBQ sauce, and serve.
cheapTips: Buy tri-tip when on sale and freeze for later
Make your own BBQ sauce instead of buying bottled

recipes.name: Whole Hog Plate
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak hickory chips in water for 30 minutes.
Apply dry rub generously to all pork pieces.
Set smoker to 225°F and add wood chips.
Place pork shoulder on grate and smoke for 3 hours, then add ribs and belly.
Continue smoking all pieces for 3 more hours until shoulder reaches 190°F internal temp.
Remove meat and let rest for 15 minutes.
Shred shoulder, slice ribs, and chop belly into pieces.
Arrange assorted meats on a plate with bread and pickles, drizzle with warm BBQ sauce.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder in bulk when discounted
Use store-brand dry rub and sauce

recipes.name: St. Louis Ribs
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove the membrane from the back of ribs by sliding a knife underneath and peeling it off.
Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, and pepper to create a dry rub.
Apply dry rub evenly on both sides of ribs and let sit for 30 minutes.
Soak wood chips and set smoker to 250°F.
Place ribs on grate and smoke for 4–5 hours until meat pulls back from bones.
During the last hour, brush ribs with BBQ sauce every 15 minutes.
Remove ribs and brush with melted butter.
Cut between bones and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy ribs at warehouse stores for bulk savings
Mix your own dry rub instead of buying pre-made packets

recipes.name: Memphis Wet Ribs
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove membrane from ribs and apply a dry rub of brown sugar, paprika, cayenne, and garlic powder.
Let ribs sit with rub for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Set smoker to 250°F and add soaked hickory chips.
Place ribs on grate and smoke for 4 hours.
Mix BBQ sauce with apple cider vinegar to create a thin wet sauce.
Brush ribs generously with wet sauce every 15 minutes during the last hour of smoking.
Remove ribs when meat pulls back 1/4 inch from bones.
Serve with extra wet sauce on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Make sauce from scratch with ketchup, vinegar, and spices
Buy baby back ribs on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Smoked Chicken Quarters
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken quarters dry with paper towels.
Rub chicken with olive oil and apply salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
Set smoker to 225°F and add soaked oak chips.
Place chicken on grate skin-side up and smoke for 2 hours.
Brush with BBQ sauce and smoke for 30 more minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve with additional sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Chicken quarters are cheaper than breasts
Buy in bulk and freeze for multiple meals

recipes.name: Beef Short Ribs
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim excess fat from beef short ribs, leaving about 0.25 inch.
Mix brown sugar, paprika, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder into a dry rub.
Apply rub generously to all sides of ribs and let sit for 1 hour.
Set smoker to 225°F and add soaked hickory chips.
Place ribs on grate and smoke for 4 hours, spritzing with beef broth every 30 minutes.
During the last hour, brush ribs with BBQ sauce every 15 minutes.
Ribs are done when meat pulls back and a toothpick pierces easily.
Remove and serve hot with extra sauce.
cheapTips: Buy chuck short ribs instead of premium cuts
Use homemade dry rub instead of seasoning packets

recipes.name: Barbeque Nachos
recipes.description: Southern BBQ snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Spread tortilla chips on a baking sheet.
Warm pulled pork with BBQ sauce on the stovetop or microwave for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle shredded cheese evenly over chips.
Top with warm BBQ pork and jalapeños.
Bake for 5–7 minutes until cheese is melted.
Drizzle with sour cream and sprinkle green onions and cilantro.
Serve immediately while hot and crispy.
cheapTips: Use leftover pulled pork from previous meals
Buy store-brand tortilla chips and cheese

recipes.name: Beignet Café au Lait
recipes.description: French-Creole breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm milk and dissolve butter in it, then cool slightly.
Whisk together flour, granulated sugar, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Beat egg and add to warm milk mixture, then combine with flour mixture to form dough.
Knead for 2 minutes, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes.
Roll dough to 0.25 inch thickness on a floured surface and cut into 2-inch squares.
Heat oil to 375°F and fry beignets in batches until golden brown on both sides (about 1 minute per side).
Remove with slotted spoon and dust generously with powdered sugar.
Brew strong coffee, mix with hot milk in a 1:1 ratio, and serve alongside warm beignets.
cheapTips: Use instant coffee instead of expensive espresso beans
Make beignets in batches and freeze extras

recipes.name: Shrimp Gumbo
recipes.description: Creole dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and slowly whisk in flour to create a dark roux, stirring constantly for 8–10 minutes until chocolate brown.
Add diced onion, celery, and bell pepper (the holy trinity) to roux and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Pour in chicken broth and canned tomatoes with juices, stirring to combine.
Add Creole seasoning and hot sauce, then bring to a simmer.
Simmer gumbo for 15 minutes to blend flavors.
Add shrimp and okra to pot and cook for 5 minutes until shrimp turn pink.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve over white rice in bowls.
cheapTips: Use frozen okra instead of fresh
Buy frozen shrimp at a discount warehouse

recipes.name: Memphis Dry Rub Ribs
recipes.description: Memphis BBQ dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove the membrane from the underside of ribs using a sharp knife.
Mix brown sugar, paprika, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne in a bowl to create dry rub.
Apply dry rub generously and evenly to both sides of ribs, patting it in firmly.
Let ribs sit with rub for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Set smoker to 250°F and add soaked hickory chips.
Place ribs on grate and smoke for 4–5 hours, spritzing with apple cider vinegar solution every 30 minutes.
Ribs are done when meat pulls back from bones and bends easily.
Remove and serve immediately without sauce to showcase the dry rub flavor.
cheapTips: Make your own dry rub instead of buying packets
Buy ribs when on sale and freeze for later

recipes.name: Prince's Hot Chicken
recipes.description: Nashville Hot Chicken lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Marinate chicken thighs in buttermilk for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Mix flour, cayenne pepper, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper in a shallow bowl.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep pot or Dutch oven.
Remove chicken from buttermilk and dredge thoroughly in the spiced flour mixture.
Carefully place chicken into hot oil and fry for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken and drain on paper towels.
Mix hot sauce with remaining spiced flour to create a paste and brush onto the hot chicken.
Serve immediately on white bread with pickles.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze them; they're cheaper than breasts
Use store-brand buttermilk and spices from the bulk section

recipes.name: Hattie B's Hot Chicken
recipes.description: Nashville Hot Chicken lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound to 1-inch thickness.
Marinate pounded chicken in buttermilk and 1 teaspoon salt for 4 hours.
Combine flour, cayenne pepper, paprika, black pepper, and garlic powder in a shallow dish.
Heat oil to 325°F in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Dredge each chicken breast in the flour mixture, coating thoroughly on all sides.
Fry chicken for 10-12 minutes until deep golden brown and cooked through.
Melt butter and mix with remaining spice blend to create a glaze.
Brush the hot glaze over the fried chicken immediately after removing from oil.
Serve on buttered buns with coleslaw and pickles.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens and break them down yourself instead of buying pre-cut pieces
Make your own buttermilk by mixing milk with lemon juice

recipes.name: Bolton's Spicy Chicken & Fish
recipes.description: Nashville Hot Chicken lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat catfish fillets and chicken thighs dry and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Submerge both proteins in buttermilk for at least 1 hour.
Mix cornmeal, flour, cayenne pepper, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper together.
Heat oil to 350°F in a large cast-iron skillet or deep pot.
Dredge catfish and chicken in the cornmeal mixture until fully coated.
Fry catfish for 6-7 minutes until golden and flakes easily.
Fry chicken for 12-14 minutes until deep golden brown and reaches 165°F internally.
Drain both on paper towels and serve immediately with hot sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy catfish frozen in bulk; it's cheaper and keeps longer
Substitute chicken legs for thighs to save money

recipes.name: Fish & Chips
recipes.description: Nashville Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 0.25-inch thick fries and soak in cold water for 30 minutes.
Heat oil to 325°F in a deep pot or fryer.
Drain potatoes and pat completely dry, then fry in batches for 5-6 minutes until soft but not brown.
Remove fries and increase oil temperature to 375°F.
Whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and black pepper.
Combine water and dry mixture to create a light batter.
Dip fish fillets into batter and fry at 375°F for 4-5 minutes until golden and crispy.
Return fries to hot oil for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain all on paper towels, season with salt, and serve immediately with tartar sauce.
cheapTips: Use frozen cod instead of fresh; it's more affordable and works just as well
Buy potatoes in bulk when on sale and store in cool place

recipes.name: Meat and Three Plate
recipes.description: Nashville Soul Food lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season pork chops with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat oil in a skillet and pan-fry pork chops for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Remove pork and set aside on a plate.
Chop salt pork and onion, then cook in the same skillet for 2 minutes.
Add chopped collard greens to the skillet with a splash of water and simmer for 20-25 minutes until tender.
Prepare cornbread according to package directions using milk instead of water.
Heat canned black-eyed peas in a saucepan with butter, salt, and pepper for 5 minutes.
Arrange pork chop, greens, peas, and cornbread on a plate and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use canned greens if fresh are expensive; drain and rinse before cooking
Buy pork chops from the family pack section for better deals

recipes.name: Greens with Pot Liquor
recipes.description: Nashville Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop bacon and cook in a large pot until crispy, then remove and set aside.
Dice onion and mince garlic, then sauté in the bacon fat for 3-4 minutes.
Add vegetable broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Wash collard greens thoroughly, remove tough stems, and chop into bite-sized pieces.
Add greens to the boiling broth in batches, stirring as they wilt.
Season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Simmer for 30-35 minutes until greens are very tender and the pot liquor is flavorful.
Stir in vinegar and cooked bacon just before serving.
Serve with cornbread and the pot liquor spooned over the greens.
cheapTips: Buy greens in bundles rather than pre-packaged for better value
Use whatever greens are on sale: collards, mustard, or turnip

recipes.name: Hot Brown Sandwich
recipes.description: Nashville Regional lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fry bacon until crispy, then drain and crumble into pieces.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat and whisk in flour to create a roux.
Gradually pour in milk while stirring constantly to create a smooth sauce.
Add cheese, salt, and pepper to the sauce and stir until melted.
Toast bread slices lightly and arrange two slices on each plate.
Layer sliced turkey breast on the toast.
Slice tomato and arrange over the turkey.
Pour the cheese sauce generously over the sandwich.
Top with crumbled bacon and place under the broiler for 2-3 minutes until sauce bubbles.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use deli counter turkey slices or rotisserie chicken instead of pre-packaged
Make cheese sauce from scratch with butter and flour rather than using canned sauce

recipes.name: Pimento Cheese Sandwich
recipes.description: Nashville Southern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain roasted red peppers thoroughly and chop into small pieces.
Combine shredded cheddar cheese and mayonnaise in a mixing bowl.
Fold chopped peppers and pickles into the cheese and mayo mixture.
Season with garlic powder, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Mix until well combined and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes if time allows.
Spread pimento cheese thickly on bread slices.
Cut sandwiches diagonally and serve immediately or pack in lunch containers.
cheapTips: Buy cheese from the block section and shred it yourself to save 20-30%
Use store-brand mayo and seasonings to cut costs

recipes.name: Sweet Tea
recipes.description: Nashville Southern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring 2 quarts of water to a rolling boil in a large pot.
Remove from heat and immediately add tea bags.
Steep for 5-7 minutes until the water is deeply brewed.
Remove tea bags by pressing them gently with a spoon against the side of the pot.
While tea is still hot, stir in sugar until completely dissolved.
Pour tea into a pitcher and squeeze lemon juice into it.
Add ice and stir well.
Refrigerate until cold and serve over fresh ice in glasses.
cheapTips: Buy tea bags in bulk for significant savings
Use tap water instead of bottled water

recipes.name: Red Velvet Cake
recipes.description: Nashville Southern snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease two 9-inch round cake pans.
Combine flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk together eggs, buttermilk, oil, vinegar, red food coloring, and vanilla.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Divide batter evenly between prepared pans.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool cakes in pans for 10 minutes, then turn out onto wire racks.
For frosting, beat softened cream cheese and butter until smooth.
Gradually add powdered sugar and vanilla, beating until light and fluffy.
Once cakes are cool, spread frosting between layers and over the outside of the cake.
cheapTips: Make your own buttermilk by mixing milk with vinegar
Use store-brand cream cheese and powdered sugar

recipes.name: Brisket Plate
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt in a bowl to create a dry rub.
Coat the entire brisket generously with the dry rub and let sit for 2 hours at room temperature.
Preheat oven to 325°F and place brisket fat-side up in a large roasting pan.
Combine beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, and apple cider vinegar, then pour around the brisket.
Cover the pan tightly with foil and bake for 5-6 hours until the meat is very tender and pulls apart easily.
Remove foil, increase heat to 400°F, and bake uncovered for 30 minutes to develop a bark.
Let rest for 15 minutes, then slice against the grain into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Brush slices with melted butter and serve with pan drippings as sauce.
cheapTips: Buy brisket on sale and freeze; it keeps for months.
Skip expensive BBQ sauce and use the pan drippings instead.

recipes.name: Ribs
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove the thin membrane from the back of each rib rack by sliding a knife underneath and peeling it off.
Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt together and rub generously on both sides of the ribs.
Preheat oven to 300°F and place ribs bone-side down on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Pour apple juice into the bottom of the pan around the ribs, cover tightly with foil, and bake for 2.5 hours.
Mix together butter, honey, and ketchup to create a glaze.
Remove foil, brush ribs with glaze, and return to oven for 20 minutes uncovered.
Apply another coat of glaze and bake for another 15 minutes until the sauce caramelizes.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice between the bones and serve.
cheapTips: Buy ribs on sale and freeze for later use.
Use store-brand honey and ketchup to save on glaze costs.

recipes.name: Burnt Ends
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and brown sugar to create a dry rub.
Rub the entire brisket point with the spice mixture and let sit for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 325°F and bake the brisket covered in foil for 3 hours until very tender.
Cut the cooked brisket into 1-inch cubes.
In a bowl, mix butter, brown sugar, ketchup, and Worcestershire sauce.
Toss the brisket cubes with the glaze mixture and spread on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Increase oven temperature to 400°F and bake the cubes uncovered for 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the edges caramelize and char slightly.
Serve hot with extra sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Use the point cut (cheaper than whole brisket) for this recipe.
Make sauce from pantry staples instead of buying BBQ sauce.

recipes.name: Chopped Brisket Sandwich
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Chop the cooled brisket into small bite-sized pieces.
Heat BBQ sauce in a large skillet over medium heat, then add the chopped brisket and stir until heated through (about 5 minutes).
In a bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Add coleslaw mix to the dressing and toss well to combine, then set aside.
Butter the hamburger buns lightly and toast them cut-side down in a skillet until golden (about 1 minute per side).
Place a generous scoop of warm chopped brisket on the bottom half of each bun.
Top each portion with a heaping spoonful of coleslaw.
Close the sandwich with the top bun and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use leftover brisket from a previous meal to reduce cooking time and cost.
Buy store-brand coleslaw mix and make your own dressing instead of buying prepared coleslaw.

recipes.name: Smoked Turkey Leg
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt in a small bowl.
Rub the spice mixture all over both turkey legs, coating evenly and massaging into the skin.
Preheat oven to 325°F and place turkey legs on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Pour apple juice into the bottom of the pan around the legs and cover tightly with foil.
Bake covered for 2 hours until the meat is very tender.
Mix butter and honey together and brush onto the turkey legs.
Increase oven temperature to 400°F, remove foil, and bake uncovered for 15-20 minutes until the skin is crispy and caramelized.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Turkey legs are often cheaper per pound than chicken breasts.
Use the drippings as a gravy base instead of buying premade sauce.

recipes.name: Beef Ribs
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and brown sugar to create a dry rub.
Apply the rub generously to all sides of the beef ribs and let rest for 2 hours.
Preheat oven to 300°F and place ribs meat-side up on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Mix beef broth and apple cider vinegar, then pour around the ribs.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 3 hours until the meat is very tender.
Remove foil and mix butter with brown sugar, then brush onto the ribs.
Increase temperature to 400°F and bake uncovered for 20-25 minutes until the top caramelizes.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving with pan drippings.
cheapTips: Buy beef ribs in bulk and freeze portions for later.
Use the pan drippings as sauce to skip buying bottled BBQ sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Plate
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt together.
Rub the spice mixture inside and outside the whole chicken, paying special attention to the skin.
Preheat oven to 375°F and place the chicken breast-side up on a roasting pan.
Roast for 1 hour and 15 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165°F at the thickest part of the thigh.
During the last 20 minutes, mix butter, ketchup, apple cider vinegar, and honey together.
Brush the sauce over the chicken twice during the final 20 minutes of cooking.
Let rest for 10 minutes before carving.
Serve the carved chicken with extra sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy whole chickens instead of individual parts to save money.
Make sauce from basic pantry items rather than buying premade BBQ sauce.

recipes.name: Brisket Sandwich
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat BBQ sauce in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced brisket to the sauce and stir gently until heated through, about 5-7 minutes.
Mix mayonnaise and mustard together and spread on 4 slices of bread.
Layer pickles and onions on the mustard-mayo mixture.
Butter the remaining 4 slices of bread lightly and toast them in a separate skillet until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, place a generous portion of hot brisket on top of the pickles and onions.
Drizzle extra sauce from the skillet over the brisket.
Top with the toasted buttered bread slice and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use leftover cooked brisket to save on prep time and energy costs.
Buy store-brand bread and condiments instead of premium brands.

recipes.name: Half Smoke
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add sliced onions.
Cook onions for 5 minutes until they start to caramelize, stirring occasionally.
Add the half-smoke sausages to the skillet and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally until browned on all sides.
Pour BBQ sauce over the sausages and onions and simmer for 3 minutes.
Toast the hot dog buns lightly in a separate skillet or under the broiler.
Mix mayonnaise with a pinch of black pepper and spread on the inside of each toasted bun.
Place a sausage in each bun and top with caramelized onions and BBQ sauce.
Add a small scoop of coleslaw on top and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy half-smoke sausages on sale and freeze for later use.
Use store-brand hot dog buns instead of specialty brands.

recipes.name: Smoked Sausage
recipes.description: Southern BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the smoked sausage links into 1/2-inch thick coins.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the bell peppers and onions.
Cook vegetables for 5-7 minutes until they soften, stirring occasionally.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 more minute until fragrant.
Add the sausage slices to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Mix BBQ sauce, apple juice, brown sugar, black pepper, and salt in a small bowl.
Pour the sauce over the sausage and vegetables and simmer for 10-12 minutes until the sauce reduces slightly and caramelizes.
Serve hot over rice or with cornbread on the side.
cheapTips: Buy smoked sausage in bulk from warehouse stores for better per-pound pricing.
Use seasonal bell peppers when they're cheapest.

recipes.name: Memphis Brisket
recipes.description: Memphis BBQ dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, black pepper, onion powder, and cayenne in a bowl to create dry rub.
Pat brisket dry and coat generously on all sides with dry rub, pressing it in firmly.
Heat oven to 300°F and place brisket fat-side up in a large roasting pan.
Whisk together beef broth, apple cider vinegar, and Worcestershire sauce, then pour around brisket.
Cover pan tightly with foil and braise for 4 hours, turning once halfway through.
Remove foil, increase heat to 350°F, and cook uncovered for 1 more hour until meat is fork-tender.
Let rest for 15 minutes before slicing against the grain and serving with pan juices.
cheapTips: Buy brisket on sale and freeze; this cut is often discounted.
Use pantry spices you likely have; specialty rub ingredients are minimal.

recipes.name: Whole Hog
recipes.description: Memphis BBQ dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, black pepper, onion powder, and cayenne to create dry rub.
Score pork shoulder fat cap in a crosshatch pattern and apply dry rub generously to entire surface.
Preheat oven to 250°F and place pork on a roasting rack in a large pan.
Roast uncovered for 10-12 hours until internal temperature reaches 190°F and meat shreds easily.
Remove pork and let rest 20 minutes, then shred all meat with two forks, discarding fat and bones.
Whisk together apple cider vinegar, ketchup, Worcestershire, honey, and mustard to make Memphis sauce.
Toss shredded pork with sauce and serve on buns or with cornbread.
cheapTips: Pork shoulder is one of the cheapest cuts; buy family packs.
Make your own BBQ sauce rather than buying bottled.

recipes.name: Memphis Slaw
recipes.description: Memphis BBQ snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice cabbage thinly with a knife or mandoline and place in a large bowl.
Grate carrots and add to the cabbage.
Whisk together mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, sugar, black pepper, salt, and mustard powder in a separate bowl.
Pour dressing over cabbage and carrots and toss until fully coated.
Let slaw sit for at least 10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
cheapTips: Buy cabbage from the produce discount bin.
Make just before serving or store dressing separately to keep slaw crisp.

recipes.name: Hot Tamales
recipes.description: Delta Blues Food lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak corn husks in warm water for 30 minutes until softened.
Brown ground beef with diced onion in a skillet, then add chili powder, garlic powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Bring water and beef broth to a boil in a pot and slowly whisk in cornmeal to create a thick polenta.
Spread a thin layer of cornmeal mixture on each softened corn husk, then add a spoonful of beef filling in the center.
Roll husk tightly around filling and fold down the pointed end to seal.
Stand tamales upright seam-side down in a steamer basket over boiling water.
Steam covered for 45 minutes until masa pulls away easily from husks.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from ethnic grocers.
Dried corn husks are inexpensive and reusable for future batches.

recipes.name: Banana Pudding
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together milk and vanilla pudding mix according to package directions until thickened.
Layer one-third of vanilla wafers in the bottom of a 9-inch baking dish.
Slice 2 bananas and layer over wafers, then pour one-third of pudding mixture over bananas.
Repeat layers two more times, ending with pudding on top.
Whip egg whites to soft peaks with 1/2 cup sugar and 1 tsp vanilla extract until stiff peaks form.
Fold in 4 tbsp melted butter and spread meringue over pudding.
Bake at 350°F for 10-12 minutes until meringue is golden, then cool and refrigerate before serving.
cheapTips: Buy vanilla wafers from the discount shelf or store brand.
Use instant pudding mix instead of making custard from scratch.

recipes.name: Pork Chops and Gravy
recipes.description: Southern Soul Food dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season pork chops with salt and pepper, then dredge lightly in flour on both sides.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Fry pork chops for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through, then set aside on a plate.
Reduce heat to medium and whisk 2 tbsp butter with remaining flour to form a roux, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk and chicken broth, stirring continuously until gravy thickens, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in onion powder and return pork chops to the skillet in the gravy.
Simmer for 3 minutes, then serve pork chops with gravy spooned over top.
cheapTips: Buy pork chops on sale and freeze; this cut is often discounted.
Make gravy from pan drippings rather than using store-bought.

recipes.name: Chiles Toreados
recipes.description: Tex-Mex snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut poblanos lengthwise and remove seeds, leaving stem intact.
Fry peppers in hot oil for 2-3 minutes per side until charred and tender.
Remove peppers and arrange on a plate, then sauté minced garlic in the remaining oil until fragrant.
Drizzle garlic oil over peppers and sprinkle with queso fresco, cilantro, salt, and pepper.
Finish with lime juice and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy poblanos in bulk when in season and freeze.
Use store-brand queso fresco to save on cheese costs.

recipes.name: Chile Relleno de Queso
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast poblanos directly over a gas flame or under a broiler until blackened all over, then place in a plastic bag for 10 minutes.
Peel off charred skin, carefully cut a slit lengthwise, and remove seeds while keeping pepper intact.
Stuff each pepper with 2 oz oaxaca cheese and set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a saucepan, sauté minced garlic, then add tomato sauce, onion powder, salt, and pepper; simmer 10 minutes.
Beat eggs with 1/4 tsp salt until foamy, then dredge each stuffed pepper lightly in flour.
Heat remaining 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry peppers 2 minutes per side until egg coating is set.
Transfer peppers to serving plates, pour warm tomato sauce around them, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute mozzarella if oaxaca cheese is unavailable.
Make sauce from canned tomatoes for convenience.

recipes.name: Nachos with Queso
recipes.description: Tex-Mex snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat and whisk in flour to create a roux.
Gradually whisk in milk, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens slightly.
Remove from heat and stir in shredded cheddar cheese until completely melted and smooth.
Arrange tortilla chips on a serving platter and drizzle generously with queso sauce.
Top with sliced jalapeños, dollops of sour cream, and cilantro.
Finish with a squeeze of lime juice and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand tortilla chips to save on snack costs.
Buy jalapeños in bulk and pickle extras for other dishes.

recipes.name: Chiles Rellenos de Rajas
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast 5 poblanos over a flame until blackened, place in a plastic bag for 10 minutes, then peel.
Cut 2 roasted poblanos into strips (rajas) and sauté with sliced onion and minced garlic in 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes.
Stir in corn and heavy cream, season with 1/2 tsp salt and pepper, then simmer for 5 minutes and set aside.
Slit the remaining 3 roasted poblanos and carefully remove seeds, keeping peppers intact.
Stuff each pepper with 2 oz oaxaca cheese and 2 tbsp rajas mixture.
Beat eggs with 1/4 tsp salt until foamy and dredge stuffed peppers lightly in flour.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a skillet and fry peppers 2 minutes per side until egg coating is set.
Serve peppers topped with remaining rajas and cream sauce.
cheapTips: Buy poblanos in bulk when in season or use frozen.
Substitute mozzarella or fresh queso for oaxaca cheese.

recipes.name: Chicago-style corn on the cob
recipes.description: Mexican-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil water in a large pot and cook corn for 8-10 minutes until tender.
While corn cooks, mix mayonnaise, butter, minced garlic, and chili powder in a bowl.
Drain corn and pat dry with paper towels.
Brush each ear generously with the mayo-butter mixture.
Roll each ear in a plate of crumbled cotija cheese until well coated.
Sprinkle with chili powder and fresh cilantro.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over each ear and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy corn on sale during peak season and freeze for later use
Use regular cheese instead of cotija to save money

recipes.name: Flaming saganaki
recipes.description: Greek snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut saganaki cheese into 1-inch thick slices and coat lightly in flour.
Heat olive oil in a shallow pan over medium-high heat until very hot.
Carefully place cheese slices in hot oil and fry for 2 minutes per side until golden and crispy outside but soft inside.
Transfer to a heatproof plate or shallow dish.
Warm brandy in a small spoon over a flame, then carefully pour over the cheese.
Ignite the alcohol with a long lighter or match and let flame for 30 seconds.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the flaming cheese and extinguish the flame.
Serve immediately with crusty bread for scooping.
cheapTips: Use thick feta if saganaki is unavailable at a lower price
Skip the brandy and flame effect for a simpler, cheaper version

recipes.name: Malort shot
recipes.description: Scandinavian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour 1 oz of Malort liqueur into a chilled shot glass.
Repeat for second shot glass.
Optionally chill shot glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes beforehand.
Drink the shot quickly in one gulp.
Follow with a beer chaser if desired to ease the bitterness.
cheapTips: Buy Malort in bulk for parties to reduce per-serving cost
Skip the chaser and use water instead of beer to save money

recipes.name: Alinea tasting menu
recipes.description: Molecular gastronomy dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bloom gelatin sheets in cold water for 5 minutes, then heat beet juice gently and whisk in gelatin to dissolve.
Pour into a shallow pan and refrigerate until set, then cut into small cubes.
Create apple juice spheres by dropping juice into sodium alginate bath using a spherification technique with a syringe.
Prepare a dashi-soy reduction by simmering dashi stock with soy sauce for 10 minutes.
Plate by arranging micro greens, edible flowers, and prepared elements on a white plate in artistic patterns.
Drizzle reduced dashi and olive oil strategically around the plate.
Add liquid nitrogen carefully to create visual smoke effect just before serving.
Finish with fleur de sel and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Skip liquid nitrogen and use dry ice for similar visual effect at lower cost
Substitute high-quality olive oil with regular olive oil to reduce expenses

recipes.name: Chicago-style chili
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks, then drain excess fat.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the beef and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Stir in chili powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, kidney beans with liquid, beef broth, and Worcestershire sauce.
Bring to a simmer and reduce heat to low, stirring occasionally.
Simmer uncovered for 60-75 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot with optional toppings like shredded cheddar cheese and diced onion.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use dried beans instead of canned for significant savings

recipes.name: Chicken Vesuvio
recipes.description: Italian-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat chicken thighs dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown chicken skin-side down for 4-5 minutes, then flip and brown other side.
Remove chicken to a plate and add potatoes to the same skillet, browning lightly for 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return chicken to the skillet, add white wine and chicken broth, then sprinkle with oregano.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and braise for 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in frozen peas and simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes.
Finish with fresh lemon juice and adjust seasoning before serving.
cheapTips: Use chicken legs instead of thighs to save a dollar per serving
Replace white wine with additional chicken broth and a splash of vinegar

recipes.name: Shrimp de Jonghe
recipes.description: French-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange shrimp in a single layer in the prepared baking dish and season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Melt butter in a small saucepan and sauté minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Mix in panko breadcrumbs and fresh parsley, stirring until well combined and toasted, about 2 minutes.
Sprinkle breadcrumb mixture evenly over the shrimp.
In a measuring cup, combine sherry and chicken broth, then pour around the shrimp in the baking dish.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the dish and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and thaw overnight for better pricing
Use regular breadcrumbs instead of panko to reduce cost

recipes.name: Lake Michigan whitefish
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and butter a baking sheet or baking dish.
Pat whitefish dry with paper towels and season inside and out with salt and pepper.
Lay sliced onion on the baking sheet and place fish on top.
Scatter fresh dill over the fish and around the pan.
Dot with butter and pour white wine around the fish.
Squeeze lemon juice over the fish and arrange lemon slices on top.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork.
Toast sliced almonds in a dry skillet for 2 minutes and sprinkle over fish before serving.
cheapTips: Buy whitefish fillets instead of whole fish for easier preparation at similar cost
Skip the almonds and use a simple lemon-butter sauce instead

recipes.name: Chicago tavern-style pizza slice
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water and yeast in a bowl and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Add flour, salt, and olive oil to the yeast mixture and stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in an oiled bowl, cover with a damp towel, and let rise for 30-40 minutes until doubled.
Preheat oven to 450°F and coat a rectangular 10x14 inch pan generously with vegetable oil.
Stretch dough to fit the pan, pressing into all corners, and let rest for 5 minutes.
Spread marinara sauce evenly over dough, leaving a thin border.
Distribute pepperoni and mozzarella cheese evenly over sauce.
Bake for 18-22 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly and crust edges are golden brown.
Cool for 2 minutes, cut into squares, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Make dough from scratch instead of buying pre-made to save significantly
Use store-brand mozzarella and marinara sauce for maximum savings

recipes.name: Portillos chocolate cake
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease two 9-inch round cake pans.
Whisk together flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl.
In a large bowl, cream softened butter and granulated sugar together until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
Alternate adding flour mixture and hot water to the butter mixture, starting and ending with flour.
Divide batter between prepared pans and bake for 30-35 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pans for 10 minutes, then turn out onto wire racks to cool completely.
For frosting, beat softened butter, cocoa powder, powdered sugar, and milk until smooth and fluffy.
Place one cake layer on a plate and spread frosting on top, then place second layer on top and frost top and sides.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cocoa powder and sugar to reduce ingredient costs
Make a simple glaze with powdered sugar and milk instead of rich frosting

recipes.name: Chicago-style deep-dish pizza
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm water, yeast, and a pinch of sugar in a bowl and let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour and salt, then add yeast mixture and olive oil, mixing until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough for 8 minutes until smooth, then let rise covered in an oiled bowl for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 475°F and oil a 9-inch round deep-dish pizza pan with cornmeal.
Stretch dough to fit the pan and create a 0.5-inch rim around the edges.
Spread crushed tomatoes mixed with oregano and garlic powder over the dough.
Layer mozzarella cheese and pepperoni over the sauce.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is bubbling around the edges.
cheapTips: Buy cheese in bulk and freeze to lock in lower prices
Use store-brand canned tomatoes instead of name brands

recipes.name: Chicago-style thin-crust pizza
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Activate yeast by mixing it with warm water and let sit for 5 minutes until bubbly.
Combine flour and salt, then add yeast mixture and 2 tablespoons olive oil to form a dough.
Knead for 6 minutes until smooth, then place in oiled bowl to rise for 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 500°F and stretch dough very thin on a pizza pan brushed with olive oil.
Mix crushed tomatoes with minced garlic and Italian seasoning, then spread lightly over dough.
Sprinkle mozzarella evenly across the sauce.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is crispy and cheese is melted.
Top with fresh basil and drizzle with olive oil before serving.
cheapTips: Make your own dough rather than buying pre-made crusts
Skip fresh basil and use dried Italian seasoning to save money

recipes.name: Chicago-style hot dog
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil or grill hot dogs for 5-7 minutes until heated through and lightly browned.
Toast the buns lightly in a skillet or toaster until warm.
Place hot dog in toasted bun.
Add a thin line of yellow mustard down the center of the hot dog.
Top with sweet relish, followed by diced onion.
Layer 2 tomato slices on top of each hot dog.
Place one dill pickle spear on the side.
Sprinkle with celery salt and top with hot sauce or sport peppers, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy hot dogs on sale and freeze in bulk
Use regular relish if you cannot find sweet relish to save a few cents

recipes.name: Chicago-style gyro
recipes.description: Greek lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground lamb, breadcrumbs, minced onion, garlic, oregano, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl until combined.
Form mixture into a loaf shape on a baking sheet.
Bake at 375°F for 30-35 minutes until cooked through and browned.
While meat cooks, mix Greek yogurt with diced cucumber and 1 minced garlic clove to make tzatziki sauce.
Warm pita bread in a skillet or oven for 2 minutes.
Slice cooked gyro meat into thin pieces.
Assemble by spreading tzatziki on warm pita, then layering meat, diced tomatoes, and red onion.
Roll pita tightly and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground lamb when on sale and freeze for later use
Make your own tzatziki instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Jibarito
recipes.description: Puerto Rican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel green plantains and slice lengthwise into thin strips, then soak in salted water for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and fry plantain slices in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Drain fried plantains on paper towels and season lightly with salt.
Season steak slices with salt, pepper, and minced garlic, then pan-fry in a separate skillet for 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
Stir sofrito into cooked meat and remove from heat.
Lay a fried plantain slice flat and spread a thin layer of mayonnaise on top.
Layer meat, cheese, tomato, and lettuce on the plantain, then top with another fried plantain slice like a sandwich.
Serve immediately while plantains are still warm and crispy.
cheapTips: Buy plantains when the price drops and freeze unpeeled
Use ground beef instead of sliced steak for significant savings

recipes.name: Maxwell Street Polish
recipes.description: Polish-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced onions and bell peppers to the skillet and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft and caramelized.
Season vegetables with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Grill or boil kielbasa links for 5-7 minutes until heated through and lightly browned on all sides.
Toast the hot dog buns lightly in the skillet if desired.
Place kielbasa in each bun.
Top each kielbasa with a line of yellow mustard and hot sauce.
Pile the caramelized onions and peppers generously on top and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy kielbasa in bulk when on sale and freeze
Caramelize a large batch of onions and peppers to use throughout the week

recipes.name: Chicago Polish sausage
recipes.description: Polish-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice kielbasa sausage into 0.5-inch thick rounds.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown sausage pieces on both sides for 5 minutes.
Remove sausage and set aside, then add minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add shredded cabbage, sliced carrots, and onion to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Return sausage to the pot and add broth and caraway seeds.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 12-15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in bowls with the broth and vegetables.
cheapTips: Buy kielbasa at butcher shops or ethnic markets for better prices
Use whatever root vegetables are on sale instead of just carrots

recipes.name: Portillos Italian combo sandwich
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Lightly toast the sub rolls in a 375°F oven for 5 minutes until warm and slightly crispy on the outside.
Spread mayonnaise on the bottom half of each toasted roll.
Layer mortadella, capicola, and salami slices evenly on the mayo.
Top meat with provolone cheese slices.
Add roasted red peppers, lettuce, tomato slices, and red onion on top.
Drizzle the oil and vinegar dressing over the vegetables.
Close sandwich with the top half of the roll.
Cut diagonally and serve immediately or wrap in foil to keep warm.
cheapTips: Buy deli meats in bulk from the counter instead of pre-packaged
Make your own oil and vinegar dressing with cheap olive oil and vinegar

recipes.name: Al's Beef sandwich
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season beef roast generously with salt and pepper on all sides.
Sear the roast in a hot pot or Dutch oven for 3-4 minutes per side until browned.
Add beef broth, garlic cloves, Italian seasoning, and bay leaf to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 45-50 minutes until beef is very tender.
Remove roast and let cool slightly, then shred meat with two forks.
Return shredded meat to the cooking liquid and keep warm.
Lightly toast the sub rolls in a 375°F oven for 5 minutes.
Place shredded beef on a roll, top with provolone cheese, roasted peppers if using, drizzle with hot pepper oil and a spoonful of cooking liquid, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy beef roast at discount when marked down for quick sale
Use the leftover cooking liquid as gravy for other meals

recipes.name: Garrett popcorn
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pop popcorn kernels using a stovetop popper, air popper, or microwave until kernels stop popping.
Melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
Pour melted butter over popped popcorn in a large bowl, tossing constantly to coat evenly.
In a small bowl, mix cheddar cheese powder, salt, nutritional yeast if using, and cayenne pepper.
Sprinkle cheese mixture over buttered popcorn while tossing continuously to distribute seasoning evenly.
Let cool for 2 minutes and serve in bowls or paper cones.
cheapTips: Buy popcorn kernels in bulk from warehouse stores
Make your own cheese powder blend instead of buying expensive brand-name seasoning

recipes.name: Oyster Stew
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add oysters with their liquor and cook until oyster edges curl, about 3 minutes.
Pour in milk and cream, stirring gently to combine.
Heat until steaming but do not boil, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Ladle into bowls and top with oyster crackers before serving.
cheapTips: Buy oysters on sale or from discount seafood markets
Make your own oyster crackers substitute using crushed saltines

recipes.name: Scrod
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat fish fillets dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Mix flour with salt and pepper in a shallow bowl.
Dredge each fillet in the flour mixture, coating both sides.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook fillets for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and flaky.
Transfer to serving plates and garnish with lemon wedges and fresh parsley.
cheapTips: Buy frozen scrod instead of fresh to save 30-40%
Use vegetable oil instead of butter to reduce cost

recipes.name: Steamers
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse clams under cold water and discard any with broken shells.
Combine water, salt, and wine in a large pot and bring to boil.
Add clams, cover, and steam for 8-10 minutes until shells open.
Discard any clams that don't open.
Melt butter in a small pan with minced garlic and thyme.
Divide clams into bowls, pour broth over them, and drizzle with garlic butter.
cheapTips: Buy clams during off-season or look for sales at Asian markets
Skip the white wine and use extra broth instead

recipes.name: Boston Butt
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika in a bowl.
Rub spice mixture all over the pork shoulder.
Place pork in a roasting pan and add water to the bottom.
Cover tightly with foil and roast for 5-6 hours until meat shreds easily.
Remove foil and baste with pan drippings mixed with vinegar and brown sugar.
Roast uncovered for 30 more minutes until browned.
Let rest for 15 minutes, then shred with forks and serve.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for later use
Use a slow cooker instead of oven to save energy costs

recipes.name: Hasty Pudding
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Slowly whisk in cornmeal, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Continue cooking and stirring for 10-12 minutes until mixture thickens.
Stir in molasses, butter, salt, cinnamon, and ginger.
Cook for 2 more minutes until fully combined.
Divide into bowls and serve warm, optionally with whipped cream on top.
cheapTips: Buy molasses in bulk from discount grocery stores
Use store-brand cornmeal to save 50% on ingredient cost

recipes.name: Brown Bread
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix whole wheat flour, rye flour, cornmeal, and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk molasses, buttermilk, and baking soda together in another bowl.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed, then fold in raisins.
Pour batter into a greased loaf pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 60-70 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
cheapTips: Make large batches and freeze slices for up to 3 months
Use regular milk with vinegar instead of buttermilk

recipes.name: Oyster Pie
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a pie dish with half the dough.
Melt butter in a saucepan and whisk in flour to form a roux.
Gradually add milk while stirring until sauce thickens.
Gently fold oysters with liquor into the sauce, season with salt and pepper.
Pour oyster mixture into pie crust.
Top with remaining dough, seal edges, and brush with beaten egg yolk.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until crust is golden brown.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pie crusts to save 45 minutes of prep time
Buy oysters frozen instead of fresh to reduce cost by 25%

recipes.name: Salt Cod
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak salt cod in cold water for 24 hours, changing water every 8 hours to desalt.
Drain and cut cod into bite-sized pieces.
Boil potatoes until tender, peel, and cube them.
Melt butter in a large pot and sauté diced onion until soft.
Whisk in flour to form a roux, then gradually add milk while stirring.
Add salt cod and potatoes to the cream sauce.
Simmer gently for 10 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy salt cod at ethnic grocers for 40% less than specialty stores
Plan ahead as soaking takes 24 hours minimum

recipes.name: Shore Dinner
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a large steamer pot with 3 inches of water and add salt.
Bring water to boil and add whole potatoes, cover and steam for 15 minutes.
Add clams and lobster tail to the pot with corn.
Cover and steam for 10-12 minutes until clams open and lobster is cooked.
Discard any unopened clams.
Melt butter with minced garlic and parsley.
Arrange all items on a large platter and serve with butter sauce and lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Skip the lobster and add more clams to reduce cost to $2.50 per serving
Buy potatoes and corn in season for best prices

recipes.name: Boston Lettuce Salad
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse Boston lettuce and tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Halve cherry tomatoes and slice cucumber into rounds.
Thinly slice red onion.
Combine all vegetables in a large salad bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently until coated.
Serve immediately on individual plates.
cheapTips: Buy lettuce from farmers markets near closing time for discounts
Make larger batches and store dressing separately to prevent wilting

recipes.name: Boiled Peanuts
recipes.description: Lowcountry snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse raw peanuts thoroughly under cold water and remove any debris.
Bring 3 gallons of water to a rolling boil in a large pot.
Add salt, cayenne pepper, and garlic cloves to the boiling water.
Pour in the peanuts and stir well.
Return to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Cook for 2 to 3 hours, stirring occasionally and tasting every 30 minutes after 90 minutes until desired softness is reached.
Drain peanuts and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy raw peanuts in bulk during harvest season
Use tap water and basic table salt to minimize costs

recipes.name: Country Ham Biscuit
recipes.description: Appalachian breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Cut cold butter into small cubes and work into the flour mixture with your fingertips until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in buttermilk until a soft dough forms.
Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead gently 5 times, then roll to ½-inch thickness.
Cut out biscuits with a 2-inch cutter and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown.
Fry country ham slices until crispy, then place one slice in each warm biscuit and serve.
cheapTips: Buy country ham on sale and freeze for later use
Make extra biscuits and freeze for quick breakfasts

recipes.name: Seafood Bisque
recipes.description: Lowcountry lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot and sauté diced onion and celery for 5 minutes.
Add shrimp shells and tomato paste, cooking for 3 minutes while stirring.
Pour in chicken broth and add bay leaf, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, then strain through a fine mesh sieve.
Return strained broth to the pot and stir in heavy cream.
Add crab meat and shrimp, simmering for 8 to 10 minutes until shrimp are pink.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Ask your fishmonger for shrimp shells when buying shrimp
Use canned crab meat to save money

recipes.name: Carnitas Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut pork shoulder into 2-inch cubes and season with salt and cumin.
Heat lard in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat.
Brown pork cubes on all sides in batches, then remove and set aside.
Add onion, garlic, orange zest, lime zest, and bay leaves to the pot.
Return pork to the pot and add juice from the orange and lime.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 2 to 2.5 hours until pork is very tender and falls apart easily.
Increase heat to medium-high and cook uncovered for 15 minutes to crisp the edges.
Shred pork with two forks and serve in warm tortillas with desired toppings.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze for later
Make a double batch and freeze extra carnitas

recipes.name: Lengua Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place beef tongue in a large pot and cover with cold water.
Add quartered onion, garlic, bay leaves, and salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2 to 2.5 hours until tongue is very tender.
Remove tongue and let cool slightly, then peel away the outer skin with a knife.
Slice peeled tongue thinly against the grain.
Warm tortillas over a flame or in a skillet.
Fill tortillas with sliced tongue and top with diced onion, cilantro, and sliced jalapeño.
Serve with lime wedges for squeezing.
cheapTips: Beef tongue is inexpensive at Mexican or specialty butchers
Cook in bulk and freeze extras for quick meals

recipes.name: Cabeza Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean beef head thoroughly and cut into large chunks, removing excess hair.
Place in a large pot and cover with cold water.
Add quartered onions, garlic, bay leaves, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2.5 to 3 hours until meat is tender and falling from bones.
Remove meat from broth and let cool, then shred all meat from bones and connective tissue.
Warm tortillas over an open flame or in a skillet.
Fill tortillas with shredded meat and top with diced onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.
Serve immediately with extra lime wedges.
cheapTips: Beef head is very affordable at Mexican butchers
Save the cooking broth for soup or other dishes

recipes.name: Tripas Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean tripe thoroughly under cold water, scrubbing away any impurities.
Cut tripe into bite-sized pieces and place in a pot with cold water.
Add quartered onion, garlic, bay leaves, and salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1.5 to 2 hours until tripe is tender but still slightly chewy.
Drain tripe and pat dry.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry tripe until lightly crispy and golden, about 5 to 8 minutes.
Warm tortillas over a flame or in a skillet.
Fill tortillas with fried tripe and top with diced onion, cilantro, and lime juice.
cheapTips: Buy tripe from ethnic markets for better prices
Freeze cooked tripe for convenient meal prep

recipes.name: Chorizo Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove chorizo from casing and crumble into a skillet.
Cook over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until fully cooked and browned.
Warm tortillas over a flame or in a dry skillet for about 30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with cooked chorizo.
Top with diced onion, cilantro, sliced jalapeño, and diced tomato.
Serve immediately with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy chorizo in bulk and freeze for later
Chorizo cooks quickly, making this an easy weeknight dinner

recipes.name: Pollo Asado Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine orange juice, lime juice, minced garlic, cumin, chili powder, oregano, and salt in a bowl.
Place chicken thighs in a large zip-top bag and pour marinade over them.
Seal bag and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 4 hours.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat or preheat oven to 425°F.
If grilling, cook chicken for 6 to 8 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
If baking, place chicken on a lined baking sheet and bake for 25 to 30 minutes until cooked through.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then shred with two forks.
Warm tortillas and fill with shredded chicken, diced onion, and cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs when on sale and freeze with marinade
Make extra and use for other meals during the week

recipes.name: Shrimp Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat shrimp dry with paper towels.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add minced garlic.
Cook garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp and chili powder, cooking for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Remove from heat and squeeze lime juice over shrimp.
Warm tortillas over a flame or in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with shrimp and top with shredded cabbage, sliced jalapeño, and cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and thaw as needed for cost savings
Use the quick cooking time to make weeknight dinners easy

recipes.name: Chicago-style breakfast sandwich
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon strips in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, about 5 minutes per side, then set aside.
Crack eggs into the same skillet and cook to your preference (fried, scrambled, or over-easy work best).
Toast English muffins in a separate skillet with butter until golden brown.
Layer a toasted muffin half with cheese, bacon, egg, and tomato slices.
Top with the second muffin half and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs and bacon in bulk when on sale
Use store-brand cheese instead of name brands

recipes.name: KC Strip Steak
recipes.description: Steakhouse dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove steaks from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking and pat dry with paper towels.
Season both sides generously with kosher salt and black pepper.
Heat oil in a cast-iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Sear steaks 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare, then reduce heat to medium.
Add butter, garlic, and thyme to the pan and baste steaks continuously for 2 minutes.
Transfer to a plate and rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy steaks when your grocery store has a sale
Skip the fresh thyme and use dried thyme to save money

recipes.name: Rib Tips
recipes.description: Barbecue lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, and salt in a bowl to make a dry rub.
Remove the membrane from the back of the rib tips and rub the spice mixture all over.
Preheat oven to 275°F and place rib tips on a foil-lined baking sheet bone-side down.
Bake uncovered for 2 hours until tender.
Brush generously with barbecue sauce and bake for another 30 minutes.
Cool for 5 minutes and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy rib tips (not full racks) for a cheaper cut
Make your own barbecue sauce instead of buying premium brands

recipes.name: Kansas City Porterhouse
recipes.description: Steakhouse dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Let steaks rest at room temperature for 30 minutes and pat dry thoroughly.
Season both sides with kosher salt and black pepper.
Heat oil in a cast-iron skillet over high heat until it just begins to smoke.
Place steaks in the skillet and sear for 5-6 minutes without moving them.
Flip steaks and cook another 5-6 minutes for medium-rare, then lower heat to medium.
Add butter, garlic, and rosemary and baste the steaks for 2 minutes.
Transfer to a cutting board and rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Look for Porterhouse steaks marked down for quick sale
Use dried herbs instead of fresh to reduce cost

recipes.name: Wet Ribs
recipes.description: Barbecue lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs and season with pepper and garlic powder.
Preheat oven to 300°F and arrange ribs on two foil-lined baking sheets.
Mix barbecue sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl.
Cover ribs tightly with foil and bake for 1.5 hours until tender.
Remove foil and brush ribs generously with the sauce mixture.
Bake uncovered for another 30 minutes, basting every 10 minutes.
Cool for 5 minutes and serve with extra sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ribs when your store has a clearance sale
Make your own barbecue sauce base instead of buying specialty bottles

recipes.name: Beef Brisket
recipes.description: Barbecue lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, and salt to create a dry rub.
Trim excess fat from the brisket and rub the spice mixture generously over the entire surface.
Preheat oven to 275°F and place brisket fat-side up in a roasting pan.
Add beef broth to the pan and cover tightly with foil.
Bake for 6-7 hours until the meat is fork-tender and pulling apart.
Remove foil and increase temperature to 400°F for the last 30 minutes to get a crust.
Let rest for 15 minutes, then slice against the grain and serve.
cheapTips: Buy whole brisket instead of already-trimmed cuts
Make your own dry rub instead of buying pre-packaged seasoning blends

recipes.name: Boulevard Beer Cheese Soup
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion, celery, and carrots for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over the vegetables and stir constantly for 2 minutes to create a roux.
Pour in chicken broth and beer, stirring to smooth out lumps.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Reduce heat to low and stir in shredded cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Add milk and stir gently, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer for 5 more minutes and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use store-brand sharp cheddar cheese instead of premium brands
Substitute whole milk with half-and-half diluted with broth to save money

recipes.name: Slinger
recipes.description: American Diner breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook hash browns in a skillet with oil according to package directions until crispy and golden.
In a separate skillet, cook hamburger patties over medium-high heat about 3 minutes per side, then add cheese.
Crack 4 eggs into the skillet with the burgers and cook until whites are set but yolks are runny.
Divide hash browns between two plates and place a cheeseburger on top of each.
Carefully place 2 fried eggs on top of each burger.
Top with salsa and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen hash browns instead of making from scratch
Use store-brand or bulk hamburger meat

recipes.name: Gooey Butter Cake
recipes.description: Dessert snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and spray a 9x13 inch baking pan with butter spray.
Mix cake mix with 1 egg and 6 tablespoons melted butter until crumbly, then press into the bottom of the pan.
Beat softened cream cheese with 2 eggs, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth and creamy.
Pour cream cheese mixture over the cake mix layer and smooth the top.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until the top is set but the center still jiggles slightly when moved.
Cool in the pan for at least 20 minutes, then cut into 9 squares and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Buy cake mix and powdered sugar when on sale and stock up
Use generic cream cheese brands instead of Philadelphia

recipes.name: Pork Burnt Ends
recipes.description: Barbecue lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, and salt to make a dry rub.
Cut pork shoulder into 1.5-inch cubes and coat thoroughly with the dry rub.
Preheat oven to 325°F and place cubes on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 1.5 hours until the outside is caramelized and edges are crispy.
Toss the burnt ends in a bowl with barbecue sauce and butter, stirring gently.
Return to the baking sheet and bake for another 30 minutes until glazed and sticky.
Cool for 5 minutes and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy whole pork shoulder when on sale and cut it yourself
Use budget-friendly barbecue sauce brands

recipes.name: Tongue Sandwich
recipes.description: Jewish Deli lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place beef tongue in large pot and cover with cold water.
Add halved onion, carrots, celery, salt, and pepper to pot.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2.5 hours until tongue is tender.
Remove tongue and let cool slightly, then peel away outer membrane under running water.
Slice tongue thinly against the grain.
Toast rye bread lightly and spread mustard on each slice.
Layer sliced tongue and pickle slices on bread and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy tongue from butcher counter—often cheaper than pre-packaged cuts
Use broth from cooking tongue for soups to maximize value

recipes.name: Potato Pancakes
recipes.description: Jewish Deli breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and grate potatoes and onion into a bowl, then squeeze out excess liquid with clean kitchen towel.
Mix in eggs, flour, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Drop spoonfuls of mixture into oil and flatten with spatula to form thin pancakes.
Fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer to paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve warm with sour cream and applesauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk when on sale and store in cool, dark place
Use oil multiple times by straining; discard only when very dark

recipes.name: Roast Beef Sandwich
recipes.description: Jewish Deli lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast rye bread lightly in toaster or skillet with butter until golden.
Mix horseradish sauce with mayonnaise in small bowl.
Slice tomato and onion thinly.
Spread horseradish mayo on each bread slice.
Layer roast beef, tomato, onion, and lettuce on bread.
Top with pickle slices and remaining bread slice.
Cut diagonally and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy roast beef from deli counter near closing time for discounts
Store-brand horseradish sauce costs less than name brands

recipes.name: Whitefish Salad
recipes.description: Jewish Deli lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove skin and bones from smoked whitefish and flake flesh into large bowl.
Finely dice celery and red onion.
Add celery, onion, and dill to whitefish.
Mix mayonnaise and lemon juice together, then fold into fish mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes.
Toast bagels and spread with cream cheese, then top with whitefish salad and serve.
cheapTips: Buy smoked whitefish at the fish counter rather than pre-packaged
Make salad the day before to enhance flavor and save time

recipes.name: Herring in Cream Sauce
recipes.description: Jewish Deli lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain jarred herring and rinse under cold water to remove excess vinegar.
Slice onion thinly and peel and dice apple into small pieces.
Mix sour cream, sugar, dill, and pepper in medium bowl.
Layer herring, onion, and apple in glass container, then pour cream sauce over top.
Stir gently to combine and cover container with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight for flavors to meld.
Serve chilled on rye bread with pickles on the side.
cheapTips: Buy jarred herring in bulk when on sale and store in cool pantry
Use store-brand sour cream for significant savings

recipes.name: Kishke
recipes.description: Jewish Deli lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak beef casing in warm water for 15 minutes, then rinse inside and out gently.
Dice onion finely and cook in beef fat over medium heat until golden brown.
Mix breadcrumbs, paprika, salt, pepper, and garlic powder in bowl.
Stir cooked onion and fat into breadcrumb mixture until well combined.
Stuff mixture into casing using a piping bag or funnel, leaving 1 inch empty at each end.
Tie casing ends with kitchen twine and prick with fork to prevent bursting.
Place in pot with beef broth and diced carrots, bring to boil, then simmer for 1 hour until firm.
Cool slightly, slice into serving pieces, and serve hot with pan juices.
cheapTips: Ask butcher for beef fat trim scraps—often free or very cheap
Use purchased breadcrumbs instead of making your own to save time

recipes.name: Black and White Cookie
recipes.description: Jewish Deli snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in egg and vanilla extract until combined.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt in separate bowl.
Alternate adding flour mixture and milk to butter mixture, beginning and ending with flour.
Drop large spoonfuls of dough onto greased baking sheet and bake at 375°F for 12-14 minutes until golden.
Cool cookies completely on wire rack.
Whisk powdered sugar with water until smooth, then divide into two bowls.
Mix cocoa powder into one bowl for chocolate icing, then dip half of each cookie in vanilla icing and half in chocolate icing.
cheapTips: Make cookies in large batches and freeze extra dough for future baking
Use store-brand powdered sugar and cocoa instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Cheese Blintze
recipes.description: Jewish Deli breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk eggs, flour, milk, and salt together to make thin crepe batter.
Heat 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Pour 3 tablespoons batter into skillet, tilting to spread thinly, and cook 1 minute per side until set but not brown; set aside on plate.
Mix ricotta, cheddar, egg yolk, and sugar in bowl until well combined.
Place 2 tablespoons cheese filling in center of each crepe, fold sides in, then fold top and bottom over to seal.
Heat butter in skillet over medium heat and carefully place blintzes seam-side down.
Fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese is heated through.
Serve warm with sour cream dolloped on top.
cheapTips: Buy ricotta and cheddar cheese at warehouse stores for bulk savings
Make crepes ahead of time and refrigerate; fill and fry when ready to serve

recipes.name: Liver and Onions
recipes.description: Jewish Deli dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onions into rings and cook in butter in large skillet over medium-high heat for 8-10 minutes until golden and caramelized; transfer to plate.
Dredge liver slices in flour mixed with salt and pepper.
Add remaining butter to skillet and cook liver 2-3 minutes per side until browned outside but still slightly pink inside; do not overcook.
Return onions to skillet and pour in beef broth and vinegar.
Simmer for 3-4 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve immediately over baked potatoes.
cheapTips: Buy beef liver from butcher counter when on sale and freeze for later use
Use less expensive yellow onions instead of sweet varieties

recipes.name: Hot Chicken Sandwich
recipes.description: Nashville Hot Chicken lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breasts to 0.75-inch thickness using meat mallet.
Marinate chicken in buttermilk for at least 30 minutes in refrigerator.
Whisk together flour, cayenne, paprika, garlic powder, and salt in shallow dish.
Heat oil in deep pot or Dutch oven to 350°F using thermometer.
