Remove chicken from buttermilk and coat completely in spiced flour mixture.
Carefully place chicken in hot oil and fry for 12-15 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F and coating is deep golden brown.
Transfer to paper towels to drain, then toast brioche buns with butter.
Place fried chicken on buns, top with pickles, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze; thaw overnight before marinating
Reuse frying oil by straining and storing in cool place between uses

recipes.name: Kansas City Rib Eye
recipes.description: Steakhouse dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove steaks from refrigerator 20 minutes before cooking and pat dry with paper towels.
Season both sides generously with kosher salt and black pepper.
Heat vegetable oil in a cast-iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Place steaks in the skillet and sear for 4-5 minutes on the first side without moving them.
Flip steaks and add butter, garlic, and thyme to the pan.
Cook for another 4-5 minutes for medium-rare, basting steaks with melted butter.
Transfer steaks to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy rib eye steaks on sale and freeze for later use
Skip expensive steak seasoning and use basic salt and pepper instead

recipes.name: Barbecue Sauce Slathered Ribs
recipes.description: Barbecue lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 275°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs and mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper to create a dry rub.
Apply dry rub evenly over both sides of the ribs.
Place ribs on the baking sheet and bake for 2 hours covered with foil.
While ribs cook, mix ketchup, apple cider vinegar, molasses, onion powder, and Worcestershire sauce in a saucepan over low heat.
After 2 hours, remove foil and brush ribs generously with barbecue sauce.
Return ribs to oven uncovered for 30 minutes, brushing with sauce every 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes before cutting and serving.
cheapTips: Make your own barbecue sauce instead of buying bottled versions
Buy ribs when on sale and freeze for future meals

recipes.name: Beef Burnt Ends
recipes.description: Barbecue lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper to create a dry rub.
Rub the brisket point generously with the spice mixture on all sides.
Smoke the brisket in a smoker at 225°F for 4 hours until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Cut the smoked brisket into 1-inch cubes and place them in a foil pan.
Pour beef broth over the cubes and dot with butter.
Cover the pan with foil and return to smoker at 225°F for 1.5 hours until the edges caramelize.
Mix barbecue sauce with apple cider vinegar and toss with the burnt ends.
Return to smoker uncovered for 30 minutes to set the glaze and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use an oven at 225°F instead of a smoker if you don't have access to one
Buy brisket on sale when available and freeze until ready to cook

recipes.name: Joe's Signature Ribs
recipes.description: Barbecue lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 250°F and remove the membrane from the back of the ribs.
Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, and cayenne pepper into a dry rub.
Coat the ribs thoroughly with the dry rub on both sides.
Wrap ribs tightly in foil and bake for 3 hours at 250°F.
While ribs cook, combine ketchup, apple cider vinegar, honey, and mustard powder in a saucepan and simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove ribs from foil and place on a baking sheet.
Brush ribs with the sauce and bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 350°F, brushing with sauce every 10 minutes.
Let rest for 5 minutes and serve with extra sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Use honey and basic pantry ingredients instead of specialty barbecue sauces
Spare ribs are usually cheaper than baby back ribs

recipes.name: LC's Barbecue Combo Platter
recipes.description: Barbecue lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper into a dry rub.
Apply dry rub to ribs, brisket, and chicken thighs on all sides.
Start brisket in a 225°F smoker or oven for 3 hours.
After 2 hours, add ribs to the smoker and continue smoking both for 1 more hour.
Add chicken thighs to the smoker for the final 45 minutes.
While smoking, combine ketchup, apple cider vinegar, molasses, Worcestershire sauce, and butter in a saucepan and simmer for 15 minutes.
During the last 30 minutes of cooking, brush all meats with the barbecue sauce every 10 minutes.
Remove all meats when fully cooked, let rest 10 minutes, slice or cut into portions, and arrange on a platter with extra sauce.
cheapTips: Buy different meats on sale throughout the week and freeze until ready to cook
Make your barbecue sauce in large batches and store for future use

recipes.name: Crown Prime Rib
recipes.description: Steakhouse dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove prime rib from refrigerator 1 hour before cooking to bring to room temperature.
Preheat oven to 450°F and pat the roast dry with paper towels.
Mix kosher salt, black pepper, and minced garlic together and rub all over the roast.
Place the roast bone-side down in a roasting pan and scatter rosemary and thyme around it.
Sear the roast in a 450°F oven for 15 minutes until the outside is browned.
Reduce oven temperature to 325°F and continue roasting for 1 hour and 15 minutes for medium-rare, basting with butter every 20 minutes.
Add beef broth to the pan and continue basting until the internal temperature reaches 130°F.
Remove from oven, tent with foil, and let rest for 15 minutes before carving and serving.
cheapTips: Buy prime rib during holiday sales for significant savings
Use fresh herbs from your garden or frozen herbs to reduce costs

recipes.name: Barbecued Turkey Leg
recipes.description: Barbecue lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and pat turkey legs dry with paper towels.
Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper to create a dry rub.
Apply the dry rub generously to all sides of the turkey legs.
Place turkey legs skin-side up on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°F until the skin begins to brown.
While turkey legs cook, combine ketchup, apple cider vinegar, molasses, and Worcestershire sauce in a saucepan and simmer for 10 minutes.
Brush the barbecue sauce on the turkey legs and bake for another 30 minutes, brushing with sauce every 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving with extra sauce.
cheapTips: Turkey legs are significantly cheaper than chicken or pork cuts
Buy when on sale and freeze for future meals

recipes.name: Green Goddess Cobb Salad
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Arrange chopped romaine lettuce evenly on a large serving plate or individual plates.
Arrange diced chicken, crumbled bacon, avocado, eggs, tomatoes, and blue cheese in rows on top of the lettuce.
Combine mayonnaise, fresh basil, lemon juice, and minced garlic in a food processor and blend until smooth.
Add salt and pepper to the green goddess dressing to taste.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad or serve on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy rotisserie chicken instead of cooking your own to save time
Use regular mayonnaise and skip expensive store-bought green goddess dressing

recipes.name: Kansas City-Style Potato Salad
recipes.description: Barbecue lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil cubed red potatoes in salted water for 12-15 minutes until fork-tender.
Drain potatoes and let cool to room temperature.
Mix mayonnaise, mustard, dill pickle relish, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Add cooled potatoes, diced onion, celery, and chopped hard-boiled eggs to the dressing.
Gently fold all ingredients together until potatoes are evenly coated.
Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle paprika over the top.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes and eggs in bulk for the best prices
Make the day before serving to save time at meal prep

recipes.name: Roast Turkey Dinner
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and remove turkey from refrigerator 1 hour before cooking.
Pat turkey dry inside and out with paper towels.
Mix softened butter with chopped sage, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the butter mixture under and over the turkey skin, getting as much under the breast skin as possible.
Stuff the cavity with thyme sprigs, onion quarters, and the whole lemon.
Place turkey breast-side up on a roasting rack in a roasting pan and pour chicken broth into the bottom.
Roast for approximately 3 hours, basting every 30 minutes with pan drippings, until the internal thigh temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove from oven and let rest for 20 minutes before carving and serving.
cheapTips: Buy whole turkeys on sale after major holidays for significant savings
Use simple herbs you already have instead of expensive herb blends

recipes.name: Turkey Leg
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat turkey legs dry with paper towels.
Mix paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt in a small bowl.
Rub the spice mixture all over the turkey legs, coating evenly.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Place turkey legs in the skillet and sear for 3 minutes per side until browned.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover with a lid, and cook for 30-35 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy turkey legs in bulk from warehouse stores like Costco for better pricing.
Use basic pantry spices instead of specialty seasoning blends.

recipes.name: Chipped Ham Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Spread mayonnaise on two slices of bread and mustard on the other two slices.
Layer chipped ham evenly on the two mayo-spread slices.
Top each with one slice of American cheese.
Close the sandwiches with the mustard-spread bread slices.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until bread is golden and cheese is melted.
Remove from skillet and serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand chipped ham instead of name brands to save 30-40%.
Use white bread that's on sale or near the end of the week.

recipes.name: Mummers Parade Snack Mix
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 250°F.
Combine Cheerios, peanuts, and pretzel sticks in a large bowl.
Melt butter and mix with sugar, cinnamon, and salt in a small saucepan.
Pour butter mixture over cereal mixture and toss until evenly coated.
Spread the mixture on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for 15 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Allow to cool completely on the baking sheet for 5 minutes.
Stir in M&Ms and transfer to an airtight container.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand cereals and candies instead of name brands.
Purchase nuts and pretzels from bulk bins to save money.

recipes.name: Fried Oysters
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot or fryer to 350°F.
Whisk together eggs and milk in a bowl.
Combine flour, cornmeal, salt, and black pepper in another bowl.
Pat oysters dry with paper towels.
Dip each oyster into the egg mixture, then coat thoroughly with the flour mixture.
Carefully place coated oysters into the hot oil in batches, frying for 2-3 minutes until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy oysters in-shell and shuck them yourself to save 20-30% off pre-shucked prices.
Look for oyster sales during off-season months.

recipes.name: Crab Cake
recipes.description: Seafood lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Gently fold crab meat with crushed saltine crackers, mayonnaise, egg, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, and Old Bay seasoning until just combined.
Form the mixture into 4 patties about 1/2-inch thick.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes (can be done while heating oil).
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Carefully place crab cakes in the hot oil and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to paper towels to drain briefly.
Serve warm with lemon wedges or tartar sauce.
cheapTips: Use lump crab meat on sale or buy canned crab to save money versus fresh.
Make patties ahead and freeze for up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Chow Mein Sandwich
recipes.description: Chinese-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat and warm the deli meat for 2 minutes.
Add drained chow mein noodles to the skillet with the meat.
Pour soy sauce and sesame oil over the noodles and meat.
Toss everything together and cook for 2-3 minutes until noodles are warm and slightly crispy.
Split the sub rolls and lightly toast the insides if desired.
Divide the chow mein mixture between the two rolls.
Top with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned chow mein noodles in bulk packs from Asian markets for better prices.
Use deli meat that's on sale or near the end of its sell-by date.

recipes.name: Pork and Broccoli Rabe Sandwich
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim and rinse the broccoli rabe, cutting into 2-inch pieces.
Boil broccoli rabe in salted water for 3-4 minutes until slightly tender, then drain.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the pork cutlets for 3-4 minutes per side until done; season with salt and pepper and set aside.
In the same skillet, heat remaining olive oil and sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add broccoli rabe back to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally; season with red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Split Italian rolls and lightly toast them.
Layer a slice of provolone on each roll, top with pork cutlet, then broccoli rabe.
Serve warm.
cheapTips: Buy pork cutlets on sale and freeze for later use.
Look for broccoli rabe at Italian or specialty markets, which often have better prices.

recipes.name: Sardine Sandwich
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut the ciabatta bread in half lengthwise to create two sandwich halves.
Drain sardines and arrange them on the bottom half of the bread.
Layer tomato slices and red onion over the sardines.
Drizzle with olive oil and squeeze lemon juice over the filling.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Close the sandwich with the top half of the bread.
Cut diagonally and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned sardines in bulk at warehouse clubs for significant savings.
Choose store-brand sardines over premium brands for the same quality at lower cost.

recipes.name: Mozzarella Stick Sandwich
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot or fryer to 350°F.
Carefully place frozen mozzarella sticks into the hot oil and fry for 1-2 minutes until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and place on paper towels to drain.
Warm marinara sauce in a saucepan and stir in garlic powder and Italian seasoning.
Split the sub rolls and lightly toast them if desired.
Arrange 3 mozzarella sticks on the bottom half of each roll.
Spoon marinara sauce over the mozzarella sticks and top with fresh basil if using.
Close with the top half of the roll and serve immediately while cheese is hot.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand frozen mozzarella sticks instead of name brands to save 20-30%.
Purchase marinara sauce in larger jars, which cost less per ounce than smaller containers.

recipes.name: Creamed Chipped Beef on Toast
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden brown and set aside.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Tear or chop the chipped beef into bite-sized pieces and add to the skillet; cook for 1 minute.
Sprinkle flour over the beef and stir constantly for 1 minute to create a roux.
Slowly pour milk into the skillet while stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
Cook for 3-4 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
Season with black pepper and paprika if desired.
Pour the creamed beef over the toast and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy jarred chipped beef from the canned meat aisle instead of deli counters for better prices.
Use store-brand white bread and milk to keep costs down.

recipes.name: Soft Shell Crab
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse the soft shell crabs under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix flour, salt, black pepper, and cayenne in a shallow bowl.
Dredge each crab in the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Heat oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Carefully place crabs shell-side down in the hot skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Flip crabs and cook for another 3-4 minutes until the shell turns bright red-orange.
Transfer to a serving plate and squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy crabs directly from fish markets rather than restaurants for better prices
Skip premium garnishes and use basic lemon juice for flavor

recipes.name: Mussels Marinara
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse mussels under cold water and remove any beards with a sharp knife.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes, white wine, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes to the pot.
Simmer sauce for 5 minutes to combine flavors.
Add cleaned mussels to the sauce and cover the pot.
Cook for 5-7 minutes until mussel shells open completely, discarding any that remain closed.
Stir in fresh basil and taste for seasoning adjustments.
Serve mussels and sauce over cooked pasta.
cheapTips: Buy mussels on sale or at ethnic markets for significant savings
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh for consistent pricing

recipes.name: North End Cannoli
recipes.description: Italian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, and salt in a bowl, then add egg, wine, and 2 tablespoons oil to form a stiff dough.
Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth, then wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
Roll dough very thin on a floured surface and cut 3-inch squares.
Heat 2 quarts oil in a deep pot to 375°F and fry dough squares wrapped around metal cannoli tubes until golden.
Remove fried shells and cool on paper towels before sliding off tubes.
Mix ricotta, powdered sugar, chocolate chips, and vanilla extract in a bowl to make filling.
Pipe ricotta filling into both ends of cooled cannoli shells using a pastry bag.
Dust filled cannoli with powdered sugar and serve within a few hours for best crispness.
cheapTips: Make filling-only cannoli without homemade shells for easier budget cooking
Buy ricotta on sale and freeze for future batches

recipes.name: She-Crab Soup
recipes.description: Lowcountry lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion, celery, and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add chicken broth to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Gently fold in crab meat and crab roe, being careful not to break up the lumps.
Pour in heavy cream and stir gently to combine.
Simmer for 10 minutes to let flavors meld, then season with salt and pepper.
Remove from heat and stir in sherry just before serving.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Substitute claw crab meat for lump meat to reduce cost significantly
Omit sherry and use a splash of white wine or lemon juice instead

recipes.name: Frogmore Stew
recipes.description: Lowcountry dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil.
Add crab boil seasoning packet, salt, and lemon halves to the boiling water.
Add baby potatoes and boil for 8 minutes until they start to soften.
Add corn and sliced smoked sausage, then boil for 5 more minutes.
Add shrimp and boil for 3-4 minutes until they turn pink and curl.
Drain all contents through a colander.
Transfer to a large serving platter and toss with butter and Old Bay seasoning.
Serve hot with extra melted butter on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy shrimp frozen and on sale rather than fresh for better prices
Skip the smoked sausage and double the shrimp for a lighter, cheaper option

recipes.name: Calabash Seafood Platter
recipes.description: Calabash dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep fryer or heavy pot.
Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, and cayenne in a shallow bowl.
Pat shrimp, flounder fillets, and scallops dry with paper towels.
Dredge each piece of seafood in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Fry shrimp for 2-3 minutes until golden, then remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Fry flounder fillets for 3-4 minutes until golden, then remove to the plate.
Fry scallops for 2-3 minutes until golden, then remove to the plate.
Prepare hush puppies according to package directions and fry alongside seafood, then serve everything together on a platter.
cheapTips: Buy frozen seafood in bulk when on sale and portion yourself
Substitute frozen fish fillets for fresh to cut costs by half

recipes.name: Purloo
recipes.description: Appalachian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper, then brown them in hot oil in a large pot for 4 minutes per side.
Remove chicken and set aside, then sauté diced onion in the pot for 3 minutes until softened.
Add diced potatoes and chicken broth to the pot, then return chicken to the pot.
Simmer covered for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Mix butter and flour together to create a paste, then stir into the pot to thicken the broth.
Simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes to thicken slightly.
Drop spoonfuls of biscuit dough over the top of the pot, then cover and simmer for 10 minutes until biscuits are cooked through.
Serve hot in bowls with biscuits on top.
cheapTips: Use chicken legs instead of thighs for even cheaper protein
Make biscuit dough from scratch with flour, baking powder, salt, and butter

recipes.name: Pig Pickin' Cake
recipes.description: Lowcountry snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 inch baking pan.
Mix cake mix, crushed pineapple with juice, eggs, and vegetable oil in a bowl until combined.
Pour batter into the prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool cake completely in the pan on a wire rack.
Beat cream cheese and butter together until fluffy, then gradually add powdered sugar and mix until smooth.
Fold whipped topping into the cream cheese mixture to create frosting.
Spread frosting over cooled cake and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Cut into squares and serve chilled.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cake mix and whipped topping instead of name brands
Buy canned pineapple on sale and freeze for future use

recipes.name: Charleston Crab Cake
recipes.description: Lowcountry lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine breadcrumbs, mayonnaise, egg, mustard powder, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Gently fold crab meat into the mixture, being careful not to break up the lumps.
Form mixture into 4 cakes and refrigerate for at least 10 minutes.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Carefully place crab cakes in the hot oil and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and serve hot.
Optional: serve with remoulade sauce or cocktail sauce.
cheapTips: Use claw crab meat instead of lump for significant savings
Make your own breadcrumbs from stale bread instead of buying packaged

recipes.name: Oyster Roast
recipes.description: Lowcountry dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F and line a large baking sheet with foil.
Arrange oysters in their shells on the prepared baking sheet.
Melt butter in a saucepan and stir in minced garlic, hot sauce, salt, and pepper.
Spoon a small amount of garlic butter mixture over each oyster.
Roast oysters for 8-10 minutes until shells begin to open.
Remove from oven and use an oyster knife to fully open any remaining shells.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the oysters and garnish with parsley.
Serve immediately with oyster crackers and extra melted butter for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy oysters directly from fish markets during peak season for better prices
Use standard butter instead of fancy compound butters

recipes.name: Breakfast Burritos
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onions and bell peppers for 3 minutes until softened.
Push vegetables to the side, crack eggs into the skillet, and scramble until cooked through, about 4 minutes.
Stir in cooked sausage, cooked potatoes, and half the cheese, mixing well.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side to make them pliable.
Lay a tortilla flat, place 1 cup of filling in the center, top with remaining cheese and a spoonful of salsa.
Fold the bottom third of the tortilla up over the filling, tuck in the sides, and roll tightly away from you.
Wrap each burrito in foil and serve warm with salsa on the side.
cheapTips: Use store-brand tortillas and cheese to reduce cost by 30%
Make your own salsa from canned tomatoes instead of buying jarred

recipes.name: Chile Rellenos
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast poblanos directly over a gas flame or under the broiler until charred all over, about 5 minutes, then place in a plastic bag for 5 minutes to steam.
Carefully peel away the charred skin, make a slit lengthwise, and gently remove the seeds, keeping the pepper whole.
Stuff each pepper with about 1/3 cup of shredded cheese and set on a plate.
In a saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat, sauté minced garlic and diced onion for 2 minutes, then add tomato sauce and broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Separate eggs; beat whites until stiff peaks form, then gently fold in yolks; dust stuffed peppers lightly with flour.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and carefully dip each pepper in the egg mixture to coat completely.
Fry peppers 2-3 minutes per side until golden, then transfer to a baking dish.
Pour warm red sauce over the peppers and bake at 350°F for 10 minutes until heated through.
cheapTips: Substitute mozzarella cheese for expensive Oaxaca cheese
Use fresh tomatoes in season or canned tomato sauce year-round

recipes.name: Esquites
recipes.description: Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced jalapeño and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add corn kernels and cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through and lightly charred in spots.
Remove from heat and stir in mayo and chili powder until corn is coated.
Transfer to a serving bowl and top with crumbled cotija cheese and fresh cilantro.
Squeeze lime juice over top, season with salt and pepper, and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use frozen corn year-round instead of fresh for consistent pricing
Skip cotija and substitute feta or even parmesan for savings

recipes.name: Cheesesteak
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the steak thinly against the grain (partially freezing for 30 minutes makes this easier).
Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat until smoking hot.
Add sliced onions and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened and golden, then transfer to a plate.
In the same skillet, add steak in a single layer and cook for 2 minutes, breaking it up with a spatula, then season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Return onions to the skillet and mix with the meat.
Top with provolone cheese and cover the skillet for 1 minute until melted.
Toast the hoagie rolls lightly in the skillet or under the broiler, then spoon the cheesesteak mixture onto the rolls and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use sirloin instead of rib-eye to save 30% on meat cost
Buy store-brand hoagie rolls instead of bakery rolls

recipes.name: Roast Pork Sandwich
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and pat pork shoulder dry with paper towels.
Make small slits in the pork and insert garlic cloves and herb sprigs throughout.
Rub all over with olive oil, salt, and pepper and place in a roasting pan.
Pour chicken broth into the bottom of the pan and roast for 1.5-2 hours until meat reaches an internal temperature of 190°F and shreds easily.
Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes, then shred the pork using two forks, mixing with pan drippings.
Stir in red wine vinegar and season to taste with additional salt and pepper.
Lightly toast the hoagie rolls and fill generously with shredded pork and its juices, then serve with extra gravy on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until needed
Skip expensive fresh herbs and use 1.5 tsp dried Italian seasoning instead

recipes.name: Italian Hoagie
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice hoagie rolls in half lengthwise and lightly toast under the broiler if desired.
Layer capicola, mortadella, and provolone cheese on the bottom half of each roll.
Add lettuce, tomato slices, red onion, and roasted red peppers on top.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Drizzle the vinaigrette over the vegetables and meats.
Close the hoagie rolls and wrap tightly in foil or parchment paper for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Unwrap, cut in half if desired, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy deli meat on sale and portion into freezer bags for later
Use jarred roasted peppers instead of roasting fresh ones

recipes.name: Soft Pretzel with Mustard
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt together, then combine with yeast mixture and knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise for 30 minutes until doubled in size.
Punch down dough and divide into 4 equal pieces, rolling each into a 20-inch rope.
Form each rope into a pretzel shape (an upside-down U with ends crossed and pressed down).
Preheat oven to 425°F and bring a pot of water to a boil, dissolving baking soda in it.
Boil each pretzel for 30 seconds per side, then place on a greased baking sheet, brush with melted butter, and sprinkle with pretzel salt.
Bake for 12-14 minutes until deep golden brown and serve warm with yellow mustard for dipping.
cheapTips: Make pretzels at home instead of buying them at $3-4 per pretzel
Buy active dry yeast in bulk to reduce per-batch cost

recipes.name: Water Ice
recipes.description: Italian-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine water and sugar in a saucepan and heat over medium until sugar dissolves completely, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let the syrup cool to room temperature for 15 minutes.
Stir in lemon juice, lemon zest, and a pinch of salt.
Pour the mixture into a shallow freezer-safe container and freeze for 1 hour.
Use a fork to stir and break up ice crystals every 30 minutes for the next 3 hours until it reaches a slushy, granita-like consistency.
Alternatively, use an ice cream maker following manufacturer's instructions for a smoother texture.
Scoop into small cups or cones and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use bottled lemon juice instead of fresh to save money
Make large batches and freeze in portions for up to 2 months

recipes.name: Tastykake
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a cupcake tin with paper liners.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, beat eggs, oil, buttermilk, and vanilla extract until combined.
Fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Divide batter evenly among cupcake liners, filling each about two-thirds full.
Bake for 18-22 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool cakes in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
Once cooled, frost the top of each cake with cream cheese frosting and serve.
cheapTips: Make frosting from scratch with cream cheese and powdered sugar to save 50%
Buy cocoa powder in bulk at warehouse stores for significant savings

recipes.name: Tomato Pie
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and place the frozen pie crust in a 9-inch pie pan.
Pat tomato slices dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture.
In a small bowl, mix mayonnaise, mozzarella cheese, green onions, basil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Spread half of the cheese mixture evenly on the bottom of the pie crust.
Layer half of the tomato slices over the cheese mixture, then spread remaining cheese mixture on top, and finish with remaining tomato slices.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the top of the pie.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling at the edges.
Cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use in-season tomatoes at farmers markets instead of grocery store tomatoes
Substitute low-fat mayo to reduce cost and calories slightly

recipes.name: Dulse Bread
recipes.description: Maine breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a loaf pan.
Rinse and finely chop the dried dulse seaweed into small pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, dulse, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In another bowl, whisk together milk, melted butter, and egg.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined; do not overmix.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
cheapTips: Buy dried dulse in bulk from health food stores or online for significant savings
Use store-brand flour and baking powder to reduce costs

recipes.name: Lobster Pound Cake
recipes.description: Maine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and lemon zest.
Alternate adding flour mixture and milk to the butter mixture, beginning and ending with flour.
Fold in vanilla extract and chopped lobster meat gently.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 55-65 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 15 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
cheapTips: Use canned lobster meat instead of fresh to reduce costs significantly
Buy butter and eggs on sale and freeze for future baking

recipes.name: Sea Urchin Roe
recipes.description: Maine snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Allow sea urchin roe to sit at room temperature for 2-3 minutes to soften slightly.
Lightly butter the soda crackers and arrange on a plate.
Carefully spoon sea urchin roe onto each cracker, dividing evenly.
Sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt.
Serve immediately with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
cheapTips: Purchase fresh uni directly from seafood markets rather than specialty shops
Check for sales at Japanese markets which often have better pricing

recipes.name: Mussel Stew
recipes.description: Maine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean mussels under cold running water and remove any beards; discard any open ones.
Melt butter in a large pot and sauté onion, garlic, and celery until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in wine and stock, add thyme sprigs, and bring to a simmer.
Cook potatoes until nearly tender, about 8-10 minutes.
Add mussels and cream, cover partially, and cook for 5-7 minutes until mussels open; discard any that don't.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy mussels in bulk when on sale and freeze for later use
Use fish stock made from vegetable scraps instead of buying packaged stock

recipes.name: Blueberry Muffin
recipes.description: Maine breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a muffin tin with paper liners or grease wells.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and lemon zest.
In another bowl, beat together egg, milk, oil, and vanilla extract.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined; do not overmix.
Gently fold in blueberries until evenly distributed.
Divide batter among muffin cups, filling each about two-thirds full.
Bake for 18-22 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
cheapTips: Use frozen blueberries year-round; they are cheaper than fresh and work equally well
Buy flour in bulk to reduce per-muffin cost significantly

recipes.name: Crab Roll
recipes.description: Maine lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a small bowl, combine crab meat, celery, mayonnaise, lemon juice, and Old Bay seasoning.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Toast the hot dog buns in the butter until lightly golden, about 2 minutes per side.
Divide crab mixture evenly between the two buns.
Serve immediately, optionally garnished with additional lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Use canned crab meat instead of fresh for significant cost savings
Buy hot dog buns at discount bakeries rather than supermarket shelves

recipes.name: Lobster Salad
recipes.description: Maine lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, mustard, and lemon juice.
Add lobster meat, celery, red onion, and tarragon; mix gently to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Arrange mixed greens on plates and top with lobster salad mixture.
Garnish with tomato slices and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use canned or frozen lobster meat to reduce cost by 60% compared to fresh
Buy lettuce on sale and use within 2-3 days for freshness

recipes.name: Congrí
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion, garlic, and bell pepper until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add black beans and black-eyed peas, stirring to combine.
Cook for 5 minutes, then add cooked rice and mix well.
Continue cooking for 5-8 minutes until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in fresh cilantro and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans in bulk at discount stores for best pricing
Use leftover cooked rice from previous meals to save time and money

recipes.name: Vaca Frita
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut flank steak against the grain into thin slices.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook beef slices in batches until browned, about 2 minutes per side; set aside.
Add remaining olive oil to skillet and sauté garlic, onion, and bell pepper until tender, about 5 minutes.
Return beef to skillet and add cumin, stirring well.
Pour in beef broth and lime juice, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with rice or plantains.
cheapTips: Buy flank steak when on sale and freeze for future use
Use store-brand cumin and lime juice instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Empanadas Cubanas
recipes.description: Cuban snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make dough by mixing flour, salt, and cold butter using a fork until crumbly.
Add egg yolk and warm water, mixing until dough comes together; refrigerate 30 minutes.
Brown ground beef in a skillet with onion and garlic over medium heat.
Add cumin, olives, and raisins; simmer for 5 minutes and let cool.
Roll dough between parchment paper into thin sheets; cut into 4-inch squares.
Place 1 tbsp filling in center of each square, fold diagonally, and seal edges with a fork.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Fry empanadas in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side; drain on paper towels.
cheapTips: Make dough and filling ahead, then fry just before serving for efficiency
Buy ground beef on sale and freeze to save on filling costs

recipes.name: Huevos a la Habanera
recipes.description: Cuban breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice the onion, garlic, habanero pepper, and tomato.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the diced habanero and tomato, cooking for 3 minutes until softened.
Crack the eggs directly into the skillet over the vegetable mixture.
Cook until the eggs reach your desired doneness, about 3-5 minutes, seasoning with salt and pepper.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk from warehouse stores
Use jalapeños instead of habaneros to save money

recipes.name: Lechón Asado
recipes.description: Cuban dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mash garlic cloves with salt, cumin, oregano, and black pepper in a bowl.
Make deep slits in the pork shoulder and rub the garlic paste thoroughly into all cuts and over the entire surface.
Mix orange juice, lime juice, and olive oil, then pour over the pork.
Cover and marinate the pork for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight, in the refrigerator.
Preheat oven to 350°F and place pork in a roasting pan with the marinade.
Roast uncovered for 3-4 hours, basting every 30 minutes with the pan juices until skin is crispy and meat is fork-tender.
Remove from oven and let rest for 15 minutes before carving.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder on sale and freeze until needed
Use regular orange instead of fresh orange juice concentrate

recipes.name: Congri Negro
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add cumin and stir constantly for 30 seconds.
Pour in the black beans with their liquid and the chicken broth, add bay leaf, and bring to a boil.
Stir in the rice, salt, and pepper, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans on sale and stock up
Use store-brand rice for significant savings

recipes.name: Tamal en Cazuela
recipes.description: Cuban breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat butter in a large pot and sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Slowly whisk in the cornmeal to avoid lumps, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the chicken broth while stirring continuously to prevent clumping.
Add salt, pepper, cumin, and corn, stirring well.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture thickens.
Serve hot in bowls or small dishes.
cheapTips: Buy cornmeal in bulk from ethnic or warehouse stores
Use frozen corn instead of canned to save money

recipes.name: Bistec de Palomilla
recipes.description: Cuban dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mash garlic cloves with salt and cumin to create a paste.
Rub the garlic paste all over the beef slices and drizzle with lime juice.
Slice the onion into rings.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until very hot.
Working in batches, cook the beef slices for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked to your preference.
Remove the beef and set aside.
In the same skillet, quickly sauté the onion rings for 2-3 minutes until slightly caramelized.
Serve the bistec topped with the sautéed onions.
cheapTips: Ask the butcher to slice beef thin; cheaper cuts work fine
Buy beef on sale and freeze until ready to cook

recipes.name: Ajiaco Criollo
recipes.description: Cuban lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut the beef into 1-inch cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 5 minutes total.
Add diced onion and minced garlic, stirring for 1 minute.
Pour in the beef broth and add cumin, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, then add peeled and cubed potatoes and plantains.
Add corn (fresh cut from cob or canned), and simmer for another 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use chuck roast on sale and freeze until needed
Canned corn is cheaper than fresh when out of season

recipes.name: Pastelitos de Carne
recipes.description: Cuban snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make the dough by combining flour and salt, then cutting in cold butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add water slowly until dough forms; wrap in plastic and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil and cook the ground beef with diced onion and garlic, breaking meat apart as it cooks, about 5-7 minutes.
Season the filling with cumin, salt, and pepper, then cool slightly.
Roll out dough thinly on a floured surface and cut into 3-inch squares.
Place a teaspoon of filling on each square, fold into a triangle, and press edges with a fork to seal.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F and fry pastelitos in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Make large batches and freeze uncooked pastelitos for quick meals
Use vegetable oil instead of olive oil for frying to save money

recipes.name: Dungeness Crab Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Finely dice the celery and green onion.
In a bowl, combine the crab meat, mayonnaise, lemon juice, diced celery, and green onion.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Toast the bread lightly if desired.
Place lettuce on the bread, top with the crab salad mixture, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy canned crab instead of fresh to save significantly
Make your own mayo to reduce costs

recipes.name: Mission Burrito
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown the ground beef in a skillet with diced onion and minced garlic over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5-7 minutes.
Drain excess fat, then add the black beans (with liquid) and stir until heated through, about 2 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or over a flame until pliable.
Lay a tortilla flat and add rice down the center, then top with the beef-bean mixture.
Sprinkle cheese, drizzle with salsa and sour cream, and add cilantro.
Fold the sides of the tortilla over the filling, then roll tightly from the bottom up.
Place seam-side down in a hot skillet and toast for 1-2 minutes per side until golden, or wrap in foil and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions
Make extra rice in bulk to use throughout the week

recipes.name: Sourdough Bread Bowl
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine sourdough starter, water, and flour in a large bowl, mixing until shaggy dough forms.
Let rest (autolyse) for 30 minutes, then add salt and knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
Place in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise at room temperature for 4-6 hours, folding every hour.
Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a round ball, then place on parchment paper.
Cover with a towel and let proof for 1-2 hours until puffy.
Preheat oven to 450°F with a Dutch oven inside for 30 minutes.
Score the top of the dough with a knife, carefully transfer to the hot Dutch oven, and bake covered for 20 minutes.
Remove lid and bake another 20-25 minutes until deep golden brown.
Cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before serving; hollow out slightly if using as a bowl for soup or stew.
cheapTips: Maintain a sourdough starter at home to avoid buying yeast repeatedly
Buy flour in bulk and store in airtight containers

recipes.name: Clams Casino
recipes.description: Italian-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat your oven to 425°F.
Scrub clams under cold water and arrange on a baking sheet, then bake for 5 minutes until shells crack slightly.
Remove clams and let cool, then separate shells, keeping clam meat in one half-shell and discarding the other half.
Finely chop bacon, bell pepper, onion, and garlic, then sauté in butter for 4 minutes until softened.
Mix breadcrumbs, sautéed mixture, parsley, and parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Top each clam with 1 tablespoon of the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently.
Bake stuffed clams for 12 minutes until topping is golden brown.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy littleneck clams from fish counter sales or buy them pre-shucked for easier prep
Use regular breadcrumbs instead of Italian-flavored to save 30 cents per serving

recipes.name: Lobster Trap Cake
recipes.description: Maine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease two 8-inch round cake pans.
Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition, then mix in vanilla.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Alternate adding dry ingredients and buttermilk to butter mixture, starting and ending with dry ingredients.
Divide batter into portions and tint portions with red and yellow food coloring to create lobster colors.
Layer colored batters in pans and bake for 28-32 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely, then frost layers and stack, frosting the outside with cream cheese frosting.
Shape fondant into a lobster trap shape and place on top as decoration.
cheapTips: Skip the fondant lobster trap and use simple piped frosting details instead
Buy butter when on sale and freeze it for later baking projects

recipes.name: Blueberry Pie
recipes.description: Maine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and place one pie crust in a 9-inch pie dish.
Mix blueberries, sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, and salt in a large bowl.
Pour blueberry mixture into the pie crust and dot with butter pieces.
Cover with the second pie crust, trim edges, and crimp with a fork to seal.
Whisk together egg and water to make egg wash, then brush over the top crust.
Cut four small slits in the top crust for steam to escape.
Bake for 15 minutes at 425°F, then reduce heat to 350°F and bake for 35-40 minutes until crust is golden.
Cool on a wire rack for at least 2 hours before slicing.
cheapTips: Use frozen blueberries (thawed and drained) instead of fresh to save $2-3
Use store-bought pie crust instead of homemade to save time and ingredients

recipes.name: Whoopie Pie
recipes.description: Maine snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Whisk together flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Cream butter and brown sugar for 2 minutes, then beat in egg and vanilla.
Alternate adding dry ingredients and buttermilk to the butter mixture, mixing until just combined.
Drop rounded tablespoons of batter onto baking sheets, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until cakes spring back when touched lightly.
Cool completely on baking sheets, then pair cookies of similar size together.
Beat marshmallow fluff with powdered sugar until smooth and fluffy, then spread between cookie pairs.
cheapTips: Buy cocoa powder in bulk bins instead of small boxes to save 40%
Skip the fluff filling and use frosting made from butter and powdered sugar

recipes.name: Lobster Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Maine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and cook pasta 1 minute under al dente, then drain and set aside.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat, then whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute to make a roux.
Slowly add milk while whisking constantly to avoid lumps, then cook for 5 minutes until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar and gruyere cheese until melted and smooth.
Gently fold in cooked pasta, lobster meat, tarragon, and season with salt, pepper, and cayenne.
Transfer to a buttered 9x13 baking dish and top with panko breadcrumbs.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden and bubbly on the edges.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use canned or frozen lobster meat instead of fresh to cut cost by half
Substitute half the lobster with imitation crab meat to reduce overall expense

recipes.name: Lobster Stew
recipes.description: Maine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a large pot and add diced onion and celery, sautéing for 4 minutes until soft.
Add diced potatoes and stock, then bring to a simmer and cook for 12 minutes until potatoes are tender.
In a separate small pot, melt remaining butter and gently cook lobster meat for 3 minutes to infuse butter.
Add sherry to the lobster and butter, then pour the mixture into the main pot.
Add bay leaf and simmer for 5 minutes, then remove from heat and stir in heavy cream.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Gently reheat without boiling, then serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Use frozen lobster meat (thawed) instead of fresh to save $3-5 per serving
Substitute chicken or vegetable stock for lobster stock to reduce costs

recipes.name: Red Snappers
recipes.description: Maine snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Spread 1 teaspoon peanut butter on each saltine cracker.
Mix cinnamon and sugar in a small bowl, then sprinkle over peanut butter layer.
Melt butter and red-hot candies together in a small pot, stirring constantly until smooth.
Drizzle the cinnamon-butter mixture over each cracker.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until the peanut butter is warm and the candy begins to set.
Cool on baking sheets for 15 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy saltines and peanut butter in bulk at warehouse stores to maximize savings
Use generic cinnamon-sugar instead of mixing to save prep time

recipes.name: Lobster Bisque
recipes.description: Maine lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large pot and sauté diced onion, celery, and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add lobster shells and cook for 3 minutes to toast, then add brandy and carefully ignite to burn off alcohol.
Pour in fish stock and bay leaf, then simmer for 20 minutes to extract flavor from shells.
Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh strainer, pressing on solids to extract all liquid.
Return strained liquid to pot and add heavy cream, then heat gently without boiling.
In a separate pan, melt remaining butter and sauté lobster meat for 3 minutes until just cooked through.
Add cooked lobster meat to the bisque, season with salt and cayenne, then serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Request lobster shells from a fishmonger when buying lobster meat—usually free or very cheap
Use half-and-half instead of heavy cream to reduce cost without much difference in flavor

recipes.name: Fried Haddock
recipes.description: Maine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a deep skillet or Dutch oven to 350°F.
Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Whisk in cold water gradually until batter is smooth and thick like pancake batter.
Pat haddock fillets dry with paper towels, then dip each into batter, coating completely.
Carefully place coated fillets into hot oil and fry for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy haddock on sale and freeze in individual portions to cook later
Use vegetable oil or canola oil instead of specialty oils—same result for less cost

recipes.name: Scallop Pie
recipes.description: Maine dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and place pie crust in a 9-inch pie dish.
Melt butter in a large skillet and sauté diced onion and celery for 4 minutes until soft.
Cut scallops in half if large, then add to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes per side until opaque.
Sprinkle flour over scallop mixture and stir to coat, then cook for 1 minute.
Add fish stock and white wine, then simmer for 3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in heavy cream, frozen peas, and dill, then season with salt and pepper.
Pour scallop mixture into the pie crust, then cover with the second crust or create a lattice top.
Brush egg wash over the top crust and cut vents, then bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy scallops on sale at the seafood counter and freeze in portions for later use
Use frozen peas year-round—same nutrition as fresh at a lower cost

recipes.name: Crab Toast
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain the canned crab meat and place in a bowl.
Mix in mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, and Old Bay seasoning until combined.
Butter both slices of bread and toast them until golden brown.
Spread the crab mixture evenly on each slice of toast.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use canned crab instead of fresh to save money
Toast bread in a regular toaster instead of a pan

recipes.name: Fortune Cookie
recipes.description: Chinese-American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk egg whites and sugar together until foamy, then fold in flour gently.
Stir in melted butter, vanilla extract, and water until smooth.
Drop 1 tablespoon of batter onto baking sheet, spacing 3 inches apart, and bake 5-7 minutes until edges turn golden.
Remove from oven and quickly place a fortune on the cookie, then fold in half and then over a glass rim into a triangle shape.
Allow to cool and set for 1 minute, then remove from the glass and place seam-side down.
Repeat with remaining batter.
cheapTips: Make fortunes at home by writing on thin paper strips
Bake only a few at a time to ensure you can fold them while warm

recipes.name: Mission-Style Tamales
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak corn husks in warm water for 30 minutes to soften.
Beat lard with a mixer for 5 minutes until fluffy, then mix in masa harina, chicken broth, baking powder, and salt.
Toss shredded chicken with red chile sauce and diced onion.
Lay a softened corn husk flat and spread 2 tablespoons of masa down the center.
Place 1 tablespoon of chicken mixture in the center of the masa.
Fold both long sides of the husk over the filling, then fold the pointed bottom up.
Stand tamales upright in a steamer pot with water below, cover with extra husks, and steam for 45 minutes.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy masa harina in bulk from Mexican markets
Use rotisserie chicken to save preparation time

recipes.name: Coney Island Hot Dog
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and water to the beef, stirring well.
Simmer the meat sauce for 5 minutes until thickened slightly.
Boil or grill the hot dogs until heated through.
Place each hot dog in a bun and spread a thin line of mustard on top.
Spoon the meat sauce over each hot dog, then top with diced onion.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy hot dogs on sale and freeze them
Use bulk ground beef for better pricing

recipes.name: Detroit-Style Pizza
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, and salt in a large bowl, then add warm water and 2 tablespoons olive oil.
Knead until a shaggy dough forms, then let rest for 10 minutes.
Oil a 9x13 inch rectangular baking pan with 1 tablespoon olive oil and press the dough to fill it evenly.
Let the dough rise for 20 minutes until puffy.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a small border.
Distribute mozzarella cheese over the sauce, then scatter pepperoni, and finish with cheddar cheese.
Bake at 475°F for 15-18 minutes until the crust is golden and cheese is bubbly and slightly crispy at the edges.
Cool for 5 minutes before cutting into squares.
cheapTips: Make dough from scratch instead of using pre-made
Use store-brand cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Leg of Lamb with Kibbeh
recipes.description: Lebanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rub the leg of lamb with salt, pepper, half the allspice, and minced garlic, then let rest 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375°F and roast the lamb for 1 hour until it reaches 145°F internal temperature.
While lamb roasts, soak bulgur wheat in warm water for 15 minutes until softened, then drain well.
Brown ground lamb with diced onion in a skillet, then stir in remaining allspice, half the mint, and salt and pepper.
Mix the cooked ground lamb with the drained bulgur wheat and form into oval patties.
Fry kibbeh patties in olive oil over medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Toast pine nuts in a dry pan until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Let lamb rest for 10 minutes, then slice and serve with kibbeh patties topped with toasted pine nuts and remaining fresh mint.
cheapTips: Buy lamb when on sale and freeze it
Skip the pine nuts or use walnuts as a cheaper substitute

recipes.name: Faygo Soda Float
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour half of the Faygo soda into each of two tall glasses.
Place one scoop of vanilla ice cream into each glass.
Top each glass with the remaining soda, pouring slowly to avoid overflow.
Add a dollop of whipped cream on top of each float.
Serve immediately with a spoon and straw.
cheapTips: Buy soda and ice cream on sale
Use store-brand ice cream to save money

recipes.name: Arabic Bread with Hummus
recipes.description: Middle Eastern lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, and salt in a bowl, then add warm water and knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
Let dough rise in an oiled bowl for 30 minutes until doubled in size.
Meanwhile, blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, 1 tablespoon olive oil, and salt in a food processor until smooth, adding water if needed for consistency.
Divide dough into 8 portions and roll each into a thin oval about 1/4 inch thick.
Heat a cast iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and cook each bread for 2-3 minutes per side until puffed and lightly spotted.
Stack cooked breads on a plate and cover with a cloth to keep warm.
Transfer hummus to a serving bowl, make a well in the center, and drizzle with remaining olive oil.
Serve warm bread alongside the hummus for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy chickpeas in bulk or use canned on sale
Make hummus in larger batches and refrigerate

recipes.name: Lafayette Coney Island
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, breaking it apart as it cooks for about 5 minutes.
Add chili powder, cumin, paprika, and water to the beef and stir well.
Simmer the meat sauce for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally until thickened.
Boil or grill the hot dogs until heated through.
Place each hot dog in a bun and apply a thin line of mustard.
Top generously with the meat sauce and sprinkle diced onion on top.
Serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy hot dogs in bulk when on sale
Use generic spices from bulk bins

recipes.name: American Coney Island
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into small pieces as it browns.
Drain excess fat from the beef, then add chili powder, garlic powder, worcestershire sauce, and water.
Simmer the meat sauce for 5-7 minutes until slightly thickened and fragrant.
Boil or steam the hot dogs until heated through.
Place each hot dog in a bun and drizzle with a small amount of mustard.
Generously ladle the meat sauce over each hot dog.
Top with finely diced raw onion and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions
Make extra meat sauce and freeze for future use

recipes.name: Flint-Style Burrito
recipes.description: Mexican American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Warm the refried beans in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Heat the flour tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side to make them pliable.
Lay each tortilla flat and spread a layer of refried beans down the center.
Top the beans with cooked ground beef, diced onion, and half the cheese on each tortilla.
Roll each tortilla tightly, folding in the sides as you go.
Place the burritos seam-side down in a greased baking dish and top with remaining cheese and salsa.
Bake at 350°F for 12 minutes until cheese is melted, then serve with sour cream.
cheapTips: Use store-brand refried beans and ground beef on sale
Make your own salsa with canned tomatoes if available

recipes.name: Kielbasa with Caramelized Onions
recipes.description: Polish American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the kielbasa into 1/4-inch thick coins.
Slice the onions into thin half-moons.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat and add the sliced onions.
Cook the onions for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deep golden brown and soft.
Add brown sugar and apple cider vinegar to the onions and stir well, cooking for 2 more minutes.
Push the onions to the side of the skillet and add kielbasa slices, cooking until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir the kielbasa into the caramelized onions and season with salt and pepper.
Serve on sliced rye bread with mustard on the side.
cheapTips: Buy kielbasa on sale and freeze for later use
Use the cheapest yellow onions available; quality doesn't matter since they caramelize

recipes.name: Pasty
recipes.description: Cornish American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then cut in cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs; add ice water until dough comes together and chill for 15 minutes.
Combine ground beef, diced potatoes, rutabaga, onion, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Divide chilled dough in half and roll each piece into a 8-inch round on a floured surface.
Spoon the filling onto one half of each dough round, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Fold the dough over to create a half-moon and crimp the edges with a fork to seal.
Place pastries on a parchment-lined baking sheet and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes until golden brown.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use the cheapest ground beef available
Buy potatoes and rutabaga in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Guardians Garlic Fries
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch thick fries and soak in cold water for 15 minutes; pat dry thoroughly.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or fryer.
Fry potatoes in batches for 8-10 minutes until golden and crispy; drain on paper towels.
Mince the garlic cloves and cook in butter over low heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Toss hot fries with the garlic butter, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Sprinkle parmesan cheese and fresh parsley over the fries.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Use regular russet potatoes from bulk bins
Skip fresh parsley and use dried parsley to save money

recipes.name: Chili Cheese Burrito
recipes.description: Mexican American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Stir in the canned chili, diced onion, cumin, and salt; simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Lay each tortilla flat and spread a generous layer of the chili mixture down the center.
Top with half the cheese and jalapeños on each burrito.
Roll each tortilla tightly, tucking in the sides as you go.
Place burritos seam-side down in a greased baking dish and top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes until cheese melts, then serve with sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy canned chili in bulk when on sale
Use store-brand cheddar cheese to save money

recipes.name: Pan-Fried Whitefish
recipes.description: Great Lakes dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat whitefish fillets dry and season with salt and pepper.
Dredge both sides of each fillet lightly in flour, shaking off excess.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add minced garlic.
Place fillets in the hot butter and cook for 4-5 minutes on the first side until golden.
Carefully flip the fillets and cook the other side for 3-4 minutes until opaque throughout.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the fillets and sprinkle with dill.
Remove from heat and serve immediately with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy whitefish from warehouse stores for better prices
Use frozen fillets; they're usually cheaper and thaw quickly

recipes.name: Barbecue Ribs
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs by sliding a knife underneath and peeling it away.
Mix brown sugar, paprika, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder in a small bowl to create a dry rub.
Apply the dry rub generously to both sides of the ribs, pressing gently.
Place ribs bone-side down on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Bake at 275°F for 2.5 hours uncovered.
Combine barbecue sauce and apple cider vinegar, then brush over the ribs.
Bake for an additional 30 minutes until the sauce caramelizes and ribs are tender.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice between the bones and serve.
cheapTips: Buy ribs on sale and freeze until ready to cook
Use store-brand barbecue sauce to save money

recipes.name: Jiffy Cornbread Muffin
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and grease a muffin tin with non-stick spray.
Pour the Jiffy cornbread mix into a bowl.
Beat egg and milk together in another bowl.
Combine the wet and dry ingredients and stir until just mixed; do not overmix.
Stir in melted butter, sugar, optional corn kernels, and salt.
Divide the batter evenly into the prepared muffin tin, filling each cup two-thirds full.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
cheapTips: Jiffy mix is inexpensive and often on sale
Skip the corn kernels to save additional money

recipes.name: Detroit Bagel
recipes.description: Jewish American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Add water and knead by hand or with a mixer for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Let dough rise in an oiled bowl for 30 minutes covered with a damp cloth.
Divide dough into 2 pieces and shape each into a ball, then poke a hole and stretch into a bagel shape.
Place bagels on a parchment-lined baking sheet and let rise for 20 minutes.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil with malt syrup and boil bagels for 2 minutes per side.
Place boiled bagels on a baking sheet and bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
Cool, slice, and serve toasted with cream cheese and lox.
cheapTips: Use honey instead of malt syrup if malt syrup is unavailable
Skip the lox and use regular cream cheese to reduce cost significantly

recipes.name: Shawarma Wrap
recipes.description: Lebanese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips about 1/4-inch thick.
Mix paprika, cumin, garlic powder, olive oil, and lemon juice in a bowl to create a marinade.
Coat chicken strips with the marinade and let sit for 15 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook marinated chicken until golden and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.
Slice tomatoes, onion, and cucumber into thin strips while chicken cooks.
Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Spread tahini down the center of each tortilla and top with cooked chicken, tomatoes, onion, and cucumber.
Roll tightly, wrap in foil if desired, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later use
Make your own tahini sauce with sesame paste if available

recipes.name: Chicken and Waffles
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Marinate chicken thighs in buttermilk with paprika, salt, and pepper for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl; whisk eggs with milk, then combine wet and dry ingredients with melted butter.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pan and fry marinated chicken pieces until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F, about 12-15 minutes.
Preheat waffle iron and pour batter into each section, cooking until golden and crispy, about 5 minutes per batch.
Serve warm waffles topped with fried chicken and drizzle with maple syrup.
cheapTips: Use chicken drumsticks instead of thighs to save 20%
Make waffles in bulk and freeze extras for quick meals

recipes.name: Gai Yang
recipes.description: Thai lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound garlic, cilantro roots, and black pepper into a paste using a mortar and pestle.
Mix paste with fish sauce, soy sauce, palm sugar, lime juice, and coconut milk to create marinade.
Coat chicken thighs thoroughly with marinade and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Grill chicken over charcoal or gas heat for 20-25 minutes, turning frequently until skin is charred and meat reaches 165°F internally.
Brush with remaining marinade during last 5 minutes of cooking and serve with sticky rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken thighs on sale and freeze; they're cheaper than breasts
Use regular soy sauce if fish sauce is unavailable

recipes.name: Korean Bibimbap
recipes.description: Korean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions and set aside in serving bowls.
Brown ground beef in a pan with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 minced garlic clove, then set aside.
Blanch spinach in boiling salted water for 1 minute, drain well, toss with 0.5 teaspoon sesame oil and salt.
Julienne carrots and zucchini, stir-fry each separately in a hot pan with 0.5 teaspoon sesame oil and minced garlic for 2-3 minutes each.
Fry eggs sunny-side up in a separate pan with a bit of oil.
Arrange cooked vegetables and beef on top of rice in sections, place fried egg in center.
Mix gochujang with 1 tablespoon sesame oil and remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce to create sauce.
Drizzle sauce over bibimbap and mix thoroughly before eating.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables on sale and prep ahead of time
Substitute ground pork for beef to save money

recipes.name: Ploughman's Lunch
recipes.description: British lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice bread and butter each slice generously.
Cut cheddar cheese into thick slices and ham into folded pieces.
Arrange cheese and ham on buttered bread.
Core and slice apple into wedges, chop celery into sticks.
Arrange all components on a board or plate: bread with cheese and ham, apple slices, celery, pickled onions, gherkins, and mustard on the side.
cheapTips: Buy cheese and ham from deli counter in bulk for better value
Use store-brand pickled onions and gherkins

recipes.name: Pork Pie
recipes.description: British snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat lard and water until melted, then mix into flour and 0.5 teaspoon salt to create hot water pastry dough; cool slightly.
Dice pork shoulder and mix with sage, remaining salt, and pepper.
Mold two-thirds of warm dough into a pie mold or jar, then fill with pork mixture.
Use remaining dough to create a lid, seal edges with water, and make a small hole in center.
Brush pastry with beaten egg and bake at 350°F for 1 hour until golden brown.
Cool pie completely, then heat beef stock with gelatin until dissolved and pour through center hole using a funnel.
Refrigerate until set, at least 4 hours before removing from mold and serving cold.
cheapTips: Use pork butt instead of shoulder for even better savings
Make multiple pies and freeze for long-term storage

recipes.name: Beef and Guinness Pie
recipes.description: Irish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a Dutch oven and brown beef chunks in batches until deep color develops, about 8 minutes per batch.
Remove beef and sauté diced onions and carrots until softened, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir for 1 minute to create roux.
Pour in Guinness and beef broth, scraping up browned bits, then add beef back with tomato paste and thyme.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 90 minutes until beef is tender, stirring occasionally.
Cut potatoes into chunks and add to pot in final 20 minutes of cooking; season to taste.
Transfer filling to a pie dish, top with pie crust, brush with beaten egg, and bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until golden.
cheapTips: Use beef stew meat from the sale section
Substitute regular brown ale if Guinness is too expensive

recipes.name: Chicken and Mushroom Pie
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Poach chicken breasts in salted water for 12-15 minutes until cooked through, then shred into bite-sized pieces.
Sauté sliced mushrooms and diced onion in 2 tablespoons butter until tender and liquid has evaporated, about 8 minutes.
Make a roux by melting remaining 2 tablespoons butter and whisking in flour until smooth, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in milk and chicken broth, stirring constantly until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Stir in shredded chicken, cooked mushrooms and onions, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Pour filling into a pie dish and top with pie crust, sealing edges and brushing with beaten egg.
Bake at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until crust is golden brown and filling is bubbling at edges.
cheapTips: Buy chicken when on sale and freeze until ready to use
Use store-brand pie crust to reduce costs
