recipes.name: Black Pudding
recipes.description: British breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mince pork fat and sauté with diced onion and garlic until soft, about 5 minutes; cool slightly.
Mix cooled pork fat mixture with blood, oats, thyme, sage, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Soak sausage casings in warm water for 5 minutes to soften.
Using a piping bag or sausage stuffer, fill casings with pudding mixture, tying off ends.
Poach filled casings in simmering water (180°F) for 20 minutes until firm.
Cool completely, then slice into rounds and pan-fry in a bit of fat until crispy on both sides, about 3 minutes per side.
cheapTips: Source pig blood from specialty butchers or ethnic markets for lowest cost
Make in bulk and freeze individual slices for easy breakfast prep

recipes.name: Meat Pie with Mash and Liquor
recipes.description: British dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown ground beef with diced onion in a large pan over medium-high heat, breaking up meat as it cooks, about 8 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over beef and stir for 1 minute, then add beef broth and Worcestershire sauce; simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Boil peeled and cubed potatoes in salted water until tender, about 15 minutes; drain and mash with 2 tablespoons butter and milk.
Pour beef mixture into a pie dish and top with pie crust, pressing edges to seal and brushing with beaten egg.
Bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until crust is golden brown.
Make liquor sauce by whisking remaining 2 tablespoons butter with flour to create a paste, then cooking in beef broth until thickened, about 3 minutes.
Serve pie hot with creamy mash on the side and liquor sauce drizzled over top.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portioned bags
Use regular store-brand pie crust rather than fresh

recipes.name: Coddle
recipes.description: Irish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut bacon into chunks and sausages in half; layer both in a large pot.
Peel and slice potatoes and onions, then layer over the meat.
Pour chicken broth over everything, add thyme and bay leaf, and season with salt and pepper.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, cover with a lid, and cook for 30-35 minutes until potatoes are tender and sausages are cooked through.
Ladle coddle into bowls with broth and serve hot, traditionally with crusty bread for soaking up the liquid.
cheapTips: Buy bacon and sausages from the butcher counter for bulk discounts
Use store-brand chicken broth to save money

recipes.name: Pork Scratchings
recipes.description: British snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Cut pork skin into 1-inch squares and pat dry with paper towels.
Toss skin pieces with salt, pepper, and paprika in a bowl.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with foil.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, stirring halfway through, until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Ask your butcher for pork skin scraps, often cheaper than pre-cut portions.
Make in bulk and store in an airtight container for 3 days.

recipes.name: Champ
recipes.description: Irish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube potatoes into 1-inch pieces.
Boil potatoes in salted water for 12-15 minutes until fork-tender, then drain.
Warm milk with 2 tablespoons butter in a small saucepan.
Chop green onions into thin rings and stir into warm milk mixture.
Mash hot potatoes and stir in milk mixture until creamy and fluffy.
Season with salt and pepper, then top with remaining 2 tablespoons melted butter.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in 5-lb bags for better per-pound savings.
Green onions from the produce section cost less than pre-packaged.

recipes.name: Full Irish Breakfast
recipes.description: Irish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook bacon rashers until crispy, about 5 minutes per side, then set aside.
In the same skillet, brown sausages for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, then remove.
Slice mushrooms and tomato, then sauté mushrooms in remaining fat for 3 minutes and set aside.
Add halved tomato to skillet and cook cut-side down for 2 minutes until softened.
Warm baked beans in a small pot on low heat.
Fry eggs to desired doneness in the skillet, about 3-4 minutes.
Arrange bacon, sausages, eggs, mushrooms, tomato, and beans on a plate and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand bacon and sausages instead of premium brands.
Use canned mushrooms if fresh are expensive.

recipes.name: Bacon and Cabbage
recipes.description: Irish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces and place in a large pot with 6 cups water; bring to boil for 5 minutes to reduce saltiness.
Drain and rinse the bacon, return to pot with fresh water, add bay leaf, and simmer 20 minutes.
Add peeled, cubed potatoes and diced onion; simmer 10 minutes.
Cut cabbage into thick wedges and add to pot, pushing down into liquid.
Simmer 10 minutes until cabbage is tender and potatoes are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper, stir in butter, and serve in bowls with broth.
cheapTips: Buy bacon ends and pieces instead of rashers for significant savings.
Choose pre-cut cabbage from grocery store if time is limited but budget allows.

recipes.name: Seafood Chowder
recipes.description: Irish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot and sauté diced onion and celery until softened, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir constantly for 1 minute to make a roux.
Pour in fish stock and add diced potatoes; bring to boil and simmer 10 minutes until potatoes are nearly tender.
Cut fish into bite-sized pieces and add to pot along with shrimp; simmer 5 minutes until seafood is cooked through.
Stir in heavy cream and warm through without boiling, about 2 minutes.
Season generously with salt and white pepper, then serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp and fish fillets instead of fresh for lower cost.
Substitute half the cream with whole milk to reduce expenses.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon and Brown Bread
recipes.description: Irish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Stir in buttermilk until a shaggy dough forms; do not overmix.
Shape dough into a round loaf on the baking sheet and score a cross on top with a knife.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden and bread sounds hollow when tapped.
Cool slightly, slice, and toast lightly; spread with butter and cream cheese.
Top with smoked salmon and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Make the bread the night before to save morning prep time.
Buy smoked salmon from the deli counter instead of pre-packaged for better value.

recipes.name: Oysters Kilpatrick
recipes.description: Irish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat broiler to high heat.
Shuck oysters carefully, keeping them in the bottom shell, and arrange on a baking sheet.
Cook bacon in a skillet until crispy, then chop finely and set aside.
In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté minced onion until softened, about 2 minutes.
Mix cooked bacon, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper together.
Top each oyster with a spoonful of the bacon mixture.
Broil for 3-4 minutes until topping is golden and oysters are warmed through.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy oysters from a seafood counter on sale days or end-of-week discounts.
Use panko breadcrumbs instead of fresh breadcrumbs for texture at the same price.

recipes.name: Dublin Lawyer
recipes.description: Irish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook lobster tails for 10 minutes until cooked through; drain and cool slightly.
Remove meat from shells and cut into 1-inch chunks.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add lobster pieces and cook for 1 minute just to warm through, then carefully add whiskey and ignite with a long lighter; let flames subside.
Reduce heat to medium and stir in remaining 2 tablespoons butter and heavy cream.
Simmer for 2 minutes, then season with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Divide between two plates and garnish with fresh parsley; serve immediately.
cheapTips: Watch for sales on lobster tails in grocery stores or buy at end of day.
Use a less expensive Irish whiskey blend rather than premium single malt.

recipes.name: Colcannon Cakes
recipes.description: Irish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cube potatoes, then boil in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Mash potatoes with 2 tablespoons butter and milk until smooth.
Sauté chopped cabbage in 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes until softened; stir in chopped green onions.
Mix cooked cabbage into mashed potatoes, season with salt and pepper, and let cool for 5 minutes.
Shape potato-cabbage mixture into 6 patties about 1 inch thick.
Dust each patty lightly with flour on both sides.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry cakes for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Make a double batch and freeze unbaked patties for quick future snacks.
Use vegetable oil instead of butter for frying to reduce costs.

recipes.name: Coddle Soup
recipes.description: Irish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces and slice sausages into 1-inch thick rounds.
Peel and cube potatoes and slice onions into thin rings.
In a large pot, arrange half the potatoes and onions in a layer.
Add bacon, sausages, bay leaf, and remaining potatoes and onions in layers.
Pour stock over everything and bring to a boil; reduce to simmer and cook uncovered for 30 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and stir in fresh parsley.
Serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy bacon ends and pieces and lower-cost sausages from store brands.
Use water with bouillon cubes instead of prepared stock to save money.

recipes.name: Hangtown Fry
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, then remove and chop into bite-sized pieces.
Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of bacon fat from the skillet and sauté diced onion until softened.
Drain oysters and add them to the pan with the onion, cooking for 1 minute until heated through.
Whisk eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper, then pour into the skillet over the oyster mixture.
Stir gently with a spatula, scrambling the eggs until they begin to set, about 2 minutes.
Add chopped bacon back to the pan and continue scrambling until eggs are just cooked through.
Remove from heat, sprinkle with parmesan cheese, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use canned oysters instead of fresh to reduce cost significantly.
Buy bacon on sale and freeze for later use.

recipes.name: Green Goddess Salad
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Blend basil, parsley, mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice, garlic, and anchovies in a food processor until smooth.
Season the dressing with salt and pepper to taste.
Arrange chopped romaine lettuce in a large bowl.
Top with sliced chicken breast and avocado.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss until everything is coated.
cheapTips: Use rotisserie chicken from the grocery store to save time and money.
Skip anchovies if budget is tight—the salad is still delicious.

recipes.name: Crab Louis
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together mayonnaise, ketchup, lemon juice, and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl to make the Louis dressing.
Season the dressing with salt and pepper.
Arrange chopped lettuce on two plates as the base.
Gently toss crab meat with half of the dressing and mound it in the center of each plate.
Arrange hard-boiled eggs, tomatoes, and cucumber slices around the crab.
Drizzle remaining dressing around the plate and garnish with green onion.
cheapTips: Use canned crab meat instead of fresh to save money without sacrificing much flavor.
Buy eggs on sale and boil a batch for the week.

recipes.name: Joe's Special
recipes.description: Italian-American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and garlic, cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in chopped spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Whisk eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper, then pour into the skillet.
Scramble everything together until eggs are just cooked through, about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, sprinkle with parmesan cheese, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk and freeze portions for later use.
Use frozen spinach instead of fresh to save money.

recipes.name: San Francisco Treat (Rice-A-Roni)
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the rice-a-roni pasta mix and toast it, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes until lightly browned.
Pour in the chicken broth and water, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover with a lid.
Simmer for about 17 minutes until the rice is nearly tender.
Stir in frozen peas and carrots and cook uncovered for 3 more minutes until vegetables are heated through.
Remove from heat, season with salt and pepper, and let stand 1 minute before serving.
cheapTips: Watch for sales on Rice-A-Roni boxes and buy in bulk.
Use homemade or store-brand broth instead of name-brand.

recipes.name: Petrale Sole Meuniere
recipes.description: French dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat the fish fillets dry with paper towels.
Mix flour with salt and pepper on a shallow plate.
Lightly dredge each fillet in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a skillet over medium-high heat until foaming.
Cook the fillets for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, then transfer to a plate.
Add remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the pan and cook until it turns golden brown, about 2 minutes.
Pour the brown butter and lemon juice over the fish and garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen sole fillets instead of fresh to save 20-30%.
Buy butter when on sale and store in the freezer.

recipes.name: Oysters Kirkpatrick
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Cook bacon in a skillet until crispy, then chop and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté minced onion and bell pepper in butter until softened, about 3 minutes.
Shuck the oysters, keeping them in their bottom shell, and arrange on a baking sheet.
Top each oyster with a portion of the pepper-onion mixture and crumbled bacon.
Sprinkle parmesan cheese over each oyster.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until the edges of the oysters curl slightly and the cheese browns.
cheapTips: Ask the fishmonger to shuck the oysters for you to save time and avoid frustration.
Look for oyster sales on Monday or Tuesday at seafood counters.

recipes.name: Sweetbread Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak sweetbreads in cold water for 2 hours, then blanch in simmering salted water for 15 minutes.
Remove sweetbreads and let cool, then trim away any membranes and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Beat the egg in a shallow bowl, place flour in another shallow bowl.
Dredge sweetbread pieces in flour, then dip in beaten egg, then dredge in flour again.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and fry the breaded sweetbreads until golden on all sides, about 5 minutes total.
Toast the bread slices lightly in the same skillet.
Assemble sandwiches with mayonnaise, lettuce, and the warm sweetbreads, then serve immediately with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Ask the butcher to special order sweetbreads at a lower price if buying in bulk.
Use store-brand bread instead of artisanal to save money.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Pho
recipes.description: Vietnamese lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast star anise, cinnamon, cloves, and coriander seeds in a dry skillet for 1 minute until fragrant.
Char the onion and ginger over a flame or under the broiler for 3 minutes until blackened.
Bring beef broth to a boil in a large pot and add the toasted spices, charred onion, and ginger.
Add the beef chuck and simmer for 1 hour, then strain the broth and season with fish sauce, salt, and pepper.
Cook rice noodles according to package directions, then divide among four bowls.
Pour the hot broth over the noodles and top with thin-sliced raw beef, which will cook from the heat.
Serve with fresh basil, lime wedges, bean sprouts, and sliced jalapeño on the side.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for later, as it's often discounted.
Make broth in a slow cooker overnight to reduce energy costs.

recipes.name: Garlic Noodles
recipes.description: Asian-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook egg noodles according to package directions, drain, and set aside.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
Return noodles to the pan and toss with the garlic butter.
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil, stirring until noodles are well coated.
Cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until heated through.
Remove from heat and stir in green onion and sesame seeds, then serve with red pepper flakes if desired.
cheapTips: Buy garlic in bulk when on sale and store in the pantry.
Use store-brand soy sauce and oyster sauce to save money.

recipes.name: Empire Biscuit
recipes.description: Scottish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg and vanilla extract until well combined.
Fold in flour until dough forms, then chill for 15 minutes.
Roll dough between parchment paper to 0.25 inch thickness and cut into 24 circles with a 2-inch cutter.
Bake at 350°F for 12-15 minutes until lightly golden, then cool completely.
Sandwich pairs of biscuits together with jam in the center.
Mix powdered sugar with milk to form icing and spread over the top of each sandwich.
Let icing set for 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand butter and jam to cut costs
Make your own powdered sugar by blending regular sugar

recipes.name: Atholl Brose
recipes.description: Scottish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast oats in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3-4 minutes until fragrant, stirring occasionally.
Transfer toasted oats to a bowl and let cool slightly.
Whip heavy cream until soft peaks form.
Fold honey and whiskey into the whipped cream until just combined.
Gently fold in toasted oats and a pinch of salt.
Divide into serving glasses and chill until ready to serve.
cheapTips: Buy large oats in bulk from the natural foods section
Use affordable blended whiskey or skip for non-alcoholic version

recipes.name: Scottish Tablet
recipes.description: Scottish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Line an 8x8 inch baking pan with parchment paper.
Combine sugar, condensed milk, and butter in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat.
Stir constantly until mixture reaches 236°F on a candy thermometer (soft-ball stage), about 15-20 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in salt and vanilla extract.
Beat vigorously with a wooden spoon for 2-3 minutes until mixture thickens and loses its glossy appearance.
Pour into prepared pan and let cool at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Cut into 16 squares while still slightly warm.
Store in an airtight container between parchment layers.
cheapTips: Buy condensed milk on sale and stock up
Make in bulk and freeze for up to 2 months

recipes.name: Oatcakes
recipes.description: Scottish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix oats and salt together in a bowl.
Melt butter in hot water and pour over oat mixture, stirring until combined.
Let cool slightly, then knead with your hands until dough forms.
Place dough between two sheets of parchment paper and roll to 0.25 inch thickness.
Cut into rectangles or squares using a knife.
Place on a baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 15-18 minutes until lightly golden.
Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
cheapTips: Buy bulk rolled oats in 5-pound bags
Make a large batch and freeze for easy breakfasts

recipes.name: Porridge
recipes.description: Scottish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a saucepan.
Slowly stir in oats while bringing back to a boil to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent sticking.
Add milk and butter, stirring until smooth and creamy.
Cook for 2 more minutes until desired consistency is reached.
Serve in bowls drizzled with honey.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand rolled oats in bulk
Skip the milk and butter for a dairy-free, vegan version

recipes.name: Neeps and Tatties
recipes.description: Scottish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and cut rutabaga and potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Place rutabaga in a pot of cold salted water and bring to a boil.
After 10 minutes, add potato cubes to the same pot.
Boil together for 15-20 minutes until both vegetables are very tender.
Drain well in a colander, reserving some cooking water.
Return to pot and mash with butter, adding reserved cooking water as needed for desired consistency.
Season generously with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Transfer to a serving dish and top with a pat of butter.
cheapTips: Buy rutabagas and potatoes in 5-lb bags when on sale
Use less butter and substitute with olive oil to save money

recipes.name: Scots Broth
recipes.description: Scottish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut beef into bite-sized chunks and brown in a large pot over medium-high heat for 5 minutes.
Add beef broth and bring to a simmer, then add barley and simmer for 20 minutes.
Chop carrots, celery, onion, and potato into small dice.
Add diced vegetables and cabbage to the pot and simmer for 25-30 minutes until vegetables and meat are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Use budget beef cuts like chuck or round steak
Buy vegetables on sale and freeze extras for later

recipes.name: Portuguese Bean Soup
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic for 3 minutes.
Add diced carrot and diced sweet potato, cooking for 5 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add kidney beans with their liquid and reduce heat to medium-low.
Simmer uncovered for 25-30 minutes until vegetables are very tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in bowls, optionally with a drizzle of olive oil and fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy canned beans in bulk when on sale
Use store-brand beans to cut costs in half

recipes.name: Chicken Katsu
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound to 0.5 inch thickness using a meat mallet.
Set up three shallow bowls with flour, beaten egg, and panko respectively.
Season chicken with salt and pepper, then coat in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip in egg, then coat thoroughly in panko, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat oil in a large skillet to 350°F and fry chicken for 5-6 minutes per side until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain briefly.
Slice chicken into strips and serve over rice drizzled with tonkatsu sauce.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts on sale and freeze for later
Make your own tonkatsu sauce with ketchup, Worcestershire, and soy sauce

recipes.name: Macaroni Salad
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook elbow macaroni according to package directions, then drain and rinse with cold water until cooled.
Finely dice carrot and celery into small pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, sugar, and rice vinegar.
Add cooled macaroni, diced carrot, and diced celery to the dressing.
Toss gently until all ingredients are evenly coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
cheapTips: Use store-brand mayo and save 50% on this dish
Make ahead and keep refrigerated for up to 3 days

recipes.name: Boxty Pancakes
recipes.description: Irish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Squeeze excess moisture from grated potatoes using paper towels.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk egg and milk together, then combine with mashed potatoes and grated potatoes.
Fold wet mixture into dry ingredients until just combined.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Drop spoonfuls of batter onto the skillet, flattening slightly into pancake shapes.
Cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Serve warm with butter and jam or sour cream.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk and grate fresh rather than buying frozen.
Use basic all-purpose flour instead of specialty flours.

recipes.name: Wheaten Bread
recipes.description: Irish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Mix whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
Rub butter into the flour mixture until breadcrumbs form.
Add buttermilk gradually, stirring until a soft dough forms.
Knead dough briefly on a floured surface, then shape into a round loaf.
Place on a baking sheet and score the top with a cross using a knife.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown and hollow-sounding when tapped.
cheapTips: Buy bulk whole wheat and all-purpose flour to reduce costs.
Buttermilk can be substituted with milk mixed with vinegar or lemon juice.

recipes.name: Pints and Oysters
recipes.description: Irish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pack a serving platter with crushed ice.
Scrub oyster shells clean under cold running water.
Using an oyster knife, carefully insert blade into the hinge and twist to open shells.
Detach oysters from shells and drain excess liquid.
Arrange opened oysters on the ice platter.
Mix lemon juice and hot sauce in a small bowl for serving.
Serve oysters with lemon mixture, oyster crackers, and cold Guinness pints.
cheapTips: Buy oysters directly from seafood markets rather than restaurants.
Use cheaper beer alternatives if budget is tight; the pairing is what matters.

recipes.name: Rasher Sandwich
recipes.description: Irish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon rashers in a skillet over medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side until crispy.
Toast bread slices until golden brown.
Spread butter and mayonnaise on toasted bread.
Layer lettuce and tomato slices on bread.
Place 2 cooked bacon rashers on each sandwich.
Top with remaining bread slice and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy bacon in bulk and freeze; Irish rashers are back bacon, cheaper than regular strips.
Use store-brand bread and condiments to reduce costs.

recipes.name: Guinness Stew
recipes.description: Irish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown beef chunks in batches, about 3-4 minutes per side; set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in the same pot for 2 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in Guinness and beef broth, scraping up browned bits from the bottom.
Return beef to pot, add thyme, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 45 minutes, then add potatoes and carrots.
Simmer uncovered for another 30-40 minutes until vegetables are tender and beef is falling apart.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for later use.
Use less expensive root vegetables like turnips or parsnips.

recipes.name: Bagels
recipes.description: Montreal Jewish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flours, yeast, and salt in a large bowl.
Add honey and water, stirring until a stiff dough forms.
Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes until puffy.
Divide dough into 6 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
Poke a hole in the center of each ball and stretch into a bagel shape with a 2-inch hole.
Place bagels on parchment paper and let rise for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°F and bring a large pot of water to boil.
Boil bagels for 1-2 minutes per side until they float and rise slightly.
Place on a baking sheet, brush with beaten egg, sprinkle seeds, and bake for 20-25 minutes until golden.
cheapTips: Make a large batch and freeze; reheat in toaster oven.
Buy seeds in bulk from ethnic markets for significant savings.

recipes.name: Smoked Meat Sandwich
recipes.description: Montreal Jewish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: If buying pre-sliced smoked meat from a deli, ask them to pile it high on the slicer.
Lightly butter rye bread slices on the outside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and lightly toast the buttered bread until golden.
Quickly warm the smoked meat in the same skillet, stirring gently for 1-2 minutes.
Spread yellow mustard on the toasted bread.
Layer warm smoked meat generously on one slice of bread.
Top with the second slice and serve immediately with pickles on the side.
cheapTips: Buy smoked meat from a deli counter rather than pre-packaged slices.
Make your own pickles or buy store-brand to save money.

recipes.name: Tourtière
recipes.description: Québécois dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Brown pork and beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up meat as it cooks.
Add onion and garlic; cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in potatoes, beef broth, cinnamon, cloves, salt, and pepper.
Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender and liquid reduces by half.
Cool filling to room temperature, about 10 minutes.
Place one pie crust in a 9-inch pie dish.
Pour cooled meat filling into the crust.
Top with second pie crust, seal edges, and brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until crust is golden brown and filling is hot.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pie crusts to save time and money.
Buy ground meat on sale and freeze for later use.

recipes.name: Cipâte
recipes.description: Québécois dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, salt, and baking powder together.
Cut cold butter into flour mixture until breadcrumbs form.
Add water gradually, mixing until a shaggy dough forms; set aside.
Brown pork cubes in a large pot over medium-high heat for 5 minutes per side.
Add onion and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a simmer.
Add potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
On a floured surface, roll out dough to 0.25-inch thickness and cut into 2-inch pieces.
Drop dough pieces into the simmering stew and stir gently.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until dough is cooked through and meat is tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use pork shoulder or butt; it's cheaper than premium cuts and becomes tender when simmered.
Make double and freeze for easy weeknight dinners.

recipes.name: Creton
recipes.description: Québécois breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown ground pork, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add diced onion and garlic; cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in breadcrumbs, salt, pepper, and sage.
Add water and reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture is very thick and liquid has evaporated.
Cool completely on a plate; it will solidify as it cools.
Serve at room temperature or reheated, spread on toast or bread.
cheapTips: Buy pork shoulder or butt and grind it yourself, or ask the butcher to do it for free.
Use crushed saltine crackers instead of breadcrumbs for a chunkier texture.

recipes.name: Two Scoop Rice
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook rice ahead of time and let it cool completely.
Dice the onion into small pieces.
Heat butter in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Scramble the eggs in the skillet and remove to a plate.
Add diced onion to the same skillet and cook until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooled rice and break up any clumps while stirring constantly for 3-4 minutes.
Pour soy sauce over the rice and mix well, then return eggs to the skillet.
Toss everything together and season with salt and pepper, then top with chopped green onions.
cheapTips: Use day-old rice for better texture and lower cost
Buy eggs in bulk for cheapest per-unit price

recipes.name: Pipikaula
recipes.description: Hawaiian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice beef sirloin against the grain into thin strips about 1/4 inch thick.
Combine soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, ginger, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Toss beef strips with the marinade until evenly coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight for best flavor.
Preheat oven to 180°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Arrange marinated beef strips on the baking sheet in a single layer without overlapping.
Bake for 5-6 hours until beef is dried but still slightly chewy.
Cool completely before serving as a snack or storing in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Buy beef when on sale and freeze until needed
Make large batches and store in mason jars for weeks

recipes.name: Chicken Hekka
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized cubes.
Chop cabbage and onion into large chunks.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add cabbage and onion, stirring frequently for 3-4 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce, sugar, and water, then simmer for 8-10 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Adjust seasoning to taste and serve hot over rice.
cheapTips: Buy chicken in bulk when on sale and freeze portions
Use day-old cabbage from produce sales section

recipes.name: Fried Noodles
recipes.description: Hawaiian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook chow mein noodles according to package directions, then drain and set aside.
Beat eggs in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble until cooked, then remove to a plate.
Add garlic, carrots, and onion to the same skillet and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add cooked noodles and toss constantly to prevent sticking.
Return cooked eggs to the skillet, pour in soy sauce, and toss everything together for 1-2 minutes.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy chow mein noodles in bulk at Asian markets for half the price
Use eggs as affordable protein

recipes.name: Classic Poutine
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thick fries about 1/4 inch wide.
Soak fries in cold water for 30 minutes to remove excess starch.
Make gravy by heating beef broth in a saucepan over medium heat.
Mix cornstarch and water together, then whisk into hot broth and simmer until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Heat oil to 325°F in a deep pot or fryer.
Drain potatoes and pat dry, then fry in batches until golden and crispy, about 5-7 minutes per batch.
Drain fries on paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Place hot fries in a container, top with cheese curds, then pour hot gravy over everything and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in 10-lb bags for better unit cost
Use store-brand cheese curds instead of specialty brands

recipes.name: Poutine Italienne
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into fries and soak in cold water for 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a skillet and brown ground beef with garlic over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 2 minutes.
Stir in tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes to blend flavors.
Heat frying oil to 325°F.
Drain and pat dry potatoes, then fry in batches until golden and crispy.
Drain fries on paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Layer hot fries in a serving container, top with cheese curds, then pour meat sauce over everything.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze in portions
Use budget tomato sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Poutine Gâté
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into fries and soak in cold water for 30 minutes.
Dice chicken breast into small cubes.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a skillet and cook chicken over medium heat until golden, about 6 minutes.
Add diced onion and sliced mushrooms, cooking until soft, about 4 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and simmer for 5 minutes to create a light gravy.
Heat frying oil to 325°F.
Drain potatoes and fry in batches until golden and crispy.
Layer hot fries in a container, top with cheese curds, then pour chicken gravy over everything.
cheapTips: Buy chicken when on sale and portion into freezer bags
Use button mushrooms instead of specialty varieties

recipes.name: Poutine Aurore
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into fries and soak in cold water for 30 minutes.
Combine beef broth and tomato sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Mix cornstarch with water and whisk into the sauce until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Simmer the pink gravy for 2 more minutes.
Heat frying oil to 325°F.
Drain potatoes and pat dry, then fry in batches until golden and crispy.
Drain fries on paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Layer hot fries in a container, top with cheese curds, then pour pink gravy over everything.
cheapTips: Make gravy in bulk and refrigerate for up to 3 days
Buy broth on sale and stock your pantry

recipes.name: Poutine BBQ
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into fries and soak in cold water for 30 minutes.
Heat beef broth and barbecue sauce together in a saucepan over medium heat.
Mix cornstarch with water and whisk into the sauce, simmering until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Heat frying oil to 325°F.
Drain potatoes and pat dry, then fry in batches until golden and crispy.
Drain fries on paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Layer hot fries in a container, top with cheese curds, then pour BBQ gravy over everything.
Serve immediately while gravy is hot.
cheapTips: Use store-brand BBQ sauce instead of name brands
Buy potatoes in bulk to reduce fry cost

recipes.name: Poutine Complet
recipes.description: Quebec lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into fries and soak in cold water for 30 minutes.
Brown ground beef with diced onion in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking apart meat as it cooks.
Slice hot dogs and add to the beef, cooking for 2 more minutes.
Heat beef broth in a separate saucepan and stir in the meat mixture.
Mix cornstarch with water and whisk into the gravy until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Heat frying oil to 325°F.
Drain potatoes and pat dry, then fry in batches until golden and crispy.
Layer hot fries in a serving container, top with cheese curds and meat, then pour hot gravy over everything.
cheapTips: Buy hot dogs on sale and freeze for later use
Ground beef in bulk is more economical than small packages

recipes.name: Montreal-Style Bagel
recipes.description: Montreal Jewish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine warm water, honey, and yeast in a bowl and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix in flour, salt, and oil until a stiff dough forms, then knead by hand for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball, then poke a hole in the center and stretch into a bagel shape with a 2-inch hole.
Place bagels on a parchment-lined baking sheet, cover with a damp towel, and let rise for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Preheat oven to 425°F and bring a large pot of water to boil with 2 tablespoons honey added.
Boil bagels 1-2 minutes per side until they float and rise again, then remove with a slotted spoon.
Place boiled bagels on a baking sheet, brush with water, and sprinkle with sesame or poppy seeds.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown and crispy on the outside.
cheapTips: Buy flour and yeast in bulk to reduce per-batch costs
Use whatever seeds you have on hand or skip them entirely

recipes.name: Lox and Cream Cheese Bagel
recipes.description: Montreal Jewish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice bagels in half horizontally and toast until lightly golden.
Spread 2-3 tablespoons of cream cheese on each bagel half.
Layer 1 ounce of lox on top of the cream cheese.
Sprinkle red onion slices, capers, and fresh dill over the lox.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy lox from the deli counter by weight rather than pre-packaged
Use regular smoked salmon if lox is unavailable or too expensive

recipes.name: Chicken Rotis
recipes.description: Indo-Caribbean lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make roti dough by mixing flour, salt, 1 tablespoon oil, and water until soft, then knead for 5 minutes and let rest for 30 minutes.
Dice chicken, potatoes, onions, and mince garlic and ginger while dough rests.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large pot and sauté onions, garlic, and ginger for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute, then add diced chicken and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Add diced potatoes, salt to taste, and 0.5 cup water, then simmer for 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Divide roti dough into 8 balls and roll each flat into a thin circle on a floured surface.
Heat a cast iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and cook each roti for 1-2 minutes per side until light brown spots appear.
Wrap finished rotis in a clean kitchen towel to keep warm, then serve filled with chicken curry and fresh cilantro.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breasts for more flavor and less cost
Make a large batch of rotis and freeze extras for quick future meals

recipes.name: Perogies
recipes.description: Eastern European dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make dough by mixing flour, egg, 0.25 cup sour cream, and salt until a soft dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes and rest for 30 minutes covered.
Boil potatoes until very tender, then mash with 0.25 cup sour cream, salt, and shredded cheddar cheese until smooth.
Roll dough thin on a floured surface and cut out 3-inch circles using a cup or cookie cutter.
Place 1 tablespoon filling on each dough circle, fold in half, and pinch edges tightly to seal.
Boil salted water in a large pot and cook perogies in batches for 3-4 minutes after they float to the surface.
Remove cooked perogies with a slotted spoon and place on a serving platter.
Dice onions and cook bacon until crispy, then sauté diced onions in bacon fat until golden brown.
Toss cooked perogies with butter and top with crispy bacon and caramelized onions before serving.
cheapTips: Make perogies in large batches and freeze uncooked for easy future meals
Use russet potatoes which are cheaper and fluffier when mashed

recipes.name: Montreal-Style Hot Dog
recipes.description: Montreal snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice onion finely into small pieces.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet and fry diced onion for 3-4 minutes until golden and slightly caramelized.
Boil or pan-fry hot dogs until heated through and lightly browned on the outside.
Warm hot dog buns lightly in the same skillet or toaster.
Place cooked hot dog in warm bun and apply a thin line of mustard down the center.
Top with warm chili and fried onions, then sprinkle with paprika and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy hot dogs on sale in bulk and freeze for later
Make your own chili ahead of time instead of buying canned

recipes.name: Smoked Haddock
recipes.description: Scottish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk in a shallow pan and gently place haddock fillets in the milk.
Simmer over medium-low heat for 8-10 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
While fish cooks, melt 1 tablespoon butter in a separate pan and fry eggs sunny-side up or to your preference.
Toast bread slices until golden brown and butter with remaining 1 tablespoon butter.
Carefully remove cooked haddock from milk using a spatula and place on a serving plate.
Place fried eggs and buttered toast on the plate alongside the haddock, season fish with black pepper and a pinch of salt, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Check for sales at seafood counters or buy frozen smoked haddock
Use any mild white fish as a substitute if haddock is unavailable

recipes.name: Stovies
recipes.description: Scottish lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and slice potatoes into 0.25-inch thick slices.
Slice onions into thin rings and cut corned beef into bite-sized chunks.
Melt butter in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Layer half the potatoes in the pot, then add all the corned beef and sliced onions, then top with remaining potatoes.
Pour beef broth over everything, add salt, pepper, and thyme sprigs, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover pot with a lid and cook for 30-35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are very tender.
Remove thyme sprigs, adjust seasoning to taste, and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Use canned corned beef which is cheaper than deli counter versions
Buy potatoes and onions in bulk when on sale

recipes.name: Tablet
recipes.description: Scottish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine condensed milk, butter, and brown sugar in a heavy-bottomed saucepan and stir constantly over medium heat.
Continue stirring to prevent burning as the mixture heats and thickens, about 10-12 minutes, until it reaches soft ball stage (240°F on a candy thermometer).
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract and salt.
Let mixture cool for 2-3 minutes, then beat vigorously with a wooden spoon for 5-7 minutes until it becomes grainy and thickens.
Pour quickly onto a buttered baking sheet and spread into a 0.5-inch thick layer.
Cool completely at room temperature for 30 minutes, then cut into 1-inch squares with a buttered knife and store in an airtight container.
cheapTips: Buy condensed milk on sale and stock up
Use store-brand butter and sugar to reduce costs

recipes.name: Shortbread
recipes.description: Scottish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Cream together butter and sugar in a bowl until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Mix in flour and salt until a stiff dough forms and no flour remains visible.
Press dough evenly into an ungreased 8x8 inch baking pan, smoothing the top with your hands.
Prick the surface all over with a fork in a decorative pattern.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown at the edges but still pale in the center.
Remove from oven and cut into 12 squares while still warm, then cool completely in the pan before serving.
cheapTips: Make large batches and freeze extras for weeks of snacks
Use salted butter to reduce added salt if preferred

recipes.name: Edinburgh Rock
recipes.description: Scottish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Combine sugar, water, and cream of tartar in a heavy saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Stop stirring once boiling and clip a candy thermometer to the pan, cooking until it reaches 250°F (hard ball stage), about 15-20 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in butter, food coloring, and flavoring extract until combined.
Pour onto a buttered baking sheet and let cool for 10-15 minutes until it can be handled.
Break cooled candy into small chunks and place in a food processor with powdered sugar and cornstarch.
Pulse until the mixture becomes fine and powdery, resembling rock candy, then sift through a fine mesh strainer.
Store in an airtight container for several weeks, dusting off excess powder before eating.
cheapTips: Use basic food coloring and inexpensive flavoring extracts
Make large batches to take advantage of ingredient bulk costs

recipes.name: Poutine Hot Chicken
recipes.description: Quebec lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into strips and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix flour, cayenne pepper, paprika, salt, and black pepper in a shallow bowl.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or Dutch oven.
Coat chicken strips in seasoned flour and fry for 6-7 minutes until golden and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken and drain on paper towels.
Fry frozen fries according to package directions until crispy.
Warm gravy in a saucepan over medium heat.
Layer fries on a plate, top with fried chicken strips, cheese curds, and hot gravy.
Serve immediately while everything is hot.
cheapTips: Buy chicken on sale and freeze; use store-brand fries and gravy to save 30%
Make gravy from scratch with beef broth instead of buying prepared

recipes.name: Poutine Spaghetti
recipes.description: Quebec dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain and set aside.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry frozen fries until crispy; drain on paper towels.
Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to beef and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in marinara sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toss cooked spaghetti with the meat sauce.
Layer fries on a plate, top with spaghetti and meat sauce mixture, then add cheese curds and parmesan.
Serve immediately while fries are still warm and crispy.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk when on sale and freeze in portions
Use store-brand marinara sauce instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Poutine Steak
recipes.description: Quebec lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove steak from refrigerator 15 minutes before cooking and pat dry.
Season steak generously with salt, pepper, and garlic powder on both sides.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot for frying fries.
Heat butter in a cast iron skillet over high heat until foaming.
Sear steak 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare (internal temp 135°F); let rest 5 minutes then slice against the grain.
Fry frozen fries until golden and crispy.
Warm beef gravy in a saucepan over medium heat.
Layer fries on a plate, top with sliced steak, cheese curds, and hot gravy.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use round steak or chuck instead of sirloin to reduce cost
Buy steak on markdown near closing time or buy in bulk and freeze

recipes.name: Poutine Râpée
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and finely grate potatoes; place in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out excess moisture over a bowl.
Brown ground meat with diced onion in a skillet over medium-high heat; drain and cool slightly.
Mix grated potatoes with flour, salt, and pepper until combined.
Form a small ball of potato mixture, make an indent, fill with a spoonful of cooked meat mixture, and seal into a ball about 2.5 inches in diameter.
Heat oil to 325°F in a deep pot or Dutch oven.
Carefully place potato balls in hot oil and fry 6-8 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot, optionally with gravy or sour cream for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy potatoes in bulk bags; ground meat on sale and freeze
Make multiple batches at once and freeze uncooked for later frying

recipes.name: Poutine Hamburger
recipes.description: Quebec lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot for frying fries.
Form ground beef into two patties, season with salt and pepper.
Cook patties in a skillet over medium-high heat, 3-4 minutes per side for medium doneness.
Top each patty with a cheese slice and cover to melt, about 1 minute.
Fry frozen fries until golden and crispy.
Toast hamburger buns lightly in a skillet or toaster.
Warm beef gravy in a saucepan.
Assemble burgers with lettuce, tomato, and cooked patty on toasted buns.
On a separate plate, layer fries, top with cheese curds and hot gravy; serve alongside burger.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale in bulk and portion for freezing
Use store-brand cheese and buns to cut costs

recipes.name: Poutine Fromage
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot.
Fry frozen fries until golden and crispy; drain on paper towels.
In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat and stir in white gravy or cream sauce.
Add shredded cheddar cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Season cheese sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Place fried fries on a plate and top with cheese curds.
Pour hot cheese sauce over fries and cheese curds.
Serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Make white sauce from scratch with flour, butter, and milk instead of buying premade
Use regular shredded cheddar instead of premium aged cheese

recipes.name: Poutine Tomate
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot.
Minced garlic and sauté briefly in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add tomato sauce, oregano, salt, and pepper; simmer for 5 minutes.
Fry frozen fries until golden and crispy; drain on paper towels.
Layer fries on a plate and top with cheese curds.
Pour warm tomato sauce over fries and cheese curds.
Sprinkle with parmesan cheese.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand tomato sauce in bulk; omit parmesan for fully vegan version
Buy fries in bulk warehouse stores

recipes.name: Poutine Végétarienne
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot for frying.
Dice mushrooms, bell pepper, onion, and mince garlic.
Sauté vegetables in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes until softened.
Pour vegetable gravy into the skillet and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fry frozen fries until golden and crispy.
Layer fries on a plate and top with cheese curds.
Pour vegetable gravy and sautéed vegetables over the poutine.
Serve hot immediately.
cheapTips: Buy vegetables on sale or use frozen bell peppers and onions
Make vegetable gravy from vegetable broth and cornstarch instead of buying packaged

recipes.name: Poutine Volaille
recipes.description: Quebec lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breast into cubes or strips and season with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken until golden, about 8 minutes; remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, sprinkle flour and stir constantly for 1 minute.
Pour chicken broth slowly while stirring to create a smooth gravy; add thyme and simmer 5 minutes.
Return chicken to the gravy and keep warm on low heat.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry frozen fries until crispy.
Layer fries on a plate, top with cheese curds and chicken pieces.
Pour hot chicken gravy over everything.
Serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast on sale in bulk and freeze in portions
Use store-brand chicken broth in bulk

recipes.name: Poutine Surf and Turf
recipes.description: Quebec dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat steak and shrimp dry; season steak with salt and pepper.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot for frying fries.
Heat 1.5 tbsp butter in a skillet over high heat; sear steak 4 minutes per side for medium-rare; rest 5 minutes then slice.
In the same skillet, melt remaining butter and cook minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add shrimp, season with salt and pepper, and cook 2-3 minutes per side until pink; squeeze lemon juice over.
Fry frozen fries until golden and crispy.
Warm beef gravy in a saucepan.
Layer fries on a plate, top with cheese curds, sliced steak, and shrimp.
Drizzle hot beef gravy over everything and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy shrimp frozen in bulk when on sale; thaw before cooking
Use round steak instead of sirloin to reduce cost slightly

recipes.name: Poutine Tartare
recipes.description: Quebec lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry potatoes in batches until golden, about 8 minutes per batch, and set on paper towels.
Mix ground beef with minced onion, parsley, egg yolk, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper.
Form beef mixture into a patty and finely chop or mince it with a knife to create tartare texture.
Whisk gravy powder with water over medium heat until smooth and thickened, about 3 minutes.
Place hot fries on a plate, top with raw beef tartare, then pour hot gravy over everything and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze; use gravy powder instead of making gravy from scratch
Use store-brand vegetable oil and potatoes in bulk

recipes.name: Poutine Mille-Îles
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry potatoes in batches until golden and crispy, about 8 minutes per batch.
Whisk gravy powder with water over medium heat until smooth and thickened, about 3 minutes.
Place hot fries on a plate and sprinkle with cheese curds while fries are still hot.
Pour hot gravy over the fries and cheese curds.
Drizzle thousand island dressing over top and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use store-brand thousand island dressing and gravy powder
Buy cheese curds when on sale and refrigerate

recipes.name: Poutine Bacon
recipes.description: Quebec lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, about 8 minutes, then chop into pieces.
Cut potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry potatoes in batches until golden and crispy, about 8 minutes per batch.
Whisk gravy powder with water over medium heat until smooth and thickened, about 3 minutes.
Place hot fries on a plate and top with cheese curds while fries are still hot.
Pour hot gravy over the fries and cheese curds, then sprinkle bacon pieces and chives on top and serve.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand cheese curds and gravy powder

recipes.name: Poutine Mer
recipes.description: Quebec lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry potatoes in batches until golden and crispy, about 8 minutes per batch.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat, add minced garlic, then add shrimp and cook until pink, about 5 minutes, season with salt and pepper.
Whisk gravy powder with water over medium heat until smooth and thickened, about 3 minutes.
Place hot fries on a plate and top with cheese curds while fries are still hot.
Pour hot gravy over the fries and cheese curds, then top with cooked shrimp and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp in bulk and thaw as needed
Use store-brand gravy powder and cheese curds

recipes.name: Poutine Montréalaise
recipes.description: Quebec snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry potatoes in batches until golden and crispy, about 8 minutes per batch.
Heat beef gravy over medium heat until warm and pourable, about 3 minutes.
Mix ketchup and mayonnaise together in a small bowl.
Place hot fries on a plate and top with cheese curds while fries are still hot.
Pour hot gravy over the fries and cheese curds, then drizzle with ketchup-mayo mixture and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use canned beef gravy instead of homemade
Buy potatoes and cheese curds in bulk

recipes.name: Poutine Rib
recipes.description: Quebec lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season beef short ribs with salt and pepper, then sear in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add chopped onion and garlic to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add beef broth to the skillet, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes until meat is tender.
Cut potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry potatoes in batches until golden and crispy, about 8 minutes per batch.
Mix gravy powder with 2 tbsp water and stir into the beef rib mixture, simmer for 1 minute.
Place hot fries on a plate and top with cheese curds while fries are still hot.
Pour beef rib mixture with gravy over the fries and cheese curds and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy beef short ribs on sale and freeze
Use store-brand beef broth and gravy powder

recipes.name: Torchy's Tacos Trailer Park
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Roast poblano peppers over a gas flame or under the broiler until charred, then place in a plastic bag for 5 minutes to steam.
Peel off the charred skin from the poblanos, remove the seeds, and slice into strips.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook ground beef with diced onion and minced jalapeño until beef is browned, about 8 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Warm flour tortillas in a dry skillet or over a flame for 20 seconds per side.
Spread sour cream on each tortilla, then add seasoned ground beef, poblano strips, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Top with fresh cilantro, fold or roll, and serve with lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze; use store-brand cheese
Substitute poblanos with bell peppers if poblanos are expensive

recipes.name: Franklin Barbecue Brisket Sandwich
recipes.description: BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Trim fat from brisket, leaving about 0.25 inch, then generously coat all sides with salt and pepper.
Heat a charcoal smoker to 225-250°F and add oak wood chips for smoke.
Place brisket on the smoker with the fat side up and smoke for approximately 10-12 hours until the internal temperature reaches 195°F.
Wrap brisket in foil with butter and beef broth, then continue smoking for another 1-2 hours until very tender.
Remove brisket from smoker and rest for 15 minutes tented with foil.
Slice brisket against the grain into 0.25 inch thick pieces.
Toast bread lightly, layer brisket slices on bread, and top with pickles and onion slices, then serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy brisket when on sale and use a charcoal smoker rather than a gas one for savings
Use store-brand butter and buy sliced bread rather than artisanal

recipes.name: Veracruz All Natural Breakfast Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove chorizo from its casing and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart with a spoon until cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add diced onion and minced serrano pepper to the chorizo and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Whisk eggs together with a pinch of salt, then add to the skillet and scramble until just set, about 2 minutes.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet or over a flame for 20 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with the chorizo and egg mixture, then top with queso fresco and cilantro.
Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.
cheapTips: Buy eggs and chorizo in bulk when on sale
Use store-brand queso fresco or substitute feta cheese

recipes.name: Matt's El Rancho Enchiladas
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Cook ground beef with diced onion and minced garlic in a skillet over medium-high heat until beef is browned, about 8 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Mix sour cream with chicken broth in a small bowl.
Warm enchilada sauce in a shallow bowl over low heat for 2 minutes.
Dip each corn tortilla into the warm enchilada sauce to coat both sides, then fill with seasoned ground beef and 1 tbsp shredded cheddar cheese.
Roll tortillas and place seam-side down in the prepared baking dish, pour remaining enchilada sauce and sour cream mixture over the rolled tortillas.
Sprinkle remaining cheddar cheese over the top and bake for 25-30 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted and lightly browned.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze; use canned enchilada sauce
Buy shredded cheese in bulk and freeze for later

recipes.name: Banger's Sausage Platter
recipes.description: German lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Prick each bratwurst with a fork to prevent bursting.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the sausages on all sides for 8 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add sliced onions and bell peppers and sauté until softened, about 6 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and return sausages to the skillet, simmering for 10 minutes.
Toast bread slices until golden brown.
Spread mustard on each bread slice and top with a sausage and the caramelized onions and peppers.
Serve immediately with extra mustard on the side.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand bratwurst instead of specialty brands
Use day-old bread to reduce cost

recipes.name: Holy Roller Breakfast Taco
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook chorizo in a skillet over medium heat, breaking it apart with a spoon until fully browned, about 5 minutes.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Push chorizo to the side of the skillet and add butter, then scramble the eggs until cooked through, about 4 minutes.
Fill each tortilla with scrambled eggs, chorizo, cheese, and diced tomatoes.
Sprinkle fresh cilantro on top and fold tacos.
Serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Buy chorizo in bulk and freeze portions
Use store-brand tortillas to save money

recipes.name: Tamashii Ramen Bowl
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot and add minced garlic and ginger, simmering for 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil to the broth and stir well.
Slice mushrooms and add to the broth, simmering for 8 minutes.
Boil ramen noodles according to package directions, drain, and divide between two bowls.
Ladle the hot broth and mushrooms over the noodles.
Top each bowl with a soft boiled egg, sliced green onions, and torn nori.
Serve immediately while piping hot.
cheapTips: Use instant ramen packets as a base instead of fresh noodles
Substitute mushrooms with cheaper vegetables like bok choy

recipes.name: Suerte's Barbacoa Taco
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from ancho and guajillo chiles, then toast them in a dry skillet for 1 minute.
Soak toasted chiles in hot water for 10 minutes until softened, then blend with vinegar, cumin, salt, and 1 cup soaking liquid until smooth.
Place beef chuck roast in a slow cooker and pour the chile sauce over it.
Cook on low for 8 hours until meat shreds easily with a fork.
Remove meat and shred using two forks, then return to slow cooker and stir into sauce.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet and fill with shredded barbacoa.
Top with diced onion, cilantro, and fresh lime juice before serving.
cheapTips: Buy chuck roast on sale and freeze ahead of time
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for future meals

recipes.name: The Mighty Cone
recipes.description: Mexican lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Warm refried beans in a saucepan and mix in half the salsa verde.
Warm rotisserie chicken in a skillet, breaking it into bite-sized pieces.
Heat a skillet to medium-high and warm tortillas until pliable.
Spread bean mixture on the lower half of each tortilla, then layer with chicken, cheese, and jalapeños.
Roll the tortilla into a cone shape and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Mix sour cream with remaining salsa verde to create a drizzle sauce.
Top the cone with the cream sauce, cilantro, and fresh lime juice before serving.
cheapTips: Use leftover shredded chicken instead of rotisserie
Buy store-brand refried beans in bulk

recipes.name: Austin Biscuit Company Jalapeño Cheddar Biscuit
recipes.description: American breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Cut cold butter into small cubes and work into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Fold in shredded cheddar and diced jalapeños, then add buttermilk and gently mix until just combined.
Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch-thick rectangle, then cut into 4 biscuits.
Place biscuits on prepared baking sheet and brush tops with honey.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and serve warm.
cheapTips: Use block cheddar and shred it yourself instead of pre-shredded
Make dough ahead and refrigerate overnight

recipes.name: Matt's Famous Chili Con Carne
recipes.description: Tex-Mex dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast dried chiles in a dry skillet for 2 minutes, then soak in hot water for 10 minutes.
Blend soaked chiles with 1 cup soaking liquid and garlic until smooth, then strain through a fine sieve.
Brown ground beef in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add diced onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in chile puree, beef broth, kidney beans, diced tomatoes, cumin, and chili powder.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot with desired toppings.
cheapTips: Use dried chiles which are cheaper than fresh
Buy canned beans in bulk during sales

recipes.name: Veracruz Migas Taco
recipes.description: Mexican breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut tortillas into thin strips and heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Fry tortilla strips until lightly crispy, about 3 minutes, then remove and drain on paper towels.
In the same skillet, sauté diced onion and jalapeño for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add crispy tortilla strips back to the skillet and stir well.
Pour beaten eggs over the tortilla mixture and scramble until eggs are fully cooked, about 3 minutes.
Warm tortillas in a separate dry skillet for serving.
Fill warm tortillas with migas mixture, top with crumbled queso fresco and cilantro, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use day-old tortillas that would otherwise go to waste
Buy queso fresco from a Mexican market for better prices

recipes.name: Chicken Dopiaza
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt, pepper, and yogurt, then set aside for 15 minutes.
Dice onions into two batches: one finely minced and one in thick chunks.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and fry cumin seeds until they pop.
Add minced onions and ginger-garlic paste, stirring until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add turmeric and garam masala.
Add marinated chicken and cook until no longer pink, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes.
Add thick onion chunks and cook for another 10 minutes until chicken is tender and onions are slightly caramelized.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with rice or naan.
cheapTips: Buy whole onions in bulk instead of pre-cut
Make ginger-garlic paste at home instead of buying jarred

recipes.name: Prawn Biryani
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Soak basmati rice in water for 30 minutes, then boil in salted water until 70% cooked and drain.
Mix shrimp with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, salt, and spices, then marinate for 20 minutes.
Slice onions and fry half in ghee until dark brown and crispy, then set aside; repeat with remaining onions.
In a heavy-bottomed pot, heat remaining ghee and layer half the cooked rice on the bottom.
Spread marinated shrimp evenly over the rice, then top with remaining rice.
Sprinkle fried onions, cilantro, and mint over the top layer.
Cover the pot with foil, then place a tight-fitting lid on top and cook on medium heat for 15 minutes until steam forms.
Reduce heat to low and cook for another 10 minutes, then turn off heat and let rest 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use frozen shrimp instead of fresh to save money
Buy spices from Indian markets in bulk for better prices

recipes.name: Uchi Spicy Tuna Roll
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season warm sushi rice with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, then let cool to room temperature.
Dice sushi-grade tuna into small cubes and mix with sriracha and mayonnaise in a bowl.
Place a nori sheet shiny-side down on a bamboo sushi mat and spread a thin layer of rice across it.
Arrange spicy tuna mixture, cucumber, and avocado in a line across the center of the rice.
Using the mat, roll tightly away from you, sealing the edge with a dab of water.
Slice the roll into 8 pieces with a sharp, wet knife using a single smooth motion for each cut.
Serve immediately with soy sauce, pickled ginger, and wasabi.
cheapTips: Buy sushi rice in bulk and cook large batches to freeze
Use regular ahi tuna from the grocery store sushi counter instead of specialty suppliers

recipes.name: La Barbecue Beef Ribs
recipes.description: BBQ lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika together and rub generously on all sides of the ribs.
Place ribs bone-side down on a smoker or grill set to 225°F and smoke for 4 hours uncovered.
Wrap ribs tightly in foil with apple juice and butter, then return to heat for 2 hours.
Remove foil and brush generously with BBQ sauce mixed with Worcestershire sauce.
Return unwrapped ribs to heat for 30-45 minutes until sauce caramelizes.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy beef short ribs on sale and freeze until ready to cook
Make your own BBQ sauce from ketchup, vinegar, and spices instead of buying premium brands

recipes.name: Micro波 Mapo Tofu
recipes.description: Chinese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut tofu into 3/4-inch cubes and gently place in simmering water for 5 minutes to blanch, then drain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat and stir-fry ground pork until browned, breaking it into small pieces.
Add minced garlic and ginger, then stir in doubanjiang and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth and soy sauce, then gently add tofu cubes and bring to a simmer.
Whisk cornstarch and water together, then slowly stir into the sauce to thicken, stirring constantly for 2-3 minutes.
Drizzle sesame oil over the top and sprinkle with toasted Sichuan peppercorns and green onions.
Serve immediately over steamed white rice.
cheapTips: Buy doubanjiang at Asian markets in bulk for much less than specialty stores
Ground pork is often cheaper than ground beef; use sale prices to stock the freezer

recipes.name: Odd Duck Octopus Ceviche
recipes.description: Peruvian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Clean the octopus by removing the head, beak, and eyes, then blanch in boiling salted water for 45-50 minutes until tender.
Cool the octopus under cold running water, then peel off the outer skin and slice the arms into bite-sized pieces.
Place octopus pieces in a bowl and cover completely with fresh lime juice, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Mix red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and tomato together in a separate bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Drain excess lime juice from the octopus, reserving 2 tablespoons, and gently fold in the vegetable mixture.
Drizzle olive oil and reserved lime juice over the ceviche and toss gently.
Serve in chilled bowls topped with avocado slices and additional cilantro.
cheapTips: Buy whole octopus frozen from Asian markets and thaw before cooking for better prices
Lime prices drop significantly when in season; stock up and freeze fresh juice

recipes.name: Tyson Cole's Yellowtail Jalapeño Roll
recipes.description: Japanese dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Season cooled sushi rice with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Place nori shiny-side down on a bamboo sushi mat and spread a thin layer of rice across it.
Arrange yellowtail, jalapeño slices, cucumber, and avocado in a line across the center of the rice.
Using the mat, roll tightly away from you, then press sesame seeds onto the outside of the roll.
Slice the roll into 8 pieces with a sharp, wet knife using a single smooth motion for each cut.
Serve with soy sauce, pickled ginger, and wasabi.
cheapTips: Buy yellowtail from the sushi counter at off-peak hours for better pricing
Make sushi rice in bulk and refrigerate to save time on multiple rolls

recipes.name: Valerie's El Paso Red Enchiladas
recipes.description: Mexican dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove stems and seeds from dried red chiles, then toast lightly in a dry skillet for 30 seconds.
Pour boiling water over chiles and let soak for 10 minutes, then blend with garlic, cumin, salt, and chicken broth until smooth.
Strain the chile sauce through a fine sieve to remove any remaining skin pieces.
Heat oil in a shallow dish and dip each tortilla briefly to soften, then dip in chile sauce.
Fill each tortilla with shredded chicken and diced onion, then roll tightly and place seam-side down in a greased baking dish.
Pour remaining chile sauce over all enchiladas and sprinkle cheddar cheese on top.
Bake at 350°F for 20-25 minutes until sauce is bubbling and cheese is melted, then garnish with sour cream and serve.
cheapTips: Buy dried chiles in bulk at Mexican markets for significant savings over supermarket prices
Cook chicken in bulk and freeze in portions for quick enchilada assembly

recipes.name: Chi'lantro Korean Tacos
recipes.description: Korean-Mexican Fusion lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice skirt steak thinly against the grain into bite-sized pieces.
Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, minced ginger, garlic, and sugar in a bowl.
Marinate steak in the mixture for at least 15 minutes while preparing other ingredients.
Heat a cast iron skillet over high heat until very hot, then cook marinated steak in batches for 2-3 minutes total, keeping meat rare to medium-rare.
Warm tortillas directly over a gas flame or in a dry skillet for 15 seconds per side.
Assemble tacos with warm tortillas, steak, cilantro, jalapeño slices, and a dollop of kimchi.
Squeeze lime juice over tacos and serve immediately.
