cheapTips: Buy skirt steak on sale and freeze in marinade for up to 3 months
Make large batches of marinade and store in a jar to reuse throughout the month

recipes.name: East Side King Fried Chicken Sandwich
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pound chicken breasts to 3/4-inch thickness and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Mix flour, cornstarch, paprika, cayenne, salt, and black pepper in a shallow dish.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a deep pan or Dutch oven.
Dredge chicken in the flour mixture, coating completely and shaking off excess.
Carefully place chicken in hot oil and fry for 6-8 minutes until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Drain fried chicken on paper towels for 1 minute.
Toast brioche buns lightly in a dry skillet, then spread with mayonnaise and layer with chicken and dill pickle slices.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breasts in bulk when on sale and freeze for future use
Make your own pickling brine with vinegar and spices instead of buying pre-pickled

recipes.name: The Odd Duck Beef Tartare
recipes.description: French snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Hand-chop beef tenderloin finely with a sharp knife; do not use a food processor as it will damage the texture.
Place chopped beef on a chilled plate and create a small well in the center.
Gently place the raw egg yolk in the center well without breaking it.
Arrange capers, red onion, parsley, cornichon, and mustard around the beef.
Drizzle with olive oil and Worcestershire sauce, then season with salt and pepper.
Mix gently with a fork just before eating, incorporating the egg yolk throughout.
Serve immediately with toasted crusty bread slices.
cheapTips: Ask the butcher for beef trim or samples instead of buying premium-cut tenderloin
Source ingredients from Costco for bulk savings on quality beef

recipes.name: Torchy's Queso
recipes.description: Mexican snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Remove the casing from chorizo and cook in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking into small pieces, until browned and cooked through.
Roast poblano pepper over a gas flame or under a broiler until charred, then place in a plastic bag for 5 minutes to steam.
Remove poblano from bag and peel away the charred skin, then remove seeds and chop finely.
Reduce skillet heat to low and add sliced cheese, stirring constantly until completely melted and smooth.
Stir in heavy cream, then add roasted poblano, minced jalapeño, and minced onion.
Fold in cilantro and season with salt to taste, then transfer to a serving bowl.
Serve immediately with warm tortilla chips for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy white American cheese from the deli counter in bulk and slice yourself for better prices
Use store-brand chorizo instead of premium brands without sacrificing flavor

recipes.name: Pontefract Cakes
recipes.description: Yorkshire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix licorice powder with powdered sugar in a bowl.
Dissolve gum arabic in water and stir into the licorice mixture until you have a thick paste.
Dust a work surface with cornstarch and roll out the paste to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into small circles using a bottle cap or small round cutter.
Let the cakes sit uncovered for 24 hours to firm up before serving.
cheapTips: Buy licorice powder in bulk from health food stores
Make large batches and store in an airtight container for weeks

recipes.name: Rhubarb Crumble
recipes.description: Yorkshire dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and chop rhubarb into 1-inch pieces.
Toss rhubarb with sugar and vanilla extract, then spread in a 9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix flour, oats, brown sugar, and salt.
Cut butter into small cubes and work into the flour mixture until it resembles breadcrumbs.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the rhubarb.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until the topping is golden and rhubarb is tender.
cheapTips: Buy rhubarb at farmers markets when in season for better prices
Use store-brand oats and flour to reduce costs

recipes.name: Whitby Fish and Chips
recipes.description: Yorkshire lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into thick chips and soak in cold water for 30 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat oil to 325°F and fry chips in batches for 5-7 minutes until soft but not golden; drain and set aside.
Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Whisk in cold water until you have a smooth batter.
Increase oil temperature to 350°F and pat fish dry, then coat in batter.
Fry battered fish for 6-8 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Raise oil temperature to 375°F and fry chips again for 2-3 minutes until crispy and golden.
Drain fish and chips on paper towels and serve with lemon wedges.
cheapTips: Buy frozen cod fillets instead of fresh for better value
Reuse frying oil several times before discarding

recipes.name: Potted Shrimps
recipes.description: Yorkshire lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 4 tablespoons butter in a skillet over medium heat and add minced garlic.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Stir in mace, cayenne, salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Divide shrimp mixture between two small ramekins or pots.
Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter and pour over the shrimp to seal it.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours until the butter sets firm.
Toast bread slices and serve alongside the potted shrimps for scooping.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and thaw overnight in the refrigerator
Make in bulk and store in the fridge for up to a week

recipes.name: Bacon Butty
recipes.description: Yorkshire breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon rashers in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
Toast the bread slices until golden brown.
Spread butter on the inside of each toast slice.
Layer bacon on one slice and spread ketchup and brown sauce over it.
Top with the second slice of toast and cut diagonally.
Serve immediately while warm.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale and freeze for future use
Use store-brand condiments to save money

recipes.name: Fried Bread
recipes.description: Yorkshire breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once oil is shimmering, carefully place bread slices in the pan.
Fry for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer to paper towels to drain excess oil.
Season with salt while still warm and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Use day-old bread which is cheaper and fries better
Reuse frying oil for multiple batches

recipes.name: Cock-a-Leekie Soup
recipes.description: Yorkshire lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil and add whole chicken breast with bay leaf and thyme.
Simmer chicken for 20-25 minutes until cooked through, then remove and shred.
Slice leeks into rounds and chop potatoes into small cubes.
Add barley, leeks, and potatoes to the broth and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in shredded chicken and prunes if using, and cook for 5 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use chicken thighs instead of breast for more flavor at lower cost
Make a large batch and freeze portions for later

recipes.name: Wensleydale and Walnut Cake
recipes.description: Yorkshire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 8-inch round cake pan.
Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in milk.
In another bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt together.
Fold dry ingredients into wet ingredients, then fold in Wensleydale cheese and walnuts.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 35-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
cheapTips: Substitute walnuts with chopped almonds or pecans if cheaper
Use mild cheddar if Wensleydale is not available or too expensive

recipes.name: Batter Pudding
recipes.description: Yorkshire dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and pour oil into a 9-inch baking pan.
Whisk together flour, milk, eggs, and salt until smooth batter forms.
Place pan with oil in the oven for 5 minutes until very hot.
Carefully pour batter into hot oil and bake for 25-30 minutes until risen and golden.
While pudding bakes, heat beef broth or gravy in a saucepan.
Remove pudding from oven when puffed and crispy, then pour hot broth over it.
Return to oven for 5 minutes, then serve hot with the gravy.
cheapTips: Make your own gravy from pan drippings instead of buying canned
Use beef bouillon cubes dissolved in water for a cheaper alternative

recipes.name: Teacake
recipes.description: Yorkshire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Soak dried fruit in warm milk for 10 minutes to plump it up.
Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl.
Fold dry ingredients alternately with milk-fruit mixture into the wet ingredients.
Drop spoonfuls onto prepared baking sheet, spacing 2 inches apart.
Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.
cheapTips: Buy dried fruit from bulk bins instead of pre-packaged boxes
Make a double batch and freeze extras for up to 3 months

recipes.name: Rhubarb Tart
recipes.description: Yorkshire dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut cold butter into flour and salt until breadcrumb texture forms, then mix in egg yolk and 0.5 cup sugar until dough forms.
Chill dough for 30 minutes, then roll out and press into a 9-inch tart pan.
Prick pastry with a fork and blind bake at 375°F for 12 minutes.
Cut rhubarb into 1-inch pieces and toss with 0.75 cup sugar and cornstarch.
Pour rhubarb filling into pre-baked shell and bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes until golden.
Cool for 15 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy rhubarb in season (spring) for best price
Use store-brand flour and butter to reduce costs

recipes.name: Colley
recipes.description: Yorkshire breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk together with milk, salt, and pepper.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until foaming.
Pour egg mixture into the pan and let sit for 30 seconds without stirring.
Push cooked eggs gently from edges toward center, tilting pan to let uncooked egg flow to edges.
When eggs are nearly set but still slightly wet on top, sprinkle with chives and fold in half.
Slide onto a plate and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale
Skip fresh chives and use dried if needed

recipes.name: Cornish Hen
recipes.description: Cornish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and pat hen dry with paper towels.
Rub hen inside and outside with 2 tbsp softened butter, salt, and pepper.
Stuff cavity with lemon halves, thyme sprigs, and garlic cloves.
Tie legs together with kitchen twine and place breast-side up on a roasting pan.
Rub remaining butter over the outside and roast for 45-50 minutes until juices run clear.
Rest for 5 minutes before carving and serving.
cheapTips: Watch for sales on Cornish hens and freeze until needed
Skip fresh thyme and use dried in a pinch

recipes.name: Cornish Cream Tea
recipes.description: Cornish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Boil water and steep tea bags for 3-4 minutes in a teapot.
Warm scones in oven at 325°F for 5 minutes.
Split warm scones in half horizontally.
Spread jam on bottom halves of scones, then top with clotted cream.
Top with remaining scone halves.
Pour tea into cups, add sugar and milk to taste, and serve alongside scones.
cheapTips: Make your own scones instead of buying pre-made
Use store-brand jam and clotted cream

recipes.name: Scones with Clotted Cream
recipes.description: Cornish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Cut cold butter into small cubes and rub into flour until breadcrumb texture forms.
Stir in milk gently until a soft dough just comes together.
Turn dough onto floured surface, pat to 0.75-inch thickness, and cut into 6 rounds with a biscuit cutter.
Place on baking sheet, brush tops with beaten egg, and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden.
Cool slightly and serve warm with clotted cream and jam.
cheapTips: Skip clotted cream and serve with regular whipped cream
Make a double batch and freeze extras

recipes.name: Cornish Saffron Bun
recipes.description: Cornish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Steep saffron in warm milk for 10 minutes until golden.
Mix yeast with warm saffron milk and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
In a large bowl, combine flour, salt, and sugar, then rub in butter until breadcrumb texture.
Pour yeast mixture and beaten egg into flour and knead until smooth elastic dough forms, about 8 minutes.
Fold in currants, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in warm place for 1 hour until doubled.
Punch down dough and divide into 4 equal pieces, shape into round buns, and place on greased baking sheet.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes until puffy.
Bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy saffron in bulk online for better pricing
Substitute dried currants with raisins if needed

recipes.name: Cornish Splits
recipes.description: Cornish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix yeast with warm milk and 1 tbsp sugar, let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour, remaining sugar, and salt in a bowl, rub in butter until breadcrumb texture.
Pour yeast mixture into flour and knead until smooth dough forms, about 6 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes until doubled in size.
Divide dough into 8 pieces, shape into ovals, and place on greased baking sheet.
Cover and let rise 30 minutes until puffy.
Bake at 375°F for 15-18 minutes until light golden.
Cool slightly, split open, and fill each with clotted cream and jam.
cheapTips: Use store-brand jam instead of premium varieties
Substitute clotted cream with whipped cream

recipes.name: Cornish Broth
recipes.description: Cornish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat broth in a large pot and bring to boil.
Add beef stew meat and simmer for 20 minutes until partially tender.
Add barley, carrots, turnip, celery, and potato, then bring back to simmer.
Continue cooking for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender and beef is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use less expensive cuts of beef for stew meat
Buy frozen vegetables to reduce prep time and cost

recipes.name: Mackerel with Gooseberry Sauce
recipes.description: Cornish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse mackerel fillets and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook mackerel skin-side down for 4-5 minutes until skin is crispy.
Flip fillets and cook another 2-3 minutes until cooked through, then remove to a plate.
In the same pan, combine gooseberries, remaining butter, sugar, and white wine.
Simmer for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until gooseberries break down and sauce thickens slightly.
Season sauce with salt, pepper, and dill.
Pour gooseberry sauce over mackerel fillets and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Substitute frozen gooseberries for fresh when out of season
Buy mackerel at the fish counter when on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Cornish Beef Stew
recipes.description: Cornish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef chunks in batches, about 3 minutes per side, then set aside.
Sauté diced onions in the same pot for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to caramelize slightly.
Return beef to pot, add broth and thyme, and bring to simmer.
Cut carrots and potatoes into chunks and add to pot.
Simmer for 60 minutes, covered, until beef is very tender and vegetables are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy chuck roast on sale and cut into cubes yourself
Use dried thyme instead of fresh to save money

recipes.name: Onion Bhaji
recipes.description: Indian snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice onions thinly and set aside in a bowl.
Mix chickpea flour, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne, and salt in a separate bowl.
Add water to the flour mixture gradually, stirring until you get a thick batter.
Fold in the sliced onions and fresh cilantro.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F or until a drop of batter sizzles immediately.
Drop spoonfuls of the batter into the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes until golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with chutney or yogurt.
cheapTips: Buy onions in bulk when on sale and store in a cool, dark place.
Use vegetable oil instead of more expensive oils.

recipes.name: Chicken Jalfrezi
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Heat oil in a large pan and add minced garlic and ginger, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add diced onions and bell peppers, cooking for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in cumin, garam masala, and turmeric, cooking for 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes with their juice and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat and cook for 15-20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce thickens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve with rice or naan.
cheapTips: Buy chicken when it's on sale and freeze for later use.
Use canned tomatoes instead of fresh to save money year-round.

recipes.name: Lamb Vindaloo
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut lamb into 1-inch cubes and pat dry with paper towels.
Blend garlic, ginger, chili peppers, and 2 tbsp water into a paste.
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown lamb in batches, then set aside.
In the same pot, sauté diced onions until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add the spice paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in cumin, coriander, turmeric, and tomato paste, cooking for 1 minute.
Return lamb to pot with vinegar and chicken broth, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes until lamb is very tender, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt to taste and serve with rice or flatbread.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shoulder or stew meat on sale, as it's more affordable than premium cuts.
Make a larger batch and freeze portions for future meals.

recipes.name: Lamb Korma
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pat lamb dry and set aside.
Blend yogurt, garlic, ginger, and 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Heat oil in a large pot and brown the lamb in batches, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, cook diced onions until softened and golden, about 6 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, and garam masala, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the yogurt-garlic mixture and ground almonds, stirring to combine.
Return lamb to pot with chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low heat for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lamb is tender.
Season with salt to taste and serve with basmati rice.
cheapTips: Use plain Greek yogurt from the sale section or buy larger containers.
Buy ground almonds in bulk from discount stores or make your own by grinding whole almonds.

recipes.name: Prawn Madras
recipes.description: Indian dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel and devein prawns, then pat dry and set aside.
Blend garlic, ginger, and 3 tbsp water into a paste.
Heat oil in a large pan and sauté diced onions until golden, about 4 minutes.
Add the garlic-ginger paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in red chili powder, cumin, and coriander, cooking for 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes and their juice, simmering for 8 minutes.
Add prawns and coconut milk, stirring gently, and cook for 6-8 minutes until prawns are pink and cooked through.
Season with salt to taste, garnish with fresh cilantro, and serve with rice or naan.
cheapTips: Buy frozen prawns when on sale as they're cheaper than fresh and freeze well.
Use canned coconut milk from discount retailers for better prices.

recipes.name: Yorkshire Pudding
recipes.description: Yorkshire dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and place a 12-cup muffin tin in the oven.
Mix flour and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk eggs and milk together in another bowl until well combined.
Make a well in the flour and gradually pour in the egg mixture, whisking until you have a smooth batter with the consistency of heavy cream.
Add black pepper to the batter.
Carefully remove the hot muffin tin from the oven and add 1 tsp of oil or beef drippings to each cup.
Pour batter evenly into each cup until half-full and immediately return to the oven.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until risen and golden brown, without opening the oven door during cooking.
Serve hot with roast beef and gravy.
cheapTips: Use vegetable oil instead of beef drippings for a lower cost.
Make extra batter and freeze cooked puddings for quick reheating.

recipes.name: Parkin
recipes.description: Yorkshire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking pan.
Combine oats, flour, ginger, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
In a saucepan, melt butter over low heat and stir in brown sugar and molasses until combined.
Pour the butter mixture into the dry ingredients and mix until well combined and crumbly.
Press the mixture firmly into the prepared baking pan.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until lightly golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then cut into squares.
Store in an airtight container for up to one week.
cheapTips: Buy oats in bulk and store in airtight containers.
Use store-brand molasses and brown sugar to save money.

recipes.name: Fat Rascal
recipes.description: Yorkshire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Cut in butter until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs, then stir in sugar.
Fold in currants and candied peel.
Whisk egg and milk together, then add to the dry mixture and stir until a soft dough forms.
Divide dough into 4 portions and shape into slightly flattened circles on the prepared baking sheet.
Sprinkle almond slices on top of each cake.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
Cool on a wire rack and serve warm or at room temperature.
cheapTips: Use regular raisins instead of candied peel to reduce costs.
Skip almond slices or use crushed almonds from cheaper bulk bins.

recipes.name: Wensleydale Cheese
recipes.description: Yorkshire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat milk to 90°F in a large pot, stirring occasionally.
Dilute rennet in 0.25 cup cool non-chlorinated water and add to the milk, stirring well for 1 minute.
Let sit undisturbed for 30 minutes while the milk curdles.
Cut curds into 0.25-inch cubes using a long knife, stirring slowly for 5 minutes.
Gradually heat to 102°F over 30 minutes while stirring occasionally.
Pour curds into a cheesecloth-lined colander and let whey drain for 10 minutes.
Gather the corners of the cheesecloth and hang to drain for 12-24 hours until very firm.
Cut the curds into pieces, salt lightly, and form into a block shape.
Store wrapped in cloth in a cool cellar or refrigerator for 2-4 weeks to age, turning occasionally.
cheapTips: Buy milk directly from local dairy farms or use store brand milk.
Make larger batches to spread equipment and ingredient costs over more cheese.

recipes.name: Yorkshire Tea Cake
recipes.description: Yorkshire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 7-inch round cake tin.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then add vanilla extract.
Alternate adding flour mixture and milk to the egg mixture, beginning and ending with flour.
Fold in dried fruit gently until just combined.
Pour batter into the prepared tin.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
cheapTips: Buy dried mixed fruit in bulk or use store-brand versions.
Use budget butter and regular sugar rather than specialty baking ingredients.

recipes.name: Bara Ceirch
recipes.description: Welsh breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix rolled oats, flour, and salt in a large bowl.
Rub in butter until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add water gradually until a stiff dough forms.
Roll dough between parchment paper to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut into rectangles and place on a greased baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F for 15-20 minutes until golden and crisp.
cheapTips: Buy oats in bulk to save significantly
Use store-brand flour and butter

recipes.name: Pice ar y Maen
recipes.description: Welsh snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Rub in butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Stir in sugar and dried fruit.
Beat egg with milk and fold into dry ingredients until just combined.
Shape dough into a flat cake about 1/2-inch thick on a baking sheet.
Score into wedges and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden.
cheapTips: Buy dried fruit in bulk sections
Use store-brand baking powder

recipes.name: Teisen Lap
recipes.description: Welsh snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x9 inch cake pan.
Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla extract.
In another bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt.
Fold dry ingredients into wet ingredients.
Stir in dried fruit.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 35-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
cheapTips: Buy dried fruit on sale and freeze
Use all-purpose flour from bulk bins

recipes.name: Teisen Nionod
recipes.description: Welsh snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a round cake pan.
Peel and finely chop onions.
Cream butter and sugar together until fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time.
Fold in flour, baking powder, and salt.
Gently stir in chopped onions and caraway seeds.
Pour into prepared pan and bake for 30-35 minutes until golden and firm.
cheapTips: Use budget onions from discount produce
Make your own caraway seed blend

recipes.name: Cig Moch a Cheirch
recipes.description: Welsh breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8-10 minutes.
Remove bacon and crumble, reserving 1 tablespoon of bacon fat.
In a separate pot, bring water and salt to a boil.
Stir in oats and reduce heat to medium-low.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in butter and milk, then fold in crumbled bacon.
Cook for another 2 minutes until creamy and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy bacon on sale and freeze
Use budget oats from bulk sections

recipes.name: Swansea Omelet
recipes.description: Welsh lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Beat eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté leeks for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add ham and cook for 1 minute.
Pour eggs over the filling and let set for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle cheese over one half and fold omelet in half when eggs are nearly set.
Slide onto a plate, top with parsley, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy eggs in bulk when on sale
Use store-brand cheddar cheese

recipes.name: Crempog
recipes.description: Welsh breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, beat eggs and mix with milk.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just blended.
Heat a griddle or non-stick skillet over medium heat and grease lightly.
Pour small dollops of batter onto the griddle and cook 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Stack pancakes and serve warm with honey or jam.
cheapTips: Buy honey at discount stores in bulk
Use generic baking powder

recipes.name: Llymru
recipes.description: Welsh breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a saucepan.
Slowly stir in oats to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add butter and honey, stirring until dissolved.
Stir in milk and cook for 1-2 more minutes until creamy.
Transfer to bowls and serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy oats in bulk bins for cheapest price
Use generic honey

recipes.name: Codling
recipes.description: Welsh dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Layer sliced potatoes and onions in a greased baking dish.
Place cod fillets on top and season with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Pour sauce over the fish and vegetables.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until fish flakes easily and potatoes are tender.
Sprinkle with parsley before serving.
cheapTips: Buy cod when on sale and freeze
Use budget potatoes from discount grocers

recipes.name: Welsh Mutton Pie
recipes.description: Welsh dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Toss meat in flour seasoned with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a large pot and brown meat in batches, about 8 minutes total.
Add onions and cook for 3 minutes.
Add potatoes and broth, bring to a simmer and cook for 30 minutes until meat is tender.
Transfer filling to a 9-inch pie dish and let cool slightly.
Cover with one sheet of pie crust, trim edges, and brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until crust is golden brown.
cheapTips: Use lamb shoulder instead of leg for cheaper meat
Buy store-made pie crust to save time and money

recipes.name: Cornish Lamb Hotpot
recipes.description: Cornish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Layer half the potato slices on the bottom of a large casserole dish.
Add layers of lamb, onions, and carrots, seasoning each layer with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Top with remaining potato slices in an overlapping pattern.
Pour beef broth over the top and dot with butter.
Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour.
Remove foil and bake uncovered for 20-25 minutes until potatoes are golden.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy lamb shoulder in bulk and freeze portions.
Use seasonal root vegetables to reduce cost.

recipes.name: Cornish Nuggets
recipes.description: Cornish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized nugget pieces.
Set up three bowls with flour mixed with salt and pepper, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs.
Coat each nugget in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing gently.
Heat oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Fry nuggets in batches for 3-4 minutes until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
cheapTips: Make extra and freeze uncooked for quick future meals.
Use store-brand breadcrumbs to save money.

recipes.name: Cawl
recipes.description: Welsh dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring beef broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add beef chunks and bring back to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Skim off any foam from the surface.
Add potatoes, carrots, parsnips, onions, and leeks; simmer for 45 minutes.
Add cabbage and season with salt and pepper.
Simmer for another 20 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for later use.
Use whatever root vegetables are cheapest at your market.

recipes.name: Bara Brith
recipes.description: Welsh snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Pour hot tea over mixed dried fruit and let soak for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
In a bowl, whisk together flour and baking powder.
In another bowl, cream butter and brown sugar, then beat in egg.
Fold in flour mixture alternately with the soaked fruit and tea.
Pour batter into loaf pan and bake for 50-60 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Brush warm loaf with honey and cool in pan for 10 minutes before turning out.
cheapTips: Buy dried fruit in bulk and store in an airtight container.
Make strong tea from inexpensive bags instead of loose leaf.

recipes.name: Welsh Cakes
recipes.description: Welsh snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt together.
Cut cold butter into cubes and rub into flour until breadcrumb texture forms.
Stir in sugar and currants.
Beat egg with vanilla and mix into dough until combined.
Roll dough to 0.25-inch thickness on a floured surface.
Cut into 3-inch circles using a cutter.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and cook cakes 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Dust with caster sugar while warm.
cheapTips: Keep butter in the freezer until ready to use for better texture.
Substitute regular sugar for caster sugar if needed.

recipes.name: Cockles and Mussels
recipes.description: Welsh lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Rinse cockles and mussels under cold water, discarding any that are open or damaged.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in white wine and bring to a simmer.
Add cockles and mussels, cover, and cook for 6-8 minutes until shells open.
Discard any shells that remain closed.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with parsley, and serve with crusty bread.
cheapTips: Buy shellfish on sale or at farmers markets for better prices.
Use cheaper white wine for cooking rather than premium bottles.

recipes.name: Faggots and Peas
recipes.description: Welsh dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix pork, liver, breadcrumbs, onion, sage, egg, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Form mixture into 8 balls and place in a baking dish.
Pour beef broth around the faggots.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in frozen peas during the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Simmer on stovetop for 2-3 minutes to heat through.
Serve faggots with peas and gravy from the pan.
cheapTips: Buy pork offal from butchers; it's much cheaper than other cuts.
Use store-brand frozen peas instead of fresh.

recipes.name: Tatws Pwnc
recipes.description: Welsh dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook diced potatoes in salted boiling water for 12-15 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Meanwhile, fry bacon pieces in a large pan until crispy and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté diced onions in bacon fat and butter until soft.
Add cooked potatoes to the pan with onions.
Pour milk over the mixture and heat gently, stirring carefully.
Season with salt and pepper.
Return bacon to the pan and mix gently.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy bacon in bulk when on sale and freeze in portions.
Use store-brand milk and butter.

recipes.name: Lobscouse
recipes.description: Welsh dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat and brown beef chunks in batches, then set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onions until softened.
Return beef to pot and add broth, tomato paste, bay leaves, and Worcestershire sauce.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 30 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots, then simmer covered for another 35-40 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper.
Remove bay leaves and serve hot in bowls.
cheapTips: Buy chuck roast on sale and make large batches to freeze.
Skip premium beef broth and use store brand or make your own.

recipes.name: Welsh Lamb Stew
recipes.description: Welsh dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Bring beef broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add lamb chunks and return to a simmer, skimming off foam for 2-3 minutes.
Add onions, carrots, and leeks along with fresh thyme.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 40 minutes.
Add potatoes and continue simmering for 30-35 minutes until lamb is tender and potatoes are cooked.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Remove thyme sprigs and serve hot.
cheapTips: Buy lamb neck fillet instead of shoulder for cost savings.
Make large batches and freeze portions for quick weeknight meals.

recipes.name: Pilchard Pâté
recipes.description: Cornish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Drain the pilchards and remove any large bones, then place in a food processor.
Add softened butter, cream cheese, lemon juice, parsley, salt, and pepper to the processor.
Blend until smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed.
Transfer the pâté to a serving bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Serve chilled with crackers or buttered toast.
cheapTips: Buy canned pilchards on sale in bulk
Use store-brand cream cheese to reduce costs

recipes.name: Cornish Fairings
recipes.description: Cornish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy, then beat in the egg.
Whisk together flour, ginger, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt in a separate bowl.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until just combined.
Roll dough into small balls and flatten slightly on prepared baking sheets.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until lightly golden.
Dust warm cookies with icing sugar and cool on a wire rack.
cheapTips: Buy spices in bulk sections
Use store-brand flour and sugar

recipes.name: Stargazy Pie
recipes.description: Cornish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pastry by mixing flour, salt, and cold butter until breadcrumb texture, then add water until dough forms; chill 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375°F and roll out two-thirds of dough to line a 9-inch pie dish.
Layer potatoes and onions in the crust, season with salt and pepper, then pour milk over.
Arrange fish fillets on top with their heads poking through the crust decoratively, then place egg slices between them.
Sprinkle parsley over the filling.
Roll out remaining dough, cut strips, and arrange as lattice on top, then trim and seal edges.
Bake for 50-60 minutes until crust is golden and filling is cooked through.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use canned sardines instead of fresh to reduce cost
Buy potatoes and onions in bulk

recipes.name: Cornish Yeast Cake
recipes.description: Cornish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix warm milk with yeast and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar, then beat in eggs one at a time.
Add yeast mixture to the butter mixture and stir well.
Mix flour, salt, and nutmeg in a separate bowl, then gradually incorporate into wet ingredients.
Fold in currants and knead dough for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with a cloth, and let rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Preheat oven to 350°F, transfer dough to a greased loaf pan, and let rise 30 minutes.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until golden brown and a skewer comes out clean.
cheapTips: Buy yeast in bulk and store in freezer
Use store-brand currants instead of premium brands

recipes.name: Cornish Heavy Cake
recipes.description: Cornish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 inch baking pan.
Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then add vanilla extract.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl.
Alternately add flour mixture and milk to the butter mixture, beginning and ending with flour.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
cheapTips: Buy eggs from discount grocers
Use store-brand butter for baking

recipes.name: Cornish Chough Pastry
recipes.description: Cornish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Make pastry by cutting cold butter into flour and salt until breadcrumb texture, then add water until dough forms; chill 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix cream cheese, minced garlic, fresh herbs, and black pepper in a bowl.
Cut roasted peppers into strips and fold into the cheese mixture.
Roll out pastry and cut into 4-inch rounds using a bowl or cutter.
Place a spoonful of pepper mixture on each round, fold in half, and seal edges with a fork.
Arrange pastries on baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes until golden.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use jarred roasted peppers instead of roasting fresh
Buy cream cheese when on sale and freeze

recipes.name: Cornish Murkey Cake
recipes.description: Cornish breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9-inch round cake pan.
Cream butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy, then beat in eggs.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt in a separate bowl.
Alternately add flour mixture and milk to the butter mixture, stirring until just combined.
Fold diced apples gently into the batter.
Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake for 45-50 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 15 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
cheapTips: Buy apples in season and store for weeks
Use salted butter to reduce added salt

recipes.name: Cornish Hake with Samphire
recipes.description: Cornish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and rinse samphire under cold water to remove excess salt.
Season hake fillets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Sauté garlic for 30 seconds, then add hake fillets skin-side up and cook for 2 minutes.
Add white wine and remaining butter to the skillet, then add samphire around the fish.
Transfer skillet to oven and bake for 10-12 minutes until hake is opaque and flakes easily.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the dish and garnish with dill.
Serve immediately with the samphire and pan juices.
cheapTips: Use frozen hake fillets instead of fresh
Substitute spinach if samphire is unavailable

recipes.name: Cornish Lobster Bisque
recipes.description: Cornish dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt butter in a large pot and sauté onion, celery, and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in fish stock, add bay leaf, and bring to a simmer.
Add lobster meat pieces, reserving some for garnish, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and blend soup until smooth using an immersion blender.
Return to heat, stir in sherry, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Slowly stir in heavy cream and season with salt and pepper.
Simmer gently for 5 minutes without boiling, then ladle into bowls and garnish with reserved lobster meat.
cheapTips: Use frozen cooked lobster meat instead of fresh
Substitute shrimp if lobster is too expensive

recipes.name: Cornish Seaweed Butter
recipes.description: Cornish snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Toast nori seaweed sheets lightly over a gas flame or in a dry skillet for 10 seconds each side until fragrant.
Crumble toasted nori into fine pieces.
Place softened butter in a bowl and beat with a fork until creamy.
Fold in crumbled nori, lemon zest, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and parsley.
Transfer seaweed butter to a small serving bowl or shape into a log using plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes until firm.
Serve with crackers or spread on warm bread.
cheapTips: Buy nori seaweed sheets from Asian markets for half the price
Use margarine instead of butter for dairy-free version

recipes.name: Butter Pie
recipes.description: Lancashire lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then cut in 8 tablespoons cold butter until breadcrumb texture forms.
Add ice water gradually until dough just comes together, wrap and chill 30 minutes.
Roll out dough and press into a 9-inch pie dish, prick with fork.
Cream remaining butter with sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then add milk and vanilla extract.
Spread filling evenly over pastry base.
Bake at 350°F for 30-35 minutes until golden and filling is set.
Cool completely before serving.
cheapTips: Buy butter on sale and freeze for later use
Make your own pastry instead of buying pre-made

recipes.name: Eccles Cake
recipes.description: Lancashire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Thaw puff pastry if frozen and preheat oven to 400°F.
Melt butter and mix with currants, brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Roll out pastry and cut into 3-inch squares.
Place 1 teaspoon filling in center of each square, fold corners to center and press gently.
Place seam-side down on baking sheet, flatten slightly with your hand.
Beat egg with water and brush over cakes, then sprinkle with demerara sugar.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
Cool on wire rack before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand puff pastry to save 50%
Substitute raisins for currants if cheaper

recipes.name: Chorley Cakes
recipes.description: Lancashire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Roll pastry thin and cut into 3-inch rounds using a cookie cutter.
Melt butter and mix with currants, brown sugar, and allspice for filling.
Place teaspoon of filling on each pastry round and fold in half.
Seal edges with a fork, creating a decorative pattern.
Beat egg with water and brush over cakes.
Sprinkle with caster sugar and bake 12-15 minutes until golden.
Transfer to wire rack to cool.
cheapTips: Buy currants in bulk from ethnic sections
Make double batch and freeze unbaked

recipes.name: Pendle Witches Brew
recipes.description: Lancashire dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Brown beef chunks in a large pot over medium-high heat in batches, about 5 minutes per batch.
Remove beef and sauté diced onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Return beef to pot and stir in tomato paste, cooking 2 minutes.
Add broth and ale, scraping up browned bits, then add bay leaves and thyme.
Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Cut potatoes and carrots into chunks and add to pot.
Continue simmering 20-25 minutes until vegetables and beef are tender.
Season with salt and pepper, remove herbs, and serve hot.
cheapTips: Use chuck roast on sale and cube yourself
Substitute water for half the beer to reduce cost

recipes.name: Lancashire Cheese and Potato Pie
recipes.description: Lancashire lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, cut in 6 tablespoons cold butter until breadcrumbs form, add water until dough holds together.
Wrap dough and chill 30 minutes, then roll and line a 9-inch pie dish.
Peel and thinly slice potatoes and onion.
Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a pan and cook onions until soft, about 5 minutes.
Layer half the potatoes in pie shell, add onions and half the cheese, then remaining potatoes.
Heat milk and pour over filling, top with remaining cheese and season with pepper.
Bake covered with foil at 375°F for 35 minutes, then uncovered for 10 minutes until golden.
Cool 10 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-brand cheddar instead of specialty cheese
Buy potatoes in bulk bags for better pricing

recipes.name: Goosnargh Cakes
recipes.description: Lancashire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in egg yolk, then fold in flour, salt, caraway seeds, and lemon zest.
Roll dough into walnut-sized balls and place on baking sheets.
Lightly beat egg white and brush over balls, then flatten gently with bottom of glass.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until light golden.
Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack.
cheapTips: Buy caraway seeds from bulk bins
Make a large batch to freeze for later

recipes.name: Pork Pies
recipes.description: Lancashire lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat lard and water together until steaming, then mix into flour and salt to form warm dough.
Knead until smooth, cover, and let rest 20 minutes.
Mix ground pork with minced onion, sage, and pepper for filling.
Divide dough into 4 parts, shape each into a ball, and hollow out to form pie shells.
Fill each shell with pork mixture and seal top with dough, crimping edges.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 375°F for 45 minutes until golden.
Heat broth and pour through steam hole in each pie after cooling 10 minutes.
Cool completely before serving.
cheapTips: Use ground pork shoulder instead of premium cuts
Make 8 pies and freeze half for future meals

recipes.name: Wet Nelly
recipes.description: Lancashire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9-inch baking dish.
Tear bread into chunks and layer half in the baking dish.
Mix raisins, sugar, spices, and salt, then scatter half over bread.
Add remaining bread, then top with remaining raisin mixture.
Dot with butter pieces.
Heat water until steaming and pour gently around the dish edges.
Bake covered with foil for 25-30 minutes until bread is soft and syrupy.
Cool slightly before serving warm.
cheapTips: Use day-old bread from bakery section for discount
Buy spices in bulk for lower cost

recipes.name: Lancashire Black Pudding
recipes.description: Lancashire breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook bacon until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Remove bacon and set aside, then fry black pudding slices 2-3 minutes per side until heated through.
Add mushroom slices and halved tomato to pan and cook 3-4 minutes.
Push everything to the side, add butter, and crack eggs into pan.
Cook eggs to desired doneness, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Toast bread in a separate pan or toaster.
Plate toast and arrange pudding, bacon, eggs, and vegetables on top.
Serve immediately while hot.
cheapTips: Buy black pudding from European or specialty sections
Use store-brand eggs to save on costs

recipes.name: Lancashire Beef and Beer Pie
recipes.description: Lancashire dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and toss beef with flour, salt, and pepper.
Brown beef in batches in butter over medium-high heat, set aside.
Sauté chopped onions until soft, about 5 minutes.
Return beef to pot, add tomato paste, and cook 2 minutes.
Pour in broth and ale, add bay leaf and thyme, then bring to boil.
Cover and simmer in oven for 60 minutes, stirring halfway.
Add carrots and potatoes cut into chunks, continue cooking 35-40 minutes until tender.
Transfer beef mixture to pie dish, cool 15 minutes, then cover with puff pastry.
Brush pastry with beaten egg and bake at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck on sale and freeze for future use
Use store-brand puff pastry instead of homemade

recipes.name: Haslet
recipes.description: Lancashire lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground pork, breadcrumbs, onion, sage, egg, salt, and pepper in a large bowl until well combined.
Shape the mixture into a loaf and wrap with caul fat or drape bacon strips over the top.
Heat oil in a roasting pan and brown the haslet on all sides for 3-4 minutes.
Pour chicken broth around the haslet and roast at 350°F for 60 minutes until cooked through.
Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve warm with gravy made from pan drippings.
cheapTips: Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions
Use regular bacon instead of caul fat to save money

recipes.name: Mrs Kibbles Cakes
recipes.description: Lancashire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.
Beat in the egg until fully incorporated.
Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl.
Fold dry ingredients into wet mixture, then stir in currants and milk until a soft dough forms.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto the baking sheet, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown on top.
Cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Buy dried fruit in bulk bins for better pricing
Use store-brand flour and butter

recipes.name: Lancashire Suet Pudding
recipes.description: Lancashire dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour, suet, breadcrumbs, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
Add water slowly, stirring until a soft dough forms.
Lightly flour a work surface and roll dough to 0.25 inch thickness.
Spread browned ground meat and onions on dough, then roll tightly and wrap in parchment paper.
Tie the pudding securely in the parchment with kitchen twine.
Place in a steamer basket over boiling water and steam for 90 minutes, ensuring water stays hot.
Remove pudding and let rest for 5 minutes before unwrapping.
Slice and serve with beef broth poured over top.
cheapTips: Buy suet from butcher counter where it's often very affordable
Use store-brand beef broth in bulk

recipes.name: Bury Black Pudding
recipes.description: Lancashire breakfast — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix pork blood, fat, breadcrumbs, onion, salt, pepper, and allspice in a large bowl.
Soak hog casings in warm water for 10 minutes to soften them.
Using a piping bag or funnel, fill casings carefully with the blood mixture, leaving 0.5 inch at each end.
Tie the ends of the casings with kitchen twine to form links.
Bring a large pot of water to 170°F and poach puddings for 20-25 minutes until firm.
Remove puddings with a slotted spoon and let cool on paper towels.
Heat oil in a skillet and fry puddings over medium heat until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Serve warm with eggs and toast.
cheapTips: Buy pork blood and casings from specialty butchers or online
Make larger batches and freeze for future use

recipes.name: Lytham Shrimp Potted Shrimp
recipes.description: Lancashire lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Melt 0.25 cup butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
Stir in shrimp, salt, white pepper, nutmeg, and mace blade.
Cook gently for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are warmed through.
Remove from heat and discard mace blade.
Stir in lemon juice and divide the shrimp mixture into ramekins.
Melt remaining 0.25 cup butter and pour a layer over each ramekin to seal.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes until butter is solid.
Serve with crackers or toasted bread slices.
cheapTips: Buy frozen shrimp and thaw ahead for better value
Use clarified butter or ghee to stretch the butter layer

recipes.name: Wigan Pie
recipes.description: Lancashire lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and lightly grease a 9-inch pie pan.
Brown ground pork in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes, then stir in potato and apple.
Season with salt, pepper, and sage, then add broth and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Let filling cool for 10 minutes, then place one pie crust in the pan.
Pour filling over the crust and top with the second crust, sealing edges with a fork.
Cut small vents in the top and brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until the crust is golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pie crusts to save time and money
Buy ground pork on sale and freeze in portions

recipes.name: Lancashire Parkin
recipes.description: Lancashire snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and grease a 9x9 inch baking pan.
Mix flour, oats, ginger, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
Melt butter with brown sugar and molasses in a saucepan over low heat.
Pour wet ingredients into dry and mix until well combined.
Press mixture firmly into the prepared baking pan.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 15 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
Cut into squares and serve.
cheapTips: Buy bulk oats and molasses for significant savings
Make double batch and freeze for weeks of snacks

recipes.name: Turkey Pot Pie
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and place a 9-inch pie dish on a baking sheet.
Melt butter in a large skillet and sauté onion, celery, and carrot until softened, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add broth, stirring until sauce thickens, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in cooked turkey and peas, then pour filling into pie dish.
Lay pie crust over filling and trim edges, then seal with fork.
Cut vents in top and brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until crust is golden brown and filling bubbles at edges.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
cheapTips: Use leftover turkey from roasting instead of buying fresh
Buy frozen vegetables which are cheaper than fresh

recipes.name: Salisbury Steak
recipes.description: American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, onion, egg, salt, and pepper in a bowl until just combined.
Form mixture into 4 oval patties, each about 1 inch thick.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown patties for 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove patties and set aside, then whisk together broth, tomato sauce, and Worcestershire sauce in the same pan.
Return patties to skillet and cover with sauce.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 20-25 minutes until patties are cooked through.
Transfer patties to a serving platter and pour sauce over top.
Serve with mashed potatoes or egg noodles.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef in bulk and divide into portions to freeze
Use generic tomato sauce and Worcestershire sauce

recipes.name: Meatball Marinara
recipes.description: Italian-American dinner — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix ground beef, ground pork, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Roll mixture into 1.5-inch meatballs, making about 16-20 balls.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown meatballs in batches for 3-4 minutes, turning occasionally.
Pour marinara sauce over meatballs and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions and drain.
Divide pasta among serving bowls and top with meatballs and sauce.
Serve immediately with extra parmesan cheese on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground meat on sale and freeze in portions
Use store-brand marinara sauce and pasta for savings

recipes.name: Burger and Fries
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch thick sticks and soak in cold water for 30 minutes.
Heat oil to 325°F in a deep pot or fryer and fry potatoes in batches for 5-7 minutes until golden; drain on paper towels and season with salt.
Divide ground beef into two 1/4-lb patties, season both sides with salt and pepper, and make a small indent in the center of each with your thumb.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side until desired doneness, adding cheese during the last minute.
Lightly toast hamburger buns in the skillet or toaster oven.
Assemble burgers by spreading ketchup and mustard on buns, then layering lettuce, tomato slice, onion, and cooked patty with melted cheese.
Serve burgers immediately with hot fries on the side.
cheapTips: Buy ground beef on sale and freeze for later use
Use store-brand buns and condiments to save 50 cents per burger

recipes.name: Apple Pie à la Mode
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Mix flour and salt, then cut cold diced butter into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs, then add ice water until dough forms; refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Peel, core, and slice apples into 1/4-inch slices and toss with both sugars, cinnamon, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Roll out two-thirds of dough and press into a 9-inch pie dish, then fill with apple mixture.
Roll out remaining dough, cut into strips, and weave a lattice pattern over the filling.
Beat egg with 1 tbsp water and brush over crust, then bake at 375°F for 40-45 minutes until crust is golden brown.
Cool pie on a wire rack for at least 15 minutes before slicing.
Serve warm pie slices topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
cheapTips: Use store-bought pie crust to save 15 minutes and $1 per pie
Buy apples in bulk when in season and freeze for later use

recipes.name: Banana Split
recipes.description: American snack — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Peel banana and slice lengthwise, then place both halves in the bottom of a banana split boat or elongated dish.
Place vanilla ice cream scoop between banana halves on the left side.
Place chocolate ice cream scoop in the middle.
Place strawberry ice cream scoop on the right side.
Drizzle chocolate syrup over vanilla scoop, strawberry syrup over strawberry scoop, and pineapple topping over chocolate scoop.
Top the entire split with whipped cream in the center.
Garnish with maraschino cherries on top and chopped peanuts sprinkled over whipped cream, then serve immediately with a long spoon.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand ice cream and syrups instead of name brands
Skip expensive toppings like peanuts and use sprinkles instead

recipes.name: Turkey Club
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes until crispy, then drain on paper towels and break in half.
Toast all six bread slices until golden brown.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each toast slice.
On the first slice, layer half the turkey, two pieces of bacon, two lettuce leaves, and one tomato slice.
Top with second toast slice and repeat layers with remaining turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato, and cheese on top.
Place final toast slice on top and secure with two toothpicks inserted diagonally.
Cut sandwich in half diagonally and serve immediately with a pickle or side salad.
cheapTips: Buy turkey breast on sale and slice it yourself instead of pre-sliced deli meat
Use store-brand bacon which costs 20% less than name brands

recipes.name: Mortadella Sandwich
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice ciabatta rolls in half horizontally and lightly brush cut sides with olive oil.
Lightly toast rolls for 2-3 minutes until warm and slightly crispy on the inside.
Divide mortadella slices and provolone cheese between the two rolls.
Top each with roasted red peppers and fresh arugula.
Whisk together olive oil and red wine vinegar, then drizzle over arugula.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Close sandwiches, cut in half diagonally, and serve immediately.
cheapTips: Buy mortadella from the deli counter by the pound instead of pre-packaged
Use jarred roasted peppers from the grocery store instead of roasting fresh ones

recipes.name: Chopped Cheese
recipes.description: American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Dice potatoes into 1/4-inch cubes and dice onion finely.
Heat oil in a griddle or large skillet over medium-high heat and add diced potatoes, cooking for 4-5 minutes until golden.
Push potatoes to the side and add ground beef, breaking it up with a spatula as it cooks for 2-3 minutes until no longer pink.
Mix potatoes and beef together, add diced onion, and cook for another minute until onion begins to soften.
Season with salt and pepper, then tear American cheese into pieces and mix throughout the meat and potato mixture until melted and combined.
Toast the hero roll lightly on the griddle.
Transfer chopped cheese mixture onto toasted roll, drizzle with hot sauce if desired, and serve hot immediately.
cheapTips: Use the cheapest ground beef available and drain excess fat
Buy hero rolls from the bakery section where they're cheaper than pre-packaged

recipes.name: Spicy Italian
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice sub rolls in half horizontally.
Layer pepperoni, hot capicola, soppressata, and provolone cheese evenly on both roll bottoms.
Top each sandwich with roasted red peppers and peperoncini peppers.
Drizzle olive oil over the peppers and sprinkle Italian seasoning on top.
Season lightly with salt and top with the second half of each roll.
If desired, wrap sandwiches in foil and warm in a 350°F oven for 3-4 minutes until cheese begins to melt.
Cut in half if desired and serve immediately, making sure to drizzle any remaining peperoncini juice on the side for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy cured meats from the deli counter by the slice instead of pre-packaged packages
Make your own peperoncini peppers by saving money on spicy condiments

recipes.name: The Original Italian Beef
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear beef roast on all sides for 2-3 minutes per side until browned.
Remove beef and set aside, then sauté diced onion and minced garlic in the same pot for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Return beef to pot, add beef broth, Italian seasoning, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 30-35 minutes until beef is very tender and can be shredded easily with two forks.
Remove beef from broth and shred with two forks until it reaches a pulled meat consistency.
Return shredded beef to the broth and stir in giardiniera peppers with juice, simmering for 2-3 more minutes.
Toast sandwich rolls lightly, then fill each with shredded beef using a slotted spoon and serve with a small bowl of the cooking broth for dipping.
cheapTips: Buy beef chuck roast on sale and freeze until needed
Use store-brand giardiniera peppers which are much cheaper than specialty brands

recipes.name: Soppressata Sandwich
recipes.description: Italian lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice Italian bread loaf horizontally and lightly brush cut surfaces with olive oil.
Layer soppressata slices on the bottom half of the bread.
Slice fresh mozzarella into 1/4-inch slices and layer over soppressata.
Slice tomato into 1/4-inch slices and layer over mozzarella, then season with salt and pepper.
Tear fresh basil leaves and distribute over tomato.
Drizzle balsamic vinegar over all ingredients.
Top with bread's upper half, cut sandwich into two portions, and serve immediately while fresh.
cheapTips: Buy soppressata from the deli counter by the slice instead of packaged
Use store-brand fresh mozzarella which is cheaper than premium brands

recipes.name: Capicola Sandwich
recipes.description: Italian-American lunch — a popular dish you can make at home.
steps: Slice hoagie rolls in half horizontally.
Spread mayonnaise thinly on both halves of each roll.
Layer capicola slices and provolone cheese on the bottom halves.
Top with lettuce leaves, tomato slice, and thin red onion slices.
Drizzle Italian dressing over vegetables and season with salt and pepper.
Top each sandwich with the upper half of the roll.
Cut diagonally if desired and serve immediately, or wrap in foil for transport.
cheapTips: Buy store-brand hoagie rolls from the bakery section instead of name-brand
Purchase capicola from the deli counter by weight instead of pre-packaged

recipes.name: Marry Me Chicken
recipes.description: Golden pan-seared chicken simmered in a creamy sun-dried tomato parmesan sauce so good it might just earn a proposal.

ingredients.note: large, sliced in half lengthwise into 4 cutlets

steps: Slice each chicken breast in half lengthwise to make 4 thin cutlets. Pat dry, season both sides with salt and pepper, then lightly dredge in flour.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Sear the chicken 4-5 minutes per side until deeply golden and just cooked through, then transfer to a plate.
Lower heat to medium and add the butter. Stir in the minced garlic and chopped sun-dried tomatoes and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up the browned bits, then stir in the heavy cream, italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes. Simmer 2-3 minutes.
Whisk in the parmesan until the sauce is smooth and slightly thickened. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.
Nestle the chicken back into the sauce, spoon it over the top, and simmer 3-4 minutes until heated through and the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve over pasta, rice, or with crusty bread to mop up the sauce.
cheapTips: Buy a whole chicken breast value pack and slice your own cutlets instead of paying extra for pre-thin-cut.
Half-and-half or whole milk thickened with a teaspoon of flour stands in for heavy cream and costs less.
A small jar of sun-dried tomatoes goes a long way; freeze leftover ones in the oil for the next batch.

substitutions.swap: half-and-half or whole milk + 1 tsp flour
boneless chicken thighs
pecorino or grated cheddar

recipes.name: Spicy Vodka Pasta (Gigi Hadid)
recipes.description: Gigi Hadid's famous creamy, spicy tomato vodka penne that's silky, cozy, and ready in under half an hour.

ingredients.note: about a quarter of a 6 oz can

steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne until just shy of al dente. Reserve about 1 cup of the starchy pasta water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Add the minced shallot and garlic and saute 2-3 minutes until soft and fragrant but not browned.
Stir in the tomato paste and red pepper flakes. Cook, stirring constantly, for 4-5 minutes until the paste deepens to a brick-red color and smells sweet.
Pour in the vodka and let it sizzle for about 1 minute to cook off the raw alcohol, then stir in the heavy cream until the sauce turns a smooth pinkish-orange.

Add the drained pasta along with a splash of reserved pasta water, the butter, and the parmesan. Toss vigorously over low heat until the sauce clings and turns glossy, adding more pasta water as needed.
Season with salt to taste, plate, and finish with extra parmesan and torn fresh basil.
cheapTips: Buy a single shallot or use a wedge of regular onion instead of a whole bunch to cut cost.
A small bottle of vodka lasts for dozens of batches, so the per-serving cost is just pennies.
Use a wedge of real parmesan and grate it yourself, or swap in the cheaper green-can parmesan to save more.

substitutions.swap: Whole milk thickened with a teaspoon of butter, or evaporated milk
Skip it and add a splash of water plus a squeeze of lemon
A quarter of a regular yellow onion

recipes.name: Viral Smashed Cucumber Salad
recipes.description: Cool, crunchy cucumbers smashed and tossed in a punchy garlic, soy, and chili-oil dressing that soaks into every craggy edge.
steps: Trim the ends off the cucumbers. Lay each on a cutting board and lightly smash with the flat side of a knife or a rolling pin until they crack and split open.
Tear or cut the smashed cucumbers into rough bite-size chunks and put them in a colander or bowl.
Toss the chunks with the salt and let them sit for 10-15 minutes, then drain off the released water and pat dry. This keeps the salad crisp, not watery.
Whisk together the minced garlic, soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili oil, sesame oil, and sugar in a small bowl.
Pour the dressing over the drained cucumbers and toss well so every craggy edge gets coated.
Chill for at least 10 minutes for best flavor, then top with toasted sesame seeds and scallion before serving.
cheapTips: Buy regular slicing cucumbers in season instead of pricey Persian ones; just scrape out the wateriest seeds.
Make your own chili oil by heating vegetable oil and pouring it over red pepper flakes and garlic.
Salt-and-drain step lets you stretch one batch over two days without it going soggy.

substitutions.swap: plain white or apple cider vinegar with a pinch more sugar
sriracha or red pepper flakes bloomed in hot oil
smashed zucchini, salted a bit longer

recipes.name: Quesabirria Tacos
recipes.description: Crispy cheese-fried tacos stuffed with chili-braised beef, served with a rich consommé for dunking.

ingredients.note: beef chuck roast, cut into large chunks
ancho or chiles de arbol for extra heat

steps: Toast the dried guajillo chilies in a dry pot for 30 seconds per side, then cover with hot water and soak 10 minutes until soft. Sear the beef chuck chunks with salt and pepper in the pot until browned, then set aside.
Blend the soaked chilies with the tomatoes, half the onion, garlic, cumin, oregano, cinnamon, ground cloves, vinegar, and a splash of broth until smooth. Strain the sauce back over the beef.
Add the beef broth, bay leaves, remaining onion, and salt. Cover and braise on low for 2.5 to 3 hours (or pressure cook 45 minutes) until the beef shreds easily.

Remove the beef, shred it with two forks, and toss with a few ladles of the braising liquid. Skim the orange-red fat off the top of the pot and reserve it for dipping the tortillas. Keep the rest as consommé.
Dip each tortilla in the reserved fat, lay it on a hot griddle, and sprinkle with mozzarella. When the cheese melts, add shredded beef to one half and fold the tortilla over.
Fry the folded tacos until crispy and golden on both sides, pressing gently. Garnish with chopped cilantro and diced onion.
Pour the warm consommé into small bowls with cilantro and a squeeze of lime. Serve tacos hot for dunking.
cheapTips: Beef chuck is one of the cheapest braising cuts and gets meltingly tender after a long simmer, so don't pay extra for premium beef.
Make a double batch of the braised beef and consommé and freeze half; it reheats perfectly for quesabirria, ramen, or burritos all week.
Buy whole dried guajillo chilies from the Latin aisle or a Mexican market instead of pre-made paste; a small bag costs a couple dollars and makes several batches.

substitutions.swap: Use beef stew meat or boneless short rib trimmings
Any low-moisture melting cheese like Monterey Jack or a cheese blend
2 tbsp chili powder plus 1 tsp smoked paprika if you can't find whole dried chilies

recipes.name: Pesto Eggs on Toast
recipes.description: The viral TikTok trick where eggs fry right in a sizzling pool of pesto, piled onto crispy toast for a 10-minute flavor bomb.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden and crisp; set aside on plates.
Spoon the pesto into a cold nonstick skillet and spread it into a thin layer. Set heat to medium and let the pesto warm and start to sizzle, about 1 minute.
Crack the eggs directly into the sizzling pesto, spacing them apart. Season with a little salt and pepper.
Cover the pan and cook 2-3 minutes for runny yolks and crisp, golden pesto-fried edges, or longer if you prefer firm yolks.
If using, smash the avocado over the toast and crumble the feta.
Slide the pesto eggs onto the toast, scraping up all the crispy pesto bits from the pan. Top with a pinch of red pepper flakes and serve immediately.
cheapTips: A jar of pesto stretches across many breakfasts, just 2 tbsp per serving here.
Skip the avocado and feta to keep it under a dollar a plate, the pesto eggs shine on their own.
Use up the heel ends of a bread loaf for toast instead of tossing them.

substitutions.swap: Blend a handful of basil or spinach with garlic, olive oil, and parmesan for homemade pesto
Grate a little parmesan or any hard cheese you have
Use an English muffin or bagel instead

recipes.name: Bang Bang Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy golden chicken bites tossed in a creamy sweet-chili mayo that's sweet, tangy, and just spicy enough to keep you coming back.

ingredients.note: cup, for the bang bang sauce

steps: Whisk the mayonnaise, sweet chili sauce, sriracha, and honey in a bowl to make the bang bang sauce; set aside.
Pat the chicken pieces dry and season with the salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Set up a breading station: cornstarch in one bowl, beaten eggs in a second, panko in a third. Coat each piece in cornstarch, then egg, then press into the panko.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a skillet over medium-high until shimmering (around 350F). Fry the chicken in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through (165F inside).
Drain the chicken on a paper-towel-lined plate for a minute so it stays crispy.
Toss the warm chicken in half the bang bang sauce, or drizzle it over the top so the coating stays crunchy.
Garnish with sliced scallions and serve over rice with the extra sauce on the side.
cheapTips: Buy chicken breast in a family pack and freeze portions; it's far cheaper per pound than small trays.
Make your own sweet chili sauce with sriracha, sugar, vinegar, and a little water if you don't want to buy a bottle.
Air-fry the breaded pieces at 400F for 12 minutes instead of pan-frying to save on oil.

substitutions.swap: chicken thighs for juicier, cheaper meat
crushed cornflakes or regular breadcrumbs
honey plus a splash of rice vinegar and extra sriracha

recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken
recipes.description: Juicy pan-seared chicken smothered in a buttery garlic-parmesan cream sauce that tastes like a restaurant splurge for pennies.

ingredients.note: large, sliced in half lengthwise into 4 cutlets

steps: Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally to make 4 thin cutlets. Pat dry, then season both sides with salt and pepper.
On a plate, stir together the flour and garlic powder. Dredge each cutlet in the mixture, shaking off the excess.
Heat the olive oil and 1 tablespoon of the butter in a large skillet over medium-high. Sear the chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through (165F inside), then transfer to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium and melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter. Add the minced garlic and cook 30-60 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up the browned bits, then stir in the heavy cream and Italian seasoning. Simmer 2-3 minutes to thicken slightly.
Off the heat, whisk in the grated parmesan until the sauce is smooth and glossy. Taste and adjust salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Return the chicken and any juices to the pan, spoon the sauce over the top, and simmer 1-2 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.
cheapTips: Buy a whole bag of chicken breasts on sale and freeze in pairs - cutlets stretch 2 breasts to feed 4.
